data.title: Associate Director Quality Management
data.description:
Job Overview

This role is assigned to designated Delivery Unit(s), country/countries, sponsor(s), business units(s), and/or specific tasks as defined by the line manager (LM). Contributes to the development and is responsible for the implementation of specific quality improvement initiatives as agreed with the relevant Head(s) of assigned business lines. Provides advice and supports relevant key stakeholders with regards to quality control, risk assessment, risk management, and corrective/preventive actions. 

Essential Functions

- The CQM Lead leverages expertise in risk-based quality and study management to drive actions that strengthen & standardize risk-based approach & deliverables via fit-for-purpose business processes/tools. 
 - Contributes to the development, and supports implementation of the Quality Management Plan within the scope of the assignment this will include: Planning and executing the Quality Management activities. Risk identification and assessment through data review and quality control processes. Providing support in risk mitigation, in planning corrective/preventive actions, and guidance for improvement. Supporting the assigned business line management and staff to enhance effectiveness in project delivery. ; 
 - Cooperate closely with the relevant business lines and other stakeholders, support maintaining focus on quality in project delivery. 
 - Provides advice and support to teams within the assigned business line on all aspects of Good Clinical Practice (GCP) compliance. 
 - Works in close cooperation with teams to manage non-compliance, quality issues
 - Assist in planning corrective/preventive actions, as applicable according to Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs). 
 - Informs the assigned business line and Quality Assurance of quality issues according to SOPs. 
 - Works closely with Quality Assurance and assigned business staff in case of suspected misconduct, as required by the applicable SOPs. 
 - May provide assistance during audits and regulatory inspections to the teams to the extent agreed with the line manager, as required by the applicable SOPs. 
 - Acts as the primary contact for Quality Assurance on quality matters - on the level of the assignment, attend meetings/teleconferences. 
 - Prepares periodic reports to business lines on quality related matters, risk assessments and specific quality improvement initiatives. 
 - Manages staff in accordance with organization's policies and applicable regulations. Responsibilities include planning, assigning, and directing work, appraising performance and guiding professional development, rewarding and disciplining employees, addressing employee relations issues and resolving problems. Approve actions on human resources matters. ; 
 - Upon agreement with the Head of relevant business line: Performs any other reasonable tasks as required by the role. 

Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Medical or Life Science (or equivalent industry experience) required, and PhD preferred. 

Expert knowledge of and experience in (minimum of 12 years) processes related to clinical trial design, planning, start up, conduct, analysis, and reporting clinical development (principles and concepts as well as regulatory environment). 

- Sound working knowledge of relevant terminology, International Conference on Harmonization (ICH), Good Clinical Practice (GCP), Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), applicable regulatory requirements, quality management processes. 
 - Excellent organizational, interpersonal and communication skills. 
 - Excellent judgement and decision-making skills. 
 - Demonstrated leadership and line management skills. 
 - Excellent influencing and negotiation skills. 
 - Strong computer skills including Microsoft Office applications. 
 - Excellent problem-solving skills. 
 - Demonstrated ability to work in a matrix environment. 
 - Ability to lead and motivate a clinical team also required. 
 - Ability to travel within the region/country. 
 - Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with co-workers, managers and clients. 
 - Fluent in English. 

IQVIA is a leading global provider of clinical research services, commercial insights and healthcare intelligence to the life sciences and healthcare industries. We create intelligent connections to accelerate the development and commercialization of innovative medical treatments to help improve patient outcomes and population health worldwide. Learn more at https: //jobs. iqvia. com

IQVIA is committed to integrity in our hiring process and maintains a zero tolerance policy for candidate fraud. All information and credentials submitted in your application must be truthful and complete. Any false statements, misrepresentations, or material omissions during the recruitment process will result in immediate disqualification of your application, or termination of employment if discovered later, in accordance with applicable law. We appreciate your honesty and professionalism.

data.description:
Company Overview

At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We're a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that's critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future. 

Department Overview

Software Engineering

Job Description

We are seeking a Software Engineer to join our core engineering team to design and develop a high-throughput, mission-critical active-active microservice framework responsible for dynamically routing and balancing traffic across multi-site deployments based on real-time health, capacity, and geolocation metrics. 

Key Responsibilities

Develop the core Load Distribution engine using Finite State Machines (FSM) to

manage dynamic homing, execute Weighted Average Score (WAS) algorithms, 

and implement hysteresis. 

Architect high-throughput API and messaging layers using gRPC for metrics

ingestion and RabbitMQ (RMQ) for event-driven communication. 

Implement distributed leader election and consensus mechanisms utilizing

Consul Raft and LockAuthority across active-active deployments. 

Ensure system scalability to handle 3, 000+ assignments per second while

integrating Apache Ignite/GridGain for stateless caching and data recovery. 

Basic Requirements

Required Skills & Experience

Deep hands-on experience in Golang (preferred) and proficiency in Java or C, 

C++. 

Strong computer science fundamentals, data structures, and algorithms. 

Deep understanding of distributed systems, multi-threading, concurrency control, and Finite State Machines (FSM). 

Hands-on expertise with networking and messaging protocols including gRPC, 

Protobuf v3, and RabbitMQ. 

Strong background with distributed databases like Apache Ignite and GridGain, 

and consensus tools like Consul Raft and LockAuthority. 

Practical knowledge of persistence and caching solutions such as PostgreSQL, 

Redis, and ElasticSearch. 

Excellent written and verbal communication skills for technical documentation

and explaining complex ideas. 

Industry Experience - 2 to 4 years. 

Preferred Qualifications

Proven ability to design active-active multi-site architectures handling network

partitions, majority/minority quorums, and site-isolation scenarios. 

Experience with large-volume transaction systems, data migration workflows, 

and end-to-end observability frameworks like OpenTelemetry and Kibana. 

Familiarity with enterprise security tooling such as Vault and mTLS. 

Background in automated deployments using Docker and CI/CD pipelines. 

Travel Requirements

None

Relocation Provided

None

Position Type

Experienced

Referral Payment Plan

No

EEO Statement

Motorola Solutions is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status or any other legally-protected characteristic. 

We are proud of our people-first and community-focused culture, empowering every Motorolan to be their most authentic self and to do their best work to deliver on the promise of a safer world. If you'd like to join our team but feel that you don't quite meet all of the preferred skills, we'd still love to hear why you think you'd be a great addition to our team.

data.title: Principal Platform Software Engineer
data.description:
Job Description

Leads platform projects crossing multiple teams, evolving runtimes or middleware patterns for interoperability and multi-tenant scale. Diagnoses and resolves complex cross-service issues; enforces versioning, compatibility, and safe rollout practices. Drives observability standards, capacity planning, and resilience patterns across several workloads. Produces migration guides and adoption playbooks that raise ecosystem consistency and developer experience. 

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

Platform Software Development: 

- Lead cross-team evolution of middleware patterns or runtimes to standardize interoperability at scale. 
 - Define and enforce versioning, deprecation, and rollout strategies that minimize downstream breaks. 
 - Drive shared observability baselines (SLOs, error budgets) and resilience patterns across several services. 

Software Development and Coding - Design, Testing, and Optimization: 

- Designs software solutions and analyzes and identifies requirements to achieve business and operational goals, sharing results with manager upon completion. 
 - Adheres to and improves execution of all phases of the software development lifecycle; provides guidance and coaching to engineers to drive improvements. 
 - Utilizes advanced knowledge to develop and guide new software features and enhancements leading design specifications, ensuring accessibility, and develops documents to clarify software design and code. 
 - Leads code reviews in multiple areas to help drive improvements. 
 - Conducts debugging and troubleshooting to identify and fix complex software issues. 
 - Develops fixes for identified issues. 
 - Implements comprehensive software testing (e. g. , functional and non-functional testing), quality assurance processes, software error logging, monitoring, and observability for effective debugging, sharing work with manager and/or lead upon completion. 
 - Conducts performance profiling and optimization of coding, building scalable solutions, and anticipating and resolving potential outcomes. 
 - Troubleshoots and resolves complex issues related to application programming interface (API) functionality and integration. 
 - Implements complex API versioning, lifecycle, and interoperability strategies. 

Software Architecture - Software System Structural Design: 

- Implements and contributes to developing software, systems, and services, ensuring review by manager and/or senior technical leaders upon completion. Recommends project or design scope. 
 - Provides technical guidance and coaching to less experienced developers in existing software architecture. 
 - Contributes to periodic reviews and ensures adherence to architectural standards. 
 - Collaborates with stakeholders and networks externally to ensure work aligns with software architecture. 
 - Implements complex performance optimization and scalability strategies in software design. 
 - Occasionally conducts technology research and evaluation for potential architectural changes that may have an impact on results for the team. 

Issue/Defect Collaboration - Software Products Support: 

- Collaborates with stakeholders to understand customer issues and align solutions. 
 - May provide advanced technical guidance and support to customers regarding customer-reported issues. 
 - Advocates for customers' interests and suggests product enhancements based on feedback. 
 - Provides input to ensure customer satisfaction through timely resolution of issues and effective communication. 
 - Identifies and implements customer issue and/or defect handling and training processes. 
 - Investigates and troubleshoots complex and broad-reaching/scoped maintenance issues to ensure customer agreement on short- and long-term solutions (e. g. , future enhancements). 

Practices and Standards Compliance - Security and Compliance: 

- Collaborates with the team and externally to follow development practices and coding standards, providing coaching to less experienced team members. 
 - Participates in peer review processes, provides technical leadership, and ensures code quality and adherence to broad acceptance criteria during development, independently. 
 - Demonstrates and shares advanced knowledge of industry best practices and applies them to software development processes. 
 - Implements complex secure coding practices to prevent security vulnerabilities. 

Development Operations - System Maintenance: 

- Performs periodic maintenance and testing operations for systems that require upgrading or patching (e. g. , for critical vulnerabilities), sharing results with manager upon completion. 
 - Drives improvements, ensures automation, testing, and debugging of systems to ensure service/product availability, health, support, and reliability. 

Core Responsibilities

Planning & Execution: 

- Manages and coordinates moderately complex tasks, monitoring timelines and deliverables to ensure timely completion and adherence to requirements for a moderately sized project or initiative. Efficiently delegates, monitors, and prioritizes work across multiple projects, providing technical oversight and adjusting plans to address shifts in resources or timelines. 

Collaboration & Partnership: 

- Collaborates across the organization to align on expectations and achieve shared objectives. Leverages understanding of business leaders, stakeholders, and/or customers to ensure proposed solutions meet their needs. Supports inclusivity by actively seeking and listening to diverse perspectives, ensuring others feel heard and respected. 

Problem Solving: 

- Identifies and addresses moderately complex issues by analyzing a wide range of data and/or information to identify solutions in accordance with standard practices. Proactively escalates unresolved or critical issues with a thorough assessment and suggests potential solutions. Reviews, contributes to, and documents problem solving strategies. 

Continuous Learning: 

- Pursues learning opportunities to expand knowledge and skills and/or tools in new areas and stays abreast of the latest industry trends and best practices. Proactively seeks and leverages ongoing feedback and training to improve skills. Coaches and mentors junior team members, fostering continuous learning and knowledge sharing within and across teams. 

Continuous Improvement: 

- Develops ideas, recommends updates, and/or collaborates on the implementation of process improvements to increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows across teams, and evaluates the impact on key stakeholders. Solicits feedback from others on ideas for alternative approaches and methods for continued improvement. 

Performance and Development: 

- Contributes to the talent development pipeline by participating in candidate interviews, assessing candidates, and providing hiring recommendations.

Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives.

That's why we're committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. data.description:
Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we're helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential. 

Title And Summary

Lead Platform Engineer

Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential. 

Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. With connections across more than 210 countries and territories, we are building a sustainable world that unlocks priceless possibilities for all. 

Overview

The Lead Platform Engineer is a hands-on technical leader responsible for designing, building, and maintaining automation frameworks and platform services that support largescale hybrid infrastructure environments. This role focuses on engineering reusable automation patterns using Chef, Infrastructure as Code, and DevOps tooling to deliver consistent, secure, and self-service infrastructure capabilities. The ideal candidate brings strong DevOps engineering experience, deep knowledge of Chef (Infra, Habitat, or Automate), and a passion for building scalable automation systems, not performing manual operations. 

- Design, develop, and maintain Chef cookbooks, recipes, roles, and policy files to automate configuration management across cloud and prem environments. 
 - Build and maintain Chef Automate or equivalent orchestration pipelines for compliance, reporting, and fleet management. 
 - Engineer reusable automation frameworks, including shared libraries, templates, and patterns for consistent infrastructure provisioning. 
 - Integrate Chef automation with CI/CD pipelines, secrets management, artifact repositories, and enterprise governance controls. 
 - Implement automated testing and validation for Chef code using tools such as Test Kitchen, InSpec, and ChefSpec. 
 - Collaborate with cloud, platform, and security teams to define and enforce configuration baselines, compliance policies, and hardened system standards. 
 - Support the design and implementation of Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation, ARM/Bicep) for provisioning compute, network, and platform services. 
 - Troubleshoot complex automation, configuration, and infrastructure issues across hybrid environments. 
 - Contribute to platform engineering initiatives such as self-service catalogs, GitOps workflows, and automated remediation. 
 - Document automation patterns, architectural decisions, and operational runbooks. 

All bout you

- 5-8+ years of experience in DevOps, platform engineering, infrastructure automation, or configuration management roles. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with Chef Infra, including cookbook development, policy files, Test Kitchen, and InSpec. 
 - Experience managing largescale configuration management environments (Chef Server, Chef Automate, or similar). 
 - Solid understanding of Linux systems administration, OS hardening, and configuration of lifecycle management. 
 - Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and on Prem virtualization (VMware, HyperV). 
 - Strong scripting or programming skills (Ruby preferred for Chef, plus Python, Bash, or PowerShell). 
 - Experience with CI/CD tooling such as GitHub Actions, GitLab, Jenkins, or Azure DevOps. 
 - Strong understanding of Git workflows, branching strategies, and code review practices. 
 - Ability to troubleshoot complex automation and infrastructure issues across hybrid environments. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with Chef Habitat or application-level automation. 
 - Experience with Chef Automate for compliance, reporting, and fleet orchestration. 
 - Familiarity with Terraform or other IaC tools for provisioning infrastructure. 
 - Experience with policyascode tools (OPA, Conftest, Sentinel). 
 - Background in security hardening, compliance frameworks, or CIS benchmarks. 
 - Exposure to Kubernetes, Helm, or container orchestration. 
 - Experience with monitoring and observability platforms (Prometheus, Datadog, Splunk, ELK). 
 - Knowledge of network automation or infrastructure APIs. 
 - Core Technical Skills (Competency Areas)
 - Configuration Management
 - Chef Infra (cookbooks, recipes, policy files)
 - Chef Automate, InSpec, Test Kitchen
 - Ruby development for automation
 - Infrastructure as Code & Provisioning
 - Terraform, CloudFormation, ARM/Bicep (preferred but not required)
 - Hybrid cloud provisioning (AWS, Azure, GCP)

 - DevOps & CI/CD
 - Pipeline design and automation
 - Automated testing, linting, and security scanning

Corporate Security Responsibility

All Activities Involving Access To Mastercard Assets, Information, And Networks Comes With An Inherent Risk To The Organization And, Therefore, It Is Expected That Every Person Working For, Or On Behalf Of, Mastercard Is Responsible For Information Security And Must:

data.title: Senior Software Engineer I
data.description:
Job Description

As a Senior Software Engineer I, you will help advance Mission Control's Automation First strategy by engineering scalable, reliable automation capabilities that reduce operational toil, accelerate incident remediation, and improve service availability. This role will focus on building and evolving automation solutions across the Mission Control ecosystem, including using automation framework Incident Pilot, AIOps integrations, event-driven remediation workflows, self-healing patterns, observability-driven triggers, and automation enablement during onboarding. You will partner closely with Operations Engineering, Tools Engineering, SRE, App Support, and onboarding teams to convert repeatable production support activities into governed, measurable, and resilient automations. 

Responsibilities

- Design, build, and support automation capabilities that enable Mission Control to detect, triage, repair, and validate incidents with minimal manual intervention. 
 - Engineer event-driven workflows that connect observability signals, incident data, runbooks, and automation execution platforms to deliver consistent remediation outcomes. 
 - Advance inhouse automation framework IncidentPilot and related automation platforms by improving configuration workflows, routing logic, automation triggering, failure handling, auditability, reporting, and self-service capabilities. 
 - Partner with Mission Control onboarding teams to identify automatable SOPs and runbooks before or during onboarding, ensuring automation is embedded as a standard part of service transition. 
 - Build reusable automation patterns for self-healing, job retriggers, pod scaling, component-based validations, health checks, reroutes, incident enrichment, and operational notifications.

 - Establish engineering practices that ensure automation is safe, governed, testable, auditable, and aligned with enterprise controls and production readiness expectations. 
 - Monitor automation performance, adoption, success rates, exception paths, and operational savings to demonstrate measurable value and guide continuous improvement. 
 - Provide technical leadership and mentorship to engineers by reinforcing coding standards, testing discipline, design reviews, and responsible AI-assisted development practices. 
 - Collaborate across Mission Control, SRE, App Support, Observability, and enterprise platform teams to remove friction, standardize repeatable processes, and scale automation across domains.

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or comparable experience. 6+ years of software engineering experience in a professional environment, with hands-on experience building production-grade services, integrations, scripts, APIs, or automation workflows using Java, Python, or similar technologies.

 - Practical experience implementing integration solutions, including REST APIs, batch and real-time processing, Kafka, messaging platforms, or workflow orchestration tools. 
 - Understanding of observability and cloud-native principles, including monitoring, alerting, service discovery, circuit breakers, distributed tracing, dashboards, and operational telemetry.

 - Working knowledge of AI-enabled development tools, AIOps concepts, and responsible use of AI-assisted engineering workflows.

 - Experience with automated, functional, integration, and performance testing to validate automation correctness and stability. 
 - Ability to communicate technical designs, risks, tradeoffs, and operational impact clearly with engineering and operations partners. 
 - Strong analytical thinking, ownership, curiosity, continuous learning, and continuous improvement mindset. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience building or supporting incident automation platforms, workflow engines, event-driven remediation tools, or self-healing operational capabilities. 
 - Experience with Mission Control-adjacent tooling or patterns such as IncidentPilot, ServiceNow integrations, Event and Incident Pipelines, Kafka-based event ingestion, AIOps workflows, or observability-driven automation. 
 - Experience working with automation platforms such as Ansible, EAP-style execution platforms, runbook automation, or enterprise orchestration tools.

data.title: Senior Software Engineer
data.description:
Job Overview

Join the Central Engineering - Software team as a Senior System QA Engineer, helping to validate complex Linux server and SoC platforms. You will develop automated tests and investigate system-level issues across hardware, firmware and software, contributing to reliable platform bring-up, performance and long-duration stability. This role offers the opportunity to work across processor, memory, I/O, networking, storage, power and thermal technologies, collaborating with engineering teams to turn challenging failures into clear, actionable findings. 

Responsibilities

- Develop and maintain functional, performance, stress and stability tests for Linux server and SoC platforms. 
 - Create test automation, log-analysis tools and regression coverage using C/C++, Python and shell scripting. 
 - Validate and debug interactions across firmware, Linux kernel and device drivers, system management, networking, storage and hardware bring-up. 
 - Investigate failures found during system-level workloads and long-duration testing; gather evidence, identify likely root causes and communicate findings clearly to partner engineering teams. 
 - Exercise platform reliability, availability and serviceability features, telemetry, power and thermal behaviour, and reset and boot flows. 
 - Contribute to validation of memory, high-speed I/O, PCIe, NVMe, Ethernet, RDMA and accelerator-related workloads where relevant to the platform. 

Required Skills and Experience

- Practical experience programming in C or C++ and using Python and shell scripting to develop test automation, analyse logs and support regression testing. 
 - Ability to validate and debug Linux-based server or SoC platforms across firmware, kernel, device drivers, system management and hardware bring-up; equivalent practical experience is welcome. 
 - Experience designing and running system-level functional, performance, stress or long-duration stability tests, with effective failure detection and root-cause analysis. 
 - Understanding of system architecture and behaviour across areas such as CPU and memory, cache coherency, DMA, NUMA, IOMMU/SMMU, PCIe, networking, storage, power or thermal management. 

Nice-to-Have Skills and Experience

- Experience with BMC-based server management, secure boot, firmware authentication, boot-stage sequencing, watchdogs, reset flows, inter-processor communication or mailbox mechanisms. 
 - Knowledge of RAS validation across memory, interconnect, PCIe or accelerator subsystems, including use of telemetry such as performance counters, sensors and activity monitors.

Please email us about anything we can do to accommodate you during the recruitment process. 

Hybrid Working

Job Summary

Test analyst position for an experienced professional with strong hands on skills in Python and Java to design implement and optimize test automation for complex enterprise systems in a hybrid day shift environment with no travel contributing to highly reliable software delivery that supports global merchandising operations and business growth. 

Responsibilities

- Design comprehensive test strategies and detailed test plans using Python and Java to validate complex application features and integrations ensuring robust quality across enterprise systems and minimizing defect leakage to production.

 - Investigate defects with methodical root cause analysis using logs code level insights and test data review providing concise defect reports and recommendations that help engineers resolve issues efficiently. 
 - Optimize automated and manual test cases by eliminating redundancies refining validation steps and aligning with evolving system behavior improving test cycle efficiency while preserving coverage for critical business flows. 
 - Collaborate closely with developers business analysts and operations teams in a hybrid work model to clarify expected behavior reproduce complex issues and agree on risk based testing priorities that align with release objectives. 
 - Monitor test execution metrics such as pass rates defect density and execution time preparing structured test summary reports that inform release readiness decisions and highlight areas needing additional validation.

 - Contribute to continuous improvement of testing frameworks and guidelines by proposing enhancements to automation utilities coding patterns and documentation helping the testing function scale to larger and more complex initiatives. 
 - Coordinate with hybrid teams to schedule test cycles for day shifts ensuring dependencies environment availability and data readiness are managed so test execution proceeds without avoidable delays. 
 - Review peer test cases scripts and defect reports providing constructive feedback that improves clarity maintainability and consistency with established quality standards and organizational practices. 
 - Mentor less experienced test professionals by demonstrating effective test design automation techniques in Python and Java and structured defect analysis methods strengthening overall team capability and delivery quality. 

Qualifications

- Possess six to ten years of focused experience in software testing with strong exposure to enterprise applications and proven ability to design thorough and efficient test suites. 
 - Demonstrate advanced practical proficiency in Python by writing clean test automation scripts utilities and reusable components that integrate with modern test frameworks and pipelines. 
 - Display solid applied skills in Java for creating stable test harnesses service level validation tools and automation frameworks that can be shared across multiple project teams. 
 - Bring hands on understanding of quality assurance concepts such as traceability risk based testing boundary coverage and defect life cycle management applied consistently on past projects. 
 - Exhibit familiarity with merchandising or retail domain processes including product setup pricing promotions and inventory flows using this knowledge to design realistic and business relevant test scenarios. 
 - Show experience working in hybrid delivery models and coordinating with distributed stakeholders using structured communication and documentation practices that sustain smooth day shift collaboration. 
 - Apply practical knowledge of continuous integration and version control tooling to trigger automated test runs review execution logs and maintain stable test branches within shared repositories. 
 - Utilize strong analytical and problem solving abilities to interpret requirements detect edge cases and convert complex business rules into clear verifiable test conditions that reduce production incidents. 
 - Maintain high standards for written and verbal communication producing precise test cases defect descriptions and summary reports that support transparent quality decisions and stakeholder confidence. 
 - Adapt quickly to new tools frameworks and business processes embracing ongoing learning to refine testing approaches and support the organization goal of delivering reliable solutions that positively impact customers and society.

data.title: QA Engineer – Automation & Data Quality
data.description:
We are seeking a QA Engineer with a strong automation-first mindset and hands-on experience testing web applications, APIs, and data/analytics systems. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys working close to the code, understands distributed systems, and thinks holistically about quality across the application, data, and reporting layers. 

You will work closely with Engineering, Product, Analytics, and DevOps teams to ensure that features are delivered with high functional correctness, system reliability, and data integrity. 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES: 

Quality Ownership & Functional Testing

- Collaborate with Product Managers and Engineering teams to understand requirements, clarify acceptance criteria, and define test strategies early in the development lifecycle. 
 - Establish and maintain QA standards, processes, and best practices for consistent quality across teams. 
 - Validate that delivered features meet functional, non-functional, and business requirements with a strong focus on usability and reliability. 
 - Analyze test results to identify defects, behavioral risks, and edge cases, and recommend preventive solutions. 
 - Track and report quality metrics such as defect leakage, automation coverage, release readiness, and data accuracy. 
 - Proactively identify risks and challenges within a sprint and propose remediation or process improvements. 
 - Drive assigned initiatives independently, with a strong sense of ownership. 

Test Automation & Engineering

- Design, implement, execute, and maintain automated and manual test cases across backend systems. 
 - Build and maintain a robust automation suite that is used consistently across releases. 
 - Drive in-sprint automation, ensuring that new features are automated as part of development rather than post-release. 
 - Partner with developers to improve testability, observability, and environment stability. 
 - Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines to support continuous delivery

Data & Analytics Quality Assurance (Explicit Focus)

- Basic validation of data flows between source systems and reports or dashboards. 
 - Verify correctness of key data fields in reports and analytics views. 
 - Perform simple data checks by comparing source data with reporting outputs (OLTP databases, payment gateways, CRM systems like HubSpot) and downstream analytics platforms. 
 - Validate reports, dashboards and metrics for accuracy, completeness, and consistency. 
 - Identify and help prevent common analytics issues such as data drift, duplication, late-arriving data and broken joins. 
 - Collaborate with developers and analysts to clarify data-related test scenarios. 
 - Hands-on experience in writing SQL queries with joins for data validation and testing

Non-Functional Testing

- Execute and guide performance, reliability, and basic security testing. 
 - Validate system behavior under load, stress, and failure scenarios. 
 - Work with Engineering and DevOps teams to identify and mitigate production risks early.

data.title: Lead Tech Firmware Engineering VII
data.description:
Job Description

JOB DESCRIPTION

Senior Firmware Developer - Thermal Application

Location - Pune Chakan

Position Summary

The Senior Firmware Developer - Thermal Application engineer will be responsible for leading the design, development, validation, and support of electrical and electronic systems for HVAC equipment, with strong hands‐on experience in screw chiller machines and thermal products. This role involves technical leadership, cross‐functional coordination, and end‐to‐end ownership of electrical, controls, and integration activities throughout the product lifecycle-from concept to commissioning. 

Key Responsibilities

- Lead the design and development of electrical and electronic systems for HVAC machines, including screw chillers and thermal products. 
 - Prepare, review, and approve electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, control panel layouts, interlock logic, and BOMs. 
 - Select and integrate electrical and electronic components such as VFDs, controllers, PLCs, HMIs, sensors, protection devices, and safety components. 
 - Lead and support PLC and HMI programming activities, including control logic review, I/O allocation, tag mapping, alarm handling, and parameter optimization. 
 - Drive BMS integration (BACnet / Modbus or equivalent), including points list definition, signal mapping, validation, and coordination with site/BMS teams. 
 - Support control philosophy development and close integration of electrical systems with controls and embedded software. 
 - Drive design validation testing (DVT), dry testing, performance testing, and troubleshooting in lab and factory environments. 
 - Lead root cause analysis and corrective action implementation for electrical and controls‐related issues identified during testing or field operation. 
 - Support commissioning, field issues, and service escalations related to electrical, controls, and automation systems. 
 - Coordinate with Mechanical, Software, Product Management, QA, Sourcing, and Service teams to ensure successful product execution. 
 - Ensure compliance with applicable electrical standards, safety norms, cybersecurity guidelines (where applicable), and regulatory requirements. 
 - Support component localization, alternate sourcing, and cost optimization initiatives without compromising performance or reliability. 
 - Provide technical guidance, reviews, and mentoring to junior engineers and team members. 

Required Skills & Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Electrical, Electronics, or Instrumentation Engineering (or equivalent). 
 - 4 to 6 years of relevant industry experience, preferably in HVAC, industrial machinery, or automation systems. 
 - Strong machine‐level experience with HVAC systems, particularly screw chiller machines and thermal products. 
 - Deep knowledge of industrial electrical systems, power distribution, control panels, safety circuits, and VFD applications. 
 - Solid working experience with PLC and HMI programming in industrial or HVAC applications. 
 - Proven exposure to BMS integration using standard industrial protocols such as BACnet and Modbus. 
 - Working knowledge of programming languages such as C, C++, Structured Text (ST), and Function Block Diagram (FBD); ability to review logic and coordinate with software teams. 
 - Hands‐on experience in testing, commissioning, and troubleshooting complex HVAC and automation systems. 
 - Proficient in reading and interpreting electrical drawings, control schematics, functional descriptions, and technical specifications. 
 - Strong analytical, problem‐solving, communication, and team‐leadership skills.

data.title: Software Development Manager III, Seller Fulfillment Technology (International FBA Team)
data.description:
Description

Own a core part of Fulfillment by Amazon (FBA) for Amazon's fastest-growing and most strategic marketplaces - from emerging international markets to the future of FBA in Europe. International FBA builds the software that lets third-party (3P) sellers send inventory into Amazon's network, keep it in stock, and fulfill orders, and we're hiring a Software Development Manager to lead a high-impact engineering charter end to end. 

Key job responsibilities

Own the vision, multi-year roadmap, and quarterly execution for the engineering charter, translating seller and business goals into a clear, prioritized delivery plan. 

Lead, coach, and grow a team of software engineers - owning hiring, performance management, and career development, and building a strong bench of technical leaders. 

Drive the architecture and design of high-scale, low-latency, highly available distributed systems, making sound technical and build-vs-adopt decisions. 

Build Generative AI (GenAI) solutions and conversational assistants that simplify complex, multi-step seller workflows into guided experiences. 

Own operational excellence - availability, latency, and correctness - for services with direct seller and business impact; strengthen on-call, reduce operational load, and drive issues to root-cause resolution. 

Manage region-specific complexity across diverse international marketplaces, including local compliance, tax, and capacity requirements. 

Partner across Product, Applied Science, Operations, Compliance, and worldwide (WW) FBA teams to align on shared roadmaps, resolve dependencies, and deliver end to end. 

Represent your area in leadership, business, and operational reviews; communicate crisply in writing (narrative style) and in person to both technical and business audiences. 

Set and uphold a high bar for engineering quality, security, and best practices across the software development lifecycle (SDLC). 

A day in the life

You start the morning by scanning your team's operational dashboards and any overnight on-call activity - checking the health of the seller-facing systems you own and making sure nothing is blocking sellers from getting inventory into Amazon. You join your team's daily standup, unblock engineers, and dive into a design review for a new Generative AI (GenAI) conversational assistant feature that will help sellers manage their inventory. 

Midday, you meet with your Product and Applied Science partners to align on the quarterly roadmap and prioritize the next set of deliverables - balancing near-term seller impact against longer-term bets like the Europe FBA transformation. You spend focused time writing or reviewing a technical narrative, and you have a career-development one-on-one with one of your engineers. 

In the afternoon, you make a key architecture decision on a high-scale service, review a peer's design document, and represent your area in a business review with leadership. You close the day by clearing code reviews, responding to your team, and jotting down priorities for tomorrow. Throughout, you're operating as both a builder and a leader - setting technical direction, growing your people, and delivering measurable impact for sellers across International FBA's marketplaces. 

About The Team

International FBA builds the seller-facing software behind Fulfillment by Amazon (FBA) across two strategic frontiers. In Emerging Markets - India, UAE, KSA (Kingdom of Saudi Arabia), Egypt, Mexico, Brazil, Turkey, Australia, and South Africa - we own the end-to-end seller journey, building region-specific architecture where local law and network economics demand it, and pioneering Generative AI (GenAI) assistants that make selling on Amazon radically simpler. 

In Europe, we're reinventing FBA itself: transforming a fragmented, country-by-country operation into a single, unified European supply chain (the "One EU" vision) - one shipment, one inventory pool, one set of controls - so sellers reach the whole continent effortlessly. 

We're a team of builders who care equally about seller experience and engineering excellence. We work across product, science, and operations, own our systems end to end, and take real ownership of outcomes that move Amazon's international business forward. 

Basic Qualifications

- 7+ years of engineering experience
 - 3+ years of engineering team management experience
 - 8+ years of leading the definition and development of multi tier web services experience
 - Experience partnering with product or program management teams
 - Bachelor's degree

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience in communicating with users, other technical teams, and senior leadership to collect requirements, describe software product features, technical designs, and product strategy
 - Experience in recruiting, hiring, mentoring/coaching and managing teams of Software Engineers to improve their skills, and make them more effective, product software engineers

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. data.title: AMS-DE-AIOps-Engineer-Manager
data.description:
At EY, you'll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we're counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all. 

Service line - Position Title: TechOps - Digital Engineering Operations - AI Engineer - Manager

At EY, we're all in to shape your future with confidence. 

We'll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. 

Join EY and help to build a better working world. 

About Global Delivery Services

Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY's strategy by ensuring effective support to EY's growth agenda. 

Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80, 000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom. 

Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service. 

Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY's global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services. 

Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation. 

The Opportunity

As a Manager in EY GDS Tech Ops practice, you will be responsible for hands-on technical leadership, stakeholder collaboration, and delivery ownership, designing, and operationalizing intelligent AI agents and autonomous workflows that leverage LLMs, AI services, and enterprise integrations. The role requires strong expertise in AI engineering, automation, software development, and cross-functional collaboration to deliver scalable, secure, and business-impacting Agentic AI solutions. 

Your Key Responsibilities

- Lead and manage a team of AI Engineers, Developers, and Solution Architects, providing technical guidance, coaching, mentoring, and career development support. 
 - Create a high-performance culture focused on innovation, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement. 
 - Own end-to-end delivery of AI and automation engagements, ensuring quality, timelines, budget adherence, and stakeholder satisfaction. 
 - Design, develop, and deploy Agentic AI solutions leveraging Large Language Models (LLMs), multi-agent architectures, retrieval systems, and AI orchestration frameworks to automate complex business and engineering workflows. 
 - Architect and implement AI-powered autonomous workflows and intelligent agents capable of reasoning, planning, decision-making, and executing tasks across enterprise systems. 
 - Integrate LLMs, NLP, Computer Vision, and other AI/ML services into enterprise applications and platforms through APIs, SDKs, and cloud-native architectures. 
 - Identify, analyze, and transform repetitive and high-value operational and engineering processes into scalable AI and automation solutions. 
 - Develop custom applications, services, and automation logic using Python and modern AI frameworks to connect disparate systems and enable end-to-end workflow automation. 
 - Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define agent behaviors, tool integrations, guardrails, evaluation frameworks, and success metrics for AI solutions. 
 - Monitor, maintain, troubleshoot, and continuously optimize AI agents and automated workflows to ensure reliability, scalability, security, and performance. 
 - Establish technical standards, reusable components, best practices, and reference architectures for Agentic AI and automation implementations. 
 - Create and maintain technical documentation, solution designs, operational runbooks, and deployment guidelines for AI-powered automation solutions. 
 - Collaborate closely with AI Platform, Engineering, Operations, and Business teams to identify, integrate, and operationalize AI services, tools, accelerators, and enterprise AI capabilities. 
 - Evaluate emerging AI technologies, frameworks, and agent orchestration platforms, recommending innovative solutions that drive business value and operational efficiency. 
 - Drive adoption of AI, Agentic AI, automation solutions, and reusable accelerators across engagements, practices, and client programs. 
 - Provide technical leadership and mentorship to engineers, contributing to solution design reviews, code quality, architecture governance, and engineering best practices. 
 - Support business development activities related to AI and automation, including solution design, proposals, client workshops, demonstrations, and technical presentations. 
 - Ensure all AI and automation solutions comply with organizational security, governance, risk management, privacy, and responsible AI standards. 
 - Contribute to resource planning and technical execution by estimating effort, prioritizing work, coordinating with stakeholders, and ensuring successful delivery of AI initiatives. 

Skills And Attributes For Success

- Hands-on experience with Large Language Models (LLMs), prompt engineering, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), AI agents, and agent orchestration frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, CrewAI, AutoGen, or similar technologies. 
 - Strong understanding of Generative AI, NLP, machine learning concepts, and integration of AI services into enterprise workflows. 
 - Experience integrating AI, automation, and enterprise systems through REST APIs, SDKs, event-driven architectures, and cloud-native services. 
 - Ability to analyze complex business and engineering processes and design scalable Agentic AI and intelligent automation solutions that deliver measurable business value. 
 - Experience developing and deploying autonomous workflows leveraging AI agents, tool calling, workflow orchestration, and decision-making frameworks. 
 - Experience with cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud, including AI and machine learning services. 
 - Knowledge of vector databases, embeddings, knowledge graphs, semantic search, and enterprise data integration patterns is highly desirable. 
 - Experience building AI, GenAI, automation solutions, accelerators, and reusable frameworks within managed services or large-scale enterprise environments is preferred. 
 - Understanding ITSM, ITIL, DevOps, MLOps, LLMOps, and operational governance practices is an added advantage. 
 - Familiarity with AI governance, Responsible AI principles, security, privacy, and regulatory compliance requirements. 
 - Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across AI, engineering, operations, platform, and business teams. 
 - Ability to mentor team members, contribute to technical leadership, and drive the adoption of Agentic AI, automation, and engineering best practices across engagements. 

To qualify for the role, you must have

- Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, Engineering, or related field. 
 - 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with at least 2-3 years of hands-on experience designing, developing, and deploying Generative AI, Agentic AI, intelligent automation, or AI-powered solutions in enterprise environments. 
 - Proven experience building and implementing solutions utilizing Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), prompt engineering, agent orchestration frameworks, and AI-powered workflows. 
 - Hands-on experience with AI/ML frameworks, NLP technologies, vector databases, semantic search, and enterprise knowledge retrieval systems. 
 - Strong programming expertise in Python and working knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript, with experience developing APIs, automation services, and enterprise integrations. 
 - Understanding AIOps, MLOps, LLMOps, model evaluation, monitoring, observability, and governance practices for production AI systems. 
 - Experience with multi-agent systems, MCP (Model Context Protocol), AI copilots, and enterprise AI platforms. 

What we look for:

 - Continuous learners who stay current with advancements in LLMs, AI agents, RAG architecture, agent orchestration frameworks, and cloud-based AI services. 
 - Strong problem solvers with the ability to analyze complex business challenges, identify automation opportunities, and design innovative AI-driven solutions. 
 - Self-motivated professionals who take ownership of outcomes and proactively troubleshoot, optimize, and enhance AI-enabled workflows and systems. 
 - Collaborative team players who can effectively partner with AI, engineering, platform, operations, and business stakeholders in distributed, hybrid, and global work environments. 
 - Engineers with a strong customer and business-value mindset, capable of translating requirements into scalable, secure, and impactful AI solutions. 
 - Detail-oriented professionals who maintain high standards for code quality, testing, documentation, governance, and operational excellence. 
 - Individuals with strong communication and presentation skills, able to articulate technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences. 
 - Professionals who embrace innovation while balancing Responsible AI principles, security, compliance, and enterprise governance requirements. 
 - Mentors and knowledge sharers who contribute to team growth, promote engineering best practices, and help drive enterprise adoption of Agentic AI and automation capabilities. 

What We Offer You

At EY, we'll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We'll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more. 

Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today. 

To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need. 

Our Commitment: As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost. 

Professional Development: From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship. 

People and Culture: In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing. 

Benefits: Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development. 

How to Apply: If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy. 

Successful candidates advance to a competency-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits. 

"We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion". 

EY | Building a better working world

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

data.title: Director of Engineering
data.description:
About Delhivery

Delhivery is India's leading logistics and supply chain infrastructure company. We are a technology-first organization operating a massive physical network. Our proprietary platforms handle millions of shipments daily across 18, 000+ pin codes, generating vast volumes of multi-modal, spatial, operational, and conversational data. As we transition toward autonomous, self-healing supply chain workflows, this role will lead the engineering frontier that builds our central intelligence and agentic platforms. 

The Mandate: 

As a SEM/Director, you will hold the architectural blueprint and operational authority for Delhivery's ecosystem. Your mandate is to design the core platform infrastructure, establish engineering standards, and govern the deployment of autonomous agentic systems across all product lines (including Warehouse Management, Transportation, Last-Mile, and Merchant Platforms). 

You will act as the central technical authority, driving the adoption of open standards to securely and uniformly connect AI models to Delhivery's enterprise data sources and operational tools. You will enable product teams to build safe, deterministic, and highly optimized AI systems while reviewing and greenlighting all agents before they launch into production. 

Core Responsibilities

- Establish Enterprise AI Standards: Own the definition of technical blueprints, design patterns, and SDKs for agentic workflows across the organization. Establish organization-wide standards for Agentic implementations, covering orchestration, context management, structured outputs, tool invocation, security, identity, observability, evaluation, lifecycle management, and interoperability. 
 - Centralized Architecture & Launch Review: Serve as the final technical gateway for all AI agent deployments at Delhivery. Design automated governance frameworks that validate architecture compliance, tool permissions, security boundaries, model behavior, latency budgets, cost efficiency, reliability, structured output correctness, evaluation quality, and operational readiness before any AI system reaches production. 
 - Architect Production-Grade Agentic Workflows: Design and deploy core multi-agent systems optimized for large-scale enterprise problems involving planning, reasoning, workflow orchestration, long-running execution, memory, human-in-the-loop approvals, asynchronous execution, and real-time decision making across warehouse, transportation, customer experience, and operational platforms
 - Build the Central AI Control Plane & Catalog: Architect Delhivery's shared AI infrastructure layer. Develop central enterprise capabilities for unified model routing, automated prompt drift detection, vector database multi-tenancy, and a centralized catalog that allows secure, audited discovery of enterprise data and services by autonomous agents
 - Lead a High-Caliber Engineering Team: Mentor and scale a specialized engineering squad focused on foundational AI platform development. Cultivate a unified AI engineering community across Delhivery by hosting architectural reviews and upskilling product engineers on production-grade systems design and MCP-driven architectures. 

Core Capabilities & Architectural Focus

This role is centered on building the underlying infrastructure, standardized protocols, and evaluation frameworks required to scale intelligent workflows safely: 

- Platform & Gateways: Designing resilient LLM gateways, automated model failover mechanisms, and enterprise-wide token optimization telemetry, inference optimization to deliver low-latency AI services. 
 - Evaluation & Deployment Pipelines: Building continuous integration frameworks that programmatically test, benchmark, and audit the safety, retrieval accuracy, prompt regressions, safety, hallucination rates, policy compliance, and tool-calling reliability of agents developed across different business units before production deployment. 
 - State & Orchestration: Engineering custom graph architectures or leveraging advanced state-management systems optimized for high-throughput, asynchronous tool execution. 

What We Are Looking For

- Proven Engineering & Governance Leadership: 8+ years of core software engineering experience, with a significant track record of architecting, deploying, and establishing engineering standards for high-scale distributed systems or building production AI systems involving LLMs, agentic workflows, orchestration frameworks, evaluation systems, retrieval architectures, or model serving platforms. 
 - Platform Architecture & Protocol Expertise: Demonstrated success in building developer platforms, shared infrastructure SDKs, or building systems leveraging open interoperability protocols (such as gRPC, GraphQL, or Model Context Protocol). 
 - Systems-First Pragmatism: A deep commitment to engineering metrics-focusing heavily on system latency, API validation, compute cost-efficiency, secure tool execution boundaries, and predictable, deterministic software behavior. 
 - Cross-Functional Influence: The ability to effectively collaborate with, advise, and align diverse product engineering heads and business stakeholders toward a unified technical vision.

Job Title: Manager - Data Operations

Summary: 

We are looking for a skilled and experienced Manager - Data Operations to manage the day-to-day operation of enterprise data pipelines and platforms supporting corporate finance transformation. 

This role combines hands-on operational oversight, service management, and team leadership to ensure timely, accurate, and reliable data delivery. The ideal candidate will work closely with data engineering, platform, governance, and business teams to support finance processes across P2P, O2C, R2R, and FP&A. 

You will be accountable for operational performance, incident coordination, data quality monitoring, and continuous improvement within the assigned service scope, helping business users and clients access trusted data within agreed service levels. 

Responsibilities: 

Data Operations & Technical Oversight

- Manage daily operation of batch and streaming data pipelines, including ingestion, transformation, scheduling, and delivery to downstream systems and reporting platforms. 
 - Monitor job execution, data freshness, processing volumes, and dependencies; coordinate reruns, backfills, and recovery using approved procedures and reconciliation checks. 
 - Maintain operational runbooks, standard operating procedures, job inventories, dependency maps, and escalation paths for supported data services. 
 - Investigate pipeline failures, data discrepancies, and performance issues using logs, monitoring tools, and SQL; engage engineering teams where code or architecture changes are required. 
 - Coordinate production changes and releases with engineering and DevOps teams, validating operational readiness, support handover, rollback procedures, and post-release checks. 
 - Lead incident triage, business-impact assessment, escalation, and service restoration; coordinate root-cause analysis and track corrective actions to closure. 

Service Delivery & Operational Excellence

- Plan and prioritize operational workloads, support requests, and improvement activities to meet agreed SLAs and critical business processing deadlines. 
 - Implement incident, problem, change, and service request management practices; maintain effective shift handovers and on-call coverage where required by the service model. 
 - Track and report pipeline success rates, data freshness, SLA adherence, incident volumes, recovery times, and recurring failures; use trends to improve service performance. 
 - Automate repetitive checks, recovery steps, and reporting where appropriate; work with engineering teams to reduce manual effort, recurring incidents, and inefficient resource usage. 
 - Operate data quality checks and source-to-target reconciliations; route exceptions to accountable data owners and maintain evidence of resolution, access reviews, and approved controls. 

Team Leadership & Talent Management

- Manage a team of data operations analysts and support engineers, assigning responsibilities and ensuring appropriate coverage for supported services. 
 - Build a culture of accountability, collaboration, service ownership, and disciplined execution, with clear expectations for operational quality. 
 - Manage capacity planning, onboarding, performance feedback, and training; develop cross-skilling and backup coverage for critical processes. 
 - Coach team members on troubleshooting, data validation, incident handling, documentation, and stakeholder communication. 

Business & Stakeholder Management

- Partner with finance stakeholders, data owners, and reporting teams to understand data dependencies, business priorities, and critical reporting or period-close schedules. 
 - Coordinate with data engineering, platform, security, and governance teams to resolve operational issues and maintain clear ownership across service boundaries. 
 - Support onboarding of new data services by validating support requirements, monitoring coverage, runbooks, knowledge transfer, and acceptance criteria. 
 - Communicate service status, incidents, business impact, recovery estimates, and improvement progress clearly to stakeholders and management. 

Data Quality & Continuous Improvement

- Work with data owners to define and maintain operational checks for completeness, accuracy, validity, consistency, and timeliness of critical datasets. 
 - Identify recurring data and process issues; maintain a prioritized improvement backlog and standardize reusable monitoring, reconciliation, and support practices. 
 - Support backup and recovery validation, continuity exercises, and retention procedures with platform and governance teams; verify data integrity following restoration. 

Qualifications

Education & Experience

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - 7+ years of experience in data operations, data engineering support, production support, or analytics operations, including responsibility for enterprise data services.

data.description:
A Day in Your Life at MKS: (Summary & Objectives)

As a Mgr. , Product Compliance at MKS Inc. , you will: 

- Own the execution & the results of the Product Compliance audits and certification-surveillance programs across assigned MKS manufacturing locations. 
 - Work with corporate compliance, quality, Mfg. , Ops. , Eng. , supply chain, supplier quality, and external laboratories/certification bodies to establish clear action owners, due dates, escalation paths, and measurable deliverables. 

In this role, you will report to the Director of Product Compliance. 

You Will Make an Impact By: (Responsibilities)

Primary Objective - Product Compliance Audit Program Ownership

- Own the Product Compliance audits for assigned manufacturing sites and all certification activities. You will be accountable for 3rd-party audit readiness and execution, timely closure of findings, and the controls required to keep certified products aligned with approved constructions and regulatory requirements. 
 - Establish audit deliverables and hold Quality, Manufacturing, Operations, Engineering, Supply Chain/Supplier Quality, and suppliers accountable to committed dates; escalate missed commitments to site and business leadership, and ensure identified gaps are mitigated before the audits. 
 - Own compliance-critical manufacturing-control expectations, i. e. , receiving inspection, calibration, production test records, document control, and engineering/manufacturing change control, product transfers, etc. related to CCL (Components Critical to Compliance List). Evaluate changes for certification impact, and complete agency notifications and technical reviews before implementation. 
 - Manage working relationships with MKS compliance group, third-party laboratories, NRTLs/certification bodies, inspectors, and technical reviewers. 

Skills You Bring: (Required Skills)

- B. S. or M. S. in EE, ME, Quality Engineering, or a related technical discipline, with 7+ years of relevant experience in product compliance, certification, quality, manufacturing, or regulatory engineering. 
 - Demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders and cross-functional teams, establish accountability without relying solely on direct authority, and drive deliverables to closure. 
 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to represent MKS effectively internally and externally. 
 - Working knowledge of product safety and EMC/EMI compliance requirements and standards such as IEC/UL/EN 61010-1, IEC/EN 61326-1, IEC/EN 60825-1, applicable IEC 61000 series standards, SEMI S2. 
 - Working knowledge of global product compliance frameworks and regulations, including CE marking, LVD, EMC, FCC, NRTL certifications, UKCA, KC, RoHS, REACH, China RoHS, and other applicable regional requirements. 
 - Strong understanding of manufacturing and quality-system controls relevant to certification audits, including critical components, engineering and supplier change control, traceability, doc control, calibration, inspection, and testing. 
 - Working knowledge of ISO 9001 and internal auditing principles, with the ability to interpret requirements, assess objective evidence, classify risk, and ensure findings are effectively closed. 
 - Strong program-management discipline, including prioritization, action tracking, resource planning, risk management, escalation, executive reporting, and management of multiple concurrent audits and certification commitments. 

Preferred Skills

- Hands-on experience with UL, Intertek/ETL, CSA, TÜV, or similar NRTL/certification-body factory inspection 
 - Formal ISO 9001 internal auditor or lead auditor training; ASQ Certified Quality Auditor (CQA) is a plus. 
 - Experience managing supplier quality audits, supplier corrective actions, contract and global manufacturers 
 - Experience with ERP, PLM, and QMS systems used to manage BOMs, approved vendor lists, engineering changes, controlled documents, certifications, audit evidence, and CAPA records. 
 - Experience with semiconductor, vacuum, plasma, RF/power, laser/optical, precision motion, or other complex equipment. 
 - Experience managing third-party audit/certification budgets, service providers, or statements of work is a plus. 

Key Interfaces

- Internal: Product Compliance, Quality, Manufacturing, Operations, Engineering, Supply Chain, Supplier Quality, Service, site leadership, and business-unit leadership. 
 - External: Third-party test laboratories, NRTLs/certification bodies, auditors/inspectors, suppliers, contract manufacturers, and other regulatory or certification representatives. 

Supervisory Scope

- Reporting Relationships: Manager-level role with matrixed audit coordinators, as applicable to the organization structure. 
 - Financial Responsibilities: Responsible for planning and managing assigned third-party audit, certification, and related services. 

Physical Demands and Working Conditions

- Able to travel domestically and internationally (~30%) as needed to support manufacturing-site, supplier, laboratory, and certification audits. 
 - Able to work in manufacturing, laboratory, and supplier environments and comply with applicable site safety and personal protective equipment requirements.
