Job Description: 

About us*

At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. Responsible Growth is how we run our company and how we deliver for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day. 

One of the keys to driving Responsible Growth is being a great place to work for our teammates around the world. We're devoted to being a diverse and inclusive workplace for everyone. We hire individuals with a broad range of backgrounds and experiences and invest heavily in our teammates and their families by offering competitive benefits to support their physical, emotional, and financial well-being. 

Bank of America believes both in the importance of working together and offering flexibility to our employees. We use a multi-faceted approach for flexibility, depending on the various roles in our organization. 

Working at Bank of America will give you a great career with opportunities to learn, grow and make an impact, along with the power to make a difference. Join us!

Global Business Services

Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations. 

Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence and innovation. 

In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services. 

Process Overview*

Global Finance was set up in 2007 as a part of the CFO Global Delivery strategy to provide offshore delivery to Line of Business and Enterprise Finance functions. The capabilities hosted include Accounts Payable, General Accounting & Reconciliations, Management Reporting & Analysis, Research & Analytics, Financial Transaction Processing, Finance Systems Support & Regulatory reporting. Over the years, the scope of Global Finance has been expanded to include operations for other enterprise control functions like Human Resources and Risk and Compliance. 

CFO Change Automation team, which is part of CFO COO group in involved in various analytics, automation and reporting & governance needs that helps the CFO group analyze and address key challenges & provide relevant solutions using ET or any other relevant technologies. The team provides deep dive analysis by deploying analytics and data mining tools like SQL, Alteryx, Tableau, Workiva etc. as well as is involved in setting up automated solutions for complex BAU processes. 

Job Description*

CFO Change Automation team aims in driving opportunity assessment, prioritization, and process automation & governance across all verticals of CFO. 

In support of CFO Change objectives this position will be responsible for managing the end to end delivery of complex initiatives from a functional leader perspective. His expertise will be to bridge the gap between business needs & designing technical solutions coupled with his efficiency in ET. 

This person will be responsible for assisting business teams to expedite implementation of automated solutions through collaboration with other CFO and Enterprise Architecture teams to provide a consistent and governed approach in accordance with data management and tech strategy models. This person would serve in an execution role to support business with new and emerging tools used in process optimization efforts and driving Operational Excellence. 

This initiative execution/ business integration role will require the individual to lead, manage, and deliver on the end to end scope of Automation initiatives. This individual will get significant exposure to senior stakeholders across CFO through leading initiative routines to communicate project progress, governance, new opportunities and key decisions. 

Responsibilities*

- Lead the end-to-end design and delivery of intelligent agents using Microsoft Copilot Studio, including workflow orchestration, system integrations, and scalable automation use cases. 
 - Design and manage end-to-end automation workflows, ensuring scalability, stability, and measurable business impact. 
 - Partner with business and technology stakeholders to translate functional requirements into AI-driven agent solutions, ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture, governance, and control standards. 
 - Stay updated with evolving AI and automation toolsets, enabling scalable and practical AI-powered workflows
 - Lead development of solutions on low-code/no-code platforms (e. g. , Alteryx, Tableau, automation tools, workflow engines)
 - Effectively manage the end to end delivery of their Automation projects / initiatives
 - The role will require skills required to deliver a complex and multi-faceted project end-to-end
 - Strong knowledge in data warehousing concepts. Good understanding of RPA (UiPath), Alteryx, Tableau, Workiva, VB, SQL, Data Modeling and other newly upcoming technologies. 

Requirements*

Education*

Bachelor's degree (preferably in Computer Science, Data Science etc)

Certifications If Any

Technical certifications in Microsoft Copilot M365, Studio, RPA tools like UiPath, Alteryx Advanced and Tableau preferred

Experience Range*

7-10 years

Foundational skills*

- Practical experience with generative AI tools (e. g. , Microsoft 365 Copilot), including the ability to frame effective prompts and apply AI outputs for accurate, relevant, and reusable business deliverables
 - Strong analytical judgment and risk awareness, with experience using AI for data analysis and executive ready insights (e. g. , variance, trends), while ensuring appropriate controls, validation, and human review of automated outputs
 - Strong hands-on experience with UiPath Studio for designing, developing, and testing automation solutions aligned to business processes
 - Hands-on expertise in developing and deploying agents in Microsoft Copilot Studio, including prompt design, conversation flows, and API/connectivity integration
 - Strong understanding of agent-based architectures and intelligent automation frameworks, with the ability to deliver reliable, scalable, and production-ready solutions
 - Must have intermediate to advanced knowledge of tools such as Alteryx and Tableau, UiPath, Workiva, Power pivot, Visual Basic, SQL and others and have at least 7-9 years of relevant experience in analytics, automation and reporting
 - Ability to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment is critical
 - Must have good project management and communications skills
 - Experience of managing multiple projects concurrently with tight and changing deadlines
 - Good documentation skills to capture test results and report them to onshore process team
 - Good analytical skills and ability identify/raise questions
 - Ability to lead/facilitate discussions across various levels of stakeholders/support partners

Desired Skills

- Leverage cutting-edge capabilities such as Copilot (M365, Chat, GitHub), Prompt Engineering to drive intelligent automation outcomes, with a strong focus on Responsible AI and ethical adoption. 
 - Exposure to advanced AI tools with a focus on responsible AI adoption, governance, and enterprise-scale deployment. 
 - Excellent understanding with other programming languages such as SQL, Python and VBA will be strongly preferred
 - Strong collaboration and relationship management skills to drive change
 - Prior experience with either of self-service tools such as Alteryx and Tableau, UiPath (RPA), Power pivot, Workiva and others
 - Proven ability to work with system tools in complex environments and good understanding of business

Work Timings*

Flexible between 11: 30 am to 8: 30 pm or 12: 30 pm to 9: 30 pm

Job Location*

Mumbai/Gurugram

data.description:
Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we're helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential. 

Title And Summary

Senior Software Engineer

Overview

Mastercard is a technology company in the Global Payments Industry. We operate the world's fastest payments processing network, connecting consumers, financial institutions, merchants, governments, and businesses in more than 210 countries and territories. Mastercard products and solutions make everyday commerce activities - such as shopping, travelling, running a business, and managing finances - easier, more secure, and more efficient for everyone. 

MasterCard is seeking for a Senior Software Engineering to join our Data and Analytics team in building new data driven products for our consumers. The candidate will work with cross-functional teams and business stakeholders in developing product platforms. The ideal candidate should be passionate about design thinking, customer experience journey, highly motivated, intellectually curious, analytical, and possesses an entrepreneurial mindset. 

Join our team and help shape the future of data and analytics!

Role

Mastercard is building digital platform for data accessibility for different personas e. g. , business-users, data engineers, for faster retrieval of data. 

The Senior Software Development Engineer is a hands-on developer specializing in Java, Spring boot development with a particular focus producing API services in building product platforms. 

What You Will Do

- Design components by translating product requirements, break down project into tasks and provide accurate estimates. 
 - Responsible for the analysis, design, development, and delivery of software solutions. 
 - Plan, design, and develop technical solutions and alternatives to meet business requirements in adherence with MasterCard standards, processes, and best practices. 
 - Independently come up with different solutions, extensible low-level design. Write modular, extensible, readable, and performant code. 
 - Choose the right Data Structures, tools and tech stacks and be able to do High Level Designing with guidance. 
 - Research new frameworks and technologies, assist with prototyping and proof-of-concepts, participate in code reviews. 
 - Build, develop, mentor and coach junior team members. 
 - Collaborate with teams by contributing to the shared vision and working closely with cross-functional stakeholders. 
 - You will be responsible for the API's you (and or your team) build and will support them till the time they are live in production. 
 - Contribute ideas to help ensure that required standards and processes are in place. Maintain solution and technology road maps. 
 - Accountable for full systems development life cycle including creating high quality requirements documents, use-cases, design, and other technical artifacts including but not limited to detailed test strategy/test design, performance benchmarking, release rollout and deployment plans, contingency/back-out plans, feasibility study, cost and time analysis and detailed estimates. 
 - Research and evaluate current and upcoming technologies and frameworks. Participate in PoCs (Proof of Concept) and help the Department with selection of Vendor Solutions, Technologies, Methodologies and Frameworks. 

All About You

- Excellent communication skills with the ability to communicate with all levels of management. 
 - Ability to build rapport and relationships. 
 - A record of successful delivery of software applications as an individual
 - Problem solver and solution-seeking approach
 - Knowledgeable - possessing the technical knowledge, market knowledge, and other specialized knowledge of the team's problem domain. 
 - Hands on experience in building complex and highly scalable and performing systems. 
 - Solid understanding and hands-on experience in Java, J2EE, Spring, Spring Security, Spring Boot, RESTful web services
 - Solid understanding and experience integrating web services. 
 - Exposure to building cloud ready applications (microservices)
 - Exposure to Test Driven Development, Continuous Delivery, and Integration
 - Must be high-energy, detail-oriented, proactive and can function under pressure in an independent environment. 
 - Must provide the necessary skills to have a high degree of initiative and self-motivation to drive results. 
 - Possesses strong communication skills -- both verbal and written - and strong relationship, collaborative skills, and organizational skills. 
 - Willingness and ability to learn and take on challenging opportunities and to work as a member of matrix based diverse and geographically distributed project team. 
 - Bachelor's in computer degree (BE/BTech)
 - 7-10 years of work experience

Corporate Security Responsibility

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must: 

- Abide by Mastercard's security policies and practices; 
 - Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed; 
 - Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
 - Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard's guidelines.

Job Description

This is your chance to change the path of your career and guide multiple teams to success at one of the world's leading financial institutions. 

As a Manager of Software Engineering at JPMorgan Chase within Consumer and Community Banking Technology, you lead multiple engineering teams and manage day-to-day implementation activities that deliver secure, reliable, and scalable technology solutions. You identify and escalate risks, remove delivery impediments, and help ensure your teams' work aligns with compliance standards, business requirements, service level agreements, and tactical best practices. You also guide responsible adoption of enterprise-authorized AI-assisted engineering practices and SDLC/TLM automation to improve delivery speed, quality, resiliency, and operational outcomes while maintaining appropriate human oversight and secure handling of data. 

Job Responsibilities

- Guide immediate teams of software engineers on daily tasks, technical decisions, delivery priorities, and quality expectations. 
 - Set clear standards for team output, engineering practices, collaboration routines, and accountability across multiple workstreams. 
 - Lead adoption of enterprise-authorized AI-assisted engineering practices and SDLC/TLM automation to improve delivery speed, quality, and operational outcomes. 
 - Establish expectations for human validation, secure handling of inputs and outputs, and consistent use of reusable engineering patterns. 
 - Apply knowledge of the Software Development Life Cycle toolchain, including approved AI-assisted development and automation capabilities, to increase automation value. 
 - Anticipate dependencies across teams, platforms, and delivery partners to support timely execution of products and applications. 
 - Manage stakeholder relationships by communicating delivery status, risks, trade-offs, and escalation needs with clarity and accountability. 
 - Ensure team delivery aligns with compliance standards, service level agreements, business requirements, and applicable control expectations. 
 - Coach engineers and technical leads on delivery discipline, responsible technology practices, engineering excellence, and career development. 
 - Resolve execution issues by identifying root causes, coordinating cross-team action, and strengthening delivery routines to prevent recurrence. 
 - Improve team effectiveness by using metrics, retrospectives, automation opportunities, and operating feedback to strengthen quality, resiliency, and capacity. 

Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills

- Formal training or certification on software engineering concepts and 5+ years of applied experience. 
 - Demonstrated experience coaching, mentoring, and developing software engineers or technical contributors. 
 - Experience leading technology projects from planning through execution, delivery, and production support. 
 - Experience managing technologists across delivery priorities, performance expectations, risk management, and stakeholder commitments. 
 - Experience leading responsible adoption of enterprise-authorized AI-assisted development and delivery tools across engineering teams. 
 - Ability to define ways of working for AI-assisted engineering, including review expectations, validation routines, outcome measurement, and secure data handling. 
 - Understanding of responsible AI use in engineering workflows, including data sensitivity, resiliency, security, and governance expectations. 
 - Proficiency across the Software Development Life Cycle, including requirements analysis, design, development, testing, deployment, and support. 
 - Advanced understanding of agile delivery practices, CI/CD, application resiliency, security, and production readiness. 
 - In-depth knowledge of financial services technology environments, IT systems, control expectations, and practical cloud-native engineering.

It has been more than 60 years since SYSTRA has garnered expertise that spans the entire spectrum of Mass Rapid Transit System. SYSTRA India's valuable presence in India roots back to 1957, where SYSTRA worked on the electrification of Indian Railways. Our technical excellence, holistic approach and the tremendous talent provides a career that puts people who join us at the heart of improving transportation and urban infrastructure efficiency. 

Understand better who we are by visiting www. systra. in

Context

In India, SYSTRA is an international consulting and engineering company operating in the fields of Metros, High Speed Rail, Railways, Roads, Buildings, Urban planning, and Water Infrastructure for public and private organizations. 

Our unique expertise is backed with a reputation built through technical excellence delivered on projects. Our fully integrated services are tailored to plan and manage projects using proven best practices. 

SYSTRA India's comprehensive know-how and expertise in Railways provides a wide spectrum of solutions for any challenge (Building a new rail link, doubling the capacity, gauge conversion, upgrading a network, improving the performance of existing lines, etc. ). Our extensive experience encompasses, bridges, station buildings, Depots, Earthwork & Track Works, Power Supply and Transmission, Signaling & Telecommunications, Rolling Stock, Utilities diversion and yard re-modelling etc. Our services cover the entire life cycle of the project implementation. 

We are proud to deliver Project Management Services to the Rail Land Development Authority (Indian Railways) for three major railway station projects: Mumbai, New Delhi, and Ahmedabad. Our involvement spans the entire project lifecycle, ensuring comprehensive support throughout each stage of implementation. 

We are seeking applications for the position of Quality Manager (Systems) for New Delhi Railway station redevelopment project based at New Delhi. 

Missions/Main Duties

- Develop and implement a comprehensive quality assurance plan for systems components for NDLS redevelopment project. Define quality objectives, standards, and procedures to ensure consistency and compliance with project requirements.

 - Ensure every team member must have gone through Business Ethics and compliance training
 - Ensure every project member has knowledge of Environment policy of company. 
 - Ensure each member of team has gone through 9 lifesaving rules

Profile/Skills

 - Having 8 years' experience and Minimum 5/6 years in similar position and project for Diploma(Specialisation in Quality Management ) - with relevant experience. 
 - Excellent verbal and written communication. 
 - Ability to work within a culturally diverse organization, recognizing and respecting differences. 
 - Ability to problem solve, especially in an integrated project delivery environment, applying industry best practices.

Associate Software Engineer

We have an opportunity for an Associate Software Engineer to join our Universal Asset Insights team in Bangalore, reporting to the Senior Manager, Engineering. In this role, you will help build and evolve Infoblox Universal Asset Insights, a cloud-first platform that automates discovery and analysis of IP-based and non-IP-based assets across public clouds, on-premises networks, OT/IoT environments, and third-party applications. Collaborating closely with Product Management, Architecture, and cross-functional engineering teams, you will contribute to scalable microservices, data pipelines, and AI-powered capabilities that give our customers real-time, actionable visibility into their hybrid environments-while using our agentic AI development stack to boost productivity and reliability across the software development lifecycle. 

Be a Contributor - What You'll Do

- Develop cloud-hosted microservices and data pipelines for asset ingestion, transformation, and normalization across hybrid and multi-cloud environments
 - Build extensible integrations, including low-code/no-code patterns, that onboard new asset sources quickly and securely
 - Implement containerized, event-driven services using Docker and Kubernetes that meet scalability and reliability goals
 - Design and implement APIs and data models that expose rich asset and topology data to downstream analytics and user experiences
 - Use AI-assisted tools and agentic frameworks (LLM coding assistants, agents/sub-agents, MCP-style servers) to accelerate coding, testing, and documentation
 - Contribute to architecture reviews and design discussions to keep the platform secure, observable, maintainable, and cost-efficient
 - Implement and tune data storage patterns across relational, time-series, and NoSQL databases to support performant querying and analytics
 - Partner with SRE and Operations on observability (metrics, logs, traces), SLIs/SLOs, and incident response
 - Integrate asset visibility with Infoblox core services (DNS, DHCP, IPAM) and adjacent ecosystems such as CTEM, CAASM, and ITSM
 - Stay current on trends in asset intelligence, ETL, streaming, no-code/low-code, and agentic AI, and share ideas that improve developer productivity

Be Prepared - What You Bring

- 1- 2 years of professional software development experience in Golang/Go, with exposure to backend services
 - Foundational experience with microservices or distributed systems using Docker and Kubernetes on a major cloud platform

Principal Engineer - Agentic AI for Network & Security Operations

Meet the Team

The Cisco CTO Organization is shaping the future of networking and security through AI-native, cloud-delivered and autonomous operations platforms. We are building intelligent systems that make network and security operations more observable, proactive, reliable and efficient at enterprise scale. 

Your Impact

As a Principal Engineer, you will define and build the architecture for agentic AI and autonomous operations across Cisco's networking and security portfolio. 

You will combine deep experience in network management, security platforms, distributed systems, cloud-native architecture and large-scale telemetry with emerging agentic AI technologies. Your work will help operators diagnose problems faster, understand complex operational conditions and safely automate remediation. 

You will provide technical direction across multiple engineering teams and turn new AI capabilities into scalable, reliable and customer-facing products. 

What You'll Do

- Define the architecture for agentic AI platforms supporting network troubleshooting, operational assistance, incident analysis and dynamic visualization. 
 - Build tool-using AI agents that reason over network telemetry, configurations, events, alerts, logs and operational knowledge. 
 - Establish evaluation frameworks, guardrails, correctness standards and gateway services for safely deploying agents in production. 
 - Design real-time fault-detection, alerting, suppression, analysis and automated-remediation systems. 
 - Develop closed-loop operational workflows for proactive detection, guided investigation and safe remediation. 
 - Architect large-scale streaming and event-processing platforms capable of analyzing high-volume network and security telemetry. 
 - Create reusable platform services for search, scheduling, observability, data protection and operational integrations. 
 - Integrate network and security platforms with SIEM, IT service-management, collaboration and customer-notification systems. 
 - Design resilient, observable and cost-efficient cloud platforms using Kubernetes, microservices and distributed data technologies. 
 - Define multi-cloud architectures that operate consistently across AWS and GCP. 
 - Lead performance, scalability, reliability and cloud-cost optimization initiatives. 
 - Establish non-functional requirements and review architecture for services delivered across multiple teams. 
 - Partner with product and engineering leaders to translate emerging AI capabilities into customer outcomes. 
 - Mentor senior engineers and promote architecture, resiliency, observability and software-quality practices. 

Success in This Role

Successful Candidates Will Demonstrate The Ability To

- Turn complex operational problems into scalable platform capabilities. 
 - Balance rapid AI innovation with correctness, safety, reliability and observability. 
 - Operate across AI, networking, security and cloud-platform boundaries. 
 - Lead through architecture, technical influence and hands-on contribution. 
 - Deliver measurable improvements in operational efficiency, customer experience, platform cost and system reliability. 

Minimum Qualifications

- 15+ years of experience in networking, security, platform engineering, distributed systems or related fields. 
 - Significant experience serving as a principal engineer, architect, founding engineer or equivalent senior technical leader. 
 - Strong expertise in enterprise network management, including wired or wireless infrastructure, device telemetry, configurations, fault management and operational automation. 
 - Experience designing production systems for network assurance, fault detection, alert processing or automated remediation. 
 - Hands-on experience building LLM-based or agentic systems for networking, security, operations or customer-support use cases. 
 - Experience with agent orchestration, tool-using agents, evaluation, guardrails and production correctness. 
 - Experience building high-volume streaming or event-driven platforms using technologies such as Kafka, Flink, Kinesis or equivalent systems. 
 - Strong knowledge of distributed data and search technologies such as OpenSearch, Elasticsearch, Hudi, RocksDB, Redis, DynamoDB or relational databases. 
 - Experience designing cloud-native platforms using Kubernetes, Docker, microservices and asynchronous messaging. 
 - Experience with AWS, GCP or comparable public-cloud platforms. 
 - Strong programming ability in Java and/or Python. 
 - Working knowledge of network and security protocols such as TCP/IP, HTTP, TLS, SNMP, SMTP, ICAP or related technologies. 
 - Experience with observability platforms such as Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, Loki or comparable systems. 
 - Proven ability to define technical direction, review designs and deliver production systems across multiple engineering teams. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience applying agentic AI to network operations, security operations or autonomous infrastructure. 
 - Experience with LangGraph or comparable agent-orchestration frameworks. 
 - Knowledge of retrieval, grounding, agent evaluation and operational safety techniques for enterprise AI systems. 
 - Experience with Network-as-a-Service, Zero Trust, CASB, DLP, network assurance or cloud-security platforms. 
 - Experience building rule-based or intelligent anomaly- and fault-detection systems at large scale. 
 - Experience implementing closed-loop detection, investigation and remediation. 
 - Experience integrating operational platforms with SIEM and ITSM systems such as Splunk, ServiceNow or equivalent products. 
 - Experience architecting multi-tenant security proxies, policy-enforcement systems or cloud data-protection services. 
 - Demonstrated success improving platform performance, reliability and cloud cost. 
 - Experience leading platform migrations across data centers and public clouds. 
 - Strong product mindset with a record of connecting technical innovation to measurable customer and business outcomes. 
 - Granted patents, publications or demonstrated technical innovation in networking, security, AI or distributed systems. 
 - Experience mentoring engineers and influencing technical execution without direct organizational authority. 

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we're revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era - and beyond. We've been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint. 

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you'll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere. 

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you. 

Disclaimer

About

To ensure that we hire the best talent in the right way, we follow a strict hiring process and recently, Cisco has been made aware of fraudulent recruiters claiming to be from the company. Please be advised that any communication from Cisco about careers will:

data.description:
About ScienceLogic. . . 

ScienceLogic is redefining IT operations for the modern enterprise. Our AIOps platform empowers organizations to achieve Autonomic IT - where systems are self-healing, self-optimizing, and seamlessly aligned with business outcomes. We help enterprises and service providers gain unified visibility across hybrid and multi-cloud environments, automate workflows, and unlock performance at scale. 

We're accelerating digital transformation through the power of automation, AI, and analytics - giving IT and business leaders the tools to deliver superior customer experiences, drive efficiency, and innovate with confidence. 

What We're Looking For. . . 

ScienceLogic is hiring an Engineering Manager for our PowerPack team based in our Hyderabad office. This role will manage a team of approximately 20 software engineers and SDETs responsible for the development, quality, and ongoing evolution of the PowerPack portfolio. You will report to the Director of Product Engineering (India) and will be a member of the India engineering leadership team. This is a people-first leadership role with meaningful technical responsibility. We are looking for an experienced engineering leader who can build trust, develop future leaders, drive execution, and thoughtfully apply AI-enabled practices to improve engineering outcomes. 

What You'll Be Doing. . . 

You'll lead a team of approximately 20 engineers comprised of full-time employees and, covering responsibilities across: 

People & Growth

- Conduct regular 1: 1s with team members, providing coaching, feedback, and career development support. 
 - Hiring: run screening and calibration with recruiting partners, and own onboarding for new hires. 
 - Management of Contractors performance monitoring and support through contractor-to-FTE conversion process. 
 - Performance management and career development conversations that go beyond the annual review. 
 - Team health across the org: morale and psychological safety, not just velocity metrics. 
 - Conflict resolution and mediation to keep the team cohesive under pressure. 

Delivery & Execution

- Weekly alignment with your Product Owner on priorities, roadmap, and backlog, and with the leads you're developing as they take on more scope. 
 - Sprint execution accountability across both working groups, including capacity planning. 
 - Handling major or complex escalations, including regular syncs to work through what's outstanding. 
 - Tracking delivery metrics (velocity, uptime, bug counts, deployment frequency) and reporting progress, risk, and dependencies to stakeholders. 

Technical Leadership

- Architecture and design review for pull requests, ensuring sound technical decisions across the team's work. 
 - Promoting engineering best practices: testing, code review, documentation, and CI/CD. 
 - Sponsoring and helping lead cross-team technical initiatives, such as major platform migrations and release-process automation. 
 - Running demo sessions and hands-on skill-building with the team on key technical areas. 

AI-Enabled Engineering

- Identify where AI creates real leverage in your team's engineering workflows, and act on it yourself, not just approve it from a distance. 
 - Work alongside engineers to design and deliver AI-enabled solutions to real product and delivery problems. 
 - Build your team's capability to use AI as a working tool, including hands-on training for engineers who are still building that muscle. 

Org Design

- Today, the org runs flat: you manage all 20 engineers directly, organized across two informally-led working groups. 
 - A key responsibility of this role is to identify and develop emerging leaders, establish a Team Lead layer, and evolve the organization into a more scalable team structure over time. 

Qualities you possess. . . 

- Experience: 
 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or an equivalent technical discipline
 - 10+ years of software engineering experience, including at least 3-5 years leading engineering teams. 
 - Proven track record of delivering high-impact software products, with the willingness to roll up your sleeves and work directly with engineers when needed. 
 - Experience managing engineering teams of this size directly, and a track record of developing individual engineers into first-line leaders, even where that title doesn't formally exist yet. 
 - Self-starter with the ability to operate effectively in ambiguous environments. 
 - Technical Competence: 
 - Strong understanding of modern software architecture and distributed systems. 
 - Proficiency in Python and REST APIs, with familiarity across other technology stacks. 
 - Proficiency in database technologies and event-driven architecture. 
 - Deep understanding of the software development lifecycle (SDLC), CI/CD, and testing methodologies. 
 - Hands-on, personal experience building or shipping at least one AI-enabled feature: you were in the technical problem, contributing to design and trade-offs, not sponsoring or approving someone else's work. 
 - Leadership & Management: 
 - Exceptional leadership, coaching, and mentoring skills, with a visible track record of developing engineers with diverse experience levels and career aspirations. 
 - Demonstrated ability to build, motivate, and retain high-performing engineering teams, with strong delivery instincts across sprint accountability, capacity planning, and cross-team coordination. 
 - Strong critical thinking and problem-solving abilities. 
 - Excellent communication, interpersonal, and negotiation skills with engineers, peers, and senior leadership. 

As a plus, you have. . . 

- Experience in a GCC, IDC, or other geographically distributed engineering environment. 
 - Product engineering background: ownership of outcomes, not just delivery of tasks. 
 - Familiarity with AIOps, monitoring, observability, or enterprise SaaS domains. 
 - Engineering background with hands-on depth in Python, REST APIs, or cloud-native development, enough that you're credible in architecture and design conversations, even though you won't be writing production code day to day in this role. 
 - Familiarity with Agile/Scrum at scale, where ceremonies drive outcomes rather than checkbox rituals. 
 - Familiarity with JavaScript and frameworks like React. 
 - Exposure towards Spec Driven Development(AI-DLC) and or TDD

Don't meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. At ScienceLogic, we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you're excited about this role but your past experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles. 

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or any other applicable legally protected characteristics in the location in which you are applying.

ScienceLogic is a leader in IT Operations Management, providing modern IT operations with actionable insights to resolve and predict problems faster in a digital, ephemeral world. Its solution sees everything across cloud and distributed architectures, contextualizes data through relationship mapping, and acts on this insight through integration and automation.

Renesas is one of the top global semiconductor companies in the world. We strive to develop a safer, healthier, greener, and smarter world, and our goal is to make every endpoint intelligent by offering product solutions in the automotive, industrial, infrastructure and IoT markets. Renesas employs roughly 21, 000 people in more than 30 countries worldwide. As a global team, our employees actively embody the Renesas Culture, our guiding principles based on five key elements: Transparent, Agile, Global, Innovative, and Entrepreneurial. Renesas believes in, and has a commitment to, diversity and inclusion, with initiatives and a leadership team dedicated to its resources and values. At Renesas, we want to build a sustainable future where technology helps make our lives easier. Join us and build your future by being part of what's next in electronics and the world. 

Job Description

Seeking a technically strong and proactive Post-Silicon System Validation / Functional Validation Engineer to drive the planning, execution, and debug of system-level validation of IP and SoC/MCU designs. This role is critical in verifying functional correctness, feature compliance, performance, and robustness of silicon devices across use cases, voltage/temperature corners, and real application conditions. 

Key Responsibilities: 

- Execute post‐silicon system and functional validation of automotive SoCs/MCUs to ensure functional correctness, robustness, and performance. 
 - Own feature‐level validation plans, test strategies, and coverage matrices aligned with architecture and design specifications. 
 - Execute validation of boot flows, power/clock/reset, memory subsystems, interconnects, and interfaces across stress, corner, and fault scenarios. 
 - Drive system bring‐up on evaluation boards, emulation/FPGA platforms, and silicon validation setups. 
 - Develop and maintain test firmware, diagnostics, automation scripts, and stress tools to exercise system features. 
 - Perform hands‐on silicon debug and root‐cause analysis, working closely with design, DV, firmware, and software teams to drive closure. 
 - Analyse validation data and logs, track issues through structured closure, and contribute to quality metrics. 
 - Support escape‐prevention efforts by identifying coverage gaps, corner cases, and robustness risks. 
 - Mentor junior engineers and provide technical guidance within the validation team. 
 - Contribute to validation readiness reports, risk assessments, and release signoff inputs. 

Qualifications

- B. E. /B. Tech or M. E. /M. Tech in Electronics, Electrical, or Computer Engineering. 
 - 3 to 12 years of experience in post-silicon validation, system validation, or embedded SoC bring-up. 
 - Strong understanding of SoC architecture, ARM cores (A/M series), peripherals, power/clock/reset, and low-power design techniques. 
 - Experience validating high-speed interfaces (e. g. , DDR, USB, PCIe, MIPI, Ethernet) and standard protocols (SPI, I2C, UART, CAN, LIN, FlexRay, etc. ). 
 - Proficiency in C/C++ or embedded programming for firmware development and test automation. 
 - Hands-on experience with lab tools (oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, power analyzers, thermal sensors). 
 - Familiarity with validation frameworks, debug utilities (JTAG, Lauterbach, OpenOCD), and issue tracking systems (JIRA, Bugzilla). 
 - Strong leadership, communication, and collaboration skills. 
 - Experience with AI frameworks for SoC Validation efficiency and quality gain- eg validation specific AI agents, Cody AI for content development etc. Preferred

- Ability to work effectively in a multicultural, cross-functional environment. 
 - Familiarity with automotive technical trends. 
 - Self-starter with a proactive mindset and strong analytical and strategic thinking capabilities. 
 - Experience in validation of (Neural Processing Unit) or AI accelerator HW functionality on SoC. 

Additional Information

Renesas is an embedded semiconductor solution provider driven by its Purpose 'To Make Our Lives Easier. ' As the industry's leading expert in embedded processing with unmatched quality and system-level know-how, we have evolved to provide scalable and comprehensive semiconductor solutions for automotive, industrial, infrastructure, and IoT industries based on the broadest product portfolio, including High Performance Computing, Embedded Processing, Analog & Connectivity, and Power.

We design and develop sustainable, power-efficient solutions today that help people and communities thrive tomorrow, 'To Make Our Lives Easier. '

At Renesas, you can:

Our people-first culture and global support system, including the remote work option and Employee Resource Groups, will help you excel from the first day. data.title: R&D Engineer (GEN AI/ ML)
data.description:
Company Description

Ubisoft is a global leader in gaming with teams across the world creating original and memorable gaming experiences, from Assassin's Creed, Rainbow Six to Just Dance and more. We believe diverse perspectives help both players and teams thrive. If you're passionate about innovation and pushing entertainment boundaries, join our journey and help us create the unknown!

Job Description

Job Summary

UBISOFT is seeking an Intermediate R&D Engineer to prototype and validate new technologies that improve game testing and quality control. This role focuses on building rapid prototypes and running experiments using GenAI, VLMs (Vision-Language Models), and AI/ML to explore automation opportunities across QC. You will work closely with the R&D Manager and cross-functional partners to translate ideas into measurable experiments, evaluate feasibility, and iterate toward proof-of-value prototypes. This role provides an excellent opportunity to gain hands-on experience in software development, automation, and quality control processes within the gaming industry. 

Core Responsibilities

Job Duties / Responsibilities

- Build rapid prototypes using GenAI/VLM/ML to address QC and testing pain points. 
 - Design and execute experiments: define hypotheses, datasets/inputs, evaluation criteria, baselines, and success metrics (accuracy, precision/recall, latency, cost, robustness). 
 - Implement data pipelines for experiments: data collection, cleaning, labeling support, and dataset versioning (as needed for proofs-of-concept). 
 - Explore and compare approaches and document trade-offs. 
 - Integrate prototypes with existing internal tools/test systems at a lightweight level (APIs, CLIs, plugins) to enable user trials and feedback. 
 - Analyze experiment results, identify failure modes, and iterate quickly based on findings and stakeholder input. 
 - Maintain reproducible research practices: experiment tracking, configuration management, and clear documentation of assumptions and limitations. 
 - Collaborate in agile workflows: estimate assigned tasks, provide status updates, and incorporate feedback iteratively. 

Learning Opportunities

- Gain hands-on experience with software development and automation tools. 
 - Develop a deeper understanding of software testing lifecycles. 
 - Enhance coding and debugging skills in a collaborative environment. 
 - Learn about CI/CD pipelines and version control systems. 

Core Competencies

- Eager to Learn: Highly motivated and quick to grasp new concepts. 
 - Experimental Mindset: Comfortable with ambiguity; able to form hypotheses and learn quickly through iteration. 
 - Pragmatic Engineering: Delivers prototypes that are usable and measurable, without over-engineering. 
 - Analytical Thinking: Interprets results critically; understands bias, variance, and common evaluation pitfalls. 
 - Collaboration: Works well with technical and non-technical stakeholders; communicates trade-offs clearly. 
 - Adaptability: Keeps pace with rapidly evolving AI/ML tooling and best practices. 

Behavioral Competencies

- Curiosity: Passion for exploring new technologies and their applications. 
 - Teamwork: Ability to collaborate effectively with diverse teams. 
 - Adaptability: Willingness to take on new challenges and adapt to changing priorities.

data.title: Software Test Engineer
data.description:
Description

Job Summary

We are looking for a Software Test Engineer II with 3-5 years of relevant experience who can contribute to both manual and automation testing for enterprise software products. 

This role is suited for a detail-oriented quality engineer with strong manual testing fundamentals, an automation mindset, and hands-on exposure to modern automation tools such as Playwright and Python. The candidate should be able to analyze requirements, design effective test coverage, execute manual and automated tests, troubleshoot issues, and collaborate with QA, engineering, product, and global teams to deliver high-quality software. 

Exposure to Git for version-controlling automated tests, Azure Pipelines or similar CI/CD tools for running automated tests, and familiarity with AI-assisted testing or development tools will be valuable for this role. 

What You Will Do

- Plan, design, and execute test cases for functional, integration, regression, exploratory, and end-to-end scenarios. 
 - Create, maintain, and improve automated test scripts using modern automation tools such as Playwright and Python. 
 - Identify the right balance between manual validation and automation coverage based on risk, repeatability, and product impact. 
 - Analyze requirements, participate in backlog refinement, provide test estimates, and define test coverage for user stories. 
 - Use Git or similar version control tools to manage and maintain automated test assets. 
 - Log, track, troubleshoot, and validate defects using existing defect management tools. 
 - Support automated test execution through CI/CD pipelines where applicable. 
 - Contribute to regression readiness, release validation, test data setup, traceability, and test metrics. 
 - Collaborate with developers, QA engineers, product teams, and global stakeholders to improve product quality. 
 - Continuously improve testing practices by identifying opportunities for better automation, stronger coverage, faster feedback, and more reliable validation. 

Automation Mindset

- Identify repeatable, high-value scenarios that should be automated. 
 - Use automation to improve regression coverage, reduce manual effort, and provide faster release feedback. 
 - Write maintainable automation scripts with focus on reliability, readability, reuse, and ease of debugging. 
 - Be open to learning new tools, frameworks, and product areas as automation needs evolve. 

Qualifications And Skills

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - 3-5 years of relevant experience in software testing, with a strong mix of manual testing and test automation experience. 
 - Strong understanding of SDLC, STLC, Agile/Scrum, defect lifecycle, and release validation practices. 
 - Hands-on experience in manual testing, including test planning, test case design, test execution, defect management, and test metrics. 
 - Hands-on or working experience with Playwright and Python for test automation. 
 - Experience using Git or similar version control systems for maintaining automated test scripts. 
 - Exposure to Azure Pipelines or similar CI/CD tools for running automated tests. 
 - Familiarity with AI-assisted testing or development tools such as LLMs, ChatGPT, Claude, Codex, GitHub Copilot, or similar tools. 
 - Ability to analyze requirements, identify test gaps, raise risks early, and define effective test coverage. 
 - Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills across product, application, data, and integration issues. 
 - Ability to work with minimal supervision in a fast-paced, collaborative, and global environment. 
 - Strong written and verbal communication skills. 

Good to Have / Added Advantage

- Awareness of AI testing concepts such as LLM-as-a-Judge, golden datasets, prompt/output validation, or model response evaluation. 
 - Exposure to observability or tracing tools such as Langfuse for AI workflow validation. 
 - Previous experience with AI-enabled applications, reconciliation, financial close, month-end close, accounting, or enterprise SaaS applications. 

Cultural Fit

- Detail-oriented, quality-focused, and accountable for outcomes. 
 - Strong manual testing discipline with an automation-first mindset. 
 - Collaborative, open to feedback, and comfortable working with global teams. 
 - Continuous improvement mindset with curiosity to learn new tools, frameworks, and testing approaches. 
 - Embraces change, growth, innovation, and evolving quality engineering practices. 

At our core, Trintechers stand committed to fostering a culture rooted in our core values - Humble, Empowered, Reliable, and Open. Together, these values guide our actions, define our identity, and inspire us to continuously strive for excellence in everything we do. 

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin or disability.

This role requires strong experience in agile work management, integration testing, quality assurance, requirements management, SDLC practices, systems integration, troubleshooting, web services, workflow management, and test automation. 

The ideal candidate will plan, prioritize, and manage work using agile practices to enable iterative delivery, collaboration, adaptability, and continuous improvement. They will partner with developers and engineering teams to review source code, identify issues, improve quality, and promote maintainability and coding standards. 

This position is responsible for designing, executing, and maintaining tests that validate interactions across integrated components, systems, services, APIs, data flows, interfaces, and dependencies. The candidate will help establish and maintain QA processes and standards that prevent defects, optimize performance, improve customer satisfaction, and support compliance. 

The role also requires strong understanding of requirements management, SDLC, systems integration, web services, troubleshooting, and workflow management. The candidate should be a key contributor who can guide others informally and help teams deliver reliable, maintainable solutions. 

Role

In This Role, You Will

- Perform QE activities across assigned projects, including test planning, strategy, validation, automation, and release readiness. 
 - Collaborate with cross-functional engineering teams to enhance testing processes and strengthen quality practices. 
 - Contribute to SME QE teams focused on test validation and automation within assigned projects. 
 - Design, execute, and maintain integration tests to validate interactions between systems, services, APIs, data flows, interfaces, and dependencies. 
 - Establish and maintain QA processes and standards that prevent defects, improve quality, optimize performance, and support customer expectations. 
 - Apply agile work management practices to plan, prioritize, and manage work effectively in iterative delivery environments. 
 - Partner with product owners, developers, and delivery teams to review requirements, clarify acceptance criteria, manage changes, identify risks, and ensure testability throughout the SDLC. 
 - Support SDLC activities including requirements, design, coding, testing, deployment, and maintenance to ensure solutions remain high quality and maintainable. 
 - Contribute to systems integration by validating communication, interoperability, and reliability across diverse technologies, processes, applications, and services. 
 - Implement and support UI, API, backend, and integration automation using tools such as Playwright, Cypress, and API automation frameworks. 
 - Support API performance testing and performance validation using tools such as Gatling and BlazeMeter. 
 - Troubleshoot complex issues across systems, applications, services, integrations, test environments, and networks using structured methods and tools. 
 - Evaluate source code written by developers to identify and address potential issues, support maintainability, improve quality, and ensure adherence to coding standards and best practices. 
 - Analyze workflows, identify bottlenecks, streamline procedures, monitor progress, allocate resources, and adapt processes to ensure work moves smoothly from one stage to the next. 
 - Contribute to CI/CD and DevOps practices by supporting automated test execution, version control, and integration of test automation into delivery pipelines. 
 - Provide technical guidance to team members, support proof-of-concepts, coach others informally, and help teams adopt scalable and maintainable test automation practices. 
 - Communicate status, risks, dependencies, and quality insights clearly to stakeholders and leadership. 
 - Promote agile ways of working, continuous learning, collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement across the team. 

All About You / Experience

The ideal candidate for this position should have: 

- Strong experience in quality engineering, test strategy, planning, automation, QA, and software validation across complex technology programs. 
 - Ability to apply skills independently and consistently in complex or nuanced situations while supporting broader business, delivery, and quality goals. 
 - Strong knowledge of agile principles and practices, including planning, prioritization, iterative delivery, collaboration, adaptability, and continuous improvement. 
 - Experience collaborating with developers and engineering teams to review source code, identify potential issues, improve maintainability, and promote coding standards and best practices. 
 - Hands-on experience with UI and API automation tools such as Playwright and Cypress. 
 - Strong experience in API integration testing and backend validation. 
 - Experience designing and maintaining integration tests that validate data flows, interfaces, dependencies, web services, and system interactions. 
 - Experience with API performance testing and exposure to performance testing tools such as Gatling and BlazeMeter. 
 - Strong understanding of requirements management, including documenting, analyzing, tracing, prioritizing, agreeing on, and communicating requirements and changes to stakeholders. 
 - Strong understanding of software development life cycle practices, including requirements gathering, design, coding, testing, deployment, and maintenance. 
 - Experience with systems integration, including validating communication and interoperability across applications, services, technologies, and processes. 
 - Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills, with the ability to systematically identify, diagnose, and resolve technical issues across systems, applications, services, test environments, and networks. 
 - Experience with web services and standardized protocols that enable communication, data exchange, interoperability, scalability, and integration across diverse systems. 
 - Ability to analyze workflows, identify bottlenecks, streamline procedures, monitor progress, allocate resources, and adapt processes to achieve outcomes. 
 - Working knowledge of version control tools such as Git. 
 - Experience with API testing tools such as Insomnia. 
 - Experience with test case management tools such as XRay. 
 - Experience with project management tools such as Jira. 
 - Exposure to cloud platforms, preferably Azure. 
 - Familiarity with AI-assisted engineering and quality practices, including GitHub Copilot, Playwright MCP servers, and automation accelerators. 
 - Ability to work on proof-of-concepts. 
 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate across teams and present quality insights clearly. 
 - Self-driven, proactive, adaptable, and committed to continuous improvement. 

Corporate Security Responsibility

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must: 

- Abide by Mastercard's security policies and practices; 
 - Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed; 
 - Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
 - Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard's guidelines.

data.title: Senior Director, Engineering (AI Voice Agents)
data.description:
About Birdeye Inc. 

Birdeye builds AI coworkers for multi-location brands. Jay for marketing, Myna for operations, and Robin for customer experience orchestrate AI agents to win AI visibility, book appointments, and drive consistent CX at every location. They run on BirdAI, the Agent OS built on 13 years of multi-location data infrastructure and 3, 000+ integrations. BirdAI consolidates every signal, reasons with industry, brand and location context, and acts autonomously or with a human in the loop. 

Birdeye is trusted by the world's largest multi-location brands across healthcare, dental, restaurants, financial services, auto, retail, and property management. G2 ranks Birdeye #1 in Enterprise Multi-Location Marketing Platforms and named it to the 2026 Best Agentic AI Products list. Learn more at birdeye. com. 

About The Role

Every day, local businesses miss a large share of their inbound calls - and in appointment-driven industries, every missed call is a lost patient, a lost repair job, a lost service visit. Front desks are understaffed, phones ring after hours, and customers who don't get through simply call the next provider. Birdeye's AI Voice Agents group exists to fix this: AI agents that answer every call naturally, book and reschedule appointments directly into the systems businesses already run on, and give owners complete visibility into every conversation and outcome. 

As Senior Director of Engineering, you will lead this group end to end: the real-time voice agent platform, a CRM/PMS integrations and data-sync layer handling business-contact data at massive scale, and the conversation dashboard where customers see every call, booking, and insight. You inherit an existing engineering team - the mandate combines 0-to-1 product urgency with the leadership challenge of aligning that team around one architecture, raising the delivery bar, and shipping GA products across four verticals. 

The role is based in India, leading Birdeye's India-based Voice Agents engineering team with direct exposure to US product leadership and customers. You will report to senior R&D leadership and partner daily with Product, Design, and the partnerships team driving CRM/EHR/FSM/DMS alliances. You lead from the front: deeply technical, close to the code where it matters - architecture decisions, critical-path reviews, and agent-quality evals. 

What You Will Own

- Voice agent platform: real-time conversational pipeline (telephony, ASR, LLM orchestration, TTS), sub-second latency, barge-in handling, graceful human handoff, and per-vertical conversation design for appointment booking, rescheduling, and reminders. 
 - Integrations & data sync: bidirectional sync of business contacts, calendars, and appointments with EHR/PMS (e. g. , Epic, Dentrix, Eaglesoft), FSM (e. g. , ServiceTitan, Housecall Pro), DMS (e. g. , CDK, Reynolds, Tekion), and horizontal CRMs - reliable at tens of millions of records with conflict resolution, idempotency, and audit trails. 
 - Conversation dashboard & analytics: the customer-facing surface for full conversation history, transcripts, booking outcomes, containment/conversion metrics, and agent-quality analytics across locations. 
 - The team: lead the existing engineering team (voice/ML, backend/integrations, frontend, QA) through managers and senior ICs; shape team structure around the platform/integrations / dashboard pillars, develop and hire leaders, and establish on-call, quality bars, and eval-driven development for agent behavior. 
 - Execution & operating cadence: fast, predictable release cycles - planning, weekly reviews, and retrospectives that drive improvement; clear technical plans and milestones with trade-offs made explicit. 
 - Trust & compliance: HIPAA (BAAs), SOC 2, telephony/TCPA compliance, and safe-AI guardrails for autonomous customer-facing conversations. 

What success looks like: 

- GA voice agent live in at least two verticals with measurable booking-conversion and call-containment targets. 
 - Certified, bidirectional integrations with the top systems of record in each launch vertical. 
 - Conversation dashboard adopted as a daily surface by customers; analytics driving retention and upsell. 
 - The team operating as a high-performing unit: clear team charters, a strong manager bench, predictable delivery, and production-grade reliability (99. 9%+ voice uptime). 

What we're looking for: 

- 15+ years in software engineering, 6+ years leading large engineering teams through managers of managers, including inheriting and re-aligning an existing team. 
 - A blend of large-scale engineering rigor and startup speed - e. g. , senior tenure at a global-scale technology organization plus experience at a high-growth startup. 
 - Leadership at an AI-native product company (agents, enterprise search/RAG, conversational AI, or ML-heavy 
 - consumer platforms) - you have shipped AI products to demanding users, not just prototyped them. 
 - Shipped and operated real-time and/or high-scale distributed systems in production - voice/video, telephony, streaming, or large-scale data synchronization. 
 - Hands-on familiarity with the modern LLM/voice stack (ASR/TTS, agent orchestration, evals, prompt/tool design) and pragmatic judgment on build-vs-buy (e. g. , Retell/Vapi-class infra vs. in-house). 
 - Experience integrating with third-party systems of record (CRM, EHR/PMS, FSM, or DMS) and running partner-facing engineering relationships. 
 - 0-to-1 product instincts at scale: comfort with ambiguity, fast iteration against real customer calls, and shipping before everything is perfect - while keeping a large org focused. 
 - Strong cross-functional operator: partners tightly with Product, Design, GTM, and external partners; communicates crisply with executives. 

Nice to Have: 

- Domain experience in healthcare, dental, home services, or automotive software; HIPAA/SOC 2 exposure. 
 - Prior experience at a vertical SaaS or SMB-focused platform company. 
 - Experience with contact-center or CCaaS technology, SIP/WebRTC, or conversational analytics. 
 - Advanced degree (MS/PhD) in Computer Science or a related field; publications or patents in search, ML, or distributed systems. 
 - Experience leading India-based engineering orgs building for US/global customers, and operating across India-US time zones. 
 - A visible commitment to building inclusive teams - e. g. , mentoring, women-in-tech advocacy, or community leadership. 

AI First Mindset: 

AI fluency is core to how we work. We expect leaders to use AI daily in their own workflow - and as part of the interview process, you'll walk us through how you use AI tools today to drive impact in your role and your team's.

data.title: DevOps Engineer, Engineering Team Manager, Vice President
data.description:
About This Role

You can work with us at one of top FinTech companies. We sell our Aladdin platform to over 200 of the top global corporations, in total managing about quarter of all the world's money under management. 

BlackRock is global but close-knit team of individuals who share a common goal of providing the very best possible level of support to our business partners and customers. From the top of the firm down, we embrace the diversity of values, identities and ideas brought by our employees. We are serious about our people and offer Flexible Time Off, collaborative working spaces and several other benefits. 

An individual selected in this position will have the responsibility to cover business-critical computing workloads, real-time / interactive processing, data transfer services, application and new technology on-boarding and upgrades, and recovery procedures. The international team is split into 4 global regions to provide 24*7*365 support. 

This role is accountable for enterprise‐scale reliability, risk posture, and operational resilience through the adoption of AI‐enabled, autonomous infrastructure and service operations. 

The leader transitions the organization from human‐driven, reactive operations to AI‐supervised, self‐healing systems, ensuring technology platforms scale safely, predictably, and in alignment with business growth and regulatory expectations. 

The role owns strategy, outcomes, and governance, if any of these excites you, we want to talk to you. 

Team Overview

The Service Management Operations Group is responsible for monitoring, supporting, and administering production environments for all BlackRock businesses (including subsidiaries and BlackRock Solutions) acting as a first responder relative to troubleshooting, problem resolution, and escalation. 

Collaborating with skilled professionals across the globe and managing a broad range of technologies and applications, the Operations Group delivers service quality and excellence through teamwork, innovating operational processes, and being part of the One BlackRock culture. 

Key Responsibilities

- Own reliability outcomes
 - Deliver measurable improvements in availability, latency, recovery time, and incident recurrence for critical workloads. 
 - Establish and mature SRE practices: SLIs/SLOs, error budgets, and reliability governance. 
 - Build AI‐enabled, signal‐driven operations
 - Replace alert volume with AI‐correlated signals that prioritize true business impact and early risk indicators. 
 - Implement and improve detection, correlation, and routing workflows integrated into operational processes and tooling. 
 - Engineer self‐healing systems (automation-first)
 - Design, implement, and govern automated remediation for known failure patterns (with safe guardrails and audit trails). 
 - Maintain structured human oversight for novel scenarios and ensure continuous learning feeds back into automation. 
 - Embed reliability and operability into engineering lifecycle
 - Partner with Engineering/Architecture/Product to build operability, observability, resilience-by-design into services. 
 - Drive root-cause elimination and reduce recurrence through systemic fixes, not repetitive recovery. 
 - Change-aware resilience + risk posture
 - Own change-aware operations: use AI risk signals to anticipate failures based on historical data, dependency graphs, and weak points. 
 - Support production readiness: capacity planning, disaster recovery exercises, and disciplined change governance. 
 - Evidence, auditability, and resilience expectations
 - Ensure AI-driven systems are observable, explainable, and auditable, meeting operational and regulatory expectations. 
 - Develop and lead high performing global team, fostering strong ownership, technical depth, and a culture of accountability and continuous improvement. 

Qualifications / Competencies

- Bachelor's degree in computer science /engineering (or equivalent practical experience). 
 - 10+ years across Service Management, DevOps, SRE, Product Engineering, and/or large-scale production operations. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with observability/monitoring/telemetry platforms, focused on actionable insights and reliability outcomes. 
 - Proven experience transitioning environments from reactive support to proactive, signal-driven / AI-assisted operations. 
 - Designed/tuned/governed automation and AIOps workflows, enabling automated remediation while retaining structured human oversight for exceptions. 
 - Experience implementing change-aware operations, drift detection/correction, and data-driven reliability governance to reduce incident recurrence. 
 - AI-assisted capacity forecasting and proactive scaling for performance predictability and cost efficiency. 
 - End-to-end operational fluency: telemetry → ITSM integration → automated execution. 
 - Experience sponsoring or governing AI-assisted/autonomous operational platforms. 

Our Benefits

To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about. 

Our hybrid work model

BlackRock's hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person - aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock. 

Guidance on AI use for candidates

At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work - enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we've provided guidance on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self. 

About BlackRock

At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children's educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress. 

This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment - the one we make in our employees. It's why we're dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive. 

To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers. BlackRock. com. We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, and TikTok. 

BlackRock is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to age, disability, family status, gender identity, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation and other protected attributes at law.

data.title: Engineering Manager, Managed Gateways Infrastructure
data.description:
Are you ready to unlock intelligence?

If you don't think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box - we're looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others. 

The Mission

Kong Cloud Gateways is Kong's foundational cloud-native SaaS platform, powering its managed API and AI Gateway offerings. It provides a multi-tenant control plane, automation, and platform services that let customers securely deploy, operate, and scale dedicated gateway infrastructure with the simplicity of a fully managed cloud service. Behind that experience sits a distributed platform responsible for provisioning, fleet management, software lifecycle, zero-downtime upgrades, observability, security, and multi-region operations across globally distributed cloud infrastructure - built to a target of 99. 99% availability, balancing reliability, performance, operational excellence, and infrastructure efficiency at global SaaS scale. 

As a Software Engineering Manager for Managed Gateways Infrastructure, you will own and grow Kong's Bangalore-based engineering team, taking full accountability for this multi-tenant SaaS platform. Kong Cloud Gateways is growing 100% YoY, and as enterprises increasingly adopt AI alongside traditional APIs, this platform becomes an increasingly important part of Kong's API and AI strategy - every improvement in automation, scalability, and operational excellence you drive accelerates new platform capabilities and lets product teams innovate faster. Beyond the technical charter, you play a key role in shaping a dynamic engineering culture - one built on urgency, ownership, and first-principles thinking - as the team scales to match the pace of the business. 

This is a highly technical, hands-on leadership role - you're expected to stay close to the systems, dig into hard problems alongside your team, and not hesitate to get into the trenches when it matters. 

What You'll Do

- Own and grow Kong's Managed Gateways Infrastructure engineering team in Bangalore - scaling the team's capability, raising the technical bar, and staying hands-on in critical implementations and incidents, not just directing from a distance. 
 - Own the reliability and scalability of a multi-tenant SaaS infrastructure platform serving customers across regions and clouds - every architectural decision has to hold up under multi-tenant load, isolation, and blast-radius considerations, not just single-tenant assumptions. 
 - Drive 4-9s (99. 99%+) availability across Kong's global infrastructure footprint - owning capacity, resilience, and failure-mode design across multi-region, multi-cloud deployments (AWS, Azure, GCP) so Cloud Gateways stays up for customers everywhere, at any scale. 
 - Act as a direct technical contributor when it counts - complex incidents, architecture reviews, and high-stakes implementations that materially move the needle on Managed Gateways' growth and reliability. 
 - Lead, mentor, and grow a high-performing engineering team building and operating Kong's SaaS infrastructure for Managed Gateways, in direct support of our critical enterprise customer base globally. 
 - Architect and implement robust, scalable, and fault-tolerant cloud-native systems using technologies like Kubernetes, Golang, and major cloud providers (AWS, Azure, GCP). 
 - Own the complete operational lifecycle end-to-end - infrastructure, reliability, on-call, incident response, and blameless post-mortems - as one integrated engineering charter, not a separate function. 
 - Drive developer delight and operational efficiency through automation, self-service tooling, and streamlined workflows for deploying and managing API gateways, while proactively preventing technical debt and reducing operational toil. 
 - Define, track, and report on key SLOs and SLIs, and advocate for architectural best practices that keep Managed Gateways performant and resilient as it scales.
