Job Description

This is a remote position. 

About Embrace Finance Group

Embrace Finance Group, the financial-services division of Embrace Software Inc. , helps every institution - from regional banks to local credit unions - deliver the speed, intelligence and experience customers now expect in a digital world. Today we serve nearly 450 financial institutions and hundreds of local government agencies. 

We are building an AI-led unified financial services platform spanning digital banking, document automation, item processing and branch modernization, engineered in partnership with the Embrace AI Group. The next generation of our online banking solution is a cornerstone of that platform - and this role will lead it. 

The Role

We are hiring a Lead Engineer/ Architect (. NET), a hands-on technical leader who will accelerate the build-out of the next generation of our online banking platform for US Banks and credit unions on ASP. NET Core and C#. You will spend a significant portion of your time writing production code and owning architecture, while also mentoring engineers and setting the technical bar. 

You will partner day-to-day with Finance Group technology leaders on product and delivery, the Embrace Technology group on shared architecture, cloud and DevOps standards and Venture Labs / the Embrace AI Group to bring emerging capabilities into the platform. 

At its core this is a forward-deployed engineering (FDE) practice with an AI-first, new-product mandate. You will embed with financial institutions and internal product partners, turn ambiguous problems into shipped product and lead a small team of highly empowered, highly skilled engineers who take ideas from conceptualization to launch in weeks - not quarters. You will go full-stack from modern UX/UI through public REST APIs down to a . NET control plane and treat large language models and agentic AI services as first-class building blocks of the platform rather than bolt-ons. 

Key Responsibilities

- Architect and hands-on build the new ASP. NET Core / C# online banking platform - system design, service boundaries, data modeling and API contracts. 
 - Design and implement critical features and platform components; lead code and design reviews, setting the technical bar. 
 - Lead and mentor a small agile team - run sprints, unblock engineers, own delivery commitments, coach through 1: 1s and pair programming. 
 - Partner with Finance Group technology leaders, product, QA and security to translate business and regulatory needs into robust solutions. 
 - Collaborate with the Embrace Technology group on shared architecture, cloud and CI/CD standards and with Venture Labs / Embrace AI Group to embed AI capabilities (AI-assisted dev, predictive insights, fraud/risk monitoring) into the platform. 
 - Drive engineering best practices - testing, CI/CD and adoption of modern AI dev tools. 
 - Operate as a forward-deployed engineer - embed with internal product partners to co-design solutions, then rapidly conceptualize, prototype and launch new products, compressing concept-to-production from quarters to weeks. 
 - Lead AI-first, new-product development end-to-end - design and ship LLM- and agent-powered capabilities using services such as Google Vertex AI / Gemini, OpenAI (and Azure OpenAI) and orchestration frameworks like LangChain, with disciplined evaluation, guardrails and cost / latency management. 
 - Build full-stack and real-time - modern, accessible UX/UI, public REST APIs and live experiences via SignalR on . NET Core / C# control plane, with event-driven services through Azure Service Bus / messaging, etc. 
 - Own the cloud and delivery foundation - infrastructure-as-code with Terraform, CI/CD on GitHub (Actions) and containerized, repeatable deployments across Azure and/or AWS. 
 - Engineer security and compliance in by design - identity and access management (OAuth2 / OIDC, SSO, MFA), secrets management and data protection aligned to PCI DSS, SOC 2 and FFIEC, with auditability from day one. 
 - Build and empower the team - recruit, coach and unblock a small squad of progressive FDEs, giving them the autonomy, tooling and technical bar to ship safely and fast. 

How We Work - Forward-Deployed & AI-First

- Small, empowered squads: highly skilled FDEs own outcomes end-to-end, from conceptualization to launch, with minimal hand-offs. 
 - AI-first by default: LLMs, RAG and agentic workflows are first-class both as design tools and as product capabilities - we prototype with AI, evaluate rigorously and ship. 
 - Fast and safe: short iteration loops, trunk-based development, automated testing, infrastructure-as-code and progressive delivery behind feature flags. 
 - Polyglot pragmatism: . NET / C# anchors the control plane; we use the best-fit language or service elsewhere and optimize for outcomes, not dogma. 

Our Stack & Tooling

- Control plane & services: . NET (ASP. NET Core, C#), public REST APIs, SignalR for real-time, Azure Service Bus for messaging and eventing. 
 - AI & LLM: Google Vertex AI / Gemini, OpenAI / Azure OpenAI, LangChain and similar orchestration; vector stores, RAG, plus evaluation and guardrail tooling. 
 - Cloud & platform: Azure and/or AWS, Terraform for IaC, GitHub + GitHub Actions for CI/CD and containers. 
 - Front-end: modern, accessible UX/UI (Angular / React). 
 - Identity, security & compliance: IAM (OAuth2 / OIDC, SSO, MFA), secrets management, PCI DSS, SOC 2 and FFIEC. 
 - Data: Microsoft SQL Server today, with modern data stores adopted as the platform evolves. 

Requirements

- 5+ years building modern, data-intensive . NET web applications, with a proven tech-lead / lead-developer track record and direct team ownership. 
 - Polyglot. Expert-level C# and . NET (Framework and modern . NET / Core); strong SQL and Microsoft SQL Server; solid REST API experience at scale. 
 - Proven experience in financial services / online banking, with strong preference for platforms serving US Banks, credit unions, or other regulated FIs. 
 - Front-end experience with modern Javascript/UI frameworks like Angular / React. Familiarity with classic frameworks like ASP. NET, Razor templates, Htmx, Bootstrap, Orchard Core, etc is a strong plus for modernizing. 
 - Experience with cloud (Azure, AWS), DevOps and CI/CD; understanding of US banking security and compliance (PCI DSS, SOC 2, FFIEC guidance). 
 - Strong communicator across engineering and business stakeholders (Finance Group, Embrace Technology, Venture Labs); excellent ownership and problem-solving. 
 - Comfortable in a highly remote, fast-paced, agile environment. Bachelor's in CS, Software Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience). 
 - Demonstrated 0→1 product delivery at speed - ideally in a forward-deployed, customer-embedded, or startup / venture environment. 
 - Hands-on AI/LLM application development - prompt and context engineering, RAG and agentic patterns on at least one major platform (Vertex AI / Gemini, OpenAI, or Azure OpenAI) with orchestration such as LangChain and a pragmatic grasp of evaluation, guardrails and cost. 
 - Real-time and event-driven experience - SignalR, Azure Service Bus or equivalent messaging - and public REST API design at scale. 
 - Strong platform / DevOps depth - Terraform (IaC), GitHub Actions CI/CD, containerization and multi-cloud (Azure and/or AWS). 
 - Identity, security and compliance depth for regulated FIs - IAM / OAuth2 / OIDC, SSO / MFA, secrets management and PCI DSS / SOC 2 / FFIEC. 

Benefits

- Competitive salary commensurate with experience; 100% remote with autonomy. 
 - Career advancement across the Embrace portfolio; the chance to shape a platform used by hundreds of US banks and credit unions with the Embrace AI Group and Venture Labs. 
 - A high-autonomy, AI-first engineering culture where small teams of empowered FDEs take ideas from concept to launch - and see them used by hundreds of US banks and credit unions.

data.title: Manager, Network and Infrastructure Reliability
data.description:
Join us in bringing joy to customer experience. Five9 is a leading provider of cloud contact center software, bringing the power of cloud innovation to customers worldwide. 

Living our values everyday results in our team-first culture and enables us to innovate, grow, and thrive while enjoying the journey together. We celebrate diversity and foster an inclusive environment, empowering our employees to be their authentic selves. 

Five9 is rebuilding the operational leadership for its Network & Infrastructure team and needs a hands-on, senior technical manager to take direct ownership of the environment and the team executing the work. 

The right candidate will have directly managed production networks at scale, led teams of engineers who build and maintain those systems, and successfully transitioned frontline operations from manual "click-ops" into automated, code-driven execution. If you have not personally managed engineering teams through this specific transition, this is not the right role. 

Modernization is already underway, but the current engineering team is short-handed and lacks several critical skills. The person stepping into this role must stabilize daily operations quickly, assess the existing talent, and immediately begin rebuilding both the team and the operating workflows against clear, sprint-level, and measurable milestones. 

This is a true player-coach role. You must stay close enough to the technical work to keep your engineering judgment sharp, maintain credibility with senior engineers, and be willing to set the standard by example on the keyboard when needed. At the same time, you must focus on building automated validation gates and upskilling your team so that you can step out of the daily critical path. Carrying a portion of the senior technical load to stabilize the team at the outset is expected; still operating as the primary technical bottle-neck six months in is a failure. 

What Success Looks Like In Your First 120 Days

- A working map of the network and infrastructure estate across our DCs and our cloud footprint, plus a clear assessment of your team's capabilities and operational bottlenecks. 
 - A team skills assessment and a tactical execution plan that details how your team will transition from manual operations to infrastructure/network-as-code, automation, and drift control, balanced against current project deliverables. 
 - Key engineering hires onboarded successfully, with existing team members actively engaged in cross-training and upskilling programs. 
 - Early modernization wins visible in production, the on-call and incident load distributed fairly across the team, and you have successfully transitioned from tactical firefighting to guiding team execution. 

What You Bring To Five9

- A track record of building and leading cohesive teams, raising engineering standards, and shifting daily operations from reactive to proactive, engineering-led execution. 
 - Experience stabilizing operations and guiding engineering teams through periods of technical change and modernization. 
 - Strong communication skills backed by operational data, clear risk articulation, and the ability to report measurable outcomes to department leadership. 
 - Proven ability to build trust, accountability, and a high-performance culture within your engineering team. 
 - Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, with experience partnering closely with software engineering, security, SRE, and product teams. 
 - Ability to mentor and develop senior engineers and technical leads, driving accountability while establishing clear ownership, operational discipline, and career growth pathways. 
 - Strong decision-making and prioritization skills in high-pressure production environments with competing operational demands. 
 - Demonstrated ability to lead teams through ambiguity, align team goals with broader department objectives, and execute complex technical migrations. 
 - Effective conflict resolution and stakeholder management skills to align technical delivery with business needs. 
 - Strong operational judgment in network and infrastructure security, with the ability to partner effectively with Security Operations teams. 

What We Require

- 7+ years of experience in network/infrastructure engineering, with 3+ years directly managing engineering teams in mission-critical, multi-DC production environments. 
 - Deep technical background in modern DC networking, including OSPF, EVPN, VXLAN, Cisco Nexus, and NX-OS. 
 - Experience managing infrastructure in a hybrid cloud environment, with a strong focus on supporting GCP workloads. 
 - Proven success guiding teams to build and adopt network automation and IaC using tools such as Ansible, Terraform, Python, Git, and CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Hands-on experience modernizing legacy environments by introducing configuration management, drift detection, and policy-based operations where they didn't exist before. 
 - Strong understanding of network and infrastructure observability using tools such as ThousandEyes, Grafana, Loki, NetFlow, and Netscout to achieve a "single pane of glass" for system health. 
 - Experience supporting the underlying infrastructure needs of Kubernetes, AI, and GPU workloads. 
 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience). 

Workplace location: This role is fully remote for candidates who reside further than a 30 kilometer driving distance from either our Bangalore or Chennai offices. Candidates who reside within a 30 kilometer driving distance of one of our office locations would be required to work in-office 3 days a week. 

Five9 embraces diversity and is committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. The more inclusive we are, the better we are. Five9 is an equal opportunity employer. 

Five9 is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities throughout the application and interview process. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please contact us at accommodations@five9. com to request an accommodation. Requests will be handled confidentially and in accordance with applicable law.

data.title: Engineering Manager, Accounting Products
data.description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career. 

About The Team

Stripe's Revenue & Financial Management group is building new products that expand the scope of problems we tackle beyond payments into Revenue Management, Financial Operations and analytics. Right now this includes products like Billing, Invoicing, Revenue Recognition, Reconciliation and the underlying platform for batch and real time processing of large scale financial data to power these solutions. These solutions are going to be key pillars for Stripe's growing SaaS business and a major revenue stream. 

What you'll do

We are seeking an experienced engineering manager to lead the team building the foundation for accounting system and user-facing product features that will streamline and automate accrual accounting for Stripe customers. 

Responsibilities

- Lead your team of talented engineers to solve data engineering challenges at scale and deliver a high level of technical and operational excellence
 - Collaborate with product managers and talk to directly to customers to drive a high-impact, prioritized roadmap for your team
 - Recruit, coach, mentor, develop, and grow engineers on your team
 - Be deeply involved in launching new product features and capabilities
 - Partner with engineers and product managers across Stripe to ensure your features are integrated into the Stripe suite
 - Contribute to engineering initiatives across the Revenue and Finance Automation (RFA) organization and across Stripe as a member of Stripe's engineering management team

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement. 

Minimum Requirements

- 5+ years of engineering management experience and 10+ years of overall experience in the industry. 
 - Successfully led high-complexity teams, working in parallel on multiple high-impact areas. 
 - Works very well cross-functionally, and is able to think rigorously and make hard decisions and tradeoffs. 
 - Thrives on a high level of autonomy and responsibility. 
 - Encourages a healthy work environment that's both supportive and challenging and enables engineers to do their best work. 
 - Strong technical background and hands-on experience in solving large scale and difficult technical problems. 
 - Values and enjoys working with a diverse group of people with different expertise. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Familiarity with large scale distributed systems or big data processing systems. 
 - Experience working in high-growth teams similar to Stripe. 
 - Experience building financial systems or tools for financial experts. 
 - Experience with accounting procedures or systems

In-office expectations

Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible. 

Pay and benefits

Stripe does not yet include pay ranges in job postings in every country. Stripe strongly values pay transparency and is working toward pay transparency globally. 

We look forward to hearing from you. 

At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out-and set you apart-especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us. 

Apply now

We are seeking 2 Lead AI Engineers with deep expertise in agentic systems architecture and production LLM deployments. In this role, you will design and ship multi-agent pipelines, advanced RAG architectures, and tool-orchestration layers tailored for life sciences, pharma commercial analytics, and medical affairs workflows.  - Frameworks & SDKs: Hands-on proficiency with agentic frameworks (LangGraph, LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI) and direct SDK usage of Anthropic Claude API, OpenAI Assistants API, or Vertex AI Agent Builder. 
 - Vector Stores & RAG: Expertise with vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, pgvector), hybrid search, and evaluation frameworks (RAGAS). 
 - Domain Context: Exposure to regulated data environments (HIPAA, GxP, 21 CFR Part 11) and pharma commercial data (Rx/claims, medical affairs, or clinical ops).

 - Opportunity to work at the bleeding edge of agentic AI and Model Context Protocol (MCP) in the life sciences sector.

products, platforms, and services.

Requirements

Job Description

We are seeking a Principal Engineer II to lead the architecture and development of our SaaS

control plane for media products. This is a leadership role where you will set technical direction, 

mentor engineers, and ensure the platform scales securely and reliably across tenants, users, and

resources. 

You should have

CloudWatch

SCIM)

acceptable)

distributed tracing)

tooling, and ability to guide teams in AI integration

 - Authentication & Authorization
 - API Gateway & Service Mesh

service accounts, API keys), entitlement/subscription enforcement

- Own onboarding flows end-to-end: account creation, identity setup, resource

provisioning, and readiness

- Design APIs and async workflows with resilience, failure handling, and graceful retries

operational automation

make on-call manageable

- Collaborate across teams (auth, database, platform) to deliver secure, consistent

features

- Operational excellence: contribute to runbooks, alerts, and iterative improvements to

reduce toil

- Mentor engineers in cloud-native patterns, API gateway plugin design, and SaaS

data.title: Staff SRE for K8s Platform Team (AWS, Kubernetes, Platform Creation, Helm, Karpenter, Istio)
data.description:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence. 

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk. 

Workforce Identity Cloud
Okta Workforce Identity Cloud (WIC) provides easy, secure access for your workforce so you can focus on other strategic priorities, such as reducing costs and doing more for your customers. 
If you like to be challenged and have a passion for solving large-scale automation, testing, and tuning problems, we would love to hear from you. The ideal candidate is someone who exemplifies the ethics of, "If you have to do something more than once, automate it" and who can rapidly self-educate on new concepts and tools. 
Position Overview: 
The Staff Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) will play a key role in building and managing Kubernetes platforms that support cloud-native applications and services. This position focuses on architecting and managing reliable, scalable, and secure Kubernetes-based platforms on AWS, ensuring high availability and performance while optimising costs and automation. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with AWS infrastructure, Kubernetes platform creation, Helm charts, Karpenter scaling, and Istio service mesh. 
Key Responsibilities: 
 - Kubernetes Platform Creation: Design, implement, and maintain highly available, scalable, and fault-tolerant Kubernetes platforms. Ensure clusters are optimised for production workloads, providing high resilience and operational efficiency. 
 - AWS Infrastructure Management: Build, manage, and optimise AWS cloud infrastructure, including EKS, ECS, S3, VPCS, RDS, IAM, and more. Implement best practices for cost management, scaling, and security within AWS. 
 - Helm Management: Utilise Helm to automate and streamline the deployment of applications and services to Kubernetes clusters. Create, maintain, and manage Helm charts for production-ready deployments. 
 - Karpenter Implementation: Implement and manage Karpenter to dynamically scale Kubernetes clusters in response to workload demands.   
 - Istio Service Mesh Management: Configure and manage Istio to provide service-to-service communication, security, and observability within the Kubernetes clusters. Enable fine-grained traffic management, service discovery, and policy enforcement. 
 - Platform Automation & Scaling: Automate the deployment, scaling, and management of infrastructure and applications. Work with CI/CD pipelines to ensure a seamless flow from development to production with minimal downtime. 
 - Incident Management & Troubleshooting: Respond to incidents, troubleshoot, and resolve system issues related to performance, availability, and security in a timely and effective manner. 
 - Security & Compliance: Design and implement secure cloud infrastructure with appropriate access controls, network security, and compliance frameworks. 
 - Documentation & Knowledge Sharing: Create and maintain detailed documentation for Kubernetes platform setup, operational procedures, and best practices. Promote knowledge sharing across teams. Required Qualifications: 
 - 5+ years of experience with Kubernetes/ K8s, Helm, Karpenter, Istio; 
 - 8+ years of Experience with infrastructure-as-code tools like Terraform, Chef or  Ansible
 - 8+ years of Experience with serverless computing (AWS Lambda, API Gateway) and microservices architecture. 
 - Proven experience with AWS (EKS, ECS, RDS, S3, CloudFormation, IAM, etc. ) and solid understanding of cloud-native architectures. 
 - Strong expertise in Kubernetes platform creation, management, and optimisation (e. g. , setting up highly available clusters, networking, and storage). 
 - Hands-on experience with Helm for Kubernetes application deployment and management. 
 - Practical experience with Karpenter for dynamic scaling of Kubernetes clusters and optimising resource usage. 
 - Expertise in managing and securing Istio for service mesh, including traffic management, security, and observability features. 
 - Proficiency in CI/CD pipelines and automation tools (e. g. , Jenkins, GitLab, CircleCI, Terraform, Spinnaker, Ansible). 
 - Strong scripting and automation skills in Python or Go for infrastructure management and platform automation. 
 - Experience with monitoring, logging, and alerting tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, CloudWatch, and ELK Stack. Preferred Qualifications: 
 - Experience with multi-region cloud environments. 
 - Understanding of security best practices for cloud platforms and Kubernetes (e. g. , role-based access control (RBAC), encryption, and compliance frameworks). 
 - Familiarity with Docker and containerization principles. 
 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent professional experience). 
 - Certifications (Preferred): CKA (Certified Kubernetes Administrator), CKAD (Certified Kubernetes Application Developer), or AWS Certified DevOps Engineer are highly desirable.

Cloud infrastructure group at Barco is committed to provide business scalability while consolidating cloud resources and enabling a variety of Barco services to share the same infrastructure without compromising each other's data. data.title: Java And React Full Stack Developer
data.description:
Company Description MindVora Solution is a technology-driven IT services and digital engineering company that helps organizations access skilled technology professionals and scalable engineering capabilities. The company supports businesses that need additional technology capacity, niche expertise, or flexible resources for ongoing and new initiatives across India and international locations. MindVora Solution's core strengths include Java, Spring Boot, microservices, Python, full stack development, cloud (AWS/Azure), data engineering, analytics, AI/ML, DevOps, QA, and cybersecurity. The organization also provides specialized support in FinTech and capital markets technologies such as Calypso and Murex, and collaborates with enterprises, GCCs, FinTechs, IT services firms, consulting companies, and system integrators. MindVora Solution focuses on resource augmentation and vendor partnerships to deliver high-quality engineering support tailored to client requirements. 
Role Description This is a full-time, on-site Java and React Full Stack Developer role based in Hyderabad. The developer will design, develop, and maintain end-to-end web applications using Java, Spring Boot, microservices on the back end and React on the front end. Daily responsibilities include writing clean, maintainable code, implementing responsive user interfaces, integrating APIs, and ensuring application performance, security, and scalability. The role involves collaborating with product owners, designers, and other engineers, participating in code reviews, troubleshooting issues, and supporting deployment and release activities. The developer will also contribute to technical documentation and continuous improvement of development processes and best practices. 
Qualifications

- Strong back-end web development skills in Java, Spring Boot, and microservices, with experience in designing and implementing RESTful APIs. 
 - Front-end development skills using React, JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML, and Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) for building responsive, user-friendly interfaces.

In Microsoft 365 Copilot, we are reimagining search with AI. data.title: Senior Software Development Engineer
data.description:
Razorpay is one of India's leading full-stack financial technology companies, powering the way businesses move, manage, and grow money. Founded in 2014 by Harshil Mathur and Shashank Kumar with a simple vision - to simplify payments for Indian businesses - we've since grown into a fintech powerhouse driving India's digital payment revolution. 

Razorpay powers millions of businesses with a smarter, scalable stack that goes beyond transactions to help them truly build and grow. 

From building AI-native agentic payments, to AI-assisted fraud detection and real-time risk intelligence to automated reconciliation, smart payouts, and predictive financial insights, we are embedding intelligence across our stack to make money movement faster, safer, and more efficient. In close collaboration with ecosystem partners - including banks, networks, regulators - we are pioneering industry-first solutions that are shaping the next era of fintech

Across India, Singapore and Malaysia, our products span everything from seamless checkouts to payroll automation - powering a fintech ecosystem that's redefining how money moves across Asia. 

Today, that ecosystem supports everyone from early-stage startups to some of India's largest enterprises, enabling them to accept, process, and disburse payments at scale while expanding into new ways of managing money more efficiently. 

Our scale speaks volumes: Razorpay processes $180+ billion in annualized transactions, powering leading businesses like Airbnb, Facebook, WhatsApp, Airtel, CRED, BookmyShow, Zomato, Swiggy, Lenskart, Mirae Asset Capital markets, Indian Oil, National Pension Scheme - and over 100 of India's unicorns. With strong roots in India and growing operations in Southeast Asia, we are shaping the next chapter of financial technology across the region. 

We are backed by global investors including GIC, Peak XV Partners (formerly Sequoia Capital India & SEA), Tiger Global, Ribbit Capital, Matrix Partners, MasterCard, and Salesforce Ventures, having raised over $740 million to date. Strategic acquisitions - including Ezetap (POS and offline payments), Curlec (Malaysia expansion), BillMe (digital invoicing), and POP (rewards-first UPI) - along with earlier moves in fraud prevention, payroll, and lending, have further strengthened our platform and widened our footprint across Asia. 

But what truly sets Razorpay apart is our culture. At Razorpay, ownership is our oxygen - you own what you build, with no micromanagement or red tape, just the runway to make your ideas fly. Learning is a lifestyle - if you're curious, you'll feel at home here. People > Pedigree - we hire for attitude, hustle, and hunger more than degrees. Transparency thrives over titles - this is where interns question CXOs and CXOs say "thank you. " Guided by our values of Customer First, Autonomy & Ownership, Agility with Integrity, Transparency, Challenging the status quo and a strong belief that Razorpay grows with Razors, you'll be part of a 3000+ strong team building not just products, but the financial infrastructure of the future. 

About The Role

A Senior SDE at Razorpay is well-grounded - smart, quality-focused, product-thinking, and business-conscious. Not a mere coder. You bring strong technical context and the experience to build software that matters at scale. Engineering at Razorpay creates significant impact across the payments ecosystem. You are expected to influence the culture of the company - bring conviction, challenge the status quo, set the bar, and help the team grow. We are looking for engineers who are current - not just technically strong, but actively working in AI-augmented workflows. At Razorpay, AI is not a feature we are building toward - it is part of how we build today. 

What You Will Build

- Scale Razorpay's payment infrastructure to get every Indian to pay online
 - Shape REST APIs used by developers worldwide
 - Contribute to open source and set standards for mobile payments
 - Drive product and design discussions - not just implement them
 - Brainstorm and create new directions in Razorpay's quest to make online payments easy and accessible to all

What We Are Looking For

- 3+ years of experience in technology
 - Strong product design sense - you think about the user, not just the implementation
 - Proficiency in any of: PHP, Python, Django, Golang, Java, or C++
 - Ability to understand end-user requirements, formulate use cases, and arrive at effective solutions
 - Good understanding of REST APIs and the web in general
 - Ability to build a feature from scratch and drive it to completion independently
 - Willingness to learn new technology - whatever lets you deliver the best product
 - Clean, well-structured code as a default - with awareness of performance and time complexity trade-offs

AI Fluency We Expect

- Hands-on experience with AI coding assistants - you use them actively, not occasionally
 - Ability to decompose problems into structured, constrained prompts with clear expected outcomes
 - Critical review mindset - you own every line of AI-generated code, spot hallucinations, incorrect assumptions, and security gaps
 - Strong LLD depth before agent use - you design first, delegate second
 - Awareness of where AI helps and where it fails - and the judgment to know the difference

Why This Role Is Different

- Most companies say they want engineers who care about product. We actually mean it. You will influence product direction from day one - not just implement specs. 
 - No whiteboard coding. No obscure algorithm puzzles. Every round mirrors what you would actually do at Razorpay. If you have been doing the same thing for two years and want a reset - this role will challenge you in ways that are hard to find elsewhere. 

Good to Have

- Weekend side projects or contributions to open source on GitHub
 - Prior experience at a product company
 - Hands-on experience building with LLMs or agentic frameworks
 - Working knowledge of a backend programming language beyond your primary stack
 - Experience designing systems for scalability, reliability, and fault tolerance

Razorpay believes in and follows an equal employment opportunity policy that doesn't discriminate on gender, religion, sexual orientation, colour, nationality, age, etc. We welcome interests and applications from all groups and communities across the globe. 

Follow us on LinkedIn & Twitter

data.description:
Why Pythian

At Pythian, we are experts in strategic database and analytics services, driving digital transformation and operational excellence. Pythian, a multinational company, was founded in 1997 and started by ensuring the reliability and performance of mission-critical databases. We quickly earned a reputation for solving tough data challenges. We were there when the industry moved from on-premises to cloud environments, and as enterprises sought more from their data, we expanded our competencies to include advanced analytics. 

Today, we empower organizations to embrace transformation and leverage advanced technologies, including AI, to stay competitive. We deliver innovative solutions that meet each client's data goals and have built strong partnerships with Google Cloud, AWS, Microsoft, Oracle, SAP, and Snowflake. The powerful combination of our extensive expertise in data and cloud and our ability to keep on top of the latest bleeding edge technologies make us the perfect partner to help mid and large-sized businesses transform to stay ahead in today's rapidly changing digital economy. 

Why You

Do you thrive on solving tough problems-even under pressure? Are you motivated by fast-paced environments with continuous learning opportunities? Do you enjoy collaborating with a team of peers who push you to constantly up your game?

At Pythian, we are building a next-generation Site Reliability Engineering team. We need motivated and talented individuals on our teams, and we want you!

You'll act as a technology leader, advisor for our clients, and mentor for other team members. Projects would include infrastructure architecture, automation, and intelligent monitoring systems from design through implementation. If you Love Your Data and want to Love Your Career, this could be the job for you!

If this is you, and you wonder what it would be like to work at Pythian, reach out to us and find out!

Intrigued to see what a life is like at Pythian? Check out #pythianlife on LinkedIn and follow @loveyourdata on Instagram!

Not the right job for you? Check out what other great jobs Pythian has open around the world! Pythian Careers

What You Will Be Doing

- Operate, maintain, and administer solutions contributing to customer infrastructure's operational efficiency, availability, and visibility. 
 - Planning maintenance activity, design documentation, and standard procedures
 - Provide Root Cause Analysis reports for outages/incidents (ITIL - Problem Management)
 - Observe and provide feedback on the current state of the client's infrastructure, and identify opportunities to improve resiliency, reduce incident occurrence, and automate repetitive administrative and operational tasks. 
 - Contribute to, improve, and maintain team documentation about client systems and infrastructure, procedures, policies, and schedules. 
 - Gather and document information about client environments through audit activities, and analyze the information to identify opportunities for improvement and application of best practices. 
 - Work collaboratively with teammates to contribute to the continuous improvement of our working culture. 
 - Act as a technology leader for clients, as well as drive client discussions on technology road maps. 
 - Participate in an on-call rotation in an escalation capacity. 

What We Need From You

- Experience working with Google (necessary) and AWS Clouds (including infrastructure as code deployment with Cloud Formation, Terraform, Opsworks, etc)
 - Scripting and automation of administrative tasks using Python and Scala is a must
 - Solid understanding of microservices architecture and container technologies (Kubernetes is a must, Docker, lxc, etc)
 - Clear understanding of software development lifecycles and best practices from an infrastructure point of view (PRs, merge, rebase, etc)
 - Understanding the end-to-end operations of a 'Business System' vs components. 
 - Comprehensive systems hardware and network troubleshooting experience
 - Common Linux distribution platform installation, configuration, performance tuning, and cloud migration. 
 - TCP/IP networking, NIC bonding, and network services configuration (DNS, NTP, DHCP, SMTP, etc)
 - Operation and administration of virtual infrastructure, including experience with at least one hypervisor (VMware, Hyper-V, KVM, etc. )
 - Ability to describe IaaS, PaaS, SaaS, pros and cons of each, use cases for virtualization and cloud
 - Administration of web servers and supporting technologies, including network load balancers
 - Experience with the design, development, and deployment of Puppet
 - System and application error investigation, troubleshooting of access/availability issues including deep multi-system root cause analysis
 - Experience managing networking devices, such as switches and firewalls from a variety of vendors
 - Solid understanding of DevOps tools, processes, and culture
 - Ability to pick up new technologies quickly
 - Ability to provide accurate work scheduling and task estimations for work delivery

What You Will Receive

- Love your career: Competitive total rewards package. Blog during work hours; take a day off and volunteer for your favorite charity. 
 - Love your work/life balance: Flexibly work remotely from your home, there's no daily travel requirement to an office! All you need is a stable internet connection. 
 - Love your coworkers: Collaborate with some of the best and brightest in the industry!
 - Love your development: Hone your skills or learn new ones with our substantial training allowance; participate in professional development days, attend training, become certified, whatever you like! 
 - Love your workspace: We give you all the equipment you need to work from home including a laptop with your choice of OS, and an annual budget to personalize your work environment! 
 - Love yourself: Pythian cares about the health and well-being of our team. You will have an annual wellness budget to make yourself a priority (use it on gym memberships, massages, fitness and more). Additionally, you will receive a generous amount of paid vacation and sick days, as well as a day off to volunteer for your favorite charity. 

Hiring Disclaimer

- The successful applicant will need to fulfill the requirements necessary to obtain a background check. 
 - Accommodations are available upon request for candidates taking part in any aspect of the selection process. 

AI Disclaimer

Pythian may utilize Enterprise Generative Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools or features throughout its hiring process. These tools help us manage high volumes of applications efficiently and may be employed to review applications, analyze resumes, and assist with other recruitment steps. While Pythian uses AI in its hiring process, it does not substitute for human judgment. Our Talent Acquisition Team reviews all AI-generated recommendations, and the system is subject to regular bias audits to ensure fairness and compliance with all applicable employment and human rights laws. All final hiring decisions are made by, and remain the responsibility of, human decision-makers. By applying for this position, you consent to Pythian's use of these AI tools in the evaluation of your application. You have the right to request a human review of any solely AI-driven decision or to request an accommodation. Should you require further details regarding the processing of your data, please reach out to us.

Training & Development

Ensure project teams are well-versed in quality assurance processes, industry best practices, and compliance standards. 

Develop a culture of quality ownership among site engineers and supervisors. 

Financial Accountability For Quality Compliance

data.description:
When you join Verizon

You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely - even if they're daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love - driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together - lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere & always. Want in? Join the #VTeamLife. 

What You'll Be Doing. . . 

Type of Work: Highly technical, code-driven, and execution-focused. The daily focus is on accelerating the pre-sales cycle by building automated demo labs, scripting repetitive sales engineering tasks (like BOM generation and RFP parsing), and showcasing network automation capabilities to enterprise customers. 

Expected Volumes: High volume of scripting, API integration, and lab management. You will maintain internal code repositories, write Infrastructure as Code (IaC) templates, manage automated demonstration portals, and execute high-speed Proof of Concepts (PoCs) concurrently. 

Risk & Criticality: Moderate commercial risk. You are the technical automation engine for the team. While senior architects design the overarching telecom solutions, your code directly dictates how fast and effectively those solutions can be demonstrated and quoted. Broken scripts or failed API calls during a live demo can derail customer confidence and stall the sales cycle. 

What We're Looking For. . . 

- Pre-Sales Workflow Automation: Write scripts to eliminate manual pre-sales bottlenecks. Automate the generation of Bill of Materials (BOMs) by querying CPQ APIs, automate network diagramming, and use data parsing to accelerate RFP/RFI responses. 
 - Zero-Touch Provisioning (ZTP) Demonstrations: Build and maintain the scripts used in live customer pitches. You will help senior architects show (not just tell) customers how easily our telecom network can be provisioned and managed via APIs. 
 - API & Systems Integration: Serve as the team's API expert. Connect disparate pre-sales tools (e. g. , Salesforce, CPQ, vendor portals, and internal lab hypervisors) to create a seamless, automated workflow for the Solutions Architecture team. 
 - NetDevOps Handoff: Revolutionize the pre-sales-to-delivery handoff. Instead of handing over Word documents, package your successful solution design as Git repositories, JSON payloads, and Ansible playbooks for the Implementation team to deploy instantly. 
 - Foundational Network Support: Understand the basics of the telecom and networking equipment you are automating (IP addressing, routing basics, firewalls) just enough to successfully write the code that provisions them. 

You'll Need To Have

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field. 
 - 2 to 4 years of hands-on experience in network automation, scripting, DevOps, or a heavily automated systems engineering role. 
 - Automation & Scripting: High proficiency in Python. Deep understanding of how to interact with RESTful APIs, manage authentication (OAuth, API keys), and parse data formats like JSON, YAML, and XML. 
 - Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Hands-on experience with configuration management and provisioning tools such as Ansible, Terraform, or Nornir. 
 - Version Control: Comfortable using Git and collaborative platforms like GitHub or GitLab to manage and document your code. 
 - Experience integrating or building with LLM APIs (Anthropic Claude, OpenAI) to automate internal workflows, such as parsing dense technical RFPs or auto-generating technical documentation. 

Even better if you have one or more of the following: 

- Industry certifications focused on automation, such as Cisco DevNet Associate, AWS Certified Developer, or HashiCorp Certified: Terraform Associate. 
 - Experience with CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitLab CI) applied to network infrastructure (NetDevOps). 
 - Basic Networking Context: Must understand foundational networking concepts (OSI model, IP Subnetting, basic routing, and what a firewall does) to know what your scripts are automating. 

Where you'll be working

In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes work from home and assigned office days set by your manager. 

Scheduled Weekly Hours

40

Equal Employment Opportunity

Verizon is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, gender, disability or any other legally protected characteristics.

data.title: Senior QA Engineer
data.description:
About Us

We're rebuilding vertical software with AI - from the inside. 

Embrace owns the software running inside 16% of the Fortune 500, 45+ state agencies, and 450+ banks and credit unions. We acquire entrenched vertical software businesses and rebuild them around AI - products, operations, go-to-market, all of it. Our Venture Lab launches new AI-native products into those same markets, using the distribution and customer relationships our portfolio already owns. 

You'll ship AI into production against real workflows, real customers, and a P&L you can see move within a quarter. 

We hire people who want scope, speed, and ownership, and who are tired of working on AI that never reaches a customer. If you want to spend the next five years shipping into software that already runs the economy, talk to us. 

Job Description

This is a remote position. 

Embrace Healthcare Group powers some of the most innovative healthcare technology solutions in North America, with a focus on enhancing clinical efficiency and compliance across emergency care settings. 

EPOWERdoc, a leading SaaS platform within the Embrace Healthcare Group portfolio, specializes in Emergency Department Information Systems (EDIS) tailored for hospitals of all sizes. Designed by clinicians for clinicians, EPOWERdoc streamlines emergency room documentation with intuitive workflows, customizable templates, peer-reviewed clinical content, and real-time coding assistance-helping providers reduce documentation time and focus more on patient care. 

We're looking for a Senior QA Engineer to build EPOWERdoc's next-generation quality engineering practice, AI-native from day one. This is a hands-on builder role: you'll choose and architect our test automation stack, write much of the code yourself, and use AI coding agents every day to design, generate, maintain, and triage tests. 

You'll also own how we test AI itself. You'll design the evaluation harnesses and guardrails that show EPOWERdoc's AI-powered capabilities are accurate, safe, and dependable enough for an emergency department. You'll partner closely with developers, product managers, designers, and clinical content experts. 

Key Responsibilities: 

- Lead QA strategy: Own the end-to-end quality strategy for EPOWERdoc, defining test plans, risk-based coverage goals, and quality gates for every release. 
 - Architect the QA tech stack: Evaluate, select, and document the tooling for UI, API, performance, accessibility, and security testing, recording each decision and its trade-offs in architecture decision records. 
 - Build automation and expand coverage: Design and maintain scalable test frameworks for web applications, APIs, and integrations. Set standards clear enough that engineers and AI agents can extend them reliably. Use these frameworks to replace manual regression with automated coverage of critical clinical workflows such as triage, documentation, orders, and discharge. 
 - Performance and reliability: Build load, stress, and soak tests that model real emergency department peak volumes, establish performance baselines, and catch regressions before they reach production. 
 - Own CI/CD quality: Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines so every pull request and build is validated quickly. Use parallel execution and AI-assisted test impact analysis to keep feedback loops short as the suite grows. 
 - Defect management: Work with engineering teams to identify, document, prioritise, and resolve defects early in the development lifecycle, and drive root-cause analysis. 
 - Exploratory testing: Lead exploratory testing of new features and complex clinical user flows, combining human judgement with AI-driven exploration where automation alone adds less value. 
 - Agile partnership: Bring a quality perspective to sprint planning, refinement, and retrospectives, including estimates, acceptance criteria, and release readiness. 
 - Quality advocacy: Champion a quality-first culture from code reviews to release management. Report on quality metrics and trends such as escaped defects, flakiness, and test cycle time. 
 - Security and compliance: Ensure testing practices, test data, and the use of AI tools meet HIPAA and healthcare data security standards, with no real PHI in test environments or AI prompts. 

AI-NATIVE QUALITY ENGINEERING

AI is part of how this team works every day. In this role you will: 

- AI-assisted test design: Use LLMs to turn user stories, acceptance criteria, and clinical specifications into test scenarios, edge cases, and boundary conditions, then review and sharpen them with sound test-design judgement. 
 - Agentic test authoring: Use AI coding agents and Playwright's MCP server and test agents (planner, generator, and healer) to create and maintain automated tests. Hold generated code to the same review and quality bar as production code. 
 - Self-healing and failure triage: Apply AI to locator healing, flaky-test detection, and automated failure analysis: clustering failures, summarising likely root causes, and routing defects to the right owner. 
 - Synthetic test data: Make realistic, PHI-free synthetic patient records and clinical scenarios the default for functional, performance, and AI evaluation testing, using tools such as Synthea or LLM-driven generators. 
 - Testing AI features: Design evaluation frameworks for AI-powered EPOWERdoc capabilities. These include golden datasets, scoring rubrics, LLM-as-judge grading calibrated against human review, and regression gates that run whenever a model, prompt, or knowledge source changes. 
 - AI safety and guardrails: Test AI features for hallucination, clinical and coding accuracy, bias, PHI leakage, prompt injection, and graceful failure. Work with clinical experts to define what "good enough for the ED" means in measurable terms. 
 - Measure and share impact: Track how AI changes test authoring time and maintenance effort, and share what works with other Embrace engineering teams. 

THE STACK YOU'LL SHAPE

This is our starting point, not a mandate. You'll own the final decisions and the reasoning behind them. 

- UI and end-to-end: Playwright with TypeScript, including visual regression and automated accessibility checks (axe-core). 
 - API and integration: Playwright API testing, contract testing (for example Pact), and validation of HL7 and FHIR interfaces. 
 - Performance: Locust or k6 for load, stress, and soak testing. 
 - Security: OWASP ZAP and dependency scanning in CI, plus the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications as the baseline for AI features. 
 - AI tooling: AI coding agents (such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or Cursor), Playwright MCP and test agents, and LLM evaluation frameworks such as Promptfoo, DeepEval, or Ragas, with tracing through Langfuse or LangSmith. 
 - CI/CD and reporting: Tests running on every pull request, with Allure or a similar dashboard for trends, flakiness, and release readiness. WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

- First 30 days: You understand EPOWERdoc's clinical workflows, existing test assets, and release process. You've proposed the target QA stack and AI-native approach as written architecture decision records. 
 - By 90 days: Playwright smoke and regression suites cover the most critical clinical workflows and run on every pull request. A performance baseline exists for peak load. AI-assisted test authoring is in daily use with measured results. 
 - By 6 months: Manual regression effort is a small fraction of today's. Flaky tests are tracked and trending down. An evaluation harness gates every release of AI-powered features. 

Requirements

- Experience: 5+ years of professional QA or software testing experience, including at least 3 years building test automation, ideally in a SaaS or web application environment. 
 - QA foundations: Solid understanding of QA methodologies, risk-based testing, test design techniques, and software development life cycles. 
 - Programming: Strong coding skills in TypeScript or JavaScript and working proficiency in Python. You write test code with the same care as production code. 
 - Test automation: Hands-on experience with modern automation tools, with Playwright strongly preferred (Cypress or Selenium also considered). This includes building scalable frameworks from the ground up, managing test data, keeping suites stable and fast, and a record of well-reasoned tooling decisions. 
 - AI-native practice: Daily use of AI coding agents in test engineering, with examples you can walk us through, and the judgement to spot when AI output is wrong or shallow. 
 - Testing AI systems: Understanding of how LLM features fail and how to test non-deterministic outputs with eval datasets, rubric or model-based grading, and pass thresholds. 
 - Performance testing: Hands-on experience with Locust, k6, JMeter, or similar tools, including designing realistic workload models and interpreting the results. 
 - API and CI/CD: Solid experience with API testing, CI/CD tools, and Git, and with running automated suites within build pipelines. 
 - Communication and ownership: Ability to explain quality risks clearly to engineers, product managers, and leadership, with strong analytical skills and a proactive, self-starter attitude. 
 - Ways of working: Experience working in a highly remote, fast-paced, and agile environment across time zones. 
 - Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience). Nice to have

- Healthcare experience: Work in healthcare or health tech, especially EHR, EDIS, or other regulated clinical software (for example, ONC Health IT certification testing). This includes familiarity with HL7 v2, FHIR, and HIPAA requirements for test data and environments. 
 - AI tooling experience: Hands-on experience with LLM evaluation and observability tools, or building MCP servers and custom AI agents for engineering teams. 
 - Security and accessibility testing: Experience testing web and AI applications, including prompt-injection testing, red-teaming, and WCAG. 

Benefits

- Competitive salary aligned with UK working hours, ensuring fair and transparent compensation. 
 - Global Team Collaboration-work alongside extremely talented professionals from around the world. 
 - Professional Growth Support with access to training programs designed to enhance your skills and expand your knowledge. 
 - Clear Career Progression and excellent opportunities for long-term advancement within the organization. 
 - Comprehensive Health Benefits to support your wellbeing and peace of mind. 
 - Flexible Remote Work Options that empower you to balance work and life effectively.

data.description:
Location: India

Function: Engineering / Cloud Platform

Reports To: Sr. Engineering Manager

Are you. . . 

- Interested in building automation that ensures the reliability and quality of foundational cloud services? 
 - Passionate about software engineering, API testing, distributed systems, and building quality into CI/CD? 
 - Excited about solving complex testing challenges across a growing SaaS platform?

If so, we'd love to meet you. 

Why Esko?

Esko, part of Veralto (NYSE: VLTO), is the global leader in packaging and product lifecycle solutions. More than 25, 000 customers across 140+ countries rely on Esko to design, manage, manufacture, and deliver products found on store shelves every day. Packaging for 9 out of 10 major consumer brands is managed using Esko solutions. As we enter our next phase of growth, we're making significant investments in cloud, AI, and platform engineering to build the future of product innovation. 

Our vision is to create the industry's leading AI-native Product Intelligence Platform. This modern, multi-tenant cloud platform unifies product, packaging, regulatory, quality, manufacturing, and supply chain data into a single intelligent ecosystem. By combining cloud-native architecture, intelligent automation, and AI-powered insights, we're helping global consumer goods, life sciences, and manufacturing companies innovate faster, improve compliance, reduce waste, and bring products to market with greater speed and confidence. 

About The Role

As an SDET on the Cloud Platform team, you will help ensure the quality, reliability, and scalability of the foundational services that power Esko's cloud products. 

You will work closely with software engineers, architects, and DevOps engineers to build automated testing for platform capabilities such as data and repository services, workflow, search, identity and access management services. 

This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who enjoys writing code, understanding how distributed systems behave, finding difficult failure scenarios, and building automation that helps engineering teams release with confidence. 

What You Will Do

- Design, develop, and maintain automated tests and test frameworks for cloud platform services and APIs. 
 - Build API, integration, contract, regression, system, and end-to-end tests for distributed services. 
 - Test complex platform behaviors including data integrity, asynchronous workflows, service interactions, authentication and authorization, and failure scenarios. 
 - Build performance, scalability, and reliability tests for critical platform services. 
 - Integrate automated tests and quality gates into CI/CD pipelines to provide fast feedback to engineering teams. 
 - Develop test infrastructure, test data, mocks, and tooling needed to test complex cloud services. 
 - Investigate failures across distributed systems using logs, metrics, traces, and other diagnostic information. 
 - Partner with software engineers and architects to improve testability and build quality into the software development lifecycle. 
 - Contribute to automation standards, testing practices, and continuous improvement across the Cloud Platform team. 

Required Experience

- 5+ years of experience in SDET, Quality Engineering, Software Engineering, or Test Automation roles. 
 - Strong programming skills in Java, Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, or another modern programming language. 
 - Hands-on experience building automated tests for REST APIs, microservices, and cloud-native applications. 
 - Experience with API, integration, regression, and system-level testing. 
 - Good understanding of distributed systems and common testing challenges such as asynchronous processing, retries, failures, and service dependencies. 
 - Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, or equivalent. 
 - Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills. 
 - Ability to work effectively with software engineers, architects, product managers, and DevOps engineers. 

Preferred Experience

- Experience with AWS or another major cloud platform. 
 - Experience with Kubernetes, Docker, and containerized applications. 
 - Experience with performance and load testing using JMeter, Gatling or equivalent. 
 - Experience with API contract testing and testing event-driven or asynchronous systems. 
 - Experience debugging distributed systems using observability tools, logs, metrics, and traces. 
 - Experience with Playwright, Selenium, or other UI automation frameworks. 

What Success Looks Like

Within your first year, you will: 

- Establish performance testing and baseline metrics for critical platform services to identify performance regressions early. 
 - Increase automated coverage of API, integration, reliability, and performance scenarios. 
 - Identify defects and failure scenarios earlier in the development lifecycle. 
 - Improve CI/CD quality gates and reduce dependence on manual regression testing. 
 - Become a trusted engineering partner who helps teams design more testable, reliable, and scalable platform services. 

At Veralto, we value diversity and the existence of similarities and differences, both visible and not, found in our workforce, workplace and throughout the markets we serve. Our associates, customers and shareholders contribute unique and different perspectives as a result of these diverse attributes. 

Unsolicited Assistance

We do not accept unsolicited assistance from any headhunters or recruitment firms for any of our job openings. All resumes or profiles submitted by search firms to any employee at any of the Veralto companies, in any form without a valid, signed search agreement in place for the specific position, approved by Talent Acquisition, will be deemed the sole property of Veralto and its companies. No fee will be paid in the event the candidate is hired by Veralto and its companies because of the unsolicited referral.

About This Role

We are seeking a Software Test Automation Engineer with hands-on experience across manual and automated software testing. You will analyse business requirements, user stories and acceptance criteria; design and execute functional and integration tests; build and maintain reusable automated tests; perform API testing; support CI/CD execution; and manage defects through to closure. 

The role requires a sound understanding of SDLC, STLC, test-design techniques and the defect lifecycle, together with practical experience working in Agile teams. You will collaborate with developers, product owners, business analysts and other stakeholders to embed quality throughout the delivery lifecycle and proactively manage quality risks. 

What You'll Do

 - Perform API and integration testing, validating requests, responses, error handling and end-to-end workflows 
 - Execute automated test suites within CI/CD pipelines and investigate test failures 
 - Manage defect identification, logging, prioritisation, retesting and closure, providing clear evidence and reproducible steps 
 - Conduct root-cause analysis of test failures, distinguishing product defects from test-data, environment and automation issues

You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best.

About the job

Job Description: PLC/SCADA Development Engineer

Experience:   5-10 years

Qualification:   Degree/Diploma in Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation, or Automation Engineering

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced PLC/SCADA Development Engineer with hands-on expertise in designing, developing, and commissioning automation systems for large-scale industrial process applications. The candidate must have practical development experience with both Siemens, Schneider and Rockwell Automation (Allen-Bradley) PLC and SCADA/HMI platforms. 

Mandatory Requirements and Responsibilities

- Must have hands-on experience on  Siemens, Schneider and Rockwell Automation (Allen-Bradley) PLC programming and SCADA/HMI development. 
 - Must have experience working on large-scale process automation systems, involving multiple PLCs, distributed I/O, and centralized SCADA systems. 
 - Must be capable of independently designing, developing, testing, and troubleshooting PLC programs for process control, equipment sequencing, interlocks, permissives, alarms, and control loops. 
 - Must have experience developing SCADA applications and HMI screens, including process mimic diagrams, equipment graphics, faceplates, alarm displays, and historical trends. 
 - Must have practical experience with  Siemens TIA Portal/STEP 7, SIMATIC S7 PLCs, and WinCC, and  Rockwell Studio 5000, ControlLogix/CompactLogix PLCs, and FactoryTalk View, as applicable. 
 - Must understand process requirements and be able to translate P&IDs, process descriptions, and control narratives into PLC logic and SCADA/HMI applications. 
 - Must have a basic working knowledge of process field instrumentation, including flow, pressure, temperature, and level transmitters, control valves, actuators, and analog/digital signals. 
 - Must understand PLC-SCADA communication, remote I/O, and industrial communication protocols such as Modbus TCP/RTU, PROFINET, EtherNet/IP, and OPC UA. 
 - Must have experience in system integration, PLC/SCADA testing, FAT/SAT, commissioning, and on-site troubleshooting. 
 - He/She must have developped program and screens for the processes involving electrical systems(i. e. Electrical heaters, Thyristor, Transformer, VFDs, various feeders etc. )
 - Must be capable of independently handling automation software development, debugging, technical documentation, and project handover.

It extends your existing software with AI-native apps and agents that work alongside your teams and customers - updating workflows, coordinating across teams, and eliminating repetitive work. We call this Team Intelligence: human-AI collaboration that breaks down silos, brings people back together, and frees you to solve bigger problems. Backed by Khosla Ventures and Mayfield with $150M+ raised, DevRev is trusted by global companies across industries. 

About The Role

As a Forward Deployment Architect, you will serve as a hands-on senior technical architect on the Applied AI Engineering team, owning the end-to-end design and delivery of AI-driven business transformation projects. 

You'll work closely with pre-sales teams to scope technical integration and implementation strategies, translating business requirements into architectural solutions. Once opportunities move to post-sales, you'll own the detailed technical designs from original scoping documents and drive execution including hands-on coding to build proofs-of-concept, custom integrations, and solution prototypes that validate technical feasibility. 

As the technical owner of the customer relationship, you'll partner cross-collaboratively to ensure successful delivery. Your role spans from understanding domain-specific customer needs to architecting scalable, agent-based AI solutions using DevRev's platform**, with direct involvement in implementing key technical components and debugging complex integration challenges. 

This position requires a unique blend of enterprise architecture expertise, AI solution design, hands-on development skills, customer empathy, and cross-functional collaboration. You'll act as the connective tissue between pre-sales, customer success, engineering, and product teams, bringing our AI capabilities to life for real-world business impact. 

What You'll Do

- Customer-facing: 80% working directly with customers 
 - Design & Deploy AI Agents: Build, configure, and launch intelligent agents using the DevRev platform to solve real customer problems. 
 - Integrate Systems: Connect AI agents with external platforms (e. g. , CRMs, APIs, databases) for seamless workflow automation. 
 - Optimize Performance: Tune prompts, logic, and agent configurations for accuracy, reliability, and scalability. 
 - Own Requirements: Partner with customers to deeply understand their needs and translate them into technical agent specifications. 
 - Prototype & Iterate: Lead live demos, build rapid proof-of-concepts, and refine solutions through customer feedback. 
 - Lead Execution: Define project plans, align internal teams, and ensure timely delivery of deployments. 
 - Advise Customers: Act as a trusted technical advisor on AI agent architecture, performance, and long-term scalability. 

What You Bring

- Experience: 7+ years in software development, AI/ML engineering, or technical consulting. Customer-facing experience is a plus. 
 - Background: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field. 
 - Coding Skills: Strong proficiency using TypeScript/JavaScript, Python, data structures and algorithms, (Nice to have: Go). 
 - Applied AI Knowledge: Large language models (LLMs), prompt engineering, frameworks like RAG and function calling, and building evals to validate agentic AI solutions. 
 - Cloud & DevOps: Hands-on experience with AWS, GCP, or Azure, and modern DevOps practices (CI/CD, containers, observability). 
 - System Integration: Comfortable integrating systems via APIs, webhooks, and event/data pipelines. 
 - Data-Driven Mindset: Use A/B testing, telemetry, and metrics to guide decisions and drive improvements. 
 - Communication: Strong written and verbal skills to articulate technical concepts to both engineers and business stakeholders. 
 - Customer Empathy: A bias for action and a relentless focus on solving problems for customers. 
 - Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related discipline. Advanced degrees or certifications in AI/architecture frameworks (e. g. , TOGAF, SAFe) are a plus. 

As part of our hiring process, shortlisted candidates will undergo a Background Verification (BGV). By applying, you consent to sharing personal information required for this process. Any offer made will be subject to successful completion of the BGV. 

How do we work?

Whatever your role, our values describe what we ask of each other. 

Be a bridger

Look beyond your own role. Ask questions, share context and help others get unstuck. That may mean bringing the right people together or picking up a problem that doesn't necessarily fit neatly into your job description. 

Care loudly

We want your perspective, not just your agreement. Speak up when something isn't working or someone needs support. Give honest feedback with respect for the person receiving it. Don't let an uncomfortable conversation become an unspoken problem. 

Own the outcome

Take responsibility for the result, not just your part in the process. Use AI to move the work forward, not to outsource your judgment. Make the call, check whether it worked and change course when it didn't. If something goes wrong, own it and help fix it. 

That's DevRev!

DevRev is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability, age, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related condition, or any other basis protected by law.
