data.description:
Why Harvey

At Harvey, we're transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we're reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come. 

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We're scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth - personal, professional, and financial - is unmatched. 

Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission - operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you. 

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today - and we're just getting started. 

Role Overview

Harvey is building the infrastructure foundation behind one of the most ambitious AI product companies in the world. Our Core Infrastructure team powers every user interaction across Harvey's legal AI platform, which already processes billions of prompt tokens and millions of daily requests for leading law firms, enterprises, and other high-stakes customers. 

We are looking for an Engineering Manager to lead Core Infrastructure from Bengaluru as we scale the platform, the team, and the next generation of Harvey products. This is a high-leverage role for a builder-leader who can grow strong engineers, drive technical execution, and raise the bar on reliability, performance, security, and developer velocity. 

This is not a pure operations role. Core Infrastructure at Harvey is responsible for building new systems as well as hardening existing ones, with an emphasis on architecture, scale, and long-term platform leverage rather than reactive firefighting alone. 

Harvey is in a build era, not a maintenance era. New product surfaces ship rapidly, and India engineering is expected to play a foundational role in shaping the architecture, culture, and roadmap of Harvey's next decade. 

At Harvey, we value Decisiveness, Simplicity, and the mindset that Job's Not Finished. We move fast, prioritize clarity, and are always striving for excellence. If this resonates with you, we'd love to hear from you. 

Why This Role Matters

Core Backend Infrastructure exists to "deliver core infrastructure that powers our products and teams, " and its current mission is operational excellence at scale. The team serves two critical user groups: external customers who need Harvey to be as reliable as the tools it replaces, and internal product engineering teams who need infrastructure they can build on without firefighting. 

The systems this team owns are directly tied to Harvey's next wave of growth, including agent infrastructure, database resilience, site reliability, vector search, job execution, regional data residency, and multi-cloud scale. 

What You'll Do

- Lead, hire, and develop a high-agency infrastructure team in Bengaluru, creating a culture of accountability, technical excellence, and strong mentorship. 
 - Own delivery for core infrastructure investments spanning cloud infrastructure, observability, container orchestration, reliability, and platform foundations. 
 - Partner closely with Product Engineering, Security, and adjacent platform teams so infrastructure accelerates product delivery instead of constraining it. 
 - Guide technical strategy across multi-cloud infrastructure, including Azure- and GCP-based systems, Kubernetes orchestration, networking, container management, and infrastructure as code. 
 - Drive operational excellence through better observability, incident response, disaster recovery, runbooks, alerting, and recovery tooling. 
 - Help the organization scale safely by improving system design quality, hardening critical paths, and pushing durable solutions to reliability bottlenecks before they become customer-facing failures. 
 - Partner with AI and product teams to support Harvey's next major product surfaces, including agent workflows, model infrastructure, and large-scale document processing systems. 
 - Contribute as a hands-on technical leader when needed, especially in architecture reviews, incident leadership, prioritization, and high-stakes cross-functional programs. 

Representative Problems You May Lead

- Hardening the Agent Platform so product teams can ship AI agent experiences with resource isolation, authenticated sandbox access, and resilient execution. 
 - Improving database resilience and recovery so incidents are mitigated quickly and the main database never becomes the bottleneck during critical events. 
 - Raising site reliability through stronger alerting, failover strategy, autoscaling, and runbooks so customers are never the first to know Harvey is degraded. 
 - Scaling vector and retrieval infrastructure that underpins document-heavy workflows and enterprise search, including migrations that improve reliability and unlock new capabilities. 
 - Building a multi-region, enterprise-grade platform that meets strict data residency, security, and uptime expectations for global customers. 

What We're Looking For

- 12+ years of hands-on backend infrastructure or platform engineering experience in production environments
 - 5+ years of engineering management experience. 
 - Deep technical strength across cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes, networking, observability, CI/CD, and infrastructure-as-code tooling such as Terraform or Pulumi. 
 - A track record of designing and scaling reliable distributed systems, with strong judgment around performance, fault tolerance, and operational tradeoffs. 
 - Experience leading complex cross-functional initiatives and translating ambiguous platform needs into clear execution plans and measurable outcomes. 
 - Strong people leadership: hiring well, coaching engineers, creating accountability, and building a healthy, high-performing team culture. 
 - Clear communication and calm execution during incidents, escalations, and high-stakes customer-impacting situations. 
 - A systems mindset, bias for simplicity, and the ability to raise standards while keeping teams moving fast. 

Nice to Have

- Experience with AI/ML infrastructure, high-throughput inference systems, or model platform reliability. 
 - Experience operating multi-tenant, security-sensitive platforms for enterprise or regulated customers. 
 - Familiarity with Azure at scale; GCP or AWS experience also transfers well. 
 - Experience supporting global, follow-the-sun operations or building teams across regions. 

Additional Information

- Work eligibility: Must be authorized to work in India. Visa sponsorship is not available for this role.

 - Proven ability to set cross-team technical standards and drive alignment without formal management authority - influencing through design quality, working prototypes, and clear documentation rather than positional control. 
 - Strong judgment on architectural tradeoffs spanning model selection, inference patterns, deployment, and governance, balanced with respect for team-level autonomy over delivery. 
 - Excellent cross-functional communication skills and translating ambiguity into documented, decisive architecture calls. 
 - Legally eligible to work in India on an ongoing basis

At Smartsheet, your ideas are heard, your potential is supported, and your contributions have real impact. You'll have the freedom to explore, push boundaries, and grow beyond your role. We welcome diverse perspectives and nontraditional paths-because we know that impact comes from individuals who care deeply and challenge thoughtfully. data.title: Senior Backend Engineer
data.description:
Job Title: Senior Backend Engineer - FastAPI & Python | HLD/LLD & AI Experience (Payments / FinTech / US Multinational)

Location: Bangalore / Hyderabad, India (Hybrid / On-site options)

Employment Type: Full-time

Experience Required: 2-5 Years

About The Opportunity

We are partnering with a prominent US-based payment transaction and financial technology enterprise that is scaling its state-of-the-art engineering hubs in Bangalore and Hyderabad. Our client processes high-volume global payment transactions, powers robust merchant solutions, and is aggressively integrating next-generation artificial intelligence and automated workflows into its core transaction security, fraud detection, and merchant intelligence platforms. 

They operate at high velocity-where production-grade reliability, ultra-low latency, and architectural excellence form the backbone of global financial operations. 

The Role

As a Senior Backend Engineer (FastAPI & Python), you will design, build, and scale high-throughput REST APIs and distributed microservices that power global payment transactions and intelligent AI-driven workflows. 

You will own both High-Level Design (HLD) and Low-Level Design (LLD) for critical backend systems, ensuring fault tolerance, low latency, and strict security compliance. Beyond traditional backend engineering, you will collaborate with AI teams to integrate LLM and RAG services seamlessly into payment rails, fraud detection pipelines, and merchant analytics. 

What You'll Own

System Architecture & Design: Own HLD and LLD for scalable, resilient, and high-performance backend microservices processing payment transactions. 

FastAPI & Python Development: Build production-grade, asynchronous REST APIs and backend services using Python, FastAPI, and modern concurrency frameworks. 

AI & LLM Integration: Architect backend pipelines that interface with Large Language Models, vector search databases, and automated decision engines. 

Database & Caching Management: Design efficient schemas, optimize queries, and manage high-throughput relational databases (e. g. , MySQL, PostgreSQL, MariaDB) and caching layers (Redis). 

Code Quality & Scalability: Establish rigorous coding standards, perform thorough code reviews, write comprehensive unit/integration tests, and ensure high system availability. 

Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with product managers, frontend teams, data engineers, and DevOps to deliver robust features from conception to production deployment. 

What We're Looking For

Experience: 2-5 years of professional backend software engineering experience, with deep expertise in Python and asynchronous frameworks (FastAPI/Flask). 

Architectural Mastery: Proven track record in designing robust HLD and LLD for distributed systems, microservices, and event-driven architectures. 

AI Familiarity: Hands-on experience integrating AI/ML models, LLM APIs, or vector search engines into backend applications. 

Data & Infrastructure: Strong proficiency with SQL databases, connection pooling, indexing strategies, and cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP/Azure, Docker, Kubernetes). 

FinTech / High-Scale Mindset: Understanding of transaction security, PCI-DSS compliance, API security best practices, and ultra-low latency requirements. 

High Agency: A proactive builder who thrives in fast-paced environments, takes end-to-end ownership of systems, and drives engineering excellence. 

Why Join?

High-Impact FinTech Scale: Build backend infrastructure that directly handles high-volume global payment transactions and merchant operations. 

Modern Technology Stack: Work with Python, FastAPI, advanced microservices, and applied AI without legacy baggage. 

Growth & Leadership: Play a pivotal role in shaping engineering standards and scaling technology hubs across Bangalore and Hyderabad. 

The Perks: Competitive compensation, flexible work culture, continuous learning budgets, and robust health benefits.

data.title: Software Engineer, Distributed Data Systems (IN)
data.description:
About Onehouse

Onehouse is a mission-driven company dedicated to freeing data from data platform lock-in. We deliver the industry's most interoperable data lakehouse through a cloud-native managed service built on Apache Hudi. Onehouse enables organizations to ingest data at scale with minute-level freshness, centrally store it, and make available to any downstream query engine and use case (from traditional analytics to real-time AI / ML). 

We are a team of self-driven, inspired, and seasoned builders that have created large-scale data systems and globally distributed platforms that sit at the heart of some of the largest enterprises out there including Uber, Snowflake, AWS, Linkedin, Confluent and many more. Riding off a fresh $35M Series B backed by Craft, Greylock and Addition Ventures, we're now at $68M total funding and looking for rising talent to grow with us and become future leaders of the team. Come help us build the world's best fully managed and self-optimizing data lake platform!

The Community You Will Join

When you join Onehouse, you're joining a team of passionate professionals tackling the deeply technical challenges of building a 2-sided engineering product. Our engineering team serves as the bridge between the worlds of open source and enterprise: contributing directly to and growing Apache Hudi (already used at scale by global enterprises like Uber, Amazon, ByteDance etc) and concurrently defining a new industry category - the transactional data lake. The Data Infrastructure team is the grounding heartbeat to all of this. We live and breathe databases, building cornerstone infrastructure by working under Hudi's hood to solving incredibly complex optimization and systems problems. 

The Impact You Will Drive: 

- As a foundational member of the Data Infrastructure team, you will productionize the next generation of our data tech stack by building the software and data features that actually process all of the data we ingest. Accelerate our open source enterprise flywheel by working on the guts of Apache Hudi's transactional engine and optimizing it for diverse Onehouse customer workloads. 
 - Act as a SME to deepen our teams' expertise on database internals, query engines, storage and/or stream processing. 

A Typical Day: 

- Design new concurrency control and transactional capabilities that maximize throughput for competing writers. 
 - Design and implement new indexing schemes, specifically optimized for incremental data processing and analytical query performance. 
 - Design systems that help scale and streamline metadata and data access from different query/compute engines. 
 - Solve hard optimization problems to improve the efficiency (increase performance and lower cost) of distributed data processing algorithms over a Kubernetes cluster. 
 - Leverage data from existing systems to find inefficiencies, and quickly build and validate prototypes. 
 - Collaborate with other engineers to implement and deploy, safely rollout the optimized solutions in production. 

What You Bring to the Table: 

- Strong, object-oriented design and coding skills (Java and/or C/C++ preferably on a UNIX or Linux platform). 
 - Experience with inner workings of distributed (multi-tiered) systems, algorithms, and relational databases. 
 - You embrace ambiguous/undefined problems with an ability to think abstractly and articulate technical challenges and solutions. 
 - An ability to prioritize across feature development and tech debt with urgency and speed. 
 - An ability to solve complex programming/optimization problems. 
 - An ability to quickly prototype optimization solutions and analyze large/complex data. 
 - Robust and clear communication skills. 
 - Nice to haves (but not required): 
 - Experience working with database systems, Query Engines or Spark codebases. 
 - Experience in optimization mathematics (linear programming, nonlinear optimization). 
 - Existing publications of optimizing large-scale data systems in top-tier distributed system conferences. 
 - PhD degree with 2+ years industry experience in solving and delivering high-impact optimization projects. 

How We'll Take Care Of You

- Equity Compensation; our success is your success with eligible participation in our company equity plan
 - Health & Well-being; we'll invest in your physical and mental well-being by reimbursing up to 20, 000 INR for your monthly insurance premium
 - Financial Future; we'll invest in your financial well-being by making this role eligible for the provident fund of which Onehouse will contribute up to 1800 INR/month
 - Location; we are a remote-friendly company (internationally distributed across N. America + India), though some roles will be subject to in-person requirements in alignment with the needs of the business
 - Generous Time Off; unlimited PTO (mandatory 1 week/year minimum), uncapped sick days and 17 paid company holidays
 - Food & Meal Allowance; weekly lunch stipend, in-office snacks/drinks
 - Equipment; we'll provide you with the equipment you need to be successful and a one-time $500 (USD) stipend for your initial office/desk setup
 - Child Bonding!; 26 weeks off for birthing and 12 weeks for surrogate and adoptive parents - fully paid so you can focus your energy on your newest addition

House Values

One Team

Optimize for the company, your team, self - in that order. We may fight long and hard in the trenches, take care of your co-workers with empathy. We give more than we take to build the one house, that everyone dreams of being part of. 

Tough & Persevering

We are building our company in a very large, fast-growing but highly competitive space. Life will get tough sometimes. We take hardships in the stride, be positive, focus all energy on the path forward and develop a champion's mindset to overcome odds. Always day one!

Keep Making It Better Always

Rome was not built in a day; If we can get 1% better each day for one year, we'll end up thirty-seven times better. This means being organized, communicating promptly, taking even small tasks seriously, tracking all small ideas, and paying it forward. 

Think Big, Act Fast

We have tremendous scope for innovation, but we will still be judged by impact over time. Big, bold ideas still need to be strategized against priorities, broken down, set in rapid motion, measure, refine, repeat. Great execution is what separates promising companies from proven unicorns. 

Be Customer Obsessed

Everyone has the responsibility to drive towards the best experience for the customer, be an OSS user or a paid customer. If something is broken, own it, say something, do something; never ignore. Be the change that you want to see in the company. 

Pay Range Transparency

Onehouse is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. Our job titles may span more than one career level. The pay range(s) for this role is listed above and represents the base salary range for non-commissionable roles or on-target earnings for commissionable roles. Actual compensation packages are dependent upon several factors that are unique to each candidate, including but not limited to: job-related skills, depth of transferable experience, relevant certifications and training, business needs, market demands and specific work location. Based on the factors above, Onehouse utilizes the full width of the range; the base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. The total compensation package for this position will also include eligibility for equity options and the benefits listed above. 

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

We are looking for a Quality and Reliability Manager to lead product-quality, package-reliability and qualification activities for memory products in a high-volume semiconductor assembly and test environment.

Postman is the world's leading API platform, used by more than 45 million+ developers and 500, 000 organizations, including 98% of the Fortune 500. About The Team

Automation Testing builds how developers test and automate their APIs, from local runs and CI pipelines to scheduled and large-scale runs in the cloud. 

About The Role

You'll work across Automation Testing, starting with performance testing: load-testing APIs at scale. The role leans toward the product experience: how users set up and run tests, and read and debug their results. 

What You'll Do

- Build features that help developers test their APIs and automate those tests, locally, in CI and in the cloud
 - Make test runs fast, reliable and easy to debug, at any scale

 - Ship end to end, from design to production, with well-tested code

What We're Looking For

- 3+ years building and shipping production software
 - Strong fundamentals and clean, well-tested code

 - Product sense, and comfort working on the backend APIs your UI uses (Node. js)

Nice to have

- Experience with load-testing tools such as k6, JMeter, Gatling or Locust
 - Experience with API testing, developer tools or test automation

What Else?

In addition to Postman's pay-on-performance philosophy, and a flexible schedule working with a fun, collaborative team, Postman offers a comprehensive set of benefits, including full medical coverage, flexible PTO, wellness reimbursement, and a monthly lunch stipend. Along with that, our wellness programs will help you stay in the best of your physical and mental health. Our frequent and fascinating team-building events will keep you connected, while our donation-matching program can support the causes you care about. We're building a long-term company with an inclusive culture where everyone can be the best version of themselves. 

At Postman we value in person collaboration. We are in office 5 days a week for all roles based out of our hubs in San Francisco Bay Area, Boston, Austin, New York City, Tokyo and London. For roles based in Bangalore, employees currently work in the office three days a week and will transition to five days per week by the end of the year. We were thoughtful in our approach which is based on collaboration and grounded in feedback from our workforce, leadership team, and peers. The benefits of our in office model will be shared knowledge, brainstorming sessions, communication, and building trust in-person that cannot be replicated via zoom. 

Our Values

At Postman, we create with the same curiosity that we see in our users. We value transparency and honest communication about not only successes, but also failures. In our work, we focus on specific goals that add up to a larger vision. Our inclusive work culture ensures that everyone is valued equally as important pieces of our final product. We are dedicated to delivering the best products we can. 

Equal Opportunity

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status. data.title: Manager, Salesforce Development
data.description:
Business Systems | ECI Solutions Hyderabad | On-site

Job Title

Manager, Salesforce Development

Location

Hyderabad, India - On-site

Work Model

On-site, 5 days per week

Department

Business Systems / Enterprise Applications (Internal IT)

Reports To

Chief Information Officer

Direct Reports

3-6 Salesforce developers and admins (India-based)

Employment Type

Full-time, permanent

Experience

9-14 years total; 6+ years hands-on Salesforce development; 2+ years leading a development team

Working Hours

India business hours with 2-3 hours of overlap with US Central Time

About Eci Solutions

ECI Solutions builds cloud-based business management and ERP software for small and mid-sized companies in manufacturing, distribution, building and construction, and field service. Our Business Systems organisation runs the Salesforce platform that our global sales, revenue and customer support teams depend on every day - a single connected org that sits at the centre of our quote-to-cash and customer-support operations and integrates with our ERP, billing, CPQ, data, and telephony systems. 

THE ROLE

We are hiring a hands-on Manager, Salesforce Development to run ECI's Salesforce engineering team in India. This is a player-coach role: roughly 50-60% of your time is spent designing and writing code, and the remainder is spent leading people, setting technical standards, reviewing work, and partnering with stakeholders in the US and Europe. 

You will own the technical quality of everything the team ships across Service Cloud and Sales/Revenue Cloud, including the integrations that connect Salesforce to our ERP, billing, and support systems, and the Agentforce and Data Cloud capabilities we are rolling out across service and revenue operations. 

This role suits an engineer who is still energised by solving hard platform problems but has grown past wanting to be the only person who can solve them. 

Key Responsibilities

Technical Leadership

- Own the technical design of Salesforce solutions across Service Cloud, Sales Cloud and Revenue Cloud, balancing declarative configuration against custom code and documenting the reasoning behind each choice. 
 - Set and enforce coding standards, design patterns, naming conventions, test-coverage expectations, and a definition of done for the team. 
 - Run code reviews as a teaching exercise, not a gate - raise the team's ceiling, not just the pull request's. 
 - Guard against technical debt: governor limit risk, hard-coded IDs, uncontrolled triggers, duplicated automation, and sprawling unmanaged Flows. 
 - Partner with architects and the US platform team on org strategy, release planning, and Salesforce release readiness (three major releases per year). 

Hands-on Delivery

- Write and review production Apex, Lightning Web Components, SOQL, Flow, and integration code for the most complex and highest-risk work on the backlog. 
 - Design and build integrations between Salesforce and ERP, billing, CPQ, data warehouse, and telephony platforms using REST/SOAP APIs, Platform Events, Change Data Capture, and middleware such as MuleSoft. 
 - Lead the build-out of Agentforce agents, Prompt Builder templates, and Data Cloud grounding for internal service and revenue use cases, including the guardrails, testing and monitoring that make them safe to deploy. 
 - Troubleshoot production incidents, lead root-cause analysis, and drive permanent fixes rather than repeat workarounds. 

People and Delivery Management

- Line-manage a team of developers and admins: goal setting, one-to-ones, performance reviews, growth plans, and certification paths. 
 - Plan and sequence sprint work with product owners and business stakeholders; protect the team from thrash and make trade-offs visible early. 
 - Onboard and mentor junior developers, giving them real work with a safety net. 
 - Interview and help hire additional developers as the India team grows. 

DevOps and Governance

- Own the release process end to end: source control branching strategy, CI/CD pipeline, sandbox seeding, regression testing, and deployment. 
 - Maintain environment strategy and data management practices, including sandbox refresh planning and data masking for non-production orgs. 
 - Ensure solutions meet security, access control, audit, and data-privacy requirements, and participate in security and compliance reviews. 

Required Qualifications

- Experience: 9-14+ years in software engineering, with at least 6 years building on the Salesforce platform and at least 2 years leading or formally mentoring a development team. 
 - Apex and LWC: Expert-level Apex (asynchronous patterns, batch, queueable, trigger frameworks, bulkification, governor limits) and Lightning Web Components with modern JavaScript. 
 - Breadth across clouds: Production experience in both Service Cloud and Sales Cloud; working knowledge of CPQ or Revenue Cloud quote-to-cash processes. 
 - Integration: Proven experience integrating Salesforce with ERP or financial systems - REST/SOAP, authentication patterns (OAuth 2. 0, JWT, Named Credentials), error handling, retry and reconciliation design. 
 - Data model design: Ability to design a scalable Salesforce data model and reason about sharing, visibility and large data volumes. 
 - DevOps: Git-based source control, Salesforce DX, and a CI/CD toolchain (Copado, Gearset, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, or GitHub Actions). 
 - Testing: Disciplined about unit testing, test data factories, and meaningful assertions - not coverage padding. 
 - Communication: Able to explain a technical trade-off to a non-technical business stakeholder in writing, in English, without losing them or oversimplifying. 
 - Availability: Able to work on-site and to overlap with US-based stakeholders for part of the day. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with Agentforce, Einstein, Prompt Builder, Agent Builder, or Data Cloud in a production setting. 
 - Experience in an internal IT or business systems function, supporting a single large org rather than multiple client projects. 
 - MuleSoft Anypoint Platform or comparable enterprise middleware experience. 
 - Familiarity with MuleSoft IDP and Fabric a plus. 
 - Experience with Salesforce Field Service, Experience Cloud, or Marketing Cloud Account Engagement. 
 - Exposure to an ERP platform (SAP, NetSuite, Microsoft Dynamics, Infor, or a vertical ERP) and to order-to-cash processes. 
 - Experience migrating from Salesforce CPQ to Revenue Cloud Advanced. 
 - Background in a SaaS or software company. 

CERTIFICATIONS

- Required: Salesforce Certified Platform Developer I. 
 - Strongly preferred: Salesforce Certified Platform Developer II. 
 - Valued: Application Architect, Integration Architect, Service Cloud Consultant, Sales Cloud Consultant, Revenue Cloud Consultant, Agentforce Specialist, or JavaScript Developer I. 

What Success Looks Like

- By 60 days: You know the org, its automation, its integrations, and its sore spots; you have shipped production code; you have met every stakeholder who files work with the team. 
 - By 6 months: Coding standards and a review process are in place and used; release cadence is predictable; each team member has a written growth plan; the top two or three sources of recurring production issues have been permanently fixed. 
 - By 12 months: The team ships significant features without escalation, technical debt is measurably lower, Agentforce capabilities are live and monitored, and at least one team member has stepped up to lead work independently. 

What We Offer

- A single, high-impact internal Salesforce org - you will see the business result of what you ship, not just a ticket closing. 
 - Real investment in Agentforce, Data Cloud and AI-assisted automation, with budget and executive sponsorship behind it. 
 - Funded Salesforce certifications, Trailhead time, and a defined technical career path. 
 - Health insurance, provident fund, and leave policy per ECI India policy. 

ECI Solutions is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and do not discriminate on the basis of gender, religion, caste, age, disability, marital status, or any other protected characteristic. 

How To Apply

Please apply with your CV and, where possible, your Trailhead profile link. Candidates should be able to reliably commute to or relocate to Hyderabad.

What You'll Do

What Else?

In addition to Postman's pay-on-performance philosophy, and a flexible schedule working with a fun, collaborative team, Postman offers a comprehensive set of benefits, including full medical coverage, flexible PTO, wellness reimbursement, and a monthly lunch stipend. Along with that, our wellness programs will help you stay in the best of your physical and mental health. data.description:
SPEED & SPIRIT is what we look for in our candidates, defined by some simple values that inspire us to BE DRIVEN in our performance, BE VIBRANT in our sporting legacy, BE TOGETHER in our team spirit, and BE YOU to let our individual talent and experience shine. Applying for a job at PUMA is easy and all genders are welcome. Simply click APPLY ONLINE and follow the steps to upload your application. 

YOUR MISSION: 

You will be part of the Core Commerce Platform organisation responsible for delivering the omnichannel commerce capabilities that power the purchase journey, inventory availability, delivery promise, order processing & fulfilment and post-purchase experiences across channels. The organisation plays a critical role in ensuring products are available to buy, orders can be fulfilled reliably, and commitments made to consumers are delivered consistently. Through a portfolio of commerce platform capabilities, the organisation enables seamless omnichannel experiences while supporting efficient, scalable, and resilient commerce operations across the global digital ecosystem. 

As an OMS Lead Engineer, you will provide technical leadership for the team building and supporting omni-channel commerce capabilities. You will own technical architecture, engineering standards, and key technology decisions while ensuring solutions are scalable, reliable, resilient, and aligned with the broader commerce platform strategy. Working closely with the Engineering Manager, Product Owners and Retail Tech Teams, you will deliver scalable, resilient, and secure omni-channel commerce capabilities. You will champion engineering best practices, code quality, observability, and continuous improvement across the team. 

What you will do: 

- Lead the design, development, and evolution of Order Management capabilities including order orchestration, inventory availability, fulfilment, returns, and post-purchase experiences. 
 - Own the technical architecture, engineering standards, and key technology decisions for OMS platforms and related integrations. 
 - Design and build scalable, resilient, API-first and event-driven services supporting omnichannel commerce use cases such as Click & Collect (BOPIS), Ship-from-Store, Endless Aisle, and Delivery Promise. Partner with Product Owners, Architects, Retail Technology, Supply Chain, and Business stakeholders to translate requirements into robust technical solutions. 
 - Drive integration of OMS with Commerce Platforms, ERP, WMS, Payments, Logistics, and Customer Service systems. 
 - Ensure inventory visibility, order processing, fulfilment, and returns workflows are accurate, reliable, and scalable across channels and regions. 
 - Champion engineering excellence through code quality, automated testing, secure development practices, and continuous improvement. 
 - Establish and promote best practices in microservices, cloud-native architecture, observability, performance optimization, and reliability engineering. 
 - Mentor and coach engineers, providing technical guidance, architecture reviews, and hands-on support for complex initiatives. 
 - Drive adoption of AI-assisted engineering practices and automation to improve developer productivity, quality, and delivery efficiency. 

YOUR TALENT: 

- 10+ years of hands-on experience designing and building Order Management capabilities using Java/Spring Boot or equivalent frameworks, including implementation, extension, integration, and customization of packaged or custom order management solutions. 
 - 3+ years of experience leading a technical capability, project or engineering team. 
 - Experience with enterprise order management platforms such as Fluent Commerce (preferred), IBM Sterling OMS, Manhattan Associates, Kibo Commerce, or Salesforce OMS is highly desirable. 
 - Hands-on software engineering experience with Java, Spring Boot, and modern microservices architectures, building scalable, resilient, and production-grade services. 
 - Deep understanding of the end-to-end order lifecycle, including order capture, sourcing, fulfilment, shipment, returns, exchanges, and post-purchase processes. 
 - Proven experience customizing and extending OMS capabilities to support evolving business requirements, omnichannel fulfilment models, and enterprise integrations. 
 - Strong knowledge of omnichannel commerce operations, including Ship-from-Store (SFS), Buy Online Pick Up In Store (BOPIS), Ship-to-Store, Curbside Pickup, Endless Aisle, and associated order routing strategies. 
 - Solid understanding of inventory management, sourcing optimization, fulfilment orchestration, and order allocation concepts across stores, DCs, and third-party fulfilment networks. 
 - Proven experience integrating OMS platforms with Commerce, WMS, ERP, POS, Payment, 3PL, Carrier, and Customer Service systems to enable end-to-end order visibility and orchestration. 
 - Experience designing OMS-centric microservice architectures with clear domain boundaries across Order Management, Inventory, Sourcing, Fulfilment, Returns, and Customer Service capabilities. 
 - Hands-on experience with Kafka or similar event-streaming platforms for event-driven architectures, asynchronous processing, and enterprise-scale system integrations. 
 - Experience with performance engineering, scalability testing, and optimization of high-throughput, business-critical commerce platforms. 
 - Experience defining and implementing capacity planning, resiliency, and scaling strategies to support peak trading events and global commerce operations. 
 - Experience driving technical architecture, establishing engineering standards, mentoring engineers, and influencing technical direction across cross-functional teams. 
 - Experience leveraging AI-assisted engineering tools, coding agents, and LLM-powered development workflows to improve engineering productivity, software quality, and delivery efficiency. 

PUMA provides equal opportunities for all job applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or disability. Equality for all is one of the core principles at PUMA and we do not tolerate any form of harassment or discrimination. 

At PUMA, every application is reviewed by real people who are committed to fairness, transparency, and equal opportunity - no matter your background, identity, or experience. To ensure our process stays true to these values, no automated systems or AI tools are used to make hiring decisions. Every decision is made by real people -with real judgment and accountability. We may use functions supported by Artificial Intelligence (AI) to carry out isolated organizational steps, such as scheduling interviews. Because at PUMA, whoever wants to play, can play.

data.description:
Company Overview

Docusign brings agreements to life. Over 1. 5 million customers and more than a billion people in over 180 countries use Docusign solutions to accelerate the process of doing business and simplify people's lives. With intelligent agreement management, Docusign unleashes business-critical data that is trapped inside of documents. Until now, these were disconnected from business systems of record, costing businesses time, money, and opportunity. Using Docusign's Intelligent Agreement Management platform, companies can create, commit, and manage agreements with solutions created by the #1 company in e-signature and contract lifecycle management (CLM). 

What you'll do

Docusign's Mobile Engineering team builds and operates complex solutions for global business challenges that cross cultures, legal jurisdictions, and impact millions of businesses every day. We are looking for a Lead Software Engineer (P5) to be at the forefront of driving technical design, feature implementation, and ongoing evolution for our native Android applications and customer-facing Android SDKs. Our Android SDKs empower enterprise customers and third-party developers to seamlessly integrate Docusign's Intelligent Agreement Management platform directly into their own mobile applications. In this role, you will act as a primary technical authority, balancing hands-on architecture and high-performance Kotlin development with cross-team leadership. You will work closely with Product, Design, QA, and backend platform teams, while occasionally engaging with enterprise partners to ensure our SDKs and native app experiences are secure, performant, and intuitive to integrate. 

This position is an individual contributor role reporting to Senior Director, Engineering. 

Responsibility

- Drive the end-to-end architectural vision, API design, and implementation for native Android applications and developer-facing Android SDKs
 - Write clean, modular, and well-tested Kotlin code, creating robust public API interfaces, AAR packages, and Maven artifacts for enterprise integration
 - Set high standards for code quality, conducting thorough code reviews and establishing best practices across testing, modularity, and security
 - Partner with Product, Design, QA, and backend engineering to ensure mobile features align with platform APIs and enterprise scalability requirements
 - Collaborate with enterprise developer partners to understand integration requirements, collect feedback, and ensure smooth SDK adoption
 - Mentor and coach engineers across the team, elevating technical capability and fostering a culture of continuous learning
 - Identify opportunities proactively to optimize Gradle build pipelines, continuous integration, testing automation, and release speed
 - Stay ahead of Android platform developments, Google I/O updates, and Android ecosystem trends, adopting new technologies where they deliver clear value

Job Designation

Hybrid: Employee divides their time between in-office and remote work. Access to an office location is required. (Frequency: Minimum 2 days per week; may vary by team but will be weekly in-office expectation)

Positions at Docusign are assigned a job designation of either In Office, Hybrid or Remote and are specific to the role/job. Preferred job designations are not guaranteed when changing positions within Docusign. Docusign reserves the right to change a position's job designation depending on business needs and as permitted by local law. 

What you bring

Basic

- B. S. in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent practical experience
 - 10+ years of professional software engineering experience in cloud, SaaS, or enterprise software environments
 - 5+ years specifically building production native Android applications and public or internal Android SDKs backed by cloud APIs
 - 3+ years of deep, hands-on experience with Kotlin (along with working knowledge of Java for legacy codebase interoperability)
 - Demonstrated experience designing clean, maintainable SDK APIs, modular architectures, and managing library distribution through systems like Maven Central or private repositories
 - Proven track record of mentoring engineers and leading complex technical initiatives across cross-functional teams

Preferred

- M. S. in Computer Science or a related technical field
 - Experience managing Android binary library packaging (AARs), semantic versioning, dependency isolation, and SDK deprecation cycles
 - Deep knowledge of modern Android frameworks, Jetpack Compose, Kotlin Coroutines, Flow, memory management, and security protocols (OAuth, SSO, and data encryption at rest)
 - Familiarity with iOS development principles or cross-platform SDK design considerations
 - Active contributions to open-source Android libraries, developer blog posts, or tech community speaking engagements

Life at Docusign

Working here

Docusign is committed to building trust and making the world more agreeable for our employees, customers and the communities in which we live and work. You can count on us to listen, be honest, and try our best to do what's right, every day. At Docusign, everything is equal. 

We each have a responsibility to ensure every team member has an equal opportunity to succeed, to be heard, to exchange ideas openly, to build lasting relationships, and to do the work of their life. Best of all, you will be able to feel deep pride in the work you do, because your contribution helps us make the world better than we found it. And for that, you'll be loved by us, our customers, and the world in which we live. 

Accommodation

Docusign is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities in our job application procedures. If you need such an accommodation, or a religious accommodation, during the application process, please contact us at accommodations@docusign. com.

The focus of this role is the platform itself - its reliability, supportability, and usability - and the standards and self-service patterns that help teams adopt it consistently. About The Opportunity

Role: Sr. Devops Engineer

About The Function

At MakeMyTrip (MMT), technology is at the heart of everything we do. As a leading player in the travel industry, we leverage cutting-edge solutions like AI, machine learning, and cloud infrastructure to create seamless and innovative travel experiences. We prioritize a tech-first mindset, where our engineering teams lead the charge in transforming the way people travel. 

Our culture encourages collaboration, creativity, and thought leadership, empowering engineers to challenge the status quo and develop impactful, game-changing solutions. At MMT, you'll work with the latest technologies, continually push boundaries, and have the chance to shape the future of travel. 

Join us and become part of a forward-thinking, tech-driven organization that thrives on innovation and continuous learning. 

About The Role

We are looking for a highly skilled and experienced DevOps Engineer to join our team. The ideal candidate will bring deep expertise in Linux, containers, multi-cloud platforms (preferably AWS, GCP), CI/CD, and scripting to help streamline and enhance our development and deployment processes. You will be responsible for managing infrastructure, automating workflows, and ensuring high availability and performance of our applications. 

What Will You Be Doing

- Design, implement, and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitHub and Jenkins. 
 - Install and configure SAST tools such as SonarQube, Nexus, and enforce CI best practices. 
 - Deploy and manage containerized applications using Docker. 
 - Manage AWS cloud infrastructure, focusing on services such as VPC, EC2 ECS, EKS, S3 IAM, ALB, Lambda, etc. , and associated networking components. 
 - Analyze and optimize the Cost of the cloud infrastructure. 
 - Install and manage third-party tools like Kong, Consul, Redash, Debezium, Kafka, and RabbitMQ (RMQ). 
 - Perform application-level debugging and provide L2 support to the SRE team for production incidents. 
 - Automate infrastructure provisioning using Ansible and Terraform across AWS, Azure, and GCP. 
 - Manage monitoring and logging pipelines using tools like Zabbix and ELK. 
 - Build internal tools and automate routine tasks using Bash and/or Python scripting. 
 - Collaborate with development, QA, and operations teams to ensure reliable and frequent software delivery. 
 - Continuously improve internal processes to enhance team efficiency and performance. 
 - Mentor junior team members through regular code reviews, knowledge-sharing sessions, and hands-on technical guidance, ensuring consistent growth and alignment. 

Qualification & Experience

- 3 to 7 years of experience in DevOps or related roles. 
 - Strong experience in Linux system administration. 
 - Hands-on experience with Docker for containerization. 
 - Deep understanding of AWS Cloud services, especially VPC, ALB, EC2 ECS, EKS, and S3 IAM. 
 - Proven experience with Jenkins, SonarQube, Nexus, and GitHub. 
 - Familiarity with build tools such as Maven (mvn) and npm. 
 - Strong scripting skills in Bash and/or Python. 
 - Solid experience with application debugging and system troubleshooting. 
 - Exposure to Mobile CI/CD pipelines is a plus. 
 - Familiarity with at least one programming language (e. g. , Java, Node. js, Go, Python). 
 - Experience with Infrastructure-as-Code tools like Terraform or CloudFormation.

At F5, we strive to bring a better digital world to life. Our teams empower organizations across the globe to create, secure, and run applications that enhance how we experience our evolving digital world. About Us

F5 is a leading technology company dedicated to securing and optimizing applications across diverse on-premises, edge, and multi-cloud environments. We are looking for passionate individuals who are ready to help us build and scale resilient infrastructure that supports our global operations and innovative product suite. 

The Role

We are seeking a Platform Engineer to modernize and automate our virtual machine and core infrastructure services that form the backbone of our data center and hybrid-cloud environments. This role is multifaceted, focused on increasing the reliability, scalability, and security of foundational services such as DNS, PKI, logging, and observability through Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and GitOps practices, as well as scaling and executing on our VM and hypervisor management ecosystems. You will also be responsible for automating the deployment and lifecycle management of critical COTS (Commercial Off-The-Shelf) management tools. The ideal candidate has a strong background in traditional data center technologies and system engineering, combined with a passion for modern automation and platform engineering principles. 

Key Responsibilities

- Support hypervisor operations across a global datacenter footprint and provide VM management services, such as patching, backups, and monitoring through automation and at scale. 
 - Create and manage reusable Terraform modules and Ansible playbooks to ensure consistent, repeatable, and version-controlled deployments of all core services. 
 - Apply GitOps principles for managing all infrastructure and service configurations, using pull requests for changes and enabling automated reconciliation. 
 - Lead the architecture, automation, and operational management of core infrastructure services, including enterprise DNS, Public Key Infrastructure (PKI), and NTP. 
 - Design, build, and maintain a centralized log aggregation to feed observability platform for infrastructure and applications. 
 - Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines to automate the testing, validation, and promotion of changes to core service configurations and infrastructure. 
 - Embed security and compliance into the entire sevice lifecycle, including secret management, certificate lifecycle automation, and vulnerability scanning. 
 - Implement monitoring, alerting, and dashboards for all managed services, and apply SRE principles to improve their reliability and performance.

Preferred Qualifications

- Familiarity with security and control frameworks such as NIST CSF, SOX, and ISO 27002. 
 - Experience working in hybrid-cloud environments and connecting on-premises services to public cloud providers (AWS, Azure). 
 - Knowledge of containerization and Kubernetes.

data.title: Software Engineer
data.description:
This role is eligible for our hybrid work model: Two days in-office. 

Software Engineer

As a Software Engineer on this team, you will operate across a wider surface than a typical product role. In a given quarter you might embed with a product squad as a forward-deployed engineer to build a custom automation that saves them hours a week, build a shared internal tool that generalizes that automation for everyone, and build the measurement layer that shows where our tools and AI are creating value and where they aren't. Some work is embedded and forward-deployed; some is building shared platforms centrally; some is the measurement layer underneath. You'll move between those modes as the work demands. 

We are looking for engineers who want to build products for other employees - energized by being close to a real problem, shipping something that removes it, and then making that solution reusable. Whether your background is in backend, full-stack, data, or platform engineering, we value a builder's instinct and a measurement mindset in equal measure. 

This is a deliberately unsettled space, and that's the point. Applied AI and internal-tooling use cases evolve constantly - what's high-leverage this quarter may not be next. We have a strong point of view on why this team matters and what to chase first, but the specific bets are an evolving canvas, shaped in collaboration with teams across the business. That openness is real opportunity, not ambiguity for its own sake. 

Why This Job's a Big Deal

We are growing the Employee Tools & Automation team - dedicated to making every Priceline employee measurably more effective with tools, including AI. 

We treat internal productivity as an engineering problem, not a training problem or a procurement problem. 

This Team Does Three Things That Reinforce Each Other

- We build internal tools, automations, and AI-augmented workflows that take toil out of how Priceline works. 
 - We embed with teams often acting as forward-deployed engineers, sitting close to a real workflow, building the custom automation that solves it, then generalizing what works into something every team can use. 
 - We measure what our tools and AI are actually doing across the org, including but not limited to: spend, adoption, and the first honest signal on whether our investment is paying off. 

These reinforce each other. Being close to teams is what tells us which tools to build and what the usage data actually means. The tools we build generate the signal. The signal tells us where to focus next. We are not a dashboard team - we are the engineering team that turns "everyone's experimenting in pockets" into leverage the whole org can rely on. 

In This Role, You Will Get To

Forward-Deployed Engineering & Applied Automation

- Embed with product and engineering teams to understand a real workflow, then build the custom automation, integration, or AI-augmented tool that removes its friction. 
 - Build agentic and LLM-powered workflows that automate toil - log analysis, repetitive multi-step processes, content generation, data wrangling - where they create real, measurable leverage. 
 - Generalize one-off solutions into reusable internal tools and templates so a win for one team becomes a win for every team. 
 - Act as a hands-on partner to teams adopting new tooling, lowering the barrier from "interested" to "productive. "

Internal Tools & Platforms

- Design, build, and operate internal tools and beta platforms that improve how employees work - authoring experiences, automation surfaces, and integrations across the tools Priceline already uses. 
 - Integrate with the AI vendor ecosystem (Claude, Cursor, and others) and internal systems to build workflows that span tools rather than living inside one. 
 - Prototype and evolve beta tooling rapidly, then harden what proves valuable into supported platforms. 

Measurement, Spend & Applied-Usage Signal

- Build the data pipelines that aggregate and normalize tool and AI spend and usage across vendors, attributed by team (POM team) - turning a fragmented vendor picture into one honest view. 
 - Build the measurement layer that begins to correlate adoption with real outcomes - a first, intellectually honest step toward an ROI signal the org does not have today. 
 - Provide the spend and efficiency signal that downstream programs (including the agentic engineering platform) depend on, without overclaiming what the data can prove. 

Engineering Standards & Reliability

- Build telemetry and observability into the tools you ship, so usage and value are measurable by design rather than guessed at. 
 - Maintain reliability and a high signal-to-noise bar - internal tools that teams depend on have to work. 
 - Define reusable patterns and reference implementations so the team's output compounds over time. 

Who You Are

- 3. 5+ years in a software engineering role, with a track record of shipping and owning workstreams independently. 
 - Proficiency in one or more languages (TypeScript, Python, Java, Go, or similar) and a willingness to work across the stack. 
 - Experience building shared frameworks, internal tools, or platforms used by other engineers or teams. 
 - Experience integrating systems via APIs and building data pipelines or integrations across multiple sources. 
 - Systems thinking: you don't just want to solve one team's problem - you want to build the tool that solves it for everyone. 
 - A measurement mindset: healthy skepticism about correlation vs. causation, and the instinct to instrument what you build so its value is visible. 
 - Strong collaboration and communication - forward-deployed work means embedding with teams, understanding their problems, and earning their trust. 
 - Illustrated history of living the values necessary to Priceline: customer, innovation, team, accountability, and trust. 
 - The Right Results, the Right Way is not just a motto at Priceline; it's a way of life. Unquestionable integrity and ethics are essential. 

Who We Are

WE ARE PRICELINE. 

Our success as one of the biggest players in online travel is all thanks to our incredible, dedicated team of talented employees. Priceliners are focused on being the best travel deal makers in the world, motivated by our passion to help everyone experience the moments that matter most in their lives. Whether it's a dream vacation, your cousin's graduation, or your best friend's wedding - we make travel affordable and accessible to our customers. 

Our culture is unique and inspiring (that's what our employees tell us). We're a grown-up, startup. We deliver the excitement of a new venture, without the struggles and chaos that can come with a business that hasn't stabilized. 

We're on the cutting edge of innovative technologies. We keep the customer at the center of all that we do. Our ability to meet their needs relies on the strength of a workforce as diverse as the customers we serve. We bring together employees from all walks of life and we are proud to provide the kind of inclusive environment that stimulates innovation, creativity and collaboration. 

Priceline is part of the Booking Holdings, Inc. (Nasdaq: BKNG) family of companies, a highly profitable global online travel company with a market capitalization of over $80 billion. Our sister companies include Booking. com, BookingGo, Agoda, Kayak and OpenTable. 

If you want to be part of something truly special, check us out!

Flexible work at Priceline

Priceline is following a hybrid working model, which includes two days onsite as determined by you and your manager (ideally selecting among Tuesday, Wednesday, or Thursday). On the remaining days, you can choose to be remote or in the office. 

Perks & Benefits At Priceline

Our benefits are designed to support your health, wellbeing, and life inside and outside of work. Eligible Priceliners have access to: 

Health & wellness coverage including medical, dental, vision, and mental health resources

Generous time off including PTO, holidays, a company-wide Priceline Pause reset week, and paid volunteer days

Work/life support including the ability to work up to 4 weeks per year from anywhere, parental leave, dependent care and family support resources, Summer Fridays, and office perks like stocked kitchens and catered meals (varies by location)

Financial security programs such as retirement plans with company contributions, life and disability coverage, and tax-advantaged accounts

Signature travel perks including employee-only discounts on hotels and flights, VIP deals, and Big Deal Bucks credits

Additional perks & discounts like travel and partner discounts, tuition support, legal support, and pet benefits

A people-first culture with Employee Resource Groups (ERGs), social events, recognition programs, and service awards that help you connect, grow, and celebrate together

Specific benefits and programs vary by location. 

Inclusion is a Big Deal!

To be the best travel dealmakers in the world, we believe our team should reflect the broad range of customers and communities we serve. We are committed to cultivating a culture where all employees have the freedom to bring their individual perspectives, life experiences, and passion to work. 

Priceline is a proud equal opportunity employer. We embrace and celebrate the unique lenses through which our employees see the world. We'd love for you to join us and help shape what makes our team extraordinary. 

Applying for this position

We're excited that you are interested in a career with us. For all current employees, please use the internal portal to find jobs and apply. 

External candidates are required to have an account before applying. When you click Apply, returning candidates can log in, or new candidates can quickly create an account to save/view applications.

data.title: SW QA Engineer - Simcenter Flightstream
data.description:
We are Siemens

Siemens Digital Industries Software is a leading provider of solutions for the design, simulation, and manufacture of products across many different industries. Formula 1 cars, skyscrapers, ships, space exploration vehicles, and many of the objects we see in our daily lives are being conceived and manufactured using our software. 

Siemens Digital Industries Software is seeking a talented and driven Software Quality Assurance Engineer to join our Quality Assurance team and contribute to the continued growth and development of our industry-leading CAE/CFD solutions. 

In this role, you will contribute across the software development lifecycle of Simcenter Flightstream, helping ensure the quality, accuracy, reliability, and robustness of capabilities used for aerodynamic, hydrodynamic, and multidisciplinary analysis. 

As a key member of the Quality Assurance team, you will independently design, develop, and execute manual and automated test cases, validate software capabilities delivered by the Development team, and analyze complex technical results. You will combine strong engineering knowledge with a quality mindset to identify issues, assess risks, improve test coverage, and continuously enhance testing tools and processes. 

The ideal candidate has a strong foundation in aerodynamics, CFD, or aircraft design, combined with excellent analytical thinking, attention to detail, problem-solving skills, and programming ability. 

Key Responsibilities

- Validate complex engineering capabilities: Design and develop comprehensive test cases to evaluate aerodynamic, hydrodynamic, and multidisciplinary capabilities, ensuring software results are accurate, reliable, and consistent with expected engineering behavior. 
 - Develop automated regression testing: Create, maintain, and improve automated regression tests to identify unintended changes and ensure the stability of Simcenter Flightstream capabilities across software releases. 
 - Analyze and communicate technical results: Analyze test results, investigate unexpected behavior, and prepare clear technical reports using visualizations, key performance indicators, and other relevant data. 
 - Ensure release quality: Thoroughly test software releases, assess quality and technical risks, document test execution results, and communicate findings and recommendations to relevant stakeholders. 
 - Investigate and manage defects: Identify, reproduce, document, and track software defects; communicate risks effectively and collaborate with Development teams to support timely investigation and resolution. 
 - Improve quality engineering practices: Identify opportunities to improve test coverage, automation, tools, and processes, contributing to the continuous improvement of the overall QA approach. 
 - Collaborate globally: Work effectively with a globally distributed and cross-functional team, contributing technical expertise and participating in projects across Quality Assurance, Development, and other engineering functions. 

Qualifications

- Master's degree in Aeronautical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Ocean Engineering, or a related technical discipline. 
 - Strong academic background or professional experience in Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD), aerodynamics, hydrodynamics, aircraft design, or related engineering disciplines. 
 - Solid understanding of aerodynamics and CFD workflows, including the ability to analyze engineering results and identify unexpected or potentially incorrect behavior. 
 - Knowledge of panel methods, vortex-lattice methods, or other reduced-order aerodynamic methods. 
 - Experience designing, executing, or analyzing complex engineering test cases, simulations, or validation studies. 
 - Programming or scripting experience using Python, C++, Java, or similar languages, with the ability to develop or maintain automated testing and analysis solutions. 
 - Strong analytical, problem-solving, and attention-to-detail skills, combined with excellent verbal and written communication skills in English. 

Preferred Skills

- Hands-on experience with Simcenter Flightstream and/or Simcenter STAR-CCM+, including the ability to create, configure, analyze, and troubleshoot complex simulation cases. 
 - Experience with software quality assurance, validation, verification, or regression testing of engineering or scientific software. 
 - Experience managing or troubleshooting Windows and Linux test environments. 
 - Experience creating technical reports, visualizations, and engineering performance indicators. 
 - Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively in a globally distributed and matrix organization. 
 - Strong ownership mindset, self-motivation, and commitment to continuous learning and technical development. 

Why Us

At Siemens Software, flexibility is how we work - hybrid by default, built on trust and autonomy. Together, 30, 000 people across more than 200 countries build technology that shapes the real world. You'll grow through real projects, strong technical peers, and global mobility, backed by the scale and benefits of an industrial software leader. We're committed to equality and inclusion, and we hire based on merit, skills, and impact. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow!

Diversity & Inclusion

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities. At Siemens, we believe people who've had real experiences dealing with being different will excel as leaders. Let's foster a culture of creativity and innovation. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

About This Role

Wells Fargo is seeking a Quality Assurance Administrator to join the Chief Operating Office (COO), an organization dedicated to strengthening the company's risk and control infrastructure, driving operational excellence, and supporting effective business execution across the enterprise. In this role, you will help oversee and enhance Front Line Control Group supervision activities by monitoring sales, service, compliance, and operational practices, while identifying opportunities to improve controls, processes, policies, and customer-focused outcomes. You will partner closely with U. S. line of business leaders and key stakeholders to assess operational risk, evaluate the effectiveness of controls and supervision programs, support risk mitigation initiatives, and contribute to the successful execution of business priorities. This position offers a unique opportunity to make a meaningful impact by helping drive a strong risk culture, improving operational efficiency, and supporting Wells Fargo's commitment to execution discipline, customer centricity, and continuous improvement

In This Role, You Will

- Document quality findings, performance measures, exceptions, and emerging trends for management review. 
 - Provide clear, factual feedback and procedural information to team members based on established quality standards and guidelines. 
 - Support the implementation and monitoring of the risk-based Front Line Control Group supervision program, including performance triggers and program-effectiveness measures. 
 - Research, inspect, and monitor detection strategies and associated outcomes to help identify potential operational risks.

 - Provide subject matter knowledge and interpretation of procedures to key business partners
 - Coordinate and monitor implementation and maintenance of processes, procedures, and policies
 - Interact with immediate Strategy and Execution colleagues on operational initiatives

Required Qualifications

Job Expectations

 - Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment while maintaining adherence to established policies, procedures, and quality standards. 
 - Assists with the implementation and monitoring of a risk-based Front Line Control Group supervision program, including performance triggers, measurement of initiatives and program effectiveness to identify and assess operational risk that arises from inadequate or failed internal processes, people, systems or external events. 
 - Research, inspection and monitoring of detection strategies and their corresponding outcome. 
 - Provides support for projects and initiatives to identify and mitigate operational risk or opportunities to improve processes, policies and/or tools. 
 - Tests the adequacy and effectiveness of policies, procedures, processes, initiatives and internal controls; drafts reports of findings for operational risk management; identifies operational risk issues; and works with higher level consultants to analyze issues and assist in implementing action plans to address deficiencies and mitigate risk.

- Executing Centralized Supervision procedures and maintaining working knowledge of conduct risk activities and supervision efforts. -

1 Nov 2026

We Value Equal Opportunity

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other legally protected characteristic. 

Employees support our focus on building strong customer relationships balanced with a strong risk mitigating and compliance-driven culture which firmly establishes those disciplines as critical to the success of our customers and company. They are accountable for execution of all applicable risk programs (Credit, Market, Financial Crimes, Operational, Regulatory Compliance), which includes effectively following and adhering to applicable Wells Fargo policies and procedures, appropriately fulfilling risk and compliance obligations, timely and effective escalation and remediation of issues, and making sound risk decisions. The ideal candidate combines strong automation expertise with experience testing distributed systems, event-driven architectures, cloud-native applications, APIs, and complex enterprise integrations. 

Key responsibilities:

 - Validate Kafka/MSK event flows, message transformations, canonical data models, database transactions, and downstream system integrations. 
 - Implement automated API testing, contract testing, service virtualization, and integration testing across enterprise applications and services. 
 - Integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines and collaborate with Engineering and DevOps teams to enable continuous quality and shift-left testing practices. 
 - Perform non-functional testing including performance, reliability, resiliency, and scalability testing of distributed systems.

 - Analyze defects, troubleshoot complex issues, perform root cause analysis, and drive quality improvements across the platform.

Qualifications: 

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or related discipline.

Simplify Healthcare®, the group's flagship company, has spent over 17 years building cloud-native platforms that support health plans managing billions in premiums and millions of members.
