data.title: Global Sanctions and SWIFT Utility Delivery Lead
data.description:
If you're looking for further opportunities to develop your career, take the next step in fulfilling your potential right here at HSBC. 

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organizations in the world, with operations in 58 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realize their ambitions. 

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Global Sanctions Technology Executive, GPS

The Opportunity

Own the strategy, integrated delivery, modernisation and reliable operation of HSBC's global sanctions screening capabilities within the GPS value stream in Global Payments Solutions, with explicit end-to-end technology accountability for Name Screening and Transaction Screening. The role leads approximately 200 colleagues and strategic partners supporting around 68 million screened transactions each month across 48 markets, together with the global party and record populations subject to continuous Name Screening, and provides a single point of technology leadership for roadmap execution, production readiness, resilience uplift, service transition and safe change. 

Translate the Screening Future State Architecture into controlled, measurable platform outcomes, bringing Name Screening and Transaction Screening together within a coherent Screening-as-a-Service strategy. Move fragmented, duplicative and vendor-centric utilities toward standard interfaces, common reusable services, consolidated screening data, end-to-end observability, consistent adjudication and governed automation, while retaining the distinct risk, regulatory, criticality, latency, resilience, geography and data-residency requirements of each screening type. The strategic direction is to shift from high-volume alert processing to outcome-led risk protection: preventing access or transactions outside risk appetite, improving true-positive detection, reducing false positives and manual intervention, and minimising unnecessary customer friction. 

What You'll Do

- Strategy, roadmap and investment: Own the multi-year global sanctions technology strategy and integrated roadmap for Name Screening and Transaction Screening, aligned to Group strategy, financial-crime risk appetite, regulatory expectations and the CBCC Future State Architecture. Set priorities, funding and sequencing to create a coherent Screening-as-a-Service utility, standardise the global operating model and shared building blocks, and make explicit build, buy, partner and retire decisions based on risk effectiveness, resilience, customer outcomes, strategic control and total cost. 
 - Name Screening and Transaction Screening transformation: Lead progressive modernisation across both screening domains. For Name Screening, advance globally consistent, model-driven continuous screening triggered by onboarding, party change, list change and risk events, with local variation only where regulation or data and hosting residency require it. For Transaction Screening, deliver high-throughput, real-time and 24x7 capabilities with regional segregation, scalable capacity, graceful degradation and no uncontrolled bypass, while strengthening tuning, layered auto-discounting and rapid response to geopolitical or regulatory change. 
 - Architecture, engineering and release excellence: Establish secure, scalable patterns across cloud and hybrid deployment, Kubernetes, Java/Spring, APIs, event streaming, distributed databases, caching, CI/CD and infrastructure automation. Embed automated testing, configuration management, observability, performance engineering and evidence-based release readiness, while meeting data and hosting residency requirements and maximising global standards and reuse. 
 - Risk effectiveness and control governance: Maintain zero tolerance for sanctions breaches and strengthen the effectiveness of Name Screening and Transaction Screening in line with policy, regulatory expectations and risk appetite. Improve true-positive detection while evidencing reductions in false positives; govern lists, policies, models, algorithms, filters, thresholds, routing, tuning and discounting through validation, impact analysis, segregation of duties, maker-checker controls, reconciliation, auditability and global standards with local divergence by approved exception. 
 - Service readiness, resilience and production outcomes: Own availability, capacity, performance, recoverability and continuity for mission-critical sanctions services, including evolution toward 24x7 transaction and continuous name screening. Ensure every material change is supportable and recoverable, with production-like testing, viable back-out, clear handover, post-implementation verification and sustainable remediation of incident, service-review and control-assessment actions. 
 - Data, observability, automation and AI: Create a trusted, consolidated screening data asset spanning Name Screening and Transaction Screening, with strong quality, lineage, completeness, reconciliation and end-to-end tracking from screening event to risk outcome. Use real-time analytics and transparent management information to support assurance and regulatory evidence. Govern AI-assisted matching, entity resolution, triage, prioritisation, recommendations and layered auto-discounting with human accountability, explainability, validation, drift monitoring, feedback loops and safe fallback arrangements, progressively moving toward near-zero-touch operations where the control evidence supports it. 
 - Customer and operational outcomes: Embed Name Screening and Transaction Screening controls seamlessly into customer onboarding, servicing and payment journeys. Apply risk-based segmentation, improve data capture at source and provide predictable turnaround and proactive status information. Reduce duplicate screens, repeat alerts, manual adjudication and unnecessary requests for information, while ensuring Financial Crime and Operations have the data needed to make timely decisions to reject, block, freeze, escalate or exit in accordance with policy. 
 - Leadership, governance and stakeholder alignment: Lead and develop a globally distributed, inclusive engineering organisation; own workforce shape, investment priorities, standards, talent and succession plans. Establish transparent, decision-oriented governance across Financial Crime, Operations, Global Businesses, regions, Group Data, Foundations Technology, Architecture, Cybersecurity, Risk, Audit, Finance and Procurement; manage suppliers against measurable delivery, quality, security and service-readiness outcomes. 

Measures of success

- Predictable delivery of the Screening-as-a-Service roadmap for Name Screening and Transaction Screening against approved milestones, investment and benefit commitments, with greater reuse of common capabilities and less duplication across screening types, regions and products. 
 - Measurably improved risk effectiveness across Name Screening and Transaction Screening: stronger true-positive detection and designation-to-action outcomes, controlled reductions in false positives, duplicate alerts, manual adjudication and repeated customer outreach, and faster risk-led decisioning. 
 - Resilient, secure and scalable screening services, including continuous Name Screening and real-time 24x7 Transaction Screening, with improved availability, throughput, recovery performance and capacity for peak volumes, list events and regulatory change, and reduced change failure, high-severity incidents and customer disruption. 
 - Reliable data, observability and regulatory evidence, with demonstrable governance of lists, models, policies, filters, algorithms, AI and configuration changes. 
 - A sustainable, inclusive and high-performing global technology organisation and effective strategic supplier ecosystem. 

Role

What you will need to succeed in the role

- Significant senior technology, engineering and platform-delivery leadership experience in global payments, sanctions screening, financial crime technology or a comparable regulated, mission-critical domain. 
 - Proven delivery of complex, multi-year transformation across regions, business lines, platforms and suppliers, including legacy modernisation and product/platform operating models. 
 - Strong knowledge of transaction and name screening, list management, matching/filtering, adjudication, case management, discounting, customer outreach and associated regulatory controls. 
 - Deep understanding of cross-border payments, ISO 20022, payment messaging and payment-processing controls, together with the operation of high-volume, high-availability and preferably 24x7 services. 
 - Practical command of modern cloud/hybrid engineering, containerisation, APIs, event streaming, distributed data, CI/CD, observability, cybersecurity, data protection, resilience and disaster recovery. 
 - Experience leading controlled data, analytics, machine-learning or AI capabilities, and managing technology risk, audit, regulatory assurance, suppliers, utilities and build-versus-buy decisions. 
 - Evidence of building and developing large, globally distributed and culturally diverse teams, with exceptional executive, regulator and cross-functional stakeholder influence. 
 - Relevant degree, technology qualification or equivalent professional experience; cloud, architecture, engineering, resilience or security certification is desirable. 

You'll achieve more when you join HSBC. 

HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and, opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified persons irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc. , We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role. 

Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

Description

Invent the future with us. 

Ampere is a semiconductor design company for a new era, leading the future of computing with an innovative approach to CPU design focused on high-performance, energy efficient AI compute. 

As a pioneer in the new frontier of energy efficient high-performance computing, Ampere is part of the Softbank Group of companies driving sustainable computing for AI, Cloud, and edge applications. 

Join us at Ampere and work alongside a passionate and growing team - we'd love to have you apply!

About The Role

As a core member of the Ampere Debug Tools team, you will be responsible for the architecture, design, and development of Debug Tools solutions for the next generation of Ampere products. This role is distinguished by deep technical ownership, architecture leadership, and cross-team influence. 

The Debug Tools Team is part of the Ampere Software Team. Our mission is to develop a comprehensive debug strategy and roadmap for internal debug capabilities, as well as to develop and deploy debug solutions for all internal and external Ampere SoC users. 

- Internal users include Debug Tools software users from the Virtual Platform, Emulation, Platform, Design Validation (DV), Post-Silicon Validation, Design For Test (DFT), Firmware, Operating System, Software, Performance, and Application Engineering teams. 
 - External users include partners, ODMs, OEMs, datacenter, edge and embedded customers. 
 - Debug solutions include Arm Development Studio, TRACE32 PowerView, and OpenOCD debuggers, Arm Self-Hosted Trace for Linux, and utilities for invasive debug, bus trace, instruction trace, array dump, and scan dump. This role will be for the lead of the Arm Development Studio implementation. 

What You'll Achieve

- Architect, design, develop, and deploy software-based Debug Tools for custom 64-bit Armv9 SoC and other processors. 
 - Invent new debug tools and techniques for future products and technologies. 
 - Influence the architecture and design team decisions with knowledge of internal and external debug tools on Ampere SoCs. 
 - Contribute to software architecture and design documents, application notes, and other software product documentation. 
 - Develop tooling for advanced debugging techniques, such as instruction trace, bus trace, array dump, scan dump, and ATE bootstrapping. 
 - Develop open source JTAG and self-hosted trace and debugger software for internal and external use in debugging Ampere microprocessors. 
 - Develop Arm Development Studio, TRACE32, and OpenOCD utilities for internal and external use in debugging Ampere microprocessors. 
 - Perform pre-silicon bring-up of debug software on software simulators and hardware emulation platforms. 
 - Collaborate with hardware design, architecture, post-silicon validation, and platform AE teams, as necessary, to resolve critical customer issues. 

About You

 - Proficiency in C/C++, Python, and Bash programming. 
 - Experience using Arm Development Studio, TRACE32 PowerView, OpenOCD, and GDB debuggers.

data.title: Senior Manager, Test Engineering- Networking background is a must
data.description:
For more than 30 years, SonicWall  has delivered a partner-first unified cybersecurity portfolio that helps SMBs, MSPs, and IT teams consolidate network security, endpoint security, security service edge (SSE), and threat response across hybrid environments. By bringing connected technology, real-time threat intelligence, automation, and expert services together, SonicWall helps organizations simplify security operations, achieve better security outcomes, and lower total cost of ownership. Backed by a global ecosystem of more than 17, 000 partners, SonicWall delivers enterprise-grade protection built for SMB and mid-market realities.   

For more information, visit www. sonicwall. com or follow us on X, LinkedIn, Facebook, and Instagram.   

Role Overview

We are looking for a highly experienced Senior QA Manager to own end-to-end quality for SonicOS, the core operating system powering SonicWall's next-generation firewall products. This is a high-impact leadership role where you will define quality strategy, drive automation and test infrastructure investments, and partner closely with Product Management, Development, Release Engineering, DevOps, and Support teams to ensure every release meets high standards of reliability, security, and customer trust. 

You will be responsible not just for test execution, but for shaping how quality is built into the product lifecycle - from early design reviews and threat modelling to release readiness and post-release learning. 

Key Responsibilities

Quality Strategy & Release Ownership

- Define and continuously improve the QA strategy for SonicOS across major releases, patches, and hotfixes
 - Establish quality gates, entry/exit criteria, and clear release readiness standards
 - Drive risk-based testing and shift-left practices to catch issues early
 - Own go/no-go decisions for releases from a quality standpointFirewall Domain & Technical Leadership

- Provide strong technical leadership across firewall features such as: 
 - Stateful firewall, NAT, VPN (IPSec/SSL), routing, HA
 - Security services like IPS, DPI-SSL, Gateway AV, App Control, Web Filtering
 - Review PRDs, design documents, and architecture proposals with a quality & security mindset
 - Define comprehensive test strategies covering: 
 - Functional correctness and complex E2E customer workflows
 - Performance, scale, and stress (throughput, sessions, DPI impact)
 - HA failover, upgrades/downgrades, config migrations, and long-run stability
 - Champion security and negative testing to validate abuse cases and threat scenariosAutomation, CI/CD & Test Infrastructure

- Define the long-term automation vision (UI, API, CLI, E2E) and measurable coverage goals
 - Partner with automation leads to build scalable, reliable frameworks integrated into CI/CD
 - Drive stability and reliability of automated test suites (reduce flakiness, improve signal)
 - Own strategy for testbeds spanning hardware appliances, virtual firewalls, and cloud deployments
 - Work with infra teams to ensure availability, capacity planning, and reliability of test environmentsExecution Excellence & Metrics

- Own and track key quality metrics: defect leakage, escape rate, regression effectiveness, automation ROI, flakiness trends
 - Lead regular release readiness and quality reviews with senior stakeholders
 - Drive deep root cause analysis for production escapes and systemic quality gaps
 - Convert learnings from field issues into preventive quality improvementsPeople Leadership & Stakeholder Influence

- Build, mentor, and retain a strong leadership bench of QA managers, leads, and senior engineers
 - Set clear expectations, career paths, and technical growth plans for the QA organization
 - Influence engineering leadership and PMs to prioritize quality, reliability, and customer impact
 - Represent QA in leadership forums, customer escalations, and cross-functional reviewsRequired Skills & Experience

- 10+ years of total technical experience, including at least 2+ years in a management or leadership role
 - Strong background in testing firewall / network security products or similar system software
 - Deep understanding of networking and security fundamentals (TCP/IP, routing, NAT, VPN, HA, IPS/DPI concepts, authentication mechanisms)
 - Experience owning quality for complex, large-scale system software releases
 - Proven leadership experience managing and scaling QA teams across geographies
 - Strong exposure to automation strategy and CI/CD-driven quality practices
 - Excellent communication skills with the ability to influence senior technical stakeholdersGood to Have

- Prior experience with SonicOS or comparable firewall OS platforms
 - Exposure to security compliance programs (FIPS, Common Criteria, SOC2)
 - Experience testing in hybrid environments (hardware + virtual + cloud)
 - Experience handling customer escalations and field issue RCAWhat Success Looks Like

- Predictable, high-quality SonicOS releases with reduced Sev1/Sev2 customer issues
 - Measurable improvement in automation coverage and test effectiveness
 - Faster feedback cycles for Dev and PM through shift-left and CI/CD integration
 - Strong QA leadership bench and high team engagement
 - Improved customer trust and reduced critical escalations

data.title: Principal Software Engineer, Debug Tools
data.description:
Description

Invent the future with us. 

Ampere is a semiconductor design company for a new era, leading the future of computing with an innovative approach to CPU design focused on high-performance, energy efficient AI compute. 

As a pioneer in the new frontier of energy efficient high-performance computing, Ampere is part of the Softbank Group of companies driving sustainable computing for AI, Cloud, and edge applications. 

Join us at Ampere and work alongside a passionate and growing team - we'd love to have you apply!

About The Role

As a core member of the Ampere Debug Tools team, you will be responsible for the architecture, design, and development of Debug Tools solutions for the next generation of Ampere products. This role is distinguished by deep technical ownership, architecture leadership, and cross-team influence. 

The Debug Tools Team is part of the Ampere Software Team. Our mission is to develop a comprehensive debug strategy and roadmap for internal debug capabilities, as well as to develop and deploy debug solutions for all internal and external Ampere SoC users. 

- Internal users include Debug Tools software users from the Virtual Platform, Emulation, Platform, Design Validation (DV), Post-Silicon Validation, Design For Test (DFT), Firmware, Operating System, Software, Performance, and Application Engineering teams. 
 - External users include partners, ODMs, OEMs, datacenter, edge and embedded customers. 
 - Debug solutions include Arm Development Studio, TRACE32 PowerView, and OpenOCD debuggers, Arm Self-Hosted Trace for Linux, and utilities for invasive debug, bus trace, instruction trace, array dump, and scan dump. This role will be for the lead of the Arm Development Studio implementation. 

What You'll Achieve

- Architect, design, develop, and deploy software-based Debug Tools for custom 64-bit Armv9 SoC and other processors. 
 - Invent new debug tools and techniques for future products and technologies. 
 - Influence the architecture and design team decisions with knowledge of internal and external debug tools on Ampere SoCs. 
 - Contribute to software architecture and design documents, application notes, and other software product documentation. 
 - Develop tooling for advanced debugging techniques, such as instruction trace, bus trace, array dump, scan dump, and ATE bootstrapping. 
 - Develop open source JTAG and self-hosted trace and debugger software for internal and external use in debugging Ampere microprocessors. 
 - Develop Arm Development Studio, TRACE32, and OpenOCD utilities for internal and external use in debugging Ampere microprocessors. 
 - Perform pre-silicon bring-up of debug software on software simulators and hardware emulation platforms. 
 - Collaborate with hardware design, architecture, post-silicon validation, and platform AE teams, as necessary, to resolve critical customer issues. 

About You

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or Software Engineering or related technical field & 8 years of related experience; or MS degree & 5 years; or PhD & 3 years
 - Proficiency with Arm® architecture and ecosystem, including Armv8-a/v9-a and Armv7-m processor architectures, Arm Debug Interface Architecture, Arm CoreSightTM Architecture, Arm AMBA® APB, AXI, AHB, and CHI protocols. 
 - Proficiency in C/C++, Python, and Bash programming. 
 - Experience using Arm Development Studio, TRACE32 PowerView, OpenOCD, and GDB debuggers. 
 - Experience with instruction trace, bus trace, scan dumps, array dumps, and crash capture. 
 - Experience with version control tools such as git, and software best practices. 
 - Strong analytical, debugging, and testing methodology skills. 
 - Proven ability to own problems and drive them to a resolution. 
 - Experience with system software debugging, tracing, and analysis tools, such as perf, ftrace, etc, is recommended. 

What We'll Offer

At Ampere we believe in taking care of our employees and providing a competitive total rewards package that includes base pay, cash long-term incentive, and comprehensive benefits. 

Benefits Highlights Include

- Premium medical, dental, vision insurance, parental benefits including creche reimbursement, as well as a retirement plan, so that you can feel secure in your health, financial future and child care during work. 
 - Generous paid time off policy so that you can embrace a healthy work-life balance 
 - Fully catered lunch in our office along with a variety of healthy snacks, energizing coffee or tea, and refreshing drinks to keep you fueled and focused throughout the day. 

And there is much more than compensation and benefits. At Ampere, we foster an inclusive culture that empowers our employees to do more and grow more. We are excited to share more about our career opportunities with you through the interview process. 

DR

Ampere is an inclusive and equal opportunity employer and welcomes applicants from all backgrounds. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, citizenship, religion, age, veteran and/or military status, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, physical or mental disability, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law.

Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery center. The GDS team plays an important role in EY's strategy by ensuring effective support to EY's growth agenda. 

Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80, 000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom. 

Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.

Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services. 

Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation. 

The Opportunity

5 to 10 years of experience in ETL Testing/PowerBI Testing with basic expertise in Automation Testing. 

Your Key Responsibilities

- Develop comprehensive and detailed test plans for ETL pipelines. 
 - Design and execute test cases based on source-to-target mapping documents across layers. 
 - Create and manage UAT test plans and test cases based on existing dashboards, in close collaboration with the client's analytics team. 
 - Execute test cycles end-to-end, track defects, manage issue resolution, and support iterative testing cycles. 
 - Ensure clear communication, coordination, and status tracking across QA, engineering, and business teams. 
 - Responsible for decision-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution. 

Skills And Attributes For Success

Testing skills: 

- Requirement Analysis
 - Test Scenario Design
 - Test Case Creation and Execution
 - User Acceptance Testing (UAT) Support
 - Regression Testing
 - JIRA/Confluence (any QC tool)
 - Agile/Scrum Methodology
 - Defect Management
 - Stakeholder Communication

Core Power BI Skills: 

- Power BI Dashboard and Report Testing
 - Data Validation and Reconciliation Testing
 - DAX Formula Validation
 - KPI and Metric Verification
 - Visualizations Testing (Charts, Tables, Maps, Cards)
 - Filter, Slicer, and Bookmark Validation
 - Security Role (RLS) Testing
 - SQL Query Writing and Validation

Additional Skills

- Strong Structured Query Language (SQL), including window functions (ETL Skillset)
 - Experience testing Streaming or Change Data Capture (CDC) pipelines (ETL Skillset)
 - Databricks/Snowflake or Apache Spark (ETL Skillset) - Strong understanding of data migration, data quality, and reconciliation processes. 
 - Ability to work with large datasets, complex reporting structures, and high-volume test scenarios. 
 - Robot Framework (Automation Skillset)
 - Python/Pyspark (ETL/Automation)

What We Offer You

At EY, we'll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We'll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more. 

Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today. 

To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need. 

Our Commitment: As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost. 

Professional Development: From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship. 

People and Culture: In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing. 

Benefits: Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development. 

How to Apply: If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy. 

Successful candidates advance to a competency-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits. 

"We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion". 

EY | Building a better working world

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets. 

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate. 

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

data.title: Plant Maintenance & Engineering Head
data.description:
Company Description Power Works Engineering specializes in the engineering, design, and supply of advanced flow control equipment and piping systems for nuclear power plants. 

We are building a new valve manufacturing plant serving the nuclear sector, in the Pune industrial belt. The building is nearing completion. 

Role Description

We are looking for an experienced Head of Plant Engineering & Maintenance to lead the technical development, commissioning, and maintenance of our new manufacturing facility in Pune. 

The plant will specialize in manufacturing industrial valves for nuclear power plants. 

The successful candidate will oversee the transformation of the facility into a fully operational manufacturing plant and subsequently lead its engineering and maintenance functions. 

Key Responsibilities

- Plant Setup & Layout: Plan production layouts, warehouses, offices, external areas, and supporting infrastructure. 
 - Infrastructure & Utilities: Oversee civil and MEP works, electrical systems, HVAC, compressed air, water, drainage, fire protection, security, CCTV, and IT infrastructure. 
 - Site Handover & Commissioning: Manage technical acceptance, defect rectification, FAT/SAT, equipment installation, commissioning, and operational handover. 
 - Equipment Management: Ensure installation and reliable operation of CNC machinery, welding equipment, cranes, compressors, test benches, and other industrial equipment. 
 - Project & Budget Management: Manage contractors, suppliers, procurement, CAPEX/OPEX budgets, schedules, contracts, and technical documentation. 
 - Maintenance Systems: Establish CMMS/EAM, preventive and corrective maintenance, emergency repairs, root cause analysis, spare parts management, and calibration coordination. 
 - Safety & Compliance: Implement LOTO, PTW, and MOC procedures, ensuring compliance with industrial, electrical, fire, environmental, and applicable ISO requirements. 
 - Team Leadership: Recruit and manage the engineering and maintenance team, establish KPIs, and support commissioning and two-shift operations. 
 - Operational Efficiency: Improve equipment reliability, utility efficiency, energy and water consumption, and maintenance costs while supporting future expansion. 

Candidate Requirements

- Education: Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial, Mechatronics Engineering, or a related field. 
 - Experience: 12+ years in plant engineering, maintenance, or commissioning, including at least 5 years in leadership roles. 
 - Greenfield Projects: Proven experience in setting up and commissioning manufacturing facilities, including plant layouts, industrial fit-out, utilities, and infrastructure development. 
 - Technical Expertise: Strong knowledge of industrial MEP systems, electrical distribution, HVAC, compressed air, fire protection, and manufacturing infrastructure. 
 - Manufacturing Equipment: Hands-on experience with CNC machinery, welding, heat treatment, material handling, and industrial testing equipment. 
 - Maintenance Management: Experience establishing maintenance teams, CMMS/EAM systems, preventive maintenance programs, and equipment reliability processes. 
 - Project Management: Demonstrated ability to manage contractors, technical procurement, CAPEX/OPEX budgets, project schedules, and commissioning activities. 
 - Safety & Compliance: Practical knowledge of Indian industrial safety regulations, statutory approvals, and Maharashtra factory requirements. 
 - Leadership & Communication: Strong team management, cross-functional coordination, and professional working proficiency in English. 
 - Location: Willingness to work permanently on-site in Talegaon-Chakan and support commissioning and two-shift operations. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience in nuclear, power generation, heavy engineering, automotive, defence, aerospace, or other complex manufacturing industries. 
 - Previous responsibility for delivering a greenfield manufacturing facility from shell-and-core condition to operational readiness. 
 - Familiarity with ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001, ISO 19443, and ASME NQA-1 principles. 
 - Experience with SAP PM, IBM Maximo, or equivalent CMMS/EAM systems. 
 - Knowledge of TPM, RCM, Lean/5S, and root cause analysis. 
 - Hindi and/or Marathi language skills.

data.title: Global Sanctions and SWIFT Utility Delivery Lead
data.description:
Location: Hyderabad/ Pune/ Bangalore

If you're looking for further opportunities to develop your career, take the next step in fulfilling your potential right here at HSBC. 

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organizations in the world, with operations in 58 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realize their ambitions. 

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Global Sanctions Technology Executive, GPS

The Opportunity

Own the strategy, integrated delivery, modernisation and reliable operation of HSBC's global sanctions screening capabilities within the GPS value stream in Global Payments Solutions, with explicit end-to-end technology accountability for Name Screening and Transaction Screening. The role leads approximately 200 colleagues and strategic partners supporting around 68 million screened transactions each month across 48 markets, together with the global party and record populations subject to continuous Name Screening, and provides a single point of technology leadership for roadmap execution, production readiness, resilience uplift, service transition and safe change. 

Translate the Screening Future State Architecture into controlled, measurable platform outcomes, bringing Name Screening and Transaction Screening together within a coherent Screening-as-a-Service strategy. Move fragmented, duplicative and vendor-centric utilities toward standard interfaces, common reusable services, consolidated screening data, end-to-end observability, consistent adjudication and governed automation, while retaining the distinct risk, regulatory, criticality, latency, resilience, geography and data-residency requirements of each screening type. The strategic direction is to shift from high-volume alert processing to outcome-led risk protection: preventing access or transactions outside risk appetite, improving true-positive detection, reducing false positives and manual intervention, and minimising unnecessary customer friction. 

What You'll Do

- Strategy, roadmap and investment: Own the multi-year global sanctions technology strategy and integrated roadmap for Name Screening and Transaction Screening, aligned to Group strategy, financial-crime risk appetite, regulatory expectations and the CBCC Future State Architecture. Set priorities, funding and sequencing to create a coherent Screening-as-a-Service utility, standardise the global operating model and shared building blocks, and make explicit build, buy, partner and retire decisions based on risk effectiveness, resilience, customer outcomes, strategic control and total cost. 
 - Name Screening and Transaction Screening transformation: Lead progressive modernisation across both screening domains. For Name Screening, advance globally consistent, model-driven continuous screening triggered by onboarding, party change, list change and risk events, with local variation only where regulation or data and hosting residency require it. For Transaction Screening, deliver high-throughput, real-time and 24x7 capabilities with regional segregation, scalable capacity, graceful degradation and no uncontrolled bypass, while strengthening tuning, layered auto-discounting and rapid response to geopolitical or regulatory change. 
 - Architecture, engineering and release excellence: Establish secure, scalable patterns across cloud and hybrid deployment, Kubernetes, Java/Spring, APIs, event streaming, distributed databases, caching, CI/CD and infrastructure automation. Embed automated testing, configuration management, observability, performance engineering and evidence-based release readiness, while meeting data and hosting residency requirements and maximising global standards and reuse. 
 - Risk effectiveness and control governance: Maintain zero tolerance for sanctions breaches and strengthen the effectiveness of Name Screening and Transaction Screening in line with policy, regulatory expectations and risk appetite. Improve true-positive detection while evidencing reductions in false positives; govern lists, policies, models, algorithms, filters, thresholds, routing, tuning and discounting through validation, impact analysis, segregation of duties, maker-checker controls, reconciliation, auditability and global standards with local divergence by approved exception. 
 - Service readiness, resilience and production outcomes: Own availability, capacity, performance, recoverability and continuity for mission-critical sanctions services, including evolution toward 24x7 transaction and continuous name screening. Ensure every material change is supportable and recoverable, with production-like testing, viable back-out, clear handover, post-implementation verification and sustainable remediation of incident, service-review and control-assessment actions. 
 - Data, observability, automation and AI: Create a trusted, consolidated screening data asset spanning Name Screening and Transaction Screening, with strong quality, lineage, completeness, reconciliation and end-to-end tracking from screening event to risk outcome. Use real-time analytics and transparent management information to support assurance and regulatory evidence. Govern AI-assisted matching, entity resolution, triage, prioritisation, recommendations and layered auto-discounting with human accountability, explainability, validation, drift monitoring, feedback loops and safe fallback arrangements, progressively moving toward near-zero-touch operations where the control evidence supports it. 
 - Customer and operational outcomes: Embed Name Screening and Transaction Screening controls seamlessly into customer onboarding, servicing and payment journeys. Apply risk-based segmentation, improve data capture at source and provide predictable turnaround and proactive status information. Reduce duplicate screens, repeat alerts, manual adjudication and unnecessary requests for information, while ensuring Financial Crime and Operations have the data needed to make timely decisions to reject, block, freeze, escalate or exit in accordance with policy. 
 - Leadership, governance and stakeholder alignment: Lead and develop a globally distributed, inclusive engineering organisation; own workforce shape, investment priorities, standards, talent and succession plans. Establish transparent, decision-oriented governance across Financial Crime, Operations, Global Businesses, regions, Group Data, Foundations Technology, Architecture, Cybersecurity, Risk, Audit, Finance and Procurement; manage suppliers against measurable delivery, quality, security and service-readiness outcomes. 

Measures of success

- Predictable delivery of the Screening-as-a-Service roadmap for Name Screening and Transaction Screening against approved milestones, investment and benefit commitments, with greater reuse of common capabilities and less duplication across screening types, regions and products. 
 - Measurably improved risk effectiveness across Name Screening and Transaction Screening: stronger true-positive detection and designation-to-action outcomes, controlled reductions in false positives, duplicate alerts, manual adjudication and repeated customer outreach, and faster risk-led decisioning. 
 - Resilient, secure and scalable screening services, including continuous Name Screening and real-time 24x7 Transaction Screening, with improved availability, throughput, recovery performance and capacity for peak volumes, list events and regulatory change, and reduced change failure, high-severity incidents and customer disruption. 
 - Reliable data, observability and regulatory evidence, with demonstrable governance of lists, models, policies, filters, algorithms, AI and configuration changes. 
 - A sustainable, inclusive and high-performing global technology organisation and effective strategic supplier ecosystem. 

Role

What you will need to succeed in the role

- Significant senior technology, engineering and platform-delivery leadership experience in global payments, sanctions screening, financial crime technology or a comparable regulated, mission-critical domain. 
 - Proven delivery of complex, multi-year transformation across regions, business lines, platforms and suppliers, including legacy modernisation and product/platform operating models. 
 - Strong knowledge of transaction and name screening, list management, matching/filtering, adjudication, case management, discounting, customer outreach and associated regulatory controls. 
 - Deep understanding of cross-border payments, ISO 20022, payment messaging and payment-processing controls, together with the operation of high-volume, high-availability and preferably 24x7 services. 
 - Practical command of modern cloud/hybrid engineering, containerisation, APIs, event streaming, distributed data, CI/CD, observability, cybersecurity, data protection, resilience and disaster recovery. 
 - Experience leading controlled data, analytics, machine-learning or AI capabilities, and managing technology risk, audit, regulatory assurance, suppliers, utilities and build-versus-buy decisions. 
 - Evidence of building and developing large, globally distributed and culturally diverse teams, with exceptional executive, regulator and cross-functional stakeholder influence. 
 - Relevant degree, technology qualification or equivalent professional experience; cloud, architecture, engineering, resilience or security certification is desirable. 

You'll achieve more when you join HSBC. 

HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and, opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified persons irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc. , We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role. 

Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website. 

- Issued By HSBC Software Development (India) Limited***

data.title: Lead Engineer-Systems Engineering
data.description:
Job Description Summary

data.description:
Job Description Summary

As a Senior Staff Software Architect, you will define and evolve the architecture of Cardiology platform based on embedded software used across multiple products. This role requires strong architectural ownership beyond individual component development, with experience scaling design systems. 

The ideal candidate should combine strong architecture, governance, performance engineering, quality strategy, technical leadership, and practical AI-assisted engineering experience. 

GE HealthCare is a leading global medical technology and digital solutions innovator. Our purpose is to create a world where healthcare has no limits. Unlock your ambition, turn ideas into world-changing realities, and join an organization where every voice makes a difference, and every difference builds a healthier world. 

Job Description

We are in a phase of growth, designing next generation Cardiology devices. This requires an architect who thinks like a platform owner, not just a component builder. You must look beyond individual implementation details to think about scale, governance, and empowerment. You will define the architectural foundations and self-service patterns that let teams move fast without breaking the consistency, compatibility, and accessibility standards required for patient safety. 

Core Responsibilities

- Architecture & Platform Design 
 - Platform Architecture: Define and evolve scalable architecture for embedded system. 
 - Quality, Performance & Technical Debt 
 - Quality Strategy: Define quality strategy across unit, component, regression, integration, and E2E testing. Establish release-blocking quality gates and compatibility expectations. 
 - Performance Engineering: Diagnose and improve rendering, memory, bundle-size, and framework-integration performance. Define measurable performance baselines, and engineering health metrics rather than subjective assessments. 
 - Debt Prioritization: Prioritize technical and QA debt based on customer impact, adoption, risk, and maintainability. 
 - Roadmap
 - Architecture Roadmap: Create architecture roadmaps and guide long-term evolution without unnecessary rewrites, aligning with product priorities. 
 - Cross-Functional Partnership: Partner with Leadership, Product, UX, QA, DevOps, and engineering teams to drive architecture decisions across organizational boundaries. 

Core Competencies

- Communicating Trade-offs & Alignment: Exceptional ability to communicate complex architectural concepts by clearly explaining options, technical trade-offs, risks, and long-term implications. Works closely with cross-functional engineering, UX, and product teams to ensure alignment and secure buy-in. 
 - Architectural Ownership: Acts as the clear architectural owner for Embedded System platform. Demonstrates cross-team architectural ownership rather than experience limited to individual contributor delivery. 
 - Applied AI for Development: Uses AI-assisted engineering for refactoring, testing, migrations, documentation, debugging, and code review. Understands model selection and context/token management. Can define safe team-level AI development practices (validation, security, human-review controls) and demonstrate measurable improvements in productivity. 
 - Evidence-Based Direction: Challenges existing architecture when required and can demonstrate examples where technical direction was corrected based on evidence. 
 - Mentorship: Mentors senior engineers and Tech Leads, raising architectural capability across the team. Balances scalability, compatibility, performance, developer experience, security, and delivery needs. 

Required Skills

- Proven experience architecting platforms or large design systems used by multiple applications. 
 - Hands on Linux based embedded software development; able to own, create and deliver platform components, application development and analyze and resolve technical issues
 - Strong knowledge of Object-Oriented Analysis and Design, Software Design Patterns and C++ coding principles. 
 - Conduct technical design reviews of software to ensure reliability and performance
 - Interacting with global teams to promote consistency and maximize synergies across common software platforms
 - Ensuring SDLC process compliance during requirements gathering, architecture design, implementation, and verification. 
 - Aware of and comply with the GEHC Quality Manual, Quality Management System, Quality Management Policy, Quality Goals, and applicable laws and regulations as they apply to this job type/position
 - Complete all planned Quality & Compliance training within the defined deadlines. Identify and report any quality or compliance concerns and take immediate corrective action as required
 - Ensure compliance/closure of Regulatory and Quality requirements before approving Design Outputs/Program Deliverables
 - Lead continuous improvement activities by driving the implementation of process and product quality improvement initiatives

Qualifications & Essential Skills

- Bachelor's Degree / Masters in a relevant Engineering discipline (Electronics or Software is preferred)
 - 15+ years of experience in developing embedded Linux platform application with at least 3 years in a lead architect role specifically focused on Embedded software
 - Strong C, C++ language skills. 
 - Should have hands on experience in Shell / perl/ python scripting
 - Expertise in using Source control tools
 - Experience in Build automation and continuous integration
 - Excellent communication, leadership, and interpersonal skills to collaborate with architects, product managers, and executive stakeholders. 

Desired Skills

The Technical Lead - Quality Assurance is a senior technical leader responsible for driving end-to-end quality strategy, governance, and execution across assigned products or programs. This role combines deep hands-on expertise with leadership capabilities to ensure high-quality software delivery, strong automation adoption, and alignment with business and customer expectations. 

Operating across the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), the QA Technical Lead partners closely with Product, Engineering, and Client Delivery teams to define testing strategies, improve efficiency, and ensure robust validation of complex business workflows. The role plays a critical part in strengthening quality practices, reducing risk, and enabling predictable, high-quality releases. 

This position also focuses on building team capability, mentoring QA engineers, and driving innovation through automation, AI-driven testing, and continuous improvement initiatives. 

Deliverables and Performance Measures

- Define and execute end-to-end QA strategy aligned with product, business, and customer requirements

 - Drive risk-based testing approaches to prioritize critical functionalities and reduce production defects
 - Establish and enforce QA standards, frameworks, and best practices across teams
 - Monitor and analyze quality metrics such as defect leakage, test coverage, and execution efficiency
 - Lead root cause analysis (RCA) and implement corrective actions to improve product quality

data.title: Engineer - Controls Engineering
data.description:
Job Description Summary

Systems Engineering ist eine funktionsübergreifende technische Disziplin, die sich auf einen Ansatz, eine Denkweise und einen Prozess konzentriert. Alle Tätigkeiten, die sowohl die geschäftlichen als auch die technischen Anforderungen der Kunden berücksichtigen, mit dem Ziel, ein Qualitätsprodukt bereitzustellen, das die Anforderungen der Benutzer erfüllt. Die Disziplin zur Umsetzung eines soliden Prozesses zum Entwerfen, Erstellen und Optimieren von Systemen, der aus der Identifizierung und Quantifizierung von Systemanforderungen, der Erstellung alternativer Systementwurfskonzepte, der Durchführung von Design-Trade-off-Studien, der Auswahl und Implementierung der besten Entwürfe und der Überprüfung der Tatsache besteht, dass das Design ordnungsgemäß integriert ist und ausgeführt wird. Prozess, der vom Konzept über die Produktion bis zum Betrieb verläuft. 

Beeinflusst die Qualität der eigenen Arbeit und der Arbeit anderer im Team. Führt betriebliche/technische Standardaufgaben aus, die in der Regel Anweisungen und Arbeitsabläufen unterliegen. Möglicherweise besteht Spielraum, um die Reihenfolge zu ändern und Aufgaben/Pflichten basierend auf sich ändernden Arbeitssituationen zu erledigen. 

Job Description

Rollen und Verantwortlichkeiten

- Identifizieren, entwickeln, bewerten, führen ein und verwalten Engineering-Lösungen für die Anforderungen der Produkt- und Steuerungssystemtechnologie. Wenden die Steuerungstheorie und mathematische Modellierung auf Entwurfs- und Steuerungssysteme mit dem gewünschten Verhalten an. Beinhaltet Bedienbarkeit, Festlegen von Grenzen, Zyklusoptimierung, Steuerlogik, steuerungsbezogene Software, Sensoren, Hardware- und Softwarealgorithmen sowie Feedback zur Steuerung der Leistung von Geräten, Subsystemen und Systemen. 
 - Erweiterung der Kenntnisse der eigenen technischen Disziplin zur Umsetzung von Richtlinien/Strategien. Kann Support-Rollen mit spezialisiertem technischem Wissensgebiet beinhalten; laufender Erwerb von Kenntnissen und Fähigkeiten auf höherem Niveau. 
 - Grundlegendes Verständnis der wichtigsten Geschäftstreiber; nutzt dieses Verständnis, um eigene Arbeit zu leisten. Gute Kenntnisse darüber, wie sich die Arbeit des eigenen Teams in andere Teams integriert und zum Bereich beiträgt. 
 - Kann eine gewisse Autonomie besitzen, um Entscheidungen innerhalb eines definierten Rahmens zu treffen. Löst Probleme in Situationen, in denen gute technische Kenntnisse und Urteilsvermögen im Rahmen festgelegter Verfahren erforderlich sind. Konsultiert hochrangigere Teammitglieder zu Problemen außerhalb definierter Anweisungen/Parameter. 
 - Eine Stelle auf diesem Niveau erfordert gute zwischenmenschliche Fähigkeiten und kann notwendig sein, um ein Junior-Team zu führen. Entwickelt für kundenorientierte Rollen starke Kundenbeziehungen und dient als Schnittstelle zwischen Kunden und GE Vernova. Erklärt anderen technische Informationen. 

Grundqualifikationen

- Diese Rolle erfordert grundlegende Erfahrung . Der Wissensstand ist vergleichbar mit einem Bachelor-Abschluss einer akkreditierten Universität oder Hochschule (oder einem Abitur mit entsprechender Erfahrung). 

Gewünschte Eigenschaften

- Sehr gute mündliche und schriftliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten. Ausgeprägte Sozialkompetenz und Führungsqualitäten. Fähigkeit, selbständig zu arbeiten. Starke Fähigkeiten zur Problemlösung. Hinweis: Um die Einwanderungsbestimmungen der USA und andere gesetzliche Anforderungen zu erfüllen, muss die Mindestanzahl der Jahre an Erfahrung angegeben werden, die für eine Tätigkeit in den USA erforderlich sind. Für Rollen außerhalb der USA sollten sich die JDs auf das für die Rolle erforderliche inhaltliche Erfahrungsniveau konzentrieren, um die Einhaltung der geltenden Rechtsvorschriften zu gewährleisten, und eine Mindestanzahl von Jahren sollte NICHT verwendet werden. Diese Stellenbeschreibung soll einen allgemeinen Leitfaden für die Rolle liefern. Sie soll jedoch nicht die von jedem Mitarbeiter gemäß dem jeweiligen Arbeitsvertrag und/oder gemäß einer anderweitigen Vereinbarung zwischen einem Mitarbeiter und seinem Vorgesetzten geforderten Pflichten ändern oder anderweitig einzuschränken/erweitern. 

Additional Information

Relocation Assistance Provided: Yes

Job Description

We are seeking a Lead AI Engineer with strong software engineering foundations and hands-on experience in Generative and Agentic AI. In this role, you will architect, design and build production-grade AI systems powered by large language models and intelligent agents. 

You will design scalable AI workflows, integrate autonomous agents into real-world applications, and help translate cutting-edge AI capabilities into reliable business solutions. 

Responsibilities

- Architect and Design production-ready applications leveraging Generative AI and agentic AI frameworks. 
 - Build, Deploy and Monitor intelligent workflows using LLMs, multi-agent coordination, and orchestration pipelines. 
 - Integrate new AI applications with traditional pre-existing applications. 
 - Implement prompt engineering strategies, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and contextual memory systems. 
 - Implement various AI coding techniques (context-driven, spec-driven development etc. ). 
 - Architect and implement AI agents capable of reasoning, planning, and multi-step task execution. 
 - Implement and utilize Model Context Protocol (MCP) patterns to enable structured communication between agents, tools, and systems. 
 - Provide mentoring and technical guidance to developers and other AI Engineers. 
 - Develop evaluation pipelines to measure accuracy, safety, and performance of AI systems. 
 - Optimize latency, cost efficiency, and scalability of AI-powered workflows. 
 - Collaborate with product managers, data teams, and software engineers to deliver AI features. 
 - Ensure reliability through testing, logging, monitoring, and observability of AI behavior. 
 - Own architectural decisions, coding standards, and best practices. 
 - Act as an AI trailblazer for development teams by promoting best practices, reusable patterns, and adopting AI-driven engineering approaches. 
 - Apply AI governance principles to ensure responsible model usage, auditability, and transparency in AI workflows. 
 - Support implementation of governance controls related to data handling, model behavior monitoring, and risk mitigation. 
 - Research emerging AI tools and frameworks to continuously improve system capabilities. 
 - Document AI workflows and maintain reproducible engineering processes. 

Qualifications

data.title: Team Lead MEP - Stadiums, Sports Complexes & Arenas
data.description:
ROLE PURPOSE: 

Provide technical, operational, and people leadership for the MEP engineering function supporting US-based stadiums, sports complexes, arenas, and large-venue construction projects from Turner Technical Services offices in Mumbai or Bengaluru. Lead multidisciplinary engineering coordination, technical reviews, constructability, procurement support, testing and commissioning, quality, safety, schedule, risk, event-readiness, and system turnover. 

The Team Lead will coordinate with US project teams, owners, architects, design consultants, commissioning agents, trade partners, manufacturers, venue operators, technology providers, and internal teams. The role may be calibrated based on project complexity, technical accountability, team leadership, and demonstrated proficiency against the Engineering Career Development Qualifications. 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

- Technical & team leadership: Lead, mentor, and develop MEP engineering professionals; establish technical priorities, quality expectations, and delivery commitments. 
 - Project delivery: Lead engineering coordination for stadiums, arenas, sports complexes, training facilities, and other large public-assembly venues. 
 - MEP systems: Oversee HVAC, ventilation, plumbing, drainage, fire protection, controls, electrical distribution, emergency power, lighting, sports lighting, and life-safety systems. 
 - Venue-specific systems: Coordinate field/turf systems, retractable roofs and seating, scoreboards, LED displays, broadcast infrastructure, AV/ICT, security, access control, public-address, and venue technology. 
 - Crowd & life safety: Support engineering solutions for egress, emergency communication, mass notification, fire protection, crowd movement, accessibility, and event-day safety. 
 - Hospitality & athlete facilities: Coordinate MEP requirements for suites, premium clubs, concessions, kitchens, locker rooms, training areas, medical facilities, and athlete-support spaces. 
 - Design & constructability: Review drawings, specifications, RFIs, submittals, shop drawings, calculations, equipment selections, and installation sequencing; identify and resolve coordination issues. 
 - Testing & commissioning: Coordinate TAB, equipment start-up, controls verification, functional testing, emergency-power testing, life-safety testing, integrated systems testing, and event simulations. 
 - Project controls: Track engineering deliverables, RFIs, submittals, procurement, long-lead equipment, schedule constraints, commissioning activities, and event-readiness milestones. 
 - Risk management: Identify and mitigate technical, schedule, quality, safety, life-safety, operational, and event-readiness risks. 
 - Stakeholder management: Maintain effective relationships with project teams, clients, designers, contractors, venue operators, commissioning agents, and technology providers. 
 - Closeout & turnover: Coordinate record documents, O&M manuals, warranties, test reports, commissioning documentation, training, and final system acceptance. 
 - Continuous improvement: Promote Lean practices, standardization, knowledge sharing, digital tools, and lessons learned across projects. 

QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE

- Relevant experience of 12+ years, at least 5 years in sports complex/stadium projects
 - Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related engineering discipline. 
 - Progressive experience in MEP engineering, construction engineering, design coordination, commissioning, or complex building-project delivery. 
 - Stadium, arena, sports complex, entertainment, hospitality, or large public-assembly experience strongly preferred. 
 - Strong knowledge of HVAC, electrical distribution, emergency power, plumbing, fire protection, controls, lighting, life safety, ICT, AV, and building systems. 
 - Understanding of US building, electrical, mechanical, fire/life-safety, accessibility, and public-assembly codes and standards. 
 - Demonstrated ability to lead multidisciplinary teams and mentor engineers. 
 - Strong technical problem-solving, communication, coordination, and stakeholder-management skills. 
 - Experience project platforms such as Procore, Autodesk Construction Cloud, Bluebeam, or similar tools preferred. 
 - Ability to manage multiple priorities and provide working-hour overlap with US-based project teams. 
 - Flexibility to support critical project and event milestones, including sporting events, concerts, opening events, and commissioning activities.

Job Description

Be part of the solution at Technip Energies and embark on a one-of-a-kind journey. You will be helping to develop cutting-edge solutions to solve real-world energy problems. 

We are currently seeking a Lead full Stack Developer, to join our Chennai Team, and this position will be directly reporting to Head of the Department. 

About us: 

Technip Energies is a global technology and engineering powerhouse. With leadership positions in LNG, hydrogen, ethylene, sustainable chemistry, and CO2 management, we are contributing to the development of critical markets such as energy, energy derivatives, decarbonization, and circularity. Our complementary business segments, Technology, Products and Services (TPS) and Project Delivery, turn innovation into scalable and industrial reality. 

Through collaboration and excellence in execution, our 17, 000+ employees across 34 countries are fully committed to bridging prosperity with sustainability for a world designed to last. 

About the mission we offer you: 

As a Lead Full Stack Developer, the candidate will be responsible for leading the design, development, and delivery of a scalable and high-performance application. They will work in collaboration with a team of full-stack developers in a Scrum-based environment, under the guidance of a Business Application Owner. 

The Lead Developer will play a critical role in ensuring the technical quality of the application by promoting best practices, ensuring secure coding standards, and optimizing performance. The candidate is expected to mentor team members, provide technical leadership, and act as the primary point of contact for technical challenges. A deep understanding of the business domain and the ability to translate complex functional requirements into scalable technical solutions are essential for success in this role. 

This role also requires hands-on technical expertise to address challenges in system design, database architecture, integration with microservices, and cloud deployment. The ideal candidate will be proactive, detail-oriented, and committed to delivering high-quality software solutions that align with business needs. 

Qualifications / Skills: 

- Software Development: 8 to 12 years of experience in web software development with demonstrated leadership capabilities. 
 - Database Expertise: 6+ years of hands-on experience with SQL Server, database optimization, and writing complex queries. 
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. 
 - Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. 
 - Ability to work independently. 

Starting Date: Immediately

About you: 

We love to hear from you and how you match with this position. To be successful in this mission you should consider the following requirements: 

Assignment, Context, Job Main Challenges & Key Expectations: 

- Learning Curve: The candidate is expected to quickly acquire deep knowledge of the application's technical and business context. 
 - Team Leadership: The candidate will mentor and guide the development team, ensuring they follow best practices in coding, design, and testing. 
 - Stakeholder Collaboration: Close collaboration with Product Owners (POs), test leads, and business stakeholders to refine user stories, resolve ambiguities, and ensure technical feasibility. 
 - Technical Ownership: The candidate will own the design, development, and delivery of complex modules, ensuring the application is secure, maintainable, and scalable. 
 - Code Quality and Security: The candidate is expected to champion DevSecOps practices, embedding security throughout the CI/CD pipeline and software development lifecycle. This 
 - includes advocating secure coding practices and leveraging tools such as SonarQube and Snyk to improve code quality and detect vulnerabilities. 
 - Continuous Improvement: Staying updated with emerging technologies and proactively identifying opportunities to enhance the application and development processes. 

Job Scope: 

- Analyze user stories and oversee the translation of functional requirements into technical tasks. 
 - Design and implement scalable, secure, and maintainable architecture solutions. 
 - Optimize database schema design, queries, and application performance. 
 - Ensure robust documentation, comprehensive unit testing, and effective resolution of issues. 
 - Act as a mentor and guide to the development team, ensuring adherence to coding standards and promoting a culture of technical excellence. 

Responsibilities: 

- Actively participate in and lead all Agile ceremonies daily standups, sprint planning, reviews, demos, and refinements. 
 - Collaborate with Product Owners (POs), developers, and other stakeholders to refine user stories and provide technical insights. 
 - Estimate user stories, allocate tasks, and guide team members during refinement and sprint planning. 
 - Implement user stories with clean, maintainable, and secure code. 
 - Design scalable and reliable architecture while ensuring adherence to security and performance benchmarks. 
 - Utilize tools such as SonarQube and Snyk to identify and resolve code vulnerabilities, technical debt, and code smells. 
 - Conduct and oversee thorough code reviews to maintain quality and enforce secure coding practices. 
 - Integrate DevSecOps practices into the CI/CD pipeline, including automated security scanning using SonarQube (SAST) and Snyk (dependency/container vulnerability checks), secrets management, DAST, and compliance-as-code, ensuring security is a shared responsibility across the development lifecycle. 
 - Leverage AI-assisted development tools (e. g. , GitHub Copilot, Claude) to accelerate coding, automate code review feedback, enforce code quality standards, and generate documentation; evaluate and responsibly adopt AI/ML capabilities within the application where they deliver measurable business value. 
 - Ensure responsible use of AI tools in line with company AI policy: review all AI-generated code before merge and never share confidential or client data in prompts. 
 - Manage Azure cloud resources, Azure API Management, Azure Key Vault, Azure Monitor, and Application Insights. 
 - Design and write comprehensive unit test cases to ensure high reliability and code coverage. 
 - Debug and resolve complex issues identified in QA, UAT, pre-production, and production environments. 
 - Provide production support, troubleshoot issues, and ensure system reliability during hyper-care and beyond. 
 - Mentor team members, facilitate knowledge-sharing sessions, and foster team development. 
 - Stay updated on emerging technologies and propose their adoption when relevant. 
 - Lead strategies for code cleanup, performance optimization, and process improvements. 
 - Maintain Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) and own the technical roadmap for the application. 
 - Track and manage technical debt as a prioritized backlog item, agreed with the Product Owner. 
 - Lead incident management for production issues, including root cause analysis (RCA) and preventive actions. 
 - Coordinate with other application teams, vendors, and infrastructure and cyber security teams, including support for architecture and security reviews. 
 - Participate in technical interviews and contribute to hiring and onboarding developers. 

Success Measures (KPIs): 

- Sprint predictability: committed versus delivered story points. 
 - Defect leakage to UAT and production. 
 - Unit test code coverage meeting the agreed target. 
 - SonarQube quality gate pass rate on all pipelines. 
 - Closure of security vulnerabilities (SonarQube, Snyk) within the agreed SLA. 
 - Timely resolution of production incidents with completed RCA. 
 - Growth in team capability through mentoring and knowledge sharing. 

Preferred Certifications: 

- Microsoft Certified: Azure Developer Associate (AZ-204) 
 - Microsoft Certified: DevOps Engineer Expert (AZ-400) 
 - Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305) 
 - Certified ScrumMaster (CSM) or Professional Scrum Master (PSM)

Your career with us

Working at Technip Energies is an inspiring journey, filled with groundbreaking projects and dynamic collaborations. Surrounded by diverse and talented individuals, you will feel welcomed, respected, and engaged. Enjoy a safe, caring environment where you can spark new ideas, reimagine the future, and lead change. As your career grows, you will benefit from learning opportunities at T. EN University, such as The Future Ready Program, Graduate Program, and from the support of your manager through check-in moments like the Mid-Year Development Review, fostering continuous growth and development. 

What's Next?

Once receiving your system application, our recruiting team will screen and match your skills, experience, and potential team fit against the role requirements. We ask for your patience as the team completes the volume of applications with reasonable timeframe. Check your application progress periodically via personal account from created candidate profile during your application. 

We invite you to get to know more about our company by visiting www. ten. com and follow us on LinkedIn , Instagram , Facebook , X and YouTube for company updates.

We are investing in modern engineering practices that make our platforms easier to build, operate, and support. 

You will: 

- Define and promote DevOps, DevSecOps, and Platform Engineering practices across the Data Platform capability. 
 - Develop reusable automation, CI/CD pipelines, engineering templates, and self-service tooling that help teams move faster. 
 - Improve platform onboarding and delivery through Infrastructure as Code, automation, and standard patterns. 
 - Reduce operational complexity by replacing manual processes with repeatable engineering practices. 

Strengthen Reliability, Security, and Compliance

We believe reliable and secure platforms are built into the engineering

process, not added afterwards. 

You will: 

- Improve monitoring, observability, alerting, operational visibility, and service health across platform services. 
 - Ensure AWS services and platform components align with standards and controls defined by Central Cloud Engineering and Cyber Security teams. 
 - Identify, prioritise, and coordinate remediation of vulnerabilities, cloud configuration findings, compliance gaps, and operational risks. 
 - Lead incident response, root cause analysis, and continuous improvement activities that strengthen platform resilience. 
 - Maintain operational documentation, controls, and evidence required for audit and compliance reviews. 

Enable Faster Delivery

We want teams to spend less time managing environments and more time delivering solutions. 

You will: 

- Work with Architects and Engineering teams to implement approved designs using standardised tooling and deployment practices. 
 - Coordinate release readiness, environments, and operational support for new platform capabilities. 
 - Support onboarding of services and data integrations into Corporate Data Cloud. 
 - Use operational metrics and engineering insights to reduce deployment risk, lead time, recurring incidents, and technical debt. 
 - Explore AI-assisted operations, automation, and operational intelligence capabilities that improve service health and engineer productivity. 

Lead and Partner

We work collaboratively across engineering, architecture, security, and operations teams. 

You will: 

- Coach and support engineers across DevOps and Platform Engineering disciplines. 
 - Partner with Product Owners, Architects, Central Cloud Engineering, Cyber Security, and delivery teams to resolve dependencies and achieve shared outcomes. 
 - Represent Data Platforms within operational governance, cloud compliance reviews, and engineering forums. 
 - Communicate platform health, risks, vulnerabilities, and delivery progress clearly to stakeholders. 
 - Promote knowledge sharing, continuous improvement, and practical engineering standards across the team. 

About You

You are an experienced DevOps or Platform Engineering professional who enjoys improving reliability, simplifying operations, and helping teams deliver technology more effectively. 

You combine strong technical skills with practical judgement, collaboration, and a continuous improvement mindset. You are comfortable working across engineering, architecture, operations, and security teams while balancing delivery speed, platform stability, and compliance requirements. 

You Will Bring

- 6+ years of experience in DevOps, Platform Engineering, Cloud Engineering, Site Reliability Engineering, or related technology disciplines. 
 - Experience supporting enterprise Data, Analytics, or Cloud platforms in production environments. 
 - Strong knowledge of CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, automation, configuration management, and release engineering practices. 
 - Practical experience with AWS and modern Data Platform technologies such as Snowflake, Microsoft Fabric, or equivalent cloud-based solutions. 
 - Experience implementing cloud engineering standards and remediating security vulnerabilities, compliance findings, and operational risks. 
 - Knowledge of monitoring, observability, incident management, problem management, and service reliability practices. 
 - Understanding of cloud security controls, operational risk management, audit requirements, and IT service management principles. 
 - Experience leading technical work and collaborating across matrixed delivery teams. 
 - Strong communication, stakeholder management, problem-solving, and decision-making skills. 
 - Experience working within regulated or operationally complex environments is advantageous. 
 - A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 

How We Work

- We automate wherever it improves safety, speed, reliability, or consistency. 
 - We build platforms that are secure, resilient, scalable, and easy to operate. 
 - We favour reusable tooling, common patterns, and self-service capabilities over one-off solutions. 
 - We learn from production, measure outcomes, and continuously improve. 
 - We work closely with engineering and control functions to ensure the compliant path is also the simplest path. 
 - We believe the best solutions are created through collaboration, ownership, and shared learning. 

Why This Role Matters

Every analytics, automation, machine learning, and AI initiative depends on reliable platform services and strong engineering foundations. 

As DevOps Lead, you will influence how Data Platform capabilities are built, secured, deployed, and operated. Your work will help teams deliver changes faster, improve service reliability, strengthen cloud compliance, and create a better engineering experience across Corporate Data Cloud. 

This is a role with visible impact, broad technical exposure, and the opportunity to shape the future of Platform Engineering within Data Platforms. 

Inclusion and Accessibility

We are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work. 

We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe diverse teams build better solutions and stronger products. 

If you require an adjustment or accommodation during the recruitment process or while performing the role, we will work with you to provide the support you need

We're proud to have been recognised as a Great Place to Work® in India '25
