 - Strong communication skills with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.

BNP Paribas is a top-ranking bank in Europe with an international profile. It operates in 71 countries and has almost 199 000 employees. data.title: Director, Software Engineer -
data.description:
More than 3 billion people in over 180 countries use WhatsApp to stay in touch with friends and family, anytime and anywhere. In India, it is also where a great deal of everyday life gets done - people message businesses, coordinate their families, and increasingly send money as easily as they send a message. We are building a new team to take WhatsApp further in that direction. The newly established WhatsApp Services team is focused on making WhatsApp more useful for more of what people already use it for, and on building what comes next. This engineering leader for India will oversee the newly established WhatsApp Services team, treated as a zero-to-one effort so we can move fast, take risks, and build as we go. Staffed and prioritized, like every other WhatsApp team, from day one. Payments on WhatsApp aren't a bet on paper: live and growing in India; the existing WhatsApp payments engineering team moves across as the foundation. As an engineering leader at WhatsApp, you will use your start-up mindset and your full range of engineering leadership skills to produce elegantly simple products. You'll be expected to push the boundaries of what's possible in a mobile app, while sharing in our commitment to quality and attention to detail. This is a role for someone who can hold both the ceiling and the floor: sets an ambitious long-term technical vision for what WhatsApp can become in India. 

Director, Software Engineer - WhatsApp Responsibilities: 

- Build, manage and support varied teams of engineers and engineering managers delivering one of the highest-priority initiatives across WhatsApp and Meta. 
 - Define and execute engineering strategy and multi-team roadmaps that balance technical investment, emerging capabilities and business priorities. 
 - Establish a shared technical vision across the company (WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook, Messenger) and ensure all teams are clear on the strategy, the problem to solve, the timeline and the contribution required of them. 
 - Build and scale the engineering organization by attracting, developing and retaining engineers and engineering managers across multiple teams. 
 - Establish team structures and operating models that maximize impact while minimizing organizational complexity and execution overhead. 
 - Partner with product, design and data science counterparts to drive shared accountability for outcomes across the full product development lifecycle. 
 - Proactively identify and resolve the largest cross-functional execution risks, including vision gaps, dependency conflicts and organizational blockers, escalating clearly when team priorities conflict. 
 - Cultivate a culture of executional excellence and analytical rigor, driving process improvements across teams and functions that reduce operational overhead and accelerate delivery. 
 - Champion engineering craft and quality standards across teams, fostering a self-reinforcing culture of continuous improvement. 
 - Monitor and act on organizational health signals to maintain high engagement, low attrition and effective team dynamics across reporting lines. 
 - Develop a leadership bench through both external hiring and internal growth, and contribute to company-wide engineering initiatives including recruiting, mentorship and technical standards. 

Minimum Qualifications: 

- 10+ years of technical industry experience in software engineering
 - 7+ years of engineering management experience, including managing other engineering managers
 - Track record of building and scaling engineering organizations, including recruiting, developing and retaining engineers and engineering managers
 - Proven track record of delivering and operating large-scale production systems
 - Experience establishing technical strategy and organizational roadmaps across multiple teams, with demonstrated ability to drive execution against them
 - Experience forming cross-functional partnerships across product, design and data science to deliver large-scale engineering outcomes
 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, relevant technical field, or equivalent practical experience

Preferred Qualifications: 

- Experience building and operating payment systems at scale, including the reliability, correctness and regulatory requirements they carry
 - Background in monetization, payments, commerce, or AI/ML products
 - Experience building 0-to-1 organizations or standing up new product areas
 - Experience with global, multi-market products (particularly emerging markets)

Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. People who choose to build their careers by building with us at Meta help shape a future that will take us beyond what digital connection makes possible today-beyond the constraints of screens, the limits of distance, and even the rules of physics.

data.description:
Life at Plume

At Plume, we believe that technology isn't about moving faster, it's about making life's moments better. Which is why we've built the world's first, and only, open and hardware-independent service delivery platform for smart homes, small businesses, enterprises, and beyond. Our SaaS platform uses WiFi, advanced AI, and machine learning to create the future of connected spaces-and human experiences-at massive scale. 

We now deliver services to over 60 million locations globally and have managed over 3 billion devices on our platform. We're expanding rapidly, pioneering a new category, and we achieved our Series F funding in just four years. Our customers include many of the world's largest Internet Service Providers (ISPs) who look to Plume to help them evolve their smart home offerings while gleaning insights from their own data. 

With a bias for action and a love for being trailblazers, the team at Plume embodies a combination of relentless curiosity and imaginative innovation. We challenge ourselves to think in ways that other companies don't, work to do what should be done (rather than what can), and if we can't do it exceptionally well, we don't do it. It's how we've assembled a team of world-class builders, thinkers, and doers. And it's how we're reinventing what's possible every day. 

This is a work-from-office / In-Office role based in our Hyderabad, India location. 

Plume's Core Engineering team builds the open-standards firmware foundation of our platform across RDK-B, prplOS and OpenWRT and OpenSync. We are looking for a Staff Engineer to own the controller based broadband router firmware stack end to end: architecture, design, implementation, upstreaming

You will be the technical lead for various features like device management, network management, Wi-Fi and multi-AP mesh features such as backhaul management and steering, onboarding and metrics etc. 

What You'll Do

- Own architecture and design for various CPE features like EasyMesh, Wi-Fi Optimization, remote and local controller over standard SDK platforms like RDK-B, PrplOS, OpenWRT and OpenSync. This includes deep Wi-Fi sub-system management like backhaul link tracking, standard and hitless (make-before-break) backhaul steering, backhaul STA policies, and AP/STA metrics. 
 - Break large features into sequenced, reviewable work. Write design documents, feature matrices and validation reports that both engineers and program stakeholders can use. 
 - Maintain Plume's RDK-B Yocto layer and patch framework. Lead quarterly rebases onto new RDK-B releases and keep reference builds healthy on gateway and extender targets. 
 - Close gaps in TR-181 data models exposed through USP (obuspa) and UBus, RBus, including Wi-Fi DataElements, DHCP and DNS. 
 - Deliver onboarding flows: WPS, Wi-Fi EasyConnect (DPP) and backhaul onboarding, with WPA3/SAE, 6 GHz and Wi-Fi 7 MLO support. 
 - Triage and fix Alpha, Beta and GA blockers: mesh instability, IPv6 dual-stack and RA behavior, routing, firmware upgrade failures, and CPU and memory regressions. Back each fix with measured before/after data. 
 - Upstream fixes to opensource community like RDK Central, PrplOS, OpenWRT and evaluate competing community contributions against our own implementation. 
 - Contribute to cross-platform work on prplOS/prplMesh and OpenSync, including porting spikes and architecture comparisons. 
 - Review code and mentor engineers. Work closely with QA, program management and architects in other regions. 

What You'll Bring

- 10+ years building embedded Linux or networking firmware, with 4+ years on Wi-Fi or broadband CPE software. 
 - Strong C and C++ on Linux user space, plus shell scripting. Comfortable debugging on target with gdb, core dumps, /proc and packet captures. 
 - Hands-on RDK-B (e. g. CCSP components, RBus, OneWifi, WebConfig, and Yocto/BitBake builds) and PrplOS experiences
 - Deep 802. 11 knowledge: hostapd and wpa_supplicant, 802. 11k/v/r and BTM, WPA3/SAE, 6 GHz, MLO. 
 - Working knowledge of EasyMesh and IEEE 1905. 1: topology discovery, TLVs, controller/agent state machines and backhaul. 
 - TR-181 and USP/TR-369. TR-069 experience is a plus. 
 - Solid IP networking: IPv4/IPv6 dual stack, DHCPv4/v6, router advertisements, routing, netfilter/iptables and QoS. 
 - A track record of taking features from spike to GA, with written designs that others build from. 
 - Fluent in Git and GitHub pull-request workflows, quilt-style patch management and Jenkins CI. 

About Plume

As the creator of the only open, hardware-independent, cloud-controlled experience platform for ISPs and their subscribers, Plume partners with over 400 ISP customers, including some of the world's largest such as Charter, Liberty Global, and J: COM. 

Using OpenSync, the most widely supported open-source, silicon-to-cloud framework for smart spaces, Plume's software-defined network allows ISPs to decouple their service offerings from hardware and rapidly curate and deliver new services over a multi-vendor, open-platform architecture.

data.description:

To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value, demonstrating the impact of shared infrastructure at scale. By centralizing conversations, automation and intelligence into one system, we help businesses move faster, reduce complexity and execute efficiently. 

Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2. 5 billion message events daily. With 250 terabytes of distributed data, 250+ microservices and over 1 million domain names supported, our architecture is built for performance, resilience and long-term scalability. 

Our People

With over 2, 000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home. 

Our Impact

Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1. 5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. We're proud to be a part of that. 

Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts

About The Role

We are looking for a Staff Engineer - Backend to help design, build, and evolve the systems powering HighLevel's CRM platform. This is a senior individual contributor role for an engineer who can solve complex backend and distributed systems problems, influence architecture across teams, and raise the engineering bar across the organization. 

You will work on systems handling high-volume APIs, asynchronous processing, large datasets, search and indexing, event-driven workflows, and business-critical operations at scale. This role requires someone who can move comfortably between architecture and implementation. You should be able to investigate a production bottleneck, design a scalable solution, challenge existing architectural assumptions, and work hands-on with engineers to take that solution to production. 

What You Ll Do

- Design and evolve highly scalable, reliable backend systems and services 
 - Lead architecture for complex and cross-team backend initiatives 
 - Design APIs, data models, event-driven workflows, and service boundaries 
 - Build systems capable of handling high-throughput requests and large-scale datasets 
 - Design asynchronous processing using queues, events, streams, and background workers 
 - Make architectural decisions around relational databases, NoSQL databases, search systems, caching, and messaging infrastructure 
 - Identify performance bottlenecks across applications, databases, queues, and infrastructure 
 - Improve API latency, throughput, resource utilization, and system scalability 
 - Design systems for graceful degradation, retries, idempotency, failure recovery, and fault tolerance 
 - Establish patterns for data consistency and distributed workflows across services 
 - Lead database and data-access optimization initiatives 
 - Design effective caching, indexing, partitioning, sharding, and data-retention strategies 
 - Improve observability through metrics, logs, tracing, dashboards, and actionable alerts 
 - Lead investigations into complex production incidents and drive permanent corrective actions 
 - Define engineering standards around reliability, scalability, testing, security, and maintainability 
 - Review architecture proposals and critical code changes across teams 
 - Identify systemic technical debt and drive pragmatic modernization initiatives 
 - Partner with Product and Engineering leadership to make technical trade-offs based on business requirements 
 - Mentor senior engineers and develop stronger technical ownership across teams 
 - Remain hands-on and contribute code to critical systems and initiatives

Minimum Qualifications

- 8+ years of software engineering experience, with significant experience building backend systems at scale 
 - Strong proficiency in at least one backend language such as Node. js/TypeScript, Go, Java, or similar 
 - Strong understanding of distributed systems and microservice architecture 
 - Deep understanding of API design and service-to-service communication 
 - Strong knowledge of relational and NoSQL database systems 
 - Experience designing systems involving large datasets and high request volumes 
 - Strong understanding of concurrency, asynchronous processing, queues, and event-driven architectures 
 - Experience with caching and distributed caching strategies 
 - Strong understanding of database indexing, query optimization, transactions, and data consistency 
 - Experience designing reliable systems with retries, idempotency, timeouts, rate limiting, and failure recovery 
 - Strong understanding of scalability, availability, consistency, and performance trade-offs 
 - Experience diagnosing complex production issues using metrics, logs, and distributed tracing 
 - Strong system design and architectural decision-making skills 
 - Demonstrated ability to lead technically complex initiatives involving multiple engineers or teamsPreferred Qualifications 
 - Strong experience with Node. js / TypeScript and Go 
 - Experience operating distributed systems at significant scale 
 - Experience with Elasticsearch / OpenSearch 
 - Experience with PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Firestore, or similar databases 
 - Experience with Kafka, Pub/Sub, RabbitMQ, SQS, or similar messaging systems 
 - Experience with Redis and distributed caching 
 - Experience designing search, indexing, aggregation, and reporting systems 
 - Experience with high-volume event processing and data pipelines 
 - Experience with Kubernetes and cloud-native infrastructure 
 - Experience with AWS, GCP, or similar cloud platforms 
 - Experience with observability platforms such as Grafana, Prometheus, OpenTelemetry, or similar tooling 
 - Experience designing multi-tenant SaaS platforms 
 - Experience with CRM, workflow automation, task management, messaging, or similar products 
 - Experience performing large-scale data migrations without significant customer Impact

Tech Stack

Backend: Node. js, TypeScript, Go

Databases & Search: MySQL, MongoDB, Firestore, Elasticsearch/OpenSearch

Caching: Redis

Messaging & Events: Kafka, Pub/Sub

Architecture: Microservices, REST APIs, Event-Driven Systems

Infrastructure: Kubernetes, GCP

Observability: Metrics, Logs, Distributed Tracing and Alerting

What Success Looks Like

A successful Staff Engineer: 

- Designs systems that remain reliable as traffic and data volume grow significantly 
 - Solves architectural problems that affect multiple services and engineering teams 
 - Identifies scalability and reliability risks before they become production incidents 
 - Improves latency, throughput, availability, and infrastructure efficiency 
 - Makes strong technical decisions around data storage, caching, messaging, and service architecture 
 - Simplifies complex systems rather than introducing unnecessary abstractions 
 - Creates reusable architectural patterns that improve engineering velocity across teams 
 - Leads ambiguous technical initiatives from problem definition through production 
 - Raises the quality of system design and technical decision-making across the organization 
 - Improves operational excellence through better observability, incident prevention, and failure recovery 
 - Mentors engineers to independently solve increasingly complex systems problems 
 - Remains hands-on and capable of going deep into production systems when required

What We Look For

We are looking for engineers who think about systems beyond the happy path. 

A Staff Engineer should naturally ask: 

- What happens when this system handles 10x the current traffic?
 - What happens when a dependency becomes slow or unavailable?
 - How does this behave when millions of events arrive within a short period?
 - What are our consistency guarantees, and where can we tolerate eventual consistency?
 - How do we prevent duplicate processing and make operations idempotent?
 - Is the database the bottleneck, or are we solving the problem at the wrong layer?
 - Should this data live in a transactional database, search engine, cache, or event stream?
 - How do we migrate this architecture without disrupting existing customers?
 - How will we observe this system in production and know when it is degrading?
 - Can we solve this once at the platform level instead of every team solving it independently

The Staff Engineer role is not defined by writing the most code. It is defined by identifying the highest-leverage technical problems, making strong architectural decisions, solving the hardest parts, and enabling engineering teams to build reliable systems faster. 

Why Join Us

- Build backend systems operating at significant global scale
 - Solve challenging distributed systems and data architecture problems
 - Influence architecture across multiple products and engineering teams
 - Work with high-volume APIs, event streams, databases, search systems, and distributed infrastructure
 - Drive improvements in scalability, reliability, performance, and engineering efficiency
 - Remain deeply technical without moving into people management
 - Work in a fast-moving engineering environment with significant autonomy and Ownership

This information is used solely for compliance with government recordkeeping, reporting, and other legal requirements. Providing this information is voluntary and refusal to do so will not affect your application status. This data will be kept separate from your application and will not be used in the hiring decision.

Senior Rust Software Engineer (Desktop Native)

Bitwarden promotes better internet security and safety with the leading open source password management solution for individuals, teams, and business organizations. Our philosophy on security is that "we are all in this together" - we continue to offer a full-featured free version of Bitwarden so that everyone can be protected with strong password management. We also provide enterprise-grade solutions to some of the largest companies in the world, and will continue to innovate in the identity and authentication market as the world starts to grow beyond passwords. Read more on the Bitwarden blog. 

As a Senior Rust Engineer on the Desktop Native team, you will own desktop autofill and native OS integrations, including the SSH agent, Autotype, native passkeys, and the DuckDuckGo integration, built on the same cross-platform Rust SDK that also powers browser autofill. This role is primarily for someone strong in Rust, FFI and language bindings, and native OS-level integration on Windows, macOS, and Linux, with the unusual challenge of delivering secure, reliable native experiences on top of a zero-knowledge, end-to-end encrypted product. This is not primarily a front-end or UI role. 

WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Design, build, and maintain native desktop integrations including the SSH agent, Autotype, native passkeys, and the DuckDuckGo integration
 - Participate in the hands-on design, development, and evolution of the shared Rust SDK, including language bindings and FFI, consumed across desktop and browser clients
 - Interface directly with OS-level APIs on Windows, macOS, and Linux to deliver reliable native behavior. 
 - Improve performance, reliability, security, and maintainability of native integrations handling sensitive credential data. 
 - Partner with product, design, QA, and the Autofill team to deliver high-quality experiences end to end. 
 - Review pull requests and help raise the quality of native/systems engineering, including community contributions in GitHub. 
 - Identify technical debt and contribute to pragmatic refactoring and architecture improvements to the Desktop Native roadmap
 - Participate in code reviews, learning, and spreading technical knowledge
 - Independently plan, estimate, and deliver new feature work and bug fixes
 - Occasionally review & approve bug fixes submitted by the user community

WHAT YOU BRING TO BITWARDEN

- Strong production Rust experience - 4-6+ years overall backend/systems experience, including FFI and language bindings
 - Native desktop application experience, interfacing directly with OS-level APIs on Windows, macOS, or Linux
 - Experience designing and versioning cross-platform SDKs or shared libraries consumed by multiple client surfaces
 - Experience using AI tooling in your development and testing workflow (Anthropic Claude preferred)
 - Experience with Electron, TypeScript, and other web tech for cross-platform desktop applications and web clients is a plus
 - Collaborative and adaptable mindset
 - Openness and authenticity combined with excellent communication skills
 - Excitement and enthusiasm for open source and for better internet security 
 - Excellent problem-solving skills - you might not know all the answers, but you know how to find and communicate the solution

WHY WORK WITH US

- Our user community loves us and we love them. Come to work each day with a sense of purpose as we bring a more secure internet experience to everyone from our friends and family to the world's largest organizations. 
 - Become an expert. You'll get immersed in the prominent technology markets of security and open source software. 
 - We are dedicated to building a diverse and talented team. Work remotely with motivated and supportive team members across the world. 
 - Learn and grow. Take on new challenges with the support of your team, and join our #growth-club to continue personal and professional development. 
 - At Bitwarden, we are passionate about what we do, but not necessarily everything we do. Our engineering team makes it a policy to carve out some time for personal growth, learning, skill building and pursuing personal passions that positively impact the team and company. To ensure that everyone has time to reaffirm their purpose and grow, you are encouraged to self-direct up to 15% of your week to what you feel is important for the company and for yourself. 

Equal Opportunity Employer

We are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where everyone can do their best work. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and make employment decisions based on skills, experience, qualifications, and business needs.

Core Engineering

 - Build and maintain data, model, and application pipelines with the logging, monitoring, and reproducibility that keep them trustworthy in production. 
 - Build the evaluation that lets the team trust a change before it ships - the eval set, the metrics, the honest before-and-after - offline, and online where the stakes justify it. 
 - Reproduce, triage, and fix issues in live systems, then add the tests or monitoring that stop them recurring. 
 - Keep an eye on the cost, latency, and reliability of the models and services you run - production ML and AI carry a real operational bill. 

Depending on the focus area, the responsibility will also entail: 

- Machine Learning & Modeling - build, evaluate, and productionize models end to end: feature engineering, training, and rigorous offline and online evaluation with drift and fairness monitoring. 
 - AI / GenAI Engineering - build RAG and agentic pipelines, with the prompt and context engineering, evaluation, and observability that keep them reliable where wrong answers have real consequences. 
 - ML Platform & MLOps - build feature stores, model deployment and serving, CI/CD for ML, and pipeline orchestration; own the tooling other engineers build on. 

This role may require flexibility across shifts and locations based on business needs. 

QUALIFICATION

- Minimum Education: B. E. /B. Tech in Computer Science, Information Technology or related disciplines. 
 - Candidates should be from IITs, NITs, or other premier engineering institutes only.

Experience

- 0 - 1 years of experience. 

Foundation

SKILLS AND COMPETENCIES

- Genuine proficiency in Python, with solid command of data structures, algorithms, and problem-solving - and code you would be willing to show us: organized into functions and modules, version-controlled, with tests, not only notebook cells.

 - Fluency with SQL and working with real, messy data at some scale. 

Demonstrated through projects, internships, research, competitions (Kaggle), or open source: 

- At least one ML or AI system you have built that ran outside a notebook - a deployed model, a data or feature pipeline, a working RAG or agent prototype - that you can walk through, including the trade-offs you made and what you would change. 
 - An understanding that a good offline metric is not a working system: awareness of data leakage, distribution shift, and how you would measure success in production. 
 - Depth in at least one focus area: Applied ML and evaluation; MLOps and cloud/deployment tooling; or LLMs, RAG, and agentic frameworks. 

Bonus - Any Of This Help You Stand Out

- Exposure to a major cloud (AWS / GCP / Azure) and containerized deployment.

data.title: Software Engineer 6 (Architect Equivalent)
data.description:
Who are we?

Whatfix is an AI platform advancing the "userization" of enterprise applications, empowering companies to maximize the ROI of their digital investments. Technology needs adoption. It's no different for AI. As AI reshapes roles, workflows, and human-machine interactions, it also introduces new layers of complexity and user friction. This is where Whatfix plays a pivotal role. A decade old DNA of empowering people to succeed with technology and not replacing them. We call this philosophy Userization: the belief that technology must adapt to the user, not the other way around. 

At the heart of userization philosophy is ScreenSense, our proprietary AI engine, which continuously interprets both the context of what users are doing in an application or an AI tool and the intent behind their actions. By combining these signals, Whatfix delivers real-time guidance, nudges, knowledge, and automation directly in the flow of work. 

This intelligence powers our entire product suite. 

- Digital Adoption helps users get productive faster. 
 - Product Analytics uncovers friction and closes adoption gaps. 
 - Mirror allows employees to train in safe, simulated environments. 

These are embedded with Whatfix AI Agents which supercharge creation, insights, and user guidance. 

Our upcoming AI-first products are already creating a buzz in the market. 

- Seek is an AI-native assistant that not only knows your business context but can also act across applications to get work done on your behalf. 
 - Whatfix Mirror 2. 0 is the world's only System plus Role simulation with a complete assessment to lead the Gen AI simulation category. 

Together, these products reflect Whatfix's commitment to building enterprise-ready AI teammates that maximize productivity and ROI. It gives users a unified, intelligent way to find answers across systems, apps, and knowledge silos and helps anyone looking to deliver fast and contextual answers. 

Whatfix is bridging the gap between rapid technological change and human enablement-ensuring AI is not only embedded but also usable, trusted, and outcome-driven for every employee. 

At Whatfix, we're not just making software easier-we're making AI work for people. 

The company has seven offices across the US, India, UK, Germany, Singapore, and Australia and a presence across 40+ countries. 

Customers: 700+ enterprise customers, including 80+ Fortune 500 companies such as Shell, Schneider Electric, and UPS Supply Chain Solutions. 

Investors: A total of ~$270 million USD has been raised as yet. Most recently Series E round of $125 Million USD led by Warburg Pincus, with participation from existing investor SoftBank Vision Fund 2. Other investors include Cisco Investments, Eight Roads Ventures (A division of Fidelity Investments), Dragoneer, Peak XV Partners, and Stellaris Venture Partners. 

Whatfix's leadership is consistently recognized across top industry analysts and business rankings: 

- Won the 2025 AI Breakthrough Award for the Overall AI-based Analytics Solution of the Year
 - Only DAP to be recognized as a "Leader" across various DAP reports for the past 5+ years by leading analyst firms like Gartner, Forrester, IDC, and Everest Group. 
 - With over 45% YoY sustainable annual recurring revenue (ARR) growth, Whatfix is among the "Top 50 Indian Software Companies" as per G2 Best Software Awards. 
 - Named a Gartner Customers' Choice for DAP for the second year in a row (2024 and 2025)-the only vendor in the market to earn this distinction consecutively. 
 - We also boast a star rating of 4. 6 on G2 Crowd, 4. 5 on Gartner Peer Insights, and a super-high CSAT of 99. 8%
 - Stevie Award winner in the category (Bronze): Customer Service Department of the Year - Computer Software - 100 or More Employees. 
 - Winner of the ISG Paragon Innovation Award in partnership with Sophos (customer) for the EMEA region and finalist in the Transformation Award category. 
 - RemoteTech Breakthrough Awards winner for "Software Asset Management Solution of the Year"These recognitions are matched by business performance: 

- Highest-Ranking DAP on 2023 Deloitte Technology Fast 500TM North America for Fifth Consecutive Year
 - Listed on the Financial Times & Statista's High-Growth Companies Asia-Pacific 2025 list. 
 - Won the Silver for Stevie's Employer of the Year 2023 - Computer Software category and also recognized as Great Place to Work 2022-2023
 - Only DAP to be among the top 35% companies worldwide in sustainability excellence with EcoVadis Bronze Medal

What you'll own

- Complex initiatives, end to end. The technical outcome, risks, dependencies and delivery of initiatives that cross system and team boundaries. 
 - Technical direction. You write and review specs and designs, challenge assumptions, and catch architectural, scalability, reliability, security and operational risks early. You take major designs to our Architecture Review Board (ARB). 
 - Clarity for others. You break large initiatives into outcomes that can be delivered on their own, so several engineers and coding agents can execute in parallel without waiting on you. 
 - AI in the product. You design and ship AI-powered capabilities, such as LLM integration, agents and tool calling, retrieval and evaluation, held to the same bar as any production system: latency, cost, safety and tenant isolation. 
 - Production quality. You use production and customer issues to find systemic weaknesses, and fix them so whole classes of problems don't come back. 
 - A stronger team. You mentor several engineers, share reusable specs, patterns and tooling, and help hire across Engineering. 
 - Customer and product impact. You work with Product, customers and customer-facing teams, and help shape the roadmap with a clear technical point of view. 

How you'll build

- Spec first. Every meaningful change starts with a written spec: the problem, expected outcome, constraints and acceptance criteria. 
 - Delegate real work to agents. You hand substantial implementation to coding agents and give them what they need to succeed: repository context, instruction files, and tests written before delegation. 
 - Review like it matters. Agent output isn't correct because it compiles or passes its own tests. You catch the race condition, the missing index, the cache that never invalidates and the weak assumption before they reach production. 
 - Own what you merge. Whether you or an agent wrote it, you can explain, debug and change it without leaning on the agent. 
 - One discipline. Frontend, backend, data, testing, deployment and monitoring are all part of solving the problem. Technology is a tool, not a boundary. 
 - Safe use of AI. Approved tools only, with security, privacy, data and licensing requirements intact. 

Must-Have Skills: 

- 8-13 years building software in product companies. What you've owned matters more to us than the number. 
 - Strong engineering judgment in system design and distributed systems, including performance, scalability, fault tolerance and high availability. 
 - Full-stack depth. Our services are mostly Java and Spring Boot, our frontends TypeScript and React, backed by SQL and NoSQL stores and distributed caching such as Redis, on Docker, Kubernetes and cloud-native CI/CD. You're deep in at least one part of this and effective across all of it. 
 - Real experience with coding agents such as Claude Code, Cursor or Copilot on meaningful work. You've delegated substantial work, seen where agents go wrong, and changed how you scope and verify as a result. 
 - Hands-on experience building AI features: LLM APIs, prompt and context design, retrieval, agents and tool use, and evaluation. You understand the cost, latency and failure modes of probabilistic systems. 
 - A track record of leading technical initiatives across teams and mentoring engineers. 
 - Customer-first thinking, and clear written communication. Your specs and design docs are easy for people and agents to act on. 
 - Good to have: multi-tenant B2B SaaS experience, or frontend work embedded inside other applications, such as browser extensions or in-app overlays. 

Nice-to-Have: 

- Exposure to mobile product ecosystems and architecture considerations. 
 - Familiarity with front-end technologies like JavaScript/React JS
 - Prior experience in SaaS, B2B, or large-scale platform development. 

Why Join Us?

- Be part of a fast-growing team driving critical backend infrastructure for Whatfix products. 
 - Opportunity to work on modern technology stacks and contribute to systems at scale. 
 - Transparent growth path with clear expectations and regular reviews. 
 - Flexible work environment with high ownership and impactful challenges. 

Perks & Benefits (India)

- Best-in-class medical insurance coverage
 - Free lunch & dinner buffet
 - Doorstep cab drop facility
 - Education sponsorship
 - Internal job transfer & global mobility programs
 - Scope to represent Whatfix at global events
 - We also provide uncapped incentives, bonus plans and opportunities to employees (especially those in GTM teams) to travel to meet our global customers. 

Note: 

- We strive to live and breathe our Cultural Principles and encourage employees to demonstrate some of these core values - Customer First; Empathy; Transparency; Fail Fast and scale Fast; No Hierarchies for Communication; Deep Dive and innovate; Trust, Do it as you own it; 
 - We are an equal opportunity employer and value diverse people because of and not in spite of the differences. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status
 - At Whatfix, we deeply value collaboration, innovation, and human connection. We believe that being together in the office five days a week fosters open communication, strengthens our sense of community, and accelerates innovation-ultimately helping us achieve our goals more effectively. At the same time, we recognize the importance of flexibility in balancing personal and professional priorities. To support this, we offer the option to work from home up to two days per month. 
 - In any situation that requires additional flexibility, we're open to considering exceptions on a case-by-case basis to ensure you're supported in managing both work and life seamlessly.

data.title: Chapter Area Lead – Software Testing and Test Automation
data.description:
Role: Chapter Area Lead - Software Testing and Test Automation

About the role

Within Bosch Digital's Software Engineering Chapter Domain, we are looking for a senior technology and people leader to take responsibility for the Software Testing & Test Automation Chapter Area. 

The Chapter organization owns the professional "how": developing expertise, establishing methods and standards, growing people and ensuring functional excellence across delivery organizations. As Chapter Area Lead, you provide direction for this field and create the environment in which Chapter Leads and testing experts can succeed. 

The Chapter Area includes test automation, functional testing, load and performance testing, and test architecture. Its ambition is to strengthen end-to-end quality engineering, increase meaningful automation, develop reusable enablers and continuously improve software quality. 

What you will be responsible for

- Set the professional direction for software testing and test automation, translating business needs and technology developments into a clear capability strategy and roadmap. 
 - Define and evolve testing standards, methods, reference practices and guardrails while allowing teams appropriate flexibility for their product and delivery context. 
 - Lead, coach and develop Chapter Leads; strengthen succession, leadership capability and a culture of ownership, feedback and continuous learning. 
 - Build the required competence portfolio through recruiting, workforce planning, upskilling and reskilling, ensuring that expertise is available where business risk and demand are highest. 
 - Represent the Chapter Area toward the Software Engineering Chapter Domain, Product and Business Alliances, Tribes, regions and customers as a senior expert and thought leader. 
 - Drive reuse and cross-organizational adoption of test frameworks, practices and engineering enablers instead of fragmented project-specific solutions. 
 - Shape the evolution of AI-enabled quality engineering, continuous testing, automation, performance, security and reliability practices. 
 - Balance professional excellence with capacity, staffing, skill mix, utilization, cost and measurable business value. 

What we are looking for

You combine deep software-quality expertise with the ability to lead leaders, shape a global professional community and operate at the intersection of technology, people and business. 

Leadership experience

- Several years of substantial leadership experience in software engineering, IT, digital product development or a comparable technology environment. 
 - Experience leading leaders, multiple teams or a broad professional community rather than only one delivery team. 
 - A strong record of developing people, building capability and enabling others to take ownership. 
 - Experience influencing across functions, regions and organizational boundaries without relying solely on formal authority. 

Technical and professional expertise

- Recognized senior expertise in software testing, test automation or quality engineering. 
 - Deep understanding of software-development lifecycles, risk-based testing, test design and test-automation architecture. 
 - Practical knowledge across several areas: API and integration testing, functional and non-functional testing, load and performance testing, CI/CD and DevOps, test environments and data, quality metrics, secure software practices, reliability engineering. 
 - Ability to evaluate emerging approaches, including AI-assisted testing, and separate sustainable engineering improvements from short-lived tooling trends. 

Strategic and business capability

- Ability to translate technology and market developments into an actionable capability strategy. 
 - Sound judgment on where global standards and reuse create value and where local flexibility is necessary. 
 - Experience anticipating competence gaps and steering recruiting, development and deployment priorities. 
 - Confidence working with workforce supply and demand, capacity, staffing, investment priorities and measurable outcomes. 

Communication and stakeholder leadership

- Ability to explain complex engineering and quality topics in clear business terms. 
 - Confidence facilitating decisions where quality, delivery speed, capacity, cost and risk compete. 
 - Credibility with testing experts, engineering leaders, Product Owners, Product and Service Managers, architects and senior business stakeholders. 
 - Excellent English and the ability to work effectively across cultures and time zones. 

Your leadership style

- You grow by growing others and coach leaders instead of solving every problem personally. 
 - You lead through expertise, credibility and purpose, creating autonomy through clear alignment. 
 - You combine high technical standards with pragmatism, customer orientation and business judgment. 
 - You actively give and seek constructive feedback and create room for experimentation and learning. 
 - You remain effective in ambiguity, resolve conflicts constructively and take accountability for decisions. 
 - You think globally, are capable of managing multicultural teams, respect different contexts and build trusted networks across boundaries. 

Education and experience

- University degree in computer science, software engineering, engineering, business information systems or a comparable discipline, or equivalent professional experience. 
 - Significant professional experience in software engineering and quality engineering, including responsibility beyond a single product or project. 
 - Leadership experience in an international, distributed technology organization. 
 - Excellent English; additional languages are an advantage.

data.title: Senior Staff Digital Methodology Engineer - Design for Testability (DFT)
data.description:
We Are

Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow. 

You Are

You have spent over a decade architecting test solutions for chips that power everything from autonomous vehicles to data centers, and you understand that DFT is not an afterthought, it is the difference between a design that ships on time and one that bleeds money in yield loss. You know the nuances of scan compression versus hierarchical DFT, not from a textbook, but from making the call on a 10-billion-gate SoC where the wrong decision costs months. 

You are the person design teams call when ATPG coverage is stuck at 97% and manufacturing is demanding 99. 5%. You have debugged IJTAG networks that span multiple chiplets, written the Tcl that automated what used to take three engineers a week, and sat in rooms with VPs explaining why their test access strategy needs to change before tapeout. You do not just know the IEEE standards, you have deployed them in production silicon and lived with the consequences. 

At Synopsys, you will work on methodologies that define how the world's most complex chips get tested. The problems are hard, the customers are sophisticated, and what you build will matter. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Define and drive DFT methodologies for next-generation ASIC and SoC designs across strategic customer programs, translating architecture decisions into deployable best practices
 - Lead deployment of advanced test solutions including scan compression, hierarchical DFT, IEEE 1500 wrappers, IJTAG instrumentation networks, and embedded test IP across multi-billion-gate designs
 - Architect scalable test access infrastructures using IEEE 1149. 1, IEEE 1149. 6, IEEE 1687, and IEEE 1500 standards for complex multi-die and chiplet-based systems
 - Develop automation frameworks, signoff criteria, and reusable methodology packages using Tcl, Python, and Perl that accelerate adoption across business units
 - Serve as technical leader and subject matter expert for Synopsys TestMAX DFT, TestMAX ATPG, diagnosis, and silicon lifecycle solutions in customer engagements and internal escalations
 - Collaborate directly with R&D teams to influence TestMAX product roadmap based on real deployment challenges and customer requirements
 - Provide technical leadership for strategic customer engagements, methodology reviews, and complex DFT architecture decisions that impact tapeout schedules and silicon success

The Impact You Will Have

- Enable successful deployment of industry-leading DFT methodologies across the world's most advanced semiconductor programs in AI, automotive, and hyperscale computing
 - Drive measurable improvements in test coverage, pattern count reduction, and manufacturing yield through methodology standardization and best-practice development
 - Influence next-generation TestMAX capabilities by translating customer deployment challenges into product requirements that shape future releases
 - Accelerate adoption of standards-based test architectures across strategic accounts, reducing time-to-market and improving silicon reliability
 - Improve engineering productivity across multiple programs through automation frameworks and reusable methodology packages that eliminate redundant work
 - Establish Synopsys as the trusted technical advisor in DFT and manufacturing test, strengthening customer relationships and competitive positioning
 - Contribute to breakthrough technologies powering autonomous vehicles, AI accelerators, and next-generation networking infrastructure

What You'll Need

- Bachelor's or Master's in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field
 - 10+ years in semiconductor or EDA industry with at least 5 years focused on DFT architecture, ATPG, and manufacturing test methodologies
 - Demonstrated expertise architecting and implementing DFT solutions for large-scale ASIC and SoC designs, including successful tapeouts
 - Hands-on experience with Synopsys TestMAX DFT and TestMAX ATPG solutions in production design environments
 - Deep technical knowledge of scan insertion, scan compression, hierarchical DFT, ATPG and diagnosis, stuck-at/transition/path-delay/bridge/cell-aware fault models, and coverage optimization techniques
 - Expertise deploying IEEE 1149. 1 (JTAG), IEEE 1149. 6 (AC JTAG), IEEE 1687 (IJTAG), and IEEE 1500 standards in complex test access architectures
 - Experience integrating DFT IP including Codec/embedded compression, OCC, LBIST, TAP controllers, JTAG and IJTAG infrastructure, TDR networks, and IEEE 1500 wrappers
 - Strong understanding of RTL-to-GDSII flows and how DFT interacts with synthesis, physical design, timing closure, and signoff
 - Proficiency with Tcl, Python, Perl, or Shell scripting for methodology automation and deployment
 - Experience defining enterprise-wide DFT standards and signoff methodologies is a strong plus
 - Background supporting advanced-node ASICs, multi-billion-gate SoCs, silicon bring-up, diagnosis, or yield improvement is highly valued
 - Knowledge of functional safety standards and automotive test requirements is a plus
 - Contributions to industry test standards, technical publications, patents, or conference presentations strengthen your candidacy

Who You Are

- You can walk into a room with a customer's design team, diagnose a coverage gap in their hierarchical DFT strategy, and sketch a solution on the whiteboard that they trust enough to implement before tapeout
 - You mentor engineers not by telling them what to do, but by asking the questions that help them see the tradeoff they missed between test time and pattern count
 - You are comfortable presenting a methodology roadmap to a VP in two slides and then diving three levels deep with an engineer debugging an IJTAG network the same afternoon
 - You push back when a proposed DFT architecture does not align with manufacturing realities, and you do it in a way that builds trust rather than friction
 - You treat automation as a first-class deliverable, not an afterthought, because you know the methodology only scales if the Tcl actually works
 - You stay current with industry trends, standards evolution, and emerging test challenges because you know that what worked on 7nm will not necessarily work on 3nm

The Team You'll Be Part Of

You will join the Digital Methodology Center of Excellence, a highly visible organization responsible for defining and advancing Synopsys' DFT methodologies, best practices, and customer deployment strategies. Working closely with R&D, product engineering, customer success, and strategic accounts, you will help shape the future of Design-for-Test and drive successful adoption of the industry's most advanced test solutions worldwide. 

Rewards and Benefits

We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

data.title: Senior Product Validation Engineer
data.description:
Sandisk understands how people and businesses consume data and we relentlessly innovate to deliver solutions that enable today's needs and tomorrow's next big ideas. With a rich history of groundbreaking innovations in Flash and advanced memory technologies, our solutions have become the beating heart of the digital world we're living in and that we have the power to shape. 

Sandisk meets people and businesses at the intersection of their aspirations and the moment, enabling them to keep moving and pushing possibility forward. We do this through the balance of our powerhouse manufacturing capabilities and our industry-leading portfolio of products that are recognized globally for innovation, performance and quality. 

Sandisk has two facilities recognized by the World Economic Forum as part of the Global Lighthouse Network for advanced 4IR innovations. These facilities were also recognized as Sustainability Lighthouses for breakthroughs in efficient operations. With our global reach, we ensure the global supply chain has access to the Flash memory it needs to keep our world moving forward. 

Description

About the position: 

As a Senior Product Validation Engineer, you will be part of firmware verification team that design and develop white box and grey box tests in Python to verify device firmware designs for each firmware/Product/System feature. You will be working closely with product/System architects and firmware engineers to create a comprehensive system verification test for features. In this role, you will be contributing to test strategy, test development, integrating the tests using various development platforms, deploying it on system verification lab for regression runs and perform failure analysis. The role focuses on defining and executing robust firmware/Device/system verification strategies for UCIe/AXI and custom host-device protocols across both pre‐silicon and post‐silicon environments. 

Responsibilities

- Collaborate closely with firmware engineers & architects on product architecture and designs to define the comprehensive verification plan to validate each product features
 - Design, Develop and Integrate the white box and gray box tests on products in roadmap
 - Conduct test plan reviews and code reviews to ensure the tests are scalable and meeting the requirements
 - Participate in driving failure analysis and collaborate with integration/execution engineers for test deployment. 
 - Validate designs against UCIe Specification ensuring compliance with electrical, logical, and transaction-layer requirements. 
 - Define and own firmware/System validation strategy for UCIe front-end subsystems, including resets, interrupts, Logging and error handling. 
 - Define, plan, and execute system-level validation strategies for front-end (PHY + controller) IP, back end(Controller +NAND) IP and SoC-level integration. 
 - Integrate tests into scalable automation frameworks supporting simulation, emulation, and silicon validation. 
 - Debug firmware issues, perform front-end error injection, and expose design or integration defects. 
 - Validate UCIe compliance, robustness of fault detection and recovery mechanisms. 
 - Review and verify firmware trace logs and debug telemetry for correctness and completeness. 
 - Drive validation readiness across pre‐silicon and post‐silicon platforms, ensuring alignment of firmware specs, drivers, and test collateral. 
 - Interface with cross‐functional stakeholders to ensure validation coverage meets product and customer requirements. 
 - Drive compliance and interoperability testing with various endpoints 
 - Proven expertise in defining and driving end-to-end validation strategies across simulation, emulation/FPGA, and post-silicon platforms for complex SoCs and storage systems. 
 - Strong experience validating hardware IPs in pre-silicon environments (RTL simulation, SystemC/VDK, emulation, FPGA prototyping) and post-silicon environments. 
 - Possess deep understanding of Host SoC integration, firmware-hardware interactions, subsystem interoperability, and system-level debug across the complete product stack. 
 - Proficiency in high-performance/AI compute architectures, accelerator data paths, workload scheduling, and system-level performance validation

Qualifications

Required Qualifications & Skills: 

- BE/B. Tech/ME/M. Tech degree in CSE/ ECE/ EEE/ IS or related field
 - In-depth knowledge of UCIe/AXI, flow control, ordering rules, error handling, power management
 - Proficiency with protocol analyzers/exercisers (Teledyne LeCroy, Keysight) etc. 
 - Experience with high‐performance storage, networking, or compute SoCs. 
 - Strong expertise in UCIe protocol, DMA, and ASIC front-end architecture. 
 - Strong scripting skills in Python/C/C++ based scripting API's. 
 - Hands-on experience with error injection, fault modeling, and silicon debug tools. 
 - Familiarity with pre‐silicon (simulation/emulation) and post‐silicon lab validation flows. 
 - Solid understanding of firmware-hardware interaction and system-level debugging. 
 - Demonstrated leadership in test strategy definition, technical reviews, and mentoring. 
 - Strong problem-solving skills and ability to drive issues to closure under schedule pressure. 
 - Excellent communication skills with the ability to collaborate across teams and influence technical decisions. 
 - Proficiency in scripting and automation using Python, C/C++, or Bash. 
 - Minimum 6 - 8 years of related experience in firmware verification or system level testing along with Gen5/Gen6 PCI-SIG protocol testing
 - Knowledge on Git, CI & source code management flow and agile development practices. 

Soft Skills

- Strong problem-solving skills with a focus on root cause analysis. 
 - Collaborative and proactive communication style. 
 - Attention to detail and quality assurance mindset. 
 - Ability to work effectively in a global, cross-functional team. 

Additional Information

Sandisk thrives on the power and potential of diversity. As a global company, we believe the most effective way to embrace the diversity of our customers and communities is to mirror it from within. We believe the fusion of various perspectives results in the best outcomes for our employees, our company, our customers, and the world around us. We are committed to an inclusive environment where every individual can thrive through a sense of belonging, respect and contribution. 

Sandisk is committed to offering opportunities to applicants with disabilities and ensuring all candidates can successfully navigate our careers website and our hiring process. Please contact us at jobs. accommodations@sandisk. com to advise us of your accommodation request. In your email, please include a description of the specific accommodation you are requesting as well as the job title and requisition number of the position for which you are applying.

data.description:
Company

Qualcomm India Private Limited

Job Area

Engineering Group, Engineering Group > Hardware Engineering

General Summary

As a leading technology innovator, Qualcomm pushes the boundaries of what's possible to enable next-generation experiences and drives digital transformation to help create a smarter, connected future for all. As a Qualcomm Hardware Engineer, you will plan, design, optimize, verify, and test electronic systems, bring-up yield, circuits, mechanical systems, Digital/Analog/RF/optical systems, equipment and packaging, test systems, FPGA, and/or DSP systems that launch cutting-edge, world class products. Qualcomm Hardware Engineers collaborate with cross-functional teams to develop solutions and meet performance requirements. 

Minimum Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Engineering, or related field and 4+ years of Hardware Engineering or related work experience. 

OR

Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Engineering, or related field and 3+ years of Hardware Engineering or related work experience. 

OR

PhD in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Engineering, or related field and 2+ years of Hardware Engineering or related work experience. 

As a "CPU Core Validation Engineer(Staff/Sr. Staff)" you would be part of CPU Validation team in CPU org working on validation of CPU core pipeline arch and micro arch features. 

Roles And Responsibilities

- Develop detailed test plan considering the IP arch and uarch features. 
 - Work with CPU design and verification teams to develop CPU bring up and functional validation test plans for the IP owned. 
 - Develop validation methodology and test contents to exercise on emulators during pre-Si phase and on Silicon. 
 - Work with SOC bring up teams, software teams to plan CPU core features bringup and end to end validation. 
 - Triage and debug failures on Silicon. 
 - Develop test contents and testing strategies to assist validation of CPU on silicon. 
 - Work with CPU verification teams to reproduce silicon fails on emulators and FPGAs. 
 - Work with design team to suggest, architect new debug features to improve future CPU bringup's. 

Minimum Requirements

- BA/BS degree in CS/EE with 7 to 16 years' experience. 
 - 7+ Experience in Silicon Validation and bring up. 
 - Implementation of assembly, C/C++ language embedded firmware 
 - Experience with software tool chain including assemblers, C compilers, Makefiles, and source code control tools. 

Preferred Requirements

- Good understanding of micro-processor architecture, in domains such as: Cache Coherence, Memory ordering and Consistency, Prefetching, Branch Prediction, Renaming, Speculative execution, and Address Translation/Memory Management. 
 - Knowledge of Random Instruction Sequencing (RIS) and testing a given design, at the Block/Unit-level and Subsystem/Chip-level for proving correctness. 
 - Experience in writing Test plans and Assembly code. 
 - Ability to develop and work independently on a block/unit of the design.

data.title: Principal Digital Methodology Engineer - Design for Testability (DFT)
data.description:
We Are

Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow. 

You Are

You have spent over a decade architecting test solutions for chips that power everything from autonomous vehicles to data centers, and you understand that DFT is not an afterthought, it is the difference between a design that ships on time and one that bleeds money in yield loss. You know the nuances of scan compression versus hierarchical DFT, not from a textbook, but from making the call on a 10-billion-gate SoC where the wrong decision costs months. 

You are the person design teams call when ATPG coverage is stuck at 97% and manufacturing is demanding 99. 5%. You have debugged IJTAG networks that span multiple chiplets, written the Tcl that automated what used to take three engineers a week, and sat in rooms with VPs explaining why their test access strategy needs to change before tapeout. You do not just know the IEEE standards, you have deployed them in production silicon and lived with the consequences. 

At Synopsys, you will work on methodologies that define how the world's most complex chips get tested. The problems are hard, the customers are sophisticated, and what you build will matter. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Define and drive DFT methodologies for next-generation ASIC and SoC designs across strategic customer programs, translating architecture decisions into deployable best practices
 - Lead deployment of advanced test solutions including scan compression, hierarchical DFT, IEEE 1500 wrappers, IJTAG instrumentation networks, and embedded test IP across multi-billion-gate designs
 - Architect scalable test access infrastructures using IEEE 1149. 1, IEEE 1149. 6, IEEE 1687, and IEEE 1500 standards for complex multi-die and chiplet-based systems
 - Develop automation frameworks, signoff criteria, and reusable methodology packages using Tcl, Python, and Perl that accelerate adoption across business units
 - Serve as technical leader and subject matter expert for Synopsys TestMAX DFT, TestMAX ATPG, diagnosis, and silicon lifecycle solutions in customer engagements and internal escalations
 - Collaborate directly with R&D teams to influence TestMAX product roadmap based on real deployment challenges and customer requirements
 - Provide technical leadership for strategic customer engagements, methodology reviews, and complex DFT architecture decisions that impact tapeout schedules and silicon success

The Impact You Will Have

- Enable successful deployment of industry-leading DFT methodologies across the world's most advanced semiconductor programs in AI, automotive, and hyperscale computing
 - Drive measurable improvements in test coverage, pattern count reduction, and manufacturing yield through methodology standardization and best-practice development
 - Influence next-generation TestMAX capabilities by translating customer deployment challenges into product requirements that shape future releases
 - Accelerate adoption of standards-based test architectures across strategic accounts, reducing time-to-market and improving silicon reliability
 - Improve engineering productivity across multiple programs through automation frameworks and reusable methodology packages that eliminate redundant work
 - Establish Synopsys as the trusted technical advisor in DFT and manufacturing test, strengthening customer relationships and competitive positioning
 - Contribute to breakthrough technologies powering autonomous vehicles, AI accelerators, and next-generation networking infrastructure

What You'll Need

- Bachelor's or Master's in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field
 - 15+ years in semiconductor or EDA industry with at least 5 years focused on DFT architecture, ATPG, and manufacturing test methodologies
 - Demonstrated expertise architecting and implementing DFT solutions for large-scale ASIC and SoC designs, including successful tapeouts
 - Hands-on experience with Synopsys TestMAX DFT and TestMAX ATPG solutions in production design environments
 - Deep technical knowledge of scan insertion, scan compression, hierarchical DFT, ATPG and diagnosis, stuck-at/transition/path-delay/bridge/cell-aware fault models, and coverage optimization techniques
 - Expertise deploying IEEE 1149. 1 (JTAG), IEEE 1149. 6 (AC JTAG), IEEE 1687 (IJTAG), and IEEE 1500 standards in complex test access architectures
 - Experience integrating DFT IP including Codec/embedded compression, OCC, LBIST, TAP controllers, JTAG and IJTAG infrastructure, TDR networks, and IEEE 1500 wrappers
 - Strong understanding of RTL-to-GDSII flows and how DFT interacts with synthesis, physical design, timing closure, and signoff
 - Proficiency with Tcl, Python, Perl, or Shell scripting for methodology automation and deployment
 - Experience defining enterprise-wide DFT standards and signoff methodologies is a strong plus
 - Background supporting advanced-node ASICs, multi-billion-gate SoCs, silicon bring-up, diagnosis, or yield improvement is highly valued
 - Knowledge of functional safety standards and automotive test requirements is a plus
 - Contributions to industry test standards, technical publications, patents, or conference presentations strengthen your candidacy

Who You Are

- You can walk into a room with a customer's design team, diagnose a coverage gap in their hierarchical DFT strategy, and sketch a solution on the whiteboard that they trust enough to implement before tapeout
 - You mentor engineers not by telling them what to do, but by asking the questions that help them see the tradeoff they missed between test time and pattern count
 - You are comfortable presenting a methodology roadmap to a VP in two slides and then diving three levels deep with an engineer debugging an IJTAG network the same afternoon
 - You push back when a proposed DFT architecture does not align with manufacturing realities, and you do it in a way that builds trust rather than friction
 - You treat automation as a first-class deliverable, not an afterthought, because you know the methodology only scales if the Tcl actually works
 - You stay current with industry trends, standards evolution, and emerging test challenges because you know that what worked on 7nm will not necessarily work on 3nm

The Team You'll Be Part Of

You will join the Digital Methodology Center of Excellence, a highly visible organization responsible for defining and advancing Synopsys' DFT methodologies, best practices, and customer deployment strategies. Working closely with R&D, product engineering, customer success, and strategic accounts, you will help shape the future of Design-for-Test and drive successful adoption of the industry's most advanced test solutions worldwide. 

Rewards and Benefits

We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

data.description:
Job Title: Mobile Application Developer

Department: Research & Development - Diagnostics

Location: Vapi, Gujarat

Reports To: R&D Manager

Experience: 0-2 Years

Job Purpose: 

To support the design, development, testing, and maintenance of mobile applications for advanced in-vitro diagnostic (IVD) systems and connected healthcare technologies. The role involves developing mobile applications using Android, Java, Kotlin, and iOS technologies to support diagnostic workflows, device connectivity, data visualization, remote monitoring, and seamless integration with diagnostic instrument software and backend systems. 

Key Responsibilities: 

1. Mobile Application Development

• Develop, enhance, and maintain mobile applications for Android and iOS platforms. 

• Build Android application components using Java and Kotlin. 

• Support iOS application development using Swift or other relevant iOS technologies, as applicable to project requirements. 

• Develop user-friendly interfaces, dashboards, notifications, and data visualization features for healthcare and diagnostic applications. 

• Implement application logic, input validation, error handling, and responsive user interactions. 

• Follow modular coding practices, reusable components, and mobile application development standards. 

2. Diagnostic Systems & Device Integration

• Support mobile application development for clinical chemistry and immunoassay diagnostic systems and connected healthcare devices. 

• Assist in integrating mobile applications with diagnostic instruments, backend services, and cloud-based platforms. 

• Support device connectivity and data exchange using Bluetooth, Wi-Fi, REST APIs, and other relevant communication technologies. 

• Develop features for instrument status monitoring, notifications, configuration, and diagnostic data visualization, as applicable. 

• Collaborate with embedded software, hardware, backend, and desktop application teams to support end-to-end system integration. 

3. Backend Integration & Data Management

• Integrate mobile applications with backend services and databases through REST APIs and other relevant interfaces. 

• Work with JSON, XML, and other data formats for exchanging information between mobile applications and backend systems. 

• Support secure data transmission, authentication, session management, and error handling. 

• Assist in implementing data synchronization, local storage, and offline functionality where required. 

• Ensure reliable communication between mobile applications, diagnostic instruments, and connected software platforms. 

4. Testing, Debugging & Software Quality

• Perform functional testing, debugging, and troubleshooting of Android and iOS applications. 

• Prepare and execute test cases to validate application functionality, usability, compatibility, and performance. 

• Support integration testing across mobile applications, diagnostic devices, and backend systems. 

• Identify software defects, investigate root causes, and implement corrective fixes under the guidance of senior engineers. 

• Maintain technical documentation, test reports, and software release records. 

• Follow software development lifecycle (SDLC) practices and support applicable medical device software quality requirements, including IEC 62304, where relevant. 

5. Security & Application Maintenance

• Follow secure coding practices and appropriate application authentication and authorization mechanisms. 

• Support data privacy, secure API communication, and protection of sensitive healthcare information. 

• Assist in application version management, deployment, updates, and compatibility testing. 

• Use Git or other version control tools to maintain code quality and collaboration. 

• Participate in code reviews, bug fixes, and continuous improvement activities. 

6. Innovation & Continuous Learning

• Contribute to R&D initiatives involving connected diagnostics, digital health, mobile healthcare applications, and medical device technologies. 

• Explore new mobile development frameworks, APIs, and connectivity technologies relevant to diagnostic applications. 

• Participate in proof-of-concept development, feasibility studies, and prototype evaluation. 

• Continuously enhance technical knowledge through hands-on development, mentoring, and cross-functional collaboration. 

Qualifications and Experience: 

• B. E. / B. Tech. in Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer Engineering, or a related discipline. 

• MCA / M. Sc. Computer Science or an equivalent relevant qualification may also be considered. 

• Fresh graduates or candidates with up to 2 years of relevant mobile application development experience. 

• Strong fundamentals in Java and/or Kotlin, with an understanding of Android application development. 

• Basic understanding of iOS application development and its ecosystem is preferred. 

• Academic projects, internships, or practical exposure to Android or iOS application development will be an added advantage. 

• Exposure to healthcare applications, medical devices, diagnostic systems, or connected devices is desirable. 

Skills and Competencies: 

• Understanding of Android development using Java and Kotlin. 

• Basic knowledge of iOS development, Swift, Xcode, and the Apple application ecosystem is preferred. 

• Understanding of object-oriented programming (OOP), data structures, algorithms, and debugging techniques. 

• Familiarity with Android Studio, mobile application lifecycle, UI components, and application architecture. 

• Basic knowledge of REST APIs, JSON, networking, and backend integration. 

• Awareness of Bluetooth, Wi-Fi, and mobile-to-device communication is an advantage. 

• Familiarity with Git, unit testing, and mobile application debugging tools. 

• Understanding of application security, data privacy, and secure communication practices. 

• Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving, and attention to detail. 

• Good verbal and written communication skills. 

• Ability to collaborate with multidisciplinary R&D teams and learn diagnostic workflows. 

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs): 

• Quality, functionality, and maintainability of mobile application code. 

• Timely completion of assigned mobile development tasks and R&D milestones. 

• Application stability, performance, and compatibility across supported devices. 

• Successful integration with diagnostic instruments, backend services, and APIs. 

• Effectiveness in identifying and resolving software defects. 

• Quality and completeness of testing, technical documentation, and release records. 

• Adherence to coding standards, security practices, and applicable software quality requirements. 

• Contribution to connected diagnostic solutions and continuous product innovation.
