Job Description

As a Test Automation Engineer, you will design and implement automation solutions that validate system behavior across UI, APIs, and integrations. You will contribute to building a robust quality engineering ecosystem by integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines and supporting continuous delivery. 

In this role, you will translate requirements into effective test strategies, combining automation with manual, exploratory, and integration testing to ensure comprehensive quality coverage across all application layers. 

This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys hands-on coding, solving complex validation challenges, and improving system quality at scale, while taking ownership of end-to-end quality outcomes and collaborating closely with cross-functional teams. 

Responsibilities

Automation Development & Framework Ownership

- Design, develop, and own scalable test automation frameworks and reusable components
 - Build automated test suites across: 
 - UI (Web/Mobile)
 - API and integration layers
 - Ensure automation solutions are maintainable, reliable, and extensible across teams

Test Strategy & Implementation

- Translate requirements into automation-ready test scenarios, test data, and validation strategies
 - Contribute to test strategy, coverage planning, and quality goals
 - Identify test gaps and proactively mitigate risks
 - Perform automation feasibility analysis to determine optimal test approach (manual vs automated)

Delivery & Execution Excellence

- Execute a balanced mix of automated and manual tests aligned with sprint goals, ensuring comprehensive validation across functional, integration, and edge-case scenarios. 
 - Contribute to task breakdown, estimation, and sprint commitments
 - Proactively raise risks, blockers, and testability concerns
 - Identify, log, prioritize, and track defects through resolution lifecycle
 - Perform root cause analysis and collaborate with development teams for fixes

Manual & Functional Testing

- Design, document, and execute detailed test cases and test scenarios
 - Perform functional, exploratory, and regression testing across features
 - Validate end-to-end workflows and business scenarios
 - Identify edge cases and usability issues through exploratory testing
 - Ensure test coverage for areas not suitable for automation

Quality, Standards & Engineering Practices

- Write clean, testable, and maintainable automation code
 - Participate in code reviews and continuous improvement of automation frameworks
 - Ensure adherence to Definition of Ready (DoR) and Definition of Done (DoD)
 - Take ownership of end-to-end quality outcomes across assigned areas
 - Follow established DevOps, security, and quality engineering practices

CI/CD & DevOps Integration

- Integrate automation into CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps preferred)
 - Enable continuous testing and shift-left quality practices
 - Monitor and improve pipeline stability, execution time, and reliability
 - Validate and troubleshoot system integrations, data flows, and error handling based on defined architectural designs and interfaces

Non-Functional Testing

- Contribute to performance, reliability, and resilience testing
 - Validate system behavior under load, stress, and failure scenarios

Observability & Debuggability

- Leverage logs, metrics, and traces to improve test reliability
 - Support root cause analysis of failures and improve system observability

Test Data & Environment Management

- Design and manage test data strategies and datasets
 - Ensure availability of stable, production-like test environments

Incident & Operational Support

- Assist in troubleshooting defects across environments
 - Support maintenance and continuous improvement of automation suites
 - Analyze and reduce flaky tests and unstable scenarios

Collaboration & Growth

- Collaborate with developers, QA, Product Owners, and Tech Leads
 - Actively learn and adopt new tools, frameworks, and best practices
 - Contribute to team knowledge sharing and a strong quality culture

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, IT, or related field
 - 5+ years of experience in software testing with strong automation focus
 - Experience in designing and implementing test automation frameworks
 - Strong understanding of testing principles, SDLC, STLC, and Agile practices

Technical Skills

- Programming experience in one or more: C#, Java, Python, JavaScript, Swift

 - Experience with: 
 - API testing (REST, Postman, etc. )

 - CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps)
 - Familiarity with: 
 - Test data management
 - Test reporting and logging tools
 - Debugging and root cause analysis
 - Release Management
Assets

 - Security testing (SAST, DAST, SCA)
 - Exposure to: 
 - Cloud platforms (Azure preferred)
 - DevSecOps practices
 - Experience using AI-assisted tools responsibly (e. g. , GitHub Copilot)
Key Expectations

- Drive an automation-first approach (target 60-80% regression automation), while ensuring critical flows and edge cases are validated through manual testing where automation is not feasible or cost-effective.

 - Ensure high reliability, scalability, and stability of automation pipelines

Why Husky?

data.title: Senior QA Engineer - Wireless (Bluetooth Protocols/Bluetooth Profiles) - 4 to 6yrs
data.description:
Senior Wireless QA Engineer

We are Silicon Labs. We are a leader in secure, intelligent wireless technology for a more connected world. Our integrated hardware and software platform, intuitive development tools, unmatched ecosystem and robust support make us the ideal long-term partner in building advanced industrial, commercial, home and life applications. We make it easy for developers to solve complex wireless challenges throughout the product lifecycle and get to market quickly with innovative solutions that transform industries, grow economies, and improve lives. 

Meet the Wireless QA Team

At Silicon Labs, the Wireless QA Team plays a crucial role in driving the success of our wireless technology products. We are at the heart of the innovation that powers our next-generation IoT solutions, ensuring that our wireless products meet the highest standards of performance, efficiency, and usability. Our Team is responsible for testing and validating the performance, functionality, and compatibility of wireless communication systems, applications, and devices. 

Our team conducts comprehensive testing of Bluetooth protocols, profiles, and stack implementations across different platforms and devices. They work closely with Bluetooth hardware engineers, software developers, and product managers to deliver high-quality Bluetooth products that meet industry standards and provide seamless connectivity and user experience. 

What makes our team unique? We work in a highly collaborative, international environment where innovation and creativity are encouraged. Our site fosters a culture of learning, where team members are empowered to solve real-world problems and make meaningful contributions to the success of Silicon Labs. We take pride in developing solutions that transform industries and improve lives through technology. 

Explore more about our Wi-Fi solutions here: www. silabs. com

Responsibilities

- Develop comprehensive test plans, strategies, and approaches for Bluetooth testing, covering Bluetooth Classic, BLE, Bluetooth mesh, and related protocols. 
 - Design and execute detailed tests for Bluetooth profiles (e. g. , A2DP, HFP, GATT, LE Audio etc), ensuring proper implementation and functionality in real-world scenarios. 
 - Test and validate Bluetooth protocol stack implementations, including interoperability between different Bluetooth versions, chipsets, and operating systems. 
 - Analyze and troubleshoot complex issues related to Bluetooth communication, signal interference, range, and performance. 
 - Develop and maintain custom test scripts, automated test cases, and tools (using languages like Python, Embedded C) for comprehensive Bluetooth functionality, performance, and stress testing. 
 - Utilize specialized Bluetooth test tools and protocol analyzers (e. g. , Ellisys, Teledyne LeCroy) to capture, decode, and analyze Bluetooth traffic. 
 - Conduct performance testing to assess Bluetooth range, data throughput, connection stability, and battery consumption, particularly for Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) devices. 
 - Test Bluetooth security features, including pairing protocols, encryption, and authentication, to identify vulnerabilities and ensure data protection. Skills You Will Need

- Experience: At least 4+ years of experience in software testing/development, with a focus on Bluetooth technology and test automation using Python/Embedded C. 
 - Technical Expertise: 
 - In-depth knowledge of Bluetooth technologies, including Bluetooth Classic, Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE), Bluetooth mesh, and the Bluetooth protocol stack. 
 - Strong understanding of Bluetooth profiles such as A2DP, HFP, HID, GATT, PAN, LE Audio, and their respective functionalities and use cases. 
 - Expertise in using Bluetooth testing tools and protocol analyzers (e. g. , Ellisys, Teledyne LeCroy, Frontline). 
 - Experience with Bluetooth specification documentation (e. g. , Bluetooth SIG), and familiarity with Bluetooth standards (e. g. , Bluetooth 5. x, BLE) 
 - Problem-Solving: Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, particularly in complex Bluetooth connectivity and performance issues. 
 - Communication: Excellent communication skills to effectively collaborate with cross-functional teams, document test results, and present findings clearly to stakeholders. Preferred Qualifications: 

- Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Telecommunications, or a related field. 
 - Bluetooth Certification: Experience with the Bluetooth Qualification process or Bluetooth certification is a plus. 
 - Experience with wireless communication technologies beyond Bluetooth (e. g. , Wi-Fi, Zigbee) is a plus. 
 - Expertise in Python, Gen AI tool and Linux environment is expected 
 - Additional Skills: Experience with C/C++ for embedded systems or low-level testing is a plus. 

Benefits & Perks

Not only will you be joining a highly skilled and tight-knit team where every engineer makes a significant impact on the product; we also strive for good work/life balance and to make our environment welcoming and fun. 

- Equity Rewards (RSUs)
 - Insurance plans with Outpatient cover
 - National Pension Scheme (NPS)
 - Flexible work policy
 - Childcare support.

data.title: Senior Director, Software Engineering
data.description:
Job Description Summary

We are looking for a visionary, hands-on software leader to head our CT Software Engineering organization in Bangalore. In this role, you will shape how our CT software turns clinical and operational challenges into innovative, reliable solutions that help radiologists and technologists scan faster, see more clearly, reduce patient dose, and deliver better patient outcomes. 

You will lead a team of approximately 120 engineers, setting the technical vision, building world-class software engineering practices, and accelerating the speed at which we move from idea to validated product, all within the rigor required of a regulated medical device environment. As a key part of the global CT Software organization, you will bring a global mindset, working seamlessly with CT teams and partners around the world while establishing Bangalore as a center of excellence for CT software innovation. 

GE Healthcare is a leading global medical technology and digital solutions innovator. Our mission is to create a world where healthcare has no limits. Unlock your ambition, turn ideas into world-changing realities, and join an organization where every voice makes a difference, and every difference builds a healthier world. 

Job Description

Senior Director of Software Engineering - Computed Tomography (CT)

Location: Bangalore, India

Reports to: VP of Software Engineering - CT

Team size: ~120 software engineers

Travel: ~20-25% international travel to global CT R&D sites, customer sites, and leadership forums

Role Summary

We are looking for a visionary, hands-on software leader to head our CT Software Engineering organization in Bangalore. In this role, you will shape how our CT software turns clinical and operational challenges into innovative, reliable solutions that help radiologists and technologists scan faster, see more clearly, reduce patient dose, and deliver better patient outcomes. 

You will lead a team of approximately 120 engineers, setting the technical vision, building world-class software engineering practices, and accelerating the speed at which we move from idea to validated product, all within the rigor required of a regulated medical device environment. As a key part of the global CT Software organization, you will bring a global mindset, working seamlessly with CT teams and partners around the world while establishing Bangalore as a center of excellence for CT software innovation. 

Key Responsibilities

- Strategic Leadership and Vision
 - Define and communicate a multi-year software vision and strategy for the Bangalore CT organization, aligned with global CT business priorities, product roadmaps, and customer needs. 
 - Translate business objectives into clear engineering goals, measurable outcomes, and investment priorities. 
 - Develop and drive strategic initiatives that improve engineering productivity, product quality, and time-to-market. 
 - Anticipate technology and industry trends in CT and position the organization to take advantage of them. 
 - Customer-Centric Innovation
 - Champion a deep understanding of customer pain points by engaging directly with radiologists, CT technologists, service teams, and hospital IT and operations stakeholders. 
 - Partner with Product Management, Clinical, Applications, and UX teams to turn unmet customer needs into differentiated software solutions, for example simpler scan workflows, faster and more consistent exams, lower dose, better image quality, higher system uptime, and smarter automation. 
 - Build an innovation pipeline that balances near-term customer improvements with longer-term breakthrough capabilities. 
 - Encourage rapid experimentation through prototypes, proofs of concept, hackathons, and customer pilots to validate ideas early and often. 
 - Innovation Speed and R&D Execution
 - Oversee end-to-end delivery of CT software programs, including innovation projects, new product introductions (NPIs), design changes, sustaining engineering, and field actions. 
 - Ensure programs are delivered with high quality, on schedule, and within budget, with predictable and transparent execution. 
 - Increase innovation velocity by shortening feedback loops, reducing cycle time, and removing organizational and technical bottlenecks, without compromising safety or compliance. 
 - Use metrics such as DORA metrics, lead time, defect escape rate, and customer-reported issues to drive data-informed decisions and continuous improvement. 
 - Identify and manage key delivery risks and cross-site dependencies proactively. 
 - World-Class Software Engineering Practices
 - Establish and continuously raise the bar on engineering excellence, including code quality, design reviews, automated testing, CI/CD, DevSecOps, and release management. 
 - Lead the adoption of modern engineering practices and tools, including test automation, simulation and virtual scanner environments, infrastructure as code, observability, and AI-assisted development, adapted for a regulated environment. 
 - Provide leadership on Lean and Agile principles at scale; coach teams on estimation, work sizing, backlog health, and flow efficiency. 
 - Benchmark the organization against industry leaders and drive a roadmap toward best-in-class engineering maturity. 
 - Quality, Safety, and Regulatory Compliance
 - Ensure all software activities comply with applicable medical device regulations and standards, and relevant cybersecurity requirements. 
 - Build quality and compliance into everyday engineering workflows so that they support speed rather than slow it down. 
 - Partner with Quality, Regulatory, and Systems Engineering leaders to ensure CT products meet compliance, controllership, radiation safety, and patient safety standards. 
 - Ensure audit readiness and lead the organization's response to software-related CAPAs, field issues, and regulatory inquiries. 
 - Technical Standards, Architecture, and Platforms
 - Partner with global system architects and cross-functional leaders to define future CT technology platforms that are scalable, secure, interoperable, and reusable across product lines. 
 - Drive platform thinking and modular design to reduce duplication, speed up new feature delivery, and lower total cost of ownership. 
 - Global Leadership and Collaboration
 - Lead the Bangalore CT software organization as an integral part of the global CT software team, with a "one team" mindset built on trust, shared goals, and seamless collaboration across geographies, cultures, and time zones. 
 - Represent the Bangalore CT organization in global leadership forums and strengthen its visibility and impact across the business. 
 - Work closely with global partners in Product Management, Systems Engineering, Hardware, Detector and Physics, Clinical, Service, Manufacturing, Quality, and Regulatory. 
 - Talent Management and Culture
 - Attract, develop, and retain top engineering talent in a highly competitive market. 
 - Build strong technical and functional leadership benches, organizational models, and succession plans. 
 - Create an inclusive, high-performance culture built on ownership, curiosity, psychological safety, and continuous learning. 
 - Develop clear technical and managerial career paths, and mentor emerging leaders and senior technical experts. 
 - Engineering Operations and Finances
 - Own and manage the Bangalore CT software engineering budget, headcount, and resource allocation. 
 - Explore and implement alternative resourcing models, such as partners, vendors, and centers of excellence, to scale capacity and accelerate innovation. 
 - Use portfolio and project management tools to track progress, report status, and highlight key risks. 
 - Drive cost efficiency and productivity improvements while protecting investment in innovation. 
 - Stakeholder Engagement and Communication
 - Present regular updates on strategy, progress, and risks to executive sponsors, global CT leadership, and customers. 
 - Align stakeholders on priorities, timelines, and trade-offs; resolve conflicting priorities through proactive and transparent communication. 
 - Ensure data, process, and system changes are implemented in line with project objectives and timelines. 
 - Thought Leadership and Knowledge Sharing
 - Act as a recognized technical and leadership voice inside the company and in the wider industry, including conferences, publications, and industry and academic partnerships. 
 - Share technical, procedural, and business knowledge to raise the capability of the broader organization. 
 - Encourage the creation of learning content, internal tech talks, communities of practice, and patents and invention disclosures. 

Education Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. A Master's degree or other advanced degree is preferred. 

Required Skills

- 15+ years of experience in software engineering, including the design and development of complex, scalable software systems. 
 - 5+ years leading large software organizations (100+ engineers), including leaders of leaders. 
 - Proven experience working in and with globally distributed teams across multiple countries and cultures. 
 - Demonstrated track record of delivering innovative products that solved real customer problems and created measurable business impact. 
 - Experience working with regulatory compliance in the medical devices industry or another highly regulated industry. 

Skills And Competencies

- Strategic thinking with the ability to connect technology choices to customer value and business outcomes. 
 - Customer focus, with a habit of grounding decisions in direct customer insight. 
 - Global mindset, with cultural agility and a proven ability to build cohesive teams across borders. 
 - Bias for speed and action, balanced with sound judgment on quality, safety, and risk. 
 - Deep knowledge of modern software development methodologies, architecture, and tools. 
 - Strong program and portfolio management, organizational, and financial skills. 
 - Excellent communication, influencing, and executive presence, with the ability to explain complex technical topics to diverse audiences. 
 - Ability to inspire, coach, and build high-performing teams and future leaders. lex problems. 

Inclusion And Diversity

GE Healthcare is an Equal Opportunity Employer where inclusion matters. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, colour, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law. 

We expect all employees to live and breathe our behaviours: to act with humility and build trust; lead with transparency; deliver with focus, and drive ownership - always with unyielding integrity. 

Our total rewards are designed to unlock your ambition by giving you the boost and flexibility you need to turn your ideas into world-changing realities. Our salary and benefits are everything you'd expect from an organization with global strength and scale, and you'll be surrounded by career opportunities in a culture that fosters care, collaboration, and support.

data.description:
At U. S. Bancorp India, we're on a journey to do our best. We believe it takes all of us to bring our shared ambition to life, and each person is unique in their potential. A career with U. S. Bancorp India gives you a wide, ever-growing range of opportunities to discover what makes you thrive at every stage of your career. Try new things, learn new skills and discover what you excel at-all from Day One. 

Job Description

The Opportunity

We are seeking an accomplished and visionary technology executive to serve as Head of Technology - Consumer Banking, Business Banking & Digital (CBB), India. This executive will lead the India-based engineering organization supporting the bank's Consumer Banking, Business Banking, and Money Movement products & platforms. 

As a key member of the global CBB technology leadership team and the India GCC Technology leadership team, this leader will be responsible for building and scaling world-class engineering capabilities, driving digital transformation, modernizing platforms, accelerating product delivery, and establishing India as a strategic innovation and engineering hub. 

The role requires an exceptional combination of technology expertise, organizational leadership, talent development, and executive stakeholder management. The successful candidate will partner closely with global business technology leaders to deliver customer-centric solutions, improve operational efficiency, and strengthen the bank's digital capabilities. 

Key Responsibilities

Technology and Engineering Leadership

- Partner with global CBB Technology and product leaders to align technology investments with strategic business priorities. 
 - Build, scale, and lead a high-performing engineering organization across Consumer, Business, and Digital Banking domains. 
 - Establish India as a strategic engineering center capable of owning products, platforms, and critical enterprise capabilities. 
 - Foster a strong engineering culture focused on accountability, craftsmanship, innovation, continuous improvement, and customer obsession. 
 - Drive engineering productivity through modern tools, automation, AI-assisted development, and platform standardization. 
 - Create an environment that attracts, retains, and develops exceptional technology talent. 

Talent Strategy & Organizational Development

- Lead multiple engineering managers, directors, architects, and distinguished technologists. 
 - Develop a multi-year workforce strategy to build sustainable technology capabilities within the GCC. 
 - Lead talent acquisition, workforce planning, succession planning, and leadership development programs. 
 - Mentor and coach senior technology leaders while building a robust leadership pipeline. 
 - Drive transformation from contractor-heavy teams toward a strategically balanced permanent workforce model. 
 - Build a culture of learning, innovation, inclusion, and continuous professional development. 

GCC and Executive Stakeholder Management

- Serve as the primary technology leader for India supporting global Consumer Banking, Business Banking, and Digital executives. 
 - Play a key role in the expansion and maturation of the GCC as a strategic technology center. 
 - Build trusted relationships with CBB CIO and Technology leadership, Business Leaders, Product Leaders, Risk Partners, and Operations stakeholders. 
 - Influence strategic decisions through data, technology insights, and strong business partnership. 
 - Communicate effectively with executive leadership regarding strategy, delivery performance, technology risk, and transformation progress. 
 - Drive outcomes through collaboration and influence across highly matrixed global organizations. 

Risk, Security & Regulatory Compliance

- Ensure technology solutions comply with regulatory requirements, enterprise standards, and risk management frameworks. 
 - Partner closely with Information Security, Operational Risk, Compliance, Legal, and Audit teams. 
 - Strengthen resilience, disaster recovery, business continuity, and operational readiness capabilities. 
 - Maintain rigorous controls appropriate for a highly regulated financial services environment. 

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or equivalent in related field. 
 - 20+ years of relevant experience in software engineering, technology delivery, and digital transformation. 
 - 15+ years of leadership experience managing large engineering organizations. 
 - Demonstrated success managing complex global technology organizations - prefer Bank's GCC. 
 - Proven experience leading senior technology leaders, engineering managers, and architects. 

Preferred Qualifications

Technology & Engineering

- Strong understanding of AI-enabled software development and engineering productivity tools. 
 - Strong background in software delivery, platform engineering, Dev/ML Ops, Site Reliability Engineering, and technology operations. 
 - Experience leading large-scale modernization and digital transformation initiatives. 
 - Expertise in Agile product development methodologies and engineering excellence frameworks. 

Banking & Financial Services

- knowledge of Consumer Banking, Business Banking, Digital Banking and Money Movement technologies. 
 - Experience supporting customer-facing digital channels and financial products. 
 - Strong understanding of regulatory, risk, compliance, and security requirements within financial institutions. 
 - Experience operating in highly regulated environments. 

Leadership

- Proven track record building and scaling engineering organizations with 500+ technology professionals. 
 - Exceptional ability to influence senior executives and drive outcomes without direct authority. 
 - Demonstrated success in talent development, succession planning, and organizational transformation. 
 - Strong executive presence with excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. 
 - Experience managing globally distributed engineering teams. 

This role represents a unique opportunity to shape the future of the bank's consumer, business and digital technology landscape while building one of the industry's most impactful banking technology organizations in India. 

If there's anything we can do to accommodate a disability during any portion of the application or hiring process, please refer to our disability accommodations for applicants. 

Posting may be closed earlier due to high volume of applicants. 

This is an U. S. Bancorp India posting. U. S. Bancorp India is a part of the U. S. Bank family.

data.description:

The result is a sharper focus on business objectives and a dramatic improvement in employee productivity. Through our key technology partnerships and our people-first approach, Milestone continues to deliver industry-leading innovation to our clients. With more than 3, 000 employees serving over 200 companies worldwide, we are following our mission of revolutionizing the way IT is deployed. 

Job Overview

Salesforce Lead - Conversational Agentic ITSM Platform

Experience: 7-10 Years

Location: Kochi / Bangalore / Hyderabad (Hybrid)

Job Type: Full-Time

Reports To: Service Delivery Manager / Salesforce Architect

About The Role

We are seeking an experienced and highly capable Salesforce Lead to drive the technical delivery of our next-generation Conversational Agentic ITSM Platform powered by Salesforce, Agentforce, AI, Data Cloud, and MuleSoft. 

This is a hands-on technical leadership role for professionals who can lead development teams, guide solution design, mentor developers and senior developers, and closely partner with architects to deliver scalable enterprise solutions. The ideal candidate combines deep Salesforce platform expertise with strong people leadership, delivery ownership, and architectural thinking. 

As a Salesforce Lead, you will be responsible for translating business and platform strategy into high-quality technical solutions while ensuring adherence to architecture, governance, security, and engineering best practices. You will lead cross-functional teams building intelligent service management experiences across Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, Sales Cloud, Agentforce, Enterprise Service Management (ESM), ITSM, CMDB, IT Asset Management, and enterprise integrations. 

This role offers an opportunity to play a key leadership position in shaping the future of AI-powered service management and conversational enterprise platforms. 

Key Responsibilities

Technical Leadership & Delivery

- Lead a team of Salesforce Developers and Senior Salesforce Developers across multiple workstreams. 
 - Provide technical leadership throughout the full software development lifecycle, from solution design to production deployment. 
 - Partner closely with Salesforce Architects to translate architectural vision into scalable and maintainable technical solutions. 
 - Own technical delivery, ensuring solutions meet business, security, scalability, and performance requirements. 
 - Drive estimation, sprint planning, technical task allocation, and delivery execution. 
 - Conduct design reviews, code reviews, and architecture compliance reviews. 
 - Establish and enforce Salesforce development standards, coding conventions, CI/CD processes, and governance frameworks. 

Solution Design & Development

- Lead the design and development of Salesforce solutions supporting the organization's Conversational Agentic ITSM Platform. 
 - Design scalable solutions leveraging Salesforce Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, Sales Cloud, Platform, and Agentforce capabilities. 
 - Build intelligent service experiences utilizing Agentforce, AI-driven workflows, conversational experiences, and autonomous service capabilities. 
 - Design and develop complex solutions using Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Flows, Platform Events, Integration Patterns, and Salesforce APIs. 
 - Guide implementation of enterprise service management processes including: 
 - Incident Management
 - Service Request Management
 - Change Management
 - Problem Management
 - Knowledge Management
 - Employee Support Services
 - CMDB Management
 - IT Asset Management
 - Service Catalog Management
Integration & Enterprise Architecture

- Lead enterprise integration initiatives using MuleSoft and API-led connectivity patterns. 
 - Design reusable integration frameworks connecting Salesforce with ITSM, ERP, HR, Monitoring, Collaboration, Identity, and Business Systems. 
 - Collaborate with enterprise architects and integration teams to ensure platform interoperability and data consistency. 
 - Drive API governance, performance optimization, security controls, and integration best practices. 

Team Leadership & Mentoring

- Mentor Salesforce Developers and Senior Developers through coaching, design guidance, and hands-on technical support. 
 - Support career development and capability building within the Salesforce team. 
 - Identify skill gaps and define technical learning and certification roadmaps. 
 - Foster a culture of engineering excellence, collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement. 
 - Act as the primary technical escalation point for complex solution and production challenges. 

AI & Platform Innovation

- Champion adoption of Agentforce, Generative AI, Data Cloud, and emerging Salesforce innovations. 
 - Guide implementation of conversational AI, agentic workflows, intelligent automation, and self-service experiences. 
 - Evaluate new platform capabilities and recommend innovative solutions that improve service delivery and operational efficiency. 
 - Contribute to strategic platform roadmaps and technology decision-making. 

Required Qualifications

Must Have

- 7 to 10 years of Salesforce platform experience with at least 2-3 years in a technical lead role. 
 - Strong hands-on expertise across: 
 - Service Cloud
 - Sales Cloud
 - Experience Cloud
 - Salesforce Platform
 - Deep technical expertise in: 
 - Apex
 - Lightning Web Components (LWC)
 - Salesforce Flows
 - SOQL/SOSL
 - Platform Events
 - Integration Patterns
 - REST/SOAP APIs
 - Salesforce Security Model
 - Strong experience with large-scale Salesforce implementations and enterprise delivery programs. 
 - Experience leading and mentoring development teams. 
 - Experience working alongside solution architects and enterprise architects. 
 - Proven ability to drive technical decision-making and delivery governance. 
 - Strong understanding of: 
 - Data Architecture
 - Security & Sharing Models
 - DevOps & CI/CD
 - Release Management
 - Application Lifecycle Management
 - Experience in Agile, Scrum, and DevOps-driven environments. 
 - Strong stakeholder communication and leadership skills. 
Preferred Qualifications

- Experience implementing Enterprise Service Management (ESM) and IT Service Management (ITSM) solutions. 
 - Experience with: 
 - CMDB
 - IT Asset Management (ITAM)
 - Service Catalog
 - Enterprise Operations Management
 - Hands-on experience with MuleSoft and API Management. 
 - Experience working in global delivery models. 
 - Salesforce Platform Developer I & II Certifications. 
 - Salesforce Application Architect or System Architect Certification. 
 - Scrum Master, SAFe, or Agile certifications. 
Added Advantage

- Hands-on experience with Salesforce Agentforce. 
 - Experience building Conversational AI and autonomous service experiences. 
 - Exposure to Generative AI, Prompt Engineering, Agentic AI, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) concepts. 
 - Experience with Salesforce Data Cloud. 
 - Experience delivering Digital Transformation and Enterprise Automation initiatives. 
 - Knowledge of Service Operations, ITIL, or Enterprise Service Management frameworks. 

What We Are Looking For

We are seeking professionals who: 

- Think like technical leaders while remaining hands-on contributors. 
 - Can successfully lead teams while maintaining a strong engineering mindset. 
 - Are comfortable partnering with architects and influencing platform strategy. 
 - Enjoy solving complex enterprise-scale technology challenges. 
 - Can balance delivery excellence, innovation, governance, and stakeholder expectations. 
 - Are passionate about Agentforce, AI, Conversational Platforms, and Intelligent Automation. 
 - Demonstrate ownership, accountability, and strong decision-making capabilities.

data.title: Principal Manager, Tech (HCDev)
data.company: D. E. Shaw India Private Limited
data.description:
The D. E. Shaw group is a global investment and technology development firm with more than $100 billion in investment capital as of June 1, 2026, and offices in North America, Europe, and Asia. Since our founding in 1988, our firm has earned an international reputation for successful investing based on innovation, careful risk management, and the quality and depth of our staff. We have a significant presence in the world's capital markets, investing in a wide range of companies and financial instruments in both developed and developing economies. 

We are looking for an engineering manager to join our Human Capital Development (HC Dev) team based in Hyderabad, Bengaluru, or Gurugram. HC Dev builds and operates the core platforms and data systems that support how the firm hires, assesses, develops, and retains its people. We are in the midst of a broader evolution of these platforms, spanning their data foundations and use of AI, creating significant opportunities to shape their architecture, technical direction, and future. 

WHAT YOU'LL DO DAY-TO-DAY: 

In this role, you will lead an engineering team with ownership of its technical direction and delivery. You will work closely with other engineering managers and senior engineers across HC Dev, shape the roadmap in partnership with the business, drive architecture and engineering quality, and develop the engineers on your team. You will lead the design and delivery of web applications, data platforms, and supporting infrastructure, working closely with business stakeholders and product managers. You will set the technical direction for the systems your team owns, working with senior engineers and leads to drive architecture, key design decisions, and engineering quality. The team's technology stack includes Java/Spring, React/TypeScript, SQL Server, and Python. You will manage a team of engineers, including senior engineers and leads, with responsibility for performance, career growth, and team effectiveness. You will shape the roadmap for your area with business leadership and product managers, and own planning, estimation, capacity planning, and scope management while navigating delivery risks, trade-offs, and escalations independently. You will remain close to design and development, guiding the team on engineering best practices and providing technical leadership on complex, high-impact problems. You will mentor engineers on both technology and domain aspects to support their growth and development. 

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR: 

The ideal candidate should hold-

Basic Qualifications: 

- A bachelor's or master's degree in computer science or a related field, with 8 to 11 years of relevant experience
 - Robust software design and architecture experience, with sound judgment on trade-offs involving scalability, availability, security, and maintainability
 - Experience managing and developing engineers, including providing feedback, coaching, and supporting career growth
 - Proven ability to work with senior stakeholders, shape requirements and technical direction, build alignment, and handle escalations independently
 - Solid software engineering background across web applications, backend services, or data-intensive systems, with experience building and operating production systems at scale
 - Proven experience delivering complex projects end to end, including planning, estimation, execution, and course correction
 - Robust problem-solving and analytical skills, with a focus on engineering quality and sound technical judgment
 - Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with both technical and business stakeholders

Preferred Qualifications: 

- Experience engineering production AI systems, including retrieval, agentic workflows, tool use, model orchestration, and integration with enterprise data and services
 - Experience taking AI capabilities from prototype to production, including evaluation, observability, reliability, and operating these systems as models and underlying dependencies evolve

Interested candidates can apply through our website: https: //www. deshawindia. com/recruit/jobs/Ads/Link/PMHCDevSept26

We encourage candidates with relevant experience looking to restart their careers after a break to apply for this position. Learn about Recommence, our gender-neutral return-to-work initiative. 

The Firm offers excellent benefits, a casual, collegial working environment, and an attractive compensation package. For further information about our recruitment process, including how applicant data will be processed, please visit https: //www. deshawindia. com/careers

data.description:
In most instances, this position requires in-person interviews as part of the hiring process. Minimum qualifications: 

- Bachelor's degree, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - 8 years of experience in software development. 
 - 3 years of experience in a technical leadership role. 
 - 2 years of experience in a people management or team leadership role. 

Preferred qualifications: 

- 10 years of experience with software development. 
 - 7 years of experience in a technical leadership role; overseeing strategic projects, with 5 years of experience in a people management, supervision/team leadership role. 
 - Experience working with the following areas: Kubernetes or container orchestration frameworks, Cloud infrastructure (GCP, cloud computing platform, other) system integration, configuration management, control management, orchestration layer, etc. and with data collection/monitoring/alerting infrastructure, data analysis pipelines and machine learning. 
 - Track record of successful product delivery. 

About The Job

Like Google's own ambitions, the work of a Software Engineer goes beyond just Search. Software Engineering Managers have not only the technical expertise to take on and provide technical leadership to major projects, but also manage a team of Engineers. You not only optimize your own code but make sure Engineers are able to optimize theirs. As a Software Engineering Manager you manage your project goals, contribute to product strategy and help develop your team. Teams work all across the company, in areas such as information retrieval, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking, security, data compression, user interface design; the list goes on and is growing every day. Operating with scale and speed, our exceptional software engineers are just getting started -- and as a manager, you guide the way. 

With technical and leadership expertise, you manage engineers across multiple teams and locations, a large product budget and oversee the deployment of large-scale projects across multiple sites internationally. 

Google Cloud accelerates every organization's ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google's cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems. 

Responsibilities

- Coach, mentor, and scale an hardware systems and platform software engineering team in BLR, advocating technical excellence and high ownership. 
 - Work alongside TLs to drive architectural definition, board/system validation, and qualification for next-generation Google Distributed Cloud connected (GDCc) and Google Global Cache (GGC) compute servers. 
 - Steer engineering engagements with key (original equipment manufacturer) OEMs (Dell, HPE, Supermicro) to co-design and qualify platforms adhering to Google's rigorous reliability, and security standards. 
 - Collaborate with AI platform and accelerator teams to qualify compute platforms capable of hosting local Gemini models, GPU/NPU subsystems, and low-latency inference workloads. 
 - Coordinate platform software, BIOS/OpenBMC, security attestation, and OS bring-up with distributed Google Cloud software teams.

data.description:
Organization OverviewCompany Description

QAD is a leading provider of ERP solutions purpose-built for manufacturing industries - automotive, life sciences, food & beverage, high tech, and industrial. Serving thousands of global manufacturers, QAD's Adaptive Manufacturing Cloud helps companies operate with greater precision, agility, and intelligence. 

Enterprise software is entering a third era. The first gave manufacturers a System of Record - ERP that answered 'what do we have and what did we commit to?' The second gave them Data Infrastructure - the ability to move, analyse, and query that data at scale. The third era is domain-specific intelligence: AI agents that can act autonomously on manufacturing data, but only if that data has been given the context, relationships, and governed rules that allow an agent to reason correctly. 

Job Description

The ERP Platform Architect owns the architecture of the foundation underneath Adaptive ERP: the frameworks, shared services, data layer, and runtime that every functional area builds on. This architect is the technical partner to the Director, ERP Platform: one engineering head paired with one architect. 

Open: final scope and level to be confirmed. 

Responsibilities

- Develop the platform architecture and technical roadmap with the Director, ERP Platform and the Lead Architect. 
 - Define clear contracts and standards for shared platform services: application interfaces, integrations, identity, data access, and extensibility. 
 - Assess legacy dependencies and technical debt, and design incremental modernization paths that preserve compatibility for customers. 
 - Set requirements for performance, security, resilience, observability, and testability. 
 - Review designs and critical implementation choices, using prototypes to resolve hard platform risks. 
 - Coach engineers and provide technical input into development plans and promotion assessments. 

Qualifications

Required Skills: 

- Senior architecture and hands-on engineering experience on a complex enterprise software platform. 
 - Deep knowledge of frameworks, data layers, APIs, integration patterns, extensibility, and multi-environment deployment. 
 - A record of modernizing established software incrementally, balancing long-term architecture with delivery. 
 - Influence across engineering teams, turning architectural decisions into implemented outcomes. 

Preferred

- Enterprise ERP or manufacturing software experience. 
 - Experience with Progress/OpenEdge environments and Java services. 
 - AI-assisted modernization or development. 

What Success Looks Like

One coherent target architecture that every workstream builds toward, cross-team technical decisions made quickly, and visible progress in modernizing the product. 

The benchmark is a chief-architect-calibre leader early in that arc: broad, credible with executives, and able to drive change rather than only advise on it. 

Why QAD?

You'll be shaping the future of intelligent manufacturing platforms at global scale-working with ambitious leaders, modern cloud technologies, and AI‐driven innovation that delivers real‐world impact. 

Additional Information

- Your health and well being are important to us at QAD. We provide programs that help you strike a healthy work-life balance. 
 - Opportunity to join a growing business, launching into its next phase of expansion and transformation. 
 - Collaborative culture of smart and hard-working people who support one another to get the job done. 
 - An atmosphere of growth and opportunity, where idea-sharing is always prioritized over level or hierarchy. 
 - Compensation packages based on experience and desired skill set

About QAD

QAD | Redzone is redefining manufacturing and supply chains through its intelligent, adaptive platform that connects people, processes, and data into a single System of Action. With three core pillars - Redzone (frontline empowerment), Adaptive Applications (the intelligent backbone), and Champion AI (Agentic AI for manufacturing) - QAD | Redzone helps manufacturers operate with Champion Pace, achieving measurable productivity, resilience, and growth in just 90 days. 

QAD is committed to ensuring that every employee feels they work in an environment that values their contributions, respects their unique perspectives and provides opportunities for growth regardless of background. QAD's DEI program is driving higher levels of diversity, equity and inclusion so that employees can bring their whole self to work.

data.title: Manager, Site Reliability Engineer (Production Engineering)
data.description:
Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world's largest in-line cloud security platform. 

We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world's hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler. 

Role

We are looking for a Manager, Site Reliability Engineering to join our team. This is a Hybrid (Bangalore) role, reporting to the VP, Site Reliability Engineering in the Engineering department. 

In this role, you will lead a team of Production Engineers responsible for the reliability, scalability, and operational excellence of our global platform. You will provide the technical leadership and execution rigor to drive an automation-first and reliability-focused engineering culture. By maturing observability, operational readiness, and architectural standards, you will help reduce Mean Time to Mitigate (MTTM) and improve the resilience of a globally distributed, multi-cloud infrastructure protecting millions of users. 

What You'll Do (Role Expectations)

- Lead and grow a team of Production Engineers responsible for the reliability, availability, and scalability of large-scale production services
 - Drive an automation-first culture by guiding the team to eliminate manual toil, improve workflows, and build resilient, self-healing tools and systems
 - Implement and mature observability practices, including monitoring, alerting, SLIs/SLOs, and error budgets to improve service health and operational decision-making
 - Lead high-severity incident response, strengthen response playbooks, and drive deep post-incident reviews that result in durable engineering improvements
 - Partner with Engineering and cross-functional teams to conduct operability reviews and influence architecture and service design for scale, resilience, and maintainability

data.title: Director, Engineering (Lynx + Extensions Platform)
data.description:
Organization OverviewCompany Description

QAD is a leading provider of ERP solutions purpose-built for manufacturing industries - automotive, life sciences, food & beverage, high tech, and industrial. Serving thousands of global manufacturers, QAD's Adaptive Manufacturing Cloud helps companies operate with greater precision, agility, and intelligence. 

Enterprise software is entering a third era. The first gave manufacturers a System of Record - ERP that answered 'what do we have and what did we commit to?' The second gave them Data Infrastructure - the ability to move, analyse, and query that data at scale. The third era is domain-specific intelligence: AI agents that can act autonomously on manufacturing data, but only if that data has been given the context, relationships, and governed rules that allow an agent to reason correctly. 

Job Description

This director owns the engineering that moves customers onto Adaptive streamlined. Many customers carry years of custom code. Lynx is QAD's tooling, built on AWS' ATX, that analyzes existing customizations and supports their conversion to approaches compatible with Adaptive streamlined. The Extensions Platform is where customers build and run those extensions. This leader owns both, plus the engineering side of the pre-engagement assessment every customer goes through before migrating. It is the most customer-facing engineering leadership role in the transformation. 

Responsibilities

- Own the engineering capabilities and technical support model that enable Services and partners to assess, plan, and execute customer transitions: assess their environment, customizations, integrations, and business processes; convert what can be converted; resolve what cannot. 
 - Lead the engineering side of the pre-engagement gate with Services, Sales, and Product, so customers are qualified and planned before migration starts. 
 - Own the combined roadmap, delivery commitments, budget, and results for Lynx and the Extensions Platform. 
 - Lead and develop both managers and their teams, with clear ownership, performance expectations, and succession. 
 - Turn findings from every migration into backlog: missed customizations become Lynx work, platform gaps become Extensions Platform work. 
 - Build an Extensions Platform that lets customers create their own extensions, replacing what they give up in custom code. 
 - Manage internal and vendor delivery, and measure the process: conversion effort, cycle time, and customers reaching Adaptive streamlined. 

Qualifications

Required

- Engineering leadership across multiple teams through managers, accountable for people, technology, execution, and results. 
 - Experience delivering migration tooling, developer tooling, customization frameworks, or low-code/no-code platforms for enterprise software. 
 - Comfort working directly with customers, Services, and partners, turning complex needs into repeatable product capabilities. 
 - Strong technical judgment and credibility in design decisions alongside architects. 

Preferred

- ERP or manufacturing software experience. 
 - Leadership of large legacy modernization or customer conversion programs. 
 - Practical experience using AI for code analysis, transformation, or developer productivity. 

What Success Looks Like

A repeatable, measurable path to Adaptive streamlined, fewer recurring conversion blockers, and steadily less effort per customer migration. 

Additional Information

- Your health and well being are important to us at QAD. We provide programs that help you strike a healthy work-life balance. 
 - Opportunity to join a growing business, launching into its next phase of expansion and transformation. 
 - Collaborative culture of smart and hard-working people who support one another to get the job done. 
 - An atmosphere of growth and opportunity, where idea-sharing is always prioritized over level or hierarchy. 
 - Compensation packages based on experience and desired skill set

About QAD

QAD | Redzone is redefining manufacturing and supply chains through its intelligent, adaptive platform that connects people, processes, and data into a single System of Action. With three core pillars - Redzone (frontline empowerment), Adaptive Applications (the intelligent backbone), and Champion AI (Agentic AI for manufacturing) - QAD | Redzone helps manufacturers operate with Champion Pace, achieving measurable productivity, resilience, and growth in just 90 days.

Job Description

At NI IP Routing SW, we believe in fostering a flat and non-hierarchical work environment. We are obsessed about delivering high-quality products and ensure the utmost level of excellence in everything we do. We are a passionate bunch and strive to be technological leaders in our industry. You will be integral to a close-knit team to engineer best-in-class products for the most critical networks - data centers for web/hyper-scalers, telcos and enterprises (including AI fabrics), and communication service provider networks. 

We are looking for SW engineers who wish to be a part of developing and evolving the current and next generation of routers that form the core of anything internet. These routers are at the heart of Nokia's IP product offerings, from data centers (including AI fabrics) to providing strong, resilient low latency and dependable IP backhaul for service providers and mission critical networks. In this role, you will have the opportunity to work with one of the best engineering teams in the industry. We value your expertise and offer an environment where you can thrive both professionally and personally. There are more customers we want to win, more networks to penetrate, more technologies to enable and more applications to support. We want to make smaller products, and we want to make bigger products. We want to build products based on newer standards and newer ASICS in the market. 

You will play a critical role in designing and implementing high-performance data path solutions on both custom and merchant silicon. You will be responsible for writing efficient and modular code that is well-tested and robust, ensuring that it meets the high standards required for the most critical networks. Your role will involve working on advanced packet forwarding techniques in IP, MPLS, Segment Routing, VxLANs. You will also contribute into Traffic Management technologies - QoS (Policers, Schedulers, Shapers), ACLs, TCAM Management, and Packet Extractions to CPU. DCN2026. 

How You Will Contribute And What You Will Learn

- Design and implementation: You will gain deep expertise in designing and implementing datapath solutions on both custom and merchant silicon. 
 - Advanced packet forwarding: Develop your skills in IP, MPLS, Segment Routing, VXLANs, and QoS technologies such as Policers, Schedulers, and ACLs. DPDK and performance optimization: You'll be working with DPDK and similar technologies to maximize performance for high-throughput systems. 
 - Virtualized environments: Expand your knowledge in working with virtualized Linux environments such as KVM and Dockers. 
 - Team collaboration: Work closely with cross-functional teams, including product management and software testers, to deliver customer-driven solutions. 
 - Robust and modular code: Focus on writing modular, maintainable code that is well unit-tested, improving your coding skills and best practices. 

Key Skills And Experience

- Bachelor's degree with 3-10 years of Experience. 
 - Proven experience in packet forwarding technologies (IP, MPLS, Segment Routing, VXLANs). 
 - Experience with QoS technologies (Policers, Schedulers, ACLs) and TCAM management. 
 - Hands-on experience with DPDK for high-performance packet processing. 
 - Proficiency in C/C++ programming, with a focus on networking solutions. 
 - Contributions to SONiC or other open-source networking projects (desirable). 
 - Methodical problem-solving skills and attention to detail. 
 - Experience working in virtualized Linux environments (e. g. , KVM, Docker, etc. ). 
 - Passion for networking technologies and high-performance systems.

data.title: Cloud Platform Software Engineer
data.description:
At IBEE Cloud, we are building a next-generation cloud platform from the ground up-covering compute, storage, networking, and developer platforms. Unlike typical roles that consume cloud services, this role focuses on designing and building cloud infrastructure itself, similar to platforms like Amazon Web Services, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure. 

Role Overview

As a Cloud Platform Software Engineer, you will design and build core infrastructure services that power IBEE Cloud. This includes APIs, control planes, schedulers, orchestration systems, and distributed services for compute, storage, and networking. 

You will work deeply on systems design, distributed systems, and infrastructure abstraction layers, building platforms that developers and enterprises rely on to run their applications. 

Key Responsibilities

- Design and build core cloud services (Compute, Object Storage, Networking, DNS, Load Balancers)
 - Develop control plane systems (API layer, orchestration, resource lifecycle management)
 - Build multi-tenant, highly available distributed systems
 - Design scalable metadata systems (for VMs, volumes, buckets, networking)
 - Work on schedulers for compute, GPU, and container workloads
 - Implement authentication, authorization, and isolation mechanisms
 - Optimize systems for performance, scalability, and fault tolerance
 - Build internal developer platforms and APIs (similar to AWS/GCP primitives)
 - Collaborate with infra, networking, and GPU teams

What Makes This Role Different

- You are building the cloud, not deploying apps on cloud
 - Work on core primitives like compute, storage, and networking
 - Solve hard distributed systems problems at scale
 - Direct impact on platform architecture and product direction

Requirements

Required Skills

- Strong programming skills (Go / Java / Python preferred)
 - Deep understanding of distributed systems and system design
 - Experience building backend systems or large-scale APIs
 - Knowledge of Linux internals (processes, networking, storage)
 - Understanding of networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS, routing)
 - Experience with databases (SQL/NoSQL, distributed storage systems)

Preferred Qualifications

- 2-6+ years of experience in backend / platform / systems engineering
 - Experience building or contributing to infrastructure systems
 - Familiarity with Kubernetes, container runtimes, or virtualization (KVM)
 - Exposure to object storage (S3-compatible), block storage, or file systems
 - Experience with message queues and event-driven systems (Kafka, RabbitMQ)
 - Understanding of IAM systems and multi-tenant architectures

Key Areas You'll Work On

- Cloud control plane (API + orchestration layer)
 - Compute platform (VM lifecycle, scheduling, GPU allocation)
 - Object storage (S3-compatible APIs, metadata systems)
 - Networking platform (VPC, load balancers, firewall, routing)
 - Developer platform (CLI, SDKs, automation APIs)

Benefits

Why Join IBEE Cloud

- Opportunity to build a cloud platform from first principles
 - Work on real infrastructure (bare metal, networking, GPU systems)
 - High ownership with fast execution and learning
 - Build systems comparable to global cloud providers

Work Environment

- Flexible (Remote / Hybrid)
 - Engineering-first, systems-focused culture
 - High-impact role with cross-functional collaboration

data.description:
About Whirlpool India

Whirlpool of India Limited, headquartered in Gurugram, is a leading home appliances company dedicated to enhancing life at home and inspiring generations through its trusted brands. The company operates three state-of-the-art manufacturing facilities in Faridabad, Pune & Puducherry, each reflecting Whirlpool's commitment to providing best-in-class consumer solutions. Further driving innovation, the company has a Technology & Engineering Center, where India's world-class talent architects the next generation of home innovation. In the 2024-25 fiscal year, Whirlpool of India reported approximately INR 8110 Cr in annual revenue and employed 2193 people. More information is available at www. india. whirlpool. in

The team you will be a part of

The Service Quality team is responsible for setting up of the Service Quality standards for Whirlpool India along with addressing consumer complaints by effectively managing service call center. Also responsible for leading cost saving projects and service strategy consolidation along with managing the serviceability of the assigned categories. 

This Role In Summary

The Service Quality Lead will be responsible for driving end-to-end service quality, customer experience, technical capability, and product/service performance for the Air Conditioner and Microwave categories. The role will identify quality gaps and convert customer, field and data insights into effective corrective and preventive actions. It will drive sustainable improvement in key service KPIs, including repeat rate, First Time Fix, NPS and complaint resolution. The role will also lead P4G and Total Cost of Quality (TCQ) initiatives focused on reducing Cost of Poor Quality, warranty costs, repeat repairs and service inefficiencies. Partnering with cross-functional teams, the role will identify, quantify and deliver impactful cost-saving opportunities without compromising customer experience or service quality. 

Your Responsibilities Will Include

- Ensure service readiness for new product launches, including SOPs, technical training, tools, spares, troubleshooting and field support. 
 - Analyse customer VOC, field data, product failures and service trends to identify quality gaps, recurring issues and improvement opportunities. 
 - Lead RCA, CAPA and corrective actions for critical and recurring product/service quality issues in collaboration with Engineering, Plant Quality, Manufacturing, Marketing and Service Operations. 
 - Drive Field Fix implementation for identified product and technical issues, ensuring effective execution, compliance and closure across the service network
 - Drive P4G and TCQ initiatives to reduce Cost of Poor Quality, warranty costs, repeat repairs, material consumption, avoidable visits and other service-related costs. 
 - Establish effective control over customer machine replacements and Under-Warranty (UW) costs, ensuring appropriate validation, approvals and cost governance. 
 - Manage coordination with FPS vendors for technical interventions, product quality issues, field actions and resolution of critical cases. 
 - Drive technical capability development of Service Engineers, Master Engineers and Service Partners through targeted training, certification and technical interventions. 
 - Own LMS platform management for the categories, ensuring training content, curriculum, certification, completion and capability tracking are effectively managed. 
 - Drive SBOM readiness and MSL review for new and existing products, ensuring adequate parts availability based on failure trends, installed base and service requirements. 
 - Monitor and improve Service Partner quality performance through audits, scorecards, governance reviews and structured improvement plans. 
 - Establish early-warning mechanisms and quality dashboards to proactively identify product, process and service quality risks. 
 - Benchmark best practices and lead continuous improvement and quality transformation projects across the service network. 

Minimum Requirements

Education: Bachelor's degree in Engineering, preferably Mechanical, Electrical, Electronics, Production or a related discipline. 

Preferred Skills And Experiences

8+ years in Consumer Durables, HVAC, Refrigeration or related industries, with strong service and field operations exposure. 

Strong expertise in spare parts planning, SBOM readiness, MSL optimisation and parts availability. 

Proven experience in Service Partner quality, technical capability and FPS/vendor coordination. 

Strong cross-functional leadership across Engineering, Quality, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Marketing and Service. 

Data-driven problem-solving, stakeholder management and ability to convert VOC/field insights into improvements. 

Experience in new product launch readiness, including SOPs, training, tools, spares and field support. 

Excellent communication and presentation skills with senior leadership and field teams. 

Connect with us and learn more about Whirlpool India. See what it's like to work at Whirlpool by visiting Whirlpool Careers. Additional information about the company can be found on Facebook, Instagram and YouTube. 

At Whirlpool India, we value and celebrate diversity. Whirlpool India is committed to equal employment opportunity and prohibits any discrimination on the basis of race or ethnicity, religion, sex, pregnancy, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, age, physical or mental disability, veteran status, or any other category protected by applicable law.

Organization OverviewCompany Description

QAD is a leading provider of ERP solutions purpose-built for manufacturing industries - automotive, life sciences, food & beverage, high tech, and industrial. Serving thousands of global manufacturers, QAD's Adaptive Manufacturing Cloud helps companies operate with greater precision, agility, and intelligence. 

Enterprise software is entering a third era. The first gave manufacturers a System of Record - ERP that answered 'what do we have and what did we commit to?' The second gave them Data Infrastructure - the ability to move, analyse, and query that data at scale. The third era is domain-specific intelligence: AI agents that can act autonomously on manufacturing data, but only if that data has been given the context, relationships, and governed rules that allow an agent to reason correctly. 

Job Description

The SRM Architect owns the technical direction of QAD's SaaS products outside the core ERP: Supplier Relationship Management (SRM), Enterprise Quality Management (EQMS), and Demand & Delivery. Development on these products is largely outsourced, so this person is the internal technical authority who sets direction and holds partners to it. Major customer commitments, including a strategic co-investment partnership, depend on this role. 

Responsibilities

- Define the target architecture and a practical modernization roadmap for SRM, EQMS, and Demand & Delivery, with engineering and product leaders. 
 - Make and document architecture decisions on application design, AWS deployment, multi-tenancy, integrations, data, security, and performance. 
 - Set technical standards for outsourced engineering partners, review their designs and delivered work, and resolve technical risks before they reach customers.

What Success Looks Like

Customer commitments delivered on time, partners held to a clear technical standard, and an architectural roadmap the business can plan against.

Why QAD?

You'll be shaping the future of intelligent manufacturing platforms at global scale-working with ambitious leaders, modern cloud technologies, and AI‐driven innovation that delivers real‐world impact.

data.title: Pre-Silicon SoC Validation - Technical Lead

Job Details

Job Description: 

Role Summary

Seeking an experienced SoC Validation Engineer to define, drive, and execute validation strategies across the full silicon lifecycle, from architecture definition and pre-silicon planning through silicon power-on, post-silicon debug, stepping readiness, and PRQ quality convergence. 

The role requires deep expertise in complex SoC validation, security validation, coherency flows, firmware and hardware interaction, disaggregated architecture, and cross-functional technical leadership. 

The engineer will be responsible for ensuring early risk identification, high-quality milestone readiness, predictable silicon bring-up, rapid sighting debug, and continuous feedback from post-silicon learnings into earlier validation phases. 

Key Responsibilities

Define and drive end-to-end SoC validation strategy across the full lifecycle, including architecture definition, pre-silicon validation planning, RTL milestone readiness, silicon power-on preparation, post-silicon debug, stepping readiness, and PRQ quality convergence. 

Develop comprehensive validation plans, execution strategies, coverage goals, debug plans, and sign-off criteria aligned to program milestones and product quality targets. 

Drive validation of critical SoC flows across security, coherency, memory, fabric, IO, and cross-die interactions in disaggregated architectures. 

Validate complex hardware, firmware, and software interactions with specific focus on security handshakes, coherency protocols, cache and fabric ordering, access control, isolation, attestation, fuse/security policy behavior, and multi-die/domain interactions. 

Review architecture and microarchitecture specifications to identify validation gaps in security, coherency, shared-resource behavior, cross-die communication, firmware sequencing, and lifecycle readiness from pre-silicon through post-silicon execution. 

Drive debug of complex pre-silicon and post-silicon failures, identify root cause across RTL, firmware, microcode, platform software, validation content, security policy, coherency behavior, and system-level configuration. 

Partner with architecture, design, verification, firmware, post-silicon, security, coherency, platform, manufacturing, and program teams to ensure high-quality validation readiness, silicon bring-up efficiency, and timely closure of issues across product milestones. 

Use post-silicon sightings, customer issues, stepping feedback, defect trends, security observations, and coherency escapes to strengthen earlier validation strategies, improve coverage, and prevent repeated escapes across programs. 

Define validation quality metrics, execution dashboards, risk indicators, milestone readiness reports, and sign-off recommendations for leadership reviews. 

Drive innovation in validation efficiency, including automation, test grading, coverage-driven execution, AI/ML-assisted bug hunting, regression optimization, and shift-left methodologies. 

Mentor senior and mid-level engineers, build technical depth in the team, and contribute to reusable validation methodologies, collateral, and best practices across programs. 

Qualifications

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electronics Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, VLSI, Embedded Systems, Computer Science, or a related discipline. 

12-20 years of relevant industry experience in pre-silicon validation, SoC validation, design verification, silicon validation, firmware validation, or hardware/software co-validation. 

Strong understanding of SoC architecture, microarchitecture, CPU/core integration, fabrics, memory subsystem, security, coherency, cache hierarchy, firmware-driven security flows, and disaggregated/multi-die architectures. 

Hands-on experience defining and executing validation strategies across the product lifecycle, including architecture review, pre-silicon planning, RTL milestone readiness, silicon power-on preparation, post-silicon sighting debug, stepping feedback, and PRQ quality convergence. 

Proven experience in developing validation plans, test strategies, debug methodologies, coverage closure plans, post-silicon feedback loops, and milestone sign-off criteria for complex SoCs and disaggregated silicon products. 

Required Technical Skills

Deep knowledge of SoC architecture, system architecture, disaggregated and multi-die architecture, microarchitecture fundamentals, IP/subsystem integration, fabrics, memory hierarchy, and cross-die communication. 

Strong expertise in validation methodologies across the pre-silicon to post-silicon continuum, including test planning, content development, coverage closure, milestone readiness, silicon bring-up support, sighting reproduction, and lifecycle feedback loops. 

Strong technical depth in security validation, coherency validation, cache/fabric ordering, access-control flows, isolation mechanisms, firmware-authenticated flows, fuse/security policy behavior, and multi-domain system interactions. 

Strong debug skills using waveform analysis, logs, traces, checkers, assertions, firmware instrumentation, and platform-level debug tools. 

Experience with one or more programming or scripting languages such as C, C++, Python, Perl, SystemVerilog, UVM, or similar validation automation languages. 

Knowledge of firmware and microcode flows, manageability firmware, or other SoC firmware interactions. 

Understanding of validation quality metrics, functional coverage, test effectiveness, regression health, bug trends, and milestone readiness indicators. 

Leadership and Collaboration Expectations

Operate as a senior technical leader who can independently define technical direction, influence stakeholders, and drive convergence across multiple teams. 

Lead cross-functional discussions with architecture, design, verification, firmware, post-silicon, platform, manufacturing, and program management teams. 

Identify program risks early, propose mitigation plans, and drive technical decision-making to protect milestone predictability and product quality. 

Communicate complex technical issues clearly through reviews, dashboards, status reports, debug summaries, and leadership updates. 

Mentor engineers, build validation capability within the organization, and help establish scalable processes for future SoC programs. 

Preferred Qualifications

Prior Intel Xeon product validation experience across one or more server SoC generations, including pre-silicon planning, silicon power-on, post-silicon debug, stepping readiness, or PRQ quality convergence. 

Exposure to Cheetah-based validation methodologies, including validation environment integration, filelist/dependency setup, methodology quality checks, simulation build/run readiness, or SoC/IP integration collateral checks. 

Exposure to security, coherency, cache hierarchy, fabric, memory validation. 

Experience with lifecycle-driven validation improvements, including shift-left strategies, post-silicon sighting reproduction in pre-silicon environments, reusable validation content, formal-assisted validation, collateral consistency checks, and AI/ML-driven validation efficiency improvements. 

Prior experience driving A0/TI readiness, milestone sign-off, or post-silicon sighting reproduction in pre-silicon environments. 

Demonstrated ability to deliver results through ambiguity, influence without authority, and enable technical convergence across distributed teams.
