data.description:
About Us

Mercari is a Japan-based C2C marketplace company founded in 2013 with the mission to "Create value in a global marketplace where anyone can buy & sell. " From being the first tech unicorn from Japan before its IPO in 2018, we have come a long way towards becoming a global player and continuously and diligently work towards our transformation journey with a strong focus on our mission. 

Since its inception, Mercari Group has worked to grow its services, investing in both our people and technology. Over time Mercari has expanded from being the top player in the C2C marketplace in Japan to new geographies like the U. S. We have also successfully launched new businesses such as Merpay, a mobile payment service platform with a vision to create a society where anyone can realize their dreams through a new ecosystem centered not only on payment service but also on credit. Today, Mercari Group is made up of multiple subsidiary businesses including logistics, B2C platform, blockchain, and sports team management. 

For our services to be utilized by people worldwide, there is still a mountain of work ahead of us. This endeavor naturally requires the capability of the best talent and minds, and that is exactly the reason for us to launch the India Center of Excellence. With your help, we will continue to take on the world stage and strive to grow into a successful global tech company. 

Our Culture

To achieve our mission at Mercari, our organization and each of our employees share the same values and perspectives. Our individual guidelines for action are defined by our four values: Go Bold, All for One, Be a Pro and Move Fast. Our organization is also shaped by our four foundations: Sustainability, Diversity & Inclusion, Trust & Openness, and Well-being for Performance. Regardless of how big Mercari gets, the culture will remain essential to achieving our mission and something we want to preserve throughout our organization. We invite you to read the Mercari Culture Doc which summarizes the behaviors and mindset shared by Mercari and its employees. We continue to build an environment where all of our members of diverse backgrounds are accepted and recognized, and where they can thrive while holding dear to Mercari's culture. 

Organization/Team Mission

Mercari Engineering Principles

Mercari Engineering Principles are a shared understanding that serves as the foundation of engineering beliefs and behavior at Mercari. The Engineering Principles are designed to complement the organizational identity (Mercari's mission, values, and culture) from an engineering viewpoint. 

These principles ultimately help us achieve Mercari's mission by defining the ideal state we seek to realize in the long term. 

- Passion For The Product
 - Grow Together
 - Solve Through Mechanisms
 - Collaborate Openly

Role

We're looking for a Tech Lead with a strong computer science background and proven experience building and operating platform or infrastructure systems. You'll provide technical leadership for platform initiatives while remaining hands-on, improving developer productivity and ensuring the reliability, security, scalability, and observability of Mercari services. 

You'll work with engineers and stakeholders across teams to identify problems, set technical direction, and deliver platform capabilities that support large-scale systems. You'll also guide the release, migration, adoption, and operation of those capabilities. 

What You'll Do

- Lead the design, development, and operation of platform features and tools that support the full software development lifecycle, from build and test through deployment and operation
 - Set technical direction for platform initiatives, make pragmatic architectural decisions, and communicate trade-offs clearly
 - Write and review production code, design documents, and infrastructure changes while maintaining high engineering standards
 - Plan and lead migrations and adoption of platform features and tools, working with internal developers to minimize disruption
 - Improve platform stability, scalability, availability, and security in collaboration with the SRE and Security teams
 - Improve observability of services and the platform to reduce incidents and control costs
 - Improve and automate daily platform operations, reducing toil, and guide incident response and follow-up improvements
 - Mentor engineers, share knowledge, and foster engineering best practices through technical guidance and collaboration
 - Work with internal developers and stakeholders to understand their needs, prioritize problems, and deliver practical solutions

You may be a good fit if you

- Are passionate about improving developer productivity and experience
 - Enjoy building, operating, and maintaining scalable infrastructure through operational automation
 - Lead by example and enjoy mentoring engineers and helping teams make sound technical decisions
 - Take a pragmatic approach to problems and are neutral about technology choices
 - Avoid reinventing the wheel and make effective use of existing tools and ecosystems
 - Have strong communication and interpersonal skills and can align stakeholders across teams

Platform areas

- ETI
 - Network
 - Platform Infra
 - Observability

Bold challenges

The platform and its tools are used across the Japan marketplace, Japan fintech, and the Mercari US marketplace. Changes and improvements can affect organizational performance-from development agility to system reliability-and your work can have a significant impact. 

The team needs to understand developers' challenges and the needs of Mercari Group product development. As a lead engineer, you'll help gather requirements, prioritize problems, and guide practical solutions that draw on your knowledge and experience. 

Requirements

Minimum requirements

- At least 8 years of experience developing, operating, and maintaining complex, scalable production systems, including cloud-based platforms
 - Experience leading the technical design and delivery of platform or infrastructure initiatives across teams
 - Strong computer science background and in-depth knowledge of a major cloud platform such as AWS, Azure, or GCP
 - Strong written communication skills for documenting designs, explaining technical trade-offs, and collaborating with stakeholders
 - Proficiency with container platforms such as Kubernetes or Docker in production environments
 - Hands-on experience building tools and automation with languages such as Bash, Go, or Python
 - Strong experience implementing and managing infrastructure as code (IaC), such as Terraform
 - Experience mentoring engineers and providing technical guidance through design and code reviews
 - Ability to collaborate with a team and adapt to a dynamic environment

Preferred requirements

- Experience with distributed systems or microservices architecture
 - Understanding of service-level agreements (SLAs) and objectives for maintaining system performance and reliability
 - Familiarity with monitoring and observability technologies such as Datadog, Prometheus, Graphite, Grafana, Kibana, or Elasticsearch
 - Previous open-source software development experience or active participation in open-source communities
 - Production experience with service meshes such as Istio, Kong, or Linkerd

Benefits

Employment Status : Full-time

Office location: Bengaluru

Hybrid workstyle : 2 Days Work From Office

(We believe in high performance and professionalism. We work from office for 2 days/week and work from home 3 days/week

To build a strong & highly-engaged organization in India, we highly encourage everyone to work from our Bangalore office, especially during the initial office setup phase

We will continue to review and update the policy to address future organizational needs)

Working Conditions

data.description:
Overview of 66degrees

66degrees is an end-to-end AI transformation partner that guides enterprises from complex business challenges to clear, quantifiable outcomes. Our company is the culmination of several successful firms, each a leader in its own right in cloud, artificial intelligence, and data. This convergence of talent and expertise is how we help businesses reach their own "inflection point, " where chaotic data becomes a strategic asset, complexity becomes clarity, and AI becomes an engine for growth. Our ultimate vision is to be the catalyst for a future where every business operates as an intelligent enterprise, with autonomous systems unlocking human potential. 

At 66degrees, we believe in thriving through challenges and winning together. These values not only guide us in achieving our goals as a company but also for our people. We are dedicated to creating a significant impact for our employees by fostering a culture that sparks innovation and supports professional and personal growth along the way. 

Overview of Role

66degrees' Managed Cloud Optimization (MCO) team works with some of the largest cloud users in the world to help them transform their businesses with technology. Our Site Reliability Engineers (SREs) combine Google Cloud Platform expertise with a passion for devops methodologies to help our clients maintain, optimize, and scale their cloud implementations. 

On a daily basis, our SREs work with varied and exciting customers on topics ranging from solving critical outages to designing and deploying new cloud workloads to building self-healing automation. Our SREs work with cutting-edge Google Cloud technologies like Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE), Anthos, BigQuery and data pipelines, as well as leading 3rd party tools like Prometheus, Datadog, and many others. Our SREs also work with languages like Python and Terraform to create automation, deploy infrastructure, and contribute to open-sourcing. 

If you're looking to continually build and apply your Google Cloud expertise to new and varied environments while acting as a key contributor to building the best Google consulting partner in the industry - let's talk. 

Responsibilities

Our ideal candidate will understand the value of teamwork. We are looking for the right fit with our rapidly growing organization and will invest in training. 

We Are Based In Chicago, Illinois And Denver, Colorado. Remote Candidates Should Not Hesitate Applying. A 66degrees' Site Reliability Engineer's Responsibilities And Duties Are As Follows: 

- Ensure near-zero downtime with monitoring and alerting, self-healing automation, and continuous improvement
 - Create highly automated, available and scalable systems by applying software and infrastructure principles
 - Employ and advise clients on DevOps and SRE principles and practices, covering deployment pipelines, HA, service reliability, technical debt, and operational toil for live services running at scale
 - Provide a proactive approach to our clients' workloads, anticipating failures, automating tasks, ensuring availability, and providing a great customer experience
 - Work closely with clients, your team, and Google engineers to investigate and resolve infrastructure issues
 - Contribute to ad-hoc initiatives such as writing documentation, open-sourcing, and improving operation, making a huge impact at a rapid-growth Google Premier Partner

Qualifications

- Minimum 3+ years of cloud and infrastructure experience, including demonstrated expertise with Linux, Windows, k8s, databases, and networking services
 - 2+ years of Google Cloud experience and related certifications strongly preferred but not required
 - Proficiency with Python required. Other programming language experience is a plus
 - Strong provisioning and configuration skills using Terraform
 - Experience with 24x7x365 monitoring, incident response, and on-call support. 
 - Experience in troubleshooting that spans systems, network, and code
 - Experience determining & negotiating Error budgets, SLIs, SLOs, and SLAs with product owners
 - Demonstrate the ability to work independently and as a member of a greater team, including cross-team activities
 - Experience working in Agile Scrum, Kanban methodologies in SDLC
 - Proven experience balancing service reliability, metrics, sustainability, technical debt, and operational toil for live services running at scale
 - Strong communication skills, as this is a heavily customer-facing role
 - Bachelor's degree in computer science, electrical engineering, or equivalent required

Please note, we cannot sponsor or transfer any visas, of any kind, at this time. 

66degrees is an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to actual or perceived race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, national origin, age, weight, height, marital status, sexual orientation, veteran status, disability status or other legally protected class. 

AI Transparency & Disclosure

As an AI transformation partner, 66degrees leverages intelligent solutions to enhance our recruitment experience. We utilize AI tools-including LinkedIn Recruiter's Hiring Assistant and interview transcription technologies-to assist with sourcing, role analysis, and capturing interview highlights. 

These tools augment our process, but we "Commit to Our Craft" by ensuring all final hiring decisions are made by our human Talent Team. By applying, you acknowledge the use of these technologies to help us "Win Together" in finding the best fit for our team.

data.title: DevOps Lead
data.description:
Vantive is a vital organ therapy company on a mission to extend lives and expand possibilities for patients and care teams everywhere. For 70 years, our team has driven meaningful innovations in kidney care. As we build on our legacy, we are deepening our commitment to elevating the dialysis experience through digital solutions and advanced services, while looking beyond kidney care and investing in transforming vital organ therapies. Greater flexibility and efficiency in therapy administration for care teams, and longer, fuller lives for patients- that is what Vantive aspires to deliver. 

We believe Vantive will not only build our leadership in the kidney care space, it will also offer meaningful work to those who join us. At Vantive, you will become part of a community of people who are focused, courageous and don't settle for the mediocre. Each of us is driven to help improve patients' lives worldwide. Join us in advancing our mission to extend lives and expand possibilities. 

Lead, DevOps

Job Description

Role Summary

We are seeking an experienced DevOps erve as the primary DevOps Capability Representative and subject matter expert for assigned product teams, assessing DevOps maturity, identifying capability gaps, recommending improvement opportunities, and guiding teams through the implementation and adoption of approved standards, practices, and enterprise capabilities. 

Responsibilities

- Own and advance a designated DevOps capability domain, defining its implementation patterns, adoption strategy, technical direction, roadmap, and continuous improvement initiatives. 
 - Serve as the primary DevOps Capability Representative and subject matter expert for assigned product teams, providing technical leadership, standards guidance, architecture direction, and capability adoption support. 
 - Lead DevOps excellence evaluations by establishing maturity baselines, assessing current-state capabilities, defining and tracking key performance indicators, performing gap analyses, measuring progress against target-state objectives, and recommending improvement opportunities. 
 - Lead DevOps capability adoption across product teams by assessing current-state maturity, identifying capability gaps, establishing implementation backlogs, defining roadmaps, and driving adoption of enterprise DevOps standards. 
 - Perform application, platform, and team readiness assessments to identify technical, operational, process, skills, and capability gaps. Conduct gap assessments against enterprise cloud requirements, engineering standards, architecture principles, security requirements, and DevOps standards, and define remediation plans to address identified deficiencies. 
 - Lead the planning and execution of DevOps transformation and implementation initiatives, including roadmap development, backlog establishment, work prioritization, effort estimation, resource planning, budget forecasting, and day-to-day delivery coordination. 
 - Assign, lead, and support DevOps Engineers embedded within product teams to accelerate capability adoption, standards implementation, platform modernization, and delivery improvements. 
 - Ensure all engagements include structured coaching, mentoring, knowledge transfer, documentation, and capability enablement activities that increase team self-sufficiency and reduce long-term dependency on embedded DevOps support. 
 - Establish clear engagement objectives, success criteria, transition plans, and exit criteria that enable operational ownership to be successfully transferred to product teams once capabilities have been adopted. 
 - Provide low-level solution architecture and low-level cloud architecture guidance, ensuring applications, platforms, delivery pipelines, and operational practices remain aligned with enterprise standards, architecture principles, and strategic technology direction. 
 - Design, review, and contribute Infrastructure as Code (IaC), application deployment specifications, automation scripts, and reusable implementations that improve scalability, security, reliability, and operational efficiency. 
 - Lead and promote observability and monitoring practices that improve visibility into application and platform health, reliability, performance, and operational effectiveness. 
 - Integrate security controls and tooling into development pipelines and partner with engineering teams to embed security throughout the software development lifecycle. 
 - Apply and promote DevOps good practices, industry standards, enterprise architecture principles, and approved engineering patterns across product teams and platforms. 
 - Define and promote standard implementation patterns, ensuring teams leverage approved enterprise platforms, shared services, and reusable capabilities whenever practical and appropriate. 
 - Track delivery milestones, capability adoption progress, implementation outcomes, and team objectives, proactively identifying risks and driving corrective actions when required. 
 - Perform code reviews, architecture reviews, standards compliance reviews, and change-control assessments to identify quality, security, reliability, and compliance gaps. 
 - Promote awareness and adoption of enterprise platforms, shared services, engineering capabilities, and reusable solutions available across the organization. 
 - Create opportunities for experimentation, proof-of-concepts, pilot implementations, and innovation initiatives that improve engineering effectiveness, accelerate adoption, and support the evolution of DevOps capabilities. 
 - Stay current with emerging technologies, industry trends, automation practices, cloud capabilities, observability approaches, and AI-driven engineering techniques, recommending solutions that improve the repeatability, reliability, security, and efficiency of software delivery. 
 - Demonstrate initiative, maintain a continuous learning mindset, and support the ongoing evolution of the assigned DevOps capability domain. 

Requirements

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. 
 - 6+ years of experience in IT operations, DevOps, platform engineering, or a related discipline. 
 - Deep expertise in at least one designated DevOps capability domain, such as CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, cloud architecture, observability and monitoring, deployment automation, platform engineering, or DevSecOps. 
 - Strong technical background in DevOps practices, including cybersecurity and secure software delivery. 
 - Experience with low-level solution architecture, Infrastructure as Code, low-level cloud architecture, and observability and monitoring. 
 - Expert knowledge of continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD). 
 - Demonstrated understanding of the Software Development Lifecycle. 
 - Experience with Agile development and Scrum methodologies. 
 - Strong knowledge of DevOps good practices and relevant industry standards. 
 - Excellent project-management, problem-solving, and analytical skills. 
 - Strong communication, presentation, interpersonal, and stakeholder-management skills, including written and verbal communication. 
 - Strong English-language skills and comfort communicating in English with technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Demonstrated ability to coach, mentor, and teach technical concepts to engineers and product teams. 
 - Ability to work independently, take initiative, and drive projects and capability outcomes to completion. 
 - Capability-ownership mindset with accountability for technical quality, adoption, standards, and continuous improvement. 
 - Demonstrated ability to balance hands-on technical leadership with team and people leadership. 
 - Experience assessing candidates for technical positions. 
 - Demonstrated ability to quickly develop a working understanding of new technologies. 
 - Fast learner with a strong willingness to acquire and apply new skills. 
 - Demonstrated ability to accept feedback and take action. 

Preferred Qualification

- AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Associate, or a comparable cloud certification, is a plus

Reasonable Accommodation

Vantive is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities globally. data.description:
As a Technical Manager, you will lead and grow a high-performing engineering team responsible for Staples Print's full-stack applications, automation quality engineering, and platform reliability. You will own the end-to-end delivery of complex initiatives spanning . NET/C#, React, QA automation, and Java services, setting architectural direction, establishing engineering standards, and ensuring your team ships with quality and velocity. This is a people-first, delivery-focused leadership role: you will hire, mentor, and develop engineers at all levels, translate business goals into executable technical roadmaps, remove blockers relentlessly, and hold yourself and your team accountable to outcomes, not just activity. You bring an architectural mindset, an unwavering "will be done" attitude, and the ability to balance short-term delivery demands with long-term platform health. You will partner closely with Product Management, Architecture, and senior stakeholders across Staples Digital Solutions to shape the technical strategy for the Staples Print GCC team in Chennai. 

Duties & Responsibilities

· Design, architect, and develop scalable full-stack applications using . NET / ASP. NET Core (C#) on the backend and React / TypeScript on the frontend. 

· Define and enforce system architecture patterns for distributed, microservices-based, and event-driven systems emphasizing resilience, scalability, and maintainability. 

· Develop and optimize RESTful APIs, microservices, and integrations with messaging platforms (Azure Service Bus, Kafka, or Solace). 

· Integrate AI-backed APIs and LLM services into platform features such as personalization, intelligent search, and AI-assisted order workflows by connecting to established AI services and embedding their outputs into application logic. 

· Design secure, scalable integration patterns for consuming AI/ML APIs and services (e. g. , Azure OpenAI, OpenAI API, Azure Cognitive Services) within the application stack. 

· Apply practical prompt engineering techniques, manage context windows effectively, and implement output validation to ensure LLM API responses are safe, relevant, and usable within the application. 

· Collaborate with data and analytics teams to consume ML model outputs via APIs and embed predictions into application logic (e. g. , personalization, recommendations) no ML model building required. 

· Champion responsible AI practices including bias awareness, content moderation, rate limiting, cost controls, and auditability of AI-generated outputs. 

· Use AI-assisted development tools (GitHub Copilot, Azure AI) to accelerate delivery and promote their adoption across the engineering team. 
· Work with data and platform teams to understand how AI services are deployed and monitored, ensuring application-side integrations handle model updates, versioning, and service changes gracefully. 
· Lead design reviews, code reviews, and technical spike initiatives; champion best practices in code quality, security, and performance optimization. · Mentor junior and mid-level engineers through pair programming, design discussions, and constructive code feedback. 
· Collaborate with product managers, UX designers, data teams, and platform engineers to translate business requirements into robust technical solutions. 
· Drive CI/CD practices, automated testing strategies, and release readiness across the team.

· Contribute to technical documentation, architecture decision records (ADRs), and runbooks.

Basic Qualifications · Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent experience. · 11-14 years of total software engineering experience, with at least 4 years directly managing engineers across a full-stack team. · Demonstrated ability to own and deliver large-scale engineering initiatives end-to-end: from architectural design through production deployment and post-release support. · Strong architectural mindset: experience making design decisions for distributed systems, microservices, RESTful APIs, event-driven architectures, and cloud-native platforms on Azure (App Services, AKS, Service Bus, Key Vault, Entra ID). · Deep hands-on background in . NET / ASP. NET Core / C# and a strong working understanding of React and modern JavaScript/TypeScript frontend development. · Solid understanding of QA automation principles: test pyramid, automation frameworks (Selenium, Playwright), and API/integration test strategies. · Proven track record of building and developing engineering teams: hiring, performance management, coaching, and retention. · Proficiency with CI/CD tooling (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions) and modern DevOps practices. · Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills; able to translate technical complexity into business language and influence decisions at senior levels. · Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; data-driven approach to managing team health and delivery metrics (cycle time, defect rates, deployment frequency, MTTR). · Experience with Azure cloud services including App Services, AKS, Service Bus, Key Vault, and Entra ID (Azure AD). · Experience with the full SDLC: requirement analysis, design, testing, deployment, documentation, and post-release support. · Experience with unit, integration, and automation testing frameworks (xUnit, NUnit, Selenium, Playwright). · Experience leading Agile ceremonies: sprint planning, retrospectives, quarterly roadmap planning, and cross-team dependency management. · Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent experience. · Excellent problem-solving skills with a bias for action and a "will be done" delivery mindset. 

Preferred Qualifications · Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. 

· Working knowledge of Java and Spring Boot, sufficient to review designs, assess technical debt, and guide the team on backend service decisions. · Hands-on experience with Generative AI, LLM APIs (Azure OpenAI, OpenAI), agentic AI workflows, RAG pipelines, or AI-assisted developer tooling (GitHub Copilot). · Experience with load and performance testing frameworks: JMeter, StressStimulus, Gatling, or k6. · Experience managing distributed teams across onshore/offshore or GCC model structures. · Familiarity with eCommerce or print-on-demand platform engineering. · Experience with observability and monitoring tooling: Splunk, Application Insights, Dynatrace, or similar. · Exposure to prompt engineering, AI-driven test generation, or integrating AI productivity tools into engineering workflows. · Experience with Agile at scale: SAFe, LeSS, or leading multiple scrum teams within a single program. · Familiarity with Blazor (WASM or Server) for . NET-based frontend development. · Experience with secure application development practices and DevSecOps principles (OWASP, secrets management, vulnerability scanning). · Hands-on experience with Generative AI tools/APIs (e. g. , OpenAI, Copilot, Azure OpenAI)

data.description:
This is where your work makes a difference. 

At Baxter, we believe every person-regardless of who they are or where they are from-deserves a chance to live a healthy life. It was our founding belief in 1931 and continues to be our guiding principle. We are redefining healthcare delivery to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond. 

Our Baxter colleagues are united by our Mission to Save and Sustain Lives. Together, our community is driven by a culture of courage, trust, and collaboration. Every individual is empowered to take ownership and make a meaningful impact. We strive for efficient and effective operations, and we hold each other accountable for delivering exceptional results. 

Here, you will find more than just a job-you will find purpose and pride. 

Job Summary

We are seeking a Development and Test Manager with 12+ years of experience leading software development, verification, and quality engineering for connected healthcare and regulated medical software. The manager will provide technical and people leadership across the complete product lifecycle-from requirements, architecture, design, and implementation through functional, automation, performance, reliability, and release-readiness testing. This role owns delivery of cloud-native applications, REST and GraphQL APIs, user interfaces, microservices, medical-device integrations, and EMR/EHR workflows within agreed quality, schedule, and budget commitments. The role combines engineering leadership, development and test governance, technical direction, stakeholder management, design-control compliance, and audit-ready delivery. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Define and continuously improve the integrated software development and test strategy in alignment with product roadmaps, business priorities, regulatory commitments, architecture direction, and release plans. 
 - Lead software developers, automation engineers, performance engineers, and functional verification engineers; manage capacity, hiring, onboarding, objectives, coaching, technical development, succession planning, and delivery accountability. 
 - Plan and lead engineering assignments involving the evaluation, selection, and adaptation of software designs, technologies, development methods, test approaches, tools, and engineering practices. 
 - Provide technical direction from product conception through requirements, architecture, detailed design, implementation, integration, verification, release, and sustaining activities. 
 - Establish software engineering governance covering estimation, design and code reviews, coding standards, branching and configuration management, unit and component testing, static analysis, code coverage, technical debt, defect management, and quality metrics. 
 - Ensure software architecture and implementation meet requirements for maintainability, security, scalability, performance, reliability, interoperability, observability, and supportability. 
 - Own delivery of cloud-native applications, microservices, REST and GraphQL APIs, web user interfaces, integration services, and data processing capabilities using appropriate C#/. NET and related technologies. 
 - Establish test governance, risk-based planning, entry and exit criteria, requirements traceability, defect management, quality dashboards, and release-readiness assessments. 
 - Own the roadmap and governance for reusable C#-based REST API and UI automation frameworks, including coding standards, test-data management, parallel execution, logging, reporting, and environment configuration. 
 - Ensure unit, component, integration, smoke, regression, performance, scalability, reliability, security, and release-level testing is incorporated into CI/CD pipelines with appropriate automated quality gates. 
 - Guide design, development, integration, and verification of HL7 ADT, FHIR resources, clinical workflows, EMR/EHR interfaces, connected medical devices, real-time communications, notifications, and downstream clinical systems. 
 - Implement configuration and change management throughout the complete product lifecycle, including design, development, verification, release, and sustaining phases. 
 - Partner with product, clinical, systems, architecture, DevOps, cybersecurity, quality, regulatory, service, manufacturing, and external integration teams to resolve dependencies, technical issues, and product risks. 
 - Drive root-cause analysis by correlating application behavior, source code, automated and performance results, logs, API traces, network data, database records, queues, container metrics, and infrastructure telemetry. 
 - Incorporate field issues, customer feedback, post-market learnings, and production trends into product design improvements, corrective actions, regression coverage, reliability testing, and performance validation. 
 - Ensure compliance with the product development process, design controls, Quality System requirements, software lifecycle procedures, cybersecurity expectations, and applicable regulatory standards. 
 - Maintain audit-ready requirements, architecture and design records, code and review evidence, plans, test cases, objective evidence, reports, approvals, and traceability in approved tools such as Jira, Jama, source-control platforms, and validated test-management systems. 
 - Develop project plans, engineering milestones, resource strategies, budgets, and delivery forecasts; identify and mitigate issues that could affect quality, cost, scope, or schedule. 
 - Manage external development partners, contractors, vendors, and third-party service providers, including technical direction, deliverable acceptance, and performance monitoring. 
 - Communicate development progress, quality status, technical risks, mitigation plans, resource needs, architecture decisions, test findings, and go/no-go recommendations to program and leadership forums. 

What You'll Bring

- 12-18 years of software engineering, software development, testing, verification, quality engineering, or performance engineering experience, including at least 5 years leading multidisciplinary technical teams in a regulated or safety-critical environment. 
 - B. E/B. Tech in Computer Science / Electronics & Communication / Electrical or related field 
 - Demonstrated experience managing the complete software development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, architecture, design, implementation, code review, unit testing, integration, verification, release, and sustaining engineering. 
 - Strong hands-on or technical leadership experience with C#/. NET, object-oriented design, design patterns, REST and GraphQL APIs, microservices, web applications, and distributed systems. 
 - Demonstrated ownership of functional and automation test strategy for REST APIs, web user interfaces, integration workflows, and end-to-end regression using Playwright, Selenium, NUnit, xUnit, MSTest, or comparable technologies. 
 - Experience with software architecture and engineering practices such as clean architecture, secure coding, static analysis, code quality, code coverage, configuration management, branching strategies, dependency management, and technical-debt reduction. 
 - Experience validating distributed microservices, event-driven systems, JSON/XML, SQL/PostgreSQL, authentication, authorization, RabbitMQ, Azure Service Bus, MQTT, or comparable technologies. 
 - Working knowledge of Azure, Docker, Kubernetes, autoscaling, service discovery, role-based access control, secrets management, service mesh, resilience, and cloud observability. 
 - Experience with CI/CD architecture, Git, build automation, automated quality gates, pipeline troubleshooting, artifact management, deployment practices, test reporting, and engineering dashboards. 
 - Healthcare domain expertise covering HL7 v2, ADT messages and acknowledgements, FHIR REST resources, EMR/EHR workflows, connected medical devices, data integrity, patient safety, privacy, and clinical risk. 
 - Knowledge of regulated healthcare software practices and standards such as IEC 62304, ISO 13485, ISO 14971, design controls, cybersecurity expectations, and formal verification evidence.

Preferred Skills

 - Experience with Jira, Jama, validated toolchains, Agile/Scrum delivery, and formal release-readiness reviews.

In this fully remote role, you will be responsible for testing Guidewire InsuranceSuite solutions, including PolicyCenter, ClaimCenter, and BillingCenter, across various business processes and application workflows. You will design and execute comprehensive test strategies covering functional, integration, regression, system, and user acceptance testing. Working closely with developers, business analysts, and business stakeholders, you will identify defects, validate fixes, and ensure applications meet business and technical requirements. You will also contribute to API testing, test automation initiatives, and continuous quality improvement throughout the software development lifecycle. This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced QA professional to contribute to reliable insurance technology solutions within a collaborative Agile environment.

- Test Planning and Execution: Develop, maintain, and execute comprehensive test plans, test cases, and test scripts for Guidewire applications. Perform functional, integration, regression, system, and User Acceptance Testing (UAT) to ensure solutions meet business and technical requirements.

Test end-to-end business processes and verify application behaviour against defined requirements. 
 - Requirements Analysis and Test Coverage: Analyze business and technical specifications to identify testing requirements and design effective test scenarios. Ensure adequate test coverage and document execution results to validate application functionality and reliability.

Develop reusable pipeline patterns and shared libraries to standardize software delivery. Integrate automated quality checks and security controls, configure SonarQube quality gates, and troubleshoot pipeline failures to improve deployment consistency and reliability.

 - Drive Agentic Adoption: Build and anchor strong executive-level relationships within your customer portfolio, ensuring flawless Agentforce activation, rollout, and sustained production value. 
 - Accelerate Portfolio Performance: Operationally run your account portfolio with engineering rigor - monitoring health, delivery velocity, and core consumption metrics to accelerate progress toward customer business outcomes.

You're Our Person If. . .

You don't just understand the tech stack - you know how to orchestrate it to unblock enterprise scale and drive immediate production value.

Even Better If. . .

data.title: AI Specialist
data.description:
Miyamoto International is seeking an AI Specialist with minimum 4 years of experience in professional software engineering (Python) to support and expand AI capabilities across our global teams. This role offers flexibility to work remotely, Pan-India, with Miyamoto offices based globally and specifically in US. 

Role Description

Miyamoto International uses Microsoft Copilot company-wide. We are hiring an AI Specialist to help us get a lot more out of it - and to build the things Copilot cannot do on its own. This is a hands-on role that splits between extending Copilot across every department and building more advanced AI tooling in Python where Copilot falls short - custom agents, retrieval over our own documents, API integrations, and internal automations. 

You will partner with departments across the firm - engineering, operations, marketing, finance, project teams - to find where AI can meaningfully advance productivity. You will assist with AI training and enablement so adoption keeps pace with the tools. 

This is not a Copilot-trainer role and not a prompt-engineering role. Coding experience is required. We want someone who is genuinely passionate about AI, follows the field closely, and translates that fluency into working software. 

What You Will Do

- Get more out of Copilot. Help teams use Copilot effectively across Microsoft 365 - Word, Excel, Outlook, Teams, Power Automate. Build Copilot-based automations and extensions where they fit. 
 - Build advanced AI tooling in Python. When Copilot cannot do the job, you build it: custom agents, retrieval systems over Miyamoto documents, API integrations, internal automations. 
 - Partner with departments. Sit with engineering, project, ops, marketing, and finance teams. Identify high-leverage workflows. Design and ship solutions for them. 
 - Assist with AI training and enablement. Run pair sessions, write internal documentation, answer questions, help teams adopt new tools well. 
 - Stay current. Track Copilot updates and the broader AI ecosystem - Claude, GPT, Cursor, open-source models, agent frameworks. Recommend what we adopt next. 
 - Set good habits. Help define responsible AI use across the firm - data handling, vendor selection, internal best practices. 

Minimum Qualifications

- 4+ years professional software engineering with Python as a primary language. 
 - Hands-on production experience building with LLMs - agents, retrieval, integrations, or internal automations. Code samples or a GitHub portfolio expected. 
 - Working knowledge of Microsoft Copilot across Microsoft 365 - and a clear view of where it shines and where you need to build custom. 
 - Familiarity with the broader AI tooling landscape: Claude, GPT, Cursor, LangChain or equivalents, vector databases, agent frameworks. 
 - Active learner. You follow the field - GitHub activity, blog, talks, OSS contributions, or a clear recent point of view. 
 - Strong communicator. Comfortable embedding with non-technical departments, running trainings, writing documentation people read. 
 - Professional English fluency required. 

This is not a Copilot-trainer role and not a prompt-engineering role. Coding experience is required. We are looking someone who is genuinely passionate about AI, follows the field closely, and translates that fluency into working software.

data.title: Quality Engineer
data.description:
At Warner Music Group, We're a Global Collective Of Music Makers And Music Lovers, Tech Innovators And Inspired Entrepreneurs, Game-changing Creatives And Passionate Team Members. Here, We Turn Dreams Into Stardom And Audiences Into Fans. We Are Guided By Three Core Values That Underpin Everything We Do Across All Our Diverse Businesses

- Curiosity: We do our best work when we're immersing ourselves in culture and breaking through barriers. Curiosity is the driving force behind creativity and ingenuity. It fuels innovation, and innovation is the key to our future. 
 - Collaboration: Making music and bringing it to the world is all about the power of originality amplified by teamwork. A great idea, like a great song, travels globally. We ignite passions and build connections across our diverse community of artists, songwriters, partners, and fans. 
 - Commitment: We pursue excellence for our team and our talent. Everything in music starts with a leap into the unknown, and we're committed to keeping the faith, acting with integrity, and delivering on our promises. 

Technology is one of the most important parts of our business. Whether it's signing up new artists; ensuring we provide the right data to Spotify, YouTube, and other digital service providers; or helping artists use the latest AI tools and make thoughtful decisions with data-driven insights - technology plays an invaluable role in our success. The engineering team at Warner Music Group makes all of it a reality. Check out first-hand accounts from the WMG engineering, product, design, infrastructure and data teams in our blog !

WMG is home to a wide range of artists, musicians, and songwriters that fuel our success. That is why we are committed to creating a work environment that actively values, appreciates, and respects everyone. We encourage applications from people with a wide variety of backgrounds and experiences. 

Consider a career at WMG and get the best of both worlds - an innovative global music company that retains the creative spirit of a nimble independent. 

A Little Bit About Our Team

Revelator, part of WMG, builds the technology behind how music gets released, tracked and paid for. Labels, distributors and artists use our platform and APIs to manage their catalogs, deliver releases to streaming services, and see where their music is played and what it earns. Our QA team sits in the middle of all of it. We work closely with developers, product managers and customer-facing teams to make sure what we ship is reliable and ready for real music businesses. We're a small, hands-on team, so your work is visible from day one, and the issues you catch protect the catalogs, releases and royalties our clients depend on. 

Your Role

As a Quaity Engineer, you'll own the testing for features from start to finish: reviewing requirements, planning test cases, and testing across both the UI and the APIs. You'll go beyond the happy path to find the edge cases, permission gaps and "that shouldn't happen" bugs, and you'll write reports that developers can act on right away. You'll also help shape where our QA practice goes next, contributing to test automation and AI-assisted testing as we build them out. If you have a few years of testing behind you and you're ready for more ownership, in a product that sits close to the music industry, we'd love to hear from you. 

Here You'll Get To

- Design, develop, and execute test cases based on product requirements. 
 - Collaborate with developers to clarify features and identify edge cases early. 
 - Perform functional, regression, and exploratory testing. 
 - Log detailed bug reports and verify fixes. 
 - Validate API endpoints using Postman and test backend behavior. 
 - Run SQL queries to validate data and support end-to-end testing. 
 - Contribute to test plans, test case repositories, and QA documentation. 

About You

- 4+ years of hands-on experience in manual QA. 
 - Strong understanding of software QA methodologies, tools, and processes. 
 - Experience working withPostmanto test REST APIs. 
 - Good knowledge of and ability to write queries to validate data. 
 - Proven ability to collaborate with remote teams and developers. 
 - Detail-oriented mindset with strong communication skills. 

We'd Love It If You Also Had

- Exposure to automation frameworks (e. g. , Selenium, Cypress, Playwright). 
 - Experience testing in Agile environments. 
 - Familiarity with tools like JIRA, TestRail, or similar test management platforms. 

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

Our solutions hosted on our Iris Smart Manufacturing platform combine equipment and process domain expertise in Mining & Metals, Oil & Gas, Chemicals & Petrochemicals with the state-of-the-art in data sciences, machine learning, and process optimization. 

The IRIS platform can work in hybrid mode and is built using microservices architecture. 

The applications are containerised and run on Azure Kubernetes service and use Azure blob storage, Data Lake, IoT Hub, Event Hub, Event Grid, and Queues. 

The development team embraces DevOps culture and delivers products using Continuous Delivery principles.

data.title: QA/QC Manager
data.description:
- Role Summary

The Lead of QA/QC is a senior technical and governance authority responsible for establishing, implementing, and overseeing quality assurance and quality control (QA/QC) frameworks across the delivery of data center and missions. 

The role represents the client's quality, compliance, and risk interests, ensuring that all design, procurement, construction, and handover activities meet approved standards, specifications, regulatory requirements, and operational reliability expectations. The QA/QC Head supports projects from early design through construction, commissioning, and handover, with a strong focus on quality governance, compliance monitoring, defect prevention, and continuous improvement in fast‐track environments. 

- Key Responsibilities

QA/QC Leadership & Project Delivery

- Provide end‐to‐end QA/QC leadership across data center projects from design development through construction, commissioning, and handover. 
 - Act as the QA/QC Lead, advising the client on quality strategies, risks, compliance gaps, and corrective actions. 
 - Develop, implement, and maintain the Project Quality Management Plan (PQMP) in alignment with Employer's Requirements (ERs), contractual obligations, and client standards. 
 - Establish quality objectives, inspection regimes, and acceptance criteria aligned with program, phasing, and operational readiness requirements. 
 - Design Quality Review & Technical Governance
 - Oversee quality assurance of design deliverables across all disciplines, including: 
 - CSA, MEP, ELV, IT, and specialist systems
 - Specifications, drawings, calculations, and schedules
 - Ensure design deliverables comply with: 
 - Local codes, regulations, and authority requirements
 - International standards (e. g. , ISO, NFPA, ASHRAE, IEC)
 - Client data center design standards and quality benchmarks
 - Verify incorporation of constructability, maintainability, and commissioning requirements into design documentation. 
 - Participate in design reviews, technical workshops, value engineering, and constructability sessions with a quality focus. 
 - Construction Quality Oversight, Audits & Compliance
 - Provide QA/QC oversight during construction to ensure works comply with approved designs, specifications, and quality plans. 
 - Review and approve contractor Quality Plans, Inspection and Test Plans (ITPs), method statements, and material submittals. 
 - Conduct regular site inspections, quality audits, and compliance reviews. 
 - Monitor and track non‐conformances (NCRs), observations, and corrective/preventive actions. 
 - Ensure workmanship quality, testing compliance, and traceability of materials and installations. 
 - Oversee defect management, punch lists, and quality close‐out processes. 
 - Interface Management & Coordination
 - Coordinate closely with: 
 - CSA, MEP, ELV, IT, and commissioning teams to ensure consistent quality standards
 - Contractors, subcontractors, and vendors to enforce quality requirements
 - Commissioning teams to ensure quality readiness prior to testing and IST
 - Ensure quality requirements are embedded in procurement, construction, and commissioning workflows. 
 - Support cross‐discipline coordination to prevent quality gaps and interface failures. 
 - Risk Management, Continuous Improvement & Change Control
 - Identify quality‐related risks impacting safety, performance, durability, and operational reliability. 
 - Implement preventive quality measures to reduce rework, delays, and defects. 
 - Support phased delivery, fast‐track, and live environment projects while maintaining quality standards. 
 - Provide QA/QC input to change management, variations, and claims. 
 - Support schedule and cost impact assessments related to quality issues and corrective actions. 
 - Promote continuous improvement through lessons learned and quality trend analysis. 
 - Data Center-Specific QA/QC Expertise
 - Quality oversight of mission‐critical systems including: 
 - Structural and architectural works
 - Electrical power and grounding systems
 - Mechanical cooling and containment systems
 - ELV, controls, BMS, EPMS, and DCIM systems
 - Ensure quality alignment with redundancy, resilience, and Tier‐level requirements. 
 - Monitor quality readiness for commissioning, IST, and operational handover. 
 - Ensure quality documentation supports long‐term operations and maintenance. 
 - Client & Stakeholder Management
 - Act as the primary QA/QC representative to the client. 
 - Support senior leadership in managing client expectations related to quality and compliance. 
 - Present quality status, risks, trends, and corrective actions to stakeholders. 
 - Coordinate with authorities, designers, contractors, and vendors on quality matters. 
 - Maintain complete and auditable quality records and reports. 
 - Qualifications & Experience

Education

- Bachelor's degree in engineering, Construction Management, or a related technical discipline. 

Professional Certifications (Preferred)

- ISO 9001 Lead Auditor or equivalent. 
 - Chartered Engineer / Professional Engineer (CEng, PE, or equivalent). 
 - Data center or mission‐critical certifications (e. g. , Uptime Institute ATD, CDCP) are advantageous. 

Experience

- 15-20 years of experience in QA/QC, construction quality management, or technical governance roles. 
 - Proven experience delivering data center or mission‐critical infrastructure projects. 
 - Technical Skills & Tools
 - Advanced understanding of QA/QC systems, inspection regimes, and audit methodologies. 
 - Strong knowledge of construction standards, codes, and authority requirements. 
 - Familiarity with quality management systems, NCR tracking, and reporting tools. 
 - BIM and digital tools for quality inspections and issue tracking. 
 - Strong technical reporting, documentation, and governance capabilities. 
 - Core Competencies
 - Strong leadership and independent professional judgment. 
 - High attention to detail with a systematic, risk‐based approach. 
 - Effective communication and stakeholder engagement skills. 
 - Ability to enforce standards while maintaining collaborative relationships. 

Proactive mindset focused on prevention rather than correction.

data.title: Principal Systems Software Engineer
data.description:
Job Description

Firmware connects hardware capability to cloud reliability. At OCI, you will work where those layers meet-investigating challenging failures, developing lasting fixes, and improving how firmware is tested, deployed, and operated across our infrastructure. 

As a Principal Systems Firmware Engineer, you will design, develop, and improve BMC firmware or BIOS/UEFI and the tools that support its deployment across OCI's server and GPU infrastructure. You will own complex engineering problems across firmware, hardware, and operating systems, delivering changes that improve platform reliability, diagnosability, security, and recovery. 

Your initial focus will be engineering improvements for platforms already operating in our fleet. You will use production findings to identify design weaknesses, develop and validate firmware fixes, extend automated testing, and eliminate recurring failure modes. Success means delivering durable improvements that reduce failures and the need for manual intervention. 

You will also participate in an India daytime on-call rotation, complementing US engineering teams. This responsibility connects your engineering work directly to how platforms behave in production and includes incident investigation, mitigation, and coordinated handoffs. 

As the team grows, its scope is expected to expand into new server and GPU platform development, with opportunities to work alongside silicon suppliers and ODM/JDM partners on firmware integration, platform bring-up, and validation. 

This role offers the opportunity to help shape a new team's engineering practices while remaining deeply involved in design, code, and complex technical investigations. 

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

Own firmware development and integration. Design, develop, debug, and maintain BMC or BIOS/UEFI components and supporting systems software. Define clear interfaces across firmware, hardware, operating systems, and fleet management services. 

- Resolve complex fleet issues. Lead investigations into boot failures, management controller faults, firmware update problems, hardware initialization failures, and other platform reliability issues. Develop mitigations, establish root cause, and deliver durable fixes. 
 - Provide operational support. Participate in the India daytime on-call rotation, coordinate investigations and handoffs with US teams, and communicate impact, progress, and resolution clearly. 
 - Build automation and preventive controls. Develop tools for firmware provisioning, updates, diagnostics, recovery, and validation. Improve telemetry, logging, and failure analysis to reduce recurring incidents and manual intervention. 
 - Drive software quality and security. Write maintainable code, lead design and code reviews, and develop functional, regression, negative, and recovery tests. Apply secure development practices and support firmware vulnerability remediation. 
 - Contribute to platform bring-up. Diagnose interactions across firmware, hardware, bootloaders, and operating systems. Use platform logs and appropriate hardware debugging tools to isolate faults and validate end-to-end behavior. 
 - Collaborate with engineering and vendor partners. Work with hardware, silicon, operating system, validation, and fleet operations teams. As product development scope grows, work with ODM/JDM partners on requirements, defect resolution, firmware releases, and platform readiness. 
 - Provide technical leadership. Own delivery of complex engineering work, identify dependencies and risks, document designs and debugging methods, mentor engineers, and contribute to hiring and continuous improvement. 

Required Qualifications

- Meet one of the following education and software development experience combinations: 
 - 11 years of software development experience; or 
 - A bachelor's degree/B. Tech in a relevant engineering, computing, information technology, mathematics, physics, or related field, with 7 years of software development experience; or 
 - A master's degree/M. Tech in one of these fields, with 5 years of software development experience; or 
 - A doctorate in one of these fields, with 3 years of software development experience. 
 - At least 6 years of experience using programming and scripting languages, with strong C/C++ skills and the ability to build diagnostic and automation tools. 
 - Substantial hands-on development and debugging experience in BMC firmware or BIOS/UEFI, with the ability to investigate interactions across the broader server platform. 
 - Strong understanding of server architecture, embedded systems, hardware/software interfaces, and Linux fundamentals. 
 - Demonstrated ability to diagnose complex issues across firmware, hardware, and operating systems, using evidence to distinguish symptoms from root causes. 
 - Experience owning software components through design, implementation, code review, testing, release, and ongoing support. 
 - Experience developing automated tests, diagnostics, or operational tooling and improving reliability, observability, or performance. 
 - Ability to lead technical investigations, mentor colleagues, and communicate effectively across engineering teams and external partners. 
 - Willingness to participate in the India daytime on-call rotation. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with OpenBMC or other server BMC stacks, or with server BIOS/UEFI implementations such as EDK II or commercial firmware platforms. 
 - Familiarity with relevant platform interfaces and protocols, such as Redfish, IPMI, PLDM/MCTP, SMBus/I2C, SPI, PCIe, or ACPI. 
 - Experience with server or GPU platform bring-up, hardware initialization, power and thermal management, or reliability, availability, and serviceability (RAS) features. 
 - Experience using JTAG, logic analyzers, protocol analyzers, or emulators, and interpreting schematics and board documentation. 
 - Experience with secure boot, firmware signing, update and recovery mechanisms, or firmware security remediation. 
 - Experience supporting production infrastructure at cloud or hyperscale environments, including controlled firmware rollouts and incident response. 
 - Experience collaborating with silicon suppliers, BIOS/BMC vendors, or ODM/JDM engineering teams.

data.title: Manager/Senior Manager, Engineering - Observability and Monitoring
data.description:
We are looking for a senior Manager, Engineering for our Observability and Monitoring teams. Someone who can take ownership of two high-visibility teams building the operational backbone of SimCorp One, and who is ready to help define how we see, detect, and resolve issues across the company before clients feel them. 

What Makes Us, Us

Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!

At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values - Caring, Customer success-driven, Collaborative, Curious, and Courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered. 

If you like what we're saying, keep reading!

WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US

The AI & Insights area is building the foundation for reliable, intelligent operations of SimCorp's offerings. When something breaks in our systems, we need to know immediately, and our teams need to quickly be able to understand the root cause. Ideally, we see the signals in advance, initiate self-healing, and avoid interruptions for our clients. Observability and Monitoring are how we enable that. 

The Observability team owns the data foundation: a standard, Open Telemetry-based way for every SimCorp system to emit logs, traces, and metrics, collected on a central Operational Data Platform that SREs, monitoring, and AI agents can all use. The Monitoring team owns what we do with that data: one governed monitoring standard with a single alert funnel, a standard alert payload, and one Grafana instance for dashboards and alert rules. Together, the two teams are the data and signal layer for AIOps: AI-assisted root-cause analysis, proactive resolution, and self-healing workflows. 

You will partner closely with the Product Managers for Observability and Monitoring and with the architect to turn the roadmap into delivery, and you will report directly to the Senior Director of Engineering. You will also be part of the AI & Insights leadership team, contributing to the broader deliveries and growth of the area. 

What Will You Be Responsible For

Team leadership and development

- Lead and grow the Observability and Monitoring teams, distributed across multiple locations, creating clear priorities and a supportive, engaged culture 
 - Develop individual engineers through regular 1: 1s, coaching, and honest feedbac 
 - Build one coherent engineering group across two domains, with the right composition, skills, and no single-person dependencies 
 - Hire and onboard new engineers into fast-moving workstreams as scope grows

Delivery and operations

- Own delivery of the Observability and Monitoring roadmaps 
 - Hold a high bar on quality, security, and operational readiness 
 - Manage day-to-day prioritisation, capacity, and engineering health across both teams, keeping delivery and engagement strong 
 - Remove blockers before they slow the team down, including the ones involving other teams

Stakeholder and cross-team collaboration

- Partner with the Product Managers to translate product strategy into an executable delivery plan 
 - Work with the architect on technology direction, from the OpenTelemetry data plane to the alerting and visualisation stack 
 - Collaborate with SREs, Operations, SaaS reliability, and the product development teams who instrument their code and consume the data, and translate technical work into clear updates for non-technical stakeholders 
 - Align with the Senior Director of Engineering on priorities and risks

Strategy and growth

- Help shape SimCorp's observability, monitoring, and AIOps strategy as scope expands from collecting data to automated root-cause analysis and self-healing 
 - Anticipate where the teams need to grow in skills, headcount, and tooling, and advocate for it 
 - Bring an informed point of view on measuring what matters, such as monitoring maturity, SLOs, and incident detection and resolution times, rather than coverage alone 
 - Make AI agents part of how the teams work and how SimCorp operates, with people orchestrating, reviewing, and holding the bar. 

What We Value

Ownership and independence You take responsibility without being told to, dig in when things are unclear, and are comfortable deciding with incomplete information and following through. 

Management experience You have led engineering teams before, ideally in a platform context, with a genuine track record of accountability for team outcomes and engagement. 

Technical grounding in observability and monitoring engineering You have a background in software or platform engineering and engage comfortably with telemetry (logs, traces, and metrics), instrumentation standards such as Open Telemetry, alerting, SLOs, and incident response. You are curious about how AI can speed up root-cause analysis and operations. You will not write production code, but you understand what your engineers build, ask the right questions, and spot when something is off. 

Communication clarity You write and speak in plain, precise English, can explain a complex platform decision to a non-technical stakeholder, and represent your team with confidence in senior forums. 

Benefits

- Global hybrid work policy - We ask you to work 2 days a week from the office. If you choose you can work remotely the other days. Of course, you are welcome at the office if that is your preference. 
 - Culture - Inclusive and diverse company culture. 
 - Work-life balance - We believe that an equilibrium between professional responsibilities makes us all the best version of ourselves, both in private life and as colleagues in the workplace. 
 - Empowerment - We believe that all voices are valuable and must be heard. You will be involved in shaping our work processes. 
 - Career & Growth - Simcorp does offer opportunities for professional development: there is never just only one route - we offer an individual approach to professional development to support the direction you want to take. 

NEXT STEPS

Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible, we process incoming applications continually. Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed. At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photos, age, or any non-professional information from your application. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process. 

If you are interested in being a part of SimCorp but are not sure this role is suitable, submit your CV anyway. SimCorp is on an exciting growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to assist you discover the right role for you. The approximate time to consider your CV is three weeks. 

We are eager to continually improve our talent acquisition process and make everyone's experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process we will ask you to provide your feedback, which is highly appreciated. 

WHO WE ARE?

For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world's leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 3, 000+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, education, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds. 

SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the recent merger with Axioma, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry-leading, full, front-to-back offering for our clients. 

SimCorp is an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, without regard to race, gender, age, disability, or any other protected status under applicable law. We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated into our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide best-in-class solutions to our clients.

Description

Have you ever wondered how Amazon delivers millions of customer orders with exceptional speed and reliability? Behind every fast and on-time delivery is a complex network of software, infrastructure, robotics, and operational processes engineered to work seamlessly at scale. 

Amazon Fulfillment Technologies (AFT) builds the software and infrastructure that power Amazon's world-class fulfillment centers. Our systems integrate with warehouse automation, machines, and human associates to orchestrate critical fulfillment processes across a global network. These technologies enable the movement of millions of inventory units and support billions of transactions, ensuring that customers receive the products they want, when they expect them. 

About The Mansort Team

The Mansort team owns the manual sortation layer of Amazon's fulfillment network. Our systems determine where packages should be routed after packing and before reaching the outbound dock, enabling accurate and efficient movement of shipments through fulfillment centers. 

We build and operate software responsible for sort plan generation, chute and destination assignment, and scan-and-sort workflows used by warehouse associates. Our systems operate on the fulfillment center floor across hundreds of buildings worldwide, where reliability, performance, and correctness directly influence operational efficiency and customer delivery promises. 

Mansort operates in a technically demanding environment characterized by high transaction volumes, stringent low-latency requirements, and the need for continuous availability despite connectivity disruptions or upstream dependency failures. Correctness is equally critical: every sortation decision must accurately direct a package to its intended destination to prevent operational errors and missed transportation cutoffs. 

Manual sortation complements Amazon's automated sortation capabilities by providing the flexibility and scalability needed to handle peak demand, support new geographies and fulfillment center formats, and accommodate diverse operational requirements that cannot always be addressed through fixed automation. 

As Amazon continues to expand its global fulfillment network and introduce new supply chain capabilities, delivery models, and customer experiences, the Mansort team has an opportunity to solve challenging engineering problems, modernize existing systems, and build scalable, resilient solutions that support the future of fulfillment operations. 

Key job responsibilities

Design and develop scalable systems by owning the architecture, design, implementation, testing, and deployment of distributed software systems operating in live fulfillment center environments. 

Build high-throughput, low-latency services that meet stringent performance, scalability, and availability requirements. 

Ensure operational reliability and correctness through robust sortation workflows, data integrity, routing accuracy, fault tolerance, and graceful degradation. 

Solve complex business and technical problems using pragmatic engineering decisions, innovative solutions, and modern technologies. 

Drive operational excellence by improving observability, monitoring, troubleshooting, and recovery mechanisms to minimize disruptions. 

Collaborate with product managers, operations teams, process engineers, and partner engineering teams to improve fulfillment efficiency and customer experience. 

Influence technical direction by contributing to architecture, engineering standards, and technical strategy within the team and broader organization. 

Maintain high engineering standards by writing clean, maintainable, well-tested code and ensuring software quality, performance, security, and reliability. 

Mentor engineers through knowledge sharing, design discussions, code reviews, and technical guidance to strengthen team capabilities.

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
 - 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
 - Experience programming with at least one software programming language
