data.title: Sr Lead - Software Quality Engineering/Bangalore
data.description:
About Northern Trust

As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world's most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions. 

Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide. 

With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24, 000 partners, we serve the world's most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service. 

Northern Trust is looking for a Senior Lead to join its Technology Development Centre in Pune/Bangalore, India. 

Job Overview

The Automation QA Lead holds distinct accountability for quality delivery across Trade, Securities, Accounting , Corporate Actions application changes and initiatives. 

The role is responsible for defining test architecture, embedding quality into delivery execution, and ensuring stable, compliant, and audit‐ready releases. 

The role partners closely with Product, Business, Development, Operations, and vendor teams and serves as a functional quality escalation point. 

Application Domain: Asset Servicing, Reconciliation , Asset Pricing, Trade life cycle, Corporate actions

Required Technical Skills

- Deep expertise in designing automation frameworks for Web, API, MQ, DB and mainframe systems
 - Strong programming ability in Typescripts/ JavaScript Java, Python or similar languages with CI CD integration
 - Experience with containers, observability, test data, environment lifecycle, performance and reliability testing
 - Strong exposure to latest AI tools / technologies with exposure to agentic workflows

Roles & Responsibilities

- Accountable for functional test delivery across Securities platforms including Post‐Trade, Settlements, Custody, Reconciliation, and Payments. 
 - Responsible for defining Test architecture, including scope, approach, entry/exit criteria, regression strategy, and quality gates. 
 - Lead planning, execution, monitoring, and closure of functional and integration testing activities. 
 - Analyze business requirements, workflows, and dependencies to identify functional risks and coverage gaps. 
 - Accountable for functional defect triage, severity assessment, business impact articulation, and driving defects to resolution. 
 - Provide functional quality sign‐off for releases, including clearly documented risks, constraints, and mitigation plans. 
 - Oversee end‐to‐end business flow validation across upstream and downstream systems. 
 - Act as an escalation point for functional quality risks, delivery issues, and readiness concerns. 
 - Drive consistent status reporting, RAID management, readiness reviews, and stakeholder communications. 
 - Mentor and guide QA team members, ensuring adherence to functional testing standards, practices, and delivery discipline. 
 - Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives focused on test effectiveness, consistency, and functional coverage maturity. 

Required Knowledge

- Strong understanding of Asset Servicing domains, particularly Post‐Trade processing like settlements. 
 - In‐depth knowledge of functional testing, integration testing, regression strategy, and release readiness practices. 
 - Familiarity with complex enterprise platforms supporting Capital Markets processing (BaNCS or similar). 
 - Understanding of interface concepts including APIs, file‐based integrations, and messaging (SWIFT preferred). 
 - Knowledge of QA governance, audit readiness, and risk‐based testing methodologies. 

Required Skills

- Proven experience owning functional QA delivery for complex, multi‐system platforms. 
 - Strong analytical and problem‐solving skills to assess functional impacts and testing risks. 
 - Excellent defect management, stakeholder communication, and influence skills. 
 - Ability to manage multiple priorities, risks, and delivery timelines concurrently. 
 - Exposure to hybrid QA models and automation impact analysis (hands‐on automation not mandatory). 

Qualifications & Skills

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience. 
 - 13+ years of experience in QA / Testing, preferably within Asset Servicing. 
 - Demonstrated leadership through ownership, accountability, and decision‐making (Lead IC role). 
 - Ability to communicate effectively with senior stakeholders, product owners, and delivery teams. 
 - Proactive, detail‐oriented, and quality‐driven mindset with strong execution focus. 

Shift: EMEA: 12: 30PM to 9: 30PM IST

Working with Us

As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve. 

Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust's history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities. 

Reasonable Accommodation

Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs. com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with. 

About Our Bangalore Office

The Northern Trust Bangalore office, established in 2005, is home to over 5, 600 employees. In this stunning office space, we offer fantastic amenities which include our Arrival Hub - Jungle, the GameZone, and the Employee Experience Zone that appeal to both clients and employees. Learn more.

Job Description

About Datahash

Datahash is a privacy-centric first-party data platform. Our core product, Datahash Signals, gives marketers low-code, no-code integrations between web, app, e-commerce, CRM, marketing automation and data warehouses on one side and the major ad channels on the other: Meta, Google, TikTok, Snap, Amazon and more. We are one of a handful of badged integration partners across these channels and work with them directly on first-party data adoption programmes, where advertisers are moving to server-side integrations, conversions APIs and privacy-safe measurement. We are bootstrapped, profitable, and run across Dubai, Bangalore, Mumbai and London with clients in EMEA, India, Africa, APAC and the US. 

The role

We are looking for an experienced, hands-on engineer who can take a product from an initial idea to a reliable production system, owning technical discovery, architecture, implementation, deployment, and continuous improvement. 

Think of this as operating with the independence and breadth of a small product engineering team. You should be comfortable turning ambiguous requirements into working software, making pragmatic architectural decisions, and moving across the stack to deliver complete product capabilities. 

This is a senior individual contributor role with substantial technical ownership. You will write code, solve difficult engineering problems, and remain accountable for what you ship. Strong use of AI coding tools and agents is central to the role, backed by the engineering judgment to validate their output. 

What You Will Own

- End-to-end product development. Translate business problems into technical plans, working prototypes, production features, and subsequent improvements. 
 - Architecture and technical decisions. Design systems that balance speed, simplicity, security, reliability, scalability, and cost. 
 - Full-stack implementation. Build user interfaces, backend services, APIs, integrations, data models, and background processing workflows. 
 - Production delivery. Own testing, CI/CD, cloud deployment, observability, troubleshooting, and performance optimization. 
 - Technology evaluation. Quickly learn unfamiliar technologies, test assumptions through focused experiments, and choose tools based on the problem. 
 - AI-assisted engineering. Use coding assistants, agents, and automation to accelerate research, implementation, testing, debugging, and documentation. 
 - Quality and maintainability. Review and validate all code, including AI-generated code, and establish appropriate tests, documentation, and operational safeguards. 
 - Product collaboration. Work directly with product and business stakeholders to clarify requirements, challenge assumptions, define scope, and deliver useful increments. 
 - Technical influence. Raise engineering standards through design discussions, code reviews, reusable components, and knowledge sharing. 

What Success Looks Like

You can take a loosely defined product need, propose a sensible approach, and deliver a complete, usable solution with minimal coordination overhead. You use AI effectively to shorten delivery cycles, make sound technical decisions, and leave behind software that is secure, observable, maintainable, and ready to evolve. 

How We Hire

We move fast and we are transparent about how we decide. Every decision about a person is made by a person. 

Step 1: a short structured screen within two working days of applying. Step 2: a 50-minute conversation with the hiring manager. Step 3: a small exercise close to the real work, which you present to two or three of us. Step 4: fit and terms, including the founder for this role. We aim to give you a decision within five working days of the final conversation. 

We evaluate evidence rather than claims, the quality of your questions, how you handle ambiguity, and how naturally you already use AI in your own work. 

What To Share When Applying

Share one or two products or substantial features you personally took from concept to production. Explain what you owned, the key architectural trade-offs, how you used AI or automation, and the outcomes achieved. Links to working products, code samples, or architecture walkthroughs are welcome. 

Requirements

What we are looking for

- A strong track record of independently building and shipping production software with ownership across multiple stages of the product lifecycle. 
 - Deep expertise in at least one backend ecosystem and strong working capability across modern frontend development, databases, APIs, and cloud infrastructure. 
 - Broad understanding of tools, frameworks, and architectural approaches, with the ability to explain their trade-offs and select the simplest effective solution. 
 - Demonstrated ability to become productive quickly in unfamiliar codebases and technologies. 
 - Sound understanding of system design, data modeling, asynchronous processing, caching, queues, authentication, authorization, and application security. 
 - Hands-on experience with automated testing, CI/CD, containers, monitoring, and production incident diagnosis. 
 - Practical experience using AI development tools for meaningful engineering work, including breaking work into tasks, providing context, reviewing changes, and verifying results. 
 - Strong debugging skills and the ability to reason across application code, infrastructure, data, and third-party integrations. 
 - Product judgment: the ability to identify what matters, reduce unnecessary scope, and make sensible build-versus-buy decisions. 
 - Clear communication, strong ownership, and the ability to make progress with limited supervision. 

How You Approach The Work

- You turn an unclear problem into a concrete plan and start delivering. 
 - You know when a prototype is sufficient and what must change before it reaches production. 
 - You use AI to increase your capacity while retaining a clear understanding of the systems you build. 
 - You can distinguish a useful abstraction from unnecessary complexity. 
 - You surface risks and trade-offs early and take responsibility for resolving them. 
 - You work independently while seeking feedback and specialist input when it improves the outcome. 

Good to have

- Experience as an early engineering hire, founding engineer, or owner of a product built from scratch. 
 - Experience with SaaS platforms, multi-tenant systems, data pipelines, or integration-heavy products. 
 - Experience building LLM-powered features, agent workflows, or internal automation. 
 - Experience improving cloud costs, application performance, and production reliability. 
 - Exposure to conversions APIs, server-side tracking or ad-platform APIs. 

Benefits

- A startup environment backed by a stable, bootstrapped, profitable business. 
 - Competitive compensation and one of the most employee-friendly ESOP programmes in the industry. 
 - Work from anywhere, on your hours; coworking access when you want a change from home. 
 - Health cover for you and your family. 
 - Real international exposure: clients and partners across the Gulf, Europe, Africa, India, APAC and the US. 
 - A yearly offsite that we take seriously, and a culture that does not. 

Datahash is an equal-opportunity employer. We hire on evidence and fit for the work and do not ask for salary history. Compensation is discussed at the fit-and-terms stage.

data.title: Software Engineer in Test
data.description:
Senior SDET - Automation Framework Architect (Playwright, Selenium, API, CI/CD)

THE ROLE

Own test strategy, quality architecture, and the automated regression infrastructure for Securly Flex - the flex period scheduling and attendance platform that 1, 000+ schools use every school day to place students into intervention, enrichment, and support sessions. 

Flex decides where students are supposed to be. A defect in Autoassign placement, capacity limits, separation rules, roster sync, or attendance recording does not just break a feature - it can put a student in the wrong room, leave a must-attend intervention empty, place students together who are required to be kept apart, or send inaccurate attendance into a district's student information system. The test infrastructure you build is the last line of defense before production. 

This is an engineering leadership role, not a QA role. You will define what "production-ready" means for Flex, build the automation platform that enforces it through CI/CD quality gates, and write production-quality code for that platform yourself. You will also serve as the team's expert on rules-engine correctness and edge-case testing - your understanding of how Flex's rules interact (priorities, capacity limits, restricted sessions, sign-up cutoffs, and check-in controls) directly shapes both the test suite and the implementation team's design decisions. 

Location: Pune, India (Hybrid - 2 days onsite)

Experience: 6-10+ years

Reports to: Director of Quality Engineering

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Own the quality bar. Define what "passing" means for Flex: establish written quality criteria covering scheduling correctness, data integrity, access control, and performance that gate production releases. 
 - Test the rules engine. Design and implement automated test suites covering Autoassign placement logic - student choice, teacher priority, must-attend assignments, rostered and restricted sessions, at-risk designations, seat and room capacity, separation (contact control) rules, conflict detection, and the guarantee that manual registrations are never overwritten - plus the edge cases around them: conflicting rules, boundary conditions, concurrent registrations at capacity limits and sign-up cutoffs, API calls that skip UI validation, and permission boundaries. 
 - Gate every release. Build CI/CD quality gates that prevent regressions from reaching production; own the pipeline configuration and ensure the quality bar is enforced, not advisory. 
 - Set performance baselines. Measure and establish written performance baselines for peak-load moments: sign-up windows opening and closing, Autoassign runs before each flex period, and attendance taking across thousands of concurrent users; define the thresholds that constitute a performance regression. 
 - Cover web, mobile, and integrations. Own end-to-end coverage across web, mobile, and integrations: student, teacher, and admin workflows; the student mobile app; email, in-product, and push notifications; roster imports and attendance exports to the SIS; and the shared rostering and single sign-on Flex runs on with Securly Pass. 
 - Build the framework. Architect and build the Flex automation framework: reusable libraries, test data utilities for roster and attendance files, parallel execution, and reporting that the whole team extends - and contribute fixes to product code where it improves testability. 
 - Mentor and scale. Mentor engineers on test architecture as a first-class discipline, and bring AI-assisted tooling into how the team generates scenarios, triages failures, and scales coverage. 
 - Shape architecture. Partner with your technical lead and the Distinguished Engineer on architecture and testability decisions, and influence testing standards across teams beyond your own squad. 
 - Own incidents. Join the on-call rotation and own the full incident lifecycle for quality regressions: detection, diagnosis, resolution, and retrospective. 

SKILLS & REQUIREMENTS

Must-Have

- Test framework architecture - designing automation frameworks from scratch (page object or screenplay patterns, BDD where it fits, parallel execution, reporting) that other engineers extend. You build the platform, not just the scripts. 
 - Test automation (SDET-level) - Playwright, Cypress, or Selenium for UI plus API-level automation (REST, contract testing). Must automate business-rule behavior - placement decisions, capacity and eligibility rules, state transitions - not just UI interaction tests. 
 - CI/CD quality gates - integrating test suites into pipelines; defining and enforcing regression gates for a multi-tenant product used daily by 1, 000+ schools. At this level you own the definition of the bar, not just the tests that check it. 
 - Rules-engine and data-integrity testing - designing deterministic test data and fixtures for scheduling, allocation, or eligibility logic; building data utilities that validate rosters, registrations, and attendance across CSV/XML imports, exports, and concurrent edits. 
 - Strong programming - JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, or Python at production quality (TypeScript strongly preferred). Your test code is held to the same review standard as product code. 
 - Technical communication - ability to produce written quality criteria, test strategy and edge-case documentation, and performance baseline documents that the implementation team, engineering manager, PM, Support, and leadership can act on. 
 - Education & experience - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related technical field, with 6 to 10+ years of hands-on SDET / test automation experience. Strongly Preferred

- Performance & concurrency testing - k6, JMeter, Gatling, or Locust; modeling burst traffic (thousands of users acting in the same minute) and catching race conditions at capacity limits and sign-up cutoffs. 
 - AI-assisted test engineering - using AI tools to generate test scenarios, triage failures, or scale framework adoption across teams. 
 - Security & access-control testing - role-based permissions (student / teacher / admin), multi-tenant data isolation between districts, and student data privacy expectations. Nice to Have

- Mobile test automation - Appium, Maestro, Detox, or similar for iOS and Android; push notification and device-fragmentation coverage. 
 - Integration testing - SIS data import/export, rostering sync, single sign-on, and notification delivery (email, in-product, push). 
 - K-12 EdTech domain - understanding of bell schedules, flex and advisory periods, MTSS intervention tiers, and how districts manage SIS data helps design realistic test scenarios. WHO YOU ARE

- You test the edge cases, not just the happy path. You test the ways the system should fail and doesn't, and you document those cases so the implementation team designs against them. 
 - You have built automation frameworks from the ground up - not just inherited them - and other engineers have built on what you designed. 
 - You treat test architecture as a first-class engineering discipline. A feature without a regression suite is not finished - and you enforce that standard through CI/CD gates, not just code review comments. 
 - You define what "quality" means on a product that decides where students are supposed to be, and produce written criteria that hold the codebase to that standard across every engineer and every release. 
 - You are hands-on at a senior level - you still write the framework code, and you raise the bar for everyone who writes tests after you. Experience shipping product feature code is a bonus, not a requirement. 
 - Your edge-case documentation and performance baselines are used by the implementation team to make better architecture decisions. Your influence extends past your own work. 
 - You own your area end to end with minimal oversight, and you resolve ambiguity in requirements and design tradeoffs instead of waiting for a fully formed spec. 

ABOUT SECURLY

Tech Giant Scale. EdTech Innovation. Unmatched Student Impact. 

Securly processes over 1. 1 billion requests per day and 54 TB of data daily, protecting more than 20 million students across 20, 000+ schools globally. Since pioneering the first cloud-based web filter for K-12 in 2013, Securly has built one of the most trusted, high-scale platforms for student safety, wellness, and engagement. 

By turning data into meaningful, actionable intelligence, Securly enables schools to identify risk earlier, reduce harmful incidents, and strengthen student support - driving measurable improvements in student safety and wellbeing at scale. 

We are proud to be consistently recognized as a Top Place to Work, named a Top 40 Most Used EdTech platform, and included on the GSV 150 list as one of the most transformational growth companies in digital learning and workforce skills. 

BENEFITS

- Comprehensive Health Insurance (employee, parents, spouse, children)
 - Accidental & Term Life Insurance
 - Learning & Development reimbursement
 - Paid Time Off
 - Public Holidays (10+ per year)
 - Retirement Benefits (EPF & gratuity)
 - Parental Leave (as per statutory norms)

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

Securly is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to inclusion, fairness, and respect. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds, identities, and experiences.

data.description:
Are you ready to make an impact at DTCC?

Do you want to work on innovative projects, collaborate with a dynamic and supportive team, and receive investment in your professional development? At DTCC, we are at the forefront of innovation in the financial markets. We are committed to helping our employees grow and succeed. We believe that you have the skills and drive to make a real impact. We foster a thriving internal community and are committed to creating a workplace that looks like the world that we serve. 

The Information Technology group delivers secure, reliable technology solutions that enable DTCC to be the trusted infrastructure of the global capital markets. The team delivers high-quality information through activities that include development of essential, building infrastructure capabilities to meet client needs and implementing data standards and governance. 

Pay And Benefits

- Competitive compensation, including base pay and annual incentive
 - Comprehensive health and life insurance and well-being benefits, based on location
 - Pension / Retirement benefits
 - Paid Time Off and Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well-being. 
 - DTCC offers a flexible/hybrid model of 3 days onsite and 2 days remote (onsite Tuesdays, Wednesdays and a third day unique to each team or employee). 

The Impact You Will Have In This Role

Assists in the technical design of application components, builds applications, interfaces between applications, and understands data security, retention, and recovery. Can research technologies independently and recommend appropriate solutions. Contributes to technology-specific best practices & standards; contributes to success criteria from design through deployment, including, reliability, cost-effectiveness, performance, data integrity, maintainability, reuse, extensibility, usability and scalability; contributes expertise on significant application components, vendor products, program languages, databases, operating systems, etc. , executes on the plan by building components, testing, configuring, tuning, and deploying solutions. 

Provides technical and domain expertise for the Distributed Common Data Transport Service (dCDTS) platform. Assists with system backend technical implementation for functionality, interconnectivity and coordination with other DTCC business applications, resiliency and reliability and performance. Provides full-lifecycle support (development-to-production) for developed components. Works with QA and Product partners to ensure quality of delivery against specified requirements

Your Primary Responsibilities

- Technology Expertise - is a domain expert on one or more of programming languages, vendor products, DTCC applications, data structures, business lines
 - Platforms - works with Infrastructure partners to stand up development, testing, and production environments
 - Requirements Elaboration - works with the Functional Architect to ensure designs satisfy functional requirements
 - Data Modeling - reviews and extends data models
 - Is aware of frameworks - that promote concepts of isolation, extensibility, and extendibility
 - System Performance - contributes to solutions that satisfy performance requirements; constructs test cases and strategies that account for performance requirements; tunes application performance issues
 - Security - implements solutions and complete test plans working mentoring other team members in standard methodology
 - Standards - is aware of technology standards and understands technical solutions need to be consistent with them
 - Documentation - develops and maintains system documentation
 - Is familiar with different software development methodologies (Waterfall, Agile, Scrum, Kanban)
 - Aligns risk and control processes into day to day responsibilities to monitor and mitigate risk; brings up appropriately. 

Qualifications

- Minimum of 7+ years of related experience
 - Bachelor's degree preferred or equivalent experience

Talents Needed For Success

- 7+ years' experience in full-stack development, including JavaScript; core Java development, Perl/Shell Scripting; automated unit testing for front-end and back-end development
 - 3+ years' experience with Oracle RDBMS, SQL Query development, Stored Procedure development
 - Experience with Eclipse, Git/BitBucket, Maven, Jenkins, HiPAM tools
 - Experience deploying to and configuring Tomcat application servers
 - Experience with Agile development, including Scrum and Kanban, use of JIRA
 - Strong written and verbal communication skills
 - Self-motivated, able to work independently or in a team environment
 - Experience with IBM's Application Connect Enterprise (ACE, formerly IIB) is a plus

Actual salary is determined based on the role, location, individual experience, skills, and other considerations. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

data.title: Sr. Manager, Engineering
data.description:
Join Us as a Sr. Manager, Engineering!

Are you ready to make a significant impact in an innovative environment? At ORBCOMM, we're looking for an experienced and technically strong Sr. Manager, Engineering to lead high-performing software engineering teams responsible for building and operating our cloud-based IoT and asset intelligence solutions. 

If you're passionate about developing engineering talent, building scalable cloud platforms, and translating complex business requirements into reliable technology solutions that create meaningful customer value, we'd love to hear from you. 

Why You'll Love Working Here

As a Sr. Manager, Engineering, you'll lead software engineering teams responsible for the design, development, delivery, and operation of ORBCOMM's cloud-based products and platforms. 

You'll partner closely with Product Management, Program Management, Architecture, Quality Assurance, DevOps, and Customer Success to deliver scalable, secure, and reliable solutions that support ORBCOMM's global customers. 

This role combines technical leadership, people leadership, and delivery execution. You'll help establish engineering standards, guide technical decision-making, develop engineering talent, and ensure teams have the structure, priorities, and resources needed to deliver high-quality products. You'll also collaborate with globally distributed engineering teams, helping create consistent engineering practices and a culture of accountability, innovation, continuous improvement, and customer focus. 

This role is based out of our Hyderabad office. We operate in an onsite work environment. 

What You'll Do

Engineering Leadership & Delivery

- Lead software engineering teams responsible for the development and operation of ORBCOMM's cloud-based IoT, asset intelligence solutions and AI First offerings. 
 - Drive execution of cloud platform initiatives, ensuring timely delivery of high-quality, scalable, and reliable software. 
 - Manage engineering capacity, prioritization, and resource allocation across multiple projects and initiatives. 
 - Partner with Product Management to translate business requirements into technical solutions and executable delivery plans. 
 - Drive Agile development practices, including sprint planning, release management, and continuous delivery. 
 - Monitor engineering productivity, software quality, system reliability, and customer satisfaction to identify opportunities for improvement. 

Technical & Operational Excellence

- Establish and champion engineering best practices across software development, architecture, code quality, testing, security, and operational excellence. 
 - Guide teams in the development and operation of cloud-native applications, microservices, APIs, and distributed systems. 
 - Promote effective CI/CD, DevOps, automation, monitoring, and production support practices. 
 - Drive improvements in application scalability, performance, reliability, and security. 
 - Support customer escalations and critical production issues when required, ensuring appropriate technical resources and stakeholders are engaged. 

People & Organizational Leadership

- Lead, coach, and mentor engineering teams while fostering a culture of accountability, innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement. 
 - Develop engineering talent through ongoing coaching, feedback, career development, and succession planning. 
 - Build and scale high-performing engineering teams capable of supporting evolving product and business priorities. 
 - Create an environment that encourages technical excellence, ownership, problem-solving, and knowledge sharing. 

Cross-Functional & Global Collaboration

- Partner closely with Product Management, Program Management, Architecture, QA, DevOps, Customer Success, and other business stakeholders. 
 - Collaborate effectively with engineering teams across multiple locations and time zones. 
 - Communicate engineering priorities, risks, dependencies, and progress clearly to technical and business stakeholders. 
 - Apply data-driven decision-making to engineering priorities, resource planning, and continuous improvement initiatives. 

Who You Are

You're an experienced engineering leader who combines strong technical knowledge with exceptional people leadership and execution capabilities. You understand how to build high-performing teams while maintaining a strong focus on software quality, operational reliability, and customer outcomes. 

If You Have

- 15+ years of progressive software engineering experience, including 5+ years of engineering management experience. 
 - Demonstrated experience leading globally distributed software engineering teams. 
 - Strong experience building and operating cloud-native applications and enterprise software platforms. 
 - Hands-on knowledge of public cloud platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud. 
 - Hands on experience with microservices architecture and distributed systems. 
 - Knowledge of containerization and orchestration technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes. 
 - Experience with CI/CD pipelines, DevOps practices, and modern software delivery methodologies. 
 - Strong understanding of SaaS platforms, API development, and system integrations. 
 - Experience with cloud security, scalability, performance optimization, monitoring, and system reliability. 
 - Familiarity with databases, messaging systems, and event-driven architectures. 
 - Experience managing cloud-based enterprise software products and platforms. 
 - Experience within IoT, transportation, logistics, telematics, supply chain, industrial automation, connected products, or a related technology environment. 
 - Knowledge of IoT platforms, connected devices, telemetry, and asset tracking solutions is highly desirable. 
 - Strong people leadership, coaching, and talent development capabilities. 
 - Excellent stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration skills. 
 - Strong analytical and data-driven decision-making capabilities. 
 - Excellent communication skills with the ability to effectively communicate with technical teams, business stakeholders, and executive leadership. 
 - A customer-focused mindset with a passion for delivering measurable business outcomes. 
 - Leverage AI-enabled tools and automation to support daily tasks and productivity. 
 - Commitment to continuous learning in digital and AI literacy. 

Then we want to meet you!

The Benefits Of Working Here

A career with ORBCOMM offers a unique opportunity to grow your skills and expand your expertise in a collaborative, innovative environment. Beyond being part of an exceptional team, we provide a competitive, locally relevant benefits package designed to support our employees around the world. Benefits vary by location and include health and wellness coverage, paid time off, retirement or savings programs, flexible work arrangements, insurance coverage, lifestyle perks, and access to employee discounts-helping you thrive both professionally and personally. 

How We Hire

ORBCOMM uses technology-enabled tools, including artificial intelligence (AI), to support parts of the recruitment process. All hiring decisions are made by people, as part of our human-led, tech-enabled culture. 

About Us

At ORBCOMM, we're pioneers in IoT technology that drives innovation and empowers our clients to make data-driven decisions. Our industry-leading solutions enable customers to boost productivity, streamline operations, and increase their bottom line. With over 30 years of experience and the most comprehensive solution portfolio in the industry, we enable the management of millions of assets worldwide across diverse sectors, including transportation, heavy industries, satellite, and maritime. Discover how ORBCOMM is transforming industries and unlocking the potential of data to drive meaningful change at www. orbcomm. com !

Ready to Join Us?

We believe that our people are our greatest asset. Your skills and passion can help us achieve remarkable things! If you're seeking a thrilling career opportunity in a vibrant, growth-oriented environment, ORBCOMM is the perfect fit for you. 

We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace and appreciate all applicants for their interest in joining our team. Only candidates selected for an interview will be contacted. 

At ORBCOMM, we are also dedicated to ensuring accessibility and are pleased to offer accommodations for individuals with disabilities upon request throughout all aspects of the selection process.

data.title: R&D Senior Member of Technical Staff, Product Development
data.description:
AVEVA is creating software trusted by over 90% of leading industrial companies. 

Job Title: R&D Senior Member of Technical Staff, Product Development

Location: Bangalore

Employment Type: [full-time. ]

The job

- Work closely with the Product Owner, stakeholders, and Scrum Team to understand, define, design, and implement software solutions that meet business and customer needs. 
 - Actively participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies, including sprint planning and estimation, backlog refinement, daily Scrum meetings, sprint reviews, and retrospectives. 
 - Collaborate with Customer Support to troubleshoot customer-reported issues, identify root causes, and drive them to timely resolution. 
 - Develop high-quality, maintainable, and scalable code that is fully reviewed, unit tested, documented, and delivered in accordance with agreed quality standards. 
 - Analyze, design, implement, and validate security requirements in alignment with industry-standard cybersecurity practices. 

Contribute to continuous improvement of engineering practices, development processes, and overall product quality. 

Key Responsibilities

- Must Have: 
 - 8+ years of software engineering experience, including 1+ years in a technical leadership role. 
 - Strong hands-on expertise in C#, . NET / ASP. NET Core, and enterprise cloud-based application development. 
 - Good understanding and hands-on experience with modern front-end frameworks, particularly Angular. 
 - Strong knowledge of Microsoft Azure and cloud-native architecture. 
 - Strong software design fundamentals, including OOP, SOLID principles, design patterns, and reusable framework/component design. 
 - Strong knowledge of SQL Server, database design, data access patterns, and application performance considerations. 
 - Strong engineering quality and security mindset, including automated testing, secure coding, authentication/authorization, dependency risk, and vulnerability remediation. 
 - Strong technical leadership skills, including mentoring engineers, conducting design/code reviews, defining engineering standards, and collaborating across Development, DevOps, Security, Product, and R&D teams. 
 - Strong awareness of cybersecurity principles and their importance throughout the software development lifecycle. 
 - Ability to translate business and product requirements into technical designs, executable backlogs, dependencies, estimates, and realistic delivery plans. 
 - Nice to Have: 
 - Good understanding of Azure DevOps, CI/CD practices, Infrastructure-as-Code, and Azure automation using PowerShell / Azure CLI. 
 - Strong operational awareness, including observability, logging, monitoring, troubleshooting, performance diagnostics, and production support. 
 - Experience with technical discovery, prototypes/POCs, architecture documentation, and communicating technical decisions across teams. 
 - Knowledge or practical experience with AI, Generative AI, AI-enabled applications, and AI-assisted software development. 
Essential Requirements

4-5 bullet points taken from the JD. 

Desired Skills And Competencies

3-4 bullet points taken from the JD on technical skills and competencies (soft skills), ideally aligned with AVEVA values of Impact, Aspiration, Curiosity and Trust. 

If you are in ETAP or RIB, please delete the below and this line. 

R&D at AVEVA

Our global team of 2000+ developers work on an incredibly diverse portfolio of over 75 industrial automation and engineering products, which cover everything from data management to 3D design. AI and cloud are at the centre of our strategy, and we have over 150 patents to our name. 

Our track record of innovation is no fluke - it's the result of a structured and deliberate focus on learning, collaboration and inclusivity. If you want to build applications that solve big problems, join us. 

Find out more: aveva. com/en/about/careers/r-and-d-careers/

India Benefits include: 

Gratuity, Medical and accidental insurance, very attractive leave entitlement, emergency leave days, childcare support, maternity, paternity and adoption leaves, education assistance program, home office set up support (for hybrid roles), well-being support

It's possible we're hiring for this position in multiple countries, in which case the above benefits apply to the primary location. Specific benefits vary by country, but our packages are similarly comprehensive. 

Find out more: aveva. com/en/about/careers/benefits/

Hybrid working

We work in a hybrid way at AVEVA. Most roles are based at a local AVEVA office, with an expectation of being on-site 50% of your working hours to support collaboration and connection. Some positions are fully office-based depending on the nature of the work, and certain roles that support specific customers or markets may be remote. The working arrangement for this position will be confirmed during the hiring process. 

Hiring process

Interested? Great! Get started by submitting your cover letter and CV through our application portal. AVEVA is committed to recruiting and retaining people with disabilities. Please let us know in advance if you need reasonable support during your application process. 

Find out more: aveva. com/en/about/careers/hiring-process

About AVEVA

AVEVA is a global leader in industrial software with more than 6, 500 employees in over 40 countries. Our cutting-edge solutions are used by thousands of enterprises to deliver the essentials of life - such as energy, infrastructure, chemicals, and minerals - safely, efficiently, and more sustainably. 

We are committed to embedding sustainability and inclusion into our operations, our culture, and our core business strategy. Learn more about how we are progressing against our ambitious 2030 targets: sustainability-report. aveva. com/

Find out more: aveva. com/en/about/careers/

AVEVA requires all successful applicants to undergo and pass a drug screening and comprehensive background check before they start employment. Background checks will be conducted in accordance with local laws and may, subject to those laws, include proof of educational attainment, employment history verification, proof of work authorization, criminal records, identity verification, credit check. Certain positions dealing with sensitive and/or third-party personal data may involve additional background check criteria. 

AVEVA is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to being an exemplary employer with an inclusive culture, developing a workplace environment where all our employees are treated with dignity and respect. We value diversity and the expertise that people from different backgrounds bring to our business. AVEVA provides reasonable accommodation to applicants with disabilities where appropriate. If you need reasonable accommodation for any part of the application and hiring process, please notify your recruiter. Determinations on requests for reasonable accommodation will be made on a case-by-case basis.

data.title: Sr Systems Engineer
data.description:
Senior Systems Engineer

We are seeking a Senior Systems Engineer to lead the design, scalability, and reliability of our internal healthcare application platform. This role owns Kubernetes platform standards, CI/CD and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) strategy, operational excellence, and cost optimization. The role also mentors engineers and partners with development and leadership teams. 

Key Responsibilities

- Design, own, and evolve the Kubernetes platform architecture for healthcare applications, including cluster strategy, upgrades, and multi-environment standards. 
 - Define and enforce standardized deployment patterns using Helm, Kustomize, and GitOps (e. g. , Argo CD or Flux). 
 - Architect enterprise CI/CD pipelines with built-in security scanning, quality gates, and release governance. 
 - Lead IaC strategy with reusable Terraform modules, configuration management, and policy-as-code. 
 - Establish observability standards, SLOs/SLIs, and alerting. Lead incident response, root cause analysis, and post-incident reviews. 
 - Drive platform security and compliance (HIPAA, audit readiness, secrets management, RBAC, network policies, image hardening). 
 - Own cloud cost governance (FinOps): rightsizing, autoscaling, reserved capacity, and cost reporting, with measurable savings. 
 - Plan and test disaster recovery, backup, and high availability. 
 - Mentor engineers, conduct design and code reviews, and author technical documentation and runbooks. 
 - Partner with development, security, and leadership teams on the platform roadmap and technical decisions. 

Required Skills

- 5+ years in Systems Engineering, DevOps, SRE, or Platform Engineering, including 3+ years running Kubernetes in production. 
 - Expert-level Kubernetes administration (AKS, EKS, or OpenShift), Docker, Kustomize and Helm. 
 - Proven experience designing CI/CD at scale with Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD, or Jenkins. 
 - Advanced Terraform skills (module design, state management) plus Ansible or similar tools. 
 - Strong scripting and automation in PowerShell, Python, or Bash. 
 - Deep Azure experience (networking, identity, security, cost management); multi-cloud is a plus. 
 - Hands-on observability experience with Prometheus, Grafana, Azure Monitor, or ELK. 
 - Track record of leading production incidents and delivering reliability improvements. 

Preferred Skills

- Experience in healthcare or other regulated environments (HIPAA, HITRUST, SOC 2). 
 - GitOps, service mesh (Istio or Linkerd), and policy engines (OPA/Gatekeeper or Kyverno). 
 - FinOps practices and cloud cost tooling (Kubecost, Azure Cost Management). 
 - Relevant certifications: CKA/CKS, Azure Solutions Architect or DevOps Engineer, Terraform Associate. 

What Success Looks Like

- A standardized, self-service Kubernetes platform adopted across application teams. 
 - Defined SLOs met consistently, with reduced incident frequency and faster recovery (MTTR). 
 - Majority of infrastructure and deployments fully automated through IaC and GitOps. 
 - Audit-ready platform security and compliance posture. 
 - Documented, measurable infrastructure cost savings. 
 - Stronger team capability through mentoring, standards, and documentation.

 - User role
 - Pharmacy
 - Medication
 - Configuration
 - Integration
 - Payment status
 - Previous actions
 - Operational exceptionsThe product therefore needs engineers who can understand local implementation details while simultaneously protecting the coherence of the wider platform. 

🧭 Your roleYou will take deep technical ownership of a substantial part of Script Assist while helping establish engineering patterns that scale beyond it. 

You will move comfortably between: 

- Architecture
 - Product behaviour
 - Node. js services
 - React applications
 - Databases
 - Integrations
 - Code review
 - Production incidents
 - Mentoring
 - Technical strategyYou should be able to understand the hardest parts of the codebase without becoming the only person capable of changing them. 

Architecture and system designYou will: 

- Define domain and module boundaries
 - Design backend services and APIs
 - Define data ownership
 - Review database models
 - Design integration patterns
 - Establish appropriate shared abstractions
 - Improve configuration architecture
 - Challenge unnecessary coupling
 - Reduce fragile customer-specific behaviour
 - Lead important technical migrations
 - Help simplify accumulated complexityYou should understand when to introduce: 

- Configuration
 - Shared services
 - Events
 - Queues
 - Transactions
 - APIs
 - Feature flags
 - Migration layersand equally importantly, when not to introduce them. 

Hands-on engineeringYou will remain capable of personally implementing difficult production changes. 

That includes: 

- Node. js / TypeScript backend development
 - React / TypeScript frontend development
 - API design
 - Database work
 - Integration development
 - Debugging
 - Performance investigation
 - Refactoring
 - Testing
 - Production incident investigationYou should still enjoy working directly with code. 

Multi-tenant SaaS complexityThe strongest candidates will have experience with products where many customers share the same platform while behaving differently. 

Relevant problems include: 

Tenant architecture
 - Tenant isolation
 - Tenant-aware data models
 - Customer-specific configuration
 - Organisations and sub-organisations
 - Entitlements
 - Feature flagsWorkflow complexity
 - Workflow engines
 - State machines
 - Rules engines
 - Configurable business logic
 - Approval flows
 - Long-running workflows
 - Versioned workflows
 - Exception handlingPermissions
 - RBAC
 - User roles
 - Organisation-level access
 - Fine-grained permissions
 - AuditabilityIntegrations
 - REST APIs
 - GraphQL
 - Webhooks
 - Public APIs
 - External systems
 - Background jobs
 - Asynchronous processing
 - Event-driven architectureDistributed-system behaviour
 - Idempotency
 - Retries
 - Partial failures
 - Transactions
 - Outbox patterns
 - Queues
 - Dead-letter handling
 - Concurrency
 - Reconciliation
 - Correlation IDsProduct evolution
 - Schema changes
 - Data migrations
 - Backward compatibility
 - Safe rollouts
 - Feature flags
 - Progressive migrations
 - Production monitoring
 - Incident recoveryYou do not need to have implemented every specific pattern. 

We care about whether you have actually solved these kinds of problems. 

Technical leadershipA Staff Engineer at Script Assist should improve the work of other engineers. 

You will: 

- Lead important design reviews
 - Review difficult code
 - Challenge poor technical decisions
 - Establish engineering patterns
 - Mentor Senior and mid-level engineers
 - Help engineers decompose complex problems
 - Document major technical decisions
 - Improve testing strategy
 - Improve observability
 - Help identify technical debt worth solving
 - Resolve architectural disagreements
 - Work with Product on technical trade-offs
 - Raise the quality of engineering across your areaWe do not want someone who responds to every difficult problem by saying: 

"I'll just build it myself. "You should be capable of solving the hardest problems while making the people around you increasingly capable of solving them too. 

Production ownershipYou will take responsibility beyond merge and deployment. 

You should care about: 

- What happened in production
 - Whether customers are seeing unexpected behaviour
 - Performance
 - Errors
 - Failed integrations
 - Operational recovery
 - Logging
 - Monitoring
 - Reconciliation
 - Incident preventionA major production incident should result not merely in a patch, but in a better system afterwards. 

Essential technical backgroundWe need substantial recent production experience with: 

- Node. js
 - TypeScript
 - React / React. js
 - Backend systems
 - API design
 - Databases
 - Distributed applications
 - Automated testing
 - Git
 - Docker
 - CI/CD
 - Cloud environments
 - Production observabilityParticularly relevant: 

- NestJS
 - Express
 - Fastify
 - PostgreSQL
 - MongoDB
 - Redis
 - GraphQL
 - Kafka
 - RabbitMQ
 - SQS
 - Kubernetes
 - AWS / Azure / GCP
 - Integration testing
 - Event-driven systemsOne particular database, message broker or cloud provider is not mandatory. 

Node. js requirementWe need genuine backend Node. js ownership. 

Experience limited to: 

- Front-end build tooling
 - Server-side rendering
 - Simple proxy services
 - Thin BFF layersis insufficient unless you also have substantial Node. js backend experience elsewhere. 

Relevant product backgroundsThe most interesting candidates will often come from mature enterprise SaaS products involving: 

- Workflow management
 - Automation
 - CRM
 - Identity
 - Permissions
 - Governance
 - APIs
 - Developer platforms
 - Operational systems
 - Enterprise configurationPotentially relevant engineering environments include: 

- Okta / Auth0
 - Blue Yonder / JDA Software
 - Freshworks
 - Diligent
 - Postman
 - LeadSquared
 - Comparable enterprise SaaS businessesThese are examples only. 

We assess your actual product ownership, not your employer's brand. 

How you should thinkWe are interested in engineers who ask questions such as: 

- What is the real domain boundary here?
 - Is this customer-specific or product behaviour?
 - Should this become configuration?
 - What happens to existing tenants?
 - What happens to workflows already underway?
 - What happens if the event arrives twice?
 - How do we recover from partial failure?
 - How do we prove this migration is safe?
 - How will another engineer understand this in two years?
 - How do we make this simpler rather than merely making it work?That style of reasoning matters enormously. 

Communication and judgementYou will work directly with senior Product and Engineering colleagues across the UK and India. 

You should be able to: 

- Explain difficult technical concepts clearly
 - Challenge assumptions constructively
 - Defend technical decisions with evidence
 - Understand commercial/product constraints
 - Avoid overengineering
 - Make pragmatic trade-offs
 - Communicate clearly in written English
 - Mentor without patronising or micromanaging
ExperienceWe expect strong candidates will typically have approximately 8-14+ years of software engineering experience. 

However, Staff-level scope matters more than calendar years. 

You do not necessarily need to hold a Staff title today. 

A Lead or exceptional Senior engineer who is already: 

- Leading architecture
 - Influencing several engineers
 - Reviewing critical work
 - Owning production behaviour
 - Taking responsibility beyond individual featurescan absolutely be relevant. 

📈 Why join Script Assist?At a very large organisation, a Staff Engineer may own one layer or one subsystem of a much bigger machine. 

At Script Assist, you can have meaningful influence across a significant part of the product. 

You will help determine: 

- How major areas are designed
 - How the platform handles customer variation
 - How engineers structure new functionality
 - How code quality is maintained
 - How technical debt is reduced
 - How production issues are prevented
 - How engineering scales as the company growsYou will remain hands-on. 

But the objective is not simply to become the person who can write the most difficult code. 

- The objective is to make a substantial part of the platform - and the engineers responsible for it - better because of your technical leadership.

The Engineering Manager - Firmware Engineering will lead a team delivering firmware across sustaining engineering, product enhancements, production support, qualification, and new product development.

You Will Make an Impact By

- Lead firmware execution across sustaining, enhancements, qualification, production support, and product development. 
 - Provide hands-on technical leadership in embedded firmware, real-time systems, controls, communications, and diagnostics. 
 - Own team priorities, resources, commitments, risks, and delivery. 
 - Drive architecture, design and code reviews, troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, and technical decisions. 
 - Strengthen requirements, code quality, verification, configuration, release, and defect-prevention practices. 
 - Expand CI/CD, test automation, regression automation, and approved AI-assisted development. 
 - Partner with global teams on execution, qualification, production issues, and product delivery. 
 - Coach engineers, develop technical leads, and build capability, ownership, and succession. 

Key Result Areas

Delivery: On-time delivery, commitment reliability, backlog health, and responsiveness. 

Quality: Defect leakage, repeat defects, verification effectiveness, and corrective-action closure. 

Productivity and Automation: Development cycle time, automated test coverage, CI/CD maturity, and measurable benefits from automation and approved AI tools. 

Talent and Ownership: Skill growth, time to productivity, retention, technical-lead development, and progression toward deliverable and workstream ownership.

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electronics, Electrical, Computer Engineering, Embedded Systems, Computer Science, or a related discipline. 
 - 10+ years of firmware or embedded-systems experience, including 3+ years of engineering leadership. 
 - Strong technical depth in embedded C/C++, real-time systems, processors, communications, diagnostics, and embedded architecture. 
 - Experience delivering firmware through design, integration, verification, release, sustaining, and production support. 
 - Hands-on experience with design and code reviews, debugging, root-cause analysis, and technical problem solving. 
 - Experience with automated testing, CI/CD, configuration management, and modern firmware-development practices. 
 - Strong execution, people leadership, global collaboration, and stakeholder-management skills. 

Preferred Skills: 

- Experience in semiconductor equipment, instrumentation, controls, power systems, industrial automation, or similar complex products. 
 - Experience with RTOS-based systems, embedded Linux, industrial communications, high-reliability products, or hardware-in-the-loop testing.

data.title: Senior Specialist QA – Functional Testing (Clearing and Trading domains)
data.description:
The P&SE Post Trade NCCP engineering organization is expanding technology center in Bengaluru (Bangalore). We are looking for a Senior Specialist with Manual/Functional testing to join our Clearing Counter Party (CCP) system QA team. 

This is an opportunity to join the world's leading exchange technology company and work with innovative technologies in an international environment where our clients include high profile organizations like Hong Kong Exchange, Singapore Exchange, Swiss Exchange and Saudi Stock Exchange. If innovation and efficiency drive you forward this is the place for you!

We are looking for candidates with strong technical skills, good understanding for Clearing and Trading domains, who have a genuine desire and drive to deliver top technology solutions to today's markets. 

With this position we offer: 

In this role, you will join the P&SE Post Trade NCCP QA team in Bangalore, part of Nasdaq Marketplace Technology. As this is a growing team in Bangalore, you will play a key role in helping build and shape our local QA function from the ground up. At the same time, you will be connected to a broader global network of QA professionals working across our Clearing systems, giving you exposure and collaboration opportunities well beyond the local team

Role Requirement: 

As a Senior Specialist QA for Functional/Manual testing, you will work in a multi-functional product engineering team with highly skilled and expert Business Analysts, Software Engineers, and Test Engineers. 

- Your responsibilities will be related to Functional/Manual testing in a DevOps oriented environment for a clearing system. Including such as: 
 - Review functional business requirements. 
 - Build implement and maintain tests, develop test plans & test effort estimates, 
 - Build test specifications and test reports. 
 - Lead and mentor a small team of Functional testers. 
 - Understand the Application/Product Components and integration points to perform E2E testing
 - Work closely with NCCP Automation team for test case handover, execution and Sign off. 
 - Analyze & Mitigate complex problems/issues arising because of Test failures, identify & resolve bottlenecks such as Test data and Env issues. 
 - Stay up to date on the latest trends in the QA space. 

We expect you to have: 

- Overall experience of 10+yrs as a Functional/Manual QA with 2 years of hands on Automation experience. 
 - Support, participate, test and implement new business initiatives, products, programs, processes, etc. (e. g. , process simplification and automation, business requirements) that are aligned with the organizational strategy. 
 - Proficient in Test effort estimation, Test planning and Test Reporting. 
 - Hands on experience in API testing. 
 - Strong experience in Clearing and Trading domains (Financial Markets). 
 - Proactively assembles and commits to results the extended Nasdaq team of experts that together leads all business activities with an existing customer or prospect. 
 - Good understand of DB concepts and hands on experience with SQL. 
 - Experience working in agile teams either using Scrum or Kanban. 
 - Working knowledge of Java

You can expect a collaborative, fast-paced, and constantly evolving work environment where you are recognized for your results and ability to drive things forward proactively & persistently. Every day brings many opportunities to learn & grow and rewards with a global impact we build. 

Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English. 

A degree in Computer Science, Information Systems or equivalent work experience

It would be great if you have

- Experience in non-functional tests such as failover tests and performance tests. 
 - Experience in security related testing. 

Come as You Are

Nasdaq is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds and identities. 

We are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where diverse perspectives, experiences, and identities are valued and celebrated. 

We ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided with reasonable accommodation throughout the hiring process.

data.title: QA Architect
data.description:
Required Qualifications

- 10+ years in software QA/testing with at least 5 years focused exclusively on Non-Functional Testing (performance, load, stress, security) for enterprise-grade web applications. 
 - Proven track record of architecting and driving NFT programs end-to-end - from customer NFR workshops through tooling setup, test execution, and executive-level reporting. 
 - Hands-on proficiency with performance/load testing tools such as JMeter, Gatling, Locust, or k6, and security testing tools such as OWASP ZAP, Burp Suite, Nessus, or Qualys. 
 - Solid working knowledge of Azure cloud infrastructure (App Services, Azure Load Testing, Azure Monitor, Application Insights) and its impact on application performance and security posture. 
 - Experience with APM and observability platforms (Dynatrace, Datadog, or New Relic) for performance profiling, bottleneck isolation, and capacity planning. 
 - Strong communication and consulting skills - ability to run NFR definition sessions with customers, present risk-rated findings to non-technical stakeholders, and align cross-functional teams on quality gates. 

Tech Stack

- JMeterLocustGatlingk6OWASP ZAPBurp SuiteNessus / QualysAzure DevOpsAzure Load TestingApplication InsightsDatadogDynatracePlaywrightPythonDocker / Kubernetes

Preferred Qualifications

- Certifications in performance testing (ISTQB Performance Testing Specialist) or security testing (CEH, OSCP, or relevant Azure security certifications). 
 - Experience with UI/UX performance measurement tools (Google Lighthouse, WebPageTest, Core Web Vitals) for page responsiveness and load-time optimization on B2B portals. 
 - Prior experience in an IT services or consulting environment - managing NFT deliverables, customer expectations, and multi-stakeholder engagements simultaneously. 
 - Familiarity with DevSecOps practices and shift-left security integration within Azure-based CI/CD workflows. 
 - Exposure to accessibility testing standards (WCAG 2. 1) relevant to enterprise B2B web applications. 

Roles & Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

- Define and own the end-to-end Non-Functional Testing strategy and framework covering performance, load, stress, UI/UX responsiveness, and security vulnerability testing for an Azure-hosted B2B web application. 
 - Lead customer-facing NFR requirement workshops - translate business expectations into measurable test criteria, SLA thresholds, and acceptance gates in collaboration with product and engineering stakeholders. 
 - Evaluate, select, and onboard the NFT tooling stack; establish standards for load simulation, vulnerability scanning, and frontend performance profiling suited to the Azure platform. 
 - Design realistic workload models, test scenarios, and data strategies for load and stress testing that reflect B2B usage patterns, peak traffic, and failure conditions. 
 - Plan and execute security vulnerability assessments (VAPT) aligned to OWASP Top 10; coordinate with DevSecOps teams to log, prioritize, and track remediation of findings. 
 - Integrate NFT suites into Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines, establishing automated performance gates and regression baselines that block releases when thresholds are breached. 
 - Monitor application performance using APM tools (Dynatrace, Datadog, or Application Insights); analyse bottlenecks and provide root-cause analysis with actionable optimization recommendations. 
 - Lead, mentor, and grow a team of QA engineers - providing technical direction, script/code reviews, and hands-on guidance during test execution, triage, and reporting to both technical and business audiences.

data.title: Senior Test Developer – Automotive Simulation Testing & Failure-Triage Lead
data.description:
Do you enjoy solving complex automotive software failures and leading high-impact validation activities in a fast-paced engineering environment? We are looking for an experienced SWQA Lead with strong automotive domain knowledge, hands-on simulation testing expertise, advanced Python skills, and a proven ability to identify regression-causing changelists (CL's) through systematic bisection. This role is central to Integration testing quality and simulation failure triage. You will lead daily testing activities, analyze various failures and artifacts, identify root causes, isolate culprit changelists (CLs), and coordinate resolution across software, simulation, validation, and infrastructure teams. As the Person in Charge (PIC), you will manage priorities, assign work, remove blockers, improve triage efficiency, and ensure release-impacting issues are driven to closure. You will also apply Agentic AI workflows to accelerate failure investigation, evidence correlation, classification, and reporting. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Lead daily pre-merge testing, simulation failure triage, task prioritization, team execution, and timely closure of critical issues. 
 - Perform root-cause and signal-level analysis using logs, traces, metrics, videos, and state transitions to isolate software, simulation, configuration, infrastructure, analyzer, or evaluator failures. 
 - Lead the bisections using source-control history, failure patterns, signal evidence, and code-impact analysis to identify culprit CLs and complex multi-change regressions. 
 - Develop Python-based tools and automation for log analysis, failure classification, regression isolation, automated bisection, and reporting. 
 - Apply Agentic AI workflows to correlate diagnostic evidence, identify patterns, summarize failures, recommend investigation paths, and improve triage efficiency. 
 - Collaborate with development, systems, simulation, validation, tools, and infrastructure teams; track quality metrics, communicate risks, mentor engineers, and establish consistent triage practices. 

What We Need To See

- B. Tech. or equivalent degree in CS, CE, ECE, EEE, Automotive Engineering, or a related field, with 8-12 years of relevant automotive software testing and validation experience. 
 - Strong expertise in HIL/SIL, simulation testing, automotive verification workflows, and root-cause analysis using signals, logs, traces, and system-level evidence.

Responsibilities

 - Optimize existing automation pipelines by analyzing performance bottlenecks and implementing improvements that reduce deployment time minimize errors and increase throughput for complex content automation scenarios. 
 - Collaborate with product engineering and operations teams to translate business requirements into well defined automation solutions that support day shift operations and align with enterprise standards and regulatory expectations.

 - Configure monitoring and alerting for automated processes to promptly identify failures or anomalies enabling rapid incident response that protects service availability and improves end user experience. 
 - Integrate automation solutions with Air Time Inventory processes when applicable enabling more accurate scheduling faster content updates and improved utilization of inventory resources that support business growth and audience satisfaction. 
 - Document automation designs operational procedures and troubleshooting guides in clear and accessible formats so cross functional teams can effectively support and evolve the content automation ecosystem. 
 - Conduct periodic reviews of automation security posture including credential handling and access controls to align with enterprise security policies and protect sensitive content and configuration data. 
 - Coordinate and execute controlled rollouts of new or enhanced automation capabilities during day shifts ensuring minimal business disruption and transparent communication with impacted stakeholders. 
 - Mentor peers on automation concepts and Ansible techniques through demonstrations and knowledge sharing sessions fostering a culture of continuous improvement and innovation in content operations. 
 - Evaluate emerging tools and practices related to content automation and inventory management proposing enhancements that advance organizational efficiency reduce operational cost and deliver greater value to audiences and clients. 

Qualifications

- Demonstrate five to eight years of experience designing and implementing automation solutions with substantial hands on expertise in Ansible for configuration management and orchestration in enterprise environments. 
 - Possess strong understanding of content lifecycle management and operational processes for digital delivery platforms with the ability to translate workflow requirements into scalable automation patterns. 
 - Bring experience or familiarity with Air Time Inventory concepts such as scheduling allocation and utilization enabling effective collaboration with domain experts and smoother integration of automation outcomes. 
 - Exhibit proficiency in scripting and automation adjacent tools that complement Ansible capabilities supporting complex orchestration scenarios and advanced configuration routines.

data.description:
About Business

JOB DESCRIPTION

Adani Group: Adani Group is a diversified organisation in India comprising 10 publicly traded companies. It has created a world-class logistics and utility infrastructure portfolio that has a pan-India presence. Adani Group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, in the state of Gujarat, India. Over the years, Adani Group has positioned itself to be the market leader in its logistics and energy businesses focusing on large-scale infrastructure development in India with O & M practices benchmarked to global standards. With four IG-rated businesses, it is the only Infrastructure Investment Grade issuer in India. 

Adani Power Limited (APL): Adani Power Limited (APL), a part of the diversified Adani Group, is the largest private thermal power producer in India. We have a power generation capacity of 15, 250 MW comprising thermal power plants in Gujarat, Maharashtra, Karnataka, Rajasthan, Chhattisgarh, Madhya Pradesh, and Jharkhand, and a 40 MW solar power project in Gujarat. 

Job Purpose: This role is responsible to manage the continuous availability, reliability, and functionality of DCS and PLC systems. This includes scheduling and performing regular system backups, maintenance, and troubleshooting, as well as coordinating with OEMs for system upgrades. The role also involves managing hardware and software resources, network integrity, and cybersecurity measures to prevent data loss and system vulnerabilities. 

Responsibilities

Lead - DCS_PLC (Distributed Control System_ Programmable Logic Control)

System Reliability And Maintenance

Ensure the availability and functioning of all control loops in auto mode, maintaining reliability of equipment protection under BTG. 

Schedule and execute regular backups of DCS and PLC systems to prevent data loss. 

Perform routine maintenance and troubleshooting of DCS and PLC hardware to minimize downtime. 

Monitor system alarms daily and ensure the healthiness and redundancy of systems. 

Coordinate with Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEMs) for annual maintenance activities and system upgrades. 

Manage the proper functioning of Operator Workstations (OWS) and Engineering Workstations (EWS). 

Maintain periodical backups and availability of historian systems for data integrity and recovery. 

Hardware And Software Management

Manage the availability of DCS and PLC hardware and software, including necessary spares for emergency replacements. 

Maintain up-to-date DCS and PLC licenses and manage renewals to avoid operational disruptions. 

Conduct patch updates of DCS and PLC software to address vulnerabilities and enhance system performance. 

Upgrade DCS and PLC systems proactively to prevent obsolescence and maintain compatibility with new technologies. 

Network And Cybersecurity

Manage the storage, backup, and restoration of systems in compliance with cybersecurity policies. 

Ensure the healthiness and redundancy of the DCS and PLC network, preventing single points of failure. 

Oversee the transfer of data to third-party systems, such as Pi servers, ensuring secure and reliable communication. 

Review and strengthen network security measures to protect against cyber threats and unauthorized access. 

Business Sustainability

Implement and Follow IMS, AWMS, DISHA and CHETNA guidelines within the department. 

Promote the safety of personnel and equipment through rigorous training and strict adherence to safety protocols. 

Implement risk management practices to mitigate potential hazards and ensure operational continuity. 

Develop and maintain emergency response plans to address potential incidents swiftly and effectively. 

Ensure adherence to statutory compliances and regulations. 

Implement MoC (Management of Change) protocols to ensure safe and compliant modifications to equipment and processes. 

Provide support for Root Cause Analysis (RCA), Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA), Zero Forced Outage (ZFO) to enhance system reliability. 

Implement field related ZFO action items and AWMS for continuous improvement in maintenance practices. 

Digitization And Automation

Execute comprehensive digitization strategies and automation solutions to optimize operational efficiency. 

Implement process and system improvements, adopting newer technologies and innovative ideas. 

Drive the implementation of digital transformation initiatives. 

Analyse data trends and system performance to identify opportunities for automation and digitization enhancements.

Environment & Sustainability

Techno Commercial

Operations & Maintenance

Security

Stores

Support Functions

ENDORSE

ENOC

Key Stakeholders - External

Vendor

Qualifications

Educational Qualification: 

Bachelor's degree in C&I or Electronics & Communication or equivalent degree. 

Work Experience (Range Of Years)

6+ years of experience in industrial automation, specifically with DCS and PLC systems. 

Preferred Industry

Experience in the power generation, petrochemical, oil and gas, or heavy industrial sectors.
