data.description:
Description

Role Overview

As an L6 Software Development Manager in AWS Infrastructure Supply Chain, you will define the strategic vision for your team, establish a roadmap, and successfully deliver software that powers one of the world's largest and most complex physical infrastructure supply chains. You will independently manage a team of SDEs building large-scale distributed systems that enable AWS to procure, manufacture, ship, and deploy hundreds of thousands of server and network racks into data centers globally across AMER, EMEA, APAC, and GOVT regions. 

Strategic Ownership

Define the strategic vision for your team, partnering effectively with customers and stakeholders across the supply chain lifecycle - from demand planning and material supportability to manufacturing, logistics, and DC deployment. 

Establish a roadmap and successfully deliver software that executes that vision, aligned with the end-to-end supply chain needs spanning systems like S&OP POR, RP3, Build Planner, Fulfillment Planner, and the Infrastructure Control Tower. 

Make crisp, independent decisions about what projects move forward and in what priority order, balancing competing priorities across demand forecasting, capacity planning, fulfillment optimization, and observability. 

Write narratives, PR/FAQs, and other strategic documentation to drive alignment and decision-making. 

Technical Domain

Your team will work on one or more of the following areas: 

Real-time observability platforms - powering the Infrastructure Control Tower that tracks 100K+ active demands through stage progression, dwell times, blocker reason codes, and checkpoint milestones. 

AI/ML-driven forecasting - demand planning, ETA prediction, and supply-demand matching across 130+ component categories and 1, 400+ Superset Fungibility Groups (SFGs). 

Optimization engines - capacity planning systems that match server/network demand (converted to kW) against DC power supply at lineup, breaker, site, and meter-site levels. 

Multi-agent orchestration systems - coordinating fulfillment across vendors, manufacturing sites, and DC positions in priority order (ML → Network → Non-ML). 

Data pipelines - processing millions of events daily across the fulfillment pipeline from Purchase Request through to Handoff. 

People Leadership

Independently manage a team of SDEs; hire the right mix of engineers to accomplish team goals. 

Assess SDE performance effectively; manage both high and low performers and take effective action addressing employee concerns. 

Hire, develop, and promote SDEs, delegating appropriately based on the strength and development objectives of individuals on your team. 

Build an effective development process that consistently delivers software with minimal defects and system disruption. 

Customer & Operational Excellence

Define metrics to measure customer experience, team development progress, and operational excellence across the supply chain systems your team owns. 

Establish customer engagement mechanisms to stay connected to the needs of internal customers - service teams (EC2, S3, EBS), supply planners, manufacturing partners, and logistics operators. 

Ensure your team adheres to SLAs and effectively manages software operations. 

Proactively identify risks and bring them to the attention of your manager, customers, and stakeholders with mitigation plans before they become roadblocks. Know when to escalate to Senior Leaders. 

Deliver Results

Consistently deliver software with minimal defects and system disruption. 

Improve the quality of software owned by your team and operational performance metrics under your leadership. 

Communicate ideas effectively, both verbally and in writing, to all types of audiences - from engineering peers to senior leadership. 

A day in the life

Strategic Vision & Roadmap

Define the strategic vision for your team within the supply chain domain - whether that's demand planning, fulfillment optimization, manufacturing observability, or capacity planning

Establish and execute a roadmap that aligns with the end-to-end supply chain lifecycle, translating business needs into engineering deliverables

Make crisp, independent decisions about project prioritization, balancing competing demands across systems like RP3, Fulfillment Planner, Build Planner, and Control Tower

Author narratives, PR/FAQs, and strategic documents to drive alignment with leadership and stakeholders

Technical Delivery & Operational Excellence

Deliver high-quality software consistently with minimal defects and system disruption across large-scale distributed systems processing millions of events daily

Manage software operations effectively - ensuring uptime, reliability, and performance for systems tracking 100K+ active demands

Define and monitor metrics for team development progress, customer experience, and operational excellence (e. g. , stage dwell times, on-track/off-track KPIs, manufacturing output trends)

Drive continuous improvement - improve software quality and operational performance metrics under your leadership

People Management & Development

Independently manage a team of SDEs - hire the right mix of engineers to accomplish team goals

Assess SDE performance and manage both high and low performers with effective action

Hire, develop, and promote SDEs - build a talent pipeline and export talent across the organization

Delegate appropriately - assign tasks based on individual strengths and development objectives, stretching engineers into areas like AI/ML forecasting, optimization engines, and real-time observability

Customer Engagement & Stakeholder Management

Partner effectively with customers and stakeholders - internal service teams (EC2, S3, EBS), supply planners, GSMs, manufacturing partners (Jabil, Foxconn, Quanta), and logistics operators

Establish customer engagement mechanisms to stay connected to evolving supply chain needs

Define metrics to measure customer experience across the fulfillment pipeline - from Purchase Request through Handoff

Risk Management & Escalation

Proactively identify risks and bring them to the attention of your manager, customers, and stakeholders with mitigation plans before they become roadblocks

Know when to escalate to Senior Leaders - especially critical in a domain where delays in manufacturing, material shortages, or DC readiness issues can cascade across the global fleet

Ensure your team adheres to SLAs across all systems and operational commitments

Culture & Process

Build an effective development process that enables sustainable, high-quality delivery

Use mechanisms, not good intentions - establish trust-and-verify systems for operational excellence, code quality, and team health

Drive root cause analysis - instill a culture of asking "5 whys, " fixing to root cause, and adding missing metrics after incidents

Basic Qualifications

- 3+ years of engineering team management experience
 - 7+ years of engineering experience
 - 8+ years of leading the definition and development of multi tier web services experience
 - Knowledge of engineering practices and patterns for the full software/hardware/networks development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, certification, and livesite operations

 - Experience designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience in communicating with users, other technical teams, and senior leadership to collect requirements, describe software product features, technical designs, and product strategy

Job Title: Engineering Manager - HV Substations (EPC)

Job Location: Chennai, India

Join Us!

We combine AtkinsRéalis project management expertise and Hitachi Energy's deep technological knowledge to create a company dedicated to substations - we are Linxon!

The Engineering Manager leads the multidisciplinary engineering team assigned to one major project, or to several projects in parallel, within the High Voltage (HV) substation EPC business. The role owns technical delivery end-to-end - from design coordination through to as-built handover - while acting as the primary technical interface toward vendors, subcontractors, and internal/external stakeholders. This is a senior, hands-on leadership position requiring both deep electrical engineering credibility and strong people-management skills. 

What will you do?

Team Leadership

- Manage, coordinate, and develop the project engineering team, covering primary (substation layout, electrical calculations, studies), secondary (protection, control, automation, SCADA), BIM/3D modelling, and civil/structural engineering disciplines. 
 - Allocate engineering resources and Distribute workload across the allocated resources of the project team based on project phase, milestones, and priorities; scale the team up or down as projects move through ECI, detailed engineering, and site support phases. 
 - Set individual and team objectives, mentor engineers, and support technical skill development within the discipline groups. 
 - When responsible for multiple projects simultaneously, arbitrate priorities and resource allocation across projects in line with overall business objectives. 
 - Act as the primary point of contact for Principal Design Engineer in UK and guarantee the delivery of the design by GETS as per project plan. 
 - Attend weekly internal design review and monthly project plan review meetings. 

Engineering Delivery & Technical Ownership

- Own the overall technical quality, consistency, and interdisciplinary coordination of the engineering deliverables (single line diagrams, layouts, protection & control schemes, civil/structural drawings, 3D BIM models, technical specifications). 
 - Ensure engineering outputs comply with applicable codes, standards, client technical specifications, and internal engineering standards. 
 - Resolve interdisciplinary technical conflicts (e. g. , primary/civil layout clashes, secondary/primary interface issues) and ensure design freeze milestones are met. 
 - Review and approve Guarantee the review and the approval of the key technical documents and design packages before issue to client or procurement according to project delivery plan. 

Vendor & Supplier Interface

- Act as the senior technical point of contact toward equipment vendors and subcontractors. 
 - Support technical clarification meetings, technical bid evaluations, factory acceptance tests (FAT), and design review meetings with suppliers. 
 - Ensure vendor technical documentation (drawings, datasheets, calculations) is reviewed, commented, and approved in line with project schedule. 

Internal Coordination & Stakeholder Management

- Interface with the wider project engineering organization (project management, procurement, construction, commissioning, QA/QC) to align engineering priorities with overall project schedule and deliverables. 
 - Represent the engineering function in internal project review meetings, steering committees, and client-facing technical discussions. 
 - Communicate risks, technical constraints, and schedule impacts clearly and proactively to project leadership and internal stakeholders. 
 - Act as a credible, senior technical voice able to defend engineering positions and priorities in front of internal stakeholders and management. 

Experience, Education And Other Required

- Degree in Electrical Engineering (Bachelor'S or Master's level). 
 - Minimum 18+ years of experience required, with a solid background in the HV EPC substation business (design, engineering, and/or execution of AIS/GIS substations, HV equipment, protection & control systems). 
 - Proven experience managing or leading a multidisciplinary engineering team (primary, secondary, civil, and/or BIM disciplines). 
 - Track record of managing engineering scope on EPC substation projects, ideally with exposure to both single-project and multi-project engineering management. 
 - Direct experience interfacing with equipment vendors and subcontractors on technical matters (technical clarifications, bid evaluation, design reviews, FAT). 
 - Experience working within a structured project engineering environment, coordinating with project management, procurement, and construction functions. 
 - Strong technical grounding across HV substation engineering disciplines, sufficient to arbitrate between primary, secondary, civil, and BIM inputs. 
 - Solid understanding of project engineering processes: design freeze, document control, interdisciplinary coordination, schedule-driven deliverables. 
 - Strong leadership and people-management skills, with the ability to organize, motivate, and hold a technical team accountable. 
 - Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, comfortable presenting and defending positions to senior internal and client stakeholders. 
 - Strong personality and presence, with the seniority and confidence to front demanding internal stakeholders and represent engineering interests at project level. 
 - Fluent in English (additional languages an advantage depending on project geography). 

What We Offer

In return, we offer a wide range of rewards and benefits, 

- 20 days Privilege Leave, 13 days Emergency leave and 14 Public holidays per year 
 - Medical Insurance, Life Insurance and Career Progression 
 - When it comes to diversity and inclusion, we see things differently at Linxon - we encourage applications from people of all races, ages, genders, religions, sexual orientations and more - so whoever you are, we hope you'll see things our way, too. 

About Linxon

Shaping energy solutions to empower sustainable connectivity. 

We combine AtkinsRéalis project management expertise and Hitachi Energy's deep technological knowledge to create a company dedicated to substations - we are Linxon. 

Linxon's vision is to deliver the best market offering for turnkey substation projects through world-class power technologies and delivering the highest level of competence in managing infrastructure projects. 

As a leading engineering company, we help our customers with turnkey substation solutions in the field of power transmission, renewable energy, and transportation. 

In this role, you will have the opportunity to be part of a new company as it evolves and help shape it for the future. If you like new challenges, have an entrepreneurial spirit, and are interested in working with other motivated professionals with expertise in the Substations EPC business, then this is the new opportunity for you. 

To know more about the Linxon please click on the link below. 

Building the infrastructure to power the world - we are Linxon! - YouTube

data.description:
Who We Are

Addepar is a global data and AI platform empowering investment professionals to turn complex financial information into actionable intelligence. Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI-powered insights within investment and client workflows. More than 1, 500 firms in 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $10 trillion in assets. Its open platform integrates with 650 software, data and consulting partners to power end-to-end investment operations across firms of all sizes and levels of complexity. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, São Paulo, London, Edinburgh, Geneva, Warsaw, Dubai, Pune and Singapore. 

The Role

As a Field Engineer, Team Lead you will serve as a player-coach - guiding a team of field engineers while personally executing the most complex, mission-critical technical work yourself. Operating at the intersection of engineering and client success, you are both the technical anchor for your team and Addepar's technical vanguard in the field, translating complex business requirements into production-grade integrations, automations, and data solutions. 

You will be the technical expert across Addepar's full solution suite - from API integrations and automation frameworks to advanced data platforms (including our white-labeled Databricks offering, ADX) and AI-driven tooling. At the same time, you will develop your people-management skills: providing daily guidance, coordinating work allocation, and turning the vision set by leadership into reality while keeping your team aligned to our core processes. This role combines a forward-deployed delivery model with hands-on technical depth and functional leadership of a high-performing engineering team. 

Applicants must have legal authorization to work in the country where this role is based on the first day of employment. Visa sponsorship is not available for this position. 

Important Note: This role will require you to work from Pune office 3 days a week in UK shift i. e. 2: 30 PM to 11: 30 PM IST. (hybrid role)

What You'll Do

- Serve as a player-coach: provide functional leadership and daily operational guidance to a team of field engineers while remaining a hands-on technical contributor on the most complex engagements
 - Architect, build, and deliver custom integrations, automations, and data pipelines using Addepar's APIs, ADX (Databricks), and modern engineering tools
 - Manage the team's work allocation and coordinate activities across simultaneous client engagements, ensuring results are delivered on schedule and in collaboration with cross-functional partners
 - Guide the team through issue resolution, proactively escalate blockers, and maintain alignment with client and internal stakeholders
 - Design and implement production-grade solutions that dramatically improve client onboarding efficiency, reduce time-to-value, and enable operational scale
 - Build intelligent automation leveraging AI, LLMs, and machine learning to solve complex data transformation, validation, and reconciliation challenges
 - Serve as the technical owner for ADX implementations, designing robust data infrastructure within Databricks to streamline client data onboarding and analytics
 - Write and review production-quality Python code for ETL pipelines, API integrations, data validation frameworks, and automation tooling
 - Translate ambiguous client requirements into flexible, scalable technical solutions through deep discovery, prototyping, and iterative delivery
 - Support career development by providing continuous feedback loops on technical and project execution, mentoring engineers as they grow
 - Identify and drive opportunities to improve tools, workflows, and automation for greater team efficiency, and develop internal frameworks and best practices that accelerate delivery
 - Collaborate with Product, Engineering, and Services teams to identify opportunities for productization and influence the platform roadmap
 - Act as a technical advisor and trusted partner to clients, proactively identifying opportunities to drive additional value

Who You Are

- Experience: Minimum 8+ years of experience in software engineering, data engineering, or forward-deployed technical roles, with demonstrated experience guiding, mentoring, or leading other engineers
 - Technical Skills: Advanced proficiency in Python with experience building production-grade applications, APIs, and data pipelines; strong understanding of REST APIs, authentication patterns, and integration architecture
 - Data Platforms: Hands-on experience with Databricks, Spark, and distributed data processing frameworks; proficiency in SQL and experience working with large-scale datasets across relational and NoSQL databases
 - Pipelines & Automation: Experience designing and implementing ETL/ELT pipelines for complex data transformations; familiarity with AI/ML tools and experience implementing LLM-driven automation solutions
 - Domain Knowledge: Strong understanding of financial data domains including portfolio management, performance analytics, and multi-asset class portfolios
 - Engineering Practices: Experience with version control (Git), CI/CD pipelines, and modern software development practices
 - Leadership: A solutions-driven, player-coach mindset - able to balance hands-on delivery with coordinating a team, providing feedback, and a commitment to growing your people-management skills
 - Communication: Outstanding communication skills with the ability to conduct technical presentations and translate complex concepts for both technical and non-technical audiences
 - Organization: Highly organized with attention to detail, able to prioritize and context-switch across simultaneous client engagements and deliver results that may impact schedules and costs
 - Mindset: Independent, adaptable, and entrepreneurial with a strong work ethic, a bias for action, and a passion for client impact; thrives in ambiguous, fast-paced environments while maintaining high-quality standards

Our Values

- Act Like an Owner - Think and operate with intention, purpose and care. Own outcomes. 
 - Build Together - Collaborate to unlock the best solutions. Deliver lasting value. 
 - Champion Our Clients - Exceed client expectations. Our clients' success is our success. 
 - Drive Innovation - Be bold and unconstrained in problem solving. Transform the industry. 
 - Embrace Learning - Engage our community to broaden our perspective. Bring a growth mindset. 

In addition to our core values, Addepar is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We seek to bring together diverse ideas, experiences, skill sets, perspectives, backgrounds and identities to drive innovative solutions. We commit to promoting a welcoming environment where inclusion and belonging are held as a shared responsibility. 

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation. 

PHISHING SCAM WARNING: Addepar is among several companies recently made aware of a phishing scam involving con artists posing as hiring managers recruiting via email, text and social media. The imposters are creating misleading email accounts, conducting remote "interviews, " and making fake job offers in order to collect personal and financial information from unsuspecting individuals. Please be aware that no job offers will be made from Addepar without a formal interview process. Additionally, Addepar will not ask you to purchase equipment or supplies as part of your onboarding process. If you have any questions, please reach out to ta-operations@addepar. com.

 - 5 years of experience working in a complex organization. 
 - Experience leading through technical and organizational complexity. 
 - Experience with Java, C++, or both. 
 - Passion for technology, collaboration, and solving challenging problems. 

About The Job

Like Google's own ambitions, the work of a Software Engineer goes beyond just Search. Software Engineering Managers have not only the technical expertise to take on and provide technical leadership to major projects, but also manage a team of Engineers. You not only optimize your own code but make sure Engineers are able to optimize theirs. As a Software Engineering Manager you manage your project goals, contribute to product strategy and help develop your team. Teams work all across the company, in areas such as information retrieval, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking, security, data compression, user interface design; the list goes on and is growing every day. Operating with scale and speed, our exceptional software engineers are just getting started -- and as a manager, you guide the way. 

With technical and leadership expertise, you manage engineers across multiple teams and locations, a large product budget and oversee the deployment of large-scale projects across multiple sites internationally. 

In Google Search, we're reimagining what it means to search for information - any way and anywhere. To do that, we need to solve complex engineering challenges and expand our infrastructure, while maintaining a universally accessible and useful experience that people around the world rely on. In joining the Search team, you'll have an opportunity to make an impact on billions of people globally. 

Responsibilities

- Guide the technical direction to transition the core fabric of Search into an inherently multimodal platform, driving critical AI Mode (AIM) and AI Overviews (AIO) orchestration improvements. 
 - Drive the organizational working methodology toward agent-driven architectures and spec-driven development. Have AI fluency and be prepared to discuss your knowledge of AI tools in the hiring process. 
 - Manage complex integrations with sibling infrastructure teams, product teams, and downstream AI partners. Leverage the local Uber Tech lead (UTL)/Technical Lead (TL) presence in Bangalore to make effective architectural decisions and unblock your team. 
 - Foster rigorous engineering practices. Advocate system reliability, precise capacity planning, and latency optimizations. 
 - Hire, mentor, and sponsor a high-performing engineering team. Establish clear operational standards, support career development, and actively advocate for your team's technical visibility.

It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system. 

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365-all within 90 seconds. 

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1. 85B+ from the world's top investors-including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, Bedrock, GIC, Elad Gil and Goldman Sachs-and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

About The Role

While your primary focus will be on the backend, this is a truly full-stack role. You will help design the distributed systems that power our platform and also contribute to React and React Native code to deliver polished end-to-end product experiences. 

You will be responsible for building scalable backend services, APIs, and data models, while partnering closely with product and design to ensure the underlying complexity is translated into seamless, high-performance user experiences.

- Design and implement scalable backend services using Python and Golang to support complex enterprise data modeling and product use cases.

 - Work closely with Product, Design, and other engineers to break down complex user problems and build components that are technically strong and practically useful for teams building on top of them.

data.title: Senior Software Engineer
data.description:
From Fivetran's founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We're proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven. 

About Us

Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data. 

Together, we're delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data - from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on. 

Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions. 

As we bring our teams and technology together, we're building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It's an exciting time to join us: we're creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact. 

During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites. 

About The Team

The Semantic Layer team owns the systems that turn dbt models into trusted, reusable business metrics. At the heart of this is MetricFlow - the open-source semantic engine that powers the dbt Semantic Layer. MetricFlow lets data teams define metrics once in code and consume them consistently across BI tools, notebooks, AI agents, and downstream applications. 

This team is the steward of MetricFlow as an open-source project: shipping releases, reviewing community contributions, evolving the query compiler, and ensuring it integrates cleanly with the broader dbt ecosystem. You'll work at the intersection of language design, query compilation, and distributed data execution - solving problems that directly shape how thousands of organizations measure their business. 

About The Role

We're hiring a Senior Software Engineer to join the Semantic Layer team in Bangalore. You'll be a core contributor to MetricFlow - designing features, optimizing query generation, hardening the open-source codebase, and partnering with the community of contributors and adopters around it. This is a high-ownership role: you'll write production code, drive technical decisions, and help shape the long-term architecture of one of the most important projects in the modern data stack. 

What You'll Do

- Design, build, and maintain core features of MetricFlow, including metric definitions, query compilation, dimensional modeling, and SQL generation across multiple data warehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks, Redshift, and others). 
 - Own MetricFlow as an open-source project - triage issues, review external pull requests, manage releases, and engage the community on GitHub and in Slack. 
 - Collaborate with engineers across dbt Cloud, dbt Core, and the Semantic Layer service to ensure MetricFlow integrates seamlessly with the rest of the dbt ecosystem. 
 - Improve performance, reliability, and observability of metric query execution at scale. 
 - Partner with product, design, and developer-relations teammates to translate customer and community feedback into shipped improvements. 
 - Write clear technical documentation, RFCs, and design docs that raise the bar for how the team thinks and ships. 
 - Mentor other engineers through code review, pairing, and technical guidance. 

Skills We're Looking For

- Strong professional software engineering experience, with a strong track record of shipping production systems. 
 - Deep proficiency in Python, including modern typing, testing practices, and packaging. 
 - Strong SQL fundamentals and a working understanding of how analytical query engines and data warehouses execute queries. 
 - Experience designing systems that involve parsing, compilation, or transformation - for example: query planners, DSL compilers, type systems, or rule-based engines. 
 - Solid grasp of software design principles: clean APIs, modularity, testability, and backwards compatibility. 
 - Excellent written and verbal communication - you can explain complex tradeoffs clearly to engineers, PMs, and external community members. 
 - Experience collaborating in a distributed, asynchronous team environment. 

Bonus Skills (Optional)

- Prior experience contributing to or maintaining a popular open-source project. 
 - Familiarity with dbt, MetricFlow, LookML, Cube, or other semantic-layer technologies. 
 - Background in data warehousing internals, query optimization, or analytical SQL dialects. 
 - Experience with CI/CD, GitHub Actions, and release engineering for Python libraries. 
 - Exposure to building developer-facing APIs, SDKs, or CLIs. 

Why Join Us

- Impact at scale: Your code will run inside the data platforms of tens of thousands of companies, including some of the world's largest enterprises. 
 - Open-source ownership: You'll be a public, named maintainer of a foundational project - your work is visible, reviewed, and used by the global data community. 
 - A team that values craft: We invest in design docs, code review, and durable engineering. We ship fast, but we don't ship sloppy. 
 - Competitive compensation: Market-leading salary, equity, comprehensive health insurance, generous time off, learning & wellness stipends, and home-office support. 

Perks And Benefits

100% employer-paid medical insurance
 - Generous paid time away from work, including paid vacation or flexible/unlimited vacation depending on role and country, plus paid sick time, inclusive parental leave, paid holidays, including a year-end Global Week of Rest, and volunteer days off. 
 - RSU stock grants*
 - Professional development and training opportunities
 - Company virtual happy hours, free food, and fun team-building activities
 - Monthly cell phone stipend
 - Access to an innovative mental health support platform that offers personalized care and resources in areas such as: therapy, coaching, and self-guided mindfulness exercises for all covered employees and their covered dependents. 

*May vary by country and worker type - please reach out to your recruiter for more information

Click here to learn more about Fivetran's Benefits by Region. 

We're honored to be valued at over $5. 6 billion, but more importantly, we're proud of our core values of Get Stuck In, Do the Right Thing, and One Team, One Dream. Read about us in Forbes. 

Fivetran brings together high-quality talent across the globe to make data access as easy and reliable as electricity for our customers. We value and recognize that our customers benefit from having innovative teams made of people from many backgrounds, experiences, and identities. Fivetran promotes diversity, equity, inclusion & belonging through attracting, recruiting, developing, and retaining a diverse workforce, not only because it is the right thing to do, but because it helps us build a world-class company to better serve our customers, our people and our communities.

At Finantic AI India, we sit at the intersection of finance and technology, helping US Commercial real estate companies run their finance and accounting smarter. Based in Chennai and serving US clients, we offer commerce graduates with good analytical mindset, a launchpad to apply core accounting concepts, build strong MSExcel and ERP skills, learn how AI is transforming finance operations, and grow into future-ready finance professionals in a high-learning startup environment. 

The US Commercial real estate market is entering a renewed growth phase, with major firms projecting steady recovery in leasing and investment activity across sectors like industrial, multifamily, data centers, and high-quality office assets. This growth is driving intense focus on robust finance and accounting operations. 

US CFOs are tightening month-end close, lender reporting, lease accounting, and portfolio-level consolidation, and increasingly rely on specialized offshore teams to handle this work at scale. For commerce graduates, this creates a strong learning runway: you get hands-on exposure to real estate leases, property-level P&L, cash-flow and refinancing metrics, consolidations across large portfolios, and the use of AI in F&A, building a profile that is both technically strong and globally relevant in a high-demand niche market

- Architect and build scalable, high-performance front-end applications from the ground up for an AI-native finance and accounting automation platform

Description

Ring is looking for Software development Engineer to join our growing Sidewalk cloud services team and help build a nationwide community network that will enable connectivity for millions of IOT devices. You will be responsible for building core cloud services that will provide a scalable backbone to the network and support functionalities like authentication, encryption, message routing, and device life-cycle management. You will develop real-time monitoring and analytics solutions to continuously learn, and help keep customer trust by preventing security incidents and improving network availability. 

As a Software Development Engineer, you will have the opportunity to influence the product roadmap, drive key components of overall system architecture and lead the adoption of best practices within the org. You will work closely with and influence AWS IOT service teams, as well as cross functional teams across Ring, Echo, and Alexa, to bring a unified connectivity solution for our customers. 

Sidewalk cloud services team owns all the core services and infrastructure that is backbone of the Sidewalk network. Sidewalk is already enabled on more than 80 million Amazon and Ring devices, with more devices added every day. The team is responsible for scaling the core connectivity and messaging platform for the network. Services follow event driven system architecture that blends various server-less computer technologies. The team believes in choosing the right tool and technology for the job, and has created services in various programming languages like Java, Kotlin, Go, Rust, and Python. 

Key job responsibilities

- Manage key components of the core Sidewalk cloud services and messaging platform, that processes millions of messages in a day. 
 - Think big; bring fresh ideas and approaches to simplify onboarding new devices on the Sidewalk network and improve customer value. 
 - Evaluate different design choices, prototype new technology, and implement technical solutions that address business requirements. 
 - Contribute in defining product roadmap, understand business impact of system choices, and make technical trade-offs using sound judgement. 
 - Work closely with ML scientists, understand the requirements, design and deliver innovative monitoring solutions to help preserve customer trust. 
 - Drive engineering best practices around operational excellence, security, test automation coverage and set standards in the team. 
 - Deal with ambiguity, make data-driven decisions and juggle cross-organization complexity. 
 - Drive consensus when confronted with discordant views by identifying the best path forward and influence other to follow it. 

About The Team

Since its founding in 2013, Ring has been on a mission to make neighborhoods safer, together for everyone. From the first-ever Video Doorbell, to the award-winning DIY Ring Alarm system, Ring's smart home security product line, as well as the Neighbors app, offer users affordable whole-home and neighborhood security. At Ring, we are committed to making security accessible and convenient for everyone-while working hard to bring communities together. Ring is an Amazon company. For more information, visit www. ring. com. With Ring, you're always home. 

Basic Qualifications

- 4+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
 - 4+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience
 - 4+ years of leading design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
 - Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team

Preferred Qualifications

- 5+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience

Team: Consumer Product

Location: India (Gurgaon or Bangalore)

Company Introduction

We're noon, the Middle East's homegrown e-commerce company, built to champion the region and shape a brighter, more exciting future. 

At noon, we never stop. We're hungry for change, constantly testing, failing, learning and iterating. Growth, passion, fearlessness and tenacity drive everything we do. If you're ready to help us redefine online customer experiences, we want you on our team. 

About the role

Consumer Product teams own the systems behind what millions of customers see and do on noon every day, across the UAE, Saudi Arabia and Egypt. As a backend engineer, you will own services end to end, from the design doc to the dashboard you watch after rollout, and see your work land in front of customers quickly. 

What you'll do

- Design, build and operate high-traffic backend services and the APIs (REST and gRPC) that power noon's app and web, and evolve them without breaking existing clients. 
 - Build event-driven workflows and pipelines that react to orders, payments, deliveries and customer actions, handling retries, ordering and reprocessing safely. 
 - Integrate with internal teams and external partners, handling failures, timeouts and rate limits gracefully. 
 - Own the reliability, performance and cost of your services, with solid logging, metrics, alerting and tracing in place. 
 - Take features from problem definition through design, launch and iteration, working directly with product, design, data and business teams. 
 - Join the on-call rotation for what you own, and help the engineers around you improve through reviews and pairing. 
 - Move fast, experiment often and take ownership of measurable results. 

Level expectations

- SDE 3 (4+ years of backend engineering): Independently owns features and services end to end, writes clean, well-tested code, and handles integrations and on-call with limited guidance. 
 - SDE 4 (6+ years, leading the design of production systems): Owns the technical direction of one or more domains, leads design for complex multi-service systems, mentors others and drives cross-team initiatives. 

What you'll need

- Professional backend engineering experience in line with the level above. 
 - Strong proficiency in at least one language such as Python, Go or Java, with the appetite to pick up others. Python and Go are used day to day. 
 - Understanding of microservices and experience integrating with third-party APIs. 
 - Experience with relational databases such as MySQL, PostgreSQL or Spanner, including schema design, transactions and data consistency. 
 - Experience with asynchronous or event-driven systems such as message queues, background workers and scheduled jobs. 
 - Strong problem-solving skills and a high degree of ownership. 
 - Clear communication and the ability to work well with product, data and other engineering teams. 

Good to have

- Experience with key-value or wide-column stores such as Redis or Bigtable. 
 - Hands-on experience with Google Cloud (Pub/Sub, Spanner, BigQuery), Kubernetes and Open Telemetry. 
 - Experience with high-traffic read paths: latency budgets, caching and graceful degradation. 
 - Experience with payments, security or handling sensitive data and PII. 
 - Experience building multi-country, multi-currency products, including English and Arabic localization. 
 - Working effectively with AI coding agents, including judgement on what to verify before a change lands. 

Who will excel?

- People with high standards who understand that hard work matters. 
 - Engineers who are relentlessly resourceful and have a deep bias for action. 
 - Builders with the courage to be fiercely original. 

noon is not for everyone. Readiness to adapt, pivot and learn is essential. If you match most of this but not all of it, apply anyway.

 - Architect and implement AI agents capable of reasoning, planning, and multi-step task execution. 
 - Implement and utilize Model Context Protocol (MCP) patterns to enable structured communication between agents, tools, and systems.

 - Develop evaluation pipelines to measure accuracy, safety, and performance of AI systems. 
 - Optimize latency, cost efficiency, and scalability of AI-powered workflows.

Qualifications

 - Experience designing RESTful APIs and scalable service architectures.

data.title: Manager, Quality Engineering
data.description:
At Quickbase, we help organizations build better ways to run their operations. Our products give teams the flexibility to create applications around how their work actually happens, connecting people, information, and processes so they can keep work moving as needs change. 

For more than 25 years, organizations have turned to Quickbase to solve operational challenges that off-the-shelf software wasn't built for. Today, we're building on that foundation with new products and new possibilities for how people create, adapt, and improve the systems their work depends on. 

Working at Quickbase means helping find better ways forward. We're a team of curious, collaborative people who care about solving problems, learning as we go, and building things that make work better for our customers and each other. 

Title: Manager, Quality Engineering

Reporting to: Sr Director, Quality Engineering

Location: Bangalore, India

Department: Quality Engineering

About Quickbase

At Quickbase, we help organizations build better ways to run their operations. Our products give teams the flexibility to create applications around how their work actually happens, connecting people, information, and processes so they can keep work moving as needs change. 

For more than 25 years, organizations have turned to Quickbase to solve operational challenges that off-the-shelf software wasn't built for. Today, we're building on that foundation with new products and new possibilities for how people create, adapt, and improve the systems their work depends on. 

Working at Quickbase means helping find better ways forward. We're a team of curious, collaborative people who care about solving problems, learning as we go, and building things that make work better for our customers and each other. 

About The Role

As a Quality Engineering Manager, you will own the quality strategy for a significant product domain while leading a talented team of Quality Engineers supporting multiple engineering teams. Through your partnership with other Quality Engineering (QE) leaders, you'll help shape and evolve our quality tooling and practices and continue to build a culture where quality is a shared responsibility. 

Our teams support quality efforts across multiple product domains, invest heavily in automation, and embrace AI-assisted development. This role requires technical judgement, strong people leadership, and the ability to build trust across teams. 

Success in this role is measured by the quality of the software your team helps deliver, the growth of the quality engineers you lead, and your ability to influence how quality is built into the software development lifecycle. 

What You'll Do

- Lead, coach, and develop a team of 6-10 Quality Engineers supporting multiple engineering teams and product initiatives. 
 - Own the quality strategy for a product domain by partnering closely with other leaders, tech leads, and product managers to improve software quality, delivery predictability, and customer outcomes. 
 - Provides technical and architectural leadership in test automation, frameworks, CI/CD, and testing standards. 
 - Partner with QE leadership to define and evolve scalable quality practices and AI-assisted testing solutions, translate those into clear team priorities and goals, and drive consistent adoption to improve quality outcomes
 - Balance competing priorities across multiple engineering teams, helping stakeholders understand tradeoffs while ensuring the highest-value work receives appropriate quality investment. 
 - Coach and mentor through clear, actionable feedback -- developing technical and leadership capabilities, clarifying promotion expectations, and supporting career growth. 
 - Lead teams through ambiguity, changing priorities, and organizational change while maintaining focus, engagement, and delivery excellence. 
 - Influence engineering teams to build quality earlier in the software development lifecycle through collaboration, data, and thoughtful decision-making. 

About You

You believe quality engineering is much more than finding defects - it's a shared engineering responsibility woven into how software gets built. You also lead by helping others do their best work, and you measure your own success by theirs. 

You Will Be Successful In This Role If You

- Build trust quickly with your team and other leaders and teams in the organization. 
 - Lead with curiosity, active listening, empathy, and thoughtful communication. 
 - Make informed decisions in an environment where priorities can change or information is incomplete. 
 - Balance customer needs, quality, delivery timelines, and business priorities when making tradeoffs
 - Create an inclusive, collaborative environment where individuals feel empowered to learn, experiment, and continuously improve. 
 - Believe your success is a reflection of the success, engagement, and growth of your team. 

Experience We Think You'll Need

- Demonstrated success managing and developing a high-performing Quality Engineering team. 
 - Experience with or working knowledge of AI-assisted software development; including AI assisted test generation, model evaluation, and skills/playbooks. 
 - Experience developing and scaling quality processes that drive greater efficiency and support organizational growth. 
 - Experience leading and working with distributed teams across multiple locations and time zones. 
 - Understanding of fundamental quality engineering strategies and practices. 
 - Demonstrated ability to influence decisions on teams without direct authority. 
 -

Why Quickbase?

At Quickbase, Quality Engineering is a strategic partner in how software is built and this role carries real scope: you'll help shape and evolve our quality strategy not just execute someone else's plan. 

Quality Engineering is also at an inflection point. We're actively building what AI-assisted quality engineering looks like in practice, and this role has direct influence over how that evolves - not adopting a playbook someone else already wrote. 

You'll do this alongside the rest of the QE leadership team -- sharing practices, tackling problems together, and growing together. You won't be leading in isolation. 

If you want a role where your decisions shape how quality is built across a growing organization, and you want to help define what quality engineering looks like in an AI-driven future, we'd love to talk. 

Important Notices

Recorded Interviews. Quickbase uses an interview recording tool to record and transcribe interviews for evaluation purposes in accordance with applicable privacy laws. By participating in an interview, you consent to this recording and transcription. 

Interview Integrity. AI is part of how we work at Quickbase - we expect you to use it too. Your application and interviews should still reflect you and your own thinking. We'll tell you when AI is encouraged throughout the selection process. Misrepresentation at any stage may result in removal from consideration for this and future roles. 

How We Review Applications We use AI throughout our hiring process to help review, screen, schedule interviews, and assess applications. These tools support our team's review; they do not replace it, and every hiring decision is made by a person. 

Equal Opportunity Statement

Quickbase is committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply - even if you don't meet every qualification listed. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. 

Benefits

- Modern Health
 - Group Medical Insurance
 - Night Shift Allowance
 - Hybrid Work Allowance
 - Mobile and Internet Allowance
 - Meal Benefit
 - Office Transportation
 - On-Call Weekend Allowance
 - Weekend Working Allowance
 - Employee Referral Bonus

data.title: Lead Workplace Engineer
data.description:
Your Future Evolves Here

Evolent partners with health plans and providers to achieve better outcomes for people with most complex and costly health conditions. Working across specialties and primary care, we seek to connect the pieces of fragmented health care system and ensure people get the same level of care and compassion we would want for our loved ones. 

Evolent employees enjoy work/life balance, the flexibility to suit their work to their lives, and autonomy they need to get things done. We believe that people do their best work when they're supported to live their best lives, and when they feel welcome to bring their whole selves to work. That's one reason why diversity and inclusion are core to our business. 

Join Evolent for the mission. Stay for the culture. 

What You'll Be Doing: 

Job Summary

This role designs, architects and improves all Microsoft 365 technologies, Intune Suite, Purview, Copilot and integrations with adjacent technologies. The lead seeks to improve digital employee experience, across all digital touch points and proactively addresses security gaps. The engineer also collaborates with technology vendors, product managers, IT security and legal or compliance teams to ensure alignment with company policy and applicable legislation. 

This role also leads the development and governance of agentic AI solutions-building autonomous agents and AI-driven automation that eliminate manual, repeatable work across the digital workplace-and sets the engineering standards other engineers follow when building with AI. 

Essential Functions

- Implement, monitor and operate digital workplace technologies (endpoint hardware, software, services and SaaS tools)
 - Integrate digital workplace technologies with adjacent technologies (identity, security, vulnerability management, IT service and asset management, remote access, backup, directory services, etc. )
 - Ensure stability and security of digital workplace technology through effective endpoint management and timely patching
 - Support security operations processes by monitoring and reporting anomalies related to devices and identities
 - Actively participate in resolving high-priority outages, troubleshooting efforts and capacity/availability planning sessions
 - Establish computing configuration and operating standards in coordination with IT colleagues
 - Work on various digital workplace technology projects
 - Create, publish and communicate knowledgebase articles
 - Monitor technology trends and seek ways to enhance continuous improvement initiatives
 - Assess criticality of services and applications and automate testing of those deemed critical before patching and upgrading
 - Provide IT support for issues escalated from level 1 or level 2
 - Participate in the major incident management process to investigate, diagnose and remediate digital workplace technology outages
 - Act as mentor for the IT support and operations teams, forming a tight partnership for mutual success. Ensure information is flowing freely to minimize siloed operations and engineering
 - Build and deploy agentic AI solutions that autonomously execute multi-step digital workplace workflows
 - Write and maintain production-quality code and scripts (Python, PowerShell, C#, or similar) to build integrations, APIs and automation pipelines
 - Define engineering standards, guardrails and governance for the secure, responsible design and deployment of AI agents, including least-privilege permissions, human-in-the-loop controls, evaluation and observability
 - Partner with the organization's AI initiatives to define agent ownership models, reusable agent design patterns and application lifecycle management (ALM) practices
 - Evaluate emerging agentic AI platforms, models and tools; lead proof-of-concept development and build/buy recommendations for enterprise adoption

Required Qualifications

- 10+ years managing or supporting IT systems and platforms
 - 5+ years of experience implementing digital employee experience (DEX), endpoint management, analytics and automation tools
 - Experience with standard IT operations frameworks (e. g. , ITIL)
 - Digital workplace tool management expertise: tools, techniques, monitoring and integration
 - Experience with configuration management, identity and access management, active directory, desktop virtualization, collaboration platforms and other cloud-based services
 - Experience implementing modern management of endpoint devices
 - Experience with continuous engineering or other agile methods to keep pace with frequent changes and to reduce complexity
 - Ability to write technical documentation
 - Demonstrated coding/scripting ability (Python, PowerShell, C#, or similar) with a track record of building and maintaining automation, integrations or tools in a production environment
 - Hands-on experience building or deploying agentic AI solutions 
 - Working knowledge of LLM integration patterns: prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and tool/function calling
 - Understanding of responsible AI, security and governance practices for autonomous systems, including least-privilege access, human-in-the-loop review and monitoring/evaluation of agent outputs

Preferred Qualifications

- Natural excitement and ability to learn technologies and explain technical issues to a variety of audiences and levels
 - Passionate about DEX, with an awareness of the latest digital trends
 - Experience using automation to drive continuous improvement, including the use of AI/ML
 - Experience leading or contributing to an internal AI pod or scrum team, including agent design, use-case development and ALM practices
 - Familiarity with the Model Context Protocol (MCP) or similar tool-integration standards for connecting agents to enterprise systems
 - Experience with agent evaluation and observability practices (tracing, testing harnesses, accuracy/cost monitoring) to ensure agents are safe, reliable and cost-effective in production

Preferred Education

- Bachelor's degree in IT or related field. 

Preferred Certifications

- Microsoft Certified: Azure AI Engineer Associate (AI-102) or equivalent agentic AI certification

General Performance Criteria

As the Lead Digital Workplace Engineer, you will be required to fulfill your responsibilities while meeting the following general performance criteria for this position at this level: 

Expertise: You have very deep knowledge of the skills necessary to perform your role, and the structure of the technology for which you are responsible. 

Communication: You guide others through problem solving whether it is a technical issue, project impediment, or conflict. 

Domain: You guide the delivery of your team to make a positive impact on other parts of the company based on detailed knowledge of the needs of those stakeholders and how those needs are supported by your team. 

System: You own relevant segment of systems that are used regularly for the business to function and are well versed in the related KPIs. 

Process: You question the status quo in a constructive manner to find areas for the team to improve. 

Influence: You regularly make an impact to your entire team. 

To ensure a secure hiring process we have implemented several identity verification steps, including submission of a government issued photo ID. We conduct identity verification during interviews, and final interviews may require onsite attendance. All candidates must complete a comprehensive background check, in-person I-9 verification, and may be subject to drug screening prior to employment. The use of artificial intelligence tools during interviews is prohibited and monitored. Misrepresentation will result in immediate disqualification from consideration. 

Mandatory Requirements: 

Employees must have a high-speed broadband internet connection with a minimum speed of 50 Mbps and the ability to set up a wired connection to their home network to ensure effective remote work. These requirements may be updated as needed by the business. 

Evolent is an equal opportunity employer and considers all qualified applicants equally without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or disability status. If you need reasonable accommodation to access the information provided on this website, please contact recruitingteam@evolent. com for further assistance. 

The expected base salary/wage range for this position is $. As part of our total compensation package, Evolent is proud to offer comprehensive benefits (including health insurance benefits) to qualifying employees. All compensation determinations are based on the skills and experience required for the position and commensurate with experience of selected individuals, which may vary above and below the stated amounts.

data.title: Senior Manager WOP
data.description:
Who are Inchcape

At Inchcape Shipping Services, our vision is to create a connected world where customers can trade successfully and make informed decisions in every port, everywhere. We achieve this by combining our worldwide infrastructure with local expertise, through our global network of more than 250 proprietary offices and a team of over 3, 000 dedicated professionals. Our diverse customer base includes owners and charterers in the oil, cruise, container, and bulk commodity sectors, as well as naval, government, and intergovernmental organizations. 

We have an ambitious growth model, and a career here is certainly going to be a rewarding one that will allow you to bring your skills & experience. We embrace change and are open to new thinking and pushing for positive change in our industry. 

Main Purpose of Job : 

- Lead the World of Ports (WOP) marine data and operational delivery function, acting as the senior maritime subject-matter expert between global Inchcape teams, product, technology and customers. 
 - Own delivery against KPIs for collection, verification, validation and publication of port, terminal, berth, vessel and marine-operational datasets and APIs, ensuring accuracy, timeliness and operational relevance. 
 - Translate practical seagoing and port-operational expertise into product requirements, customer use cases and continuous improvements that support safe, efficient and commercially sound maritime decision-making. 

Key Accountabilities : 

- Lead, coach and develop the WOP marine/data operations team, setting clear standards for performance, quality and professional growth. 
 - Act as the senior marine subject-matter expert for port, terminal, berth, vessel and cargo operations across WOP products and services. 
 - Own marine-data governance, validation standards and quality controls to ensure data is operationally credible, consistent and fit for customer use. 
 - Engage directly with shipowners, operators, charterers, terminals, ports and other customers to understand operational needs and convert feedback into actionable requirements. 
 - Build strong working relationships across the Inchcape global network to improve source coverage, verification discipline and timeliness of marine information. 
 - Partner with Product, Technology and Data teams to define specifications, acceptance criteria and priorities for maritime data and digital solutions. 
 - Provide marine-operational oversight for new datasets, APIs and product features, ensuring outputs reflect real-world shipping and port workflows. 
 - Use data and domain insight to identify gaps, trends and opportunities, providing clear recommendations that support the WOP product roadmap. 
 - Manage multiple workstreams and improvement initiatives, balancing operational delivery, customer priorities, risk and strategic objectives. 
 - Establish and maintain SOPs, controls, documentation and audit trails that strengthen operational resilience and data quality. 
 - Represent WOP in customer and stakeholder forums, communicate progress to senior management, and support sprint/release readiness from a marine-business perspective. 

Key Deliverables

- Demonstrable senior-level maritime experience with strong practical knowledge of vessel operations, ports, terminals, berths, cargo operations and port agency workflows. 
 - Strong marine assurance and operational risk mindset, with the ability to assess the reliability and operational relevance of maritime information. 
 - Consistently high data quality, verification and service performance against agreed KPIs and customer expectations. 
 - Successful conversion of marine-domain knowledge and customer feedback into clear product requirements, user stories and acceptance criteria. 
 - Effective leadership of a geographically dispersed team, with measurable improvements in capability, accountability, quality and productivity. 
 - Trusted engagement with senior internal stakeholders and external maritime customers, supported by clear, credible and concise communication. 
 - Successful delivery of marine-data, API and digital initiatives in partnership with Product, Technology and Data teams. 
 - Well-governed processes, SOPs and controls that support traceability, continuous improvement and operational resilience. 
 - Proactive identification of data gaps, customer pain points and maritime-market opportunities that inform the WOP roadmap and priorities. 

Skills and Experience required : 

- Marine Operations Expertise: In-depth knowledge of vessel operations, ports, terminals, berths, cargo handling, port agency processes and ship/shore interfaces. 
 - Seagoing / Marine Background: Senior officer-level seagoing or equivalent shore-based marine operations experience, with strong practical understanding of shipboard and port operations. 
 - Marine Assurance & Risk: Sound knowledge of marine assurance, operational risk, HSSE principles and safe operating practices relevant to vessels and terminals. 
 - Data Governance: Ability to define verification rules, quality controls and governance standards for critical maritime operational data. 
 - Customer & Stakeholder Engagement: Credible communication with shipowners, operators, charterers, ports, terminals, agents and senior internal stakeholders. 
 - Product & Business Translation: Ability to convert marine workflows, operational pain points and customer needs into product requirements, user stories and acceptance criteria. 
 - Digital Maritime Transformation: Strong understanding of maritime digitalisation, data platforms, APIs, vessel/port intelligence and technology-enabled operational decision support. 
 - Team Leadership: Proven ability to lead, coach and develop multidisciplinary and geographically dispersed teams while setting clear performance standards. 
 - Project & Delivery Management: Ability to manage concurrent workstreams, priorities, risks, dependencies and delivery milestones in a fast-paced environment. 
 - Commercial Awareness: Understanding of how reliable port and vessel intelligence supports voyage planning, chartering, operations, demurrage, risk and customer value. 
 - Analytical Capability: Ability to interpret complex maritime datasets, identify anomalies and trends, and communicate practical insights to technical and non-technical audiences. 
 - Change & Continuous Improvement: Ability to improve processes, introduce new standards and guide teams through operational and technology change. 
 - Communication & Reporting: Strong written and verbal communication skills, including senior-management reporting and customer-facing presentations. 
 - Problem Solving & Judgement: Sound operational judgement with a structured approach to resolving data, process, customer and delivery issues. 

Experience : 

- Maritime Experience: Typically 10+ years in shipping, marine operations, ports, terminals, vessel operations or closely related maritime roles. 
 - Senior Marine Responsibility: Experience at senior officer level at sea (preferably Master Mariner / Chief Engineer / Chief Officer / Second Engineer) or equivalent senior shore-based marine responsibility. 
 - Port & Terminal Operations: Hands-on exposure to port calls, berth/terminal operations, cargo operations, marine services and ship/shore coordination. 
 - Marine Assurance: Experience applying marine assurance, HSSE, operational risk or compliance principles in vessel, port or terminal environments. 
 - Leadership & People Management: Proven experience leading teams, setting standards, managing performance and developing capability. 
 - Maritime Data / Digital Solutions: Experience using or delivering maritime data, port intelligence, vessel-tracking, API, analytics or other digital shipping solutions. 
 - Customer Relations: Experience engaging maritime customers and stakeholders, gathering requirements and resolving operational or service issues. 
 - Product / Project Delivery: Experience contributing to or leading product, data or technology initiatives from requirement definition through implementation. 
 - Data Quality & Governance: Experience establishing validation processes, quality controls, SOPs and traceable governance for operational information. 
 - Cross-functional Working: Demonstrated ability to work effectively across marine operations, commercial, product, technology and data teams. 
 - Global / Distributed Operations: Experience working across different geographies, cultures and time zones in a global maritime environment. 
 - Change Management: Track record of implementing process or technology change while maintaining operational delivery. 
 - Executive Communication: Experience providing concise progress, risk and recommendation updates to senior management and external stakeholders. 
 - Continuous Improvement: Demonstrated record of improving operational quality, efficiency, customer outcomes or data reliability

Education and Professional Qualification : 

Essential: Recognised marine qualification and substantial maritime operating experience. 

Preferred: Master Mariner (STCW II/2), Chief Engineer (STCW III/2), or equivalent senior deck/engine certification. Alternatively, a degree in Nautical Science, Marine Engineering, Maritime Studies or Marine Operations supported by significant vessel, port or terminal experience. A relevant management, project-management or digital/data qualification is advantageous. 

Why Inchcape Shipping Services?

We believe in building a diverse and high-performing workforce that works together to provide our customers with the exceptional service they deserve. To reach the highest standards, we depend on our people, their welfare, training and expertise. We realize the value of our staff and know that your unique experiences, skills and passions will help you to build a rich and rewarding career in our dynamic industry. 

Our values are at the centre of everything we do, and the successful candidate will be expected to demonstrate and fully adopt these: 

Global Perspective - we connect the world and see the bigger picture. 

The Power of People - we rely on the strength of local agent knowledge and relationships. 

Progress - we adopt new thinking and push for positive change in our industry. 

In return, we will offer you: 

A diverse range of benefits, depending on your geographical location. Globally, as a minimum, you will receive: 

- A retirement savings plan
 - Holiday
 - Competitive salary
 - Employee Assistance Programme
 - Career development and progression opportunities
 - Values Award celebration events

Plus, much more!

If you think that you have the right skills, knowledge and attitude to join our team, then we invite you to apply by simply clicking at the top of this advert!

#ISSthebiggerpicture

Appointment to this role will be subject to satisfactory references and possession of a valid Right to Work documentation depending upon your geographical location. 

Inchcape is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer and equality, diversity and inclusion are at the centre of everything we do. We recognise that our customers, colleagues, contractors and other partners are central to our success and that we work in a diverse society. We acknowledge not only our legal, but also our moral responsibility to ensure all groups have equality of opportunity.

data.title: Quality Manager (QA)
data.description:
QA-Manager Criteria

B Tech (Chemical, Food, Cosmetics) with minimum 3 to 7 years of experience as QA head in cosmetics/ FMCG industry

- Quality System Oversight
 - Develop, implement, and maintain GMP (Good Manufacturing Practices) and ISO standards for cosmetics production. 
 - Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements (FDA, EU Cosmetics Regulation, BIS in India, etc. ). 
 - Raw Material & Supplier Quality Control
 - Establish and monitor quality standards for incoming raw materials, packaging, and ingredients. 
 - Conduct supplier audits and approve vendors based on quality performance. 
 - Production Process Monitoring
 - Supervise in-process quality checks during mixing, filling, and packaging stages. 
 - Identify deviations and implement corrective/preventive actions (CAPA). 
 - Finished Product Testing & Release
 - Oversee microbiological, stability, and performance testing of finished products. 
 - Approve batch release only after meeting defined quality specifications. 
 - Documentation & Reporting
 - Maintain accurate records of quality inspections, audits, and test results. 
 - Prepare monthly quality reports and present findings to senior management. 
 - Training & Team Development
 - Train production and QA staff on hygiene, safety, and quality protocols. 
 - Build a culture of continuous improvement and quality awareness across departments. 
 - Customer Complaint & Recall Management
 - Investigate product complaints and implement root cause analysis. 
 - Lead recall procedures if necessary, ensuring consumer safety and regulatory compliance. 

About Company

Founded in 2011, Purplle has emerged as one of India's premier omnichannel beauty destinations, redefining the way millions shop for beauty. With 1, 000+ brands, 60, 000+ products, and over 7 million monthly active users, Purplle has built a powerhouse platform that seamlessly blends online and offline experiences. 

Expanding its footprint in 2022, Purplle introduced 6, 000+ offline touchpoints and launched 100+ stores, strengthening its presence beyond digital. Beyond hosting third-party brands, Purplle has successfully scaled its own D2C powerhouses-FACES CANADA, Good Vibes, Carmesi, Purplle, and NY Bae-offering trend-driven, high-quality beauty essentials. 

What sets Purplle apart is its technology driven hyper-personalized shopping experience. Staff Embedded SW/FW Engineer (Bringup)

Graphcore is a globally recognised leader in Artificial Intelligence computing systems. As part of the SoftBank Group, Graphcore is a member of an elite family of companies responsible for some of the world's most transformative technologies. Job Summary

We have an exciting opportunity to be part of a collaborative, cross-functional development team developing C code used to validate cutting-edge, high-performance AI chips and platforms. You will play a critical role in supporting new product introductions and post-silicon validation. 

Working within the Post-Silicon Bringup team, you will be involved with bringing first silicon to life, developing code primarily in C to configure and exercise systems and sub-systems on new silicon devices, and working closely with many other teams to help it become a fully characterised and working product, reporting project status/progress to program management on a regular basis. You will have the opportunity to, and be responsible for, leading, mentoring, and providing technical guidance to other engineering team members. In this role, you can leverage your experience and industry knowledge to architect and drive implementation of continuous improvements to test infrastructure and processes. 

The Team

The Post-Silicon Bringup team sits within the Architecture and Validation team, we are responsible for bringup and validation of new silicon when it returns from manufacture, enabling and supporting the production SW and FW teams to bring up their software and supporting the Silicon Characterisation team. 

Responsibilities And Duties

- Plan, design, develop and debug silicon bringup sequences and test in bare metal C/C++ on FPGA/Emulator prior to first silicon
 - Deploy configuration sequences and validation tests on first silicon and debug them
 - Develop automated test framework and regression test suites in Python to optimize validation efficiency
 - Collaborate closely with engineers from many other disciplines on a variety of topics
 - Work with Validation and Production Test engineering peers to implement best practices and continuous improvements to test methodologies
 - Analyse test results, identify and debug failures/defects
 - Contribute to shared test and validation infrastructure
 - Provide feedback to architects

Candidate Profile

Essential

- Strong experience in Bare metal / embedded C/C++
 - Good knowledge of digital ASICs. 
 - Be highly motivated, a self starter, and a team player 
 - Ability to work across teams and programming languages to find root causes of deep and complex issues
 - Experience of the post-silicon validation process applied in digital ASIC environments
 - Python, Linux
 - Excellent communication skills and the ability to collaborate with others to solve problems. 
 - Excellent problem-solving, analytical & diagnostic skills

Desirable

 - Good knowledge of mixed-signal building blocks such as PLLs, high speed PHYs and IC control/communication protocols is highly desirable. 
 - Experience of Arm CPUs, System IP and debug tools. 
 - Experience of AMBA protocols. 
 - Understanding of ML applications and their workloads. 
 - Experience in Characterization, Failure Analysis, Test Development, Statistical analysis, and Customer Support

Benefits

In addition to a competitive salary, Graphcore offers a competitive benefits package. We welcome people of different backgrounds and experiences; we're committed to building an inclusive work environment that makes Graphcore a great home for everyone. We offer an equal opportunity process and understand that there are visible and invisible differences in all of us. From Fivetran's founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. About Us

Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data. 

Together, we're delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data - from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on. 

Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions.
