Overview

At Zebra, we are a community of innovators who come together to create new ways of working. United by curiosity and a culture of caring, we develop smart solutions that anticipate our customer's and partner's needs and solve their challenges. 

Being part of Zebra Nation means you are seen, heard, valued, and respected. Drawing from our unique perspectives, we collaborate to deliver on our purpose. Here you are part of a team pushing boundaries today to redefine the work of tomorrow for organizations, their employees, and those they serve. 

You'll have opportunities to learn and lead in a forward-thinking environment, defining your path to a fulfilling career while channeling your skills toward causes you care about-locally and globally. 

Come make an impact every day at Zebra. 

What We're Looking For

Analyzes, designs, develops, and maintains software solutions for the organization's products and systems. Leads system integration of software and hardware to ensure consistent performance and program reliability. Develops, validates, and tests software functionality and user documentation. Work is evaluated upon completion to ensure objectives and quality standards are met. Determines and develops innovative approaches to solve complex problems, leveraging technical expertise and industry best practices. 

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

- Establishes requirements for moderately complex software design projects
 - Prioritizes features to ensure the most impactful are implemented first
 - Leads and participates in code reviews, proactively identifying and addressing issues early in the development process
 - Completes all phases of moderately complex software design and development projects, including in process and final inspections to meet quality standards
 - Develops and tests comprehensive documentation to support software projects, including design specifications, code comments, and user manuals
 - Explores and applies the latest technologies and innovative approaches to enhance software designs and implementations
 - Reviews and refines existing software or firmware designs, identifying opportunities for optimization and improvement
 - Provides recommendations and solutions to technical problems, leveraging expertise across multiple technical domains
 - May develop custom tools or scripts to streamline analysis, debugging, or problem solving processes
 - Exercises sound judgment in selecting methods and techniques to deliver effective solutions to complex problems
 - Works with minimal supervision, receiving general guidance on new assignments and strategic objectives
 - Provides mentorship and guidance to junior level personnel, including both exempt and non-exempt team members
 - Builds strong professional networks with senior internal and external stakeholders, frequently engaging in inter-organizational and customer-focused discussions

Job Requirements

- Bachelors Degree or Advanced Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related engineering discipline
 - 5+ years of relevant software engineering experience. 3+ years of experience with an Advanced Degree
 - Equivalency: Equivalent work experience will be considered in lieu of a degree

Key Skills And Competencies

- Proficient in multiple programming languages and software development frameworks
 - Strong understanding of software architecture, design patterns, system-level programming, and adopting GenAI in Software Development Lifecycle
 - Experience with software testing strategies, debugging tools, and performance optimization techniques
 - Ability to evaluate and integrate new technologies into existing software solutions
 - Strong problem solving skills with a demonstrated ability to develop innovative solutions to complex challenges
 - Proficiency with version control systems (e. g. , Git, GitHub) and familiarity with CI/CD pipelines
 - Excellent communication and collaboration skills with the ability to mentor and influence junior team members
 - Experience working with cross-functional teams and engaging with external customers or stakeholders
 - Demonstrated ability to work independently while effectively managing multiple priorities

Position Specific Information

- Travel Requirements: Up to 15%
 - Able to Telework?: Hybrid

Physical Demands

- Sedentary work that primarily involves sitting or standing

Benefits

We understand the importance of work-life balance and wellbeing, which is why we offer flexibility for our teams including: hybrid work, adaptable hours, Summer Flex Fridays, Focus Fridays, and an annual companywide well-being day to promote revitalization and success. 

Job Posting Statement

To protect candidates from falling victim to online fraudulent activity involving fake job postings and employment offers, please be aware our recruiters will always connect with you via @zebra. com email accounts. Applications are only accepted through our applicant tracking system and only accept personal identifying information through that system. Our Talent Acquisition team will not ask for you to provide personal identifying information via e-mail or outside of the system. If you are a victim of identity theft contact your local police department. 

AI Technology Statement

Zebra Technologies leverages AI technology to evaluate job applications using objective, job-relevant criteria. This approach enhances efficiency and promotes fairness in the hiring process. However, every decision regarding interviews and hiring is made by our dedicated team, because we believe people make the best decisions about people. For more on how we use technology in hiring and how we process applicant data, see our Zebra Privacy Policy.

Are you ready to make an impact at DTCC?

Do you want to work on innovative projects, collaborate with a dynamic and supportive team, and receive investment in your professional development? At DTCC, we are at the forefront of innovation in the financial markets. We are committed to helping our employees grow and succeed. We believe that you have the skills and drive to make a real impact. We foster a thriving internal community and are committed to creating a workplace that looks like the world that we serve. 

The Information Technology group delivers secure, reliable technology solutions that enable DTCC to be the trusted infrastructure of the global capital markets. The team delivers high-quality information through activities that include development of essential, building infrastructure capabilities to meet client needs and implementing data standards and governance. 

Pay And Benefits

- Competitive compensation, including base pay and annual incentive
 - Comprehensive health and life insurance and well-being benefits, based on location
 - Pension / Retirement benefits
 - Paid Time Off and Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well-being. 
 - DTCC offers a flexible/hybrid model of 3 days onsite and 2 days remote (onsite Tuesdays, Wednesdays and a third day unique to each team or employee). 

The Impact You Will Have In This Role

The Development family is responsible for creating, designing, deploying, and supporting applications, programs, and software solutions. May include research, new development, prototyping, modification, reuse, re-engineering, maintenance, or any other activities related to software products used internally or externally on product platforms supported by the firm. The software development process requires in-depth subject matter expertise in existing and emerging development methodologies, tools, and programming languages. Software Developers work closely with business partners and / or external clients in defining requirements and implementing solutions. The Software Engineering role specializes in planning, documenting technical requirements, designing, developing, and testing all software systems and applications for the firm. Works closely with architects, product managers, project management, and end-users in the development and enhancement of existing software systems and applications, proposing and recommending solutions that solve complex business problems. 

Your Primary Responsibilities

- Act as a technical expert on one or more applications utilized by DTCC
 - Work with the Business System Analyst to ensure designs satisfy functional requirements
 - Partner with Infrastructure to identify and deploy optimal hosting environments
 - Tune application performance to eliminate and reduce issues
 - Research and evaluate technical solutions consistent with DTCC technology standards
 - Align risk and control processes into day to day responsibilities to monitor and mitigate risk; escalates appropriately
 - Apply different software development methodologies dependent on project needs
 - Contribute expertise to the design of components or individual programs, and participate in the construction and functional testing
 - Support development teams, testing, troubleshooting, and production support
 - Create applications and construct unit test cases that ensure compliance with functional and non-functional requirements
 - Work with peers to mature ways of working, continuous integration, and continuous delivery
 - Aligns risk and control processes into day to day responsibilities to monitor and mitigate risk; escalates appropriately

Qualifications

- Minimum of 6 years of related experience
 - Bachelor's degree preferred or equivalent experience

Talents Needed For Success

- Fosters a culture where honesty and transparency are expected. 
 - Stays current on changes in his/her own specialist area and seeks out learning opportunities to ensure knowledge is up-to-date. 
 - Invests effort to individually coach others. 
 - Builds collaborative teams across the organization. 
 - Communicates openly keeping everyone across the organization informed. 

Actual salary is determined based on the role, location, individual experience, skills, and other considerations. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

data.title: Software Engineer (Product)
data.description:
About Avoca

Avoca is transforming how home service companies engage with their customers. Our AI-powered conversational agents handle every high-value inbound call, from booking jobs, qualifying leads, and driving higher revenue, all at a speed and consistency unmatched by human call centers. 

We're a Series B startup backed by Kleiner Perkins, Meritech Capital, General Catalyst, and other top-tier investors, with $125M raised and a $1B valuation. We grew 10x in 2025 and have scaled to 170+ employees in under two years across our NYC headquarters and Santa Barbara office. 

In a $1T+ market where 85% of missed calls go to competitors, we're building the category-defining platform for AI-driven customer engagement, serving the largest brands in home services. With high-energy, in-office teams in both locations, every hire here has an immediate and visible impact. 

About The Role

We're looking for a software engineer who ships fast without dropping quality. You'll own features end-to-end with support from senior engineers, learn how AI systems behave in production, and see your work reach customers within days rather than quarters. The Bengaluru team is product engineering, so everything you build is customer-facing. 

What You'll Do

- Development & Implementation - Build scalable backend services, APIs, and AI-powered features using TypeScript/Node. js, Python, and cloud platforms. 
 - Collaboration & Learning - Work closely with senior engineers, participate in code reviews, and contribute to technical and architecture discussions. 
 - Product Integration - Partner with Product, Design, and Customer Success to translate requirements into robust, customer-facing solutions. 

Specifically, you'll: 

- Build and ship features end-to-end, from backend services to customer-facing interfaces. 
 - Work on AI-powered workflows: prompt design, evaluation, and the systems that make LLMs reliable in production. 
 - Build integrations with CRM systems, scheduling platforms, and third-party communication tools. 
 - Fix real customer problems, often with a short loop between report and fix going live. 
 - Write comprehensive tests, add monitoring, and take ownership of what you ship after it ships. 
 - Participate in on-call rotation and incident response to ensure system reliability. 
 - Take loosely defined problems, ask the right questions, and drive them to done with minimal hand-holding. 

Work Environment & Schedule

- Hybrid, based in Bengaluru - regular office presence expected for collaboration and team coordination. 
 - Some overlap with US business hours may be needed for client coordination and project work. 

What You'll Bring

- 2+ years of software engineering experience, ideally full-stack, including at least 1 year in a fast-paced startup or growth-stage environment. 
 - Strong programming skills in modern JavaScript/TypeScript and Python, with backend development experience. 
 - Hands-on experience with AWS or GCP and modern deployment practices. 
 - Experience building and maintaining RESTful APIs and understanding of service-oriented architectures. 
 - Comfort working with SQL databases at scale. 
 - A track record of fast, high-quality execution - you move quickly and your work holds up. 
 - Self-driven: you unblock yourself, chase down context, and don't need work broken into small pieces. 
 - Comfort with ambiguity and changing requirements in a fast-moving startup. 
 - Curiosity about AI and LLMs - direct experience is a plus, appetite to learn is required. 
 - Low ego, high energy, and a bias toward shipping. 

Bonus Points

- Experience with AI/ML technologies, LLMs, or conversational AI systems. 
 - Background in B2B SaaS or enterprise software. 
 - Previous startup experience or exposure to rapid scaling. 
 - Contributions to open source or active developer community participation. 
 - Experience with real-time systems, or event-driven architectures. 
 - Familiarity with Docker/containerization and orchestration tools. 

Why Avoca

- Compensation in line with industry standards and above. 
 - Direct impact - your code powers thousands of businesses and millions of customer interactions. 
 - Accelerated learning - work on cutting-edge AI technology with experienced mentors. 
 - Clear paths for advancement as the company and team scale. 
 - A fast-moving, collaborative culture built for builders who thrive on speed, iteration, and impact. 

Why Avoca

At Avoca, you'll be part of a team that's building a category-defining company at the center of a massive market opportunity. We're a fast-moving, collaborative team with a culture designed for builders who thrive on speed, iteration, and impact. 

Avoca provides equal employment opportunities to applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, or disability.

data.title: Staff Developer (Python FastAPI, React)
data.description:
Job Description

If you are an Application Developer looking to grow your career building enterprise-grade product and asset management platforms, this role offers the opportunity to work on MyAssets, Field Device Data Hub (FDDH), and product documentation APIs for a global automation technology leader. Working alongside a Senior Developer, you will contribute to Python FastAPI backend services, React front-end interfaces, and REST API integrations, including third-party documentation vendor connections that support Emerson's global product information ecosystem. 

In This Role, Your Responsibilities Will Be: 

- Build and maintain Python FastAPI backend services and REST APIs supporting MyAssets, FDDH, and product documentation platforms under the guidance of the Senior Developer. 
 - Develop and maintain React. js front-end components, including state management, responsive UI, and integration with FastAPI backend services for product and asset management workflows. 
 - Write and maintain PostgreSQL queries, support schema updates, and assist with data migrations for platform databases. 
 - Assist with REST API integrations to third-party documentation platforms (Zoomin and similar) by consuming APIs, handling data transformation, and supporting publication workflows. 
 - Apply SDLC practices throughout feature delivery and design, develop, test, and support production releases across the portfolio. 
 - Debug and resolve issues across FastAPI, PostgreSQL, and React layers and escalate complex root causes to the Senior Developer with clear analysis. 
 - Write clean, well-documented, and reusable code following team standards, participate actively in code reviews, and maintain technical documentation for owned features, including API endpoint notes, data flow descriptions, and test cases. 
 - Collaborate with Product Owners, QA, and System Analysts to understand requirements and deliver quality solutions on time. 
 - Participate in Agile ceremonies and CI/CD delivery practices using Azure DevOps. 

Who You Are: 

You readily take on new challenges and display a can-do attitude in good and difficult times. You act with a clear sense of ownership and take personal responsibility for decisions, actions, and failures. You effectively communicate in various settings and provide timely, helpful information to individuals across the organization. You partner with others to get work done and create teamwork that allows the organization to achieve shared objectives. You are curious and eager to learn, you seek feedback, grow from it, and continuously improve your craft. 

For This Role, You Will Need: 

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field. 
 - 3-5 years of software development experience with hands-on delivery in Python and React in a professional environment. 
 - Proficiency in building REST API services using FastAPI, including endpoint definition, Pydantic models, request/response handling, and basic async patterns. 
 - Solid experience building React components with modern JavaScript (ES6+), state management (Redux or Context API), and integration with REST API backends. 
 - Experience consuming and building REST APIs, understanding of HTTP methods, status codes, JSON payloads, and basic authentication patterns (JWT or API key). 
 - Working knowledge of PostgreSQL or MySQL, including writing queries, basic schema understanding, and supporting data operations in a relational database environment. 
 - Familiarity with Git version control, Azure DevOps, or similar CI/CD tools, and sprint-based delivery and strong English communication skills. 

Preferred Qualifications That Set You Apart

- Experience integrating with third-party SaaS platforms or documentation tool APIs (Zoomin, Paligo, or similar) via REST. 
 - Familiarity with product information, asset management, or documentation delivery platforms. 
 - Exposure to asynchronous patterns in Python, including FastAPI Background Tasks, Celery, or task queuing basics. 
 - Experience with automated testing tools such as PyTest for backend, Jest or React Testing Library for frontend. 
 - Basic familiarity with Docker for local development environments. 
 - Experience working in international, cross-time zone Agile delivery teams. 

Our Culture & Commitment to You: 

At Emerson, we prioritize a workplace where every employee is valued, respected, and empowered to grow. We foster an environment that encourages innovation, collaboration, and diverse perspectives-because we know that great ideas come from great teams. Our commitment to ongoing career development and growing an inclusive culture ensures you have the support to thrive. Whether through mentorship, training, or leadership opportunities, we invest in your success so you can make a lasting impact. We believe diverse teams, working together are key to driving growth and delivering business results. 

We recognize the importance of employee wellbeing. We prioritize providing competitive benefits plans, a variety of medical insurance plans, Employee Assistance Program, employee resource groups, recognition, and much more. Our culture offers flexible time off plans, including paid parental leave (maternal and paternal), vacation, and holiday leave. 

About Us

WHY EMERSON

Our Commitment to Our People

At Emerson, we are motivated by a spirit of collaboration that helps our diverse, multicultural teams across the world drive innovation that makes the world healthier, safer, smarter, and more sustainable. And we want you to join us in our bold aspiration. 

We have built an engaged community of inquisitive, dedicated people who thrive knowing they are welcomed, trusted, celebrated, and empowered to solve the world's most complex problems - for our customers, our communities, and the planet. You'll contribute to this vital work while further developing your skills through our award-winning employee development programs. We are a proud corporate citizen in every city where we operate and are committed to our people, our communities, and the world at large. We take this responsibility seriously and strive to make a positive impact through every endeavor. 

At Emerson, you'll see firsthand that our people are at the center of everything we do. So, let's go. Let's think differently. Learn, collaborate, and grow. Seek opportunity. Push boundaries. Be empowered to make things better. Speed up to break through. Let's go, together. 

Accessibility Assistance or Accommodation

If you have a disability and are having difficulty accessing or using this website to apply for a position, please contact: idisability. administrator@emerson. com . 

About Emerson

Emerson is a global leader in automation technology and software. Through our deep domain expertise and legacy of flawless execution, Emerson helps customers in critical industries like life sciences, energy, power and renewables, chemical and advanced factory automation operate more sustainably while improving productivity, energy security and reliability. 

With global operations and a comprehensive portfolio of software and technology, we are helping companies implement digital transformation to measurably improve their operations, conserve valuable resources and enhance their safety. 

We offer equitable opportunities, celebrate diversity, and embrace challenges with confidence that, together, we can make an impact across a broad spectrum of countries and industries. Whether you're an established professional looking for a career change, an undergraduate student exploring possibilities, or a recent graduate with an advanced degree, you'll find your chance to make a difference with Emerson. Join our team - let's go!

No calls or agencies please.

data.title: Senior Associate Engineer - AI Services
data.description:
Make an impact with NTT DATA

Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion - it's a place where you can grow, belong and thrive. 

Your day at NTT DATA

The Senior Associate Software Development Engineer is a developing subject matter expert, tasked with supporting the designing, developing, and testing of software systems, modules, or applications for software enhancements and new products including cloud-based or internet-related tools. 

This role is accountable for supporting detailed design for certain modules/sub-systems, doing prototype for multi-vendor infrastructure, and showcasing it internally or externally to clients. 

This role designs and develops functionality in a micro-services environment working with APIs, telemetry data, and running ML/AI algorithms on it, working with both structured and unstructured data. 

Key responsibilities: 

- Receives instructions to design and develop solutions and functionality that drives the growth of business. 
 - Contributes to writing and testing code. 
 - Supports the execution of automated testing. 
 - Receives instructions from various stakeholders to participate in software deployment. 
 - Supports the delivery of software components while working in collaboration with the product team. 
 - Supports the integration and building of solutions through automation and coding, using 3rd party software. 
 - Receives instructions to craft, build, and debug large scale distributed systems. 
 - Supports writing, updating and maintaining the technical program, end-user documentation, and operational procedures. 
 - Assists with refactoring code. 
 - Contributes to the reviewing of code written by other developers. 
 - Performs any other related task as required. 

To thrive in this role, you need to have: 

- Developing understanding of cloud architecture and services in multiple public clouds like AWS, GCP, Microsoft Azure, and Microsoft Office 365. 
 - Subject matter expert in programming languages such as C/C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, Python, Node. js, libraries and frameworks. 
 - Developing expertise of data structures, algorithms, and software design with strong analytical and debugging skills. 
 - Developing knowledge of micro services-based software architecture and experience with API product development. 
 - Developing expertise in SQL and no-SQL data stores including Elasticsearch, MongoDB, Cassandra. 
 - Developing understanding of container run time (Kubernetes, Docker, LXC/LXD). 
 - Developing proficiency with agile, lean practices and believes in test-driven development. 
 - Possess a can-do attitude and one that takes initiative. 
 - Excellent ability to work well in a diverse team with different backgrounds and experience levels. 
 - Excellent ability to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment. 
 - Developing proficiency with CI/CD concepts and tools. 
 - Developing proficiency with cloud-based infrastructure and deployments. 
 - Excellent attention to detail. 

Academic qualifications and certifications: 

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field. 
 - Microsoft Certified Azure Fundamentals preferred. 
 - Relevant agile certifications preferred. 

Required experience: 

- Moderate level experience working with geo-distributed teams through innovation, bootstrapping, pilot, and production phases with multiple stakeholders to the highest levels of quality and performance. 
 - Moderate level experience with tools across full software delivery lifecycle, for example. IDE, source control, CI, test, mocking, work tracking, defect management. 
 - Moderate level experience in Agile and Lean methodologies, Continuous Delivery / DevOps, Analytics / data-driven processes. 
 - Familiarity with working with large data sets and ability to apply proper ML/AI algorithms. 
 - Moderate level experience in developing micro-services and RESTful APIs. 
 - Moderate level experience in software development. 

Workplace type:

data.title: Senior Engineering Manager
data.description:
About Ethos

Ethos (Nasdaq: $LIFE) is a leading life insurance technology company on a mission to protect families by democratizing access to life insurance and empowering agents at scale. With its robust three-sided technology platform, Ethos is transforming the life insurance experience for consumers, agents, and carriers alike. Ethos offers instant, accessible products and a seamless online process that requires no medical exams and just a few health questions; it eliminates traditional barriers, making it easier than ever for everyone to protect their families. Ethos is redefining how life insurance is bought, sold, and underwritten. 

About The Role

We're looking for a Senior Engineering Manager to lead our Platform Engineering teams at Ethos. You'll own the systems that power every policy we sell, from the moment a customer enters our funnel through the lifetime of that policy. This is a hands-on leadership role that can operate at both altitude and depth

You will be the outcome owner for the area you lead, accountable for the reliability, correctness, and velocity of the systems every other team depends on. Platform is where engineering leverage compounds, and you'll join at a point where you can shape the architecture, the strategy, and the culture of the team. 

Duties And Responsibilities

- Own the outcomes for your domain end to end - the strategy, the technical direction, and the results. 
 - Hire, grow, and retain strong engineers and leads, and mentor the team through design and architecture reviews. 
 - Partner with Product and Staff Engineers to build the technical roadmap and run quarterly planning. 
 - Own cross-team architectural decisions and the internal standards other teams build on: service decomposition, event schema evolution, inter-service contract stability, and data consistency. 
 - Set the engineering quality bar - system reliability, test coverage, incident response SLAs, and on-call health. 
 - Drive operational excellence: observability, runbook quality, postmortem culture, and the reduction of toil. 
 - Translate ambiguous business problems into well-scoped projects with clear milestones and honest timelines. 

Qualifications And Skills

Leadership

- 3+ years of engineering management experience in high-growth organizations, including managing senior ICs and leads. 
 - A track record of building high-performing teams and developing engineers to the next level. 
 - Experience managing platform teams, not just product feature teams. 
 - Strong written communication - clear in PRDs, design docs, postmortems, and upward reporting. 
 - Champions engineering quality: design patterns, code reviews, and disciplined unit, integration, and contract testing. 
 - A self-starter, comfortable with ambiguity and able to make trade-off decisions at speed without much guidance. 

Technical

- A strong engineering foundation - you've shipped production services and can hold your own in architecture reviews without being the day-to-day coder. 
 - Hands-on experience with event-driven microservices: Kafka, async event processing, and schema versioning. 
 - Backend architecture for large, high-scale web applications, including relational databases, distributed caching, and resilience patterns such as retries and dead-letter handling. 
 - Experience with AWS, and with TypeScript/Node. js backend services at scale (Go or Python a bonus). 
 - Comfort with Datadog or an equivalent for SLO definition, alerting, and incident triage. 

#SP1

Don't meet every single requirement? If you're excited about this role but your past experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. At Ethos we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace. 

We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. Pursuant to the SF Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider employment for qualified applicants with arrests and conviction records. 

To learn more about what information we collect and how it may be used, please refer to our California Candidate Privacy Notice. 

Recruitment Notice: Please be aware of recruitment scams. All legitimate communication from our team will only come from email addresses ending in @ethos. com or @getethos. com. 

We will never ask for payment, banking details, or sensitive personal information during the hiring process. If you are contacted by someone claiming to represent us from a different email address, please treat it as fraudulent.

 - Provide day-to-day people management, technical guidance, coaching, and career development for direct reports. 
 - Create a strong team culture of ownership, urgency, accountability, customer focus, engineering discipline, and continuous improvement. 
 - Manage workload, priorities, resource allocation, and execution commitments in coordination with stateside engineering leadership. 
 - Drive performance management, skills development, succession planning, and team capability growth as the Pune organization expands. 
 - Help define practical processes, communication rhythms, and handoff mechanisms that allow Pune and US-based teams to operate as one integrated engineering organization. 

Technical Leadership & Mechanical Design Oversight

- Provide experienced mechanical design leadership for data center rack, enclosure, and infrastructure product lines, including both released-product support and new design development. 
 - Apply practical knowledge of sheet metal enclosure design, manufacturing processes, tolerancing, component selection, and configuration control. 
 - Guide engineers through complex design decisions involving manufacturability, fit/function, structural integrity, serviceability, cost, quality, and compliance impact. 
 - Review and approve technical work products including 3D models, drawings, BOM updates, engineering changes, and supporting documentation. 
 - Support development and release of mechanical designs using Autodesk Inventor and PTC Creo, while ensuring consistent use of engineering standards, templates, and best practices. 
 - Ensure lessons learned from manufacturing issues, quality feedback, field concerns, and customer requirements are captured and applied to future product improvements. 

Sustaining Engineering, NPDI & Change Management Execution

- Lead and coordinate sustaining engineering activities including issue resolution, design updates, product improvements, cost reductions, component substitutions, and lifecycle support for released products. 
 - Support new product development execution by helping the Pune team contribute to design documentation, drawing release, design updates, prototype support, and transition-to-production readiness. 
 - Oversee effective execution of engineering change orders, documentation updates, BOM maintenance, part-number/revision control, and product data accuracy within ERP and PLM systems. 
 - Partner with engineering change analysts and cross-functional stakeholders to ensure changes are properly reviewed, approved, released, tracked, and implemented with minimal disruption. 
 - Investigate and resolve manufacturing, quality, supplier, and field-reported issues using structured root-cause analysis and corrective/preventive action methodologies. 
 - Balance fast response to production and customer needs with disciplined engineering change control and long-term product robustness. 

Cross-Functional & Global Collaboration

- Partner closely with US-based engineering leadership and technical leads, taking direction on priorities while providing clear local execution ownership in Pune. 
 - Maintain a few hours of daily working overlap with US Eastern Time to support standups, design reviews, issue escalation, handoffs, and real-time collaboration. 
 - Collaborate with Manufacturing, Quality, Supply Chain, Operations, Product Management, Compliance, and other engineering teams to implement changes and product improvements effectively. 
 - Support smooth transitions between new product development, production launch, and ongoing sustaining ownership. 
 - Communicate clearly across geographies, functions, and levels of the organization, escalating risks and resource needs early with proposed solutions. 

Qualifications Minimum Requirements

- Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent technical experience. 
 - 12+ years of mechanical engineering experience with strong exposure to product development, sustaining engineering, lifecycle support, manufacturing support, or related design leadership responsibilities. 
 - Demonstrated people-management experience, including hiring, onboarding, mentoring, performance management, workload planning, and career development for engineering teams. 
 - Strong mechanical design background with the ability to review, guide, and challenge detailed engineering work while also leading through others. 
 - Experience leading engineering work across cross-functional teams and globally distributed organizations. 
 - Proficiency in 3D CAD modeling and drawing release processes; Autodesk Inventor and PTC Creo experience strongly preferred. 
 - Hands-on experience with PLM/PDM systems such as Autodesk Vault, Windchill, or Agile. 
 - Experience with ERP systems such as Oracle PD Cloud, Microsoft Dynamics, or similar business systems. 
 - Strong understanding of engineering change management, BOM/documentation control, root-cause analysis, corrective action processes, and disciplined product data management. 
 - Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to collaborate effectively across geographies and time zones. 
 - Ability to make sound technical and organizational decisions with limited supervision while keeping leadership informed of risks, tradeoffs, and resource constraints. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Engineering Management, or related field. 
 - Experience building, scaling, or transforming engineering teams in a global or multi-site environment. 
 - Experience designing and supporting sheet metal enclosures and assemblies for data center, ICT, or technology infrastructure applications. 
 - Working knowledge of manufacturing processes including laser cutting, punch press, press brake, welding, assembly, and powder coating. 
 - Experience supporting high-volume, configurable, or engineered-to-order products in production. 
 - Familiarity with mechanical compliance standards relevant to data center and infrastructure products, including UL, IEC, CB schemes, seismic qualification, and environmental standards such as RoHS and REACH. 
 - Experience coordinating engineering change analysts, configuration management resources, or documentation-control activities. 
 - Experience with automation or scripting tools such as iLogic, VB. NET, Python, C#, or C++. 

What Will Make You Successful?

data.title: Principal Emulation IP Engineer
data.description:
We Are

Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow. 

You Are

You have spent years in the trenches of ASIC verification, and somewhere along the way you realized that emulation is not just another tool in the flow, it is the thing that makes or breaks your ability to ship complex IP on time. You know PCIe or DDR inside and out, not just the spec but the weird corner cases, the errata that nobody talks about, and the places where emulation models fall short of what the design team actually needs. 

You have worked on Zebu or similar platforms long enough to know what good emulation IP looks like and what happens when it is not quite right. You have closed that gap before, probably more than once, and you know how to do it without creating chaos for the teams depending on your work. Sitting with a design team in Bangalore, a verification lead in California, and an IP product manager in Europe does not faze you. You walk out with a plan that everyone believes in. 

You do not wait for perfect alignment. Ask the right questions, push back when something does not make sense, and move. At Synopsys, you will work on IP that powers the next generation of silicon, and the emulation strategies you define will directly affect how fast we get there. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Bridge the gap between Emulation IP capabilities and Design IP verification needs across both Controller and PHY domains for high-speed interfaces like PCIe and DDR
 - Define technical requirements for Emulation IP, working directly with IP development and verification teams to ensure correct implementation and deployment on Zebu platforms
 - Track and report key metrics on Emulation IP quality, performance, and coverage, driving continuous improvement across verification workflows
 - Stay ahead of evolving PCIe and DDR standards, interpret specification updates, ECNs, and errata, and translate those into actionable changes for both Emulation and Design IP teams
 - Review and validate test plans for Emulation IP and Design IP, ensuring completeness, traceability, and alignment with product quality goals
 - Collaborate cross-functionally with verification, design, product, and platform teams to optimize emulation methodologies and standardize best practices
 - Mentor engineers on emulation strategies, verification techniques, and IP development workflows

The Impact You Will Have

- Accelerate time to market for high-performance IP by defining emulation strategies that catch issues earlier and reduce silicon respins
 - Elevate product quality across Synopsys IP portfolios by ensuring Emulation IP meets the real needs of design and verification teams
 - Drive adoption of best-in-class emulation and verification methodologies that become standard practice across the organization
 - Influence the next generation of emulation solutions and workflows, positioning Synopsys as a leader in pre-silicon validation
 - Improve cross-functional collaboration and alignment between geographically distributed teams, reducing friction and rework
 - Standardize verification workflows and metrics, making it easier for teams to track progress, identify gaps, and deliver with confidence
 - Shape how Synopsys develops and deploys Emulation IP for cutting-edge digital designs and system architectures

What You'll Need

- 8+ years of hands-on experience in emulation, pre-silicon verification, or IP product development
 - Expert-level knowledge of PCIe or DDR interfaces, including protocol details, verification strategies, and real-world implementation challenges
 - Extensive experience with Zebu or similar emulation platforms, specifically for IP verification and system-level validation
 - Proven track record leading IP product development initiatives with a strong focus on emulation and verification
 - Demonstrated ability to work cross-functionally in matrixed, global teams and drive consensus across diverse stakeholders
 - Strong communication skills with the ability to influence technical direction and inspire change across engineering teams
 - Comfort working in dynamic, ambiguous environments where requirements evolve and priorities shift

Who You Are

- You can walk into a room where the Emulation IP does not quite match what the design team needs and walk out with a concrete plan to close the gap without derailing either team's schedule
 - You do not need someone to tell you what the next version of the PCIe or DDR spec means for your work. You read it, figure out the implications, and start the conversation with your team
 - You are the person people come to when emulation results do not make sense, and you know how to debug across the boundary between emulation models, RTL, and test environments
 - You push back when a test plan looks complete on paper but is missing coverage for the cases that actually matter in production
 - Mentoring engineers who are newer to emulation or IP verification comes naturally to you, and you do it in a way that builds their confidence and capability
 - You stay organized across multiple workstreams, stakeholders, and time zones without losing track of what matters most

The Team You'll Be Part Of

You will join a dynamic, high-performing engineering team focused on IP development, emulation, and verification at the forefront of semiconductor innovation. Our team is collaborative, cross-functional, and globally distributed, working together to solve complex challenges and deliver industry-leading solutions. You will have the opportunity to collaborate with experts across multiple domains, drive impactful initiatives, and shape the future of digital design and verification at Synopsys. 

Rewards and Benefits

We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

data.title: Quality Manager
data.description:
About The Role

As Quality Manager, you lead the plant quality function to deliver zero-defect manufacturing, exceed customer expectations, and ensure compliance with OEM, IATF, and regulatory standards. You drive a culture of continuous improvement by leveraging robust quality systems, data-driven decision-making, and disciplined problem-solving. Through strong leadership and collaboration across manufacturing, engineering, supplier quality, and customer teams, you enable operational excellence in quality performance and customer satisfaction while developing a high-performing quality organization. 

Key Responsibilities

- Lead the site quality function to consistently achieve world-class quality performance, customer satisfaction, and compliance with OEM and industry standards. 
 - Champion zero-defect manufacturing by driving proactive quality planning, risk mitigation, and continuous improvement initiatives across welding and assembly operations. 
 - Lead customer quality management activities, including customer complaints, audits, issue resolution, and timely closure of corrective actions. 
 - Ensure effective implementation, maintenance, and continuous improvement of the Quality Management System (QMS) in compliance with IATF 16949, ISO standards, and customer-specific requirements. 
 - Drive defect reduction initiatives through structured problem-solving methodologies and implementation of Cost of Poor Quality (COPQ) reduction strategies. 
 - Oversee Advanced Product Quality Planning (APQP), Production Part Approval Process (PPAP), Process Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (PFMEA), Statistical Process Control (SPC), Measurement System Analysis (MSA), Control Plans, and implementation of 7QC tools. 
 - Lead root cause analysis, corrective and preventive action (CAPA) processes, and systematic containment activities for internal and external quality concerns. 
 - Partner with manufacturing, engineering, maintenance, supplier quality, and customer teams to resolve quality issues and improve process capability. 
 - Establish and monitor quality KPIs, performance metrics, and reporting systems to drive accountability and visibility across the organization. 
 - Develop and coach a high-performing quality team, fostering technical excellence, ownership, and continuous learning. 
 - Ensure compliance with all safety, environmental, regulatory, and customer requirements while promoting operational discipline and best practices. 

Job Requirements

- Bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering, Production Engineering, Automobile Engineering, or a related technical discipline. 
 - Minimum 15+ years of experience in Quality Management within a Tier-1 automotive manufacturing environment. 
 - Strong expertise in welding and assembly manufacturing processes and quality management systems. 
 - Proven experience in customer quality management, audit management, complaint handling, and corrective action implementation. 
 - Demonstrated knowledge and practical application of IATF 16949, APQP, PPAP, PFMEA, SPC, MSA, Control Plans, and core quality tools. 
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with experience driving defect reductionand continuous improvement initiatives. 
 - Experience leading cross-functional teams and influencing stakeholders to achieve quality and business objectives. 
 - Proficiency in interpreting customer requirements, regulatory standards, and quality system expectations. 
 - Effective communication, coaching, and leadership skills with a strong ownership mindset and customer focus. 
 - Relevant quality certifications and automotive quality credentials are preferred.

data.title: Staff DevOps Engineer
data.description:
Are you an experienced DevOps leader with deep expertise in Azure, AWS, Kubernetes, and Infrastructure as Code? Do you enjoy building cloud platforms that are secure, scalable, and cost-efficient, and helping other engineers improve along the way? If you like hands-on technical leadership at the point where cloud infrastructure, platform engineering, and software delivery meet, we want you on our team. 

As a Staff DevOps Engineer, you'll lead the design and growth of our cloud infrastructure, platform engineering, and software delivery practices. You'll lead by example, drive application and platform modernization, and build engineering patterns that teams across the organization can reuse. You'll work closely with software engineering, architecture, security, and product teams to deliver solutions that are secure, scalable, resilient, and cost-efficient. 

About The Role

In this role as a Staff DevOps Engineer, you will: 

- Cloud platforms and delivery pipelines become more secure, scalable, and reliable, and easier for engineering teams to use. 
 - Application modernization and Kubernetes adoption move forward through practical, reusable patterns. 
 - Automation, standardization, and GitOps improve deployment quality and engineering productivity. 
 - Cloud costs are actively managed, with measurable savings and effective governance. 
 - The team gets stronger through mentoring, knowledge sharing, and higher technical standards. 
 - Build and run cloud platforms: Design, build, and run secure, scalable, highly available cloud-native platforms on Microsoft Azure and AWS. On Azure, you'll build with App Service, Function Apps, AKS, API Management, Key Vault, Service Bus, Logic Apps, SQL Server, Cosmos DB, Storage, Virtual Machines, and Azure AI Foundry. On AWS, you'll build with EC2, Lambda, Elastic Beanstalk, Textract, API Gateway, storage, and related services. 
 - Lead application modernization and Kubernetes: Lead the move of legacy and . NET applications to cloud-native, containerized architectures. Own Kubernetes and AKS architecture, deployment, security, scalability, resiliency, and day-to-day operations, including GPU-based AI and machine learning workloads. Use Helm to standardize how applications are packaged and deployed, and create platform patterns that can be reused across applications, teams, and environments. 
 - Drive Infrastructure as Code and automation: Build and maintain Infrastructure as Code with Terraform and Bicep. Create infrastructure modules and deployment patterns that are reusable, secure, compliant, and version-controlled. Expand automation and self-service so developers can deliver faster and more consistently. 
 - Improve CI/CD and GitOps: Design, build, and improve CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Workflows, GitHub Actions, and Argo CD. Advance GitOps practices and automated deployment strategies across environments to increase deployment frequency, release quality, reliability, and engineering productivity. 
 - Strengthen networking, observability, and reliability: Design and troubleshoot cloud networking, including VNets, subnets, network interfaces (NICs), private endpoints, DNS, load balancing, and network security. Set up monitoring and observability with Datadog, Azure Application Insights, and related tools. Define useful alerts, health indicators, and incident response practices. Lead root cause analysis to stop incidents from happening again. 
 - Optimize cloud costs: Find and lead cost optimization work across Azure and AWS. Balance cost, performance, security, reliability, and scalability in architecture decisions. Promote practical governance, resource usage standards, and engineering ownership of cloud spend. 
 - Lead and mentor: Act as a trusted advisor and subject matter expert on cloud, DevOps, and platform engineering. Mentor engineers, constructively challenge existing approaches, and raise the bar for architecture, automation, quality, and delivery. Lead the creation of reference architectures, technical standards, and best practices. Shape platform strategy and explain decisions, risks, and trade-offs clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. 

About You

You're a fit for the role of Staff DevOps Engineer if you have: 

- Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure and AWS. 
 - Deep experience with cloud-native architecture, distributed systems, serverless services, storage, virtual machines, managed application platforms, messaging, APIs, and both relational and NoSQL databases. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with Kubernetes and AKS, including application modernization and GPU workload deployment. 
 - Hands-on experience with Helm for Kubernetes package management. 
 - Skill in Infrastructure as Code with Terraform and Bicep. 
 - Strong CI/CD experience with GitHub Workflows, GitHub Actions, and Argo CD. 
 - Experience deploying and supporting . NET applications. 
 - Good working knowledge of Linux. 
 - Skill in Shell scripting and Python. 
 - Experience with Datadog, Azure Application Insights, or similar monitoring and observability tools. 
 - A track record of finding and delivering cloud cost savings. 
 - Working knowledge of Azure AI Foundry. 
 - Strong problem-solving, collaboration, communication, and mentoring skills. 
 - Experience building shared platform engineering capabilities used by multiple product teams. 
 - Experience putting enterprise-scale GitOps and cloud governance practices in place. 
 - Experience supporting AI/ML platforms, generative AI solutions, or GPU-enabled infrastructure. 
 - Relevant Azure, AWS, Kubernetes, or Terraform certifications. 
 - Experience working in a complex enterprise or regulated software environment. 

What's in it For You?

- Hybrid Work Model: We've adopted a flexible hybrid working environment for our office-based roles while delivering a seamless experience that is digitally and physically connected. 
 - Flexibility & Work-Life Balance: Flex My Way is a set of supportive workplace policies designed to help manage personal and professional responsibilities, whether caring for family, giving back to the community, or finding time to refresh and reset. This builds upon our flexible work arrangements, including work from anywhere for up to 8 weeks per year, empowering employees to achieve a better work-life balance. 
 - Career Development and Growth: By fostering a culture of continuous learning and skill development, we prepare our talent to tackle tomorrow's challenges and deliver real-world solutions. Our Grow My Way programming and skills-first approach ensures you have the tools and knowledge to grow, lead, and thrive in an AI-enabled future. 
 - Industry Competitive Benefits: We offer comprehensive benefit plans to include flexible vacation, two company-wide Mental Health Days off, access to the Headspace app, retirement savings, tuition reimbursement, employee incentive programs, and resources for mental, physical, and financial wellbeing. 
 - Culture: Globally recognized, award-winning reputation for inclusion and belonging, flexibility, work-life balance, and more. We live by our values: Obsess over our Customers, Compete to Win, Challenge (Y)our Thinking, Act Fast / Learn Fast, and Stronger Together. 
 - Social Impact: Make an impact in your community with our Social Impact Institute. We offer employees two paid volunteer days off annually and opportunities to get involved with pro-bono consulting projects and Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) initiatives. 
 - Making a Real-World Impact: We are one of the few companies globally that helps its customers pursue justice, truth, and transparency. Together, with the professionals and institutions we serve, we help uphold the rule of law, turn the wheels of commerce, catch bad actors, report the facts, and provide trusted, unbiased information to people all over the world. 

About Us

Thomson Reuters informs the way forward by bringing together the trusted content and technology that people and organizations need to make the right decisions. We serve professionals across legal, tax, accounting, compliance, government, and media. Our products combine highly specialized software and insights to empower professionals with the data, intelligence, and solutions needed to make informed decisions, and to help institutions in their pursuit of justice, truth, and transparency. Reuters, part of Thomson Reuters, is a world leading provider of trusted journalism and news. 

We are powered by the talents of 26, 000 employees across more than 70 countries, where everyone has a chance to contribute and grow professionally in flexible work environments. At a time when objectivity, accuracy, fairness, and transparency are under attack, we consider it our duty to pursue them. Sound exciting? data.title: QA Engineer 2 - DPP
data.description:
We're reinventing the market research industry. Let's reinvent it together. 

At Numerator, we believe tomorrow's success starts with today's market intelligence. We empower the world's leading brands and retailers with unmatched insights into consumer behavior and the influencers that drive it. 

QA Engineer - DPP

Role Overview

We are looking for a QA Engineer to support the quality, reliability, and integrity of DPP deliverables across data ingestion, transformation, APIs, and downstream reporting. The successful candidate will review requirements and acceptance criteria, design and execute manual and automated tests, validate end-to-end data flows and business rules, and work closely with Product, Engineering, and Data teams to identify defects early, reduce delivery risk, and support high-quality releases. 

Key Responsibilities

Test Planning & Design

Review requirements, acceptance criteria, and supporting documentation to create clear, traceable test scenarios and test cases for each User Story. 

Review test coverage with relevant stakeholders and maintain the regression suite to ensure ongoing support for business-critical DPP functionality. 

Test Execution & Defect Management

Execute manual and automated tests to validate new features, regression scenarios, and data transformations across the DPP platform. 

Record defects and data issues with clear reproduction steps, supporting evidence, and impact assessment to enable efficient triage and resolution. 

Work closely with Engineering and Data teams to support root-cause analysis, validate fixes, and confirm production readiness. 

Validation & Closure

Retest resolved defects and confirm that acceptance criteria, business rules, and quality expectations have been met before closure. 

Maintain accurate defect reporting, status tracking, and quality documentation to support transparent delivery decisions. 

Data Integrity & ETL Validation

Validate the accuracy, completeness, and consistency of extracted, transformed, and loaded data across the DPP platform. 

Confirm that processed data aligns with business rules, acceptance criteria, and reporting expectations. 

Continuous Improvement

Identify opportunities to improve QA processes, tooling, and automation to increase efficiency and test effectiveness. 

Contribute to knowledge sharing and continuous learning within the wider QA and delivery teams. 

Technical Skills & Tools

Mandatory Tools: 

Azure DevOps (Test Management & Release Support): Plan and execute DPP test cycles, manage test evidence and defects, support release readiness, and contribute to quality sign-off across delivery pipelines. 

Azure DevOps (Defect Tracking & Traceability): Log, triage, and track defects and data issues, maintain traceability to User Stories, data changes, and releases, and work with Engineering and Data teams on root-cause analysis and fix validation. 

SQL (Data Validation): Write and execute queries to validate data transformations, reconciliations, referential integrity, and data quality rules across staging and curated layers. 

Postman & Swagger (API Testing): Validate API contracts, schemas, authentication and authorization, error handling, and payload accuracy using Swagger/OpenAPI specifications; create and maintain collections for smoke and regression testing. 

Databricks & Azure Data Factory: Support validation of transformation logic, pipeline outcomes, and orchestration processes. Databricks is the primary platform used in DPP, while Azure Data Factory knowledge remains valuable as an additional skill aligned to broader ETL requirements. 

Programming & Frameworks: 

Python or Java: Experience using one or both languages for test automation, API checks, and data validation scripting. 

PyTest / Robot Framework / Contract Testing / Automated Data Checks: Familiarity with test frameworks and data-quality tooling to support DPP regression coverage and ongoing monitoring. 

KPIs & Success Metrics

Test Execution Delivery: Complete planned DPP test execution within agreed sprint timelines, with clear evidence and status visibility. 

Defect Detection Rate: Identify and log at least 90% of critical defects (data quality issues, pipeline failures, and API contract breaks) before release. 

Defect Turnaround Time: All defects are triaged, prioritized, and assigned within 24 hours of discovery. 

Coverage & Traceability: Maintain end-to-end coverage of User Stories, acceptance criteria, core business rules, and key data scenarios, with clear traceability across testing and release activity. 

Data Quality & Integrity: Ensure validated datasets meet transformation rules, reconciliation checks, and agreed quality tolerances for the DPP platform. 

Status Reporting: Provide weekly QA status updates covering test progress, defect trends, data quality outcomes, pipeline/API risks, and release readiness. 

Continuous Improvement: Propose at least one process or tooling improvement per quarter (e. g. , automation, data-quality checks, or pipeline monitoring) to strengthen DPP quality. 

What You'll Bring to Numerator

Candidate Profile

- Proven experience in QA or software testing within data-driven platforms, ideally involving ETL processes, APIs, and reporting or analytics solutions. 
 - Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate issues across data, APIs, and application behavior. 
 - Strong SQL knowledge is essential, including the ability to write and execute queries for data validation, reconciliation, and root-cause analysis. 
 - Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the confidence to work effectively across Product, Engineering, and Data teams. 
 - High attention to detail and a strong commitment to delivering reliable, high-quality outcomes. 

Nice-to-have Skills

- Experience testing modern data platforms, data pipelines, or cloud-based analytics solutions. 
 - Exposure to automation frameworks, CI/CD pipelines, or quality gates within engineering workflows. 
 - Understanding of API standards, data contracts, and integration testing practices. 
 - Experience working in Agile delivery environments with cross-functional product and engineering teams.

data.title: Manager Product Development
data.description:
Itron is innovating new ways for utilities and cities to manage energy and water. We create a more resourceful world to protect essential resources for today and tomorrow. Join us. 

Itron Resiliency Solutions is an innovative business unit within Itron focused on solving mission critical problems for utilities through software and AI. Resiliency Solutions offers unique, market leading solutions for front-line worker safety, storm response, excavation damage prevention, construction management, and many more. These software and AI solutions solve end-to-end challenges for the utilities that power our society and are used by the largest and most complex organizations in the world such as National Grid, Southern Company, and Exelon. 

Itron Resiliency Solutions is a global, diverse team of builders and innovators who tackle previously impossible challenges for our customers. If you have a desire to challenge yourself, solve impactful problems, and work with a passionate and talented team, this is the place. 

Position Summary

We're hiring a hands-on Engineering Manager in Bengaluru to lead a team that owns production software end to end - from what customers need, to how it's built, to how it runs. This is not a coordination role: you will still design systems, review code and get into incidents, while growing the people around you. 

Our India engineering team is taking full ownership of core products and growing quickly, including a ground-up rebuild of a customer-critical service. Y ou'll help shape how this team works, who joins it, and what it ships. Y ou'll report to the Director of Engineering and work closely with Product, Program Management, Customer Support and business stakeholders. 

What You'll Own In Your First Year

- A team and its outcomes. Lead a team of engineers (growing as we hire) and own what it delivers - measured by what changed for customers, not by tickets closed. 
 - Hiring. Help build the team: define what good looks like, interview, and close candidates. 
 - Quality as a first-class priority. Set the bar for testing, release and on-call so the team ships often without breaking customers. 
 - Technical direction. Make and document the architecture tradeoffs for your area, and stay close enough to the code to know when a design is wrong. 
 - People growth. Run 1: 1s, give direct feedback, and create stretch paths so strong engineers grow faster than a standard promotion cycle. 
 - Own: Own it end to end with Speed, quality, depth and long term vision. 

What You Must Bring

- You have led engineers. At least 2 years directly managing a team - hiring, feedback, 

performance conversations, growing people. 

- Tech-lead: A tech-lead role for at least 4 years. 
 - You are still hands-on. Y ou've designed and built production systems in the recent

past, and you can review a pull request or a design doc and find the real problem in it. 

- You've owned multiple systems in production end to end. A system or product where

you were accountable for it working for customers - releases, incidents, and the

follow-through after. 

- You've delivered under ambiguity. You've taken a problem nobody had fully defined - a new product, an inherited system, a team in transition - and turned it into something

shipped. 

We care how you engineer more than which language you did it in. 

Technical background

- You've built and run production systems with a modern stack, such as: Cloud: AWS - you've designed, deployed and operated services on it, not just consumed them. 
 - Languages: one or more modern languages such as Python, Java or JavaScript/TypeScript. 
 - Frameworks: modern service frameworks such as FastAPI, Node. js or equivalents. 
 - Databases, in depth: data modeling, query and index optimization, and scaling (replication, partitioning, caching). Y ou can walk us through a data model you designed and a performance problem you fixed, with the before and after. 

Exact tools matter less than depth. Strong experience on an equivalent stack is welcome. 

What Sets Great Candidates Apart

- Impact you can explain. You can name a result, the baseline it moved from, and how your team got there. You've also stopped or cut something that wasn't working. Teams you've grown. People you hired or coached who went on to bigger roles, and a team that got measurably better at shipping under you. 
 - Scale and complexity. Y ou've handled real load, real data volume or a genuinely hard domain - and can tell the story of one hard technical problem in detail. 
 - Inherited systems. You've taken over a codebase or product from another team or location and made it better without stopping delivery. 
 - Quality discipline. Y ou've raised a team's bar on testing, releases or incident response, and can show what changed. 
 - Cross-functional range. You've worked directly with product, support and business partners, and made scoping calls rather than just executing them. 
 - Framework mindset: You have a framework mindset and find opportunities to covert a custom implementation into a framework. 

What We Look For In Everyone We Hire

Whatever the role, we hire for six things. For a manager, each one also shows up in the team you build. 

- Customer obsession. Y ou know who uses what your team builds and what changed for them. Y ou treat support escalations and on-call as signal, not chores. 
 - Impact over activity. Y ou measure success by outcomes, not sprints delivered or meetings run. Y ou'll choose the boring solution if it ships sooner. 
 - Honesty. You give credit to your team and are specific about your own part. You tell leadership bad news early, and you say what didn't work. 
 - Independence. Y ou don't need a roadmap handed to you. Y ou find the problem worth solving and get it done with little hand-holding - and you build a team that works the same way. Y ou will work with leaders who will partner with you in the journey. 
 - Passion. Not the word on a resume - the evidence: something you kept going back to, a craft you kept deepening, people you kept teaching. 
 - Depth. At least one system or domain you could talk about for an hour, down to the internals and the tradeoffs. Y ears in a role aren't depth; complexity handled is. 

Itron is committed to building an inclusive and diverse workforce and providing an authentic workplace experience for all employees. If you are excited about this role but your past experiences don't perfectly align with every requirement, we encourage you to apply anyway. In the end, you may be just who we are looking for!

The successful candidate's starting wage will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills and experience. 

Itron is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. If you require an accommodation to apply, please contact a recruiting representative at 1-800-635-5461 or email Accessibility@itron. com. 

Itron is transforming how the world manages energy, water and city services. Our trusted intelligent infrastructure solutions help utilities and cities improve efficiency, build resilience and deliver safe, reliable and affordable service. With edge intelligence, we connect people, data insights and devices so communities can better manage the essential resources they rely on to live. Join us as we create a more resourceful world: www. itron. com

data.description:
Position Summary

JOB DESCRIPTION

Vertiv is seeking a AME Manufacturing Development & Deployment Engineer. This role is the critical architect of our "Connected Factory, " responsible for the physical and digital realization of manufacturing processes on the plant floor. You will lead the deployment of advanced production lines for Power and Thermal products, ensuring that Discrete Event Simulation (DES) and Yamazumi models are executed with precision. This role requires a leader who can manage the convergence of physical equipment-such as Automation cells and DC Torque tools-with our OT digital stack, including Inductive Automation's Ignition, Power Apps, and mobile tablet integration, to ensure a seamless "Vertical Startup" with real-time data visibility

Responsibilities

- On-Site Process & OT Deployment: Lead the physical installation of manufacturing lines, integrating OT devices and Automation into a unified factory ecosystem. Orchestrate the rollout of Ignition Perspective HMI and Microsoft Power Apps to provide shop-floor operators with real-time digital work instructions and performance dashboards. 
 - Smart Tooling & IoT Integration: Direct the deployment and calibration of DC Torque tools and smart sensors. Ensure these devices are networked to capture granular assembly data (e. g. , torque curves, cycle times) to feed directly into the Digital Twin and Quality Management Systems. 
 - Factory-Level Yamazumi Execution: Validate and refine Yamazumi modeling on the shop floor. Utilize Tablets and mobile devices to conduct live work content graphing, ensuring the synchronization of manual labor with automated machine cycles to meet Takt time targets. 
 - Digital-to-Physical Validation: Use Discrete Event Simulation (DES) data to guide the layout of automation cells and material handling. Verify that the physical throughput and data latency of networked OT devices match simulation predictions, neutralizing bottlenecks during the deployment phase. 
 - Full Line Balancing & Tablet-Based SOPs: Synchronize all factory processes, deploying Tablets at each workstation to replace paper-based systems. Ensure a seamless data flow between automated cells and manual enclosure integration through integrated Power Automate workflows. 
 - Equipment & Automation Commissioning: Oversee the validation (IQ/OQ/PQ) of manufacturing equipment, including robotics, conveyors, and testing protocols. Ensure all OT infrastructure is robust, secure, and fully communicative with the broader MES/ERP environment. 
 - Digital Handoff & Hyper-care: Lead the creation of digital Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs). Act as the primary technical lead during the launch "hyper-care" period, troubleshooting both physical mechanical issues and digital logic gaps in the Ignition/Power App interface. 
 - Cross-Functional Factory Alignment: Collaborate with IT, Plant Managers, and Supply Chain to ensure the factory's network infrastructure supports high-density IoT and mobile tablet connectivity required for new deployments. 

Skills

- Deployment & Automation Expertise: Proven ability to manage large-scale equipment installations and PLC/Automation startups in an international environment. 
 - OT Stack Proficiency: Hands-on experience deploying Inductive Automation (Ignition), Microsoft Power Apps, and Power Automate within a manufacturing context. 
 - Smart Hardware Integration: Expert knowledge of integrating DC Torque tools, OT gateways, and Industrial Tablets into a production line. 
 - Operational Line Balancing: Advanced proficiency in Takt time optimization and Work Content Graphing using digital data collection tools. 
 - Simulation Application: Ability to use Discrete Event Simulation outputs to optimize the placement of automation and the configuration of digital workflows. 
 - Bilingual Proficiency: Professional fluency in English and Spanish to facilitate communication with regional engineering teams and local factory staff

EDUCATION AND CERTIFICATIONS

- Degrees: Bachelor's degree in Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Systems Engineering, or Mechanical/Electrical Engineering. 
 - Experience: Minimum of 15+ years of hands-on experience in manufacturing deployment or plant engineering, specifically with power products or high-complexity electronics. 
 - Proven Launch Track Record: Demonstrated success in "Vertical Startups" and the physical implementation of DFM/DFA principles on the factory floor. 
 - Software Proficiency: Experience with Advanced Simulation tools (e. g. , FlexSim, Arena) and CAD (SolidWorks/AutoCAD) for factory footprint and layout design. 
 - Certification: Six Sigma Black Belt or Lean Certification is highly desirable.

No Special Physical Requirements

ENVIRONMENTAL DEMANDS

No Special Requirements

Travel Time Required
