data.title: Senior Platform Software Engineer
data.description:
Job Description

Owns moderately complex components within platform services or SDKs; leads team-level improvements to integration frameworks and developer tooling. Performs deep debugging across a bounded set of distributed services, driving fixes that protect downstream consumers and upgrade paths. Analyzes usage, performance, and error budgets for specific platform surfaces; implements targeted resilience and capacity optimizations. Authors and curates team-scoped documentation, samples, and adoption guidance. 

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

Platform Software Development: 

- Own a bounded platform component (service module, SDK area) and evolve its contracts for multi-tenant use. 
 - Perform deep debugging across a limited-service graph; drive compatibility-safe remediation plans. 
 - Implement targeted resilience/capacity patterns and document adoption guidance for team consumers. 

Software Development and Coding - Design, Testing, and Optimization: 

- Designs software solutions and analyzes and helps identify requirements to achieve business and operational goals, independently. 
 - Adheres to and suggests improvements to all phases of the software development lifecycle. 
 - Utilizes working knowledge to develop new software features and enhancements following design specifications and develops documents to clarify software design and code. 
 - Leads code reviews in designated areas to help drive improvements. 
 - Conducts debugging and troubleshooting to identify and fix moderately complex software issues. Develops fixes for identified issues. 
 - Implements software testing (e. g. , functional and non-functional testing), quality assurance processes, software error logging, monitoring, and observability for effective debugging, ensuring review by manager and/or lead throughout the process. 
 - Exercises judgment and discretion to conduct performance profiling and optimization of coding. 
 - Troubleshoots and resolves moderately complex issues related to application programming interface (API) functionality and integration. 
 - Implements moderately complex API versioning, lifecycle, and interoperability strategies. 

Software Architecture - Software System Structural Design: 

- Designs and develops software, systems, and services aligned to pre-defined system architecture. 
 - Develops working knowledge of software architecture decisions and best practices. 
 - Collaborates with team leads to review work to ensure alignment with software architecture. 
 - Implements moderately complex performance optimization and scalability strategies in software design. 

Issue/Defect Collaboration - Software Products Support: 

- Collaborates within and beyond immediate team to understand customer issues and align solutions. 
 - May provide technical guidance and support to customers regarding customer-reported issues, independently. 
 - Coaches, mentors, and guides others to advocate for customers' interests and suggests product enhancements based on feedback. 
 - Influences team to ensure customer satisfaction through timely resolution of issues and effective communication. 
 - Implements customer issue and/or defect handling and training processes, independently. 
 - Investigates and troubleshoots complex product maintenance issues to ensure customer agreement on short- and long-term solutions (e. g. , future enhancements). 

Practices and Standards Compliance - Security and Compliance: 

- Collaborates with the team to establish and follow development practices and coding standards. 
 - Exercises judgment and discretion to ensure code quality and adherence to broad acceptance criteria during development. 
 - Keeps up to date with industry best practices and applies them to software development processes. 
 - Implements secure coding practices to prevent security vulnerabilities. 

Development Operations - System Maintenance: 

- Performs periodic maintenance and testing operations for systems that require upgrading or patching (e. g. , for critical vulnerabilities). 
 - Exercises judgment and discretion to drive improvements, ensure automation, testing, and debugging of systems to ensure service/product availability, health, support, and reliability. 

Core Responsibilities

Planning & Execution: 

- Independently manages work, monitoring timelines and deliverables to ensure projects or initiatives stay on track and meet requirements. Proactively prioritizes work and adapts to resource or timeline shifts, suggesting adjustments to maintain project efficiency. 

Collaboration & Partnership: 

- Collaborates across teams to align on expectations and achieve shared objectives. Builds and maintains a comprehensive understanding of business, stakeholder, and/or customer needs to build and support effective partnerships. Actively listens to diverse perspectives and asks questions to ensure understanding of others. 

Problem Solving: 

- Independently identifies and addresses standard and non-standard issues in accordance with standard practices, escalating more complex issues as appropriate. Analyzes data and/or information from multiple sources to troubleshoot standard and non-standard errors. Contributes to knowledge sharing and best practices. 

Continuous Learning: 

- Embraces continuous learning by actively seeking to build knowledge and new skills and/or tools and staying current with industry trends and best practices. Seeks out and leverages feedback and training to improve skills. Contributes to a culture of continuous learning and knowledge sharing with team members. 

Continuous Improvement: 

- Develops ideas and recommends updates to increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows within a team. Seeks input from team members on alternative approaches and methods for improving work.

data.title: Full Stack Product Engineer (100% Remote )
data.description:
Help build the open future of digital intelligence

At InnoCraft (trading as Matomo), we believe everyone has the right to data sovereignty, privacy and trusted analytics insights. 

Born from open source and backed by a global community, Matomo helps organisations understand their users and digital performance without surrendering ownership, privacy or control of their data. 

Today, Matomo is used on more than one million websites across 190 countries, supporting leading brands, national governments, universities and organisations in regulated industries. 

We are looking for a Product Engineer to help organisations make sense of their digital performance as AI changes how people discover and interact with them. You'll help decide which problems matter most, shape solutions and deliver software that gives customers clearer insights while protecting their privacy and ownership of their data. Working closely with Product and your engineering team, you'll have the trust and responsibility to take ideas through to measurable customer outcomes. 

This is an opportunity to take real ownership, solve challenging product and platform problems, and see your work make a difference in a widely used open-source product. 

Why this role matters

Customers need confidence in their data, a clear understanding of their users and tools that help them act on what they learn. As digital behaviour changes, Matomo needs to meet those needs while remaining accessible to smaller organisations and capable enough for demanding enterprise use. 

Our Product Engineering teams focus on five domains: Measurement Integrity, Human Analytics, AI Analytics & Digital Presence, Growth & Web, and Enterprise Platform. You'll work within one of these domains, collaborating across teams where customer problems and technical decisions overlap. 

You'll build new capabilities and improve a mature, widely used product. That means understanding existing systems, choosing practical solutions and evolving Matomo with care for the customers, open-source users, integrations and plugins that depend on it. ]

Your work will directly influence: 

- The accuracy and trustworthiness of the data customers use to make decisions. 
 - How clearly customers understand human behaviour and their digital presence as AI changes how people discover and interact with them. 
 - How easily customers get started, find value and grow their use of Matomo. 
 - How effectively enterprise customers manage access, governance and integrations at scale. 

We make extensive use of approved AI tools throughout our engineering workflow, from exploring ideas and prototyping to building, reviewing and testing software. We expect you to use them to move faster and improve quality, while applying your own judgement and taking responsibility for the decisions you make and the software you ship. 

What you'll own

- Understand the problem. Work with Product, colleagues and customers to uncover needs, question assumptions and agree what a useful outcome looks like. 
 - Shape the solution. Explore options, test ideas through prototypes and make clear trade-offs about scope, complexity and what to deliver first. 
 - Build across the stack. Own the technical design and implementation, choosing practical solutions that fit the product and its existing systems. 
 - Build quality in from the start. Work with QA and Design as needed, considering privacy, security, accessibility, performance and compatibility throughout delivery. 
 - Deliver and learn. Ship in small increments, take responsibility for how your changes work in production, and use customer feedback and evidence to measure results and improve them. 
 - Use AI effectively throughout delivery. Give tools the context they need, challenge their suggestions and verify the results. Keep privacy, security and maintainability central to the work you ship. 

What you bring

- 5+ years experience delivering full-stack software, with the technical depth to investigate difficult problems and make sound design decisions. 
 - Product judgement and a drive to solve real customer problems. You can explain why a change is worth building and care whether people use and benefit from it. 
 - Confidence taking ownership of outcomes, clarifying problems and shaping solutions without needing every requirement spelled out in a ticket. 
 - Confidence working in mature systems, understanding existing behaviour and improving it without unnecessary rewrites. 
 - The ability to balance delivery speed with quality, privacy, security and backwards compatibility. 
 - Strong experience using AI throughout development: refining requirements, preparing clear context for prompts, building and testing solutions, and checking the results. You keep reusable AI skills and instructions up to date, follow developments in models and tools, and experiment with new ways to improve delivery and quality. 
 - Strong written and spoken English, with the ability to communicate clearly in a global, asynchronous environment 
 - A strong record of taking ownership, exercising sound judgement and delivering measurable outcomes

Helpful experience

- You are happy working wherever the problem takes you: frontend, backend, databases, APIs, product flows, documentation, or customer feedback. 
 - Our stack includes PHP, MySQL, JavaScript, Vue. js, and TypeScript. Exact stack experience is useful, but not required. We care more about your ability to learn, reason, ship, and solve meaningful problems. 
 - Experience in product management, UI/UX design or building your own product or business. 
 - Contributing to or maintaining open-source projects, or building plugins, APIs and integrations used across different environments. 
 - Analytics, data-intensive systems or enterprise software. 

You may not match every item, but you should bring strong capability in the core requirements and a clear record of creating meaningful impact. 

Why Matomo?

Matomo is for people who want their work to matter. 

You will help build technology that protects data privacy, strengthens digital sovereignty and gives organisations a genuine alternative to surveillance-based platforms. 

We are intentionally lean, globally distributed and backed by a worldwide open-source community. Important work is not buried under layers. You will have access to meaningful problems, the context behind decisions and the opportunity to influence what Matomo becomes next. 

We value people who take ownership, exercise strong judgement and turn complex problems into clear, valuable outcomes. People who raise standards, challenge assumptions and care about the complete result, not only their part of it. 

High performance at Matomo means choosing the work that matters most, moving it forward with urgency and leaving customers, colleagues and Matomo stronger because of your contribution. 

You will have freedom over where and, within the needs of your role, when you work. In return, we expect clear communication, dependable follow-through and accountability for outcomes. 

We also protect focused work through: 

- No-meeting Fridays 
 - No more than two days each week with late meetings 
 - No meetings after 10pm in any time zone

This is a place for people who want meaningful responsibility, visible impact and the opportunity to help build something globally significant. 

Benefits

- 100% remote working within your country of employment 
 - Flexible working hours, within the collaboration and coverage requirements of the role 
 - 25 days of paid annual leave 
 - Home-office equipment allowance 
 - Health insurance support, where applicable 
 - Mental-health and wellbeing support 
 - Paid volunteering day 
 - Pet bereavement leave

Benefits vary depending on the country of employment. 

Hiring Process

Application → Screening → Online aptitude test → People & Culture interview → Hiring Manager/Behaviour interview→ Live Coding test (Final round)

Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion

Matomo values what makes you unique. We're an inclusive employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, because diverse perspectives help us build better products. 

Fight for data privacy. Build the open future of digital intelligence. Create meaningful impact from anywhere. 

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

data.title: Senior Software Engineer - Rust - Payments
data.description:
Role Overview

Join our Payments Engineering team and continue to build your expertise! We're looking for a collaborative Senior Software Engineer to help build and improve a world-class payment platform that impacts millions of users. 

This is your opportunity to take ownership of your work, support your team, and grow your skills in a supportive environment. 

Key Responsibilities

Team Collaboration : 

- Proactively collaborate with your team, communicating progress and helping to remove obstacles. 
 - Give and graciously receive direct, useful feedback to improve both your work and the team's processes. 
 - Mentor junior engineers and help them grow their technical skills while contributing to a supportive team culture that adopts company values. 

Design & Development

- Design small systems or processes with collaborative support, making design choices that prioritize long-term maintainability and scalability. 
 - Actively participate in design reviews and improvement efforts, anticipating how your work affects upstream and downstream systems. 
 - Take ownership of the reliability of your deliverables and ensure quality and efficiency in your own work while supporting others to do the same. 

Quality & Operations

- Plan and execute validation for your systems, ensuring repeatable and traceable practices while understanding common failure points. 
 - Plan and execute validation for systems, utilizing repeatable and traceable practices to monitor performance and mitigate potential security or operational risks. 
 - Understand testing coverage and common failure points, contributing to documentation to ensure the team learns from every incident. 
 - Identify recurring operational issues (e. g. , latency, throughput bottlenecks) and propose improvements to our cloud-native environment. 

Tech Stack

- RUST, RESTful APIs, Kafka, PostgreSQL, Cloud native. 

Required Skills

- Experience : 5 - 8 years of professional software development experience. 
 - Domain Knowledge : A deep understanding of the business, user needs, and the technical landscape. You can learn new business logic efficiently and mentor others on our systems and practices. 
 - Impact & Ownership : You take ownership of your projects, solve problems independently, and have a thorough understanding of the product. You actively participate in production, review others' contributions, and have informed opinions on strategic decisions. 
 - Strategic Mindset : You think beyond immediate tasks, using data and insights to weigh trade-offs and align decisions with long-term goals. 
 - Security Focus : You have a deep understanding of security, how it affects your domain, and experience with risk assessments and mitigations. 
 - Team Growth : A passion for growing your team and helping them contribute to their goals. 
 - Experience in designing and implementing "secure-by-design" systems that include robust monitoring, reporting, and root-cause analysis to handle the distributed nature of the cloud. 
 - Experience with DevOps practices : Continuous integration / continuous deployment (CI/CD), containerization (Docker), and orchestration (k8s). 
 - Rust Expertise : Deep professional experience building and scaling applications using Rust. 
 - Cloud Native Background : Proven track record migrating applications from on-prem to cloud (AWS, Kubernetes, or similar tools). 

Preferred Skills

- Previous experience with billing, financial systems, or high-volume payment gateways. 
 - Experience in a formal or informal technical leadership role (Team Lead or Lead Engineer). 

(ref: hirist. tech)

data.title: Sr Manager, Software Development & Engineering Senior
data.description:
Your opportunity

At Charles Schwab, our purpose is simple: we champion client's goals with passion and integrity. Guided by honesty, mutual respect and a commitment to doing what's right, we bring innovation, education, and service together to help shape financial futures. Our people are the foundation of our success - they approach their work with curiosity and collaboration, coming together to create solutions that make a meaningful impact for clients and communities. As we expand into India, we are bringing this same culture of inclusion, learning, and opportunity to new talent. Joining us means becoming part of a global team where your work matters and your future can take shape. 

Our Hyderabad location is central to Schwab's growth, bringing together talented people and technology to drive innovation, scale and efficiency. Here, you will work alongside teams who create solutions that support millions of clients every day. The work you do is more than daily operations - it's a chance to experiment, learn, and build within a values-driven, supportive environment. This is a unique opportunity to be part of our early growth phase and shape something new, backed by the stability and strength of a Fortune 500 company. Your impact begins on day one, and your contributions will help define our future in the region. 

What you have

Key Responsibilities

At Schwab, you are empowered to make an impact on your career. Innovative thinking meets disciplined engineering as we challenge the status quo and strengthen the quality of digital experiences that serve our clients. 

This Senior Manager role will lead quality engineering and SDET practices for business-critical enterprise applications. The role combines hands-on automation architecture with technical leadership, partnering across product, development, architecture, operations, and risk teams to build quality into every stage of delivery. 

The ideal candidate is a pragmatic quality leader who can independently drive large-scale initiatives, modernize automation frameworks, coach engineers, and improve release confidence through measurable, risk-based testing. 

AI-enabled quality engineering is a core expectation of this position. The leader will establish practical, governed use of AI agents and coding assistants to accelerate test design, framework development, end-to-end regression automation, failure analysis, and continuous quality improvement while maintaining human review, security, privacy, traceability, and reliability controls. 

- Drive quality strategy and successful execution for complex, business-critical programs, aligning test coverage, automation, release readiness, and quality outcomes with organizational objectives. 
 - Architect, develop, and evolve scalable UI and API automation frameworks using Playwright with JavaScript/TypeScript and Selenium with Java, applying reusable design patterns, reliable synchronization, test-data management, and actionable failure diagnostics. 
 - Establish an effective quality-engineering approach across functional, integration, regression, end-to-end, API, database, accessibility, compatibility, and non-functional testing, with appropriate use of exploratory and risk-based testing. 
 - Validate data integrity and backend processing through advanced SQL across Microsoft SQL Server and PostgreSQL, including source-to-target reconciliation, stored procedure validation, and troubleshooting of complex application workflows. 
 - Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and GitHub-based workflows; improve execution speed, stability, reporting, environment readiness, and defect traceability using modern test and quality-management tooling. 
 - Lead test planning, estimation, quality metrics, defect triage, root-cause analysis, release risk assessments, and production-quality reviews, distinguishing product defects from automation or environment instability. 
 - Guide and mentor SDETs and QA engineers, set coding and automation standards, conduct design and code reviews, and foster accountability, collaboration, continuous learning, and engineering excellence. 
 - Partner with geographically distributed product, engineering, architecture, DevOps, operations, compliance, and vendor teams to manage dependencies, resolve blockers, and deliver secure, resilient, and maintainable solutions. 

Required Qualifications

Preffered Qualification

- Contribute to long-term quality-engineering roadmaps, platform modernization, tooling decisions, and responsible adoption of AI-assisted testing while following data privacy and company-policy guardrails. 
 - Define and lead an AI-enabled quality-engineering strategy, including the creation and governed use of specialized testing agents for requirement analysis, test-case generation, automation development, test-data preparation, code review, regression-suite maintenance, defect reproduction, and failure triage.

data.description:
ELLKAY started out providing connectivity solutions to laboratories and within a few years, grew to also provide data management solutions to ambulatory organizations. ELLKAY is now a trusted data management partner in five healthcare segments. ELLKAY's solutions continue to serve laboratories and ambulatory practices and have expanded to empower hospitals and health systems, healthcare IT vendors, ambulatory practices, health plans, and other healthcare organizations with cutting-edge technologies and solutions that drive their growth and interoperability strategies. 

Today, ELLKAY remains true to our core values, building strong partner relationships and offering unparalleled service and support while providing innovative, scalable solutions to the challenges our customers face in today's data-rich world. 

ELLKAY's experience, customer-focused approach, and reputation for innovation, speed, and accuracy differentiate ELLKAY as a premier partner for your interoperability needs and data management strategy. 

Job Description

The Quality Engineer designs, develops, and maintains automated quality solutions that provide fast, reliable feedback throughout the delivery lifecycle. Working as an embedded member of an Agile engineering team, this role combines exploratory testing with code-based automation across services, interfaces, data flows, and user experiences. 

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

- Translate requirements and acceptance criteria into maintainable automated tests and focused exploratory testing for functional and integration risks. 
 - Develop automation for APIs, services, web, interfaces, databases, events, and end-to-end business workflows using approved frameworks and coding standards. 
 - Apply the test pyramid and risk-based coverage principles, emphasizing stable unit-adjacent, component, API, contract, and integration checks over brittle end-to-end tests. 
 - Create reusable test utilities, fixtures, page or service objects, data builders, mocks, and service-virtualization assets that improve delivery speed and maintainability. 
 - Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines; diagnose failures, remove flaky behavior, and keep execution time and feedback quality within team targets. 
 - Validate positive, negative, boundary, error-handling, authorization, compatibility, accessibility, and recovery scenarios appropriate to the product risk. 
 - Prepare and manage test data in accordance with privacy, security, masking, retention, and environment-control requirements. 
 - Review stories, designs, code changes, logs, and telemetry to identify testability gaps and defects before release. 
 - Document defects with clear evidence, business impact, and reproducible conditions; partner with developers on root-cause analysis and verification. 
 - Participate in refinement, planning, design discussions, code reviews, quality reviews, and release-readiness activities as a full engineering team member. 
 - Monitor automation results and quality signals; communicate coverage, failures, residual risk, and readiness without relying on pass-rate alone. 
 - Contribute improvements to team frameworks, standards, documentation, and engineering practices. 

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, information systems, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - Typically 3+ years in software quality engineering or software development with meaningful hands-on test automation experience. 
 - Proficiency in at least one programming language and experience with UI and API automation, SQL, Git, build tools, and CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Understanding of HTTP, REST or event-driven integrations, databases, application architecture, and common debugging techniques. 
 - Ability to design clear test scenarios, write maintainable code, analyze failures across system layers, and balance speed with coverage. 
 - Strong collaboration, ownership, attention to detail, and written and verbal communication skills. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with cloud platforms, containers, contract testing, performance testing, accessibility testing, or observability tools. 
 - Exposure to healthcare systems, regulated data, interoperability, or privacy-conscious test-data management. |

ELLKAY is committed to fostering a collaborative and high-performance work environment that supports innovation, teamwork, and professional growth. Most roles are designed to operate from our office locations to encourage effective collaboration and engagement across teams. 

Any alternative work arrangements may be considered at the company's discretion based on role requirements and business needs. 

For more information about our company, please visit www. ELLKAY. com .

data.title: Senior Platform Software Engineer
data.description:
Job Description

Owns moderately complex components within platform services or SDKs; leads team-level improvements to integration frameworks and developer tooling. Performs deep debugging across a bounded set of distributed services, driving fixes that protect downstream consumers and upgrade paths. Analyzes usage, performance, and error budgets for specific platform surfaces; implements targeted resilience and capacity optimizations. Authors and curates team-scoped documentation, samples, and adoption guidance. 

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

Platform Software Development: 

- Own a bounded platform component (service module, SDK area) and evolve its contracts for multi-tenant use. 
 - Perform deep debugging across a limited-service graph; drive compatibility-safe remediation plans. 
 - Implement targeted resilience/capacity patterns and document adoption guidance for team consumers. 

Software Development and Coding - Design, Testing, and Optimization: 

- Designs software solutions and analyzes and helps identify requirements to achieve business and operational goals, independently. 
 - Adheres to and suggests improvements to all phases of the software development lifecycle. 
 - Utilizes working knowledge to develop new software features and enhancements following design specifications and develops documents to clarify software design and code. 
 - Leads code reviews in designated areas to help drive improvements. 
 - Conducts debugging and troubleshooting to identify and fix moderately complex software issues. Develops fixes for identified issues. 
 - Implements software testing (e. g. , functional and non-functional testing), quality assurance processes, software error logging, monitoring, and observability for effective debugging, ensuring review by manager and/or lead throughout the process. 
 - Exercises judgment and discretion to conduct performance profiling and optimization of coding. 
 - Troubleshoots and resolves moderately complex issues related to application programming interface (API) functionality and integration. 
 - Implements moderately complex API versioning, lifecycle, and interoperability strategies. 

Software Architecture - Software System Structural Design: 

- Designs and develops software, systems, and services aligned to pre-defined system architecture. 
 - Develops working knowledge of software architecture decisions and best practices. 
 - Collaborates with team leads to review work to ensure alignment with software architecture. 
 - Implements moderately complex performance optimization and scalability strategies in software design. 

Issue/Defect Collaboration - Software Products Support: 

- Collaborates within and beyond immediate team to understand customer issues and align solutions. 
 - May provide technical guidance and support to customers regarding customer-reported issues, independently. 
 - Coaches, mentors, and guides others to advocate for customers' interests and suggests product enhancements based on feedback. 
 - Influences team to ensure customer satisfaction through timely resolution of issues and effective communication. 
 - Implements customer issue and/or defect handling and training processes, independently. 
 - Investigates and troubleshoots complex product maintenance issues to ensure customer agreement on short- and long-term solutions (e. g. , future enhancements). 

Practices and Standards Compliance - Security and Compliance: 

- Collaborates with the team to establish and follow development practices and coding standards. 
 - Exercises judgment and discretion to ensure code quality and adherence to broad acceptance criteria during development. 
 - Keeps up to date with industry best practices and applies them to software development processes. 
 - Implements secure coding practices to prevent security vulnerabilities. 

Development Operations - System Maintenance: 

- Performs periodic maintenance and testing operations for systems that require upgrading or patching (e. g. , for critical vulnerabilities). 
 - Exercises judgment and discretion to drive improvements, ensure automation, testing, and debugging of systems to ensure service/product availability, health, support, and reliability. 

Core Responsibilities

Planning & Execution: 

- Independently manages work, monitoring timelines and deliverables to ensure projects or initiatives stay on track and meet requirements. Proactively prioritizes work and adapts to resource or timeline shifts, suggesting adjustments to maintain project efficiency. 

Collaboration & Partnership: 

- Collaborates across teams to align on expectations and achieve shared objectives. Builds and maintains a comprehensive understanding of business, stakeholder, and/or customer needs to build and support effective partnerships. Actively listens to diverse perspectives and asks questions to ensure understanding of others. 

Problem Solving: 

- Independently identifies and addresses standard and non-standard issues in accordance with standard practices, escalating more complex issues as appropriate. Analyzes data and/or information from multiple sources to troubleshoot standard and non-standard errors. Contributes to knowledge sharing and best practices. 

Continuous Learning: 

- Embraces continuous learning by actively seeking to build knowledge and new skills and/or tools and staying current with industry trends and best practices. Seeks out and leverages feedback and training to improve skills. Contributes to a culture of continuous learning and knowledge sharing with team members. 

Continuous Improvement:

data.title: Senior Platform Software Engineer
data.description:
Job Description

You will drive an automation-first operating model, turning recurring operational tasks into reliable, reusable software and workflows. You will use AI-assisted design, development, and automation to accelerate engineering work, improve troubleshooting, and reduce manual effort while maintaining production safety and engineering quality. 

This role combines independent technical ownership, production reliability, and collaboration across development, infrastructure, security, and cloud service teams. 

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

- Independently design, build, test, and operate tools and frameworks that improve the reliability and usability of NonProduction environments. 
 - Develop self-service capabilities for environment provisioning, service onboarding, deployment, configuration, health validation, and troubleshooting. 
 - Build reusable automation libraries, APIs, command-line tools, and workflow integrations with clear interfaces, documentation, and ownership. 
 - Engineer and improve development, integration, test, and release-validation pipelines, including build orchestration, artifact promotion, and failure diagnosis. 
 - Automate NonProduction environment lifecycle activities, including provisioning, upgrades, configuration synchronization, drift detection, and cleanup. 
 - Build observability capabilities using metrics, logs, traces, deployment events, and environment metadata to explain platform and application health. 
 - Develop dashboards and diagnostic tools that correlate service versions, configuration, feature flags, dependencies, and recent changes. 
 - Define and measure the reliability of DevEx services and NonProduction platforms, including availability, provisioning time, pipeline success, deployment duration, and recovery time. 
 - Build automated health checks and validation frameworks that detect environment issues and provide actionable diagnostic evidence. 
 - Develop AI-assisted tools, skills, or agents for pipeline failure analysis, log investigation, environment comparison, knowledge retrieval, and guided troubleshooting. 
 - Evaluate AI-assisted capabilities against representative scenarios for accuracy, usefulness, and safe failure handling; validate outcomes before adoption. 
 - Implement secure automation with appropriate permissions, secrets handling, auditability, recovery procedures, and approval boundaries. 
 - Improve NonProduction resource utilization through rightsizing, lifecycle policies, and automated identification of idle or orphaned resources. 
 - Support designated NonProduction platforms, investigate recurring issues, and turn support findings into durable tooling and framework improvements. 
 - Partner with developers, QA, release engineering, SRE, and security teams to identify friction and prioritize improvements. 
 - Evaluate echnical tradeoffs across reliability, performance, scalability, security, cost, and operational complexity; document design decisions and recommend solutions aligned with service objectives and delivery needs. 
 - Participate in the scheduled oncall rotation and support Production environments, including after-hours coverage; triage alerts, respond to incidents, coordinate escalations, restore service, and ensure clear handovers and follow-up actions. 
 - Maintain technical documentation, onboarding guides, runbooks, and examples; contribute to code reviews and engineering standards. 

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - Professional experience in platform engineering, developer tooling, SRE, DevOps, infrastructure software, or backend software engineering, including ownership of production systems. 
 - Proficiency in Python, Go, Java, or a comparable language, with experience building maintainable tools, services, or frameworks. 
 - Experience designing reusable interfaces, integrating APIs, and developing automated tests. 
 - Hands-on experience with Linux, Git, containers, Kubernetes, and at least one major cloud platform(OCI, AWS, or Azure). 
 - Experience developing infrastructure-as-code modules using Terraform or an equivalent tool. 
 - Experience building, troubleshooting, or improving CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Experience implementing observability using metrics, logs, dashboards, or distributed tracing. 
 - Strong troubleshooting skills across application dependencies, Kubernetes, infrastructure, and networking fundamentals. 
 - Demonstrated ability to identify developer friction or repetitive support work and address it through automation or self-service capabilities. 
 - Practical experience using AI-assisted development tools, including reviewing generated code and validating results. 
 - Ability to independently deliver well-scoped projects and collaborate effectively with users of the platform. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with OCI, including OKE, IAM, networking, Object Storage, and DevOps tooling. 
 - Experience building internal developer platforms, portals, command-line tools, or workflow frameworks. 
 - Familiarity with Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, centralized logging, and telemetry correlation. 
 - Experience with environment metadata, configuration drift analysis, feature-flag tooling, artifact/BOM management, or deployment comparison. 
 - Experience building AI-assisted diagnostic tools, retrieval-based knowledge systems, or agents integrated with operational APIs. 
 - Familiarity with agent evaluation, permission boundaries, human approval workflows, and safe tool execution. 
 - Experience with event-driven automation, asynchronous workflows, idempotency, retries, and partial-failure recovery. 
 - Experience supporting shared development and test environments with multiple teams or tenants. 
 - Experience measuring developer productivity and using adoption, reliability, and support data to guide improvements. 
 - Familiarity with NonProduction cloud cost optimization and resource lifecycle management.

data.title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer
data.description:
Job Description

Are you looking to apply your skills contributing to a next generation of Database cloud services? Are you calm and collected when others panic under pressure? Do you get a thrill from solving really tough problems? Do you light up in conversations about uptime, horizontal scalability, performance, security, and DevOps?

The Autonomous AI Database Team is responsible for building the cloud service framework powering various Oracle Autonomous AI Database cloud services, including Autonomous Data Warehouse (ADW) and Autonomous Transaction Processing (ATP). The framework automates deployment, scaling and management of databases in the cloud. It is built on top of Oracle's Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) Layer. 

The autonomous AI database cloud service framework features APIs to handle all lifecycle management operations of databases. It also performs operations autonomously based on internal and external events. The team has the unique opportunity to make significant contributions to the full stack of Oracle technology, from database kernel to cloud service platform and to customer-facing portals. 

As a Site reliability Engineer, you will be responsible for defining and deploying autonomous database services with deep focus on architecture, production operations, capacity planning, performance management, deployment, and release engineering. You will work with multiple cross-functional teams helping deliver new and outstanding experiences to our stakeholders while ensuring reliability and performance. 

We are a dynamic and enthusiastic team with great emphasis on go-getters and proactive individuals. 

Overview from oracle. com with links to other collateral: 

https: //cloud. oracle. com/en_US/datawarehouse

https: //www. oracle. com/database/autonomous-database/feature. html

Career Level - IC3

Responsibilities

In this role you will need to: 

Take ownership of the implementation and production operations of a wide array of core system platform solutions

React to production deficiencies by continuously implementing automation, self-healing, and real-time monitoring to production systems

Be a strong contributor to development of platform services including architecture, provisioning, configuration, deployment, and support

Partner with the distributed team in prototyping new database platform services

Stay informed of cloud infrastructure stacks

Innovate

Preferred Qualifications: 

Degree level : BE/BS/MS

Programming languages like Python, Java

Expert knowledge and in-depth experience of the Oracle Engineered systems and subsystems. 

Ability to troubleshoot and resolve complex hardware/software issues, restore environments to an operational state, perform root cause analysis and provide forward thinking mitigation strategies

Expert level understanding, implementation experience and troubleshooting of Oracle Database technology including RAC, Dataguard, ASM, RMAN etc

Demonstrated operations experience with Linux platform (i. e. RHEL, OEL) including administration, management, and troubleshooting

Strong communication and analytical skills

Familiarity with security practices in web application delivery and General knowledge of network topology

Experience with configuration management tools

*Core Competencies: *

- Extensive expertise in Oracle Engineered Systems and subsystems with hands-on experience in deployment, optimization, and maintenance. 
 - Proven ability to diagnose and resolve complex hardware/software issues, restore system functionality, conduct root cause analysis, and implement proactive mitigation strategies. 
 - Advanced proficiency in Oracle Database technologies, including RAC, Data Guard, ASM, RMAN, and performance tuning, with a focus on implementation and troubleshooting. 
 - Operational mastery of Linux platforms (e. g. , RHEL, OEL), including system administration, maintenance, and issue resolution. 
 - Strong experience in automation using Python and shell scripting to develop custom solutions, streamline processes, and improve system efficiency. 
 - Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (OCI, AWS, Azure, GCP) is a plus.

data.title: Full Stack - Principal Software Engineer
data.description:
At Curriculum Associates, we believe in the potential of every child and are changing the face of education technology with award-winning learning programs like i-Ready that serve a third of the nation's K-8 students. For more than 50 years, our commitment to making classrooms better places, serving educators, and supporting accessible learning experiences for all students has driven the continuous improvement of our innovative programs. Our team of more than 2, 500 employees is composed of lifelong learners who stand behind this mission, working tirelessly to serve the educational community with world-class programs and support every day. 

Summary

The Full Stack Principal Software Engineer will be responsible for bringing new digital products to market and enhance existing ones by leveraging your expertise in software development with state-of-the-art industry frameworks collaborating closely with product management on engineering teams. 

Essential Duties/responsibilities

- Deliver large software initiatives in collaboration with product owners, to deliver i-Ready experiences. 2. Partner with architects and senior engineers to design robust software ensuring seamless customer experience at scale. 
 - Operate with a continuous improvement mindset, conducting code and design reviews, as well as leveraging state-of-the-art code quality and productivity tools. 
 - Develop automated unit and integration tests to accompany all application code. 
 - Contribute ideas and effort to improve efficiency of our software development lifecycle. 
 - Model and champion efficiencies in software development and delivery practices. 
 - Drive code maintainability by addressing technical debt and defects proactively. 
 - Communicate clearly and consistently utilizing verbal and written forms, to ensure seamless progress on shared team goals. 
 - Engage in personal and peer development through mentorship program participation. 
 - Engage in proactive learning to improve functional as well as technical knowledge. 

Required Job Skills And Abilities

About The Role

The Data Infrastructure Team is a lean, high-impact group operating in a true founder mode. We are responsible for building and safeguarding all data systems, managing the lifecycle of 500+ production-grade resources across 10+ types of data stores. Our core mission is to build self-serve, automated platforms that ensure our systems are efficient, scalable, and continuously evolving. We don't just operate systems-we invent them. 

What You Will Do

data.title: Software Development Engineer, Backend ( Golang )
data.description:
OVERVIEW OF THE COMPANY
 Fox Corporation Under the FOX banner, we produce and distribute content through some of the world's leading and most valued brands, including: FOX News Media, FOX Sports, FOX Entertainment, FOX Television Stations and Tubi Media Group. We empower a diverse range of creators to imagine and develop culturally significant content, while building an organization that thrives on creative ideas, operational expertise and strategic thinking. 

JOB DESCRIPTION OVERVIEW OF THE COMPANY: 

Fox Corporation is home to industry-leading brands including FOX News Media, FOX Sports, FOX Entertainment, FOX Television Stations, Tubi Media Group, and FOX One, our recently launched direct-to-consumer (DTC) platform. 

Across our portfolio, we build and operate large-scale digital platforms that serve millions of users globally. Our teams combine innovative technology, deep data insights, and world-class content to deliver highly personalized, reliable, and scalable consumer experiences across web, mobile, and connected TV platforms. 

Job Description

As a Software Engineer in the Backend/API team, you will be responsible for building and operating scalable, resilient backend systems that power multiple consumer-facing platforms. You will work on high-throughput, low-latency services and APIs that are critical to core product experiences. 

This role requires engineers who take end-to-end ownership - from understanding the problem and designing systems to implementing, deploying, and operating them in production. We are looking for strong backend engineers who can work independently, make sound technical decisions, and deliver reliable systems without the need for constant hand-holding. 

A Snapshot Of Your Responsibilities

- Design, build, and operate backend services and APIs that run at high scale with strict reliability and performance requirements. 
 - Take complete ownership of assigned problem areas, from requirements understanding and system design to production rollout and ongoing operations. 
 - Perform high-level and low-level system design, clearly articulating trade-offs and architectural decisions. 
 - Write high-quality, maintainable, and well-tested code across backend components. 
 - Build and evolve distributed systems that are resilient, fault-tolerant, and observable in production. 
 - Optimize existing systems for performance, latency, scalability, and cost. 
 - Apply strong problem-solving skills and data structures knowledge to design efficient, real-world solutions. 
 - Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver backend capabilities that support evolving product needs. 
 - Participate actively in code and design reviews, maintaining high engineering standards. 
 - Continuously improve system reliability, developer productivity, and engineering best practices within the team. 

What Will You Need

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related technical field. 
 - 4-8 years of experience building backend software systems in production environments. 
 - Strong programming skills in one or more backend languages, preferably Golang. 
 - Solid understanding of data structures, algorithms, and their application in backend and distributed systems. 
 - Experience designing and building distributed systems with a focus on scalability, availability, and reliability. 
 - Hands-on experience working with cloud-based systems (e. g. , AWS or equivalent). 
 - Experience working with databases and data stores (relational and/or NoSQL) and an understanding of data modeling and performance trade-offs. 
 - Practical understanding of modern AI systems, including large language models (LLMs), and how to integrate AI capabilities into backend software. 
 - Familiarity with using AI to build, enhance, or operate software systems (e. g. , LLM-based APIs, prompt-driven workflows, automation, developer productivity). 
 - Ability to work independently, take ownership, and deliver systems end-to-end with minimal guidance. 

We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, gender identity, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories consistent with applicable law.

data.description:
We are looking for a Senior SDET to build and maintain Web and API automation frameworks from scratch and define the automation strategy within the squads. 

The mandatory requirements are 4+ years of SDET experience, strong Java programming skills, REST Assured, and Playwright. 

RECRUITMENT PROCESS

- Application - Share a few details about your experience and background. 
 - Coding Challenge - If applicable, complete it in the coding language you are most comfortable with. 
 - Video Interview - Record a short video introduction in English. 
 - Technical Interview or Hiring Manager Interview - Discuss your experience and fit for the role. 
 - Offer - If it's a match, you'll receive an offer. 

What You'll Gain

- Remote work - Work from where you feel most productive. 
 - Local presence in India - Work in a structured and compliant environment aligned with Indian regulations. 
 - Competitive compensation in INR - Receive compensation in INR, plus support for learning, education, and wellness. 
 - Exciting projects - Work with modern technologies for global clients and fast-growing companies. 

MUST HAVES

- 4+ years of experience as an SDET Engineer 
 - Technical Solvency: Strong programming skills in Java (a "developer-first" approach to QA). 
 - API Automation: Extensive experience using REST Assured for backend testing. 
 - Frontend Automation: Proven hands-on experience with Playwright. 
 - Testing Philosophy: Deep understanding of the "shift-left" approach and integrating automation into CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Ability to work independently and provide technical direction on quality initiatives. 
 - Upper-intermediate English level. 

NICE TO HAVES

- Domain Experience: Previous experience in the Loyalty or Fintech sectors. 
 - Experience with Performance or Load testing (e. g. , JMeter or Gatling). 
 - Familiarity with Cloud infrastructure and SQL for data validation within test scripts. 
 - Experience working with Mocking frameworks. 

What You Will Do

- Framework Design: Build and maintain scalable, robust automation frameworks from the ground up for both Web and API layers. 
 - Strategy & Leadership: Define the automation strategy, ensuring high test coverage and reliable release cycles within your squads. 
 - Backend Validation: Create comprehensive API automation suites to ensure the integrity of microservices. 
 - Frontend Validation: Implement and manage frontend automation scripts to ensure a top-tier user experience. 
 - Coaching: Mentor other engineers on testing best practices and foster a "quality-first" culture.

data.title: Senior Testing Lead - Automation, Performance, Security & Functional QA
data.description:
Position: Senior Testing Lead - Automation, Performance, Security & Functional QA

Location: Hyderabad ( 8 PM to 5 AM IST)

Work Type: Full-Time/Onsite

Experience: 8+ Years

PETADATA is looking for a highly experienced Senior Testing Lead with 8+ years of experience to own the overall quality strategy, build and scale test automation, and lead functional, performance, security, API, and data-validation testing for a data migration platform operating across cloud and on-premise environments. 

Roles & Responsibilities Quality Strategy & Leadership

- Own and define the overall QA and testing strategy across functional, automation, performance, security, and data-integrity testing. 
 - Establish quality gates, release criteria, testing standards, metrics, and reporting. 
 - Identify and prioritize testing efforts based on business and technical risk, especially data-correctness risks. 
 - Build and manage the quality function with minimal supervision. 
 - Mentor developers and QA engineers and promote a quality-first engineering culture. 
 - Partner closely with Engineering, DevOps, Architecture, Security, and Implementation teams. 

Test Automation

- Design and build test automation frameworks from scratch. 
 - Develop automated UI, API, integration, and regression testing solutions. 
 - Use tools such as Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, and REST/API automation frameworks. 
 - Integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Build scalable regression suites that improve release velocity and confidence. 
 - Use programming languages such as Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, or Java for automation. 

Functional & Migration Testing

- Own end-to-end functional testing across supported CRM platforms and migration scenarios. 
 - Test standard and custom objects, relationships, transformations, mappings, and edge cases. 
 - Design test scenarios based on real-world customer data migration use cases. 
 - Validate migration correctness from source to destination. 
 - Test multi-tenant behavior, configuration, and tenant data isolation. 
 - Identify defects and ensure issues are properly investigated, resolved, and prevented from recurring. 

Data Validation & Integrity

- Build automated source-to-target data validation frameworks. 
 - Validate: 
 - Record counts 
 - Field-level accuracy 
 - Data mappings 
 - Relationships and associations 
 - Transformations 
 - Deduplication 
 - Overall data integrity 
 - Use SQL and programmatic validation techniques to verify migration results. 
 - Ensure migrated customer data remains complete, accurate, and consistent. Performance Testing

- Design and execute load, stress, scalability, and performance testing. 
 - Test large data volumes and high numbers of concurrent migrations. 
 - Establish performance baselines, benchmarks, and SLAs. 
 - Identify performance bottlenecks and work with Engineering and Architecture teams to resolve them. 
 - Use tools such as k6, JMeter, Gatling, or Locust. 
 - Integrate appropriate performance testing into the CI/CD pipeline. 

Security Testing

- Perform and coordinate security testing across the application and platform. 
 - Test tenant isolation and ensure no cross-tenant data access is possible. 
 - Validate authentication and authorization controls. 
 - Perform input validation and abuse-case testing. 
 - Integrate SAST, DAST, and vulnerability scanning into CI/CD. 
 - Coordinate penetration testing with internal security teams and external security vendors. 
 - Support security and compliance requirements such as SOC 2 and ISO 27001 through appropriate testing evidence. 

Technical Quality & Delivery

- Ensure software is secure, scalable, reliable, and production-ready. 
 - Establish automated quality checks throughout the development lifecycle. 
 - Collaborate with developers to identify defects early. 
 - Review testing approaches and improve overall engineering quality. 
 - Support both cloud and on-premise deployments. 
 - Help establish reliable test environments using cloud, containers, and infrastructure automation. 

Note: Should be highly self-directed, comfortable building the QA function from the ground up, and able to work effectively with distributed engineering teams across required time zones. 

Note: Should be able to work independently and work in USA time zones

Required Skills

- 8+ years of professional QA / Test Engineering experience. 
 - Strong experience leading QA strategy and quality engineering for software products. 
 - Strong hands-on experience building test automation frameworks from scratch. 
 - Proficiency with Playwright, Cypress, and/or Selenium. 
 - Strong API and REST testing experience. 
 - Strong programming experience with Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, or Java. 
 - Hands-on experience integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Experience with functional, integration, regression, and end-to-end testing. 
 - Strong experience with performance/load testing using JMeter, k6, Gatling, Locust, or similar tools. 
 - Working knowledge of security testing, including OWASP, authentication, authorization, tenant isolation, SAST, DAST, and vulnerability scanning. 
 - Strong SQL and data-validation experience. 
 - Experience validating source-to-target data integrity across multiple systems. 
 - Strong understanding of data migration, ETL, integration, or data-intensive applications. 
 - Experience testing multi-tenant SaaS applications. 
 - Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP. 
 - Experience with on-premise/customer-deployed software is preferred. 
 - Experience with Salesforce, HubSpot, Zoho, or similar CRM platforms is a plus. 
 - Familiarity with Docker, containers, and IaC is a plus. 
 - Exposure to chaos/resilience testing or contract testing is a plus. 
 - Experience supporting SOC 2 / ISO 27001 or other compliance audits is preferred. 
 - Strong problem-solving, communication, leadership, ownership, and decision-making skills. 
 - Ability to independently establish testing processes, frameworks, quality standards, and release criteria. 

Education

Bachelor s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field is preferred. 

Candidates must attend phone/video calls and in-person interviews as required. After selection, candidates will undergo background checks on Education and Experience. 

Please email your resume to divyam@petadata. ai

After carefully reviewing your experience and skills, one of our HR team members will contact you about the next steps.

data.title: Senior Principal DFT Engineer
data.description:
Description

Invent the future with us. 

Ampere is a semiconductor design company for a new era, leading the future of computing with an innovative approach to CPU design focused on high-performance, energy efficient AIcompute. 

As a pioneer in the new frontier of energy efficient high-performance computing, Ampere is part of the Softbank Group of companies driving sustainable computing for AI, Cloud, and edge applications. 

Join us at Ampere and work alongside a passionate and growing team - we'd love to have you apply!

About the role: 

The ideal candidate will work with multi-functional global teams to design, implement and verify Boundary Scan, ATPG (Stuck-AT/AT-Speed) SCAN, MBIST, IO BIST and JTAG/IJTAG DFT features on our next generation highly complex server class processor products. Will work in close collaboration with test engineering team to deliver ATE patterns and post silicon bring-up and debug. 

What you'll achieve: 

- DFT features like EDT, SSN, shared bus based MBIST insertion, ijtag, simulation and debug on RTL and gates netlist for automotive applications. 
 - Verification of jtag/ijtag, MBIST features in RTL and GLS. 
 - Boundary Scan insertion, simulation and verification. 
 - Hands on knowledge in state-of-the-art EDA tools for DFT, design and verification (Mentor, Cadence, Synopsys)
 - STA DFT Test mode timing constraint development and analysis
 - In-depth knowledge of Verilog HDL and experience with simulators and waveform debugging tools 
 - ATE silicon debug and utilize scripting with perl/Tcl for efficient handling of ATE data

About you: 

- M. Tech in Electronics Engineering or Computer Engineering with 8+ years of semiconductor experience or B. Tech in Electronics Engineering or Computer Engineering with 12+ years of semiconductor experience
 - Expert with methods and techniques to design, implement and verify regular and shared bus based Memory BIST on repairable and non-repairable memories using Electrical fuses. 
 - Expert knowledge and practical work experience partnering with designers to implement highly customized and tools-driven MBIST solutions. 
 - Solid understanding of MBIST algorithms needed for 5nm and lower technology nodes and ability to code new algorithms, operation sets supporting tool driven solutions for functional safety applications. 
 - Experience in implementing EDT, SSN, IST, boundary scan, jtag/ijtag features. 
 - Work independently to generate test plans, run simulations and debug failures on RTL and Gate Level
 - Hands on experience in the usage of industry standard tools, like Siemens Tessent Shell flow, or Synopsys SMS/SHS flow
 - Experience in Multimedia subsystems DFT (Image, display, video etc. )
 - Expert understanding tradeoffs to optimize coverage and test time reduction with the ability to foresee physical implementation and timing challenges during early development. 
 - Experience in working with physical design teams to support STA constraints, reviewing timing reports. 
 - Expert in using silicon debug/diagnosis tools to root cause silicon bringup and production test issue. 
 - Experience in setting up and running Scan DRC flows in RTL. 
 - Experience with industry standard simulation tools, including Verilog, and scripting languages like Perl, Python, Shell or Tcl. 
 - Experience in revision control systems like GIT, perforce etc. . 
 - Needs in depth experience in stuck at, transition delay, path delay, etc. coverage loss analysis and identifying solutions to improve test coverage
 - Experience in leading the effort to derive cell aware fault models and develop necessary flows to generate ATPG and to support silicon debug. 
 - Good knowledge of functional safety, clock domain crossing analysis, logic synthesis and scan insertion

What we'll offer: 

At Ampere we believe in taking care of our employees and providing a competitive total rewards package that includes base pay, cash long-term incentive, and comprehensive benefits. 

Benefits highlights include: 

- Premium medical, dental, vision insurance, parental benefits includingcrechereimbursement, as well as a retirement plan, so thatyou can feel secure in your health, financial futureand child care during work. 
 - Generous paid time off policy so that you can embrace a healthy work-life balance
 - Fully catered lunch in our office along with a variety of healthy snacks, energizing coffee or tea, and refreshing drinks to keep you fueled and focused throughout the day. 

And thereismuch more than compensation and benefits. At Ampere, we foster an inclusive culture that empowers our employees to do more and grow more. We are excited to share more about our career opportunities with you through the interview process. 

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us. 

Ampere is an inclusive and equal opportunity employer and welcomes applicants from all backgrounds. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, citizenship, religion, age, veteran and/or military status, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, physical or mental disability, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law.

data.title: Sr. Software Developer -C++
data.description:
Opentext - The Information Company

OpenText is a global leader in information management, where innovation, creativity, and collaboration are the key components of our corporate culture. As a member of our team, you will have the opportunity to partner with the most highly regarded companies in the world, tackle complex issues, and contribute to projects that shape the future of digital transformation. 

AI-First. Future-Driven. Human-Centered. 

At OpenText, AI is at the heart of everything we do-powering innovation, transforming work, and empowering digital knowledge workers. We're hiring talent that AI can't replace to help us shape the future of information management. Join us. 

YOUR IMPACT

As a Senior Software Engineer on the CX-E Voice engineering team, you will develop, maintain, and enhance enterprise voice and unified messaging software. You will focus on sustaining engineering, investigating complex customer-reported issues, identifying root causes, fixing defects, and delivering reliable patches for released product versions. You will use your expertise in C++, Python, advanced debugging, and test automation to improve product quality and reliability across Linux and Windows environments. You will also leverage GitHub Copilot in Visual Studio Code and Visual Studio Professional to accelerate development and testing while ensuring the quality and correctness of AI-generated code. 

What The Role Offers

- Investigate, debug, and resolve complex production defects in the CX-E Voice back end. 
 - Perform root-cause analysis using logs, traces, crash dumps, WinDbg, and other debugging tools. 
 - Identify and fix memory leaks, heap corruption, concurrency issues, and other memory-related defects. 
 - Design, develop, and enhance back-end features using modern C++ across Linux and Windows environments.

data.title: Full-Stack Engineer (Cloud and AI)
data.description:
About GenAirate

GenAirate builds SnapLine, a submission intelligence platform that converts unstructured broker submissions (emails, PDFs, Excel, images) into structured, decision-ready data for underwriters. SnapLine was built for Lloyd's and the London Market and is now expanding into US specialty insurance. We are SOC 2 Type 2, ISO 27001 and ISO 42001 certified. 

The role

You will build and run the product end to end: the interfaces underwriters use, the services behind them, and the cloud infrastructure they run on. A large part of the work is the document processing pipeline that turns messy, inconsistent submissions into reliable structured data. We are looking for someone who cares about how systems are designed, takes responsibility for outcomes rather than tasks, and does not need to be chased. 

What you'll do

- Design, build and ship full-stack features, from API and data model through to a UI that works for underwriters under time pressure
 - Build and improve document processing pipelines: ingestion, classification, OCR and parsing, extraction, validation and traceability back to the source document
 - Design architectures that are clean, efficient and cost-aware, and that hold up as submission volumes and document variety grow
 - Build event-driven services on AWS and GCP, with sound choices on queues, storage, concurrency and failure handling
 - Integrate LLM-based components (RAG, retrieval, agentic workflows) with proper evaluation, fallbacks and monitoring
 - Take ownership of what you ship: deployment, observability, reliability and fixing problems at the root rather than patching symptoms
 - Raise issues early, make clear technical decisions, and write them down so the wider team can build on them
 - Work with product and design to turn real underwriter workflows into clear, accessible interfaces
 - Apply secure development practice as a normal part of the job, in line with our certifications

What we're looking for

- 3 to 6 years of professional software engineering, with production full-stack experience
 - Strong Python and TypeScript, with React or a comparable frontend framework
 - Experience building data or document processing pipelines that handle messy, real-world inputs
 - Good architectural judgement: you can explain trade-offs in performance, cost, maintainability and reliability, and you simplify rather than over-engineer
 - Hands-on cloud experience on AWS or GCP, including containers (ECS or Kubernetes), queues or messaging, and infrastructure as code
 - Solid grounding in APIs, data modelling, and both SQL and NoSQL stores
 - A track record of owning services in production: debugging, observability, incident response
 - A self-starter mindset: you take a problem from vague to shipped without close supervision
 - Clear written communication; you will be working across time zones with a UK and US team

Useful, not required

- Experience with LLM applications, vector search or OpenSearch, OCR or document AI tooling
 - Exposure to Bedrock, Pub/Sub, Firestore or similar services
 - Insurance or related financial services background. Not needed; we will teach the domain. 

What we offer

- Direct work on a product with live London Market and US customers
 - A small team where engineers have real ownership and influence on design
 - Competitive Compensation

How to apply

Send your CV and a short note on something you have built and run in production to shravan@genairate. io.

data.title: Senior SDET – Automation Framework Architect (Playwright, Selenium, API, CI/CD)
data.description:
Senior SDET - Automation Framework Architect (Playwright, Selenium, API, CI/CD)THE ROLEOwn test strategy, quality architecture, and the automated regression infrastructure for Securly Flex - the flex period scheduling and attendance platform that 1, 000+ schools use every school day to place students into intervention, enrichment, and support sessions. 

Flex decides where students are supposed to be. A defect in Autoassign placement, capacity limits, separation rules, roster sync, or attendance recording does not just break a feature - it can put a student in the wrong room, leave a must-attend intervention empty, place students together who are required to be kept apart, or send inaccurate attendance into a district's student information system. The test infrastructure you build is the last line of defense before production. 

This is an engineering leadership role, not a QA role. You will define what "production-ready" means for Flex, build the automation platform that enforces it through CI/CD quality gates, and write production-quality code for that platform yourself. You will also serve as the team's expert on rules-engine correctness and edge-case testing - your understanding of how Flex's rules interact (priorities, capacity limits, restricted sessions, sign-up cutoffs, and check-in controls) directly shapes both the test suite and the implementation team's design decisions. 

Location: Pune, India (Hybrid - 2 days onsite)
Experience: 6-10+ years
Reports to: Director of Quality Engineering

WHAT YOU'LL DO
 - Own the quality bar. Define what "passing" means for Flex: establish written quality criteria covering scheduling correctness, data integrity, access control, and performance that gate production releases. 
 - Test the rules engine. Design and implement automated test suites covering Autoassign placement logic - student choice, teacher priority, must-attend assignments, rostered and restricted sessions, at-risk designations, seat and room capacity, separation (contact control) rules, conflict detection, and the guarantee that manual registrations are never overwritten - plus the edge cases around them: conflicting rules, boundary conditions, concurrent registrations at capacity limits and sign-up cutoffs, API calls that skip UI validation, and permission boundaries. 
 - Gate every release. Build CI/CD quality gates that prevent regressions from reaching production; own the pipeline configuration and ensure the quality bar is enforced, not advisory. 
 - Set performance baselines. Measure and establish written performance baselines for peak-load moments: sign-up windows opening and closing, Autoassign runs before each flex period, and attendance taking across thousands of concurrent users; define the thresholds that constitute a performance regression. 
 - Cover web, mobile, and integrations. Own end-to-end coverage across web, mobile, and integrations: student, teacher, and admin workflows; the student mobile app; email, in-product, and push notifications; roster imports and attendance exports to the SIS; and the shared rostering and single sign-on Flex runs on with Securly Pass. 
 - Build the framework. Architect and build the Flex automation framework: reusable libraries, test data utilities for roster and attendance files, parallel execution, and reporting that the whole team extends - and contribute fixes to product code where it improves testability. 
 - Mentor and scale. Mentor engineers on test architecture as a first-class discipline, and bring AI-assisted tooling into how the team generates scenarios, triages failures, and scales coverage. 
 - Shape architecture. Partner with your technical lead and the Distinguished Engineer on architecture and testability decisions, and influence testing standards across teams beyond your own squad. 
 - Own incidents. Join the on-call rotation and own the full incident lifecycle for quality regressions: detection, diagnosis, resolution, and retrospective. 

SKILLS & REQUIREMENTSMust-Have
 - Test framework architecture - designing automation frameworks from scratch (page object or screenplay patterns, BDD where it fits, parallel execution, reporting) that other engineers extend. You build the platform, not just the scripts. 
 - Test automation (SDET-level) - Playwright, Cypress, or Selenium for UI plus API-level automation (REST, contract testing). Must automate business-rule behavior - placement decisions, capacity and eligibility rules, state transitions - not just UI interaction tests. 
 - CI/CD quality gates - integrating test suites into pipelines; defining and enforcing regression gates for a multi-tenant product used daily by 1, 000+ schools. At this level you own the definition of the bar, not just the tests that check it. 
 - Rules-engine and data-integrity testing - designing deterministic test data and fixtures for scheduling, allocation, or eligibility logic; building data utilities that validate rosters, registrations, and attendance across CSV/XML imports, exports, and concurrent edits. 
 - Strong programming - JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, or Python at production quality (TypeScript strongly preferred). Your test code is held to the same review standard as product code. 
 - Technical communication - ability to produce written quality criteria, test strategy and edge-case documentation, and performance baseline documents that the implementation team, engineering manager, PM, Support, and leadership can act on. 
 - Education & experience - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related technical field, with 6 to 10+ years of hands-on SDET / test automation experience. Strongly Preferred
 - Performance & concurrency testing - k6, JMeter, Gatling, or Locust; modeling burst traffic (thousands of users acting in the same minute) and catching race conditions at capacity limits and sign-up cutoffs. 
 - AI-assisted test engineering - using AI tools to generate test scenarios, triage failures, or scale framework adoption across teams. 
 - Security & access-control testing - role-based permissions (student / teacher / admin), multi-tenant data isolation between districts, and student data privacy expectations. Nice to Have
 - Mobile test automation - Appium, Maestro, Detox, or similar for iOS and Android; push notification and device-fragmentation coverage. 
 - Integration testing - SIS data import/export, rostering sync, single sign-on, and notification delivery (email, in-product, push). 
 - K-12 EdTech domain - understanding of bell schedules, flex and advisory periods, MTSS intervention tiers, and how districts manage SIS data helps design realistic test scenarios. WHO YOU ARE
 - You test the edge cases, not just the happy path. You test the ways the system should fail and doesn't, and you document those cases so the implementation team designs against them. 
 - You have built automation frameworks from the ground up - not just inherited them - and other engineers have built on what you designed. 
 - You treat test architecture as a first-class engineering discipline. A feature without a regression suite is not finished - and you enforce that standard through CI/CD gates, not just code review comments. 
 - You define what "quality" means on a product that decides where students are supposed to be, and produce written criteria that hold the codebase to that standard across every engineer and every release. 
 - You are hands-on at a senior level - you still write the framework code, and you raise the bar for everyone who writes tests after you. Experience shipping product feature code is a bonus, not a requirement. 
 - Your edge-case documentation and performance baselines are used by the implementation team to make better architecture decisions. Your influence extends past your own work. 
 - You own your area end to end with minimal oversight, and you resolve ambiguity in requirements and design tradeoffs instead of waiting for a fully formed spec. ABOUT SECURLYTech Giant Scale. EdTech Innovation. Unmatched Student Impact.
