data.description:
Job Title - Senior Specialist Automation

City, Country - Asoj, Vadodara, India

At dsm-firmenich, being a force for good is not optional. Diversity, Equity & Inclusion is a shared responsibility woven into our daily work to not only benefit our People, Customers & Communities but also drive business value. Equal access to opportunities is a given, belonging is a shared feeling, authenticity is celebrated. 

Your Key Responsibilities

- Troubleshoot and maintain PLC, SCADA, HMI, MES, and industrial automation systems to ensure uninterrupted manufacturing operations. 
 - Diagnose and resolve automation-related equipment failures, process control issues, and communication network faults. 
 - Perform PLC programming modifications, online troubleshooting, backup management, and software version control. 
 - Support MES systems, electronic batch records, production data collection systems, barcode solutions, and shop-floor digital applications. 
 - Investigate and resolve integration issues between PLCs, MES, SCADA systems, weighing systems, printers, scanners, and ERP interfaces. 
 - Maintain industrial communication networks including Modbus, Profibus, Profinet, OPC, Ethernet/IP, and TCP/IP-based systems. 
 - Support installation, commissioning, validation, and qualification activities for automation and digitalization projects. 
 - Maintain software backups, automation documentation, network architecture drawings, and system configuration records. 
 - Support Industry 4. 0 initiatives, process digitalization projects, and continuous improvement programs. 
 - Perform Root Cause Analysis (RCA) of automation, MES, and system failures to minimize manufacturing downtime. 
 - Troubleshoot industrial PCs, operator workstations, thin clients, printers, barcode readers, network switches, and other manufacturing IT infrastructure. 
 - Coordinate with corporate IT teams for server, network, cybersecurity, and infrastructure-related issues. 
 - Support manufacturing applications and system administration activities including SAP functional support. 
 - Ensure compliance with GMP, Data Integrity, cybersecurity, and quality requirements. 
 - Reading and interpreting P&IDs, control philosophies, network architecture diagrams, electrical drawings, and automation schematics. 
 - Support VFDs, MCCs, motors, sensors, actuators, and field instrumentation integrated with automation systems. 

Compliance & Safety Skills

- Permit to Work (PTW), LOTO, and electrical safety practices. 
 - Knowledge of GMP, Data Integrity (ALCOA+), and computerized system compliance requirements. 
 - Awareness of OT cybersecurity principles and industrial network security practices. 
 - Participation in audits, risk assessments, system validations, and safety inspections. 
 - Compliance with change management, deviation management, and CAPA processes. 
 - Knowledge of hazardous area requirements and safe operation of automation and electrical systems. 

We bring. 

- Empowerment to make meaningful contributions while upholding ethical standards. 
 - Recognition and celebration of your efforts and accomplishments. 
 - Opportunities for growth and advancement for those who embrace innovation and take initiative. 
 - Opportunity to build a career making a significant impact on billions of lives, with the freedom to shape your own path. 
 - Responsibility and accountability in living company values and driving sustainable solutions. 
 - Supportive environment where individuals are empowered to progress and contribute to meaningful change. 

You bring. 

- B. E. / B. Tech in Electrical Engineering, Instrumentation Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Automation Engineering, or equivalent. 
 - 6-8 years of experience in industrial automation, MES systems, and manufacturing digital technologies. 
 - Strong knowledge of PLC, SCADA, HMI, industrial networking, and process automation systems. 
 - Hands-on experience with Siemens, Allen Bradley/Rockwell, Schneider, ABB, Mitsubishi, or equivalent automation platforms. 
 - Experience supporting MES applications, shop-floor systems, and automated manufacturing processes. 
 - Understanding of industrial communication protocols including Modbus, Profinet, Profibus, OPC, and Ethernet/IP. 
 - Hands-on troubleshooting experience of industrial PCs, network devices, printers, barcode scanners, and manufacturing IT infrastructure. 
 - Familiarity with SQL databases, data historians, reporting tools, and manufacturing data management systems will be an advantage. 
 - Basic understanding of cybersecurity concepts related to Operational Technology (OT) environments. 
 - Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills. 
 - Ability to work independently and collaboratively in cross-functional teams. 
 - Good communication and stakeholder management skills. 

Note

We believe in building strong operational and business understanding from day one. Accordingly, the successful candidate will undertake a structured 4-month immersion program at our Daman Manufacturing Facility. Company-provided accommodation will be available throughout the training period. Upon completion, the employee will transition to Vadodara, which will be the designated permanent work location. 

Equal opportunities commitment

dsm-firmenich is fully dedicated to inclusion because when people feel engaged and empowered, their creativity and innovation drive unprecedented progress. We aim to build a workplace where opportunity really is equal, so everyone can thrive. We do not discriminate if there's a place for everyone at dsm-firmenich. 

As a committed equal opportunity employer, we ensure our recruitment practices are inclusive and fair. We encourage the recruitment of a diverse workforce, representative of the communities in which we work, by using inclusive language, diverse interview panels, and diversified sourcing strategies. Selection is based on qualifications, competency, experience, performance history and fit with the team to advance fair and equitable opportunity. 

Employment decisions are based upon job-related reasons regardless of an applicant's race, color, ethnicity, national origin, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, backgrounds, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other status protected by law. 

We are committed to providing reasonable support for disabled applicants in our recruiting process. Should you need assistance, and are comfortable to share this, please let us know. 

About Dsm-firmenich

At dsm-firmenich, we don't just meet expectations - we go beyond them. 

Join our global team powered by science, creativity, and a shared purpose: to bring progress to life. 

From elevating health to making fortified food and sustainable skincare, the impact of your work here will be felt by millions - every single day. Whether it's fragrance that helps you focus, alternative meat that's better for the planet, or reducing sugar without losing flavor, this is where you help shape the future of nutrition, health, and beauty for everyone, everywhere. 

And while you're making a difference, we'll make sure you're growing too. With learning that never stops, a culture that lifts you up and the freedom to move across businesses, teams, and borders. Your voice matters here. And your ideas? They're essential to our future. 

Because real progress only happens when we go beyond, together. 

Our Application Process

Interested in this position? Please apply on-line by uploading your resume in English via our career portal (www. dsm-firmenich. com/careers). For further information, please contact Supriya Patade, Talent Acquisition Partner (Supriya. patade@dsm-firmenich. com). 

Inclusion, Belonging And Equal Opportunity Statement

At dsm-firmenich, we believe being a force for good starts with the way we treat each other. When people feel supported, included, and free to be themselves, they do their best work - and that's exactly the kind of culture we're building. A place where opportunity is truly equal, authenticity is celebrated, and everyone has the chance to grow, contribute, and feel they belong. 

We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and we're serious about making our hiring process as fair and inclusive as possible. From inclusive language and diverse interview panels to thoughtful sourcing, we're committed to reflecting on the world we serve. 

We welcome candidates from all backgrounds - no matter your gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, or anything else that makes you. 

And if you have a disability or need any support through the application process, we're here to help - just let us know what you need, and we'll do everything we can to make it work. 

Agency statement

We're managing this search directly at dsm-firmenich. If you're applying as an individual, we'd love to hear from you. We're not accept agency submissions or proposals involving fees or commissions for this role.

data.title: Lead Data Scientist - AI Delivery
data.description:
About The Role

The FCC DnA team is seeking an experienced Lead Data Scientist to provide technical and delivery leadership across multiple AI and Data Science initiatives. This role will serve as a key India delivery partner to the U. S. AI leadership team and will be responsible for independently driving execution across products and use cases such as Data Integrity, intelligent document processing, Broker Statement processing, workflow automation and other Applied AI initiatives. 

The role requires a strong technical leader who can manage a small team, translate business priorities into executable plans, remove delivery blockers and work effectively across Data Science, Product, Engineering and Platform teams. Since these solutions are deployed on the Digital Twin platform, the successful candidate should be comfortable working with platform engineering teams on APIs, environments, deployments, integrations, monitoring and production issues. 

This is not intended to be a pure people-management role or a pure modeling role. The person should maintain strong technical depth across Data Science, Machine Learning and Applied AI, while also understanding enough software and platform engineering to move solutions from development through production. Experience with Statistical Modeling and model lifecycle management is a strong plus, as the role will also support and collaborate with the broader AI Modeling team. 

The successful candidate should be able to work independently with limited day-to-day supervision, take ownership of delivery outcomes, communicate risks and decisions clearly, and present technical progress and recommendations confidently to senior leaders. 

Key Responsibilities

- Own end-to-end delivery of multiple AI and Data Science initiatives from requirements and solution design through development, testing, deployment and production stabilization. 
 - Act as the primary India delivery lead for assigned initiatives and independently manage priorities, milestones, dependencies, risks and execution. 
 - Lead and mentor a small team of Data Scientists, AI Engineers and technical resources, providing clear direction, technical guidance and accountability. 
 - Translate ambiguous business problems into practical AI, analytics and engineering solutions aligned to business outcomes. 
 - Partner closely with the Digital Twin platform team to resolve environment, integration, deployment, performance and production issues. 
 - Provide sufficient technical depth to distinguish whether issues originate in the model, application, integration, data or platform layer and coordinate the appropriate resolution. 
 - Participate in solution architecture and design discussions and ensure solutions are scalable, reliable, secure and maintainable. 
 - Guide teams on API integrations, data pipelines, authentication, cloud environments, CI/CD, logging, monitoring and other production dependencies. 
 - Provide technical oversight for Machine Learning, NLP, document intelligence, Generative AI, RAG and Agentic AI solutions. 
 - Review model and AI approaches, evaluation methodology, error analysis, performance metrics and implementation trade-offs. 
 - Partner with the AI Modeling team on model development, validation, monitoring, drift detection and productionization when required. 
 - Drive root-cause analysis and corrective actions when solution accuracy, reliability or production performance is below expectations. 
 - Promote reusable frameworks, components and delivery patterns that can support multiple products and customers. 
 - Partner with Product, Business, Advisory, Engineering and Content teams to ensure technical delivery remains aligned to customer and business needs. 
 - Provide concise status updates covering progress, risks, dependencies and decisions required, and escalate issues early with recommended actions. 
 - Present technical solutions, delivery updates and recommendations clearly to senior leaders and non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Support hiring, interviewing, mentoring and capability development as the AI/Data Science team grows. 

Experience

Required Qualifications

- 8+ years of progressive experience in Data Science, Machine Learning, Applied AI, AI Engineering or related technical roles. 
 - Demonstrated experience leading end-to-end delivery of production AI, Machine Learning or analytics solutions. 
 - At least 2-3 years of experience leading technical teams, workstreams or complex cross-functional initiatives. 
 - Proven ability to independently manage multiple projects or workstreams with limited supervision. 
 - Experience working with Engineering, Platform, DevOps or Cloud teams to move AI solutions into production. 
 - Experience troubleshooting production issues and coordinating resolution across multiple technical teams. 
 - Experience managing, mentoring or providing technical direction to Data Scientists and/or AI Engineers. 
 - Experience communicating technical decisions, risks and outcomes to senior stakeholders. 
 - Experience working in distributed or global teams is strongly preferred. 
 - Experience in Financial Services, Banking, Insurance, Risk, Regulatory or Compliance environments is desirable. 

Data Science & Modeling Expertise

- Strong understanding of Statistics, Machine Learning and predictive modeling concepts. 
 - Experience with regression, classification, tree-based models, ensemble methods, clustering and other common Machine Learning techniques. 
 - Strong understanding of model evaluation, validation, feature engineering, overfitting, class imbalance, data leakage and model monitoring. 
 - Ability to challenge model selection and evaluation approaches and assess trade-offs across accuracy, explainability, stability and maintainability. 
 - Understanding of model lifecycle management including development, validation, deployment, monitoring, drift detection and retraining. 
 - Experience with document intelligence, NLP or unstructured data processing is highly desirable. 
 - Experience with Generative AI, LLMs, embeddings, RAG and Agentic AI is highly desirable. 
 - Ability to determine when traditional Machine Learning, Generative AI or a hybrid approach is most appropriate. 

AI, Engineering & Platform Skills

- Strong Python skills and good SQL and data engineering fundamentals. 
 - Strong understanding of REST APIs and enterprise system integrations. 
 - Experience with Azure and/or AWS cloud environments. 
 - Good understanding of Docker, Git, CI/CD and modern software delivery practices. 
 - Working knowledge of application architecture, microservices and scalable system design. 
 - Understanding of authentication, secrets management, API security and enterprise networking concepts. 
 - Experience with logging, monitoring, troubleshooting and production support. 
 - Understanding of MLOps and/or LLMOps practices including versioning, deployment, monitoring and evaluation. 
 - Ability to work effectively with platform engineers without needing to be a dedicated platform engineer. 

Leadership Mindset

- Takes ownership of outcomes rather than limiting responsibility to assigned tasks. 
 - Works independently and moves initiatives forward even when requirements or dependencies are ambiguous. 
 - Balances business priorities, technical quality, delivery speed and long-term maintainability. 
 - Identifies risks early, performs root-cause analysis and brings solution-oriented recommendations. 
 - Challenges technical assumptions constructively and raises the quality of decisions across the team. 
 - Develops team members through technical coaching, clear expectations and meaningful feedback. 
 - Communicates confidently with Data Scientists, Engineers, Product leaders and senior business stakeholders. 
 - Can present complex technical topics in clear business language and influence decisions across teams. 
 - Remains hands-on enough to provide meaningful technical guidance while successfully leading delivery across multiple initiatives. 
 - Demonstrates strong judgment, accountability and a collaborative leadership style. 

Education

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Data Science, Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Engineering or another quantitative/technical discipline. 

Our Interview Practices

To maintain a fair and genuine hiring process, we kindly ask that all candidates participate in interviews without the assistance of AI tools or external prompts. Our interview process is designed to assess your individual skills, experiences, and communication style. We value authenticity and want to ensure we're getting to know you-not a digital assistant. To help maintain this integrity, we ask to remove virtual backgrounds and include in-person interviews in our hiring process. Please note that use of AI-generated responses or third-party support during interviews will be grounds for disqualification from the recruitment process. 

Applicants may be required to appear onsite at a Wolters Kluwer office as part of the recruitment process.

data.title: Team Lead - Platform Monitoring Engineer
data.description:
We are seeking an experienced, hands-on Team Lead to shape the future of platform observability and proactive customer monitoring. This is a high-impact technical role for someone who thrives at the intersection of platform reliability, incident response, and customer obsession. 

The successful candidate will balance technical depth with people leadership: driving monitoring solutions, alerting mechanisms, and customer-focused incident detection tools, and raising the bar of the engineers around them. You will partner closely with cross-functional engineering teams to investigate and resolve incidents, drive root cause analyses, and champion solutions that improve customer reliability and stability of the Databricks Platform. 

The Impact You Will Have

Technical Leadership

- Lead platform incident investigation, coordinating cross-functional teams through rapid detection, mitigation, and resolution to minimize customer impact. 
 - Conduct thorough post-incident root cause analysis across infrastructure, services, and cloud providers to identify systemic patterns and prevent future occurrences. 
 - Guide the design and implementation of customer-focused alerting pipelines and end-to-end observability workflows that expand detection coverage and reduce mean time to detection. 
 - Build automation tools, establish reusable monitoring patterns, and resolve reliability gaps that directly impact customer experience. 
 - Participate in and help structure the on-call rotation, leading by example during high-severity incidents. 

People Leadership

- Collaborate with internal customer stakeholders to design and execute the customers' reliability plan, focusing on observability and monitoring. 
 - Participate in growing the local team of Platform Monitoring Engineers, including hiring and onboarding. 
 - Act as the local point of leadership and a connection to the broader global team, aligning local execution with global goals. 

What We Are Looking For

- Minimum of 6 years of experience as an SRE, DevOps Engineer, CRE, Production Engineer, or similar role. 
 - 2+ years of experience leading engineers, whether as a people manager or team lead, with clear mentorship and coaching responsibilities. 
 - Production-level experience with at least one major cloud provider (AWS, Azure, GCP) and proficiency in container and orchestration technologies (Docker, Kubernetes). 
 - Hands-on experience with monitoring, logging, and alerting tools such as ELK, Prometheus, Grafana, PagerDuty, etc. Ability to architect monitoring solutions that correlate metrics, logs, and traces. 
 - Strong proficiency in Python or similar languages with the ability to build production-quality automation tools. 
 - Experience owning critical phases of the incident lifecycle from detection through resolution and post-mortem analysis in demanding production environments. 
 - Excellent communication skills, with the ability to influence cross-functional partners. 
 - BS, Master's, or PhD in Computer Science or Computer Engineering, or a related Engineering field.

ASSOCIATE MANAGER, IN-STOCK OPERATIONS Role Summary

The Associate Manager, In-Stock Operations leads a team of In-Stock Specialists, translating individual execution into consistent team-wide performance. You own the team's output quality, capacity, and development - setting priorities, unblocking your team, and driving the projects that move inventory health metrics forward. You are accountable for your team's results, not just your own. 

What You'll Do

- Manage a team of In-Stock Specialists (I, II, and Senior) - setting goals, assigning work, and monitoring performance against SLAs and inventory health metrics (DIO, in-stock rate). 
 - Own hiring, onboarding, performance reviews, coaching, and career development for direct reports. 
 - Run team rituals (1: 1s, stand-ups, retros) and maintain a clear view of team capacity, workload distribution, and coverage. 
 - Lead cross-functional projects end-to-end (e. g. , WBR, new brand onboarding, expiration-date programme) - defining scope, timelines, and success metrics, and coordinating across brand management, the US team, and leadership. 
 - Identify and prioritize automation and process-improvement opportunities across the team, and hold owners accountable for shipping them. 
 - Own and present WBR-level reporting and inventory health metrics to leadership, translating data into a clear narrative and action plan. 
 - Serve as the escalation point for complex vendor, catalogue, or marketplace issues that require cross-team coordination or leadership visibility. 
 - Partner with brand management and marketplace leads to align on inventory strategy and proactively manage risk. 
 - Build and maintain team documentation, training materials, and onboarding processes so the team scales without you as a bottleneck. 

What Success Looks Like

- Team consistently meets or exceeds SLAs 
 - Your team's capacity and skills grow over time - specialists are promoted, and the team absorbs more scope without proportional headcount growth. 
 - Cross-functional projects you own land on time and deliver measurable results. 
 - You spend meaningfully more time on planning, coaching, and problem-solving than on individual task execution. 

Qualifications

- 2+ years of experience in inventory operations, supply chain, or e-commerce operations, including direct ownership of core inventory processes. 
 - Prior experience managing or leading a team - formally or informally - including hiring, coaching, and performance management. 
 - Strong project management skills - able to scope, sequence, and drive cross-functional projects to completion. 
 - Deep fluency in inventory health metrics (DIO, in-stock rate) and the forecasting/ordering mechanics that drive them. 
 - Comfortable pulling and synthesizing data from multiple systems (e. g. , Snowflake, brand selling accounts) to build a narrative for leadership. 
 - Track record of identifying and shipping process or automation improvements using AI tools, scripts, or workflow automation. 
 - Experience with e-commerce marketplaces (Amazon, Chewy, Australia marketplace, or equivalent) strongly preferred. 
 - Excellent written and verbal communication; able to build trust with stakeholders across functions and time zones. 

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

Amazon Flex delights customers by delivering millions of packages faster than ever before. While this group continues to expand, the tech systems of this group have evolved into reusable architectures operating at hyper scale (while maintaining agility and being nimble to change) that can cater to the anticipated growth of this business over the next few years. data.description:
Agentic AI Platform Architect & Product Lead

Employment Type: Full-Time

Experience: 10+ years of overall software engineering experience, including 3+ years of hands-on experience in AI/ML, LLM application development, Generative AI, platform architecture, solution architecture, or technical product development. 

Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced Agentic AI Platform Architect & Product Lead to drive the development and evolution of the Fluid AIQ Platform and lead AI-powered application development for upcoming client projects. 

The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on experience building production-ready applications using LLMs, AI agents, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), tool/function calling, workflow orchestration, and modern AI frameworks. 

This role goes beyond traditional chatbot development, focusing on building intelligent agentic applications capable of reasoning, planning, interacting with enterprise systems, using tools, and operating within defined guardrails. 

The position combines AI architecture, hands-on engineering, technical leadership, and product commercialization. You will help transform platform capabilities into modular commercial offerings that can be deployed independently and expanded based on client requirements. 

Key Responsibilities

1. Agentic AI Architecture & Platform Development

- Design scalable architectures for agentic AI applications, including single-agent and multi-agent systems. 
 - Define agent orchestration, tool usage, memory, state management, and workflow patterns. 
 - Establish reusable reference architectures, implementation guides, client onboarding playbooks, and engineering standards. 
 - Evaluate AI technologies, models, frameworks, and infrastructure based on business and technical requirements. 
 - Contribute to the evolution and architecture of the Fluid AIQ Platform. 

2. AI Application Development

- Build production-ready applications using AI agents, LLMs, RAG, and workflow automation. 
 - Implement tool/function calling, planning and reasoning workflows, and human-in-the-loop processes. 
 - Develop integrations with enterprise APIs, business applications, and external systems. 
 - Implement MCP Server/Client integrations and autonomous or semi-autonomous workflows. 
 - Build AI-powered decision-support solutions and reusable platform components. 

3. LLM & Generative AI Engineering

- Work with LLM providers and models, including OpenAI, Anthropic/Claude, Azure OpenAI, Google Gemini, and open-source or local models. 
 - Implement prompt engineering, structured outputs, context management, function calling, and model fallback strategies. 
 - Evaluate and benchmark models based on cost, performance, latency, privacy, and business use cases. 
 - Ensure flexibility in model and framework selection without unnecessary platform dependency on a single provider. 

4. Product Leadership & Commercialization

- Take technical and product ownership of Fluid platform components and client AI programs. 
 - Help package platform capabilities into independent, commercially viable modules. 
 - Support the commercialization of reusable platform capabilities and technical IP. 
 - Develop sales-enablement materials and implementation guidance. 
 - Track and report platform health, adoption, and delivery metrics to leadership. 

5. AI Safety, Reliability & Governance

- Implement guardrails and validation mechanisms to reduce hallucinations, incorrect tool usage, unauthorized actions, and unsafe outputs. 
 - Design human-approval workflows where required. 
 - Build reliable agent workflows with error handling, retries, fallback mechanisms, and observability. 
 - Support release management, environment management, service-level objectives, and production support models. 
 - Address security, privacy, compliance, and responsible AI requirements. 

6. Technical Leadership & Collaboration

- Lead and mentor architects and engineers working on agentic AI solutions. 
 - Collaborate with architecture, development, and cross-functional teams. 
 - Evaluate emerging AI technologies and build proof of concepts (POCs). 
 - Ensure solutions meet business requirements, quality standards, and delivery timelines. 

Mandatory Technical Skills

Agentic AI & Generative AI

- Strong understanding of Generative AI, LLMs, AI agents, and agentic AI architectures. 
 - Hands-on experience with RAG, prompt engineering, embeddings, vector search, context management, and AI evaluation. 
 - Experience with agent orchestration, tool/function calling, multi-agent systems, agent memory and state, and human-in-the-loop workflows. 
 - Understanding of agent guardrails, reliability, and observability. 

Programming & Application Development

- Strong programming skills in at least one of the following: Python or Node. js/TypeScript. 
 - Experience with REST APIs, microservices, authentication and authorization, asynchronous processing, event-driven architectures, and database integration. 

AI Frameworks & SDKs

- Hands-on experience with one or more of the following: LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, OpenAI SDK, Anthropic SDK, Claude Agents SDK, or equivalent agent SDKs. 
 - Ability to evaluate and select frameworks based on solution requirements rather than relying on a single technology. 

LLM Integration

- Experience integrating multiple LLM providers, preferably OpenAI, Anthropic/Claude, Azure OpenAI, Google Gemini, or Ollama/open-source LLMs. 

Data Engineering & RAG

- Experience with PostgreSQL, vector databases, pgvector, Pinecone, Weaviate, Qdrant, or similar technologies. 
 - Knowledge of embedding models, document processing, semantic search, and hybrid search. 
 - Familiarity with knowledge graphs and ontology design, including Neo4j, RDF/OWL, or GraphRAG. 
 - Understanding of multi-tenant data architecture. 

Cloud Platforms

- Strong experience with at least one cloud platform: Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud. 

Good-to-Have Skills

- Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations. 
 - Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, and other AI coding tools. 
 - Ollama and open-source LLMs. 
 - Multimodal AI, Voice AI, and AI workflow automation. 
 - AI observability, evaluation platforms, and model evaluation. 
 - Fine-tuning, AI security, prompt-injection protection, and PII/data protection. 
 - Enterprise SaaS, CRM, and ERP integrations. 
 - AI FinOps and FinOps Foundation practices. 
 - Cloud marketplace listings, including Azure Marketplace and AWS Marketplace. 
 - Product management experience and experience commercializing consulting IP as licensed software. 
 - Experience replacing or complementing traditional RPA solutions with AI-agent-based approaches. 

What We're Looking For

- A hands-on technical leader who can translate business requirements into scalable agentic AI solutions. 
 - Someone who can combine architecture, engineering, platform development, and product thinking. 
 - A professional capable of taking AI capabilities from proof of concept to production-ready and commercially deployable solutions. 
 - Strong communication, technical decision-making, stakeholder management, and mentoring skills. 

Interested in building production-grade Agentic AI platforms and bringing AI-powered products to market? Apply now!

data.title: Manager / Senior Manager – Design & Engineering
data.description:
About Kirloskar Solar: It was the year 1888. A seed was planted. It has been a long and wonderful journey and the main constants have been our integrity, our innovation and our wonderful customers. Our group's scope of operations span across a vast spectrum of industries. Kirloskar Solar is propelled by a leading multi-engineering conglomerate, backed by 133 years of glorious legacy and undisputed leadership in giving cutting edge technology - The Kirloskar Group. We offer turn-key solar solutions, products, and services to all segments, from residential to large scale commercial and industries. We have an extensive portfolio of customers in all segments like Residential, Commercial, Industries, SMEs across sectors like Health care, Hospitality, Automotive, Commercial, Education, Agriculture and Manufacturing. We provide sustainable energy efficient solution to serve the entire spectrum of electricity consumers from those who have zero power cuts to those who have frequent power cuts. Product basket consists of solar PV modules, On-Grid String Inverters, On-Grid Central Inverters, Off-Grid Inverters, Off-Grid and On-Grid Power Packs. Please feel free to peruse our website www. kirloskarsolar. com for in depth details about our organization. 

Position Overview: We are seeking an experienced, technically strong, and detail-oriented Manager / Senior Manager - Design & Engineering to lead basic and detailed engineering for rooftop and ground-mounted solar power projects. The candidate will be responsible for developing optimized, technically compliant, and cost-effective engineering solutions from initial feasibility and concept design through detailed engineering, final Bill of Materials (BOM), and execution support. The ideal candidate must have strong hands-on experience in solar EPC design, electrical and civil/structural engineering coordination, engineering calculations, equipment selection, technical specifications, and design optimization. The candidate should be capable of balancing technical performance, safety, constructability, project cost, and contractual requirements while leading a multidisciplinary engineering team. 

Key Roles and Responsibilities

A. Basic and Detailed Engineering: Lead basic and detailed design engineering for rooftop and ground-mounted solar PV projects across different capacities. Review project inputs, site surveys, feasibility assessments, client specifications, tender documents, and contractual requirements. Develop concept designs, design philosophies, engineering criteria, system configurations, and technical design packages. Ensure seamless transition from preliminary engineering to detailed design and execution ready drawings. Coordinate with project execution, procurement, quality, commissioning, and O&M teams to ensure design practicality and constructability. Provide technical support during project execution and resolve site-related engineering issues. 

B. Solar PV System Design and Optimization: Prepare and review PV module layouts, string configurations, inverter sizing, DC/AC ratios, equipment placement, and plant capacity optimization. Optimize module orientation, tilt angle, row spacing, shading losses, cable routing, and energy yield. Evaluate rooftop structural constraints, available installation areas, roof loading, access pathways, and maintenance clearances. Develop ground-mounted plant layouts considering topography, grading, drainage, access roads, soil conditions, setbacks, and evacuation infrastructure. Evaluate alternative design configurations to improve generation, reduce electrical losses, minimize material consumption, and lower overall project costs. Support energy yield assessments and performance calculations using appropriate engineering tools and simulation software. 

C. Electrical Design and Engineering: Prepare and review single-line diagrams (SLDs), DC and AC schematics, string layouts, cable schedules, cable sizing calculations, and electrical load calculations. Perform voltage-drop, short-circuit, fault-level, earthing, lightning protection, and electrical equipment sizing calculations. Design and review inverter transformer systems, HT/LT switchgear, protection systems, metering arrangements, and auxiliary power systems. Develop earthing layouts, lightning protection layouts, cable trench and tray routing, and electrical equipment layouts. Prepare protection coordination requirements, relay setting inputs, and grid interface engineering in coordination with relevant specialists. Review grid connectivity requirements and coordinate technical submissions for utility approvals and electrical inspections. Ensure appropriate consideration of electrical safety, system reliability, maintainability, and applicable grid requirements. 

D. Civil, Structural and Mechanical Engineering Coordination: Coordinate structural engineering for rooftop mounting systems and ground-mounted module mounting structures (MMS). Review structural loading, wind loads, foundations, pile design inputs, soil investigation reports, and mounting structure specifications. Coordinate civil drawings for foundations, inverter and transformer platforms, control rooms, cable trenches, roads, drainage, and associated infrastructure. Review roof load assessments, waterproofing requirements, structural adequacy, and installation constraints for rooftop projects. Verify alignment between module dimensions, mounting structure design, equipment foundations, and electrical layouts. Coordinate with internal teams and external consultants to resolve interdisciplinary engineering conflicts. 

E. Engineering Calculations, Standards and Compliance • Perform, review, and approve engineering calculations and design documents within the assigned technical authority. • Ensure compliance with applicable Indian Standards (IS), relevant IEC standards, IEEE standards, and other applicable national and international codes. Apply relevant CEA regulations, electrical safety requirements, grid codes, and applicable DISCOM/utility technical specifications. Ensure that the latest applicable standards, client specifications, and statutory requirements are incorporated into engineering deliverables. Review design assumptions, calculation methodologies, technical deviations, and engineering risks. Maintain engineering design criteria, calculation templates, standard drawings, specifications, and technical documentation. 

F. Bill of Materials (BOM) and Cost Optimization: Develop and finalize detailed project BOMs covering PV modules, inverters, MMS, DC and AC cables, connectors, junction boxes, transformers, switchgear, earthing, lightning protection, and other associated equipment. Prepare accurate material quantity take-offs from approved engineering drawings and calculations. Coordinate with procurement and SCM teams to finalize technical specifications, equipment selection, and vendor documentation. Identify value-engineering opportunities through optimized equipment sizing, cable selection, structural design, layout efficiency, and material utilization. Evaluate alternate makes, technologies, and technical configurations without compromising safety, quality, performance, or contractual compliance. Minimize design changes, excess material consumption, wastage, and avoidable procurement costs. Ensure alignment between the final BOM, approved drawings, project budget, and execution requirements. 

G. Technical Specifications and Vendor Engineering: Prepare technical specifications, datasheets, tender drawings, equipment schedules, and technical evaluation documents. Review vendor drawings, datasheets, design calculations, quality documents, and technical submittals. Conduct technical bid evaluations and support procurement in selecting technically suitable and commercially competitive equipment. Coordinate with manufacturers and suppliers for technical clarifications, deviations, and engineering approvals. • Ensure consistency between equipment interfaces, project specifications, design calculations, and approved drawings. 

H. Design Review and Quality Assurance: Establish design review procedures, interdisciplinary checks, and engineering document control systems. Conduct design reviews, constructability assessments, and internal technical audits before drawing release. Implement revision control, approval workflows, and document traceability. Ensure timely issuance of approved-for-construction (AFC) drawings and other execution critical documents. Resolve engineering comments from clients, consultants, utilities, and project execution teams. Maintain a repository of standard designs, lessons learned, and engineering best practices. 

I. Team Leadership and Cross-Functional Coordination: Lead, mentor, and develop design engineers and multidisciplinary engineering resources. Allocate engineering deliverables, define priorities, monitor productivity, and ensure adherence to project schedules. Establish clear accountability for design accuracy, technical quality, document release, and engineering cost optimization. Coordinate effectively with Projects, Procurement, SCM, Business Development, O&M, Quality, and Commissioning teams. Provide technical guidance on complex design issues and support resolution of site engineering challenges. Develop standardized engineering processes and continuously improve design efficiency and quality. 

Essential Qualifications and Experience

• B. E. / B. Tech. in Electrical, Electronics, or Mechanical Engineering from a recognized institution. 

• 10-15 years of relevant experience in solar or renewable energy design and engineering, preferably within a Solar EPC organization. 

• Strong hands-on experience in basic and detailed design of both rooftop and ground-mounted solar PV projects. 

• Proven experience preparing and reviewing engineering calculations, technical drawings, specifications, equipment sizing, and final BOMs. 

• Strong understanding of DC and AC electrical design, cable sizing, voltage drop, short-circuit calculations, earthing, lightning protection, and protection systems. 

• Practical experience in layout optimization, equipment selection, structural and civil engineering coordination, and value engineering. 

• Working knowledge of applicable IS, IEC, IEEE, CEA, and utility-specific standards and requirements. 

• Experience coordinating with procurement, project execution, vendors, clients, and statutory authorities on technical matters. 

• Willingness to travel 20-30% across India for site surveys, design reviews, technical discussions, and project support.

data.title: Staff Engineer Software - AUTOSAR MCAL
data.description:
About GlobalFoundries

GlobalFoundries is a leading full-service semiconductor foundry providing a unique combination of design, development, and fabrication services to some of the world's most inspired technology companies. With a global manufacturing footprint spanning three continents, GlobalFoundries makes possible the technologies and systems that transform industries and give customers the power to shape their markets. For more information, visit www. gf. com. 

MIPS by GlobalFoundries company is a microprocessor pioneer with deep roots in RISC-based computing. Today, MIPS is building RISC-V processor solutions for high-performance and embedded applications, combining CPU architecture expertise with platform software, tools, and ecosystem enablement. 

Join the RISC-V Revolution at MIPS!

Introduction

We are looking for hands-on embedded software engineers to develop AUTOSAR-compliant MCAL components for next-generation MIPS RISC-V automotive real-time MCUs. You will work across driver development, hardware bring-up, safety-compliant engineering, integration, and validation for applications including ADAS, powertrain, body electronics, and domain controllers. 

What You'll Do

- Develop and maintain AUTOSAR MCAL drivers for peripherals such as ADC, PWM, GPT, ICU, DIO, PORT, CAN, LIN, SPI, UART, WDG, MCU, FLS, and Ethernet. 
 - Own assigned MCAL modules across requirements analysis, design, coding, configuration, unit testing, integration, and validation. 
 - Implement software in compliance with MISRA C and AUTOSAR coding guidelines, and resolve findings from static-analysis tools. 
 - Create software design descriptions, configuration guidance, test specifications, traceability, and other required engineering work products. 
 - Bring up and debug MCAL drivers on FPGA and silicon using Lauterbach, iSystem, or similar embedded debug tools. 
 - Collaborate with SoC architecture, hardware, platform software, functional safety, validation, and tools teams on clocks, resets, interrupts, DMA, memory maps, and peripheral integration. 
 - Integrate MCAL components with AUTOSAR BSW stacks and configuration environments, and support system-level issue resolution. 
 - Develop automated unit, integration, and regression tests and contribute to CI-based quality checks. 
 - Participate in code reviews, design reviews, defect analysis, and continuous improvement of reusable MCAL components. 

What You Should Have

- 4-6 years of embedded software development experience, including meaningful hands-on AUTOSAR MCAL or low-level driver development. 
 - Strong embedded C programming skills and practical knowledge of pointers, memory-mapped I/O, interrupts, concurrency, and linker or startup concepts. 
 - Experience developing or integrating MCAL modules and working with AUTOSAR specifications and configuration workflows. 
 - Good understanding of MCU subsystems including clocks, resets, interrupt controllers, DMA, timers, watchdogs, communication peripherals, and memory interfaces. 
 - Experience with MISRA C, static analysis, code reviews, unit testing, and requirements-to-test traceability. 
 - Working knowledge of ISO 26262 software development practices and safety-oriented engineering deliverables. 
 - Experience with hardware bring-up and debugging using Lauterbach, iSystem, J-Link, oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, or similar equipment. 
 - Experience with Git and scripting in Python or shell for build and test automation. 
 - Ability to read hardware specifications and translate register-level behavior into reliable production-quality drivers. 

Good to Have

- Hands-on use of EB tresos Studio, Vector DaVinci Configurator, or equivalent AUTOSAR configuration tools. 
 - Experience with Vector, Elektrobit, ETAS, or another third-party AUTOSAR BSW stack. 
 - Exposure to tools such as Polyspace, QAC, Tessy, Cantata, or equivalent static-analysis and unit-test solutions. 
 - Knowledge of RISC-V architecture or experience moving MCAL software across MCU architectures. 
 - Exposure to ASPICE, safety audits, tool qualification, customer delivery, or OEM/Tier-1 integration. 
 - Experience with automotive communication protocols such as CAN, LIN, Ethernet, and SPI. 

What You'll Get

- Opportunity to build MCAL software for a new RISC-V automotive MCU platform. 
 - Direct collaboration with CPU, SoC, functional safety, validation, and platform software teams. 
 - End-to-end ownership from specification and driver implementation through hardware validation and customer enablement. 
 - A flexible growth path toward MCAL architecture, functional safety, platform leadership, or deep technical specialization. 

GlobalFoundries is an equal opportunity employer, cultivating a diverse and inclusive workforce. We believe having a multicultural workplace enhances productivity, efficiency and innovation whilst our employees feel truly respected, valued and heard. 

As an affirmative employer, all qualified applicants are considered for employment regardless of age, ethnicity, marital status, citizenship, race, religion, political affiliation, gender, sexual orientation and medical and/or physical abilities. 

All offers of employment with GlobalFoundries are conditioned upon the successful completion of background checks, medical screenings as applicable and subject to the respective local laws and regulations.

data.title: Senior Ground Software Engineer
data.description:
ReOrbit is looking for a Senior Ground Software Engineer to join the ReOrbit team and support the software campaigns for our current satellite product lines UKKO, SILTA and future missions. 

It's an exciting chance to join a dynamic start-up, with the opportunity to make a real impact, to reach our goal of pushing the boundaries of space data transfer. 

Responsibilities

- Design, develop, test and maintain robust ground software systems for satellite communications, spacecraft database and mission operations
 - Participate in the work of all stages in the software development process
 - Analysis of customer requirements and flow down into the software documentation
 - Deliver technical documents and estimates for proposals and reviews
 - Participate in defining the Work Breakdown Structure (WBS) and work packages for bids
 - Definition of test / validation procedures
 - Support to reviews at all levels of the design, development and testing
 - Be able to communicate effectively and provide support to Assembly, Integration and Test teams

Skills And Requirements

- Minimum of 10 years of professional experience in developing complex software tools
 - Professional proficiency in at least one object-oriented programming language (e. g. Java, Python, C++, etc. )
 - Experience across the full software development lifecycle, including requirements definition, design, implementation, testing, and maintenance
 - Demonstrated ability to work effectively in team-based and multidisciplinary environments
 - Professional experience using version control systems in a collaborative development setting
 - Ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear, well-structured documentation
 - Strong attention to detail and commitment to software quality throughout the development process

What does ReOrbit do?

ReOrbit builds the foundation for the next generation of space applications by transforming satellites into truly intelligent, interconnected platforms, defined by software. Our satellite design philosophy revolves around the idea that satellites must network, communicate with each other and thus improve mission efficiency. How can this be achieved? Thanks to a flexible software-first architecture, where all these aspects are dealt with upfront in the mission concept, as integrated functionalities. 

ReOrbit's top-notch team of software engineers and system architects develop in-house software, procure hardware from the best-in-class suppliers, and seamlessly integrate the components to create flexible and secure satellites. Today, we are a rapidly growing company building a very strong multidisciplinary team to support our activities. We are headquartered in Helsinki, Finland with a subsidiaries in Bristol, UK and Bariloche, Argentina. 

Working at ReOrbit

At ReOrbit, we are focused on building a strong team as we believe nothing can be accomplished without innovative, humble and curious minds working together on a common goal. We're all about fostering an inclusive, dynamic environment where equality and diversity are our strength. 

We offer

- Challenging but rewarding environment - you will thrive if you are always reflecting on how to make things better. Your ideas will be heard. 
 - Ambitious and supportive network of people, who are motivated to change the space industry, bringing expertise from both classic and new space . 
 - Benefits such as lunch vouchers, events, parties, occupational health care and additional health insurance - but most importantly a possibility to be a part of a unique and diverse team, connected by similar mindset and sense of humor. 
 - We like to spend time together! You can choose activities whichever is to your liking - runOrbit, climbOrbit; become ping pong or board games champion. 
 - We support relocation and integration into the UK society. 

Join us in our journey of building software enabled satellites for secure communications

and, thus, creating the most compelling in space data flow company of the new space era. 

The Company may require a security clearance for certain positions. Any such security clearance will be conducted in accordance with applicable law and the Company's relevant policies

For agencies: We do not accept unsolicited CVs for our open vacancies. Any CV sent to our team unsolicited will reserve us the right to pursue a candidate without obligation to the sender. All candidate submissions must be conducted through our official channels and in accordance with our terms of engagement.

data.title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer
data.description:
The Senior Site Reliability Engineer is the hands-on technical lead for the Site Reliability Engineering capability within F&P Solutions Production Operations. Working closely with the Head of Production Operations, the job holder provides day-to-day technical direction, coaching, prioritization support, and a clear point of coordination for SRE engineers while remaining directly engaged in engineering and operations. The role strengthens reliability, recoverability, and operational predictability across the software environment and combines Site Reliability Engineering and DevOps capability with focused ownership of Incident Management coordination and Release Management governance. The job holder leads major production incident coordination, governs production release readiness and controls, establishes common SRE standards and practices, and drives improvements in observability, automation, resilience, and operational readiness. The role works across software delivery, Quality Management, DevOps, Architecture, Product, Customer Support, and leadership stakeholders, bringing exceptional communication, influence, sound judgment, and visible end-to-end ownership. This is a technical leadership role without direct reports: the job holder guides and enables the SRE team, but responsible technical teams retain ownership for investigation, remediation, deployment execution, validation, and service recovery. 

What You'll Do

SRE technical leadership: Serve as the hands-on technical lead and primary coordination point for the SRE capability. Provide technical direction, support prioritization, establish common engineering and operational practices, facilitate knowledge sharing, and coach SRE engineers while remaining accountable for delivering engineering outcomes. 

Reliability roadmap and team enablement: Partner with the Head of Production Operations to translate reliability priorities into a practical SRE roadmap and backlog. Coordinate work across the SRE engineers, identify capability or coverage gaps, promote consistent use of standards and tooling, and provide visible progress, risks, and recommendations without assuming formal people-management responsibility. 

Incident Management leadership and coordination: Act as Incident Manager for priority production incidents. Own intake, triage, severity confirmation, incident record control, coordination flow, stakeholder communication cadence, escalation control, recovery tracking, closure, and follow-up while keeping technical remediation with the responsible team. 

Major incident response: Establish and facilitate focused incident response channels or war rooms; engage the correct technical and business owners; maintain a concise operational timeline; track decisions, risks, recovery status, and next actions; and escalate non-response or stalled recovery. 

Incident readiness: Maintain service ownership, contact, escalation, support-window, runbook, dashboard, log, and traceability references. Help teams prepare incident response paths before failures occur and support simulations or readiness exercises. 

Post-incident learning: Coordinate after-action reviews and root cause analysis follow-through. Ensure corrective and preventive actions have clear owners, target dates, traceability, and closure evidence. Translate lessons into monitoring, automation, runbook, process, or release-control improvements. 

What You'll Bring

Bachelor's degree in computer science, software engineering, information technology, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. 

Eight or more years of experience in software engineering, DevOps, cloud operations, platform engineering, Site Reliability Engineering, or technical production operations, including demonstrated technical leadership and senior-level ownership across teams. 

Demonstrated experience leading or guiding SRE, platform, cloud, or production operations engineers through technical direction, coaching, standards, work coordination, and cross-functional delivery without relying on formal authority. 

Demonstrated experience leading major production incidents, including triage, severity assessment, stakeholder communication, escalation, service restoration tracking, and post-incident follow-through. 

Demonstrated experience with software release or change governance, including readiness checks, approvals, deployment coordination, rollback planning, post-release validation, and audit-ready traceability. 

Strong hands-on engineering experience with Amazon Web Services and cloud-native production environments. 

Advanced hands-on experience engineering observability for AWS environments, primarily using Datadog for metrics, logs, traces, dashboards, alerting, telemetry, service-level indicators, and service-level objectives.
