data.title: Staff Software Engineer
data.description:
Position Overview

We are looking for a Staff Software Engineer, RCM AI Automation & Platform to provide technical leadership and help shape the next generation of Experity's RCM technology. 

In this role, you will lead the design and evolution of platform capabilities spanning multiple RCM workflows, including backend services, APIs, integrations, event-driven and long-running workflows, configurable business rules, data, and AI-enabled automation supporting charge entry, claims processing, claim submission, rejection and denial resolution, payments, and other parts of the revenue cycle. 

You will work closely with Product Managers, RCM Operations, Software Engineers, Architects, Data teams, and QA to translate complex healthcare business workflows into scalable, maintainable software solutions. 

As a Staff Engineer, your impact will extend beyond the software you personally build. You will provide technical direction across initiatives, establish reusable architecture and engineering patterns, solve high-ambiguity and cross-system problems, mentor engineers, and help teams make sound technical tradeoffs as the RCM platform evolves. 

Success means more than delivering features. You will help increase automation, reduce unnecessary manual work, improve claim outcomes, shorten processing time, and build an RCM platform that can continue to evolve. 

You will be expected to understand the business workflow behind the software, identify opportunities for automation, and determine when deterministic software, configurable rules, data, machine learning, or AI agents are most appropriate for the problem. 

What You'll Do

Architecture & Technical Leadership

- Define and evolve the technical architecture for RCM automation capabilities spanning multiple products, services, workflows, and integrations. 
 - Lead technical design for complex, high-impact initiatives where requirements, system boundaries, or implementation approaches may initially be ambiguous. 
 - Establish reusable patterns for workflow orchestration, state management, business rules, integrations, event processing, AI-enabled automation, observability, and failure recovery. 
 - Identify where capabilities should become reusable platform services versus remaining workflow- or product-specific implementations. 
 - Drive technical decisions across service boundaries and work with architects and engineering teams to ensure solutions fit Experity's broader platform architecture. 
 - Evaluate architectural tradeoffs involving scalability, reliability, maintainability, security, cost, speed of delivery, and operational complexity. 
 - Reduce unnecessary technical complexity and prevent one-off solutions from becoming long-term platform liabilities. 

RCM Platform Engineering

- Design, develop, test, deploy, and operate scalable production software supporting Experity's Revenue Cycle Management workflows. 
 - Build backend services and REST APIs using TypeScript, Node. js, and cloud-native technologies. 
 - Contribute to modern web applications when needed using technologies such as React, Next. js, and TypeScript. 
 - Design and implement event-driven, queue-based, and asynchronous workflows with explicit state management, retries, redrive, exception handling, idempotency, and auditability. 
 - Design long-running RCM workflows that support state transitions, human-in-the-loop processing, exception handling, replay/recovery, workflow versioning, and compensation or reversal when appropriate. 
 - Ensure workflow designs can evolve across multiple RCM use cases without creating tightly coupled or duplicated implementations. 
 - Build integrations with Experity applications, healthcare clearinghouses, payer systems, and third-party RCM services. 
 - Design reliable interfaces for claims, payment, eligibility, rejection, denial, and other healthcare transaction workflows. 
 - Define integration patterns and contracts that improve consistency, resilience, traceability, and reuse across RCM systems. 

Rules, Data & Automation

- Develop configurable business rules and workflow capabilities that replace logic currently distributed across application code, spreadsheets, and operational processes. 
 - Build rules and workflow capabilities that are configurable, versioned, explainable, auditable, and safe to change without introducing unnecessary application dependencies. 
 - Guide the architecture of reusable rules, workflow, and exception-management capabilities rather than embedding business logic independently within individual services. 
 - Work with claims, financial, and operational data to improve automation, identify exceptions, and measure business outcomes. 

AI & Agentic Engineering

- Integrate Generative AI, LLMs, agents, retrieval, and machine learning capabilities where they provide measurable value, while using deterministic software and business rules where those approaches are more appropriate. 
 - Build AI-enabled capabilities using clearly defined tools, APIs, contracts, permissions, validation, evaluation, observability, and fallback paths rather than treating LLMs as standalone solutions. 
 - Define architectural patterns for safely incorporating AI agents into production RCM workflows, including tool boundaries, authorization, human-in-the-loop controls, deterministic guardrails, evaluation, fallback behavior, and auditability. 
 - Help teams determine where AI adds measurable value and where conventional software, workflow orchestration, rules, or machine learning are more appropriate. 
 - Drive reusable AI integration patterns so individual teams do not independently create incompatible agent, tool, retrieval, or evaluation architectures. 
 - Use modern AI-assisted software development practices for codebase exploration, development, testing, debugging, documentation, and engineering productivity while maintaining appropriate engineering review and quality standards. 

Reliability, Security & Operations

- Build observability, automated testing, security, operational controls, and failure recovery into software from the beginning. 
 - Design systems with healthcare security, PHI protection, least-privilege access, auditability, and safe operational logging in mind. 
 - Define reliability and observability standards across RCM services and workflows, including traceability across asynchronous and distributed processing. 
 - Lead technical investigation of complex production issues that cross application, integration, data, infrastructure, or workflow boundaries. 
 - Identify systemic causes behind recurring incidents and drive platform-level improvements rather than repeatedly addressing symptoms. 

Engineering Leadership & Influence

- Serve as a technical leader and trusted engineering partner across RCM initiatives without requiring direct people-management responsibility. 
 - Mentor engineers through architecture reviews, design discussions, code reviews, debugging, and complex technical decisions. 
 - Raise engineering quality by establishing practical standards, reusable patterns, reference implementations, and technical guidance. 
 - Influence engineering roadmaps by identifying foundational technical investments, architectural risks, scalability constraints, and modernization opportunities. 
 - Partner with Product and RCM Operations to challenge assumptions, simplify workflows, and ensure technology decisions address the underlying business problem rather than simply automating existing processes. 
 - Own critical software through production and continuously improve it based on system behavior, operational feedback, and business results. 
 - Measure the impact of engineering improvements through outcomes such as automation rate, exception rate, manual touches, processing time, rejection/denial resolution time, successful resubmission, payment outcomes, and system reliability. 

Qualifications

Required

- 8+ years of professional software engineering experience, with significant experience designing and operating complex production systems. 
 - Demonstrated experience operating at a senior technical leadership level-leading architecture and technical direction across multiple engineers, services, or initiatives. 
 - Strong software engineering fundamentals, including application design, testing, debugging, code review, and maintainability. 
 - Deep experience building backend services, REST APIs, distributed applications, and transaction-processing systems. 
 - Proficiency with TypeScript, Node. js, or comparable modern backend technologies. 
 - Experience with relational databases, SQL, data modeling, and transactional systems. 
 - Strong experience developing and operating cloud-hosted applications, preferably on AWS. 
 - Deep understanding of asynchronous processing, queues, events, distributed-system failure modes, retries, idempotency, consistency, and resilient system design. 
 - Experience architecting long-running workflow or orchestration systems involving state management, exceptions, retries, recovery, and human intervention. 
 - Experience with automated testing, CI/CD pipelines, observability, and secure software development practices. 
 - Ability to design systems and technical contracts that remain maintainable as teams, workflows, integrations, and transaction volumes grow. 
 - Ability to reason across application, platform, integration, data, security, and operational boundaries rather than optimizing a single service in isolation. 
 - Ability to investigate highly ambiguous problems using production behavior, data, logs, architecture, and user workflows. 
 - Demonstrated ability to influence technical decisions across teams through technical credibility, communication, design artifacts, and collaboration rather than organizational authority. 
 - Experience mentoring engineers and raising the technical capability of a broader engineering team. 
 - Strong collaboration and communication skills with the ability to work across engineering, product, operations, architecture, data, and executive stakeholders. 
 - Experience using modern AI-assisted software development tools and workflows while maintaining engineering quality, security, and accountability. 

Preferred

Experience in one or more of the following areas is valuable: 

- Healthcare Revenue Cycle Management, medical billing, claims, rejections, denials, eligibility, remittance, payment processing, or claim remediation. 
 - Healthcare claims transactions and standards such as 837, 835, CARC/RARC, or related payer/clearinghouse workflows. 
 - Waystar or other healthcare clearinghouse integrations. 
 - Healthcare, HealthTech, FinTech, insurance, payments, or other high-volume transactional environments. 
 - Architecture of workflow orchestration, rules engines, state machines, or exception-management platforms used across multiple products or business processes. 
 - Event-driven architectures and large-scale distributed systems. 
 - Incremental modernization of legacy platforms while maintaining production continuity and avoiding high-risk rewrites. 
 - Production use of Generative AI, LLMs, AI agents, retrieval-augmented generation, or machine learning. 
 - AI orchestration frameworks, structured tool use, MCP or similar tool protocols, and agentic workflows. 
 - Human-in-the-loop automation where AI or software recommendations require review, approval, correction, or escalation. 
 - Architecture and governance of production AI/agent systems, including evaluation, guardrails, tool authorization, observability, and fallback strategies. 
 - Snowflake or other cloud-native data platforms. 
 - Docker, Kubernetes, and containerized application deployment. 
 - Data-intensive application development and distributed data processing. 
 - Experience working with HIPAA-regulated systems, PHI, audit requirements, or other highly regulated environments. 

Technology Environment

Our RCM Engineering Environment Includes

- Backend: TypeScript, Node. js, Python
 - Frontend: React, Next. js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS
 - Cloud & Platform: AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD
 - Architecture: REST APIs, queues, events, asynchronous workflows, distributed services
 - Data: SQL, Snowflake
 - AI: AWS Bedrock, LLM APIs, retrieval, structured tool use, Generative AI, and agentic workflows
 - Integrations: Waystar, Experity EMR and Practice Management, payer systems, and third-party RCM services

Candidates are not expected to have experience with every technology listed above. At the Staff level, depth of engineering judgment, experience solving complex cross-system problems, and ability to establish scalable technical patterns are more important than matching every technology in the stack. 

How We Work

We want engineers who understand the problem they are solving, not just the ticket they are implementing. 

At the Staff level, we expect you to look beyond an individual feature or service and understand how technical decisions affect the broader RCM platform. 

You should be comfortable learning a complex healthcare domain, questioning existing processes, working through ambiguity, making practical technical tradeoffs, and taking ownership of difficult problems. 

Our engineers collaborate closely with business and operational teams because understanding the real workflow is essential to building the right solution. We value pragmatic engineering, measurable outcomes, incremental modernization, and choosing the right technology for the problem rather than applying technology for its own sake. 

Staff Engineers help turn repeated solutions into platform capabilities, repeated problems into engineering standards, and ambiguous business challenges into clear technical direction. 

We expect engineers to understand the end-to-end RCM workflow, identify where AI and automation can eliminate unnecessary work, design for exceptions and failure from the beginning, and measure whether the software actually improves operational and financial outcomes. 

We are building an AI-native engineering culture. Engineers are expected to use modern AI development tools thoughtfully to accelerate delivery and improve quality while retaining ownership of architecture, code quality, testing, security, and production outcomes. 

Equal Opportunity Employer

This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights notice from the Department of Labor.

Company

Engineering Group, Engineering Group > Software Engineering

OR

PhD in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 6+ years of Software Engineering or related work experience.

Detailed JD

==========

Job Description: CPU Software & Hardware Co-Design Engineer (ML Systems)

Location: Bangalore (or relevant)

Levels: Engineer / Senior Engineer / Staff / Principal Engineer

Role Overview

We are building a high-impact team at the intersection of CPU architecture, machine learning workloads, and system-level performance optimization. This role focuses on CPU software-hardware co-design for next-generation QMX architectures, including workload characterization, simulation, kernel optimization, and driving architectural insights for future CPU designs. The ideal candidate will work across the full stack-from ML models to low-level kernels to architectural feedback-enabling efficient execution of ML workloads on CPU platforms. 

Key Responsibilities

- ML Workload Identification & Characterization
 - Identify and prioritize critical ML use cases and models for CPU-centric execution (LLMs, vision, speech, recommender systems, etc. )
 - Analyze workload characteristics including: 
 - Compute intensity
 - Memory bandwidth and cache behavior
 - Parallelism and dataflow patterns

- Simulation & Trace Generation
 - Generate detailed execution traces for ML workloads using QEMU or equivalent simulators
 - Develop tooling to: 
 - Capture instruction-level execution behavior
 - Extract performance counters and bottlenecks

- Enable accurate modeling of workload behavior for architectural exploration
 - Bottleneck Analysis & Performance Optimization
 - Identify system bottlenecks across: 
 - CPU pipelines
 - Memory hierarchy
 - Instruction utilization

- Optimize critical hotspots through: 
 - Kernel-level tuning
 - Algorithmic improvements
 - Data layout and memory optimizations

- Drive measurable improvements in workload performance
 - Software-Hardware Co-Design
 - Collaborate with CPU architecture and design teams to: 
 - Provide data-driven insights from real workloads
 - Identify inefficiencies and propose architectural enhancements

- Influence next-generation CPU features in: 
 - Compute units
 - Vector/SIMD extensions (e. g. , QMX)
 - Memory subsystems

- ML Kernel & Library Development (QMX Focus)
 - Design and implement highly optimized ML kernels and libraries for QMX architecture
 - Develop kernels for: 
 - GEMM, convolution, attention, activation functions, etc. 

- Enable integration with: 
 - Open-source ML frameworks (e. g. , PyTorch, ONNX, XNNPACK, MLAS)

- Apply advanced optimizations: 
 - SIMD/vectorization
 - Cache-aware execution
 - Parallel execution strategies

- Benchmarking & Performance Engineering
 - Optimize CPU-centric ML benchmarks such as: 
 - Geekbench AI
 - Internal benchmarking suites

- Establish performance baselines and track improvements across hardware generations
 - Perform competitive analysis and performance positioning

Required Qualifications

- Strong background in: 
 - Computer Architecture / Systems Programming
 - Machine Learning fundamentals

- Proficiency in: 
 - C/C++ (mandatory)

- Experience with: 
 - Performance profiling, benchmarking, and optimization

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with: 
 - QEMU or equivalent simulators
 - ML kernel development (GEMM, convolution, attention)

- Knowledge of: 
 - CPU architecture (pipelines, caching, SIMD/vector extensions such as NEON, SVE, QMX)

- Familiarity with: 
 - ML frameworks and inference stacks

- Experience with low-level optimization: 
 - Intrinsics, assembly, memory and cache tuning

Why Join This Team

- Work on next-generation CPU architectures (QMX)
 - Directly influence hardware design through real workload insights
 - Solve end-to-end ML performance challenges (model → kernel → silicon)
 - Collaborate with top architecture, systems, and AI teams
 - High-impact role with visibility across product and research roadmaps

Title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer- I : FinOps

Location: Noida, Hybrid

Sumo Logic's FinOps team makes every dollar of cloud and AI spend visible, attributable and optimizable. As a Senior SRE, you'll apply SRE principles (measurement, observability, automation and accountability) to FinOps and cost optimization, treating cost the way SREs treat reliability. That means building, running and improving the tooling behind our cost decisions, from cost data pipelines and dashboards to unit-economics and allocation reporting. Beyond the tooling, you'll design new FinOps capabilities from concept through rollout and bring your technical expertise to cross-team cost-saving initiatives. 

What you will do: 

FinOps tooling & cost observability

- Build, maintain and improve FinOps tooling, including cost data pipelines, telemetry jobs, dashboards and reports across all Sumo Logic deployments. 
 - Implement and evolve unit-economics and cost-allocation reporting so cloud and AI spend maps accurately to the teams and products that drive it. 
 - Support and improve our cost regression program and tooling, detecting and investigating cost increases and helping teams resolve them. 
 - Support cross-team cost-saving initiatives, partnering with engineering teams to identify, implement and measure savings, and contribute to the cost optimization roadmap. 
 - Support commitment tracking (CSP, RI, EDP) with accurate coverage and utilization data. Applying SRE principles to FinOps

- Run FinOps tooling and cost data pipelines like production services, with monitoring, alerting, data-quality checks and runbooks. 
 - Build actionable cost alerting and budget thresholds, modeled on SRE error budgets and burn-rate alerting. 
 - Automate manual cost reporting and analysis work. 
 - Design and implement new FinOps capabilities, from technical design through rollout. What you already have

- Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Sciences, Engineering, Finance or related field (Ph. D. is a plus)
 - Comfortable with cost and unit-economics concepts (allocation, amortization, cost per unit), with the ability to turn complex data into actionable insights
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate complex data into actionable insights
 - Track record of taking ownership and influencing results, working across internal and external organizations, including engineering, finance and marketing  
 - Excellent communication skills with the ability to convey complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders  
 - Technical skills:   
 - 3+ years of professional experience in data or software engineering roles
 - 1+ years of experience with cloud financial management or FinOps framework
 - Demonstrative ability to build and operate data pipelines with complex sources
 - Operational expertise in high scale, reliable 24/7, multi-tenant global SaaS
 - Strong coding and debugging skills (Scala experience highly beneficial)About UsSumo Logic, Inc. helps make the digital world secure, fast, and reliable by unifying critical security and operational data through its Intelligent Operations Platform. Built to address the increasing complexity of modern cybersecurity and cloud operations challenges, we empower digital teams to move from reaction to readiness-combining agentic AI-powered SIEM and log analytics into a single platform to detect, investigate, and resolve modern challenges. Customers around the world rely on Sumo Logic for trusted insights to protect against security threats, ensure reliability, and gain powerful insights into their digital environments. For more information, visit  www. sumologic. com. 

Sumo Logic Privacy Policy. Employees will be responsible for complying with applicable federal privacy laws and regulations, as well as organizational policies related to data protection.

This role is part of Cloud Powered Checkout team and will build the next generation multi-tenant, client agnostic, highly scalable, omnichannel checkout solution to seamlessly enable a frictionless customer checkout experience across all sales channels globally. We process millions of orders daily through our high-performance checkout services running in Edge and Cloud. 

As a Site Reliability Engineer in the CPC Team, you will work with L2, Other dependent Applications, Platform team, DevOps and Engineering practitioners to proactively maintain mission-critical infrastructure, cloud platforms, microservices, tools, and processes that will ensure the highest levels of availability and reliability of CPC applications. 

Our team works closely with our US stores and eCommerce business to better serve customers by empowering team members, stores, and merchants with technological innovation. From groceries and entertainment to sporting goods and crafts, Walmart U. S. offers an extensive selection that our customers value, whether they shop online at Walmart. com, through one of our mobile apps, or in-store. Focus areas include customers, stores and employees, in-store service, merchant tools, merchant data science, and search and personalization. 

What You'll Do

Incident triage, Escalation and Resolution: Triage site-impacting production issues by quantifying impact, severity and urgency, analyzing systems for quick remediation, engaging the right teams for recovery [Reduce MTTE Mean Time to Engage], and focusing on immediate restoration [ Reduce MTTR Mean Time to Restore] of large-scale enterprise systems. 

Alert, Monitoring, Log analysis: Detect and analyze monitoring graphs and alerts to identify systems causing production impacts with various tools like Grafana, Prometheus, MMS, Service Now, JIRA, Dynatrace, Splunk etc [Reduce MTTD Mean Time to Detect]. 

Enhance Alerting solutions: Design and implement JavaScript for the integration of alerting tool with service API endpoints with various tools like ServiceNow, Spotlight, Splunk, and xMatters. Requires knowledge of: Monitoring and alerting tools; Monitoring metrics and key performance indicators (for example, availability, MTBF, MTTR); SLIs and SLOs (for example, request latency, availability, error rates, saturation); Distributed tracing; Alerting logic. To demonstrate awareness of the metrics used to monitor software or system performance. Monitors current performance data to ensure adherence to defined SLOs and SLIs for simple applications/systems. Demonstrates awareness of the different types of alerts generated by the monitoring tools. Demonstrates awareness of infrastructure and application metrics. 

Disaster Recovery Planning: Requires knowledge of: Disaster recovery procedures and processes; Enterprise disaster recovery systems. To work with business partners to identify and document critical applications. 

Performance and Optimization : Requires knowledge of: Unix/Linux performance optimization tuning; Java/NodeJS/Tomcat/Apache tuning and optimization; Chaos tools to utilize established criteria (for example, probability of failure, frequency of failure) to measure site reliability. Monitors site reliability conditions and new reliability requirements. 

Work on Product Enrichment ; Content Services projects at Walmart: Develop enterprise monitoring and utilize tooling software solutions such as Grafana, Splunk etc, to improve visibility, pro-actively detect issues and restore system availability. 

Develop Tools and support: Design and develop solutions for widespread internal communications for cloud applications support or workflows for infrastructure availability issues with various internal applications with multiple programming languages like Java, JavaScript (React, Node JS), Python and Shell programming technologies like Prometheus, Database Query languages. Design and develop a UI tool to display Item Content Quality data on a dashboard using AngularJS, ReactJs, HTML5 ; CSS3 etc

To create and maintain Playbooks. 

Steps to perform correct analysis on the issues and engage correct teams for CPC, Dependent downstream services and Platform teams. 

To handle Deployments. Streamline the deployments process and handle the responsibility as a single team. Understand and explore Post validations and back out steps to make app more resilient. 

Coordinate with platform teams for non-app releases like VM upgrades, DB Maintenance, and other component environment related tasks. 

Participate in rotating on-call duties and work across different time zone with a multi-national team

Responsible for timely root cause analysis [RCA] of production issues. 

Develop reusable tooling and processes to drive and improve customer experience and lower operational costs. 

Understand DevOps Industry best practices

Help teams to build highly Observable and Resilient systems

Collaborate with developers to capture requirements and understanding pain points

Build reusable tools, library, dashboards which can be used across DevOps/SRE teams

What You'll Bring

Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Engineering or related discipline

10+ years of hands-on related to Site Reliability Engineer, Operations ; Development experience with Java Script, Java, Restful services, Git, Maven, Jenkins, DevOps, Containerization, Docker, Kubernetes, Azure, Google cloud, Kafka, Azure Cosmos, Azure SQL, Mega cache CI/CD , Prometheus, Grafana, Splunk etc. 

Automation and Self-healing: Demonstrate knowledge of scripting and software development for automation and self-healing of multi-cloud environments. Help enhance existing solutions by developing automation with Docker, Kubernetes and working with DevOps and Engineering partners. 

Excellent end to end technical understanding of core infrastructure, cloud services, platforms, and micro-services. 

Ability to effectively triage be able to detect and determine symptom vs cause. 

Identify and drive continuous improvement efforts to reduce waste (eliminate, automate or streamline). 

Influence the design of system architecture and tactical solutions. 

Familiar with log centric tooling. Produce time series data and reusable dashboards for use both during and post event.

People are why we innovate, and people power our innovations. We are people-led and tech-empowered.

data.title: Site Reliability Engineer II
data.description:
Job Description

The Enterprise Technology Services organization partners with every part of the American Express business to power the company's growth and innovation with trust and efficiency, and drive competitive differentiation with speed. We support the delivery and operations of technology, digital, and data capabilities, platforms, and services globally. Specifically, our team is responsible for the company's technology engineering, architecture, and infrastructure, providing 24x7 support to ensure an uninterrupted, high-quality experience for customers and colleagues. 

We are looking for a talented Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) with strong Java/Kotlin software engineering skills to join our team in Bengaluru, India. In this role, you will help enhance the reliability, resiliency, and operational excellence of mission-critical systems through software engineering, automation, observability, and proactive failure prevention. You will leverage modern engineering practices and emerging AI capabilities to improve incident diagnostics, accelerate recovery, automate operational workflows, and reduce service disruptions. Working alongside experienced engineers, you will contribute to building scalable, highly available systems that deliver exceptional experiences for our customers. 

Responsibilities

- Function as a member of an Agile engineering team, contributing to the design, development, deployment, and operational reliability of highly available, scalable, and resilient applications. 
 - Develop high-quality, maintainable software and automation solutions using Java, Kotlin, or Python, leveraging AI-assisted coding and Spec-Driven Development (SDD) practices to improve engineering productivity and code quality. 
 - Contribute to Non-Abstract Large System Design (NALSD), supporting the design and implementation of scalable, fault-tolerant distributed systems for mission-critical payment processing and customer-facing applications. 
 - Participate in Failure Mode Analysis to identify potential system vulnerabilities, assess failure scenarios, and implement mitigation strategies to improve system resilience. 
 - Design and execute controlled chaos engineering experiments to validate system resilience, identify weaknesses, and improve fault tolerance and recovery capabilities. 
 - Design and enhance application observability using OpenTelemetry (OTEL), distributed tracing, metrics, logging, and monitoring frameworks to improve visibility into system health and operational reliability. 
 - Contribute to defining, monitoring, and improving Service Level Indicators (SLIs), Service Level Objectives (SLOs), and error budgets to drive data-informed reliability improvements. 
 - Develop and maintain automation for application deployments, infrastructure operations, incident response, and system recovery, leveraging resilient workflow orchestration technologies such as Temporal where appropriate. 
 - Explore and apply Generative AI capabilities, including RAG, context engineering, and agentic workflows using frameworks such as LangGraph, to improve operational automation, incident investigation, troubleshooting, and engineering efficiency. 
 - Support the reliability and observability of AI-enabled workflows, including automated evaluation using Promptfoo, safety controls using NeMo Guardrails, and AI observability practices. 
 - Troubleshoot application and infrastructure issues, participate in incident response and root cause analysis, and implement corrective and preventive actions to reduce recurring failures. 
 - Develop and maintain operational runbooks, troubleshooting guides, and automated remediation procedures to improve operational readiness. 
 - Implement and enhance CI/CD pipelines, application scaling, automated testing, and infrastructure automation across development, testing, and production environments. 
 - Participate in code reviews, performance optimization, and continuous improvement initiatives while collaborating with software engineering, infrastructure, security, and platform teams. 

Qualifications

- 4+ years of professional experience in software engineering, Site Reliability Engineering, DevOps, or related technical disciplines, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - Strong programming skills in Java, Kotlin, or Python, with experience developing production-quality applications, automation tools, and distributed services. 
 - Strong understanding of data structures, algorithms, object-oriented programming, system design, and software engineering principles. 
 - Experience designing, developing, testing, and supporting RESTful APIs, microservices, and distributed applications using technologies such as Java/J2EE, Spring Boot, Kotlin, or Python. 
 - Working knowledge of multithreading, concurrency, application performance tuning, and troubleshooting. 
 - Experience with CI/CD tools and workflows such as Jenkins, Maven, Git, or similar technologies. 
 - Experience with relational or NoSQL databases such as DB2, PostgreSQL, Redis, or Couchbase. 
 - Hands-on experience with application observability, including OpenTelemetry, metrics, logs, distributed tracing, and monitoring platforms such as Prometheus, Grafana, or Splunk. 
 - Familiarity with resilience engineering practices such as NALSD, failure mode analysis, chaos engineering, SLOs, SLIs, and error budgets. 
 - Experience investigating production issues, performing root cause analysis, and implementing corrective actions. 
 - Familiarity with AI-assisted software development, including SDD, prompt engineering, and AI-supported coding, testing, and debugging. 
 - Understanding of Generative AI concepts such as LLMs, RAG, context engineering, and agentic orchestration using LangGraph or similar frameworks. 
 - Awareness of AI evaluation, safety, and observability concepts, including tools such as Promptfoo, NeMo Guardrails, and AI tracing frameworks. 
 - Ability to independently deliver moderately complex engineering tasks and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams. 
 - Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills. 

About Us

At American Express, our culture is built on a 175-year history of innovation, shared values and Leadership Behaviors, and an unwavering commitment to back our customers, communities, and colleagues. From delivering differentiated products to providing world-class customer service, we operate with a strong risk mindset, ensuring we continue to uphold our brand promise of trust, security, and service. 

As part of Team Amex, you'll experience our powerful backing with comprehensive support for your holistic well-being and many opportunities to learn new skills, develop as a leader, and grow your career. Here, your voice and ideas matter, your work makes an impact, and together, you will help us define the future of American Express. 

About The Team

We back you with benefits that support your holistic well-being so you can be and deliver your best. This means caring for you and your loved ones' physical, financial, and mental health, as well as providing the flexibility you need to thrive personally and professionally: 

- Competitive base salaries
 - Bonus incentives
 - Support for financial-well-being and retirement
 - Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life insurance, and disability benefits (depending on location)
 - Flexible working model with hybrid, onsite or virtual arrangements depending on role and business need
 - Generous paid parental leave policies (depending on your location)
 - Free access to global on-site wellness centers staffed with nurses and doctors (depending on location)
 - Free and confidential counseling support through our Healthy Minds program
 - Career development and training opportunities

American Express is an equal opportunity employer and makes employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, disability status, age, or any other status protected by law. 

Offer of employment with American Express is conditioned upon the successful completion of a background verification check, subject to applicable laws and regulations.

Job Titile : Software Engineer II

Software Engineer II - C# / . NET Framework

About The Role

We are looking for a Software Engineer II to join our engineering team and contribute to the development, maintenance, and ongoing evolution of a Windows-based restaurant operations platform. 

This is a hands-on software engineering role suited to a mid-level developer with approximately 3-5 years of professional C# experience. The role involves working within an established, modular codebase that supports restaurant operations and integrates Windows services, web applications, APIs, databases, and other system components. 

The immediate focus is on maintaining and extending our existing C# / . NET Framework platform, resolving production issues, and delivering incremental product improvements. Over time, you will also contribute to the gradual modernization of the platform. 

What You'll Do

- Design, develop, test, and maintain software using C# and . NET Framework. 
 - Deliver well-scoped product enhancements, technical improvements, and bug fixes. 
 - Maintain and extend applications built with ASP. NET MVC 5 and Web API 2. 
 - Develop and troubleshoot REST APIs and integrations with other platform components. 
 - Work with SQL Server, including ADO. NET, stored procedures, and query troubleshooting. 
 - Develop and maintain Windows Services and other Windows-hosted application components. 
 - Troubleshoot issues across store-side agents, server components, APIs, databases, and system integrations. 
 - Work with multithreaded and asynchronous application code and network-based communication. 
 - Diagnose application and integration issues in development, test, and production environments. 
 - Write and maintain focused automated unit tests. 
 - Participate in code reviews and apply established engineering practices. 
 - Work safely and effectively within a large, established codebase where changes may affect multiple interconnected components. 
 - Contribute to technical improvements and the gradual modernization of the platform while continuing to support existing functionality. 

Required Qualifications

- 3-5 years of professional software development experience using C#. 
 - Strong practical experience with . NET Framework, particularly versions 4. 5 through 4. 7. 2. 
 - Experience with Visual Studio, MSBuild, and NuGet. 
 - Experience developing or maintaining applications using ASP. NET MVC 5 and Web API 2. 
 - Working knowledge of IIS, Web. config configuration, HTTP, and REST APIs. 
 - Experience with Microsoft SQL Server, including: 
 - ADO. NET 
 - stored procedures 
 - SQL query troubleshooting 
 - investigating application/database integration issues 
 - Experience developing or supporting Windows Services. 
 - Practical understanding of multithreading, asynchronous programming, and networking concepts. 
 - Experience debugging and troubleshooting applications in production or production-like environments. 
 - Experience using Git and working with established source-control and code-review practices. 
 - Experience writing and maintaining unit tests. 
 - Ability to understand, maintain, and incrementally improve an existing codebase rather than relying exclusively on greenfield development. 

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with one or more of the following would be beneficial: 

- Entity Framework 6 
 - RabbitMQ 
 - Couchbase 
 - WCF

 - Windows Forms

data.description:
About Revantage

Revantage, a Blackstone Real Estate portfolio company, is a global provider of corporate services. 

With a corporate purpose of 'In Pursuit of Better, ' Revantage delivers value-added services and world-class talent for Blackstone Real Estate portfolio companies, spanning diverse asset classes, including residential, logistics, office, hospitality and retail sectors. The company's footprint extends across North America, Europe and Asia Pacific.

In addition to supporting Revantage, we also recruit for Blackstone Real Estate portfolio companies, giving you the unique opportunity to work within a network of best-in-class professionals across a broad real estate platform. 

India

With offices in Bengaluru and Gurugram, our teams in India deliver expertise, innovation and operational excellence that support thousands of assets across logistics, data centers, residential, commercial and hospitality. 

Whether you're building new capabilities, driving critical initiatives or strengthening partnerships, you'll have the opportunity to truly Build What Matters. 

Role Summary

We are seeking a Quality Assurance (QA) Tester for American Campus Communities (ACC), a Blackstone Real Estate portfolio company and the largest owner, manager and developer of high-quality student housing communities in the United States. This role is based in Bengaluru, India and is hired through Revantage India. 

The QA Tester is responsible for the design, execution and documentation of testing across ACC's Oracle Fusion Cloud environment and the integrations, interfaces, reports and business processes that surround it. The role supports both the in-flight Oracle implementation - including system integration testing, user acceptance testing support, data conversion validation and cutover readiness - and the ongoing steady-state testing that follows go-live, including enhancement testing, defect regression and validation of Oracle's quarterly release updates. The QA Tester partners closely with US-based IT leadership, functional and technical analysts, system integration partners and business process owners to ensure that changes to the Oracle ecosystem are delivered accurately, are thoroughly documented and do not disrupt downstream finance and operations processes. 

Primary Role - Quality Assurance Testing: Oracle Fusion and Integrated Systems

- Own the overall test strategy, test plans and testing approach for the Oracle Fusion Cloud program, covering Financials modules including General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Fixed Assets, Cash Management and Procurement
 - Develop, maintain and execute test cases, test scripts and test scenarios for Oracle Fusion Cloud Financials modules, including General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Fixed Assets, Cash Management and Procurement, based on functional design documents, configuration workbooks and business requirements. 
 - Execute system integration testing, regression testing and end-to-end process testing across Oracle and the surrounding application landscape, validating that business processes function correctly from source system, through Oracle, and out to downstream consumers. 
 - Test inbound and outbound integrations between Oracle Fusion and property management, banking, treasury, payroll, procurement and reporting systems, including file-based interfaces, APIs and Oracle Integration Cloud flows; validate payload accuracy, error handling, reprocessing and exception reporting. 
 - Validate data conversion and migration activities, including reconciliation of converted balances, master data and historical transactions between legacy systems and Oracle. 
 - Test reports, dashboards and analytics developed in OTBI, BI Publisher, Financial Reporting Studio and Fusion Data Intelligence, reconciling output to source data and confirming correct parameters, security and formatting. 
 - Support user acceptance testing, including preparation of business-facing test scripts, coordination of tester schedules, hands-on support to business users during execution, and tracking of UAT results through to closure. 
 - Plan and execute regression testing for Oracle's quarterly release updates, assessing the impact of new features and patches on existing configurations, integrations, reports and extensions. 
 - Log, triage, document and track defects through resolution in the program's defect management tool, including clear reproduction steps, supporting evidence and appropriate severity and priority classification, and partner with functional and technical teams on root cause analysis and retest. 
 - Maintain the test case repository, requirements traceability matrices and test evidence to ensure complete coverage of requirements and to satisfy internal control, audit and SOX documentation standards. 
 - Build and maintain automated test scripts and regression suites where automation adds value, and maintain those assets as configurations and business processes change. 
 - Prepare and maintain test data sets across development, test and staging environments, coordinating environment readiness and refreshes with the technical team. 
 - Produce clear and timely test status reporting, including execution progress, pass and fail rates, open defects by severity, and risks to the delivery schedule, for project leadership and stakeholders. 
 - Participate in requirements and design reviews to identify testability gaps, ambiguous requirements and delivery risks early in the lifecycle
 - Lead, mentor and coordinate a team of QA engineers, including work allocation, estimation, daily prioritization and review of test cases, scripts and evidence for quality and completeness. 
 - Validate security roles, user provisioning and segregation of duties configurations as part of testing cycles. 
 - Support cutover and post-go-live validation activities, including production smoke testing, hypercare defect triage and verification of fixes in the production environment. 
 - Contribute to the continuous improvement of QA standards, templates, testing methodology and automation coverage across the Oracle program. 
 - Must be able to work from the Bengaluru office under the hybrid working model, with a shift aligned to US Central Time and available until 11: 00 AM CT Flexibility is expected during testing cycles, cutover events, quarterly update windows and other peak periods. daily. Perform other projects and responsibilities as assigned. 

Qualifications & Skills

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, information systems, engineering, accounting or a related field is required. 
 - undefined
 - Minimum of eight years of software quality assurance and testing experience, including at least four years testing enterprise ERP applications and at least two years leading a QA team, is required. 
 - undefinedLead and manage a small to mid-sized QA team (2-5 engineers), including task allocation, daily progress tracking, deliverable reviews, mentoring and onboarding of new team members. Must have hands-on testing experience with Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP is required; coverage across General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Fixed Assets, Cash Management or Procurement is preferred. Experience supporting at least one full-lifecycle ERP implementation, including system integration testing, user acceptance testing and cutover, is strongly preferred. Demonstrated experience testing system integrations and interfaces, including file-based feeds, web services and APIs, and middleware such as Oracle Integration Cloud, is required. Experience validating reports and data in OTBI, BI Publisher, Financial Reporting Studio or Fusion Data Intelligence is preferred. Working knowledge of SQL sufficient to independently query and reconcile data between source systems and Oracle is preferred. Experience with test automation tools and frameworks, such as Oracle Test Automation, Tricentis Tosca, Selenium or similar, is preferred; a willingness to develop and expand automation capability is required. 
 - Experience with test management and defect tracking tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, qTest or similar is required.

 - Familiarity with SOX and IT general control requirements as they relate to testing documentation and evidence retention is preferred. 
 - ISTQB certification or an equivalent quality assurance credential would be a plus . 
 - Proficient in Microsoft Office applications, with emphasis on Excel. 
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with meticulous attention to detail and the discipline to document findings clearly and completely. 
 - Strong written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to explain defects, test results and risks clearly to onshore technical and business stakeholders.

Job Description Summary

The Regional Quality Excellence Manager will be part of the GE Vernova Hydro Power Central Quality organization and will drive the deployment, governance, and effectiveness of Root Cause Analysis (RCA), Continuous Improvement (CI), and Quality Excellence initiatives across Europe region. Reporting to the Global RCA Leader, this role serves as the regional focal point to strengthen problem-solving capabilities, improve quality performance, and drive sustainable corrective and preventive actions. 

The role is responsible for leading RCA and CI deployment, supporting QMS internal and certification audits, driving execution of the Zero-Defect Framework, and ensuring governance of Lessons Learned (LL), Customer Experience (CX), and Voice of Customer (VoC) processes across the region. Working closely with regional and global stakeholders, the role will improve quality maturity, operational excellence, customer satisfaction, and prevention of recurring issues through standardized methodologies, governance, and data-driven decision-making. 

Job Description

Roles and Responsibilities

Regional RCA & Continuous Improvement

- Serve as the regional focal point for RCA and Continuous Improvement across Europe, ensuring alignment with global quality strategy and governance. 
 - Lead deployment and consistent application of standard RCA methodologies, tools, and problem-solving practices across projects, functions, and operational sites. 
 - Facilitate and support complex root cause investigations for major non-conformities, recurring failures, customer concerns, and critical quality events. 
 - Drive sustainable corrective and preventive actions (CAPA) to reduce recurrence of quality issues and improve operational performance. 
 - Monitor RCA effectiveness, closure of actions, and business impact through defined KPIs and governance mechanisms. 

Zero Defect Framework Execution

- Support deployment and governance of the Hydro Zero Defect Framework across the region. 
 - Ensure implementation of preventive quality methodologies, risk mitigation actions, and process discipline to drive defect prevention and right-first-time execution. 
 - Monitor regional progress, maturity, and effectiveness of Zero-Defect initiatives and support continuous improvement actions. 

QMS Governance, Internal & Certification Audits

- Support execution and governance of the Quality Management System (QMS) within the Europe region, ensuring alignment with internal standards and external regulatory requirements. 
 - Coordinate and support QMS internal audits and certification audits (e. g. , ISO 9001) across regional sites and functions. 
 - Ensure timely closure of audit findings, corrective actions, and systemic improvements to strengthen process compliance and quality maturity. 
 - Promote standardization and continuous improvement of quality processes, documentation, and governance practices. 

Lessons Learned (LL), Customer Experience (CX) & Voice of Customer (VoC) Governance

- Drive regional governance and effective deployment of Lessons Learned (LL) processes to strengthen preventive actions and organizational learning. 
 - Support Customer Experience (CX) initiatives by monitoring quality feedback, identifying recurring pain points, and driving improvement actions. 
 - Ensure effective governance and utilization of Voice of Customer (VoC) inputs to improve quality performance, customer satisfaction, and business responsiveness. 
 - Promote cross-functional sharing of best practices, recurring learnings, and systemic improvement opportunities. 

Quality Performance, Analytics & Reporting

- Analyse quality trends, recurring failure patterns, customer feedback, and performance indicators to identify systemic quality drivers and improvement opportunities. 
 - Support regional quality reviews and reporting related to RCA effectiveness, NCR trends, audit findings, customer feedback, and CI performance. 
 - Utilize dashboards, quality metrics, and analytics to support data-driven decision-making and performance improvement. 

Stakeholder Collaboration & Capability Building

- Partner with Quality, Engineering, Project Management, Sourcing, Manufacturing, and Regional Leadership teams to drive effective RCA, CI, and quality governance deployment. 
 - Coach and mentor teams on structured problem-solving methodologies (e. g. , 8D, 5 Why, Fishbone, A3, CAPA, Lean Six Sigma tools). 
 - Strengthen regional RCA, audit, and CI capabilities while fostering a proactive quality and continuous improvement culture. 

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Quality, Manufacturing, Industrial Engineering, or a related discipline. 
 - min 12+ years of experience in Quality, Root Cause Analysis, Continuous Improvement, Manufacturing, Engineering, Project Quality, or Operational Excellence environments. 
 - Strong expertise in structured problem-solving methodologies (RCA, 8D, CAPA, 5 Why, Fishbone, FMEA, A3, etc. ). 
 - Strong knowledge of Quality Management Systems (QMS), ISO 9001, Non-Conformity Management, and Continuous Improvement methodologies. 
 - Experience supporting or leading internal and certification audits within a regulated or industrial environment. 
 - Strong analytical capability to identify trends, systemic issues, and recurring quality drivers using quality metrics and performance data. 
 - Excellent stakeholder management, influencing, and cross-functional collaboration skills in a global environment. 
 - Fluent English communication skills, both verbal and written. 
 - Preferred certifications: Lean Six Sigma Green/Black Belt and/or ISO 9001: 2015 Internal Auditor certification

Desired Characteristics

- Strong problem-solving, process-oriented, and continuous improvement mindset with ability to manage complex quality challenges. 
 - Experience leading regional or cross-functional quality improvement programs. 
 - Good understanding of Cost of Poor Quality (CoPQ), Lessons Learned, Zero Defect methodologies, Customer Experience (CX), and Voice of Customer (VoC) concepts. 
 - Strong operational judgment with ability to influence stakeholders and drive accountability without direct authority. 
 - Experience with quality analytics, dashboards, digital quality systems, and performance reporting. 
 - Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and operate effectively in a fast-paced, matrixed global environment. 
 - Additional European language skills (French, German, Italian, Spanish) would be an advantage. 

Additional Information

Relocation Assistance Provided: No

- This is a remote position

data.title: SAP Test Manager
data.description:
Job Description: SAP Test Manager / Test Lead

Position: SAP Test Manager / Lead

Employment Type: Full-time

Experience Level: Senior Level

Job Overview

We are seeking an experienced SAP Test Manager / Test Lead to oversee and manage end-to-end testing activities across complex SAP implementation and rollout programs. In this role, you will define comprehensive test strategies, coordinate test planning and execution, and drive quality assurance standards. You will leverage SAP Cloud ALM (CALM) and Jira for complete test lifecycle management, defect tracking, and governance while serving as a primary point of contact for key client stakeholders. 

Key Responsibilities

- Test Strategy & Planning: Design, implement, and maintain overall SAP Test Strategies, Test Plans, and Governance Frameworks tailored to client requirements and project scope. 
 - Test Execution Management: Drive end-to-end test phases including Integration Testing, System Integration Testing (SIT), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and Cutover / Go-Live testing. 
 - Tool & Process Management: Utilize SAP Cloud ALM (CALM) and Jira to create test cases, track execution progress, manage defects, build quality dashboards, and deliver regular status reports to senior management. 
 - Stakeholder Management: Manage direct relationships with client leadership, functional leads, business users, and third-party vendor teams to align on test scope, schedules, risks, and acceptance criteria. 
 - Defect & Risk Governance: Facilitate daily defect triage meetings, establish clear SLAs for defect resolution, manage escalation paths, and proactively address quality risks to keep project schedules on track. 

Required Qualifications & Mandatory Skills

- SAP Testing Leadership: 
 - Proven expertise as an SAP Test Manager or Test Lead with a strong track record in Test Strategy, Test Planning, Test Coordination, and Test Execution Management across SAP landscapes. 
 - Tools Expertise (CALM & Jira): 
 - Hands-on proficiency with SAP Cloud ALM (CALM) and Jira for end-to-end test planning, defect management, metrics tracking, and governance reporting. 
 - Client-Facing & Stakeholder Management: 
 - Exceptional customer-facing communication and interpersonal skills, with demonstrated experience interacting with client executives, managing business expectations, and facilitating user training/UAT sessions. 
Preferred / Good-to-Have Skills

- Test Automation: Exposure to or experience with automated testing tools and methodologies within SAP environments (e. g. , TOSCA, Worksoft Certify, Selenium, or native SAP automation capabilities). 

Key Competencies

- Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities. 
 - Leadership skills with a collaborative approach to leading cross-functional delivery teams. 
 - Capability to thrive in high-pressure project delivery environments. 

Skills: alm, testing, management, cloud, sap

data.title: Lead DevOps Engineer - Guidewire [T500-30471]
data.description:
Talent500 is hiring for one of its clients. 

Who are we: 

Core Insurance Platforms (CIP) is Zurich's global capability responsible for building, running, and evolving core insurance technology. We set a unified, scalable operating model-covering governance, standards, architecture, service delivery, and reuse-so our business units can deliver at speed and scale. 

CIP is the strategic steward of Zurich's Guidewire ecosystem, aligning platform roadmaps to business strategy while driving stability, modernization, reduced supplier dependency, and long term cost efficiency. 

India delivery center is one of our global delivery and capability hub. We bring together experts in AI, engineering, analysis, quality, and architecture to deliver product & process solutions, application run services, change and transformation initiatives, and centralized platform services across both on prem and Guidewire Cloud environments. Our teams operate from multiple global delivery centers, supporting Zurich's business units worldwide. 

About the Role: 

We are looking for a hands-on Senior DevOps Engineer to own and enhance CI/CD, build and release automation, engineering quality, security scanning and performance-testing capabilities across the Guidewire application landscape. 

The role will work closely with Guidewire developers, architects, QA, security and operations teams to enable reliable, secure and efficient software delivery. 

Key Responsibilities: 

- Design, maintain and continuously improve CI/CD pipelines supporting Guidewire application builds, testing, deployments and releases. 
 - Administer and support the Guidewire engineering toolchain, including Bitbucket, TeamCity, JFrog and JaCoCo. 
 - Build and maintain Azure DevOps pipelines for automated build, test, deployment and release activities. 
 - Manage source-code repositories, branching strategies, pull requests and development workflows. 
 - Automate build, packaging, artefact management and deployment processes across environments. 
 - Integrate Veracode security scanning and quality gates into CI/CD pipelines and support vulnerability remediation. 
 - Integrate JaCoCo code-coverage reporting and enforce agreed code-quality thresholds within build pipelines. 
 - Manage application artefacts, packages and dependencies through JFrog. 
 - Support performance, load and stress testing using JMeter, including automated execution where appropriate. 
 - Troubleshoot build, deployment, integration, pipeline and environment issues. 
 - Maintain technical documentation, engineering standards and runbooks in Confluence. 
 - Use Jira to manage delivery backlogs, defects, technical debt and improvement activities. 
 - Support release planning, production deployments, rollback readiness and operational handover. 
 - Drive automation and continuous improvement to increase deployment reliability and reduce manual intervention. 

Qualifications: 

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience. 
 - Typically 5-8 years of software engineering, build and release, cloud engineering or DevOps experience. 
 - Proven experience implementing and supporting enterprise CI/CD pipelines and production deployment processes. 
 - Strong knowledge of Git-based development, DevSecOps controls, scripting and release automation. 
 - Ability to troubleshoot complex issues across build, deployment and runtime environments. 

Must have Skills: 

- Jira and Confluence
 - Bitbucket within a Guidewire engineering environment
 - TeamCity within a Guidewire engineering environment
 - JFrog for artefact and dependency management
 - JaCoCo for Java code-coverage reporting
 - Azure DevOps pipelines and repositories
 - Veracode application-security scanning
 - JMeter performance and load testing
 - CI/CD, Git, build automation and release management
 - PowerShell, Python and/or Bash scripting
 - Experience supporting Guidewire build and deployment processes

Nice to have Skills: 

- Guidewire Cloud and InsuranceSuite experience
 - ClaimCenter, PolicyCenter and/or BillingCenter technical knowledge
 - Terraform or equivalent Infrastructure as Code technology
 - Docker and Kubernetes/AKS
 - Datadog, OpenTelemetry, Azure Monitor or Application Insights
 - Microsoft Azure cloud engineering experience
 - Insurance or financial-services domain experience

Description

The Boiler Performance Engineer is responsible for executing boiler performance engineering activities associated with BPS projects, including performance analysis, thermal calculations, proposal support, contract execution, technical documentation, and engineering deliverables. The role supports project teams in achieving technical, quality, and schedule objectives while ensuring compliance with company standards and customer requirements. 

Essential Responsibilities

- Perform boiler performance engineering activities for contracts from project kick-off through completion of performance testing and final technical documentation. 
 - Support proposal development activities, including preliminary thermal design, performance evaluations, technical clarifications, schedule inputs, and man-hour estimates. 
 - Prepare and review thermal calculations, performance studies, operating predictions, and guarantee evaluations. 
 - Develop and maintain project engineering documentation in accordance with established procedures and ISO work instructions. 
 - Coordinate with Project Engineers, thermal design teams, schedulers, and other functional disciplines to ensure timely project execution. 
 - Track project engineering hours against budgeted estimates and communicate any scope changes that may impact man-hours. 
 - Support project schedule adherence by meeting assigned milestones and proactively identifying potential delays. 
 - Participate in engineering, proposal, and project review meetings as required. 
 - Assist in the preparation of technical reports, customer presentations, and engineering recommendations. 
 - Review operating data and test results to evaluate equipment performance and recommend corrective actions or design improvements. 
 - Ensure technical deliverables meet company quality standards and customer specifications. 

Requirements

Mandatory Qualifications

- Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, preferably Mechanical Engineering. 
 - Five (5) to ten (10) years of experience in boiler performance, thermal engineering, heat transfer, combustion, product design, or a related engineering field. 
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret complex technical data. 
 - Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills. 
 - Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel and Word. 
 - Ability to manage multiple assignments, prioritize workload, and meet project deadlines. 
 - Self-motivated with the ability to work independently and collaboratively within a multidisciplinary engineering team. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience in boiler performance engineering involving coal-fired, natural gas-fired, oil-fired, or biomass-fired applications.

data.title: Fullstack AI Quality Engineer – Applied & Agentic AI Systems
data.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. 

The Position

Job Description
We are seeking a highly skilled AI Quality Engineer specializing in testing Generative (and non-Generative) AI applications and agentic systems to join our team. The ideal candidate will have expertise in both traditional software testing and specialized testing methodologies for Large Language Models (LLMs)-based and AI-based systems. 

As a fullstack Quality Engineer within a lean, agentic software team, you will cover the entire spectrum of quality assurance. You will span manual exploratory testing, traditional automated UI/API/MCP testing (across our Python and TypeScript stack), classical machine learning validation, and cutting-edge generative and agentic AI evaluation. This role requires a deep understanding of LLM, agentic and ML systems behaviors, and testing frameworks to ensure the reliability, fairness, and effectiveness of our AI-powered solutions. 

Description of the area

At Roche Digital Technology, we are advancing the boundaries of Applied AI. The Applied AI Engineering Team focuses on architecting, building, and operating high-value AI solutions and services to solve complex business challenges in healthcare. 

In the 2026 tech landscape, we operate in small, highly autonomous agile teams (e. g. , ~9 members) powered by advanced coding agents (like Claude Code) to develop and ship solutions faster than ever before. In this highly regulated environment, quality cannot be an afterthought. You will be the foundational pillar ensuring our rapidly developed agentic workflows and AI, GenAI, and agentic applications are safe, compliant, and robust before they reach the clinical or enterprise user. 

Job Responsibilities

- Generative & Agentic AI Testing Strategy: Design and implement comprehensive testing strategies specifically tailored for LLM-based applications and agentic systems, including evaluation of model responses, RAG pipelines accuracy, and overall system reliability. You will expand this to evaluate autonomous multi-agent behaviors and tool-use accuracy
 - Full-Stack Test Automation: Design and implement automated testing solutions for continuous evaluation of LLM applications, including integration tests, performance tests, and specialized AI behavior tests. This spans both our Python backend services and modern TypeScript/React/Angular frontends
 - Quality Assurance Framework & Compliance: Utilize Roche's testing frameworks that address both traditional software quality aspects and AI-specific concerns such as output consistency, contextual accuracy, and ethical compliance; co-create and maintain such frameworks when required. Create and maintain comprehensive test documentation testing strategy, test cases, and testing guidelines specific to AI applications and compliant with Roche practices
 - Edge Case, Bias, and Fairness Testing: Identify and develop test scenarios for edge cases in LLM behavior, including handling of ambiguous inputs, potential biases, and unexpected response patterns. Design and execute tests to identify potential biases in model outputs and ensure fair treatment across different user groups and use cases
 - Security & Performance Testing: Collaborate within development teams to test for potential vulnerabilities specific to LLM applications, including prompt injection, data leakage, and other AI-specific security concerns. Collaborate with other engineers to conduct thorough performance testing of GenAI applications, including response time analysis, load testing, and resource utilization monitoring

Qualifications

- Hold B. Sc. , B. Eng. , M. Sc. , M. Eng. in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent degree with strong background in testing methodologies
 - Be passionate about quality assurance and testing, particularly in the context of AI and GenAI applications and agents
 - Have strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail
 - Utilize critical thinking and problem-solving when using AI prompts (in e. g. NLP, data distributions and edge cases)
 - Be proactive in identifying potential issues and suggesting improvements

Education / Experience

- Experience: 7+ years of experience in software testing, with at least 1 year focused on genAI and/or agentic applications
 - Regulated Environments: Be ready to work in a regulated environment with qualified infrastructure and validated applications, understand the difference between GxP and non-GxP products and the importance of CSV and ITSM processes in the delivery
 - Agile Integration: Be experienced in working with Agile development teams

Skills
Must-have: 

- Comprehensive Full-Stack Testing Mastery
 - Core Languages & Testing Frameworks: Advanced command of Python and standard testing frameworks (e. g. , pytest, allure), alongside practical familiarity with specialized AI evaluation tools. High competence in TypeScript-driven test frameworks (such as Playwright, Jest, and Cypress) for thoroughly verifying dynamic generative user interfaces
 - End-to-End Automation & CI/CD: Proven expertise in architecting and maintaining end-to-end automated testing suites that bridge traditional UI/API validation with complex, asynchronous AI/LLM evaluation pipelines
 - Pipeline Integration: Hands-on experience integrating these comprehensive suites within GitHub Actions or modern CI/CD pipelines to ensure continuous, reliable quality checks throughout the entire development lifecycle
 - Advanced AI Quality & Evaluation Mastery
 - AI Evaluation Frameworks: Expertise in implementing evaluation harnesses (e. g. , RAGAS, DeepEval, Promptfoo) to quantify LLM performance, hallucination rates, and answer relevancy
 - Agentic Workflow Validation: Ability to test autonomous agentic loops, including tool-use accuracy, step-by-step reasoning verification, and goal-directed performance metrics
 - Evaluation Datasets: Experience in curating, managing, and versioning 'Golden Datasets' for benchmarking model responses against ground truth in both development and production environments
 - Observability & Feedback Loops: Leveraging tracing (e. g. , LangSmith, Arize Phoenix) to monitor production inputs/outputs, identify drift, and capture user feedback for continuous improvement
 - Basic broad AI knowledge: Understanding of LLM architectures, RAG systems, agents, and common failure modes in AI applications
 - Python Expertise: Advanced proficiency in writing robust, maintainable Python code for test automation (e. g. , pytest). Experience using Python to orchestrate complex AI evaluation workflows, process large datasets for benchmarking, and automate interactions with LLM/AI services. Ability to integrate Python scripts into CI/CD pipelines for automated quality checks and performance observability in agentic systems

Should-have: 

- Cloud: Practical experience with testing applications on cloud platforms (AWS) and working with cloud-based AI services
 - Observability & ALM: Experience with monitoring and observability tools, log analysis, and performance metrics tracking (Grafana). Experienced in Roche mandatory ALM tools (Jira, GitHub)
 - Agentic SDLC & Engineering Excellence: Leverage AI coding assistants and autonomous agents (e. g. , Claude Code, Ona) daily to accelerate full-stack development and testing cycles. Conduct rigorous code reviews for both human-written and AI-generated code
 - Security: Understanding of security testing methodologies, particularly in the context of AI applications

Could-have: 

- Regulatory Compliance: Proven understanding of AI quality assurance and testing standards within highly regulated industries

Additional Qualifications

- Stay current with the latest developments in AI and GenAI testing methodologies and best practices
 - Have excellent communication skills and the ability to clearly document findings and recommendations
 - Be able to communicate in English at the level of C1+
 - Located in Hyderabad, India, with working hours structured to capture the 'golden hours' of overlap with Central European Time (typically running through the IST evening)

Who we are

A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100'000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. 

Let's build a healthier future, together.
