data.description:
Experience: 8. 00 + years

Salary: Confidential (based on experience)

Shift: (GMT+05: 30) Asia/Kolkata (IST)

Opportunity Type: Remote

Placement Type: Full time Permanent Position

(*Note: This is a requirement for one of Uplers' client - Phyllo)

What do you need for this opportunity?

Must have skills required: 

Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, pytest, REST Assured, Supertest, GCP

Phyllo is Looking for: Job Description: 

Lead Quality Assurance Engineer

Location: Bangalore, Karnataka, India

About Us: 

Phyllo is a data gateway that allows social data to be accessed from source platforms (e. g. YouTube, Twitch, Upwork, Shopify, etc. ). We build the underlying infrastructure that connects with every creator platform, maintain a live data feed to the systems used by these platforms to manage creators' data, and provide a normalized data set so that businesses can use creators' data in a simple yet impactful way. 

More info at: Our website: https: //www. getphyllo. com/

About the role: 

AI coding tools now let our engineers ship more code, faster. Your job is to make sure we can prove it works just as fast. As Lead QA Engineer, you will own test automation for Phyllo's APIs, SDKs and web apps, and lead a small team of QA engineers. 

This is an automation-first, hands-on role. You will build test suites that run on every code change, use AI tools to write and maintain tests faster, and review that AI output with a critical eye. You will work side by side with product managers and engineers to agree on what "working" means before code is written, and coach your team to grow from testers into automation engineers. 

What you'll be expected to do: 

- Build and own test automation (UI and API)
 - Set the test automation strategy: what to automate, at which level (API, contract, UI), and what to keep for exploratory testing. 
 - Design and maintain API test automation in code, covering functional, schema/contract, negative, authentication and data-accuracy checks against our OpenAPI specs. 
 - Build reliable end-to-end UI test suites using sound design patterns (page objects, stable locators, isolated test data) so tests stay fast and trustworthy. 
 - Run automated tests in CI/CD on every pull request and release, with clear quality gates and fast feedback to engineers. 

https: //www. getphyllo. com/

- Use AI coding assistants and agents to draft test plans, generate scripts and test data, and triage failures, and review every AI-generated test as carefully as human-written code. 
 - Verify that data flowing through our APIs is complete, correct and consistent across platforms, including pagination, webhooks and rate limits. 
 - Track and reduce flaky tests, and report quality metrics (coverage, escaped defects, flake rate, pipeline time) that the team acts on. 

Lead and grow the QA team

- Lead and mentor a small team of junior QA engineers: set priorities, assign work, review their test code, and run regular 1: 1s and feedback. 
 - Help your team move from manual testing to automation through pairing, code reviews and clear learning goals. 
 - Define QA standards: coding conventions for tests, review checklists, defect triage and release sign-off. 
 - Own release readiness and make the go/no-go call together with engineering leads. 
 - Take part in hiring and onboarding new QA engineers. 

Work closely with product and engineering

- Work with product managers early to turn requirements into clear acceptance criteria and test scenarios before development starts. 
 - Partner with engineers on testability, test data and shared ownership of quality. 
 - Reproduce and debug issues using logs, network traces and API responses, and give engineers precise, actionable bug reports. 
 - Explain quality risks and release status in plain language to product, engineering and leadership. 

You'll be a good fit if you: 

- Have 5+ years in quality engineering, including at least 3 years building test automation (not only running manual tests). 
 - Have led or mentored QA engineers: assigning work, reviewing code and coaching people to grow. 
 - Write solid code in at least one language used for test automation: TypeScript/JavaScript, Python or Java. 
 - Have deep hands-on experience automating REST API tests in code (e. g. Playwright, REST Assured, pytest, SuperTest), with a solid grasp of HTTP, OAuth/API-key authentication, JSON schemas and OpenAPI. Postman experience is welcome, but API tests must live in code and CI. 
 - Have built a UI automation framework with a modern tool such as Playwright (preferred), Cypress or Selenium. 
 - Run tests in CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins or similar) and work daily with Git, pull requests and code reviews. 
 - Use AI coding assistants regularly in your testing work, and can tell when an AI-generated test is wrong, shallow or passing for the wrong reason. 
 - Are comfortable debugging with logs, browser dev tools and SQL. 
 - Communicate and collaborate clearly, with the confidence to challenge unclear requirements with product managers and engineers. 
 - Hold a BS in Computer Science or have an equivalent combination of technical education and work experience. 

Good to have (not required): 

- AI-driven UI testing: Playwright Test Agents (planner, generator, healer) or Playwright MCP used with coding agents such as Claude Code, Cursor or GitHub Copilot. 
 - AI-assisted API testing: Postman Agent Mode, KushoAI, or Keploy (regression tests generated from recorded API traffic).

data.description:
About Revantage

Revantage, a Blackstone Real Estate portfolio company, is a global provider of corporate services. 

With a corporate purpose of 'In Pursuit of Better, ' Revantage delivers value-added services and world-class talent for Blackstone Real Estate portfolio companies, spanning diverse asset classes, including residential, logistics, office, hospitality and retail sectors. The company's footprint extends across North America, Europe and Asia Pacific. 

Creating a culture that inspires impact and momentum requires the right team. We know what it takes to lead an industry, and are looking for leaders who seek constant growth, want to excel, and continuously improve upon themselves and the industry. 

In addition to supporting Revantage, we also recruit for Blackstone Real Estate portfolio companies, giving you the unique opportunity to work within a network of best-in-class professionals across a broad real estate platform. 

India

With offices in Bengaluru and Gurugram, our teams in India deliver expertise, innovation and operational excellence that support thousands of assets across logistics, data centers, residential, commercial and hospitality. 

Whether you're building new capabilities, driving critical initiatives or strengthening partnerships, you'll have the opportunity to truly Build What Matters. 

Role Summary

We are seeking a Quality Assurance (QA) Tester for , a Blackstone Real Estate portfolio company and the largest owner, manager and developer of high-quality student housing communities in the United States. This role is based in Bengaluru, India and is hired through Revantage India. 

The QA Tester is responsible for the design, execution and documentation of testing across Oracle Fusion Cloud environment and the integrations, interfaces, reports and business processes that surround it. The role supports both the in-flight Oracle implementation - including system integration testing, user acceptance testing support, data conversion validation and cutover readiness - and the ongoing steady-state testing that follows go-live, including enhancement testing, defect regression and validation of Oracle's quarterly release updates. The QA Tester partners closely with US-based IT leadership, functional and technical analysts, system integration partners and business process owners to ensure that changes to the Oracle ecosystem are delivered accurately, are thoroughly documented and do not disrupt downstream finance and operations processes. 

Primary Role - Quality Assurance Testing: Oracle Fusion and Integrated Systems

- Develop, maintain and execute test cases, test scripts and test scenarios for Oracle Fusion Cloud Financials modules, including General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Fixed Assets, Cash Management and Procurement, based on functional design documents, configuration workbooks and business requirements. 
 - Execute system integration testing, regression testing and end-to-end process testing across Oracle and the surrounding application landscape, as assigned by the QA Lead. 
 - Execute system integration testing, regression testing and end-to-end process testing across Oracle and the surrounding application landscape, validating that business processes function correctly from source system, through Oracle, and out to downstream consumers. 
 - Test inbound and outbound integrations between Oracle Fusion and property management, banking, treasury, payroll, procurement and reporting systems, including file-based interfaces, APIs and Oracle Integration Cloud flows; validate payload accuracy, error handling, reprocessing and exception reporting. 
 - Validate data conversion and migration activities, including reconciliation of converted balances, master data and historical transactions between legacy systems and Oracle. 
 - Test reports, dashboards and analytics developed in OTBI, BI Publisher, Financial Reporting Studio and Fusion Data Intelligence, reconciling output to source data and confirming correct parameters, security and formatting. 
 - Support user acceptance testing, including preparation of business-facing test scripts, coordination of tester schedules, hands-on support to business users during execution, and tracking of UAT results through to closure. 
 - Plan and execute regression testing for Oracle's quarterly release updates, assessing the impact of new features and patches on existing configurations, integrations, reports and extensions. 
 - Log, triage, document and track defects through resolution in the program's defect management tool, including clear reproduction steps, supporting evidence and appropriate severity and priority classification, and partner with functional and technical teams on root cause analysis and retest. 
 - Maintain the test case repository, requirements traceability matrices and test evidence to ensure complete coverage of requirements and to satisfy internal control, audit and SOX documentation standards. 
 - Build and maintain automated test scripts and regression suites where automation adds value, and maintain those assets as configurations and business processes change. 
 - Prepare and maintain test data sets across development, test and staging environments, coordinating environment readiness and refreshes with the technical team. 
 - Provide accurate daily updates on test execution progress, blockers and open defects to leadership. 
 - Participate in requirements and design reviews to identify testability gaps, ambiguous requirements and delivery risks early in the lifecycle. Validate security roles, user provisioning and segregation of duties configurations as part of testing cycles. 
 - Support cutover and post-go-live validation activities, including production smoke testing, hypercare defect triage and verification of fixes in the production environment. 
 - Contribute to the continuous improvement of QA standards, templates, testing methodology and automation coverage across the Oracle program. 
 - Must be able to work from the Bengaluru office under the hybrid working model, with a shift aligned to US Central Time and available until 11: 00 AM CT Flexibility is expected during testing cycles, cutover events, quarterly update windows and other peak periods. 
 - daily. 
 - Perform other projects and responsibilities as assigned. 

Qualifications & Skills

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, information systems, engineering, accounting or a related field is required. 

Minimum of three years of software quality assurance and testing experience, including at least one year testing enterprise ERP applications, is required. 

- Must have hands-on testing experience with Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP is required; coverage across General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Fixed Assets, Cash Management or Procurement is preferred. 
 - Experience supporting at least one full-lifecycle ERP implementation, including system integration testing, user acceptance testing and cutover, is strongly preferred. 
 - Demonstrated experience testing system integrations and interfaces, including file-based feeds, web services and APIs, and middleware such as Oracle Integration Cloud, is required. 
 - Experience validating reports and data in OTBI, BI Publisher, Financial Reporting Studio or Fusion Data Intelligence is preferred. 
 - Working knowledge of SQL sufficient to independently query and reconcile data between source systems and Oracle is preferred. 
 - Experience with test automation tools and frameworks, such as Oracle Test Automation, Tricentis Tosca, Selenium or similar, is preferred; a willingness to develop and expand automation capability is required. 
 - Experience with test management and defect tracking tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, qTest or similar is required. 
 - Familiarity with Oracle's quarterly update cycle and the associated regression testing approach is preferred. 
 - Working understanding of core finance and accounting processes, including record to report, procure to pay and order to cash, sufficient to test business scenarios meaningfully; real estate, property management or student housing experience is an advantage. 
 - Familiarity with SOX and IT general control requirements as they relate to testing documentation and evidence retention is preferred. 
 - ISTQB certification or an equivalent quality assurance credential would be a plus . 
 - Proficient in Microsoft Office applications, with emphasis on Excel. 
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with meticulous attention to detail and the discipline to document findings clearly and completely. 
 - Strong written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to explain defects, test results and risks clearly to onshore technical and business stakeholders. 
 - Ability to manage multiple concurrent testing priorities against fixed delivery deadlines and to work independently with limited onshore supervision. 
 - Demonstrates a positive attitude and maintains a high level of professionalism when working with onshore stakeholders and leadership across time zones.

data.title: R&D Engineering, Sr Manager
data.description:
We Are

Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow. 

You Are

You have spent years in the trenches of ASIC verification, and somewhere along the way you realized that emulation is not just another tool in the flow, it is the thing that makes or breaks your ability to ship complex IP on time. You know PCIe or DDR inside and out, not just the spec but the weird corner cases, the errata that nobody talks about, and the places where emulation models fall short of what the design team actually needs. 

You have worked on Zebu or similar platforms long enough to know what good emulation IP looks like and what happens when it is not quite right. You have closed that gap before, probably more than once, and you know how to do it without creating chaos for the teams depending on your work. You are comfortable sitting with a design team in Bangalore, a verification lead in California, and an IP product manager in Europe, and walking out with a plan that everyone believes in. 

You do not wait for perfect alignment. You ask the right questions, you push back when something does not make sense, and you move. At Synopsys, you will work on IP that powers the next generation of silicon, and the emulation strategies you define will directly affect how fast we get there. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Bridge the gap between Emulation IP capabilities and Design IP verification needs across both Controller and PHY domains for high speed interfaces like PCIe and DDR
 - Define technical requirements for Emulation IP, working directly with IP development and verification teams to ensure correct implementation and deployment on Zebu platforms
 - Track and report key metrics on Emulation IP quality, performance, and coverage, driving continuous improvement across verification workflows
 - Stay ahead of evolving PCIe and DDR standards, interpret specification updates, ECNs, and errata, and translate those into actionable changes for both Emulation and Design IP teams
 - Review and validate test plans for Emulation IP and Design IP, ensuring completeness, traceability, and alignment with product quality goals
 - Collaborate cross-functionally with verification, design, product, and platform teams to optimize emulation methodologies and standardize best practices
 - Mentor engineers on emulation strategies, verification techniques, and IP development workflows

The Impact You Will Have

- Accelerate time to market for high performance IP by defining emulation strategies that catch issues earlier and reduce silicon respins
 - Elevate product quality across Synopsys IP portfolios by ensuring Emulation IP meets the real needs of design and verification teams
 - Drive adoption of best in class emulation and verification methodologies that become standard practice across the organization
 - Influence the next generation of emulation solutions and workflows, positioning Synopsys as a leader in pre-silicon validation
 - Improve cross-functional collaboration and alignment between geographically distributed teams, reducing friction and rework
 - Standardize verification workflows and metrics, making it easier for teams to track progress, identify gaps, and deliver with confidence
 - Shape how Synopsys develops and deploys Emulation IP for cutting edge digital designs and system architectures

What You'll Need

- 15+ years of hands-on experience in emulation, pre-silicon verification, or IP product development
 - Expert-level knowledge of PCIe or DDR interfaces, including protocol details, verification strategies, and real-world implementation challenges
 - Extensive experience with Zebu or similar emulation platforms, specifically for IP verification and system-level validation

The Lead Engineer - Hard Automation & Special Purpose Machines role recognizes expanded responsibility in translating customer requirements into concept development, leading the design and validation of complex welding automation systems, and ensuring manufacturing-ready execution with delivery accountability.  - Strong experience in manufacturing-driven design, including conducting DFMA reviews, with a proven ability to design manufacturable and serviceable mechanical systems with an on time and on quality focus. 
 - Working knowledge of submerged arc welding applications, particularly for pipes, pressure vessels, and growing lines, with the ability to translate application understanding into design concepts.

data.description:
Job Description

Thomson Reuters is expanding its Data Science and AI organization and is looking for a Manager to lead a team building intelligent products and automation. You will own the full lifecycle of ML and GenAI solutions, from problem framing to production deployment and operation. The work spans traditional machine learning and modern GenAI systems, including LLM applications, RAG, agents, and multi-agent platforms. You will set technical direction, develop your team, and partner with business stakeholders to deliver measurable impact. 

Key Responsibilities

Problem framing and solution design

- Translate business problems into well-scoped data science and AI use cases with clear hypotheses, success metrics, and value estimates. 
 - Lead the design and development of ML and GenAI solutions, including predictive models, LLM applications, RAG, and agents, from exploration through validated prototype. 
 - Partner with engineering to move solutions into production by defining model requirements, performance thresholds, and monitoring and retraining needs. 

Evaluation and impact measurement

- Define evaluation frameworks for classical models and LLM and agent solutions, covering accuracy, groundedness, safety, and regression. 
 - Design experiments and pilots, including A/B tests, to measure business impact and adoption, and use results to guide iteration and prioritization. 
 - Analyze post-launch model and agent performance, including quality, drift, and cost signals, and recommend improvements. 

AI roadmap and portfolio prioritization

- Shape the data science and AI roadmap for the team's use case portfolio, prioritizing by business value, feasibility, and risk. 
 - Identify reusable agentic patterns such as prompts, skills, workflow templates, and evaluation sets, and partner with engineering to make them available across teams. 
 - Provide data science input into build-versus-buy decisions, including evaluation of model and vendor quality. 

Coaching and mentoring

- Lead, coach, and grow data scientists and AI engineers through feedback, code and design reviews, and career development. 
 - Build a culture of rigor, experimentation, and ownership. 
 - Hire, onboard, and retain strong talent. 

Stakeholder partnership

- Partner with Sales, Marketing, Product, and Operations to prioritize use cases and design solutions. 
 - Apply AI and data science to business problems such as workflow automation, customer retention, cross-sell, segmentation, pricing, and recommendations. 
 - Communicate results and trade-offs clearly to audiences from engineers to senior leadership. 

Required Qualifications

- 8-10 years of experience in data science and machine learning, with models deployed in production. 
 - Experience leading, mentoring, or managing data scientists or ML engineers. 
 - Hands-on experience building LLM applications, including prompt engineering, RAG, embeddings, and vector search. 
 - Experience designing and shipping agentic systems, including tool use, orchestration, and agent evaluation. 
 - Strong foundation in statistics, machine learning, and hypothesis testing. 
 - Expert Python and strong SQL skills. 
 - Experience with scikit-learn, PyTorch, or TensorFlow. 
 - Experience with cloud platforms (preferably AWS), containerization, and CI/CD for model deployment. 
 - Experience applying ML to business problems such as predictive analytics, segmentation, pricing, or recommendations. 
 - Strong communication and stakeholder management skills. 
 - Bachelor's degree or higher; a quantitative field is preferred. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience building multi-agent platforms with frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, or AutoGen. 
 - Experience with MCP and building reusable tools and skills for agents. 
 - Experience with LLMOps tooling, including tracing, evaluation, guardrails, and prompt management. 
 - Experience with advanced RAG techniques such as hybrid search, re-ranking, and retrieval evaluation. 
 - Familiarity with responsible AI practices, including hallucination mitigation, privacy, and governance. 
 - Experience on sales, marketing, or revenue-operations data, or automating business workflows with AI. 
 - Experience owning an AI platform used by multiple teams.

Tech Team Lead

Founding Engineering Hire • Build from the Ground Up

Company: Allsec AI

Location: Chennai (Hybrid)

Website: www. allsec. ai

Engagement Type: Full-Time | Early-Stage Start-up

About Allsec AI

Allsec AI is an AI-native, digital-first, omni-channel CX managed services company. We help enterprises unlock scalable, efficient, and real-time customer experience operations through agentic AI, intelligent workflows, and automation. We are redefining outsourcing by delivering packaged, outcome-led services that eliminate traditional contact Centre inefficiencies. 

About This Role

This is a founding engineering hire. You will be joining a pre-revenue, product-stage company with no existing engineering team in place, which means you will be responsible for taking our base demo product and building it into a production-grade platform. 

You will work in close collaboration with a US-based Technical Consultant who will provide architectural direction and high-level technical guidance. For day-to-day operations, delivery execution, and team coordination, you will report to the India Operational Head. 

As the company scales, you will build and lead a cross-functional team of engineers and own the India engineering operations end to end. If you are looking for a role where every decision you make has direct, visible impact. 

Reporting Structure

- Technical guidance, architecture direction, and product vision: US-based Technical Consultant
 - Operational reporting, delivery accountability, and day-to-day coordination: India Operational Head

Key Responsibilities

Foundation & Architecture

- Inherit, extend, and scale the existing technology stack (backend, frontend, DevOps, data pipelines, and ML/AI systems) building on a working demo product toward a production-ready platform. 
 - Establish production-grade engineering standards, tooling, and development processes, taking the codebase from demo quality to enterprise-ready. 
 - Define and own a scalable architecture for real-time, high-volume CX operations. Product & Infrastructure

- Own and evolve the existing multi-cloud infrastructure (Digital Ocean, Azure, GCP) improving reliability, scalability, and cost efficiency. 
 - Extend and optimise existing integrations across multiple LLM providers, STT/TTS systems, AI agents, NLP pipelines, and vector databases. 
 - Ensure system observability, security, redundancy, and performance from day one. Team Building

- As the first engineering hire, identify and help recruit subsequent technical team members. 
 - Mentor and develop engineers as the team scales; enforce best practices and foster technical excellence. 
 - Contribute actively to hiring decisions and help shape the engineering culture of the organisation. Collaboration & Stakeholder Management

- Translate technical direction from the US-based Technical Consultant into executable roadmaps. 
 - Collaborate with CX implementation and QA functions to align technology with delivery operations. 
 - Actively participate in architectural decisions and long-term technical planning. 

Requirements

- 6-10 years of total experience, with at least 1 year in a tech or team lead capacity. 
 - Deep experience with one or more full-stack frameworks (e. g. , Node. js + React, Django + Vue, or equivalent). 
 - Strong understanding of AI/ML model development and deployment - LLMs, transformers, RAG pipelines. 
 - Proven experience with cloud platforms (Digital Ocean, Azure, and/or GCP) and infrastructure as code (Terraform/CDK). 
 - Familiarity with prompt engineering, LangChain, vector databases (Pinecone, FAISS), and LLM APIs. 
 - Hands-on experience integrating and managing multiple LLM providers (e. g. , OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini) alongside STT and TTS systems in production or near-production environments. 
 - Experience with CI/CD pipelines, containerisation (Docker/Kubernetes), and scalable microservices. 
 - Demonstrated ability to operate with autonomy and build things without an established team or process around you. 
 - Good communication skills - you will primarily interface with a global stakeholder in the US and an operations-focused leader in India. 

Nice to Have

- Experience with contact centre platforms, chatbots, or voice AI systems. 
 - Exposure to MLOps, streaming data platforms, and real-time analytics dashboards. 
 - Prior start-up or early-stage product experience - particularly experience being the first or only engineer. 
 - Comfort working across time zones and with distributed teams. 

Why Join Allsec AI

- You will be the architect of the technology foundation, i. e. , you will take a working demo and turn it into the infrastructure that powers enterprise CX at scale; every architectural decision from here is yours. 
 - Work on cutting-edge AI/CX technology with global exposure and direct collaboration with the US technical leadership. 
 - Clear path to leading the India engineering organisation as the company scales. 
 - Competitive compensation and equity options available for the right candidate. 

Contact

If you think this role excites you, please send your resumes to careers@allsec. ai & hr@allsec. ai

 - Drive a culture of continuous improvement and shared accountability.

data.title: Senior Product Engineering Lead (Client Journey & Solutioning)
data.description:
Senior Product Engineering Lead (Java, Fintech)

Location: Hyderabad, India

About Olea: 

Olea is a digital infrastructure platform that connects global liquidity with trade and supply chain opportunities, fueling growth and unlocking potential worldwide. Olea has diverse liquidity pools with varying appetite and focuses. Olea's vision is to connect capital to opportunity. It has a strong conviction in the role of trade to support sustainable economic development across countries, particularly emerging markets, particularly Asia where many smaller suppliers are based. Olea supports suppliers and buyers in over 70 corridors. 

Role summary: 

We are looking for a Senior Product Engineering Lead for our Client Journey & Solutioning engineering team, based in our Hyderabad office, to bridge the gap between complex business product lines and highly scalable technology. In this role, you will lead and guide a high-performing engineering team focused on crafting seamless, friction-free client onboarding and transaction workflows for trade finance products, including invoice financing, factoring, and supply chain finance. You will be a hands-on Java technical lead with a product manager's mindset, closely collaborating with Business teams and the SDET Architect to champion agile methodologies. You will also promote the adoption of AI-assisted engineering workflows, while ensuring that all code, whether human-written or AI-generated, adheres to strict structural guardrails and automated testing standards. 

Responsibilities: 

· Team Leadership & Product Collaboration: Partner closely with Business Product teams to translate complex invoice financing, factoring, and supply chain finance requirements into intuitive, reliable client journeys and technical solutions. 

· Technical Leadership: Act as the technical lead for the team: set architecture and design direction, own design and code reviews, and stay hands-on in the Java codebase to unblock engineers and raise the engineering bar. 

· End-to-End Delivery Management: Manage the full software development lifecycle (SDLC) for both existing client-facing and product applications, balancing the ongoing enhancement and stability of the existing production platform with the delivery of new greenfield capabilities. Own backend scalability, automated testing, 

and production stability, and provide technical direction for the client-facing frontend experience. 

· AI-Native Engineering Leadership: Establish and scale AI-native engineering workflows, leveraging AI coding assistants, automated testing, and structured development guardrails to accelerate delivery velocity while enforcing rigorous engineering discipline, and encourage the team to adopt them. 

· Guardrails & Code Integration: Establish and oversee robust code merge gates; ensure that whether code is generated by AI and reviewed by a developer, or written directly by a developer, it strictly passes the automated test suite, security linting, and compliance checks before being merged into the main codebase. 

· Technical Mentorship & Culture: Guide, mentor, and pair-program with engineers to uplift the team's technical capabilities, foster an agile DevOps culture, and continuously optimize CI/CD pipelines. 

· Proactive Problem Solving: Take ownership of resolving systemic technical debts, operational bottlenecks, or misalignments between business requirements and technical execution. 

· Product & Business Ownership: Draw on your product management experience to guide engineering decisions: understand the business model, client needs and commercial outcomes of each product line, contribute to roadmap and prioritisation, and make trade-offs between scope, value and technical risk. 

Role specific technical competencies: 

· Product & Solution Architecture: Ability to translate complex business processes into scalable technical architectures, customer journeys, APIs, and platform capabilities. 

· Core Tech Stack (Java): Strong, hands-on background in the Java stack, including Java 11/17+, Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, Hibernate/JPA, microservices, REST APIs, event-driven messaging (e. g. Kafka) and relational databases. NodeJS / TypeScript experience is a nice-to-have, not a requirement. 

· Backend & Platform Leadership: Proven experience designing and delivering secure, high-throughput, and scalable backend architectures, with the ability to guide the team on client-facing user interfaces and their integration with backend APIs. 

· Fintech & Trade Finance Domain Expertise: Mandatory domain experience in Fintech (e. g. payments, lending, transaction banking or trade finance). Hands-on domain knowledge and engineering experience within supply chain finance frameworks, notably Invoice Financing, Factoring, and Supply Chain Finance workflows, is strongly preferred. 

· Client Journey Solutioning: Demonstrated ability to map out complex financial workflows into highly performant, intuitive, and secure client solutions and API integrations. 

· Product Management & Business Acumen: Product manager or product owner experience, or equivalent hands-on ownership of a product, with a clear understanding of product strategy, requirements definition, prioritisation and how technology decisions drive business outcomes. 

· AI-Native Engineering Proficiency: Solid hands-on experience using AI coding platforms or enterprise AI assistants in day-to-day engineering, and the ability to use them effectively to boost team velocity without compromising architectural integrity, code security, or regulatory compliance. 

· Core Software Engineering: Strong systems design patterns, data structures, algorithms, and advanced test automation practices. 

Qualifications (training, licenses, memberships and certifications): 

· Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a similar quantitative/engineering discipline. 

· 6+ years of Java software engineering experience, within Fintech, transactional banking, or Trade Finance platforms. 

· 3-5+ years leading engineering teams, with a proven track record of managing technical teams in these domains. 

· Strong background in Java-based product engineering, with the ability to lead technically while remaining hands-on. 

· Mandatory domain experience in Fintech. 

· Product manager or product owner experience (or equivalent hands-on product ownership), with a clear understanding of product and business. 

· Hands-on experience using AI coding assistants in software delivery. 

Note: 

Olea is committed to diversity and inclusion. By providing equal opportunities we foster a work environment which embraces diversity and gets the best out of the broadest spectrum of people to sustain business performance and competitive advantage. We build an inclusive culture by demonstrating respect for each other's unique strengths and perspectives to enable every employee to develop a sense of belonging and have the opportunity to maximise their potential.

Description

Job Location

The primary work location for this role is [insert location] with a hybrid work model. 

About Envestnet

Envestnet is an adaptive WealthTech company that is redefining the future of wealth management by helping advisors meet the moment with its comprehensive technology, actionable insights, and industry leading support. Backed by over 25 years of experience and approximately $7. 0 trillion in platform assets, Envestnet is trusted by over one third of financial advisors across leading banks, wealth managers, brokerages, and RIAs. 

For a deeper look at how Envestnet is shaping the future of financial advice, visit www. envestnet. com. 

The Team You'll Join

You will join Envestnet's Technology team, where we design, build, and maintain scalable, secure, and robust WealthTech solutions that power the future of financial advice. The team collaborates closely with product, operations, and business stakeholders to drive innovation, enhance efficiency, and enable sustainable growth. Guided by modern engineering practices and a commitment to domain excellence, technical rigor, and collaboration, the Technology team ensures our platforms remain resilient, adaptable, and aligned with evolving business needs making it a core driver of Envestnet's long‐term success. 

How You'll Contribute

Provides leadership and oversight to the Software Development Engineering group. Oversees team efforts to build scalable, secure platforms in support of Envestnet business operations, including wealth management, financial data aggregation and advisor-driven technology solutions. Works across cloud-based architectures, integrating complex data sources and APIs to deliver reliable, high-performance systems. Collaborates with product managers, data scientists and compliance stakeholders to meet both business and regulatory requirements. 

- Define engineering strategy and the execution model for the enterprise CRM integration domain across Tamarac, Envestnet UMP, and MoneyGuide. 
 - Own end-to-end delivery across multiple teams, including the phased rollout: Tamarac engagement inbound, MoneyGuide relationship read, and UMP relationship plus control. 
 - Set domain architecture direction with senior technical leaders: the canonical data model, per-field direction and write authority, echo suppression, entity crosswalk and resolution, and the versioned API and event contract. 
 - Consolidate overlapping canonical-modeling efforts across separate backlogs into one owned contract, and take a stated position on the Envestnet-wide party/Holders framework. 
 - Own Envestnet's data-plane relationship with customer CRM orgs (Salesforce, Dynamics, Redtail, Wealthbox, Advyzon). That means one integration identity and one change-capture subscription per org, schema versioning under Envestnet's control, and per-tenant mapping and entitlement configuration. 
 - Drive compliance and data governance: SOX-relevant audit of reads and writes with dual actor identity, per-firm ingestion scope, redaction of unstructured advisor content, tenant isolation, and advisor-level entitlement extended to delegated agent access. 
 - Manage budget, headcount, and org design, including build-versus-buy decisions on CRM adapters, mapping layers, and per-org licensing. 
 - Implement KPIs: per-object sync freshness, availability, latency, write success and rejection rates, cost efficiency, and quality trends. 
 - Influence prioritization across engineering, product, AI/agent engineering, and partners, including repositioning partner overlays from independent extractors to consumers of the service. 
 - Lead the transformation: retire point-to-point integrations and migrate onto shared streaming, canonical, and observability infrastructure. 
 - Build leadership bench strength through structured succession planning. 
 - Drive adoption of agentic coding practices across the SDLC to increase productivity and cut time-to-delivery. 

What You'll Need To Bring

- 10+ years of software engineering experience, including leading managers, technical leads, or multiple teams across a major domain. 
 - Proven ability to define engineering strategy, translate business objectives into multi-quarter plans, and deliver measurable customer and business outcomes. 
 - Experience setting domain-level architecture direction, including platform consolidation, integration modernization, and replacing point-to-point integrations with a canonical shared service. 
 - Deep enterprise CRM integration experience: 
 - Salesforce: managed packages, Change Data Capture, Pub/Sub API and platform events, replay and gap/overflow handling, field-level security, and Financial Services Cloud. 
 - Microsoft Dynamics 365/Dataverse: change tracking and delta tokens, service endpoints, Entra ID service principals, and least-privilege Graph scopes. 
 - Experience designing canonical or master data models and persistent entity crosswalks: per-field direction control, write authority, echo suppression in bi-directional sync, conflict policy, and pre-write constraint validation. 
 - Event-driven architecture background: Kafka/Amazon MSK, the transactional outbox pattern, Debezium CDC, and Kafka Connect sinks. 
 - PostgreSQL at scale (row-level security, partitioning, logical replication) with Flyway migrations. 
 - . NET, xUnit, Reqnroll, RESTful API design and versioning, and consumer-driven contract testing. 
 - AWS (EC2, S3, API Gateway, Lambda, RDS, EKS, CloudWatch, SQS), Kubernetes, Docker, and IaC (CloudFormation, CDK, Terraform). 
 - Identity and access management: OAuth 2. 0, OIDC, Keycloak, RFC 8693 token exchange for delegated and agent identities, and entitlement models finer than tenant scope. 
 - Experience driving compliance, data governance, and security: SOX audit trails, PII and tax-ID tokenization, data classification, redaction of unstructured content, and retention policy. 
 - Experience with engineering KPIs, OKRs, MBRs, budgeting, headcount planning, org design, hiring, performance management, and succession planning. 
 - Experience with vendor evaluation and build-versus-buy decisions, including security review of vendors needing write access to customer systems of record. 
 - Strong stakeholder management across engineering, product, AI/agent engineering, partners, and business leaders, including commercially sensitive partner conversations. 
 - Experience building leadership bench strength and inspiring high-performing teams through coaching, development, and accountability. 
 - Experience with DevOps, automation, agile/Scrum, and test-driven development. 
 - Experience driving adoption of agentic coding or AI-enabled engineering workflows across the SDLC. 
Nice-to-Haves

- Wealth management or financial services domain experience, including advisor workflows, household and account structures, and portfolio accounting or custodial data. 
 - Familiarity with Redtail, Wealthbox, and Advyzon integration models. 
 - Experience with RabbitMQ and with bridging or consolidating multiple event buses. 
 - SQL Server, Redis, and ElastiCache experience. 
 - Apigee or similar API management experience. 
 - Experience delivering data to a warehouse or lakehouse across a curated medallion boundary (Snowflake sinks, Silver-layer contracts). 
 - Familiarity with MCP-backed agent access patterns. 

Why You'll Enjoy Working at Envestnet

Help shape the future of WealthTech. At Envestnet you'll gain hands-on experience and collaborate with some of the industry's brightest minds to deliver meaningful, innovative solutions that make a real difference. 

We value flexibility in how and where work gets done, and we recognize strong performance with meaningful rewards-because your contributions should drive both business success and your own personal growth. If you're looking for a place where your work has impact, your development is supported, and your contributions are truly valued, Envestnet is where you can build your future. 

The opportunity is now!

Our Investment in You

At Envestnet, our total rewards philosophy is designed to attract, motivate, and grow exceptional talent. We offer competitive, market-aligned compensation complemented with performance-linked incentives and rewards programs that recognize and reward impact. 

In addition, we provide a comprehensive suite of benefits - subject to Envestnet's plan eligibility rules - that support your overall well-being, including medical insurance for you and your family, annual health check-ups, free online doctor consultations and telemedicine services, subsidized health club memberships, and an employee assistance program. Our investment in you means supporting you professionally, financially, and personally at every stage of your journey with us. 

Our Commitment to Inclusion & Belonging

Envestnet is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer and does not discriminate in employment on the basis of religion, race, color, caste, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, age, disability, medical condition, nationality, ethnic origin, marital status, or any other status protected under applicable Indian law. This commitment is in accordance with the Constitution of India and applicable labor and employment laws. All employment decisions are made solely based on merit, qualifications, performance, and business needs. 

We strive to provide an inclusive application and interview process. If you are a candidate with a disability and require reasonable accommodation, please contact us at [email protected]. Please include your full name, the title of the role you are applying for, and the accommodation necessary to assist you with the recruiting process. 

Recruitment Fraud

At Envestnet, safeguarding the trust and safety of job seekers is a top priority. We are aware that scammers may impersonate Envestnet recruiters or create fake job opportunities to deceive candidates. Review the information on our recruitment fraud awareness page to help you recognize and avoid recruitment fraud.

data.title: Principal Machine Learning Engineer
data.description:
About Ema

Ema builds AI Employees for HR, IT and Finance. Our AI Employees take on the busy work across the employee experience, from recruiting, onboarding and benefits to IT support, invoice processing and payroll, so people can spend their time on work that needs them. Founded by former executives from Google, Coinbase, Flipkart, and Okta, our team includes engineers from premier tech companies and graduates of Stanford, MIT, UC Berkeley, CMU, and IITs. 

We are backed by industry leading investors including Accel, Naspers/Prosus, Creaegis, Section32, and angels like Sheryl Sandberg and Dustin Moskovitz. Headquartered in Silicon Valley and with offices in London, Bangalore and Vancouver, Ema is at the frontier of what Agentic AI can do in production. We ship real systems that run real business processes at scale. 

Role Overview & Key Responsibilities

This is a high-leverage leadership role that spans architecture, execution, and org-building, and will shape the direction of our AI / ML initiatives at Ema. We are seeking an AI / ML technical leader who can take a vision and build it. As a Principal ML Engineer at Ema, you will be a senior technical leader responsible for shaping the machine learning roadmap, architecting large-scale ML systems, driving innovation, and ensuring our mixture of expert models (LLM + SLM + Custom Model) is accurate and performant at scale. You will collaborate across teams (research, product, infra, data, etc. ), mentor senior engineers, and influence strategy and execution at company-wide levels. 

Responsibilities

- Lead the technical direction of GenAI and agentic ML systems that power enterprise-grade AI agents - spanning reasoning, retrieval, tool use, and integrations across various SaaS products. 
 - Architect, design, and implement scalable production pipelines for model training, fine-tuning, retrieval (RAG), agent orchestration, and evaluation - ensuring robustness, latency efficiency, and continuous learning. 
 - Define and own the multi-year ML roadmap for GenAI infrastructure - including agent frameworks, RAG systems, world-class evaluation loops, and integration with MCP, browser, and vision pipelines. 
 - Identify and integrate cutting-edge ML methods / research (deep learning, large models, recommender systems, LLMs, etc. ) into Ema's products or infrastructure. 
 - Research, prototype, and integrate cutting-edge ML and LLM advancements (reasoning, memory architectures, multi-modal perception, long-context models, autonomous agents) into the platform. 
 - Optimize trade-offs between accuracy, latency, cost, interpretability, and real-world reliability across the agent lifecycle - from prompt design to orchestration and execution. 
 - Champion engineering excellence - drive observability, reproducibility, versioning, testing, and bias-aware development across ML and agentic systems. 
 - Mentor and elevate senior engineers and researchers, fostering a culture of scientific rigor, experimentation, and system-level thinking. 
 - Collaborate cross-functionally with product, infra, and research teams to align ML innovation with enterprise needs - enabling secure integrations, privacy-aware deployments, and scalable use cases. 
 - Influence data strategy - guide how retrieval indices, embeddings, structured/unstructured corpora, and feedback loops evolve to improve grounding, factuality, and reasoning depth. 
 - Drive system scalability and performance - ensuring ML agents and RAG pipelines can operate across billions of knowledge objects, diverse APIs, and real-time enterprise contexts. 

Required Skills & Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's (or PhD) degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, or a related field. 
 - A strong track record (usually 10-12+ years) of applied experience with ML techniques, especially in large-scale settings. 
 - Experience building production ML systems that operate at scale (latency / throughput / cost constraints). 
 - Experience in Knowledge retrieval and Search space. 
 - Exposure in building Agentic Systems and Frameworks. 
 - Proficiency in relevant programming languages (e. g. Python, C++, Java) and ML frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch, etc. ). 
 - Strong understanding of the full ML lifecycle: data pipelines, feature engineering, model training, serving, monitoring, maintenance. 
 - Experience designing systems for monitoring, diagnostics, logging, model versioning, etc. 
 - Deep knowledge of computational trade-offs: distributed training, inference, optimizations (e. g. quantization, pruning, batching). 
 - Excellent communication skills; ability to present complex systems / trade-offs to technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Experience mentoring senior engineers; ability to lead technical discussions and influence across orgs. 

Why Join Ema?

- Work at the forefront of agentic AI systems-driving real enterprise transformation. 
 - Own mission-critical platforms that make or break Ema's capabilities. 
 - Join an elite team of engineers, product thinkers, and AI researchers who value deep execution. 
 - Help define the architectural, cultural, and operational DNA of a company set to define a new category. 

Our culture & Values

data.description:
About Us

Walnut Folks Group is the parent company of three agencies shaping how brands grow in India: 

- Confluencr - influencer marketing (700+ brands served)

- Intent Farm - performance and marketplace marketing

- Kalakaaar - talent representation

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior Full Stack Developer - Generative AI who can take a problem from idea to production. 

This isn't a role where you'll simply receive technical specifications and implement tickets. You'll work closely with founders, business teams, and product stakeholders to identify opportunities, shape solutions, build applications, and own them after launch. 

You'll work across our SaaS products, Creator App, and internal AI-powered systems. Depending on the problem, you might build a customer-facing feature, develop an AI-powered workflow, or turn a manual business process into a scalable application. 

We value engineers who combine solid software fundamentals with practical AI expertise, move quickly without compromising reliability, and take responsibility for the outcomes of what they build. 

What You'll Do

1. Own Products End to End

Understand business problems by working directly with founders, marketing teams, operations, finance, and other stakeholders. 

Translate requirements into clear technical plans, define MVPs, and prioritize features based on business impact. 

Build and ship complete features across frontend, backend, databases, APIs, and AI integrations. 

Take ownership of applications throughout their lifecycle, from initial prototype to production, monitoring, and continuous improvement. 

2. Build AI-Powered Products

Integrate LLMs and generative AI capabilities into real-world products and business workflows. 

Build AI-powered features using techniques such as structured outputs, tool calling, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and agentic workflows where appropriate. 

Evaluate models, prompts, and architectures to balance quality, latency, reliability, and cost. 

Design workflows that combine AI with business rules, databases, and external APIs. 

Implement appropriate validation, error handling, observability, and human review for AI outputs. 

3. Develop Scalable Full-Stack Applications

Build responsive, user-friendly frontend experiences and reliable backend services. 

Design APIs, data models, and database schemas that support product requirements and future growth. 

Write maintainable, testable code and follow sound engineering practices. 

Integrate third-party services, authentication systems, background jobs, and other infrastructure as needed. 

Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks, bugs, and production issues. 

4. Ship, Measure, and Improve

Prototype promising ideas quickly and validate them with actual users. 

Deploy applications and manage releases, monitoring, and ongoing maintenance. 

Use user feedback, product usage, and business outcomes to guide improvements. 

Leverage AI coding tools to accelerate development while maintaining code quality, security, and reliability. 

Document key technical decisions and share learnings with the team. 

What We're Looking For

Essential Skills

- 2-4 years of experience building and shipping full-stack software applications. 
 - Strong programming fundamentals and hands-on experience developing frontend and backend applications. 
 - Practical experience integrating LLMs or generative AI into applications, workflows, or developer tooling. 
 - Experience designing and working with REST APIs, databases, and third-party integrations. 
 - Familiarity with deploying applications to production and troubleshooting real-world issues. 
 - Ability to break down ambiguous requirements into practical, well-scoped solutions. 
 - A strong sense of ownership, with a focus on usability, reliability, and business outcomes. 
 - We are particularly interested in candidates who have gone beyond basic chatbot implementations. 
 - Working with LLM APIs and structured model outputs. 
 - Building RAG pipelines, semantic search, or document-processing workflows. 
 - Implementing AI agents, tool calling, or multi-step AI workflows where appropriate. 
 - Evaluating AI output quality and handling hallucinations, failures, and edge cases. 
 - Using AI coding assistants to improve development speed and productivity. 
 - Experience building consumer-facing applications or SaaS products with active users. 
 - Experience with cloud infrastructure, CI/CD, automated testing, and application monitoring. 
 - Experience with background processing, queues, caching, or event-driven systems. 
 - Experience in marketing technology, creator platforms, analytics, or workflow automation. 
 - A strong portfolio, GitHub repository, live product, or technical case study demonstrating your work. 
 - You don't need experience with every technique listed. We value practical implementation experience and sound technical judgment over familiarity with buzzwords. 

How You Work Matters

- You can communicate technical trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders. 
 - You are comfortable making decisions when requirements are incomplete. 
 - You know when to use AI, when traditional software is more reliable, and when a simpler solution is better. 
 - You can move fast, accept feedback, and iterate without losing sight of code quality. 
 - You take responsibility for what happens after deployment, not just for writing the code. 

Our Technology Environment

We care more about your ability to choose the right tools and build reliable products than about matching every item on a checklist. 

Depending on the product, our engineering environment may involve modern frontend frameworks, backend services, relational or NoSQL databases, cloud infrastructure, LLM APIs, and AI development tools. 

You'll have the opportunity to evaluate technologies, experiment with new approaches, and make informed architectural decisions. 

How We'll Measure Success

In this role, success means: 

- Turning business problems into working solutions that users can actually use. 
 - Shipping useful prototypes and production features with appropriate speed and quality. 
 - Building AI capabilities that deliver measurable improvements in accuracy, productivity, or user experience. 
 - Maintaining reliable applications through testing, monitoring, and continuous improvement. 

Why Work With Us

Flexible Work Culture

We focus on outcomes, not rigid rules. You'll have the autonomy to manage your work, with a culture built on trust and accountability.

data.title: Associate IS Engineer
data.description:
About Amgen

Amgen harnesses the best of biology and technology to fight the world's toughest diseases and make people's lives easier, fuller, and longer. We discover, develop, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help millions of patients. Amgen helped establish the biotechnology industry more than 40 years ago and remains at the cutting edge of innovation, using technology and human genetic data to push beyond what is known today. 

Role Description

We are seeking an Associate IS Engineer to support the delivery, operation, maintenance, and continuous improvement of enterprise applications and digital solutions. 

This is a blended application engineering role combining IT application support, application lifecycle management, technical troubleshooting, integration support, and software development. The successful candidate will work across both run/support activities and change/development initiatives, helping ensure applications remain reliable, secure, compliant, and fit for business needs. 

Working under the guidance of senior engineers, the Associate IS Engineer will investigate and resolve application and integration issues, support application releases and upgrades, participate in incident and problem management, maintain application documentation and configurations, and work with business, infrastructure, platform, security, and vendor teams. 

The role will also contribute to full-stack development and application enhancements, including front-end development, API integration, back-end development, testing, and deployment where required. 

Roles And Responsibilities

- Provide day-to-day technical and operational support for enterprise applications and associated integrations which could be either of these SaaS, COTS and Custom-built application 
 - Monitor application health, availability, interfaces, scheduled jobs, and other operational components, and proactively identify potential issues. 
 - Investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve application incidents, defects, integration failures, data issues, and performance problems. 
 - Perform technical root-cause analysis and support implementation of corrective and preventive measures for recurring problems. 
 - Support incident, problem, request, and change-management processes in accordance with established IT service-management practices. 
 - Work with business users, application owners, infrastructure teams, security teams, integration teams, and external vendors to resolve technical issues. 
 - Support application configuration, upgrades, patches, releases, environment changes, and production deployments. 
 - Support application integrations with enterprise platforms, databases, APIs, identity and access-management solutions, and cloud services. 
 - Maintain application documentation including architecture and interface details, configuration information, operational procedures, troubleshooting guides, and support knowledge articles. 
 - Contribute to application lifecycle activities including technical assessments, upgrades, modernization, remediation, and application retirement where applicable. 
 - Participate in periodic operational, security, compliance, and application health activities as required. 

Software Development & Enhancement

- Contribute to the design, development, testing, deployment, and maintenance of application enhancements and software solutions. 
 - Manage the application SDLC and supporting ITIL Lifecyle completely 
 - Translate business and technical requirements into maintainable and user-friendly application functionality. 
 - Develop or enhance front-end applications using technologies such as React, Vite, TypeScript/JavaScript, HTML5, and CSS3. 
 - Build reusable, responsive, accessible user-interface components following enterprise design standards. 
 - Integrate applications with RESTful APIs, enterprise services, databases, and third-party platforms. 
 - Contribute to back-end development using Python and FastAPI, or comparable technologies, under the guidance of senior engineers. 
 - Participate in technical design discussions, peer code reviews, troubleshooting sessions, and technical walkthroughs. 
 - Follow coding standards, secure-development practices, reusable software-design patterns, and established engineering practices. 
 - Develop and maintain appropriate unit, integration, regression, and end-to-end automated tests. 
 - Support CI/CD processes for automated builds, testing, security scanning, and deployment. 
 - Analyse and remediate application vulnerabilities, software dependency issues, and technical debt in collaboration with senior engineers.

Job Description

Job Description - Production Supervisor

XDU/CDU End-of-Line Testing Production Supervisor

Company: Vertiv Location: Chakan Plant, Pune, India Department: Production / Manufacturing Reports To: Production Manager Employment Type: Full-Time

Position Summary

We are seeking an experienced and technically proficient CDU (Coolant Distribution Unit) End-of-Line Testing Supervisor to lead and manage the end-of-line testing operations for our CDU production line. The ideal candidate will bring deep expertise in liquid cooling systems, chilled water systems, and automated testing equipment, combined with strong supervisory and production management skills. This role is critical to ensuring every CDU leaving the production line meets stringent quality, performance, and safety standards. 

Key Responsibilities Technical & Testing

- Supervise and execute end-of-line testing of Coolant Distribution Units (CDUs) used in data centre liquid cooling applications
 - Operate, program, and troubleshoot automated test equipment (auto testers) designed for CDU functional and performance validation
 - Conduct and oversee water pressure testing including hydrostatic testing, leak testing, and pressure decay testing as per established procedures and standards
 - Read, interpret, and validate readings from instrumentation including pressure transducers, temperature sensors (RTDs, thermocouples), flow meters, differential pressure gauges, and other water system instruments
 - Ensure proper functioning and calibration of all test instruments and equipment
 - Validate CDU components and sub-assemblies including butterfly valves, ball valves, control valves, coupling joints (Victaulic/grooved couplings), heat exchangers, pumps, manifolds, and piping assemblies
 - Understand and apply knowledge of chilled water system principles - flow dynamics, pressure drops, heat rejection, temperature differentials, and coolant loop operations
 - Diagnose and resolve test failures by analyzing root causes related to hydraulic, mechanical, or electrical sub-systems of the CDU
 - Maintain and update test procedures, checklists, and acceptance criteria documentation

Safety & Compliance

- Enforce and ensure strict adherence to electrical safety protocols during CDU testing (lockout/tagout, grounding, insulation resistance testing, high-voltage precautions)
 - Enforce and ensure strict adherence to mechanical safety protocols (pressurized system handling, PPE compliance, safe coupling/decoupling of water lines, spill containment)
 - Conduct risk assessments and ensure all testing activities comply with EHS (Environment, Health & Safety) standards
 - Maintain safety records, incident reports, and ensure corrective actions are implemented promptly
 - Ensure compliance with relevant industry standards and regulatory requirements for pressure vessel and water system testing

Supervision & People Management

- Supervise, mentor, and train a team of testing technicians and operators on CDU testing procedures, instrument handling, and safety practices
 - Develop and maintain operator certification and skill matrix programs for the testing team
 - Conduct regular performance reviews, provide feedback, and identify skill development needs
 - Plan and manage shift schedules, manpower allocation, and workload distribution to meet production targets

Production & Operations Management

- Coordinate with production planning to align testing schedules with production targets and delivery timelines
 - Monitor and report key metrics - first pass yield (FPY), test cycle time, defect rates, and throughput
 - Drive continuous improvement initiatives to reduce test cycle times, improve yield, and enhance testing reliability
 - Maintain 5S standards on the testing shop floor - Sort, Set in Order, Shine, Standardize, Sustain
 - Adhere to and promote standard manufacturing practices including lean manufacturing, Kaizen, and visual management
 - Coordinate with cross-functional teams including Design Engineering, Quality, Manufacturing Engineering (ME), Advanced Manufacturing Engineering (AME), Supply Chain, and Service for issue resolution and process improvements
 - Participate in new product introduction (NPI) activities by supporting test procedure development and validation for new CDU models
 - Manage test equipment maintenance schedules and coordinate with vendors for calibration and servicing

Required Qualifications Education

- Bachelor's Degree in Engineering - Mechanical, Electrical, Mechatronics, or a related discipline

Experience

- Minimum 5 years of hands-on experience in testing, quality, or production supervision roles in a manufacturing environment
 - Demonstrated experience with liquid cooling systems, chilled water systems, or HVAC systems
 - Proven experience with pressure testing procedures (hydrostatic, pneumatic, leak detection)
 - Experience working with automated test systems/auto testers in a production environment

Technical Skills

- Strong working knowledge of chilled water system components - valves (butterfly, ball, control), coupling joints, heat exchangers, pumps, expansion tanks, and piping systems
 - Proficiency in reading and interpreting P&ID (Piping & Instrumentation Diagrams) and engineering drawings
 - Ability to read, calibrate, and troubleshoot instruments - pressure transducers, temperature sensors (RTDs/thermocouples), flow meters, differential pressure gauges, and data loggers
 - Understanding of electrical systems in CDUs - control panels, VFDs, sensors, and wiring
 - Familiarity with test automation software/platforms and data acquisition systems
 - Knowledge of relevant standards (ASME, ASHRAE, ISO) related to pressure testing and water systems

Supervisory & Management Skills

- Proven ability to lead, train, and develop a team of technicians and operators
 - Strong understanding of production scheduling, manpower planning, and resource optimization
 - Experience in maintaining quality standards in a production/testing environment (ISO 9001 awareness preferred)
 - Hands-on experience with 5S implementation and shop floor discipline
 - Familiarity with lean manufacturing principles, Kaizen, and continuous improvement methodologies
 - Excellent coordination and communication skills for cross-functional collaboration
 - Proficiency in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) and familiarity with ERP/MES systems

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience specifically in data centre cooling equipment manufacturing or testing
 - Exposure to CDU, in-row cooling, or precision cooling product lines
 - Knowledge of data centre infrastructure and liquid cooling architectures (direct-to-chip, rear-door heat exchangers, immersion cooling)
 - Certification in Six Sigma (Green/Black Belt) or equivalent quality methodology
 - Experience with SPC (Statistical Process Control) and test data analytics
 - Familiarity with PLC-based test automation and SCADA systems

Key Competencies

- Attention to detail and commitment to quality
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
 - Safety-first mindset
 - Ability to work under pressure and meet tight production deadlines
 - Proactive and self-driven with a continuous improvement orientation
 - Effective team leadership and people development skills
 - Adaptability to a fast-paced, evolving manufacturing environment

Vertiv is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

data.title: Director - SoC Verification
data.description:
Job Title: 

- Director - SoC Verification

We Are

Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow. 

You Are

You have built a career at the intersection of deep SoC verification expertise and organizational leadership. You have closed coverage on complex multi-protocol designs and know that scaling verification across a services organization requires clear structure, strong leaders, and a strategy that holds when customer scope, timelines, and design complexity move at once. The difference between a verification plan that delivers and one that collapses three months before tapeout is usually visible early, and you are the kind of leader who sees it and acts before it becomes an escalation. You operate at two levels simultaneously. One day you are reviewing a coverage closure strategy for an automotive SoC with safety requirements your team has never seen before. The next you are restructuring team assignments because two customer engagements just expanded scope and you need to rebalance without dropping quality. You build leaders, not just projects. You know how to develop a senior engineer into someone who can own customer signoff, and you know when to step into a room yourself because the technical or relationship stakes require it. At Synopsys, you will lead verification for the System Solutions Group and shape how we deliver complex SoC services to customers who depend on us to get it right. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Lead and grow a multi-team SoC verification organization delivering customer-facing services across automotive, aerospace, defense, and high-performance computing
 - Define and drive SSG verification strategy, including methodology standards, signoff criteria, VIP and tool deployment, and reusable testbench patterns adopted across projects
 - Own organizational planning including headcount, hiring, succession, performance management, and skill development to build scalable verification capability
 - Partner with sales and account teams to scope opportunities, assess technical and resource risk, prioritize work against capacity, and align delivery with customer and business objectives
 - Serve as executive-level technical authority on complex SoC verification challenges, escalations, and convergence across multi-protocol, multi-domain, and advanced-node designs
 - Establish clear accountability across verification managers and technical leads, and drive adoption of Synopsys VCS, Verdi, and VIP based on customer project learnings
 - Build and maintain executive customer relationships that enable long-term engagement growth and position Synopsys as the verification partner of choice for complex SoC programs

The Impact You Will Have

- Your organization will enable customers to tape out complex SoCs on schedule, affecting product launches in AI, automotive, aerospace, and high-performance computing
 - The verification strategy and standards you define will scale across SSG projects, improving coverage quality, reducing cycle time, and compressing ramp time on new engagements
 - The leaders you develop will strengthen Synopsys capability to win and execute larger, more complex verification service engagements
 - Your capacity planning and executive customer engagement will shape how leading semiconductor companies adopt Synopsys EDA tools, VIP, and verification services
 - What you build will directly influence how SSG scales verification delivery, wins competitive pursuits, and expands into new customer segments and protocol domains
 - The organizational structure and accountability model you establish will become the foundation for how SSG verification grows over the next three to five years

What You'll Need

- Bachelor's or Master's in Electronics Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field with 20+ years of hands-on SoC, subsystem, or IP verification experience, including significant leadership scope
 - Expert-level knowledge of UVM-based verification, coverage-driven closure, verification planning, and complex multi-domain debug across processor-based SoC architectures
 - Proven experience leading large verification organizations or multi-project teams through planning, delivery, and customer signoff in a services or product development environment
 - Deep working knowledge of protocols such as PCIe, Ethernet, USB, DDR, and AMBA interconnects, and hands-on proficiency with Synopsys VCS, Verdi, and VIP
 - Demonstrated ability to build organizational structures with clear accountability, develop managers and technical leads, and partner with sales and senior customer stakeholders on scoping and escalations
 - Experience with ARM-based SoC architectures, automotive functional safety verification, or emulation flows is a strong plus

Who You Are

- You translate vague customer requests into scoped plans, staffed organizations, and delivery models your teams can execute without losing quality
 - You see both the technical gap and the organizational failure behind a coverage miss or escalation, and you know how to fix both
 - You build leaders, not just projects, and you invest time developing managers and senior engineers into people who can own customer outcomes independently
 - You communicate effectively to engineers debugging a testbench, customer architects reviewing signoff criteria, sales executives scoping a new opportunity, and Synopsys senior leadership reviewing quarterly business performance
 - You make hard calls on resource allocation, project prioritization, and team structure when the right answer is not the easy one, and you explain the tradeoff clearly enough that people understand why
 - You know when to delegate and when to step in yourself, whether that means reviewing a verification plan before it goes to a customer or sitting in an escalation call with an executive stakeholder

The Team You'll Be Part Of

You will lead verification within the System Solutions Group (SSG), which delivers end-to-end SoC design and verification services to Synopsys customers across high-performance computing, automotive, aerospace, and defense. You will build and lead the verification organization and collaborate with SSG design and architecture peers, sales, application engineering, IP, and EDA teams to deliver customer engagements and scale Synopsys verification capability. 

Rewards And Benefits

We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.
