Project Role Description : Develop custom software solutions to design, code, and enhance components across systems or applications. Use modern frameworks and agile practices to deliver scalable, high-performing solutions tailored to specific business needs. 

Must have skills : Automotive ECU Software

Good to have skills : Advanced Driver Assistance System

Minimum 15 Year(s) Of Experience Is Required

Educational Qualification : BE or BTech or ME or MTech in Mechanical Automotive Electronics Electrical or related Engineering discipline

Summary: 

As a Senior Manager / Technical Lead in ADAS Validation and System Integration, you will lead cross-functional teams responsible for ADAS feature validation, performance evaluation, root cause analysis, scenario development, and toolchain automation. The role involves driving validation strategy across SIL, MIL, HIL, and vehicle-level testing while ensuring feature performance meets customer, NCAP, and regulatory requirements. The position requires strong technical leadership, stakeholder management, and extensive experience in ADAS data analysis and validation methodologies. 

Roles & Responsibilities: 

- Lead end-to-end ADAS feature validation across MIL, SIL, HIL, and vehicle-level testing environments. 
 - Develop and execute validation strategies for Active Safety features, including Automatic Emergency Braking (AEB), Lane Keeping Assist (LKA), Adaptive Cruise Control (ACC), Blind Spot Detection, and other driver assistance systems. 
 - Perform vehicle data analysis, root cause investigations, and performance assessments to identify issues and recommend feature improvements. 
 - Develop validation plans, test scenarios, and performance evaluation frameworks aligned with customer requirements, NCAP protocols, NHTSA regulations, and UNECE standards. 
 - Drive scenario-based testing, fault injection, and edge-case validation to evaluate system robustness and performance. 
 - Lead the development of validation tools, data analytics frameworks, dashboards, and automation solutions using MATLAB, Python, VBA, and AI/ML techniques. 
 - Lead and mentor validation, data analysis, and tool development teams, ensuring effective resource utilization, technical quality, and timely project delivery. 
 - Collaborate with system engineering, software development, calibration, perception, and vehicle integration teams to resolve technical issues and improve ADAS performance. 
 - Manage project planning, resource allocation, effort estimation, budgeting, delivery tracking, and stakeholder communication. 
 - Support business development through presales activities, technical proposals, capability demonstrations, Statements of Work (SOWs), and identification of new business opportunities. 
 - Present project status, validation results, performance metrics, technical risks, and recommendations to global customers and senior leadership. 
 - Drive Agile execution and continuous improvement across validation and development activities. 
 - Contribute to Software-Defined Vehicle (SDV) validation through scenario development, test automation, and data-driven performance assessment

Professional & Technical Skills: 

- Experience: 15-20 years of overall automotive industry experience, including at least 8 years in ADAS and Active Safety systems. 
 - ADAS Validation: Strong expertise in feature validation, vehicle data analysis, root cause investigation, scenario-based testing, and performance evaluation. 
 - Validation Methodologies: Hands-on experience with MIL, SIL, HIL, and vehicle-level testing. 
 - Automotive Tools: Proficiency in CAN data analysis and tools such as CANoe, Vehicle Spy, INCA, dSPACE ControlDesk, CarMaker, CarSim, and the Applied Intuition toolchain. 
 - Programming & Automation: Strong proficiency in MATLAB, Simulink, and Python, with exposure to VBA and AI/ML-based data processing and test automation. 
 - Requirements Management: Experience with requirements analysis and management using IBM DOORS and Jama. 
 - Functional Safety & Regulations: Understanding of ISO 26262, SOTIF (ISO 21448), NCAP protocols, NHTSA regulations, UNECE requirements, and global automotive safety standards. 
 - ADAS Systems & Integration: Knowledge of sensor architectures, perception systems, sensor fusion, and vehicle system integration. 
 - Project & Team Leadership: Proven experience in project planning, resource optimization, budgeting, estimation, team development, and stakeholder management. 
 - Agile & Product Development: Experience with Agile methodologies, product ownership practices, and BDD-based testing. 
 - SDV & Analytics Platforms: Exposure to SDV platform validation, Azure Databricks, Power BI, SharePoint dashboards, and data analytics platforms. 
 - Customer & Business Management: Experience working with global OEMs, managing vehicle development programs, supporting presales activities, preparing technical proposals and SOWs, and participating in capability demonstrations. 
 - Communication & Leadership: Excellent communication, technical presentation, analytical, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to engage global customers and senior stakeholders. 

Additional Information: 

- The candidate should have minimum 15 years of experience in Automotive ECU Software. 
 - This position is based at our Bengaluru office. 
 - A BE or BTech or ME or MTech in Mechanical Automotive Electronics Electrical or related Engineering discipline is required.

data.title: USB Lead Engineer
data.description:
USB Lead Engineer - Linux Enablement & AVV (Pre/Post-Silicon) - RISC‐V MPU Platform

Location: Pune / Bangalore, India

Own USB enablement on Linux - driver bring-up, compliance, and AVV from FPGA to first silicon. 

About GlobalFoundries

GlobalFoundries is a leading full-service semiconductor foundry providing a unique combination of design, development, and fabrication services to some of the world's most inspired technology companies. With a global manufacturing footprint spanning three continents, GlobalFoundries make possible the technologies and systems that transform industries and give customers the power to shape their markets. For more information, visit www. gf. com. 

About The Role

We're building a next-generation, application-class RISC‐V MPU SoC platform for Linux systems - bringing together multimedia, industrial connectivity, security, and high-speed I/O. 

In the Platform Software team, you will be the technical owner for USB across the stack: boot-to-user-space enablement, kernel/driver integration, and automated validation (AVV) on virtual platforms/FPGA and first silicon. You'll partner closely with architects and hardware teams to de-risk the USB subsystem, drive bring-up readiness and deliver a production-quality SDK experience. 

Key Responsibilities

- USB Linux enablement & integration: enable and maintain USB host/device/dual-role functionality on a 64-bit RISC‐V MPU Linux platform. 
 - Bring up USB controllers (e. g. , xHCI/EHCI for host, UDC for device/gadget), PHY integration, clocks/resets, and interrupts. 
 - Drive kernel/BSP enablement: Device Tree bindings, power management (runtime/PM QoS), suspend/resume, and performance tuning. 
 - Develop/debug USB drivers and related subsystems: USB core interactions, hub behavior, gadget framework, and class drivers as needed. 
 - Enable and validate user-space workflows: enumeration, throughput/latency, storage/networking classes, and reliability over hot-plug scenarios. 
 - Deliver USB-ready SDK releases: integration, regression validation, and developer-facing documentation/debug guides. 
 - AVV & silicon validation (pre/post-silicon): create test plans and automation to validate USB functionality, performance, and compliance on FPGA/emulation and first silicon. 
 - Contribute to shift-left validation using virtual platforms/emulation/FPGA; build reusable USB validation apps/tests to exercise data paths and corner cases. 
 - Debug and root-cause USB issues across HW/FW/kernel using logs, traces, and lab equipment (e. g. , JTAG, logic/protocol analyzers); drive fixes to closure. 
 - Cross-functional ownership: partner with architects, RTL/PHY, board, and platform teams to define requirements, de-risk schedules, and land USB features. 
 - Own USB feature planning: role/port matrix, power & charging considerations, compliance goals, and bring-up milestones. 
 - Provide bring-up and validation feedback that influences USB architecture decisions (controller/PHY selection, debug hooks, observability, testability). 
 - Align with internal and external stakeholders on deliverables, bug triage, and release readiness for USB enablement. 
 - Customer & ecosystem engagement: support early adopters and upstream fixes when appropriate (kernel, Device Tree, test collateral). 
 - Work with OEMs/Tier‐1s during bring-up and USB interoperability; contribute patches upstream when it improves maintainability. 
Required Qualifications

- B. E. /B. Tech or M. E. /M. Tech in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field. 
 - Strong experience with minimum 8-15 years in Embedded Linux platform/BSP and device-driver development. 
 - Expert-level C programming; comfortable reading and modifying kernel, driver, and low-level firmware code. 
 - Strong Linux internals knowledge: boot flow, memory/interrupt subsystems, concurrency, and performance debugging. 
 - Hands-on SoC/platform bring-up experience, including high-speed I/O enablement and ownership mindset for subsystem quality. 
 - Hands-on with U‐Boot, Linux kernel, Device Tree, and Yocto/OpenEmbedded; experience integrating and validating USB in BSP/SDK releases. 
 - Strong debugging skills with GDB and at least one OpenOCD/JTAG, Lauterbach, or similar tools; able to debug complex HW/SW interactions. 
 - Experience working on FPGA, emulation, or early-silicon platforms for bring-up/validation. 

Good to Have

- Deep USB knowledge (USB2/USB3) and familiarity with Linux USB architecture (usbcore, HCD, gadget framework). 
 - Experience with USB compliance/interoperability testing and post-silicon triage (throughput, link stability, suspend/resume, hot-plug). 
 - Exposure to USB Type‐C/PD, retimers, and/or Alt Modes (e. g. , DisplayPort) is a plus. 
 - Familiarity with platform security boundaries relevant to USB (secure boot, firmware/OS boundaries, attack surface considerations). 
 - Experience with QEMU, virtual platforms, or emulation workflows used for early driver/test development. 
 - Exposure to CI/CD and automated validation (Python/shell test frameworks, dashboards, regressions) for continuous USB quality. 

What We Offer

- Build a RISC‐V MPU platform from the ground up and see it shipped in real products. 
 - End-to-end ownership across pre-silicon → FPGA → first silicon → production SDK releases. 
 - Work closely with CPU architects and SoC teams, your data drives decisions. 
 - Deep technical work, strong peer group, and long-term growth on a strategic platform

MIPS - GlobalFoundries company is an equal opportunity employer, cultivating a diverse and inclusive workforce. We believe having a multicultural workplace enhances productivity, efficiency and innovation whilst our employees feel truly respected, valued and heard. 

As an affirmative employer, all qualified applicants are considered for employment regardless of age, ethnicity, marital status, citizenship, race, religion, political affiliation, gender, sexual orientation and medical and/or physical abilities. 

All offers of employment with GlobalFoundries are conditioned upon the successful completion of background checks, medical screenings as applicable and subject to the respective local laws and regulations. 

Information about our benefits you can find here: https: //gf. com/about-us/careers/opportunities-asia

data.title: Principal Expert, US Insurance Industry
data.description:
Life at UiPath

The people at UiPath believe in the transformative power of automation to change how the world works. We're committed to creating category-leading enterprise software that unleashes that power. 

To make that happen, we need people who are curious, self-propelled, generous, and genuine. People who love being part of a fast-moving, fast-thinking growth company. And people who care-about each other, about UiPath, and about our larger purpose. 

Could that be you?

Your Mission

UiPath is building a new way to design and deliver enterprise processes. UiPath cartographer draws on a curated library of industry process knowledge, interviews the business, and produces process maps and design documents. AI coding agents then turn those designs into working, orchestrated solutions, in days rather than months. 

In insurance, "almost right" isn't good enough. The best AI companies in regulated industries have learned the same lesson: quality comes from making a senior practitioner part of the team to building the benchmarks, evaluations and feedback loops around their experience and judgment. 

That's this role. As our Principal Expert for insurance, you will own the quality of everything our AI produces for US insurers. You'll set the bar, build the tests that hold the AI to it, and work in the field with customers and partners to make sure what we ship works in a real carrier. 

This role does not carry a sales quota and is not a product management role. Success is measured by the quality of the insurance solutions we deliver and how confidently customers build on them. 

Why This Role Is Exciting

- Your work sets the standard. What you define as good will be used by insurance customers, partners and AI agents across the platform. 
 - You see the impact. Take a process from discovery to a working solution in days, then keep improving it. 
 - You're building something new. Help decide which lines of business we go after next and how we measure the success of AI-designed processes. 

What You'll Do At UiPath

Own insurance AI quality

- Own the quality of insurance process knowledge, designs and solutions across Property & Casualty and Life & Annuity. 
 - Decide what needs fixing first, review changes before they go to customers, and sign off when a process is ready. 
 - Work with industry experts, partners and reviewers to maintain and improve quality. 

Build the insurance benchmark

- Build a library of real insurance use cases covering claims, FNOL and triage, total loss, endorsements, life claims, medical records, disability claims and new business NIGO. 
 - Define test cases, scoring criteria and expected answers to evaluate every new AI model and product release before it reaches customers. 

Turn expert judgment into evaluations

- Evaluate AI outputs at every stage, from process knowledge and process maps to design documents and working solutions. 
 - Work with applied scientists and engineers to make sure automated AI evaluations match expert judgment, so we can scale quality checks without relying on manual reviews for everything. 

Find failures and make sure they get fixed

- Review actual outputs, identify common failure types across regulation, coverage, workflows, data and terminology, and prioritise them based on customer impact. 
 - Turn recurring failures into reusable test cases and make sure fixes work before they go live. 
 - Share clear updates on quality, key issues and progress with leadership, product teams and customers. 

How You'll Work

You'll work in a small, senior team of automation consultants, engineers and applied scientists, working directly with customers. 

- Work with insurance carriers, MGAs and consulting partners to understand how their claims and underwriting teams operate, and test our designs against real processes. 
 - Join consultants and engineers on customer deployments and use what you learn to improve our benchmarks and evaluations. 
 - Run a regular review cycle, roughly every two weeks, to assess outputs, prioritise fixes and track improvements. 
 - Join customer and partner meetings. 

What You'll Bring To The Team

- Extensive experience (typically 12+ years) in US insurance, ideally starting hands-on in claims and moving into claims operations senior or mid level roles. 
 - Deep P&C or Life & Annuity knowledge across the lifecycle
 - Working knowledge of US claims regulation: unfair claims settlement practices, state acknowledgment and payment deadlines, total-loss and salvage rules, and market conduct exams. 
 - Experience mapping or redesigning claims or policy servicing operations: queues, handoffs, SLAs, exceptions, fraud referral and QA. 
 - The confidence to review complex documents quickly, spot what's plausible but wrong, and explain exactly why. 

Nice To Have

- Life & Annuity or disability expertise: contestability, beneficiary determination, unclaimed property, suitability, and underwriting evidence such as medical records. 
 - Experience evaluating AI or automation output: writing test cases, rubrics or reference answers, or running QA or validation programs. 
 - Experience with insurance AI, claims automation or document intake programs. 
 - Comfort with data and light technical work, such as spreadsheets, data analysis or prompting AI tools. 
 - Experience leading or calibrating a team of reviewers, auditors or claims QA specialists. 
 - Commercial lines, workers' compensation, employee benefits or broker/MGA experience. 

Maybe you don't tick all the boxes above-but still think you'd be great for the job? Go ahead, apply anyway. Please. Because we know that experience comes in all shapes and sizes-and passion can't be learned. 

Many of our roles allow for flexibility in when and where work gets done. Depending on the needs of the business and the role, the number of hybrid, office-based, and remote workers will vary from team to team. Applications are assessed on a rolling basis and there is no fixed deadline for this requisition. The application window may change depending on the volume of applications received or may close immediately if a qualified candidate is selected. 

We value a range of diverse backgrounds, experiences and ideas. We pride ourselves on our diversity and inclusive workplace that provides equal opportunities to all persons regardless of age, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, and expression, national origin, disability, neurodiversity, military and/or veteran status, or any other protected classes. Additionally, UiPath provides reasonable accommodations for candidates on request and respects applicants' privacy rights. To review these and other legal disclosures, visit our privacy policy.

At Solventum, we improve lives by helping healthcare professionals do their best work. Join a team using innovation and insight to make a real impact on the future of healthcare. All roles listed are with Solventum, and we're committed to protecting your personal information-learn more in our Privacy Policy: https: //www. solventum. com/en-us/home/legal/website-privacy-statement/applicant-privacy/

Job Description

3M Health Care is now Solventum

At Solventum, we enable better, smarter, safer healthcare to improve lives. As a new company with a long legacy of creating breakthrough solutions for our customers' toughest challenges, we pioneer game-changing innovations at the intersection of health, material and data science that change patients' lives for the better while enabling healthcare professionals to perform at their best. Because people, and their wellbeing, are at the heart of every scientific advancement we pursue. 

We partner closely with the brightest minds in healthcare to ensure that every solution we create melds the latest technology with compassion and empathy. Because at Solventum, we never stop solving for you.

As a Power Platform & AI Automation Engineer, You Will Have The Opportunity To Tap Into Your Curiosity And Collaborate With Some Of The Most Innovative And Diverse People Around The World. Here, You Will Make An Impact By

- Leads the end-to-end delivery of assigned automation backlog items using Copilot Studio, Cowork, Power Apps, Power Automate, and PowerShell for M365 automation, administration and lifecycle management, following established and recommended architecture patterns, governance standards, and ALM guidance.

 - Three (3) years of experience building solutions with Power Platform (Power Apps canvas and model-driven applications, Power Automate flows with enterprise error-handling and resiliency patterns, Dataverse, Copilot Studio).

data.title: Senior Staff Engineer Product Engineering
data.description:

This role offers the opportunity to work closely with product, design, manufacturing, and customer engineering teams to drive root cause analysis, improve product quality, and directly influence customer satisfaction. 

Your role

Key responsibilities in your new role

- Own customer-reported Failure Analysis (FA) cases from initiation through customer closure. 
 - Perform electrical failure analysis on IoT Wi-Fi and Bluetooth semiconductor devices. 
 - Conduct lot trace analysis and manufacturing data reviews to identify potential process or product anomalies. 
 - Execute DC/bench testing and electrical characterization as part of failure investigations. 
 - Perform ATE testing on UltraFlex platforms and analyze test logs to determine failure mechanisms. 
 - Conduct Wi-Fi and Bluetooth system-level validation to isolate and reproduce issues. 
 - Drive root cause identification and corrective actions using structured problem-solving methodologies. 
 - Collaborate with Product Engineering, Design, Manufacturing, Applications Engineering, and Quality teams to resolve customer issues. 
 - Interface directly with internal and external customers, providing technical updates and investigation findings. 
 - Author detailed failure analysis reports and customer-facing technical summaries. 
 - Manage FA case communications and documentation within Salesforce. com. 
 - Support sustaining engineering activities for microprocessors and IoT product portfolios. 
 - Present technical findings and corrective action recommendations to customers and cross-functional stakeholders. 

Your profile

Qualifications And Skills To Help You Succeed

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electronics, Electrical Engineering, Microelectronics, Semiconductor Physics, or a related field. 
 - 8+ years of experience in Customer Quality, Failure Analysis, Product Engineering, or Semiconductor Quality roles. 
 - Strong expertise in electrical failure analysis and semiconductor device characterization. 
 - Hands-on experience with UltraFlex test systems; experience with Advantest, Verigy, Maverick, or Magnum platforms is highly desirable. 
 - Sound understanding of semiconductor physics, device failure mechanisms, and manufacturing processes. 
 - Proven experience using quality and problem-solving tools such as 8D, DOE, FMEA, FTA, Fishbone Analysis, Why-Why, Statistical Yield Analysis, and Is/Is-Not methodology. 
 - Strong data analysis skills with proficiency in Excel (Pivot Tables, data interpretation, trend analysis). 
 - Experience creating professional customer-facing FA reports, presentations, and technical documentation. 
 - Excellent communication and customer-facing presentation skills. 
 - Knowledge of scripting, automation, data science, or analytics tools is an added advantage. 
 - Ability to work effectively across global, cross-functional teams and manage multiple complex investigations simultaneously.

The Acute Care Monitoring (ACM) Research & Development organization develops software and technology solutions that support patient monitoring and respiratory interventions across the continuum of care. The software verification and validation function is responsible for ensuring product quality, reliability, safety, and regulatory compliance through comprehensive test strategy development, test automation, verification and validation activities, and continuous quality improvements for medical device software products. 

This position is based in Hyderabad, India and follows a Flex work arrangement. No travel is required. 

As a senior software verification and validation professional, you will lead verification and validation activities for medical device software products across multiple programs. The role focuses on test strategy development, test automation, software quality assurance, regulatory compliance, and cross-functional collaboration to ensure safe, effective, and high-quality software releases for Acute Care Monitoring products. 

Primary Responsibilities

- Lead software verification and validation activities across multiple medical device software programs and serve as test lead for RPE initiatives. 
 - Design, develop, and execute verification and validation strategies using manual and automated testing methodologies. 
 - Develop and enhance test automation frameworks for desktop, web, mobile, and embedded software applications. 
 - Review software requirements, test designs, and test scripts to ensure comprehensive verification of product functionality and quality requirements. 
 - Collaborate with global cross-functional Agile teams throughout requirements, design, implementation, verification, and release activities. 
 - Support non-product tool validation (NPTV), defect analysis, risk assessments, static code analysis, and quality assurance activities. 
 - Mentor verification and validation engineers, promote testing best practices, and support continuous process improvements.

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree OR Master's degree in Computer Science, Biomedical Engineering, Biotechnology, Electronics Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or related technical discipline with 15+ years of experience in software verification and validation, including 2+ years in medical device, medical IT, or other regulated industries. 
 - Experience in software verification and validation for desktop, web, mobile, and embedded software applications using manual and automated testing methodologies. 
 - Proficiency in Python, LabVIEW, TestStand, and C# with experience developing automated test solutions and test frameworks. 
 - Experience with UI test automation tools, Selenium, Appium, debugging techniques, and both white-box and black-box testing methodologies.

Preferred Qualifications

Physical Job Requirements

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by employees assigned to this position, but they are not an exhaustive list of all the required responsibilities and skills of this position.

Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced Staff Performance Engineer to lead and scale performance engineering practices for our cloud-native SaaS platform. This role is responsible for driving performance, scalability, reliability, and cost efficiency at an organizational level, with a strong focus on serverless and distributed architectures. 

You will define performance engineering strategy, build scalable and AI-driven performance platforms, and influence architectural decisions across teams. The role requires deep expertise in modern cloud environments and a strong focus on embedding performance into the entire software lifecycle, from development to production. 

Key Responsibilities

- Define and drive organization-wide performance engineering strategy aligned with business KPIs, customer experience, and cost efficiency
 - Architect and build scalable, self-service performance engineering platforms enabling teams to run performance tests and analysis independently
 - Design and implement AI-driven performance engineering solutions including anomaly detection, predictive performance insights, adaptive load testing, and automated optimization recommendations
 - Lead the design and execution of advanced performance testing strategies for serverless, distributed, and event-driven systems
 - Establish and standardize performance benchmarks, SLAs, SLOs, and KPIs across services
 - Drive integration of performance testing and validation into CI/CD pipelines to enable continuous performance engineering (shift-left approach)
 - Analyze system-wide performance bottlenecks including latency, cold starts, concurrency limits, and resource utilization across distributed systems
 - Collaborate with engineering, SRE, and architecture teams to influence system design for scalability, resilience, and performance optimization
 - Own performance in production environments by leveraging observability tools, distributed tracing, and real-time monitoring systems
 - Implement intelligent observability solutions using tools such as CloudWatch, Datadog, New Relic, and AI-based monitoring platforms
 - Lead capacity planning and scalability initiatives for high-throughput and globally distributed systems
 - Drive cost-performance optimization strategies in cloud-native environments (FinOps alignment)

 - Stay updated with emerging trends in performance engineering, including AI/ML-driven optimization and cloud-native innovations

Desired Skill and Requirements

Must Have

- 8+ years of experience in performance engineering within large-scale SaaS or cloud-native environments

 - Ability to influence architectural and technical decisions across teams
 - Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
 - Ownership mindset with the ability to drive cross-functional initiatives
 - Mentorship and leadership capabilities
 - Ability to operate in a fast-paced, high-growth SaaS environment

 - 3+ years of experience in Senior, Lead, or Staff-level performance engineering roles
 - 4+ years of experience performance testing large-scale SaaS or distributed systems
 - 5+ years of hands-on experience with performance testing tools such as JMeter, Gatling, k6, or Locust
 - Experience designing and executing large-scale performance tests in production-like environments
 - Experience identifying and resolving performance bottlenecks across application, database, network, and infrastructure layers
 - Experience tuning databases for performance at scale
 - Experience defining and implementing performance benchmarks, KPIs, and capacity planning strategies
 - Experience working with observability and monitoring platforms for performance analysis
 - Experience optimizing event-driven and serverless architectures
 - Experience influencing architecture and engineering decisions across teams and domains
 - Experience operating in fast-paced, high-growth SaaS environments

Education

 - Equivalent practical experience in performance engineering or cloud-native systems

We're looking for a Senior QA Engineer (Performance Testing) to join Procore's Product & Technology QA Engineering Team in India. In this role, you will be responsible for designing, executing, and scaling performance and load tests for critical systems to ensure our platform delivers reliable and high-performing experiences to millions of users worldwide. 

You should be detail-oriented, analytical, and self-driven, with the ability to work in a fast-paced environment with cross-functional teams across various domains and locations. This role will focus on performance testing of web applications, APIs, and backend services, and will play a key part in performance tuning and capacity planning. 

Procore software solutions aim to improve the lives of everyone in construction, and our Product & Technology team is the driving force behind our innovative, top-rated global platform. We're a customer-centric group encompassing engineering, product, design, data, and business systems. 

This position reports into the QA Manager and will be based in our Bengaluru offices. We're looking for someone to join us immediately. 

What You'll Do: 

- Design and develop robust performance test plans and strategies for backend services, APIs, and web applications.

- 5+ years of experience in performance engineering or software quality assurance with a strong focus on performance testing.

 - Solid understanding of system architecture, distributed systems, and cloud-native applications (preferably AWS or GCP).

data.title: Senior Software Developer - Android
data.description:
About WeRize

Founded in 2019 by Vishal Chopra and Himanshu Gupta, WeRize is building India's largest full stack fintechplatform for 500 million underserved middle-class customers who live in 5000+ small towns of India. WeRize (Wortgage technologies pvt ltd) also owns RBI registered NBFC subsidiary (Wortgage Finance pvt ltd). 

This customer segmentis not served by privatesector banks, Insurersand Mutual Fund companies due to their low ticket-size and lifetime value and is dependent on PSU/Govt. banks. PSU/Government banks rarely provide financial products beyond basic savings accounts and these customers lack access to unsecured loans, MSME loans, credit cards, affordable housing loans, loan against property , health and life insurance and investment products. WeRize manufactures innovative unsecured consumer credit, mortgages, loan against property, MSME loans, savings and insurance products designed for this customer base keeping in mind their needs, requirements and purchasing power, with a view to add a layer of financial security to their lives and enable access to credit. While customers in these geographies use smartphones, they need properguidance and support when purchasing the right financial products for themselves. So, a pure digital model doesn't work for this segment. WeRize has innovated on this front through its 'Finance ki online dukaan (Social Shopify of Finance)', a first of its kind social distribution tech platform in the financial services space that educates and enables local financially literate freelancers across these small towns to source business through online and offline channels, recommend the right financial product(s) to customers as well as provide after sales support. These freelancers, who are located in more than 5000+ towns and cities, earn as much as INR 30, 000 a month from WeRize in commissions. 

Our social distribution platform supported by financially literatefreelancers means exceptionally low cost of customer acquisition (CAC) and operations costs compared to both fully digital and on-the-ground financial services providers. Digital conversions among this target group are way lower when comparedto upper income customers in metros and hence pure digital CAC doesn't workfor this segment. While companies like LIC and Fino Bank also rely on freelancer distribution, they deploy local on-fieldteams/branches to manage freelancers in every city. That resultsin very high CAC and operations costs for such companies. WeRize on the other hand, has been able to acquire, train and manage thousandsof freelancers in 5000+ citiesonly through its tech platform and without any feet-on-street team of its own. This results in highly profitable business model for Werize. 

To know more about the company, please visit: https: //www. werize. com

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to own the complete hybrid mobile stack-spanning React/TypeScript web apps, React Native shells, and native Android code. You will spend roughly 60% of your time on React/React Native and 40% on native Android development. 

Key Responsibilities

- Feature Development & Architecture: Build and maintain features across React (TypeScript), React Native, and native Android. Design robust, secure messaging bridges between web and native components. 
 - Native Development & WebView: Write Kotlin native modules (camera, permissions, storage) and configure/harden WebViews (sessions, security allowlisting, file choosers).

data.description:
Company Description

At Nielsen, we are passionate about our work to power a better media future for all people by providing powerful insights that drive client decisions and deliver extraordinary results. Our talented, global workforce is dedicated to capturing audience engagement with content - wherever and whenever it's consumed. Together, we are proudly rooted in our deep legacy as we stand at the forefront of the media revolution. When you join Nielsen, you will join a dynamic team committed to excellence, perseverance, and the ambition to make an impact together. We champion you, because when you succeed, we do too. We enable your best to power our future. 

Job Description

We are looking for a strong Quality Engineering candidate who can flex across MTS-2 and MTS-3 expectations depending on depth of experience, ownership, and technical maturity. This role is ideal for someone who brings deep hands-on automation skills with solid manual testing foundations, and who is excited to work on products spanning mobile, TV/CTV, web, backend services, and large-scale data pipelines. 

This person will work across Nielsen Pulse / Streaming+, EMM / panel applications, and adjacent digital measurement platforms. The role requires end-to-end quality ownership across user journeys, platform integrations, data collection flows, and backend validation in a domain where correctness, scale, and platform diversity matter. 

The ideal candidate is comfortable testing not just UI behavior, but also events, telemetry, APIs, databases, data pipelines, and platform-specific edge cases across Android, iOS, web, and TV environments. They should be able to design robust automation, perform deep debugging, and partner closely with engineering, product, data, and operations teams to ship high-quality releases. 

Qualifications

- Own test strategy, planning, execution, and sign-off for features spanning manual and automation coverage
 - Build and maintain scalable automation frameworks for UI, API, integration, and regression testing
 - Validate complex end-to-end flows across mobile, TV/CTV, web, backend services, and data pipelines
 - Perform deep validation of data correctness across logs, APIs, databases, batch jobs, event streams, and downstream reports
 - Design test cases for large-volume, high-variability, real-world datasets and platform combinations

The role is responsible for daily business-as-usual delivery, process establishment, service quality, operational risk management, performance management, team culture, and alignment with the broader Wealth Management strategy. 

The position requires strong operational leadership, sound AML/KYC technical knowledge, effective stakeholder management, and the ability to translate regulatory and business requirements into sustainable processes, controls, and measurable outcomes.

People Leadership and Team Management

 - Recognize strong performance, address performance concerns consistently and promptly, and support career development.

Risk, Control, and Compliance Management

- Ensure compliance with regulatory, audit, risk, and policy requirements while maintaining a strong control environment. 
 - Identify, assess, and mitigate operational and compliance risks, control gaps, and process weaknesses. 
 - Support RCSA, quality, and control monitoring activities, driving remediation and continuous improvement. 
 - Partner with AML, Compliance, Risk, and Audit teams to strengthen controls, implement regulatory changes, and promote sound risk management practices. 

Stakeholder Management and Client Service

- Build effective relationships with business, AML, operational, and project stakeholders across locations.

Process Improvement and Strategic Change

 - Lead or support transitions, migrations, regulatory change initiatives, and strategic projects. 
 - Leverage management information, trend analysis, and operational insights to identify improvement opportunities and measure outcomes. 
 - Maintain effective procedures, documentation, and training materials while promoting successful change adoption across the team.

- Minimum 6 years of AML/KYC experience, including 1 year of people management.

 - Effective leadership, stakeholder management, and communication skills. 
 - Ability to build high-performing teams through coaching, development, and accountability. 
 - Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage competing priorities and deliver results. 
 - Client-focused mindset with a commitment to quality, compliance, and continuous improvement. 
 - Proven ability to lead change, drive process improvements, and support strategic initiatives. 

Qualifications

 - Minimum 6 years of AML/KYC experience, including 1 year of people management experience. 
 - Experience supporting Wealth Management clients and managing service delivery, operational risk, controls, and process improvement initiatives. 
 - Experience leading or supporting transitions, change initiatives, and operational enhancements preferred. 
 - Professional certification such as CAMS or ACAMS preferred. 

Reporting Relationships

Direct Reports

AML CRF Review Team partners

Key Stakeholders

- Wealth Management Operations and global partners
 - AML, Compliance, Risk, and Audit
 - Human Resources and change teams
 - Upstream and downstream operational teams

Eligibility for Internal Partners

- 24 months as a Technical Coordinator/Associate Consultant to move as a Team Leader/ Consultant.

As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve. 

Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust's history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.

Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs. com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.

The Northern Trust Pune office, established in 2016, is now home to over 3, 000 employees. The office handles various functions, including Operations for Asset Servicing and Wealth Management, as well as delivering critical technology solutions that support business operations across the globe. 

Our Pune team takes our commitment to service to heart. In 2024, they volunteered more than 10, 000+ hours into the communities where they live and work. Learn more.

data.title: Senior OR Lead RTL Design Engineer
data.description:
About Client: 

Our Client is a signal processing infrastructure company. they build the full acquisition and compute stack for human-aware technology - from custom analog front-end IP that captures biosignals at the source, to signal-first compute systems built for time-critical workloads. 

Our Client's Silicon is their ground-up effort to build a new compute category. 

About the Role

We need a strong RTL expert who can lead our silicon program to tapeout. You will be the technical bridge between our architecture and our design partner, owning every step from RTL freeze to GDSII handoff, working with our partners. You will also build and lead the RTL team of 5-7 engineers. This is a hands-on lead role. You write RTL, review RTL, run synthesis, and own the result. The architect defines what gets built. You own how it gets built. 

Responsibilities

- Translate the architecture specification into synthesizable SystemVerilog
 - Own the RTL coding standards, linting rules, and design methodology
 - Lead a team of 5-7 RTL engineers through the full design cycle
 - Own the synthesis flow (Design Compiler or Genus) and drive timing closure
 - Define and maintain SDC timing constraints
 - Review all RTL code submissions for correctness, synthesizability, and style
 - Coordinate with the outsource partner on GDSII handover (netlist, constraints, floorplan
 - guidance)
 - Work closely with the verification team to resolve bugs and achieve coverage closureRequirements

Experience

- 4+ OR 7+ years of RTL design experience in SystemVerilog
 - At least 1 tapeout through to GDSII (not just RTL - you've seen the full flow)
 - Synthesis and timing closure experience (Design Compiler or Genus, PrimeTime or
 - Tempus)
 - Processor, DSP, or datapath-heavy design experience
 - Familiarity with advanced process nodes (28nm class or below)
 - Strong code review skills, you can spot timing hazards, FSM issues, and non-synthesizable patterns in review
 - Comfortable leading a small team while remaining hands-onGood to have

- VLIW or vector processor design experience
 - Experience with deterministic/real-time architectures (no caches, fixed latencies)
 - Formal verification awareness (writing SVA, working with formal tools)
 - FPGA prototyping experience (Vivado)

Work Mode: 5 days WFO

Location: Bangalore

data.description:
Our Purpose

At SentinelOne, we are driven by a clear purpose: to give the advantage to those who secure our future. As AI reshapes how organizations build, operate, and innovate, the responsibility to protect them becomes more critical than ever. When you join SentinelOne, your work helps protect global enterprises, critical infrastructure, and the technologies shaping tomorrow. If you are motivated by meaningful challenges and want your impact to be real, measurable, and global, you will find purpose here. 

About Us

SentinelOne is a company at the intersection of AI and security, pioneering a new operating model for cybersecurity. Our AI-native platform unifies protection across endpoint, cloud, identity, data, and AI systems to deliver autonomous detection and response with clarity and speed. By combining real-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters. 

Our teams are builders, problem-solvers, and innovators committed to shaping the future of security. If you are excited to solve hard problems alongside talented, mission-driven people, we invite you to help us build a safer future for humanity. 

What Are We Looking For?

We're looking for people who are relentlessly curious and committed to continuous learning. AI is reshaping every function across our business, and we enable every team member, regardless of role or level, to build fluency in AI tools and concepts. Those who thrive here actively seek out new solutions, experiment thoughtfully, and apply what they learn to drive better, faster, smarter outcomes. 

As a Staff Software Engineer, you will be tasked with taking ownership and acting on it, without being tied to a single team or codebase. As company priorities shift, you will move to where your skills make the biggest difference, whether that is a new product area, a scaling challenge, or an ambiguous problem nobody has framed yet. You should be excited about setting technical direction for large-scale distributed systems, comfortable diving into complexity, and eager to own the architecture, reliability, and operability of what you build, while influencing technical strategy across multiple teams and mentoring engineers at all levels. 

What Will You Do?

Primary responsibilities include: 

- Set technical direction by defining the architecture and technical roadmap for the systems you work on, aligning multiple squads of backend and frontend engineers around a coherent long-term vision. 
 - Drive complex initiatives end-to-end, leading the most ambiguous, cross-cutting projects from problem framing through production and delivering under uncertainty. 
 - Own the architecture by making foundational design decisions, choosing patterns and technologies for scale, reliability, performance, and maintainability, and establishing the standards others build on. 
 - Own operability and lifecycle at scale, shaping deployment, observability, patching, and upgrade strategy so that our systems stay secure, reliable, and current. 
 - Own outcomes, not just tasks, taking accountability from design through production and incident resolution. 
 - Multiply the team by mentoring and growing engineers, raising the engineering bar through design and code reviews, and serving as a force multiplier across the organization. 
 - Influence without authority, driving alignment and technical decisions across teams through clear communication and sound judgment. 
 - See your impact, as your work directly improves how customers deploy, operate, and trust SentinelOne, and is a visible part of key company initiatives. 

What Skills and Knowledge Will You Bring?

Ideal candidates will have: 

- 8 or more years of backend development experience, including a track record of technical leadership on large-scale systems. 
 - Proficiency in at least one of Go or Python, with a strong foundation in data structures, algorithms, and system design. 
 - Solid experience with unit and integration testing, and with both relational and NoSQL databases, including database design and sharding. 
 - Proven experience designing distributed systems, including partitioning, consistency, and availability trade-offs, and architecting high-performance, microservices-based backend systems at scale. 
 - Hands-on experience with event-driven architecture and messaging platforms such as Kafka; experience with high-scale API design and resilience patterns such as circuit breakers; and a deep understanding of operating systems and networking fundamentals. 
 - Hands-on experience with at least one public cloud (AWS, GCP, or Azure), and with Docker and Docker Compose. 
 - A strong ownership mindset and the agency to act without waiting to be told; comfort with ambiguity, breaking down unclear problems and delivering under uncertainty; and adaptability, learning new domains quickly and being happy to move between teams. 
 - Proven cross-team influence, driving alignment and technical decisions without formal authority, and a track record of mentoring engineers and contributing to their career growth. 
 - Excellent communication skills, including translating technical complexity into business context and leading projects in a hybrid or remote team. 
 - Open-source contributions, experience with AI coding agents and agentic development workflows, experience architecting software for on-prem, self-hosted, or air-gapped deployments, and hands-on experience with the Kafka ecosystem (Kafka Pub/Sub, Kafka Connect, etc. ) are preferred. 

Why SentinelOne?

AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. From day one, we architected an AI-native platform designed to operate at machine speed, not as an add-on to legacy systems but as the foundation itself. If you want to build where innovation and impact move together, this is that place. 

We invest in our Sentinels with comprehensive, competitive benefits designed to support you and your family: 

Equity & Rewards

- Restricted Stock Units (RSUs)
 - Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP)

Time Off & Wellbeing

- Competitive leave benefits

Insurance & Financial Security

- Medical and insurance benefits

Work Perks & Flexibility

- Global home office allowance
 - Internet allowance
 - LinkedIn Learning license
 - Social Connect program
 - Food allowance (Bangalore office)
 - Meal vouchers (Sodexo)

Wellness & Lifestyle

- Health & wellness benefit

SentinelOne is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. 

SentinelOne participates in the E-Verify Program for all U. S. based roles.

data.title: Software Engineering Manager - C#.NET Distributed Systems
data.description:
Software Engineering Manager, DryvIQ Team at Nasuni - C#. NET

Hyderabad, India | Hybrid - 3 days onsite

Role overview

Nasuni is expanding the DryvIQ engineering team in Hyderabad following our acquisition of DryvIQ, bringing intelligent content discovery, classification, sensitivity detection, and policy-driven governance into the Nasuni platform. 

We're looking for a hands-on Software Engineering Manager to lead a team of approximately 4-7 Software Engineers building primarily backend services using C#/. NET, microservices, and distributed systems, with some React-based frontend development. 

This is a technical people-leadership role. You'll stay close enough to the architecture and code to challenge designs, troubleshoot difficult problems, and raise engineering standards, while your primary accountability is building an effective engineering team and delivering reliable product outcomes. 

This role is well suited to an engineering leader who still enjoys getting into technical details but measures success through the capability and results of the team. 

Level and scope

You will own the engineering effectiveness, delivery, technical quality, and development of a product engineering team. You'll make and facilitate architecture and engineering decisions within your area, translate product priorities into executable technical plans, and partner closely with Product, SDET/QA Automation, Security, Operations, and global Nasuni engineering teams. 

You will directly manage Software Engineers and work closely with SDET/QA Automation resources through a dotted-line partnership. 

What you'll do

- Lead, coach, and develop 4-7 Software Engineers while creating clear expectations for ownership, quality, collaboration, and growth. 
 - Guide the design and evolution of C#/. NET backend microservices, APIs, asynchronous workflows, and distributed processing systems. 
 - Stay technically engaged through architecture and design reviews, code reviews, debugging, incident analysis, and selective hands-on development. 
 - Own team execution from planning through production, balancing roadmap delivery with reliability, maintainability, security, and technical debt. 
 - Establish strong engineering practices around automated testing, CI/CD, observability, performance, secure development, and production readiness. 
 - Partner with SDET/QA Automation to build quality into engineering workflows rather than treating testing as a downstream activity. 
 - Develop systems that operate safely through partial failures, retries, rate limits, concurrency, backpressure, and changing workloads. 
 - Partner across DryvIQ and Nasuni as the platforms become more deeply integrated, maintaining appropriate tenant isolation, permissions, auditability, and sensitive-data controls. 
 - Hire and onboard engineers, provide actionable feedback, manage performance, and create development opportunities for the team. 
 - Use approved AI-assisted engineering tools to improve areas such as development, testing, debugging, code review, incident analysis, and engineering workflows while ensuring outputs are appropriately validated for correctness, security, performance, and data sensitivity. 

What success looks like

Within your first 90 days, you'll understand the DryvIQ architecture, establish trust with the engineering team and partners, and take ownership of team execution. 

Within 6-12 months, the team should demonstrate stronger delivery predictability, engineering quality and production ownership while delivering meaningful DryvIQ/Nasuni integration outcomes. 

Qualifications

Must-Have

- 10+ years of professional software engineering experience, with meaningful recent backend/product engineering depth. 
 - 3+ years of direct people management or comparable sustained engineering-team leadership. 
 - Strong hands-on background with C#/. NET and production backend services. 
 - Experience designing, building, and operating microservices, distributed systems, or event driven architecture. 
 - Demonstrated ownership of engineering delivery, architecture decisions, production quality, and technical tradeoffs. 
 - Experience coaching engineers through technical and professional growth. 
 - Strong collaboration across Product, QA/SDET, architecture, and geographically distributed engineering teams. 

Preferred

- B2B SaaS or enterprise software product experience. 
 - Cloud-native development, containers, Kubernetes, messaging/event-driven systems, CI/CD, and observability. 
 - Database experience including Posgres and Clickhouse 
 - Experience leading teams responsible for high-volume data processing or complex integrations. 
 - Working knowledge of React or modern frontend architecture. 
 - Practical use of AI-assisted engineering and AI-Automation with disciplined validation. 

Ideal

- Content management, data governance, data security, classification, DLP, storage, information management, or repository/connector platforms. 
 - Experience integrating an acquired technology or modernizing systems across platform boundaries. 
 - Experience building teams during periods of rapid product and organizational change. 

Experience guideline: Typically 10-15+ years overall, including 3-6+ years leading software engineers. Scope and demonstrated impact matter more than years alone. 

About Nasuni

Nasuni is the unstructured data foundation for enterprise teams-and the AI that supports them. We manage, protect, and activate the world's unstructured data so organizations can work smarter, spend wisely, and create safely without limits. As a Vista-backed SaaS data infrastructure company, Nasuni is building a next-generation, AI-ready platform that turns massive file estates into secure, governed, actionable data for automation, analytics, and global collaboration. 

Why work here - Hyderabad

Join at an important product moment as DryvIQ's content intelligence and governance capabilities become part of Nasuni's broader platform. In Hyderabad, you'll lead engineers solving meaningful distributed-systems, cloud, security, content-intelligence, and data-governance challenges with global partners. 

Vista Equity Partners' backing connects our Hyderabad team to a broader software ecosystem, leadership programs, learning opportunities, and AI innovation communities-combining the pace of a growing product company with the reach of a global technology investor. 

Benefits

As part of our commitment to your well-being and growth, Nasuni offers competitive benefits designed to support every stage of your life and career, including competitive compensation programs, flexible time off and leave policies, comprehensive health and wellness coverage, hybrid and flexible work arrangements, employee referral and recognition programs, professional development and learning support, an inclusive and collaborative team culture, modern office spaces with team events and perks, and retirement and statutory benefits as per Indian regulations. 

To all recruitment agencies: Nasuni does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our job boards, Nasuni employees, or any other company location. Nasuni is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes. 

Nasuni is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and respectful workplace where every team member can thrive. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, caste, color, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, disability, age, national origin, or any other status protected by applicable laws in India or the country of employment. 

This privacy notice relates to information collected (whether online or offline) by Nasuni Corporation and our corporate affiliates (collectively, "Nasuni") from or about you in your capacity as a Nasuni employee, independent contractor/service provider or as an applicant for an employment or contractor relationship with Nasuni.

Objective of the Role: Head - Manufacturing Engineering / Industrial Engineering

To lead the Manufacturing Engineering and Industrialisation function with end-to-end ownership of process development, line design, NPI, equipment selection, automation, commissioning, process validation and SOP, ensuring the organisation develops robust, scalable, cost-effective and future-ready manufacturing capabilities. 

The role will drive the transformation of product design into a manufacturable process, improve productivity and quality, optimise manufacturing costs, and establish advanced manufacturing technologies aligned with the company's growth and global standards. 

Roles & Responsibilities: 

1. Manufacturing Engineering Strategy: 

- Develop and implement the Manufacturing Engineering strategy aligned with business, product and global manufacturing objectives. 
 - Establish manufacturing engineering standards, processes and best practices across the organisation. 
 - Develop a 3-5 year manufacturing technology roadmap aligned with business growth. 
 - Drive advanced manufacturing, automation, digitalisation and Industry 4. 0 initiatives. 

2. End-to-End Industrialisation / Concept-to-SOP: 

- Own the complete Concept → Process Design → Prototype → Pilot → Validation → SOP → Mass Production cycle. 
 - Ensure product manufacturability through DFM/DFA reviews and early identification of manufacturing risks. 
 - Lead industrialisation of new products, technologies and manufacturing processes. 
 - Ensure smooth transition from product engineering to stable mass production. 

3. Process & Line Design

- Develop manufacturing process flows and detailed process concepts. 
 - Design production lines based on capacity, takt time, cycle time, line balancing, manpower, quality and material flow. 
 - Define automation levels, process sequence, quality gates and inspection points. 
 - Drive process optimisation to achieve robust, scalable and cost-effective manufacturing. 

4. Equipment, Automation & Technology

- Define technical specifications for machines, equipment, tooling and automation. 
 - Lead technical evaluation and selection of machine and equipment suppliers. 
 - Evaluate equipment for capacity, cycle time, reliability, capability, maintainability, safety and cost. 
 - Lead FAT, SAT, installation, commissioning and process validation. 
 - Drive implementation of robotics, automation, vision systems, traceability and smart manufacturing. 

5. Global Transformation & Technology Transfer

- Lead and implement global manufacturing transformation projects initiated by the corporate/global engineering organisation. 
 - Act as the key interface between global engineering teams and India manufacturing operations. 
 - Drive transfer of global technologies, processes, systems and best practices to India. 
 - Ensure successful implementation of global standards while adapting them to local manufacturing requirements. 
 - Establish governance for tracking global transformation projects, milestones, risks and business benefits. 

6. Localisation Strategy

- Develop and execute localisation strategies for products, processes, equipment, tooling, technology and suppliers. 
 - Evaluate global technologies for local feasibility, cost competitiveness, scalability and manufacturability. 
 - Identify opportunities to localise imported equipment, components, tooling and manufacturing technologies. 
 - Develop local suppliers and technology partners without compromising global quality and engineering standards. 
 - Drive localisation to improve cost competitiveness, lead time and supply-chain resilience. 

7. Process Validation & Quality

- Lead PFMEA, Process Flow, Control Plan and process validation activities. 
 - Ensure machine and process capability before SOP. 
 - Establish appropriate measurement systems, inspection methods and quality controls. 
 - Drive structured problem-solving using 8D, 5 Why, Fishbone, DOE and other appropriate methodologies. 
 - Ensure lessons learned are incorporated into future product and process development. 

8. Line Commissioning & Ramp-up

- Lead installation, commissioning and validation of new manufacturing lines. 
 - Resolve technical, quality, capacity and equipment issues during commissioning. 
 - Conduct run-at-rate and capacity validation. 
 - Ensure successful SOP and production ramp-up. 
 - Stabilise processes during the initial production phase and achieve targeted productivity. 

9. Supplier & Technology Partner Management

- Identify, evaluate and develop machine, automation, tooling and technology suppliers. 
 - Lead technical evaluation, supplier selection and development. 
 - Manage supplier performance against technical, quality, cost and delivery requirements. 
 - Develop strategic partnerships with key technology and equipment suppliers. 

10. Manufacturing Excellence & Productivity

- Drive improvements in OEE, cycle time, throughput, yield, manpower productivity and manufacturing cost. 
 - Identify and eliminate process bottlenecks. 
 - Drive Lean Manufacturing, Kaizen, Poka-yoke and continuous improvement initiatives. 
 - Benchmark global manufacturing practices and implement relevant best practices locally. 

11. Capex & Engineering Project Management

- Develop and manage the Manufacturing Engineering Capex plan and budget. 
 - Evaluate business cases and ROI for new equipment, automation and technology. 
 - Lead complex engineering projects within agreed cost, quality and timeline. 
 - Establish project governance, milestones, risk management and escalation mechanisms. 

12. Team Leadership & Capability Building

- Lead and develop the Manufacturing Engineering and Industrialisation team. 
 - Build capabilities in process engineering, automation, industrialisation, project management and advanced manufacturing. 
 - Define KPIs, performance objectives and development plans. 
 - Build succession and develop future engineering leaders. 
 - Create a culture of technical ownership, innovation and continuous improvement. 

13. Cross-Functional & Global Collaboration

- Work closely with R&D, Product Engineering, Quality, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Procurement, Finance and Business teams. 
 - Collaborate with global engineering and manufacturing teams on technology transfer and transformation projects. 
 - Resolve product-versus-process challenges and ensure manufacturability. 
 - Represent India Manufacturing Engineering in relevant global engineering forums. 

14. Future Manufacturing Technology

- Identify emerging technologies relevant to e-Mobility, automotive and advanced manufacturing. 
 - Develop and execute the manufacturing technology roadmap. 
 - Evaluate advanced automation, robotics, digital manufacturing, AI-enabled process monitoring and traceability. 
 - Build future-ready manufacturing capabilities aligned with the company's long-term growth plans. 

Candidate Requirement: 

- 15-20 years of experience in Manufacturing Engineering / Industrialisation / NPI. 
 - Engineering degree in Mechanical / Production / Industrial / Mechatronics. 
 - Preferred experience in Automotive, Auto Components, e-Mobility, Electric Motors or Heavy Engineering. 
 - Strong experience in Concept-to-SOP, NPI, process design and new line development. 
 - Hands-on exposure to equipment selection, automation, line commissioning and machine supplier management. 
 - Experience in global technology transfer, transformation projects and localisation in an MNC environment. 
 - Strong knowledge of PFMEA, Control Plan, process validation, OEE, Lean and continuous improvement. 
 - Experience managing Capex, projects and cross-functional/global teams. 
 - Proven ability to lead and develop Manufacturing Engineering teams. 
 - Strategic mindset with strong focus on cost, quality, productivity, technology and future manufacturing capabilities.

Job Summary

The Electrical and C&I Quality Lead is responsible for overseeing, inspecting, and approving all quality control (QC) and quality assurance (QA) activities related to electrical and instrumentation systems. This role ensures that all installations, testing, and commissioning meet project specifications, design drawings, and international engineering standards

Key Responsibilities

Quality Control & Inspections

- Perform Vendor Inspections: Check all electrical and C&I Item check Quality check like cable, Transformer, HT Motors, LT Motors, DDCMIS, PLC Panel, LT Switchgear, Field Instruments, Cable Tray, LT Switchgear etc. 
 - Review Technical Documents: Check and approve Manufacturing Quality Plans (MQP), Material Test Certificates (MTC), Pre-Bid documents, Vendor Evaluation Documents ect. 
 - Material Verification: Inspect incoming electrical and instrumentation goods at the site to ensure they match approved vendors and technical parameters

Testing Assurance

- System Validation: Ensure Control Systems like DCS (Distributed Control System) and PLC (Programmable Logic Controller) are validated against regulatory standard procedures. 
 - Punch List Management: Identify quality defects, create "punch lists" (lists of open tasks), and track them until they are fixed. 

Governance & Compliance

- Audit and Standards: Ensure the project complies with safety and international quality benchmarks like ISO 9001, IEC 61508, and local grid codes. 
 - Root Cause Analysis (RCA): Lead investigations if equipment fails or quality errors happen repeatedly, then create corrective action plans. 
 - Documentation & Reporting: Maintain standard test records, sign off on inspection reports, and submit daily quality logs to the Project Head. 

Job Requirements

Education & Experience

- Degree: Bachelor's degree (B. E. / B. Tech) in Electrical Engineering or Electronics & Instrumentation Engineering. 
 - Experience Level: 
 - For Mid-to-Senior Lead roles: 12 to 18 years of experience in QA/QC engineering. 
 - Heavy exposure to power plants (BTG/FGD systems), oil & gas, or renewable energy sites is highly preferred. 
Technical Skills & Certifications

- Knowledge: Deep understanding of electrical systems (transformers, switchgear, VFDs) and C&I systems (transmitters, control valves, PLC/DCS). 
 - Standards: Familiarity with international codes like IEC, IEEE, and ISO standards. 
 - Certifications (Good to Have): ISO 9001 Lead Auditor certification, or Internal ISO Auditor. 

Soft Skills

- Strong leadership to manage a team of junior QC inspectors and contractors. 
 - Clear communication skills to explain technical issues to vendors and client

At Kidde Global Solutions, you're joining a global technology leader in fire and life safety solutions and our employees are the heart of it all. With industry-defining brands in life safety and security, you'll be part of a legacy of leadership working with cutting-edge technologies that protect lives and property worldwide. As a leading fire safety brand, our mission is to provide solutions that protect people and property from the effects of fire and related hazards. We're committed to expanding our impact and providing dynamic opportunities for growth within our team. You'll be part of a company that prioritizes quality, integrity, collaboration, and customer care, with the resources, training, and incentives to ensure your success every step of the way. 

Job Responsibilities

An energetic person who is capable of leading Verifications & Validation of New product development and/or sustaining programs. Drive quality assurance in embedded product lifecycle. 

- QA Engineer supporting the continued design, development and quality delivery of firmware & software applications for fire products /complex systems driving and ensuring quality assurance. 
 - Knowledge of Fire Domain is added advantage. 
 - Lead with strategies for Verification & Validation, analyze project requirements to define system/subsystem level test plans and ensure compliance with global industry standards and regulations. 
 - Experience in testing different communication protocols such as I2C, SPI, RS232, RS485, TCP/IP, BACnet, Modbus, UART, CAN etc. 
 - Lead and implement scalable automated test environment in hardware and software in loop environment. Good knowledge of Hardware Simulators. 
 - Having knowledge on Test Frameworks at embedded systems. Integration test knowledge with debugging tools like JTAG and emulators
 - Good at manual and automated test execution in embedded and software systems. Good understanding of SDLC, defect life cycle
 - Experience in understanding requirements traceability matrix & and validate system interface at design and consumer level
 - Experience in automation testing and hands-on in developing automation framework
 - Good Working knowledge of Test Management Tools Ex. HPALM/IBM/Jira
 - Create Manual test cases/automation test scripts, Document and Execute the test cases that conform to the technical and functional specifications for firmware and Software applications
 - Document and present test results as per the QA policies and procedures
 - Contributes ideas on product and process improvements. Participates in design review sessions
 - Implement appropriate automation technologies to meet the short- and long-term goals of the company including test frameworks
 - Adhere to the Automation Framework for Fire domain products and enhancements

Education Preferred

BE/ME or B. Tech. /M. Tech. in Electronics/Communication/Electrical Engineering / Computer Science

Experience Preferred

Minimum 12 to 15 years of embedded products quality assurance experience required as below: 

- Essential Competencies: 
 - Involved in all phases of product development life cycle, including requirements gathering, backlog grooming, risk analysis, planning, scheduling, test strategy, test environment, test execution, defect management, test reporting, deployment support and production issue analysis support. 
 - Experience in Embedded Software Quality Assurance (SQA).

World Leaders in Fire and Life Safety

Job Description: 

SFCC Senior Quality Assurance Engineer

Role

The SFCC Senior QA Engineer will be responsible for ensuring the quality, stability, and performance of Salesforce Commerce Cloud (SFCC) applications across the entire customer journey. The individual will lead end-to-end testing activities, validate integrations, support business-critical releases, and act as the QA lead for SFCC initiatives. 

Responsibilities

- Own end-to-end QA activities for Salesforce Commerce Cloud (SFCC) projects and releases. 
 - Validate SFCC storefront, checkout, payment, order management, fulfillment, and post-purchase journeys. 
 - Perform testing of SFCC Business Manager configurations including catalogs, promotions, campaigns, price books, inventory, and customer groups. 
 - Create and execute Test Plans, Test Cases, Test Scenarios, and Test Strategy documents. 
 - Perform Functional, Regression, Integration, System, UAT, Smoke, and Sanity Testing. 
 - Validate integrations between SFCC and OMS, Payment Gateways, Tax Engines, Shipping Providers, and third-party systems. 
 - Conduct Cross-browser, Cross-device, Responsive, Accessibility (WCAG), Localization, and Internationalization testing. 
 - Participate in Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, backlog grooming, story reviews, and retrospectives. 
 - Manage defects through logging, triaging, tracking, root cause analysis, and closure. 
 - Lead QA sign-off discussions and release readiness assessments. 
 - Support UAT, Production Validation, Hypercare, and Post-Release Monitoring activities. 
 - Coordinate testing efforts across business, product, development, and external stakeholder teams. 
 - Review test execution reports, release documentation, and quality metrics. 
 - Mentor junior QA engineers and promote QA best practices. 
 - Drive continuous improvement initiatives, automation opportunities, and regression suite optimization. 

Must Have

- 7+ years of Quality Assurance experience with at least 3-5 years of Salesforce Commerce Cloud (SFCC) testing experience. 
 - Strong hands-on experience in Salesforce Commerce Cloud (SFRA). 
 - Deep understanding of SFCC Business Manager (BM) administration and configurations. 
 - Experience testing complex B2C eCommerce applications. 
 - Strong understanding of: 
 - Catalog Management
 - Price Books
 - Promotions & Campaigns
 - Inventory Management
 - Customer Groups
 - Order Lifecycle Management
 - Experience validating storefront, checkout, and post-purchase customer experiences. 
 - Strong knowledge of B2C Commerce architecture and system integrations. 
 - Experience testing integrations with OMS, Payment, Tax, and Shipping systems. 
 - Hands-on experience in Functional, Regression, Integration, System, UAT, and Smoke Testing. 
 - Cross-browser and Cross-device Testing expertise. 
 - Responsive Web Testing experience across Desktop, Mobile, and Tablet devices. 
 - Accessibility (WCAG) Testing experience. 
 - Localization and Internationalization Testing experience. 
 - Experience with Test Planning, Risk Assessment, Defect Management, and Quality Reporting. 
 - Agile/Scrum project experience. 
 - Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and stakeholder management skills. 
 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills. 
 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field. 

Good to Have

- Experience with Headless Commerce and Composable Commerce architecture. 
 - Experience testing Mobile Applications (iOS and Android). 
 - API Testing experience using Postman or similar tools. 
 - Exposure to Selenium, Katalon, Playwright, or other automation frameworks. 
 - Experience with Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics, and web tracking validation. 
 - Experience testing multi-site, multi-language, and multi-currency implementations. 
 - Knowledge of Loyalty, Marketplace, and Subscription Commerce models. 
 - Exposure to Cloud Platforms and Release Management processes. 
 - Experience establishing reusable regression suites and automation strategies. 
 - Prior experience leading enterprise-scale eCommerce releases and mentoring QA teams.

The centre focuses on improving efficiency and timely execution, fostering innovation, adopting futuristic technologies, building functional expertise and embracing digital technologies. Oversee multiple Precast Projects execution to set benchmarks, audit projects for standardized compliance across L&T Construction, track and showcase Precast Technology benefits in various infrastructure as well as buildings Precast Construction projects across India for all L&T Construction ICs. - Liaise with the Project Team/Site/Cluster/IC QC Teams on the quality related activities of the project to achieve established benchmarks.

 - Enforce established QA/QC Evaluation Criteria for Precast Yards and Site Installation
 - Conduct periodic Audits to ensure compliance
 - Conduct QA/QC training programs for Precast Construction
 - Build Knowledge Bank for QA/QC related issues/case studies/challenges and disseminate the same across L&T Construction

Support in Standardization and Modularization efforts of PWCC by collecting and analysing data of IC wide demands and challenges to deliver superior quality and safe product
