data.title: Member of Technical Staff – NextGen RTOS V&V Testing
data.description:
About Wind River

Wind River is a global leader in delivering software for mission-critical intelligent systems. For more than four decades, the company has been an innovator and pioneer, powering billions of systems that require the highest levels of security, safety, and reliability. 

Wind River helps customers across automotive, aerospace, defense, industrial, medical, and telecommunications industries solve complex technology challenges on their journey toward the new intelligent machine economy. The company's software powers generation after generation of the safest, most secure systems in the world. Examples include playing a key role in NASA space missions such as Artemis I, the James Webb Space Telescope, and multiple Mars rovers. We've achieved recent 5G milestones including the world's first successful 5G data session with Verizon and building one of the largest Open RAN networks in the world with Vodafone. 

The company has received industry recognition for its technology innovation and leadership, and for its workplace culture, including global Great Place to Work certification and being named a "Top Workplace" for ten consecutive years. If you want to be part of a unique culture where the lived experience is based on our cultural attributes of growth mindset, customer-focus, and diversity, equity, inclusion & belonging, come join us and help advance the future software defined world. 

YOUR ROLE

We are seeking a skilled Validation and Testing Developer to join our team in developing the next generation Real-Time Operating System (RTOS). 

As a Member of Technical Staff for verification and validation testing, you will contribute to researching, evaluating, and selecting validation tooling, as well as designing and implementing the test framework used for both certified and non-certified software components. You will also be contributing to designing and implementing system testing and V&V test development. 

In your daily job you will: 

- Work with technical leads to evaluate next-generation validation and verification tools and recommend tools best suited for certification objectives (all Design Assurance Levels) for DO-178C and other standards
 - Assess tool qualification requirements per Software Tool Qualification Considerations
 - Participate in architecting and developing a scalable, maintainable test framework for the RTOS to support both certified (DO-178C) and non-certified testing workflows, such as requirements-based testing, structural coverage analysis, and traceability
 - Implement automation capabilities for continuous integration and regression testing
 - Develop system-level tests to validate RTOS functionality, performance, and timing behavior
 - Create and execute verification and validation (V&V) test cases traceable to system and software requirements
 - Collaborate with systems and software engineers to ensure complete requirements coverage
 - Take initiative to improve the RTOS product and processes
 - Collaborate and engage effectively with global software engineering teams. 
 - Work in an Agile Scrum Teams and follow Agile processes

How You Will Contribute

Key skills and competencies for succeeding in this role are: 

- BTech / MTech degree (Computer Science, Computer/Electrical Engineering, or equivalent technical degree). 
 - 8+ years of experience in software testing, verification, or validation
 - Strong understanding of RTOS concepts (scheduling, concurrency, determinism, resource management)
 - Experience with DO-178C (or DO-178B) software lifecycle and verification objectives is a plus
 - Familiarity with DO-330 tool qualification processes is a plus
 - Proficiency in test automation and framework development (e. g. , Python, C, C++)
 - Experience with requirements-based testing and traceability
 - Experience with static analysis, model-based testing, or formal methods
 - Knowledge of structural coverage tools and techniques (MC/DC, branch, statement)
 - Experience with commercial or open-source RTOS platforms (e. g. , VxWorks, RTEMS, Zephyr, FreeRTOS) is a plus
 - Familiarity with verification tools such as VectorCAST, LDRA, Parasoft, Rapita, or equivalent is a plus
 - Experience with CI/CD pipelines
 - Experience with firmware bringup and boot up is a plus

WHY JOIN US?

In a world increasingly driven by software innovation, Wind River is pioneering the technologies that accelerate the digital transformation of our customers with a new generation of mission‐critical AI systems-built for an AI‐first world with the most exacting safety, security, performance, and reliability standards. Our success depends on our ability to innovate with velocity and deliver solutions that help customers solve their toughest challenges. 

Wind River is a global leader in mission‐critical intelligent systems. For more than four decades, we have been an innovator and pioneer, powering billions of systems that demand the highest levels of security, safety, and reliability. We support customers across automotive, aerospace, defense, industrial, medical, and telecommunications industries as they build the next generation of intelligent machines. 

Wind River's technology has supported historic achievements-from NASA's Artemis I and the James Webb Space Telescope to multiple Mars rovers, as well as the world's first successful 5G data session with Verizon and one of the largest Open RAN networks with Vodafone. 

With industry recognition for innovation, leadership, and workplace excellence-including global Great Place to Work certification and being named a "Top Workplace" for ten straight years-Wind River offers a culture built on growth mindset, customer focus, and diversity, equity, inclusion & belonging. 

Your Benefits At Wind River

- Named Top Workplace for the 10th year in a row
 - Wind River's strong commitment to DEIB
 - Birthday and Volunteer Time Off
 - Competitive Salary & Benefits Package
 - Extensive Learning Programs
 - Wellness benefits through Unmind

APPLY TODAY, AND TOGETHER LET'S CHANGE TOMORROW!

Wind River is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to diversity. We prohibit discrimination based on race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected status. 

Privacy Notice - Active Candidates: https: //www. aptiv. com/privacy-notice-active-candidates

Aptiv is an equal employment opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability status, protected veteran status or any other characteristic protected by law.

data.title: Senior Software Development Engineer
data.description:
Who We Are

Inovalon was founded in 1998 on the belief that technology, and data specifically, would empower the transformation of the entire healthcare ecosystem for the better, improving both outcomes and economics. At Inovalon, we believe that when our customers are successful in their missions, healthcare improves. Therefore, we focus on empowering them with data-driven solutions. And the momentum is building. 

Together, as ONE Inovalon, we are a united force delivering solutions that address healthcare's greatest needs. Through our mission-based culture of inclusion and innovation, our organization brings value not just to our customers, but to the millions of patients and members they serve. 

Who You Are

As a Senior Software Development Engineer, you help ensure the quality, reliability, and performance of broadly used software capabilities by designing, executing, and improving effective testing practices. You work closely with developers and cross-functional partners to validate requirements, identify issues early, and support high-quality releases in an Agile environment. Your work helps strengthen product performance and user experience for internal teams, clients, and the people they serve. 

What You'll Do

- Execute test scripts for complex, widely used product capabilities and components across integration, functional, API, data, regression, system, and end-to-end testing. 
 - Create, maintain, and extend comprehensive test plans and test cases for user stories, defects, and technical enhancements to ensure requirements and specifications are fully validated. 
 - Design structured, reusable, automation-ready test cases that can be used by Quality Engineers and automated test frameworks. 
 - Use AI-assisted tools to accelerate test case creation, expand test coverage, identify edge cases, and improve test effectiveness while applying human judgment to validate and refine outputs. 
 - Analyze functional requirements and specifications to identify gaps, clarify expected behavior, and define test strategies that verify complete coverage. 
 - Partner with developers to troubleshoot defects, isolate complex issues involving dependent software components, and communicate findings clearly to stakeholders. 
 - Set up, perform, and interpret performance and load tests to evaluate product behavior under expected and stressed conditions. 
 - Analyze, document, and report test results, quality metrics, and testing status from an overall product perspective. 
 - Develop and maintain test scripts, test cases, and software test and performance measurement tools using appropriate programming languages and software applications. 
 - Continuously improve test plans, scripts, and cases based on quality data, production incidents, lessons learned, and team priorities. 

What You'll Need

- 5+ years of demonstrated QA and testing experience or equivalent experience required. 
 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or Information Technology or equivalent combination of education and experience required. 
 - Experience developing test cases and test scripts. 
 - Good knowledge of basic test techniques, including positive and negative testing, interface testing, and database testing. 
 - Demonstrated hands-on experience across all phases of software testing, including integration, functional, API, data, regression, system, and end-to-end testing. 
 - Experience with test tools and source control tools such as Microsoft Azure DevOps and/or GitHub. 
 - Thorough understanding of the software development life cycle, quality before design, Agile software development, and current QA best practices, methodologies, standards, and testing approaches. 
 - Experience validating the effectiveness of application user experience. 
 - Ability to communicate effectively across a variety of staff levels and lead work effectively within a team environment. 
 - Growth Potential & Learning Agility: You actively build your knowledge of product behavior, testing methods, tools, and emerging technologies, and apply new learning to improve test quality and team outcomes. 
 - Leadership: You influence through collaboration, communicate clearly with developers and peers, support shared quality goals, and help move issues to resolution when perspectives differ. 
 - Adaptability: You adjust quickly to changing priorities, evolving requirements, and shifting release needs while staying focused on quality and delivery outcomes. 
 - Creative Thinking: You develop practical, effective ways to improve test coverage, uncover edge cases, and strengthen quality processes across complex product areas. 
 - Analytical Skills: You interpret test results, identify patterns and root causes, break down complex issues, and use evidence to guide decisions and recommendations. 
 - Nice to have: Experience with test automation frameworks such as Playwright and an understanding of databases. 

Our Shared Commitments

- Maintain compliance with Inovalon's policies, procedures and mission statement; 
 - Adhere to all confidentiality and HIPAA requirements as outlined within Inovalon's Operating Policies and Procedures in all ways and at all times with respect to any aspect of the data handled or services rendered in the undertaking of the position; and
 - Fulfill those responsibilities and/or duties that may be reasonably provided by Inovalon for the purpose of achieving operational and financial success of Employer. 

Work Environment

This is primarily a computer-based role performed in a remote, hybrid, or office environment. The role requires prolonged periods of computer use and frequent communication and interaction with others, either virtually and/or in person. The role may occasionally require transporting or moving work-related equipment weighing up to 10 pounds, such as a laptop and related materials. Some travel may be required, depending on the needs of the role. Reasonable accommodations may be provided to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the position, consistent with applicable law. 

This position is not eligible for immigration sponsorship (e. g. H-1B, TN, or E-3). Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States as a condition of employment. (This is only applicable for US-based positions)

If you don't meet every qualification listed but are excited about our mission and the work described, we encourage you to apply. Inovalon is most interested in finding the best candidate for the job, and you may be just the right person for this or other roles. 

By embracing inclusion, we enhance our work environment and drive business success. Inovalon strives to provide equal opportunities to the communities where we operate and to our clients and everyone whom we serve. We endeavor to create a culture of inclusion in which our associates feel empowered to bring their full, authentic selves to work and pursue their professional goals in an equitable setting. We understand that by fostering this type of culture, and welcoming different perspectives, we generate innovation and growth. 

Inovalon is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirement. 

To review the legal requirements, including all labor law posters, please visit this link

To review the California Consumer Privacy Statement: Disclosures for California Residents, please visit this link

Work Location: If the US position is listed as remote, employees who reside within a 40-mile radius of one of our office locations in Tampa, FL; Canonsburg, PA; or Bowie, MD will follow a hybrid work schedule and are expected to work in the office two days per week (Tuesdays and Wednesdays).

Role Title : AVP, Mobile Engineer III - AI native (L10)

Company Overview: Synchrony (NYSE: SYF) is a leading consumer financing company that has been at the heart of American commerce and opportunity for nearly a century. Synchrony delivers credit and banking products that empower tens of millions of consumers to improve their financial lives and access what matters most. Leveraging innovative solutions that are shaping the future of retail commerce, Synchrony supports the growth and success of some of the nation's most respected brands, alongside hundreds of thousands of small and midsize businesses, including health and wellness providers. Committed to excellence in service and culture, Synchrony is proud to be named as #3 as a Great Place to Work® in India and is honored to be ranked the #1 Best Company to Work For® in the U. S. by Fortune magazine and Great Place to Work®. For more information, visit www. synchrony. com. 

Organizational Overview

We are looking for a Senior AI-Native Mobile Engineer with deep expertise in native iOS engineering and strong fluency in Generative AI, Agentic AI, and AI-assisted software engineering practices. 

This is not a traditional mobile development role. 

This role combines the expectations of a senior hands-on iOS technical leader with the mindset of an AI-native engineer who helps define how modern mobile applications are designed, built, tested, and delivered using A

You will lead the design and development of high-quality, secure, scalable mobile experiences, while also driving adoption of AI-powered engineering workflows, reusable patterns, and platform capabilities that improve developer productivity and technical outcomes across the mobile organization. 

You Will Work At The Intersection Of

Native iOS Engineering + Generative AI + Agentic AI + Developer Productivity + Mobile Platform Leadership

Role Summary / Purpose

The Senior AI-Native Mobile Engineer is a senior individual contributor responsible for leading the design, development, and evolution of high-quality iOS applications and shared mobile capabilities. This role provides hands-on technical leadership across application architecture, feature delivery, AI-powered mobile experiences, performance, reliability, security, accessibility, observability, and developer experience. 

The role partners closely with Engineering Managers, Tech Leads, Android engineers, QE leads, backend engineers, architects, and platform teams to deliver scalable, secure, and consistent customer experiences. In addition to strong native mobile engineering depth, this role is expected to actively leverage and champion AI-assisted and AI-native engineering practices across the software development lifecycle. 

Key Responsibilities

Native Mobile Engineering

- Lead the technical design, development, and delivery of complex native iOS features and platform capabilities. 
 - Design and build high-quality mobile applications using Swift, SwiftUI, UIKit, Xcode, and Apple's iOS SDKs. 
 - Define and apply scalable architecture patterns that ensure maintainability, testability, performance, and alignment with enterprise standards. 
 - Build secure, performant, reliable mobile applications with strong attention to accessibility and user experience. 
 - Integrate backend services using REST, GraphQL, WebSocket, and related service patterns. 
 - Collaborate with backend and platform engineering teams on API contracts, authentication, resiliency, error handling, and service integration requirements. 
 - Diagnose and resolve complex production issues involving crashes, performance bottlenecks, networking, concurrency, memory management, and application stability. 
 - Drive best practices for code quality, automated testing, observability, release readiness, and operational excellence. 
 - Contribute to reusable iOS components, frameworks, SDKs, shared libraries, and mobile platform foundations. 
 - Partner with Android engineers to promote consistent mobile patterns, shared standards, and cohesive cross-platform experiences. 

Generative AI & Agentic AI

- Integrate LLM capabilities into mobile applications to enable AI-powered conversational, search, recommendation, and workflow-driven experiences. 
 - Build production-quality mobile experiences powered by Generative AI and AI agents. 
 - Integrate AI models and services such as OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Gemini, Claude, or enterprise AI platforms. 
 - Implement streaming responses, tool/function calling, structured outputs, and multimodal experiences within mobile applications. 
 - Build and integrate AI agents and agentic workflows that improve customer experience or engineering execution. 
 - Work with technologies such as MCP, RAG, LangGraph, LangChain, or equivalent orchestration frameworks where appropriate. 
 - Design secure AI architectures covering data handling, context management, authentication, authorization, privacy, and governance. 
 - Help define practical standards for safe, scalable adoption of AI in mobile applications within a regulated environment. 

AI-Native Software Engineering

- Actively leverage AI tools such as GitHub Copilot and other LLM-based engineering tools for code generation, refactoring, testing, documentation, troubleshooting, and technical discovery. 
 - Build AI-powered workflows across the software development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, architecture, implementation, testing, and code review. 
 - Explore and develop engineering agents that can interpret Jira stories, analyze codebases, generate implementation plans, and support development workflows. 
 - Automate repetitive engineering activities using AI agents, developer tools, and intelligent workflows. 
 - Champion practical AI-assisted engineering practices while maintaining strong engineering judgment, quality, security, and compliance standards. 
 - Continuously evaluate emerging AI models, coding assistants, agents, frameworks, and developer productivity tools. 

Mobile Platform, Engineering Excellence & Leadership

- Help establish reusable AI capabilities and engineering patterns across mobile teams. 
 - Develop common patterns, APIs, SDKs, frameworks, and standards for AI-powered mobile experiences. 
 - Improve mobile build and release reliability through contributions to CI/CD pipelines, build automation, code-quality gates, security scanning, and deployment workflows. 
 - Drive mobile observability through crash analytics, performance monitoring, logging, release-health metrics, and rollout analysis. 
 - Participate in architecture reviews, technical spikes, proof-of-concepts, and design discussions for foundational mobile capabilities. 
 - Mentor and coach engineers on Swift, SwiftUI, UIKit, architecture, testing, debugging, and technical decision-making. 
 - Produce clear technical documentation, including design proposals, implementation guidance, architecture decision records, and operational runbooks. 
 - Participate in Agile ceremonies, PI planning, ART syncs, and cross-team coordination, identifying and escalating technical risks early. 
 - Contribute to communities of practice, engineering standards, internal knowledge sharing, and developer experience improvements. 

Required Skills/Knowledge

- Bachelor's Degree and 5+ years of relevant experience in Information Technology, or in lieu of a degree, 7+ years of relevant experience in Information Technology. 
 - Strong hands-on experience in native iOS development, with deep production expertise in Swift, SwiftUI, UIKit, Xcode, and Apple's iOS SDKs. Working knowledge of Android development concepts, Kotlin, and Jetpack Compose is good to have. 
 - Demonstrated experience designing, building, and supporting production-scale iOS applications. 
 - Strong understanding of iOS architecture patterns, including MVVM, Clean Architecture, modularization, dependency injection, and coordinator-based navigation, where applicable. Familiarity with Android architecture principles is a plus. 
 - Strong understanding of performance, security, testing, accessibility, observability, and release engineering for mobile applications. 
 - Experience integrating mobile applications with RESTful APIs, microservices, authentication services, API gateway patterns, and modern backend services. 
 - Strong knowledge of Swift concurrency, async/await, actors, GCD, reactive programming, and asynchronous networking. 
 - Experience building reusable iOS components, frameworks, SDKs, or shared libraries. 
 - Hands-on experience integrating Generative AI / LLM capabilities into software applications. 
 - Experience with LLM APIs, prompt engineering, tool/function calling, structured outputs, or AI agents. 
 - Demonstrated AI fluency, including productive use of GitHub Copilot or equivalent AI-assisted development tools. 
 - Experience with CI/CD, build automation, code signing, provisioning, test automation, and release workflows. 
 - Strong testing experience including unit, integration, UI, and automation testing using tools such as XCTest and XCUITest. 
 - Familiarity with secure coding practices, static analysis, dependency scanning, and mobile security standards. 
 - Working knowledge of Android architecture and development concepts to enable effective cross-platform collaboration. 
 - Strong analytical, system design, debugging, problem-solving, and technical communication skills. 
 - Ability to influence technical decisions and collaborate effectively across teams without direct authority. 
 - Experience working in Agile delivery environments at scale, including SAFe or similar frameworks. 
 - Within the first year, you will help us: 
 - Deliver production-quality AI-powered mobile experiences on iOS. 
 - Establish reusable patterns for AI-native mobile development. 
 - Lead the implementation of scalable, secure, and maintainable iOS architecture and platform capabilities. 
 - Improve engineering quality and speed through AI-assisted and agentic development workflows. 
 - Automate meaningful portions of the mobile software development lifecycle. 
 - Strengthen standards for mobile architecture, testing, security, observability, and release engineering. 
 - Improve developer productivity through reusable tooling, frameworks, and AI-enabled engineering practices. 
 - Help move mobile engineering from AI-assisted development to AI-native engineering. 
Desired Skills/Knowledge

- Experience with both iOS & Android. 
 - Experience with SwiftUI migration strategies from UIKit-based applications. 
 - Experience with Jetpack Compose and broader Android mobile patterns. 
 - Experience with OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Gemini, Claude, or equivalent enterprise AI platforms. 
 - Experience with MCP, RAG, LangGraph, LangChain, or similar agent orchestration technologies. 
 - Experience building AI agents, internal developer platforms, or engineering productivity solutions. 
 - Experience with mobile CI/CD and build automation tools such as Bitrise, Xcode Cloud, Fastlane, GitHub Actions, or similar. 
 - Experience with modular architecture, Swift Package Manager, CocoaPods, dependency management, and versioning strategies. 
 - Experience with on-device AI, Core ML, Apple Intelligence, ML Kit, MediaPipe, or local/edge model execution. 
 - Experience with service virtualization, API mocking, contract testing, and test-environment management. 
 - Experience with observability platforms such as New Relic, Splunk, Datadog, Firebase Crashlytics, CloudWatch, or similar. 
 - Experience implementing accessibility aligned with WCAG and Apple accessibility standards. 
 - Experience in financial services or other regulated, security-sensitive environments. 
 - Experience working with distributed, cross-shore engineering teams across time zones. 
 - Experience contributing to communities of practice, standards documentation, and technical forums. 

Key Technologies

Mobile: Swift, SwiftUI, UIKit, Xcode, iOS SDK, Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Android SDK

AI: LLMs, Generative AI, AI Agents, RAG, Tool Calling, MCP, Agentic Workflows

AI Platforms: OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Gemini, Claude, enterprise AI platforms

Engineering: Git, CI/CD, automated testing, observability, APIs, cloud platforms

AI Development: GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, and emerging AI coding/agent platforms

Work Timings 2: 00PM to 11: 00 PM IST

This role qualifies for Enhanced Flexibility offered in Synchrony India and will require the incumbent to be available between 06: 00 AM Eastern Time - 11: 30 AM Eastern Time (timings are anchored to US Eastern hours and will adjust twice a year locally). This window is for meetings with India and US teams. The remaining hours will be flexible for the employee to choose. Exceptions may apply periodically due to business needs).

Description

About Us

Trintech is a leading global provider of cloud-based reconciliation and financial close solutions for Finance & Accounting teams. Our Cadency platform and Adra suite help organizations automate reconciliations, close management, journal entries, governance, risk, and compliance processes for more than 4, 200 clients worldwide. 

Job Summary

We are looking for a Software Test Engineer II with 3-5 years of relevant experience who can contribute to both manual and automation testing for enterprise software products. 

This role is suited for a detail-oriented quality engineer with strong manual testing fundamentals, an automation mindset, and hands-on exposure to modern automation tools such as Playwright and Python. The candidate should be able to analyze requirements, design effective test coverage, execute manual and automated tests, troubleshoot issues, and collaborate with QA, engineering, product, and global teams to deliver high-quality software. 

Exposure to Git for version-controlling automated tests, Azure Pipelines or similar CI/CD tools for running automated tests, and familiarity with AI-assisted testing or development tools will be valuable for this role. 

What You Will Do

- Plan, design, and execute test cases for functional, integration, regression, exploratory, and end-to-end scenarios. 
 - Create, maintain, and improve automated test scripts using modern automation tools such as Playwright and Python. 
 - Identify the right balance between manual validation and automation coverage based on risk, repeatability, and product impact. 
 - Analyze requirements, participate in backlog refinement, provide test estimates, and define test coverage for user stories. 
 - Use Git or similar version control tools to manage and maintain automated test assets. 
 - Log, track, troubleshoot, and validate defects using existing defect management tools. 
 - Support automated test execution through CI/CD pipelines where applicable. 
 - Contribute to regression readiness, release validation, test data setup, traceability, and test metrics. 
 - Collaborate with developers, QA engineers, product teams, and global stakeholders to improve product quality. 
 - Continuously improve testing practices by identifying opportunities for better automation, stronger coverage, faster feedback, and more reliable validation. 

Automation Mindset

- Identify repeatable, high-value scenarios that should be automated. 
 - Use automation to improve regression coverage, reduce manual effort, and provide faster release feedback. 
 - Write maintainable automation scripts with focus on reliability, readability, reuse, and ease of debugging. 
 - Be open to learning new tools, frameworks, and product areas as automation needs evolve. 

Qualifications And Skills

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - 3-5 years of relevant experience in software testing, with a strong mix of manual testing and test automation experience. 
 - Strong understanding of SDLC, STLC, Agile/Scrum, defect lifecycle, and release validation practices. 
 - Hands-on experience in manual testing, including test planning, test case design, test execution, defect management, and test metrics. 
 - Hands-on or working experience with Playwright and Python for test automation. 
 - Experience using Git or similar version control systems for maintaining automated test scripts. 
 - Exposure to Azure Pipelines or similar CI/CD tools for running automated tests. 
 - Familiarity with AI-assisted testing or development tools such as LLMs, ChatGPT, Claude, Codex, GitHub Copilot, or similar tools. 
 - Ability to analyze requirements, identify test gaps, raise risks early, and define effective test coverage. 
 - Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills across product, application, data, and integration issues. 
 - Ability to work with minimal supervision in a fast-paced, collaborative, and global environment. 
 - Strong written and verbal communication skills. 

Good to Have / Added Advantage

- Awareness of AI testing concepts such as LLM-as-a-Judge, golden datasets, prompt/output validation, or model response evaluation. 
 - Exposure to observability or tracing tools such as Langfuse for AI workflow validation. 
 - Previous experience with AI-enabled applications, reconciliation, financial close, month-end close, accounting, or enterprise SaaS applications. 

Cultural Fit

- Detail-oriented, quality-focused, and accountable for outcomes. 
 - Strong manual testing discipline with an automation-first mindset. 
 - Collaborative, open to feedback, and comfortable working with global teams. 
 - Continuous improvement mindset with curiosity to learn new tools, frameworks, and testing approaches. 

Embraces change, growth, innovation, and evolving quality engineering practices. 

At our core, Trintechers stand committed to fostering a culture rooted in our core values - Humble, Empowered, Reliable, and Open. Together, these values guide our actions, define our identity, and inspire us to continuously strive for excellence in everything we do. 

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin or disability.

Senior Automation Engineer

Multi-asset platform for capital markets

We are looking for a hands-on Senior Automation engineer to continuously modernize, strengthen and accelerate our test automation frameworks. This is a senior individual-contributor role for an engineer who writes excellent production-quality Python code, can diagnose complex technical problems, and turns that expertise into reliable, maintainable and fast automation infrastructure. Our automation stack includes a Python-based backend for Clear Flow in house framework and Playwright with TypeScript for frontend end-to-end testing. The successful candidate will lead framework design and evolution, improve test reliability and execution speed, strengthen CI integration, and mentor other engineers. Experience testing financial technology or trading systems is highly desirable. 

What you'll be doing

- Lead continuous framework modernization: Own the technical direction and ongoing improvement of our automation frameworks, libraries, utilities and test architecture. 
 - Write high-quality Python: Develop and review robust, readable, efficient Python code for backend automation, framework services, test utilities and integrations. 
 - Improve performance and scalability: Profile and reduce test execution time; identify bottlenecks in setup, data handling, environment interaction and parallel execution; improve resource use without sacrificing reliability. 
 - Increase test reliability: Reduce flaky tests, improve diagnostics and failure reporting, strengthen logging and debugging support, and make failures easier to reproduce and resolve. 
 - Develop end-to-end automation: Maintain and improve Playwright/TypeScript UI automation and ensure effective integration with Python-based backend testing. 
 - Improve CI/CD integration: Make automated suites easier to run and troubleshoot in CI pipelines; improve test selection, reporting, repeatability and feedback time. 
 - Design for maintainability: Apply sound object-oriented design, modular architecture, reusable abstractions, clear interfaces and appropriate design patterns-avoiding unnecessary complexity. 
 - Work across teams: Partner with software engineers, quality engineers and infrastructure teams to investigate failures, improve testability and prevent defects earlier. 
 - Provide technical leadership: Mentor engineers through code reviews, design discussions, partnership and practical guidance; establish coding standards and framework-development practices. 
 - Measure impact: Use meaningful metrics such as execution duration, flakiness, failure diagnosis time, framework adoption and regression coverage to prioritize improvements. 
 - Support quality strategy: help with product testing when needed as well help determine where automation provides the greatest value, while retaining sound test design and appropriate exploration or manual testing where needed. 

Essential Skills

- Strong, hands-on Python programming skills. You should be comfortable designing, implementing, debugging, profiling and refactoring non-trivial code-not just writing test scripts. 
 - Typically, 8+ years of relevant software engineering, test automation or framework-development experience, including substantial ownership of automation frameworks. 
 - Demonstrated experience designing and evolving reusable automation frameworks, test libraries or developer tooling used by multiple engineers or teams. 
 - Strong software engineering fundamentals: data structures, algorithms, object-oriented design, modularity, error handling, testing, debugging and clean-code practices. 
 - Experience building and maintaining integration-level, API or backend automated tests. 
 - Practical experience with Playwright and TypeScript for front end-end end-to-end automation, or the ability to demonstrate equivalent depth and quickly contribute to this stack. 
 - Experience with Git, code reviews, CI/CD pipelines and collaborative Agile software development. 
 - Ability to investigate complex failures across application code, test code, test data, environments and infrastructure. 
 - Strong communication and mentoring skills, with the ability to explain design trade-offs and raise engineering quality across a team. 

Desired Skills

- Experience testing financial technology, electronic trading, capital markets, market data, order management or other complex, high-throughput systems. 
 - Experience with development and maintenance of Python-based automation frameworks. 
 - Experience improving large regression suites through parallelization, smarter test selection, test-data management, code coverage, performance profiling and flakiness reduction. 
 - Experience with distributed systems, asynchronous programming, service integrations, messaging or event-driven architectures. 
 - Experience with Linux-based test environments, containers and troubleshooting environment-dependent failures. 
 - Experience using AI-assisted engineering tools effectively, with appropriate review and validation of generated code.

 - Strong frontend expertise in React and/or Angular, JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML, and CSS

UST is looking for Firmware Architect with strong experience in Storage Domain.

We are seeking a Firmware Architect with expertise in storage system architecture and low-level embedded software design. In this role, you will define the next-generation architectural roadmap, security framework, and protocol stacks for high-performance SSD and storage enterprise platforms. You will collaborate closely with hardware, verification, validation, and system integration teams to bring cutting-edge storage solutions from concept to deployment.

- Architecture & Strategy: Define overall embedded firmware architecture, memory mapping, boot sequence, and control flow for high-performance storage solutions.

 - Out-of-Band & In-Band Management: Architect sideband management infrastructure over I2C, UART, VDM, and MCTP bindings for platform telemetry, error reporting, and out-of-band diagnostics. 
 - Performance & HW/FW Co-Design: Collaborate with ASIC and system engineering teams to optimize ARM-based hardware/software interfaces, hardware acceleration engines, and flash memory controllers (SPI NOR, RAID management). 
 - Debugging & Analysis: Lead complex system-level debug efforts, triage hard-to-reproduce platform bugs, and establish diagnostic standards using JTAG and protocol analyzers. 
 - Leadership & Standards: Drive firmware design reviews, code quality standards, unit testing frameworks, and mentor senior engineering staff across cross-functional teams.

data.title: Engineering Manager - Firmware
data.description:
What You'll Do

As Firmware Engineering Manager, you will lead a global team responsible for embedded firmware and platform software for Critical Power Solutions technology and product-development programs, including uninterruptible power supplies, energy storage, power distribution, and energy metering. You will own people leadership, technical direction, execution, quality, and lifecycle delivery across real-time operating system (RTOS) and embedded Linux platforms. You will partner with product management, systems, hardware, validation, cybersecurity, manufacturing, and global engineering teams to translate business needs into scalable architectures and predictable releases. The role balances hands-on technical leadership with coaching, talent development, resource planning, risk management, and continuous improvement. 

"

- Lead, coach, and develop a team of firmware engineers and technical leads; set clear objectives, provide regular feedback, conduct performance and development discussions, and build succession plans. 
 - Own delivery of embedded firmware for technology development and new product programs across RTOS and embedded Linux platforms while meeting scope, schedule, cost, quality, cybersecurity, and product-performance commitments. 
 - Establish firmware strategy, platform roadmaps, software architecture, requirements, and reuse plans for products including uninterruptible power supplies, energy storage, power distribution, and energy metering. 
 - Translate business and system requirements into executable plans; prioritize the portfolio, allocate resources, manage dependencies, and make transparent trade-off decisions. 
 - Provide technical oversight for board support packages, device drivers, bootloaders, middleware, inter-process communication, networking, diagnostics, and application-layer software. 
 - Guide RTOS design for deterministic behavior, scheduling, synchronization, interrupt handling, memory constraints, safety, and reliability; guide embedded Linux development using Yocto-based distributions, kernel and driver integration, and system services. 
 - Drive disciplined engineering practices including design reviews, code reviews, static analysis, unit and integration testing, continuous integration, configuration management, release governance, and defect prevention. 
 - Monitor program execution using meaningful metrics, identify technical and delivery risks early, remove obstacles, and communicate status and recovery plans to stakeholders. 
 - Partner with systems, hardware, power electronics, validation, cybersecurity, manufacturing, quality, and product teams to deliver robust end-to-end solutions. 
 - Ensure compliance with applicable product-development processes, functional-safety expectations, cybersecurity requirements, open-source obligations, and company release procedures. 
 - Lead root-cause analysis and resolution of complex field, lab, and production issues; ensure corrective actions are systemic and lessons learned are reused. 
 - Build capability through hiring, onboarding, mentoring, technical communities of practice, knowledge sharing, and targeted learning plans. 
 - Foster an inclusive, accountable, and innovative team culture that encourages constructive challenge, collaboration, ownership, and continuous learning. 
 - Manage suppliers and engineering partners where applicable, including technical scope, deliverables, reviews, quality, and integration. 
 - Champion process improvement, automation, platform reuse, and engineering productivity across global firmware teams. "

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Electrical, Electronics, Computer, Software Engineering, Computer Science, or a related discipline; master's degree preferred
 - 9+ years of embedded software or firmware development experience, including substantial experience with embedded Linux and/or RTOS-based products. 
 - 3+ years of experience leading engineers through direct people management, technical leadership, or program leadership in a global environment. 

Skills

- Strong C and C++ skills, object-oriented design, software architecture, algorithms, data structures, concurrency, and multi-threading. 
 - Practical RTOS expertise, including task scheduling, synchronization, interrupt handling, memory management, timing analysis, debugging, and real-time performance optimization. 
 - Strong embedded Linux expertise, including Yocto Project, Linux kernel concepts, device trees, board support packages, device drivers, bootloaders, system services, and cross-compilation toolchains. 
 - Experience with software lifecycle practices and tools such as Git, Jira, continuous integration, automated testing, static analysis, requirements traceability, and release management. 
 - Working knowledge of embedded cybersecurity, secure boot, cryptography, vulnerability management, and secure development practices. 
 - Demonstrated ability to make architecture and delivery trade-offs, resolve complex technical issues, and communicate decisions clearly to technical and business stakeholders. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with Yocto releases such as Dunfell and Kirkstone, open-source software governance, and upstream contribution. 
 - Familiarity with power conversion, uninterruptible power supplies, energy storage, power distribution, metering, or other high-reliability industrial products. 
 - Familiarity with functional safety, product certification, model-based design, test automation, and Agile product development. 
 - Experience managing external engineering partners, suppliers, budgets, or multi-site resource plans. "

"Embodies Eaton leadership attributes-ethical, passionate, accountable, efficient, transparent, and learning-with demonstrated capability in: 

- People leadership - sets direction and expectations, delegates effectively, coaches for performance, recognizes contributions, and addresses performance issues promptly and fairly. 
 - Talent development - identifies strengths and gaps, creates development opportunities, supports career growth, and builds succession and hiring plans. 
 - Inclusive leadership - creates psychological safety, values diverse perspectives, and builds an environment where people can contribute at their best. 
 - Strategic thinking - connects technology and platform choices to customer needs, product roadmaps, business priorities, and long-term capability. 
 - Execution and accountability - converts strategy into clear plans, uses metrics to manage commitments, removes barriers, and delivers results. 
 - Decision quality - makes timely, fact-based decisions under uncertainty and explains trade-offs, risks, and rationale. 
 - Influence and stakeholder management - aligns global and cross-functional teams, manages conflict constructively, and communicates effectively at all levels. 
 - Change leadership - leads teams through ambiguity, drives adoption of improved practices, and sustains organizational change. 
 - Customer and business acumen - understands customer outcomes, commercial priorities, competitive technologies, and quality expectations. 
 - Innovation leadership - creates space for experimentation, facilitates effective problem solving, and converts promising ideas into scalable solutions. 
 - Learning agility and resilience - adapts quickly, seeks feedback, remains composed under pressure, and helps the team recover from setbacks. 
 - Integrity and judgment - models ethical behavior, protects confidential information, and makes decisions consistent with company values. "

The ideal candidate will combine deep hands-on technical expertise in AI engineering with strong engineering leadership, capable of translating complex business requirements into scalable, secure, reliable, and production-ready AI solutions.  - LLM Frameworks: Practical experience with frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, or equivalent technologies. 
 - Model Ecosystem: Experience working with commercial or open-source LLMs, such as OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, or Llama-based models. 
 - Data & Integration: Experience with REST APIs, databases, data pipelines, enterprise integrations, and distributed systems. 
 - Cloud & Deployment: Experience with AWS, Azure, or GCP; containerisation and deployment using Docker and Kubernetes. 
 - AI Evaluation & Security: Experience with LLM evaluation, observability, prompt security, guardrails, and production monitoring. 
 - Engineering Practices: Strong knowledge of software architecture, CI/CD, automated testing, Git, code reviews, and production support. Preferred Qualifications

- Experience building enterprise AI platforms, reusable AI frameworks, or AI products at scale. 
 - Exposure to financial services, banking, payments, lending, fraud detection, risk, or other regulated enterprise environments. 
 - Experience with model gateways, model routing, inference optimisation, caching, and cost management. 
 - Familiarity with enterprise knowledge management, identity and access management, data governance, and audit requirements. 
 - Experience with MLOps, LLMOps, model lifecycle management, and AI application observability. 
 - Exposure to on-premises or private-cloud AI deployments and enterprise security constraints. 
 - Experience taking AI products from 0-to-1 development through production rollout and scaling. Leadership & Competencies

- Strong technical ownership and the ability to make sound architecture and engineering decisions. 
 - Proven ability to lead engineering teams and deliver complex technology initiatives.

 - Ability to balance experimentation and innovation with production reliability and delivery commitments. 
 - Strong stakeholder management and communication skills. 
 - Ability to explain complex AI concepts to engineering teams, product leaders, and business stakeholders. Success Measures

data.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer
data.description:
About Rippling

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system. 

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365, all within 90 seconds. 

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1. 85B+ from the world's top investors, including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, Bedrock, GIC, Elad Gil, and Goldman Sachs, and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes. 

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @rippling. com addresses. 

About Monetization Platform

The Monetization Platform team owns the systems behind how Rippling sells, contracts, bills, collects, and recognizes revenue across products and countries. 

The team owns the platform behind the complete monetization lifecycle: 

Quote → Contract → Entitlement → Subscription → Usage → Bill → Revenue

These systems support a $1B+ sales base, manage entitlements, metering, and usage-based billing rules, and enable localized billing as Rippling launches into new countries. 

As Rippling continues to introduce new products, pricing models, packaging structures, and markets, the Monetization Platform provides the common infrastructure that allows teams to move quickly without rebuilding monetization logic each time. 

Our vision is simple: 

Let any team monetize any product, anywhere, without writing code. 

This is a platform for engineers who enjoy solving foundational problems where correctness matters, abstractions need to last, and the impact extends far beyond a single product or team. 

The opportunity

- Rippling's product portfolio is expanding rapidly across HR, IT, Finance, and new product categories. 
 - Every new product introduces monetization complexity: what a customer purchased, what they are entitled to use, how their subscription evolves, how usage should be measured, what they should be charged, how payments are collected, and how that activity is ultimately reflected in financial systems. 
 - We are hiring a Senior Staff Software Engineer to provide technical leadership for the next generation of Rippling's Monetization Platform. 
 - You will own broad, ambiguous, multi-team technical charters spanning contracts, entitlements, subscriptions, usage metering, billing, invoicing, payments, tax, compliance, and revenue workflows. 
 - You will work on systems where errors are expensive. Incorrect contract state, entitlement state, usage calculations, invoices, payments, taxes, or revenue records can directly affect customers, financial accuracy, and trust. 
 - This role combines: 
 - Hands-on backend and platform engineering
 - Org-level architectural leadership
 - Technical leadership and mentorship
 - Cross-functional influence across Engineering, Product, Finance, Accounting, Revenue Operations, Payments, Security, and Data
 - You will define architecture, make difficult technical tradeoffs, align teams around durable solutions, mentor technical leaders, and help build a platform that allows Rippling to monetize new products and markets faster and with greater confidence. 
 - This is not an architecture-only role. You will stay close to execution through design reviews, code reviews, debugging, prototyping, production investigations, and implementation-level technical decisions. 

What you'll own

- Own major technical charters across CPQ, contracts, entitlements, subscriptions, usage metering, billing, invoicing, payments, tax, compliance, and revenue workflows. 
 - Define architecture for systems requiring strong guarantees around data integrity, auditability, reliability, recoverability, and clear ownership across service boundaries. 
 - Design durable platform abstractions that allow product teams to introduce new packaging, pricing, entitlement, metered billing, subscription, and contract models without building custom one-off solutions. 
 - Lead multi-team initiatives from problem definition and architecture through technical design, execution, migration, launch, and long-term operational ownership. 
 - Define clear service boundaries, APIs, data models, ownership models, and failure-handling strategies across interconnected monetization systems. 
 - Make high-quality technical tradeoffs across correctness, scalability, performance, cost, compliance, maintainability, and delivery speed. 
 - Stay hands-on through design reviews, code reviews, debugging, prototyping, production investigations, and implementation-level decisions. 
 - Partner closely with Product, Revenue Operations, Finance, Accounting, Payments, Platform, Security, Data, and product engineering teams. 
 - Identify systemic technical risks early and drive alignment on durable solutions, particularly where customer trust or financial accuracy is at stake. 
 - Establish engineering standards for critical monetization systems, including testing, observability, incident learning, migration safety, rollout mechanisms, and operational readiness. 
 - Mentor Staff, Senior, and mid-level engineers and help grow technical leadership across the organization. 
 - Raise the engineering bar through strong technical judgment, thoughtful design reviews, clear technical writing, and operational excellence. What success looks like

- Platform leverage: Product teams can launch new products, pricing structures, packaging models, entitlement models, and usage-based offerings without rebuilding core monetization infrastructure. 
 - Correctness and trust: Critical contract, entitlement, subscription, billing, payment, tax, and revenue workflows maintain a high standard of data integrity, auditability, and reliability. 
 - Clear architectural boundaries: Monetization capabilities have well-defined ownership, APIs, data contracts, and service boundaries, reducing coupling and one-off implementations. 
 - Faster product and market expansion: New products and country launches can adopt common monetization capabilities rather than creating bespoke billing and entitlement systems. 
 - Operational excellence: Critical monetization systems have strong observability, safe migration patterns, effective incident learning, and clear operational ownership. 
 - Technical leadership: Engineers across teams look to you for architectural guidance, difficult technical decisions, and direction on complex cross-system problems. 
 - Stronger technical leaders: Staff, Senior, and mid-level engineers around you develop greater technical judgment, ownership, and ability to lead increasingly complex initiatives. 

What we're looking for

- 15+ years of software engineering experience, preferably across backend engineering, platform engineering, infrastructure, distributed systems, product engineering, or systems engineering. 
 - Proven experience operating at Senior Staff, Principal Engineer, or equivalent Staff+ scope. 
 - Deep hands-on engineering foundation with strong coding, debugging, system design, and production ownership experience. 
 - Experience building and operating large-scale distributed systems with demanding reliability, observability, and data correctness requirements. 
 - Strong architecture depth across APIs, databases, data modeling, concurrency, event-driven systems, service boundaries, reliability, performance, failure modes, and long-term maintainability. 
 - Demonstrated ability to own ambiguous, cross-functional, multi-team technical initiatives from definition through production ownership. 
 - Strong technical judgment and the ability to make tradeoffs across product needs, business constraints, engineering quality, and long-term platform direction. 
 - Ability to influence senior engineers, product leaders, and cross-functional stakeholders without relying on formal authority. 
 - Strong mentorship record and a track record of raising the technical bar for engineers around you. 
 - Clear written and verbal communication, especially when explaining complex technical decisions to technical and non-technical audiences. 
 - Comfort operating in fast-paced, high-ambiguity environments. 
 - Deep backend programming experience in one or more languages. Python and Django experience is a strong plus. Bonus points

- Experience building monetization, entitlement, metered or usage-based billing, subscription, pricing, payments, accounting, revenue, tax, or fintech systems. 
 - Experience building internal platforms used by multiple product engineering teams. 
 - Experience working in SaaS, enterprise software, HR technology, payroll, compliance, workflow-heavy domains, or high-growth product companies. 
 - Experience with MongoDB or similar NoSQL databases. 
 - Experience with reliability engineering, incident response, performance tuning, observability, and operational excellence. 
 - Experience with security, permissions, auditability, compliance, or enterprise-grade controls. 
 - A builder-leader mindset: someone who can define direction, align stakeholders, establish durable architecture, and remain close to execution.

data.title: Staff Software Engineer, Backend / Agent Orchestration
data.description:
Build the Future Workforce

Wand turns AI into labor. It enables humans and AI agents to operate together as a unified, hybrid workforce, with comprehensive management and oversight. And it's already operating at scale inside some of the world's largest organizations. 

Wand built the world's first Agentic Labor Infrastructure enabling governments and global enterprises to create, manage, and scale digital workforces. 

Our mission is to integrate agent ecosystems into the core of work and business, unlocking a generational leap in the global economy. We're building the infrastructure that lets humans and AI agents operate together safely, transparently, and at scale. 

Join Wand in leading the Agentic Shift

Wand is building a high-performing global team who take full ownership of what they build. We lead by example, move fast, make data-aware decisions, and continuously push for more- always with a focus on delivering real value to customers. 

You would be joining a world-class team that combines deep research expertise and real-world product execution, with experience spanning Deepmind, Google, Amazon, Miro, Elise AI, IBM and Accern. 

Position Summary

Every agent on our platform runs because of what this team builds. We're hiring a Staff Software Engineer to help architect the distributed backend that powers agent orchestration at Wand: workflow execution on Temporal, sandboxed agent code, and the pipelines that keep thousands of agents running without falling over. Zero UI, zero fluff. Just hard distributed systems problems at real scale. 

You'll pair directly with our Tech Lead on the India based team and take the architecture to the next level. We need someone who can turn "design v3 of this system" into a real, working plan, then help the team build it. 

This isn't just about orchestrating a single agent. It's about orchestrating a workforce of agents working together through processes, and building the layer that makes that possible. Orchestration, task execution and tool calling, and sandboxing are largely independent pieces, so depth in any one of them matters more than breadth across all of them. 

Role Responsibilities

- Architect the agent orchestration and workflow execution system on Temporal, including the sandboxing that keeps agent code execution, web access, and file systems locked down and safe. 
 - Build the task management, autonomous execution loops, and tool calling infrastructure that let agents run independently and act in the real world at scale. 
 - Own the distributed data and event pipelines (Kafka, Kubernetes, Redis) that keep the platform observable and resilient. 
 - Turn ambiguous, high stakes problems into concrete technical designs, ship them, and document the architecture so the next engineer doesn't have to guess. 
 - Pair with the team's Tech Lead to raise the bar on architecture and code quality, reviewing designs across the team as it scales. 
 - Work with the Workforce Management team so the execution layer supports what they're building on top, and pitch in on production support, including coverage that overlaps with US afternoons. 

Key Requirements

- Real scalable distributed systems experience: production systems that run across many machines, not one box. 
 - Hands on with Temporal or comparable workflow orchestration systems. 
 - Strong with Kafka, and Kubernetes for container orchestration (especially for the sandboxing components). 
 - Deep backend chops. There's no frontend here, so this needs to run deep. 
 - Experience with distributed streaming and event driven systems (we use Kafka and Redis). What you built with these tools matters more than which specific ones you've used. 
 - A track record of owning architecture end to end, not just contributing to someone else's plan. 
 - Strong in Go and Python. 
 - Clear communicator who can design independently and bring the team along. 
 - Exposure to agentic or LLM based systems, especially tool calling. 

Preferred Experience

- Experience building safe, isolated execution environments (sandboxing). 
 - Background in process automation or RPA (e. g. BPMN, Camunda, UiPath, or similar), even without direct agent experience. We're building orchestration for a workforce of agents, and process automation experience transfers well. 
 - Exposure to distributed data stores such as Cassandra or ClickHouse. Helpful, not required. 
 - Experience building infrastructure other teams can't live without. 
 - On call experience for distributed systems. 
 - Time spent scaling infrastructure inside a fast growing engineering org.

What You'll Do

Guide the team in architectural decisions and best practices for building scalable applications. 

Drive design, development, implementation and documentation

Build, test and deploy cutting edge solutions at scale, impacting associates of Walmart worldwide. 

Interact with Walmart engineering teams across geographies to leverage expertise and contribute to the tech community.

Work with senior leadership to chart out the future roadmap of the products

Participate in hiring and building teams enabling them to be high performing agile teams. 

Interact closely for requirements with Business owners and technical teams both within India and across the globe. 

What You'll Bring

Bachelor's/Master's degree in Computer Science, engineering, or related field, with minimum 10+ years of experience in software design, development and automated deployments. 

Have prior experience in delivering highly scalable large scale data processing Java applications. 

Strong in high- and low-level system design. Should be experienced in designing data intensive applications in open stack. 

A good understanding of CS Fundamentals, Microservices, Data Structures, Algorithms & Problem Solving

Should be experienced in CICD development environments/tools including, but not limited to, Git, Maven, and Jenkins. 

Strong in writing modular and testable code and test cases (unit, functional and integration) using frameworks like JUnit, Mockito, and Mock MVC

Hands on experience building Java-based backend systems and experience working in cloud-based solutions is a must. Proficient in Java, Spring Boot, Kafka, and Spark. 

Experienced in microservices architecture. Possesses good understanding of distributed concepts, common design principles, design patterns and cloud native development concepts. 

Hands-on experience in Spring boot, concurrency, garbage collection, RESTful services, data caching services and ORM tools. 

Experience working with Relational Database and writing complex OLAP, OLTP and SQL queries. 

Provide multiple alternatives for development frameworks, libraries, and tools. 

Experience in working with NoSQL Databases like cosmos DB. 

Experience in working with Caching technology like Redis, Mem cache or other related Systems. 

Experience in event-based systems like Kafka. 

Experience utilizing monitoring and alert tools like Prometheus, Splunk, and other related systems and excellent in debugging and troubleshooting issues. 

Exposure to Containerization tools like Docker, Helm, Kubernetes. 

Knowledge of public cloud platforms like Azure, GCP, etc. will be an added advantage. 

An understanding of Mainframe databases will be an added advantage. 

Good to Have

- Python - ability to read/write Python for scripting, data pipelines, or lightweight AI/ML tooling that complements the core Java stack. 
 - Familiarity with architecting GenAI-augmented features within existing Java/Spring Boot systems - knowing when an LLM-based solution is (and isn't) the right architectural choice compared to traditional rule-based or ML approaches. 
 - Understanding of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) patterns at a system-design level - evaluating vector store options (Pinecone, Azure AI Search, pgvector), chunking/embedding strategies, and how retrieval pipelines fit into existing service architectures. 
 - Exposure to integrating and governing LLM APIs (OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic, or open-source models) in production - able to reason about latency budgets, failure handling, and fallback strategies at scale across a large engineering org. 
 - Awareness of agentic system design (tool-calling, multi-step orchestration, single vs. multi-agent topologies) and frameworks such as LangChain / LangGraph / Semantic Kernel - enough to guide teams on when agentic patterns add value vs. unnecessary complexity. 
 - Ability to guide the team on responsible AI practices: prompt injection risks, output validation/guardrails, PII handling, model versioning, and auditability - especially relevant given the financial/payments domain this team operates in. 
 - Comfort evaluating inference cost and performance trade-offs (token usage, caching strategies, model selection between small vs. large models) when advising on AI-related architectural decisions. 
 - Experience mentoring engineers on AI-assisted development practices and fostering safe, consistent adoption of tools like GitHub Copilot or Code Puppy across the team.

data.title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer
data.description:
Company Description

Nexthink is the leader in digital employee experience management software. The company provides IT leaders with unprecedented insight allowing them to see, diagnose and fix issues at scale impacting employees anywhere, with any application or network, before employees notice the issue. As the first solution to allow IT to progress from reactive problem solving to proactive optimization, Nexthink enables its more than 1, 300 customers to provide better digital experiences to more than 18 million employees. Dual headquartered in Lausanne, Switzerland and Boston, Massachusetts, Nexthink has 9 offices worldwide. 

Job Description

We are looking for an experienced, proactive and innovative professional that is keen to join as a Senior Site Reliability Engineer! The mission of Nexthink's SRE team is to strengthen our infrastructure and enhance our ability to deploy, monitor, and scale systems effectively and reliably. They work closely with over 50 Product Engineering teams that develop our products and services, as well as with the Technical Platform Engineering, Security and Architecture teams to understand the reliability requirements, design and implement solutions, and promote them for adoption and usage. 

Join our vibrant team of diverse and experienced engineers where cutting-edge technology meets innovation. Be a part of Nexthink's Digital Employee Experience technological revolution, ensuring our global customers enjoy a seamless user experience. Apply now and become a key player in our dynamic SRE organisation. 

As a Senior Site Reliability Engineer, you will: 

- Implement and manage cloud-native systems (AWS) using best-in-class tools and automation. 
 - Operate and enhance Kubernetes clusters, deployment pipelines, and service meshes to support rapid delivery cycles. 
 - Design, build, and maintain the infrastructure powering our multi-tenant SaaS platform with reliability, security, and scalability in mind. 
 - Define and maintain SLOs, SLAs, and error budgets, and proactively address availability and performance issues. 
 - Develop infrastructure-as-code (Terraform or similar) for repeatable and auditable provisioning. 
 - Build internal platform tools and automation to support provisioning, monitoring, and operational efficiency. 
 - Monitor infrastructure and applications ensuring high-quality user experiences. 
 - Participate in a shared on-call rotation, responding to incidents, troubleshooting outages, and driving timely resolution and communication. 
 - Act as an Incident Commander during the on-call duty and coordinate cross-team responses effectively to maintain an SLA. 
 - Drive and refine incident response processes, reducing Mean Time to Detect (MTTD) and Mean Time to Recovery (MTTR). 
 - Diagnose and resolve complex issues independently, minimizing the need for external escalation. 
 - Work closely with software engineers to embed observability, fault tolerance, and reliability principles into service design. 
 - Automate runbooks, health checks, and alerting to support reliable operations with minimal manual intervention. 
 - Support automated testing, canary deployments, and rollback strategies to ensure safe, fast, and reliable releases. 
 - Contribute to security best practices, compliance automation, and cost optimization. 

Qualifications

- Minimum Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience. 
 - 5+ years of experience as a Site Reliability Engineer or Platform Engineer with strong knowledge of software development best practices. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with public cloud services (AWS, GCP, Azure) and supporting SaaS product. 
 - Strong programming or scripting skills (e. g. , Python, Go, Bash. . . ), and experience with infrastructure-as-code (e. g. Terraform). 
 - Proficiency with Kubernetes, container-based deployment (e. g. , Docker) and related ecosystems (e. g. , Helm). 
 - Experience supporting multi-tenant microservices architectures. 
 - Experience with CI/CD pipelines & tools (e. g. , Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, FluxCD, Crossplane). 
 - Experience with managing monitoring solutions (e. g. Datadog). 
 - Comfortable participating in a rotating on-call schedule, managing critical incidents, and leading post-incident reviews. 
 - At ease with operating and managing production systems, striking the right balance between urgency and methodology. 
 - Strong system-level troubleshooting skills and a proactive mindset toward incident prevention. 
 - Deep understanding of Linux systems, networking, and common troubleshooting practices. 
 - Solid understanding of the network stack (e. g. , TCP/IP, VPN, etc. ), cloud architectures (VPC, subnets, firewalls, load balancers), service mesh (e. g. , Istio) and storage (e. g. , S3, EBS, etc). 
 - Knowledge of zero-downtime deployment strategies, blue/green and canary releases. 
 - Exposure to compliance standards such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, or HIPAA. FedRAMP experience is a big plus. 
 - Experience with chaos engineering or resilience testing practices. 
 - Excellent problem-solving skills, collaborative mindset, and a strong grasp of agile, iterative development. 
 - Self-driven, highly organised, and capable of independently managing priorities. 
 - Curiosity to learn new things and discover new technologies. 
 - Strong communication, presentation, and team collaboration skills. 
 - Excellent written and verbal skills in English. 
 - The prior experience with any of the above-mentioned tools is a bonus, but not a must! We encourage you to apply even if you do not meet every single requirement. We welcome candidates with different level of background and experience. If you are excited about this role, please apply and our recruiters will assess your application. 

Additional Information

We are the pioneers and trailblazers of a global IT Market Category (DEX) that is shaping the future of how the world works, giving our customers' IT Teams total digital visibility across their enterprise. Our innovative solutions integrate real-time analytics, automation, and employee feedback across all endpoints. This enables our IT teams to solve complex technical challenges, create ever more productive workplaces, and deliver happy, satisfied employees in the digital workplace. 

With over 1000 employees across 5 continents, Nexthink operates as One Team, connecting, collaborating and innovating to continuously grow. We call our employees 'Nexthinkers' and our commitment to diversity, inclusion, and equity is second to none. We currently have over 75 nationalities working with us, from all cultures and backgrounds, speaking many different languages.
