Through our unparalleled science, data, technology and laboratory network, we advance diagnostics, accelerate innovation and help address some of the world's most important health challenges. As we shape the future of healthcare, we are leveraging advanced technologies, intelligent digital solutions and data-driven innovation across our operations to enhance how work gets done and deliver greater value to customers and patients. With our global scale and deep expertise, you'll have the opportunity to do meaningful work, grow your career and make a real impact on people's health around the world. Together, we're improving health and improving lives. 

Labcorp is a global leader in diagnostic testing and drug development solutions, helping healthcare providers, researchers, and patients make informed decisions that advance care. Join us in our mission to improve health and improve lives. 

Labcorp is seeking a QA Engineer - Salesforce & Enterprise Applications to support quality assurance across Salesforce and integrated enterprise applications to join our team!

Work Schedule: This is an initial one-year contract position, and the role is assigned to a second-shift schedule. with standard business hours of Monday through Friday, 12. 30 PM IST - 9. 30 PM IST in your local time zone. Business needs may occasionally require flexibility in work hours, including earlier, later, or additional hours, with reasonable notice provided when possible. 

Job Responsibilities

- Analyze user stories, business requirements, solution designs, and acceptance criteria from a QA perspective to ensure requirements are complete, consistent, and testable. 
 - Identify requirement gaps, edge cases, dependencies, and quality risks early in the software development lifecycle and work with Business Analysts, Product Owners, and Developers to clarify expected behavior. 

Technical Oversight

- Develop and maintain test plans, test scenarios, test cases, test data, and test execution documentation. 
 - Perform rigorous functional, integration, end-to-end, regression, and negative testing for Salesforce applications and related enterprise systems. 
 - Test Salesforce functionality including business processes, Flows, validation rules, objects, fields, permissions, profiles, record types, and other configuration and customization. 
 - Design, develop, execute, and maintain automated test cases using Copado Robotic Testing, with a focus on reusable and maintainable regression automation. 
 - Evaluate existing and new test cases to identify opportunities to improve automation coverage, regression coverage, and overall testing effectiveness. 
 - Test integrations between Salesforce and other enterprise applications, including APIs, middleware, scheduled processes, and inbound/outbound interfaces. 
 - Perform data migration and data validation testing, including field mapping, record counts, data completeness, accuracy, transformation, synchronization, and exception handling. 
 - Identify, document, and track defects with clear reproduction steps, severity, supporting evidence, and business impact; retest fixes and perform appropriate regression testing. 
 - Participate in Agile ceremonies including backlog refinement, sprint planning, daily stand-ups, demonstrations, and retrospectives, and provide QA estimates, status updates, and quality risks. 
 - Collaborate with cross-functional teams to continuously improve QA processes, test automation, regression coverage, defect prevention, and overall software quality. 

Minimum Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field. 
 - 8 years or more experience as a Software Quality Assurance Engineer. 
 - 3 years or more experience testing Salesforce platform applications on Sales Cloud or Service Cloud. 
 - 2 years or more experience in Salesforce, Copado, or related QA/test automation certifications. 
 - 2 years or more experience performing functional, integration, end-to-end, regression, and negative testing. 
 - 2 years or more experience with test automation, preferably Copado Robotic Testing, or similar enterprise test automation tools. 
 - 2 years or more experience with data migration, data conversion, or large-scale data validation testing. 
 - 2 years or more experience working in Agile/Scrum delivery environments. 

Preferred Qualifications

- 1 year or more experience testing REST/SOAP APIs and integration platforms
 - 1 year or more experience with Jira, Salesforce DevOps processes, and version-control practices. 

Certifications

- Salesforce certifications. Professional certifications such as ISTQB, ASTQB, CSTE, CSQA, CQSE

Additional Job Standards

- Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills with attention to detail. 
 - Strong experience analyzing user stories, requirements, and acceptance criteria and translating them into comprehensive test scenarios and test cases. 
 - Strong analytical, troubleshooting, defect-management, and communication skills. 
 - Strong command of the English language. Fluent in speaking and writing English. 
 - Ability to independently analyze requirements and identify quality risks before testing begins. 
 - Strong ownership of testing outcomes and commitment to delivering high-quality solutions. 
 - Ability to effectively balance comprehensive testing with Agile delivery timelines. 
 - Strong collaboration and communication skills across business and technical teams. 
 - Ability to continuously identify opportunities to improve testing efficiency, automation coverage, and quality processes. 

About The Role

- The QA Engineer will be responsible for analyzing requirements from a quality perspective, developing and executing comprehensive test scenarios, and building and maintaining automated tests using Copado Robotic Testing. The role requires strong Salesforce testing experience and the ability to test complex business processes involving integrations, data migration, and multiple enterprise systems.

data.description:
About The Role

TTEC is scaling its Automation & AI portfolio to move beyond manual, ticket-by-ticket process work toward an agentic framework that can right-source work across business units. This role is central to that shift - building the multi-agent systems, integrations, and evaluation rigor needed to deploy AI agents safely and at scale across TTEC's technology and business operations. 

What You'll Do

- Design and implement multi-agent workflows using Google Agent Development Kit (ADK), including agent orchestration, tool routing, and memory/context management 
 - Build integrations using Model Context Protocol (MCP) to expose internal systems (Jira, SharePoint, ServiceNow, internal APIs, etc. ) as discoverable tools that agents can call at runtime 
 - Develop and maintain evaluation frameworks to measure agent accuracy, task completion rate, and safety - both pre- and post-deployment 
 - Design, build, and optimize conversational and task-based agents in Microsoft Copilot Studio, integrating with Power Platform (Power Automate, Dataverse) and enterprise data sources 
 - Apply strong prompt engineering practices - structured prompting, few-shot design, guardrails, and iterative evaluation - to improve agent reliability and reduce hallucination/drift 
 - Architect and deploy agentic solutions on Google Cloud Platform (GCP) (Vertex AI, Cloud Functions, Cloud Run, IAM) with attention to scalability, cost, and security 
 - Partner with business unit stakeholders to identify manual, repeatable processes suitable for agent-based automation, translating business requirements into technical agent designs 
 - Collaborate with the Automation & AI team on reusable patterns, shared tooling, and governance standards (security review readiness, access control, data handling) 
 - Contribute to internal enablement - documentation, training, and knowledge transfer so the broader team can build and extend agentic solutions 
 - Monitor deployed agents in production, iterating based on performance data, user feedback, and evaluation results

Required

What You'll Bring

- Hands-on experience building with Google Agent Development Kit (ADK) or comparable agent orchestration frameworks (LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI) 
 - Practical experience with Model Context Protocol (MCP) - building or consuming MCP servers/tools 
 - Strong prompt engineering skills, including evaluation-driven prompt iteration 
 - Experience with Microsoft Copilot Studio for building and deploying enterprise agents/bots 
 - Working knowledge of GCP services relevant to AI workloads (Vertex AI, Cloud Functions/Run, IAM, logging/monitoring) 
 - Solid software engineering fundamentals - Python (preferred), API design, version control 
 - Understanding of LLM evaluation methodology: accuracy, task completion, safety/guardrail testing

Primary Location

India-Telangana-Hyderabad

data.description:
WHAT YOU DO AT AMD CHANGES EVERYTHING

At AMD, our mission is to build great products that accelerate next-generation computing experiences-from AI and data centers, to PCs, gaming and embedded systems. Grounded in a culture of innovation and collaboration, we believe real progress comes from bold ideas, human ingenuity and a shared passion to create something extraordinary. When you join AMD, you'll discover the real differentiator is our culture. We push the limits of innovation to solve the world's most important challenges-striving for execution excellence, while being direct, humble, collaborative, and inclusive of diverse perspectives. Join us as we shape the future of AI and beyond. Together, we advance your career. 

Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced SMTS Software Quality Engineer to join the HIP Runtime Quality Engineering team within the ROCm ecosystem. In this role, you will focus on defect triage, root‐cause analysis, and scalable test automation for the HIP runtime, ensuring robustness, portability, and performance across AMD and NVIDIA GPU backends. 

The role sits at the intersection of runtime systems, GPU APIs, and CI-driven quality assurance, working closely with HIP runtime developers, compiler teams, and system software engineers to improve test coverage and accelerate issue resolution across a fast-evolving open‐source stack. 

HIP is a C++ runtime API and kernel language designed for CUDA portability and heterogeneous GPU programming in the ROCm platform. 

Key Responsibilities

Defect Triage & Root Cause Analysis

- Own end-to-end triage of HIP runtime failures observed in CI, nightly, and release testing pipelines. 
 - Analyze failures across HIP runtime APIs, including memory management, streams, events, kernels, graphs, and device management. 
 - Perform log analysis, repro reduction, and backtrace debugging across Linux and Windows environments. 
 - Correlate failures across: 
 - ROCr system runtime
 - HIP runtime
 - Driver / firmware interfaces
 - Compiler (hipcc / clang) interactions
 - File high‐quality bug reports with clear reproduction steps, root cause hypotheses, and impact assessment. 

Test Automation & Framework Development

- Design, enhance, and maintain automated test frameworks for HIP runtime validation using existing HIP test infrastructure (Catch2-based and custom harnesses). 
 - Expand functional, negative, stress, and regression coverage for: 
 - HIP Runtime APIs
 - Graph APIs
 - Memory copy variants (1D/2D/3D, async/sync)
 - Multi-GPU and peer-to-peer use cases
 - Integrate tests into CI/CD pipelines with actionable failure reporting. 
 - Develop Python, C++, and shell-based automation for test execution, result aggregation, and trend analysis. 
 - Drive test flakiness reduction and improve signal-to-noise ratio in large-scale CI. 

Cross-Team Collaboration

- Partner with HIP runtime developers to: 
 - Review test gaps for new features and APIs
 - Validate bug fixes and performance-sensitive code paths
 - Collaborate with: 
 - Compiler and language runtime teams
 - ROCr system runtime teams
 - Release engineering and CI infrastructure teams
 - Contribute test fixes and enhancements upstream in open-source HIP/ROCm repositories. 

Quality Metrics & Continuous Improvement

- Define and track quality metrics such as failure escape rate, test coverage, and mean-time-to-resolution (MTTR). 
 - Identify systemic issues and propose data-driven quality improvements. 
 - Participate in release readiness assessments for HIP runtime drops. 

Required Qualifications

Technical Skills

- Strong experience in software quality engineering, test automation, or SDET roles. 
 - Solid proficiency in C++ with debugging experience (gdb/lldb). 
 - Working knowledge of HIP or CUDA runtime concepts, including kernels, streams, memory models, and device execution. 
 - Experience with Linux-based development and debugging. 
 - Familiarity with CI systems (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or similar). 
 - Experience writing and maintaining automated tests for low-level systems or runtime libraries. 

Debugging & Analysis Skills

- Ability to reason about runtime abstractions, concurrency, and asynchronous execution. 
 - Strong skills in failure reproduction, minimization, and log-driven debugging. 
 - Experience triaging issues across hardware-software boundaries is a plus. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with GPU programming models (HIP, CUDA, OpenCL). 
 - Familiarity with ROCm stack components (HIP, ROCr, compilers, drivers). 
 - Experience testing graph APIs, async execution models, or multi-GPU systems. 
 - Prior contributions to open-source system software or test frameworks. 
 - Knowledge of Python-based test orchestration and reporting tools. 
 - Knowledge and application of AI tools in validation and testing. 

What Success Looks Like

- Faster, higher-quality issue triage with actionable root cause insights. 
 - Improved automation coverage for HIP runtime APIs and edge cases. 
 - Reduced CI noise and faster feedback for developers. 
 - Strong collaboration with runtime and compiler engineers to ship stable, high-quality HIP releases.

data.title: Senior Database Engineer
data.description:
About Us

Advancing connectivity to secure a brighter world. 

Nokia is a global leader in connectivity for the AI era. With expertise across fixed, mobile and transport networks, powered by the innovation of Nokia Bell Labs, we're advancing connectivity to secure a brighter world. 

Learn more about life at Nokia. 

Description: 

Senior Database Performance & Benchmark Engineer, the responsible for designing and executing rigorous testing strategies across a complex hybrid environment consisting of large-scale on-premises SQL Server instances and public cloud managed database services. You will act as the bridge between infrastructure engineering, database administration, and application development to ensure our systems are resilient, highly scalable, and optimized for peak

production workloads. 

Your responsibilities

- Hybrid Benchmarking & Load Testing: Design, script, and execute comprehensive load, stress, and endurance tests utilizing synthetic tools (e. g. , HammerDB, OStress, Apache JMeter) and production replay tools (e. g. , WorkloadTools, DEA). 
 - Performance Telemetry & Monitoring: Establish performance baselines and build continuous monitoring dashboards utilizing OS-level metrics (PerfMon/Linux Sysstat) and SQL Server Dynamic Management Views (DMVs). 
 - Cloud Migration & Scaling Validation: Benchmark on-premises workloads and simulate equivalent performance in public cloud environments (such as AWS RDS/EC2, Azure SQL, or GCP Cloud SQL) to accurately size cloud infrastructure and control costs. 
 - Bottleneck Isolation & Optimization: Analyze execution plans, identify plan regressions, and isolate resource contention bottlenecks (CPU, Memory, Disk I/O, TempDB, and network latency). 
 - Concurrency & Lock Management: Diagnose and resolve complex locking, blocking, and deadlock scenarios discovered during high-concurrency simulation cycles. 
 - Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Performance QA, DevOps, Infrastructure, and Application teams to establish quality gates and provide actionable code/indexing optimization recommendations. 

Your skills and experience

Must-Have: 

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, information technology, engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent with 7+ years of experience in dedicated database administration (DBA), database engineering, or specialized database performance testing experience. 
 - Hybrid Environment Mastery: Proven track record managing or benchmarking both traditional on-premises enterprise hardware and public cloud architectures (AWS, Azure, or GCP). 
 - Deep SQL Server Internals: Expert-level knowledge of SQL Server query optimization, execution plan analysis, Query Store, Extended Events (XEvents), and system DMVs and Extensive experience setting up and operating database benchmarking suites such as HammerDB, SQLQueryStress, OStress, or similar automated simulation frameworks. 
 - Solid understanding of underlying storage configurations (SAN, NVMe, Cloud IOPS allocations), virtualization layers, and network latency mechanics in hybrid setups and Scripting & Automation: Proficiency in PowerShell, T-SQL, or Python to automate test deployments, data generation, and telemetry collection. 
 - Experience with cloud native infrastructure-as-code tools (e. g. , Terraform) to spin up and tear down transient performance testing sandboxes and Experience with production workload masking and synchronization methodologies to generate high-fidelity, non-sensitive testing datasets.

Job Description

Our Story

At Alight, we believe a company's success starts with its people. Alight embraces values that come directly from our people - purposeful, human, united and growth-minded - reflecting our inclusive culture and promise that our clients expect. We are passionate about connecting purpose with impact. Our Benefits

With a comprehensive total rewards package, Alight offers programs and plans that support your mind, body, wallet, and life. Benefits include health, starting Day One. Additionally, Alight colleagues enjoy wellbeing programs, retirement plans, and career growth opportunities - all within a thriving global organization. 

Great Place to Work

Thanks to the work of every colleague, Alight has received multiple awards of recognition including "Great Place to Work" for the past 7 years and Fortune's "Best Companies to Work For. " To learn more about our company culture and awards Click Here. 

We invite you to join our team! Learn more at careers. alight. com. 

(THE ROLE)

The Senior Testing Specialist is accountable to test and sign off on the quality of CBA solutions, ensuring that delivery meets client requirements and acceptance criteria. The role leverages deep domain expertise, test design discipline, realistic test data setup, defect analysis, and stakeholder communication to identify quality risks and support production-ready releases. This updated role also requires responsible use of AI as a productivity accelerator for data quality analysis, test design, SQL validation, issue summarization, and documentation. 

AI capability requirement

Candidates must demonstrate practical, responsible use of generative AI to accelerate data profiling, data quality rule design, test case creation, SQL analysis, and issue summarization. AI-generated checks, summaries, or SQL must be validated, corrected, and explained before use. 

(RESPONSIBILITIES)

Primary Responsibilities

· Participate in requirements meetings to understand client impact, acceptance criteria, testing coverage, environment needs, non-functional requirements, and testing effort. 

· Participate in sprint planning by reviewing user stories, identifying testing tasks, providing estimates, and confirming readiness of test data and environments. 

· Create, document, execute, track, and report manual and automated test cases for assigned projects, enhancements, and defects. 

· Create realistic participant, provision, configuration, and environment data needed for development, functional testing, regression testing, and UAT preparation. 

· Capture, analyze, log, and retest defects; identify quality risks; and partner with developers, product owners, and solution leaders to resolve issues or prioritize backlog items. 

· Execute functional and non-functional testing, including regression, data validation, configuration validation, and release-readiness testing. 

· Support UAT by preparing environments and test participants, validating test scenarios, and documenting results, risks, and required follow-up. 

· Use AI-assisted QA and data analysis tools to accelerate test design, data quality checks, SQL validation, issue summaries, and documentation while independently validating outputs. 

Required Skills and Experience

· Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, MIS, Engineering, Math, or a related field, or equivalent experience. 

· 4-6 years of software quality assurance, data testing, or related experience. 

· Experience with SQL-based testing and data validation. 

· Experience creating and executing manual tests, with exposure to test automation or automated data-validation approaches; familiarity with Agile testing methodologies, test planning, test case creation, defect management, and release validation. 

· Experience with QA automation frameworks, test-management tools, or automated SQL/data-quality validation is a plus. 

· Strong knowledge of CBA domain, product behavior, environment setup, test data preparation, client impact, and quality risk analysis. 

· Ability to analyze requirements, identify edge cases, distinguish true defects from expected business variance, and communicate findings clearly. 

· SQL and data quality fundamentals, including joins, aggregations, exception queries, duplicate detection, null analysis, referential integrity checks, record-count validation, and trend analysis. 

· Strong secure data handling discipline, including preventing confidential, proprietary, client, colleague, production, PII, or PHI data from being entered into public AI tools. 

AI Required and Preferred Skills. 

(REQUIREMENTS)

Skill Area

Requirement / Posting Language

AI-assisted data analysis

Experience using generative AI tools to accelerate data profiling, SQL analysis, data quality rule design, query explanation, documentation, and issue summarization. 

Prompt engineering

Ability to write clear prompts for data validation scenarios, anomaly detection logic, SQL troubleshooting, reconciliation checks, and data quality reporting. 

AI output validation

Ability to critically review AI-generated SQL, data quality rules, test cases, and summaries for accuracy, completeness, privacy, and business relevance. 

Data analysis and RCA

Ability to profile datasets, identify patterns, isolate root causes, document evidence, and recommend corrective actions. 

Preferred AI usage

Experience with ETL validation, source-to-target reconciliation, data lineage, data observability, BI/report validation, data governance, and automated data quality checks. 

Application and Interview

By applying for a position with Alight, you understand that, should you be made an offer, it will be contingent on your undergoing and successfully completing a background check consistent with Alight's employment policies. Background checks may include some or all the following based on the nature of the position: Government ID validation, education verification, employment verification, and criminal check, search against global sanctions and government watch lists, credit check, and/or drug test. You will be notified during the hiring process which checks are required by the position. 

Alight requires all virtual interviews to be conducted on video. Please be aware that Alight is a camera-on culture and may require occasional travel to one of our physical office locations. 

Our commitment to Inclusion

We celebrate differences and believe in fostering an environment where everyone feels valued, respected, and supported. We know that diverse teams are stronger, more innovative, and more successful. 

At Alight, we welcome and embrace all individuals, regardless of their background, and are dedicated to creating a culture that enables every employee to thrive. Join us in building a brighter, more inclusive future. 

As part of this commitment, Alight will ensure that persons with disabilities are provided with reasonable accommodation for the hiring process. If reasonable accommodation is needed, please contact alightcareers@alight. com.

Alight is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer and does not discriminate against anyone based on sex, race, color, religion, creed, national origin, ancestry, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy, marital or domestic partner status, citizenship, military or veteran status, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, genetic information, or any other legally protected characteristics or conduct covered by federal, state, or local law. In addition, we take affirmative action to employ disabled persons, disabled veterans, and other covered veterans. 

Alight provides reasonable accommodation to the known limitations of otherwise qualified employees and applicants for employment with disabilities and sincerely held religious beliefs, practices and observances, unless doing so would result in undue hardship. Applicants for employment may request reasonable accommodations/modifications by contacting their recruiter. 

Authorization to work in the Employing Country

Applicants for employment in the country in which they are applying (Employing Country) must have work authorization that does not, now or in the future, require sponsorship of a visa for employment authorization in the Employing Country and with Alight.

We are looking for a highly motivated PLC Programmer / Controls & Automation Engineer to join our automation team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, programming, commissioning, and troubleshooting industrial automation systems involving PLCs, HMIs, SCADA, robotics, servo drives, and motion control applications.

 - Good understanding of industrial automation systems and electrical controls.

 - Knowledge of robotics integration and automation systems.

 - Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.

data.title: Quality Assurance Engineer –
data.description:
About SCG in India

SCG is strengthening its presence in India through sustainable construction solutions, innovative building materials, and integrated sourcing and supply chain operations. Our business activities include: 

- Sustainable building solutions through advanced AAC walls and blocks designed to support India's evolving construction industry. 
 - Global sourcing and supply integration, connecting India's manufacturing capabilities with SCG's international business network. 
 - Commitment to quality and operational excellence, focusing on product reliability, manufacturing standards, and continuous improvement. 

For quality engineering professionals, this offers an opportunity to contribute to high-quality building materials, strengthen manufacturing standards, and support sustainable construction solutions in India. 

About the Role

The Quality Assurance Engineer supports product quality assurance, material testing, and quality improvement activities to ensure building materials meet established specifications, customer requirements, and applicable industry standards. 

The role focuses on monitoring product quality, identifying defects, supporting corrective actions, and collaborating with Production and Engineering teams to maintain consistent product performance and reliability. 

Key Responsibilities

- Support quality assurance activities across incoming materials, manufacturing processes, and finished products. 
 - Coordinate product inspections and material testing to ensure compliance with established quality specifications and applicable standards. 
 - Monitor product quality indicators, including dimensional accuracy, density, compressive strength, and other relevant material properties. 
 - Maintain quality inspection records, test reports, and documentation to support traceability and compliance. 
 - Investigate product defects and non-conformities, conduct root cause analysis, and coordinate corrective and preventive actions. 
 - Collaborate with Production, Engineering, and relevant teams to address quality issues and improve product consistency. 
 - Support quality audits, quality management system activities, and continuous improvement initiatives. 
 - Analyze quality performance data and recommend improvements to reduce defects, minimize rework, and enhance customer satisfaction. 

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering, Materials Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field. 
 - 0-3 years of experience in quality assurance, quality control, material testing, or manufacturing quality; new graduates are welcome. 
 - Basic understanding of quality assurance principles, manufacturing processes, and material testing methods. 
 - Familiarity with construction materials, concrete products, AAC blocks, or related building materials is an advantage. 
 - Basic knowledge of quality management systems, including ISO 9001, and relevant Indian Standards (BIS) is preferred. 
 - Strong analytical, problem-solving, and attention-to-detail skills. 
 - Good communication and coordination skills, with the ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams. 
 - Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel. 
 - Good command of English, both written and spoken. 
 - Proactive, responsible, and eager to learn, with a strong interest in product quality and continuous improvement. 

Career Development

This role provides opportunities to develop expertise in quality assurance, quality management systems, product testing, manufacturing excellence, and continuous improvement, supporting career growth within SCG's building materials and international business network.

At EY, we're dedicated to helping our clients, from start-ups to Fortune 500 companies - and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.

 - Ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams and adapt to a fast-paced, target-driven environment.

data.title: Vice President of Software Engineering
data.description:
Job Summary

The Vice President - Software Engineering is responsible for leading the design, development, delivery, and continuous evolution of the MADTECH. AI platform. This role provides strategic and technical leadership to multiple engineering teams responsible for building scalable, secure, cloud-native B2B SaaS products. 

The ideal candidate is an accomplished engineering leader with deep expertise in software architecture, cloud platforms, AI-enabled applications, data engineering, DevOps, and modern engineering practices. This individual will build high-performing engineering teams, establish engineering excellence, drive innovation, and ensure timely delivery of high-quality products while working closely with Product Management, AI/ML, Data Engineering, QA, Customer Success, and Business leadership. 

Key Responsibilities

Engineering Strategy & Technology Leadership

- Define and execute the engineering strategy aligned with the organization's business and product objectives. 
 - Establish engineering standards, architectural principles, coding best practices, and software development governance. 
 - Drive technology modernization and adoption of emerging technologies including AI, Generative AI, cloud-native platforms, and automation. 
 - Develop long-term technology roadmaps to ensure scalability, maintainability, and security. 

Software Engineering Leadership

- Lead multiple engineering teams responsible for backend, frontend, platform engineering, integrations, and DevOps. 
 - Ensure successful delivery of high-quality software products within timelines and budget. 
 - Oversee software architecture, technical design, implementation, testing, deployment, and production support. 
 - Drive engineering productivity through Agile delivery methodologies and engineering metrics. 

Architecture & Platform Engineering

- Provide technical leadership for scalable microservices architecture and distributed systems. 
 - Guide architectural decisions across cloud infrastructure, APIs, data platforms, AI services, and integrations. 
 - Ensure platform scalability, performance, availability, reliability, and security. 
 - Lead architecture reviews and technology evaluations. 

Engineering Operations & Delivery Excellence

- Improve engineering processes, SDLC, CI/CD pipelines, release management, and deployment automation. 
 - Implement DevSecOps best practices. 
 - Monitor engineering KPIs including
 - Velocity
 - Quality
 - Reliability
 - Deployment frequency
 - MTTR
 - Engineering efficiency
 - Ensure operational excellence through observability, monitoring, incident management, and root cause analysis. 

AI & Data Engineering Enablement

- Collaborate with AI/ML teams to integrate intelligent capabilities into the platform. 
 - Enable scalable data pipelines, APIs, AI agents, RAG architectures, and GenAI applications. 
 - Promote engineering practices that support analytics, automation, and customer intelligence. 

Cross-functional Collaboration

- Partner closely with Product Management to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions. 
 - Collaborate with QA, Security, DevOps, Customer Success, Sales Engineering, and Product teams throughout the product lifecycle. 
 - Support customer escalations requiring engineering leadership. 

People Leadership

- Recruit, mentor, coach, and retain world-class engineering talent. 
 - Build a culture of ownership, innovation, collaboration, accountability, and continuous learning. 
 - Develop engineering managers and technical leads. 
 - Drive performance management, succession planning, and career development. 

Technical Expertise

- Strong expertise in designing and developing scalable, secure, cloud-native B2B SaaS applications using modern software engineering principles and best practices. 
 - Deep understanding of software architecture, including microservices, distributed systems, event-driven architecture, API-first design, and multi-tenant platforms. 
 - Proficiency in cloud platforms, with hands-on experience in AWS (mandatory); exposure to Azure and GCP is preferred. Strong knowledge of containerization technologies such as Docker, Kubernetes, Amazon EKS, and modern CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Extensive experience with modern software development technologies and frameworks such as Java, Python, Node. js, React, Angular, TypeScript, and related technologies. 
 - Strong understanding of AI/ML and Generative AI technologies, including AI Agents, LangChain, LangGraph, RAG architectures, MCP (Model Context Protocol), TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn, and LLM integrations. 
 - Experience with data engineering, including SQL, data warehousing, ETL/ELT, reverse ETL, data modeling, data lakes, and large-scale data processing frameworks. 
 - Strong knowledge of RESTful APIs, GraphQL, event-driven architectures, Kafka, webhooks, third-party integrations, and modern integration frameworks. 
 - Experience implementing DevSecOps practices, Infrastructure as Code (Terraform/CloudFormation), automated testing, release management, monitoring, logging, observability, and production support. 
 - Expertise in Agile software development methodologies, including Scrum, Kanban, Jira, engineering planning, sprint execution, and continuous delivery. 
 - Strong understanding of software quality engineering, secure coding practices, performance optimization, scalability, reliability engineering, and engineering governance. 

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline. Master's degree preferred. 
 - 15+ years of software engineering experience, with at least 8 years leading large engineering teams. 
 - Proven experience delivering enterprise-scale B2B SaaS products. 
 - Strong hands-on background in software architecture, cloud platforms, distributed systems, APIs, and modern application development. 
 - Experience leading engineering organizations of 30+ engineers across multiple functional teams. 
 - Strong understanding of AI/ML technologies, cloud-native applications, and modern software engineering practices. 
 - Experience working with global customers across the US, UK, Australia, and MENA markets. 
 - Demonstrated success in building high-performing engineering organizations. 
 - Excellent leadership, communication, stakeholder management, and decision-making skills. 
 - Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth technology environment. 
 - Willing to work from Mysuru or Bengaluru. 

Why MADTECH. AI?

Join us in building the future of AI-powered Marketing Decision Intelligence. 

At MADTECH. AI, we're developing a next-generation B2B SaaS platform that brings together AI, advanced analytics, cloud technologies, and intelligent automation to help organizations make faster, smarter, and data-driven business decisions. 

As the VP - Software Engineering, you will have the opportunity to shape the technical vision of our platform, lead high-performing engineering teams, and influence the architecture of products used by global customers. You'll work on cutting-edge technologies, solve complex engineering challenges, and foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and engineering excellence. 

If you're passionate about building scalable SaaS products, mentoring exceptional engineering talent, and making a meaningful impact in a fast-growing AI company, MADTECH. AI offers the opportunity to innovate, lead, and grow with us.

data.title: Production Engineering Manager
data.description:
Manager - Manufacturing & QC

SP Ultraflex Systems Pvt. Ltd. , a leading manufacturer of advanced Slitter Rewinders and Web Inspection & Rewinding Machines, seeks a technically proficient, hands-on and authoritative professional to lead its Mechanical Manufacturing and Quality Control functions. 

Our machines are continuously evolving through technological innovation, design enhancements and new component developments. The role demands strong engineering fundamentals, adaptability and the ability to rapidly understand and implement new designs, components and manufacturing processes. 

Key Responsibilities

- Lead and oversee all stages of mechanical manufacturing: 
 - Erection Stage: Fabrication, structural alignment, dimensional accuracy and workmanship. 
 - Paint Stage: Surface preparation, painting processes, finish quality and inspection. 
 - Assembly Stage: Precision assembly, alignment, fitting and integration of critical mechanical components. 
 - Apply strong mechanical engineering knowledge to resolve technical challenges, interpret evolving designs and translate engineering changes into effective manufacturing practices. 
 - Provide decisive shop-floor leadership, enforcing discipline, accountability, productivity and quality standards. 
 - Drive timely execution of production schedules, optimize manpower utilization and minimize rework. 
 - Establish robust quality control practices across all manufacturing stages. 
 - Develop structured induction training for new recruits and continuous technical training, skill enhancement and multiskilling of existing personnel. 
 - Mentor supervisors and workers, building a technically competent, disciplined and high-performing workforce. 
 - Coordinate effectively with Design, PPC, Purchase and Automation teams to ensure seamless implementation of new designs and components. Candidate Profile

- Degree/Diploma in Mechanical Engineering. 
 - 12-20 years of relevant experience in low-volume, customized machinery manufacturing, preferably capital equipment, special-purpose machinery, printing/converting machinery or precision engineering. 
 - Strong practical knowledge of mechanical engineering, fabrication, precision assembly, alignment, tolerances and manufacturing quality standards. 
 - Demonstrated experience in managing fabrication/erection, painting and critical mechanical assembly operations. 
 - Ability to quickly comprehend new engineering designs, adapt manufacturing methods and guide teams through continuous product and process changes. 
 - Proven ability to independently lead shop-floor teams, enforce performance standards and deliver measurable productivity and quality improvements. 
 - Strong leadership presence, assertiveness, decisiveness and the ability to command respect while maintaining a fair and professional work environment. 
 - Excellent technical problem-solving, people management and execution skills. IMPORTANT - INDUSTRY EXPERIENCE

data.title: Senior Software Engineer
data.description:
At NiCE, we don't limit our challenges. We challenge our limits. Always. We're ambitious. We're game changers. And we play to win. We set the highest standards and execute beyond them. And if you're like us, we can offer you the ultimate career opportunity that will light a fire within you. 

So, what's the role all about?

NiCE is building SPARK, a new internal incubation team that turns great ideas from across CX International into working AI solutions, and then into enterprise-grade tools that roll out to colleagues around the world. We are looking for builders who understand the business as well as the code. 

As Technical AI Architect & Builder, you will design and build the AI solutions that SPARK brings to life. You combine real business knowledge with solid software engineering: you understand how sales, service, support, and operations teams actually work, and you know how to take an idea through the full software development lifecycle to a solution people use every day. 

You will work as part of a small team of senior builders, led by the Senior Technical AI Architect & Builder, with significant ownership of the solutions you deliver. You will partner closely with the Business Analyst and the Project Manager. 

How will you make an impact?

You will design and build the AI solutions at the heart of SPARK, owning them from the first prototype through hardening and handover, working with the Senior Technical AI Architect & Builder, the Business Analyst, and the Project Manager. 

Design Solutions that Fit the Business

- Work with the Business Analyst and business teams to understand the process, the users, and the outcome, and shape a solution design that fits how people actually work
 - Translate use cases into solution architectures covering agents, retrieval, integrations, data flows, and user experience
 - Choose the right approach for each problem, whether that is an AI agent, a workflow automation, a prompt-based assistant, or a conventional software fix
 - Estimate effort and flag technical risks early to the Project Manager

Build and Ship

- Build working prototypes and production-grade solutions using LLM APIs, agent frameworks, and RAG pipelines
 - Work with IT to develop integrations, APIs, and services that connect AI solutions to enterprise systems such as Salesforce, Snowflake, Power BI, ServiceNow, Workday, and Microsoft 365
 - Apply prompt engineering and context design that deliver reliable results, and iterate on user feedback
 - Write clean, tested, documented code and keep it in well-organised shared repositories
 - Optimize solution costs

Engineer for Quality and Scale

- Apply the full SDLC to every solution (design, build, test, release, and support), using Git workflows, code review, and CI/CD pipelines
 - Build automated evaluations and regression tests so quality is measured, not assumed
 - Add logging, monitoring, and cost tracking so solutions can be run and supported in production
 - Follow the security, privacy, and responsible AI standards set with the Senior Technical AI Architect & Builder and NiCE's security teams
 - Ensue audit trails are included and follow the discussed solutions on agreed guardrails measure. 

Hand Over and Improve

- Prepare documentation, runbooks, and demos for the Support Helpdesk, the Change Management & Evangelist, and the business teams who will use each solution
 - Use feedback and recurring support issues to fix, improve, and extend solutions after launch
 - Share patterns and reusable components that make the next build faster

Have you got what it takes?

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience
 - 6-8 years of software development experience across the full SDLC, building enterprise-grade, scalable software
 - 2+ years of hands-on experience building LLM-powered applications, such as RAG pipelines, agents, tool use, or prompt-engineered assistants
 - Proficiency in Python and/or TypeScript, with strong knowledge of REST APIs, JSON, and async or event-driven design
 - Solid business knowledge: experience working closely with functions such as sales, customer service, operations, or finance, and the ability to turn their needs into working software
 - Experience with at least one agent or orchestration framework (LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, or equivalent) and with vector databases or search
 - Practical experience with a major cloud platform (Azure, AWS, or GCP)
 - Solid Git workflow, code review, testing, and CI/CD practices
 - Ability to work with autonomy in a small, fast-moving team with evolving requirements
 - Fluency in English

You will have an advantage if you also have: 

- Experience implementing MCP servers or clients, and integrating with enterprise systems
 - Familiarity with the Anthropic Claude API and tool-use patterns
 - Background in CX, contact centre, CCaaS, or enterprise SaaS environments, with exposure to Cognigy or NiCE CXone
 - Experience with LLM evaluation frameworks and observability tooling
 - Experience with low-code or agent-building platforms such as Claude, Microsoft Copilot Studio
 - Experience in workflow applications such as N8N or similar

What's in it for you?

SPARK is a chance to be a founding member of a brand-new team, and to shape how NiCE turns AI ideas into everyday tools used by colleagues around the world. 

Join an ever-growing, market-disrupting, global company where the teams, comprised of the best of the best, work in a fast-paced, collaborative, and creative environment! As the market leader, every day at NiCE is a chance to learn and grow, and there are endless internal career opportunities across multiple roles, disciplines, domains, and locations. If you are passionate about AI, innovative at heart, and excited to constantly raise the bar on what intelligent technology can do, you may just be our next NiCEr!

Enjoy NiCE-FLEX!

At NiCE, we work according to the NiCE-FLEX hybrid model, which enables maximum flexibility: 2 days working from the office and 3 days of remote work, each week. Naturally, office days focus on face-to-face meetings, where teamwork and collaborative thinking generate innovation, new ideas, and a vibrant, interactive atmosphere. 

Requisition ID- 11875

Reporting into: VP, Business Operations

Role Type: Individual Contributor

About NiCE

NICE Ltd. (NASDAQ: NICE) software products are used by 25, 000+ global businesses, including 85 of the Fortune 100 corporations, to deliver extraordinary customer experiences, fight financial crime and ensure public safety. Every day, NiCE software manages more than 120 million customer interactions and monitors 3+ billion financial transactions. 

Known as an innovation powerhouse that excels in AI, cloud and digital, NiCE is consistently recognized as the market leader in its domains, with over 8, 500 employees across 30+ countries. 

NiCE is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, neurotype, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation or any other category protected by law.

Manager, Embedded Software Engineering

Role Purpose

This exciting opportunity is created to build and lead a growing embedded software team in Bangalore, shaping its technical capability, ways of working and contribution to global product development. The successful candidate will recruit and develop a team that can scale up rapidly in the medium term, while building strong partnerships across software, electronics, hardware and product teams in Europe, Asia and the US. With a focus on delivery, engineering quality and continuous learning, the successful candidate will help the team make a lasting impact on industrial products. 

Role Responsibilities

- Recruit, onboard and develop the Bangalore embedded software team, building the structure and capabilities to scale up rapidly in the medium term. 
 - Provide functional and disciplinary leadership, set clear priorities and create an environment where engineers can do their best work. 
 - Build effective working relationships with global software, hardware, electronics and product teams across Europe, Asia and the US.

 - Facilitate cross-site technical decisions, planning and prioritisation, and resolve or escalate conflicts when priorities diverge.

data.title: Director / Vice President – SaaS Production Operations, SRE & Security
data.description:
Director / Vice President - SaaS Production Operations, SRE & Security

Location: Chennai, India (relocation support available)

Experience: 15+ years

Leadership Scope: Production Operations, Cloud Infrastructure, SRE, DevSecOps, Security Engineering and ISMS

Role Overview

We are seeking a senior technology leader to own end-to-end production operations, reliability engineering, cloud infrastructure and security engineering for a business-critical, customer-facing SaaS platform. 

This is a hands-on leadership role requiring proven experience running live SaaS production environments, managing 24×7 operations, meeting customer SLAs, leading major incidents and building proactive security engineering capabilities. 

The successful candidate will lead an established Cloud Operations and Information Security Management System (ISMS) organization, strengthen its technical capabilities and drive measurable improvements in reliability, security, automation and operational efficiency. 

We are looking for a proven production operations leader-not someone whose experience is limited to enterprise IT infrastructure, architecture, product development or compliance management. 

Key Responsibilities

1. SaaS Production Operations & Reliability

- Own end-to-end operational reliability, availability, performance and support for customer-facing SaaS platforms. 
 - Lead 24×7 application monitoring, production support, on-call operations, escalation management and customer SLA adherence. 
 - Establish and manage SLOs, SLIs, error budgets, observability and reliability improvement programs. 
 - Personally lead critical production incidents, coordinate technical response, conduct root cause analysis (RCA) and drive preventive actions. 
 - Improve incident frequency, Mean Time to Recovery (MTTR), change success rates and production stability. 
 - Establish effective capacity planning, performance optimization, release safety and operational readiness practices. 2. Cloud Infrastructure & Platform Engineering

- Own cloud architecture, provisioning, infrastructure operations and platform resilience. 
 - Manage cloud environments across OCI, AWS, Azure or GCP, with OCI experience preferred. 
 - Oversee Kubernetes, virtual machines, microservices infrastructure, cloud networking and databases. 
 - Drive Infrastructure as Code (IaC), policy as code, configuration automation and standardized provisioning. 
 - Own disaster recovery, backup and restoration testing, business continuity and infrastructure cost optimization through FinOps. 3. Security Engineering & Proactive Risk Prevention

- Lead hands-on security engineering across IAM, privileged access, secrets management, API authorization and multi-tenant isolation. 
 - Establish continuous vulnerability identification, risk prioritization, remediation SLAs and security verification. 
 - Drive cloud security posture management, security monitoring, threat detection and security incident response. 
 - Own penetration-testing programs and ensure identified vulnerabilities are remediated within defined timelines. 
 - Embed security controls into production operations and software delivery rather than relying solely on periodic audits. 4. DevSecOps & Secure Delivery

- Partner with software Engineering to integrate automated security controls into CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Implement SAST, DAST, SCA, secret scanning, container security and Infrastructure as Code scanning. 
 - Establish security gates, remediation SLAs, exception management and measurable security engineering outcomes. 
 - Enable secure and efficient releases without introducing unnecessary manual bottlenecks. 5. ISMS, Compliance & Customer Assurance

- Lead operational implementation of ISO 27001, ISO 27017, ISO 27018 and SOC 2 controls. 
 - Ensure controls are continuously enforced and validated across production systems. 
 - Manage customer security assessments, audit readiness, risk registers and corrective actions. 
 - Build an integrated operating model where security engineering and compliance work together, with technical risk reduction as the priority. 6. Automation & AI-Driven Operations

- Drive AIOps adoption for anomaly detection, event correlation, predictive monitoring and incident response automation. 
 - Reduce manual operational effort through scripting, workflow automation and intelligent monitoring. 
 - Establish production security controls for AI agents, including identity, tool authorization, execution isolation, audit trails and human approval for high-risk actions. 7. Organization Leadership & Transformation

- Lead and develop the existing Cloud Operations, SRE and ISMS organization, including managers and senior technical leaders. 
 - Establish clear ownership, operational KPIs, escalation structures and accountability across teams. 
 - Identify capability gaps, recruit critical talent and develop a technically strong leadership pipeline. 
 - Drive operational transformation through automation, engineering discipline, measurable service improvements and continuous learning. 
 - Report production reliability, security exposure, major incidents, remediation progress and infrastructure efficiency to executive leadership. Mandatory Requirements

- 15+ years of overall technology experience, with substantial experience in production operations, SRE, cloud infrastructure or security engineering leadership. 
 - Proven leadership of a customer-facing SaaS product or platform in a live production environment. 
 - Direct accountability for 24×7 application monitoring, customer SLAs, production reliability and major incident management. 
 - Demonstrated experience personally leading critical production incidents and implementing corrective and preventive actions. 
 - Strong technical leadership experience managing managers, senior engineers and multi-disciplinary teams. 
 - Hands-on expertise in at least one major cloud platform: OCI, AWS, Azure or GCP. 
 - Strong understanding of Kubernetes, microservices, networking, databases, infrastructure automation and disaster recovery. 
 - Practical security engineering experience covering IAM, secrets management, API authorization, vulnerability management and security incident response. 
 - Experience implementing DevSecOps controls and automated security testing within CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Demonstrated success in improving an existing organization's processes, reliability, security posture and operational performance. Preferred Experience

- Multi-tenant SaaS products in insurance, fintech, financial services or other regulated industries. 
 - OCI architecture and operations. 
 - ISO 27001, ISO 27017, ISO 27018 and SOC 2 control implementation in production environments. 
 - AIOps implementation and AI-agent security in production. 
 - Experience scaling engineering organizations and driving operational transformation. First-Year Success Measures

First 90 days

- Establish baseline reliability, incident, security and cloud cost metrics. 
 - Identify operational and security risks, with clear owners and remediation timelines. 
 - Deliver a prioritized 12-month transformation roadmap. Within 12 months

- Demonstrate measurable improvements in production incident frequency, MTTR, vulnerability exposure time and cloud cost efficiency. 
 - Establish automated security gates and tenant-isolation testing. 
 - Complete a successful disaster recovery test. 
 - Strengthen operational ownership, incident prevention, security automation and team effectiveness. Candidate Application Requirements

Please provide specific examples demonstrating: 

- A major production incident you personally led on a customer-facing SaaS platform, including business impact, your role and corrective actions. 
 - A security engineering initiative or security incident you led, including tools used, vulnerabilities addressed and remediation timelines. 
 - Your current leadership structure, including direct reports, managers reporting to you, total team size and budget responsibility. 
 - Whether your production platform was a product sold to customers or a service delivered to a client. Candidates should be prepared to discuss measurable outcomes and their personal accountability for production reliability and security. 

Ideal candidate: A senior production operator who combines strong technical depth, executive leadership, customer-facing SaaS operations ownership, SRE, proactive security engineering and organizational transformation experience.

data.title: Principal Validation Engineer
data.description:
Renesas is a global semiconductor leader shaping the backbone of next‐generation automotive, industrial, cloud, and IoT innovation. With over $9. 3 billion in annual revenue (2024) and a world‐class team of 22, 700+ employees, Renesas operates at scale while retaining the agility to drive category‐defining breakthroughs. The company's footprint spans more than 30 countries, enabling deep customer proximity and a uniquely global innovative engine. As Japan's semiconductor powerhouse and a top global player in microcontrollers, analog, and power technologies, Renesas delivers real‐world impact across EVs, smart factories, renewable energy infrastructure, and edge intelligence. For ambitious problem‐solvers who want to work on meaningful, systems‐level challenges with huge industry leverage, Renesas offers the scale, stability, and strategic clarity of a market leader-paired with the transformative momentum of a company reinventing how the world computes, connects, and electrifies. 

Renesas has a growing presence in India with HC approaching 1000+ and significant presence with active government and university collaboration as well as OSAT footprint (JV with CG India). With the growing importance of India as a market (Growing semiconductor market and government goals / mandates of localization needs) and talent hub, our division's (India for India) mission is to grow India market. We aspire to create products (SoCs, Software, Power and Analog chips etc) which serve needs for local market. Renesas is a leading electronics supplier globally, and this is a unique opportunity to directly influence the future products which will be offered to our customers in a new, fast growing and large Indian market with specific needs and applications. 

Job Description

Renesas is looking for a Principal SoC Validation Engineer, to redefine how SoCs are built and validated-driving first‐time‐right silicon, eliminating customer escapes, and setting a new industry benchmark for validation excellence

Key Responsibilities

- Define and own the end‐to‐end silicon validation strategy for automotive and Embedded SoCs, from pre‐silicon enablement through post‐silicon production release. 
 - Ensure first‐time‐right silicon, robust validation coverage, and zero customer escapes across all assigned programs. 
 - Lead global validation teams responsible for silicon bring‐up, characterization, and system‐level validation across multiple concurrent programs. 
 - Establish and drive a System Use Case Validation Program, harvesting real customer/OEM and system scenarios and converting them into automated, traceable validation suites. 
 - Influence SoC architecture, design, and program decisions through early validation insights, risk identification, and data‐backed recommendations. 
 - Drive shift‐left validation as a measurable engineering program, increasing reuse across simulation, emulation/FPGA, and silicon to reduce late surprises. 
 - Own escape‐prevention strategy, including robustness testing, fault scenarios, coverage models, and disciplined validation signoff criteria. 
 - Build and scale high‐performing validation organizations, developing strong technical leadership (Staff/Principal pipeline) and execution ownership. 
 - Lead automation, standardization, and infrastructure modernization across validation labs, board farms, and CI systems. 
 - Establish validation methodologies, quality benchmarks, metrics, and dashboards aligned with Renesas standards and automotive expectations. 
 - Identify technical, execution, and program risks early; drive data‐driven mitigation and executive decision‐making. 
 - Provide clear executive‐level reporting on validation status, risks, readiness, and outcomes. 
 - Act as a trusted partner to Design, DV, Test, Firmware, Software, Product Engineering, Quality, and BU leadership. 
 - Adoption of industry best practices as a measurable program

Qualifications

Required Skills & Experience

- B. E. /B. Tech or M. E. /M. Tech in Electronics, Electrical, or Computer Engineering, or equivalent industry experience. 
 - 15+ years of experience in semiconductor validation, characterization, or silicon engineering, with demonstrated ownership of silicon quality outcomes. 
 - 3+ years in senior technical leadership roles 
 - Strong domain expertise in SoC validation, system‐level use‐case testing, and robustness validation. 
 - Proven experience delivering complex SoC programs from first silicon through production release. 
 - Deep understanding of silicon validation flows, lab environments, and post‐silicon debug ecosystems. 
 - Demonstrated success building and scaling automation‐first validation frameworks using Python, C++, or similar technologies. 
 - Strong experience driving cross‐functional execution in a matrixed, global environment. 
 - Excellent executive communication, stakeholder management, and decision‐making skills. 
 - Experience with AI frameworks for SoC Validation efficiency and quality gain- eg validation specific AI agents, Cody AI for content development etc. Preferred

- Experience with ISO 26262 / ASIL‐B development and validation environments. 
 - Exposure to emulation/FPGA‐based shift‐left validation and pre↔post silicon continuity models. 
 - Strong foundation in mixed‐signal and digital silicon validation, including pattern‐based and system‐level methodologies. 
 - Track record of institutionalizing industry best practices across multiple programs and organizations. 
 - Experience leading culture change toward proactive risk ownership, evidence‐based closure, and challenge‐ready execution. 
 - Automotive OEM or Tier‐1 customer engagement experience. 

Additional Information

Renesas is an embedded semiconductor solution provider driven by its Purpose, To Make Our Lives Easier. With a global team of over 21, 000 engineers and problem solvers in more than 30 countries, we offer the opportunity to work on world‐leading technology for Automotive, Industrial, Infrastructure, and IoT, shaping a safer, healthier, greener, and smarter future. 

At Renesas, TAGIE is our culture, grounded in being Transparent, Agile, Global, Innovative, and Entrepreneurial. It shapes how we work, grow and deliver on our purpose together. This collaborative spirit and mindset drive our semiconductor technology to transform industries and impact millions of lives. 

We believe in rewarding our employees with a competitive benefits package alongside their salary. More information will be provided during the hiring process. 

Are you ready to join our team and shape the future with us?

Renesas Electronics is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer, committed to supporting diversity and fostering a work environment free of discrimination on the basis of sex, race, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, military status, veteran status, or any other basis protected by law. data.title: Validation Engineer – Post Silicon Functional Validation, Compute Subsystem (CSS)
data.description:
About The Team

The Compute Subsystem (CSS) team at Arm designs and delivers integrated, validated compute subsystems that serve as reference platforms for Arm-based SoCs. The team collaborates across CPU, interconnect, memory, and IO IP teams to build efficient, high-performance solutions targeting client, infrastructure, and automotive markets. 

The Functional Validation Team ensures that Arm's compute subsystems meet quality, performance, and functionality expectations through comprehensive pre-silicon and post-silicon validation across the product lifecycle. 

Role Overview

As a Validation Engineer, you will be responsible for developing, executing, and improving validation methodologies for Arm's compute subsystems IPs both before and after silicon bring-up. You will work closely with design, verification, emulation and customer enablement teams to ensure robust validation coverage and early detection of complex system-level issues. 

or

As a Validation Engineer in the Compute Sub-System (CSS) team, you will be responsible for validating key subsystem IPs and platform functionality across the pre-silicon and post-silicon lifecycle. You will develop validation solutions, execute comprehensive test plans, debug complex hardware/software issues, and collaborate closely with Architecture, Design, DV, Firmware, and Software teams to ensure high-quality silicon delivery. 

Key Responsibilities

- Develop and execute pre-silicon and post-silicon validation plans for Arm's compute subsystems. 
 - Build and enhance test environments, automation frameworks, and validation infrastructure using emulation and silicon platforms. 
 - Perform system-level functional validation, focusing on CPU clusters, coherent interconnects, memory controllers, and peripheral integration. 
 - Drive root-cause analysis of hardware, firmware, and software issues, collaborating with cross-functional teams. 
 - Develop diagnostic, stress, and performance workloads to validate system functionality, power, and performance. 
 - Support silicon bring-up and debug activities, including board-level testing and post-silicon lab validation. 
 - Analyse coverage gaps and contribute to improving validation efficiency and quality metrics. 
 - Contribute to automation and continuous integration for validation workflows. 

Required Skills And Experience

- 1-3 years of relevant industry experience in SoC, subsystem, or IP-level functional validation. 
 - Strong understanding of ARM based SoC architecture, AMBA protocols (AXI/ACE/CHI), cache coherency, and CPU subsystems. 
 - Proficiency in C/C++ and scripting languages (Python) for test automation and analysis. 
 - Experience with hardware validation tools (logic analyzers, oscilloscopes, JTAG debuggers) and pre-silicon simulation/emulation environments. 
 - Solid understanding of pre-silicon verification techniques and post-silicon validation challenges. 
 - Familiarity with C based IP drivers and firmware for system-level bring-up and validation. 
 - Strong analytical and debugging skills; ability to triage complex hardware/software interactions. 

Our 10x Mindset

At Arm, we believe progress happens when people are empowered to think bigger and push beyond what seems possible. Our 10x mindset is about curiosity, ambition and creating impact that will be used by millions. We learn fast, prioritise collaboration and turn bold ideas into real technology. We look for people who are inspired by this way of working and want to grow in an environment where bold ideas are welcomed. Discover how the 10x mindset shapes life at Arm: https: //careers. arm. com/10x-mindset

Use of AI in Your Application

At Arm, we embrace the benefits AI can bring, including in recruitment. You may use AI to support your preparation, such as improving the clarity of written responses, practicing interview questions, or learning more about our industry. However, your application and interview responses must reflect your own thinking, experience, and abilities. We want to understand your authentic perspective, creativity, and approach to problem solving. As such, you may not use AI to complete assigned tasks as part of any assessments. If you plan to use AI-supported or assistive technologies as part of a reasonable adjustment, please contact accommodations@arm. com so we can support you. 

Recruitment Adjustments and Accommodations

At Arm, we want to build extraordinary teams. If you need an adjustment or an accommodation during the recruitment process, please email accommodations@arm. com . To note, by sending us the requested information, you consent to its use by Arm to arrange for appropriate accommodations. All accommodation or adjustment requests will be treated with confidentiality, and information concerning these requests will only be disclosed as necessary to provide the accommodation. Although this is not an exhaustive list, examples of support include breaks between interviews, having documents read aloud, or office accessibility. Please email us about anything we can do to accommodate you during the recruitment process. 

Hybrid Working

Arm's approach to hybrid working is designed to create a working environment that supports both high performance and personal wellbeing. We believe in bringing people together face to face to enable us to work at pace, whilst recognizing the value of flexibility. Within that framework, we empower groups/teams to determine their own hybrid working patterns, depending on the work and the team's needs. Details of what this means for each role will be shared upon application. In some cases, the flexibility we can offer is limited by local legal, regulatory, tax, or other considerations, and where this is the case, we will collaborate with you to find the best solution. Please talk to us to find out more about what this could look like for you. 

Equal Opportunities

Arm is an equal opportunity employer, committed to providing an environment of mutual respect where equal opportunities are available to all applicants and colleagues. We are a diverse organization of dedicated and innovative individuals, and don't discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

data.title: Advanced Software Engr
data.description:
Job Description

We are looking for an experienced Senior Test Automation Engineer with 7+ years of hands-on experience in software testing, with strong expertise in both Test Automation and Functional Testing. 

The ideal candidate will have demonstrated experience designing and developing scalable automation solutions using technologies such as Selenium, Playwright, Python, TypeScript, and Java. The candidate should be comfortable working in an Agile product development environment and collaborating closely with Development, QA/Test, Product, and DevOps teams throughout the software development lifecycle. 

This is a hands-on engineering role requiring strong technical skills, quality ownership, analytical thinking, and excellent communication. 

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

- Design, develop, maintain, and enhance automated test frameworks and test suites for web and enterprise applications. 
 - Develop reliable and maintainable automation using Selenium and/or Playwright. 
 - Write automation code using Python, TypeScript, and/or Java. 
 - Perform functional, integration, regression, system, and end-to-end testing as required. 
 - Analyze product requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and technical designs to identify appropriate test coverage. 
 - Develop comprehensive Test Strategies, Test Plans, test scenarios, and test cases based on functional and technical requirements. 
 - Define the appropriate balance between automated and manual/functional testing based on risk, complexity, and business impact. 
 - Identify opportunities to improve automation coverage, test execution efficiency, reliability, and defect detection. 
 - Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and work with tools such as GitHub and GitHub Actions. 
 - Investigate automation failures, perform root-cause analysis, and distinguish between application defects, environment issues, test-data issues, and automation defects. 
 - Participate actively in Agile ceremonies including Sprint Planning, Backlog Refinement, Daily Stand-ups, Sprint Reviews, and Retrospectives. 
 - Collaborate effectively with Developers, Test Engineers, Product Owners/Product Managers, and DevOps Engineers to ensure quality throughout the development lifecycle. 
 - Participate in defect triage and communicate quality risks, dependencies, blockers, and release-readiness concerns clearly to stakeholders. 
 - Contribute to continuous improvement of the team's testing processes, automation architecture, coding standards, and overall quality engineering practices. 
 - Use modern AI-assisted engineering tools such as GitHub Copilot to improve engineering productivity while following appropriate code-review, security, and quality practices. 
 - Mentor and support other test engineers by sharing automation and quality engineering best practices. 

Qualifications

Required Skills & Experience

- 7+ years of professional experience in Software Testing / Quality Engineering, including significant hands-on experience in automation. 
 - Strong expertise in Test Automation and automation framework development. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with Selenium and/or Playwright. 
 - Strong programming/scripting skills in at least one of the following: 
 - Python 
 - TypeScript 
 - Java 
 - Strong experience in Functional Testing, including requirements analysis, test design, test execution, defect identification, and regression testing. 
 - Experience designing and documenting a comprehensive Test Strategy for a product, application, release, or major feature. 
 - Good understanding of SDLC, STLC, Agile, and Scrum practices. 
 - Experience working within Agile/Scrum teams and delivering quality software across multiple sprints/releases. 
 - Hands-on experience with Git and GitHub for source-control and collaborative development. 
 - Experience with GitHub Actions or equivalent CI/CD solutions for automated test execution. 
 - Exposure to GitHub Copilot or other AI-assisted software engineering/testing tools. 
 - Ability to analyze automation failures and debug issues across application, automation, API, test-data, and environment layers. 
 - Good understanding of test design techniques, defect lifecycle, regression strategy, risk-based testing, and test coverage. 
 - Proven ability to collaborate effectively across Development, QA, Product, and DevOps teams. 
 - Strong analytical, problem-solving, and troubleshooting skills. 
 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate technical issues and quality risks clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
Preferred / Good-to-Have Skills

- Experience with API testing and API automation, for example REST APIs. 
 - Experience integrating test automation into CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Understanding of modern automation patterns such as Page Object Model, fixtures, reusable test components, test-data management, and parallel execution. 
 - Experience with test reporting and automated quality metrics. 
 - Exposure to testing applications deployed using cloud and containerized environments. 
 - Experience using AI-assisted tools for test-case generation, automation-code development, code review, debugging, or test analysis. 
 - Experience mentoring junior engineers or providing technical guidance on test automation. 
 - Familiarity with non-functional quality considerations such as performance, security, accessibility, reliability, and usability testing would be an advantage. 

Education

- Bachelor's degree in engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related engineering discipline from a recognised institution. 

What We Are Looking For

The successful candidate should be a hands-on Senior Test Engineer, not someone focused only on test coordination or management. We are looking for someone who: 

- Can write automation code, not just execute automated suites. 
 - Has strong functional testing fundamentals in addition to automation expertise. 
 - Can independently define a test strategy and approach for complex features. 
 - Understands quality throughout the complete software development lifecycle. 
 - Can identify what should be automated and what requires exploratory or functional testing. 
 - Is comfortable reviewing requirements and challenging gaps in acceptance criteria and testability. 
 - Can work closely with developers to identify defects early rather than relying only on end-of-sprint testing. 
 - Can collaborate with Product teams to understand customer/business expectations and with DevOps teams to enable reliable automated testing within CI/CD. 
 - Demonstrates ownership, technical depth, attention to detail, and a quality-first mindset. 
 - Communicates clearly, constructively, and confidently across cross-functional teams. 

About Us

Honeywell Technologies is a global, pure-play automation company with a legacy of innovating to help solve the world's most mission-critical challenges, enhancing the quality of life for people and communities around the world. We serve the building, industrial and process sectors with a broad portfolio of services, solutions and products, underpinned by our Honeywell Technologies Accelerator operating system and Honeywell Technologies Forge intelligence layer. By combining the deep domain expertise of our more than 50, 000 employees with decades of data from our global installed base, we are uniquely positioned to lead the industrial sector's transition from automation to autonomy.
