data.title: Lead WLAN Test Engineer
data.description:
Lead WLAN Test Engineer

Location: Bengaluru, India

Experience: 8-12 years

About the Company

Rohde & Schwarz is a telecommunications company working to ensure a safer and connected world. Its business is organized around Test & Measurement, Aerospace & Defense, and Critical Infrastructure & Networks. Across these divisions, the company develops solutions for industrial, regulatory, and government customers facing technology and connectivity challenges. This work places testing, communications, and dependable technical systems at the center of the company's business. Rohde & Schwarz states that it stands for independence, stability, and long-term relationships with customers and partners. These commitments reflect an emphasis on sustained customer and partner engagement alongside its work in technology markets. The company's activities span multiple areas where reliable connectivity and technical performance matter, from measurement and communications to infrastructure and networks. The Bengaluru-based engineering opportunity supports its work in wireless testing and validation within the telecommunications domain, contributing to the development and assessment of WLAN technologies. Rohde & Schwarz operates under its own name and brings together its divisions to address complex connectivity needs across the sectors it serves. 

About the Role

As a full-time, on-site WLAN Test Engineer in Bengaluru, you will lead wireless test strategy and validation in a telecommunications engineering environment. You will develop test plans, build Python-based automation, and assess Wi-Fi performance and RF behavior against relevant 802. 11 standards. The role combines hands-on network and protocol testing with analysis, troubleshooting, and clear documentation of test procedures and findings. You will work with engineering teams to investigate defects and resolve wireless connectivity issues, while mentoring junior test engineers and strengthening test execution. This position suits an experienced engineer with a background in WLAN testing, wireless communications, or RF testing who can take ownership of test quality and help deliver reliable wireless systems. 

Key Responsibilities

- Lead WLAN test strategy development and translate product and validation needs into effective test coverage. Align test priorities with engineering objectives and relevant wireless standards. 
 - Design wireless test plans covering Wi-Fi performance, network behavior, protocols, and RF system validation. Define test scenarios and procedures that support consistent, repeatable execution. 
 - Build and maintain Python test automation frameworks for WLAN validation. Use automation to improve test execution and support reliable assessment of wireless system behavior. 
 - Execute Wi-Fi performance, network, protocol, and RF tests against applicable 802. 11 standards. Record outcomes and identify defects or unexpected system behavior. 
 - Analyze test results and defects, troubleshoot wireless connectivity issues, and support engineering teams in investigating root causes. Communicate findings clearly to enable resolution. 
 - Document test procedures, execution details, and findings to maintain useful validation records. Share relevant results and technical observations with engineering stakeholders. 
 - Collaborate with engineering teams throughout test planning and execution, and mentor junior test engineers. Support effective knowledge sharing and consistent testing practices. 

Essential Skills & Technologies

- Strong WLAN and Wi-Fi testing capability, including practical wireless validation experience. Apply relevant 802. 11 standards when planning and assessing test coverage. 
 - Experience with radio frequency testing and RF system behavior. Evaluate wireless performance and interpret results in the context of system validation. 
 - Python programming skills for building test automation frameworks. Develop automation that supports structured, repeatable WLAN test execution. 
 - Knowledge of network testing and protocol testing for wireless systems. Design and execute test scenarios that assess connectivity and protocol behavior. 
 - Test planning and test execution skills, including designing wireless test plans and carrying them through to documented results. Maintain clarity and consistency across validation activities. 
 - Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills for investigating wireless connectivity issues, reviewing test results, and assessing defects. Explain findings to support engineering resolution. 
 - Bachelor of Technology in Electronics and Communication Engineering, Computer Science, or Electrical and Electronics Engineering. Relevant specialization in WLAN testing, wireless communications, or RF testing. 

Additional Plus

- Experience across telecommunications, telecom or ISP environments, or computers and electronics manufacturing can provide useful context for wireless product validation. 
 - Background in mentoring junior test engineers and collaborating with engineering teams can support effective knowledge sharing and coordinated defect investigation. 

What You'll Bring

- Eight to twelve years of relevant experience in WLAN, wireless communications, or RF testing, with the ability to take ownership of test strategy and validation outcomes. 
 - A Bachelor of Technology in Electronics and Communication Engineering, Computer Science, or Electrical and Electronics Engineering, complemented by relevant wireless or RF specialization. 
 - Practical strength in Python automation, 802. 11 standards, network and protocol testing, test planning, execution, and defect analysis. 
 - Professional English communication skills, sound documentation habits, and the ability to work on-site in Bengaluru while collaborating with engineering teams and mentoring junior colleagues. 

Why Join Us

Join Rohde & Schwarz and contribute to work that supports a safer, connected world. The company operates across Test & Measurement, Aerospace & Defense, and Critical Infrastructure & Networks, developing solutions for industrial, regulatory, and government customers with technology and connectivity challenges. In this engineering role, your work will focus on WLAN strategy, Wi-Fi performance testing, RF validation, and Python test automation. You will help turn test requirements into structured plans, investigate connectivity issues, and communicate findings that engineering teams can act on. The opportunity brings together hands-on wireless testing and technical leadership through collaboration and mentorship. Rohde & Schwarz identifies independence, stability, and long-term relationships with customers and partners as company values. You can apply your experience in a telecommunications environment where connectivity and dependable technical systems are central to the work. The position is full-time and on-site in Bengaluru, with scope to contribute directly to wireless validation and improve the quality and consistency of testing practices. 

What We Offer

- A full-time, on-site engineering opportunity in Bengaluru, focused on WLAN validation, Wi-Fi performance, RF behavior, and test automation. 
 - Ownership of WLAN test strategy and plans, with practical scope to execute testing, analyze defects, and collaborate with engineering teams. 
 - The opportunity to contribute to telecommunications work supporting Rohde & Schwarz's broader focus on connectivity and technology challenges.

data.title: Electrical Design Engineer
data.description:
Job Title: Switchboard Design Engineer / Team Lead

Location: Vadodara / Pune, India

Experience: 10-15+ Years

Function: Electrical Engineering / Design

Industry: Electrical Equipment, Power Distribution, Data Centers

Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced Switchboard Design Engineer / Team Lead with strong expertise in low-voltage switchboard design, UL 891 compliance, and North American electrical standards. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience designing low-voltage switchboards for commercial, industrial, and mission-critical applications, particularly data centers. 

The candidate should possess a thorough understanding of UL 891, NFPA 70 (NEC), applicable NEMA requirements, and North American electrical design practices, along with familiarity with European electrical standards and IEC-based design principles. 

This role combines technical expertise with team leadership. The successful candidate will lead and mentor a team of 4-5 electrical design engineers, oversee engineering deliverables, ensure design quality and regulatory compliance, and collaborate with cross-functional teams and international stakeholders to deliver reliable, high-quality switchboard solutions. 

Key Roles and Responsibilities

1. Switchboard Design and Engineering

2. North American Standards and UL 891 Compliance

3. European Standards and International Engineering

4. Data Center Electrical Infrastructure

5. Team Leadership and Mentoring

6. Design Validation and Quality Assurance

7. Cross-Functional and Global Collaboration

Required Technical Skills

- Strong hands-on experience in low-voltage switchboard and electrical power distribution design. 
 - Demonstrated experience with UL 891-compliant switchboards is essential. 
 - Strong working knowledge of North American electrical standards, including NFPA 70 (NEC), applicable NEMA requirements, and relevant UL standards. 
 - Knowledge of IEC-based design practices and European electrical standards. 
 - Experience with busbar design, circuit breaker selection, protection devices, electrical ratings, and switchboard construction. 
 - Understanding of SCCR, short-circuit withstand requirements, temperature-rise considerations, and electrical safety. 
 - Ability to prepare and review SLDs, schematics, wiring diagrams, GA drawings, and BOMs. 
 - Proficiency in AutoCAD, AutoCAD Electrical, EPLAN, or similar electrical engineering design tools. 
 - Understanding of electrical power distribution systems for data centers, industrial facilities, or other critical infrastructure. 
 - Ability to interpret customer specifications, engineering drawings, and technical standards. 

Leadership and Behavioral Competencies

- Proven experience leading or mentoring a team of 4-5 or more engineers. 
 - Strong technical review, analytical, and problem-solving skills. 
 - Effective project planning, task allocation, and workload management. 
 - Excellent communication and stakeholder management capabilities. 
 - Ability to manage competing priorities and meet project deadlines. 
 - Hands-on approach to engineering leadership and technical decision-making. 
 - Strong commitment to design quality, compliance, and continuous improvement. 

Educational Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or Electrical and Electronics Engineering. 
 - A master's degree or relevant technical certifications will be an advantage. Preferred Experience

- 10-15+ years of overall electrical engineering experience, including substantial experience in low-voltage switchboard design. 
 - Proven hands-on experience with UL 891-compliant switchboard products. 
 - Experience working with North American customers, engineering teams, or projects. 
 - Exposure to IEC-based European projects and international electrical standards. 
 - Experience in data centers, mission-critical facilities, or large industrial power distribution projects. 
 - Background with switchboard manufacturers, electrical equipment OEMs, or engineering-to-order (ETO) organizations. 
 - Experience supporting product testing, certification, design verification, and manufacturing implementation. 
 - Previous experience as a Switchboard Design Lead, Lead Electrical Design Engineer, Senior Electrical Design Engineer, or Electrical Engineering Team Lead.

data.description:
About Skyhigh Security: 

Skyhigh Security is a dynamic, fast-paced cloud company and a leader in data security. Our mission is to protect the world's data, and because of this, we live and breathe security. We value learning at our core, underpinned by openness and transparency. 

Since 2011, organizations have trusted us to provide them with a complete, market-leading security platform built on a modern cloud stack. Our industry-leading suite of products radically simplifies data security through easy-to-use, cloud-based, Zero Trust solutions that are managed in a single dashboard, powered by hundreds of employees across the world. With offices in Aylesbury, Bengaluru, Frisco, Milpitas, Paderborn, Sydney, Tokyo and more, our employees are the heart and soul of our company. 

Key Responsibilities: 

- Keep Production Running: Own Incident, Problem, and Change Management to maintain high availability across our cloud-native security infrastructure (SSE/CASB) and global POPs. 
 - Drive Major Incident Response & PIRs: Lead live troubleshooting during major outages, coordinate across engineering teams to restore service fast, and write thorough Post-Incident Reviews (PIRs) / RCAs to prevent repeat issues. 
 - Cut Alert Noise & Toil: Dig into metrics, logs, and dashboards to spot trends, tune noisy alerts, find performance bottlenecks, and build self-healing automation. 
 - Build Internal Tooling & AI Automation: Write code (Python/Go) and build AI-assisted workflows and agents to automate repetitive operational tasks, incident triage, and diagnostics. 
 - Own Runbooks & SOPs: Write, test, and maintain clear Standard Operating Procedures and runbooks so both on-call engineers and automated tooling have accurate playbooks. 
 - Security & Maintenance: Coordinate planned maintenance windows, production change rollouts, and routine vulnerability patching across commercial and regulated environments. 
 - On-Call Rotation: Participate in a global, follow-the-sun on-call rotation every few weeks to support our 24x7 production environment. Qualifications: 

- Experience & Education: Bachelor's degree with 4-6 years of hands-on experience in SRE, DevOps, or Linux Systems Engineering. 
 - Cloud & Containers: Solid working knowledge of AWS core services and experience running containerized workloads on Kubernetes (EKS). 
 - Linux & Web Infrastructure: Strong Linux systems administration skills and practical experience managing web/proxy servers (Nginx, Apache, Tomcat). 
 - Observability & Incident Tools: Hands-on experience setting up dashboards, queries, and alerts using Prometheus, Grafana, OpenSearch/ELK, CloudWatch, and PagerDuty. 
 - CI/CD & Configuration Management: Day-to-day experience with GitHub, configuration management (Ansible or Salt), and deployment pipelines (Jenkins, Harness, ArgoCD, or GitHub Actions). 
 - Networking Fundamentals: Solid grasp of core networking concepts including TCP/IP, UDP, DNS, proxies, and load balancing. 
 - Coding & Automation: Ability to write clean scripts and automations in Python or Go. Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform or CloudFormation).

- Hands-on network administration or troubleshooting experience in cloud or hybrid environments.

 - Familiarity with workflow orchestration engines like Temporal, Cadence, AWS Step Functions, or Airflow. 
 - Experience using secrets management tools like HashiCorp Vault. 
 - Prior background in the Cloud Security (SSE, CASB, SWG, DLP) domains.

data.title: Senior Manager Manufacturing
data.description:
Job Title: Sr. Manager Manufacturing

Location: Dewasnaka, Indore (MP)

Department: Operations

Reporting to: Director

Job Purpose: 

The Sr Manager - Manufacturing shall be the single point of accountability for all manufacturing

operations across the company's 3 factory units. The role shall own production output, quality, cost, safety, compliance and people performance at every site and ensure that the supply chain from raw material purchase to finished goods despatch runs as one integrated system. 

The person will lead the 3 Factory Operations Heads and the functional leads to drive the scale-up, 

standardisation, automation, cost leadership and a strong safety and compliance culture. 

Job Responsibilities: 

A. Overall Manufacturing Operations Leadership

* Facilitate the finalisation of annual operating plans, production targets, capacity utilisation

objectives, and performance benchmarks for each unit and the functional heads. 

* Translate business plans into unit-wise operational targets, conduct periodic business and

operational reviews to assess achievement of targets, and address performance gaps. 

* Ensure consistency in operating practices and standard operating procedures across units. 

* Identify operational bottlenecks and initiate appropriate corrective actions. 

* Drive operational excellence, process standardisation, cost efficiency, and continuous

improvement across the manufacturing network. 

* Ensure effective coordination between units to balance production requirements, capacity, 

material availability and customer commitments. 

B. Manufacturing Process and Production Management

* Drive the Operations Head of all plants to achieve planned production volumes, specifications

and delivery schedules, optimum productivity, reduction in rejection rates, and appropriate

material consumption. 

* Ensure adherence to approved formulations, process parameters, batch controls and

standard operating procedures, wherever applicable. 

C. Labour Management and Industrial Relations

Mentor the Functional IR Heads in ensuring adequate manpower availability, deployment and

utilisation as well as productivity across manufacturing operations as per shift patterns and

seasonal demand. 

D. Maintenance and Engineering

* Lead the Head of Maintenance in all units to establish preventive, predictive and breakdown

maintenance systems of the entire plant equipment. 

* Evaluate and recommend requisite automation, energy-efficiency initiatives or equipment

updations. 

E. Fire Safety, Occupational Safety, and Emergency Preparedness

* Review the performance of the Safety team on their KPI's to ensure effective implementation

of fire prevention and emergency response systems across units. 

F. Quality Control (QC) and Product Quality

* Lead the Head of QC in establishing and maintaining quality standards for incoming materials, 

in-process production and finished goods in accordance with approved specifications and

sampling procedures. 

* Monitor rejection rates, rework, customer complaints, quality deviations and product

consistency for timely investigation of non-conformities and implementation of corrective

and preventive actions. 

G. Laboratory Management

* Oversee the Laboratory team to ensure reliable and timely testing of raw materials, 

fragrances, binders, bamboo sticks, packaging materials and finished products, as applicable. 

H. Inbound Material Control

* Oversee the GRN function to ensure that all incoming materials are received, verified, 

documented and recorded accurately as per SOP's. 

* Ensure reconciliation of purchase orders, supplier invoices, delivery challans, physical

quantities and accepted quantities. 

I. Purchase and Procurement Management

* Mentor the Purchase dept to ensure timely, cost-effective, and reliable availability of raw

materials, packaging materials, consumables, spare parts month on month. 

* Ensure competitive sourcing, appropriate commercial terms, quality compliance, and

adherence to approved procurement policies. 

J. Dispatch and Finished Goods Movement

* Ensure timely, accurate, and cost-effective movement of finished goods to depots and

distribution points for efficient delivery performance. 

K. Cost Control and Resource Optimisation

* Develop and monitor operational budgets covering manufacturing, labour, maintenance, quality, procurement, safety, and dispatch. 

* Identify cost-saving opportunities, and review operational variances, and establish

accountability for corrective actions. 

L. Reporting Systems

* Ensure compliance with applicable factory, labour, safety, environmental, quality, and other

statutory requirements, in coordination with designated functional owners. 

* Have regular performance reviews on all business KPI's with the Management. 

Knowledge, Skills, & Abilities

1. Industry and Business orientation

2. Entrepreneurial approach

3. Strategic Leadership

4. Collaborative approach

5. Analytical thinking and structured problem-solving

6. Communication skills. 

7. Negotiation skills and stakeholder management

8. Team leadership and capability development. 

9. Functional expertise

Educational Qualifications & Work Experience

* Post Graduate/ Graduate degree in any discipline

* Certifications Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, TPM, EHS, quality systems or operational

excellence will be an advantage. 

* 12 -16 years of experience in a relevant manufacturing set-up. 

* Experience in manufacturing cost optimisation, plant productivity improvement, and

operational transformation. 

About the company -

MDPH is a leading FMCG company in India that owns household Brands like Zed Black, Manthan, DinDin, Coach, Orva & more. 

MDPH provides direct employment to over 4, 000 people, has a range of 1200+ SKUs, a network of over 3, 500 distributors, and has invested in 4 manufacturing plants, 39 distribution centers, and an overseas office in New York. MDPH exports to 40+ countries. 

Zed Black Agarbatti is endorsed by MS Dhoni, Manthan Dhoop is endorsed by Hrithik Roshan, and DinDin Confectionery is endorsed by Doraemon.

data.description:
- Full Time
 - Ahmedabad/GiftCity
 - Posted 1 hour ago

Website Trading Technologies

Multi-asset platform for capital markets

We are looking for a hands-on Senior Automation engineer to continuously modernize, strengthen and accelerate our test automation frameworks. This is a senior individual-contributor role for an engineer who writes excellent production-quality Python code, can diagnose complex technical problems, and turns that expertise into reliable, maintainable and fast automation infrastructure. Our automation stack includes a Python-based backend for Clear Flow in house framework and Playwright with TypeScript for frontend end-to-end testing. The successful candidate will lead framework design and evolution, improve test reliability and execution speed, strengthen CI integration, and mentor other engineers. Experience testing financial technology or trading systems is highly desirable. 

What you'll be doing

- Lead continuous framework modernization: Own the technical direction and ongoing improvement of our automation frameworks, libraries, utilities and test architecture. 
 - Write high-quality Python: Develop and review robust, readable, efficient Python code for backend automation, framework services, test utilities and integrations. 
 - Improve performance and scalability: Profile and reduce test execution time; identify bottlenecks in setup, data handling, environment interaction and parallel execution; improve resource use without sacrificing reliability. 
 - Increase test reliability: Reduce flaky tests, improve diagnostics and failure reporting, strengthen logging and debugging support, and make failures easier to reproduce and resolve. 
 - Develop end-to-end automation: Maintain and improve Playwright/TypeScript UI automation and ensure effective integration with Python-based backend testing. 
 - Improve CI/CD integration: Make automated suites easier to run and troubleshoot in CI pipelines; improve test selection, reporting, repeatability and feedback time. 
 - Design for maintainability: Apply sound object-oriented design, modular architecture, reusable abstractions, clear interfaces and appropriate design patterns-avoiding unnecessary complexity. 
 - Work across teams: Partner with software engineers, quality engineers and infrastructure teams to investigate failures, improve testability and prevent defects earlier. 
 - Provide technical leadership: Mentor engineers through code reviews, design discussions, partnership and practical guidance; establish coding standards and framework-development practices. 
 - Measure impact: Use meaningful metrics such as execution duration, flakiness, failure diagnosis time, framework adoption and regression coverage to prioritize improvements. 
 - Support quality strategy: help with product testing when needed as well help determine where automation provides the greatest value, while retaining sound test design and appropriate exploration or manual testing where needed. 

Essential Skills

- Strong, hands-on Python programming skills. You should be comfortable designing, implementing, debugging, profiling and refactoring non-trivial code-not just writing test scripts. 
 - Typically, 8+ years of relevant software engineering, test automation or framework-development experience, including substantial ownership of automation frameworks. 
 - Demonstrated experience designing and evolving reusable automation frameworks, test libraries or developer tooling used by multiple engineers or teams. 
 - Strong software engineering fundamentals: data structures, algorithms, object-oriented design, modularity, error handling, testing, debugging and clean-code practices. 
 - Experience building and maintaining integration-level, API or backend automated tests. 
 - Practical experience with Playwright and TypeScript for front end-end end-to-end automation, or the ability to demonstrate equivalent depth and quickly contribute to this stack. 
 - Experience with Git, code reviews, CI/CD pipelines and collaborative Agile software development. 
 - Ability to investigate complex failures across application code, test code, test data, environments and infrastructure. 
 - Strong communication and mentoring skills, with the ability to explain design trade-offs and raise engineering quality across a team. 

Desired Skills

- Experience testing financial technology, electronic trading, capital markets, market data, order management or other complex, high-throughput systems. 
 - Experience with development and maintenance of Python-based automation frameworks. 
 - Experience improving large regression suites through parallelization, smarter test selection, test-data management, code coverage, performance profiling and flakiness reduction. 
 - Experience with distributed systems, asynchronous programming, service integrations, messaging or event-driven architectures. 
 - Experience with Linux-based test environments, containers and troubleshooting environment-dependent failures. 
 - Experience using AI-assisted engineering tools effectively, with appropriate review and validation of generated code. 

What We Bring to the Table

Compensation

Competitive Benefits & Perks in India We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. 

- Health & Financial Security: 
 - Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage
 - Time Off & Flexibility: 
 - Enjoy the best of both worlds: the energy and collaboration of in-person work, combined with the convenience and focus of remote days. This is a hybrid position requiring three days of in-office collaboration per week, with the flexibility to work remotely for the remaining two days. Our hybrid model is designed to balance individual flexibility with the benefits of in-person collaboration, enhanced team cohesion, spontaneous innovation, hands-on mentorship opportunities and strengthens our company culture. 
 - 21 days of Paid Time Off (PTO) per year, with the option to roll over unused days. 
 - One dedicated day per year for volunteering. 
 - Two professional development days per year to allow uninterrupted professional development. 
 - An additional PTO day is added during milestone anniversary years. 
 - Robust paid holiday schedule with early dismissal. 
 - Generous parental leave for all parents (including adoptive parents). 
 - Work-Life Support & Resources: 
 - Budget for tech accessories, including monitors, headphones, keyboards, and other office equipment. 
 - Milestone anniversary bonuses. 
 - Wellness & Lifestyle Perks: 
 - Subsidy contributions toward gym memberships and health/wellness initiatives. 
 - Our Culture: 
 - Forward-thinking, culture-based organization with collaborative teams that promote diversity and inclusion. 
Trading Technologies (www. tradingtechnologies. com) is a global capital markets platform services company providing market-leading technology for the end-to-end trading operations of Tier 1 banks, brokerages, money managers, hedge funds, proprietary traders, Commodity Trading Advisors (CTAs), commercial hedgers, and risk managers. With its roots in listed derivatives, the Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) company delivers "multi-X" solutions, with "X" representing asset classes, functions, workflows, and geographies. This multi-X approach features trade execution services across futures and options, fixed income, foreign exchange (FX), and cryptocurrencies, augmented by solutions for data and analytics, including transaction cost analysis (TCA); quantitative trading; compliance and trade surveillance; clearing and post-trade allocation; and infrastructure services. The award-winning TT platform ecosystem also helps exchanges deliver innovative solutions to their market participants and technology companies to distribute their complementary offerings to Trading Technologies' clients. 

Trading Technologies is backed by leading global investment firms Thoma Bravo, one of the world's largest and most experienced software investors, and 7Ridge, a global growth equity firm focused on technology-enabled businesses. 

This investment supports Trading Technologies' continued focus on product innovation, platform scalability, and long-term growth for customers and partners worldwide. 

Trading Technologies (TT) is an equal-opportunity employer. Equal employment has been, and continues to be, a required practice at the Company. Trading Technologies' practice of equal employment opportunity is to recruit, hire, train, promote, and base all employment decisions on ability rather than race, color, religion, national origin, sex/gender orientation, age, disability, sexual orientation, genetic information, parental status, veteran, or any other protected status. Additionally, TT participates in the E-Verify Program for US offices. 

To apply for this job please visit tradingtechnologies. pinpointhq. com

data.title: Container Engineer
data.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Container Engineer based in India. 

Join a globally distributed engineering team building and operating a high-performance container platform that powers modern, cloud-native applications at scale. In this role, you will help ensure the reliability, security, observability, and cost efficiency of multi-tenant Kubernetes infrastructure across multiple regions. You will combine software engineering, platform architecture, and Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) practices to build robust automation and improve operational resilience. Working closely with infrastructure specialists and product engineers, you will make reliable deployment practices easier to adopt and maintain. The position offers the opportunity to influence core platform architecture, solve complex infrastructure challenges, and improve the experience of engineering teams worldwide. It is an excellent fit for an experienced engineer who enjoys autonomy, open-source technologies, and building scalable systems in a fast-moving, asynchronous environment. 

Accountabilities

- Platform reliability and operations: Define and maintain service-level indicators (SLIs), service-level objectives (SLOs), and error budgets for the container platform. Develop policies that connect reliability targets to platform changes and deployment decisions. 
 - Operational readiness and observability: Lead Operational Readiness Reviews (ORRs) for new capabilities and significant changes. Establish meaningful uptime metrics and improve visibility through comprehensive metrics, logs, and distributed traces across platform components. 
 - Incident management and continuous improvement: Participate in the team's on-call rotation, respond to platform incidents, and drive issues through resolution and follow-up. Facilitate blameless postmortems, identify recurring failure patterns, and implement lasting improvements that reduce detection and recovery times. 
 - Platform software engineering: Build, maintain, and deploy production-grade automation, controllers, operators, internal tools, and platform APIs. Develop custom solutions when existing tools do not adequately address the underlying technical challenges. 
 - Deployment automation and release management: Design and improve platform CI/CD pipelines, rollout mechanisms, and release processes that enable safe, efficient, and predictable deployments. 
 - Security and operational automation: Implement security automation covering intrusion detection, automated remediation, and patch management. Identify repetitive operational tasks and eliminate toil through reliable automation. 
 - Testing and quality assurance: Develop and maintain automated testing suites and pipelines that validate platform releases before they reach production workloads. 
 - Architecture and ecosystem development: Evaluate and evolve the container technology stack, including orchestration, runtimes, networking, workload isolation, and observability tools. Conduct failure-mode analysis, map dependencies, and design resilient architectures for multi-tenant environments. 
 - Infrastructure efficiency: Improve platform architecture to optimize infrastructure costs while maintaining appropriate standards for security, reliability, and performance across tenants. 
 - Engineering enablement: Help product teams adopt sustainable operational practices, including effective alerting, escalation procedures, runbook coverage, and reduced notification noise. 

Requirements

- Professional experience: At least five years of experience in platform engineering, Kubernetes or container platform operations, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), or production infrastructure, including operating production systems at scale and participating in on-call rotations. 
 - Deep technical expertise: Strong expertise in at least one of the following areas, ideally with experience across two: 
 - Container tooling and ecosystem: In-depth knowledge of Kubernetes, containerd, OCI/CRI standards, and the broader Cloud Native Computing Foundation (CNCF) ecosystem. Familiarity with technologies such as Argo CD, Argo Rollouts, Cilium, eBPF, Gateway API, Karpenter, KEDA, gVisor, or Kata Containers is valuable. 
 - Software engineering: Ability to write production-quality code in Go or a comparable systems programming language, build controllers and operators, and design platform APIs and custom automation solutions. 
 - Operational excellence and SRE: Strong understanding of SLOs, error budgets, operational KPIs, incident response, blameless postmortems, and strategies for reducing mean time to detect (MTTD) and mean time to recover (MTTR). 
 - Multi-tenant infrastructure: Experience with large-scale, multi-tenant systems and an understanding of workload isolation mechanisms, including namespaces, role-based access control (RBAC), network policies, resource quotas, virtual clusters, and stronger isolation models such as VM-based runtimes. 
 - Cloud infrastructure: Confident working with AWS environments, including multiple accounts, IAM, and VPC networking. 
 - Infrastructure as code: Experience with infrastructure-as-code tools, preferably Pulumi, with Terraform or AWS CDK also suitable. 
 - Kubernetes proficiency: Practical experience deploying, operating, troubleshooting, and improving Kubernetes-based infrastructure.

data.title: Manufacturing Automation CSA Program Lead
data.description:
Manufacturing Automation CSA Program Lead (GMP)

Your Challenge: 

As we scale our advanced manufacturing capabilities, we need a visionary leader to architect and execute our holistic Automation Quality, Compliance, and Computer Software Assurance (CSA) strategy. The GMP Automation CSA Program Lead will bridge strategic quality oversight, automation governance, and operational excellence. Deep technical expertise in GMP manufacturing automation is mandatory, as is a proven track record of strategic thinking in CSV/CSA execution. You will move compliance from a defensive testing exercise to a streamlined, risk-based enabler of modern manufacturing-orchestrating global automation quality standards, driving data integrity, and establishing modern CSV/CSA paradigms across our state-of-the-art GMP facilities. 

. . . in Our Journey: 

You will serve as the organizational authority on automation compliance and program oversight, setting the tone for how we govern manufacturing execution systems, control systems, and data infrastructure. By applying CSIA Best Practices and FDA CSA guidance to critical OT assets, you will build scalable validation and assurance frameworks that safeguard product quality and patient safety while accelerating technology deployment and operational readiness. 

Position SummaryThe GMP Automation CSA Program Lead provides high-level strategic direction, program governance, and operational oversight for all automated and computerized systems operating in our regulated GMP manufacturing network. This pivotal role defines system lifecycle policies, drives risk-proportionate software assurance frameworks, and maintains full alignment with international regulatory expectations and industrial automation standards. 

Functioning at a directorial level of strategic oversight, you will lead the cross-functional integration of Automation, Quality Assurance, IT/OT Infrastructure, Manufacturing Operations, and Engineering. The position commands solid technical mastery over industrial automation platforms (e. g. , Emerson DeltaV, SCADA, PLCs, OSIsoft/AVEVA PI System) paired with advanced strategic vision in risk-based assurance frameworks (FDA CSA, GAMP 5 2nd Edition) and industrial governance standards (CSIA Best Practices) to maximize system reliability, data integrity, and inspection readiness. 

Key ResponsibilitiesStrategic CSA Program Governance & Lifecycle Architecture
 - Define Enterprise Automation CSA Strategy: Formulate and enforce company-wide program roadmaps and computerized software assurance (CSA) frameworks tailored for complex, multi-tiered GMP automation architectures. 
 - Strategic CSV/CSA Vision: Drive the paradigm shift from traditional document-heavy CSV to modern, risk-proportionate FDA CSA principles-aligning compliance effort directly with critical process parameters (CPPs), critical quality attributes (CQAs), and direct patient/product safety impacts. 
 - CSIA Compliance Framework: Direct the integration of CSIA (Control System Integrators Association) Best Practices across system lifecycle management, vendor oversight, project execution, and OT system sustainability. 
 - Capital Project Governance: Serve as the lead compliance strategist for capital expenditure projects, system migrations, expansions, DeltaV upgrades, and enterprise historian deployments. 

System Lifecycle & Technical Documentation Governance
 - GMP Automation Architectural Oversight: Establish standard operating procedures for system architecture specifications, user requirements (URSs), functional specifications (FSs), and data flow maps across all automation levels (Level 0-Level 3). 
 - Defensible Program Portfolios: Drive enterprise traceability models and oversee the lifecycle documentation suite (Validation Plans, Risk Assessments, IQ/OQ/PQ, Traceability Matrices, and Summary Reports) to maintain defensible, audit-ready compliance evidence. 
 - Vendor & Integrator Strategy: Define technical and compliance benchmarks for external system integrators and automation suppliers. Conduct strategic reviews of vendor Quality Management Systems (QMS) to maximize the leveraging of supplier testing and FAT/SAT documentation under CSA guidelines. 

Next-Generation Assurance & Testing Execution Strategy
 - Advanced CSA Testing Methodologies: Lead the design and deployment of objective-driven testing strategies-leveraging continuous integration, automated testing tools, and unscripted testing techniques where appropriate under CSA guidance. 
 - Control Loop & Advanced Automation Verification: Apply deep GMP automation knowledge to provide subject matter expertise on the strategic assurance and quality oversight of complex control logic, batch management (ISA-88), phase logic, permissive matrices, alarm management (ISA-18. 2), and interlock architectures. 
 - Operational Readiness & Handover: Establish governance policies for seamless system transitions from project delivery into site operations, continuous monitoring, and ongoing program ownership. 

Data Integrity, Cybersecurity & Risk Management
 - ALCOA+ Framework Governance: Establish site-wide data integrity strategies for automated systems, ensuring robust design controls for electronic records, electronic signatures (21 CFR Part 11 / EU Annex 11), audit trails, and system access models. 
 - OT Cybersecurity & Resilience: Align automation assurance strategies with industrial cybersecurity frameworks (ISA/IEC 62443, CSIA guidelines) to defend against OT threats, secure time synchronization, enforce backup/disaster recovery protocols, and ensure business continuity. 
 - Lifecycle Data Flow Auditing: Direct comprehensive data integrity and functional risk assessments across interconnected control systems, enterprise historians, and manufacturing execution systems (MES). 

Quality Systems & Inspection Readiness Strategy
 - Change Control & Impact Governance: Serve as the final authority on change control impact assessments for automation platforms, ensuring that hardware, software, configuration, and patch changes undergo risk-proportionate verification without stifling innovation. 
 - Deviation & Root Cause Oversight: Lead high-level investigations, CAPAs, and continuous improvement initiatives stemming from automation events, software exceptions, or data anomalies. 
 - Regulatory Inspection Leadership: Represent the company as the primary Subject Matter Expert (SME) during regulatory agency inspections (FDA, EMA, MHRA) and client audits, articulate the site's risk-based CSA strategy, and defend automated control paradigms. 

Executive Collaboration & Program Delivery
 - Cross-Functional Leadership: Direct cross-functional alignment between Automation Engineering, Quality Assurance, IT/OT, Manufacturing, and Executive Leadership to ensure operational readiness and compliance coherence. 
 - Resource & Integrator Oversight: Manage external validation partners, managed services, and system integrators - ensuring alignment with program timelines, fiscal budgets, and quality standards. 
 - Operational Modernization: Continually benchmark internal automation practices against evolving regulatory guidance, ISPE GAMP trends, CSIA guidelines, and Industry 4. 0 automation practices. 

Required Qualifications (Must-Haves)
 - Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering (Electrical, Chemical, Automation, Biomedical), Computer Science, or a related technical discipline. 
 - Core Mastery (Must-Have): Solid, hands-on technical expertise in GMP manufacturing automation paired with proven strategic vision in Computer System Validation (CSV) and Computer Software Assurance (CSA) within a regulated environment. 
 - Experience: 8+ years of progressive experience in computer system validation/assurance, automation quality engineering, or automation engineering within a regulated pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or medical device manufacturing environment, with demonstrated experience leading program-level compliance strategies. 
 - Regulatory & Framework Expertise: 
 - Deep, practical working knowledge of FDA Computer Software Assurance (CSA) guidance, ISPE GAMP 5 (2nd Edition), 21 CFR Part 11, and EU GMP Annex 11. 
 - Strong working knowledge and experience implementing CSIA (Control System Integrators Association) Best Practices for project management, system development, and program governance. 
 - Technical Automation Mastery: Hands-on and architectural depth with industrial automation technologies, including Emerson DeltaV, SCADA systems, PLCs (Allen-Bradley/Siemens), AVEVA PI / OSIsoft PI Historian, batch execution systems (ISA-88), and industrial networks/interfaces (OPC, Modbus, Ethernet/IP). 
 - Data Integrity & Risk: Proven track record of applying risk-based quality management principles (ICH Q9) and ALCOA+ data integrity standards to automation platforms and infrastructure. 
 - Inspection Defense: Demonstrated success in leading inspection readiness programs and defending computerized automation systems directly to regulatory authorities (FDA, EMA, etc. ). 
 - Communication & Strategic Influence: Exceptional communication, executive presentation, and consensus-building skills with the ability to articulate complex automation concepts to both technical SMEs and non-technical executive leadership. 

Preferred Qualifications
 - Active involvement in professional industry bodies (e. g. , ISPE, CSIA, MESA, IEEE, ASQ). 
 - Certified CSIA Lead or experience driving CSIA certification for internal engineering organizations or integrator partners. 
 - Experience integrating Level 2 automation control systems with Level 3/4 enterprise systems (e. g. , MES, Syncade, Werum PAS-X, ERP, LIMS). 
 - Direct leadership experience managing capital automation program budgets, external engineering service providers, and system integrators. 
 - Deep knowledge of OT cybersecurity protocols and convergence architectures (ISA/IEC 62443).

data.description:
Team Lead - Python & Agentic AI

Experience : 6 - 10 Years

Function : Software Engineering / Artificial Intelligence

About The Role

We are looking for an experienced Team Lead - Python & Agentic AI to lead the development of AI-powered applications, LLM-based solutions, and multi-agent systems. 

The role combines hands-on software development with technical leadership, requiring strong expertise in Python, agent orchestration, and modern AI frameworks. 

The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing scalable AI applications, guiding engineering teams, establishing development best practices, and collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders to deliver reliable, production-ready solutions. 

Key Responsibilities

- Lead the design, development, and deployment of Python-based AI applications and backend services. 
 - Design and implement Agentic AI solutions and multi-agent architectures using LLMs, LangGraph, MCP, and related frameworks. 
 - Build agent workflows involving tool calling, orchestration, memory, APIs, and external system integrations. 
 - Apply prompt engineering, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and other AI techniques to develop effective AI workflows. 
 - Drive technical architecture, code reviews, coding standards, testing, and software engineering best practices. 
 - Troubleshoot complex technical issues and support the resolution of production incidents. 
 - Collaborate with DevOps teams on containerization, deployments, CI/CD pipelines, monitoring, and production support. 
 - Mentor developers, conduct knowledge-sharing sessions, and support the technical growth of the engineering team. 
 - Work closely with Product, QA, Analytics, and other stakeholders to ensure quality and timely delivery. 
 - Participate in sprint planning, effort estimation, architecture discussions, and technical decision-making. 

Required Skills And Qualifications

- 6 - 10 years of software development experience with strong hands-on expertise in Python. 
 - Practical experience developing Agentic AI and LLM-based applications. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with LangGraph and Model Context Protocol (MCP). 
 - Experience designing multi-agent architectures, agent workflows, and orchestration mechanisms. 
 - Good understanding of LLMs, prompt engineering, tool calling, RAG, and AI application development. 
 - Experience with FastAPI, REST APIs, and databases such as PostgreSQL. 
 - Working knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes, Git, CI/CD, and cloud environments. 
 - Strong debugging, analytical, and problem-solving skills. 
 - Good understanding of Agile methodologies and the software development lifecycle (SDLC). 
 - Strong technical leadership, communication, mentoring, and stakeholder-management skills. 
 - Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline. 

Good To Have

- Experience with LangChain and observability or evaluation tools such as Langfuse or LangSmith. 
 - Familiarity with vector databases and AI evaluation techniques. 
 - Experience working with AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform. 
 - Exposure to enterprise SaaS or analytics applications. 
 - Knowledge of application security, authentication, and authorization. 

Key Focus Areas

- Development of scalable Python-based AI applications. 
 - Design and implementation of Agentic AI and multi-agent systems. 
 - Technical leadership, mentoring, and engineering quality. 
 - Reliable deployment and operation of AI solutions in production.

data.description:
Job Description

Owns moderately complex components within platform services or SDKs; leads team-level improvements to integration frameworks and developer tooling. Performs deep debugging across a bounded set of distributed services, driving fixes that protect downstream consumers and upgrade paths. Analyzes usage, performance, and error budgets for specific platform surfaces; implements targeted resilience and capacity optimizations. Authors and curates team-scoped documentation, samples, and adoption guidance. 

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

Platform Software Development: 

- Own a bounded platform component (service module, SDK area) and evolve its contracts for multi-tenant use. 
 - Perform deep debugging across a limited-service graph; drive compatibility-safe remediation plans. 
 - Implement targeted resilience/capacity patterns and document adoption guidance for team consumers. 

Software Development and Coding - Design, Testing, and Optimization: 

- Designs software solutions and analyzes and helps identify requirements to achieve business and operational goals, independently. 
 - Adheres to and suggests improvements to all phases of the software development lifecycle. 
 - Utilizes working knowledge to develop new software features and enhancements following design specifications and develops documents to clarify software design and code. 
 - Leads code reviews in designated areas to help drive improvements. 
 - Conducts debugging and troubleshooting to identify and fix moderately complex software issues. Develops fixes for identified issues. 
 - Implements software testing (e. g. , functional and non-functional testing), quality assurance processes, software error logging, monitoring, and observability for effective debugging, ensuring review by manager and/or lead throughout the process. 
 - Exercises judgment and discretion to conduct performance profiling and optimization of coding. 
 - Troubleshoots and resolves moderately complex issues related to application programming interface (API) functionality and integration. 
 - Implements moderately complex API versioning, lifecycle, and interoperability strategies. 

Software Architecture - Software System Structural Design: 

- Designs and develops software, systems, and services aligned to pre-defined system architecture. 
 - Develops working knowledge of software architecture decisions and best practices. 
 - Collaborates with team leads to review work to ensure alignment with software architecture. 
 - Implements moderately complex performance optimization and scalability strategies in software design. 

Issue/Defect Collaboration - Software Products Support: 

- Collaborates within and beyond immediate team to understand customer issues and align solutions. 
 - May provide technical guidance and support to customers regarding customer-reported issues, independently. 
 - Coaches, mentors, and guides others to advocate for customers' interests and suggests product enhancements based on feedback. 
 - Influences team to ensure customer satisfaction through timely resolution of issues and effective communication. 
 - Implements customer issue and/or defect handling and training processes, independently. 
 - Investigates and troubleshoots complex product maintenance issues to ensure customer agreement on short- and long-term solutions (e. g. , future enhancements). 

Practices and Standards Compliance - Security and Compliance: 

- Collaborates with the team to establish and follow development practices and coding standards. 
 - Exercises judgment and discretion to ensure code quality and adherence to broad acceptance criteria during development. 
 - Keeps up to date with industry best practices and applies them to software development processes. 
 - Implements secure coding practices to prevent security vulnerabilities. 

Development Operations - System Maintenance: 

- Performs periodic maintenance and testing operations for systems that require upgrading or patching (e. g. , for critical vulnerabilities). 
 - Exercises judgment and discretion to drive improvements, ensure automation, testing, and debugging of systems to ensure service/product availability, health, support, and reliability. 

Core Responsibilities

Planning & Execution: 

- Independently manages work, monitoring timelines and deliverables to ensure projects or initiatives stay on track and meet requirements. Proactively prioritizes work and adapts to resource or timeline shifts, suggesting adjustments to maintain project efficiency. 

Collaboration & Partnership: 

- Collaborates across teams to align on expectations and achieve shared objectives. Builds and maintains a comprehensive understanding of business, stakeholder, and/or customer needs to build and support effective partnerships. Actively listens to diverse perspectives and asks questions to ensure understanding of others. 

Problem Solving: 

- Independently identifies and addresses standard and non-standard issues in accordance with standard practices, escalating more complex issues as appropriate. Analyzes data and/or information from multiple sources to troubleshoot standard and non-standard errors. Contributes to knowledge sharing and best practices. 

Continuous Learning: 

- Embraces continuous learning by actively seeking to build knowledge and new skills and/or tools and staying current with industry trends and best practices. Seeks out and leverages feedback and training to improve skills. Contributes to a culture of continuous learning and knowledge sharing with team members. 

Continuous Improvement: 

- Develops ideas and recommends updates to increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows within a team. Seeks input from team members on alternative approaches and methods for improving work.

Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. data.title: Senior Manager, Core Infrastructure Engineering
data.description:
Job Description

The Engineering Manager will lead a team building and operating scalable OCI metering services that collect, validate, and aggregate cloud resource usage for downstream pricing, rating, and billing. They will own roadmap delivery over a 2-4 quarter horizon, hire and develop engineers, and guide architecture for high-throughput distributed systems with strong data correctness, fault tolerance, and availability. The role includes overseeing batch and streaming data pipelines using managed distributed processing platforms such as Data Flow. Responsibilities include setting engineering standards and SLOs; driving performance optimization, observability, reconciliation, and recovery; ensuring operational readiness and effective on-call coverage; and overseeing security, automation, and safe deployments and rollbacks. The manager will partner with compute, networking, storage, and commercial platform teams to deliver reliable metering capabilities and support new consumption models. Experience with Java, Python, Spark, and cloud data processing platforms is preferred. 

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

System Design & Architecture - System Scalability: 

- Manages the development and implementation of scalable distributed systems and components across multiple teams, including the effective use of distributed state management tools. 
 - Oversees code and/or system optimization efforts for large-scale data processing and high-throughput requirements within and across teams to support hyper-scale systems. 
 - Guides teams to define scalability requirements for owned components and ensures design and implementation requirements are met. 
 - Manages the use of data plane platforms to effectively handle large-scale data retrieval, storage, and processing. 
 - Ensures team accurately designs performance and load testing. 

System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Design: 

- Manages the strategy for building fault-tolerant components and systems capable of withstanding in-service updates by guiding the implementation of redundancy, replication, and automatic failover mechanisms. 
 - Develops design strategies for systems to effectively handle service disruptions (e. g. , network partitions) by prioritizing consistency, availability, or partition tolerance. 
 - Leads implementation and optimization initiatives across teams for approaches to handle network unreliability, including load-shedding, throttling, and rate-limiting. 
 - Guides teams to design components and systems that are durable and adhere to service level objectives (SLOs), setting expectations for availability and durability of other computing services within the department. 

System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Performance: 

- Provides oversight in defining key performance indicators (KPIs) and telemetry to identify gaps or issues in running systems. 
 - Oversees the building and customization of moderately complex dashboards, telemetry systems, and alerting mechanisms to proactively monitor components and system health. 

System Design & Architecture - Correctness / Availability: 

- Oversees the design and implementation of functional and correctness requirements for feature sets and/or systems in new or existing systems. 
 - Guides teams to design complex test scenarios (e. g. , fault-injection, brown-out) to evaluate system correctness. 
 - Directs implementation strategies for data replication and synchronization techniques to maintain data integrity and availability. 

Operational Troubleshooting & Incident Management: 

- Guides teams to be proactive when diagnosing, debugging, and resolving issues in active components and systems to support ongoing operation. 
 - Ensures teams leverage expertise to prevent interruptions, ensuring no maintenance windows are required for customers and users when resolving issues. 
 - Oversees operational readiness protocol and ensures teams remain knowledgeable of owned components and systems to support effective troubleshooting and performance. 
 - Oversees and approves schedules for operational support rotations. 

Compliance & Security: 

- Oversees implementation of robust security measures to protect data and applications in multi-tenant environments, ensuring team strategies incorporate encryption techniques and access controls. 
 - Directs execution of remediation plans to address identified security gaps, promoting continuous improvement of security measures. 
 - Ensures comprehensive documentation and cloud infrastructure compliance with industry standards and regulations. 

Automation & Change Management: 

- Oversees the development and maintenance of automation scripts and tools (e. g. , Infrastructure as Code (IaC)) to manage cloud infrastructure. 
 - Works with teams to create and adhere to change management plans for patching, updating, and rolling back applications, and guides development of components to allow for automation of these processes. 

Core Responsibilities

Planning & Execution: 

- Manages multiple medium- to large-scale projects or initiatives across teams, ensuring timelines, deliverables, and budgets (when applicable) are monitored and met. 
 - Provides direction to teams on project work, setting priorities, and aligning with business needs. 
 - Guides teams on adjusting plans to accommodate resource or timeline changes. 

Collaboration & Partnership: 

- Drives cross-functional partnerships to align on expectations and shared objectives across multiple teams. 
 - Coaches team members to develop strategic relationships with business leaders, stakeholders, and external partners to foster collaboration and long-term success. 
 - Promotes inclusivity by actively seeking and listening to diverse perspectives, ensuring others feel heard and respected. 

Problem Solving: 

- Provides direction to multiple teams on addressing complex operational and/or technical issues, as well as guidance on analyzing complex data and/or information to identify solutions. 
 - Reviews and provides insights into unresolved or critical issues, helping teams to identify potential solutions. 

Continuous Learning: 

- Models engaging in continuous learning to deepen expertise and stay ahead of industry trends, integrating best practices into strategic planning. 
 - Leverages feedback to drive personal and team skill improvements. 
 - Identifies skill gaps across teams and empowers team members to pursue learning and knowledge-sharing opportunities that build their expertise in new areas, coaching them to apply learnings to advance the organization.

data.title: Build and Release Methodology Engineer
data.description:
NVIDIA has continuously reinvented itself. Our invention of the GPU sparked the growth of the PC gaming market, redefined modern computer graphics, and revolutionized parallel computing. Today, research in artificial intelligence is booming worldwide, which calls for highly scalable and massively parallel computation horsepower that NVIDIA GPUs excel. NVIDIA is a "learning machine" that constantly evolves by adapting to new opportunities that are hard to solve, that only we can address, and that matter to the world. This is our life's work , to amplify human creativity and intelligence. As an NVIDIAN, you'll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join our diverse team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world!

We are looking for a Senior Engineer for our Build and Release Methodology Group catering to our pioneering SOCs. As the SOC development becomes more complex requiring packing of more and more IPs and the need for doing more SOCs increase, we need to have a scalable infrastructure to be able to complete SOC development in fastest as well as most efficient way possible. This requires an SOC Build and IP Release infrastructure that caters to and keeps up with these ever-increasing complexities. In this position, you will work first-hand on architecting and developing this methodology. If you have real passion for methodologies and automation solutions, you will fit in great!

What You'll Be Doing

- Define and develop system-level methodologies and tools to build SOCs in an efficient and scalable manner. 
 - Architect and implement core build flows so as to optimize build and make it simpler and efficient. 
 - Improve build, release, and integration tools and procedures. 
 - Identify and develop Checks to enforce the best practices for the Build and Release guidelines. 
 - Develop solutions to enable abstraction and compartmentalization for customer IPs. 
 - Identify difficulties and inefficiencies in the SOC implementation process and propose ideas to solve them. 
 - Support IP teams with Build and Release related issues. 

What We Need To See

- BS or MS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or Computer Science, or equivalent experience. 
 - 2+ years of industry experience as Build and Release Engineer, Build Automation, IP integration and related areas. 
 - Strong coding skills in Perl, Python, Makefile, Shell script, or other industry-standard scripting languages. 
 - Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills. 
 - Excellent interpersonal skills to work with multi-functional teams and collaborate with team members across sites and cultures to build consensus. 
 - Background in RTL (Verilog), Verification (UVM, System Verilog) and C/C++ is a plus - Not must. 
 - Experience in synthesis and physical design is a plus - Not must. 

, , JR2028814

data.title: Engineer II - QA Manual
data.description:
At Aristocrat, we're dedicated to crafting world-class gaming content and technology that captivates and entertains millions worldwide. As an Engineer II, you will play a key role in maintaining our high standards and ensuring flawless functionality across our products. This is an outstanding opportunity to join an ambitious team that strives for excellence and innovation in everything we do. Your contributions will directly impact the quality and success of our beloved games, making this an exciting and rewarding role!

What You'll Do

- Develop test planning documentation based on requirement specifications, ensuring every element is addressed. 
 - Complete in-depth manual closed system testing to ensure each element performs without faults. 
 - Test digital games rigorously to identify and resolve issues. 
 - Use test management and defect tracking tools like Jira to ensure an efficient workflow. 
 - Analyze and validate effective automated and manual testing approaches. 
 - Conduct functional, compliance, acceptance, integration, installation, and system testing. 
 - Deliver accurate projections for test activities and make certain they finish within the allocated schedule. 
 - Contribute to the education and mentoring of junior team members, nurturing a collaborative and open environment. 
 - Address technical issues promptly, ensuring they are resolved and followed up. 
 - Maintain adherence to quality standards throughout the product development lifecycle. 
 - Coordinate with product managers, designers, and engineers to achieve excellent features and advancements.

Company Description

Arista Networks is an industry leader in data-driven, client-to-cloud networking for large data center, campus and routing environments. Arista is a well-established and profitable company with over $8 billion in revenue. Arista's award-winning platforms, ranging in Ethernet speeds up to 800G bits per second, redefine scalability, agility, and resilience. Arista is a founding member of the Ultra Ethernet consortium. We have shipped over 20 million cloud networking ports worldwide with CloudVision and EOS, an advanced network operating system. Arista is committed to open standards, and its products are available worldwide directly and through partners. 

At Arista, we value the diversity of thought and perspectives each employee brings. We believe fostering an inclusive environment where individuals from various backgrounds and experiences feel welcome is essential for driving creativity and innovation. 

Our commitment to excellence has earned us several prestigious awards, such as the Great Place to Work Survey for Best Engineering Team and Best Company for Diversity, Compensation, and Work-Life Balance. At Arista, we take pride in our track record of success and strive to maintain the highest quality and performance standards in everything we do. 

Job Description

Who You'll Work With

You will work with the Platform team who work closest to the hardware and programming chips. 

What You'll Do

As a Software Engineer your core responsibility is to deliver new cutting edge product features. A major part of this is writing and owning design/implementation of the code that drives our products. However, the role of a Software Engineer is much bigger than 'simply' writing code. Software engineers work on the whole development process, including: 

- Suggesting and deciding what features to build
 - Driving the design and architecture
 - Pushing, testing, documenting the feature
 - Working alongside customers in the field if needed

Are you right for this role?

This Is An Interesting And Exciting Opportunity To Be a Part Of The Software Development Team That Is Redefining Data Center Switching. For Success At Arista All You Need Is

- Strong industry experience of 5+ years
 - Extensive background in algorithms and strong software architecture skills
 - Fluency in C/C++ programming
 - Hands-on experience with designs and implementations in a strong product-engineering environment. 

Qualifications

- Strong software debugging skills especially in embedded systems. 
 - Experience with software development for the forwarding ASICs, FPGAs, Network Processors etc
 - Experience with hardware abstraction layer
 - Datapath forwarding for ACLs, QoS, Unicast, Multicast, EVPN MPLS, VXLAN, OAM etc
 - Strong communication skills and the ability to work in a team environment
 - Experience working through the complete software development life cycle right from requirements gathering to deliver the fully developed feature. 
 - Experience in Network Systems Software development is a plus

Additional Information

Arista stands out as an engineering-centric company. Our leadership, including founders and engineering managers, are all engineers who understand sound software engineering principles and the importance of doing things right. 

We hire globally into our diverse team. At Arista, engineers have complete ownership of their projects. Our management structure is flat and streamlined, and software engineering is led by those who understand it best. We prioritize the development and utilization of test automation tools. 

Our engineers have access to every part of the company, providing opportunities to work across various domains. Arista is headquartered in Santa Clara, California, with development offices in Australia, Canada, India, Ireland, and the US. We consider all our R&D centers equal in stature. 

Join us to shape the future of networking and be part of a culture that values invention, quality, respect, and fun.
