We are looking for a highly motivated Software Engineer (SDET) to join NetApp's ONTAP Engineering team, focusing on SAN and block storage solutions. ONTAP is a feature-rich storage platform used in mission-critical environments across cloud, hybrid, and on-prem deployments. As an Senior Engineer, you will be responsible for designing and developing scalable test frameworks, automation infrastructure, and validation pipelines that ensure high product quality for complex distributed storage systems. You will work across multiple subsystems, understand end-to-end customer workflows, and drive quality at scale. This is an advanced IC role requiring strong technical depth, ownership of features/modules, and the ability to operate with limited supervision while influencing test strategy, automation direction, and cross-team quality outcomes. 

Job Requirements

- Design, develop, and maintain scalable test automation frameworks and infrastructure using Python and related technologies
 - Own end-to-end validation for SAN/block storage features, including test design, execution, and defect lifecycle management
 - Collaborate with development teams to understand feature design, define validation strategies, and drive testability improvements early in the cycle. 
 - Develop functional, integration, stress, and scale tests for distributed storage systems
 - Drive automation-first testing approaches and improve code/test coverage across components
 - Analyze failures, debug complex issues across software layers, and drive root cause resolution. 
 - Participate in product design discussions and contribute to improving reliability, observability, and diagnosability
 - Lead or significantly contribute to test planning, quality reviews, and release readiness. 
 - Work across cross-functional teams (Dev, QA, Field Support) to understand customer use cases and ensure production readiness. 
 - Mentor junior engineers and influence engineering best practices within the team. 
 - Strong programming skills in Python (mandatory) with experience building automation frameworks. 
 - Experience with system-level testing and debugging of distributed systems
 - Solid understanding of Linux/Unix systems, multithreading, and system internals
 - Experience in storage technologies, with strong preference for SAN protocols (FC, iSCSI, NVMe-oF)
 - Understanding of file systems, data paths, replication, or high-availability systems
 - Experience in test automation for scale, performance, and stress scenarios
 - Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, test infrastructure, and modern development workflows. 
 - Strong debugging skills across software and system layers. 

Education

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field (Master's preferred). 
 - 8-12 years of relevant industry experience Proven track record of owning and delivering quality outcomes for complex subsystems
 - Demonstrated ability to work independently on moderately to highly complex problems and drive solutions Preferred Qualifications
 - Deep expertise in SAN/block storage domain (ONTAP, SnapMirror, SVM, HA/MetroCluster, etc. )
 - Experience in large-scale system validation and customer scenario testing
 - Exposure to cloud-integrated storage or hybrid cloud architectures
 - Prior experience in SDET roles driving automation strategy at team level

At NetApp, we embrace a hybrid working environment designed to strengthen connection, collaboration, and culture for all employees. This means that most roles will have some level of in-office and/or in-person expectations, which will be shared during the recruitment process. 

Equal Opportunity Employer

NetApp is firmly committed to Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) and to compliance with all federal, state and local laws that prohibit employment discrimination based on age, race, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, religion, disability or genetic information, pregnancy, protected veteran status, and any other protected classification. 

Why You'll Thrive at NetApp

At NetApp, you won't wait for the perfect moment-you'll make it. The early planning, the extra thought, the bold idea that turns good into great: That's how our people operate and how we continue to push the boundaries of data infrastructure. 

NetApp is the trusted partner for organizations transforming data into opportunity. As the only enterprise-grade storage service natively embedded in Google Cloud, AWS, and Microsoft Azure, we empower customers to run everything from traditional workloads to enterprise AI with unmatched performance, resilience, and security. 

Our culture

We celebrate mold breakers, bold thinkers, and problem solvers. We reward initiative, impact, and ownership. We provide flexibility so you can balance professional ambition with your personal life. Here, differences are not just welcomed-they drive everything we do. 

If you're ready to innovate, rise to the challenge, and own every moment - make your next move your best one. Apply now. 

Submitting an Application

To ensure a streamlined and fair hiring process for all candidates, our team only reviews applications submitted through our company website. This practice allows us to track, assess, and respond to applicants efficiently. Emailing our employees, recruiters, or Human Resources personnel directly will not influence your application. 

AI Disclosure

For select roles, some stages of our hiring process may use artificial intelligence tools to help evaluate applications and candidate selection. These tools support-rather than replace-human decision-making.

data.title: Lead Data Engineer
data.description:
PFI Innovation Centre India is an exciting new innovation center. We're building a future that helps people live better lives longer - and we're looking for bold thinkers and team players to help us do it. 

Here, you'll tackle complex challenges, collaborate with brilliant minds across the globe, and grow your career while helping millions achieve financial security. 

a Purpose Driven Company - 150 Years

While the PFI Innovation Centre brand is new to India, you'll be a part of the Prudential Financial, Inc. family. Founded in Newark, NJ, we serve 50 million customers across more than 50 countries. With $1. 334 trillion in assets, we're a global leader in institutional asset management. The 2nd largest life insurer in the US and the 9th largest institutional global asset manager. 

At the PFI Innovation Centre India, you'll find high-performance culture that's flexible, collaborative, and grounded in respect. We engage with candor, take calibrated risks, and hold ourselves accountable - always focused on delivering for our customers. It's the standard we choose every day as we grow, perform, and win as one team. We offer valuable leadership, mentoring and learning opportunities, paired with flexibility and support to help you thrive. 

Whether you're just starting out or ready to take your next step, we'll help you grow with purpose and do the best work of your career. 

What You Will Do

Are you ready to shape enterprise data products that make trusted information accessible to analytics, applications, and AI? As a Lead Data Engineer, you will lead the architecture and development of virtualized data products and semantic layers using Denodo. You will establish standards and governance, guide engineering teams, and partner across platforms to create scalable, reusable, AI-ready data capabilities. 

What You Can Expect

- Lead the architecture and development of enterprise virtual data products using Denodo virtualization and semantic modeling. 
 - Define and govern canonical business models, ontologies, business glossaries, semantic layers, naming conventions, and development standards. 
 - Design complex joins, unions, aggregations, transformations, and reusable semantic patterns for reporting, analytics, APIs, and AI agents. 
 - Optimize Denodo performance through caching, query pushdown, aggregation strategies, and virtualization best practices. 
 - Provide technical leadership to Data Engineers, AI Engineers, LLMOps Engineers, and platform teams while enabling API-first integration across AWS, analytics, catalog, AI, and enterprise platforms. 

What You Will Bring

- 10+ years of experience in Data Engineering, Data Architecture, or Analytics Engineering. 
 - 5+ years of Denodo implementation experience, including enterprise semantic layers and virtualized data products. 
 - Strong knowledge of Denodo, AWS services such as Lambda and Glue, ETL, APIs, data modeling, ontologies, data governance, and API design. 
 - Experience with Generative AI, agentic AI frameworks, and LLMOps. 
 - Strong stakeholder-engagement, consulting, and technical-leadership skills. 

What will set you apart?

- Experience designing AI-ready data platforms. 
 - Knowledge of AI-governance standards. 
 - Familiarity with Amazon Bedrock, OpenAI, Anthropic, Azure OpenAI, or similar platforms. 
 - Experience implementing enterprise metadata, lineage, and semantic-governance frameworks. 
 - *PFI Innovation Centre India welcomes all applicants, even if you don't meet every requirement. If your skills align with the role, we encourage you to apply.

data.title: Mobility Technology OBT Functional Testing Specialist
data.description:
About The Role

Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced Functional Testing Specialist to join the Mobility Technology / Digital Enablement team. The role will focus on manual testing of internal travel applications, particularly Online Booking Tools (OBTs) and integrated travel-technology platforms. 

Primary Objective

Own end-to-end quality assurance for reservation platforms and help ensure reliable operation of corporate travel policy engines, air and hotel booking workflows, GDS/NDC integrations, payment gateways, and downstream systems. 

Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate will bring strong experience in functional, regression, integration, and end-to-end testing. They will combine analytical thinking and attention to detail with effective cross-functional collaboration and a sound understanding of travel-domain processes. Prior travel-industry experience is preferred. 

Key Responsibilities

- Test Planning and Design: Create, document, and maintain detailed manual test cases for internal travel applications, with particular emphasis on Online Booking Tools. 
 - Requirements Analysis: Understand travel business processes and translate business and technical requirements into clear, practical, and testable scenarios. 
 - Test Execution: Perform functional, regression, smoke, exploratory, integration, and end-to-end testing across releases and sprint cycles. 
 - Booking-Path Validation: Test complex, multi-tier booking journeys across air, hotel, rail, and car rental, including corporate travel policies, approval workflows, and profile synchronization. 
 - API and Integration Testing: Validate XML/JSON RESTful and SOAP integrations between the OBT and GDS platforms such as Sabre, Amadeus, and Travelport, as well as NDC aggregators and direct supplier connections. 
 - Payment and Downstream-System Validation: Verify corporate, virtual, and ghost-card processing and confirm accurate data transmission to mid-office, back-office, and expense-management systems, including SAP Concur and Chrome River. 
 - Defect Management: Identify, isolate, document, prioritize, and track defects in Azure DevOps or Jira, providing clear reproduction steps, appropriate severity levels, and supporting evidence. 
 - Retesting and Resolution: Collaborate with development teams to resolve defects and complete retesting to confirm that fixes work as expected. 
 - Delivery Planning: Estimate testing effort, identify risks, and support mitigation planning to enable timely, high-quality releases. 
 - Agile Delivery: Participate in daily stand-ups, sprint planning, requirement discussions, development cycles, and retrospectives, providing timely quality-assurance input. 
 - Stakeholder Communication: Keep Product, Technology, and business stakeholders informed about testing progress, risks, blockers, quality concerns, and release readiness. 
 - Data Validation: Query databases to verify backend transaction states, profile-data mapping, and Passenger Name Record (PNR) generation. 
 - AI-Enabled Testing: Use AI tools where appropriate to support test-case creation, test-data preparation, defect analysis, and defect summarization. 
 - Continuous Improvement: Analyse user feedback and improve testing processes, documentation, test coverage, and overall quality-assurance practices. 

Must have

- 6-8+ years of overall software testing experience. 
 - Strong hands-on experience in manual testing. 
 - 15 years of formal education. 
 - Strong stakeholder management and communication skills. 
 - Proactive, curious and continuous-improvement mindset. 
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. 
 - Experience with AI, data analytics and digital technologies. 
 - Experience in UAT and working with cross-functional teams. 
 - Excellent attention to detail
 - Ability to simplify complex themes
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. 
 - Excellent verbal and written communication skills. 
 - Basic understanding of the product development lifecycle. 
 - Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodology is a plus. 
 - Knowledge of tools such as Jira, Trello, Notion, Excel, or Google Sheets is preferred. 
 - Ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced environment. 
 - Eagerness to learn and take ownership of tasks. 
 - Basic understanding of UI/UX principles. 
 - Familiarity with SQL, analytics tools, or wireframing tools is an added advantage. 

Required Skills: The person in this role will need strong skills and experience in: 

- 6 to 8 years of core software testing experience, with at least 5+ years dedicated to online tech platforms B2B and B2C
 - Experience in a cross-border global role, successfully managing multiple complex projects at a global level
 - Outstanding communication skills

Optional/Preferred skills: 

- 3 to 6 years of core software testing experience, with at least 2+ years dedicated to travel-tech platforms, corporate travel booking engines, or OTA (Online Travel Agency) ecosystems. 
 - Experience or working knowledge of the travel domain, especially online booking applications and travel business processes. 
 - Understanding of the travel lifecycle, including PNR creation, ticketing, modifications, cancellations, refunds, void windows, and corporate travel policy configurations. 
 - proficiency with API testing tools (e. g. , Postman, SoapUI). Solid hands-on experience using test management software (e. g. , Jira/Zephyr, ALM, Azure DevOps). 
 - Intermediate proficiency in SQL for backend database verification (joins, indexing, basic data manipulation). 
 - Familiarity with web debugging tools (Chrome DevTools) to analyse network traffic, errors, and payloads. 
 - Conceptual understanding or basic exposure to automation testing frameworks (Selenium, Playwright, or RestAssured) to help transition manual workflows to automation. 

Certifications: ISTQB or equivalent software testing certification Preferred Not mandatory

Work Experience: 8-10 Years of end-to-end functional testing of any online B2C/B2B product preferably travel booking systems

PFI Innovation Centre India is an exciting new innovation center. We're building a future that helps people live better lives longer - and we're looking for bold thinkers and team players to help us do it.

While the PFI Innovation Centre brand is new to India, you'll be a part of the Prudential Financial, Inc. family. Founded in Newark, NJ, we serve 50 million customers across more than 50 countries. With $1. 334 trillion in assets, we're a global leader in institutional asset management. The 2nd largest life insurer in the US and the 9th largest institutional global asset manager. 

At the PFI Innovation Centre India, you'll find high-performance culture that's flexible, collaborative, and grounded in respect. We engage with candor, take calibrated risks, and hold ourselves accountable - always focused on delivering for our customers. It's the standard we choose every day as we grow, perform, and win as one team. We offer valuable leadership, mentoring and learning opportunities, paired with flexibility and support to help you thrive. 

Whether you're just starting out or ready to take your next step, we'll help you grow with purpose and do the best work of your career. 

What You Can Expect

The People Services & Solutions team is responsible for end-to-end ownership of processes and programs that support HR across the global enterprise. Within this organization, a unique opportunity exists for a Senior Testing Analyst to play a critical role in ensuring the quality, stability, and successful delivery of HR technology solutions. This role partners closely with HR Centers of Excellence, Process Solutions, and Technology teams to support testing efforts across key HR functions, including payroll, compensation, talent acquisition, onboarding, learning, and performance management. 

What You Will Do

- Accountability for end-to-end People Team testing execution, including system integration testing (SIT), user acceptance testing (UAT), and regression testing for new initiatives, enhancements, and releases
 - Support of a variety of testing efforts across a broad range of HR functional areas including payroll, compensation, talent acquisition, onboarding, performance management, learning and development, and core HCM
 - Understanding of end-to-end business processes to ensure test cases meet business requirements and expected outcomes
 - Development of test design and scripts, including scenario coverage, defect management, and ensuring audit-ready documentation and clear sign-off processes
 - Help identify testing risks and recommend mitigation strategies
 - Identify, document, prioritize, and track testing defects through resolution, including retesting and validation to confirm defects have been resolved successfully
 - Partnership with People Team Process Solutions, Technology teams, and HR Centers of Excellence to validate testing outcomes
 - Assist with the development and maintenance of testing standards, templates, and documentation. 
 - Participate in project meetings, release planning, and change management activities, as needed
 - Championing of continuous improvement opportunities, including testing automation, process standardization, and improved vendor coordination models

What You Will Bring

- Hands-on experience in system testing, quality assurance, or business analysis within an HR or People Team function in a large, complex organization
 - Experience with HR systems (i. e. Workday or similar) from an HR administrator or technology perspective
 - Knowledge of People Team Operational processes across different areas of HR including but not limited to: payroll, talent acquisition, compensation, performance and talent management, learning and training, etc. 
 - Strong business analysis skills, including experience defining, documenting, and completing test scenarios as well as identifying data issues
 - Proven verbal and written communication skills, with ability to engage across business, technical, and vendor teams
 - Strong attention to detail, and analytical and problem-solving skills
 - Ability to operate in a fast-paced environment, managing multiple priorities and dependencies simultaneously

What will set you apart?

- Experience supporting global HR processes and understanding country-specific requirements and dependencies. 
 - Experience supporting testing activities for Workday implementations, upgrades, or releases, including Workday HCM, Recruiting, Compensation, Payroll, Learning, or Talent modules
 - Familiarity working with system integrations, data validation, and end-to-end process testing across multiple technology platforms. 
 - Exposure to test automation tools and continuous improvement initiatives
 - Ability to develop and maintain testing standards, templates, and reusable testing assets
 - PFI Innovation Centre India welcomes all applicants, even if you don't meet every requirement. If your skills align with the role, we encourage you to apply.

data.title: Engineering Manager, Managed Gateways Infrastructure
data.description:
Are you ready to unlock intelligence?

If you don't think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box - we're looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others. 

The Mission

Kong Cloud Gateways is Kong's foundational cloud-native SaaS platform, powering its managed API and AI Gateway offerings. It provides a multi-tenant control plane, automation, and platform services that let customers securely deploy, operate, and scale dedicated gateway infrastructure with the simplicity of a fully managed cloud service. Behind that experience sits a distributed platform responsible for provisioning, fleet management, software lifecycle, zero-downtime upgrades, observability, security, and multi-region operations across globally distributed cloud infrastructure - built to a target of 99. 99% availability, balancing reliability, performance, operational excellence, and infrastructure efficiency at global SaaS scale. 

As a Software Engineering Manager for Managed Gateways Infrastructure, you will own and grow Kong's Bangalore-based engineering team, taking full accountability for this multi-tenant SaaS platform. Kong Cloud Gateways is growing 100% YoY, and as enterprises increasingly adopt AI alongside traditional APIs, this platform becomes an increasingly important part of Kong's API and AI strategy - every improvement in automation, scalability, and operational excellence you drive accelerates new platform capabilities and lets product teams innovate faster. Beyond the technical charter, you play a key role in shaping a dynamic engineering culture - one built on urgency, ownership, and first-principles thinking - as the team scales to match the pace of the business. 

This is a highly technical, hands-on leadership role - you're expected to stay close to the systems, dig into hard problems alongside your team, and not hesitate to get into the trenches when it matters. 

What You'll Do

- Own and grow Kong's Managed Gateways Infrastructure engineering team in Bangalore - scaling the team's capability, raising the technical bar, and staying hands-on in critical implementations and incidents, not just directing from a distance. 
 - Own the reliability and scalability of a multi-tenant SaaS infrastructure platform serving customers across regions and clouds - every architectural decision has to hold up under multi-tenant load, isolation, and blast-radius considerations, not just single-tenant assumptions. 
 - Drive 4-9s (99. 99%+) availability across Kong's global infrastructure footprint - owning capacity, resilience, and failure-mode design across multi-region, multi-cloud deployments (AWS, Azure, GCP) so Cloud Gateways stays up for customers everywhere, at any scale. 
 - Act as a direct technical contributor when it counts - complex incidents, architecture reviews, and high-stakes implementations that materially move the needle on Managed Gateways' growth and reliability. 
 - Lead, mentor, and grow a high-performing engineering team building and operating Kong's SaaS infrastructure for Managed Gateways, in direct support of our critical enterprise customer base globally. 
 - Architect and implement robust, scalable, and fault-tolerant cloud-native systems using technologies like Kubernetes, Golang, and major cloud providers (AWS, Azure, GCP). 
 - Own the complete operational lifecycle end-to-end - infrastructure, reliability, on-call, incident response, and blameless post-mortems - as one integrated engineering charter, not a separate function. 
 - Drive developer delight and operational efficiency through automation, self-service tooling, and streamlined workflows for deploying and managing API gateways, while proactively preventing technical debt and reducing operational toil. 
 - Define, track, and report on key SLOs and SLIs, and advocate for architectural best practices that keep Managed Gateways performant and resilient as it scales. 
 - Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, engineering, and support teams to influence roadmap decisions and ensure operational readiness for new features. 

What You'll Bring

The Toolkit: 

- Proven experience leading and managing software engineering teams responsible for infrastructure and reliability in a fast-paced, high-growth environment, with a track record of staying technically hands-on rather than purely delegating. 
 - Deep, current expertise in designing, deploying, and operating highly available distributed systems on cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) - this role needs someone who can still open a terminal and debug production, not just review architecture diagrams. 
 - Extensive hands-on experience with Kubernetes (k8s) and container orchestration in production environments. 
 - Proficiency in Golang or similar modern programming languages for infrastructure automation and service development. 
 - Strong understanding of observability principles and experience with tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, or similar. 
 - Demonstrated ability to manage critical incidents personally when needed, perform root cause analysis, and implement effective preventative measures. 
 - Familiarity with API gateway technologies, service mesh, or network proxies is a significant plus. 

The Kong DNA

- Ownership: You take full responsibility for the reliability and performance of systems, driving initiatives from conception to completion. 
 - Urgency: You thrive in dynamic environments, prioritizing critical issues and delivering impactful solutions with speed and precision. 
 - Collaboration: You build strong relationships, foster open communication, and work effectively across global teams to achieve shared goals. 

Bonus Points

- Experience with open-source contributions or active participation in SRE/cloud-native communities. 
 - Certifications in cloud platforms (e. g. , AWS Certified DevOps Engineer) or Kubernetes (e. g. , CKA, CKAD). 
 - Background in companies focused on developer tools, infrastructure software, or API management. 

About Kong

Kong Inc. , the AI Connectivity Company, is building the connectivity layer of AI. Trusted by the Fortune 500® and AI-native startups alike, Kong's unified API and AI platform enables organizations to secure, manage, accelerate, govern, and monetize the flow of intelligence across APIs and AI traffic - on any model, any cloud. For more information, visit www. konghq. com.

data.title: Software Development Engineer in Test (Python)
data.description:
Own Every Moment at NetApp

At NetApp, your ideas power innovation. We lead in intelligent data infrastructure-delivering unified storage, integrated data services, and solutions that help organizations unlock the full potential of their data, from AI to multicloud. 

Ready to innovate and contribute to our path to $10B? Here, you'll collaborate with passionate teams, tackle real-world challenges, and see your impact in how customers transform and grow. If you're ready to bring curiosity, creativity, and drive to every moment, NetApp is where your journey begins. Join teams that innovate to elevate, drive results, and excel together across every function. 

Job Summary

We are looking for a highly motivated Software Engineer (SDET) to join NetApp's ONTAP Engineering team, focusing on SAN and block storage solutions. ONTAP is a feature-rich storage platform used in mission-critical environments across cloud, hybrid, and on-prem deployments. As an Senior Engineer, you will be responsible for designing and developing scalable test frameworks, automation infrastructure, and validation pipelines that ensure high product quality for complex distributed storage systems. You will work across multiple subsystems, understand end-to-end customer workflows, and drive quality at scale. This is an advanced IC role requiring strong technical depth, ownership of features/modules, and the ability to operate with limited supervision while influencing test strategy, automation direction, and cross-team quality outcomes. 

Job Requirements

- Design, develop, and maintain scalable test automation frameworks and infrastructure using Python and related technologies
 - Own end-to-end validation for SAN/block storage features, including test design, execution, and defect lifecycle management
 - Collaborate with development teams to understand feature design, define validation strategies, and drive testability improvements early in the cycle. 
 - Develop functional, integration, stress, and scale tests for distributed storage systems
 - Drive automation-first testing approaches and improve code/test coverage across components
 - Analyze failures, debug complex issues across software layers, and drive root cause resolution. 
 - Participate in product design discussions and contribute to improving reliability, observability, and diagnosability
 - Lead or significantly contribute to test planning, quality reviews, and release readiness. 
 - Work across cross-functional teams (Dev, QA, Field Support) to understand customer use cases and ensure production readiness. 
 - Mentor junior engineers and influence engineering best practices within the team. 
 - Strong programming skills in Python (mandatory) with experience building automation frameworks. 
 - Experience with system-level testing and debugging of distributed systems
 - Solid understanding of Linux/Unix systems, multithreading, and system internals
 - Experience in storage technologies, with strong preference for SAN protocols (FC, iSCSI, NVMe-oF)
 - Understanding of file systems, data paths, replication, or high-availability systems
 - Experience in test automation for scale, performance, and stress scenarios
 - Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, test infrastructure, and modern development workflows. 
 - Strong debugging skills across software and system layers. 

Education

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field (Master's preferred). 
 - 8-12 years of relevant industry experience Proven track record of owning and delivering quality outcomes for complex subsystems
 - Demonstrated ability to work independently on moderately to highly complex problems and drive solutions Preferred Qualifications
 - Deep expertise in SAN/block storage domain (ONTAP, SnapMirror, SVM, HA/MetroCluster, etc. )
 - Experience in large-scale system validation and customer scenario testing
 - Exposure to cloud-integrated storage or hybrid cloud architectures
 - Prior experience in SDET roles driving automation strategy at team level

At NetApp, we embrace a hybrid working environment designed to strengthen connection, collaboration, and culture for all employees. This means that most roles will have some level of in-office and/or in-person expectations, which will be shared during the recruitment process. 

Equal Opportunity Employer: 

NetApp is firmly committed to Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) and to compliance with all federal, state and local laws that prohibit employment discrimination based on age, race, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, religion, disability or genetic information, pregnancy, protected veteran status, and any other protected classification. 

Why You'll Thrive at NetApp

At NetApp, you won't wait for the perfect moment-you'll make it. The early planning, the extra thought, the bold idea that turns good into great: That's how our people operate and how we continue to push the boundaries of data infrastructure. 

NetApp is the trusted partner for organizations transforming data into opportunity. As the only enterprise-grade storage service natively embedded in Google Cloud, AWS, and Microsoft Azure, we empower customers to run everything from traditional workloads to enterprise AI with unmatched performance, resilience, and security. 

Our culture

We celebrate mold breakers, bold thinkers, and problem solvers. We reward initiative, impact, and ownership. We provide flexibility so you can balance professional ambition with your personal life. Here, differences are not just welcomed-they drive everything we do. 

If you're ready to innovate, rise to the challenge, and own every moment - make your next move your best one. Apply now. 

Submitting an Application

To ensure a streamlined and fair hiring process for all candidates, our team only reviews applications submitted through our company website. This practice allows us to track, assess, and respond to applicants efficiently. Emailing our employees, recruiters, or Human Resources personnel directly will not influence your application. 

AI Disclosure

For select roles, some stages of our hiring process may use artificial intelligence tools to help evaluate applications and candidate selection. These tools support-rather than replace-human decision-making.

data.title: Sr Staff Engineer, Mobile
data.description:
About The Role And Team

Engineering at Uber means building for real-world impact under real-world constraints. As a Senior Staff Software Engineer in Rider, you will shape the technical architecture and long-term evolution of the systems that power the Rider experience globally. 

Deep mobile architecture expertise will be the anchor for this role, but not its boundary. You will operate across mobile clients, edge capabilities, and backend services, tackling problems spanning application architecture, performance, reliability, server-driven experiences, client-server contracts, and emerging on-device intelligence. 

Your impact will extend well beyond the code you write. You will shape how multiple engineering teams build and ship Rider experiences-establishing durable technical foundations, simplifying complex systems, making high-leverage architectural decisions, and enabling teams to move faster without compromising performance, reliability, or quality. 

What You'll Do

- Define the multi-year technical strategy and architecture for Rider experiences across mobile applications, client platforms, edge capabilities, and supporting backend services. 
 - Set the architectural direction for the Rider application and client platform, enabling multiple teams to independently build and evolve experiences without compromising performance, reliability, or consistency. 
 - Establish engineering standards and technical foundations across architecture, dependency management, build health, application size, startup and runtime performance, observability, testing, and release quality. 
 - Architect server-driven and cross-platform experience frameworks, making deliberate trade-offs between native, web-based, shared, and backend-driven implementations. 
 - Define durable client-server contracts covering API design, schema evolution, backward compatibility, rollout safety, experimentation, offline behavior, and failure recovery. 
 - Shape the architecture for emerging on-device and edge capabilities, determining what should run on the client versus backend systems while balancing latency, privacy, reliability, battery consumption, and cost. 
 - Build frameworks, SDKs, developer tools, and reusable abstractions that make it easier for product teams to deliver high-quality Rider experiences without repeatedly solving underlying platform problems. 
 - Work with Product and Engineering leadership to identify architectural constraints and technical bets that materially expand the set of Rider experiences we can build, and shape investment priorities accordingly. 
 - Lead major architectural migrations and reduce systemic technical debt, improving engineering velocity, reliability, performance, and product quality across the organization. 
 - Navigate ambiguous, cross-organizational technical problems where there is no obvious architectural answer; make clear trade-offs, establish alignment, and drive decisions to durable outcomes. 
 - Stay close to the technology and periodically dive deep into the hardest architectural and technical problems, while multiplying impact through Staff+ engineers and technical leaders across the organization. 

What You'll Need

- Extensive experience building and operating large-scale production applications on Android or iOS, with deep expertise in mobile architecture. 
 - Proven experience driving major mobile-architecture decisions across areas such as modularization, application performance, build systems, dependency management, application size, or release infrastructure. 
 - Demonstrated ability to reason and operate across the client-server boundary, including designing APIs, data contracts, rollout mechanisms, and resilient end-to-end experiences. 
 - Track record of building platforms, frameworks, or engineering standards adopted by multiple teams-not solely delivering individual product features. 
 - Experience establishing multi-year technical direction and anticipating architectural risks before they constrain product or organizational execution. 
 - Demonstrated success leading complex, cross-functional engineering initiatives from strategy and design through global production adoption. 
 - Proven ability to influence across organizational boundaries and align senior engineering, product, and business stakeholders around a technical direction. 
 - Expertise in establishing standards and practices for testing, performance, observability, reliability, and incident management. 
 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Expert-level proficiency in Kotlin/Java or Swift/Objective-C, with the ability to work effectively across the broader technology stack. 
 - Experience with modern client architectures including server-driven experiences, cross-platform frameworks, hybrid applications, dynamic delivery, experimentation, and progressive rollouts. 
 - Experience designing robust client-server protocols and contracts using technologies such as GraphQL, gRPC, Protobuf, or equivalent API frameworks. 
 - Experience with large monorepositories, build systems such as Bazel, and mobile developer-productivity infrastructure. 
 - Experience optimizing applications for constrained devices and networks, particularly in emerging markets. 
 - Experience with on-device machine learning, model deployment and optimization, mobile ML runtimes, or hardware-accelerated inference. 
 - Experience building mobile experiences powered by LLMs or agents, including architectures that distribute intelligence across device and backend systems. 
 - Strategic architecture mindset: the ability to balance near-term delivery with durable investments that improve engineering velocity, reliability, and product quality across an organization. 
 - Experience representing an organization through internal technical forums, external publications, conference talks, or open-source contributions. 

Ready to Ride?

This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook - it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves - we'd love to hear from you. 

You may be eligible for bonuses, equity, and other compensation, as well as a range of benefits. Explore our benefits. 

Offices remain key to collaboration and Uber's culture. Unless approved for full remote work, employees must spend at least 50% of their time in-office. Some roles, like those at greenlight hubs, require full-time in-office presence. Ask your Recruiter for details about this role's requirements. 

Uber is proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing this form.

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn't a buzzword - it's a way of life.  - Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent preferred
 - Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Unleash Your Potential

Apply today to not only shape the future - but to redefine what's possible - for yourself, for AI, and the world.

This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. About EnCharge AI: 

AI Compiler Engineer

EnCharge AI is a leader in advanced AI hardware and software systems for edge-to-cloud computing. EnCharge's robust and scalable next-generation in-memory computing technology provides orders-of-magnitude higher compute efficiency and density compared to today's best-in-class solutions. The high-performance architecture is coupled with seamless software integration and will enable the immense potential of AI to be accessible in power, energy, and space constrained applications. EnCharge AI launched in 2022 and is led by veteran technologists with backgrounds in semiconductor design and AI systems. 

About the Role

EnCharge AI is seeking a highly skilled and experienced AI Compiler Engineer to spearhead the efforts in developing and optimizing graph compilers tailored to cutting-edge AI and ML workloads. You will collaborate with hardware architects, and AI researchers to enhance performance, optimize computation graphs, and enable efficient model deployment on EnCharge's Inference Accelerators. 

Responsibilities

- Architect, design, and implement optimizations for AI model execution on graph compilers to improve performance, reduce latency, and maximize hardware utilization. 
 - Work closely with ML researchers, hardware engineers, and software developers to design and deploy AI models, understanding and addressing hardware-specific challenges.

data.title: Senior AI Quality Assurance Engineer
data.description:
Senior AI Quality Assurance Engineer (Immediate Joiners Only)

About the Role

You will own the evaluation process for our AI agent system. The system includes models, prompts, tools, memory, and orchestration logic. You will test all of these parts. You will build the tests that decide if an agent is ready to ship. You will find regressions before customers find them. You will measure agent quality with numbers, not opinions. 

What You Will Do

Own the evaluation process

- Build and maintain evaluation suites for the full agent stack. 
 - Test prompt behavior, tool selection, tool calls, multi-step plans, memory use, error recovery, and task results. 
 - Define quality metrics for each capability. Examples: task success rate, trajectory correctness, tool-call accuracy, latency, and cost. 
 - Build and maintain golden datasets, regression suites, and adversarial test sets. Put these datasets under version control. Build evaluation infrastructure

- Build automated evaluation pipelines. Connect them to CI/CD. 
 - Make sure each change to a model, prompt, tool, or the harness must pass evaluation before release. 
 - Use more than one grading method: rule-based checks, exact match, semantic match, human review, and LLM-as-judge. 
 - Calibrate LLM judges against human labels. Monitor the judges for drift. 
 - Add tracing and logs to agent runs. Record each step, each tool call, and each cost. Make failures easy to diagnose. Establish and standardize KPIs and metrics

- Define the KPI set for agent quality. Include accuracy, faithfulness, answer relevance, context precision, context recall, tool-call correctness, hallucination rate, latency, and cost. 
 - Write standard definitions for each metric. Write standard rubrics and report formats. 
 - Make sure teams can compare results across models, prompts, and releases. 
 - Extend evaluation to more than one modality: text, image, audio, and structured documents. Select the correct grading method for each modality. Analyze failures and drive fixes

- Do structured error analysis. Group failures by type. 
 - Find the source of each failure: the model, the harness, or a tool. 
 - Set sample sizes, pass thresholds, and confidence bounds. Agent runs are not deterministic. Plan for variance. 
 - Work with engineers to reproduce failures and to verify fixes. Protect the evaluation results

- Find and prevent test contamination, overfitting to benchmarks, and metric gaming. 
 - Keep a mix of offline evaluations, staged evaluations, and production monitoring. 
 - Make sure evaluation results predict production behavior. Set the quality bar

- Define release criteria for agent changes. Approve or block releases with data. 
 - Write clear documentation for the evaluation methods. 
 - Report results to engineering and to leadership. 

What We Require

- AI and agent evaluation (6 years) or more years of hands-on work in evaluation of LLM systems and agents. 
 - Hands-on skill with RAGAs, Promptfoo, and DeepEval. Skill with Braintrust, LangSmith, W&B Weave, or OpenAI Evals is a plus. 
 - Proof that you can create KPIs and metrics from zero: select the metrics, set the baselines, set the thresholds, and get agreement from stakeholders. 
 - Proof that you can standardize evaluation across teams: shared metric definitions, reusable templates, versioned datasets, and one report format. 
 - Experience with evaluation in more than one modality: text plus image, audio, video, or structured documents. 
 - Knowledge of the agent evaluation problem space: trajectory evaluation, outcome evaluation, tool-use correctness, multi-turn behavior, non-determinism, and prompt sensitivity. 
 - Experience with LLM-as-judge design: rubric design, calibration against human labels, and bias control. 
 - Knowledge of statistics for evaluation: sampling, significance tests, inter-rater agreement, and variance across runs. 
 - Strong Python skills. Experience with test harnesses, data pipelines, or evaluation tools that you built. 
 - Skill with tracing and observability for agent systems. Example: OpenTelemetry-style traces and structured logs of tool calls. 

Core software QA

- Knowledge of QA fundamentals: test plans, test-case design, functional tests, regression tests, integration tests, and defect management. 
 - Hands-on skill with test automation frameworks. Examples: pytest, Playwright, Selenium. 
 - Hands-on skill with API tests. Examples: Postman, REST-assured. 
 - Experience with test suites in CI/CD pipelines. Examples: GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI. 
 - Skill with bug tracking and test management tools. Examples: Jira, TestRail, Xray. 
 - Ability to write clear defect reports that engineers can reproduce. 
 - Knowledge of non-functional tests: performance, load, and reliability. 

What Is a Plus

- Experience with red-teaming, safety evaluations, or adversarial tests of AI systems. 
 - Experience with human annotation work: labeling guidelines, calibration sessions, and inter-annotator agreement. 
 - Background in CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code, or platform engineering. 
 - Contributions to open-source evaluation tools. Published work on evaluation methods. 

What Success Looks Like

- 90 days: You know the current agent harness. You found the gaps in the current evaluations. A baseline regression suite runs on each change. 
 - 6 months: Evaluation results are trusted release gates. Failure types are tracked and decrease. Engineers come to you before they ship. 
 - 12 months: Other teams use the evaluation platform on their own. Offline results predict production quality. Our quality bar is a competitive advantage. 

Why This Role Matters

Agents fail in ways that normal software does not. They fail silently. They fail at random. They fail on step ten of a long task. Users trust an AI product only when the evaluation is rigorous. You own that rigor.

data.title: Lead AI Ops Engineer
data.description:
Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we're helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential. 

Title And Summary

Lead AI Ops Engineer

AI Ops

Overview

Mastercard's Operational Intelligence team is building the next generation of data products and AI solutions that help customers access and use operational insights in new ways. As AI agents move from POC to production, their behavior keeps changing in real time: the context they retrieve, the skills they select, how they resolve exceptions. These agents are never really "finished. " They keep learning from production outcomes, so their reliability, safety, and trustworthiness need to be actively operated, not just monitored. That is the job of AI Ops: making sure each agent's reasoning stays correct, its context stays current, and its behavior stays governed as it learns. 

Role

- Own end to end production monitoring for one or more AI agents, tracking key metrics, KPIs, accuracy, latency, SLA breaches, guardrail triggers, and out of scope rates through dedicated observability dashboards
 - Serve as L1/L2 production support, providing first response monitoring, triage, and escalation to tech teams as new agentic services go live
 - Identify and diagnose issues by monitoring eval scores and drift alerts, inspecting failing traces and patterns, and classifying root causes such as intent, tool, parameter, or hallucination errors
 - Evaluate whether the agent's reasoning remains correct in production, checking whether context retrieval stays current, whether resolutions match ground truth, and whether the learning loop is drifting
 - Monitor and manage post production reliability, including API and authentication failures and issues originating from external AI endpoints, to protect revenue generating, client facing agents
 - Partner with AI Engineering to prioritize fixes, run experiments on prompts, context, and routing in Dev, and validate improvements via evals before handing off proven changes for deployment
 - Embed governance within the agent's learning loop so that approval workflows and audit logging travel with every production change, rather than being added after the fact

All About You

- Experience monitoring or operating production AI/ML or agentic systems, including observability, evaluation, and drift detection practices
 - Strong analytical skills to diagnose root causes across intent classification, tool selection, parameter errors, and hallucination patterns
 - Understanding of AI/LLM observability concepts such as tracing, telemetry, guardrails, and evaluation engineering including benchmarks, automated evals, human review, and regression testing
 - Familiarity with governance, compliance, and responsible AI practices such as PII detection, access control, audit logging, and policy enforcement is a plus
 - Ability to work independently alongside existing Tech teams while owning a dedicated agent's post launch health
 - Excellent communication skills to translate production signals into clear, prioritized asks for AI Product and AI Engineering teams
 - Comfort working in a fast evolving environment where the process itself, not just the throughput, is what is being continuously operated on and improved

Corporate Security Responsibility

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must: 

- Abide by Mastercard's security policies and practices; 
 - Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed; 
 - Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
 - Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard's guidelines.

data.description:
NVIDIA has continuously reinvented itself over two decades. Our invention of the GPU in 1999 sparked the growth of the PC gaming market, redefined modern computer graphics, and revolutionized parallel computing. More recently, GPU deep learning ignited modern AI - the next era of computing. NVIDIA is a "learning machine" that constantly evolves by adapting to new opportunities which are hard to seek, which only we can pursue, and which matter to the world. This is our life's work: to amplify human inventiveness and intelligence. 

NVIDIA is now driving innovation at the intersection of visual processing, high performance computing and artificial intelligence. We are looking for passionate, highly motivated, creative engineers to be part of our HW architecture team. As part of this team, you would be working on projects that will help make our next generation visual computing, automotive, GPU, HPC systems better. You will get to work on high performance CPU and Memory sub-systems, Next-Gen GPUs , NOC based Interconnect Fabric etc. Make the choice to join us today. 

What You'll Be Doing

- System level performance analysis/ bottleneck analysis of complex, high performance GPUs and System-on-Chips (SoCs). 
 - Work on hardware models of different levels of abstraction, including performance models, RTL test benches , emulators and silicon to analyze performance and find performance bottlenecks in the system. 
 - Understand key performance use-cases of the product. Develop workloads and test suits targeting graphics, machine learning, automotive, video, compute vision applications running on these products. 
 - Work closely with the architecture and design teams to explore architecture trade-offs related to system performance, area, and power consumption.

What you'll do

 - Design and improve event-driven architectures, asynchronous workflows, and distributed coordination mechanisms. 
 - Solve complex engineering challenges involving consistency, retries, idempotency, deduplication, backpressure, and failure recovery.

 - Identify and eliminate performance bottlenecks, improving throughput, latency, resource utilization, and infrastructure cost efficiency. 
 - Drive architectural improvements and modernization of existing systems while maintaining production stability.

Who you are

At Bristol Myers Squibb, our employees often ask, "Who are you working for?"-a question that fuels collaboration, accountability, and urgency in our work. Our purpose-driven culture inspires us to discover, develop, and deliver innovative medicines to prevail over serious diseases. We offer uniquely interesting and meaningful work, opportunities for growth, and a supportive environment that values inclusion, wellbeing, flexibility, and comprehensive benefits. This is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it. 

Position: Sr. Software Engineer - AI Engineer

At Bristol Myers Squibb, we are inspired by a single vision - transforming patients' lives through science. Each of our colleagues contribute to innovations that drive meaningful change. 

Scope

The EMES Core Platform, Its Components, Interfaces, Data Layer And Tools - Material And Inventory, Order Management, Equipment And Instrument Integration, Sample Management, Patient Scheduling System Integration, Label Printing, Recipe Authoring And Execution, Electronic Batch Records, And Batch Reporting And Analytics - Together With

- AI and GenAI services embedded in manufacturing workflows: assistants, retrieval over controlled documents, anomaly detection and decision support. 
 - Web applications and operator-facing interfaces across shop-floor, quality and supply-chain personas. 
 - Enterprise data models, databases, audit-trail architecture and reporting data flows; cloud migration and adoption of next-generation manufacturing systems. 

Key Responsibilities

AI Engineering

- Design, build and operate production-grade AI services - not prototypes - including retrieval-augmented generation over SOPs, batch records, deviations and equipment documentation, and agentic workflows that act against MES systems under human oversight. 
 - Own the retrieval architecture (chunking, embedding selection, vector storage such as pgvector or OpenSearch, hybrid search, re-ranking, citation fidelity) and LLM application patterns: structured output and tool calling, MCP servers over enterprise systems, orchestration, cost controls and guardrails. 
 - Establish AI evaluation and observability: golden datasets, offline and online evals, regression gates in CI, hallucination and drift detection, tracing and human-in-the-loop review. 
 - Apply classical ML where it is the better tool (anomaly detection, forecasting, predictive quality) and ensure responsible, compliant AI: data classification, IP and PII protection, model and prompt versioning, reproducibility and validation evidence for GxP-relevant use. 

Web Application Development

- Deliver full-stack applications: React with TypeScript front ends, component libraries and design systems, and responsive, accessible (WCAG) interfaces built for gloved, time-pressured shop-floor use as well as office users. 
 - Build backend services in Python (FastAPI) and/or Java (Spring Boot) exposing REST and GraphQL APIs with OpenAPI-first contracts, secured with OAuth 2. 0/OIDC, JWT, SSO and fine-grained RBAC, and write the data access layer with the same rigour as the API (deliberate query design, sound ORM boundaries, pagination, no N+1 access, idempotent writes). 
 - Implement real-time and AI-assisted experiences - WebSockets/SSE for live batch and equipment status, token streaming with inline citations - alongside validation-rich workflows including e-signature interaction patterns. 
 - Own quality and performance end to end: automated tests across the stack (pytest, Jest/Vitest, Playwright), load testing, and CI/CD (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, ArgoCD) with GitOps delivery of application and database changes together against measured p95 targets. 

System and Data Architecture

- Lead the design of distributed, multi-tenant systems: bounded contexts and Domain-Driven Design, service decomposition, API and event contracts, and evolution strategy. Own the data model end to end - conceptual, logical and physical design, deliberate normalization, and referential integrity, constraints and domain invariants enforced in the database rather than only in application code. 
 - Demonstrate advanced relational expertise: complex SQL, window functions, CTEs, stored procedures (PL/pgSQL, PL/SQL), partitioning, deliberate indexing strategy, and performance diagnosis from execution plans, statistics, lock contention and pool exhaustion. 
 - Apply correct transaction design (isolation levels, concurrency control, idempotency, retry semantics) and migration discipline (Flyway/Liquibase/Alembic, expand-contract zero-downtime rollout, tested rollback), and run databases as production assets on AWS: RDS/Aurora PostgreSQL, Multi-AZ, read replicas, pooling, PITR and DR. 
 - Design regulated-grade data integrity - immutable, append-only audit trails (including hash-chained designs), e-signature records, ALCOA+, retention and archival - satisfying GxP, 21 CFR Part 11 and GAMP 5 (2nd edition, incl. AI/ML guidance) by design, not documentation alone. 
 - Design event-driven systems with Kafka (partitioning and ordering guarantees, transactional outbox, CQRS and event sourcing, sagas) and enable analytics without burdening the transactional system through change data capture (Debezium) and dimensional models for batch reporting. 
 - Reason rigorously about non-functional requirements - capacity, scalability, SLOs, failure modes, circuit breakers, backpressure, graceful degradation when a site link is down - and define caching, queuing and throttling strategy (Redis, SQS/SNS, idempotency keys). 
 - Architect for hybrid deployment (on-premise and near-line where shop-floor latency demands it, AWS for scale) using Docker, Kubernetes (EKS/ECS) and IaC; instrument for observability (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry); and apply security by design, mitigating the OWASP Top 10 and OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications. 

Collaboration and Leadership

- Partner with Manufacturing, MS&T, Quality, Automation and site IT to translate process needs into system and data design; produce and defend the artifacts of real architecture work (ADRs, design documents, data models, sequence and data-flow diagrams, threat models) and run design reviews; and communicate integration contracts to technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Mentor engineers, review code and designs, and raise the bar on clean code, TDD/BDD and craftsmanship - including governed AI-assisted development that improves throughput without weakening review rigour or compliance - while driving continuous improvement through Agile/Scrum across global teams. 

Required Qualifications & Skills

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related field, with 10-12 years of software engineering experience, including 5+ years building and operating web applications and 2+ years delivering AI/ML or GenAI capabilities into production (prototypes alone will not qualify). 
 - Expert-level SQL and relational data modeling with deep hands-on PostgreSQL (or Oracle/SQL Server): schema design, indexing, query tuning, transactions and migrations. 
 - Demonstrable system design capability at the level of a multi-service, multi-tenant platform - bounded contexts, API and event contracts, consistency and failure modes, capacity and scaling - with Docker, Kubernetes (EKS/ECS), cloud-native architecture on AWS, infrastructure as code and Kafka-based event streaming. 
 - Strong hands-on Python 3. x with FastAPI and TypeScript with React; Java/Spring Boot experience is a strong advantage. 
 - Practical experience with the LLM application stack: model APIs, embeddings and vector search, RAG, tool calling, prompt and context engineering, and evaluation. Agent frameworks (LangChain/LangGraph) and MCP server development are an advantage. 
 - Working knowledge of MES/EMES platforms, pharmaceutical manufacturing and regulatory compliance - ISA-88 and ISA-95, electronic batch records, recipe execution - or demonstrated ability to ramp quickly in a regulated domain. 
 - Solid grounding in application and data security (OAuth 2. 0/OIDC, JWT, SSO, RBAC, TLS, secrets management), automated testing, CI/CD and observability tooling. 
 - Clear written communication (design documents, ADRs, API documentation) and strong collaboration across global teams. 

We hire for skills and capabilities, not just credentials - if this role excites you, but doesn't perfectly match your resume, we encourage you to apply anyway. 

How We Work

Where you work matters - because collaboration, innovation and patient impact happen in many settings. Our roles are structured across four work models: site-essential, site-by-design, field-based and remote-by-design. The model assigned to this role is based on its core responsibilities. Learn more at https: //careers. bms. com/ways-of-working.

Applicants can request a reasonable workplace accommodation/adjustment prior to accepting a job offer. If you require reasonable accommodations/adjustments in completing this application, or in any part of the recruitment process, direct your inquiries to adastaffingsupport@bms. com. Visit careers. bms. com/eeo-accessibility to access our complete Equal Employment Opportunity statement.

For roles based in Los Angeles County only: If you live in or expect to work from Los Angeles County if hired for this position, please visit this page for important additional information: https: //careers. bms. com/california-residents/

For roles based in Washington state only: If you live in or expect to work from Washington State if hired for this position, please visit this page for important information about the Washington Fair Chance Act. 

Data Protection

For 70 years, our team has driven meaningful innovations in kidney care. Greater flexibility and efficiency in therapy administration for care teams, and longer, fuller lives for patients- that is what Vantive aspires to deliver. 

We believe Vantive will not only build our leadership in the kidney care space, it will also offer meaningful work to those who join us. At Vantive, you will become part of a community of people who are focused, courageous and don't settle for the mediocre. Each of us is driven to help improve patients' lives worldwide. Join us in advancing our mission to extend lives and expand possibilities.

We believe Vantive will not only build our leadership in the kidney care space, it will also offer meaningful work to those who join us. data.title: Principal Data Engineer - Data Quality
data.description:
Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we're helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential. 

Title And Summary

Principal Data Engineer - Data Quality

Overview

We are seeking a visionary and technically strong engineering leader to drive the evolution of our Enterprise Data Quality capabilities and platforms. The Principal Data Engineer, Data Quality will lead the design, development, and adoption of scalable data quality frameworks, services, and engineering practices that improve trust, reliability, observability, and governance of data across the organization. 

This role requires a strategic thinker with deep expertise in data engineering, data quality, metadata management, and platform architecture, capable of influencing enterprise-wide technology decisions and partnering closely with engineering, governance, analytics, AI, and business teams to deliver innovative and scalable solutions. The successful candidate will lead the development of reusable capabilities that enable consistent, automated, and measurable data quality controls across diverse data ecosystems, including batch, streaming, cloud, on-premises, and SaaS environments. 

The ideal candidate combines strong technical depth with business acumen, executive presence, and organizational leadership. They will be responsible for balancing immediate business needs with long-term platform strategy, promoting Data Quality as a Product and Data Quality as Code mindset, while leveraging automation, observability, and emerging AI technologies to improve data trust, operational efficiency, and enterprise-wide adoption. 

Role

- Define and drive the enterprise Data Quality strategy, roadmap, architecture, standards, and best practices. 
 - Lead the design, development, and evolution of scalable data quality platforms, frameworks, and shared services supporting batch, streaming, cloud, on-premises, and SaaS environments. 
 - Architect and govern metadata-driven, reusable, and configurable data quality capabilities, including rule management, observability, profiling, anomaly detection, and remediation workflows. 
 - Establish enterprise processes for defining, versioning, deploying, and monitoring technical and business data quality rules. 
 - Design and implement Data Quality observability solutions, including trust scores, quality metrics, SLAs, dashboards, alerts, and executive reporting. 
 - Partner with Data Governance, Data Management, Security, Compliance, and business stakeholders to operationalize quality controls and stewardship processes. 
 - Drive adoption of data quality practices across the data product lifecycle, promoting shift-left quality engineering and Data Quality as Code principles. 
 - Ensure quality frameworks are integrated with metadata management, lineage, catalog, governance, MDM, and data contract capabilities. 
 - Provide technical leadership, architecture guidance, and mentoring to engineering teams across multiple programs and domains. 
 - Lead evaluation, selection, and implementation of data quality tools, platforms, and emerging technologies. 
 - Collaborate with Analytics, Data Science, and AI teams to ensure trusted, high-quality, AI-ready datasets and data products. 
 - Identify opportunities to leverage AI, machine learning, and automation to improve data quality monitoring, root cause analysis, remediation, and engineering productivity. 
 - Establish engineering standards, operational controls, and CI/CD practices to improve platform reliability, scalability, security, and maintainability. 
 - Define and measure key performance indicators to track quality improvements, platform adoption, operational efficiency, and business outcomes. 
 - Influence enterprise-wide technology strategy and champion a culture of data quality, ownership, accountability, and continuous improvement. 

All About You

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Systems, Engineering, or related discipline. 
 - 10+ years of experience in Data Engineering, Data Platforms, or Data Architecture. 
 - 5+ years leading enterprise-scale data quality, observability, or data reliability initiatives. 
 - Deep expertise in Data Warehousing, Lakehouse architectures, Metadata management, Data governance and Data quality frameworks
 - Hands-on experience with SQL, Python, Spark/PySpark, Streaming technologies and Cloud data platforms
 - Strong understanding of Data contracts, Lineage, Master Data Management, Metadata-driven architectures and Data observability
 - Experience designing large-scale distributed systems and platform services. 
 - Excellent stakeholder management and executive communication skills. 

________________________________________

- Experience leveraging AI, Machine Learning, or Generative AI technologies to enhance data quality, observability, engineering productivity, and operational efficiency. 
 - Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools, intelligent anomaly detection, automated root cause analysis, and metadata enrichment capabilities. 
 - Experience supporting AI-ready data platforms, including governance, lineage, trust, and quality controls required for AI and GenAI initiatives. 
 - Demonstrated ability to identify and apply AI-driven solutions to solve complex data engineering and data quality challenges. 

Corporate Security Responsibility

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must: 

- Abide by Mastercard's security policies and practices; 
 - Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed; 
 - Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
 - Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard's guidelines.

Job Description

We are seeking a technical operations leader to join the AI Infra Operations team as a Principal Systems Engineer supporting GPU infrastructure in Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI). In this role, you will lead the development and maintenance of automation and operational tooling for GPU fleets across multiple regions, ensuring high availability. You will collaborate closely with engineering and operations teams to build robust automation, observability, and reliability solutions while continuously improving GPU operations. 

Responsibilities

Responsibilities: 

- Build and maintain automation and operational tooling for OCI GPU infrastructure across multiple geographic regions. 
 - Drive collaboration with software engineers, hardware teams, and operations partners to maintain a highly available GPU fleet. 
 - Build and improve monitoring, alerting, and diagnostics for GPU fleet health, performance, capacity, and utilization using tools such as Grafana. 
 - Serve as the senior escalation point for complex GPU host and repair issues
 - Participate in incident response and root-cause analysis to remove blockers affecting GPU capacity, availability, and regional deployments. 
 - Continuously improve AI2 Ops processes, GPU fleet automation, and OCI region build readiness. 
 - Participate in on-call rotations and provide support for critical infrastructure issues. 
 - Document operational procedures, automation workflows, troubleshooting guides, and runbooks. 
 - Build and improve AI agents, ensuring safe rollout, execution and monitoring. 
 - Mentor and guide junior engineers in operational best practices, provide senior technical support, and drive constant improvement. 

Required Qualifications: 

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - 7+ years of software operations or infrastructure automation experience with strong proficiency in Python and Bash. 
 - Expert Linux administration experience, particularly Ubuntu and Oracle Linux, in large-scale production environments. 
 - Strong understanding of distributed systems, including peer-to-peer, node-to-node, and service-to-service communication patterns. 
 - Strong data-center and host-lifecycle experience, including provisioning, validation, repair workflows, hardware replacement, and fleet recovery. 
 - Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting skills. 
 - Excellent communication and teamwork skills. 
 - Experience with observability tooling, including metrics, logging, dashboards, and alerting. 
 - Experience with AI agents and tooling
 - Experience leading on-call operations and incident response. 

Preferred Skills: 

- Hands-on experience with GPU infrastructure, including NVIDIA and AMD based systems, and familiarity with GPU shapes or instance families. 
 - Experience operating or automating GPU, compute, or other large-scale cloud infrastructure. 

About Us

Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives. 

True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That's why we're committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs. 

We're committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation-request_mb@oracle. com or by calling 1-888-404-2494 in the United States. 

Oracle is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans' status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Oracle will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.
