data.description:
About Avaya

Avaya is an enterprise software leader that helps the world's largest organizations and government agencies forge unbreakable connections. 

The Avaya InfinityTM platform unifies fragmented customer experiences, connecting the channels, insights, technologies, and workflows that together create enduring customer and employee relationships. 

We believe success is built through strong connections - with each other, with our work, and with our mission. At Avaya, you'll find a community that values your contributions and supports your growth every step of the way. 

Learn more at https: //www. avaya. com

Job Information

Job Code: 00194001

Job Family: Research and Development

Job Function: Software Engineering

About The Job

We are seeking a Performance Architect - QA to join our R&D team as a senior individual contributor. The ideal candidate is a hands-on performance engineering expert with a deep architectural pedigree in core products, platforms, or large-scale enterprise software. You will shape our overarching performance strategy and partner closely with Product Engineering, Architecture, SRE, DevOps, and R&D teams to deliver highly scalable, resilient, and low-latency products. 

In this role, you will own the performance engineering domain from an architectural perspective-driving strategies that build performance into the core system design. While performance remains your primary focus, you will also bring critical insights into end-to-end, system-level Quality Assurance. By bridging the gap between functional automation and non-functional engineering, you will ensure a holistic approach to system reliability, helping elevate our entire QA framework. This role involves technical ownership and cross-functional influence, with no people-management responsibilities. 

About You

- Experience: 15+ years in QA, software/performance engineering, and automation, with 10+ years of hands-on SaaS experience. Mandatory background in a Core Product or R&D organization. 
 - Architecture & Systems: Expertise in distributed systems, microservices, cloud-native patterns, multi-tenant platforms, and load balancing (e. g. , Istio service mesh). 
 - Performance & Reliability: Experience establishing data-driven SLOs/SLIs and error budgets. Proven ability to lead chaos engineering initiatives (fault injection, failovers) and capacity planning using real-time SRE/APM telemetry. 
 - Testing & Tooling: Expert in performance testing frameworks (K6, JMeter, Gatling, or custom simulators) and stateful/protocol-level fuzzing (HTTP/2, gRPC, WebSocket). Advanced proficiency in functional automation (Playwright, Cypress, Selenium). 
 - Cloud & Infrastructure: Hands-on with Docker, Terraform, and Kubernetes (AKS preferred) for autoscaling and high availability. 
 - Development & CI/CD: Strong programming skills in Java, Python, C#, or Go. Seamless integration of continuous verification into CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Observability: Mastery of APM tools, distributed tracing, database tuning, Prometheus, and Grafana. 
 - Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field. 

Why Join & Who Should Apply

This is a high-impact role focused heavily on technical depth, engineering judgment, and cross-functional mentorship. You are a strong fit if you: 

- Have scaled complex, distributed products in an R&D environment and deeply understand the entire product lifecycle. 
 - Can authoritatively influence architectural decisions using data-driven performance insights. 
 - Possess a big-picture vision for end-to-end QA, optimizing both functional boundaries and non-functional baselines. 
 - Can perfectly balance hands-on coding, debugging, and production analysis with strategic architecture ownership. 

Education

Bachelor degree or equivalent experience

Advance Degree preferred

Preferred Certifications

Footer

Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States without the need for visa sponsorship now or in the future. 

Avaya is an Equal Opportunity employer and a U. S. Federal Contractor. Our commitment to equality is a core value of Avaya. All qualified applicants and employees receive equal treatment without consideration for race, religion, sex, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran or any other protected characteristic. In general, positions at Avaya require the ability to communicate and use office technology effectively. Physical requirements may vary by assigned work location. This job brief/description is subject to change. Nothing in this job description restricts Avaya right to alter the duties and responsibilities of this position at any time for any reason.

data.description:
Job Title: Vice President, Software Engineering, Alpha Data Platform

The Opportunity

We are seeking an experienced engineering leader to help shape and scale Alpha Data Platform, our strategic data platform serving enterprise clients and internal teams. 

Alpha Data Platform delivers trusted data that enables faster decisions, greater agility, reduced operational risk, and deeper investment insights. 

In this role, you will lead a team of approximately 25 engineers in India and own engineering outcomes for significant areas of the platform. You will partner closely with Engineering, Product Management, Architecture, Client Delivery, Support, and others to build scalable, resilient solutions for complex, mission-critical systems. 

This is an opportunity to combine hands-on technical leadership with team development and strategic influence. You will shape architecture, improve engineering execution, and help evolve a platform that supports both State Street and its enterprise clients. 

Key Responsibilities

- Own the technical direction and successful delivery of significant Alpha Data Platform capabilities. 
 - Lead execution across the complete software development lifecycle, from architecture and design through deployment and production support. 
 - Partner with Product Management to translate business and client priorities into a clear, executable engineering roadmap. 
 - Design scalable, maintainable solutions for complex enterprise data and platform requirements. 
 - Guide architectural decisions that improve scalability, performance, resilience, security, and operability. 
 - Provide technical leadership on complex system-design decisions and critical engineering challenges. 
 - Build and develop a high-performing engineering team by hiring, mentoring, and growing engineers and team leads. 
 - Promote engineering excellence through modern development practices, automation, testing, observability, and continuous improvement. 
 - Collaborate across engineering, architecture, client delivery, and support teams on strategic initiatives and critical client needs. 

Required Qualifications

What we are looking for: 

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. 
 - 15+ years of software-engineering experience, including experience leading teams responsible for enterprise-scale production systems. 
 - Strong technical expertise in Java, distributed systems, and database design. 
 - Demonstrated success designing and delivering scalable, reliable, high-quality platforms. 
 - Experience with cloud-native architectures, event-driven systems, and modern software-engineering practices. 
 - Proven ability to hire, mentor, develop, and lead strong technical teams. 
 - Strong communication, collaboration, decision-making, and problem-solving skills. 
 - Ability to balance strategic technical direction with pragmatic delivery. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience developing data platforms or other large-scale, data-intensive systems (Strongly Preferred)
 - Experience with AI-assisted engineering practices and the thoughtful application of AI within software delivery (Strongly Preferred). 
 - Experience in financial services. 

Why this role matters

- You will have the opportunity to influence the evolution of a strategic enterprise platform, develop talented engineering teams, and deliver capabilities that help internal teams and enterprise clients use trusted data to make better and faster decisions. 

About Charles River Development

Charles River Investment management System in a platform that provides many Front-Office functions including Portfolio Management, Order Management and Execution, Compliance, Performance & Attribution, Modelling, Scenario Analysis, and Wealth Management. 

We are part of the State Street Bank. State Street is one of the largest custodian banks, asset managers, and asset intelligence companies in the world. From technology to product innovation, we're making our mark in the financial services industry. For more than two centuries, we've been helping our clients safeguard and steward the investments of millions of people. We provide investment servicing, data & analytics, investment research & trading, and investment management to institutional clients. 

Work, Live and Grow. We make all efforts to create a great work environment. Our benefits packages are competitive and comprehensive. data.title: Software Development Manager, Sports Data Platform - Prime Video Sports
data.description:
Description

Ever wondered how millions of sports fans worldwide get the right notification at the perfect moment during a live game, or how a match result instantly updates across every screen? Come build the systems that make it happen. 

We're Looking For a Software Development Manager To Lead a Team In Bangalore, India, That Sits At The Intersection Of Real Time Sports Data And Customer Experience For One Of The World's Largest Streaming Platforms. You'll Own And Drive The Technical Vision For Three Critical Areas

You'll lead the team building intelligent, real time notification systems that reach fans during the moments that matter most, think close game alerts, score updates, and live activity feeds across devices. Your systems will process live sports signals and make split second decisions about what to send, when, and to whom, at global scale. 

What You'll Do

You will hire and grow a high performing engineering team, define the technical roadmap, and deliver systems that directly shape how customers experience live sports. You'll work closely with product, design, and partner teams across multiple time zones to solve ambiguous, high impact problems. Your decisions will be visible at the highest levels of the organization and felt by millions of customers on game day. 

Why This Role

This is a rare opportunity to build from the ground up in a fast growing, high visibility space. Sports on streaming is still early innings, and the problems here are genuinely hard: real time data at scale, intelligent automation, and matching across thousands of global sports entities. You'll have the autonomy to define and drive innovative features. 

If you love building systems that delight customers in real time and want to be a part of shaping the future of live sports experiences, we'd love to talk. 

Key job responsibilities

A Manager III (SDM III) is a hybrid of system designer, people manager, roadmap/customer satisfaction driver, and project manager. They own the full technology lifecycle of their systems, including development, operations, and deprecation, and are responsible for both the technology vision and business vision of their team. 

- Ambiguity: Leads a team where the business problem or strategy may not yet be defined, with limited guidance
 - Team Management: Manages a two pizza team of SDEs, potentially across locations
 - Technical Leadership: Drives the team to invent, evolve, and deprecate data solutions; scopes projects and evaluates releases against business needs
 - Delivery: Establishes structures for delivering large systems; drives schedules, reprioritizes, and mitigates risks proactively
 - Engineering Excellence: Demonstrates technical breadth and depth; solves problems at root cause; builds flexible systems without over engineering
 - People Development: Hires the right mix of SDEs, manages performance, develops and promotes engineers
 - Communication: Writes narratives and strategic docs, fosters constructive dialogue, escalates risks proactively

Basic Qualifications

- 7+ years of engineering experience
 - 3+ years of engineering team management experience
 - 8+ years of leading the definition and development of multi tier web services experience
 - Knowledge of engineering practices and patterns for the full software/hardware/networks development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, certification, and livesite operations
 - Experience partnering with product or program management teams
 - Experience designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience in communicating with users, other technical teams, and senior leadership to collect requirements, describe software product features, technical designs, and product strategy
 - Experience in recruiting, hiring, mentoring/coaching and managing teams of Software Engineers to improve their skills, and make them more effective, product software engineers

data.title: Associate Software Quality & Test Analyst
data.description:
About Parexel

Parexel is a leading global clinical development partner delivering insights-driven clinical and consulting solutions to the life sciences industry. With 22, 000+ employees worldwide, we partner with biopharmaceutical companies and research sites to design and deliver patient-focused clinical trials that broaden access and make research a care option for anyone, anywhere. 

We work with focus, agility, and shared purpose, moving with urgency to address patient needs and accelerate the delivery of new therapies. We embrace bold thinking, adapt quickly to change, and continually raise the bar for the speed and quality of clinical research. We are expanding our team and seeking talented individuals to help drive industry leading innovation, With Heart®. 

About The Role

We are seeking an Associate Software Quality and Test Analyst (Software Quality Analyst, Test Analyst, Computer System Validation Analyst) to join our life sciences and clinical research team. As an Associate Software Quality and Test Analyst, you will support software quality, system validation, testing, and compliance activities for regulated business applications. This position plays a key role in validation deliverables, change requests, test case creation and execution, and quality documentation, helping ensure that systems remain compliant and audit ready. 

You'll collaborate with business, IT, Quality, and vendor teams, follow industry-standard processes, and contribute to system enhancements and projects. Responsibilities include system validation support, test execution, quality documentation, change request support, and traceability, with opportunities to deepen your expertise and influence system quality and compliance outcomes. 

You'll join a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment focused on making a meaningful impact through validation, testing, and quality activities that keep systems compliant, traceable, and inspection ready. Your work helps protect data integrity and the reliability of the systems that support the delivery of new therapies to patients. With diverse teams and continuous learning opportunities, the Associate Software Quality and Test Analyst can explore career paths and expand skills across clinical research. 

Key Responsibilities

- Support system validation and qualification activities for software applications
 - Develop and execute test cases, test scripts, and user acceptance testing (UAT) scenarios
 - Create, review, and maintain validation and quality documentation. 
 - Support change request assessment, testing, and implementation activities
 - Document test results, defects, and testing evidence
 - Ensure traceability between requirements, testing, and validation deliverables
 - Assist with audit readiness by maintaining accurate and inspection-ready records
 - Collaborate with business, IT, Quality, and vendor teams on system enhancements and projects

You'll Thrive In This Role If You Bring

- Strengths in software testing and UAT, system validation, and quality documentation
 - An understanding of regulated environments and the documentation and compliance standards they require
 - The ability to collaborate across teams and communicate clearly
 - A patient-focused mindset and strong attention to detail
 - Comfort working with change management and defect tracking processes

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in information technology, Computer Science, Life Sciences, Engineering, or a related field
 - 1-3 years of experience in software testing, validation, quality assurance, or related roles
 - Understanding of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), software testing methodologies, and user acceptance testing (UAT) processes
 - Strong analytical, documentation, and problem-solving skills
 - Excellent verbal and written communication skills

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with Computer System Validation (CSV)
 - Knowledge of Good Practice (GxP), Good Automated Manufacturing Practice (GAMP 5), and FDA 21 CFR Part 11 (Electronic Records and Electronic Signatures) requirements
 - Experience with change control and quality management processes
 - Familiarity with tools such as Jira, ServiceNow, HP ALM, and similar tools

We believe in flexibility, growth, and creating space for people to do their best work. Join us and be part of a team where your contributions help shape the future of clinical research. 

If this job doesn't sound like the next step in your career, but perhaps you know of someone who'd be perfect fit, send them the link to apply!

In-Process Inspections

Quality Monitoring

- Monitor production processes to identify quality issues, reporting findings to the Cluster Manager - IPQA. Assist in implementing corrective actions to address in-process quality deviations. 

Calibration & Validation

- Validation of test results and if required, calibration of AOI, Testers (IV curve measurements), weighing balance, & other measurement tool. 

Recipe Management

- Defect teaching to AOI and breakage camera

Benchmarking

- Benchmarking with competitor cells. 

Documentation

data.title: Copy of Lead, QA
data.description:
Ayr designs and manufactures critical power grid equipment including power transformers, distribution transformers, special-purpose transformers, high-voltage circuit breakers, and medium-voltage switchgear. They serve markets such as renewables, data centers, utilities, oil & gas, and industrial sectors. They position themselves as partners in power projects, offering lifecycle support and working to deliver faster than average industry timelines. 

Website: https: //ayr. energy

Role Purpose

Own in-process quality for medium and power transformers (33-400 kV), ensuring products meet applicable standards, customer specifications, and Ayr Energy's Quality Management System (QMS). Lead stage-wise quality controls across core, coil, tanking, assembly, oil processing, and final tests to achieve first-time-right builds, reduce rework, and elevate

customer satisfaction. 

Key Responsibilities

- Quality System & Documentation
 - Create and maintain Control Plans, Inspection & Test Plans (ITP), stage checklists, work instructions, and traveler/route cards; enforce hold/witness points. 
 - Own NCR/CAPA-facilitate structured root cause analysis (5-Why, Fishbone), implement fixes, and verify effectiveness; drive defect prevention. 
 - Maintain device history records, test certificates, as-built dossiers, and customer documentation packs for shipment and FAT. 
 - Supplier & Customer Interface
 - Qualify and develop suppliers for critical items (CRGO, copper, bushings, OLTC, radiators, tanks); conduct audits and PPAP/FAI where applicable. 
 - Lead customer stage and final inspections (FAT), coordinate third-party inspections/test labs, and close observations promptly. 
 - Data, Metrics & Continuous Improvement
 - Track FPY, rework/repair hours, supplier PPM, test bay failures, and COPQ; publish weekly/monthly dashboards. 
 - Apply 7 QC tools, MSA (GR&R), process capability (Cp/Cpk/Pp/Ppk), and SPC to stabilize and improve processes. 
 - Run kaizens to reduce defects (e. g. , oil leaks, winding shorts, paint defects) and cycle time at critical stages. 

Compliance & Standards

- ISO 9001: 2015 QMS; ISO 14001 and ISO 45001 (EHS) - adhere to procedures and participate in audits. 

Qualifications & Experience

- Education: BE/B. Tech or Diploma in Electrical/Mechanical Engineering (Electrical preferred). 
 - Experience: 8-15 years in transformer manufacturing quality; at least 5 years hands-on in-process/stage inspection and test bay exposure for 66 kV+ class. 
 - Certifications (preferred): Six Sigma Green Belt/Black Belt, ASQ CQA/CQE, NDT Level II (VT/PT), Lead Auditor (ISO 9001). 

Skills & Competencies

- Strong knowledge of transformer construction, drawings (GA, core/coil, schematic), tolerances, and insulation systems. 
 - Proficiency with electrical tests (TTR, WR, IR/PI, tan δ/PF, SFRA, AC withstand) and interpretation of results. 
 - Hands-on with metrology and torque tools; ability to set up gauges/fixtures and verify special processes. 
 - QMS documentation, RCA/CAPA, statistical analysis (MSA, Cp/Cpk), and SPC; working knowledge of ERP/MES and Minitab/Excel. 
 - Clear written/verbal communication; ability to coach operators, manage audits, and interface with customers and TPI bodies. 

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

- First-pass yield at critical stages and final test
 - Supplier PPM and on-time NCR closure
 - Defect/rework reduction (%), COPQ trend
 - Calibration compliance and audit scores
 - On-time documentation pack readiness and shipment clearance

Why Join Ayr Energy

Be part of a fast-growing grid hardware company building mission-critical products. You will shape world-class manufacturing systems, work with global suppliers and utilities, and grow into leadership roles with clear impact on reliability and safety of power networks. 

Work Conditions

- Primarily shop-floor based role with regular presence in test bay and oil processing areas. 
 - Shift and weekend support during critical builds or customer inspections as needed. 
 - Travel up to 60% for supplier audits, customer FATs, or type test witnessing.

data.description:

We are seeking a Software Engineering Manager to lead the development of our next‐generation cloud‐native networking, security and AI platforms.  - Foster a culture of technical excellence, accountability, and innovation

- Experience and passion for taking a leading role in building complex software systems, delivered successfully to customers.

 - Improves performance and observability through profiling, logging, metrics, and tracing.

- Leads component and service design aligned with established architecture.

 - Drives architectural improvements and incremental reduction of technical debt. 
 - Collaborates with architects and partner teams on cross-component designs.

- Leads investigation and resolution of complex customer and production issues. 
 - Coordinates with engineering, support, and product teams on mitigations and long-term fixes. 
 - Conducts root-cause analysis and implements preventive improvements. 
 - Communicates technical findings, risks, and resolution progress clearly. 

Practices and Standards Compliance - Security and Compliance: 

- Drives adoption of coding standards, engineering practices, and quality expectations. 
 - Applies secure design and coding practices throughout development. 
 - Addresses application and dependency vulnerabilities with security teams. 
 - Ensures changes meet acceptance criteria and applicable compliance requirements. 

Core Responsibilities

Planning & Execution: 

- Independently delivers complex initiatives, managing scope, dependencies, risks, and milestones. 
 - Balances feature delivery, operational needs, and technical debt while communicating risks early. 

Collaboration & Partnership: 

- Partners across engineering, product, architecture, security, and support teams. 
 - Aligns stakeholders on technical approaches and resolves disagreements through evidence and constructive discussion. 

Problem Solving: 

- Resolves complex, ambiguous problems using data, experimentation, and technical judgment. 
 - Identifies root causes and develops sustainable solutions, engaging specialists when needed. 

Continuous Learning: 

- Builds expertise in relevant technologies, cloud services, and domain workflows. 
 - Applies feedback and shares knowledge through mentoring, reviews, and technical discussions. 

Continuous Improvement: 

- Drives measurable improvements in development, testing, deployment, and support.

data.title: Senior Platform Software Engineer
data.description:
Job Description

Owns application development lifecycle, suggesting improvements and following best practices. Develops features, enhancements, and fixes based on design specs, documenting design and code. Leads code reviews, debugging, and troubleshooting for complex issues. Designs software aligned with architecture, collaborating on customer solutions. Provides technical guidance and support, driving code quality and security standards. Performs maintenance, testing, and upgrades for application systems. 

Responsibilities

Responsibilities: 

- Drives medium features and quality improvements with measurable performance and reliability outcomes. 
 - Provides global production support for critical issues with minimal guidance; improves playbooks/alerts. 
 - Troubleshoots and debugs non-routine issues spanning application layers and common OCI services; proposes fixes. 
 - Define test strategy (unit/integration) for features; ensures consistency across modules. 
 - Considers trade-offs in existing architecture; proposes moderate design improvements. 
 - Translates ambiguous requirements into scalable designs and implementation plans. 
 - Defines and stabilizes API contracts and dependencies for the application area. 
 - Recommends build priorities within the team using data from incidents, telemetry, and customer feedback. 
 - Systematically incorporates external feedback (forums, live-site reports) into backlog refinement. 
 - Mentors junior engineers; coordinates cross-functionally on feature delivery. 

Software Development and Coding - Design, Testing, and Optimization: 

- Designs software solutions and analyzes and helps identify requirements to achieve business and operational goals, independently. 
 - Adheres to and suggests improvements to all phases of the software development lifecycle. 
 - Utilizes working knowledge to develop new software features and enhancements following design specifications and develops documents to clarify software design and code. 
 - Leads code reviews in designated areas to help drive improvements. 
 - Conducts debugging and troubleshooting to identify and fix moderately complex software issues. 
 - Develops fixes for identified issues. 
 - Implements software testing (e. g. , functional and non-functional testing), quality assurance processes, software error logging, monitoring, and observability for effective debugging, ensuring review by manager and/or lead throughout the process. 
 - Exercises judgment and discretion to conduct performance profiling and optimization of coding. 
 - Troubleshoots and resolves moderately complex issues related to application programming interface (API) functionality and integration. 
 - Implements moderately complex API versioning, lifecycle, and interoperability strategies. 

Software Architecture - Software System Structural Design: 

- Designs and develops software, systems, and services aligned to pre-defined system architecture. 
 - Develops working knowledge of software architecture decisions and best practices. 
 - Collaborates with team leads to review work to ensure alignment with software architecture. 
 - Implements moderately complex performance optimization and scalability strategies in software design. 

Issue/Defect Collaboration - Software Products Support: 

- Collaborates within and beyond immediate team to understand customer issues and align solutions. 
 - May provide technical guidance and support to customers regarding customer-reported issues, independently. 
 - Coaches, mentors, and guides others to advocate for customers' interests and suggests product enhancements based on feedback. 
 - Influences team to ensure customer satisfaction through timely resolution of issues and effective communication. 
 - Implements customer issue and/or defect handling and training processes, independently. 
 - Investigates and troubleshoots complex product maintenance issues to ensure customer agreement on short- and long-term solutions (e. g. , future enhancements). 

Practices and Standards Compliance - Security and Compliance: 

- Collaborates with the team to establish and follow development practices and coding standards. 
 - Exercises judgment and discretion to ensure code quality and adherence to broad acceptance criteria during development. 
 - Keeps up-to-date with industry best practices and applies them to software development processes. 
 - Implements secure coding practices to prevent security vulnerabilities. 

Development Operations - System Maintenance: 

- Performs periodic maintenance and testing operations for systems that require upgrading or patching (e. g. , for critical vulnerabilities). 
 - Exercises judgment and discretion to drive improvements, ensure automation, testing, and debugging of systems to ensure service/product availability, health, support, and reliability. 

Core Responsibilities

Planning & Execution: 

- Independently manages work, monitoring timelines and deliverables to ensure projects or initiatives stay on track and meet requirements. 
 - Proactively prioritizes work and adapts to resource or timeline shifts, suggesting adjustments to maintain project efficiency. 

Collaboration & Partnership: 

- Collaborates across teams to align on expectations and achieve shared objectives. 
 - Builds and maintains a comprehensive understanding of business, stakeholder, and/or customer needs to build and support effective partnerships. 
 - Actively listens to diverse perspectives and asks questions to ensure understanding of others. 

Problem Solving: 

- Independently identifies and addresses standard and non-standard issues in accordance with standard practices, escalating more complex issues as appropriate. 
 - Analyzes data and/or information from multiple sources to troubleshoot standard and non-standard errors. 
 - Contributes to knowledge sharing and best practices. 

Continuous Learning: 

- Embraces continuous learning by actively seeking to build knowledge and new skills and/or tools and staying current with industry trends and best practices. 
 - Seeks out and leverages feedback and training to improve skills. 
 - Contributes to a culture of continuous learning and knowledge sharing with team members. 

Continuous Improvement: 

- Develops ideas and recommends updates to increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows within a team. 
 - Seeks input from team members on alternative approaches and methods for improving work. 

About Us

Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives. 

True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That's why we're committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs. 

We're committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation-request_mb@oracle. com or by calling 1-888-404-2494 in the United States. 

Oracle is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans' status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Oracle will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.

data.title: Software Engineer (PLC) -Control System Engineering
data.description:
Job Requirements

At Quest Global, it's not just what we do but how and why we do it that makes us different. With over 25 years as an engineering services provider, we believe in the power of doing things differently to make the impossible possible. Our people are driven by the desire to make the world a better place-to make a positive difference that contributes to a brighter future. We bring together technologies and industries, alongside the contributions of diverse individuals who are empowered by an intentional workplace culture, to solve problems better and faster. 

This position involves developing PLC and HMI control systems for semiconductor gas/chemical delivery equipment. Responsibilities include designing control logic, system integration, commissioning, and troubleshooting. The role involves designing control architectures based on customer requirements and leading the improvement of equipment stability and performance, as well as the standardization of automation. 

As a Senior Engineer, Lead the software programming, system design, and technical direction for chemical and specialty gas delivery equipment used in semiconductors. 

Proficient in PLC, HMI, C/C++, Java, and other PC-based languages at an expert level. Hold a technical vision for the assigned product areas in chemical equipment and translate complex requirements into scalable, high-performance, manufacturable solutions. Through cross-team collaboration, they contribute to engineering standardization and reliability and demonstrate technical leadership in both systems engineering and PLC software development. 

Key Responsibilities

PLC Software Development

- Understand PLC Software Development
 - Develop and maintain PLC software based on IEC 61131-3 standards. 
 - Design, program, test, and validate PLC logic for semiconductor gas and chemical delivery systems. 
 - Support Omron, Siemens, and LS PLC platforms. 
 - Develop reusable software modules and engineering standards

HMI & System Integration

- Configure and maintain HMI systems (Pro-face, MXon/M2I). 
 - Implement alarms, diagnostics, state monitoring, and data logging functions. 
 - Integrate PLC, HMI, instruments, motion devices, and network systems. 

System Engineering

- Analyze customer and product requirements and translate them into software and control system architecture. 
 - Define software-hardware interfaces and control philosophies. 
 - Support system design reviews and risk assessments. 

Troubleshooting & RCA

- Investigate field issues and implement corrective actions. 
 - Lead root cause analysis (RCA) activities. 
 - Optimize system performance, reliability, and maintainability. 

Manufacturing & Customer Support

- Support manufacturing, FAT, SAT, commissioning, and startup activities. 
 - Provide technical support during customer escalations. 
 - Develop manufacturing packages and technical documentation. 

Cross-Functional Collaboration

- Work closely with Mechanical, Electrical, Quality, Project Management, and Manufacturing teams. 
 - Collaborate with global engineering teams on platform standardization and product improvements. 
 - Participate in engineering change management (ECR/ECO) activities. 

Continuous Improvement

- Drive software standardization and code modularization. 
 - Contribute to technology roadmaps for next-generation control systems. 
 - Mentor junior engineers and share technical best practices

We are known for our extraordinary people who make the impossible possible every day. Questians are driven by hunger, humility, and aspiration. We believe that our company culture is the key to our ability to make a true difference in every industry we reach. Our teams regularly invest time and dedicated effort into internal culture work, ensuring that all voices are heard. 

We wholeheartedly believe in the diversity of thought that comes with fostering a culture rooted in respect, where everyone belongs, is valued, and feels inspired to share their ideas. We know embracing our unique differences makes us better, and that solving the worlds hardest engineering problems requires diverse ideas, perspectives, and backgrounds. We shine the brightest when we tap into the many dimensions that thrive across over 21, 000 difference-makers in our workplace. 

Work Experience

Minimum Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Automation Engineering, Software Engineering, Computer Science, or related field. 
 - Minimum 5 years of PLC software development experience. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with: Omron / Siemens / LS PLC
 - Experience with HMI development (Pro-face, MXon, M2I or equivalent). 
 - Knowledge of industrial communication protocols: Ethernet/IP, Modbus TCP/RTU, Profinet, EtherCAT
 - Experience in troubleshooting and debugging industrial automation systems. 
 - Ability to communicate effectively in an international engineering environment

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with semiconductor equipment, gas delivery systems, chemical delivery systems, or process equipment. 
 - Experience supporting customer sites, installation, and commissioning activities. 
 - Experience with SCADA or industrial software platforms. 
 - Knowledge of functional safety and industrial cybersecurity. 
 - Experience leading technical projects or system architecture reviews. 
 - Experience collaborating with global engineering organizations.

data.title: Senior Software Engineer, SaaS Control Plane IRC303076
data.description:
Description

GlobalLogic, a Hitachi Group Company, is a trusted digital engineering partner to the world's largest and most

forward-thinking companies. We promise a people-first culture of caring, flexibility, and personal and professional growth. 

GlobalLogic, a Hitachi Group Company and trusted digital engineering partner, promises a people-first culture of caring, 

flexibility, and growth. GlobalLogic invites passionate problem solvers to join us in engineering impact through intelligent

products, platforms, and services. 

GlobalLogic is the digital engineering company that promises a people-first culture of professional and personal growth. We seek

passionate problem solvers who are energized by meaningful challenges. Using the power of design and complex software

engineering, we create a better future for people and the planet. 

Our customer is a global pioneer in media technology, delivering industry-leading video and audio editing solutions to premier entertainment brands and major hollywood studios. Recognized with accolades ranging from Oscars and Grammys to NAB's Product of the Year, they continue to set the standard for digital media innovation. 

For over 15 years, the strategic partnership with GlobalLogic has been instrumental for our customer in driving product development across their core platforms in audiovideo editing and media workflow management. Our customer is expanding its collaboration with GlobalLogic to engineer next-generation, cloud-based, and AI-augmented media lifecycle management solutions. This effort is supported by a growing team of specialized engineering talent in India dedicated to accelerating Client's cloud and AI roadmap. 

Requirements

We are looking for a talented CloudPython Developer to be a member of the Media Products development team, which creates and maintains several products in our Media product portfolio on audiovideo editing, media workflow management areas. 

You should have

8+ years building backend services for cloud-based SaaS products. 

Solid AWS fundamentals: IAM, ECS/EKS, RDS/Aurora, SQS/SNS, Secrets Manager, and CloudWatch. 

Experience with multi-tenant systems and the patterns that keep tenants isolated and operations manageable. 

Comfort working in Python or Go (or both) and writing well-tested service code. 

Familiarity with async/event-driven patterns and why they matter in a distributed control plane. 

A habits of writing things down - ADRs, runbooks, API contracts. 

ice to have: Kubernetes operator patterns, ArgoCD or similar GitOps tooling, Temporal or Step Functions for workflow orchestration, or experience onboarding enterprise customers with SSO and SCIM. 

Job responsibilities

Software Engineer, SaaS Control Plane

We're building the control plane that manages every tenant, user, and resource across our SaaS platform. You'll work on the core services that handle customer onboarding, principal lifecycle, entitlements, and the operational workflows that keep the platform running reliably at scale. 

What you'll do

- Build and maintain control plane services: tenant provisioning, principal management (users, service accounts, API keys), and entitlement/subscription enforcement. 

- Own the onboarding flow end to end - from account creation and identity setup through resource provisioning and first-use readiness. 

- Design APIs and async workflows that coordinate across services reliably, handling failure and retries gracefully. 

- Instrument services for observability: structured logging, metrics, and distributed tracing so on-call is tractable. 

- Partner with the auth, database, and platform teams to deliver features that are consistent and secure across the full stack. 

- Contribute to operational health: runbooks, alerts, and iterative improvements to reduce toil. 

What we offer

Exciting Projects: We focus on industries like High-Tech, communication, media, healthcare, retail and telecom. Our customer list is full of fantastic global brands and leaders who love what we build for them. 

Collaborative Environment: You Can expand your skills by collaborating with a diverse team of highly talented people in an open, laidback environment - or even abroad in one of our global centers or client facilities!

Work-Life Balance: GlobalLogic prioritizes work-life balance, which is why we offer flexible work schedules, opportunities to work from home, and paid time off and holidays. 

Professional Development: Our dedicated Learning & Development team regularly organizes Communication skills training(GL Vantage, Toast Master), Stress Management program, professional certifications, and technical and soft skill trainings. 

Excellent Benefits: We provide our employees with competitive salaries, family medical insurance, Group Term Life Insurance, Group Personal Accident Insurance , NPS(National Pension Scheme ), Periodic health awareness program, extended maternity leave, annual performance bonuses, and referral bonuses. 

Fun Perks: We want you to love where you work, which is why we host sports events, cultural activities, offer food on subsidies rates, Corporate parties. Our vibrant offices also include dedicated GL Zones, rooftop decks and GL Club where you can drink coffee or tea with your colleagues over a game of table and offer discounts for popular stores and restaurants!

About GlobalLogic

GlobalLogic, a Hitachi Group Company, is a trusted digital engineering partner to the world's largest and most forward-thinking companies. Since 2000, we've been at the forefront of the digital revolution - helping create some of the most innovative and widely used digital products and experiences. Today we continue to collaborate with clients in transforming businesses and redefining industries through intelligent products, platforms, and services.

data.description:
Who We Are

Applied Materials is the global leader in materials science and engineering solutions that are at the foundation of virtually every new semiconductor chip and advanced display in the world. The equipment that we create and service is essential to advancing AI and accelerating the commercialization of next-generation semiconductor chips. Join us and push the boundaries of materials science and engineering in a company at the foundation of the electronics industry. The work we do together advances the world's technology. 

What We Offer

Location: 

Bangalore, IND

You'll benefit from a supportive work culture that encourages you to learn, develop, and grow your career as you take on challenges and drive innovative solutions for our customers. We empower our team to push the boundaries of what is possible-while learning every day in a supportive leading global company. Visit our Careers website to learn more. 

At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. We're committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits. 

Automation Technical Lead

About Applied

Applied Materials is the leader in materials engineering solutions used to produce virtually every new chip and advanced display in the world. Our expertise in modifying materials at atomic levels and on an industrial scale enables customers to transform possibilities into reality. At Applied Materials, our innovations make possible the technology shaping the future. 

Applied Materials India PrimeVision division (E-Beam Wafer Inspection) develops advanced semiconductor inspection solutions combining sophisticated hardware and software technologies. Our software organization is focused on delivering scalable, reliable, and high-quality software solutions that support next-generation inspection platforms

As part of our transformation towards modern microservices-based architectures, we are looking for an experienced Automation Technical Lead to define and drive the automation strategy, framework architecture, and quality engineering standards across multiple product teams. This role will be instrumental in building scalable automation capabilities and enabling high-quality software delivery across all testing layers. 

Our Team

We are a 60+ member software engineering organization with a strong focus on delivering reliable, scalable, and high-quality software solutions. Our Quality Engineering organization consists of Automation and QA engineers responsible for ensuring software quality across the development lifecycle. 

As we modernize our applications into cloud-native and microservices-based platforms, we are investing in reusable automation frameworks, common quality engineering practices, and scalable test architectures that enable teams to deliver faster while maintaining high quality standards. 

Key Focus of the Role: Define and drive Automation Test Architecture, Framework Strategy, Standardization, Quality Governance, and Automation Enablement for a modern microservices ecosystem, while ensuring high-quality engineering standards across Component, Integration, API and End-to-End testing layers. 

Roles And Responsibilities

Automation Strategy & Leadership

- Define and own the Automation Testing strategy across microservices-based platforms. 
 - Establish automation standards, best practices, governance models, and quality engineering guidelines. 
 - Drive adoption of consistent automation approaches across multiple product teams. 
 - Mentor engineering teams on effective use of Generative AI and AI-assisted development tools within automation workflows. 
 - Identify opportunities where AI can reduce automation maintenance costs and improve overall test coverage. 

Automation Architecture & Framework Design

- Define automation architecture supporting Component, Integration, API and End-to-End testing. 
 - Design and evolve reusable automation frameworks, shared libraries, utilities, and common testing services. 
 - Drive framework standardization and commonality across teams to maximize scalability. 
 - Establish test automation design principles that ensure scalability, maintainability, reliability, and efficiency. 
 - Ensure automation solutions provide strong debuggability, reporting, traceability, and execution visibility. 

Quality Enablement

- Define testing strategies and quality standards for distributed and microservices-based applications. 
 - Establish best practices for API testing, service integration testing and end-to-end validation. 
 - Define automation approaches for applications deployed on Docker and Kubernetes platforms. 
 - Partner with Development, QA, DevOps, and Platform Engineering teams to improve product testability and automation readiness. 
 - Recommend and drive improvements that increase automation effectiveness, framework reuse, and quality consistency across services. 

Automation Technical Leadership

- Mentor and guide Automation Engineers and Technical Leads on automation architecture and quality engineering practices. 
 - Lead technical reviews for automation frameworks, test strategies, and quality initiatives. 
 - Evaluate and recommend tools, technologies, and methodologies to improve automation capabilities. 
 - Present automation strategy, quality status, and roadmap updates to engineering leadership. 
 - Influence organizational adoption of automation standards and engineering excellence practices. 

Our Ideal Candidate

- Overall 8+ years of experience in Software Quality Engineering and Test Automation. 
 - Minimum 3+ years of experience leading enterprise-scale automation initiatives. 
 - Proven experience defining automation architecture and enterprise automation frameworks. 
 - Strong understanding of how AI can improve test design, test generation, maintenance, defect analysis, and productivity. 
 - Deep expertise across Component, Integration, API and End-to-End testing. 
 - Strong knowledge of microservices architectures and distributed systems testing. 
 - Experience building reusable automation platforms and common testing capabilities used by multiple teams. 
 - Strong understanding of CI/CD, Continuous Testing, DevOps, and Shift-Left Quality practices. 
 - Experience defining automation solutions for containerized environments using Docker and Kubernetes. 
 - Proficiency in Java, Python, and/or TypeScript. 
 - Experience with Playwright and modern automation technologies. 
 - Excellent problem-solving, analytical, communication, mentoring, and stakeholder management skills. 
 - Ability to influence technical direction and drive quality engineering adoption across teams. 

Qualifications

- Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Electronics Engineering, Information Technology, or related technical discipline. 

Additional Advantage

- Knowledge of modern software delivery and release practices. 
 - Semiconductor domain experience is an added advantage.

Programming Languages: Java, TypeScript

Source Control: Git

Test Automation Frameworks

- Playwright (TypeScript), REST Assured, TestNG, Junit, REST API Testing, gRPC Testing

Container & Platform Technologies

- Docker, Kubernetes, Helm

CI/CD & Quality Gates

- Jenkins, GitHub Actions / Azure DevOps

Test Management & Quality Engineering Tools

- Jira, Xray, Reportportal

Full time

Assignee / Regular

No

Yes

data.title: Principal Technical Operations Engineer
data.description:
Business Unit: 

Cubic Transportation Systems

Company Details: 

When you join Cubic, you become part of a company that creates and delivers technology solutions in transportation to make people's lives easier by simplifying their daily journeys, and defense capabilities to help promote mission success and safety for those who serve their nation. Led by our talented teams around the world, Cubic is committed to solving global issues through innovation and service to our customers and partners. 

We have a top-tier portfolio of businesses, including Cubic Transportation Systems (CTS) and Cubic Defense (CD). Explore more on Cubic. com. 

Job Details: 

Principal Technical Operations Engineer

Position Summary

The Principal Technical Operations Engineer is a hands-on senior technical leader responsible for the stability, reliability, performance, and supportability of Cubic's production systems. The role involves leading the diagnosis and resolution of the most complex software defects, customer-reported issues, configuration problems, data anomalies related challenges across live, interconnected environments. 

As a technical authority across assigned programs, this engineer influences architecture, design, configuration, production readiness, and lifecycle decisions. The role converts production insights into sustainable engineering improvements, drives the elimination of recurring failure patterns, strengthens observability and automation, and guides cross-functional teams in maintaining operational excellence across mission-critical transportation systems. 

Key Responsibilities

Production Support & Issue Resolution

- Understand the enterprise architecture end to end and own troubleshooting across multiple interconnected and complex software systems. 
 - Lead the investigation and resolution of high-impact software defects, configuration issues, integration failures, data anomalies for complex issues. 
 - Provide technical direction during the most complex cross-system production incidents, coordinating diagnosis across application, integration, database, messaging, and external interface layers. 
 - Perform deep-dive root cause and pattern analysis, converting findings into permanent corrective actions, preventive controls, and prioritized engineering improvements. 
 - Maintain system stability through proactive monitoring, configuration management, capacity awareness, and early identification of operational risks. 
 - Define reusable diagnostic approaches and troubleshooting standards that improve resolution quality, reduce mean time to restore, and strengthen support-team effectiveness. 

Technical Leadership

- Own the technical baseline for system architecture, design, configuration, and operational supportability across the full system lifecycle. 
 - Demonstrate strong cross-functional collaboration and advanced expertise in diagnosing, troubleshooting, and resolving complex technical issues. 
 - Demonstrated experience working in a Technical Business Analyst function, with exposure to analyzing end-to-end business processes and their underlying applications, system components, integrations, and data flows to identify gaps, dependencies, risks, and opportunities for operational and technical improvement. 
 - Drive root cause and pattern analysis for recurring production issues, translating findings into scalable engineering improvements and preventive actions. 
 - Champion automation and observability improvements that reduce manual intervention, strengthen reliability, and improve operational efficiency. 
 - Mentor Senior Engineers and support teams, establishing engineering standards, reusable practices, and consistent approaches to complex troubleshooting and technical decision-making.

data.title: Platform & Solution Engineering Lead
data.description:
Role Summary

The Platform and Solution Engineering Lead owns the technical foundation on which the entire Digital Quality (DQ) portfolio is built, delivered and operated. Digital Quality delivers the solutions that transform Quality, Safety and Environmental Operations (QSEO) across Pfizer, and this role is accountable for the platforms, engineering capability and delivery pipelines that allow that portfolio to move at pace while remaining compliant, secure and supportable. 

The incumbent leads a global engineering organisation covering platform engineering, solution architecture and design, integration and data engineering, DevSecOps, environment and release management, and vendor delivery oversight. Accountability spans the full technology mix - Software as a Service (SaaS), commercial off-the-shelf (COTS) and in-house developed solutions - ensuring each is engineered, integrated, validated and operated to a consistent standard rather than as isolated stacks. 

The role is the engineering counterpart to the DQ Solution Leads, who own product strategy and business outcomes, and to the Scaled AI and Solution Architect, who sets cross-portfolio architecture direction and standards; this role is accountable for making those standards real in code, configuration, pipelines and operations. It is also the principal point of alignment between Digital Quality and the wider enterprise technology landscape, including Enterprise Architecture, Cyber Security, the enterprise AI and Data organisation, and central platform and infrastructure teams. The role is global in scope, spanning the PGS network, R&D, commercial markets and corporate locations. 

Role Responsibilities

Platform Engineering and Technical Foundation

- Own the strategy, engineering and lifecycle of the shared technical foundation for Digital Quality, including cloud footprint, runtime platforms, shared services, reusable components, developer tooling and non-production environments. 
 - Build the foundation as a product used by delivery teams across the portfolio, with defined service levels, roadmaps, adoption measures and a managed path for retiring legacy and duplicated technology. 

Solution Engineering Across SaaS, COTS and Custom Build

- Provide engineering leadership and design accountability across the full technology mix, establishing how SaaS platforms are configured and extended, how COTS products are deployed and integrated, and how in-house applications are designed, built and maintained. 
 - Ensure engineering rigour, supportability and consistent quality regardless of delivery model, and prevent unmanaged customisation that undermines upgradability and cost of ownership. 

Integration and Data Engineering

- Own the integration and data engineering layer connecting Digital Quality solutions to each other and to the wider Pfizer landscape, including manufacturing, laboratory, enterprise resource planning and enterprise data platforms. 
 - Establish reusable integration patterns, interfaces and data contracts, and ensure integrations are resilient, monitored, documented and compliant with data integrity requirements. 

DevSecOps, Release and Environment Management

- Define and run the engineering operating model for Digital Quality, covering source control, continuous integration and delivery pipelines, automated testing, security scanning, infrastructure as code, and environment and release management. 
 - Drive automation of validation and compliance evidence so that release frequency, deployment reliability and lead time improve without weakening GxP control. 
 - Own the release calendar and change governance across the portfolio, including coordination of platform vendor release cycles. 

Vendor and Managed Service Delivery

- Hold strategic technology vendors, systems integrators and managed service partners to account for engineering quality, delivery commitments, security posture and service performance. 
 - Shape sourcing strategy and the internal-versus-partner capability mix, define technical standards and acceptance criteria in statements of work, and manage capacity and demand across internal and external engineering teams. 

Enterprise Technology Alignment

- Act as the principal interface between Digital Quality and enterprise technology functions, ensuring DQ solutions adopt enterprise platforms, standards and services rather than building parallel capability. 
 - Influence enterprise roadmaps, standards and investment decisions on behalf of the QSEO domain, and represent Digital Quality in enterprise architecture, cyber security and technology governance forums. 

Organisational Leadership

- Lead, develop and grow a global engineering team of approximately 8-10 direct reports, spanning platform engineers, solution architects, integration and data engineers, DevSecOps and release specialists, alongside matrixed and contract resources. 
 - Build engineering capability, talent pipelines and succession plans; set technical performance expectations and career pathways; and foster a culture of engineering excellence, automation, innovation, accountability and continuous improvement across Digital Quality. 

Compliance, Risk and Governance

- Ensure the technical foundation and all solutions built on it are maintained in a validated and compliant state in accordance with GRC (Governance, Risk and Compliance) guidelines, computerised system validation expectations, data integrity, data privacy and cyber security requirements. 
 - Maintain audit and inspection readiness for engineering processes and evidence, support internal audits and regulatory inspections, and balance pace of innovation with regulatory compliance through effective governance and risk management. 

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree required in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology or a related discipline. 
 - 10+ years of relevant experience in software or platform engineering, technical delivery leadership or engineering management (9+ years with an MS/MBA; 7+ years with a PhD), including accountability for engineering across a portfolio rather than a single application. 
 - Demonstrated experience leading, hiring and developing engineering teams at scale, including matrix leadership of vendor and contract resources across multiple geographies. 
 - Deep hands-on grounding in cloud platform engineering, integration architecture and modern software engineering practice, with practical experience of CI/CD, infrastructure as code, automated testing and security-in-the-pipeline. 
 - Experience delivering and operating across SaaS, COTS and custom-developed solutions, including vendor platform configuration, extension and upgrade management. 
 - Strong experience with Agile ways of working; SAFe preferred. 
 - Knowledge of financial management and procurement activities, with the ability to manage complex budgets, vendor contracts and internal-versus-partner capacity decisions. 
 - Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence senior technical and non-technical stakeholders. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience in the pharmaceutical industry or another highly regulated manufacturing environment, including GxP computerised system validation, data integrity and inspection readiness
 - Experience automating validation and compliance evidence within CI/CD pipelines in a regulated context. 
 - Working knowledge of quality, or EHS platforms and their integration landscape (for example Veeva, LIMS, Cority, Enablon). 
 - Experience engineering or operating AI and data capability in production, in partnership with architecture and data functions. 
 - Demonstrated success leading technology rationalisation, platform consolidation or large-scale migration programmes. 
 - Recognised cloud or architecture certification. 

Physical/Mental Requirements

Typical desk job; no specific physical or mental requirements beyond standard office work. 

Non-standard Work Schedule, Travel Or Environment Requirements

Occasional travel up to 20%

Ability to meet with colleagues virtually across different regions and time zones, including occasional out-of-hours working to support deployment go-lives and hypercare. 

ORGANIZATIONAL RELATIONSHIPS

Reports into Pfizer Digital, PGS, Enabling Functions & Enterprise Platforms - Quality Solutions Lead. 

Key business stakeholders include Enterprise Architecture, Cyber Security, the enterprise AI and Data organization, central cloud, infrastructure and platform teams, Digital Compliance and Computerized System Validation. 

External: strategic software and cloud vendors, systems integrators and managed service partners. 

RESOURCES MANAGED

Financial Accountability

Annual accountability of approximately $10M across platform, cloud consumption, engineering services and managed service investment, including business case development and investment recommendations for the Digital Quality technical foundation

Supervision

Direct leadership of approximately 8 colleagues, including platform engineers, solution architects, integration and data engineers, and DevSecOps and release specialists. Accountability for external partner and managed service relationships, including contract and systems integrator resources working across the Digital Quality portfolio under the colleague's leadership. 

Work Location Assignment: Hybrid

Pfizer is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable equal employment opportunity legislation in each jurisdiction in which it operates. 

To learn more about acceptable and prohibited uses of AI during the recruitment process, please review our candidate AI-use guidelines available on Pfizer Careers.

data.title: Head of Global USP MS&T CoE
data.description:
Position Purpose

Lead the global USP Manufacturing Science & Technology Center of Excellence responsible for technology transfers, process lifecycle management, manufacturing support, validation support, and technical governance across Sandoz manufacturing sites and external partners. 

- Provide scientific leadership and scalable technical solutions that enable robust manufacturing, uninterrupted supply, regulatory compliance, and operational excellence across the global biologics network. 

Your Key Responsibilities

Your responsibilities include, but not limited to: 

Technical Leadership

- Own technical oversight of upstream manufacturing processes across commercial products. 
 - Serve as SME for fed-batch, intensified fed-batch, and continuous perfusion upstream process control strategies. 
 - Lead resolution of complex technical manufacturing issues and investigations. 

Innovation & Emerging Technologies

- Continuously evaluate emerging upstream processing technologies, digital solutions, advanced analytics, automation platforms, single-use technologies, and manufacturing innovations for applicability across the biologics network. 
 - Assess technical feasibility, business value, implementation risks, and potential impact on product quality, process robustness, cost of goods, and supply reliability. 
 - Develop business cases and implementation roadmaps for adoption of state-of-the-art manufacturing technologies. 
 - Partner with Manufacturing, Process Development, Engineering, Digital, and external technology providers to pilot and industrialize innovative solutions. 
 - Drive implementation of approved technologies and ensure effective knowledge transfer across manufacturing sites and CMOs. 
 - Represent MS&T in external industry forums, scientific conferences, and technology networks to identify emerging best practices and innovation opportunities. 

Manufacturing Support

- Ensure timely scientific support for routine manufacturing operations. 
 - Provide expert support for investigations related to process deviations, atypical results, and process performance excursions to in-house facilities as well as CMOs as needed. 
 - Support root cause analysis and implementation of effective CAPAs. 

Process Lifecycle Management

- Lead continued process verification (CPV) programs across commercial products. 
 - Support Annual Product Reviews (APR/PQR) and trend evaluations. 
 - Lead technical risk assessments associated with process changes, deviations, investigations, and technology transfers. 
 - Support change control assessments and implementation of post-approval manufacturing changes. 
 - Ensure technical oversight of process validation lifecycle activities. 
 - Drive robust documentation and knowledge management practices. 

Technology Transfer

- Support/lead upstream process scale-up and transfer activities into and out of the site as well as into and out of the External partners. 
 - Ensure effective transfer of process knowledge, process characterization data, and control strategies. 
 - Assess technical risks associated with process transfers and scale-up activities. 

Validation Activities

- Support PPQ planning, execution, review and closure. 
 - Support process characterization and validation strategy development. 
 - Provide technical oversight for validation exceptions and deviations. 
 - Support ongoing process validation activities throughout the product lifecycle. 
 - Collaborate with Validation, Quality and Manufacturing organizations to maintain validated state. 
 - Review and approve validation protocols, reports, and technical documentation. 

Continuous Improvement

- Drive initiatives to improve yield, throughput, process capability, and cost efficiency. 
 - Promote application of advanced analytics, PAT, digital tools, and data-driven process monitoring. 
 - Identify and implement innovative manufacturing solutions. 

People Leadership

- Lead and develop Technical Managers and scientists within the upstream MS&T organization. 
 - Build technical capabilities and ensure succession planning. 
 - Foster a culture of scientific excellence, accountability, and continuous improvement. 

Key Performance Indicators

Quality & Compliance

- Critical/Major inspection observations
 - Recurring deviation rate
 - Overdue deviations and CAPAs
 - Upstream processes maintained in validated state

Operational Excellence

- Right First Time (RFT) manufacturing
 - Upstream process yield achievement
 - Upstream process CpK/PpK performance
 - Process robustness indicators

Delivery

- Technology transfers delivered OTIF
 - Validation/CPV milestones achieved
 - Technical investigations completed on time

Continuous Improvement

- Yield/productivity improvement realization
 - Successful implementation of process improvements

People

- Employee engagement
 - Talent development and succession readiness
 - Training compliance

Essential Requirements

What you'll bring to the role: 

- PhD in Biotechnology, Bioprocess Engineering, or related field (Preferred) / MSc in Biotechnology, Biochemical Engineering, Life Sciences, Chemical Engineering, Pharmaceutical Sciences, or related discipline. 
 - 10 years experience in Biologics MS&T, Process Development, Technical Operations, or Manufacturing, 3-5 years leadership experience
 - Strong expertise in upstream processing and commercial biologics manufacturing
 - Experience in technology transfer and process validation
 - Experience supporting regulatory inspections. 
 - Continuous manufacturing experience
 - Multi-product commercial manufacturing support
 - Advanced process analytics/PAT experience

Why Sandoz?

Sandoz is the global leader in Biosimilar and Generic medicines, a segment of the healthcare industry that delivers 80% of the world's medicines at 30% of the cost, touching the lives of more than 1 billion people across 100+ countries! While we are proud of our achievements, we have an ambition to do more, so that everyone can achieve the basic human right of access to good healthcare. 

With investments in new development capabilities, production sites, new acquisitions, and partnerships, we have the opportunity to shape the future of Sandoz and help even more people gain access to low-cost, high-quality medicines, sustainably. 

Our momentum is powered by an open, collaborative culture driven by our talented and ambitious colleagues, who, in return for applying their skills, experience an agile and collegiate environment with impactful careers, where diversity of thought is welcomed and where personal growth is supported!

Join us, help us make healthcare fairer and faster. 

Commitment To Diversity & Inclusion

We are committed to building an outstanding, inclusive work environment and diverse teams representative of the patients and communities we serve.

data.title: Senior SCADA Engineer F/M
data.description:
The Company

ALSTEF GROUP is a global leader in the design, integration and maintenance of turnkey automated solutions for airports, intralogistics and parcel handling. With over 1, 000 employees across 18 countries and 5 continents, we deliver innovative and scalable solutions that improve operational efficiency and meet our customers' needs. Join a diverse, international team shaping the future of automated systems. 

Description

Post description

Department: Engineering / Automation

Location: Pune, India

Experience: 5-10 Years

Employment Type: Full-Time

Industry: Airport Baggage Handling / Intralogistics / Industrial Automation

About The Role

We are looking for a Senior SCADA Engineer with strong hands-on experience in SCADA development, configuration, commissioning and troubleshooting, preferably with ICONICS and WinCC. 

The candidate will be responsible for developing and implementing SCADA/HMI solutions for Airport Baggage Handling Systems (BHS), material handling and automated intralogistics systems. The role involves close collaboration with PLC, controls, software and project teams throughout the project lifecycle. 

Key Responsibilities

- Design, develop, configure and maintain SCADA/HMI applications for automation and material handling systems. 
 - Develop and configure SCADA applications using ICONICS and Siemens WinCC. 
 - Integrate SCADA systems with PLC/automation systems, databases and other control-system components. 
 - Configure alarms, events, trends, graphics, tags, recipes, reports and user management. 
 - Develop operator-friendly SCADA screens and graphical interfaces. 
 - Perform SCADA system testing, FAT, SAT, commissioning and site troubleshooting. 
 - Interface with PLCs and control systems for real-time monitoring and control. 
 - Troubleshoot communication issues between SCADA, PLCs, servers, networks and field devices. 
 - Work with protocols/interfaces such as OPC/OPC UA, TCP/IP and industrial communication protocols. 
 - Support SCADA server/client architecture, redundancy and system configuration. 
 - Analyse system issues and provide effective technical solutions during commissioning and operation. 
 - Coordinate with PLC/Controls, Electrical, Software and Project teams to ensure smooth system integration. 
 - Prepare and maintain technical documentation, SCADA standards and project-related documents. 
 - Support remote and on-site commissioning activities whenever required. 
 - Provide technical guidance to junior engineers and support knowledge sharing within the team. 

Mandatory Technical Skills

- Strong hands-on experience in SCADA development and configuration. 
 - Experience with ICONICS SCADA is highly preferred. 
 - Experience with Siemens WinCC is required/preferred. 
 - Good understanding of PLC-SCADA communication and integration. 
 - Experience in SCADA graphics, alarms, trends, tags and database integration. 
 - Knowledge of OPC / OPC UA and industrial communication. 
 - Good understanding of industrial automation systems and control architecture. 
 - Experience in FAT, SAT, commissioning and troubleshooting. 
 - Ability to analyse and resolve SCADA and communication-related issues independently. 

Key Competencies

- Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills
 - Good understanding of automation and control systems
 - Ability to work independently on SCADA projects
 - Good communication and coordination skills
 - Willingness to travel to customer/project sites for commissioning
 - Ability to work effectively with multidisciplinary project teams

What You Will Work On

You will work on automation solutions supporting airport baggage handling and intelligent intralogistics systems, collaborating with engineering and project teams to deliver reliable and high-performance SCADA solutions from development through commissioning. 

Keywords: SCADA Engineer, Senior SCADA Engineer, ICONICS, WinCC, Siemens WinCC, SCADA Development, HMI, PLC, OPC, OPC UA, Automation, BHS, Airport Baggage Handling, Material Handling, Intralogistics, Conveyor, Commissioning, FAT, SAT

Preferred Required

Profile required Preferred Experience

Candidates with experience in any of the following industries will be preferred: 

- Airport Baggage Handling Systems (BHS)
 - Material Handling Systems
 - Intralogistics / Warehouse Automation
 - Conveyor Systems
 - Parcel Sortation
 - Automated Storage & Retrieval Systems (ASRS)
 - Industrial Automation
 - Manufacturing Automation

Experience with BHS/intralogistics projects involving PLC, SCADA and HMI integration will be an added advantage. 

Education

- Bachelor's Degree / Diploma in Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation, Automation or related Engineering discipline.
