data.title: Senior Cloud Developer
data.description:
At Basware, we deliver mission-critical cloud solutions that empower organizations to unlock their full potential. Our products are designed to bring clear and compelling value to our customers, and we're looking for a talented and forward-thinking developer who can help us shape the future of our technology. 

We are seeking a Senior Cloud Developer - Country Compliance, an experienced software engineer, who will contribute to the solutions that keep our customers compliant with country e-invoicing and tax reporting mandates. Your role will be focused on building the country-specific capabilities that connect invoices, credit notes and purchase orders to government tax portals and clearance networks, using the latest technologies and AI-assisted ways of working to deliver large-scale, high-performance, enterprise-grade solutions. 

This is a hands-on technology role, ideal for candidates seeking opportunities to both build on their existing experience and research new knowledge areas, with a significant share of design and exploratory elements to their day-to-day tasks. Every country mandate brings a different set of rules, formats and deadlines, so no two modules look the same. 

You will be working alongside engineers and developers from the Invoice Lifecycle Management (ILM) Teams, assisted by our AI Engineering team, and in integration with other Basware solutions. The product you will be contributing to is targeted at large, well-known enterprises. 

Key Responsibilities

- Design and implement country extension modules against the platform's shared frameworks and architectural conventions. 
 - Build and maintain REST APIs and service layers that carry compliance traffic to and from government portals. 
 - Implement compliance logic: XML and JSON schema validation, digital signature handling, submission to and status polling from government portals. 
 - Write automated tests as part of a TDD workflow, covering both unit and integration levels. 
 - Participate actively in code and design reviews, and help hold the quality bar across the team. 
 - Work with the Lead Developer and QA to harden the performance, security and resilience of compliance flows. 
 - Contribute to CI/CD pipeline improvements and help diagnose and fix production issues. 
 - Use AI coding assistants as part of the daily workflow, critically reviewing and validating what they generate. 

, 

- 5+ years of professional software engineering experience. 
 - Strong Java (17+) and Spring Boot experience building production REST services. 
 - Practical experience using AI coding assistants in a professional workflow, understanding their limitations and validating their output. 
 - Familiarity with XML processing, XSD schema validation and secure XML parsing practices. 
 - Practical experience with MongoDB or another NoSQL document database. 
 - Working knowledge of authentication and authorization mechanisms in web APIs. 
 - Experience deploying and operating applications on AWS cloud infrastructure. 
 - Solid understanding of software design principles and the ability to apply them in day-to-day coding. 
 - Experience with CI/CD pipelines and Test-Driven Development as a working practice. 
 - Good communication skills and the ability to collaborate cross-functionally with product, QA and compliance stakeholders. 
 - Strong sense of ownership, collaborative attitude, and willingness to learn new domains and regulations quickly. 
 - Familiarity with e-invoicing standards and networks such as Peppol and EN 16931, or with national clearance models such as Italy's SDI, Poland's KSeF or the French PPF and PDP model. 
 - Experience with digital signatures and certificates (X. 509, XAdES) or secure token and credential handling. 
 - Exposure to microservices architecture and distributed systems concepts. 
 - Experience with spec-driven AI development, where a written specification drives implementation and tests, and with AI agents and agent skills. 
 - Working knowledge of JavaScript for adjacent integration touchpoints. 
 - We highly value candidates who demonstrate curiosity, a proactive mindset and a willingness to explore and incorporate AI-driven technologies into their work. We encourage growth in this area and provide opportunities for experimentation and learning. 

Why Basware?

We're a purpose-driven company with a global footprint and a collaborative culture. At Basware, you'll work with passionate professionals, cutting-edge technology, and a shared commitment to innovation and excellence. 

Ready to make an impact?

If you're excited by the challenge, apply now and help shape the future of Basware. 

Please submit your resume and cover letter by clicking the 'I'm interested' link. 

Our recruitment process will include pre-employment actions such as enhanced background screening and reference check. 

Basware. Now it all just happens.

data.title: Senior Staff Product Engineer
data.description:
Renesas is one of the top global semiconductor companies in the world. We strive to develop a safer, healthier, greener, and smarter world, and our goal is to make every endpoint intelligent by offering product solutions in the automotive, industrial, infrastructure and IoT markets. Our robust product portfolio includes world leading MCUs, SoCs, Analog and power products, plus Winning Combination solutions that curate these complementary products. We are a key supplier to the world's leading manufacturers of electronics you rely on every day; you may not see our products, but they are all around you. 

Renesas employs roughly 21, 000 people in more than 30 countries worldwide. As a global team, our employees actively embody the Renesas Culture, our guiding principles based on five key elements: Transparent, Agile, Global, Innovative, and Entrepreneurial. Renesas believes in, and has a commitment to, diversity and inclusion, with initiatives and a leadership team dedicated to its resources and values. At Renesas, we want to build a sustainable future where technology helps make our lives easier. Join us and build your future by being part of what's next in electronics and the world. 

Job Description

Position Summary

Renesas Electronics is seeking an experienced Product Engineer ( Senior Staff level) to lead the development, qualification, release, and sustaining of advanced semiconductor power products. This role is responsible for driving product engineering execution across the full lifecycle, from silicon bring-up through high-volume production, with a strong focus on product quality, yield optimization, reliability, and customer success. The ideal candidate will bring deep expertise in power semiconductor technologies (e. g. , Point of loads (POL), Hotswap/Efuse, Drivers solutions) and demonstrate strong ownership of complex technical challenges while influencing cross-functional teams. 

Key Responsibilities

- Own product engineering activities across the full lifecycle, including silicon bring-up, characterization, qualification, production release, and sustaining

- Define and execute comprehensive product qualification strategies aligned to JEDEC and industry standards

- Drive reliability stress planning and interpretation, including HTOL, HAST/uHAST, TC, ELFR, and associated qualification methodologies. 

- Lead ESD and latch-up qualification strategy, data analysis, and failure resolution in alignment with product requirements. 

- Lead root cause analysis and resolution of complex product, test, and manufacturing issues

- Drive improvements in yield, test efficiency, product performance, and cost of quality

- Define and execute characterization and qualification strategies to ensure robust product release

- Partner with design and test engineering teams to optimize DFT, test coverage, and correlation (bench vs ATE vs system)

- Lead cross-functional efforts to resolve customer issues and field escalations

- Analyse yield, parametric, and reliability data to identify trends and drive corrective actions

- Influence product, test, and manufacturing decisions through strong technical judgment and data-driven insights

- Serve as a recognized subject matter expert in product engineering, statistical analysis, reliability, and failure analysis. 

- Lead cross-functional efforts across design, applications, reliability, and test teams to resolve highly complex technical challenges. 

- Provide leadership in defining characterization plans, qualification strategies, and analysis methodologies. 

- Communicate complex analytical findings, qualification results, and failure analysis conclusions to diverse stakeholders, including senior leadership. 

- Influence product release decisions through data-driven insight, technical expertise, and sound engineering judgment. 

- Act as a key authority on product readiness, with accountability for decisions impacting product quality and business outcomes. 

- Work on complex, ambiguous problems requiring evaluation of incomplete or conflicting data, applying conceptual and statistical thinking to determine optimal solutions. 

- Anticipate technical risks in product performance, qualification adequacy, and reliability margins, and proactively drive improvements. 

- Contribute to development of best practices in qualification methodology, data analysis, and engineering decision frameworks. 

- Mentor junior engineers in advanced statistical techniques, reliability interpretation, and structured problem solving and contribute to development of best practices

Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering or Microelectronics Engineering

- 10+ years of experience in semiconductor product engineering, test engineering, or related roles

- Strong experience in semiconductor industry, with preference for power / analog / mixed-signal products

- Deep understanding of product lifecycle (NPI through sustaining)

- Strong working knowledge of JEDEC standards (e. g. , JESD47, JESD22 series) and industry qualification practices. 

- Hands-on experience with ESD qualification (HBM, CDM) and latch-up testing/analysis. 

- Experience with reliability stress planning and interpretation (HTOL, HAST, TC, ELFR, etc. ). 

- Proven track record solving complex technical and yield-related issues

- Strong data analysis skills (JMP, Python, MATLAB or similar)

- Demonstrated success driving efficiency improvements in characterization, qualification, and yield analysis workflows. 

- Experience with ATE, silicon characterization, and production environments

- Deep expertise in statistical analysis, including distribution analysis, correlation analysis, and limit optimization. 

- Strong background in product characterization and electrical performance evaluation. 

- Extensive experience in reliability qualification, ESD, and latch-up methodologies. 

- Demonstrated expertise in failure analysis and root cause investigation across multiple failure modes. 

- Proven leadership in solving highly complex technical problems using data-driven approaches. 

- Experience influencing engineering decisions and leading cross-functional technical initiatives. 

- Strong communication and cross-functional collaboration skills

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

- Successfully lead on-time product releases with robust characterization and qualification coverage

- Drive measurable improvements in yield, test cost, and product quality

- Achieve timely resolution of critical product and customer issues

- Establish strong correlation between bench, ATE, and system-level performance

- Influence key product and test decisions to improve competitiveness

- Contribute to team capability growth through mentorship and technical leadership

Additional Information

 - Identify edge cases and usability issues through exploratory testing
 - Ensure test coverage for areas not suitable for automation

 - Participate in code reviews and continuous improvement of automation frameworks
 - Ensure adherence to Definition of Ready (DoR) and Definition of Done (DoD)

 - Enable continuous testing and shift-left quality practices

 - Validate and troubleshoot system integrations, data flows, and error handling based on defined architectural designs and interfaces

Non-Functional Testing

- Contribute to performance, reliability, and resilience testing

Observability & Debuggability

- Leverage logs, metrics, and traces to improve test reliability

Technical Skills

Assets

data.title: Head of Mechanical Engineering
data.description:
Head - Mechanical Engineering

Location: Nashik | Department: Engineering

NIDO is looking for a senior Mechanical Engineering leader to build and lead the mechanical engineering function for our warehouse automation, material handling, robotics and intralogistics products and systems. 

This is not a pure project-design or engineering coordination role. The person will own mechanical product architecture, engineering standards, design quality, product reliability, team capability and release discipline across NIDO's automation portfolio. 

We are looking for someone who can combine strong engineering fundamentals with practical product development experience and build a function that delivers reliable, standardised, manufacturable and cost-competitive products. 

What you will own

You will be responsible for the complete mechanical engineering function across product development and customer projects, including: 

- Mechanical architecture and design for conveyors, sorters, lifts, ASRS/material handling systems, robotic equipment and other automation products. 
 - Product design and development, from concept engineering, calculations and detailed design to prototyping, validation and production release. 
 - Mechanical systems involving structures, frames, mechanisms, drives, transmissions, bearings, shafts, rollers, belts, chains, linear motion systems and precision assemblies. 
 - Engineering calculations covering loads, stresses, deflections, torque, power transmission, fatigue, vibration and other relevant design parameters. 
 - 3D modelling, assemblies, manufacturing drawings, GD&T, tolerance stack-ups and mechanical BOMs. 
 - Mechanical design standards, component standardisation, modular architecture and approved design libraries. 
 - SolidWorks / equivalent 3D CAD design standards, PDM/PLM practices and engineering documentation discipline. 
 - Mechanical product design for standard NIDO products as well as project/application engineering. 
 - Design reviews, technical approvals, controlled design releases and engineering-change management. 
 - Design for Manufacturing and Assembly (DFM/DFA), value engineering, cost reduction, localisation and component optimisation. 
 - Product reliability, durability, maintainability, serviceability and lifecycle engineering. 
 - Prototype development, design verification, testing, validation and engineering improvements before product release. 
 - Mechanical safety, guarding, ergonomics and compliance with applicable machinery safety and customer standards. 
 - Technical support to Manufacturing, Procurement, Quality, Installation & Commissioning and Service teams. 
 - Resolution of recurring product and field issues through structured root-cause analysis, corrective actions and design improvements. 
 - Building engineering capability, reviewing technical work and developing the Mechanical Engineering team. Leadership responsibility

The Head - Mechanical Engineering will lead the mechanical engineering organisation and work closely with: 

Electrical Engineering · Systems Engineering · Controls & Automation · Product Management · Reliability & Validation · Procurement · Factory Operations · Quality · Installation & Commissioning

You will be expected to create a function that is increasingly based on standard product platforms, modular designs, reusable assemblies, controlled releases and strong engineering governance, rather than repeated project-by-project redesign. 

An important part of the role will be developing a technically capable team, strengthening engineering review practices and ensuring that mechanical engineering decisions are made with a clear understanding of performance, reliability, manufacturing cost and long-term product competitiveness. 

Important role boundary

At NIDO: 

- Mechanical Engineering owns the mechanical product architecture - structures, mechanisms, mechanical drives, assemblies, mechanical BOMs, manufacturing drawings and mechanical design integrity. 
 - Electrical Engineering owns the electrical hardware architecture - power distribution, panels, electrical devices, safety hardware and wiring. 
 - Controls & Automation owns PLC/software logic, motion programming and controls software architecture. 
 - Systems Engineering coordinates system-level requirements, interfaces and integration across mechanical, electrical, controls and software disciplines. The Mechanical Head must therefore be technically strong enough to work across disciplines while maintaining clear ownership of mechanical design decisions, engineering quality and product performance. 

What we are looking for

We would ideally like someone with: 

- 15+ years of relevant mechanical engineering experience, including substantial product development and engineering leadership responsibility. 
 - Strong experience in industrial automation, material handling, warehouse automation, conveyors, sortation systems, ASRS, industrial machinery, robotics or similar engineered equipment. 
 - Hands-on mechanical design experience, including complex assemblies, mechanisms, drive systems and industrial equipment. 
 - Strong proficiency in SolidWorks and/or equivalent 3D mechanical CAD platforms, with exposure to PDM/PLM systems. 
 - Sound knowledge of engineering calculations, material selection, machine elements, structural design, tolerances and manufacturing processes. 
 - Experience taking products through the complete development lifecycle - concept, design, prototype, testing, validation and production. 
 - Strong understanding of sheet metal fabrication, machining, welding, assembly processes, bought-out components and manufacturing constraints. 
 - Experience with mechanical BOMs, engineering documentation, design releases, revision control and engineering-change processes. 
 - Proven ability to improve product reliability, reduce recurring design issues and implement sustainable engineering improvements. 
 - Strong understanding of DFM/DFA, value engineering, standardisation, modularisation and cost optimisation. 
 - Ability to critically review complex mechanical designs and challenge engineering assumptions rather than only manage a team administratively. 
 - Experience working across Product, Electrical, Controls, Production, Procurement, Quality and customer-site teams. 
 - Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving and structured root-cause-analysis capability. 
 - Demonstrated ability to recruit, mentor and develop engineers while establishing strong technical standards and accountability. We are particularly interested in candidates who have built and improved repeatable industrial products, rather than having worked exclusively on one-off project engineering. 

Preferred background

Experience in one or more of the following would be particularly relevant: 

Warehouse Automation · Material Handling Equipment · Conveyor Systems · Sortation Systems · ASRS · Industrial Robotics · Industrial Machinery · Special Purpose Machines · Factory Automation · High-Speed Mechanical Systems

Experience in product-oriented engineering organisations, especially those developing and manufacturing their own machinery, would be an advantage. 

Education

B. E. / B. Tech in Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics or a closely related engineering discipline. 

A postgraduate qualification in Mechanical Design, Machine Design or a related specialisation would be an advantage. 

What success in this role looks like

Over time, we expect this person to build a Mechanical Engineering function where: 

- mechanical designs are standardised, modular and reusable; 
 - new products move through structured design, prototyping, testing and validation stages; 
 - product reliability, durability and maintainability improve measurably; 
 - design releases happen on time and with high first-pass quality; 
 - project-specific engineering variation reduces; 
 - manufacturing and assembly become simpler and more consistent; 
 - product costs improve through intelligent design and component standardisation; 
 - recurring field failures are eliminated through permanent engineering solutions; 
 - mechanical BOMs, drawings and revisions remain accurate and controlled; 
 - engineering decisions are supported by calculations, testing and technical evidence; 
 - junior engineers become stronger technically and develop independent problem-solving capability; 
 - Mechanical, Electrical, Controls and Systems Engineering work as one integrated engineering organisation. About NIDO

NIDO builds industrial technology for intelligent material flow, including automation, mechanisation, robotics and software solutions for warehouses, distribution centres and industrial operations. 

We are in a phase of strengthening and scaling our engineering capabilities, with a focus on developing reliable, innovative, standardised and globally competitive products engineered in India. 

We are looking for senior engineering leaders who want to help build not only projects, but strong products, scalable engineering platforms and high-performing engineering organisations. 

This role offers the opportunity to shape NIDO's mechanical engineering capabilities and contribute directly to the development of our next generation of products. 

Interested candidates can apply through LinkedIn or share their profile with the NIDO recruitment team.

data.description:
Description

Selling Partner Identity Verification (SPIV) ensures that Amazon is a safe and trustworthy place to shop and an amazing place to build a successful business selling products. Our mission is to build trust with our Customers and Selling Partners as we scale through technology, analytics, and science. We're committed to service as a center of excellence for Amazon. 

As part of SPIV, Seller Verification owns variety of products which enables us to collect data from WW Sellers in order to let them sell on Amazon marketplace. Our mission is to: (a) make it simple and fast for Sellers to register globally, (b) verify the identity of every person and business selling on Amazon through the Seller lifecycle, and (c) use automation to achieve accuracy, speed, and scale. When we are successful, we enable Marketplace growth and build trust with our Customers. Registration Systems receive ~1. 5M hits per week and strive towards providing a seamless experience that cannot be exploited by bad actors. As of today, sellers who intend to go global on Amazon need to register in each region and thus, go through the tedious registration process multiple times, which leads to friction for potential global sellers. 

We are looking for a Software Development Manager with a strong sense of ownership and a passion for delivering creative solutions for complex problems on an unprecedented scale. As part of leading a team of engineers, you will have the opportunity to create significant impact on our systems, our business and most importantly, our customers as we take on challenges that can reshape the e-commerce industry.

We are looking for Lead DevOps-Network Automation Engineer to shape and deliver network automation, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), and platform engineering across our network environments. data.title: Staff Manager – Bluetooth Testing and Automation
data.description:
Company

Qualcomm India Private Limited

Job Area

Engineering Group, Engineering Group > Systems Test Engineering

General Summary

We are seeking a Technical Manager to lead Bluetooth validation and test automation for Qualcomm connectivity solutions. This role combines hands-on technical expertise with team leadership and ownership of test strategy, execution, and release quality across Bluetooth Classic (BR/EDR), Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE), and HDT. 

You will work closely with development and cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality Bluetooth features for handsets, wearables, industrial IoT, and voice and music products. You will guide engineers, drive complex issue resolution, and strengthen automation and quality processes across the validation lifecycle. 

Key Responsibilities

- Lead end-to-end Bluetooth validation, including test planning, functional and protocol testing, regression execution, and release-readiness assessment. 
 - Translate product and feature requirements into test strategies, coverage plans, priorities, and execution milestones. 
 - Manage validation priorities, resource allocation, and dependencies; communicate progress, quality risks, and mitigation plans to stakeholders. 
 - Provide hands-on technical leadership in debugging Bluetooth issues using protocol traces, network analyzers, and system logs; collaborate with development teams on root-cause analysis and resolution. 
 - Drive test automation and framework enhancements to improve coverage, repeatability, and execution efficiency. 
 - Lead validation of throughput, CPU utilization, battery-current consumption, and Bluetooth certification requirements. 
 - Mentor engineers, review test plans and technical findings, and build team capability in Bluetooth protocols, debugging, and automation. 
 - Maintain disciplined QA processes, clear documentation, and effective cross-functional communication to support customer deliverables. 

Required Skills And Experience

- 8-12 years of relevant experience in Bluetooth testing and validation, with experience leading technical execution and guiding engineers. 
 - Strong knowledge of Bluetooth BR/EDR, BLE, and HDT, including protocol and feature testing, system-level debugging, and optimization. 
 - Hands-on experience with Bluetooth protocol analyzers such as Frontline and Ellisys, supported by strong analytical and problem-solving skills. 
 - Knowledge of Bluetooth profiles including AVRCP, PBAP, A2DP, HFP, OPP, PAN, and A2DP Sink. 
 - Familiarity with Bluetooth 5. 0 features and Bluetooth certification testing. 
 - Experience evaluating Bluetooth throughput, CPU utilization, and battery-current consumption. 
 - Strong test automation and framework-development experience using one or more of Python, C++, Perl, Tcl, or shell scripting. 
 - Good understanding of networking concepts and TCP/IP protocols. 
 - Ability to own project requirements independently, prioritize competing needs, and coordinate delivery across teams. 
 - Strong communication, documentation, organizational, and mentoring skills. 

Preferred Experience

Hands-on BT testing experience. 

- Experience supporting Bluetooth validation for handsets, wearables, industrial IoT, or voice and music products.

data.description:

Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler. 

Role

We are looking for a Principal Software Development Engineer to join our team. This is a Hybrid role based in Bangalore, reporting to the Director, Software Development Engineering in the Exposure Management & Security Operations department. In this role, you will architect, build, and scale critical security operations and exposure management infrastructure. You will drive end-to-end technical execution, mentor engineering talent, and lead the delivery of high-performance microservices and cloud-native solutions. 

What You'll Do (Role Expectations)

- Designing and developing high-quality, scalable, and secure software systems, including microservices and REST/gRPC APIs

 - Collaborating with front-end engineers to deliver APIs that enable user-focused, high-performance interfaces

Who You Are (Success Profile)

- You thrive in ambiguity. You're comfortable building the path as you walk it. You thrive in a dynamic environment, seeing ambiguity not as a hindrance, but as the raw material to build something meaningful. 
 - You act like an owner. Your passion for the mission fuels your bias for action. You operate with integrity because you genuinely care about the outcome. True ownership involves leveraging dynamic range: the ability to navigate seamlessly between high-level strategy and hands-on execution. 
 - You are a problem-solver. You love running towards the challenges because you are laser-focused on finding the solution, knowing that solving the hard problems delivers the biggest impact. 
 - You are a high-trust collaborator. You are ambitious for the team, not just yourself. You embrace our challenge culture by giving and receiving ongoing feedback-knowing that candor delivered with clarity and respect is the truest form of teamwork and the fastest way to earn trust. 
 - You are a learner. You have a true growth mindset and are obsessed with your own development, actively seeking feedback to become a better partner and a stronger teammate. You love what you do and you do it with purpose. 

What We're Looking For (Minimum Qualifications)

- Foundational understanding of AI/ML technologies and experience leveraging, securing, or positioning AI-driven solutions to optimize outcomes within your functional domain

 - Proficiency with Java, Spring frameworks (e. g. , Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, Spring Security), and containerization with Docker or Kubernetes
 - Deep understanding of cloud platforms such as AWS or GCP and experience with observability tools like DataDog, Grafana, or Prometheus

data.title: Senior Principal - SN QA Lead
data.description:
Business Introduction

GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems. 

Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines. 

Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges. 

Job Purpose

The QA Lead is responsible for defining, governing, and embedding quality assurance practices across the ServiceNow Platform & Enterprise Tools Domain, ensuring that platforms, products, and integrations are delivered with high levels of reliability, security, usability, and compliance. The role establishes a consistent quality strategy aligned to agile and product-based delivery, enabling teams to release changes confidently while protecting service stability and business outcomes. 

Operating as a domain-level quality authority, the QA Lead partners with Product Owners, Solution Architects, engineering teams, and Service Operations to ensure quality is designed-in throughout the delivery lifecycle. The role balances automation, risk-based testing, and governance controls to support rapid delivery while maintaining robust quality standards across ServiceNow and adjacent enterprise tooling. 

Key Responsibilities

Quality Strategy & Governance

- Define and own the quality assurance strategy for the ServiceNow Platform & Enterprise Tools Domain, aligning with product delivery, architecture standards, security requirements, and enterprise governance. 
 - Oversees the end-to-end testing environment, automated testing frameworks, platform release testing, and validation of platform upgrades across ServiceNow and enterprise tools. 
 - Establish domain-wide QA standards, test approaches, and quality gates covering functional, non-functional, regression, integration, and user acceptance testing. 
 - Define risk-based testing approaches to prioritise effort across critical services, high-transaction workflows, regulated processes, and AI-enabled automation. 

Delivery Assurance

- Provide QA leadership across multiple delivery teams, ensuring quality activities are embedded throughout the product lifecycle (refinement, build, test, release, and post-go-live). 
 - Partner with Product Owners and Delivery Managers to define acceptance criteria, test coverage expectations, and release readiness decisions. 
 - Ensure dependencies, integrations, and cross-platform impacts are adequately tested across ServiceNow modules and enterprise tooling integrations. 

Test Automation & Tooling

- Drive the adoption and continuous improvement of test automation strategies, including automated regression, API testing, workflow validation, and data integrity checks. 
 - Govern the use of QA tooling and frameworks (e. g. ServiceNow ATF, API testing tools, CI/CD quality checks), ensuring consistency and reusability. 
 - Balance automated and manual testing approaches based on risk, complexity, and business criticality. 
 - Accountable for the end-to-end testing environment, automated testing frameworks, platform release testing, and validation of platform upgrades across ServiceNow and enterprise tools. 

Non-Functional & Compliance Assurance

- Ensure non-functional requirements (performance, resilience, security, accessibility, operability) are clearly defined, tested, and signed off prior to release. 
 - Partner with Security, Risk, and Compliance teams to embed appropriate controls, evidence, and audit readiness into QA processes. 
 - Support validation of AI-enabled or automated workflows, ensuring transparency, fallback behaviour, and safe operation. 

Operational Readiness & Defect Management

- Oversee defect management processes, ensuring issues are triaged, prioritised, and resolved effectively with clear root-cause insight. 
 - Support go-live and hypercare activities, ensuring quality risks are understood and mitigated. 
 - Contribute to continuous improvement by analysing defect trends, test effectiveness, and release outcomes. 

Professional Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business, Information Technology, Project/Programme Management, or equivalent experience. 
 - Professional certifications desirable (e. g. , ITSM, etc). 

Area of Specialisation

- Quality assurance and test strategy for enterprise platforms, ServiceNow testing and validation, test automation and quality engineering, non-functional testing and risk-based assurance, agile and product-based delivery environments

Why is this level of Education Required?

- A solid educational or professional foundation is required for judgement on quality risk, release readiness, and governance trade-offs. 

Experience Required

- Overall 15 years and typically, 5-7 years in QA, testing, or quality engineering roles within complex enterprise environments. 
 - Proven experience defining and leading QA strategies across multiple teams or platforms. 
 - Strong experience testing workflow-based platforms (e. g. ServiceNow) and complex system integrations. 
 - Demonstrated experience implementing and governing test automation frameworks. 
 - Experience working within agile or DevOps delivery models. 
 - Experience operating in regulated or compliance-driven environments is highly desirable. 

Desirable Requirement: 

- Platform release and environment management leadership - Strong experience owning end-to-end release processes for a mature ServiceNow platform, including planning, coordination, and risk management across environments. 
 - Strategic QA and automated testing governance - Ability to define testing strategy, standards, and automation frameworks (functional, regression, integration) and ensure they are consistently applied across products and modules. 
 - Vendor and MSP QA delivery management - Skilled at directing outsourced QA teams, translating quality requirements into clear work packages, and ensuring MSP output meets agreed coverage, quality, and timeliness targets. 
 - Quality metrics, defect management, and continuous improvement - Strong capability in defining and using quality KPIs (defect rates, test coverage, escape rates), leading defect triage, and driving improvements in QA practices and release robustness. 
 - Collaboration with product, engineering, and release stakeholders - Able to work closely with product managers, engineers, and release managers to align test scope with risk, manage entry/exit criteria, and communicate release readiness clearly. 

Skills/Background

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a structured approach to quality risk. 
 - Excellent communication skills, able to articulate quality impacts to technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Ability to influence delivery teams without direct authority. 
 - Strong understanding of service management, operational risk, and change control. 
 - Comfortable working across global and cross-functional teams. 

#AGTech

Skills

Agile Methodology, AI Product Management, API Testing, Automated Release Management, Automation Frameworks, CI/CD, Knowledge Management, Leadership, Open Web Application Security Project (OWASP), Penetration Testing, Performance Testing, Regression Testing, Scripting, ServiceNow IT Business Management, ServiceNow IT Service Management (ITSM), Test Automation Framework, Test Case Design, Test Management Tools, Tool Selection

Why GSK?

Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. 

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2. 5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases - to impact health at scale. 

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we're committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN. recruitment-adjustments@gsk. com to discuss your needs.

Contentstack helps enterprises move beyond that complexity by connecting content, data and AI in a way that makes digital experiences faster to launch, easier to manage and more adaptive in real time.

Learn more at www. contentstack. com. 

Who Are We?

At Contentstack we are more than colleagues, we are a tribe. Our vision is to pursue equity among our communities, employees, partners, and customers. We are global-diverse yet close; distributed yet connected. We are dreamers and dreammakers who challenge the status quo. We do the right thing, even when no one is watching. data.title: Data Operation Analyst
data.description:
At Commure, we're building the AI Operating System for healthcare, the foundation that defines how care is delivered, documented, and financed. Our platform spans the full care journey: Ambient AI and Dictation eliminating documentation burden at the point of care, intelligent Agents automating patient and revenue workflows, and autonomous RCM processing billions in claims, all on a single AI-native platform integrated with 60+ EHRs. 

Healthcare carries a $1 trillion administrative burden and we're at the center of transforming it. Today, 500, 000+ clinicians across 500+ healthcare organizations nationwide trust Commure to handle $25B+ in annual claims and support over 200 million patient interactions. Our latest $70M raise at a $7B valuation reflects the confidence the market has placed in this mission. We've also been named to the Fortune Future 50 list and the 2026 AI Breakthrough Awards for "Overall NLP Company of the Year. "

Our team works directly alongside clinicians, not through layers of process, which means the gap between what you build and its impact on patient care is immediate. We move fast, deploy daily, and take full ownership from early thinking to production. If you're energized by hard problems, high stakes, and a team that holds itself to a high bar, you'll find your people here. 

The future of healthcare is being built right now. Come deliver this transformation. 

About The Role

We are seeking a Data Operations Analyst who will work at the intersection of QBR technical support and Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) data analysis. This role requires a strong mix of technical expertise (SQL, Excel, data validation), critical thinking, and attention to detail. The Analyst will be responsible for creating and enhancing QBR decks, running custom analyses, and ensuring high-quality data accuracy within patient verification and benefits processes. 

The ideal candidate will bring strong analytical skills, a problem-solving mindset, and the ability to deliver error-free, business-critical outputs for internal teams and clients. 

What You'll Do

- Deck Creation & Automation: 
 - Run daily deck automations to generate reports (10-15%). 
 - Own direct connect decks end-to-end: ensure 100% QA, escalate concerning metrics, and transition high-revenue decks to AMs (10-15%). 
 - Work on custom and strategic QBR decks (30-40%), including adding tailored slides, insights, and SQL/Excel analysis that elevate reporting beyond standard decks. 
 - Custom Analysis & Data QA 
 - Client-Facing Custom Analysis: Support ad hoc requests from clients, including detailed SQL and Excel-based analysis, and develop custom Retool dashboards where applicable. 
 - Data Verification: Validate that revenue transaction reports are accurately ingested from EHR systems and reconcile data discrepancies. 
 - Quality Assurance Testing: Develop and execute test plans for data ingestion, identify discrepancies, and document QA results. 
 - Mathematical/Financial Analysis: Apply quantitative reasoning to validate numerical accuracy in reports and ensure data integrity. 
 - Process Improvement: Collaborate with engineering and operations teams to streamline QA processes, data workflows, and reporting accuracy. 
 - Documentation & Reporting: Maintain records of QA activities, mappings, and findings, and present reports to stakeholders. 
 - Compliance: Ensure all data handling complies with HIPAA and other regulatory requirements. 
What You Have

- Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Mathematics, Healthcare Informatics, or related field. 
 - Minimum 1 year of experience in data analysis, quality assurance, or technical reporting (healthcare/RCM preferred). 
 - Strong technical ability: Proficiency in SQL and Excel (including pivot tables, VLOOKUP, macros, and data analysis). 
 - Ability to perform quantitative reasoning to review metrics logically and identify inconsistencies. 
 - High attention to detail - able to spot even the smallest errors before work is released. 
 - Strong communication skills to relay insights, raise concerns, and collaborate across teams. 
 - Familiarity with healthcare revenue cycle and financial reporting (preferred). 
 - Experience with data visualisation tools (Tableau, Power BI) is a plus. 
 - Growth mindset - ability to become semi-self-sufficient within 2-3 months. 
 - Willingness to work in India Night Shifts (US Day shift - EST to PST). 

Please be aware that all official communication from us will come exclusively from email addresses ending in @commure. com. Any emails from other domains are not affiliated with our organization. 

Employees will act in accordance with the organization's information security policies, to include but not limited to protecting assets from unauthorized access, disclosure, modification, destruction or interference nor execute particular security processes or activities. Employees will report to the information security office any confirmed or potential events or other risks to the organization. Employees will be required to attest to these requirements upon hire and on an annual basis.

Introduction To Role

Are you ready to lead the shift from low-code to scalable pro-code analytics that power critical decisions and, ultimately, better patient outcomes? As the lead in Custom Analytics management, you will be the hands-on engineering and change leader crafting a high-performance, enterprise-grade analytics application used across our global operations. 

You will champion AI-assisted development with a human-in-control ethos-accelerating delivery while safeguarding design quality, security, and compliance. Working closely with technical partners and multi-functional collaborators, you will translate complex requirements into well-structured implementations. These will involve working with React, TypeScript, Python alongside FastAPI, APIs, quality assurance, and continuous integration and delivery. Can you picture guiding teams through this transformation while leaving behind reusable patterns, frameworks, and guides that improve efficiency and quality across the board?

We are in a period of rapid growth and digital reinvention, where smarter engineering frees scientists and business colleagues to focus on discovery, insight, and decisions. Your work will streamline the process through which we develop analytics, reduce cycle time across the SDLC, and drive consistent, standards-aligned delivery that scales. 

Accountabilities

Front-End Engineering: Develop reusable UI components using React + TypeScript + Ant Design to create a consistent, maintainable user experience that accelerates feature delivery. 

Backend Services: Build and maintain backend services using FastAPI (Python) to deliver reliable, secure, and scalable business capabilities. 

API Build and Integration: Implement RESTful APIs following defined standards and guidelines, enabling interoperability and performance across services. 

Data Engineering: Handle data transformation, aggregation, and integration tasks to ensure accurate, timely insights for analytics use cases. 

Engineering Standards: Follow established system architecture and coding standards to ensure maintainability, compliance, and consistency with organizational frameworks. 

Quality and Validation: Ensure code quality through testing, validation, and alignment with standards, growing confidence in releases and reducing defects. 

Performance and Debugging: Support performance optimization and debugging across the application to improve user experience and system resilience. 

DevOps and Delivery: Collaborate using Docker and continuous integration and delivery pipelines to ensure smooth deployment processes and faster, reliable releases. 

Risk and Issue Management: Advance and communicate technical risks or blockers effectively to reduce delivery friction and protect timelines. 

AI-Assisted Delivery: Use approved AI coding assistants such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, or equivalent tools to accelerate coding, refactoring, documentation, testing, debugging, and solution analysis while maintaining human oversight. 

Coaching and Capability Building: Coach low-code/no-code developers into pro-code practices through upskilling, paired development, reusable templates, coding standards, and guided AI-assisted workflows. 

Responsible AI Guardrails: Apply guardrails for AI-generated code, including human review, testing, security validation, documentation, and alignment with enterprise architecture standards. 

Pro-Code Translation: Translate low-code/no-code prototypes into scalable pro-code solutions, balancing rapid prototyping with maintainability, extensibility, performance, and governance. 

Patterns and Templates: Create reusable patterns, repository guidance, starter templates, and playbooks that help AI tools produce consistent, standards-aligned outputs. 

Change Management: Support AI-assisted development change management through awareness, enablement, office hours, quick-start guides, feedback loops, adoption tracking, and reinforcement. 

Cross-Functional Partnership: Partner with leads, BAs, solution teams, and developers to reduce SDLC effort through AI across requirements, design, build, test, deployment, and support. 

Measurement and Reporting: Track adoption, productivity, quality outcomes, and risks from AI-assisted practices, and share progress, blockers, and lessons learned with stakeholders.

REST API design and integration

Asynchronous programming

Component-based architecture

Experience with Redux Toolkit or similar state management tools

Strong SQL Skills And Experience With Relational Databases

Clean code practices

Scalable application design

Strong debugging and problem-solving skills

Ability to use AI across the SDLC for code generation/explanation, refactoring, unit tests, test cases, debugging, documentation, and implementation planning. 

Strong understanding of responsible AI-generated code use, including review, hallucination checks, dependency validation, privacy, and security vulnerability checks. 

Experience moving teams from low-code/no-code to pro-code through capability building, coaching, standards adoption, and change management. 

Ability to create developer guidance, reusable prompts, coding patterns, repository instructions, and documentation for consistent AI-assisted outputs. 

Strong engineering mindset to balance rapid AI-assisted delivery with maintainability, scalability, quality, compliance, and production readiness. 

Comfortable mentoring developers moving from Power Platform, workflow automation, or other low-code/no-code tools into React, TypeScript, Python, APIs, Git, testing, and CI/CD. 

Desirable Skills/Experience

Job Description

Lead Software Engineer Job Location - Pune (Hybrid) About the Team

The Logistics Technology team at Williams-Sonoma, Inc. builds and supports the platforms that move product across our supply chain - from distribution center operations and warehouse management to material handling automation, labeling, and sortation for brands including Williams Sonoma, Pottery Barn, West Elm, and Rejuvenation. We partner closely with Supply Chain, Distribution Center operations, and third-party automation vendors to keep fulfillment fast, accurate, and cost-effective. It is a hands-on, high-ownership team where engineers work end to end - designing systems, integrating with WMS, PLCs, and material handling equipment, and applying automation and AI to improve how our distribution network runs every day. 

About The Role

The Lead Software Engineer will lead the design, development, and delivery of a Windows-based sortation and labeling platform that integrates with PKMS/WMS systems, PLCs, and material handling equipment (MHE) across our distribution network. The system processes TCP socket messages for carton lifecycle events, persists data to enterprise databases, and coordinates downstream services, subject-matter depth in warehouse automation and MHE, and close collaboration with cross-functional business, DC operations, WCS and WES system integrations, and coordination with third-party vendor teams such as Savoye, Opex, Honeywell Intelligrated, Boxer, and bagger/print-and-apply solution providers. 

Responsibilities

data.title: Senior Java Developer
data.description:
Description

Anaqua is seeking a Senior Java Developer to take ownership of core backend services on RightHub, our distributed, domain-driven Java platform on GCP. In this hands-on senior role, you will own services end-to-end, design domain events and service integrations, and set the technical bar for the engineers around you. This role suits someone with strong distributed-systems instincts and a track record of mentoring. 

You'll Love This Job If You Like To

- Own services end-to-end on a modern Java + Spring Boot platform - design, implementation, deployment, and monitoring. 
 - Design domain events and the integrations between services - event types, processors, idempotency, and eventual-consistency boundaries. 
 - Extend the shared platform libraries - auth, async tasks, common infrastructure - that every service in the company depends on. 
 - Write code that is genuinely tested - strong unit, integration, and contract testing as part of the development loop. 
 - Drive performance and reliability work, including query optimisation, debugging distributed flows, and capacity planning. 
 - Raise the engineering bar through code review, technical design docs, and mentoring mid-level engineers. 
 - Work across a modern stack: Java (latest LTS), Spring Boot 3. x, Spring Cloud GCP, Kubernetes (GKE), PostgreSQL with a domain-event model, and contract-first APIs with OpenAPI. 
 - Work closely with frontend engineers on the Next. js application when shipping features that cross the boundary. 

What You'll Need To Be Successful

- 5+ years of senior-level Java engineering with proven production ownership of services real users depend on. 
 - Strong Spring Boot in production - fluent on transactional boundaries, connection pools, JVM tuning, and how things break under load. 
 - Distributed-systems thinking - async messaging, idempotency, retries, ordering, eventual consistency, and clean bounded contexts. 
 - Comfort with domain-driven design and event-sourcing patterns, designing domain events that capture state transitions. 
 - Contract-first API design with OpenAPI, deep PostgreSQL (schema design, indexing, migrations under load). 
 - Production experience running services on Kubernetes, with hands-on experience on a major public cloud (GCP preferred). 
 - Strong testing discipline and extensive experience converting business requirements to technical requirements. 
 - Track record of mentoring, raising the engineering bar, and excellent written and spoken English. 
 - Spring Cloud GCP/Pub/Sub/Cloud Run, reusable internal libraries, React/Next. js knowledge, or IP/legal-tech/regulated B2B SaaS exposure all an advantage. 

Anaqua, Inc. is a premium provider of integrated intellectual property (IP) management technology solutions and services. Anaqua's AQX platform combines best practice workflows with big data analytics and tech-enabled services to create an intelligent environment designed to inform IP strategy, enable IP decision-making, and streamline IP operations. Today, nearly half of the top 100 U. S. patent filers and global brands, as well as a growing number of law firms worldwide use Anaqua's solutions. Over one million IP executives, attorneys, paralegals, administrators, and innovators in large and medium-sized companies use the platform for their IP management needs. The company's global operations are headquartered in Boston, with offices across the U. S. , Europe, Asia, and Australia. For additional information, please visit anaqua. com, or on LinkedIn.

data.title: Fullstack Developer (.Net+Angular)
data.description:
Eurofins Scientific is an international life sciences company, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic and labelling is accurate. 

The Eurofins network of companies believes that it is a global leader in food, environment, pharmaceutical and cosmetic product testing and in discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and AgroScience contract research services. It is also one of the market leaders in certain testing and laboratory services for genomics, and in the support of clinical studies, as well as in biopharma contract development and manufacturing. It also has a rapidly developing presence in highly specialised and molecular clinical diagnostic testing and in-vitro diagnostic products. 

In over 37 years, Eurofins has grown from one laboratory in Nantes, France to over 65, 000 staff across a decentralised and entrepreneurial network of more than 950 laboratories in over 1, 000 companies across 59 countries. data.description:
Job Title: Automation Test Lead - Data & Platform Engineering Overview

We are seeking a highly hands on Automation Test Lead who can architect and scale enterprise grade test automation frameworks across data platforms, APIs, and cloud native systems. 

This role is not about managing testing. It is about owning quality engineering as a discipline. You will design frameworks that teams adopt, enforce standards that prevent bad releases, and build systems that proactively catch failures before they hit production. 

You should be equally comfortable writing Python frameworks, designing data validation strategies, and challenging engineers on weak implementations. Also embrace AI ways of working wherever possible to accelerate automation. 

Core Expectations

- You do not wait for bugs, you design systems that make bugs difficult to exist
 - You build frameworks that multiple teams adopt without friction
 - You challenge architecture, not just test outcomes
 - You reduce false positives, flaky tests, and wasted compute
 - You think in terms of data reliability, contracts, and system behaviour under stress

Key Responsibilities

• Test Automation Architecture & Strategy

Own the design and evolution of a scalable, modular, metadata driven test automation framework supporting: 

- Data pipelines (batch and streaming)
 - APIs and backend services
 - End to end data product validationEnable plug and play components, parallel execution, environment isolation, and deterministic runs. 

• Data Testing Framework Engineering

Build reusable frameworks supporting: 

- SQL based assertions and reconciliation
 - Schema validation and evolution checks
 - Data contracts and producer consumer validation
 - Lineage and freshness validation
 - Config driven test definitions (YAML or JSON)Drive adoption by making frameworks easy to integrate into existing pipelines. 

• Break Systems Proactively (Destructive Testing Mindset)

Design tests for: 

- Schema drift and backward incompatibility
 - Late arriving data and partial failures
 - Duplicate, missing, or out of order events
 - High volume stress and concurrency issues
 - Failure scenarios such as retries, DLQ handling, and backpressure• ETL and Streaming Validation at Scale

Implement: 

- Row, aggregate, and hash based reconciliation
 - Incremental and backfill validation
 - Exactly once or at least once semantics validation
 - Window based and time based correctness checks• Data Quality & Observability Integration

Integrate and extend tools like: 

- Great Expectations, SodaBuild custom validations for: 

- Accuracy, completeness, uniqueness, timelinessExpose quality metrics, SLAs, and test outcomes through dashboards. 

• CI/CD & DataOps Enforcement

Embed testing into pipelines: 

- Pre merge gates and release blockers
 - Selective and parallel test execution
 - Integration with GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or similarEnsure no pipeline reaches production without passing quality gates. 

• Test Data Management

Define strategies for: 

- Synthetic data generation
 - Masking and anonymization
 - Deterministic datasets for repeatable testing
 - Edge case and boundary condition simulation• Performance & Reliability Testing

Design and execute: 

- Pipeline and query performance benchmarks
 - Concurrency and stress testing
 - Data skew and partitioning analysisContinuously optimize for cost and execution time. 

• Security & Compliance Validation

Automate checks for: 

- PII or PHI exposure
 - Encryption and access control
 - Data retention and audit requirementsSupport compliance frameworks like GxP, SOX, or ISO standards. 

• Cross Functional Quality Leadership

- Work with data engineers, platform teams, and architects to embed quality early
 - Challenge poor design decisions that impact reliability
 - Mentor engineers to adopt strong testing practices• Incident Analysis & Prevention

- Analyze production data issues and failure patterns
 - Reduce flaky tests and false alarms
 - Drive root cause fixes, not surface level patches

Mandatory Skills

• Programming & Framework Development

- Strong Python with experience building test frameworks, libraries, and CLI tools
 - Advanced SQL for validation and reconciliation• Data Engineering Ecosystem

- Hands on with DBT, and Snowflake or similar platforms
 - Strong understanding of ETL or ELT and data modelling concepts• Data Quality & Observability

- Experience with Great Expectations, Soda, or similar tools
 - Understanding of lineage and catalogue systems• Streaming Systems

- Experience testing Kafka, Kinesis, or similar systems
 - Understanding of delivery semantics and event processing challenges• CI/CD & DevOps

- Strong Git workflows
 - CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or equivalentDesired Skills

- Experience with API contract testing and tools like PACT
 - Basic UI automation for end to end validation
 - Exposure to data mesh or data product architectures
 - Observability stacks such as Prometheus or Grafana
 - Experience in regulated domains (healthcare, life sciences, finance)Cloud & Infrastructure

- AWS experience across data and compute services
 - Familiarity with IaC tools like Terraform or CloudFormation

Experience

- 9+ years in automation or quality engineering
 - 5+ years building frameworks for data platforms at scale
 - Proven track record of improving system reliability and reducing production incidents

What Success Looks Like (First 6-12 Months)

- A widely adopted, low friction test automation framework across teams
 - Significant reduction in production data incidents and schema related failures
 - Strong enforcement of quality gates in CI/CD pipelines
 - Measurable improvement in data SLAs and observability
 - Reduced test execution time with higher coverage and lower flakiness

data.description:
Company 🌱

RYZE was founded in 2019 by Andrée Werner and Rashad Hossain, out of a parents' basement, with a mission to change daily health, starting with the morning routine: a nutrient-dense mushroom coffee delivering clean energy, mental clarity, and immune support. Built on a Direct-to-Consumer foundation with a performance marketing engine, RYZE achieved hockey-stick growth and a community of over 1 million active subscribers. 

DTC remains the foundation, but RYZE has expanded into mass retail, quickly becoming the #2 items in Target's overall coffee category and is now executing a multi-channel expansion, with a cross-category launch coming in early 2027. RYZE is uniquely positioned to redefine how people think about daily wellness. 

We're a lean, fast-moving, mission-driven team who believe daily rituals create the foundation for living your greatest life, and we're just getting started!

Roles & Responsibilities Overview

The Quality Control (QC) Manager at RYZE, Inc is responsible for ensuring the quality and compliance of raw materials and finished products manufactured by external partners. This role involves overseeing quality control activities at contract manufacturers, implementing quality programs, and driving continuous improvement initiatives. The role will manage daily quality compliance, ensuring timely product release, reviewing non-conforming materials, and assisting in complaint investigations. This role works cross-functionally with various teams, including operations, R&D, and logistics, to maintain the highest standards for product quality, safety, and compliance. 

What You'll Do 🎯

Responsibilities will include: 

Product & Process Quality Control

- Review Certificates of Analysis (COAs) from suppliers and third-party labs for accuracy and compliance with specifications. 
 - Facilitate the testing and release/rejection of Raw Material and Finished Product samples based on established specifications. 
 - Provide onsite quality support during new product launches. 
 - Investigate product quality issues, including consumer complaints, deviations, and non-conformances as it pertains to contract manufacturers. 
 - Lead the material review board and manage disposal of non-conforming, expiring, damaged and returned products at warehouse and 3PLs. 
 - Train and lead a team of virtual QC individuals who support various QC functions. 

Documentation & Compliance

- Maintain accurate QC records in accordance with FDA 21 CFR Part 111/117 requirements for foods and dietary supplements. 
 - Manage and approve finished product specifications and testing protocols. 
 - Ensure proper retention and traceability of QC data for audits and regulatory inspections. 
 - Collaborate with QA to ensure corrective and preventive actions (CAPAs) are implemented for identified issues. 

Testing & Laboratory Management

- Coordinate with third-party laboratories for microbiological, chemical, analytical, and stability testing. 
 - Evaluate and approve external labs, ensuring they meet ISO/IEC 17025 standards or equivalent. 
 - Validate new testing methods or procedures when required. 

Cross-Functional Collaboration

- Work closely with Operations, QA, Regulatory, and R&D teams to ensure smooth product launches and ongoing quality monitoring. 
 - Partner with Quality on supplier quality programs to ensure raw materials and finished product consistentlymeet quality and safety requirements. 

Continuous Improvement

- Identify opportunities to improve QC processes and product quality. 
 - Implement lean or efficiency-focused initiatives to optimize QC operations. 
 - Support training initiatives for cross-functional teams on QC-related topics. 
 - Stay up to date on industry trends and regulatory changes affecting production quality.

This role is eligible for our hybrid work model: Two days in-office. Based in our Mumbai office. 

Senior Platform Engineer (MLOps & DataOps)

The MLOps & Data DevOps team enables Priceline's data engineering, machine learning, and GenAI teams through secure, scalable, reliable, and governed platforms. 

We build and operate the infrastructure, automation, deployment pipelines, observability, and self-service capabilities that allow engineering teams to deliver data and ML workloads safely to production. 

If you enjoy working at the intersection of cloud infrastructure, DevOps, SRE, data platforms, and machine learning operations, this role offers an opportunity to build platform capabilities used across Priceline. 

Why this job's a big deal

As Priceline expands its use of data, real-time analytics, machine learning, and GenAI, reliable platform engineering is critical to delivering business value safely and efficiently. 

You will help operate the platform foundation behind data pipelines, ML pipelines, model endpoints, and LLM workloads. Your work will improve deployment speed, platform reliability, cost visibility, security, and the self-service experience for data and ML engineering teams. 

This role is focused on platform engineering and operations. Data and ML teams own business logic, model development, testing, and domain-level data quality; the MLOps & DataOps team owns the infrastructure, deployment paths, automation, governance, and reliability practices that enable those workloads. 

In This Role, You Will

- Cloud Platform Infrastructure & Automation
 - Architect, govern, and scale enterprise-grade Terraform module registries and infrastructure-as-code strategies for GCP data and ML platform services. 
 - Provision, operate, and automate cloud data and ML platform services such as Cloud Composer/Airflow, Dataproc, Dataflow, BigQuery, Cloud Storage, and Vertex AI. 
 - Drive platform upgrades, lead capacity planning, and design operational improvements across development, QA, and production environments. 
 - Develop reusable automation and internal tools using Python and Shell scripting. 
 - Apply infrastructure-as-code, change-management, security, and auditability standards to platform changes. 
 - CI/CD, GitOps & Self-Service Enablement
 - Define the CI/CD enterprise architecture and build governed pipelines for Airflow DAGs, Dataproc jobs, BigQuery changes, ML pipelines, and model-serving infrastructure. 
 - Implement reliable deployment, promotion, validation, rollback, and release processes using Git-based workflows. 
 - Set the strategy for GitHub Actions, Argo CD, Codefresh, or equivalent CI/CD and GitOps tooling to improve developer experience and time to production. 
 - Design and engineer scalable self-service frameworks that allow data and ML teams to provision and deploy workloads safely without bypassing governance controls. 
 - Improve developer experience, deployment reliability, and time to production through standardization and automation. 
 - MLOps & LLMOps Platform Operations
 - Architect and optimize production ML workflows covering model training, pipeline execution, model deployment, endpoint operations, batch inference, and retraining. 
 - Operate and improve ML platforms based on Vertex AI, Kubernetes/GKE, Docker, Kubeflow, or equivalent technologies. 
 - Support model gateway and LLM platform capabilities such as LiteLLM, including model onboarding, access management, rate limiting, usage visibility, cost controls, and reliability improvements. 
 - Define and enforce repeatable enterprise standards for model versioning, artifact management, model registries, feature stores, and data/model lineage. 
 - Drive GenAI, RAG, model evaluation, guardrails, and AI observability capabilities. 
 - Monitoring, Observability, Security & SRE
 - Define and operate monitoring, logging, alerting, and reliability practices for data pipelines, ML pipelines, model endpoints, and platform services. 
 - Establish meaningful SLIs/SLOs, escalation paths, runbooks, and error-management practices. 
 - Lead tier-3 incident response for complex infrastructure failures and drive systemic architectural changes to prevent recurrence. 
 - Lead tier-3 incident response for complex infrastructure failures and drive systemic architectural changes to prevent recurrence. 
 - Participate in on-call support, lead blameless root-cause analysis (RCAs), and enforce corrective and preventative actions. 
 - Architect IAM, RBAC, service-account controls, vulnerability scanning, secrets management, and compliance guardrails into platform workflows. 
 - Cost, Governance, Leadership & Platform Enablement
 - Mentor mid-level and junior engineers, lead complex cross-team technical initiatives, and establish engineering standards for the broader MLOps and DataOps domains. 
 - Own and optimize cloud architecture for cost efficiency, actively managing capacity and FinOps practices for large-scale data and ML workloads. 
 - Evaluate, adopt, and operationalize platform capabilities that improve reliability, security, developer productivity, and operational efficiency. 
 - Partner with Cloud Infrastructure, SRE, InfoSec, Data Engineering, Data Science, and ML teams to resolve platform and operational issues. 

Who You Are

- Degree & Experience: B. Tech or B. E in Computer Science, Information technology, or equivalent practical experience, with 7+ years of experience in DevOps, SRE, cloud platform engineering, MLOps, DataOps, or a closely related discipline. 
 - Cloud Infrastructure: Strong hands-on experience with Google Cloud Platform or equivalent public cloud technologies. Experience with GCP services such as Cloud Composer, Dataproc, Dataflow, BigQuery, Google Cloud Storage, or Vertex AI is highly relevant. 
 - Infrastructure as Code: Strong practical experience with Terraform for infrastructure provisioning, configuration management, reusable modules, and controlled production changes. 
 - Containers & Kubernetes: Hands-on experience with Docker and Kubernetes. Experience with GKE is preferred for GCP environments. 
 - CI/CD & GitOps: Experience building or operating CI/CD pipelines and Git-based deployment workflows using GitHub Actions, Argo CD, Codefresh, Jenkins, or equivalent tools. 
 - Automation & Scripting: Proficiency in Python and Shell scripting for platform automation, operational tooling, pipeline hooks, and internal utilities. 
 - Data & Workflow Platforms: Experience supporting Apache Airflow/Composer, Dataproc, Dataflow, Spark, BigQuery, or comparable data-processing and workflow-orchestration technologies. 
 - MLOps: Experience supporting ML pipelines, model deployments, inference endpoints, model-serving infrastructure, or ML platform operations.

data.title: Principal Software Engineer
data.description:
Overview

The Azure App Testing team in Core AI provide cloud-scale testing capabilities that help developers validate the reliability, performance, and quality of modern applications. This includes Azure Load Testing for performance testing and Playwright Workspaces for end-to-end functional testing, enabling teams to test at scale without managing their own testing infrastructure. As applications increasingly incorporate AI and autonomous agents, testing is evolving and we are extending the platform to various agentic workloads. Playwright Workspaces provides fully managed, cloud-hosted browsers for developers, automation clients and AI agents can connect to remotely for high-scale secure and performant browser automation workloads. 

We are looking for a Principal Software Engineer who can provide deep technical leadership to shape the direction of Azure App Testing and deliver secure, reliable, scalable developer services. In this hands-on individual contributor role, you will lead architecture and implementation across service boundaries, turn ambiguous customer needs into durable platform capabilities, and raise engineering standards through technical leadership and mentorship. 

Responsibilities

- Define and evolve the architecture of distributed, multi-tenant testing services, balancing reliability, performance, security, operability, and cost. 
 - Lead complex initiatives from design and prototyping through implementation, rollout, and sustained operation, while remaining hands-on in coding and deeply engaged in design and code reviews. 
 - Build scalable execution and orchestration capabilities for load testing and managed browser automation, including scheduling, concurrency, isolation, and resilient failure handling. 
 - Shape developer-friendly APIs, tooling, and CI/CD integrations that make testing a natural part of development and release workflows. 
 - Advance AI-assisted testing with rigorous evaluation, observable behaviour, appropriate safeguards, and meaningful measures of quality and customer value. 
 - Drive live-site excellence through actionable telemetry, service-level objectives, incident response, root-cause analysis, and prevention of recurring issues; participate in the team's on-call rotation. 
 - Embed security, privacy, accessibility, and responsible AI into design and delivery, including identity, access control, and protection of customer test data. 
 - Partner with product managers, engineers, architects, security teams, and customers to set priorities, align architecture, resolve dependencies, and deliver cohesive platform capabilities. 
 - Mentor engineers, foster inclusive technical discussions, and improve engineering practices for testing, deployment safety, serviceability, and developer productivity. 

Qualifications

Required qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - 10+ years of extensive experience designing, building, and operating production software, with demonstrated technical leadership on complex initiatives spanning multiple components or teams. 
 - Strong software engineering skills in one or more languages such as C#, Java, C++, Go, Python, or TypeScript, including maintainable design, automated testing, and effective code review. 
 - Deep understanding of distributed systems, service architecture, API design, concurrency, fault tolerance, and performance engineering. 
 - Experience operating cloud services and diagnosing complex production issues using telemetry, debugging, and structured root-cause analysis. 
 - Ability to lead through influence, explain architectural trade-offs, collaborate across disciplines, and mentor engineers. 
 - A customer-focused approach and commitment to secure, reliable, inclusive engineering. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with Azure or comparable cloud platforms, containerised workloads, Kubernetes, and multi-tenant service infrastructure. 
 - Experience with browser automation or end-to-end testing using Playwright, and performance testing using JMeter, Locust, or comparable frameworks. 
 - Experience building developer platforms, SDKs, command-line tools, or integrations with GitHub, Azure DevOps, and CI/CD systems. 
 - Experience improving cloud resource efficiency, execution scheduling, service scalability, and infrastructure cost. 
 - Experience with AI-assisted developer tools or agentic workflows, including evaluation, reliability, and responsible AI practices. 
 - Experience collaborating with open-source communities or building services on open-source technologies.
