data.title: Senior Software Development Engineer in Test
data.description:
Huron helps its clients drive growth, enhance performance and sustain leadership in the markets they serve. We collaborate with education organizations to develop strategies and implement solutions that enable the transformative change our clients need to own their future. Together, we empower clients to drive innovation, create sustainable funding streams and deliver better student outcomes. 

Today, leaders of higher education institutions and academic medical centers are spending too much time reacting to market forces, rather than focusing on the essential priorities that help students, faculty and staff thrive. The most productive path forward requires an intentional approach and innovative thinking, whereby stakeholders across the entire institution rally around a shared vision and embrace the hard work of effecting change. 

You'll help our clients to achieve organizational effectiveness, improve student outcomes, implement new technologies and align resources and investments to ensure long-term sustainability. 

Join our team as the expert you are now and create your future. 

Huron is seeking a Senior Software Development Engineer in Test (Senior SDET) to join its product engineering team. You will own the test automation strategy and framework architecture, ensuring reliability and accuracy across complex application workflows. Embedded in Agile delivery teams alongside developers, product managers, and designers, you bring a software engineering mindset to quality problems and set the quality bar the whole team works toward. 

Primary Responsibilities

Test strategy and technical leadership

- Define and own the test strategy, framework architecture, and tooling roadmap for assigned product areas. 
 - Translate business requirements into traceable test cases across functional, regression, integration, and end-to-end dimensions; lead test plan reviews with developers, product owners, and project managers. 
 - Define test coverage metrics and quality gates; produce risk-based release readiness reports for engineering leadership at each milestone. 

Test automation and AI-assisted engineering

- AI-assisted development: Leverage GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, and comparable AI coding assistants to accelerate test script authorship, generate edge-case scenarios, and perform intelligent code review. 
 - AI agentic testing: Configure and evaluate agentic workflows for autonomous test generation and self-healing locators; apply Model Context Protocol (MCP) to connect AI agents to test tools, APIs, and data sources for end-to-end agentic test workflows; define system instructions, skills, and tool configurations for AI coding agents. 
 - Architect and maintain scalable automation frameworks using Selenium, Playwright, or Cypress for UI; REST Assured or similar for APIs; integrate into CI/CD pipelines via Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions. 
 - Write complex SQL queries to validate backend data integrity in PostgreSQL (using DBeaver); build data-driven test suites for parallel and cross-browser execution. 

Defect management, collaboration, and mentorship

- Isolate, document, and track defects in Azure DevOps; lead exploratory testing sessions and root-cause analysis on escaped defects. 
 - Serve as quality engineering lead across Agile delivery teams; participate in sprint planning, backlog grooming, standups, and retrospectives. 
 - Conduct code reviews and coach developers and team members on shift-left testing practices and quality engineering standards. 

Required Qualifications

Core

- B. E. /B. Tech. in Computer Science, MIS, or related discipline; 4 to 7 years in software quality engineering with the majority in test automation and framework development on a commercial product. 
 - Production-quality automation code in C#, Java, Python, or JavaScript/TypeScript; proficiency with Selenium, Playwright, or Cypress; API testing with REST Assured, Postman, or SoapUI. 
 - CI/CD pipeline experience (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or Jenkins); strong Git skills; cross-browser testing with BrowserStack or equivalent; solid SQL skills for database validation. 
 - Deep understanding of QA lifecycle and Agile/Iterative delivery; clear communicator able to produce test strategies and quality summaries for both technical and non-technical audiences. 
 - Demonstrated experience with performance engineering, scalability design, and observability practices (logging, metrics, distributed tracing) in production systems. 
 - Hands-on experience with AWS services including Lambda, ECS, RDS, API Gateway, CloudWatch, and related cloud-native tooling. 

AI and agentic development tools

Role: QA Engineer

Experience: 2 years

Location: Hyderabad

About The Role

We are hiring 2 QA Engineers with about 2 years of experience to join the Openprise QA team. You will

test our data automation platform, which connects to tools like Salesforce, HubSpot and Marketo, and

you will help grow our test automation. 

What you will do

- Test new features, enhancements and bug fixes in each release, first in the test setup and then

in the stage setup. 

- Read the issue, the linked code change (pull request) and the notes from developers, then write

clear test cases. 

- Help build our new end-to-end UI test suite in Playwright from the start: pick the key user flows, 

write the tests, and keep them stable. 

- Write and maintain automated tests for our APIs and screens, mainly in Karate for APIs and

Playwright for the UI. 

- Run the automated test suites, look into failures, and tell real bugs apart from test problems
 - Log bugs in GitHub with clear steps, screenshots or recordings, and the setup you used
 - Move issues through their QA states on time and add a short comment on what you tested and

what you found. 

- Work closely with developers and product managers to understand what each change should

do. 

- Help keep test data clean: create your own test data and remove it when you are done

Must have

- 2 to 3 years of hands-on software testing, covering both manual and automated testing
 - At least 1 year writing automated tests for APIs (Karate, Rest Assured or Postman with scripts)
 - Hands-on UI automation with Playwright (preferred) or Selenium, using JavaScript or TypeScript
 - Good grasp of REST APIs and JSON: you can read a request and response and check the values
 - Basic SQL to check data in a database
 - Basic coding in JavaScript or TypeScript (for Playwright) and Java, enough to write and fix test

code. 

- Experience with Git and GitHub: branches, pull requests and code reviews
 - Clear written English for bug reports and test cases
 - A curious mind: you ask why a test failed and dig until you know

Nice to have

- Hands-on Karate experience (feature files, reusable calls, data-driven tests)
 - Playwright features like page objects, fixtures, trace viewer and running tests in parallel
 - Experience testing SaaS products that connect to CRM or marketing tools such as Salesforce, 

HubSpot or Marketo. 

- Testing data pipelines or large data loads: imports, exports, record counts and data quality

checks. 

- Running tests in CI, for example GitHub Actions or Jenkins
 - Performance testing basics, for example Gatling or JMeter
 - Using AI tools to write or review test cases faster

Tools you will use

Area: Tools

API automation: Karate

UI automation: Playwright (new end-to-end suite), Selenium (existing tests)

Performance: Gatling

Code and issues: GitHub (issues, pull requests, project boards)

Connected apps under test: Salesforce, HubSpot, Marketo, Google Drive and others

Powered by JazzHR

We empower our people to stay resilient and relevant in a constantly changing world. We're looking for people who are always searching for creative ways to grow and learn. We are looking for Brake Control Software Validator

You'll make a difference by

- You analyze software requirements and functional specifications and derive structured test cases with clearly defined test steps and expected results. 
 - You prepare, execute, and evaluate software component tests and contribute to the testing of the overall brake control software. 
 - You use model-based development tools to understand the application logic behind the generated code and support the analysis of software behaviors. 
 - You investigate unexpected test results, document defects clearly, and work closely with software developers to clarify findings and verify implemented corrections. 
 - You ensure traceability between software requirements, test cases, and test results and prepare clear and reproducible test documentation. 
 - You assess software changes together with the development team and support the definition, selection, and execution of appropriate regression tests. 
 - You develop an understanding of brake system functionality and pneumatic relationships to evaluate test scenarios and results within their technical context. 
 - You contribute ideas to increase test coverage, improve test procedures, and enhance the efficiency of recurring testing activities. 

Desired Skills

- You have a bachelor's degree in electrical engineering, Electronics and Communication Engineering, Automation Engineering, Mechatronics, Computer Science, or a comparable technical discipline. 
 - You have 3 to 5 years of professional experience in software testing, preferably in software component testing, including test case development, test execution, defect analysis, and evaluation of test results. 
 - Ideally, you have hands-on experience with model-based software development tools and can understand the application logic used to generate control software. 
 - You can translate technical and software requirements into clear test steps and expected results and distinguish software defects from issues related to the test environment or test setup. 
 - You work systematically and carefully, document your findings consistently, and follow identified issues through to resolution. 
 - Knowledge of pneumatic systems, particularly railway braking systems, would be an advantage. 
 - Experience with requirements management, defect-tracking, version-control, or test-automation tools would be beneficial. 
 - You have good written and verbal communication skills in English and can collaborate effectively with colleagues across locations, functions, and technical disciplines. 

Join us and be yourself!

We value your unique identity and perspective and are fully committed to providing equitable opportunities and building a workplace that reflects the diversity of society. Come bring your authentic self and create a better tomorrow with us. 

Make your mark in our exciting world at Siemens. 

This role is based in Bangalore. You might be required to visit other locations within India and outside. In return, you'll get the chance to work with teams impacting - and the shape of things to come. We're Siemens. A collection of over 379, 000 minds building the future, one day at a time in over 200 countries. We're dedicated to equality, and we encourage applications that reflect the diversity of the communities we work in. All employment decisions at Siemens are based on qualifications, merit and business need. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow.

Our team builds high-quality and innovative software to enable our customers to grow their revenues powered by the state-of-the-art subscription management platform. 

Overview of the Role

We are looking for a Technical Lead - Backend Engineering who thrives in fast-paced environments and believes in getting things done. You will drive initiatives that scale our core systems, balance existing business logic with new innovations, and ensure high reliability and performance across mission-critical components. 

This role requires taking ownership of complex problems, collaborating effectively with peers, and comfortably engaging in both technical and customer-facing discussions. If you're ready to solve challenges at scale and directly impact the revenue engines of our partners, this is the opportunity for you. 

What You'll Work On

Execute with precision: Own technical execution for backend and frontend modules and lead delivery across the team. 

Scale smartly: Enhance and evolve existing backend systems with scalable architecture patterns and thoughtful refactoring-not rewrites for the sake of it. 

Drive backend excellence: Architect high-performance services using Java and Spring Boot, built for scale and uptime. 

Enable observability: Work closely with DevOps to ensure production readiness with robust monitoring and alerting practices on AWS. 

Collaborate cross-functionally: Partner with technical peers, product managers, and occasionally with customer-facing teams to ensure alignment of business and tech priorities. 

Mentor and lead: Grow backend engineering capabilities by providing clear guidance, thoughtful code reviews, and proactive problem-solving. 

What We're Looking For

Technical Expertise

7+ years of backend experience, with recent hands-on development in Java and Spring Boot. 

Proven experience building and scaling systems to handle high throughput, low latency, and event-driven architecture. 

Solid understanding of AWS infrastructure components: EC2, S3, RDS, SQS, VPC, and more. 

Familiarity with DevOps best practices, CI/CD pipelines, and performance tuning. 

Leadership & Execution

Ability to own end-to-end delivery of backend and frontend features with high accountability. 

Pragmatic decision-maker who focuses on value and execution over over-engineering. 

Experience leading and mentoring engineers, conducting design reviews, and managing technical debt effectively. 

Collaboration & Communication

Strong communication skills to influence technical decisions and align with business objectives. 

Comfortable in customer-facing discussions, when needed, to represent technical perspectives. 

Proven ability to collaborate with peers and cross-functional teams in remote/hybrid setups. 

Bonus Points

Prior experience in subscription billing, e-commerce, or high-scale fintech systems. 

Exposure to high-scale event-driven systems

Familiarity with observability tools like Prometheus, Grafana, or DataDog. 

Why Join Chargebee's Engineering Team?

Build features for a platform that processes billions of dollars in revenue annually. 

Work on real challenges of scale, resiliency, and complexity, with ownership from day one. 

Thrive in a hybrid work environment with flexibility and autonomy. 

Recharge with an uncapped leave policy, because sustainable pace matters. 

Benefits

Want to know what it means to work for a company that genuinely cares about you? Check out just a few of the benefits we give our employees: 

We are Globally Local

With a diverse team across four continents, and customers in over 60 countries, you get to work closely with a global perspective right from your own neighborhood. 

We value Curiosity

We believe the next great idea might just be around the corner. Perhaps it's that random thought you had ten minutes ago. We believe in creating an ecosystem that fosters a desire to seek out hard questions, and then figure out answers to them. 

Customer! Customer! Customer!

Everything we do is driven towards enabling our customers' growth. This means no matter what you do, you will always be adding real value to a real business problem. It's a lot of responsibility, but also a lot of fun. 

Ready to build the future of recurring revenue at scale?

Join the Chargebee tribe.

 - Drive execution of technical deliverables with a focus on quality, timely delivery, and long-term impact, while ensuring execution predictability. 
 - Support hiring efforts through workforce planning, interviewing, and evaluation with a strong focus on building a diverse and skilled team. 
 - Set the vision for your team and reinforce a business impact-oriented culture, driving a focus on long-term initiatives. 

What Makes You a Great Fit

- Strong technical expertise in designing and delivering scalable, reliable, and observable backend systems, including the ability to deeply understand systems to challenge design choices and identify failure points, dependencies, and scalability issues. 
 - Experience driving end-to-end project delivery including planning, estimation, risk mitigation, and execution tracking. 
 - Solid understanding of SDLC best practices (code reviews, testing, CI/CD, on-call processes) and driving operational excellence through metrics . 

Soft Skills & Traits

- Demonstrated ownership and accountability for team outcomes and delivery. 
 - A strong mindset for Product Thinking and Business Ownership, thinking beyond execution to understand customer and business problems, and linking technical decisions to measurable business outcomes. 
 - Strong people management skills and stakeholder communication. 
 - Ability to navigate ambiguity, prioritize competing demands based on business impact, and make trade-offs pragmatically between business value and technical needs. 
 - A continuous improvement and highly solution-oriented mindset, prioritizing achieving business outcomes and constantly looking to elevate team efficiency and engineering quality. 

The Navi OS

The Navi OS is our Operating System for how we work every day. Success at Navi is defined by living these core values. 

- Start with the Customer
 - Master the Details
 - Act with Urgency
 - Own the Outcome
 - Build for a Decade - Not a Day
 - Win as OneWe hire talented individuals who already show these strengths, because those who share these values thrive at Navi and grow with the organisation. 

To read more about the Navi OS, visit navi. com/our-values

Life at Navi

Life at Navi is fast-paced, ambitious and deeply collaborative. Beyond work, teams come together through sports, celebrations, offsites, music jams, team outings and many more shared experiences that make the journey exciting and memorable. 

We believe people do their best work when they feel supported, through flexible leave policies, strong health and wellness benefits, free financial, legal and medical consultations, ESOPs and a workplace designed for both productivity and well-being. 

Whether it's the sports turf, gym, focus zone or nap rooms, the campus is built to make everyday work more enjoyable.

Why Join Us?

- Be at the forefront of AI-driven digital engineering and work with cutting-edge technologies. 
 - Collaborate directly with ambitious, high-growth US tech companies. 
 - Receive competitive compensation and benefits, with significant opportunities for professional growth and development.

data.title: Sr. Application Architect
data.description:
Description

The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using the AWS Cloud. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing initiatives. Our team provides assistance through a collection of offerings which help customers achieve specific outcomes related to enterprise cloud adoption. We also deliver focused guidance through our global specialty practices, which cover a variety of solutions, technologies, and industries. 

We are looking for a Senior Application Architect to design and deliver modern, cloud-native applications for AWS Professional Services (ProServe) India customers. In this role, you will own the technical architecture of complex customer engagements, from application assessment and modernization strategy through design, build, and production go-live. You will advise senior customer engineering leaders on how to re-architect, migrate, and modernize their application portfolios on AWS. 

The ideal candidate is a hands-on architect with deep software engineering and IT consulting experience and a proven track record of delivering large-scale distributed applications for enterprise customers. You can work through ambiguous problems with limited guidance and make sound architectural trade-offs across cost, performance, security, and resilience. You thrive in a fast-paced, growth environment, insist on the highest standards, and enjoy mentoring engineers and turning proven patterns into reusable assets for the wider team. 

You will lead technical workstreams made up of AWS consultants, partners, and customer developers, and set the architecture direction across microservices, containers, serverless, APIs, data integration, and DevOps practices. You are expected to write and review code, produce architecture artifacts, run design reviews, and resolve technical risks before they affect delivery. You will also support pre-sales by shaping solution designs and estimates, earn customer trust through technical credibility, and use AI/GenAI (including AI-assisted development tools) to speed up how applications are designed and built. 

In this capacity you will be based in India and are expected to travel occasionally (30-40%). You will report into the India ProServe Application Architecture Delivery Practice Manager. 

Key job responsibilities

We are looking for hands-on architects/developers who are passionate about: 

- Help internal customers make decisions on their cloud and AI journey, define scalable architecture, highly available solutions that leverage AWS services and AI capabilities
 - Assisting internal customers to architect and develop applications that are cloud-optimized and AI-integrated, including Generative AI and Agentic AI solutions
 - Working as a technical leader alongside customer business, development, and infrastructure teams
 - Guiding customers through the AI Development Life Cycle (AI-DLC)/ AI-assisted software engineering, from problem framing, data readiness, and model selection to deployment, evaluation, and continuous improvement. 
 - Sharing deep software development knowledge with respect to cloud architecture, AI design patterns, and programming
 - Advising and implementing AWS best practices for both cloud-native and AI-powered workloads
 - Assisting internal customers in infrastructure, application development, and AI solution integration
 - Assisting internal customers in agile software development and Implementation of DevOps practices
 - Independently leading a team that delivers applications including AI-enabled features spanning the full software lifecycle: design, implementation, testing, deployment, and maintenance strategy
 - Scoping development efforts, identifying risks, and prioritizing deliverables to meet organizational goals; providing guidance so your team designs solutions making the right trade-offs between innovation, speed, and operational excellence

About The Team

Diverse Experiences

Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn't followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don't let it stop you from applying. 

Why AWS

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world's most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating - that's why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses. 

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there's nothing we can't achieve in the cloud. 

Inclusive Team Culture

Here at AWS, it's in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness. 

Mentorship and Career Growth

We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional. 

Basic Qualifications

- 10+ years of technical specialist, design and architecture experience
 - 10+ years of consulting, design and implementation of serverless distributed solutions experience
 - 10+ years of software development with object oriented language experience
 - 10+ years of external or internal customer facing, complex and large scale project management experience
 - Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or equivalent
 - Travel up to 30% of the time

Preferred Qualifications

- 6+ years of leading development of applications backed by AWS services or using other cloud based technologies and services experience
 - Experience with designing and building application using AWS services such as Lambda, AWS Elastic Beanstalk, Kubernetes
 - Experience in one of the following programming languages: Java, Python, Ruby, Node. js, C#, or C
 - Experience in professional, non-internship software development, or experience in machine learning, data mining, information retrieval, statistics or natural language processing
 - Experience with CloudFormation, Chef, Puppet, Salt, or Ansible in production environments
 - Familiarity with AI-DLC / AI-assisted software engineering, data preparation, prompt engineering, model evaluation, and deploying Generative/Agentic AI solutions

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https: //amazon. jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you're applying in isn't listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

 - Monitoring, observability, logging, and performance tuning. 
 - Event-driven architectures and real-time data processing systems. 

Preferred Experience

 - Collaboration with architects, security teams, product owners, and stakeholders. 

Qualifications

YOU MUST HAVE

- 5+ years of experience in software architecture and development
 - Mastery level knowledge in design principles, architectural patterns, and coding standards
 - Expert in multiple programming languages and technologies
 - Ability to work under minimal supervision and lead indirect reports by influence

WE VALUE

- Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field

 - Proven ability to drive successful software development projects and initiatives
 - Ability to work in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
 - Passion for innovation and continuous learning

Honeywell Technologies is a global, pure-play automation company with a legacy of innovating to help solve the world's most mission-critical challenges, enhancing the quality of life for people and communities around the world. data.description:
Description

Job Location

The primary work location for this role is Trivandrum with a hybrid work model. 

About Envestnet

Envestnet is an adaptive WealthTech company that is redefining the future of wealth management by helping advisors meet the moment with its comprehensive technology, actionable insights, and industry leading support. Backed by over 25 years of experience and approximately $7. 0 trillion in platform assets, Envestnet is trusted by over one third of financial advisors across leading banks, wealth managers, brokerages, and RIAs. 

For a deeper look at how Envestnet is shaping the future of financial advice, visit www. envestnet. com. 

The Team You'll Join

On the Tamarac development team, we build one of the industry's most advanced portfolio management and trading platforms for RIAs. We tackle complex engineering challenges every day-from large scale data ingestion and analytics to deep system integrations, high performance trading algorithms, and a robust full stack web experience used by thousands of advisors. 

As we continue to scale the platform-supporting 50+ million trades annually-we're modernizing our architecture to meet growing demand while delivering innovative, advisor focused features. Our engineers collaborate across disciplines to build AI powered insights, enhance cross platform capabilities, and design resilient, cloud native systems. 

This is a rare opportunity to join us in shaping the technical roadmap of a leading trading platform-driving how we scale, evolve, and deliver capabilities that elevate both the advisor and client experience, with real world impact from day one. 

How You'll Contribute

Responsible for building scalable, secure platforms in support of Envestnet business operations, including wealth management, financial data aggregation and advisor-driven technology solutions. Works across cloud-based architectures, integrating complex data sources and APIs to deliver reliable, high-performance systems. Collaborates with product managers, data scientists and compliance stakeholders to meet both business and regulatory requirements

- Architects and designs systems, services, or platforms with broad impact. 
 - Leads technical decision-making for major features or initiatives. 
 - Breaks down complex problems into scalable and maintainable solutions. 
 - Drives cross-team collaboration and align technical solutions with business goals. 
 - Establishes and enforces best practices in architecture, coding, and deployment. 
 - Mentors engineers across multiple levels and contribute to talent development. 
 - Anticipates technical risks and proactively implement mitigation strategies. 
 - Leads incident response and root cause analysis for critical issues. 
 - Influences roadmap planning through technical insight and feasibility analysis. 
 - Ensures system scalability, reliability, and performance at enterprise scale. 
 - Leads cross-functional initiatives involving engineering, product, and business teams. 
 - Designs and improves enterprise-grade CI/CD frameworks, deployment strategies, and automation pipelines. 
 - Partners with DevOps/SRE to define infrastructure patterns (scalability, observability, resilience). 
 - Actively utilizes agentic coding tools throughout the SDLC to accelerate feature delivery and drives adoption of AI-assisted development practices across the team. 

What You'll Need To Bring

- Candidates should demonstrate the relevant experience, skills, and capabilities needed to successfully perform in the role. Relevant experience may be gained through current responsibilities, prior roles, project work, leadership opportunities, or other comparable experiences. 
 - Strong technical background with . NET, C#, RESTful APIs, and API management solutions. 
 - Experience with SQL and NoSQL databases including PostgreSQL, SQL Server, and Redis. 
 - Experience with AWS services including EC2, S3, API Gateway, Lambda, RDS, EKS, CloudWatch, and SQS. 
 - Experience with Kubernetes, Docker, Kafka, CloudFormation, CDK, Terraform, DevOps practices, automation, agile delivery, Scrum, and test-driven development. 
 - Experience designing, delivering, or integrating production-grade AI/ML systems, LLM-based applications, AI platform capabilities, and agentic workflows. 
 - Strong knowledge of AI cost control, evaluation, governance, LLM integration patterns, stateful agents, memory patterns, and practical AI use case delivery. 
 - Experience with event-driven architecture, asynchronous messaging, cloud infrastructure, and observability practices. 
 - Demonstrated ability to lead architectural decisions, define technical standards, conduct code reviews, and communicate trade-offs to technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Experience in fintech, reporting, real-time financial platforms, or regulated production environments requiring strong data consistency, idempotency, fault tolerance, and scalability. 
 - Hands-on experience using agentic coding tools such as Claude Code or GitHub Copilot to accelerate feature delivery, code review, testing, and SDLC execution. 

Nice-to-Haves

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field required; master's degree preferred. 
 - Software engineering experience, including technical leadership for major features, systems, services, or platforms with broad impact. 

Why You'll Enjoy Working at Envestnet

Help shape the future of WealthTech. At Envestnet you'll gain hands-on experience and collaborate with some of the industry's brightest minds to deliver meaningful, innovative solutions that make a real difference. 

We value flexibility in how and where work gets done, and we recognize strong performance with meaningful rewards-because your contributions should drive both business success and your own personal growth. If you're looking for a place where your work has impact, your development is supported, and your contributions are truly valued, Envestnet is where you can build your future. 

The opportunity is now!

Our Investment in You

At Envestnet, our total rewards philosophy is designed to attract, motivate, and grow exceptional talent. We offer competitive, market-aligned compensation complemented with performance-linked incentives and rewards programs that recognize and reward impact. 

In addition, we provide a comprehensive suite of benefits - subject to Envestnet's plan eligibility rules - that support your overall well-being, including medical insurance for you and your family, annual health check-ups, free online doctor consultations and telemedicine services, subsidized health club memberships, and an employee assistance program. Our investment in you means supporting you professionally, financially, and personally at every stage of your journey with us. 

Our Commitment to Inclusion & Belonging

Envestnet is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer and does not discriminate in employment on the basis of religion, race, color, caste, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, age, disability, medical condition, nationality, ethnic origin, marital status, or any other status protected under applicable Indian law. This commitment is in accordance with the Constitution of India and applicable labor and employment laws. All employment decisions are made solely based on merit, qualifications, performance, and business needs. 

We strive to provide an inclusive application and interview process. If you are a candidate with a disability and require reasonable accommodation, please contact us at [email protected]. Please include your full name, the title of the role you are applying for, and the accommodation necessary to assist you with the recruiting process. 

Recruitment Fraud

At Envestnet, safeguarding the trust and safety of job seekers is a top priority. We are aware that scammers may impersonate Envestnet recruiters or create fake job opportunities to deceive candidates. Review the information on our recruitment fraud awareness page to help you recognize and avoid recruitment fraud.

data.title: System Engineering Team Leader
data.description:
Hello Visionary!

We empower our people to stay resilient and relevant in a constantly evolving world. We're looking for people who are always searching for creative ways to grow and learn. People who want to make a real impact, now and in the future. Does that sound like you? Then it seems like you'd make a phenomenal addition to our vibrant international team. 

We are looking for a System Engineering Team Leader

You'll make a difference by: 

- Lead the design, configuration, and integration of CBTC systems in line with project requirements. 
 - Ensure that CBTC systems meet safety, operational, and regulatory standards. 
 - Collaborate with internal teams (engineering, software development, etc. ) and external vendors to integrate CBTC with other train control, signaling, and communication systems. 
 - Lead CBTC-related projects from conception to completion, ensuring timely delivery within budget and scope. 
 - Supervise, mentor, and coordinate a team of engineers and technicians working on CBTC systems. 
 - Develop and track project timelines, achievements, deliverables, reporting progress to senior management. 
 - Lead testing and commissioning activities for CBTC-systems, including functional, integration, and performance tests. 
 - Address any issues identified during testing and work closely with multi-functional teams to resolve them. 
 - Ensure systems are stays in sync with local and international standards (e. g. , IEEE, IEC). 
 - Provide technical support for the operational deployment of CBTC-systems, ensuring system reliability and fixing as needed. 
 - Lead root cause analysis for any operational failures or issues related to CBTC systems. 
 - Develop and implement maintenance and upgrade strategies for CBTC systems. 
 - Ensure CBTC systems are designed and operated in compliance with safety laws and industry standards. 
 - Conduct safety assessments and risk management procedures to minimize operational disruptions and hazards. 
 - Maintain a thorough understanding of applicable laws and ensure that the CBTC implementations meet all required certifications. 
 - Serve as the primary point of contact for collaborators, including project sponsors, clients, and regulatory bodies. 
 - Prepare reports, presentations, and documentation for senior management, regulatory agencies, and other customers. 
 - Participate in meetings to discuss system performance, upgrades, and enhancements. 
 - Find opportunities for system optimization and cost-effective enhancements to improve train performance and network capacity. 
 - Stay up to date with industry trends and emerging technologies in train control systems, including CBTC, automation, and digital signaling. 

You'll win us over by: 

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in Electrical Engineering, Control Systems, Telecommunications, or a related field. Professional certification in CBTC or similar systems is a plus. 
 - At least 5-7 years of experience in CBTC systems, train control, or related railway signaling systems. 
 - Experience in managing or leading CBTC-related projects. 
 - Strong technical background in the design, integration, and testing of signaling and control systems. 
 - Expertise in CBTC technologies, including train-to-track communication, real-time data transmission, and system integration. 
 - Proficiency in relevant tools (e. g. , simulation software, troubleshooting tools, and diagnostic equipment). 
 - Knowledge of railway operations, signaling, and communications standards. 
 - Strong leadership, organizational, and interpersonal skills. 
 - Experience with project management methodologies (e. g. , Agile, Waterfall) and tools (e. g. , Microsoft Project, Jira). 
 - Problem-solving and critical thinking abilities. 
 - Ability to of working effectively under pressure and meet tight deadlines. 
 - Strong team-player with the ability to work across multidisciplinary teams. 

Join us and be yourself!

We value your unique identity and perspective and are fully committed to providing equitable opportunities and building a workplace that reflects the diversity of society. Come bring your authentic self and create a better tomorrow with us. 

This role is based in Pune, where you'll get the chance to work with teams, impacting entire cities, countries - and the shape of things to come. 

We're Siemens. A collection of over 312, 000 minds building the future, one day at a time in over 200 countries. We're dedicated to equality, and we encourage applications that reflect the diversity of the communities we work in. All employment decisions at Siemens are based on qualifications, merit and business need. Bring your curiosity and imagination and help us shape tomorrow. 

Find out more about Siemens careers at: www. siemens. com/careers & more about mobility at https: //new. siemens. com/global/en/products/mobility. html

data.title: Turbine DCS engineer
data.description:
Company Description Power Plant is a power generation facility focused on delivering reliable, efficient, and safe energy to industrial and domestic consumers. The organization emphasizes high operational standards and adherence to industry regulations, with a strong commitment to preventive maintenance and continuous improvement. Teams work with advanced turbine technologies and digital control systems to optimize performance and minimize downtime. The work environment supports collaboration among engineering, operations, and maintenance personnel, offering opportunities to work on complex technical challenges and large-scale infrastructure projects. 
Role Description The Turbine DCS Engineer is responsible for the operation, monitoring, and optimization of turbine Distributed Control Systems (DCS) at the power plant. This full-time, on-site role in Hyderabad involves configuring control logic, tuning process parameters, and ensuring reliable integration of turbine and auxiliary systems. Day-to-day tasks include diagnosing and resolving control system issues, coordinating with operations and maintenance teams during startups, shutdowns, and planned outages, and implementing modifications to improve performance, safety, and compliance. The engineer will prepare technical documentation, support root-cause analyses, participate in safety and reliability reviews, and collaborate with vendors or contractors as needed for system upgrades and maintenance. 
Qualifications

- Candidates should possess strong skills in Process Control and Control Systems Design, including configuration, logic development, and performance tuning for turbine DCS systems. 
 - Candidates should possess solid Troubleshooting and Instrumentation skills to diagnose control-related issues and work with field devices such as sensors, transmitters, and actuators. 
 - Candidates should possess a foundation in Electrical Engineering, particularly as it applies to power plant systems, protection schemes, and integration of electrical and control equipment. 
 - Relevant experience with turbine control systems (e. g. , OEM DCS platforms), PLCs, SCADA, or similar industrial automation environments is beneficial. 
 - Familiarity with power plant operations, safety standards, and industry regulations, along with the ability to interpret P&IDs, wiring diagrams, and control narratives, is preferred. 
 - Strong analytical, communication, and teamwork skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively in a multi-disciplinary engineering and operations environment. 
 - Bachelor's degree in Electrical, Instrumentation, Control Engineering, or a related technical field; equivalent experience in power generation or industrial control systems may also be considered.

data.title: Lead Solution Architect - ADMS Presales | Bespoke Applications, Azure & Digital Modernization
data.description:
Job Location: Pune, Noida, Chennai, Bangalore

Location Flexibility: Multiple Locations in Country

Req Id: 12807

Posting Start Date: 10/13/26

At Fujitsu, we've been driven to create a sustainable world through innovation since 1935. Today, we lead in digital transformation globally with our 130, 000 employees across 50+ countries. We empower our diverse community to achieve greatness through career development and opportunities. Explore our internal positions and join us in shaping a brighter future. Thank you for being a part of Fujitsu. We look forward to growing together toward a brighter future. 

Lead Solution Architect- Bespoke Applications, Azure & Digital Modernization

Role family: Business Consulting / Solution Architecture

Technology focus: Azure, web, mobile, APIs, microservices and integration

Ideal Candidate

A customer-oriented Lead Solution Architect who combines broad architectural thinking with hands-on engineering credibility. The candidate should be able to navigate from business problem to solution strategy, defend choices with senior stakeholders, and guide multidisciplinary teams toward a secure, scalable, supportable and commercially viable outcome. 

Role Purpose

Own end-to-end architecture and presales solutioning for bespoke application engagements, translating business needs into secure, scalable and delivery-ready solutions across modern user experiences, cloud-native platforms, integration and application modernization. 

Role Summary

The Lead Solution Architect will provide technical and consulting leadership across complex bespoke application opportunities and transformation programs. The role combines customer-facing presales, application architecture, business and technical analysis, cloud-native engineering, estimation, migration planning and delivery governance. The successful candidate will shape pragmatic solutions that balance business outcomes, user experience, security, operability, cost, risk and delivery feasibility. 

Application Solution Architect

- Lead customer discovery, architecture workshops, and solution definition from opportunity qualification through proposal, solution defence, and transition to delivery. 
 - Own end-to-end architecture across user experience, applications, APIs, integration, data, security, Azure cloud, DevSecOps, observability, and service management. 
 - Translate business and technical requirements into target architectures, modernization roadmaps, estimates, assumptions, dependencies, and delivery-ready artefacts. 
 - Assess legacy applications, technical debt, cloud readiness, and non-functional requirements; define rationalisation and migration strategies using the 6R approach. 
 - Design scalable web, mobile, microservices, event-driven, and cloud-native solutions, selecting technologies based on fit, maintainability, and delivery context. 
 - Lead RFI/RFP/RFQ solutioning, including technical proposals, effort and cost estimates, delivery models, presentations, proofs of concept, solution defence, and commercial clarifications. 
 - Guide design, development, migration, code reviews, testing, CI/CD, security, and resolution of complex engineering risks. 
 - Partner with sales, bid management, delivery, security, cloud, data, service, and commercial teams to ensure solutions are competitive, executable, and supportable. 
 - Establish architecture standards, reusable patterns, governance, and quality gates, and provide leadership through mobilisation and early delivery. 
 - Coach architects and engineering teams and contribute to reference architectures, accelerators, playbooks, and knowledge assets. 

Core Technical Capabilities

- Application architecture: Layered and modular design, domain-driven principles, microservices, event-driven patterns, APIs, integration, and cloud-native design. 
 - Modernisation and migration: Application rationalisation, 6R assessments, technical-debt analysis, monolith decomposition, containerisation, migration sequencing, and roadmap development. 
 - Cloud and engineering: Azure hosting, serverless and container patterns, identity, data services, Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD, DevSecOps, automated testing, observability, SRE-aligned operability, and FinOps-aware decisions. 
 - Design and development: Responsive web and mobile solutions, accessibility, usability, design systems, coding practices, code reviews, testing strategy, and engineering-quality controls. 
 - Programming and frameworks: TypeScript, JavaScript, NativeScript, Angular, React, Flutter, Spring Boot, and Node. js. 
 - Analysis and delivery: Requirements elicitation, process and capability analysis, functional decomposition, NFR definition, dependency analysis, solution option assessment, backlog shaping, sprint planning, and Agile architecture governance. 
 - Architecture governance: Context, component, deployment, integration, data, security, and NFR views; decision records; traceability; architecture reviews; standards compliance; risk management; and handover criteria. 

Leadership and Consulting Skills

- Excellent executive communication, presentation, facilitation, and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to explain complex technical decisions in business terms. 
 - Strong analytical, estimation, troubleshooting, and structured problem-solving capability, with clear articulation of trade-offs. 
 - Customer-focused and commercially aware, with an understanding of how architecture choices affect cost, risk, schedule, scalability, serviceability, and competitive positioning. 
 - Collaborative and credible across matrix teams, cultures, and time zones, with the ability to influence without authority and manage competing priorities. 
 - Strong ownership, adaptability, resilience, quality orientation, and the ability to coach architects and engineers. 

Experience And Qualifications

- Significant experience in application solution architecture, bespoke software engineering, technology consulting, or an equivalent customer-facing role. 
 - Demonstrated experience designing and modernising enterprise applications across web, mobile, API, integration, and cloud platforms. 
 - Experience leading architecture and solutioning across presales and delivery, including estimation, proposal development, and transition to implementation. 
 - Practical understanding of Azure solution patterns, security, resilience, integration, DevSecOps, operational readiness, and Agile delivery. 
 - Bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience. 
 - Relevant cloud, architecture, Agile, project-management, or engineering certifications are desirable. 

Technology and Platform Exposure

Front end and mobile: Angular, React, Flutter, NativeScript, TypeScript, JavaScript, responsive design and accessibility. 

Back end and APIs: Spring Boot, Node. js, REST/GraphQL APIs, microservices, event-driven services and API management. 

Cloud and containers: Microsoft Azure, containers, Kubernetes, serverless services, platform services, hybrid integration and cloud governance. 

Integration and Middleware: API gateways, messaging, event streaming, enterprise integration patterns and service-to-service security. 

Engineering and delivery: Git-based engineering, CI/CD, automated testing, code quality, DevSecOps, Infrastructure as Code and environment strategy. 

Operations: Monitoring, logging, tracing, alerting, resilience, backup/recovery, service readiness and support transition. 

Relocation Supported: Yes

Visa Sponsorship Approved: No

At Fujitsu, we are committed to an inclusive recruitment process that values the diverse backgrounds and experiences of all applicants. We believe that hiring people from a wide variety of backgrounds makes us stronger, not because it's the right thing to do, but because it allows us to draw on a wider range of perspectives and life experiences.

Experience:

 - Prior experience in managing civil construction projects independently. 
 - Experience in real estate, residential or commercial construction, industrial projects, infrastructure development, or construction/PMC firms will be preferred. 

About the Role: 

We are looking for an experienced and result-oriented Civil Engineering Manager - Construction Projects to plan, manage, and execute civil construction activities across projects. The ideal candidate will have strong technical expertise, hands-on site experience, and proven leadership skills to manage project teams, contractors, quality, safety, budgets, and timelines efficiently. 

Key Responsibilities: 

1. Project Planning & Execution: 

- Plan, schedule, and execute civil construction activities as per project specifications and approved drawings. 
 - Manage end-to-end civil works, including excavation, RCC, shuttering, reinforcement, masonry, finishing, and external development. 
 - Review technical drawings, designs, BOQs, and specifications to ensure accuracy and compliance. 
 - Monitor project progress and ensure timely completion within approved budgets and schedules. 

2. Team & Contractor Management: 

- Lead and supervise site engineers, supervisors, contractors, and construction teams.

 - Monitor contractor performance, manpower deployment, and productivity.

- Implement quality assurance and quality control (QA/QC) procedures. 
 - Conduct regular site inspections and ensure compliance with approved drawings and material specifications. 
 - Ensure adherence to health, safety, and environmental (HSE) standards. 
 - Identify construction defects and implement corrective and preventive measures. 

4. Budget & Cost Management: 

- Prepare cost estimates, project budgets, and resource requirements. 
 - Monitor project expenditure, material consumption, and cost variations. 
 - Review contractor bills, measurement sheets, and material procurement requests. 
 - Implement cost-control measures and minimize material wastage. 

5. Coordination & Reporting: 

- Coordinate with MEP teams, architects, structural consultants, contractors, and government authorities. 
 - Maintain daily progress reports (DPRs), site records, measurement books, and MIS reports. 
 - Track project milestones and report progress, risks, and challenges to senior management. 
 - Ensure proper documentation and compliance with applicable building codes and regulations. 

Required Skills & Competencies: 

- Strong knowledge of civil construction methods, RCC works, structural drawings, and finishing activities. 
 - Experience in project planning, execution, and site management. 
 - Proficiency in AutoCAD, MS Excel, and MS Project or Primavera. 
 - Familiarity with ERP systems, BOQs, estimation, billing, and cost control. 
 - Strong leadership, communication, negotiation, and problem-solving skills. 
 - Ability to manage multiple activities, contractors, and project deadlines. 
 - Knowledge of applicable building codes, local regulations, and construction safety standards. 

Eligibility Criteria: 

- B. E. /B. Tech in Civil Engineering; M. Tech will be an added advantage. 
 - 4-15 years of relevant experience, including site execution and managerial responsibilities. 
 - Prior experience in managing civil construction projects independently. 
 - Experience in real estate, residential or commercial construction, industrial projects, infrastructure development, or construction/PMC firms will be preferred.

data.description:
Organization- At CommBank, we never lose sight of the role we play in delivering a brighter future for our customers and supporting our communities. Our focus is to help customers and communities move forward to progress. To make the right financial decisions and achieve their dreams, targets and aspirations. Regardless of where you work within our organization, your initiative, talent, ideas and energy all contribute to the impact that we can make with our work. Together we can build tomorrow's bank today. 

Role Title - Staff Software Engineer

Business Unit- Group Security

Location- Bangalore- Manyata tech Park

Impact and Contributions: As a Staff Software Engineer - Identity Graph & Signals, you will be one of the senior individual contributors responsible for the technical direction and engineering quality of a strategic identity platform. 

The platform will build a connected representation of identities across people, privileged identities, service accounts, workloads, applications, devices, credentials, entitlements and resources. It will combine that graph with near-real-time identity and security signals to enable stronger identity intelligence, risk detection and dynamic security decisions. 

You will work on problems spanning distributed systems, graph modelling, event-driven architectures, identity security and large-scale data processing. 

This is a hands-on Staff engineering role. You will design systems, write production software, make consequential architecture decisions and raise engineering capability across the team. You will influence engineers and teams beyond your immediate delivery scope without relying on organisational authority. 

Key Responsibilities

You will: 

- Provide technical leadership for the architecture, design and evolution of the Identity Graph & Signals platform. 
 - Design and build highly available, secure and scalable distributed services that ingest, normalise, correlate and serve identity relationships and security signals. 
 - Define graph models capable of representing complex relationships between human identities, non-human identities, applications, workloads, accounts, credentials, entitlements, devices and resources. 
 - Engineer high-volume ingestion and event-processing pipelines for identity, authentication, authorisation, entitlement, device, workload and security telemetry. 
 - Develop APIs and services that allow identity relationships and signals to be consumed by authentication, authorisation, access governance, privileged access, detection and response, and other security capabilities. 
 - Solve difficult problems involving entity resolution, identity correlation, temporal relationships, graph traversal, event ordering, data quality, consistency, scale and low-latency access. 
 - Establish clear architectural boundaries, domain models, APIs, engineering patterns and technical standards that allow the platform to evolve safely. 
 - Make pragmatic engineering trade-offs across performance, reliability, security, maintainability, cost and speed of delivery. 
 - Remain deeply hands-on with production code, prototypes, design reviews and complex engineering problems. 
 - Lead technical design and code reviews, particularly for changes that affect platform architecture, security boundaries, reliability or long-term maintainability. 
 - Build security into the platform by design, including strong workload identity, authentication and authorisation, least privilege, encryption, secrets management and auditable access patterns. 
 - Design for operability from the beginning, using observability, SLOs, automated testing, deployment automation and production telemetry to continuously improve reliability. 
 - Work closely with identity architects, security engineers, product teams, data engineers and application teams across India and Australia. 
 - Identify architectural risks and systemic engineering issues early and drive them through to resolution. 
 - Mentor senior engineers and strengthen engineering capability through technical leadership, design thinking and high engineering standards. 
 - Contribute reusable patterns and engineering practices to the broader CommBank engineering community. 

Requirement-

We are looking for an engineer with substantial experience designing and building complex production systems. 

You will bring: 

- Typically 12+ years of software engineering experience, or equivalent depth of experience building and operating complex production systems. 
 - Demonstrated Staff-level technical leadership across systems or initiatives spanning multiple engineers, teams or domains. 
 - Exceptional software engineering capability in at least one modern backend language such as Java, Kotlin, Go, C#, Python or equivalent, with the ability to work effectively across a broader technology stack. 
 - Strong experience designing distributed, highly available and horizontally scalable systems. 
 - Deep understanding of API design, asynchronous processing, event-driven architectures, concurrency, failure handling and distributed-system trade-offs. 
 - Experience building platforms that process large volumes of data or events with demanding requirements for reliability, latency and correctness. 
 - Strong data-modelling capability across one or more of relational, document, key-value, search or graph data stores. 
 - Experience with cloud-native engineering on AWS, Azure or comparable cloud platforms. 
 - Strong engineering practices across automated testing, CI/CD, infrastructure automation, observability, production support and secure software development. 
 - A record of simplifying complex technical problems and turning ambiguous requirements into coherent architectures and working software. 
 - The ability to influence architecture and engineering decisions across teams while remaining collaborative and open to challenge. 
 - Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex technical decisions and trade-offs clearly. 

Highly Desirable

Direct experience in every area below is not required. Strong engineers with adjacent experience are encouraged to apply. 

Experience in one or more of the following would be highly regarded: 

- Graph databases and graph processing, including Amazon Neptune, Neo4j, JanusGraph or equivalent technologies. 
 - Graph modelling, graph traversal languages such as Gremlin or openCypher, entity resolution or relationship analytics. 
 - Large-scale streaming and event platforms such as Kafka, Kinesis, Event Hubs or equivalent. 
 - Identity and Access Management architectures involving OAuth 2. 0, OpenID Connect, SAML, SCIM, authentication, authorisation, identity governance or privileged access management. 
 - Modern workload and non-human identity patterns, including service identities, workload identities, certificates, secrets and machine credentials. 
 - Identity-security or cybersecurity telemetry, detection engineering, risk signals or continuous access evaluation. 
 - Technologies and patterns such as SPIFFE/SPIRE, Microsoft Entra, CyberArk, SailPoint, Ping Identity, HashiCorp Vault or equivalent platforms. 
 - Large-scale security, fraud, observability, recommendation, knowledge-graph or other systems where relationships and real-time signals are central to decision-making. 

What Success Looks Like

Within this role, success means more than delivering individual features. 

You will have helped create a platform where: 

- identity relationships can be understood across previously disconnected systems; 
 - identity and security signals can be processed and acted upon quickly; 
 - downstream teams can consume reliable identity intelligence through well-designed platform interfaces; 
 - architectural decisions enable rather than constrain future use cases; 
 - reliability, security and operability are intrinsic to the design; 
 - engineers around you make better technical decisions because of your influence; and
 - the platform becomes a reusable strategic capability rather than another isolated identity system. 

The Engineering Opportunity

Identity is changing. 

The traditional model of managing users, accounts and entitlements in separate systems is increasingly insufficient for cloud, APIs, workloads, AI agents and other non-human identities. Security decisions increasingly depend on understanding the relationships between identities, resources, privileges and behaviour, and on being able to respond to signals as circumstances change. 

The Identity Graph & Signals team is building that foundation at CommBank scale. 

For the right engineer, this is an opportunity to solve technically difficult problems, shape a new platform rather than inherit a finished one, and have material influence over how identity security evolves across one of Australia's largest technology environments. 

Education Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience. 

If you're already part of the Commonwealth Bank Group (including Bankwest, x15ventures), you'll need to apply through Sidekick to submit a valid application. We're keen to support you with the next step in your career. 

We're aware of some accessibility issues on this site, particularly for screen reader users. We want to make finding your dream job as easy as possible, so if you require additional support please contact HR Direct on 1800 989 696.

data.title: AIOps Platform Engineer Senior Associate Director, Software Engineering
data.description:
Some careers shine brighter than others. 

If you're looking for a career that will help you stand out, join HSBC and fulfil your potential. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further. 

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions. 

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Senior Associate Director, Software Engineering

We are seeking an experienced Senior AIOps Engineer to design, build, and operate the autonomous agents that turn observability data into safe, closed-loop operational action. You will sit at the intersection of service observability and agentic AI: connecting agents to metrics, logs, traces, events, change data, and service topology so they can detect, diagnose, and remediate production issues with minimal human intervention. You will define how agents reason over telemetry, which tools and runbooks they can call, the guardrails and approval gates that keep their actions safe, and the feedback loops that make them smarter after every incident. This role moves us from dashboards people have to watch to a self-healing production estate where AI observes, decides, and acts - and humans stay in control. 

In This Role, You Will

- Design and build autonomous AIOps agents (LLM-based and multi-agent) that run the full operational loop - observe, correlate, diagnose, decide, act, and verify - across incident triage, root-cause analysis, and auto-remediation 
 - Connect agents to the observability estate (OpenTelemetry, Grafana, Tempo/Jaeger, APM, CMDB, change and deployment events) through well-defined tools/APIs and MCP servers, giving agents real-time, topology-aware context to reason over 
 - Turn observability signals into autonomous action: build event-driven triggers on SLO burn-rate, anomaly, and correlated alert patterns that launch agent workflows such as rollback, restart, scale-out, failover, traffic shift, config fix, or ticket enrichment 
 - Build the agent action layer: convert runbooks into machine-executable, idempotent actions (runbook-as-code), with pre-checks, blast-radius limits, dry-run modes, automatic rollback, and post-action health verification against SLIs 
 - Implement guardrails and human-in-the-loop controls: risk-tiered autonomy levels, policy-as-code, approval gates for high-risk changes, full audit trails, and explainable reasoning for every decision an agent makes 
 - Apply AI to observability data: anomaly detection, forecasting, alert noise reduction, event correlation, and retrieval-augmented reasoning over past incidents, runbooks, and post-mortems to speed up RCA and cut MTTD/MTTR 
 - Build evaluation and observability for the agents themselves: trace agent reasoning and tool calls, measure accuracy, action success rate, false-action rate, latency, and cost; run replay/simulation and chaos tests before increasing autonomy in production 
 - Partner with SRE, platform, and application teams to onboard services to autonomous operations, set standards and reusable patterns, and coach engineers on using AI + observability to automate their own operational workflows

To be successful in this role, you should meet the following requirements: 

- 10+ years overall experience with 5+ years in SRE, AIOps, observability, or platform engineering. 
 - Proven hands-on development of autonomous agents using frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, CrewAI, AutoGen, Semantic Kernel, or equivalent; strong grasp of tool/function calling, MCP, planning, memory, and multi-agent orchestration 
 - Deep service observability expertise: OpenTelemetry, , Grafana, , Jaeger/Tempo, or enterprise APM (Splunk, AppDynamics); strong PromQL/LogQL/SQL and SLO/SLI/error-budget design 
 - Track record of delivering closed-loop auto-remediation in production that measurably reduced MTTR, alert noise, or manual toil, with clear safety controls and rollback 
 - Strong Python (Go a plus) with experience building event-driven services and integrations across Kubernetes, CI/CD, ITSM (ServiceNow), and automation tools. 
 - Practical knowledge of applied ML and LLM techniques for operations: anomaly detection, time-series forecasting, event correlation, RAG, prompt engineering, and evaluation of LLM outputs 
 - Understanding of responsible and secure AI in regulated environments: least-privilege agent access, PII redaction, auditability, model risk management, and change-control compliance 
 - Demonstrated technical leadership, with experience mentoring and leading engineers, setting engineering direction, reviewing designs, and developing team capability while influencing risk partners and senior stakeholders

You'll achieve more when you join HSBC. 

www. hsbc. com/careers

HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and, opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified persons irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc. , We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role. "

Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

 - Work with relational and/or NoSQL databases (e. g. , PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Redis) - schema design, query optimization, and data modeling. 
 - Integrate services with message queues/event streaming systems (e. g. , Kafka, RabbitMQ, NATS) where applicable. 
 - Contribute to CI/CD pipelines and help improve build, test and deploy automation

Requirements

- 4-6 years of overall software development experience, with at least 2-4 years of hands-on Go development in production environments. 
 - Strong understanding of Go fundamentals: goroutines, channels, interfaces, error handling, and Go's memory model/concurrency patterns. 
 - Solid experience building and consuming RESTful APIs; familiarity with gRPC is a strong plus. 
 - Experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL/MySQL) and writing efficient SQL queries; exposure to NoSQL databases is a plus. 
 - Practical experience with Docker and container orchestration (Kubernetes) in production settings.

data.title: Quality Assurance Manager
data.description:
About the Role: 

We are looking for an experienced and technically sound Quality Manager - Solar Ground Mount (C&I) to lead and manage Quality Assurance and Quality Control (QA/QC) activities for our Solar Ground-Mounted Commercial & Industrial projects. 

The ideal candidate should have strong experience in solar EPC project execution, quality management systems, site inspections, material quality assessments, testing and commissioning. The incumbent will be responsible for ensuring that project execution and installation activities comply with approved engineering designs, client specifications, applicable quality standards and regulatory requirements. 

Key Roles & Responsibilities: 

1. Quality Planning & Management

- Prepare and implement Project Quality Plans (PQP), Inspection & Test Plans (ITPs) and method statements for solar projects. 
 - Establish and maintain quality management systems in accordance with ISO 9001 requirements and project specifications. 

2. Civil, Mechanical & Electrical Quality

- Develop and implement quality inspection checklists for civil, mechanical and electrical activities. 
 - Monitor piling, pull-out and lateral load tests, foundation inspections, concrete cube testing, MMS erection, structural alignment and torque checks. 
 - Ensure quality compliance throughout project execution. 

3. Material & Vendor Quality

- Plan and witness Factory Acceptance Tests (FAT) and pre-dispatch inspections for PV modules, inverters, transformers, MMS structures, cables and switchgear. 
 - Verify incoming materials against approved technical specifications, test certificates and applicable BIS/IEC requirements. 
 - Evaluate vendor and subcontractor quality performance. 

4. Solar Module Quality & Electrical Testing

- Ensure proper handling and installation of solar modules as per OEM guidelines. 
 - Coordinate Electroluminescence (EL) and IV-curve testing wherever specified. 
 - Supervise insulation resistance, polarity, string Voc/Isc, earthing resistance, transformer and switchgear testing. 

5. Testing, Commissioning & Compliance

- Support pre-commissioning and commissioning activities. 
 - Coordinate CEIG/CEA inspections and ensure compliance with applicable regulatory requirements. 
 - Coordinate with clients, consultants and third-party inspection agencies. 

6. Non-Conformance & Corrective Actions

- Identify, raise, track and close Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs). 
 - Conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and implement Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA). 
 - Drive continuous improvement to reduce recurring defects, rework and quality deviations. 

7. Audits, Documentation & MIS

- Conduct internal quality audits and coordinate client, consultant and third-party quality audits. 
 - Maintain inspection records, testing reports, calibration records, quality registers and project quality dossiers. 
 - Prepare and monitor quality KPIs, including NCR status, inspection progress, first-pass yield and audit findings. 

8. Team Management & Continuous Improvement

- Lead and guide QA/QC engineers and inspectors across project sites. 
 - Train site engineers, supervisors and subcontractors on quality requirements. 
 - Share project learnings and implement measures to improve overall quality performance. 

Required Qualifications & Experience

- B. E. / B. Tech in Electrical, Mechanical or Civil Engineering from a recognised institute. 
 - 5-10 years of overall professional experience. 
 - Minimum 3-5 years of relevant QA/QC experience, preferably in Solar EPC project execution. 
 - Strong exposure to utility-scale and ground-mounted solar power projects. 
 - Hands-on experience in site inspections, material quality, testing and commissioning. 
 - Experience in managing QA/QC teams, vendors and subcontractors. 

Technical Skills & Competencies

- Strong understanding of QA/QC processes, Project Quality Plans, ITPs and ISO 9001. 
 - Knowledge of IEC 61215, IEC 61730, IEC 62446, relevant IS codes and CEA regulations. 
 - Experience in civil, mechanical and electrical quality inspections. 
 - Knowledge of RCA, 5-Why Analysis, Fishbone Diagram, CAPA and Pareto Analysis. 
 - Working knowledge of solar PV modules, inverters, MMS structures and solar plant installation. 
 - Proficiency in MS Excel for inspection trackers, NCR logs and KPI dashboards. 
 - Ability to prepare quality reports, audit documentation and management presentations. 
 - Strong communication, coordination and team leadership skills. 

Preferred / Additional Exposure

- ISO 9001: 2015 Lead Auditor / Internal Auditor certification. 
 - Six Sigma Green Belt or higher. 
 - Solar PV quality and inspection certifications. 
 - NDT Level II or Welding Quality / Civil QA/QC certifications. 
 - Experience working with large Independent Power Producers (IPPs). 
 - Exposure to PSU/Government solar tenders, including SECI, NTPC and State Renewable Energy Agencies. 
 - Experience handling Owner's Engineer audits and third-party inspections. 
 - Exposure to pooling substations and Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) projects. 

Key Performance Parameters

- Compliance with approved Project Quality Plans and inspection standards. 
 - Timely completion of material, civil, mechanical and electrical inspections. 
 - Reduction in quality defects, rework and recurring non-conformities. 
 - Timely closure of NCRs and implementation of CAPA. 
 - Successful completion of internal, client and third-party quality audits. 
 - Accurate and timely submission of quality documentation and project handover dossiers. 
 - Vendor and subcontractor quality performance. 

Why Join Sadbhav Futuretech Limited?

- Opportunity to work on large-scale renewable energy projects. 
 - Professional development and career growth opportunities. 
 - Employee medical insurance as per company policy. 
 - ESOP benefits as per company policy and eligibility. 
 - Opportunity to contribute to India's growing renewable energy sector. 

Interested in Joining Us?

If you have strong experience in Solar EPC Quality Management and are passionate about maintaining high-quality standards across solar projects, we would be happy to connect with you. 

Share your updated CV at: sanjay. dhami@sadbhavfuturetech. com
