data.title: Head of Quality Engineering
data.description:
About DiligentSquadDiligentSquad Technologies is an ecommerce systems integrator with more than 20 years of experience. We customise Intershop ecommerce platforms and deliver development, integrations and front-end work for several long-standing US partners and clients. Quality assurance is a core part of what we deliver. 

The roleYou will own the QA strategy and its execution across DiligentSquad's client-facing delivery. You will build a scalable, automation-first, AI-augmented quality function that cuts regression effort sharply without losing coverage of what matters to the business. You will lead and manage the QA team, stay hands-on with automation, and be the face of quality to our partners and clients. You are the single accountable owner of quality, and you hold both Dev and QA accountable for it. 

What you will do•                Define, publish and maintain the QA strategy, test architecture, test plan templates and quality standards for large commerce platforms such as Intershop or comparable systems, and see that every project follows them. 

•                Design risk-based regression for multi-brand and multi-tenant setups, where one engine serves many sites. Set tiers per client and per brand, so each change is tested for what it can actually affect. 

•                Own release sign-off and the quality gates: requirement, development, QA and UAT-ready. 

•                Lead test automation in Playwright (or equivalent) and integrate it into CI/CD pipelines. Write code yourself when needed, set coverage targets and grow a dedicated automation capability. 

•                Introduce and run AI-assisted testing, including AI-generated test design and test code, with clear human review controls and validation against requirements. 

•                Work with Dev leads on unit testing and pre-QA validation, and set up Dev-QA sync checkpoints. 

•                Run defect management end to end: severity and priority, evidence, developer discussion, retest and closure. 

•                Give QA input into estimates, with development, build, QA and UAT effort stated as separate lines. 

•                Set up metrics and governance (defect leakage, test coverage, release gates, closure reporting) and report them to the partner in monthly and quarterly quality reviews. 

•                Communicate proactively with partner project managers and leadership, including early warning when something is at risk. 

•                Coach and grow the QA team, and hold Dev and QA to shared accountability for quality. 

What we are looking forRequired•                12+ years in QA or quality engineering, including 5+ years leading QA teams. 

•                Proven test strategy work on large ecommerce or enterprise platforms. 

•                Hands-on experience with Playwright or an equivalent automation framework. 

•                Experience designing risk-based regression for multi-tenant or multi-brand systems. 

•                Strong written and client-facing communication. 

Preferred•                Intershop or a comparable commerce platform. 

•                Experience building or deploying AI-agent-assisted testing. 

•                CI/CD and API testing, including contract and performance testing. 

•                ISTQB or an equivalent certification. 

Core skill areas1.             QA strategy at platform scale

2.             Multi-brand regression design

3.             Automation leadership

4.             AI-assisted testing: has shipped AI-generated test design and code, with review controls in place

5.             Metrics and governance (defect leakage, coverage, release gates, closure reporting)

6.             Client-facing communication

7.             Team building

You will chip in to JIRA workflow automation, dashboard development, data analytics, and engineering process improvements that enable efficient execution across semiconductor development teams. 

This role provides an opportunity to gain experience working with multi-functional engineering organizations while building software solutions that improve engineering productivity and execution visibility. 

Responsibilities: JIRA Configuration & Automation

Support the implementation of JIRA workflows, issue types, screens, automation rules, and project configurations. Assist in maintaining engineering processes, defect tracking, and workflow standardization under the guidance of the Technical Lead. 

Software Development

Develop scripts, utilities, and automation using Python and SQL to extract, validate, and process engineering data from Atlassian databases and REST APIs. Chip in to custom integrations with engineering tools and reporting systems. 

Dashboard & UI Development

Develop and maintain web-based dashboards and user interfaces that visualize project health, engineering metrics, defect trends, and execution status. Work with modern web technologies to enhance usability and user experience. 

Data Analytics

Assist in building reporting pipelines, generating engineering metrics, validating data quality, and creating dashboards that provide actionable insights for engineering and program teams. 

Collaboration

Work with Design, Verification, Implementation, Validation, Power, Performance, Software, and Program Management teams to understand workflow requirements, support issue resolution, and continuously improve engineering processes. 

Required Skills And Experience

- 5+ Year of relevant experience. 
 - Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Electronics, Information Technology, or a related field. 
 - Good programming skills in Python and SQL. 
 - Basic understanding of databases, REST APIs, and software development practices. 
 - Familiarity with web technologies such as HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, or similar frameworks. 
 - Exposure to JIRA and Confluence is desirable. 
 - Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills. 
 - Willingness to learn enterprise workflow automation and engineering process development. 

"Nice To Have" Skills and Experience : 

- Knowledge of Agile development methodologies. 
 - Basic understanding of the semiconductor or SoC development lifecycle. 
 - Exposure to PostgreSQL, Git, Flask/FastAPI, or similar technologies. 
 - Interest in data visualization, dashboards, and engineering analytics. 

In Return: 

Joining Arm means becoming part of a collaborative engineering community where you'll be supported throughout your career. We invest in learning, mentoring, and professional development so you can continue building your technical expertise while working on technology that powers billions of devices worldwide. 

You'll Have Opportunities To

- Learn from extraordinary engineers across hardware and software. 
 - Work on latest SoC and low-power technologies. 
 - Build software, automation, and data solutions used across Arm engineering. 
 - Gain experience across the complete silicon development lifecycle. 
 - Grow your career through technical mentoring, training, and multi-functional collaboration. 

Our 10x Mindset

At Arm, we believe progress happens when people are empowered to think bigger and push beyond what seems possible. Our 10x mindset is about curiosity, ambition and creating impact that will be used by millions. We learn fast, prioritise collaboration and turn bold ideas into real technology. We look for people who are inspired by this way of working and want to grow in an environment where bold ideas are welcomed. Discover how the 10x mindset shapes life at Arm: https: //careers. arm. com/10x-mindset

Use of AI in Your Application

At Arm, we embrace the benefits AI can bring, including in recruitment. You may use AI to support your preparation, such as improving the clarity of written responses, practicing interview questions, or learning more about our industry. However, your application and interview responses must reflect your own thinking, experience, and abilities. We want to understand your authentic perspective, creativity, and approach to problem solving. As such, you may not use AI to complete assigned tasks as part of any assessments. If you plan to use AI-supported or assistive technologies as part of a reasonable adjustment, please contact accommodations@arm. com so we can support you. 

Recruitment Adjustments and Accommodations

At Arm, we want to build extraordinary teams. If you need an adjustment or an accommodation during the recruitment process, please email accommodations@arm. com . To note, by sending us the requested information, you consent to its use by Arm to arrange for appropriate accommodations. All accommodation or adjustment requests will be treated with confidentiality, and information concerning these requests will only be disclosed as necessary to provide the accommodation. Although this is not an exhaustive list, examples of support include breaks between interviews, having documents read aloud, or office accessibility. Please email us about anything we can do to accommodate you during the recruitment process. 

Hybrid Working

Arm's approach to hybrid working is designed to create a working environment that supports both high performance and personal wellbeing. We believe in bringing people together face to face to enable us to work at pace, whilst recognizing the value of flexibility. Within that framework, we empower groups/teams to determine their own hybrid working patterns, depending on the work and the team's needs. Details of what this means for each role will be shared upon application. In some cases, the flexibility we can offer is limited by local legal, regulatory, tax, or other considerations, and where this is the case, we will collaborate with you to find the best solution. Please talk to us to find out more about what this could look like for you. 

Equal Opportunities

Arm is an equal opportunity employer, committed to providing an environment of mutual respect where equal opportunities are available to all applicants and colleagues. We are a diverse organization of dedicated and innovative individuals, and don't discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

data.description:
About Dash Technologies

Founded in 2010 and headquartered in Dublin, Ohio, USA, Dash Technologies Inc. is a healthcare-focused technology company with a global delivery center in Ahmedabad, India. For more than 15 years, Dash has partnered with healthcare and MedTech organizations to design and engineer digital health solutions spanning Medical IoT, device and system integration, connected applications, artificial intelligence, machine learning, and data analytics. Dash combines strong engineering capabilities with practical execution to advance healthcare's digital transformation and improve care delivery. 

The Opportunity

Dash Technologies is seeking an experienced Manual Software Tester / QA Engineer to support software testing and quality assurance for a Medical Device Software product being built from scratch. 

You will be responsible for developing and executing test cases, identifying and tracking defects, supporting verification and validation activities, and ensuring high-quality software releases. 

This is a hands-on individual contributor role focused primarily on manual testing. Experience with test automation is desirable but optional. 

What You'll Do

Manual Software Testing

- Develop, review, and maintain test cases, test scenarios, test scripts, and test data. 
 - Execute functional, regression, integration, system, exploratory, and user acceptance testing. 
 - Analyze requirements and create comprehensive test scenarios covering positive, negative, boundary, and edge cases. 
 - Identify, document, and track software defects through resolution using bug-tracking tools. 
 - Perform retesting and regression testing after defect fixes and software changes. 
 - Review test results and provide clear testing status and release-readiness updates. 
 - Validate software functionality across different environments, configurations, and supported platforms. 
 - Participate in release testing and ensure identified issues are appropriately addressed before release. 

Requirements and Test Coverage

- Review business, functional, and technical requirements to ensure they are testable and clearly understood. 
 - Identify gaps, ambiguities, dependencies, and potential risks in requirements. 
 - Define acceptance criteria and contribute to backlog refinement. 
 - Maintain traceability between requirements, test cases, defects, and test results where required. 
 - Collaborate with product and engineering teams to clarify expected behavior and acceptance criteria. 

Quality Assurance

- Contribute to test planning and overall QA strategy for the product. 
 - Maintain organized and accurate testing documentation and records. 
 - Ensure testing activities are performed consistently across development cycles. 
 - Participate in defect triage, root cause discussions, and quality reviews. 
 - Communicate testing progress, risks, blockers, and quality concerns to relevant stakeholders. 
 - Support continuous improvement of testing processes and practices. 

Agile Testing

- Work closely with Agile development teams throughout the sprint lifecycle. 
 - Participate in sprint planning, backlog refinement, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives. 
 - Perform testing within development sprints rather than only at the end of the development cycle. 
 - Collaborate with developers to reproduce, investigate, and resolve defects. 
 - Ensure acceptance criteria are adequately covered before stories are considered complete. 
 - Support appropriate quality gates before software releases. 

Test Automation - Optional

- Experience with test automation is an advantage but is not mandatory. 
 - Contribute to identifying suitable test cases for automation. 
 - Work with automation engineers or developers to improve automated test coverage. 
 - Basic experience with automation tools or frameworks such as Selenium, Cypress, Playwright, or similar is desirable. 
 - Familiarity with CI/CD-based automated testing is a plus. 

Cross-Functional Collaboration

- Partner with product managers and business analysts to understand requirements and expected outcomes. 
 - Work closely with software developers to investigate and resolve defects. 
 - Collaborate with other QA team members to improve test coverage and testing practices. 
 - Communicate testing status, defects, risks, and blockers clearly to project stakeholders. 
 - Participate in product demonstrations and reviews to understand new functionality. 

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Electronics, Biomedical Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - At least 3-5 years of experience in software testing or quality assurance. 
 - Strong hands-on experience in manual software testing. 
 - Experience developing and executing test cases, test scenarios, test scripts, and test plans. 
 - Experience performing functional, regression, integration, system, and exploratory testing. 
 - Strong understanding of software testing concepts and Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC). 
 - Experience identifying, documenting, and tracking defects using tools such as Jira or similar platforms. 
 - Experience working with Agile methodologies such as Scrum or Kanban. 
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. 
 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills. 
 - Strong attention to detail and ability to work independently. 
 - Experience with test management tools such as Jira, TestRail, Zephyr, QATouch, or similar platforms. 

Bonus Points

- Experience testing Medical Device Software, Healthcare Software, or MedTech products. 
 - Experience working on products developed from scratch. 
 - Experience testing web applications, mobile applications, APIs, or integrated systems. 
 - Basic knowledge of API testing tools such as Postman or similar. 
 - Basic SQL/database testing experience. 
 - Experience with test automation tools such as Selenium, Cypress, Playwright, Appium, or similar. 
 - Experience working with CI/CD pipelines and automated test execution. 
 - Experience with performance, usability, compatibility, or security testing. 
 - Experience working in a startup or new product development environment. 
 - Experience with Medical IoT or connected healthcare applications. 

How You Work

Skills and Competencies

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. 
 - Excellent attention to detail. 
 - Ability to think from an end-user perspective and identify unexpected scenarios. 
 - Strong defect investigation and root cause analysis skills. 
 - Good understanding of risk-based testing and test prioritization. 
 - Ability to work independently and manage multiple testing activities. 
 - Strong communication and collaboration skills. 
 - Ability to work effectively with developers, product managers, business analysts, and other stakeholders. 
 - Strong ownership of assigned testing activities. 
 - Willingness to learn new technologies, tools, and testing techniques. 

Values We Seek

- Quality Mindset: Commitment to delivering reliable, high-quality software. 
 - Customer Focus: Ability to understand software from the user's perspective. 
 - Attention to Detail: Thoroughness in identifying defects and validating functionality. 
 - Collaboration: Effective communication and teamwork across technical and non-technical teams. 
 - Continuous Improvement: Interest in improving testing processes, coverage, and efficiency. 

Why Join Dash

What We Offer

- A hands-on QA role supporting a Medical Device Software product from the ground up. 
 - The opportunity to contribute to testing strategy and quality practices for a new product line. 
 - Exposure to Medical IoT, artificial intelligence, and digital health initiatives. 
 - A collaborative team at our Ahmedabad delivery center. 
 - Competitive compensation, performance-based bonuses, and comprehensive benefits. 
 - Professional development support for training and industry certifications. 
 - Flexible work arrangements and a culture that values quality, innovation, and continuous improvement.

data.title: Senior Solutions Automation Engineer
data.description:
Description

Hungry, Humble, Honest, with a Heart. 

The Opportunity

Nutanix Validated Designs (NVDs) certify Nutanix Solutions cross-product interoperability at scale. Solutions Automation Engineers build the software behind that certification: the programmatic environment builds and validation workflows that Solutions Architects and Quality Engineering rely on. 

We are changing how that work gets done. Standing up infrastructure is already a solved problem for us, because our Python infrastructure-as-code tooling builds the same environment the same way every time. Judgment is the harder part, and it covers reading a validated design, catching the contradictions buried in it, and justifying every design decision before anything gets built. That is the work we are handing to agents. 

In this role you will write the deterministic Python that has to be correct on every run, and you will build the agentic workflows around it: the prompts, the skills, the guardrails, and the evaluations that decide when an agent can act on its own and when control belongs to a pipeline or to a person. 

You will work on hard problems at scale, with the freedom to deliver, alongside engineers who care about getting it right. 

Your Role

- Design, build, and maintain Python software that deploys, configures, and validates Nutanix private and hybrid cloud environments. 
 - Build agentic workflows around that software, including prompt engineering, agent skill and tool development, and the evaluation harnesses that show a workflow works before we rely on it. 
 - Decide what belongs in deterministic code and what belongs to an agent, and be able to defend that decision. Most of what you deliver should be deterministic and repeatable, with agents used where the problem involves ambiguity, synthesis, or design judgment. 
 - Use agentic coding tools in your daily work, and help raise the team's practice as the tooling changes. 
 - Build and operate cloud native, automated pipelines, covering containerized workloads, CI/CD, and infrastructure as code, so that builds and validations run without manual intervention. 
 - Automate validation as part of building the feature, and catch regressions before a release reaches a customer. 
 - Analyze failures, determine root cause, and drive fixes to closure. 
 - Demo your work to Solutions Architects, product teams, and customers, and write documentation that other people can actually use. 
 - Engage with customers and support when needed to solve production issues. 

What You'll Bring

- Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or a related field. 
 - 6+ years building production software, with real depth in at least one role. 
 - Python is required. We are looking for production-grade depth and the ability to own a Python codebase that other people depend on. 
 - Hands-on experience building with LLMs and agentic tooling: prompt engineering, agent skills or tool definitions, and testing and evaluating non-deterministic systems. 
 - Good judgment about where automation should be deterministic and where an agent adds value, and the discipline to keep the trusted path in code. 
 - Strong fundamentals in Object-Oriented Programming, algorithms, data structures, and problem solving. 
 - Cloud native delivery experience: containerized applications (Docker, Kubernetes) and automated CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Experience working against REST APIs and building infrastructure as code. 
 - Experience with a "systems" product such as storage, virtualization, networking, databases, or operating systems. 
 - Skill in debugging complex distributed applications. 
 - Excellent written and verbal communication, and the confidence to present technical work to customers and senior stakeholders. 
 - A self-starter who can work independently, juggle competing priorities, respect differences, and maintain professionalism under pressure. 

Nice to Have

- Additional languages beyond Python: Golang, JavaScript, TypeScript, Node. js, React, Angular, etc. 
 - Experience with Terraform, Ansible, or comparable infrastructure as code tooling. 
 - Background as a platform engineer, SRE, or solutions architect who writes production code. 
 - Experience with Jira, GitHub, Artifactory, and modern CI systems. 
 - Public evidence of your work: GitHub projects, open source contributions, or published technical writing. 

--

data.title: Shift Manager
data.description:
Business Unit: 

Cubic Transportation Systems

Company Details: 

When you join Cubic, you become part of a company that creates and delivers technology solutions in transportation to make people's lives easier by simplifying their daily journeys, and defense capabilities to help promote mission success and safety for those who serve their nation. Led by our talented teams around the world, Cubic is committed to solving global issues through innovation and service to our customers and partners. 

We have a top-tier portfolio of businesses, including Cubic Transportation Systems (CTS) and Cubic Defense (CD). Explore more on Cubic. com. 

Job Details: 

Job Summary

As a Shift Coordinator on the CTS 24x7 Service Operations team, you will provide direct supervision to Tier 1 and Tier 2 staff across the Network Operations Center (NOC), Security Operations Center (SOC), and Service Desk during your assigned shift. You act as the technical and operational command authority during the shift. You are responsible for ensuring that events across all three functions are correctly triaged, tickets are properly assigned and tracked, incidents are escalated per defined protocols, and shift handovers preserve full situational awareness for the incoming shift. 

You are responsible for confirming shift staffing coverage in real time and for adjusting assignments to accommodate last-minute absences. You are the immediate escalation path for issues that exceed the authority of the Tier 1 and Tier 2 analysts on the shift, and you escalate to the Director of Technical Service Operations for issues that exceed shift authority. 

Work is conducted under the compliance frameworks that govern CTS operations, in particular ITIL 4 (Monitoring and Event Management, Incident Management, Continual Improvement), ISO/IEC 27001: 2022 (Annex A logging, monitoring, and incident management controls), and PCI DSS v4. 0. 1 (Requirements 10 and 12. 10). You will be recognized inside CTS as the shift-level owner for cross-function coordination and evidence continuity. 

Responsibilities

Essential Job Duties and Responsibilities

Shift Command and Team Coordination

- Provide direct supervision to Tier 1 and Tier 2 NOC, SOC, and Service Desk analysts during the assigned shift. 
 - Assign work at shift start and re-balance workload throughout the shift based on ticket volume, incident severity, and individual analyst capacity. 
 - Confirm complete shift coverage across NOC, SOC, and Service Desk queues at shift start; adjust in real time when staff are unavailable because of sick calls, unplanned PTO, or emergency absence. 
 - Serve as the initial escalation point for any Tier 1 or Tier 2 analyst who needs additional authority, judgment, or cross-functional coordination. 
 - Track and report shift-level metrics (ticket volume, SLA adherence, incident count by severity) at shift close. 

Shift Handover Discipline

- Execute a formal shift handover at the start and end of every shift, per the protocols defined in the NOC Scope Definition and the CTS SOC Scope of Operations. 
 - Ensure the handover record captures, at minimum: open incidents with owner and next action; active containment actions in progress; watchlist items; active maintenance windows; tooling or coverage gaps. 
 - Retain handover records as ISMS evidence supporting ISO/IEC 27001: 2022 A. 5. 10 and ITIL 4 Monitoring and Event Management practice. 

Incident Management Coordination

- Apply ITIL 4 Incident Management practice throughout the shift: validate alerts, classify severity, assign ownership, coordinate escalation, and track resolution against SLA. 
 - Coordinate the first 15 to 30 minutes of any SEV 0 or SEV 1 incident: declare the incident, engage the appropriate tiers, initiate stakeholder communications, and hand off to the Incident Commander or on-call Tier 3 engineer. 
 - Enforce severity special rules from the NOC Scope Definition (for example, loss of logging or monitoring is never a SEV 4 event; SEV 0 or SEV 1 with a recent production change requires a change correlation step). 
 - Ensure joint NOC-SOC coordination during Major Incidents: NOC leads operational recovery; SOC leads security investigation and containment; the Shift Coordinator maintains the shared incident bridge until the Incident Commander takes over. 

Cross-Function Ticket Routing and Escalation

- Monitor NOC, SOC, and Service Desk queues in the ITSM platform; ensure tickets are correctly categorized and assigned per the RACI. 
 - Route security-relevant events from the NOC or Service Desk to the SOC per the defined Escalation pathway with enriched context. 
 - Route operational recovery actions from the SOC to the NOC or regional IT Operations per the defined protocol. 
 - Escalate to the Director of Technical Service Operations for any issue that exceeds shift authority. 

Compliance Evidence and Documentation

- Ensure shift activities produce audit-ready evidence supporting PCI DSS v4. 0. 1 Requirement 10 and Requirement 12. 10, and ISO/IEC 27001: 2022 A. 5. 24-A. 5. 28 and A. 8. 15-A. 8. 16. 
 - Verify handover records, incident timelines, and containment action logs are complete and accurate before shift close. 
 - Support monthly and quarterly evidence pack preparation. 

Continuous Improvement Contribution

- Identify recurring patterns during the shift (repeat incidents, noisy alerts, gaps in playbook coverage) and log them for review by the NOC, SOC, and Service Desk Managers. 
 - Participate in post-incident reviews and contribute to the Continual Improvement Register per ITIL 4 Continual Improvement practice. 
 - Recommend changes to shift-level procedures where the shift experience identifies opportunities. 

General Duties And Responsibilities

About Lynk (Name has been changed to Elveo)

Elveo is the inventor of satellite direct to device or D2D technology, and has the world's only commercial license from the FCC to operate a commercial D2D system. Today, Lynk allows mobile network operators' subscribers to send and receive text messages to and from space via standard unmodified, mobile devices. Lynk's service has been tested and proven on all seven continents, has regulatory approvals in more than 30 countries and is currently being deployed commercially based on more than 40 MNO commercial service contracts covering approximately 50 countries. 

Our technology will enable all 8 billion people on the planet to stay connected with the existing standard phone in their pocket. Everywhere. No matter what. 

By joining Lynk, you will have the opportunity to directly touch the lives of billions. Your mission will be to bring mobile broadband to billions, pull hundreds of millions out of poverty, and save countless lives.

As a Senior Software Engineer at Lynk, you will be a technical leader in designing, building, and operating the software that powers our satellites and ground network. data.description:
About Euromonitor

Euromonitor International leads the world in data analytics and research into markets, industries, economies and consumers. We provide truly global insight and data on thousands of products and services; we are the first destination for organisations seeking growth. With our guidance, our clients can make bold, strategic decisions with confidence. 

Overview Of The Role

The Platform Engineering Manager leads Cloud Engineering and Platform Engineering teams distributed globally, creating the conditions for engineers to do their best work. The role is a people-first leadership position with strong technical leadership accountability: setting direction, removing obstacles, and ensuring the team delivers reliable platform capabilities that enable product teams to move quickly and safely. 

The Manager partners closely with Team Leaders to build a healthy, inclusive, and high-performing culture grounded in trust and psychological safety. They hire, coach, and develop engineers and leaders through regular 1: 1s, feedback, and performance reviews, applying servant leadership and demonstrating empathy for day-to-day engineering challenges (delivery pressure, incidents, technical debt, ambiguity) while supporting sustainable pace. 

The Manager provides technical leadership focused on enabling product teams through value-add platform services and capabilities. They bring a deep understanding of the problems software engineers face when building and running products-delivery friction, environment inconsistency, reliability issues, security constraints, and managing technical debt-and use that insight to shape platform roadmaps, standards, and guardrails that remove toil and accelerate delivery. 

They own the team's backlog and roadmap, aligning stakeholders on outcomes and priorities: gathering requirements and feedback, translating them into well-shaped work items, and facilitating collaboration across teams. They ensure functional and non-functional requirements are captured, and they play a key role in FinOps governance to manage public cloud costs responsibly. When critical issues occur, the Manager helps coordinate an effective response to restore service quickly and drive learning through clear follow-up actions. 

Requirements

data.title: Senior Software Engineer
data.description:
FactSet creates flexible, open data and software solutions for over 200, 000 investment professionals worldwide, providing instant access to financial data and analytics that investors use to make crucial decisions. 

At FactSet, our values are the foundation of everything we do. They express how we act and operate, serve as a compass in our decision-making, and play a big role in how we treat each other, our clients, and our communities. We believe that the best ideas can come from anyone, anywhere, at any time, and that curiosity is the key to anticipating our clients' needs and exceeding their expectations. 

Your Team's Impact

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer who is passionate about Generative AI, Agentic systems, and cloud-native API development. In this role, you will be a key contributor in designing, building, and deploying production-grade AI-powered applications and intelligent agent frameworks that transform the way our products and customers interact with data and automation. 

You will collaborate closely with ML Engineers, Data Scientists, Product Managers, and Cloud Architects to deliver scalable, reliable, and innovative solutions powered by cutting-edge GenAI technologies. 

What You'll Do

GenAI & Agentic Development

- Design and develop Agentic AI workflows using frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, or similar
 - Build and integrate LLM-powered applications using models from OpenAI, Anthropic, Meta (LLaMA), Mistral, or foundation models on cloud platforms
 - Implement Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, vector stores, and semantic search capabilities
 - Develop multi-agent orchestration systems with defined tool use, memory management, and reasoning loops
 - Evaluate, fine-tune, and optimize LLM behavior through prompt engineering and chain-of-thought design

API Development & Backend Engineering

- Build high-performance, scalable RESTful APIs and async microservices using FastAPI and Python
 - Design clean, modular, and well-documented API contracts following OpenAPI/Swagger standards
 - Implement authentication, authorization, rate limiting, and security best practices across APIs

Cloud & Platform Engineering

- Deploy and manage AI workloads on AWS (SageMaker, Lambda, API Gateway, Bedrock, S3, ECS/EKS)

Engineering Excellence

- Write clean, testable, production-ready Python code following software engineering best practices

What We're Looking For

- 5-7 years of professional software engineering experience
 - Hands-on Python development in production environments
 - Experience with GenAI technologies including LLMs, RAG, embeddings, or prompt engineering
 - Building and deploying APIs using FastAPI or similar async Python frameworks
 - Experience working with AWS cloud services in a production environment
 - Hands-on experience with Databricks for data/AI workloads

Python & Frameworks

- Expert-level Python (async programming, type hints, Pydantic, dependency injection)
 - FastAPI - routing, middleware, background tasks, OpenAPI spec generation

GenAI & Agentic

- Strong understanding of LLM internals, tokenization, context windows, and model behavior

 - Knowledge of RAG architectures, chunking strategies, and embedding models

Cloud - AWS

 - AWS Lambda, API Gateway, ECS/EKS - serverless and containerized deployments
 - S3, DynamoDB, RDS/Aurora - data storage patterns
 - IAM, VPC, Secrets Manager - security and access control

Databricks

General Engineering

Preferred / Nice-to-Have Qualifications

- Experience with multi-modal AI (vision + language models)
 - Familiarity with Azure OpenAI Service or Google Vertex AI

 - Contributions to open-source AI/ML projects

 - Background in data engineering or MLOps pipelines

Education

What's In It For You

At FactSet, our people are our greatest asset, and our culture is our biggest competitive advantage. Being a FactSetter means: 

- The opportunity to join an S&P 500 company with over 45 years of sustainable growth powered by the entrepreneurial spirit of a start-up.

Company Overview

Learn more about our benefits here. 

FactSet (NYSE: FDS | NASDAQ: FDS) helps the financial community to see more, think bigger, and work better. Our digital platform and enterprise solutions deliver financial data, analytics, and open technology to more than 8, 200 global clients, including over 200, 000 individual users. Clients across the buy-side and sell-side, as well as wealth managers, private equity firms, and corporations, achieve more every day with our comprehensive and connected content, flexible next-generation workflow solutions, and client-centric specialized support. As a member of the S&P 500, we are committed to sustainable growth and have been recognized among the Best Places to Work in 2023 by Glassdoor as a Glassdoor Employees' Choice Award winner. Teradata is building the next generation of AI-native analytics, enabling customers to deploy production-grade Generative AI systems directly where enterprise data lives. We are looking for a Staff AI Engineer to play a key role in designing and building the LLM, agent and ModelOps capabilities of Teradata's cloud and SaaS platform, taking them from prototype to secure, observable, multi-tenant production services. 

This role is ideal for an engineer who thrives at the intersection of LLMs, agentic systems and cloud-native engineering, and wants to work on core platform capabilities, not just application demos. 

You will: 

- Own the architecture and technical direction of Teradata's agentic AI platform, delivered as a secure, multi-tenant, cloud-native SaaS service. 
 - Design and build agent runtimes and harnesses: tool calling, planning, memory, context management, multi-agent orchestration, sandboxed execution and human-in-the-loop controls. 
 - Design, build and secure MCP servers and clients, and other agent and tool protocols, that expose Teradata capabilities to agents through governed, well-documented APIs. 
 - Integrate and serve LLMs, both hosted APIs and self-hosted open-weight models: model gateway, routing, caching, fallbacks, token budgets, latency and cost control. 
 - Build ModelOps / LLMOps pipelines: model, prompt and agent registries and versioning, CI/CD with evaluation gates, canary releases and rollback, and quality and drift monitoring. 
 - Build evaluation and observability frameworks for LLM and agent systems: offline evals, LLM-as-judge, tracing, regression suites, and quality, safety, latency and cost metrics. 
 - Implement AI guardrails and responsible-AI controls: prompt-injection defense, PII handling, permissions, policy enforcement and audit trails for regulated industries. 
 - Run AI services as SaaS on AWS, Azure and Google Cloud: tenant isolation, authentication and authorization, quotas, usage metering, SLOs, and production and on-call readiness. 
 - Drive scalability, performance, reliability and cost efficiency of AI workloads, using Kubernetes and infrastructure-as-code. 
 - Where use cases call for it, apply RAG, vector search and semantic retrieval patterns, including Teradata's vector store. 
 - Lead technical design reviews and influence cross-team architectural decisions; identify risks early and drive solutions. 
 - Collaborate with product, research and platform teams to turn customer use cases into scalable features, and benchmark against cloud and open-source alternatives. 

Who You'll Work With: Join Forces with the Best

You'll collaborate with a world-class team of AI architects, ML engineers and domain experts across India and Silicon Valley, working together to build the next generation of enterprise AI systems. 

You'll also work cross-functionally with: 

- Product managers and UX designers to craft agentic workflows that are intuitive and impactful. 
 - Domain specialists to ensure solutions fit real business problems in regulated industries. 
 - Cloud, SaaS and infrastructure teams responsible for deploying, evaluating and scaling AI workloads. This is a rare opportunity to shape foundational AI capabilities within a global, data-driven company. This is a deeply collaborative environment where technical innovation meets real-world application, where your ideas are not only heard but implemented to shape the next generation of data interaction. 

Minimum Requirements

- BS/MS/PhD in Computer Science, AI/ML, or a related field. 
 - 8+ years of professional software engineering experience, including ownership of complex production systems, and 2+ years building LLM-based applications or platforms in production. 
 - Strong cloud engineering on AWS, Azure or Google Cloud: Kubernetes and containers, infrastructure-as-code (for example Terraform), and CI/CD. 
 - Experience building and operating SaaS services: multi-tenancy, API design, authentication and authorization (OAuth/OIDC), observability, SLOs and reliability engineering. 
 - Hands-on LLM experience: prompt and context engineering, function and tool calling, structured outputs, and working with both commercial and open-weight models. 
 - Experience designing agentic systems: planning, memory, orchestration and custom agent harnesses, plus familiarity with agent frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain or equivalent. 
 - Experience with ModelOps / LLMOps: deploying, versioning, evaluating and monitoring models, prompts and agents in production. 
 - Working knowledge of methods for evaluating LLM and agent quality, safety, latency and cost. 
 - Proficiency in Python (and/or Java or Go), with experience shipping production-grade systems. 
 - Experience with large-scale data and performance-sensitive distributed systems. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with LLM inference and serving optimization (for example vLLM or Triton, quantization, GPU scheduling). 
 - Experience with fine-tuning and post-training of open-weight models (for example LoRA, preference optimization, distillation). 
 - Experience implementing AI guardrails, red-teaming and security controls for agents, such as prompt-injection defense. 
 - Familiarity with agent-to-agent protocols and tracing standards such as A2A and OpenTelemetry for GenAI. 
 - Experience with analytics platforms, data warehouses and SQL-based workloads.

data.title: Software Engineer III
data.description:
About Team

The Health & Wellness Engineering team at Walmart is on a mission to make healthcare more accessible, affordable, and convenient for millions of customers across the US. We build the technology that powers Walmart's pharmacy, specialty pharmacy, and wellness platforms spanning prescription management, clinical workflows, patient-facing digital experiences, and health program delivery. Our systems process millions of prescriptions annually and connect patients, pharmacists, prescribers, and payers in real time. The team operates at the intersection of technology and healthcare, building platforms that have a direct, measurable impact on patient outcomes and community health. 

What You'll Do

As a Software Engineer III for Walmart Health & Wellness, you'll have the opportunity to: 

Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend services and patient-facing applications that power Walmart's pharmacy and health platforms

Collaborate with product managers, clinical stakeholders, and cross-functional engineering teams to translate healthcare requirements into reliable, compliant software solutions

Build and maintain secure, HIPAA-compliant systems that handle sensitive patient health information (ePHI) with the highest standards of data privacy and integrity

Participate in design and architecture reviews to ensure systems meet performance, scalability, fault tolerance, and regulatory compliance requirements

Develop integrations with third-party healthcare systems

Write well-tested, production-grade code; contribute to CI/CD pipelines and champion engineering best practices including code reviews, automated testing, and observability

Troubleshoot and resolve complex production issues quickly to ensure high availability of systems that patients and pharmacists depend on daily

Adhere to Company policies, procedures, mission, values, and standards of ethics and integrity

What You'll Bring

3-5 years of professional software engineering experience with a strong full-stack background

Backend: Java & Spring Boot - Production-grade REST APIs, Spring MVC, DI, JPA/Hibernate, JUnit 5 + Mockito, Maven/Gradle

Frontend: React & TypeScript - Functional components, Hooks (useState, useEffect, useMemo, etc. ), React Router, TypeScript (interfaces, generics, enums)

State Management & UI - Redux / Redux Toolkit or Zustand; CSS Modules, styled-components, or Tailwind CSS; React Hooks/ Formik

REST API Design - Versioning, status codes, error contracts; Axios/Fetch integration with async state handling

Database - SQL (joins, aggregations, window functions), PostgreSQL/MySQL, ACID transactions, indexing, query optimization

DevOps Basics - Docker, CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins / GitHub Actions / Concord), Linux/CLI proficiency

Engineering Fundamentals - OOP, SOLID, DSA, Git branching strategies, unit & integration testing

Soft Skills - Strong ownership, clear communication, collaborative, active code-review participant

About Walmart Global Tech

Imagine working in an environment where one line of code can make life easier for hundreds of millions of people. That's what we do at Walmart Global Tech. We're a team of software engineers, data scientists, cybersecurity expert's and service professionals within the world's leading retailer who make an epic impact and are at the forefront of the next retail disruption. People are why we innovate, and people power our innovations. We are people-led and tech-empowered. 

We train our team in the skillsets of the future and bring in experts like you to help us grow. We have roles for those chasing their first opportunity as well as those looking for the opportunity that will define their career. Here, you can kickstart a great career in tech, gain new skills and experience for virtually every industry, or leverage your expertise to innovate at scale, impact millions and reimagine the future of retail. 

Walmart's culture sets us apart, and we know being together helps us innovate, learn and grow great careers. This role is based in our [Bangalore/Chennai] office for daily work, with the flexibility for associates to manage their personal lives. 

Benefits

Beyond our great compensation package, you can receive incentive awards for your performance. Other great perks include a host of best-in-class benefits maternity and parental leave, pto, health benefits, and much more. 

Belonging

We aim to create a culture where every associate feels valued for who they are, rooted in respect for the individual. Our goal is to foster a sense of belonging, to create opportunities for all our associates, customers and suppliers, and to be a Walmart for everyone. 

At Walmart, our vision is "everyone included. " by fostering a workplace culture where everyone is-and feels-included, everyone wins. Our associates and customers reflect the makeup of all 19 countries where we operate. By making Walmart a welcoming place where all people feel like they belong, we're able to engage associates, strengthen our business, improve our ability to serve customers, and support the communities where we operate. 

Equal opportunity employer

Walmart, inc. , is an equal opportunities employer - by choice. We believe we are best equipped to help our associates, customers and the communities we serve live better when we really know them. That means understanding, respecting and valuing unique styles, experiences, identities, ideas and opinions - while being inclusive of all people

data.title: AI Infrastructure Engineer – Generative AI Model Serving (Go / Rust / GPU)
data.description:
Our Company: 

At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes. With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters. Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach. Teradata delivers real business value with AI. 

Power the Platform Behind Enterprise Generative AI

At Teradata, we're not just managing data; we're unleashing its full potential. Our ClearScape AnalyticsTM platform and Enterprise Vector Store help the world's largest enterprises derive value from their most complex data. Generative AI and agentic systems are the next frontier, and they run on infrastructure that has to be fast, efficient, and dependable at scale. 

As an AI Infrastructure Engineer, you will build the serving layer that runs large language models and other generative models inside the Teradata Vantage ecosystem. You will work on GPU-accelerated inference, high-performance Go and Rust services, and the cloud-native platform that lets teams ship models to production with confidence. You will own systems end to end, from a CUDA kernel profile to a Kubernetes rollout. 

What You'll Do

- Design, build, and operate scalable, low-latency model-serving platforms for LLMs and generative models, covering batching, streaming, routing, autoscaling, and multi-tenant isolation. 
 - Develop high-performance control-plane and data-plane services in Go and performance-critical components (tokenizers, schedulers, runtimes, gRPC/HTTP gateways, native extensions) in Rust. 
 - Optimize GPU inference for throughput, latency, and cost using continuous batching, KV-cache management, quantization (INT8/FP8/AWQ/GPTQ), speculative decoding, tensor/pipeline parallelism, and efficient memory use. 
 - Integrate and extend inference engines such as vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, Triton Inference Server, Ray Serve, KServe, SGLang, llama. cpp, and ONNX Runtime; contribute fixes upstream where it makes sense. 
 - Build and manage GPU cluster infrastructure on Kubernetes (NVIDIA GPU Operator, device plugins, MIG/time-slicing, node pools, scheduling and bin-packing) across cloud and on-prem environments. 
 - Own the full delivery path: CI/CD pipelines, model packaging and registries, canary and blue/green rollouts, infrastructure as code, and automated performance regression testing. 
 - Build AI observability into everything: metrics, logs, and traces for token throughput, time-to-first-token, GPU utilization, queue depth, error and hallucination signals, using OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, and Grafana. 
 - Provide clean APIs, SDKs, and developer tooling (OpenAI-compatible endpoints, internal services, and lightweight UIs or dashboards) so AI engineers and agent builders can deploy and monitor models self-serve. 
 - Support agentic and RAG workloads by serving embedding, reranking, and generation models alongside the Enterprise Vector Store, with predictable latency and graceful degradation. 
 - Drive reliability, security, and cost efficiency: SLOs, load and chaos testing, capacity planning, GPU cost attribution, and secure model and tenant isolation. 

Who You'll Work With

You will collaborate daily with AI researchers, ML engineers, data scientists, and platform and SRE teams who champion diversity, equity, and inclusion as fundamental to our success. You'll be part of a cohesive team delivering high-quality, highly visible AI/ML functionality within the Teradata Vantage platform. You will report to the Sr. Manager, Software Engineering, who will champion your growth and empower your contributions. 

What Makes You a Qualified Candidate

- 3+ years of professional software engineering experience in backend systems, distributed systems, or AI/ML infrastructure. 
 - Strong, production-level proficiency in Go (concurrency, gRPC, profiling, service design) and working proficiency, or a demonstrated passion for learning, Rust (ownership, async runtimes such as Tokio, FFI, performance tuning). 
 - Hands-on experience with GPU computing for ML: CUDA fundamentals, GPU profiling (Nsight, nvidia-smi/DCGM), memory and bandwidth tradeoffs, and multi-GPU or multi-node inference. 
 - Experience serving LLMs or generative models in production, with practical knowledge of inference optimization techniques and the serving frameworks listed above. 
 - Solid understanding of transformer architectures and the LLM inference lifecycle (prefill vs. decode, attention, KV cache, sampling), plus familiarity with PyTorch and Hugging Face tooling. 
 - Strong system design skills and a deep understanding of distributed systems, networking, concurrency, and failure modes. 
 - Experience with containers and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes, Helm) and CI/CD (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Argo CD, or similar), plus infrastructure as code (Terraform). 
 - Full-stack engineering experience: comfortable building REST/gRPC APIs and a pragmatic front end (React or similar) for dashboards, playgrounds, or admin tools; Python for glue, tooling, and ML integration. 
 - Experience with observability practices and tools (OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, tracing) applied to ML or LLM workloads. 
 - You are obsessive about reliability, debuggability, and ensuring AI systems behave predictably and deterministically when needed. 
 - You code daily, own systems end to end, and are knowledgeable about open-source tools and know how to leverage and extend them. 

What You Bring

- A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - Genuine excitement for AI, LLMs, and the systems that make them efficient and affordable to run at scale. 
 - Strong communication skills and a bias toward measuring, benchmarking, and iterating. 
 - Familiarity with modern data platforms such as Teradata, Snowflake, or Databricks is a plus. 

Bonus Points

- Experience writing or tuning CUDA / Triton (OpenAI) / CUTLASS kernels, or contributing to inference engines. 
 - Experience with on-device or edge ML inference (ONNX, TFLite, llama. cpp, quantized small language models), embedded or mobile deployment. 
 - Knowledge of RAG pipelines, vector databases, embeddings, and agent frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, ReAct-style agents). 
 - Experience with model monitoring, drift detection, evaluation harnesses, and responsible AI practices. 
 - Open-source contributions, technical writing, or public projects in ML systems, Go, or Rust. 
 - Experience with service meshes, RDMA/InfiniBand/NCCL, Slurm, or Ray clusters. 

Why We Think You'll Love Teradata

We prioritize a people-first culture because we know our people are at the very heart of our success. We embrace a flexible work model because we trust our people to make decisions about how, when, and where they work. We focus on well-being because we care about our people and their ability to thrive both personally and professionally. We are an anti-racist company because our dedication to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion is more than a statement. It is a deep commitment to doing the work to foster an equitable environment that celebrates people for all of who they are. 

Teradata invites all identities and backgrounds in the workplace. We work with deliberation and intent to ensure we are cultivating collaboration and inclusivity across our global organization. We are proud to be an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, color, ancestry, religion, creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding, or related conditions), national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, medical condition, genetic information, gender identity or expression, military and veteran status, or any other legally protected status.

Location: Ambawadi, Ahmedabad, Gujarat

Experience: 15-20 Years

Department: R&D - Factory

Employment Type: Full-Time

About Kintech GreenUrja Private Limited

Kintech GreenUrja Private Limited operates in the renewable energy and energy storage sector, 

focusing on Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) and customized energy storage solutions

for residential, commercial, industrial, and utility-scale applications. We are committed to

delivering reliable, safe, high-quality, and sustainable energy solutions. 

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced and results-oriented Senior Manager - Quality to lead

Quality Assurance (QA) and Quality Control (QC) activities for BESS manufacturing at our

facility in Ambawadi, Ahmedabad. 

The ideal candidate will have 15-20 years of experience in quality management, preferably in

BESS, lithium-ion battery systems, battery pack manufacturing, electrical equipment, power

electronics, or electromechanical manufacturing. 

The candidate will be responsible for implementing robust quality management systems, 

ensuring product reliability and safety, managing inspections and testing, resolving quality

issues, and driving continuous improvement across the manufacturing lifecycle of Battery

Energy Storage Systems. 

Key Responsibilities

• BESS Product Quality: Lead quality assurance and quality control for BESS

manufacturing, including battery modules and packs, enclosures, electrical panels, 

wiring, and system integration, as applicable. 

• Quality Management System: Develop, implement, and maintain quality management

systems aligned with ISO 9001 and applicable customer, industry, and regulatory

requirements. 

• Incoming Material Inspection: Ensure quality verification of battery cells, battery

modules, BMS components, PCS/inverters, electrical components, cables, connectors, 

cooling systems, and other critical materials. 

• In-Process Quality Control: Establish inspection checkpoints throughout assembly, 

wiring, electrical integration, and manufacturing processes to ensure compliance with

drawings, specifications, and work instructions. 

• Final Inspection & Testing: Oversee final product inspections and coordinate

functional, electrical, and performance testing in accordance with approved specifications

and applicable standards. 

• Battery Safety & Reliability: Ensure appropriate quality controls for battery handling, 

assembly, electrical insulation, protection systems, thermal management, and other

safety-critical features. 

• BMS & Electrical Integration Quality: Coordinate quality verification of Battery

Management Systems (BMS), protection mechanisms, communication interfaces, and

integration with power conversion and auxiliary systems, as applicable. 

• Supplier Quality Management: Evaluate supplier quality performance, conduct

supplier audits, resolve material non-conformities, and implement corrective actions with

Procurement and Supply Chain teams. 

• Root Cause Analysis & CAPA: Investigate product failures, manufacturing defects, and

recurring quality issues using root cause analysis, 8D, and corrective and preventive

action methodologies. 

• Customer Complaints & Field Issues: Lead investigation and resolution of customer

complaints, product failures, warranty claims, and field quality issues in coordination

with Engineering and Service teams. 

• Quality Documentation & Traceability: Maintain inspection reports, test records, nonconformance reports, product traceability records, control plans, and quality

documentation for manufactured BESS units. 

• Audit Management: Plan and coordinate internal, external, supplier, and customer

audits and ensure timely closure of audit findings. 

• New Product Introduction (NPI): Work closely with R&D and Design Engineering

teams to establish quality plans, validate manufacturing processes, and address designrelated quality risks before production release. 

• Continuous Improvement: Implement quality improvement initiatives using FMEA, 8D

problem-solving, SPC, Six Sigma, and other applicable quality tools. 

• Rejection & Rework Reduction: Monitor defects, rejection rates, first-pass yield, and

rework costs while implementing measures to improve product quality and

manufacturing efficiency. 

• Team Leadership: Lead and develop quality engineers, inspectors, and technicians, 

ensuring effective execution of inspection, testing, and quality improvement activities. 

• Cross-Functional Coordination: Collaborate with Production, R&D, Design

Engineering, Procurement, Stores, and Maintenance teams to resolve quality issues and

improve product reliability. 

• Management Reporting: Report quality KPIs, product reliability trends, audit findings, 

customer complaints, and corrective action status to senior management. 

Required Qualifications & Experience

• Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation, Industrial, or

Production Engineering, or a related technical discipline. 

• A postgraduate qualification or relevant quality-management certification will be an

added advantage. 

• 15-20 years of experience in Quality Assurance and Quality Control, preferably in

battery manufacturing, BESS, electrical equipment, power electronics, or

electromechanical manufacturing. 

• Proven experience managing factory-level quality operations and leading a team of

quality professionals. 

• Strong understanding of incoming material inspection, in-process quality control, final

inspection, and product testing. 

• Hands-on experience with quality management systems, supplier quality, audits, root

cause analysis, CAPA, and non-conformance management. 

• Knowledge of electrical testing, product reliability, manufacturing process validation, and

product traceability. 

• Experience handling customer complaints, supplier quality issues, and manufacturing

defects. 

• Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, decision-making, and leadership

skills. 

Preferred Industry Experience

Candidates with experience in one or more of the following areas will be preferred: 

• Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) manufacturing and system integration. 

• Lithium-ion battery pack, module, or battery system manufacturing. 

• Battery Management Systems (BMS) and battery protection systems. 

• Power Conversion Systems (PCS), inverters, UPS, and power electronics. 

• Electrical panels, switchgear, transformers, and power equipment. 

• Renewable energy equipment and solar power systems. 

• Electromechanical assembly and industrial equipment manufacturing. 

Key Skills

Quality Assurance | Quality Control | BESS Manufacturing | Battery Quality | ISO 9001 |

Electrical Testing | Supplier Quality | Root Cause Analysis | CAPA | 8D Problem Solving | FMEA

| SPC | Product Reliability | Quality Audits | Manufacturing Process Validation | Team Leadership

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

• Reduction in product defects, rejection rates, rework, and warranty claims.

• Compliance with product specifications, approved testing procedures, and applicable

standards. 

• Timely closure of corrective and preventive actions. 

• Improvement in supplier quality and incoming material acceptance.

• Improved product reliability and traceability.

Interested candidates with 15-20 years of relevant experience in BESS, battery manufacturing, 

electrical equipment, or power electronics quality management are invited to apply through

LinkedIn with their updated resume

data.title: Engineering Excellence Manager
data.description:
Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world's manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. With more than 28, 000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Behind our customers - amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility - our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better. 

We welcome all makers, forward thinkers, and problem solvers who are looking for a place to do their best work. And if that's you we would love to have you join us!

Description

Job Description

Engineering Excellence Manager

Industrial Automation and Control

As Engineering Excellence Manager, you will raise the quality, consistency and repeatability of the industrial automation and control solutions we engineer for our customers. You will lead the engineering standards, design practices, trusted content and quality gates that our project teams work to, and you will hold the organisation accountable for applying them across process, discrete and hybrid engagements. Your remit covers engineering governance, design assurance, continuous improvement and technical competency development, so that every project starts from content rather than a blank page. 

You will have the Engineering Standards and Trusted Content, Design Assurance and Quality, Engineering Continuous Improvement, and Technical Competency and Training functions reporting to you. You will build a engineering chain, assuring the development of technical resources, and preparing the structure to support new delivery strategies as our automation and digital transformation portfolio grows. You will be responsible for resource development, with Engineering Domain Expertise Management. 

You will report to the Director of Engineering Delivery and have a hybrid schedule working in Pune, India. 

Your Responsibilities

Under your leadership, the following functions will have the following responsibilities -

Technical Competency and Training

- Lead a team of Technical Leads and Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) across automation domains, providing direction, coaching, performance development, and succession planning to provide a strong and sustainable technical organisation. 
 - Establish clear ownership and accountability for domain expertise, ensuring that SMEs maintain deep technical knowledge aligned with current and latest technologies. 
 - Provide leadership and oversight to the Technical Lead and SME community, ensuring technical decision-making, knowledge sharing, and understanding of engineering practices across projects, industries, and regions. 
 - Be a final escalation point for complex technical challenges and cross-domain engineering decisions that require expert judgement and resolution. 

Engineering Standards and Trusted Content

This department will be responsible for governing the usage of Trusted Content and standard templates in project execution, and will be the focal point for resolving all critical engineering problems. It will define, publish and version-control the engineering standards, design templates and reusable control libraries built on Logix controllers, FactoryTalk software and Rockwell Automation reference architectures, so that engineers across the region design from the same proven baseline. 

Design Assurance and Quality

This department will maintain engineering quality control by using our Global Quality Management System in the design and delivery of our projects and services. It will operate design reviews and quality gates across the full lifecycle, from functional design specification through factory acceptance testing, site acceptance testing and handover, and will confirm that deliverables meet the applicable functional safety, cybersecurity and industry standards including IEC 61511, IEC 62443, ISA-88 and ISA-95. 

Engineering Continuous Improvement

This department will help use Lean, Six Sigma, Agile and other quality methodologies within the engineering community. data.title: Senior QA Test Engineer
data.description:
Eurofins Scientific is an international life sciences company, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic and labelling is accurate. 

The Eurofins network of companies believes that it is a global leader in food, environment, pharmaceutical and cosmetic product testing and in discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and AgroScience contract research services. It is also one of the market leaders in certain testing and laboratory services for genomics, and in the support of clinical studies, as well as in biopharma contract development and manufacturing. It also has a rapidly developing presence in highly specialised and molecular clinical diagnostic testing and in-vitro diagnostic products. 

In over 37 years, Eurofins has grown from one laboratory in Nantes, France to over 65, 000 staff across a decentralised and entrepreneurial network of more than 950 laboratories in over 1, 000 companies across 59 countries. Eurofins companies offer a portfolio of over 200, 000 analytical methods to evaluate the safety, identity, composition, authenticity, origin, traceability and purity of biological substances and products.

Sr. Devops Engineer

About The Team

The DevOps team supports Applied Systems' product development teams and user base across the US, UK, Canada and India. We own the build, source control, release and deployment tooling that engineers rely on every day, and we build and maintain the development and test environments used to deliver our insurance software products. We work closely with development, QA, cloud and infrastructure teams in an Agile way of working, and we are increasingly using AI to automate and improve how we build, deploy and operate our platforms. 

About The Role

As a DevOps Engineer, you deliver great work while expanding your knowledge and deepening your technical skills. The team can rely on you to complete assigned work by drawing on past experience and getting input when needed. Your work is high quality, and you collaborate with the team to deliver what is needed. 

What Success Looks Like

- DevOps platform capabilities (build, source control, deployment, monitoring and test environments) are set up and maintained to meet defined specifications. 
 - Work is completed within expected timelines with limited guidance, and status is communicated to support the team. 
 - Troubleshooting support is delivered and questions are answered using documentation and monitoring tools, with others engaged on high-complexity issues when needed. 
 - Internal teams understand existing DevOps services and how to get support for complex requests or new services. 
 - Reliable delivery contributes to automation, quality and operational consistency. 

What you'll do Development, debugging, quality and security

- Complete a variety of development, testing and debugging tasks. 
 - Build, maintain and support CI/CD pipelines and build infrastructure for product teams, including helping teams migrate pipelines to modern platforms. 
 - Create and manage deployment projects, steps, variables and lifecycles, and maintain deployment manifests for promotion from development to staging and production. 
 - Install, configure, upgrade and troubleshoot development and test environments, including application servers and SQL Server databases. 
 - Configure monitoring and logging for product teams. 
 - Manage existing infrastructure to maintain security and ensure quality by considering functional and non-functional requirements. 

Automation, system administration and continuous improvement

- Identify ways to work more efficiently and share ideas for continuous improvement. 
 - Automate repetitive tasks by writing code or using tools. 
 - Use AI tools and assistants to accelerate automation, such as generating and reviewing scripts and pipeline code, analyzing logs and alerts, and reducing manual operational work. 
 - Identify opportunities to apply AI across build, deployment, monitoring and support workflows, and share what works with the team. 
 - Manage source control repositories, branching and access in line with company best practices. 
 - Perform Root Cause Analysis (RCA), with support from the team, to prevent recurrences. 

Documentation and knowledge

- Contribute to documentation on standard processes and existing DevOps platform capabilities. 
 - Share ideas for improving documentation for the team and other stakeholders. 

Prioritization and communication

- Deliver high-quality work within established timelines by prioritizing and getting support on complex issues or blockers. 
 - Communicate trade-offs and decisions to keep work aligned with standards. 
 - Act as a point of contact for development teams on build, deployment and environment issues, and communicate deployments, outages and status updates. 
 - Take an active part in Agile ceremonies and collaborate with development, operations and infrastructure teams. 

Perform other duties as assigned. Exhibit behaviors that exemplify Applied Systems' Values in Action. 

Required Qualifacations

- 8+ years of experience in DevOps engineering or a related area. 
 - Bachelor's degree in computer science or a related field. 
 - Working knowledge of software engineering principles and practices. 
 - Experience interpreting technical documentation to complete setup, testing and security steps. 
 - Experience writing code to automate repetitive tasks (for example PowerShell, Bash or Python). 
 - Practical experience with monitoring tools, including using them to track application performance. 
 - Working knowledge of Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and related tools or frameworks for public cloud platforms such as Azure or AWS. 
 - Practical experience with debugging and issue resolution. 
 - Experience using AI tools or coding assistants to automate tasks and improve productivity. 

PREFERRED QUALIFIACTIONs

- Hands-on experience with CI/CD and source control tools such as GitLab, TeamCity or Azure DevOps Server. 
 - Experience with Octopus Deploy, ArgoCD or a similar release and deployment tool. 
 - Experience administering Windows Server, IIS and SQL Server in development or test environments. 
 - Experience with Datadog or a similar observability platform. 
 - Experience with Terraform, OpenTofu, Crossplane, containers (Docker, Kubernetes) or GitOps-style deployment workflows. 
 - Experience building AI-driven automation, such as AI agents, LLM-based tooling or AIOps for alerting and incident triage. 
 - Experience working in Agile teams across multiple regions and time zones.

A culture that values who you are and recognizes that you aren't just an employee; you are a teammate, and you matter. We thrive on the benefits of our different experiences and celebrate the uniqueness our teammates bring to work with them every day. 

We flex our time together, collaborating remotely and in-person to empower our teams to work in the ways that work best for them.
