data.description:
Job Description

At EisnerAmper, we look for individuals who welcome new ideas, encourage innovation, and are eager to make an impact. Whether you're starting out in your career or taking your next step as a seasoned professional, the EisnerAmper experience is one-of-a-kind. You can design a career you'll love from top to bottom - we give you the tools you need to succeed and the autonomy to reach your goals. 

We are seeking a Senior Manager to join the Technology practice, in our Hyderabad office. We are seeking someone who thrives in a growing environment and provides clients and internal partners with exceptional service. The Sr. Manager - IT Software Development Testing Lead directs the quality assurance function for custom internal and client-facing applications and custom reporting. This position owns the testing function across the software development life cycle, designs and maintains automated test frameworks, sets standards for unit and integration testing in collaboration with development teams, and leads a team of software test engineers. 

Working within a Microsoft-centered technology stack, the Testing Lead brings a software development background to quality engineering: writing and reviewing testing code, building automated regression testing, integrating tests into Azure DevOps pipelines, and building report testing meeting acceptability thresholds. The role also serves as the quality escalation point for release readiness decisions and reports quality metrics to technology and engagement leadership. 

What It Means To Work For EisnerAmper

- You will get to be part of one of the largest and fastest growing accounting and advisory firms in the industry
 - You will have the flexibility to manage your days in support of our commitment to work/life balance
 - You will join a culture that has received multiple top "Places to Work" awards
 - We believe that great work is accomplished when cultures, ideas and experiences come together to create new solutions
 - We understand that embracing our differences is what unites us as a team and strengthens our foundation
 - Showing up authentically is how we, both as professionals and a Firm, find inspiration to do our best work
 - Numerous Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) to support our Diversity, Equity, & Inclusion (DE&I) efforts
What Work You Will Be Responsible For

Test Strategy and Quality Leadership

- Owns the overall test strategy for assigned applications and engagements, covering unit, integration, system, regression, performance, and user acceptance testing. 
 - Establishes and maintains quality assurance standards, methodologies, entry and exit criteria, and metrics, and drives their adoption across development teams. 
 - Serves as the quality decision point for release readiness, presenting risk assessments and recommendations to technology and engagement leadership. 
 - Estimates testing effort and resources, prioritizes the test backlog, and confirms that testing tasks are delivered on schedule. 
 - Evaluates and recommends testing tools, frameworks, and platform investments, including build-versus-buy analysis and proof-of-concept work. 

Automated Test Development

- Designs, codes, reviews, and maintains automated test frameworks and reusable libraries in C# / . NET for UI, API, database, and end-to-end scenarios. 
 - Builds data-driven and behavior-driven automated suites, including test data management, environment configuration, and reporting. 
 - Integrates automated regression and smoke suites into Azure DevOps pipelines with gated builds, quality gates, and automated result publication. 
 - Monitors automation health - flaky test rates, execution time, and coverage - and refactors suites to keep results trustworthy and fast. 
 - Sets automation targets by release and reports progress against manual-to-automated conversion goals. 

Unit Testing and Shift-Left Quality

- Advises developers on unit test design, test doubles, and mocking strategy, and participates in code review with a focus on testability and coverage. 
 - Defines code coverage thresholds and static analysis rules with development leadership, and monitors adherence through build reporting. 
 - Writes unit and integration tests directly when supporting shared components, remediation work, or teams building new test capability. 
 - Promotes early defect detection through requirements review, design review, and acceptance criteria refinement before development begins. 

Test Case Design and Execution

- Analyzes requirements and design specifications to produce comprehensive test plans, test cases, and test scripts with expected results and traceability to acceptance criteria. 
 - Applies risk-based, boundary, negative, and equivalence-partitioning techniques to focus coverage where defect probability and business impact are highest. 
 - Reviews and approves test cases authored by team members, providing written feedback on coverage gaps, clarity, and reusability. 
 - Directs system, functional, regression, and end-to-end business scenario testing for new applications and enhancements. 
 - Maintains and manages manual test scripts, automated suites, and test databases under version control. 
 - Coordinates user acceptance testing with business stakeholders, including scenario preparation, facilitation, and results documentation. 

Defect Management and Metrics

- Verifies and traces evidence of reproduction for reported faults, and validates fixes along with impact analysis for related functionality. 
 - Manages the defect life cycle through triage, prioritization, assignment, and closure, and escalates aging or high-severity items. 
 - Tracks and reports quality metrics such as defect density, escape rate, open defect counts, coverage, and cycle time, and uses trends to guide process improvement. 
 - Leads root cause analysis on production escapes and translates findings into concrete process or automation changes. 

Collaboration and Communication

- Serves as liaison among analysts, developers, architects, and business domain owners to clarify requirements and produce effective test scripts.

data.title: Application Platform Architect
data.description:
As an Application Platform Architect at Zeta Global, you will be a visionary leader responsible for designing the foundational architecture that supports all of our applications and services. You will focus on building a scalable, reliable, and secure platform that empowers engineering teams to build and deploy applications with speed and efficiency. This role involves defining standards, selecting technologies, and guiding the development of core platform components such as microservices frameworks, APIs, and shared libraries-including those that enable AI agents and agentic workflows. 

Key Responsibilities

- Platform Strategy: Define the technical vision and roadmap for the Zeta application platform, ensuring it meets the long-term needs of the business and engineering teams. 
 - Architectural Design: Design and lead the implementation of core platform services, including reusable microservices, APIs, and shared components that serve all applications. 
 - AI Platform Integration: Architect and build the underlying platform services and APIs that enable the seamless integration of AI agents, large language models (LLMs), and agentic workflows. Design a robust and scalable infrastructure to support these advanced capabilities. 
 - Scalability & Reliability: Ensure the platform's architecture can handle increasing scale and complexity, with a focus on high availability, performance, and fault tolerance. 
 - Developer Enablement: Create tools, frameworks, and best practices that improve the developer experience, accelerate development velocity, and ensure consistency across all applications. 
 - Technology Evaluation: Research, evaluate, and recommend emerging technologies, tools, and architectural patterns to keep the platform at the forefront of innovation. 
 - Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with engineering, DevOps, and security teams to embed security, monitoring, and operational best practices into the platform's design and development lifecycle. 
 - Documentation & Governance: Create and maintain comprehensive documentation, guidelines, and governance standards for the platform's architecture and usage. Required Qualifications

- 10+ years of experience in software engineering, with at least 3-5 years in a lead architect or principal engineer role. 
 - Extensive experience designing and building large-scale, distributed application platforms. 
 - Deep expertise in microservices architecture, RESTful APIs, and event-driven systems. 
 - Proficiency in programming languages such as Java, Scala, or Python. 
 - Strong experience with cloud platforms (AWS preferred) and cloud-native services. 
 - Experience with containerization and orchestration technologies (Docker, Kubernetes). 
 - Experience with DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, and infrastructure as code (Terraform, Ansible). 
 - Excellent communication, presentation, and leadership skills. Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with AI/ML frameworks like LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar, and a proven track record of architecting platforms to support them. 
 - Experience with service meshes (Istio, Linkerd) and API gateways. 
 - Familiarity with identity and access management (IAM) systems. 
 - Experience with security architecture, including threat modeling and secure-by-design principles. 
 - A track record of contributing to open-source projects or speaking at industry conferences.

Zeta Global is a data-powered marketing technology company with a heritage of innovation and industry leadership. Founded in 2007 by entrepreneur David A. Steinberg and John Sculley, former CEO of Apple Inc and Pepsi-Cola, the Company combines the industry's 3rd largest proprietary data set (2. 4B+ identities) with Artificial Intelligence to unlock consumer intent, personalize experiences and help our clients drive business growth.

Pay And Benefits

The Impact You Will Have In This Role

The SDET family is responsible for creating, designing, deploying, and supporting applications, programs, and software solutions. This may include new development, maintenance, automation, enhancement, and modernization of software products used internally and externally across DTCC platforms. 

As an Associate, Software Development Engineer in Test, you will help drive quality engineering practices across strategic initiatives and enterprise delivery streams. In this role, you will contribute to functional and automated testing, support shift-left quality practices, maintain end-to-end traceability, and help validate complex workflows spanning user interfaces, APIs, databases, regulatory reporting flows, file-based ingestion, and cross-system integrations. The role is expected to support secure, compliant, and scalable delivery by partnering closely with Software Engineers, Product Owners, Scrum teams, and partner platforms. This scope includes regulatory and reporting validation, schema and file-format transformations, traceability across testing tools, UI/API/backend coordination, and testing across database, integration, regression, and automation workflows. 

Your Primary Responsibilities

- Apply software development and testing methodologies, tools, and technologies to validate business, functional, and regulatory requirements across multiple enterprise applications and platforms. 
 - Design, execute, and maintain manual and automated tests across the delivery lifecycle, including functional, regression, integration, system, exploratory, and automation-assisted testing. 
 - Maintain traceability from user stories and acceptance criteria through test scenarios, test cases, automation assets, evidence, and defect tracking using tools such as JIRA and ALM/AQM. 
 - Partner with Software Engineers and Product Owners during refinement, story grooming, and scenario walkthroughs to clarify requirements, identify ambiguities early, and improve testability before code completion. 
 - Validate API, UI, and database behavior as required, including support for backend and data-level verification across enterprise systems where project scope requires it. 
 - Perform validation activities such as file ingestion, schema validation, field mapping, field transformation, XML/CSV processing, report verification, ACK/NACK handling, error validation, and simulator-driven testing. 
 - Support regulatory and control-focused testing needs, including validation of transaction/reporting accuracy, reporting timeliness, privacy and data masking, entitlements, auditability, portal access, and downstream impacts to related systems or reporting channels. 
 - Contribute to automation frameworks and continuous testing by integrating automated checks with CI/CD pipelines and supporting smoke, sanity, and regression execution as part of release readiness. 
 - Use enterprise testing and engineering tools effectively, including JIRA, ALM, Bitbucket, Jenkins, Splunk, database-driven validation platforms, simulator tools, and automation frameworks. 
 - Collaborate with internal and cross-functional teams on requirement analysis, UI/API integration, issue triage, dependency management, troubleshooting, and solution validation across shared and distributed teams. 
 - Create and maintain system, test, and execution documentation including test plans, scenario coverage, execution evidence, defect summaries, and test status reporting. 
 - Align risk and control processes into day-to-day responsibilities to monitor and mitigate risk, escalate issues appropriately, and support secure, compliant software delivery. 

Qualifications

- Minimum of 4 years of related experience in software testing, quality engineering, or test automation
 - Bachelor's degree preferred or equivalent experience
 - Experience in functional testing, automation testing, and defect lifecycle management in Agile delivery environments
 - Hands-on experience with test design techniques such as equivalence partitioning, boundary value analysis, decision table testing, pairwise testing, and exploratory testing
 - Experience working with JIRA and ALM for requirements traceability, test management, and issue tracking
 - Experience with one or more programming/scripting languages such as Java or Python
 - Familiarity with API testing and automation tools/frameworks such as Selenium, TestNG, Karate, or Rest Assured
 - Familiarity with Git / Bitbucket and CI/CD tooling such as Jenkins
 - Familiarity with AI Prompt Engineering and AI Agents
 - Experience validating file-based and data-intensive workflows involving XML, CSV, schema validations, field mappings, and database verification is preferred
 - Exposure to financial services, regulatory/reporting processes, onboarding flows, portal-based applications, or data-platform testing is preferred

Talents Needed For Success

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail
 - Ability to understand complex business workflows and translate requirements into effective test coverage
 - Strong collaboration skills and comfort working with Software Engineers, Product Owners, Scrum teams, and partner platforms
 - Effective written and verbal communication skills, including ability to document findings and present testing status clearly
 - Curiosity and ownership mindset with a strong quality-first orientation
 - Ability to balance manual validation with automation opportunities and continuously improve testing efficiency

data.description:
Manager - Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE)

Department: Customer Support / Forward Deployed Engineering

Experience: 6-10 Years

Employment Type: Full-Time

Timing: 6 PM - 03 AM (US Business Hours)

Location: On-site, Gurgaon, Haryana

About Spyne

Spyne is rebuilding the $12B+ automotive software stack from the ground up, giving dealers the AI-powered tools they need to sell more cars, faster. Founded by ex-Amazon, Cox, and OYO operators, Spyne has grown 30x in under three years and now serves 1, 500+ dealerships across the US. 

The company entered the market through Studio AI, a visual merchandising platform powered by 80+ proprietary AI models that transforms raw car photos into studio-quality images, 360-degree spins, and videos in minutes. Deeply integrated with 60+ dealer tools, from DMS and CRM platforms to major automotive marketplaces, Studio AI has become the trusted foundation inside dealer workflows nationwide. 

Now, Spyne is breaking into a much larger opportunity with Vini AI, a conversational Voice AI agent that handles inbound and outbound calls, books test drives, follows up on leads, and manages service appointments 24/7 without human intervention. Vini bookings have grown 7x in six months, and dealers who add Vini on top of Studio see ACV expansions of 4-7x. 

Together, the two products are converging into a full-stack Retail AI platform covering inventory management, digital retail, and customer relationship management. 

Backed by Accel, Vertex Ventures, and Storm Ventures, Spyne is targeting $50M ARR by the end of 2026 and positioning itself to become the category-defining AI platform for the modern dealership. 

The Role

Spyne builds AI for US car dealerships: we get their cars online faster and answer their sales and service calls. Our support team no longer just logs tickets. Our forward deployed engineers fix most dealer issues themselves, in production. 

You lead that team and set how it works. You take the hardest issues yourself, and you decide which recurring problems become product, so they stop coming back. 

What you'll do

- Fix the hardest escalations: dealer system integrations, agent behaviour, data gaps, and the handoffs between sales, service and F&I. Close the loop with the dealer and the CSM. 
 - Run the queue: a car not listed or a lead lost outranks a cosmetic bug. Keep response times, and run P0 and P1 incidents and on-call across India and US hours. 
 - Make fixes safe and fast: rules for access, review and rollback, plus runbooks and AI tooling for triage and diagnosis. 
 - Own the team's product work: every FDE spends 20% of their time on a product initiative. You decide which recurring problems they take on, and coach them from spec to shipped, measured impact. 
 - Build the team: hire 5 to 10 FDEs, review their code, and keep the queue covered as FDEs move into PM roles. 

How we'll judge it

- SLAs met, and time to fix P0 and P1 issues
 - Issues closed without core Engineering
 - Repeat issues eliminated each quarter
 - FDE product initiatives shipped, and FDEs moved into PM roles

You'll do well here if you have

- 6 to 10 years of software engineering, 4+ of them shipping production code, and you still write it. 
 - 2+ years leading engineers, as a manager or tech lead. 
 - Been accountable for customer issues in production: response times, incidents, and being on call when something breaks at night. 
 - Comfort debugging production systems you didn't write, under customer pressure. 
 - Clear written and spoken English. You'll be on calls with US dealers. 

Nice to have

- Experience leading a customer-facing engineering team (FDE, solutions engineering, support engineering). 
 - Exposure to US auto retail, DMS/CRM integrations (CDK, Reynolds, Dealertrack, VinSolutions), or voice and chat agents.

 - Apply strong software engineering practices including modular architecture, testing, version control, code review, and maintainable design. 

Azure Cloud Application Engineering

- Design, build, deploy, and operate enterprise applications on Microsoft Azure. 
 - Work with relevant Azure services such as Azure App Service, Azure Functions, Azure Container Apps/AKS, Azure SQL Database, Azure Database for PostgreSQL, Key Vault, Storage, and API Management.

 - Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation. 
 - Develop containerized applications using Docker and, where appropriate, Kubernetes. 
 - Design applications for availability, scalability, security, observability, and operational support. 
 - Experience building applications on GCP is a plus; AWS experience is also valuable. 

Data & AI Integration

- Integrate applications with enterprise data platforms, databases, APIs, and analytical services. 
 - Collaborate with Data Scientist to productionize machine learning and optimization models. 
 - Build application workflows that allow users to consume predictions, recommendations, simulations, and scenario-analysis results. 
 - Integrate Generative AI and AI services where appropriate to improve user experience and business processes. 
 - Experience working with modern data and AI platforms such as Databricks is a plus. 

Required Qualifications

- 6+ years of professional software engineering or full-stack application development experience with undergraduate degree or 3+ years of experience with master degree. 
 - Strong hands-on experience designing and building enterprise applications on Microsoft Azure. 
 - Strong frontend development experience with React, Angular, TypeScript, or similar modern frameworks. 
 - Strong backend development experience with Python, Java, Node. js, C#, or similar technologies. 
 - Experience designing REST APIs, service-oriented architectures, and application integrations. 
 - Experience building secure applications using authentication and authorization frameworks, preferably Microsoft Entra ID. 
 - Strong understanding of application architecture, scalability, security, reliability, and performance. 
 - Experience with relational databases such as Azure SQL, SQL Server, or PostgreSQL. 
 - Hands-on experience with Docker, CI/CD pipelines, and modern DevOps practices. 
 - Experience designing and deploying cloud-native applications. 
 - Strong communication skills and experience working with technical and business stakeholders. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience developing applications that expose or operationalize data science, machine learning, optimization, forecasting, simulation, or advanced analytics solutions. 
 - Experience integrating applications with Databricks or similar modern data platforms. 
 - Experience with Azure services for AI, data, integration, or application hosting. 
 - Experience with GCP application development. 
 - Familiarity with Generative AI, LLMs, or AI-enabled application architectures. 
 - Experience working closely with Data Scientists and Data Engineers to move analytical prototypes into production. 
 - Experience building internal enterprise applications for decision support, planning, forecasting, or operational analytics.

data.title: Senior Software Engineer
data.description:
Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer

What Makes Us, Us

Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!

At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values - caring, customer success-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered. 

If you like

what we're saying, keep reading!

WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US

Do you want to grow as a Full-Stack Developer by working on complex enterprise-grade solutions in a global fintech company?

At SimCorp, we build products that power investment management and financial institutions worldwide. 

As part of our Collateral Management Product Area (Data and Post-trade Engineering Line, you will contribute to the development of enterprise products within the Collateral and Derivatives domain. You will collaborate with colleagues from Ukraine, Poland, Denmark, Austria, and Germany, while gaining deep expertise in applied finance and modern software engineering practices. 

What You Will Be Responsible For

As a Senior Developer in a self-organized Scrum team, you will: 

- Design, implement, and maintain new features across both front-end and back-end (SOA). 
 - Take technical ownership of feature delivery, ensuring high quality, scalability, and performance. 
 - Drive automation-first approach: design, implement, and maintain E2E, API, Integration tests. 
 - Perform manual exploratory testing for complex scenarios. 
 - Define test strategies at feature/module level. 
 - Collaborate closely with Product Owners, Technical Leads, and teammates during analysis, refinement, and development. 
 - Contribute to architectural discussions and participate in technical decision-making
 - Mentor and support less experienced engineers through pair programming, code reviews, and knowledge sharing. 
 - Drive improvements in automation, CI/CD pipelines, and development tools. 
 - Ensure adherence to engineering best practices (XP, TDD, clean code). 
 - Engage in Sprint Reviews/Demos and continuous process improvements

Your Qualifications

We are looking for an experienced engineer with well-developed technical and collaborative skills

- Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field. 
 - 5+ years of professional experience with C# and Angular. 
 - Extensive experience in designing and developing enterprise applications. in. NET / C# and working knowledge of Angular. 
 - Demonstrated expertise in automation frameworks and CI/CD
 - Solid understanding of manual testing techniques and QA best practices. 
 - Comprehensive understanding of Cloud and On-Prem infrastructures
 - Expertise in CI/CD pipelines and tools (Git, TeamCity, Azure DevOps). [Optional]
 - Extensive experience with Microsoft Azure and building/managing pipelines
 - Readiness to learn APL. [Must Have]
 - Solid understanding of software architecture and design patterns with experience in Domain-Driven Design
 - Familiarity with XP practices (TDD, pair programming, CI). 
 - Experience with relational databases (SQL). 
 - Proficient English communication skills (Upper-Intermediate or higher), written and spoken
 - Ability to mentor, guide, and inspire other developers. 

Benefits

Attractive salary, bonus scheme, and pension are essential for any work agreement. However, in SimCorp we believe we can offer more. Therefore, in addition to the traditional benefit scheme, we provide a good work-life balance: flexible working hours and a hybrid model. Simcorp follows a global hybrid policy, asking employees to work from the office two days each week while allowing remote work on other days. 

Simcorp does offer opportunities for professional development: there is never just only one route - we offer an individual approach to professional development to support the direction you want to take. 

NEXT STEPS

Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible, we process incoming applications continually. Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed. At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photo, age, or any non-professional information from your application. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process. 

For any questions you are welcome to contact Swati Pal(Swati. pal@simcorp. com), Talent Acquisition Partner. If you are interested in being a part of SimCorp but are not sure this role is suitable, submit your CV anyway. SimCorp is on an exciting growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to assist you discover the right role for you. The approximate time to consider your CV is three weeks. 

We are eager to continually improve our talent acquisition process and make everyone's experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process we will ask you to provide your feedback, which is highly appreciated. 

WHO WE ARE?

For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world's leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 3, 000+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, educations, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds. 

SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the recent merger with Axioma, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry-leading, full, front-to-back offering for our clients. 

SimCorp is an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, without regard to race, gender, age, disability, or any other protected status under applicable law. We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated into our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide best-in-class solutions to our clients.

data.title: Foundational Engineer - Infotainment Testing
data.description:
Introduction: A Career at HARMAN Automotive

We're a global, multi-disciplinary team that's putting the innovative power of technology to work and transforming tomorrow. At HARMAN Automotive, we give you the keys to fast-track your career. 

- Engineer audio systems and integrated technology platforms that augment the driving experience
 - Combine ingenuity, in-depth research, and a spirit of collaboration with design and engineering excellence
 - Advance in-vehicle infotainment, safety, efficiency, and enjoyment

About The Role

We are looking for an experienced Infotainment Test Engineer with strong Python programming skills to join our Automotive Software Engineering team. The candidate will be responsible for validating next-generation automotive infotainment systems, designing automated test frameworks, executing functional and integration testing, and ensuring high-quality software delivery for automotive products. 

What You Will Do

- Design, develop, and execute test cases for automotive infotainment systems. 
 - Develop and maintain test automation frameworks using Python. 
 - Perform functional, integration, regression, system, and end-to-end testing. 
 - Validate multimedia, connectivity, navigation, HMI, Bluetooth, Wi-Fi, Android Auto, and Apple CarPlay features. 
 - Analyze software requirements and create comprehensive test plans and test strategies. 
 - Debug issues, perform root cause analysis, and work closely with development teams for resolution. 
 - Execute test campaigns on actual hardware platforms and simulators. 
 - Track, report, and manage defects using defect management tools. 
 - Participate in Agile development processes, sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives. 
 - Generate test reports, quality metrics, and release sign-off documentation. 

What You Need To Be Successful

- 3 to 6 years of experience in Automotive Infotainment Testing. 
 - Strong programming and scripting experience in Python. 
 - Good understanding of test automation frameworks and test methodologies. 
 - Hands-on experience in validating infotainment features such as Media, Connectivity, Navigation, Bluetooth, Android Auto, Apple CarPlay, Voice, and HMI. 
 - Experience with automotive communication protocols such as CAN, LIN, or Ethernet. 
 - Knowledge of Linux and Android-based infotainment platforms. 
 - Experience using test management and defect tracking tools such as JIRA, ALM, or Azure DevOps. 
 - Strong debugging, analytical, and problem-solving skills. 
 - Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. 

Bonus Points If You Have

- Experience with Robot Framework, PyTest, or other Python-based automation frameworks. 
 - Exposure to Automotive SPICE (ASPICE) processes. 
 - Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and automation integration. 
 - Experience with CANoe, CANalyzer, or Vector tools. 
 - Understanding of embedded systems and automotive software architecture. 
 - Exposure to cloud-connected vehicle services and OTA testing. 
 - Knowledge of ISO 26262 and automotive cybersecurity concepts. 

What Makes You Eligible

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Electronics, Electrical Engineering, Instrumentation, or related field. 
 - 3 to 6 years of relevant experience in Automotive Infotainment Testing. 
 - Proven experience in Python-based test automation. 
 - Strong understanding of automotive software quality processes and testing lifecycle. 
 - Ability to work effectively in a cross-functional and global engineering environment. 

What We Offer

- Competitive salary and benefits package
 - Opportunities for professional growth and development
 - Collaborative and dynamic work environment
 - Access to cutting-edge technologies and tools
 - Recognition and rewards for outstanding performance through BeBrilliant
 - Work from Office environment with in-person collaboration, with most office-based roles onsite Five days a week. 

You Belong Here

HARMAN is committed to making every employee feel welcomed, valued, and empowered. No matter what role you play, we encourage you to share your ideas, voice your distinct perspective, and bring your whole self with you - all within a support-minded culture that celebrates what makes each of us unique. We also recognize that learning is a lifelong pursuit and want you to flourish. We proudly offer added opportunities for training, development, and continuing education, further empowering you to live the career you want. 

About HARMAN: Where Innovation Unleashes Next-Level Technology

Ever since the 1920s, we've been amplifying the sense of sound. Today, that legacy endures, with integrated technology platforms that make the world smarter, safer, and more connected. 

Across automotive, lifestyle, and digital transformation solutions, we create innovative technologies that turn ordinary moments into extraordinary experiences. Our renowned automotive and lifestyle solutions can be found everywhere, from the music we play in our cars and homes to venues that feature today's most sought-after performers, while our digital transformation solutions serve humanity by addressing the world's ever-evolving needs and demands. Marketing our award-winning portfolio under 16 iconic brands, such as JBL, Mark Levinson, and Revel, we set ourselves apart by exceeding the highest engineering and design standards for our customers, our partners and each other. 

If you're ready to innovate and do work that makes a lasting impact, join our talent community today!

Important Notice: Recruitment Scams

Please be aware that HARMAN recruiters will always communicate with you from an '@harman. com', '@careers. harman. com' or 'harmanglobal. avature. net' email address. We will never ask for payments, banking, credit card, personal financial information or access to your LinkedIn/email account during the screening, interview, or recruitment process. If you are asked for such information or receive communication from an email address not ending in one of the above email domains about a job with HARMAN, please cease communication immediately and report the incident to us through: harmancareers@harman. com. 

HARMAN is proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. HARMAN strives to hire the best qualified candidates and is committed to building a workforce representative of the diverse marketplaces and communities of our global colleagues and customers. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. HARMAN attracts, hires, and develops employees based on merit, qualifications and job-related performance. (www. harman. com)

At EY, we're all in to shape your future with confidence. 

We'll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. 

Join EY and help to build a better working world. 

Test Lead

The Opportunity

Fuelled by strategic investment in technology and innovation, Client Technology seeks to drive growth opportunities and solve complex business problems for our clients through building a robust platform for business and powerful product engine that are integral to innovation at scale. You will work with technologists and business specialists, blending EY's deep industry knowledge and innovative ideas with our platforms, capabilities, and technical expertise. As a champion for change and growth, you will be at the forefront of integrating emerging technologies from AI to Data Analytics into every corner of what we do at EY. That means more growth for you, exciting learning opportunities, career choices, and the chance to make a real impact. 

Your Key Responsibilities

- Lead the test activities to ensure product quality, setting project timelines and supervising the activities of other testers. 
 - Drive the identification of the test scope and test environment set-up, prepare test plans, identify relevant metrics and keep track of required effort. 
 - Manage the execution of tests, review reports and interpret recommendations for product or design changes. 
 - Define and implement comprehensive test strategies, standards, and risk-based coverage. 
 - Define and implement automation strategies across functional and AI testing domains, ensuring scalability and maintainability. 
 - Evaluate and adopt cutting-edge automation tools and technologies, including AI-assisted test generation and validation

data.description:
The Next Level of Fire & Life Safety Leadership

With more than two centuries of combined history, brands like Kidde, Kidde Commercial, Edwards, GST, Badger, and Aritech have been leading the way in protecting people and property around the world. Now, we're taking that leadership to the next level. Kidde Global Solutions brings together the most trusted and iconic brands in safety, building upon our shared experience and expertise to address the needs and challenges of more customers in more places. With an unmatched portfolio of solutions and services, and a commitment to constant innovation we're elevating the standards for an entire industry - and establishing the next level of fire and life safety leadership. 

At Kidde Global Solutions, you're joining a global technology leader in fire and life safety solutions and our employees are the heart of it all. With industry-defining brands in life safety and security, you'll be part of a legacy of leadership working with cutting-edge technologies that protect lives and property worldwide. As a leading fire safety brand, our mission is to provide solutions that protect people and property from the effects of fire and related hazards. We're committed to expanding our impact and providing dynamic opportunities for growth within our team. You'll be part of a company that prioritizes quality, integrity, collaboration, and customer care, with the resources, training, and incentives to ensure your success every step of the way. 

Kidde Global Solutions is seeking an experienced Digital Portfolio QA Manager to lead quality assurance for mobile, web, cloud, desktop software, API, and connected digital applications. The role will build and guide a strong QA team, strengthen automation and testing practices, adopt practical AI methods in day-to-day QA work, and ensure reliable, secure, and scalable digital experiences across IoT, intrusion, video, and access-control product ecosystems

Role Overview

The Digital Portfolio QA Manager will be responsible for defining and executing the QA approach across web, mobile, API, cloud, desktop software, and connected product platforms. This includes planning test coverage, improving automation, using AI to make testing faster and smarter, managing release readiness, and driving measurable quality outcomes for applications and tools used to configure, commission, monitor, and manage hardware devices. 

Key Responsibilities

Responsibilities

The role is accountable for team leadership, QA planning, automation, AI adoption in testing, and release confidence across mobile, web, API, cloud, desktop software, and connected digital applications. Key responsibilities include: 

- QA strategy and ownership: Define and continuously improve the quality engineering strategy for web, mobile, API, cloud, desktop software, and connected digital application releases in alignment with product, engineering, and business objectives. 
 - Team leadership: Lead, mentor, and develop a team of QA engineers responsible for mobile and web-based digital applications, promoting accountability, engineering discipline, collaboration, and continuous improvement. 
 - AI adoption in QA: Use practical AI methods to improve testing, including AI-assisted test case creation, test data generation, automation support, defect analysis, risk identification, and quality reporting. 
 - Testing and automation methods: Lead manual, automated, regression, integration, API, mobile, web, desktop, and end-to-end testing using scalable frameworks, reusable test assets, CI/CD integration, and clear effectiveness metrics. 
 - Digital application quality: Ensure functional, usability, compatibility, accessibility, performance, security, integration, and regression quality across Android, iOS, responsive web applications, portals, APIs, desktop tools, and cloud-connected workflows. 
 - IoT and security-domain alignment: Apply a fair understanding of IoT application behavior, device-to-cloud interactions, mobile app connectivity, user workflows, and system integrations; experience in intrusion, video, access control, security panels or connected security ecosystems is highly appreciated. 
 - Release governance and metrics: Establish release-readiness criteria, quality dashboards, defect governance, traceability, risk-based testing, and executive-level reporting to provide transparent quality signals and data-driven release recommendations. 
 - Continuous improvement: Improve test productivity, automation value, defect detection, regression cycle time, release predictability, and customer quality through better processes, metrics, and AI-enabled testing improvements. 
 - Cross-functional influence: Partner closely with product management, engineering, architecture, DevOps, customer support, and program teams to align quality priorities, resolve risks, improve product reliability, and deliver customer-ready digital products. 

Education

BE, B. Tech. , ME, or M. Tech. in Electronics, Communication, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related engineering discipline. 

Experience And Technical Qualifications

Minimum 12+ years of experience in software quality engineering, digital application testing, test automation, or QA leadership roles, including substantial experience managing QA teams for product-based mobile, web, API, cloud, desktop software, or connected application platforms. 

- Managerial QA leadership: Proven experience leading QA teams, defining team goals, managing delivery commitments, reviewing quality metrics, coaching engineers, and influencing engineering and product stakeholders in a product development environment. 
 - Mobile, web, and desktop application QA: Strong experience testing Android, iOS, responsive web applications, portals, desktop software used to configure and manage hardware devices, APIs, user workflows, cross-browser behavior, device compatibility, integration flows, and cloud-connected digital services. 
 - AI and automation outcomes: Demonstrated track record of using AI in QA processes to achieve measurable outcomes such as increased automation coverage, faster regression execution, improved defect prediction, reduced manual effort, better test design quality, and stronger release confidence. 
 - Automation and toolchain expertise: Hands-on background with modern automation frameworks and tools such as Selenium, Playwright, Appium, Robot Framework, PyTest, Postman, API automation, JIRA, X-Ray or equivalent test management platforms. 
 - Preferred domain experience: Fair understanding of IoT applications, device connectivity, cloud integrations, mobile-to-device interactions, and connected product behavior; prior exposure to intrusion, video surveillance, access control, security monitoring, or smart building/security domains is highly appreciated. 

Leadership and Managerial Competencies

- People leadership and ownership: Builds and leads high-performing QA teams with clear ownership, accountability, mentoring, performance orientation, and commitment to product quality outcomes. 
 - Strategic execution: Converts product priorities into practical QA plans, balances hands-on technical judgment with managerial decision-making, removes execution barriers, and escalates risks with clarity. 
 - Stakeholder communication: Communicates quality status, automation progress, AI adoption impact, release risks, and improvement plans effectively to engineering leaders, product owners, program teams, and business stakeholders. 
 - Collaboration and delivery: Collaborates effectively across teams and maintains accountability for timely, high-quality delivery. 
 - Continuous learning: Demonstrates curiosity, creativity, and a sustained commitment to continuous learning, engineering excellence, and professional growth. 

The ideal candidate will bring strong managerial maturity, digital QA depth, automation leadership, and a proven ability to convert AI adoption into tangible quality, productivity, and release-readiness outcomes for product-based digital applications. 

World Leaders in Fire and Life Safety

Kidde Global Solutions is a world leader in fire & life safety solutions tailored for complex commercial facilities to homes. Through iconic, industry-defining brands including Kidde, Kidde Commercial, Edwards, GST, Badger, and Aritech, we provide residential and commercial customers with advanced solutions and services to protect people and property in a wide range of applications, all around the globe.

data.title: Advisory Senior Manager - Development & QA Lead
data.description:
Job Description

At EisnerAmper, we look for individuals who welcome new ideas, encourage innovation, and are eager to make an impact. Whether you're starting out in your career or taking your next step as a seasoned professional, the EisnerAmper experience is one-of-a-kind. You can design a career you'll love from top to bottom - we give you the tools you need to succeed and the autonomy to reach your goals. 

We are seeking a Senior Manager to join the Technology practice, in our Hyderabad office. We are seeking someone who thrives in a growing environment and provides clients and internal partners with exceptional service. The Sr. Manager - IT Software Development Testing Lead directs the quality assurance function for custom internal and client-facing applications and custom reporting. This position owns the testing function across the software development life cycle, designs and maintains automated test frameworks, sets standards for unit and integration testing in collaboration with development teams, and leads a team of software test engineers. 

Working within a Microsoft-centered technology stack, the Testing Lead brings a software development background to quality engineering: writing and reviewing testing code, building automated regression testing, integrating tests into Azure DevOps pipelines, and building report testing meeting acceptability thresholds. The role also serves as the quality escalation point for release readiness decisions and reports quality metrics to technology and engagement leadership. 

What it means to work for EisnerAmper: 

- You will get to be part of one of the largest and fastest growing accounting and advisory firms in the industry
 - You will have the flexibility to manage your days in support of our commitment to work/life balance
 - You will join a culture that has received multiple top "Places to Work" awards
 - We believe that great work is accomplished when cultures, ideas and experiences come together to create new solutions
 - We understand that embracing our differences is what unites us as a team and strengthens our foundation
 - Showing up authentically is how we, both as professionals and a Firm, find inspiration to do our best work
 - Numerous Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) to support our Diversity, Equity, & Inclusion (DE&I) efforts
What work you will be responsible for: 

Test Strategy and Quality Leadership

- Owns the overall test strategy for assigned applications and engagements, covering unit, integration, system, regression, performance, and user acceptance testing. 
 - Establishes and maintains quality assurance standards, methodologies, entry and exit criteria, and metrics, and drives their adoption across development teams. 
 - Serves as the quality decision point for release readiness, presenting risk assessments and recommendations to technology and engagement leadership. 
 - Estimates testing effort and resources, prioritizes the test backlog, and confirms that testing tasks are delivered on schedule. 
 - Evaluates and recommends testing tools, frameworks, and platform investments, including build-versus-buy analysis and proof-of-concept work. 

Automated Test Development

- Designs, codes, reviews, and maintains automated test frameworks and reusable libraries in C# / . NET for UI, API, database, and end-to-end scenarios. 
 - Builds data-driven and behavior-driven automated suites, including test data management, environment configuration, and reporting. 
 - Integrates automated regression and smoke suites into Azure DevOps pipelines with gated builds, quality gates, and automated result publication. 
 - Monitors automation health - flaky test rates, execution time, and coverage - and refactors suites to keep results trustworthy and fast. 
 - Sets automation targets by release and reports progress against manual-to-automated conversion goals. 

Unit Testing and Shift-Left Quality

- Advises developers on unit test design, test doubles, and mocking strategy, and participates in code review with a focus on testability and coverage. 
 - Defines code coverage thresholds and static analysis rules with development leadership, and monitors adherence through build reporting. 
 - Writes unit and integration tests directly when supporting shared components, remediation work, or teams building new test capability. 
 - Promotes early defect detection through requirements review, design review, and acceptance criteria refinement before development begins. 

Test Case Design and Execution

- Analyzes requirements and design specifications to produce comprehensive test plans, test cases, and test scripts with expected results and traceability to acceptance criteria. 
 - Applies risk-based, boundary, negative, and equivalence-partitioning techniques to focus coverage where defect probability and business impact are highest. 
 - Reviews and approves test cases authored by team members, providing written feedback on coverage gaps, clarity, and reusability. 
 - Directs system, functional, regression, and end-to-end business scenario testing for new applications and enhancements. 
 - Maintains and manages manual test scripts, automated suites, and test databases under version control. 
 - Coordinates user acceptance testing with business stakeholders, including scenario preparation, facilitation, and results documentation. 

Defect Management and Metrics

- Verifies and traces evidence of reproduction for reported faults, and validates fixes along with impact analysis for related functionality. 
 - Manages the defect life cycle through triage, prioritization, assignment, and closure, and escalates aging or high-severity items. 
 - Tracks and reports quality metrics such as defect density, escape rate, open defect counts, coverage, and cycle time, and uses trends to guide process improvement. 
 - Leads root cause analysis on production escapes and translates findings into concrete process or automation changes. 

Collaboration and Communication

- Serves as liaison among analysts, developers, architects, and business domain owners to clarify requirements and produce effective test scripts. 
 - Keeps development teams, project management, and internal customers informed of testing progress, risks, and significant issues. 
 - Produces well-written internal and external documentation, and conducts workshops or training on areas of knowledge as needed. 
 - Assists and advises internal customers on technical issues, resolving assigned incidents in a timely manner and retaining ownership until closure. 
 - Builds and maintains trusted relationships with a diverse group of clients, team members, managers, and subject matter contacts. 

Team Leadership And Firm Responsibilities

- Leads, coaches, and develops software test engineers, including work assignment, code and test case review, on-the-job training, and performance feedback. 
 - Participates in hiring, onboarding, and skills development planning for the testing team, including automation upskilling. 
 - Works with supervisors to identify and understand engagement scope, manages day-to-day activities of completing work, and assists with oversight of overall quality control of client deliverables. 
 - Monitors workload to meet billable hour expectations and performs timely reviews of work products prior to submission to a supervisor. 
 - Maintains the required CPE for firm and licensing requirements. 
 - Complies with professional and firm requirements (e. g. , employee handbook requirements, time entry procedures). 

Other Duties: 

- Provides courteous and prompt service to all internal and external parties. Prioritizes and addresses requests and assignments in a professional and cooperative manner. 
 - Identifies opportunities and recommends methods to improve service, work processes, and financial performance (e. g. , procedure optimization). Assists in the implementation of quality improvement initiatives. 
 - Assists co-workers in the completion of tasks and assignments to support continuity of service. Actively supports teamwork throughout the organization. 
 - Performs other services as assigned. 

Basic Qualifications: 

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or Information Systems and Decision Sciences is required. Coursework in data structures, algorithms, and software design is expected. 
 - ISTQB Advanced Level (Test Manager or Test Analyst) is preferred. 
 - Microsoft Certified: Azure Developer Associate, Azure DevOps Engineer, or comparable Microsoft credential is preferred. 
 - Certified ScrumMaster (CSM), Professional Scrum Master (PSM), or equivalent agile credential is preferred. 
 - 10+ years of progressive experience in software quality engineering and test automation across the full system development life cycle is required. 
 - 6+ years of experience leading, building, and developing test teams, including work assignment, review, and performance feedback, is required. 
 - 6+ years of hands-on experience designing, coding, and maintaining automated test suites - UI, API, and data layer is required. 
 - 6+ years of software development experience within the Microsoft stack, including C#, . NET / . NET Core, ASP. NET, and SQL Server / T-SQL, is preferred. 
 - Demonstrated experience writing and reviewing unit tests is required. 
 - Demonstrated experience authoring test plans, test cases, and test scripts from requirements and design specifications, including boundary, negative, and risk-based case design with traceability back to acceptance criteria, is required. 
 - Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions, including gated builds and release quality gates, is required. 
 - Experience with agile delivery, system development life cycle governance, and tools such as Azure DevOps (Boards, Repos, Pipelines, Test Plans), JIRA, Confluence, Zephyr, Xray, or TestRail is preferred. 
 - Experience with performance and load testing (JMeter, k6, Azure Load Testing), accessibility testing, or application security testing concepts is preferred. 
 - Experience in professional services, accounting, tax, or another regulated environment - including testing of financial calculations and data migrations - is preferred. 
 - Languages: C#, . NET / . NET Core, T-SQL, PowerShell, and JavaScript or TypeScript. 
 - Microsoft platform: Azure DevOps, Azure (App Service, Functions, SQL), SQL Server, Power BI, Power Platform, Dynamics 365, SharePoint, and Microsoft 365. 
 - Source control and branching strategy in Git, including pull request review and code review participation. 
 - Working knowledge of API design (REST, JSON, XML), relational data modeling, and query optimization sufficient to validate results independently. 
 - Working knowledge of Scrum, Kanban, or other agile methodologies, including estimation and sprint planning. 
 - Depth of knowledge in quality assurance and quality control processes, defect life cycle management, and release governance. 
 - Ability to translate technical quality data into clear recommendations for non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Ability to work in a dynamic, fast-paced, and continuously changing environment while holding the team to consistent standards. 
 - Strong project management skills with the ability to manage multiple projects and tasks with attention to detail and accuracy. 
 - Strong interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate professionally and appropriately with a diverse group of individuals. 
 - Demonstrates a positive attitude, proactive nature, and a high degree of professionalism, and maintains the highest level of confidentiality. 
 - Ability to work independently and within a team, and to coach others toward the same standard. 
 - Computer literacy at an intermediate or advanced level with the Microsoft Office suite of products (specifically Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and SharePoint). 

We strongly believe in a supportive work environment where all our colleagues can succeed. EisnerAmper India is proud to be an Equal Opportunity merit-based employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of caste & religion, disabilities, gender, sexual orientation, age or marital status.

The EisnerAmper Technology Testing team owns quality assurance for custom internal and client-facing applications and custom reporting. Working within a Microsoft-centered technology stack, the team designs and maintains automated test frameworks, sets standards for unit and integration testing alongside development teams, and provides release readiness recommendations and quality metrics to technology and engagement leadership. 

By instilling a culture of collaboration, teamwork, and trust across the department, we're committed to building our people into tomorrow's industry leaders. At all levels, employees are encouraged to take on new responsibilities and challenges in order to grow both as individuals and a team. 

Our core values of trust, integrity and accountability allow us to act as strategic innovators. Because when we build trust with each other, we can bring new ideas to the table and execute them without fear of failure. 

About EisnerAmper: 

EisnerAmper is one of the largest accounting, tax, and business advisory firms, with nearly 5, 000 employees including 450 partners across the world. We combine responsiveness with a long-range perspective; to help clients meet the pressing issues they face today and position them for success tomorrow. 

Our clients are enterprises as diverse as sophisticated financial institutions and start-ups, global public firms, and middle-market companies, as well as high net worth individuals, family offices, not-for-profit organizations, and entrepreneurial ventures across a variety of industries. The opportunity

We are seeking an experienced AI QA Engineer with 5-9+ years of professional experience and deep expertise in AI testing, quality engineering, validation frameworks, and enterprise AI solution assurance. The ideal candidate should possess strong hands-on experience validating AI systems, Agentic AI workflows, RAG applications, conversational AI solutions, and enterprise-scale AI platforms.

Important note: This role requires professional implementation experience in relevant AI technologies. Personal portfolio projects, cloned demos, certifications, or tutorial-based builds are helpful, but are not sufficient on their own. 

Application guidance: Candidates should be able to clearly explain at least two relevant AI implementations, including the business use case, their direct contribution, the technical approach, and the outcome delivered. 

Your Key Responsibilities

- Design, develop, and execute comprehensive testing strategies for AI, GenAI, Agentic AI, and Agentic RAG systems. 
 - Validate Large Language Model outputs for accuracy, consistency, relevance, safety, and compliance requirements. 
 - Develop test frameworks and automation suites for AI services, copilots, AI assistants, and enterprise AI applications.

 - Validate prompt engineering approaches, agent workflows, tool usage patterns, and reasoning capabilities in Agentic AI systems. 
 - Execute AI model testing across conversational AI, multimodal AI, and intelligent automation solutions.

 - Experience testing AI integrations across APIs, enterprise applications, databases, and cloud services.

 - Experience working with Microsoft Azure AI Platform and Azure AI services. 
 - Hands-on experience developing automated test frameworks and validation utilities using Python. 
 - Familiarity with FastAPI-based services and API testing frameworks. 
 - Experience designing and executing automated API testing strategies.

Soft Skills

Other Responsibilities:

Why Join Us

data.title: Staff/Principal Robotics Validation Engineer
data.description:
ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD. 

At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world's most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future. 

Whether you're designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger - technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we'll advance your career. 

Staff/Principal Robotics Validation Engineer

Join AMD's PAVS team as a Robotics Developer experience Usecases Validation Engineer where you will Validate and Execute diverse Robotics platforms, variants and customer usecases for advanced robotics systems across software, hardware, and integrated platforms. Your work will ensure safety, reliability, and performance through rigorous testing in simulation, Gazebo, Isaac sim, SIL/HIL environments, and real-world deployments. 

Key Responsibilities

- Validation Strategy & Usecases : Define Usecases and execute validation plans for robotics software stacks (perception, planning, control) and hardware subsystems. 
 - Validate AI frameworks and runtimes (PyTorch, TensorFlow, ONNX Runtime)
 - Execute and optimize workloads on ROCm/HIP, CUDA, OpenCL, and heterogeneous accelerators
 - Automation & Frameworks: Develop automated test suites for ROS2 nodes, navigation stack (Nav2), and fleet APIs using Python/C++, pytest, gtest/gmock. 
 - Simulation & Scenario Testing: Build simulation environments (Gazebo/Ignition, Isaac Sim) for warehouse layouts; author scenarios for obstacle avoidance, dynamic traffic, and multi-robot coordination. 
 - SIL/HIL Validation: Set up Software-in-the-Loop and Hardware-in-the-Loop rigs for AMR controllers, LiDAR emulators, and safety sensors; automate provisioning and logging.

data.title: Senior Network Automation & Agentic AI Developer
data.description:
Experience: 10+years

Work Mode: Hybrid/ 24/7 shift

Work Location: Hyderabad, Bangalore, Chennai, Noida, Pune, Kochi

Role Overview

We are seeking a visionary and hands-on Senior Network Automation & Agentic AI Developer to pioneer the next generation of intent-based, self-healing network infrastructures. In this role, you will bridge the gap between traditional enterprise networking and cutting-edge Artificial Intelligence. You will not just write scripts; you will architect autonomous AI Agents capable of diagnosing infrastructure faults, correlating real-time telemetry, and safely executing deterministic changes across a global multi-vendor environment. 

Key Responsibilities

- Advanced Ansible Engineering: Architect scalable, production-grade network configuration playbooks, custom roles, and execution environments using Ansible Automation Platform / AWX. Develop custom Python plugins/modules to extend Ansible functionality where native vendor support is limited. 
 - Multi-Vendor API Integration: Write highly concurrent Python middleware to interface natively with the REST APIs and SDKs of our core infrastructure stack (Cisco Nexus/ACI, Meraki Dashboard, Versa Director, and Zscaler). 
 - AI Agent Orchestration: Design, develop, and deploy autonomous multi-agent workflows using Generative AI frameworks (e. g. , LangGraph, CrewAI, LangChain) to automate complex network troubleshooting, validation, and root-cause analysis (RCA). 
 - Model Context Protocol (MCP): Build and maintain custom MCP clients and servers to securely expose internal networking tools, documentation (RAG), and script suites as executable "tools" for LLMs. 
 - Event-Driven Remediation: Build closed-loop automation systems using Event-Driven Ansible (EDA) or asynchronous message queues (Celery/Redis/Kafka) to ingest real-time syslogs and trigger proactive self-healing workflows. 
 - Guardrails & Safety Architecture: Implement strict software boundaries and input validation schemas (e. g. , Pydantic) ensuring LLM-generated variables are deterministically parsed, with mandatory Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) approval gates before configuration changes impact production. Required Technical Skill Set

- Automation & Programming: Advanced Ansible AAP, Python (Object-Oriented, Asyncio, FastAPI), robust try/except exception handling, Ansible Core, AWX/Tower, and Jinja2 templating. 
 - AI & GenAI Ecosystems: Deep practical experience with LangGraph, LangChain, or CrewAI; strict JSON/Function Calling; Model Context Protocol (MCP); Semantic Routing; and vector databases (Milvus, Chroma) for network RAG pipelines. 
 - Enterprise Networking & Security: Solid understanding of L2/L3 routing (BGP, OSPF, VXLAN EVPN), SD-WAN architectures, and Secure Service Edge (SSE) frameworks. 
 - Target Vendor Stack (Highly Desirable): Hands-on API experience with Cisco IOS-XE/NX-OS, Meraki SDK, Versa Analytics, and pyZscaler. 
 - DevOps & Observability: Git/GitOps workflows, CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions/GitLab CI), and log streaming architectures (ELK Stack, Kafka, or Splunk). Experience & Qualifications

- Total Experience: 10+ years in Enterprise Network Engineering, DevOps, or Systems Automation. 
 - Automation Focus: 3+ years of dedicated experience building infrastructure automation or developer toolchains. 
 - AI Exposure: 1+ years of hands-on application development involving LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, or local Ollama engines). 
 - Certifications (a plus): Cisco/Red Hat/Ansible

data.title: Director of Engineering, Data Platforms
data.description:
About The Role

Grade Level (for internal use): 

13

We are seeking a strong technical and people leader to join as Director of Engineering, Data Platforms for our offshore team in India. In this role, you will partner closely with the core Databricks team to support the transition of existing data pipelines to the target platform, while continuing to refine, enhance, and operationalize those pipelines for scale, quality, reliability, and secure cloud-native delivery on AWS. AWS data engineering practices commonly emphasize automated and orchestrated data flows, metadata-driven pipelines, and alignment to platform guardrails and security controls. 

This leader will manage a small, focused engineering team responsible for supporting offshore platform adoption and enabling asset-agnostic data onboarding into the enterprise data platform. The role is execution-oriented and collaborative in nature, with accountability for high-quality delivery, engineering rigor, and consistent partnership with global stakeholders. 

You will also support integrations with the enterprise data mastering platform to help ensure trusted, standardized, and reusable data flows across the ecosystem. Experience with NeoXam DataHub is a strong plus, particularly in environments where master, market, reference, risk, and investment data are managed across the full lifecycle-from acquisition through distribution-to create a trusted single source of truth. 

This role is ideal for someone who combines hands-on data platform depth with practical team leadership, strong cross-geography collaboration, and experience establishing repeatable cloud data engineering patterns across modern lakehouse and mastering ecosystems. 

Key Responsibilities

Data Pipeline Transition and Platform Delivery

- Partner with the core Databricks team to plan and execute the transition of existing data pipelines to the target data platform. 
 - Lead the offshore team in enhancing, stabilizing, and optimizing pipelines after transition, with a focus on performance, scalability, maintainability, operational excellence, and secure AWS deployment patterns. 
 - Drive implementation of repeatable engineering patterns for ingestion, transformation, testing, deployment, and monitoring across onboarded datasets. 
 - Ensure pipelines are built and managed in a way that supports long-term platform consistency, reliability, observability, and ease of support. 
 - Guide the design and operation of cloud-native data pipelines leveraging relevant AWS services such as Amazon S3 for durable storage, AWS Glue for integration and catalog-driven processing, and AWS Lake Formation for governed data lake controls. AWS training and prescriptive guidance for data engineering emphasize building, optimizing, and securing solutions with these services. 
 - Promote the use of AWS IAM, encryption, and environment-level controls to enforce secure access to platform resources and data products in line with enterprise governance expectations. AWS guidance highlights alignment with architectural guardrails and security controls for data engineering platforms. 

Data Onboarding and Asset-Agnostic Enablement

- Lead a small team responsible for supporting offshore teams with onboarding data to the enterprise platform in an asset-agnostic manner. 
 - Define and operationalize onboarding patterns that can support a broad range of data assets, domains, and source systems without requiring bespoke platform redesign for each use case. 
 - Work with partner teams to simplify and standardize how data is ingested, transformed, governed, and published to the platform. 
 - Help offshore teams adopt common onboarding frameworks, technical standards, and delivery practices that improve speed and reduce friction. 
 - Establish reusable ingestion and processing patterns across batch and streaming use cases using technologies such as AWS Glue, AWS Lambda, Amazon Kinesis, or event-driven integrations where appropriate to support scalable enterprise onboarding. AWS data engineering curricula and roadmap materials consistently position these services as core building blocks for modern cloud data engineering. 

Data Mastering Platform Integration

- Support integration of platform pipelines and datasets with the enterprise data mastering platform. 
 - Collaborate with upstream and downstream stakeholders to ensure mastered data can be consumed reliably through standardized interfaces and governed data flows. 
 - Help establish data quality controls, reconciliation processes, metadata alignment, and stewardship workflows needed to support trusted mastered data in the platform. 
 - Contribute to issue resolution and continuous improvement related to mastering-related ingestion and distribution workflows. 
 - Support data mastering capabilities aligned with platforms such as NeoXam DataHub, including data acquisition, cleansing, enrichment, mastering, and downstream distribution of trusted data products. NeoXam positions DataHub as a configurable enterprise data management platform for the financial industry that manages the full lifecycle of master, market, risk, and investment data. 
 - Work with business and platform stakeholders to support golden record / golden copy generation and maintenance for key financial datasets, including reference data, instruments, business entities, and related mastered domains. NeoXam DataHub is specifically positioned to provide a single source of truth and has been used in financial services environments for enterprise-level golden copy data management. 

Team Leadership and Delivery Management

- Lead, mentor, and develop a small team of data engineers supporting offshore onboarding and pipeline engineering. 
 - Set clear priorities, manage team execution, and ensure delivery commitments are met with quality and accountability. 
 - Provide day-to-day coaching, technical guidance, and performance feedback to team members. 
 - Foster a strong engineering culture centered on collaboration, continuous improvement, documentation, operational discipline, and measurable service ownership. 
 - Drive engineering rigor across sprint delivery, production readiness, support models, and incident management for business-critical data platforms. 

Collaboration, Governance, and Engineering Standards

- Partner effectively with global platform, architecture, governance, and Databricks-aligned teams to ensure offshore delivery aligns with enterprise standards. 
 - Contribute to design reviews, implementation planning, and technical discussions related to pipeline architecture, onboarding patterns, cloud platform controls, and mastering integrations. 
 - Support governance requirements through appropriate controls around lineage, schema consistency, data quality, retention, and secure access. 
 - Promote adoption of engineering best practices including automated testing, CI/CD, observability, incident response, and production support readiness. 
 - Help establish cloud engineering standards for infrastructure as code, release automation, and environment promotion using tools and services such as AWS CodePipeline, AWS CodeBuild, and infrastructure automation frameworks where appropriate. 
 - Ensure monitoring and operational health practices are in place using logging, alerting, and telemetry patterns appropriate for enterprise data platforms, including AWS-native operational tooling where relevant. 

Required Qualifications

Leadership and Delivery Experience

- 10+ years of experience in data engineering, data platforms, or related engineering domains. 
 - 5+ years of experience leading engineering teams, preferably in a distributed or offshore delivery model. 
 - Proven ability to lead a small, high-performing technical team in an execution-focused environment. 
 - Experience partnering with global or onshore stakeholders to deliver platform and pipeline initiatives across time zones. 

Technical Expertise

- Strong hands-on experience with modern data engineering and pipeline development, including batch and/or streaming data workflows. 
 - Experience working with Databricks-based data platforms and supporting migration or transition of pipelines into a lakehouse-oriented architecture. 
 - Strong familiarity with AWS cloud-native data engineering, including services such as Amazon S3, AWS Glue, AWS Lambda, AWS Lake Formation, and related orchestration, security, and monitoring capabilities used to build scalable and governed data platforms. AWS training materials for data engineering specifically emphasize designing, building, optimizing, and securing data solutions using AWS services. 
 - Working knowledge of technologies and concepts referenced in the source profile, such as Delta Lake, Apache Iceberg, and Databricks Unity Catalog, with the ability to apply them in practical engineering delivery contexts. 
 - Experience supporting data integration patterns involving mastering, MDM, or trusted data distribution workflows. 
 - Solid understanding of data quality, schema management, lineage, metadata, access control, and operational support for production data pipelines.
