data.title: Principal Network Automation Engineer
data.description:
Business Introduction

GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems. 

Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines. 

Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges. 

Job Purpose

We're looking for a Network Automation AI Engineer to design, build, and operate AI agents that automate network operations, ITSM, and lifecycle management across a large enterprise network estate. You'll combine traditional network automation (Cisco, Itential, ServiceNow) with modern agentic AI (LLM orchestration, MCP tool integration, RAG) to build production-grade, safety-gated automation. 

Responsibilities

- Design and build AI agents (using frameworks like Google ADK, LangChain, or similar) that interact with network infrastructure via Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers or custom tool integrations
 - Write and iterate on system prompts/instructions that ground LLM behavior in real tool schemas, enforce anti-hallucination discipline, and avoid unsafe automation
 - Integrate agents with ITSM platforms (ServiceNow) for incident, change, and CMDB data, and with network orchestration platforms (Itential) for workflow execution
 - Build human-in-the-loop approval workflows for any agent capability that can modify production network state (e. g. , plan → approve/reject → apply patterns), with strict identity/authorization guardrails
 - Develop and maintain backend services (Python, FastAPI) exposing agents via REST/A2A/JSON-RPC protocols
 - Containerize and deploy agents (Docker, Cloud Run, CI/CD via GitHub Actions) with per-agent configuration, environment isolation, and secrets management
 - Instrument agents with observability (OpenTelemetry, structured logging, Cloud Logging) for tool I/O, session traces, and audit trails
 - Collaborate with network engineering teams to translate operational runbooks (EOL/EOS tracking, device lifecycle, LAN/WAN/wireless health checks, config change validation) into agent capabilities
 - Own RBAC/token propagation and security review for agent-to-tool and agent-to-user authentication
 - Test agents against live/staging MCP servers, validate tool schemas, and iterate on prompt engineering based on real session traces
 - Document architecture decisions, known gotchas, and operational runbooks for the agent fleet

Required Qualifications

- Overall 10 Years and strong Python skills; experience building async services (FastAPI, asyncio)
 - Hands-on experience with LLM application development: prompt engineering, tool/function calling, RAG, multi-turn session/state management
 - Familiarity with agent frameworks (Google ADK, LangChain, LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, or similar) and agent-to-agent/tool protocols (MCP, A2A)
 - Networking fundamentals: Cisco IOS/IOS-XE, LAN/WAN/wireless architecture, routing, switching, firewalls
 - Experience with ITSM tooling (ServiceNow) and network orchestration platforms (Itential, NSO, or similar)
 - Docker containerization and CI/CD pipeline experience (GitHub Actions or equivalent)
 - Cloud platform experience (GCP preferred: Vertex AI, Cloud Run, BigQuery, Secret Manager)
 - Strong understanding of security practices for automation that can modify production infrastructure (least privilege, approval gating, audit logging)

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with LiteLLM or multi-provider LLM routing/fallback strategies
 - Familiarity with Itential Automation Platform / Operations Manager workflows
 - Experience with vector search / RAG pipelines (Vertex AI Search, embeddings, citation grounding)
 - Background in network automation scripting (Netmiko, NAPALM, Genie/pyATS, Ansible)
 - Experience designing safety guardrails for write-capable AI agents (change management, approval workflows)
 - Exposure to OpenTelemetry/observability tooling and FinOps/cost tracking for LLM usage

#AGTech

Skills

Agent Development Lifecycle (ADLC), AI Integration, Automation Technology, Cloud Based Services, Computer Programming, Configuration Management (CM), Engineering Technology, IP Address Management (IPAM), IT Networking, Load Balancers, Network Design, Operational Technology (OT), Orchestrate, Packet Switching, Routing and Switching, Security Engineering, Software-Defined Networking Wide Area Network (SD-WAN), System Monitors, Wireless System Design, Zero Trust Architecture

Why GSK?

Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. 

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2. 5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases - to impact health at scale. 

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we're committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people. 

Inclusion at GSK: 

As an employer committed to Inclusion, we encourage you to reach out if you need any adjustments during the recruitment process. 

Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN. recruitment-adjustments@gsk. com to discuss your needs. 

Important notice to Employment businesses/ Agencies

GSK does not accept referrals from employment businesses and/or employment agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact GSK's commercial and general procurement/human resources department to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to GSK. The obtaining of prior written authorization is a condition precedent to any agreement (verbal or written) between the employment business/ agency and GSK. In the absence of such written authorization being obtained any actions undertaken by the employment business/agency shall be deemed to have been performed without the consent or contractual agreement of GSK. GSK shall therefore not be liable for any fees arising from such actions or any fees arising from any referrals by employment businesses/agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. 

It has come to our attention that the names of GlaxoSmithKline or GSK or our group companies are being used in connection with bogus job advertisements or through unsolicited emails asking candidates to make some payments for recruitment opportunities and interview. Please be advised that such advertisements and emails are not connected with the GlaxoSmithKline group in any way. 

GlaxoSmithKline does not charge any fee whatsoever for recruitment process. Please do not make payments to any individuals / entities in connection with recruitment with any GlaxoSmithKline (or GSK) group company at any worldwide location. Even if they claim that the money is refundable. 

If you come across unsolicited email from email addresses not ending in gsk. com or job advertisements which state that you should contact an email address that does not end in "gsk. com", you should disregard the same and inform us by emailing askus@gsk. com, so that we can confirm to you if the job is genuine.

Description

What Success Looks Like

- Test failures are investigated quickly and accurately. 
 - AI is used to accelerate triage without replacing engineering judgment. 
 - Defects contain enough evidence for developers to reproduce and fix them. 
 - Product defects are clearly separated from automation and infrastructure issues. 
 - Recurring and flaky failures are identified and reduced. 
 - Practical AI-assisted workflows are created when they provide measurable value. 
 - Fixes are verified thoroughly before closure. 
 - Testing risks are communicated clearly before releases. 
 - The quality and reliability of automated test results continuously improve. 

Requirements

About the Role

We are looking for an Automation Triage Engineer to investigate automated test failures, identify root causes, and work with development and test teams to drive issues toward resolution. 

The role combines test execution, failure analysis, defect investigation, and AI-assisted troubleshooting. The ideal candidate can distinguish between product defects, test issues, infrastructure problems, and environmental failures, while using modern AI tools to accelerate analysis and create practical workflows when needed. 

Experience : 2-4 years of experience in software testing, test automation, or quality engineering. 

Job responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

- Execute automated test suites across platforms, configurations, and environments. 
 - Monitor test results and identify failures, regressions, and recurring issues. 
 - Analyze logs, error messages, screenshots, videos, traces, and other diagnostic information. 
 - Use AI-assisted techniques to summarize failures, identify patterns, compare logs, suggest root causes, and accelerate triage. 
 - Use tools such as Claude, GPT, or comparable AI assistants responsibly to support investigation and technical decision-making. 
 - Validate AI-generated analysis against test evidence rather than treating it as definitive. 
 - Classify failures as product, automation, infrastructure, configuration, network, or environment-related. 
 - Reproduce failures and isolate the conditions under which they occur. 
 - Investigate intermittent and non-deterministic test failures. 
 - Create clear and detailed defect reports with reproduction steps, evidence, logs, and impact information. 
 - Review existing defects to identify duplicates, related failures, and recurring patterns. 
 - Work closely with software developers, test automation engineers, and QA teams to resolve issues. 
 - Verify fixes by rerunning relevant tests and confirming expected results. 
 - Identify unstable or low-value automated tests and recommend corrective actions. 
 - Develop lightweight scripts, checklists, prompts, or workflow improvements when required to make triage more efficient. 
 - Create practical AI-assisted workflows based on the needs of the team and the type of failure being investigated. 
 - Maintain accurate investigation notes, failure records, and resolution status. 
 - Participate in release-readiness reviews and communicate testing risks clearly. 
 - Contribute to test strategy, failure-analysis guidelines, and team best practices.

 - Ability to analyze logs and technical diagnostic data. 
 - Experience creating clear, reproducible defect reports.

data.title: Senior Principal - Principal RE, Cloud & Hosting
data.description:
Business Introduction

GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems. 

Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines. 

Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges. 

Job Purpose

The Site Reliability Engineer improves the reliability, resilience and observability of GSK's platforms as a hands-on engineer, reducing toil, preventing incidents and meeting agreed reliability targets. The role defines and monitors SLOs, instruments platforms for observability, leads incident response through to permanent prevention, and applies AI and automation for anomaly detection, predictive alerting and self-healing. It also coaches platform engineering teams in reliability practice and error-budget discipline. 

The role sits in Reliability Engineering & Operations and is deployed into a platform domain while drawing on the central capability, so it holds the central reliability standard inside a team it does not report to. Platform build and engineering direction sit with the Principal Engineers and the Engineering Director, the major incident process sits with the Major Incident Manager, and the reliability standard itself is set by the Reliability Engineering Senior Director. Reliability targets are held jointly with the Platform Manager rather than imposed on them. 

ROLE SCALE AND COMPLEXITY

This is a senior enterprise reliability leadership role operating across globally distributed, business-critical cloud and hosting services. The post holder is accountable for setting technical direction, resolving systemic and ambiguous reliability risks, and influencing prioritisation across multiple platform teams, suppliers and geographies without relying on direct line authority. 

The role manages a portfolio of interdependent services with material operational, regulatory, cyber, resilience and financial consequences. It shapes investment and supplier decisions and may influence or govern an annual technology and service portfolio of up to approximately GBP 23 million, where applicable to the assigned scope. 

MARKET SCOPE

Global scope, supporting business operations across regions, countries and markets in which GSK operates. The role establishes consistent reliability outcomes across regional delivery teams while accommodating local regulatory, data-residency, business-continuity and market-criticality requirements. 

Key Responsibilities

- Define and monitor SLOs for the platforms served, and instrument those platforms for observability so reliability is measured rather than assumed. 
 - Apply AI and automation for anomaly detection, predictive alerting and self-healing, so that recurring conditions are handled without human intervention. 
 - Lead incident response for the platforms served, and drive root-cause resolution through to permanent prevention rather than closing on restoration. 
 - Improve resilience through capacity, failover and recovery engineering, and test recovery rather than documenting it. 
 - Reduce operational toil through automation and reusable tooling, working the identified manual task and toil candidates and evidencing the effort removed. 
 - Close observability coverage gaps for the platforms served, prioritising by the reliability risk each gap leaves unmeasured. 
 - Coach platform engineering teams in reliability practice and error-budget discipline, so reliability is built in rather than inspected in. 
 - Track reliability metrics against SLOs and team OKRs, and act on the trend rather than only reporting it. 
 - Support reliability oversight of supplier-run services, holding partner-operated components to the same SLOs as internal ones. 
 - Hold the central reliability standard while deployed in a platform domain, escalating to the Reliability Engineering Senior Director where local pressure would erode it. 
 - Feed reliability evidence into the platform backlog held by the Product Owner, so that resilience work competes on stated risk rather than on goodwill. 
 - Hold the boundaries with the Principal Engineers on platform build, the Major Incident Manager on the major incident process, and the Platform Manager on the reliability targets the platform commits to. 
 - Set the multi-year reliability strategy and engineering roadmap for the assigned cloud and hosting portfolio, translating enterprise risk and business priorities into funded reliability outcomes. 
 - Own cross-platform reliability governance, including service tiering, SLO policy, error-budget decisions, resilience exceptions and common engineering standards across internal and supplier-operated services. 
 - Lead resolution of complex, high-impact and systemic failure modes spanning cloud, hosting, network, security, applications and third-party dependencies, with authority to convene senior technical and service leaders. 
 - Provide evidence-based recommendations for investment, risk acceptance and supplier performance decisions, including prioritisation across a material service portfolio and, where delegated, spend of up to approximately GBP 25 million. 
 - Represent Reliability Engineering in Director, Senior Director and VP-level governance, communicating service risk, business impact, trade-offs and required decisions in clear executive terms. 
 - Mentor Principal and Senior Engineers, build communities of practice and raise engineering capability across regions rather than delivering only through individual contribution. 

Education & Professional Qualifications

- Degree in a technology or engineering discipline, or equivalent practical experience (e. g. , Computer Science, Software Engineering). 
 - Reliability or platform certifications desirable (e. g. , a recognised cloud certification, Certified Kubernetes Administrator, or ITIL 4 for incident and problem practice). 

Area of Specialisation

- Site reliability engineering, covering SLOs, observability instrumentation, error budgets and toil reduction. 
 - AIOps and operations automation, covering anomaly detection, predictive alerting and self-healing. 

Why is this level of Education Required?

- An engineering grounding is needed because the role writes the automation and instrumentation itself and must be credible to platform engineers whose systems it is changing. 

Job-Related Experience

- Overall 15 Years and typically 10-12+ years in infrastructure, cloud, platform or reliability engineering, including significant experience leading enterprise-scale reliability outcomes across multiple teams or service domains. 
 - 5+ years of hands-on SRE, Reliability Engineering, or Cloud Operations experience. 
 - Experience supporting large-scale production cloud and hosting environments. 
 - Experience owning operational reliability for critical business services. 
 - Proven record of improving service availability, resiliency, and operational efficiency. 
 - Demonstrated accountability for globally distributed, 24x7, business-critical services and for decisions with material operational, regulatory, customer or financial impact. 
 - Proven ability to influence Directors, Senior Directors and VP-level stakeholders, including presenting options, quantified risk, trade-offs and investment recommendations. 
 - Experience governing strategic suppliers and complex service ecosystems, with exposure to substantial technology budgets or portfolios; direct budget ownership is desirable but not mandatory where strong investment influence is evidenced. 
 - Track record of setting technical direction, leading through ambiguity and developing senior engineering capability across organisational and geographic boundaries. 

Requirements

Technical Requirements

- Strong experience with: Azure and/or GCP, Linux and Windows Server platforms, Containers and Kubernetes, Cloud networking fundamentals, Infrastructure as Code , Cloud observability platforms
 - Hands-on proficiency in: Terraform, Ansible, Python , CI/CD pipelines, Monitoring and telemetry solutions. 

Reliability & Operations

- Experience defining and operating: SLIs , SLOs, Error Budgets, Operational KPIs
 - Experience leading: Major incident response, post-incident reviews, Root-cause analysis , Capacity management, Resiliency and recovery testing. 

Operational Excellence

- Demonstrated experience in: Runbook development, Operational readiness reviews, Service transitions, Continuous service improvement, Automation-led toil reduction

Skills/Background

- Comfort operating inside a team that is not the reporting line, holding a central standard without formal authority. 
 - Composure in live incidents, including deciding when to stop investigating and restore. 
 - Discipline to pursue root cause after service is restored and attention has moved on. 
 - Ability to coach engineers into reliability practice rather than policing them into it. 
 - Judgement about which observability gaps matter and which are noise. 
 - Willingness to automate away the work rather than becoming indispensable to it. 

#AGTech

Skills

CI/CD, Cloud Based Services, Configuration Management (CM), Data Center Infrastructure Management (DCIM), Disaster Recovery (DR), Financial Operations, Identity Access Management (IAM), Incident Management, Infrastructure As Code (IaC), Kubernetes, Major Incident Management, Operating Systems (OS), Performance Tuning, Resilience Engineering, Scripting, SRE Observability, System Monitors, Terraform (Software), Vulnerability Management

Why GSK?

Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. 

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2. 5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases - to impact health at scale. 

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we're committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people. 

Inclusion at GSK: 

As an employer committed to Inclusion, we encourage you to reach out if you need any adjustments during the recruitment process. 

Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN. recruitment-adjustments@gsk. com to discuss your needs. 

Important notice to Employment businesses/ Agencies

GSK does not accept referrals from employment businesses and/or employment agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact GSK's commercial and general procurement/human resources department to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to GSK. The obtaining of prior written authorization is a condition precedent to any agreement (verbal or written) between the employment business/ agency and GSK. In the absence of such written authorization being obtained any actions undertaken by the employment business/agency shall be deemed to have been performed without the consent or contractual agreement of GSK. GSK shall therefore not be liable for any fees arising from such actions or any fees arising from any referrals by employment businesses/agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. 

It has come to our attention that the names of GlaxoSmithKline or GSK or our group companies are being used in connection with bogus job advertisements or through unsolicited emails asking candidates to make some payments for recruitment opportunities and interview. Please be advised that such advertisements and emails are not connected with the GlaxoSmithKline group in any way. 

GlaxoSmithKline does not charge any fee whatsoever for recruitment process. Please do not make payments to any individuals / entities in connection with recruitment with any GlaxoSmithKline (or GSK) group company at any worldwide location. Even if they claim that the money is refundable. 

If you come across unsolicited email from email addresses not ending in gsk. com or job advertisements which state that you should contact an email address that does not end in "gsk. com", you should disregard the same and inform us by emailing askus@gsk. com, so that we can confirm to you if the job is genuine.

data.title: Senior Software Engineer - Confluent
data.description:
Introduction

At IBM Software, we transform client challenges into solutions. Building the worldâ€TMs leading AI-powered, cloud-native products that shape the future of business and society. Our legacy of innovation creates endless opportunities for IBMers to learn, grow, and make an impact on a global scale. Working in Software means joining a team fueled by curiosity and collaboration. Youâ€TMll work with diverse technologies, partners, and industries to design, develop, and deliver solutions that power digital transformation. With a culture that values innovation, growth, and continuous learning, IBM Software places you at the heart of IBMâ€TMs product and technology landscape. Here, youâ€TMll have the tools and opportunities to advance your career while creating software that changes the world. 

Your Role And Responsibilities

About the Role

Backend engineers at Confluent, work on a set of diverse and complex challenges, such as building foundational cloud frameworks and services that power all components of the platform in the Cloud. We are building a multi-tenant, multi-cloud, cloud-native compute substrate to enable seamless data integration across Confluent Cloud. 

As a Senior Software Engineer, you think strategically and you help drive end-to-end technical delivery from the customer experience to scaling internal operations. You leverage your growing expertise in cloud-native, distributed systems to help take our execution platform to the next level. You care deeply about the key operational aspects (availability, reliability, performance, monitoring, capacity planning, and disaster recovery) of our Connect Platform, helping ensure we provide a highly available, resilient, and secure environment that our largest customers can rely on to run their mission-critical data pipelines. 

What You Will Do

- Build mission-critical infrastructure: Develop, test, and operationalize high-performance, scalable, and resilient backend services. 
 - Build and evolve Kafka connectors: Design, develop, and maintain Kafka Connect connectors for integrating with external data systems. 
 - Scale and optimize connector performance: Solve complex challenges in the stream processing space using cloud and on-premises resources to improve the performance, scalability, and elasticity of Kafka Connectors. 
 - Troubleshoot & debug: Dive into a complex technical stack that includes microservices, Kubernetes, containers, and virtualization to resolve issues and optimize performance. 
 - Support operational excellence: Participate in on-call rotations, ensure the operational readiness of our services, and help the team meet availability and performance SLA commitments. 
 - Innovate & improve: Act as a proactive engineer who identifies and suggests architectural, process, and operational improvements. 

Preferred Education

Master's Degree

Required Technical And Professional Expertise

- 4+ years of industry experience designing, building, and supporting backend systems in production. 
 - Solid engineering fundamentals with a deep focus on software quality, code reviews, documentation, and automated testing. 
 - Strong programming and algorithmic skills, with proficiency in major programming languages such as Java, Go, C/C++, or Python. 
 - Cloud-native experience, including hands-on experience or strong familiarity with configuring and deploying distributed systems and microservices using modern tools (e. g. , Kubernetes, Helm, Docker). 
 - Operational awareness, with experience participating in on-call rotations and a strong desire to build reliable, production-grade cloud services. 
 - Self-starter mentality, with the ability to work effectively in a team and excellent written and verbal communication skills. 
 - Collaborative mindset, featuring a strong sense of customer centricity, teamwork, and a drive to learn and grow alongside your peers. 
 - Educational background: BS or MS in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent work experience. 

Preferred Technical And Professional Experience

- Experience contributing to large-scale, highly available, low-latency, and high-throughput data systems. 
 - Knowledge of control planes, data planes, and multi-tenant resource management in public clouds (AWS, GCP, or Azure). 
 - Prior experience working with or extending the internal architecture of Apache Kafka® or Kafka Connect.

Day In The Life

We are looking for an experienced Senior UiPath Developer to join our Digital Center of Excellence (COE). The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on expertise in designing, developing, and deploying enterprise-grade automation solutions using the UiPath platform. This role requires a proactive individual with strong technical skills, problem-solving capabilities, and the ability to collaborate effectively with business and technology teams to deliver scalable automation solutions.

Automation Development and Solution Delivery: 

- Designing, developing, testing, and deploying automation solutions using UiPath best practices and development standards. 
 - Building scalable and reusable automation components, workflows, and frameworks. 
 - Translating business and functional requirements into technical automation solutions. 
 - Developing attended, unattended, and API-based automation solutions across multiple business functions. 

Technical Analysis And Problem Solving

- Analyzing business processes and identifying opportunities for automation optimization and efficiency improvements. 
 - Troubleshooting and resolving technical issues during development, testing, and production support. 
 - Conducting root cause analysis and implementing sustainable fixes for automation incidents. 
 - Optimizing bot performance, exception handling, and automation resiliency. 

Collaboration And Stakeholder Engagement

- Working closely with Business Analysts, Solution Architects, and business stakeholders throughout the automation lifecycle. 
 - Participating in technical discussions, solution walkthroughs, and requirement clarification sessions.

 - Providing regular updates on development progress, risks, and dependencies. 

Governance And Best Practices

Innovation And Continuous Improvement

 - Contributing reusable components, accelerators, and utilities to the COE knowledge repository. 
 - Identifying opportunities to improve development efficiency, automation quality, and delivery processes. 
 - Mentoring junior developers and supporting capability uplift within the automation team. 

Experience

Required Qualifications

- Minimum 5+ years of experience in software development or automation technologies. 
 - At least 3+ years of hands-on experience in UiPath development and enterprise RPA implementations. 
 - Proven experience delivering end-to-end automation projects in enterprise environments. 

Education

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field. 

Certifications

 - Additional certifications in automation or cloud technologies are advantageous. 

Skills And Competencies

- Strong hands-on experience with UiPath Studio, Orchestrator, REFramework, and related UiPath components. 
 - Experience with API integrations, queues, assets, OCR, Excel automation, and email automation. 
 - Good understanding of exception handling, logging, debugging, and automation support practices. 
 - Familiarity with version control systems and DevOps/CI-CD practices. 
 - Proficiency in preparing technical documentation and workflow diagrams. 
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.

Preferred Skills

 - Exposure to intelligent automation technologies including AI/ML integrations and process mining. 
 - Experience with scripting languages such as VB. NET, C#, or PowerShell. 
 - Knowledge of cloud-based automation deployments and virtual machine environments.

data.title: Senior Principal - SRE Principal, Automation & Toil Reduction
data.description:
Business Introduction

GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems. 

Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines. 

Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges. 

Job Purpose

The SRE Principal, Automation & Toil Reduction leads the engineering of automation that removes repetitive operational work and improves the reliability, resilience and efficiency of GSK platforms. The role acts as a hands-on principal SRE, shaping reusable automation patterns, enabling safe autonomous operations and embedding measurable toil reduction across platform domains. 

The role sits in Reliability Engineering & Operations and works across platform domains through a hub-and-spoke model. It owns the enterprise approach for identifying, baselining and prioritising toil, and converts high-value candidates into production-grade automation for diagnostics, remediation, recovery, fulfilment and compliance workflows. Platform build direction remains with Principal Engineers and Engineering Directors, major incident command remains with the Major Incident Manager, and the central reliability and automation standard is set by the Reliability Engineering Senior Director. Automation outcomes and priorities are agreed jointly with Platform Managers and Product Owners. 

Key Responsibilities

- Own and evolve the enterprise SRE automation and toil-reduction strategy, roadmap, reference patterns and engineering standards. 
 - Establish a consistent toil taxonomy and measurement approach using operational data, service-management evidence, task frequency, effort, risk and business impact. 
 - Prioritise automation candidates by hours avoided, repeatability, reliability risk, human-error exposure, control value, delivery complexity and reuse potential. 
 - Design and build secure, reusable automation for provisioning, diagnostics, incident triage, remediation, recovery, capacity, patching, service requests and compliance evidence. 
 - Create APIs, event-driven integrations, workflows, infrastructure-as-code modules, runbook automation and self-service capabilities rather than isolated scripts. 
 - Engineer closed-loop and AI-assisted operations with strong telemetry, policy controls, confidence thresholds, auditability and human approval for higher-risk actions. 
 - Establish production guardrails covering identity, least privilege, secrets, testing, change integration, release, rollback, failure containment and support ownership. 
 - Instrument automation to measure success, failure, latency, coverage, adoption, exceptions, cost and reliability impact end to end. 
 - Integrate automation with observability, ITSM, CI/CD, configuration, orchestration and knowledge platforms to reduce hand-offs and context switching. 
 - Use incident, problem and post-incident evidence to identify recurring failure modes and convert them into permanent engineering fixes or automated prevention. 
 - Partner with service and platform owners to define SLOs for automation-enabled services and use error-budget and risk evidence to prioritise reliability work. 
 - Lead technical design reviews for high-impact automation and prevent unsafe, brittle or low-value automation from becoming operational debt. 
 - Coach engineers, publish reusable patterns and grow an automation community of practice across internal and supplier teams. 
 - Provide technical oversight of supplier-delivered automation and ensure GSK retains maintainable code, documentation, telemetry, security evidence and knowledge. 
 - Track outcomes including toil ratio, capacity returned, automation adoption, cycle time, repeat incidents, MTTR, human-error reduction and control effectiveness. 

Professional Qualifications

- Degree in a technology or engineering discipline, or equivalent practical experience, such as Computer Science or Software Engineering. 
 - Relevant cloud, Kubernetes, DevOps, SRE, security, IT service management or automation certifications are desirable. 

Area of Specialisation

- Site reliability engineering, toil management and operations automation at enterprise scale. 
 - Software engineering for production operations, including APIs, event-driven integration, infrastructure as code, CI/CD, testing and observability. 
 - AIOps and safe autonomous operations, including anomaly detection, decision support and governed remediation. 

Experience Required

- Overall 15 years and degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Systems Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent practical engineering experience. 
 - Typically 8 or more years of experience in software, platform, infrastructure or reliability engineering, with substantial hands-on ownership of production services and automation. 
 - Demonstrated experience converting recurring operational work into reliable, reusable automation with measurable adoption and benefits. 
 - Advanced programming and automation engineering using Python or an equivalent language, including
 - APIs, testing, packaging, error handling and secure coding. 
 - Deep coding or scripting capability, plus practical experience with APIs, source control, automated testing and CI/CD. 
 - Hands-on experience with infrastructure as code, configuration management or enterprise orchestration. 
 - Experience instrumenting distributed systems and automation workflows using metrics, logs, traces and events. 
 - Experience applying SRE practices including SLOs, error budgets, incident management, postmortems, resilience and toil reduction. 
 - Experience designing safe production automation controls for access, secrets, approvals, change, rollback, audit and ongoing support. 
 - Experience leading technical design across multiple teams, mentoring experienced engineers and influencing without formal authority. 
 - Platform engineering depth in at least one domain such as cloud, hosting, networks, containers, databases or digital workplace. 

Desirable requirements: 

- Relevant cloud, Kubernetes, DevOps, SRE, security, IT service management or automation certifications. 
 - Experience with AIOps, generative AI or agentic operations, including evaluation, confidence thresholds, guardrails and human-in-the-loop approval. 
 - Experience creating self-service platforms, service catalogues, golden paths or reusable automation products. 
 - Experience with chaos engineering, game days, automated recovery testing, progressive delivery and pre-change or post-change validation. 
 - Experience integrating observability, ITSM, CMDB, CI/CD and orchestration platforms to reduce operational hand-offs. 
 - Experience operating in a global, multi-supplier environment and assuring supplier-delivered code, documentation, telemetry and knowledge transfer. 
 - Experience in pharmaceutical, life sciences, healthcare or another regulated industry, including GxP or validated systems. 
 - Experience measuring capacity returned, repeat-incident reduction, automation execution success, exception rates, control effectiveness and reuse. 

Skills/Background

- Principal-level judgement to distinguish genuine toil from valuable engineering work and to know when simplification is better than automation. 
 - Ability to influence platform, product, operations, security, quality and supplier teams without formal authority. 
 - Product mindset for automation, including users, SLOs, ownership, documentation, lifecycle, support and decommissioning. 
 - Composure during live incidents and discipline to convert restored service into permanent prevention. 
 - Ability to explain complex technical decisions to engineers and senior stakeholders in outcome-oriented language. 
 - Commitment to automate work away rather than becoming indispensable to recurring manual activity. 
 - Learning mindset toward evolving AIOps, agentic automation and platform engineering practices, without adopting technology ahead of control maturity. 

#AGTech

Skills

Automation, CI/CD, Cloud Based Services, Configuration Management (CM), Data Center Infrastructure Management (DCIM), Disaster Recovery (DR), Financial Operations, Identity Access Management (IAM), Incident Management, Infrastructure As Code (IaC), Operating Systems (OS), Performance Tuning, Python (Programming Language), Scripting, Software Engineering, SRE Observability, System Monitors, Vulnerability Management

Why GSK?

Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. 

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2. 5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases - to impact health at scale. 

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we're committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people. 

Inclusion at GSK: 

As an employer committed to Inclusion, we encourage you to reach out if you need any adjustments during the recruitment process. 

Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN. recruitment-adjustments@gsk. com to discuss your needs. 

Important notice to Employment businesses/ Agencies

GSK does not accept referrals from employment businesses and/or employment agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact GSK's commercial and general procurement/human resources department to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to GSK. The obtaining of prior written authorization is a condition precedent to any agreement (verbal or written) between the employment business/ agency and GSK. In the absence of such written authorization being obtained any actions undertaken by the employment business/agency shall be deemed to have been performed without the consent or contractual agreement of GSK. GSK shall therefore not be liable for any fees arising from such actions or any fees arising from any referrals by employment businesses/agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. 

It has come to our attention that the names of GlaxoSmithKline or GSK or our group companies are being used in connection with bogus job advertisements or through unsolicited emails asking candidates to make some payments for recruitment opportunities and interview. Please be advised that such advertisements and emails are not connected with the GlaxoSmithKline group in any way. 

GlaxoSmithKline does not charge any fee whatsoever for recruitment process. Please do not make payments to any individuals / entities in connection with recruitment with any GlaxoSmithKline (or GSK) group company at any worldwide location. Even if they claim that the money is refundable. 

If you come across unsolicited email from email addresses not ending in gsk. com or job advertisements which state that you should contact an email address that does not end in "gsk. com", you should disregard the same and inform us by emailing askus@gsk. com, so that we can confirm to you if the job is genuine.

We have a truly exciting opportunity for a Senior QA & Automation Engineer to be part of an innovative software engineering team developing solutions for the power and energy markets. 

Brady Technologies enables energy market participants to profit in new ways from the energy transition. We provide software solutions to support above market returns from trading, manage power operations, manage complex risks in evolving and volatile markets, impacted by increased decentralisation, diversity of asset types, the drive for decarbonisation, and ongoing regulatory change. Our customers include globally renowned utilities, independent power producers, renewable asset developers, energy and multi-commodity trading firms, oil & gas companies, hedge funds and other financial institutions, as well as state power grid operators. 

The Senior QA & Automation Engineer will be responsible for performing Quality Assurance and Test activities. This will involve developing and executing manual and automated tests across our product suite, which includes desktop and web applications. You will be an effective communicator who is comfortable discussing issues / ideas within the business and on site with clients. You are an enthusiastic tester whose drive is continuous improvement and a focus on helping the team deliver quality products. 

This is a great opportunity to further develop your QA career at a company with strong growth ambitions in a dynamic and future-looking industry. 

Key Accountabilities: 

- Liaise with internal teams (Product Management, Analysts etc) to understand requirements and develop testable Acceptance Criteria

 - Provide Test estimates to support bid pricing, project costing and task planning.

 - Derive and design test cases following approved development testing standards and guidelines. 
 - Design, develop and execute functional and non-functional tests (automated and manual as required)
 - Peer review QA and Test teamwork
 - Prioritise workload to meet agreed commitments. 
 - Ensure approved development procedures are followed across the SDLC. 
 - Capture, record, and document bugs allowing Development teams to readily reproduce issues. 
 - Provide timely feedback to Line Management as required. 

Technical skills: 

- Demonstrate Playwright and Cypress skills
 - Demonstrable Software testing experience across full SDLC
 - Ability to develop clear, concise, test plans and cases that will form part of a Brady repository and perform manual and automated tests across desktop and web applications. 
 - Ability to interpret written requirements and technical specification documents. 
 - Experienced in developing SQL scripts. 
 - Experience of Continuous Integration
 - Experience in release preparation - preparing checklists, release documentation and release communication. 
 - Knowledge of database architecture
 - API testing, Load and Performance testing
 - Agile / Scrum experience
 - Financial Markets knowledge

Other skills: 

- from 10 to 15 years of relevant experience
 - A good first numerate degree in either engineering, maths, or science industry experience in product testing. 
 - Be a team player, supporting and encouraging team collaboration and a mindset for Continuous Improvement
 - Be a passionate learner, willing to undertake training with a willingness to share knowledge and collaborate with colleagues
 - Excellent organisational and time management skills with an ability to prioritise your own workload
 - Commitment to quality and a thorough approach to work
 - Flexible attitude, an ability to adapt to changing requirements and to perform effectively under pressure
 - Demonstrable ability and passion to mentor, teach and coach individuals with a goal of building awareness, responsibility and self-belief. 

What Brady offers: 

- Great compensation + 5% bonus + private health insurance!
 - 24 days' holiday + bank holidays

 - Flexible working hours
 - An opportunity to build a modern technology platform for the power and energy trading markets
 - A positive, values-driven culture

data.description:
We are seeking a Enterprise Cloud Software Engineer skilled in automation engineering, artificial intelligence, and cloud operations. This role merges the Enterprise Cloud Software Developer and CloudOps Engineer positions into a single, development‐centric automation role. The focus is on building solutions, platforms, and automation frameworks that enable scalable, resilient, and intelligent cloud operations across AWS and Azure. The role emphasizes coding, Infrastructure‐as‐Code, CI/CD, and intelligent automation, while still maintaining strong operational awareness. 

The engineer will design, build, and evolve cloud automation solutions that replace manual IT operations with AI augmented, software‐driven, repeatable, and governed workflows, working closely with architecture, security, and operations teams. 

Key Responsibilities

Cloud Software Development & Automation

- Design, develop, test, and maintain cloud automation solutions using Python, PowerShell, Bash, and JavaScript to automate traditional IT and CloudOps tasks. 
 - Build reusable automation frameworks, libraries, and services using cloud SDKs, APIs, and serverless technologies (AWS Lambda, Azure Functions). 
 - Engineer high‐quality, production‐ready code following established SOLID principles, design patterns, and cloud resiliency patterns. 
 - Implement automated self‐certification, testing, and validation to ensure reliability, security, and performance before release. 

Infrastructure as Code & CI/CD

- Lead and contribute to Infrastructure‐as‐Code (IaC) using Terraform, CloudFormation, ARM/Bicep, and Ansible, aligned with enterprise standards. 
 - Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines for infrastructure and automation using Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or GitLab CI. 
 - Apply version control best practices, including pull requests, code reviews, and automated quality gates. 
 - Manage IaC state, modularization, and lifecycle across multi‐cloud and hybrid environments. 

Cloud Platforms & Operations Enablement

- Design and automate solutions across AWS and Microsoft Azure, supporting IaaS, PaaS, containerized, and serverless workloads. 
 - Enable operational capabilities such as provisioning, scaling, patching, backup, disaster recovery, and decommissioning through code. 
 - Build automation that enforces cloud governance, including tagging standards, security baselines, cost optimization, and policy‐as‐code guardrails. 
 - Collaborate with Cloud Operations teams to ensure solutions are observable, supportable, and production‐ready. 

Containers, Platforms & Modern Tooling

- Develop and support automation for container platforms such as Docker, Kubernetes, AKS, and EKS. 
 - Support enterprise cloud operating models, including shared services and multi‐tenant platforms. 

Intelligent & AI‐Enabled Automation

- Integrate AI‐driven automation into CloudOps workflows for alert enrichment, operational insights, and basic remediation. 
 - Develop Python‐based automation that leverages API‐driven AI services and intelligent runbooks. 
 - Apply awareness of AI governance, accuracy, and operational risk when building automation solutions. 

Agile Delivery & Collaboration

- Work within Agile/Scrum teams, contributing to sprint planning, estimation, reviews, and retrospectives. 
 - Partner closely with Architecture, Security, Platform, and Operations teams to drive adoption and operationalization of automation. 
 - Drive initiatives to completion by clarifying requirements, providing technical leadership, and removing delivery blockers. 
 - Produce clear documentation, runbooks, patterns, and standards to enable reuse and operational maturity. 

Required Qualifications

Education

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field. 

Experience

- 3-5 years of experience in cloud software development, automation engineering, DevOps, or infrastructure engineering. 
 - Strong hands‐on experience developing code and automation using Python, PowerShell, Bash, or JavaScript. 
 - Proven experience with IaC, CI/CD pipelines, and version control-driven delivery. 
 - Experience supporting and automating AWS and Azure environments. 

Preferred Certifications

- Advanced AWS and/or Azure Cloud Certifications
 - Terraform Associate or equivalent IaC certification
 - AI / ML or Intelligent Automation certifications (preferred but not required)

Other Skills & Mindset

- Strong software‐engineering mindset applied to infrastructure and operations. 
 - Analytical, automation‐first, and problem‐solving oriented. 
 - Customer‐focused with an emphasis on reliability, security, and operational excellence. 
 - Comfortable with failing fast, learning, and iterating in an Agile environment. 

Excellent written and verbal communication and cross‐functional collaboration skills.

data.title: Team Lead, Software Development - 4
data.description:
Department: Development

Location: Hyderabad

Description

We are looking for a Team Lead Software Engineer with strong software product development experience and the ability to lead feature delivery, guide engineering decisions, and support a high-performing development team. The role requires hands-on full-stack development expertise on Microsoft . NET technologies, strong understanding of cloud-native architecture, and the ability to collaborate effectively with stakeholders and distributed teams. The Team Lead is expected to balance individual technical contribution with people leadership, mentoring, delivery ownership, and cross-functional coordination. 

- Strong product development experience and knowledge of product development processes. 
 - Ability to own and lead different product feature areas from requirements through release. 
 - Ability to work across parallel release cycles while managing team execution and delivery risks. 
 - Strong communication skills to interact with stakeholders, clarify requirements, and drive alignment. 
 - Ability to collaborate with teams across different geographical locations and time zones. 
 - Hands-on experience with Microsoft . NET development platform and related technologies. 
 - Knowledge of AWS cloud services is preferred. 
 - Full-stack . NET development experience with interest in system integrations and data exchange techniques. 
 - Knowledge of ERP systems, business processes, microservices architecture, and event-driven design is preferred. 
 - Familiarity with security best practices including OWASP guidelines, secure coding, authentication, and authorization frameworks such as OAuth, SAML, and JWT. 
 - Comfortable in agile development environments with adaptability to evolving requirements and timelines. 

A Typical Day In The Life Includes

Engineering Delivery and Technical Execution

- Design, develop, enhance, and maintain product features and components across the application stack. 
 - Translate high-level design into low-level design, implementation plans, impact analysis, and task estimates. 
 - Write comprehensive unit tests and support automated testing practices to improve code quality. 
 - Perform code walkthroughs and reviews to ensure code paths are covered, dead code is removed, and implementation aligns with specifications. 
 - Ensure sufficient instrumentation, logging, and diagnostics are built into the code for supportability and debugging. 
 - Run performance tests, optimize code, eliminate memory leaks, and improve scalability of critical workflows. 
 - Assist in CI/CD pipeline activities and ensure product builds are stable and release-ready. 
 - Debug and fix defects identified during development, testing, production support, and customer issue investigation. 
 - Partner with Support teams on issue diagnosis, root-cause analysis, workaround identification, and permanent resolution. 

Team Management and People Leadership

- Provide day-to-day technical direction to engineers, helping the team prioritize work, remove blockers, and maintain steady delivery progress. 
 - Support sprint planning, backlog refinement, task breakdown, and execution tracking in collaboration with the manager, product owner, and scrum team. 
 - Monitor development progress, identify delivery risks early, and escalate issues with clear context, options, and recommendations. 
 - Promote engineering discipline across the team by encouraging strong design reviews, code quality, test coverage, documentation, and operational readiness. 
 - Create an inclusive and collaborative team environment where engineers can ask questions, share knowledge, and contribute effectively. 
 - Help onboard new team members by explaining product architecture, development practices, release processes, and domain context. 

Technical Leadership and Architecture

- Lead technical discussions for assigned feature areas, including architecture choices, integration patterns, API contracts, data flow, security considerations, and scalability needs. 
 - Guide the team in applying design patterns, microservices principles, event-driven design, secure coding practices, and cloud-native engineering standards. 
 - Evaluate technical trade-offs and recommend pragmatic solutions that balance maintainability, performance, security, timelines, and business priorities. 
 - Own quality gates for assigned modules, including design completeness, code review readiness, testability, observability, deployment readiness, and support handover. 
 - Drive technical debt identification and remediation plans while ensuring ongoing feature delivery is not compromised. 
 - Stay hands-on with development and troubleshooting, especially in complex, high-risk, or cross-component areas. 

Mentoring and Capability Building

- Mentor engineers through design reviews, code reviews, debugging sessions, and structured knowledge-sharing discussions. 
 - Help junior and mid-level engineers improve estimation, problem decomposition, coding standards, testing habits, and ownership mindset. 
 - Encourage reuse of common components, shared engineering practices, and consistent documentation across the team. 
 - Provide timely, constructive technical feedback to help team members improve delivery quality and engineering maturity. 
 - Identify skill gaps and recommend learning opportunities related to . NET, AWS cloud services, integrations, security, performance, and AI-enabled product capabilities. 

Project Ownership and Delivery Accountability

- Own end-to-end delivery of assigned initiatives, features, or technical workstreams from requirements clarification through design, build, testing, release, and post-release support. 
 - Ensure scope, dependencies, assumptions, risks, and acceptance criteria are understood before implementation starts. 
 - Coordinate with QA, DevOps, Support, Product Management, Architecture, Security, and dependent engineering teams to ensure smooth delivery. 
 - Track commitments, communicate progress periodically, and ensure stakeholders have visibility into status, risks, and mitigation plans. 
 - Support release readiness activities, including build validation, deployment checks, defect triage, production monitoring, and rollback or recovery planning where applicable. 
 - Drive root-cause analysis for recurring defects or production issues and convert findings into preventive engineering improvements. 

Stakeholder Management and Communication

- Engage with business stakeholders, product owners, architects, support teams, and cross-functional engineering teams to clarify requirements and align on implementation approach. 
 - Communicate technical decisions, risks, trade-offs, and delivery status clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences. 
 - Represent the engineering team in design discussions, sprint ceremonies, release discussions, issue triage, and customer-impact analysis as required. 
 - Escalate deviations from specifications, design assumptions, UI mockups, timelines, or quality expectations with proposed resolution options. 
 - Ensure team documentation, design notes, release notes, and support handover information are accurate and maintained. 

Basic Qualifications

- Hands-on Microsoft . NET development experience, including C#, ASP. NET, . NET Core, Web API, web services, and related frameworks. 
 - Experience with SQL Server, XML standards, JavaScript/JQuery, API integration, and service-based application development. 
 - Good understanding of design patterns, SOLID principles, clean code practices, and maintainable application architecture. 
 - Experience with Git-based configuration management and modern development workflows. 
 - Good understanding of AWS cloud technologies such as Lambda, Step Functions, SQS, Textract, Bedrock, and related cloud services. 
 - Experience with microservices architecture, event-driven systems, distributed processing, performance optimization, scalability, and observability. 
 - Good understanding of Python and machine learning concepts is preferred. 
 - Good to have experience with Generative AI technologies, including frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, or Hugging Face, and integration of AI/ML models into software applications. 
 - Knowledge of ERP systems, document processing, system integrations, and business workflows is preferred. 

Preferred Qualifications

Leadership Expectations

- Ownership mindset: Takes accountability for outcomes, not just assigned tasks, and follows through until issues are resolved. 
 - Execution discipline: Balances technical quality with delivery timelines and keeps the team focused on priorities. 
 - Decision quality: Makes practical engineering decisions using data, technical judgment, and stakeholder context. 
 - Coaching orientation: Invests time in mentoring team members and raising overall team capability. 
 - Collaboration: Works effectively across functions, locations, and release cycles while maintaining transparency. 
 - Operational readiness: Ensures features are supportable, observable, secure, scalable, and production-ready. 
 - Continuous improvement: Identifies recurring problems and drives improvements in process, architecture, automation, and engineering practices. 

To Be Successful You Need

- Bachelor's degree in a technical discipline or equivalent practical experience. 
 - Minimum of 4 years of software development experience, with demonstrated ability to lead feature areas or technical workstreams. 
 - Strong hands-on technical capability with Microsoft . NET, cloud services, APIs, integrations, and modern engineering practices. 
 - Good communication skills and ability to work with multiple teams, geographies, and stakeholder groups. 
 - Proven ability to mentor engineers, review designs, guide implementation, and improve technical quality. 
 - Good team player with a collaborative approach and willingness to support team members during critical delivery or production issues. 
 - Ability to manage ambiguity, clarify requirements, break down complex work, and drive execution in agile environments. 
 - Strong customer and product mindset, with focus on quality, maintainability, performance, security, and supportability. 

Success Measures

- Feature work is delivered with clear ownership, predictable execution, and minimal avoidable rework. 
 - Code quality, test coverage, documentation, observability, and support readiness improve across assigned areas. 
 - Team members receive timely guidance, blockers are addressed quickly, and engineering practices become more consistent. 
 - Stakeholders receive clear communication on progress, risks, dependencies, and technical trade-offs. 
 - Production issues, recurring defects, and technical debt are actively analyzed and converted into improvement actions. 

About Infor

Infor is where ambition meets impact. Join a global community of bold thinkers and innovators, where your expertise doesn't just solve problems. it shapes industries, unlocks opportunities, and creates real-world impact for billions of people. At Infor, you're not just building a career. you're helping to build what's next. 

Infor is a global leader in business cloud software products for companies in industry specific markets. Infor builds complete industry suites in the cloud and efficiently deploys technology that puts the user experience first, leverages data science, and integrates easily into existing systems. Over 60, 000 organizations worldwide rely on Infor to help overcome market disruptions and achieve business-wide digital transformation. 

For more information visit www. infor. com

Our Values

Our Vision

At Micron, we are transforming how the world uses information to enrich life for all.

We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Test Process Engineering Manager to lead a team responsible for developing, optimizing, and sustaining semiconductor test manufacturing processes within our Component Test organization. 

Position Summary

The Test Process Engineering Manager is responsible for leading engineering activities that enable world-class performance in semiconductor test manufacturing. This role drives process capability, yield improvement, product quality, manufacturing readiness, operational efficiency, and continuous improvement initiatives across Component Test operations. 

The successful candidate will lead a team of engineers focused on process qualification, process control, defect reduction, equipment-process interactions, manufacturing validation, data analytics, and technology deployment. This role collaborates extensively with Product Engineering, Quality Engineering, Manufacturing Operations, Equipment Engineering, Supplier Quality, Industrial Engineering, and global site teams. 

This position requires a combination of technical expertise, strategic thinking, people leadership, and data-driven decision-making. 

Key Responsibilities

People Leadership and Team Development

- Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing team of Test Process Engineers. 
 - Foster an inclusive, collaborative, and accountable work environment. 
 - Establish individual and team objectives aligned with business priorities.

 - Drive employee engagement and continuous learning initiatives. 

Test Process Engineering

- Own process engineering strategy and execution for Component Test manufacturing operations.

 - Monitor and improve process capability through statistical analysis and continuous improvement methodologies.

Yield Improvement and Quality Excellence

New Product Introduction (NPI)

- Lead manufacturing process readiness activities for new products and technology transitions. 
 - Support qualification planning, execution, validation, and production ramp activities. 
 - Conduct technical risk assessments and establish mitigation plans. 
 - Drive successful transfer of engineering solutions into high-volume manufacturing.

Process Control and Manufacturing Excellence

- Define key process indicators and monitoring systems. 
 - Establish process control plans, reaction plans, and qualification strategies. 
 - Drive Lean Manufacturing and Six Sigma methodologies. 
 - Improve cycle time, productivity, equipment utilization, and manufacturing efficiency. 
 - Support factory automation and digital manufacturing initiatives. 

Equipment and Technology Integration

- Partner with Equipment Engineering teams on equipment qualifications, upgrades, and process optimization. 
 - Analyze equipment-process interactions and identify opportunities for improvement. 
 - Support recipe governance, process standardization, and technology transfers. 
 - Drive implementation of new manufacturing technologies and innovative engineering solutions. 

Data Analytics and Digital Transformation

- Utilize advanced analytics to identify trends, risks, and improvement opportunities. 
 - Develop dashboards and reporting solutions to improve engineering decision-making. 
 - Apply statistical process control (SPC), Design of Experiments (DOE), and data science methodologies. 
 - Leverage AI-assisted analytics and digital tools to improve operational effectiveness. 

Safety, Compliance, and Operational Discipline

- Promote a safety-first culture within the organization. 
 - Ensure compliance with Micron quality systems, environmental health and safety requirements, and business processes. 
 - Support internal and external audits. 
 - Drive operational excellence and risk mitigation programs. 

Minimum Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Materials Science, Chemical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a related technical field. 
 - 8+ years of experience in semiconductor manufacturing, test engineering, process engineering, product engineering, or related technical disciplines. 
 - 3+ years of experience leading engineering teams, projects, or technical organizations. 
 - Strong knowledge of semiconductor test manufacturing processes and process control methodologies. 
 - Experience in statistical analysis, yield improvement, and structured problem-solving techniques. 
 - Demonstrated expertise in root cause analysis and corrective action implementation. 
 - Excellent communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Master's degree in Engineering or related technical discipline. 
 - Experience in memory, DRAM, NAND, SSD, or semiconductor backend manufacturing environments. 
 - Experience supporting Component Test, Final Test, Burn-In, System Level Test, or Automated Test Equipment (ATE) operations. 
 - Knowledge of SPC, DOE, FMEA, Control Plans, Risk Assessments, and Process Qualifications. 
 - Experience with JMP, Minitab, Python, SQL, Power BI, Tableau, or similar analytics platforms. 
 - Lean Six Sigma Green Belt, Black Belt, or equivalent certification. 
 - Experience leading multi-site and global engineering initiatives. 
 - Experience applying AI-enabled analytics and manufacturing automation technologies. 

Key Success Measures

Success In This Role May Be Measured Through

- Manufacturing yield improvement. 
 - Process capability enhancement. 
 - Reduction in quality excursions and defect rates. 
 - NPI process readiness and qualification success. 
 - Productivity and cycle-time improvements.

Leadership Expectations

Wind River is a global leader in delivering software for mission-critical intelligent systems. For more than four decades, the company has been an innovator and pioneer, powering billions of systems that require the highest levels of security, safety, and reliability. 

Wind River helps customers across automotive, aerospace, defense, industrial, medical, and telecommunications industries solve complex technology challenges on their journey toward the new intelligent machine economy. The company's software powers generation after generation of the safest, most secure systems in the world. Examples include playing a key role in NASA space missions such as Artemis I, the James Webb Space Telescope, and multiple Mars rovers. We've achieved recent 5G milestones including the world's first successful 5G data session with Verizon and building one of the largest Open RAN networks in the world with Vodafone. 

The company has received industry recognition for its technology innovation and leadership, and for its workplace culture, including global Great Place to Work certification and being named a "Top Workplace" for ten consecutive years. As a Senior Engineer for verification and validation testing, you will contribute to researching and evaluating tools and framework, as well as designing and implementing the test framework used for both certified and non-certified software components. You will also be contributing to designing and implementing system testing and V&V test development.

In a world increasingly driven by software innovation, Wind River is pioneering the technologies that accelerate the digital transformation of our customers with a new generation of mission‐critical AI systems-built for an AI‐first world with the most exacting safety, security, performance, and reliability standards. data.description:
ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD. 

At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world's most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future. 

Whether you're designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger - technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we'll advance your career. 

Lead Server Performance Architect

AMD is looking for an outstanding technical contributor to help architect, validate & optimize performance of new features through full chip simulation & emulation platforms for AMD-based next-generation servers. As a passionate and dedicated Server Systems Performance Architect in the Server Performance Group, you will identify new opportunities to optimize server silicon for throughput and latency by identifying opportunities across all parts of silicon micro architecture and design spanning CPU, Data Fabric, Memory subsystem and IO. You will validate and analyze performance of various design features in pre silcon design env and correlate the profiling data with AMD performance model and eventually AMD silicon. You will quantify and isolate performance bottlenecks and share the insights to help new drive features into the next generation of server CPUs. The ideal candidate is expected to be well informed on latest trends in server design and verification, have a well-rounded understanding of performance requirements for server market and be able to quickly ascertain, in a data-driven manner, how next generation server CPUs and platforms should be engineered to support those needs

Key Responsibilities

- Team Leadership
 - Lead and mentor a high-performing team of performance verification engineers. 
 - Foster a culture of innovation, technical rigor, and continuous improvement. 
 - Provide strategic direction across multiple concurrent verification programs. 
 - Program Leadership
 - Define and execute the performance verification strategy for high-performance x86 server CPU. 
 - Collaborate with architecture, u-arch, RTL, performance modeling, firmware, and software teams to define and validate performance KPIs. 
 - Ensure timely delivery of simulation/emulation results, and optimization feedback loops. 
 - Performance Analysis & Correlation
 - Develop and execute performance verification plans targeting IPC, latency, throughput, and power efficiency. 
 - Capability to debug performance outliers thru Performance Monitoring Counters (PMC). 
 - Drive correlation between RTL and performance models, ensuring architectural intent is met. 
 - Analyze performance bottlenecks using simulation, emulation, and silicon data. 
 - Toolchain & Methodology
 - Build and maintain scalable, modular performance verification infrastructure. 
 - Lead emulation-based performance setup and debug, enabling early performance validation. 
 - Integrate performance regression, profiling, and analysis flows using industry-standard and custom tools. 
 - Collaborate with compiler and OS teams to ensure software stack alignment with hardware performance goals. 
 - AI-Driven Infrastructure
 - Drive the development of AI/ML-based infrastructure to automate performance analysis, anomaly detection, and efficiency improvements. 
 - Leverage data-driven techniques to optimize verification coverage and reduce debug cycles. 
 - Cross-Functional Collaboration
 - Partner with x86 architecture, RTL design, physical design, and software teams to ensure performance targets are met. 
 - Influence design decisions through data-backed performance insights. 
 - Stakeholder Management
 - Align verification goals with business and product roadmaps. 
 - Communicate performance status, risks, and trade-offs to executive leadership and stakeholders. 
 - Industry Awareness
 - Stay current with trends in CPU architecture, performance modeling, and verification technologies. 
 - Evaluate and adopt emerging tools and techniques to maintain a competitive edge. 
Preferred Experience

- 15+ years of industry experience with performance modeling and simulation tools (e. g. , cycle-accurate simulators, emulators) with strong background in CPU microarchitecture, performance analysis, and system-level performance verification. 
 - Proven leadership in managing large, cross-functional engineering teams. 
 - Familiarity with PMC DV, latency and throughput validation, emulation platforms, and performance debug flows. 
 - Deep understanding of x86 ISA, microarchitecture, and performance metrics. 
 - Experience in developing performance test suites, performance triage tools, and simulation/emulation infrastructure. 
 - Expertise in performance analysis tools, correlation techniques, and workload optimization. 
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a data-driven mindset. 
 - Deep knowledge of modern out-of-order CPU cores, memory subsystems, and performance modeling is a plus. 
 - Experience with ML/AI techniques/frameworks for performance triage, infrastructure automation and prediction is a plus. 
 - Exposure to high-performance computing (HPC), virtualization, or server-class CPUs. 
 - Background in hardware/software co-design and performance-aware compiler optimizations. 
 - Familiarity with pre-silicon and post-silicon debug methodologies. 

Position Requirements

- Should have executed Emulation based functional and performance verification for multimillion gate SoC designs
 - Should have strong exposure to RTL coding and SOC bringup debug
 - Exceptional foundation in systems architecture, cutting across CPU, memory, storage and I/O subsystems
 - Experience with hardware performance counter monitoring tools
 - Should have exposure to performance profiling tools, preferably x86 based (e. g. linux perf, Windows perfmon)
 - MS/PhD in Computer Engineering / relevant coursework / thesis

Job Title: Assistant Manager / Senior Executive - Inprocess Quality (IPQC)
