data.title: Senior Manager, Software Engineering
data.description:
Our Company: 

At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes. With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters. Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach. Teradata delivers real business value with AI. 

What You'll Do: 

We are seeking a Senior Manager to lead our Database Performance Testing and Characterization organization. This leader will manage a high-impact team responsible for performance benchmarking, regressions, scalability, and workload characterization across releases, platforms, and customer scenarios. 

You will also be accountable for transforming how performance testing is executed, analyzed, and validated-modernizing the practice through automation, AI/Agent-assisted analysis, intelligent validation, and resilient test pipelines. The ideal candidate has a proven track record of leading teams through transformation initiatives that measurably improve productivity, quality, cycle time, and operational resiliency. 

Your Opportunity: 

- Lead and grow a team of performance engineers responsible for end-to-end performance testing of a database product (benchmarks, workloads, regressions, scalability, concurrency, and reliability under load). 
 - Own the team's delivery commitments for performance characterization requests across internal stakeholders (engineering, product, release, support) and external/customer-driven scenarios. 
 - Drive a transformation roadmap for performance testing that improves: 
 - Execution automation (repeatable runs through orchestration pipelines that are self-healing, observable and secure)
 - Result analysis using AI and Agents(regression detection, noise modeling, confidence scoring, explainability)
 - Root Cause Analysis Automation using AI/ML techniques (root-cause hypothesis generation, correlation analysis, report synthesis for performance issues)
 - Modernize Test Framework to expand capabilities and assist in shift-left abilities
 - Partner with engineering, architecture, and release teams to translate product changes into performance risk assessments and targeted test plans. 
 - Influence design decisions by providing early performance insights and recommendations. 
 - Communicate clearly to senior leadership: performance readiness, risks, mitigation plans, and trends using metrics and executive-ready summaries. 
 - Implement governance: baselines, test data versioning, environment parity, noise controls, and auditability of results. 

Who you will work with: 

This opportunity is within the Internal Engineering Organization. Team comprises of multiple global scrum teams working towards a common goal to test and release Teradata Vantage Platform and AI Products on various on-prem and cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GC) with quality and performance guidelines. 

Fast-paced, flexible, fun. That describes our work environment. . . a place to brainstorm with the best data minds, engage customers and surprise yourself with what's possible, every day. 

What makes you a qualified candidate: 

- 10+ years in performance engineering, test engineering, systems engineering, or a related discipline; 4+ years leading teams and delivering transformation roadmaps. 
 - Demonstrated experience in database performance testing or closely related systems (distributed systems, storage engines, query optimizers, large-scale compute platforms). 
 - Strong understanding of performance metrics and analysis: CPU, I/O, memory, concurrency, latency/throughput, query plans, system contention, and benchmarking methodologies. 
 - Proven track record modernizing engineering practices through automation and operational rigor (CI/CD, test orchestration, observability, reliability engineering). 
 - Proven experience applying AI/ML and/or LLM-based tooling to improve engineering productivity (analysis automation, anomaly detection, summarization, intelligent triage). 
 - Strong cross-functional leadership skills: ability to align stakeholders, negotiate priorities, and deliver outcomes in complex environments. 
 - Excellent communication skills and experience presenting to senior leadership. 

What You'll Bring

- 
 - Hands-on experience with one or more: 
 - Database internals (optimizer behavior, execution engine, indexing, statistics)
 - Performance tooling (profilers, tracers, query plan analyzers, APM)
 - Python/SQL-based analytics and visualization; statistical methods for noise and confidence intervals
 - Cloud performance testing across AWS/Azure/GCP
 - Experience building internal platforms for: test scheduling/orchestration, results repositories, dashboards, automated regression detection using AI. 
 - Familiarity with modern AI/agent patterns for engineering workflows (RAG for runbooks, agentic root-cause assistants, evaluation harnesses). 
 - Experience with security and compliance expectations for AI-enabled systems (data handling, access controls, audit trails). 
 - Background working in organizations undergoing AI proficiency/AI adoption transformation. 

Why We Think You'll Love Teradata

We prioritize a people-first culture because we know our people are at the very heart of our success. We embrace a flexible work model because we trust our people to make decisions about how, when, and where they work. We focus on well-being because we care about our people and their ability to thrive both personally and professionally. We are an anti-racist company because our dedication to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion is more than a statement. It is a deep commitment to doing the work to foster an equitable environment that celebrates people for all of who they are. 

Teradata invites all identities and backgrounds in the workplace. We work with deliberation and intent to ensure we are cultivating collaboration and inclusivity across our global organization. We are proud to be an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, color, ancestry, religion, creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding, or related conditions), national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, medical condition, genetic information, gender identity or expression, military and veteran status, or any other legally protected status.

data.title: Principal Data Systems Software Engineer
data.description:
Job Description

Owns feature areas with measurable business impact. Designs application services and schemas spanning Online Transaction Processing and Online Analytical Processing, JSON, spatial, and graph data models. Leads debugging across services and database layers; optimizes query and API performance to meet service-level agreements. Drives automated testing coverage and performance baselines; collaborates with product management and user experience to run experiments and analyze adoption and retention. 

Solve complex problems related to infrastructure cloud services and build automation to prevent problem recurrence. Design, develop, and deploy software to improve the availability, scalability, and efficiency of Oracle products and services. Design and develop designs, architectures, standards, and methods for large-scale distributed systems. Facilitate service capacity planning and demand forecasting, software performance analysis, and system tuning. 

Oracle Exadata Database team is building a new cloud native, Autonomous, multi-tenant, database optimized, smart storage cloud service. This service is expected to scale across thousands of tenants. It is based on the successful Exadata platform. This cost effective storage solution is engineered for highest performance and availability to run variety of workloads. We are hiring senior developers for this exciting team to build the service to power Autonomous database offerings in Oracle Cloud and Cloud at customer. 

We offer unique opportunities for smart, hands-on engineers with the expertise and passion to solve difficult problems in distributed highly available services and virtualized infrastructure. As part of the Oracle Database Exadata team, you will be continually challenged and have an opportunity to contribute. The role provides a mixture of production ownership and development. You will solve challenging technical problems, identify improvements and work on implementing your recommendations. 

Required Qualifications

10+ years of hands on experience in software development, including design, implementation, debugging, and support, building distributed, scalable system software and/or Services preferably in the cloud

- BS or MS degree in Computer Science, or equivalent experience
 - Proficient with programming languages Java/Python; and scripting languages (Shell, Perl and Python)
 - Deep understanding of distributed systems and web services technology
 - Experienced in crafting, building and debugging large scale distributed systems
 - Strong at applying data structures, algorithms, and object oriented design, to solve challenging problems
 - Track record of building and delivering mission critical, 24x7 production software systems 
 - Familiar with micro-services based software architecture and the evolving tools in the space like nomad/k8s
 - Experience with container run time (Docker, LXC/LXD)
 - Knowledge of professional software engineering practices & best practices for full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing and operations
 - Strong desire to build, sense of ownership, urgency, and drive. 
 - Systematic problem solving approach, combined with a strong sense of ownership and drive. 
 - Experience in communicating with users, other technical teams, and senior management to collect requirements, describe software product features, product strategy and influence outcomes in technical decision-making
 - Solid understanding of performance and efficiency with a strong customer focus
 - Demonstrated ability to mentor other software developers in all aspects of their engineering skillsets
 - Possess strong verbal and written communication skills

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

Data Systems Software Development: 

- Own a feature area's data model across Online Transaction Processing/Online Analytical Processing, JSON, spatial, or graph. 
 - Define performance budgets and enforce query patterns that meet latency targets at scale. 
 - Partner with product management to design experiments that drive adoption, conversion, and retention; analyze results to inform roadmap. 
 - Architects existing and complex new services. 

Software Development and Coding - Design, Testing, and Optimization: 

- Designs software solutions and analyzes and identifies requirements to achieve business and operational goals, sharing results with manager upon completion. 
 - Adheres to and improves execution of all phases of the software development lifecycle; provides guidance and coaching to engineers to drive improvements. 
 - Utilizes advanced knowledge to develop and guide new software features and enhancements leading design specifications, ensuring accessibility, and develops documents to clarify software design and code. 
 - Leads code reviews in multiple areas to help drive improvements. 
 - Conducts debugging and troubleshooting to identify and fix complex software issues. 
 - Develops fixes for identified issues. 
 - Implements comprehensive software testing (e. g. , functional and non-functional testing), quality assurance processes, software error logging, monitoring, and observability for effective debugging, sharing work with manager and/or lead upon completion. 
 - Conducts performance profiling and optimization of coding, building scalable solutions, and anticipating and resolving potential outcomes. 
 - Troubleshoots and resolves complex issues related to application programming interface (API) functionality and integration. 
 - Implements complex API versioning, lifecycle, and interoperability strategies. 

Software Architecture - Software System Structural Design: 

- Implements and contributes to developing software, systems, and services, ensuring review by manager and/or senior technical leaders upon completion. Recommends project or design scope. 
 - Provides technical guidance and coaching to less experienced developers in existing software architecture. 
 - Contributes to periodic reviews and ensures adherence to architectural standards. 
 - Collaborates with stakeholders and networks externally to ensure work aligns with software architecture.

data.title: Engineering Manager - Agentic AI
data.description:
Who We Are

We're an iconic Aussie brand with a global footprint. Our purpose is to build a connected future so everyone can thrive. We're all about providing the best experience and delivering the best tech on the best network. 

This includes making Telstra the place you want to work. For you, that means a having career that grows with you and working with a team powered by human connection that prioritises wellbeing and choice. 

What is the focus of the role?

The Agentic AI Engineer / Chapter Lead combines hands-on AI engineering depth with chapter leadership. The role designs, builds and operates secure, reliable and cost-effective agentic AI solutions, while developing engineering capability and establishing reusable patterns, standards and reference implementations. 

The role works across backend, platform, product, architecture, security and SRE teams to move LLM solutions from prototype to governed production use on AWS, with accountability for technical quality, responsible AI and sustainable adoption of AI-assisted engineering practices. 

What We Offer

- Performance-related pay
 - Access to thousands of learning programs so you can level-up
 - Global presence across 22 countries; opportunities to work where we do business. 
 - Up to 26 weeks maternity leave provided to the birth mother with benefits for all child births
 - Up to 16 weeks paid paternity leave provided to the non-birthing partners
 - Employees are entitled to 21 paid annual leaves per calendar year
 - Eligible employees are entitled to 12 days of paid sick / casual leave per calendar year
 - Relocation support options across India, from junior to senior positions within the company
 - Receive insurance benefits such as medical, accidental and life insurances

What You'll Do

What You'll Do

Agentic AI Solution Engineering

- Design, build and operate single-agent and multi-agent systems using LangGraph, Amazon Bedrock Agents and appropriate direct SDK approaches. 
 - Define agent workflows, state, checkpointing, human-in-the-loop controls, tool schemas, contracts, boundaries and safe hand-off patterns. 
 - Apply engineering judgement to determine when agent frameworks are required and when simpler deterministic or direct model integration is better. 

Retrieval and Enterprise Knowledge Systems

- Design and tune RAG and agentic RAG pipelines across approved enterprise knowledge sources, including ingestion, retrieval, indexing, re-ranking and grounding. 
 - Implement hybrid retrieval, query planning, self-correction and tool-augmented retrieval patterns to improve relevance and task completion. 
 - Evaluate vector stores and knowledge graph or GraphRAG approaches where scale, security, cost or relationship-heavy domains require them. 

MCP, Tools and Agent Communication

- Build and operate MCP servers and clients, including tools, resources, prompts and supported transports. 
 - Expose secure capabilities with clear descriptions, validation, versioning, least-privilege access and defined trust boundaries. 
 - Apply agent-to-agent concepts such as discovery, agent cards, task lifecycle, collaboration and capability registration. 

Evaluation, Quality and Economics

- Create evaluation frameworks using golden datasets, deterministic checks, LLM-as-judge techniques, human review and regression suites. 
 - Integrate quality, safety, groundedness, latency, token usage and cost gates into delivery and release processes. 
 - Benchmark models and architectures for quality, reliability, throughput, context requirements and total cost. 

Security, Governance and Responsible AI

- Build security, privacy, safety, guardrails and governance into agentic solutions from inception. 
 - Mitigate risks including prompt injection, data leakage, excessive agency, unsafe tool use, insecure output handling and supply-chain exposure. 
 - Implement PII handling, scoped identity, OAuth where applicable, secret management, least-privilege access, human approval and audit trails for sensitive actions. 
 - Apply data residency, retention, privacy, versioning, hallucination and bias risk assessment, change control and responsible AI requirements. 

Production Engineering and Operations

- Build AI services using strong Python practices, including asynchronous programming, FastAPI, automated testing and maintainable package design. 
 - Deploy and operate services on AWS and Kubernetes with CI/CD, secure runtime configuration and operational controls. 
 - Instrument agent systems with tracing, logging, metrics and evaluation telemetry using OpenTelemetry and relevant LLM observability platforms. 
 - Implement reliability patterns including timeouts, retries, fallbacks, failover, rate limits, concurrency controls and graceful degradation. 
 - Treat prompts, agent definitions, evaluation datasets, policies and configuration as versioned, reviewed and tested engineering artefacts. 

Chapter Leadership and Capability Uplift

- Actively build chapter capability by mentoring engineers in software engineering practices, emerging technologies, tools, approaches and delivery processes, modelling continuous learning and coaching others to lift capability across teams. 
 - Coach, develop and provide regular feedback to chapter members, clarifying performance, behavioural and engineering expectations, and supporting meaningful growth conversations. 
 - Build strong commercial capability across teams by modelling disciplined cost-value thinking, balancing engineering investment, platform cost, risk and customer outcomes to choose the most economic course of action. 
 - Foster a culture of observability across multiple teams, helping engineers use operational telemetry, service health data, incident trends and customer-impact signals to improve stability, performance and domain ownership. 
 - Influence effective decision-making in uncertain or high-pressure situations, making responsible trade-offs without always having complete information and helping teams manage risk, change and ambiguity. 
 - Build a strong culture of knowledge sharing, documentation and constructive feedback, using communities of practice, playbooks, reference patterns and learning forums to drive continuous improvement and capability uplift. 
 - Model Telstra's values and facilitate inclusive discussions across teams, creating alignment to organisational strategy and principles while identifying actionable continuous improvement opportunities. 
 - Manage recruitment of permanent employees and partner resources, shaping a healthy workforce plan, succession pipeline and highly productive team mix aligned to current and future capability needs. 
 - Set goals and lead performance appraisal for engineers, ensuring expectations, outcomes, development needs and accountability are clearly understood and fairly assessed. 
 - Ensure co-workers are treated respectfully and without discrimination, harassment or victimisation, actively contributing to psychological safety, inclusion and a respectful workplace. 
 - Assess AI and modern engineering capability needs, align people to priority work, and support safe adoption of AI-assisted engineering tools, spec-driven development and reusable standards. 
 - Balance hands-on technical leadership with people accountability, chapter health, resource planning and delivery commitments. 

About You Required Skills And Technical Expertise

- Agentic AI architecture, orchestration, LLM, prompt and context engineering. 
 - RAG, agentic RAG, enterprise knowledge systems, MCP and agent-to-agent communication. 
 - AI evaluation, model selection, token economics, quality gates and responsible AI practices. 
 - AI security, governance, privacy, guardrails, risk controls and safe production deployment. 
 - Strong production engineering across Python, AWS, Kubernetes, CI/CD, observability, reliability and operations. 
 - Technical leadership, stakeholder influence, coaching, workforce capability uplift and reusable engineering standards. 
 - undefined

Qualifications And Experience

- 10+ years professional software engineering experience, including 2+ years building LLM-based applications or equivalent production AI depth. 
 - Experience taking agentic or generative AI solutions from discovery and prototype to production operation. 
 - Experience leading technical outcomes across teams and coaching engineers in emerging technologies. 
 - Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science or related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience. 

Preferred Skills

- Integration of AI capabilities with Java, Spring Boot or Node. js services using Spring AI, LangChain4j or comparable libraries. 
 - Fine-tuning or parameter-efficient adaptation, including LoRA. 
 - Experience with additional agent frameworks such as Strands Agents, CrewAI, OpenAI Agents SDK or Claude Agent SDK. 
 - Background in SRE, platform engineering, event-driven architecture, Kafka or Redis Streams. 
 - Contributions to AI tooling, internal engineering communities or relevant cloud and AI certifications. 
 - Experience with enterprise model gateways, agent registries, AI inventory, governance platforms or internally hosted model ecosystems. 
 - End-to-end solution design from chat UI through orchestration, retrieval, tool execution and LLM response delivery, including clear ownership of user experience, backend services and model interaction patterns.

data.title: Senior Software Development Engineer - AI Native Platform
data.description:
About Autonomize AI

Autonomize AI is building the intelligence layer for healthcare. Our Genesis platform replaces brittle, manual knowledge workflows with AI agents that reason, retrieve, and act - reducing administrative burden so clinicians can focus on patients. 

We're looking for engineers who don't just integrate AI into software - they think in agents, design for inference, and treat LLMs as first-class infrastructure. 

The Opportunity

You'll architect and ship across the full Genesis stack: agentic pipelines, backend APIs, data infrastructure, and clinical-facing UI. You'll work directly with founders and customers. You'll own things end-to-end. 

This is not a role where you bolt AI onto existing CRUD. You'll be making foundational decisions about how intelligent systems are designed, evaluated, and operated at scale in a regulated industry. 

You're a Fit If You Have

- AI-native engineering is your default mode
 - You've built production systems where LLMs are doing real work - not demos, not PoCs
 - You've designed and shipped RAG pipelines, multi-agent workflows, or tool-using agents in production
 - You understand prompt engineering as an engineering discipline: versioning, evaluation, regression testing
 - You've instrumented AI systems for observability - latency, token usage, hallucination rate, drift
 - You can reason about model tradeoffs (context length, cost, latency, accuracy) and make architectural calls accordingly
 - You've worked with LLM SDKs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Bedrock, etc. ) and agentic orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, or similar)
 - You build robust backend systems
 - 6 + years building production web applications from scratch
 - Deep Python proficiency; comfortable with FastAPI, Django, or Flask in production
 - Experience designing APIs that serve both humans and AI agents (tool schemas, structured outputs, streaming)
 - Async-first thinking: asyncio, task queues, event-driven architectures
 - Kafka, Redis, or ActiveMQ for real-time data movement
 - Postgres, Elasticsearch, MongoDB, or graph databases (Neo4j, TigerGraph) in production
 - You operate at cloud scale
 - Docker and Kubernetes in production - this is a hard requirement
 - At least one public cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP) with real operational experience
 - Microservices and cloud-native design patterns
 - You've been on-call. You know what a bad deploy feels like at 2am. 
 - You can ship a frontend when the product demands it
 - React, TypeScript, or modern JS frameworks
 - Enough frontend fluency to build clinical interfaces without a dedicated frontend handoff

Bonus Points

- Led a small engineering team - mentored, reviewed, unblocked
 - CKAD or equivalent Kubernetes certification
 - ML/DL model deployment experience (PyTorch, scikit-learn)
 - Built evaluation harnesses or used MLflow, LangSmith, or similar for AI observability
 - Healthcare domain experience (FHIR, HL7, clinical workflows)

What We Value Above Credentials

Bias toward action - you ship, then iterate. You learn by doing, not by planning. 

Owner mentality - you don't wait for permission. You identify what needs to exist and build it. 

Intellectual honesty - you'd rather say "I don't know, let me find out". When unsure, seek the right information from your peers or leaders. 

Async-first communication - you write clearly, document decisions, and work well across time zones. 

What You'll Get

Ground floor equity in a VC-backed healthcare AI company growing fast

Full-stack ownership - no handoffs, no silos, no "that's not my team"

Direct access to founders and customers - your technical decisions will be seen and felt

Professional development budget - conferences, courses, certifications, books

Flexible, remote-friendly culture built around output, not hours

If you've been waiting for a role where AI isn't a feature - it's the foundation - this is it.

 - Knowledge of P&IDs, Loop drawings, control narratives and functional design specifications.

 - Excellent technical skills with a focus on meeting customer commitments on time with quality. 
 - Technical leadership and coaching to Junior Engineers working on the project. 
 - Excellent communication skills for client interactions, team collaboration, and technical reporting. 
 - Support Project Manager on the commercial angle with focus on budget and change order opportunities
 - Strong problem-solving mentality with a will to deliver results
 - Critical thinker and process / result- oriented
 - Experience & proven ability in analyzing / solutions for complex projects/issues
 - Ability to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment with minimal supervision
 - Ability to lead traditional waterfall and Agile projects
 - Fast learner and maintain standardization & following execution processes. 
 - Manage customer expectation by understanding and appreciating the cultural differences QUALIFICATIONS
 - BE/B. Tech/M. Tech in Chemical or Instrumentation Engineering. 
 - Implementation experience of offsite Blending and Movement Automation suites of Honeywell, Aveva, Yokogawa TRAVEL: Average 70%

Honeywell Technologies is a global, pure-play automation company with a legacy of innovating to help solve the world's most mission-critical challenges, enhancing the quality of life for people and communities around the world. By combining the deep domain expertise of our more than 50, 000 employees with decades of data from our global installed base, we are uniquely positioned to lead the industrial sector's transition from automation to autonomy.

data.title: Software Development Engineer, AFT External Fulfillment
data.description:
Description

Are you seeking an environment where you can apply state-of-the-art computer science techniques, build large-scale distributed systems, and directly impact how millions of customers experience ultra-fast delivery? Do you want to build the next generation of Quick Commerce fulfillment technology from the ground up?

Amazon's Quick Commerce (QC) business is scaling rapidly across multiple cities, fulfilling hundreds of thousands of daily orders with high expansion targets. We are building a brand-new QC under-the roof-fulfillment stack on AFT foundations. 

Join the QC Fulfillment Technology team and be part of developing large-scale, composable, work-cell-based systems that power our micro-stores - from inbound receiving and guided stowing to picking, staging, and last-mile handoff. These systems will be used by thousands of store associates to delight millions of customers with 10-minute delivery. In this role, the SDE will be responsible for designing, developing, and operating scalable fulfillment services. 

This is a true 0→1 opportunity where your code will directly impact how Quick Commerce fulfillment operates at Amazon. 

Key job responsibilities

- Design, build, and maintain scalable services and APIs for the QC fulfillment stack
 - Develop systems that enforce operational controls beyond Amazon sites, including external fulfillment environments with our 3P partners
 - Collaborate with Senior SDEs, Principal Engineers, TPMs, and Product Managers to define technical solutions that solve fulfillment challenges at scale
 - Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code following Amazon's engineering best practices
 - Drive continuous improvement in system performance, reliability, and operational efficiency, targeting industry-leading speeds
 - Participate in code reviews, design discussions, and technical planning sessions
 - Mentor junior engineers and contribute to raising the engineering bar across the team
 - Work in a fast-paced, agile environment with rapid iteration cycles, shipping new capabilities in weeks not months

About The Team

We are a fast-paced and focused team of passionate Amazonians building industry-leading Quick Commerce fulfillment technology. We are standing up QC fulfillment stack that will scale beyond Amazon sites and beyond India. Our team is part of AFT, and works closely with IN Tez (QC), DEX, Speed Fulfillment teams, following a collaborative engagement model with joint workshops, and dedicated SME support. 

The team values high ownership, bias for action, and insists on the highest standards while following a build-fast-and-iterate-fast methodology. We believe in speed through autonomy and safety through guardrails. 

This team is suitable for passionate engineers who are equally interested in contributing to architecture and product strategy while building high-performing, scalable systems that directly impact Quick Commerce operations and Amazon Now's growth. 

Basic Qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
 - 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
 - Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Together, we push the boundaries of known science and find new ways to connect and protect our world. Join us and help shape the future of aerospace and defense. 

What You Will Do *

- Design and develop production-quality full-stack AI applications using modern frontend technologies such as React and TypeScript and backend technologies such as Python, Node. js, Java, or . NET. 
 - Build intuitive user experiences for conversational AI, Generative AI, intelligent workflows, and agentic applications, including streaming responses, dynamic content, citations, evidence, and AI-generated artifacts. 
 - Develop application-specific backend services, backend-for-frontend APIs, asynchronous workflows, application state, and integrations required to deliver complete end-to-end AI experiences. 
 - Build human-in-the-loop experiences that allow users to review, approve, modify, reject, pause, resume, cancel, or override AI and agent actions. 
 - Design application experiences that communicate agent activity, progress, tool execution, uncertainty, partial completion, errors, retries, and recovery. 
 - Integrate applications with enterprise AI services, agent runtimes, platform APIs, identity services, enterprise applications, data sources, and other backend systems. 
 - Develop reusable application components and patterns while ensuring accessibility, performance, security, automated testing, maintainability, and alignment with enterprise design systems. 
 - Partner closely with AI Product Design, Applied AI, Platform Engineering, and product teams from early prototypes through production deployment and continuous improvement. 

What You Will Learn

- How modern full-stack engineering changes when applications are powered by LLMs, Generative AI, and autonomous or semi-autonomous agents. 
 - How to engineer user experiences around probabilistic AI behavior, asynchronous execution, streaming results, uncertainty, human oversight, and failure recovery. 
 - How enterprise applications securely interact with agents, models, tools, identity systems, enterprise data, and reusable AI platform capabilities. 
 - How AI applications are designed and operated across a global aerospace and defense company with complex security, data, and integration requirements. 
 - How emerging AI application patterns, agent interoperability standards, and AI-assisted software development practices are changing modern product engineering. 
 - How engineers in India collaborate with global AI, product, platform, architecture, and business teams to deliver enterprise AI products. 

Qualifications You Must Have : 

- A Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering. 
 - Minimum of 5 years of relevant professional experience 
 - A minimum of 3 years of hands-on full-stack software development experience, including experience building production web applications using modern frontend frameworks and backend APIs or services. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with JavaScript or TypeScript and a modern frontend framework such as React, Next. js, Angular, or Vue. 
 - Backend development experience using Python, Node. js, Java, . NET, or similar technologies, including building and consuming REST APIs, microservices, and application services. 
 - Experience with application architecture, authentication and authorization, state management, asynchronous processing, databases, API integration, and enterprise application integration. 
 - Strong software engineering fundamentals including source control, code reviews, automated testing, CI/CD, debugging, performance optimization, security, and maintainable code. 
 - Hands-on experience integrating Generative AI, LLM APIs, AI services, or other AI-enabled capabilities into software applications. 
 - Experience taking features or applications from design through development, testing, deployment, and production support. 

Qualifications We Prefer

- Experience building production conversational AI, Generative AI, or agentic applications. 
 - Experience implementing streaming interfaces using Server-Sent Events, WebSockets, or similar technologies and supporting asynchronous or long-running AI workflows. 
 - Experience working with structured model outputs, tool calls, retrieval results, citations, RAG, agent state, or other AI-native application patterns. 
 - Experience building human-in-the-loop approvals, agent-control experiences, workflow applications, developer tools, technical consoles, or configuration-heavy enterprise products. 
 - Working knowledge of LLMs, agents, tools, context, memory, evaluation, guardrails, AI observability, and emerging interoperability approaches such as MCP. 
 - Experience deploying applications using containers, cloud services, Kubernetes, CI/CD, and modern DevOps practices. 
 - Experience with enterprise design systems, accessibility standards, responsive design, application telemetry, and production performance monitoring. 
 - Experience using AI-assisted coding and development tools to accelerate design implementation, coding, testing, debugging, documentation, and delivery.

data.title: Java Application Development Intermediate Programmer Analyst
data.description:
The Applications Development Intermediate Programmer Analyst is an intermediate level position responsible for participation in the establishment and implementation of new or revised application systems and programs in coordination with the Technology team. The overall objective of this role is to contribute to applications systems analysis and programming activities. 

Responsibilities: 

- Conduct tasks related to feasibility studies, time and cost estimates, IT planning, risk technology, applications development, model development, and establish and implement new or revised applications systems and programs to meet specific business needs or user areas
 - Monitor and control all phases of development process and analysis, design, construction, testing, and implementation as well as provide user and operational support on applications to business users
 - Utilize in-depth specialty knowledge of applications development to analyze complex problems/issues, provide evaluation of business process, system process, and industry standards, and make evaluative judgement
 - Recommend and develop security measures in post implementation analysis of business usage to ensure successful system design and functionality
 - Consult with users/clients and other technology groups on issues, recommend advanced programming solutions, and install and assist customer exposure systems
 - Ensure essential procedures are followed and help define operating standards and processes
 - Has the ability to operate with a limited level of direct supervision. 
 - Can exercise independence of judgement and autonomy. 
 - Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency. 

Qualifications: 

- 5-8 years in the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC). 
 - Demonstrated solid experience in application development, with a proven history of delivering robust, scalable, and high-performance solutions. 
 - Expert-level proficiency in modern Java technologies, including Core Java, Java EE, Spring Boot, Spring Microservices, and RESTful API design. 
 - Proven expertise in designing and developing secure and efficient APIs and Web Services utilizing REST protocols. 
 - Extensive experience in architectural design and development of integrated enterprise-grade solutions, with a strong emphasis on non-functional requirements such as scalability, availability, resilience, and data consistency. 
 - Exceptional ability to write clean, efficient, and well-documented code (Core Java, J2EE, Collections, Multithreading), coupled with advanced debugging and performance optimization skills. 
 - Strong experience in defining and implementing comprehensive testing strategies, including unit, integration, and end-to-end testing, ensuring high test coverage and software quality. 
 - Hands-on experience with high-throughput messaging platforms, such as Solace, Kafka, or other industry-standard message brokers. 
 - In-depth understanding and practical application of security principles, including Authentication, Authorization, encryption, and various security protocols. 
 - Solid practical experience with modern code versioning systems, specifically GitHub Enterprise. 
 - Extensive experience with Continuous Integration/Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) pipelines and automation tools, including hands-on experience in deploying and managing applications within these frameworks. 
 - Familiarity with leading cloud platforms and proficiency in containerization technologies like Docker, along with orchestration tools such as Kubernetes. Experience with AWS ECS and Red Hat OpenShift is highly advantageous. 
 - Demonstrated interest or experience in exploring, integrating, and leveraging AI-powered tools and solutions to enhance application development workflows. 
 - Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, complemented by strong problem-solving, analytical, and critical decision-making abilities.

data.title: Senior Platform Software Engineer
data.description:
Job Description

Owns moderately complex components within platform services or SDKs; leads team-level improvements to integration frameworks and developer tooling. Performs deep debugging across a bounded set of distributed services, driving fixes that protect downstream consumers and upgrade paths. Analyzes usage, performance, and error budgets for specific platform surfaces; implements targeted resilience and capacity optimizations. Authors and curates team-scoped documentation, samples, and adoption guidance. 

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

Platform Software Development: 

- Own a bounded platform component (service module, SDK area) and evolve its contracts for multi-tenant use. 
 - Perform deep debugging across a limited-service graph; drive compatibility-safe remediation plans. 
 - Implement targeted resilience/capacity patterns and document adoption guidance for team consumers. 

Software Development and Coding - Design, Testing, and Optimization: 

- Designs software solutions and analyzes and helps identify requirements to achieve business and operational goals, independently. 
 - Adheres to and suggests improvements to all phases of the software development lifecycle. 
 - Utilizes working knowledge to develop new software features and enhancements following design specifications and develops documents to clarify software design and code. 
 - Leads code reviews in designated areas to help drive improvements. 
 - Conducts debugging and troubleshooting to identify and fix moderately complex software issues. Develops fixes for identified issues. 
 - Implements software testing (e. g. , functional and non-functional testing), quality assurance processes, software error logging, monitoring, and observability for effective debugging, ensuring review by manager and/or lead throughout the process. 
 - Exercises judgment and discretion to conduct performance profiling and optimization of coding. 
 - Troubleshoots and resolves moderately complex issues related to application programming interface (API) functionality and integration. 
 - Implements moderately complex API versioning, lifecycle, and interoperability strategies. 

Software Architecture - Software System Structural Design: 

- Designs and develops software, systems, and services aligned to pre-defined system architecture. 
 - Develops working knowledge of software architecture decisions and best practices. 
 - Collaborates with team leads to review work to ensure alignment with software architecture. 
 - Implements moderately complex performance optimization and scalability strategies in software design. 

Issue/Defect Collaboration - Software Products Support: 

- Collaborates within and beyond immediate team to understand customer issues and align solutions. 
 - May provide technical guidance and support to customers regarding customer-reported issues, independently. 
 - Coaches, mentors, and guides others to advocate for customers' interests and suggests product enhancements based on feedback. 
 - Influences team to ensure customer satisfaction through timely resolution of issues and effective communication. 
 - Implements customer issue and/or defect handling and training processes, independently. 
 - Investigates and troubleshoots complex product maintenance issues to ensure customer agreement on short- and long-term solutions (e. g. , future enhancements). 

Practices and Standards Compliance - Security and Compliance: 

- Collaborates with the team to establish and follow development practices and coding standards. 
 - Exercises judgment and discretion to ensure code quality and adherence to broad acceptance criteria during development. 
 - Keeps up to date with industry best practices and applies them to software development processes. 
 - Implements secure coding practices to prevent security vulnerabilities. 

Development Operations - System Maintenance: 

- Performs periodic maintenance and testing operations for systems that require upgrading or patching (e. g. , for critical vulnerabilities). 
 - Exercises judgment and discretion to drive improvements, ensure automation, testing, and debugging of systems to ensure service/product availability, health, support, and reliability. 

Core Responsibilities

Planning & Execution: 

- Independently manages work, monitoring timelines and deliverables to ensure projects or initiatives stay on track and meet requirements. Proactively prioritizes work and adapts to resource or timeline shifts, suggesting adjustments to maintain project efficiency. 

Collaboration & Partnership: 

- Collaborates across teams to align on expectations and achieve shared objectives. Builds and maintains a comprehensive understanding of business, stakeholder, and/or customer needs to build and support effective partnerships. Actively listens to diverse perspectives and asks questions to ensure understanding of others. 

Problem Solving: 

- Independently identifies and addresses standard and non-standard issues in accordance with standard practices, escalating more complex issues as appropriate. Analyzes data and/or information from multiple sources to troubleshoot standard and non-standard errors. Contributes to knowledge sharing and best practices. 

Continuous Learning: 

- Embraces continuous learning by actively seeking to build knowledge and new skills and/or tools and staying current with industry trends and best practices. Seeks out and leverages feedback and training to improve skills. Contributes to a culture of continuous learning and knowledge sharing with team members. 

Continuous Improvement: 

- Develops ideas and recommends updates to increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows within a team. Seeks input from team members on alternative approaches and methods for improving work. 

About Us

Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives. 

True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That's why we're committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs. 

We're committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation-request_mb@oracle. com or by calling 1-888-404-2494 in the United States. 

Oracle is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans' status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Oracle will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.

Planning & Execution: 

- Independently manages work, monitoring timelines and deliverables to ensure projects or initiatives stay on track and meet requirements. Proactively prioritizes work and adapts to resource or timeline shifts, suggesting adjustments to maintain project efficiency.

data.title: Senior Manager, Platform Software Engineering
data.description:
Job Description

Leads one or more platform teams; defines tactical and key strategic elements for middleware evolution serving multiple consumers. Accountable for performance, cost control, and reliability outcomes; escalations for distributed debugging and upgrade safety. Drives significant cross-team improvements to observability, SLOs, and resilience patterns. Engages stakeholders inside and outside the group; socializes migration plans and adoption playbooks. 

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

Platform Software Development: 

- Lead multiple platform teams to standardize middleware patterns and client libraries used by several consumer teams. 
 - Establish group-level guardrails for APIs/SDKs, deprecation strategies, and upgrade playbooks; track adoption and risk. 
 - Sponsor shared observability frameworks and capacity models across teams; review error-budget posture and corrective actions. 

Software Development and Coding - Design, Testing, and Optimization: 

- Leads teams and provides technical recommendations and guidance in designing software solutions and identifying, analyzing and ensuring alignment with requirements. 
 - Manages the execution of processes to develop and guide new software features and enhancements following design specifications, ensuring accessibility, and to develop documents to clarify software design and code. 
 - Leads code and/or functional reviews to drive improvements across a project. 
 - Leads and reviews teams to conduct debugging and troubleshooting to identify and fix software issues across multiple components or functional areas. 
 - Provides teams guidance to implement software testing (e. g. , functional and non-functional), quality assurance processes, software error logging, monitoring, and observability for effective debugging. 
 - Utilizes an analytic approach to conduct performance profiling and optimization of coding. 
 - Leads teams in troubleshooting and resolving issues related to application programming interface (API) functionality and integration. 
 - Leads teams to implement API versioning, lifecycle, and interoperability strategies. 

Software Architecture - Software System Structural Design: 

- Leads teams to design and develop software, systems, and services. 
 - Acts as a role model to provide technical guidance and domain expertise in software architecture decisions and best practices. 
 - Leads teams to conduct periodic reviews and ensures adherence to architectural framework(s) and internal development practices and standards. 
 - Collaborates with cross-functional teams to align and build software architecture with business and/or customer goals and priorities in focus. 
 - Leads teams to implement performance optimization and scalability strategies in software design. 
 - Impacts teams to conduct regular technology research and evaluation for architectural enhancements. 

Issue/Defect Collaboration - Software Products Support: 

- Collaborates with stakeholders and external clients and/or partners to understand customer issues and align solutions. 
 - Leads team(s) to provide technical guidance and appropriately prioritize support to customers regarding reported issues. 
 - Acts as a role model for teams to advocate for customers' interests and suggests product enhancements based on feedback. 
 - Develops, modifies, and executes policies to ensure customer satisfaction through timely resolution of issues and effective communication. 
 - Leads teams through processes for handling customer issues and/or defects handling and directs them to training opportunities as needed. 
 - Manages the investigation and troubleshooting of complex product maintenance issues to ensure customer agreement on short- and long-term solutions. 

Practices and Standards Compliance - Security and Compliance: 

- Collaborates with teams and other stakeholders within and outside of group to establish, follow, and enforce documented security criteria, development industry best practices and processes, and coding standards. 
 - Ensures clarity of teams' operational objectives for adherence to broad acceptance criteria. 
 - Implements moderately complex secure software development practices requiring information gathering and analysis to prevent security vulnerabilities. 

Development Operations - System Maintenance: 

- Leads teams in performing periodic maintenance and testing operations for systems that require upgrading or patching (e. g. , for critical vulnerabilities). 
 - Delegates assignments to teams to implement and evolve standard operating procedures (SOP) for development and for driving improvements, ensuring automation, testing, and debugging of systems to ensure service/product availability, health, support, and reliability. 

Core Responsibilities

Planning & Execution: 

- Manages multiple medium- to large-scale projects or initiatives across teams, ensuring timelines, deliverables, and budgets when applicable are monitored and met. Provides direction to teams on project work, setting priorities, and aligning with business needs. Guides teams on adjusting plans to accommodate resource or timeline changes. 

Collaboration & Partnership: 

- Drives cross-functional partnerships to align expectations and shared objectives across multiple teams. Coaches team members to develop strategic relationships with business leaders, stakeholders, and external partners to foster collaboration and long-term success. Promotes inclusivity by actively seeking and listening to diverse perspectives, ensuring others feel heard and respected. 

Problem Solving: 

- Provides direction to multiple teams on addressing complex operational and/or technical issues as well as providing guidance on analyzing complex data and/or information to identify solutions. Reviews and provides insights into unresolved or critical issues, helping the team to identify potential solutions. 

Continuous Learning: 

- Models engaging in continuous learning to deepen expertise and stay ahead of industry trends, integrating best practices into strategic planning. Leverages feedback to drive personal and team skill improvements. Identifies skill gaps across teams, and empowers team members to pursue learning and knowledge sharing opportunities that build their expertise in new areas and coaches them to apply learnings to advance the organization. 

Continuous Improvement: 

- Drives team to collaborate on, develop, and implement ideas to increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows within and across teams, providing oversight. Guides team to adopt new ideas for alternative approaches and methods and encourages feedback for continued improvement. 

Performance and Development:

data.title: Lead Infrastructure Engineer
data.description:
Overview

WELCOME TO SITA

At SITA, we keep airports moving, airlines flying smoothly, and borders open. Our technology and communication innovations power the success of the global air travel industry. 

You'll find us in 95% of international airports, working closely with over 2, 500 transportation and government clients. Each partnership brings unique challenges, and we thrive on delivering fresh solutions and cutting-edge tech to keep operations running like clockwork. We don't just move the world forward - we're proud to be recognized as a Great Place to Work® by our employees and certified in most of our growing locations. Here, we feel empowered, supported, and inspired to grow. 

Are you ready to love your job?

The adventure begins right here, with you, at SITA. 

About The Role & Team

The Lead Engineer (LE) serves as a principal technical leader within customer projects, overseeing the deployment and transition of technical solutions to address client requirements. Acting as a bridge between high-level architectural design and hands-on delivery, the LE ensures that solutions are practical, scalable, cost-efficient, and aligned with both organizational objectives and specific customer demands.

data.title: Senior Principal - GCP Platform Architect
data.description:
Business Introduction

GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems. 

Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines. 

Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges. 

Job Purpose

The Principal GCP Platform Architect owns the technical design of the Google Cloud platform, defining the reference architectures, patterns and standards that make solutions secure, scalable and consistent, and guiding engineering teams in applying them. The role provides design assurance across the Google Cloud and Edge services, architects for reliability and resilience rather than treating them as later additions, and designs AI into the platform through reference patterns for AI-assisted delivery and intelligent operations. 

The role sets standards and assures designs; it does not build. Engineering delivery sits with the platform engineering teams, backlog order sits with the Product Owner, domain target architecture and the architecture team sit with the Platform Architecture Director, and enterprise-level standards sit with Enterprise Architecture. Solution designs for major cross-domain initiatives sit with the Solution Architect in Enterprise Architecture. 

Key Responsibilities

- Define reference architectures, patterns and standards for the platform, aligned to DPTF strategy and to enterprise architecture. 
 - Design AI into the platform, producing reference patterns for AI-assisted delivery and for intelligent, self-healing operations. 
 - Architect for reliability and resilience by design, so that platform SLOs and error budgets are achievable rather than aspirational. 
 - Provide design assurance and technical guidance to engineering teams, reviewing designs against the standards before build rather than after. 
 - Ensure platform solutions are secure and compliant, including GxP requirements where the platform supports regulated activity. 
 - Evaluate and introduce new technologies, measuring the result against architecture OKRs rather than adopting on vendor claim. 
 - Set architecture standards that supplier and managed-service solutions must meet, and assure their designs to the same bar as internal work. 
 - Partner with Enterprise Architecture and Information Security on standards, roadmaps and exceptions. 
 - Increase pattern reuse across the platform, tracking where teams have adopted a pattern and where they have diverged and why. 
 - Reduce rework by intervening early in design, and evidence the reduction rather than asserting it. 
 - Advise the Product Owner and Platform Manager on the architectural consequence of roadmap choices, including technical debt being accepted. 
 - Hold the boundaries with the Platform Architecture Director on domain target architecture, the Solution Architect on cross-domain initiative designs, and the engineering teams on build. 

Professional Qualifications

- Degree in a technology or engineering discipline, or equivalent practical experience (e. g. , Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems). 
 - Architecture certifications desirable (e. g. , TOGAF, or recognised cloud or network architecture certification relevant to the platform). 

Experience Required

- Overall 15 years and typically 6-8 years in technology architecture or senior engineering, including at least three years producing reference architectures or standards others build to. 
 - Strong experience as a Google Cloud Architect. Knowledge of networking, security, and compliance in cloud environments. 
 - Experience deploying, configuring and managing services in Google Cloud Platform including AI Services
 - Experience running design assurance or architecture review, including declining designs that did not meet the standard. 
 - Track record of architecting for reliability and resilience, working to SLOs and error budgets. 
 - Experience designing secure and compliant solutions, ideally including GxP or another regulated context. 
 - Experience setting architecture standards that supplier or managed-service solutions had to meet. 
 - Awareness of AI reference patterns for assisted delivery and intelligent operations. 

Skills/Background

- Ability to influence engineering teams without line authority, so that patterns are adopted rather than circumvented. 
 - Judgement about when to grant an architectural exception and when to hold the standard. 
 - Clear design documentation, since patterns are only reusable if others can follow them. 
 - Comfort challenging vendor claims and evaluating technology on measured outcome. 
 - Pragmatism about technical debt, making the cost visible rather than blocking delivery outright. 
 - Collaborative habit with Enterprise Architecture and Security, whose standards constrain the platform. 

#AGTech

Skills

API Management, Automation Technology, Cloud Architectures, Cloud Financial Operations, Containerization, Database Management, Design Assurance, DevOps, Disaster Recovery (DR), Edge Computing, Google Cloud Platform Architecture, Infrastructure As Code (IaC), Kubernetes, Networking Concepts, Performance Optimizations, Reference Architectures, Security Compliance, Serverless Computing, System Monitors, Virtualization

Why GSK?

Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. 

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2. 5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases - to impact health at scale. 

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we're committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people. 

Inclusion at GSK: 

As an employer committed to Inclusion, we encourage you to reach out if you need any adjustments during the recruitment process. 

Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN. recruitment-adjustments@gsk. com to discuss your needs. 

Important notice to Employment businesses/ Agencies

GSK does not accept referrals from employment businesses and/or employment agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact GSK's commercial and general procurement/human resources department to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to GSK. The obtaining of prior written authorization is a condition precedent to any agreement (verbal or written) between the employment business/ agency and GSK. In the absence of such written authorization being obtained any actions undertaken by the employment business/agency shall be deemed to have been performed without the consent or contractual agreement of GSK. data.title: Senior Principal Platform Engineer – QA
data.description:
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems. 

Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines. 

Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges. 

Job Purpose

The Senior Principal Platform Engineer - QA will help shape and evolve the organisation's quality engineering platform, enabling teams to build, test, deploy and operate software faster, more securely, and more reliably. The QA role will set the testing and quality standards helping to build test automation that can be adopted across platform and application teams. They will also mentor the engineers around them, and treats the teams who consume the test automation as customers. The role works through infrastructure-as-code and golden paths rather than manual configuration, uses AI-assisted engineering across code generation, review and testing, and engineers reliability in by defining SLOs, instrumenting for observability and automating away toil. 

Engineering roadmap and direction sit with the Engineering Director, reference architecture and standards sit with the Platform Architect, backlog order sits with the Product Owner, and deep reliability engineering sits with the Site Reliability Engineer deployed from Reliability Engineering & Operations. 

Key Responsibilities

Quality strategy and architecture

- Define the platform quality engineering strategy, test pyramid and quality gates for all cloud platform products. 
 - Set standards for testing infrastructure-as-code: static analysis, policy-as-code, unit, integration and end-to-end tests for Terraform modules. 
 - Design ephemeral test environments that provision, validate and tear down platform stacks on every change. 

Continuous verification and automation

- Build shift-left quality into CI/CD: automated gates for security, compliance, cost and drift before merge and release. 
 - Establish contract and compatibility testing so module and API changes never break consuming business teams. 
 - Lead resilience and chaos testing for platforms. 
 - Drive performance and scale testing for self-service provisioning paths. 

GxP and computerised system assurance

- Modernise qualification from document-heavy validation to risk-based, automated Assurance. 
 - Generate qualification evidence (IQ/OQ traceability, test results, approvals) directly from pipelines. 
 - Partner with Quality, GRC and the CISO office to keep evidence audit-ready for GxP, SOX and data integrity requirements. 

Images, supply chain and security quality

- Own test frameworks for VM, OS, database and container image bakeries: CIS benchmarks, vulnerability thresholds, SBOM and signing checks. 
 - Integrate CNAPP and code scanning findings (e. g. Wiz, GitHub Advanced Security) into release gates with clear SLAs. 

AI and agentic platform quality

- Define evaluation frameworks for platform AI agents: accuracy, safety & guardrail 
 - Test agent-generated artifacts for correctness, policy compliance and blast radius before execution. 

Engineering leadership

- Set quality metrics and SLOs, report them to platform and security leadership, and drive corrective actions. 
 - Mentor engineers across platform teams; grow a quality-engineering community of practice. 
 - Evaluate and select tooling; make build-vs-buy recommendations. 

Required Experience And Skills

- 15+ years in software or platform engineering, with 3+ years leading quality or test engineering for tenant platforms at enterprise scale. 
 - Deep hands-on Terraform experience 
 - Strong policy-as-code skills around OPA/Rego 
 - Production experience on Azure and GCP; working knowledge of Kubernetes and GitOps 
 - Built CI/CD quality gates in GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps or similar. 
 - Proficient in at least one of Python, Go or TypeScript for test frameworks and tooling. 
 - Experience in a regulated industry (life sciences, pharma, finance or healthcare), including GxP or equivalent validation. 
 - Track record of setting technical direction across multiple teams without direct authority. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience testing LLM-based or agentic systems 
 - Familiarity with software supply chain standards: SLSA, SBOM (SPDX/CycloneDX), Sigstore/cosign. 
 - Chaos engineering tools such as Azure Chaos Studio, LitmusChaos or Gremlin. 
 - Experience with Red Hat Ansible Automation Platform, Azure Arc or hybrid estates. 
 - Certifications such as Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Google Professional Cloud Architect, ISTQB Advanced or CKA. 

Leadership behaviors and ways of working

- Quality as an engineering discipline: builds automation and paved roads, not manual sign-off queues. 
 - Risk-based judgement: scales testing rigour to patient, product and data-integrity impact. 
 - Influence without authority: aligns platform, security, Quality and GRC stakeholders on shared standards. 
 - Hands-on credibility: writes and reviews code, and can debug a failing pipeline alongside the team. 
 - Clear communicator: turns quality data into decisions for senior leadership and auditors alike. 

#AGTech

Skills

API Management, Automation Technology, Cloud Architectures, Cloud Financial Operations, Containerization, Database Management, DevOps, Disaster Recovery (DR), Edge Computing, Infrastructure As Code (IaC), Networking Concepts, Performance Optimizations, Scripting, Serverless Computing, Software Frameworks, Software Testing, System Monitors, Test Automation, UI Automation Testing, Virtualization

Why GSK?

Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. 

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2. 5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases - to impact health at scale. 

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we're committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

data.title: Manager, Cloud Security Engineer
data.description:
About Workstreet

At Workstreet, we're on an exciting journey to help businesses scale securely by designing and implementing cutting-edge security and compliance programs. As a fast-growing startup, we specialize in a wide range of GRC (governance, risk, and compliance) services that support frameworks across SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, CMMC, NIST 800-171, NIST 800-53, and FedRAMP. We empower companies to meet regulatory requirements and enhance their cybersecurity posture from day one. 

Get to Know the Security Services Team

We are the team that turns complex security requirements and compliance frameworks into infrastructure and services that actually work. Moving fast and taking true end-to-end ownership, our Cloud Security Engineering team designs hardened AWS, Azure, and GCP environments, writes Terraform baselines, and fixes failing controls to meet frameworks like SOC 2, ISO 27001, CMMC, and FedRAMP. We do not hide behind process or just point out gaps. We step in, build solutions, and deliver real security posture improvements with minimal disruption. 

What makes this team special isn't just our technical depth; it is how we back each other up. Our strongest engineers are the ones building reusable modules, writing custom tools, jumping into channels to unblock teammates, and mentoring without being asked. From early-stage startups to regulated enterprises, you will work directly with clients, take on real ownership early, and be surrounded by people who want to see you get good. If you enjoy solving tough security problems and want to be part of a team that is scrappy enough to move fast but seasoned enough to get it right, you will be in good company here. 

The Opportunity

Workstreet is seeking a Manager, Cloud Security Engineering to lead a team of Cloud Security Engineers who design, build, and operate cloud security controls for our clients across AWS, Azure, and GCP. This is a player-coach leadership role for someone who has built hardened cloud environments themselves and now wants to multiply that impact through a team. 

You will own the quality, capacity, and consistency of Cloud Security Engineering delivery: hiring and developing engineers, staffing and overseeing client engagements, setting engineering standards, and serving as the escalation point for technical and relationship issues. You will stay close enough to the work to review architecture, unblock engineers, and step into client conversations when it matters, while working alongside the GRC delivery teams to deliver outcomes that hold up in front of auditors and adversaries alike. 

You will work with client engineering leads and executives during U. S. Eastern Time business hours, and you will be accountable for ensuring that every client environment achieves drift-resistant, code-defined security rather than documentation-only compliance. 

What You'll Do

- Lead and develop the team: manage, coach, and grow Cloud Security Engineers through clear expectations, regular feedback, performance reviews, and defined career paths. 
 - Hire and onboard: build the interview process, recruit and select engineers, and onboard them so they take direct ownership of client work quickly. 
 - Own delivery across the client portfolio: plan capacity, assign engineers to engagements, track milestones and quality, and make sure multiple concurrent engagements stay on schedule without sacrificing technical rigor. 
 - Serve as the escalation point: handle technical and relationship escalations calmly, and lead conversations with client engineering leads and executives on scope, risk, and remediation priorities. 
 - Set engineering standards: define and maintain reusable Terraform and CloudFormation baselines, landing zone patterns, IAM and logging modules, and code review practices that make client environments drift-resistant. 
 - Guide cloud architecture decisions: review designs for AWS multi-account structures, Azure Hub-Spoke and Landing Zone architectures, least-privilege IAM, network segmentation, and encryption using services such as AWS KMS and Azure Key Vault. 
 - Direct native security tooling: set the approach for deploying and tuning AWS GuardDuty, Security Hub, AWS Config, Microsoft Sentinel, and Defender for Cloud, including logging pipelines for SIEM ingestion. 
 - Embed security in delivery pipelines: establish guardrails and automated remediation workflows, including SAST, DAST, and secret scanning in GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps. 
 - Translate frameworks into functional controls: ensure technical controls satisfy SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, GDPR, CMMC, NIST 800-171, NIST 800-53, and FedRAMP requirements in practice, not only on a compliance map, and that evidence supports audit readiness. 
 - Oversee incident response: set the escalation path for cloud security incidents and ensure rapid containment, diagnostics, and post-incident improvements. 
 - Collaborate across Security Services and GRC: coordinate with GRC delivery teams, and provide technical input on scoping, statements of work, and new client opportunities. 
 - Continuously improve the practice: track delivery health, remediation cycle times, and module reuse, and invest in tooling and automation that removes repetitive work for the team. 
 - Stay hands-on where it counts: step into architecture reviews, complex remediations, and client workshops to unblock engineers and maintain technical credibility. 

Who You Are

- Technical leader of cloud security engineers: experienced people manager who has hired, coached, and retained engineers, and who sets a high bar for work quality while backing the team under pressure. 
 - Multi-cloud security expert: deep, hands-on background securing AWS, Azure, and GCP environments, including IAM strategy (RBAC, ABAC, permission boundaries, federated identity via Okta or Entra ID), network zoning, encryption, and logging. 
 - Infrastructure as Code authority: fluent in Terraform, with working knowledge of CloudFormation, Python, or Bash, and able to review module design, versioning, state management, and provider security controls. 
 - GRC infrastructure strategist: maps technical cloud configurations to SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, and HIPAA requirements, and distinguishes compliance mappings from functional technical controls. 
 - Delivery operator: thrives in a fast-paced startup environment, balancing multiple client portfolios and competing priorities while keeping the team focused on rapid, well-governed remediation. 
 - Trusted client advisor: partners with US-based technology founders, DevOps leads, and executive teams, handles escalations with calm professionalism, and leads architectural workshops. 
 - Elite communicator: delivers precise written and verbal English communication that translates complex cloud risks into clear business decisions for both engineers and executives. 

What Will Help You Succeed

- Validated cloud security credentials: active certifications such as AWS Certified Security - Specialty, Azure Security Engineer Associate, GCP Professional Cloud Security Engineer, CISSP, CISM, or CISA. 
 - Experience building or scaling a security engineering team: in a consulting, MSSP, or hyper-growth technology environment, including capacity planning and resourcing across client engagements. 
 - Federal and regulated environment experience: hands-on history building CMMC-compliant enclaves or FedRAMP security architectures, including NIST 800-53 and NIST 800-171 control implementation. 
 - FIPS 140 encryption implementation: practical experience configuring and enforcing FIPS 140 standards across cloud services. 
 - Container and DevSecOps engineering: experience securing microservice architectures, Docker, and Kubernetes, including runtime security controls and vulnerability scanning. 
 - Zero Trust deployment models: direct experience with identity-centric security policies, network micro-segmentation, and context-aware access. 
 - Monitoring and detection tooling: advanced use of logging platforms, SIEM, vulnerability management engines, and threat hunting feeds. 

What We Offer

- Career Development: Clear path with mentorship and training opportunities.
