 - Competitive Compensation: A competitive base salary with regular performance reviews linked to merit-based appraisals and bonus opportunities. 
 - Growth Opportunity: Early-stage company with significant room for career advancement. 
 - Remote-First Culture: Flexibility to work from anywhere while collaborating with a global team. 

What You'll Need To Thrive

 - A reliable, high-speed internet connection and a professional home office environment that supports confidential conversations, virtual interviews, and uninterrupted collaboration. 
 - Commitment to working a standard schedule of 8: 00 AM-5: 00 PM U. S. Eastern Time (ET) to effectively collaborate with team members, stakeholders, and cross-functional partners while ensuring timely communication and support.

Software Engineering Team Lead - C++ / ADAS Resimulation

Position Summary

We are seeking an experienced Software Engineering Team Lead to lead a team developing C++-based resimulation solutions, applications and automation for large-scale ADAS analysis. 

This is a hands-on technical leadership role combining software development, team leadership and delivery ownership. The Team Lead will actively design, develop, debug, test and optimize C++ software alongside the team, while guiding engineers, driving execution and ensuring software quality. 

Key Responsibilities

 - Support resimulation-based analysis of ADAS perception, sensor processing and control algorithms on large-scale datasets.

 - Collaborate with Product Owners, Architects, ADAS developers, validation and platform teams.

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Electronics, Robotics or related discipline.

 - Strong Linux application development, debugging and performance optimization experience. 
 - Strong understanding of object-oriented design, design patterns, multithreading and software architecture. 
 - Experience technically leading software engineers while remaining hands-on with development. 
 - Experience with software development lifecycle, testing, CI/CD and software quality practices.

Preferred Qualifications

Job Description Summary

The Senior Manager - Systems & Verification Engineering will lead Systems and Verification & Validation organisation supporting CVUS digital products across on-premises, cloud and hybrid environments. The role owns system integration, system-level verification, test strategy and automation capability for the Digital portfolio, including the CVUS Digital Viewer. As a functional leader, this person will build and develop a high-performing team, strengthen technical capability and improve product quality and release predictability through automation-first verification practices. 

GE HealthCare is a leading global medical technology and digital solutions innovator. Our mission is to improve lives in the moments that matter. Unlock your ambition, turn ideas into world-changing realities, and join an organization where every voice makes a difference, and every difference builds a healthier world. 

Job Description

The Senior Manager - Systems & Verification Engineering will lead Systems and Verification & Validation organization supporting CVUS digital products across on-premises, cloud and hybrid environments. The role owns system integration, system-level verification, test strategy and automation capability for the Digital portfolio, including the CVUS Digital Viewer. As a functional leader, this person will build and develop a high-performing team, strengthen technical capability and improve product quality and release predictability through automation-first verification practices. 

Roles And Responsibilities

- Lead and develop the CVUS Digital Systems and V&V organization in Bengaluru. 
 - 
 - Own system requirements, interfaces, workflows, integration strategy, system behavior and verification approach. 
 - Develop and execute system V&V strategies for on-premises, cloud and hybrid digital products. 
 - Define and evolve scalable test automation frameworks, tools and infrastructure for continuous, regression and release testing. 
 - Increase automation across API, integration, workflow, system, performance and end-to-end product testing. 
 - Ensure requirements traceability from customer and system needs through verification evidence and release readiness. 
 - Own system-level verification planning, execution, defect management, risk-based testing and quality assessment. 
 - Partner with Software Engineering, Architecture, Product Management and Clinical teams to build testability and quality into product design. 
 - Establish metrics for automation coverage, test effectiveness, defect leakage, regression health and release readiness. 
 - Partner with Quality, Regulatory and Cybersecurity teams to ensure verification evidence supports design controls, risk management and regulatory expectations. 
 - Build, hire, coach and retain strong Systems and V&V talent; own workforce planning, performance management, competency development and succession. 
 - Collaborate with global CVUS teams and communicate system quality, verification status, risks and release readiness to engineering leadership. 

Educational Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering or a related engineering discipline. 

Required Qualifications

- 15+ years of progressive experience in software-intensive product development, systems engineering, verification and validation or related disciplines. 
 - 5+ years of functional engineering leadership experience, including people management, talent development, performance management and organizational capability building. 
 - Proven experience leading Systems Engineering and/or V&V teams for complex digital products. 
 - Demonstrated experience defining test automation strategies and implementing scalable automation frameworks. 
 - Strong experience in system requirements, interfaces, integration, verification planning, traceability, defect management and release-readiness assessment. 
 - Experience testing complex products across on-premises, cloud and/or hybrid environments. 
 - Strong knowledge of software development lifecycle, system architecture, APIs, distributed systems, CI/CD and automated testing. 
 - Proven ability to build teams, develop technical talent and drive execution in a global matrix organization. 
 - Strong leadership, communication, stakeholder-management and problem-solving skills. 

Desired Qualifications

- Experience with medical-device, healthcare or other regulated digital products. 
 - Knowledge of healthcare interoperability standards including DICOM, HL7 and FHIR. 
 - Experience with Azure, AWS or GCP and cloud-based system verification. 
 - Experience integrating automated verification into CI/CD and DevOps/DevSecOps pipelines. 
 - Knowledge of IEC 62304, ISO 14971, IEC 62366-1, design controls and risk-based verification. 
 - Experience modernizing manual V&V organizations towards an automation-first verification model. 
 - Demonstrated success improving product quality and release predictability using engineering metrics, root-cause analysis and continuous improvement. 

Common Engineering Expectations

- Cloud-native and hybrid cloud/on-premises product development using AWS services. 
 - Containers, Kubernetes, CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code and production observability. 
 - Secure engineering, identity and access management, encryption, secrets management and DevSecOps. 
 - Performance, scalability, availability, reliability, fault tolerance and disaster recovery.

data.title: Senior Principal Platform Engineer – QA
data.description:
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems. 

Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines. 

Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges. 

Job Purpose

The Senior Principal Platform Engineer - QA will help shape and evolve the organisation's quality engineering platform, enabling teams to build, test, deploy and operate software faster, more securely, and more reliably. The QA role will set the testing and quality standards helping to build test automation that can be adopted across platform and application teams. They will also mentor the engineers around them, and treats the teams who consume the test automation as customers. The role works through infrastructure-as-code and golden paths rather than manual configuration, uses AI-assisted engineering across code generation, review and testing, and engineers reliability in by defining SLOs, instrumenting for observability and automating away toil. 

Engineering roadmap and direction sit with the Engineering Director, reference architecture and standards sit with the Platform Architect, backlog order sits with the Product Owner, and deep reliability engineering sits with the Site Reliability Engineer deployed from Reliability Engineering & Operations. 

Key Responsibilities

Quality strategy and architecture

- Define the platform quality engineering strategy, test pyramid and quality gates for all cloud platform products. 
 - Set standards for testing infrastructure-as-code: static analysis, policy-as-code, unit, integration and end-to-end tests for Terraform modules. 
 - Design ephemeral test environments that provision, validate and tear down platform stacks on every change. 

Continuous verification and automation

- Build shift-left quality into CI/CD: automated gates for security, compliance, cost and drift before merge and release. 
 - Establish contract and compatibility testing so module and API changes never break consuming business teams. 
 - Lead resilience and chaos testing for platforms. 
 - Drive performance and scale testing for self-service provisioning paths. 

GxP and computerised system assurance

- Modernise qualification from document-heavy validation to risk-based, automated Assurance. 
 - Generate qualification evidence (IQ/OQ traceability, test results, approvals) directly from pipelines. 
 - Partner with Quality, GRC and the CISO office to keep evidence audit-ready for GxP, SOX and data integrity requirements. 

Images, supply chain and security quality

- Own test frameworks for VM, OS, database and container image bakeries: CIS benchmarks, vulnerability thresholds, SBOM and signing checks. 
 - Integrate CNAPP and code scanning findings (e. g. Wiz, GitHub Advanced Security) into release gates with clear SLAs. 

AI and agentic platform quality

- Define evaluation frameworks for platform AI agents: accuracy, safety & guardrail 
 - Test agent-generated artifacts for correctness, policy compliance and blast radius before execution. 

Engineering leadership

- Set quality metrics and SLOs, report them to platform and security leadership, and drive corrective actions. 
 - Mentor engineers across platform teams; grow a quality-engineering community of practice. 
 - Evaluate and select tooling; make build-vs-buy recommendations. 

Required Experience And Skills

- 15+ years in software or platform engineering, with 3+ years leading quality or test engineering for tenant platforms at enterprise scale. 
 - Deep hands-on Terraform experience 
 - Strong policy-as-code skills around OPA/Rego 
 - Production experience on Azure and GCP; working knowledge of Kubernetes and GitOps 
 - Built CI/CD quality gates in GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps or similar. 
 - Proficient in at least one of Python, Go or TypeScript for test frameworks and tooling. 
 - Experience in a regulated industry (life sciences, pharma, finance or healthcare), including GxP or equivalent validation. 
 - Track record of setting technical direction across multiple teams without direct authority. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience testing LLM-based or agentic systems 
 - Familiarity with software supply chain standards: SLSA, SBOM (SPDX/CycloneDX), Sigstore/cosign. 
 - Chaos engineering tools such as Azure Chaos Studio, LitmusChaos or Gremlin. 
 - Experience with Red Hat Ansible Automation Platform, Azure Arc or hybrid estates.

data.title: Principal Engineer, Test Automation
data.description:
This is where your work makes a difference. 

At Baxter, we believe every person-regardless of who they are or where they are from-deserves a chance to live a healthy life. It was our founding belief in 1931 and continues to be our guiding principle. We are redefining healthcare delivery to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond. 

Our Baxter colleagues are united by our Mission to Save and Sustain Lives. Together, our community is driven by a culture of courage, trust, and collaboration. Every individual is empowered to take ownership and make a meaningful impact. We strive for efficient and effective operations, and we hold each other accountable for delivering exceptional results. 

Here, you will find more than just a job-you will find purpose and pride. 

We are seeking a Principal Automation Engineer to define automation architecture, technical roadmaps, and engineering standards for API, UI, integration, and end-to-end testing. The ideal candidate is a systems-oriented Quality Engineer who understands how products and services interconnect, sees the broader product architecture, and can decompose requirements to capture use cases holistically. This hands-on role will lead the development of scalable C#/. NET frameworks, establish CI/CD quality gates, guide cross-team adoption, and resolve complex automation and testability challenges across distributed products. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Own the enterprise-grade automation architecture and roadmap for C#-based REST API, UI, integration, and workflow testing. 
 - Design modular frameworks with reusable libraries for configuration, service clients, page or component objects, test data, parallel execution, retries, logging, reporting, and environment management. 
 - Define coding standards, branching and review practices, framework governance, versioning, documentation, and contribution models. 
 - Establish pipeline strategy for pull-request validation, daily smoke tests, staged regression, release qualification, and automated quality gates. 
 - Guide teams on automation suitability, testability, coverage modelling, risk-based selection, and reduction of flaky or low-value tests. 
 - Lead technical reviews, proofs of concept, framework migrations, tool evaluations, and resolution of complex cross-service failures. 
 - Define dashboards and metrics for coverage, reliability, execution time, defect containment, failure causes, and productivity gains. 
 - Partner with architecture, software, DevOps, cybersecurity, systems, and verification leaders to embed quality throughout delivery. 
 - Mentor automation engineers and build engineering capability through reusable assets, coaching, and technical communities of practice. 

What You'll Bring

- B. E. /B. Tech in Computer Science, Electronics & Communication, Electrical Engineering, or a related field. 
 - 10 years of experience defining automation architecture, technical roadmaps, and engineering standards for API, UI, integration, and end-to-end testing. 
 - Mandatory: Systems-oriented Quality Engineer with a strong understanding of how products, services, and components interconnect; able to see the broader product architecture and decompose requirements to capture use cases holistically. 
 - Mandatory: Hands-on Automation Architect with advanced C# and . NET skills and a strong understanding of software design principles, dependency injection, concurrency, asynchronous execution, and extensible architecture. 
 - Mandatory: Hands-on experience architecting and developing REST API automation frameworks using RestSharp. 
 - Mandatory: Strong hands-on experience with NUnit or Selenium or playwright for test automation. 
 - Mandatory: Working knowledge of GraphQL (GQL) and experience validating GraphQL APIs. 
 - Mandatory: Solid understanding of test data management principles, strategies, and reusable data provisioning approaches. 
 - Mandatory: Strong awareness of Kubernetes and containerized test environments. 
 - Good understanding of communication protocols, particularly SIP, and hands-on exposure to SIPp for protocol-level testing. 
 - Expertise in API contracts, distributed systems, microservices, event-driven integrations, databases, authentication, authorization, and service virtualization. 
 - Deep experience with Git, CI/CD architecture, parallel execution, automated reporting, and quality gates. 
 - Proven ability to improve framework reliability, diagnose flaky tests, optimize execution, and drive adoption across multiple teams. 
 - Strong technical leadership, stakeholder communication, mentoring, and architecture decision-making skills. 

Preferred Skills

- Experience with Allure reporting is preferred. 
 - Experience with Postman is good to have. 
 - Experience with Azure, Docker, infrastructure-as-code, message brokers, observability platforms, and cloud-native test environments. 
 - Experience validating healthcare platforms, HL7/FHIR integrations, connected devices, or regulated software products. 
 - Knowledge of security, accessibility, performance, reliability, and resilience testing within a unified automation strategy. 
 - Relevant Microsoft, cloud, architecture, or testing certification is advantageous. 
 - Knowledge of SIP infrastructure and media components such as Kamailio, FreeSWITCH, RTPEngine, SBCs, registrars, RTP, and WebRTC. 
 - Experience with Azure Key Vault, Azure App Configuration, Azure Cache for Redis, Azure Web PubSub, Terraform, KEDA, and container security tooling. 
 - Familiarity with IEC 62304, ISO 13485, risk management, cybersecurity expectations, and quality systems for regulated healthcare software. 
 - Experience with Jira, Jama, validated toolchains, Agile/Scrum delivery, and formal release-readiness reviews. 
 - Experience leading a team of automation testers toward a common goal.

Baxter is an equal opportunity employer. Baxter evaluates qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, protected veteran status, disability/handicap status or any other legally protected characteristic.

Baxter is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities globally. If, because of a medical condition or disability, you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the application or interview process, please click on the link here and let us know the nature of your request along with your contact information.

data.description:
Job Title: Quality Assurance Analyst

Location: Hyderabad, Telangana

Company: Harmony United Medsolutions Pvt. Ltd. 

About Us

Harmony United Medsolutions Pvt. Ltd. (HUMS) is a dynamic and innovative company dedicated to revolutionizing the healthcare industry. We take pride in being a reliable healthcare management partner to Harmony United Psychiatric Care, a US-based healthcare company. 

With nine years of experience, we have developed and delivered end-to-end services in medical billing, A/R management, and other essential healthcare functions. We are committed to excellence, innovation, and continuous improvement. As we continue to grow, we are seeking talented professionals to join our team and contribute to our ongoing success. 

Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced Quality Assurance Analyst with a strong background in International Voice Process Auditing. The ideal candidate will have a minimum of 3 years of experience in international calling, including at least 2 years of hands-on experience in call auditing. 

The role will be responsible for monitoring, evaluating, and improving the performance of customer service representatives in an international voice support environment. The successful candidate will play a key role in ensuring compliance with quality standards, enhancing customer satisfaction, and providing insights for continuous process improvement. 

Responsibilities

- Conduct daily audits of inbound and outbound international voice calls to evaluate agent performance against predefined quality parameters
 - Create and maintain quality scorecards, audit reports, and agent performance trackers
 - Evaluate calls for communication, process adherence, compliance, accuracy, and overall customer experience
 - Provide constructive feedback and coaching to agents based on audit findings
 - Collaborate with Team Leaders and Operations Managers to implement performance improvement plans
 - Ensure compliance with client-specific guidelines and internal quality assurance frameworks
 - Identify recurring quality gaps and recommend appropriate corrective actions
 - Identify critical errors and compliance issues and escalate them appropriately
 - Conduct quality calibration sessions with Operations and Training teams
 - Assist in developing training materials, SOPs, and quality benchmarks
 - Analyze quality trends and identify opportunities for continuous process improvement
 - Prepare weekly and monthly quality reports, performance summaries, and insights for leadership review
 - Support the implementation and continuous improvement of quality assurance processes and standards

Required Skills

- Excellent verbal and written communication skills
 - Strong listening, analytical, and attention-to-detail skills
 - Hands-on experience with call monitoring and quality scorecards
 - Good knowledge of MS Excel and reporting
 - Ability to provide effective feedback and coaching
 - Strong problem-solving and interpersonal skills
 - Ability to work independently and consistently meet audit targets
 - Strong knowledge of QA methodologies, tools, and call monitoring systems
 - Ability to handle sensitive conversations professionally and provide constructive feedback

data.description:
ELLKAY started out providing connectivity solutions to laboratories and within a few years, grew to also provide data management solutions to ambulatory organizations. ELLKAY is now a trusted data management partner in five healthcare segments. ELLKAY's solutions continue to serve laboratories and ambulatory practices and have expanded to empower hospitals and health systems, healthcare IT vendors, ambulatory practices, health plans, and other healthcare organizations with cutting-edge technologies and solutions that drive their growth and interoperability strategies. 

Today, ELLKAY remains true to our core values, building strong partner relationships and offering unparalleled service and support while providing innovative, scalable solutions to the challenges our customers face in today's data-rich world. 

ELLKAY's experience, customer-focused approach, and reputation for innovation, speed, and accuracy differentiate ELLKAY as a premier partner for your interoperability needs and data management strategy. 

Job Description

We're looking for a versatile Full Stack AI/ML Engineer who can architect, build, and deploy production-grade AI/ML systems on AWS infrastructure. This role combines deep expertise in foundation models, healthcare data standards, and serverless cloud architecture to create scalable, secure, and compliant AI solutions for healthcare organizations. 

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

AI/ML Engineering

- Design and implement production foundation model applications using prompt engineering techniques including structured output design, few-shot learning, function-calling patterns, and hallucination mitigation strategies
 - Build and optimize vector search solutions using OpenSearch Serverless with k-NN, including HNSW/IVF parameter tuning, hybrid retrieval (lexical + semantic), and multi-stage ranking pipelines (BM25 + dense + re-ranking)
 - Develop and deploy Amazon Bedrock solutions leveraging Claude family models, Titan Embeddings v2, and Guardrails for PHI/PII detection while optimizing for provisioned vs on-demand throughput
 - Implement classical ML pipelines including clustering algorithms (HDBSCAN, k-means), confidence score calibration (Platt scaling, isotonic regression), and model evaluation frameworks

Healthcare Data & Standards

- Design and implement systems that work with FHIR R4 resources, HL7 v2 message structures, and USCDI data elements
 - Build ontology retrieval systems against LOINC, SNOMED, and RxNorm terminologies to support clinical decision-making and data normalization
 - Ensure HIPAA compliance and implement appropriate security controls for protected health information (PHI)

Backend & Infrastructure

- Build high-performance APIs using FastAPI and Pydantic v2 with async I/O patterns, robust retry/backoff mechanisms, and structured error handling
 - Design and deploy AWS serverless architectures including Lambda (Python + container), API Gateway (REST + HTTP), Step Functions, EventBridge, SQS, and SNS
 - Implement container-based workloads on ECS Fargate with auto-scaling policies, service discovery, and Fargate Spot optimization
 - Architect data solutions using Aurora PostgreSQL Serverless v2, DynamoDB, and S3 with appropriate indexing, partitioning, caching, and lifecycle policies
 - Write production-grade Infrastructure as Code using AWS CDK (TypeScript or Python) supporting multi-tenant provisioning and cross-account deployments

Observability & Security

- Implement comprehensive observability using AWS X-Ray distributed tracing, CloudWatch metrics/logs/alarms, structured JSON logging, and correlation ID propagation
 - Apply security engineering best practices including IAM least-privilege roles, KMS envelope encryption, Secrets Manager rotation, JWT validation, tenant isolation via session tags, and OWASP API Top-10 awareness

Evaluation & Quality

- Design rigorous evaluation frameworks including benchmark creation, per-class F1/precision/recall metrics, held-out test sets, label leakage prevention, and statistical significance testing for model comparisons
 - Implement prompt versioning and A/B testing frameworks to continuously improve model performance

Qualifications

Technical Skills

- Python Stack: Proficiency with pydantic v2, pandas/polars, fastapi, boto3, asyncio, and prompt-template libraries
 - Foundation Models: Hands-on experience with prompt engineering, structured output generation, and evaluation harnesses for LLMs
 - AWS Services: Production experience with Lambda, API Gateway, Step Functions, EventBridge, SQS, SNS, ECS Fargate, Aurora PostgreSQL, DynamoDB, S3, and AWS CDK
 - Vector Search: Practical knowledge of OpenSearch Serverless, k-NN algorithms, hybrid retrieval, and ranking optimization
 - Machine Learning: Experience with scikit-learn, clustering algorithms, and confidence calibration techniques
 - Healthcare Standards (preferable) : Working knowledge of FHIR R4, HL7 v2, USCDI, LOINC, SNOMED, and RxNorm
 - Security: Strong understanding of IAM, KMS, secrets management, and OWASP security principles

Experience

- 8+ years of software engineering experience with at least 3 years focused on AI/ML systems
 - Proven track record of deploying production ML systems at scale
 - Experience with healthcare data or regulated industries strongly preferred
 - Demonstrated ability to design and implement end-to-end ML evaluation frameworks

Soft Skills

- Strong problem-solving abilities and attention to detail
 - Excellent communication skills for collaborating with cross-functional teams
 - Self-motivated with ability to work independently and drive projects to completion
 - Commitment to code quality, testing, and engineering best practices

Preferred Qualifications

 - Familiarity with HIPAA compliance requirements and healthcare security standards
 - Contributions to open-source ML or healthcare interoperability projects

About Us

Worley is a global company of energy, chemicals and resources experts headquartered in Australia. We partner with our customers to deliver projects and create value across the life of their assets. Leveraging extensive experience and AI-enabled delivery, we support customers in navigating complexity as they meet today's needs and transition to more sustainable solutions. 

Purpose : We are seeking an experienced Process Control Engineer with deep expertise in materials handling automation, constraint control, and throughput optimisation, capable of translating plant operating objectives into robust control strategies that consistently maximise production while maintaining stable and safe operation. Experience in large-scale mining operations would be highly advantageous. 

The role is responsible for the design, implementation, tuning, and continuous improvement of constraint-based control strategies that maximise plant throughput while maintaining stable and safe operation. The role focuses on coordinating process control systems across the entire materials handling and processing circuit, ensuring production rates are optimised without causing equipment overload, blockages, or spillage. 

The successful candidate will combine strong advanced process control, automation, and optimisation experience with expertise in bulk materials handling systems. They will have demonstrated capability in developing and commissioning constraint-based control strategies, analysing process performance, and delivering plant-wide throughput improvements through effective application of control theory, process modelling, and data-driven optimisation techniques. 

To design, review, and deliver secure and resilient OT network architectures and engineering solutions that support industrial control systems, telecommunications infrastructure, digital platforms, and production-critical operational services.

data.title: Quality Consultant – Build a GxP QMS from Scratch (AI / SaaS)
data.description:
*** This is not a typical QA role. There is no QMS for you to maintain. You will build one. ***

Most QA roles ask you to follow, update and audit a quality system someone else designed. This one asks you to design, write, launch and own the Quality Management System of a regulated software business, from the ground up. And the QMS you build will run on a product we're building ourselves. If you've ever looked at a QMS and thought "I would have built this differently", this is your chance to do it. 

About us

Technopath Consulting is a niche UK consultancy specialising in process automation and AI. We help organisations rethink how work gets done, so that it's automated where it should be, intelligent where it helps and controlled where it matters. We're now building that expertise into our own products for regulated industries: 

- Route9: an application for computerised system validation and for document management, including review and approval. 
 - RoshamAI: our AI platform. 

Our offshore development centre, Rete BPO Services Pvt. Ltd. (RBS) in India, is home to our development and test team. This role is employed by RBS and works directly with Technopath's Director. 

What you'll build

- The QMS architecture: quality manual, quality policy and the full SOP set, covering document control, training, quality risk management, SDLC and CSV, change control, supplier management, deviations and CAPA, access and security, backup and recovery, data protection, release management, periodic review, internal audit, complaints and management review. Plus the forms, templates, registers and training matrix that make the SOPs work in practice. 
 - A QMS that runs on Route9: our own document review, approval and training workflows will run in Route9. You'll define how controlled documents, e-signatures, training and quality records must behave, and you'll see those requirements become the product. 
 - Quality inside an agile, cloud-native SDLC: risk-based CSV aligned with GAMP 5 (2nd edition) for SaaS products on Google Cloud with CI/CD pipelines. You'll define what a validated release looks like: validation plan, URS, specifications, risk assessments, traceability, IQ/OQ/PQ and release records. 
 - AI governance: how AI is assessed, evaluated, controlled and monitored when it's used in GxP work, both in our products and in our own processes, taking into account emerging expectations such as EU GMP Annex 22 and the EU AI Act. 
 - Supplier and partner assurance: qualifying our cloud providers and other critical suppliers. 
 - Audit readiness: an internal audit programme, management review and quality KPIs. You'll be our quality voice when customers audit us. 
 - Shaping Route9 from the inside: as our in-house quality and validation expert, you'll help make sure Route9 does what validation and quality teams really need. You won't be starting alone. We use AI heavily, including for first drafts. What we need from you is the judgement and experience to turn drafts into a working system that people actually follow and that passes audit. 

What you bring

- You have built a QMS from scratch at least once: at a start-up, a new site, a spin-off or a software vendor. This is essential; please tell us about it in your application. 
 - 6+ years in pharma, biotech, medical devices or GxP software quality. 
 - Strong working knowledge of GAMP 5, 21 CFR Part 11, EU Annex 11, ICH Q9 and data integrity (ALCOA+). 
 - Experience with computerised system validation, ideally of SaaS or cloud systems. 
 - You write clear, practical SOPs that people can follow, not documents that only auditors read. 
 - You've hosted or led audits (customer, supplier or regulatory). 
 - You're comfortable with AI tools and curious about how AI should be governed in regulated work. 
 - Excellent written and spoken English. 

Nice to have

- Experience in a software vendor or SaaS quality role
 - Hands-on use of an eQMS or electronic document management system
 - ISO 9001, ISO 13485, ISO/IEC 27001 or ISO/IEC 42001 exposure
 - Lead auditor certification

This role is probably not for you if. . . most of your experience is executing test scripts or maintaining a QMS someone else designed. We value that experience, but this role is about building. 

What we offer

- Real ownership: your name on the Quality Manual
 - Influence on a product built for quality and validation professionals
 - Direct work with the Director, with no layers of management
 - Fully remote, anywhere in India
 - Full-time employment with RBS, or a long-term full-time freelance contract

To apply, send your CV with a short note (no more than one page) about a QMS you built from scratch: its scope, how many SOPs, how long it took to go live, and how its first audit went.

data.description:

ELLKAY's experience, customer-focused approach, and reputation for innovation, speed, and accuracy differentiate ELLKAY as a premier partner for your interoperability needs and data management strategy. 

Job Description

We are seeking an experienced Staff CI/CD Engineer to design, build, and operate scalable software delivery platforms that enable rapid, secure, and reliable deployment of applications across AWS environments. This role requires deep expertise in CI/CD architecture, cloud-native technologies, software engineering practices, system internals, and production operations. 

The ideal candidate combines strong platform engineering skills with software development expertise and possesses the ability to diagnose and resolve complex production issues spanning application, infrastructure, networking, operating systems, and cloud services. The engineer will serve as a technical leader, influencing enterprisewide DevOps and platform engineering strategies while driving developer productivity and operational excellence.

CI/CD Platform Architecture

 - Build reusable pipeline templates, frameworks, and automation libraries. 
 - Implement GitOps and Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) practices across environments. 
 - Define deployment strategies including blue-green, canary, rolling, and progressive delivery models.

AWS Cloud Engineering

Platform Automation & Software Development

 - Automate operational workflows, compliance checks, environment provisioning, and release processes.

Production Operations & Troubleshooting

Storage I/O, Process scheduling, Threading, Networking and Container runtimes

- Debug complex issues using system-level diagnostics and observability tools. 
 - Support performance tuning and optimization initiatives. 

Security & Compliance

- Integrate security controls into CI/CD pipelines.

 - Partner with security teams to establish secure software supply chain practices. 
 - Drive compliance automation and audit readiness. 

Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field. 
 - 10+ years of software engineering, DevOps, platform engineering, or infrastructure engineering experience. 
 - 5+ years of experience designing and operating enterprise CI/CD platforms. 
 - Extensive experience with AWS cloud services and cloud-native architectures. 
 - Strong Python programming and software development skills. 
 - Demonstrated experience building automation frameworks and developer tooling. 
 - Deep understanding of Linux operating systems and system internals. 
 - Strong troubleshooting and debugging capabilities in complex distributed environments. 
 - Experience supporting production systems with high availability requirements.

data.title: Software Development Manager
data.description:
Description

Ask any Customer Service Associate what slows them down and they'll show you: the field that doesn't autofill, the extra click on every third contact, the lookup that opens in another tab. None of these earns a spot on a roadmap by itself. Together they cost tens of thousands of associates minutes every day, and well over a thousand such requests reach us every year from the people on the front line. 

Your team fixes them. Based in Hyderabad, it has a mandate no other team has: go into any codebase across the associate workspace, ship the fix through the owning team's pipelines and review process, and move to the next one. Each month a scored list of associate-raised problems arrives. Your team sizes them, embeds with the teams that own the code, and ships. Every fix credits the associate who raised it. 

What sets this role apart is that you run a mechanism, not just a team. The monthly intake with product leaders, the capacity math, the working relationships with a dozen engineering managers whose code your engineers touch, and the quarterly story to senior leadership about what got better are all yours. You'll also be the one who can say, with evidence, where the workspace's architecture makes small fixes hard. That feeds directly into the 2027 effort to rebuild it as one AI-assisted experience. 

You'll lead seven engineers directly and work as a peer with a senior program manager who runs intake and a senior engineer who sets the technical bar, with evenings that overlap partner teams in Seattle, Toronto, and Austin. If you like shipping every week and reading the thank-you notes, this is the job. 

Key job responsibilities

Own the fix-it mechanism end to end: monthly intake with product and senior leadership, engineer-led estimation, sequencing against capacity, delivery, and a readiness check before each fix reaches associates. 

Deliver through embedded execution. Your engineers join the team that owns the affected code as temporary members, follow its design and review norms, use its pipelines and tests, and leave the codebase better than they found it. You make that model work across teams in three cities. 

Hire, grow, and retain a team of software engineers spanning early-career to senior. Set and hold the bar on design, code, testing, and documentation, and coach engineers through promotion. 

Build and keep trust with every engineering manager whose codebase your team touches. Negotiate access, review bandwidth, and release windows; resolve design disputes through principal engineers rather than around them. 

Measure what matters: fixes shipped, associate impact per fix, and mechanism health, reported quarterly to senior leadership. 

Deliver through others: remove blockers, make scope calls, and keep stakeholders informed without surprises. 

Make the team AI-native: use AI tooling to raise velocity and quality across unfamiliar codebases. 

A day in the life

Your main job is keeping fixes flowing from associates' complaints to production. Mornings in Hyderabad start with the month's intake list alongside your program manager and a product leader: which problems made the cut and what each will take. Then a design review for a fix in another team's component, checking it follows their patterns, and a 1: 1. Late afternoon you unblock an engineer waiting on a Seattle team's review; your evening overlaps North America for a call with that team's manager about release windows. Beyond the usual: quarterly, you tell senior leadership, with numbers, what got better for associates. 

About The Team

Your main job is keeping fixes flowing from associates' complaints to production. You start your day with the month's intake list alongside your program manager and a product leader: which problems made the cut and what each will take. Then a design review for a fix in another team's component, checking it follows their patterns, then a 1: 1. You unblock an engineer waiting on a Seattle team's review, and when North America comes online you take a call with that team's manager about release windows. Beyond the usual: quarterly, you tell senior leadership, with numbers, what got better for associates. 

Basic Qualifications

- 7+ years of engineering experience
 - 3+ years of engineering team management experience
 - 8+ years of leading the definition and development of multi tier web services experience
 - Knowledge of engineering practices and patterns for the full software/hardware/networks development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, certification, and livesite operations
 - Experience partnering with product or program management teams
 - Experience designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems

Preferred Qualifications

data.title: IP Design Director
data.description:
Astera Labs (NASDAQ: ALAB) provides rack-scale AI infrastructure through purpose-built connectivity solutions. By collaborating with hyperscalers and ecosystem partners, Astera Labs enables organizations to unlock the full potential of modern AI. Astera Labs' Intelligent Connectivity Platform integrates CXL®, Ethernet, NVLink, PCIe®, and UALinkTM semiconductor-based technologies with the company's COSMOS software suite to unify diverse components into cohesive, flexible systems that deliver end-to-end scale-up, and scale-out connectivity. The company's custom connectivity solutions business complements its standards-based portfolio, enabling customers to deploy tailored architectures to meet their unique infrastructure requirements. Discover more at www. asteralabs. com. 

Position Overview

Job Description - IP Digital Design Manager

We are seeking an experienced and highly motivated Digital Design Manager to lead the micro-architecture, design, development, and delivery of IPs and Subsystems from for next-generation switch products. This role combines deep technical expertise with strong people leadership and program management skills. 

The successful candidate will be responsible for managing a team of IP digital design engineers while driving the successful execution of complex IP development programs. The role requires close collaboration with Architecture, Verification, Physical Design, DFT, Firmware, Software, Product Engineering, and SoC Integration teams to ensure delivery of high-quality IPs that meet performance, power, area, quality, and schedule objectives. 

This position offers the opportunity to influence product roadmaps, establish engineering best practices, and contribute to the development of industry-leading semiconductor solutions. 

Key Roles & Responsibilities

Technology Background

- Deep understanding of complex networking protocols such as PCIE, UALink, Ethernet is a must 
 - Experience of working on latest generations of these protocols is highly desirable. 
 - Expertise of standard front-end design flows / tools / HDLs for digital design

Technical Leadership

- Lead the end-to-end development of digital Ips / Subsystems from architecture through silicon validation. 
 - Partner with architects and product teams to define IP requirements, features, performance targets, and scalability needs. 
 - Drive microarchitecture development and ensure alignment with overall SoC and product requirements. 
 - Review and approve architecture specifications, design documents, RTL implementations, and verification plans. 
 - Ensure IP designs achieve performance, power, area (PPA), reliability, and quality targets. 
 - Lead technical reviews and provide guidance on complex design challenges. 
 - Drive design trade-off decisions and risk mitigation strategies. 
 - Lead the post-silicon support once silicon is back in the lab. Prior experience of post-silicon work is highly desirable. 

IP Development & Delivery

- Own the successful delivery of IP/Subsystem releases according to committed schedules and quality goals. 
 - Ensure all IP deliverables, including RTL, verification collateral, documentation, synthesis constraints, and integration guides, are completed and released on time. 
 - Drive IP reuse strategies to maximize engineering efficiency across multiple products and platforms. 
 - Establish standards for IP packaging, version control, configuration management, and release processes. 
 - Ensure compliance with internal design methodologies and industry best practices for all front-end flows such as Lint, CDC, Power Analysis, Timing Constraints. 
 - Work with cross-functional teams to ensure that requirements, dependencies from all stakeholders are met and incorporated into the deliverables

Team Leadership & People Management

- Build, lead, and mentor a high-performing IP design team. 
 - Set clear goals and expectations for team members. 
 - Conduct performance reviews, development planning, and regular coaching sessions. 
 - Identify skill gaps and implement training and development initiatives. 
 - Participate in workforce planning, recruiting, interviewing, hiring, and onboarding activities. 
 - Foster an inclusive, collaborative, and innovation-driven culture. 
 - Promote technical excellence and continuous learning within the organization. 

Required Qualifications

Education

- Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field. 
 - Master's degree preferred. 

Experience

- 15+ years of experience in semiconductor design and development. 
 - 5+ years of experience managing engineering teams and complex IP development programs. 
 - Proven track record of successfully delivering multiple IPs into production silicon. 
 - Experience managing cross-functional engineering programs across geographically distributed teams. 
 - Experience delivering IPs for AI, networking, datacenter, automotive, mobile, or high-performance computing products. 
 - Experience leading global engineering teams. 
 - Experience managing multiple concurrent IP development programs. 
 - Familiarity with safety-critical and security-focused design methodologies. 
 - Experience driving IP reuse strategies across multiple product generations. 

We know that creativity and innovation happen more often when teams include diverse ideas, backgrounds, and experiences, and we actively encourage everyone with relevant experience to apply, including people of color, LGBTQ+ and non-binary people, veterans, parents, and individuals with disabilities.

 - Cloud Infrastructure Experience: Experience designing and deploying applications/shared services on cloud infrastructure with providers like AWS, including S3 storage. 
 - Stack Knowledge: Knowledge of the MEAN stack, with an interest in leveraging this technology for AI-driven applications. 
 - Senior developer with 7-11 years of experience in software development, solution design and development, plus delivering high-quality technical projects/services.

Toast helps restaurants adapt, take control, and get back to what they do best : building the businesses they love. Toast connects employees, operations, and guests on a reliable, easy-to-use platform so restaurateurs can stay one step ahead of a rapidly evolving hospitality market. 

We are hiring for the 'International Payments' team - the driving force behind Toast's global expansion. We architect and scale the core payment engine powering our growth in new markets around the world. 

As a Principal-Engineer/Architect, you will spearhead technical strategy and architect scalable designs for Toast's largest restaurant brands. Partnering with product, business & engineering stakeholders, you will define the technological roadmap empowering customers to unleash the full capability of Toast. You will collaborate with engineering leaders and cross-functional teams across the organization to execute robust, mission-critical solutions seamlessly integrated with external systems. 

You will drive the evolution of our International Payments platform, expanding Toast's global footprint with best-in-class customer-facing Fintech products and foundational capabilities. 

A Day In The Life (Responsibilities)

- Gain deep expertise in Toast's payments ecosystem to enable reliable, seamless payment acceptance and processing across our fintech portfolio. 
 - Architect resilient, high-scale, mission-critical payment platform components. 
 - Design, build, deploy, and maintain highly resilient and scalable features across Toast's International line-of-products. 
 - Lead complex initiatives that would span multiple teams & systems. 
 - Collaborate with stakeholders across the organization - including PMs, SEs, QA, and UX - to help your teams get stuff done and deliver solutions that maximize value. 
 - Drive high-quality team output and ensure that the team makes solid technical decisions. 
 - Serve as a steward of an exceptional culture, encompassing both technical excellence and people‐centric values. 
 - Champion best practices for SDLC & CICD life-cycles. 
 - Champion the use of AI tools and practices to accelerate development, improve team velocity, and pioneer new ways of building - setting the bar for what it means to be an AI-first engineering organization. 
 - Mentor & coach engineers within the Fintech organisation. 
 - Hire and develop new team members, helping build a diverse team that wins together. 

What You'll Need To Thrive (Requirements)

- Strong technologist with 12+ years experience defining and implementing high scale SaaS solutions. 
 - Have strong understanding & hands-on experience of building fault-tolerant, highly-scalable & secure distributed systems. 
 - Proficiency with sql/nosql databases, strong understanding of distributed datastores and knowledge of when to use what. 
 - Strong foundations in data structures & algorithms. 
 - Strong interpersonal skills and a proven track record of building partnerships across engineering, product, customer success, and other stakeholders. 
 - Experience shipping iterative value using agile or lean software delivery methods. 
 - Experience of tackling complex and ambiguous problems, communicate clearly with others to solve the problem, and share knowledge to help the whole team succeed 
 - Experience building payments & Fintech products, with at least 10+ years in the payments industry

Our Tech Stack

- Backend services which follow a microservice architecture written using Kotlin, Java and DropWizard
 - Event driven messaging & streaming using Apache Pulsar & RabbitMQ. 
 - Apache Camel for implementing Enterprise Integration Pattern. 
 - React & ES6 based Frontend SPAs leveraging Tailwind, GraphQL and Storybook. 
 - DynamoDb & Postgres as core persistence data-storage layers. 
 - Datadog & Sentry for system and application metric and monitoring. 
 - Splunk for log aggregation. 
 - FireHydrant for alerting. 

AI at Toast

At Toast, one of our company values is that we're hungry to build and learn. We believe learning new AI tools empowers us to build for our customers faster, more independently, and with higher quality. We provide these tools across all disciplines, from Engineering and Product to Sales and Support, and are inspired by how our Toasters are already driving real value with them. The people who thrive here are those who embrace changes that let us build more for our customers; it's a core part of our culture. 

Our Total Rewards Philosophy

We strive to provide competitive compensation and benefits programs that help to attract, retain, and motivate the best and brightest people in our industry. Our total rewards package goes beyond great earnings potential and provides the means to a healthy lifestyle with the flexibility to meet Toasters' changing needs. Learn more about our benefits at https: //careers. toasttab. com/toast-benefits. 

How Toast Uses AI In Its Hiring Process

Throughout the hiring process, our goal is to get to know you. We use AI tools to support our recruiters and interviewers with tasks like note-taking, summarization, and documentation of interviews to ensure they can be fully focused on your conversation. All hiring decisions are made by people. We ask that you complete interviews and assessments on your own, without real-time AI tools, recording, or transcription bots, unless we tell you otherwise in advance. To learn more: https: //careers. toasttab. com/ai-in-hiring

Our Approach to Hybrid Working

We embrace a hybrid work model that fosters in-person collaboration while valuing individual needs. Our goal is to build a strong culture of connection as we work together to empower the hospitality community, regardless of location. Please visit the Locations page on our career site to learn more about our in-office expectations by region: https: //careers. toasttab. com/locations-toast

People Are the Secret Ingredient in Our Recipe for Success

At Toast, our employees are our secret ingredient-when they thrive, we thrive. The restaurant industry brings together people with a wide range of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives, and we value that same breadth at Toast. We strive to build a culture grounded in authenticity, respect, and humility, where every Toaster has a real opportunity to grow, contribute, and do their best work-raising the bar in delivering exceptional experiences for our customers and each other. 

Apply today!

Toast is committed to creating an accessible and inclusive hiring process. As part of this commitment, we strive to provide reasonable accommodations for persons with disabilities to enable them to access the hiring process. If you need an accommodation to access the job application or interview process, please contact candidateaccommodations@toasttab. com.

data.title: Laboratory Engineer
data.description:
Be part of something bigger!

As the world and the way people live is changing, we at Bekaert believe it's our responsibility to contribute to finding new solutions for the future. With a 140+ year old heritage of excellence, innovation, and a future-focused mindset, we strive to create value for our customers and society. We aim to do this through innovative solutions and sustainable practices. We are committed to pushing the boundaries of steel wire transformation and coatings whilst also leveraging our expertise to develop innovative solutions with new materials and services in a safe, smart, and sustainable way. Our focus extends to markets such as new mobility, low-carbon construction, and green energy. 

As a dynamic and growing company with over 19 000 employees worldwide, 75 nationalities, a retention rate above 90% and € 3, 7 billion in combined revenue in 2025, we are looking for someone like you to join our team as we continue to shape a safer, more efficient, and connected world!

Purpose and Mission

BITC Laboratory Technical Leadership, Operations & Capability Development

- BITC Laboratory comprises Static & Fatigue Testing, Adhesion Testing, Material Characterization and Tyre Forensic Analysis capabilities supporting product development, customer requirements and technical problem solving across steel cords, filaments, tyre components and other technical samples. 
 - The role provides technical leadership for laboratory operations and capability development, ensuring timely and reliable testing, sound interpretation of results and technically robust conclusions. The position is responsible for building laboratory expertise, developing and improving test methods, identifying trends and failure mechanisms, and strengthening laboratory capabilities to support product and technology development. The role also develops team capability and ensures high standards of safety, quality and continuous improvement. 

Key Activities and Responsibilities

Lab Management & QMS Implementation

- Develop and communicate the laboratory strategic roadmap, including capability development, infrastructure and investment priorities, and future growth requirements. 
 - Establish, implement and maintain laboratory processes in line with the Quality Management System (QMS) and Environmental Management System (EMS) requirements. 
 - Contribute to BITC and laboratory scorecards by ensuring reliable, timely and high-quality test delivery, while building the pipeline of future testing and capability requirements. 
 - Analyze and interpret laboratory test results, correlate findings with material/product behavior and failure mechanisms, and provide technically sound conclusions and recommendations for product development and problem solving. 
 - Drive continuous improvement in laboratory processes, methods and performance using structured approaches such as PDCA and Six Sigma. 
 - Plan and execute laboratory audits and MRMs, ensuring timely closure of actions and compliance with quality standards. 
 - Build team competency through training, knowledge sharing and performance dialogues, fostering a culture of safety, quality, collaboration and technical excellence. 
 - Oversee equipment calibration and verification, and drive the development, validation and standardization of test methods. 

Product & Application Technical Expertise

- Develop and strengthen technical knowledge of steel cord applications in tyres, including product performance and application requirements. 
 - Contribute to technical and innovation projects that generate insights for new product and technology development, while independently leading assigned sub-projects from planning through execution. 
 - Support customer projects by developing relevant testing capabilities and new test methods, translating customer requirements into robust technical approaches and actionable test results. 

Core Expertise & Lab Projects

- Develop and maintain specialized technical expertise in Mechanical Testing, Adhesion Testing, Material Characterization, and Tyre Forensics establishing these as core laboratory competencies. 
 - Build in-depth knowledge in selected technical domains through literature reviews, market and technology research, technical conferences and engagement with external technical networks. 
 - Independently lead assigned sub-projects related to technical development, problem solving, core laboratory expertise and test method development, from planning and execution through analysis and technical conclusions. 

Essential Skills & Competencies

Must Have

- Master's degree in Engineering, preferably in Mechanical Engineering or a related discipline
 - Minimum 5 years of experience in an R&D environment, with demonstrated expertise in laboratory testing and capability development
 - Strong logical, analytical and data interpretation skills
 - Structured and systematic approach to technical problem solving
 - Good command of English, both written and spoken
 - Strong sense of ownership and responsibility, with the ability to work independently and effectively within a team
 - Strong interest in technical investigation, experimentation and research-oriented work

Prefer to have

- Experience in laboratory management, technical team supervision and capability building
 - Strong knowledge of mechanical testing and fundamental principles of mechanics
 - Experience in developing or improving testing methods, processes and laboratory capabilities
 - Broad technical interests and willingness to explore emerging testing techniques and technologies

Authorization

- Prioritize and schedule laboratory testing activities based on project, customer and business requirements. 
 - Define and approve laboratory test methods, testing approaches and technical conclusions within the scope of the role. 
 - Recommend and initiate improvements to laboratory processes, methods, equipment and capabilities. 
 - Allocate laboratory resources and assign work to technicians and analysts to ensure timely execution. 
 - Identify laboratory capability, equipment and investment requirements and recommend priorities to the Head of BITC. 
 - Stop or escalate testing activities where safety, quality, equipment reliability or test-result integrity is at risk. 

Be bold and take the leap!

We're looking for individuals who are not afraid to take risks and explore new ideas. If you are passionate about personal growth and bringing your authentic self to work, we want you on our team!

At Bekaert, we celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive work environment. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, sex, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. 

To learn more about us and our exciting career opportunities, visit Bekaert Careers

data.title: Advanced Quality Planning Lead
data.description:
Your Job

The Advanced Quality Planning Lead based in Navi Mumbai, India. The role is responsible for expanding quality capabilities across the full product realization process, from design and development through manufacturing launch and stabilization. It establishes and drives a disciplined, cross-functional approach to quality planning for new products, major product changes, supplier transitions, and manufacturing process changes. 

The role ensures that customer, regulatory, engineering, supplier, and operational requirements are translated into robust, prevention-focused quality plans before production release. 

This position leads to Advanced Product Quality Planning activities, strengthens design and manufacturing readiness, and reduces quality risk across the product lifecycle. 

What You Will Do

- Drive the quality planning process from concept through launch and stabilization, including quality gates, deliverables, risks, timing, and escalation. 
 - Convert customer, product, process, regulatory, and reliability requirements into measurable critical characteristics, inspection strategies, validation plans, and acceptance criteria. 
 - Facilitate design and process risk reviews, including DFMEA and PFMEA, and ensure actions are completed and reflected in control plans, work instructions, and validation activities. 
 - Establish quality continuity from design into manufacturing by ensuring design outputs, critical characteristics, risk controls, verification results, and lessons learned are effectively transferred into production processes and controls. 
 - Coordinate production part approval, capability studies, measurement system analysis, first-article inspection, safe-launch controls, and release documentation as applicable. 
 - Work with Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, Supplier Quality, Project Management, Commercial, and regional Quality teams to resolve gaps and maintain clear accountability. 
 - Align supplier quality planning with program requirements, review supplier submissions, and escalate risks that could affect launch, cost, delivery, or customer performance. 
 - Standardize templates, governance, lessons learned, and best practices while ensuring compliance with the quality management system and applicable standards. 
 - Lead structured problem solving and containment for pre-launch and early-life issues, using root-cause methods and corrective action to prevent recurrence. 
 - Track readiness and performance indicators, identify trends, communicate risks to leadership, and drive timely recovery plans. 
 - Coach project teams and quality professionals in advanced quality methods, customer-specific requirements, and prevention-based thinking. 

Who You Are (Basic Qualifications)

- Bachelor's degree in engineering, quality, manufacturing, or a related technical field. 
 - Experience in quality, engineering, manufacturing, supplier quality, or new product introduction within an industrial or engineered-product environment. 
 - Demonstrated experience leading APQP or equivalent structured quality planning for new products and process changes. 
 - Working knowledge of FMEA, control plans, process capability, measurement system analysis, statistical methods, root-cause analysis, corrective action, and production part approval practices. 
 - Experience working across functions, sites, suppliers, and regions to deliver complex programs. 
 - Demonstrated ability to operate effectively in a matrix organization, influence without direct authority, and align stakeholders across functions, sites, and regions. 
 - Strong project leadership, facilitation, communication, and risk-management skills. 
 - Ability to interpret technical drawings, specifications, manufacturing processes, and customer requirements. 
 - Ability to travel as required to manufacturing sites, suppliers, and customer locations. 

What Will Put You Ahead

- Advanced degree in Engineering, Quality, Operations, or Business. 
 - Professional certification such as ASQ Certified Quality Engineer, Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt, or equivalent. 
 - Experience with global product launches, low-volume/high-mix manufacturing, engineered-to-order products, or regulated applications. 
 - Experience with quality planning and lifecycle management systems. 

At Koch companies, we are entrepreneurs. This means we openly challenge the status quo, find new ways to create value and get rewarded for our individual contributions. Any compensation range provided for a role is an estimate determined by available market data. The actual amount may be higher or lower than the range provided considering each candidate's knowledge, skills, abilities, and geographic location. If you have questions, please speak to your recruiter about the flexibility and detail of our compensation philosophy.

data.title: Telecom & Modem Engineer ( Senior/Staff)
data.description:
logcat. ai is the AI engineering layer for the operating-system stack. We build agentic systems for Linux and Android devices: we ingest the diagnostic artifacts a device emits (bugreports, logcat, dmesg, modem traces, ramdumps, perfetto, pcap, CAN) and help device makers diagnose, remediate, test, and author features across their OS stack, grounded in their own BSP. Think Datadog and Cursor combined for the OS layer. A VC-backed startup with a small, senior team - you work directly with the founders. 

We recently raised a $2. 55M pre-seed. The product is scaling and the customer list is growing. The team is still small, so you'll own what you build. 

Reading modem traces well is rare, which is why this stays a specialist problem. Few engineers get to build the tool their own field will use. You will be building the system that modem and Wi-Fi engineers at device makers rely on to get from a trace to a root cause. 

You'll build the first system that does automatic cross-layer root cause from the baseband, through QMI and the radio HAL, into Android, grounded in the customer's own stack. The same applies on the Wi-Fi side: automatic cross-layer root cause from the Wi-Fi driver and firmware, through the networking stack and management plane, on OpenWrt-class access points and CPE. 

The bar

- 8 plus years of relevant engineering experience. 
 - Fewer than 8 is fine if you were at a startup where you owned the whole connectivity surface yourself. 
 - Deep expertise in one of the two tracks below. 
 - Cellular: modem/baseband bringup, debug, or protocol-stack work; fluency with DIAG/QMI, QXDM/QCAT, and reading modem crash dumps; working knowledge of 4G/5G NAS, RRC, and lower-layer behavior; IMS/VoLTE/VoNR debugging (SIP/IMS signaling and carrier field issues); comfort at the RIL / radio HAL boundary. 
 - Wi-Fi / CPE: OpenWrt-based access points or CPE; Wi-Fi 6/7 (802. 11ax/be); hostapd/wpa_supplicant and mac80211/cfg80211; Qualcomm QSDK or MediaTek SDKs; debugging from wlan driver/firmware traces, hostapd logs, syslog, and packet captures. 
 - Proficient in day-to-day work with CLI-based AI coding tools like Claude Code (or an equivalent). It's how the team operates, not a nice-to-have. 

What you'll do

- Build parsers and analysis for modem traces: DIAG, QMI, QXDM/QCAT, modem ramdumps and crash logs. 
 - Build parsers and analysis for AP/CPE diagnostics: wlan driver and firmware logs, hostapd/wpa_supplicant logs, syslog, and packet captures. 
 - Map observed failures to root cause across NAS, RRC, and L1/L2, and across the RIL / radio HAL interface into Android. 
 - Implement Wi-Fi-stack reasoning: association/auth flows, roaming, mesh (EasyMesh), throughput and interference triage, driver/firmware crash analysis. 
 - Encode the cellular- and Wi-Fi-stack reasoning the platform uses to ground remediations. 

Bonus

- Qualcomm modem internals. 
 - MediaTek modem familiarity (ELT / MTK logging). 
 - Carrier certification or lab/field debug experience. 
 - Any exposure to log-analysis or ML tooling. 
 - Network-side or RAN familiarity (gNB, RRC, NGAP, CU/DU/RU splits, open-RAN). 
 - EasyMesh, TR-069/TR-369 (USP), or TR-181 device management. 
 - RF debug and throughput/interference triage; FTTH/ONT familiarity. 
 - Operator acceptance testing. 

What we offer you

- A front seat as we scale. Customer calls, the roadmap, the pipeline, how the company is actually doing. 
 - Top-of-market salary and founding equity. You'll own a piece of what you build. 
 - The AI tools you need. We use AI across writing code, reviewing it, research, ops, and internal tooling. If something would help you work better, we'll get it. 
 - Early ownership, and full visibility. We move fast, and you'll help decide where. 
 - Comprehensive medical insurance for you and your family. 
 - Start-up perks and flexible time off, the kind people actually take. 
 - A small team that's easy to work with. People here like solving hard problems and helping each other out. 

What to expect after you apply

- Screening call with Head of People & Business Operations
 - Technical conversation with Co-founder/CEO 
 - Technical exercise with Co-founder/ Head of Engineering 
 - Final conversation with Co-founder/CEO 
 - References, then offer

In your application, tell us what you'd own here, and the hardest thing you've shipped in this domain.

data.title: Software Dev Principal Engineer - DPI & SSL/TLS Security
data.description:
For more than 30 years, SonicWall  has delivered a partner-first unified cybersecurity portfolio that helps SMBs, MSPs, and IT teams consolidate network security, endpoint security, security service edge (SSE), and threat response across hybrid environments. By bringing connected technology, real-time threat intelligence, automation, and expert services together, SonicWall helps organizations simplify security operations, achieve better security outcomes, and lower total cost of ownership. Backed by a global ecosystem of more than 17, 000 partners, SonicWall delivers enterprise-grade protection built for SMB and mid-market realities.   

For more information, visit www. sonicwall. com or follow us on X, LinkedIn, Facebook, and Instagram.   

About the Role

We are seeking a Principal Engineer to lead the architecture and development of Deep Packet Inspection (DPI) and SSL/TLS Decryption engines for our NGFW appliance and virtual firewall product lines. You will drive the design of high-throughput L7 inspection and threat prevention capabilities - including Anti-Virus, Anti-Spyware, IPS, Content Filtering, and Application Control - at scale across 10G-100G+ deployments. 

Responsibilities

- 10+ years of C/C++ experience in high-performance networking, packet processing, or L7 security engines on NGFW or carrier-grade platforms.

- Familiarity with NGFW security services from leading industry vendors.

data.title: Staff Technical Product Manager
data.description:
Job Description Summary

Technical Product Manager Role will: 

Act as liaison between process owners and solution stakeholders and become the official solution advocates where required. Key person in determining when, how a solution needs to be developed, upgraded, or dropped. 

Guides project teams and customers for planning of sprints and Iterations of delivery of solutions. 

A Product manager will have to deal with "Systems of Systems" scenarios, must be concerned not just with how the solution will operate in its own context, but how it will function in the context of the larger IT ecosystem. A successful candidate is expected to question assumptions and drive change to mitigate potential risks, envision or evaluate new technology or solutions and to move towards it. 

The successful candidate will gain and understand business process relevant to the problem, defining the AS-IS process, identify gaps that needs to be addressed, define the To-Be Process and convert them into IT requirements, solutions. This position will give you an opportunity to be part of an innovation team in a greenfield area to help define new process improvements, solutions in automation, data challenges to help GE Power Conversion to continuously drive innovation and maximize businesses outcomes along with user experience. 

Job Description

- Business Analyst

Meets with business and IT stakeholders to translate business challenges into a business case for automation. 

Writes business case documentation, which includes documentation of as-is process, business process modelling, identification of automation areas, and return on investment (ROI) benefits analysis. 

Writes the Business Requirements document which includes a detailed overview of the as-is process and outlines the challenges that could be solved through an IT and/or automation solution. 

Actively engages with key stakeholders and goes to the place of work to observe the business processes in actions to effectively provide ideas for automation. 

Maintains strong relationships with key stakeholders by gaining trust of stakeholders and respect through technical leadership. 

- Technical Solution Architect

Looks at business processes to identify potential automation solutions that can be automated using RPA, AI, or similar technologies. 

Partners with business and application solution architects to understand how processes are implemented in IT systems and provides automation solutions to drive productivity and simplification. 

Writes Solution Design document and holds session with business and IT stakeholders to ensure full understanding of technical approach for solution delivery. 

- Product Management

Manages the full lifecycle of the solution, including initial problem definition, solution design, development, postproduction support, and eventual solution retirement. 

Evaluates the active solution portfolio and upgrade and improve existing solutions as required based on evolving business needs. 

Works with ITO, Project Management and/or Services processes and IT owners to identify automation opportunities. 

Writes and maintains product specifications, which includes the solution configuration guide and operations guide. 

- Vendor Management

Manages vendor relationship to drive delivery, including providing effort estimation, evaluation of proposals, and overseeing delivery of third-party resources. 

Manages Development &Testing, Deployment and Maintenance.

- At least 8 years related experience in IT Industry as Business Analyst, Solution Architect, or equivalent role.

- Quick learner of functional process and how it influences IT applications and solutions with Problem Solving mind set.

 - Good presentation and Communication skills 
 - Have had experience in evaluation of tools and s/w
 - Work expereince in AI/GenAI, Agents will be added advantage
 - Experience working in remote / global teams.

Relocation Assistance Provided: Yes
