data.title: Software Engineer | Cloud Native BNG Solution Testing, Scale & Performance, Python | 8-12 year
data.description:
Meet the Team

The Cisco cnBNG Solution Testing team validates carrier-grade broadband solutions running on IOS-XR routing platforms, including Cisco 8000, ASR 9000, and NCS 5500/5700. Our focus is ensuring that cnBNG solutions meet demanding service-provider requirements for functionality, scale, performance, resiliency, interoperability, and operational readiness. We validate the cnBNG solution end-to-end across Control Plane and User Plane functions, subscriber protocols, forwarding, high availability, and platform infrastructure. We operate at the intersection of software, hardware, networking, and customer deployments, with an automation-first approach and responsible adoption of AI-assisted engineering practices. 

Your Impact

As a Software Engineer in the cnBNG Solution Testing team, you will own end-to-end solution, scale, performance, and resiliency validation of cnBNG deployments. 

You will design sophisticated service-provider network topologies, develop comprehensive test strategies, automate large-scale subscriber and traffic scenarios, and validate the system under realistic customer workloads. You will work extensively with traffic-generation platforms such as Keysight IXIA and Spirent, analyze system and forwarding performance, identify bottlenecks, and collaborate with development teams to drive defects to resolution. 

- You will play a critical role in assessing product quality and providing evidence-based recommendations for release readiness. 
 - Design and implement end-to-end cnBNG solution testing across Control Plane, User Plane, subscriber management, forwarding, platform infrastructure, and external network elements. 
 - Own scale and performance qualification, including subscriber scale, session setup/teardown rates, throughput, latency, packet loss, convergence, CPU/memory utilization, and system behavior under sustained load. 
 - Develop realistic service-provider test topologies covering PPPoE, IPoE, DHCPv4/v6, PPP, RADIUS/CoA, L2TP, subscriber policies, accounting, QoS, and subscriber lifecycle scenarios. 
 - Build and validate large-scale cnBNG deployments with multiple Control Plane and User Plane nodes. Develop strong proficiency with Keysight IXIA and Spirent traffic generators, including subscriber emulation, protocol emulation, traffic generation, traffic analysis, performance benchmarking, and large-scale test execution. 
 - Create traffic profiles that model real-world broadband deployments, including mixed IPv4/IPv6 traffic, multiple packet sizes, bidirectional traffic, QoS classes, and subscriber service profiles. 
 - Validate CUPS / CP-UP separation, including session programming, state synchronization, state replay, reconciliation, Control Plane and User Plane failures, and recovery scenarios. 
 - Perform comprehensive high-availability and resiliency testing, including SRG geo/warm standby, process restart, node failures, link failures, ISSU, NSR/NSF, control-plane failures, and subscriber session continuity. 
 - Validate IOS-XR forwarding functionality including L2/L3 forwarding, FIB/adjacency, MPLS/L3VPN, H-QoS/policing, ACLs, mirroring, OAM/BFD, slowpath, and NPU forwarding behavior. 
 - Develop and maintain scalable Python-based test automation using pyATS/Genie or equivalent frameworks, integrating tests into CI/CD pipelines and regression suites. 
 - Build reusable automation libraries for topology setup, subscriber provisioning, traffic generation, fault injection, statistics collection, verification, and automated result analysis. 
 - Analyze performance trends and identify bottlenecks across software, forwarding hardware, NPU resources, CPU, memory, and control-plane interactions. 
 - Perform soak, longevity, stress, negative, boundary, and capacity testing to uncover issues that may only appear under sustained or extreme workloads. 
 - Validate subscriber QoS, accounting, lawful intercept, policy enforcement, and other service-provider features under functional and scale conditions. 
 - Validate CLI, YANG models, model-driven telemetry, gRPC/NETCONF/gNMI, and operational data required for managing and troubleshooting large cnBNG deployments. 
 - Debug sophisticated solution-level issues using IOS-XR logs, traces, telemetry, packet captures, core dumps, IXIA/Spirent statistics, and platform/NPU diagnostics. 
 - Perform detailed root-cause isolation, determining whether failures originate in the Control Plane, User Plane, forwarding infrastructure, Silicon One NPU, automation environment, traffic generator, or external network components. 
 - Partner closely with development, platform, system architecture, and customer-facing engineering teams to reproduce defects and drive them to closure. 
 - Define measurable test exit criteria and provide data-driven release-quality and readiness recommendations based on functional, scale, performance, and resiliency results. 
 - Use Git and modern software-development practices for automation code, test reviews, defect management, and CI/CD integration. 
 - Actively use approved AI coding assistants and engineering agents for automation development, test generation, log analysis, failure clustering, defect analysis, and troubleshooting while responsibly validating AI-generated output. 
 - Mentor junior engineers and help improve solution-testing methodology, automation architecture, scale infrastructure, and overall engineering quality. 

Minimum Qualifications (Must-Have)

- Bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical/Computer Engineering, 
 - Telecommunications, or a related field. Strong experience in system, solution, scale, performance, and resiliency testing of networking products or carrier-grade networking solutions. 
 - Strong understanding of test methodologies covering functional, integration, system, regression, scale, performance, stress, longevity, failover, and high-availability testing. 
 - Hands-on expertise with Keysight IXIA and/or Spirent traffic-generation platforms, including
 - protocol emulation, subscriber emulation, traffic generation, scale testing, and performance analysis. 
 - Strong Python programming and experience developing scalable test automation using pyATS/
 - Genie or equivalent frameworks. 
 - Experience integrating automated test suites into CI/CD and continuous regression pipelines. 
 - Strong IP networking fundamentals, including L2/L3 forwarding, IPv4/IPv6, routing, MPLS/L3VPN, and QoS. Knowledge of broadband/subscriber technologies and protocols including PPPoE, IPoE, DHCPv4/v6, PPP, RADIUS/CoA, and L2TP. 
 - Experience configuring, validating, and solving IOS-XR or another carrier-grade network operating system. 
 - Ability to design and implement large-scale network topologies and systematically characterize capacity, throughput, latency, convergence, resource utilization, and failure recovery. 
 - Strong understanding of high availability, duplication, subscriber-state management, and fault- recovery mechanisms. 
 - Strong Linux skills and experience with Git, debugging tools, packet collections, logs, telemetry, and defect-management systems. 
 - Strong solving and analytical skills with the ability to isolate sophisticated issues across traffic generators, network protocols, software, hardware, and forwarding layers. 
 - AI-assisted engineering is a must: use of AI coding assistants such as GitHub Copilot and a working understanding of generative AI, AI agents, MCP (Model Context Protocol), reusable AI skills, prompt/context management, and responsible validation of AI-generated output, including AI-assisted log and defect analysis. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience validating cnBNG, BNG, or broadband subscriber solutions. 
 - Experience with CUPS / Control Plane-User Plane separation and large-scale distributed User
 - Plane deployments. 
 - Sophisticated experience with IXIA BreakingPoint/IxNetwork and/or Spirent Test Center, including automation APIs and large-scale subscriber/traffic emulation. 
 - Experience with Cisco 8000, ASR 9000, NCS 5500/5700, Silicon One, or comparable carrier-grade routing platforms and NPUs. Experience validating subscriber scale, session churn, traffic performance, convergence, and long-duration stability. 
 - Experience with SRG geo/warm excess, ISSU, NSR/NSF, and service continuity testing. 
 - Knowledge of SRv6/Segment Routing, MPLS, EVPN/VPLS, TE/GRE tunnels, BFD, BGP Flowspec, and ACLs. Experience with YANG, gRPC, NETCONF, gNMI, OpenConfig, and telemetry. Experience building automated performance dashboards, test-result analytics, failure classification, and regression trend analysis. 
 - Familiarity with Aha/Jira APIs engineering and defect-management integrations. 

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we're revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era - and beyond. We've been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint. 

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you'll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere. 

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you. 

Disclaimer

About

To ensure that we hire the best talent in the right way, we follow a strict hiring process and recently, Cisco has been made aware of fraudulent recruiters claiming to be from the company. Please be advised that any communication from Cisco about careers will: 

- be in direct response to an application you have submitted through the company career site
 - begin with screening or an interview
 - originate from a Cisco email address, and
 - be conducted across email, phone, or WebEx

Cisco will never make a job offer without conducting an interview process or ask you for money in any way. If you have been requested to apply for a role or have received an offer from a site other than https: //careers. cisco. com or cisco. wd5. myworkday. com, do not provide any personal identifying information, including your Aadhaar or other personal identifying number, birth certificate, banking information, driver's license, or passport. 

If you are the target of a recruiting scam, consider filing a report with your local law enforcement authorities. Cisco bears no responsibility, and cannot be held liable, for any claims, damages, expenses, or other inconvenience resulting from or in any way connected to recruiting scams.

Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations.

Process Overview

Data Infrastructure & Strategic Initiatives team is responsible for all the automation aspects of testing processes, ensuring quality of data and independent testing of corporate & business level process and regulatory controls by providing seamless access to the appropriate data & platforms required to execute the associated portfolio of tests. 

A test is defined in the Independent Testing Enterprise Policy as "An independent point-in-time examination of one or more processes, controls, policies and procedures or data sources utilized for managing risk to assess the effectiveness of the control environment. A test is focused on answering a specific objective and has a pre-defined pass/fail criteria. " Compliance testing may include activities such as automated surveillance and transaction level testing and may be performed onsite. Please note: This is not an application/software testing or application/software development role. 

Job Description

As an SME, drive sustainable automation in EIT (Enterprise Independent Testing) test design, development, and implementation using a modern infrastructure and thoughtfully-designed solutions. Additionally, train/mentor the Test Automation team and help with creating dashboards for the reporting purposes.

- Developing testing automation that provides timely, useful, and actionable independent insight on the operational health of Bank of America's processes.

 - Enabling automatic test document generation from code
 - Use programming skills and knowledge of software development lifecycle principles 
 - Design and develop and implement models and tests
 - Produce clear, concise and repeatable technical documentation for models and/or tests
 - Responsible for creating and revising code for data retrieval/manipulation when needed
 - Responsible for securing testing data that meets the needs / supports given test design
 - Independently gather test scripting and data requirements and work with data partners to ensure appropriate test design and sampling requirements are incorporated into the Test Plans
 - Collaborate with key stakeholders across the Bank to understand modeling and testing business processes and requirements
 - Perform debugging and code reviews to ensure quality of code. 
 - Ensure accuracy and quality development and hold validation session with the stakeholders to get a sign-off . 
 - Ensure adherence to the SLA's / Metrics - productivity, turnaround-time and accuracy. 
 - Communicate regularly with management and other support colleagues. 
 - Manage stakeholders with respect to business deliverables. 
 - Drive projects independently and ensure timely deliverables. 
 - Train/Mentor the team in case of any issues

Requirements: 

Experience : 8 - 10 yrs

Education:

 - Certifications If Any

Foundational Skills

- Hands-on experience on Python/Sql programming
 - Software engineering: modular code, software lifecycle processes, unit testing, regression testing

 - Advanced knowledge of data warehouse and mining concepts and baseline understanding of SQL query language and syntax
 - Big data: distributed computing paradigms (e. g. , mapreduce, dataframes, etc), optimizing distributed software

 - Experience using large data tooling including Hadoop and S3 as well as Spark and Trino

data.title: Senior Principal - Platform Architect Voice
data.description:
Business Introduction

GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems. 

Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines. 

Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges. 

Job Purpose

The Platform Architect owns the technical design of GSK's voice and unified communications platform, defining the reference architectures, patterns and standards that make solutions secure, scalable and consistent, and guiding engineering teams in applying them. The role provides design assurance across the platform's services, architects for reliability and resilience rather than treating them as later additions, and designs AI into the platform through reference patterns for AI-assisted delivery and intelligent operations. 

The role sets standards and assures designs; it does not build. Engineering delivery sits with the platform engineering teams, backlog order sits with the Product Owner, domain target architecture and the architecture team sit with the Platform Architecture Director, and enterprise-level standards sit with Enterprise Architecture. Solution designs for major cross-domain initiatives sit with the Solution Architect in Enterprise Architecture. 

Key Responsibilities

- Define reference architectures, patterns and standards for the platform, aligned to DPTF strategy and to enterprise architecture. 
 - Design AI into the platform, producing reference patterns for AI-assisted delivery and for intelligent, self-healing operations. 
 - Architect for reliability and resilience by design, so that platform SLOs and error budgets are achievable rather than aspirational. 
 - Provide design assurance and technical guidance to engineering teams, reviewing designs against the standards before build rather than after. 
 - Ensure platform solutions are secure and compliant, including GxP requirements where the platform supports regulated activity. 
 - Evaluate and introduce new technologies, measuring the result against architecture OKRs rather than adopting on vendor claim. 
 - Set architecture standards that supplier and managed-service solutions must meet, and assure their designs to the same bar as internal work. 
 - Partner with Enterprise Architecture and Information Security on standards, roadmaps and exceptions. 
 - Increase pattern reuse across the platform, tracking where teams have adopted a pattern and where they have diverged and why. 
 - Reduce rework by intervening early in design, and evidence the reduction rather than asserting it. 
 - Advise the Product Owner and Platform Manager on the architectural consequence of roadmap choices, including technical debt being accepted. 
 - Hold the boundaries with the Platform Architecture Director on domain target architecture, the Solution Architect on cross-domain initiative designs, and the engineering teams on build. 

Education & Professional Qualifications

- Degree in a technology or engineering discipline, or equivalent practical experience (e. g. , Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems). 
 - Architecture certifications desirable (e. g. , TOGAF, or recognised cloud or network architecture certification relevant to the platform). 

Area of Specialisation

- Platform architecture in the relevant domain, covering reference architecture, patterns, standards and design assurance. 
 - Security and resilience by design, including AI reference patterns and GxP considerations where applicable. 

Experience Required

- Overall 15 years and typically 6-8 years in technology architecture or senior engineering, including at least three years producing reference architectures or standards others build to. 
 - Deep hands-on depth in the relevant platform domain, whether cloud, network or digital workplace. 
 - Experience running design assurance or architecture review, including declining designs that did not meet the standard. 
 - Track record of architecting for reliability and resilience, working to SLOs and error budgets. 
 - Experience designing secure and compliant solutions, ideally including GxP or another regulated context. 
 - Experience setting architecture standards that supplier or managed-service solutions had to meet. 
 - Awareness of AI reference patterns for assisted delivery and intelligent operations. 
 - Extensive experience designing enterprise voice and unified communications services. 
 - Deep knowledge of Session Initiation Protocol, call control, session border controllers, quality of service and high availability. 
 - Evidence of defining voice architectures that improved service quality, resilience, adoption or cost. 

Desirable Requirements

- Professional level unified communications certification, such as CCNP Collaboration or Microsoft Teams Voice Engineer. 
 - Experience with Cisco Webex, Microsoft Teams, contact centre or cloud calling. 
 - Experience with emergency calling, regulatory recording or voice automation. 

Skills/Background

- Ability to influence engineering teams without line authority, so that patterns are adopted rather than circumvented. 
 - Judgement about when to grant an architectural exception and when to hold the standard. 
 - Clear design documentation, since patterns are only reusable if others can follow them. 
 - Comfort challenging vendor claims and evaluating technology on measured outcome. 
 - Pragmatism about technical debt, making the cost visible rather than blocking delivery outright. 
 - Collaborative habit with Enterprise Architecture and Security, whose standards constrain the platform. 

#AGTech

Skills

Automation Technology, Cisco IP, Cloud Based Services, Cloud Solutions, Compliance Management, Computer Programming, Configuration Management (CM), IP Address Management (IPAM), Load Balancers, Network Design, Operational Technology (OT), Packet Switching, Security Engineering, Software-Defined Networking Wide Area Network (SD-WAN), System Monitors, Video Security, Voice Services, Voice Technology, Wireless System Design, Zero Trust Architecture

Why GSK?

Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. 

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2. 5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases - to impact health at scale. 

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we're committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people. 

Inclusion at GSK: 

As an employer committed to Inclusion, we encourage you to reach out if you need any adjustments during the recruitment process. 

Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN. recruitment-adjustments@gsk. com to discuss your needs. 

Important notice to Employment businesses/ Agencies

GSK does not accept referrals from employment businesses and/or employment agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact GSK's commercial and general procurement/human resources department to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to GSK. The obtaining of prior written authorization is a condition precedent to any agreement (verbal or written) between the employment business/ agency and GSK. In the absence of such written authorization being obtained any actions undertaken by the employment business/agency shall be deemed to have been performed without the consent or contractual agreement of GSK. GSK shall therefore not be liable for any fees arising from such actions or any fees arising from any referrals by employment businesses/agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site.

Please be advised that such advertisements and emails are not connected with the GlaxoSmithKline group in any way. 

GlaxoSmithKline does not charge any fee whatsoever for recruitment process. Please do not make payments to any individuals / entities in connection with recruitment with any GlaxoSmithKline (or GSK) group company at any worldwide location. Even if they claim that the money is refundable. 

If you come across unsolicited email from email addresses not ending in gsk. com or job advertisements which state that you should contact an email address that does not end in "gsk. com", you should disregard the same and inform us by emailing askus@gsk. com, so that we can confirm to you if the job is genuine.

data.title: Senior / Lead Software Engineer
data.description:
Experience3-5 years

Compensation₹8-12 LPA CTC

The role

At Trendwick, you lead the building of our AI chat assistant and AI trading agents. 

You plan how things should work, write the important parts yourself, and guide a small team of about three junior developers. 

Open to any graduate or post-graduate with 3-5 years of software development experience. No trading knowledge is needed; we teach you our products and the markets. 

Skills for this role: Python, Java, C/C++, System design, REST APIs, SQL and NoSQL databases, LLMs and AI agents (for example LangChain or RAG), Docker and cloud (AWS, Azure or GCP), CI/CD and Git, Code review and mentoring. 

At Trendwick, everyone also keeps company and client information private, never gives investment advice or promises profits, checks anything an AI tool gives before using it, joins the short daily team meeting, and keeps learning through the training we give. 

How we hire: 1. Apply on this page. 2. A short coding test or task. 3. A friendly interview with our team. 4. HR discussion and offer. Tip: add your GitHub or project link in the Portfolio URL box. 

Growth path: Associate Software Engineer → Software Engineer → Senior Software Engineer → Lead Engineer. 

Please note: we only build software. We do not handle anyone's money or give investment advice, and you will never be asked to trade or invest your own money. 

Trendwick is an equal-opportunity employer. We welcome everyone, whatever their gender, background or ability. Beware of fraud: we never ask for money for applications, training, joining or equipment. Report any such request to hr@trendwick. co or WhatsApp +971 58 307 6101. 

Responsibilities

- Plan the AI assistant: decide how our AI chat assistant and AI agents work, including which AI model to use, how they remember things and which tools they can use. 
 - Build the core: write the main backend in Python and Java, and the fast parts in C/C++. 
 - Connect AI to trading: link the AI with live market data, indicators and backtests so it gives useful answers. 
 - Keep the AI safe: make sure it never gives personal investment advice and cannot be misused. 
 - Lead trading tools: guide the building of indicators and EAs on TradingView, MetaTrader and cTrader, and check the trading logic. 
 - Guide your team: review your juniors' code, teach them and plan their tasks. 
 - Plan with product: work with Product Owners to break big features into small tasks. 
 - Automate releases: set up automatic testing and releasing (CI/CD) and deploy on the cloud. 
 - Fix problems fast: lead the fix when something breaks in the live product. 
 - Protect our work: keep our code, data and licence keys secure. 

Requirements

- 3-5 years of software development experience. 
 - Strong Python, good Java and working C/C++. 
 - Hands-on work with AI models (LLMs), or a strong AI project. 
 - Experience guiding junior developers. 
 - English and any Indian language. 

Benefits

- Full training: learn our products, trading platforms and tools step by step. 
 - Mentoring: guide a small team of about three junior developers. 
 - Work on AI: help build our AI chat assistant and AI agents from day one. 
 - Real products: build our TradingView, MetaTrader and cTrader tools from the start. 
 - Skills for the future: fintech, trading technology and AI experience stays valuable in any company.

data.title: Manager, Software Engineering | Data & AI Platform
data.description:
Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we're helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential. 

Title And Summary

Manager, Software Engineering | Data & AI Platform

Who is Mastercard?

Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential. 

Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. With connections across more than 210 countries and territories, we are building a sustainable world that unlocks priceless possibilities for all. 

Overview

Data Foundations, part of Business & Market Insights, solves shared data problems for Mastercard's analytics products: secure customer data exchange, consistent business definitions and metrics, reference datasets, data quality and AI-assisted customer data onboarding. Engineering and product set direction together, and we own outcomes, not just delivery. Where enterprise platforms fit, we reuse and shape them. Where there is a shared gap, we solve it once.

data.title: Tech Lead – Biomedical Data Engineering
data.description:
Location: Bangalore

Work Model: Hybrid - 3 days in office

About Elucidata

Elucidata is an AI Solutions Tech Data-centric AI company on a mission to make life sciences AI-ready. Headquartered in San Francisco with a 120+ member team across the US and India, we're building the future of data-centric AI for drug discovery. Our flagship AI-Agentic powered platform, Polly, helps research teams wrangle, harmonize, and analyze massive volumes of biomedical data, accelerating discoveries and making precision medicine a reality. 

Recognized by Fast Company as the "Most Innovative Biotech Company of 2024, " Elucidata partners with 25+ leading organizations, including Pfizer, Novo Nordisk, Google DeepMind, Alnylam Therapeutics, and the Bill & Melinda Gates Research Institute. Backed by top VCs like Eight Roads, F-Prime, IvyCap, and Hyperplane. 

With over 200 data products and AI solutions co-developed by 100+ domain experts, we've helped our partners achieve 4X faster R&D milestones and contribute to 16 therapies advancing toward FDA approval. At Elucidata, you'll work at the intersection of AI, biology and impact while solving real-world challenges that accelerate the journey from data to discovery. 

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced, hands-on Tech Lead to drive the design and development of scalable data engineering systems and biomedical knowledge graph infrastructure. 

In this role, you will own the technical architecture and execution of data ingestion, processing, and integration pipelines that power our AI/ML-driven solutions for biomedical research and drug discovery. 

You will work closely with ML scientists, bioinformaticians, and product teams to build reliable, production-grade systems while driving engineering best practices, mentoring developers, and making critical architectural decisions. 

What You'll Own

- Lead the architecture, design, and development of scalable data engineering systems for ingesting, processing, harmonizing, and integrating biomedical and clinical data from diverse sources. 
 - Own the development and evolution of biomedical knowledge graph infrastructure, including graph data modeling, entity and relationship management, ontology integration, and efficient data retrieval. 
 - Design and implement robust data pipelines for processing large volumes of structured and unstructured data, including scientific literature, clinical trial records, and multi-omics datasets. 
 - Build and maintain production-grade backend services and APIs that enable efficient access to biomedical knowledge graphs and support downstream AI/ML applications. 
 - Establish engineering best practices for data quality, provenance, reliability, monitoring, testing, and performance optimization across data processing workflows. 
 - Drive technical execution end-to-end, make architectural decisions, conduct code reviews, mentor engineers, and collaborate closely with AI/ML scientists, bioinformaticians, and product teams. 

What Makes You a Great Fit

- Strong hands-on experience in software and data engineering, with excellent Python programming skills and a demonstrated ability to design and build scalable, production-grade systems. 
 - Deep understanding of knowledge graph technologies, including graph data modeling, graph databases such as Neo4j, graph query languages, and API technologies such as GraphQL. 
 - Experience architecting and developing large-scale data ingestion, ETL/ELT, and processing pipelines, including workflow orchestration, distributed processing, and handling heterogeneous data sources. 
 - Strong proficiency with cloud infrastructure and engineering tools, particularly AWS, Docker, relational/NoSQL databases, and modern data engineering frameworks. 
 - Experience working with biomedical or healthcare data, including scientific literature, clinical trials, EHR/EMR data, or biological ontologies. Familiarity with clinical data standards such as OMOP CDM and clinical data transformation pipelines would be a significant advantage. 
 - Proven ability to independently own technical architecture, solve complex engineering problems, make sound design trade-offs, and mentor developers while maintaining high engineering standards. 

Why Join Elucidata?

- Opportunity to shape the future of biomedical data ecosystems by building partnerships at the frontier of science and healthcare. 
 - Direct visibility with the CEO and leadership team. 
 - High-impact role - the partnerships you establish will directly translate into Elucidata's growth and customer success. 
 - Work with global leaders and contribute to data-driven drug discovery.

data.description:
Business Introduction

GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems. 

Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines. 

Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges. 

Job Purpose

The Engineer, Product Manager leads the design, build and adoption of AI and agentic solutions in the Automation Acceleration Hub, combining hands-on AI engineering with product management to turn high-value opportunities into solutions that change how GSK runs technology. It identifies, shapes and prioritises AI and automation opportunities across DPTF, owns the AI product roadmap and backlog, and stays hands-on in design and delivery where that is what moves the work forward. Reliability and responsible-AI guardrails are built into solutions from the start, with explicit service levels for AI services. 

The role is deliberately dual: engineering depth and product ownership sit together rather than being split across two people. AI platform architecture sits with the Director, AI Platform Architect, hands-on AI and agent engineering also sits with the Principal AI Engineer / Architect and the Principal AI / Prompt / Agent Engineer, process design sits with the Principal AI Process Architect, and adoption enablement sits with the Principal AI Enablement Lead. Solutions transition to the owning domain as they mature rather than remaining in the Hub indefinitely. 

Key Responsibilities

- Identify, shape and prioritise high-value AI and automation opportunities across DPTF, linking each to strategy and to a measurable outcome rather than to a technology. 
 - Lead the design and delivery of AI and agentic solutions that accelerate delivery and operations, staying hands-on where that is what moves the work forward. 
 - Own the AI product roadmap and backlog, steering with OKRs and value metrics under lean portfolio principles. 
 - Build reliability and responsible-AI guardrails into solutions from the start, with clear service levels for AI services rather than best-effort operation. 
 - Partner with the platform domains to embed solutions in their operations, and transition ownership to them as solutions mature. 
 - Champion AI-native ways of working across DPTF, and treat adoption rather than deployment as the point at which a solution has landed. 
 - Measure and report the value and efficiency delivered by AI solutions, including where a solution did not deliver and has been stopped. 
 - Work with AI platform suppliers and model providers, holding them to performance and safety standards rather than accepting vendor assurance. 
 - Maintain a visible pipeline of assessed opportunities, so that Hub capacity is directed by value rather than by whoever asked most recently. 
 - Assess where agentic approaches are appropriate and where they are not, and record the reasoning so the judgement is reusable. 
 - Work within GSK information security, data and quality requirements, including GxP where a solution touches regulated activity, engaging those functions during design rather than at approval. 
 - Hold the boundaries with the Director, AI Platform Architect on AI platform architecture, the Principal AI Process Architect on process design, and the Principal AI Enablement Lead on adoption enablement. 

Education & Professional Qualifications

- Degree in a technology, engineering, mathematics or computer science discipline, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - AI, machine learning or cloud certifications desirable, together with product or agile credentials. 

Experience Required

- Typically 20+ years in engineering or technology delivery, including at least three years building AI, machine learning or automation solutions in production rather than in pilots. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with AI and agentic solutions, including large language model and agent frameworks. 
 - Product management experience, covering opportunity assessment, roadmap and backlog ownership and value measurement. 
 - Track record taking an opportunity through to delivered and adopted value, not to proof of concept. 
 - Practical responsible-AI awareness, including where a use case should not proceed. 
 - Experience with machine learning operations, or an automation or robotic process automation background. 
 - Experience holding technology suppliers and model providers to performance and safety standards. 
 - Practical awareness of AI patterns and judgment for where AI adds genuine value

Preferred Skills: 

- List any licenses, certificates, registrations, or any relevant job skill or abilities not covered in Educational Background or Job-Related Experience sections above that are required for the job. 
 - Combination of engineering credibility and product judgement, since the role needs both at once. 
 - Discipline to stop a solution that is not delivering value rather than continuing to invest. 
 - Judgement about where agentic approaches genuinely fit and where a simpler method is better. 
 - Ability to transition ownership to domains rather than retaining solutions in the Hub. 
 - Comfort engaging security, data and quality functions during design rather than at approval. 
 - Scepticism toward vendor and model provider claims, with the means to test them. 

#AGTech

Skills

AI Frameworks, Algorithm Optimization, Artificial Neural Networks (ANNS), Computer Programming, Deep Learning, Feature Engineering, Google Cloud Platform (GCP) for Machine Learning, Machine Learning (ML), Machine Learning Operations, Microsoft Azure Data and AI, ML Frameworks, Model Evaluation, Model Training, Model Validation, Performance Optimizations, Product Management, Robotics, Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), Solutioning, Technical Delivery

Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. 

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2. 5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. Business Introduction

GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems. 

Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines. 

Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges. 

Job Purpose

The Principal Cloud Foundations Engineer - Full Stack builds and runs the Internal Hosting Portal that allows application teams across GSK to provision and manage Cloud resources in a self-service manner. The Hosting Portal is a custom-built web application using a modern TypeScript tech stack based on TypeScript. The full stack engineer sets the engineering standard within that platform, mentors the engineers around them, and treats the teams who consume the platform as customers. The role works through autoamted software deployment rather than manual configuration, uses AI-assisted engineering across code generation, review and testing, and engineers reliability in by defining SLOs, instrumenting for observability and automating away toil. 

This is the senior hands-on engineering role in the platform team, insourced at the grades covered by this description while engineering at G7b and below is delivered through managed service partners, so the role integrates and assures partner components as well as building. Engineering roadmap and direction sit with the Engineering Director, reference architecture and standards sit with the Platform Architect, backlog order sits with the Product Owner, and deep reliability engineering sits with the Site Reliability Engineer deployed from Reliability Engineering & Operations. 

Key Responsibilities

- Design, build and automate platform infrastructure using infrastructure-as-code and golden paths, so that provisioning is repeatable rather than reconstructed each time. 
 - Use AI-assisted engineering across code generation, review and testing to accelerate delivery and raise quality, reviewing AI-generated output before it is merged. 
 - Build self-service capabilities and paved roads that reduce friction for consuming teams, so adoption does not depend on the platform team's availability. 
 - Engineer for reliability by defining SLOs, instrumenting platforms for observability and automating to reduce toil, working with the Site Reliability Engineer on standards. 
 - Set and uphold engineering standards, secure-by-default practices and code quality within the platform, and hold them in code review. 
 - Contribute to incident response and drive permanent automated fixes with Reliability Engineering rather than repeating manual recovery. 
 - Mentor and technically lead other engineers, including partner engineers, linking engineering work to platform OKRs and outcomes. 
 - Integrate and assure supplier or managed-service components, holding partner-delivered engineering to the same standards and code quality as internal work. 
 - Work the platform's manual task and toil backlog, converting identified candidates into automation and evidencing the effort removed. 
 - Close observability coverage gaps for the platform, so that reliability can be measured rather than inferred.

 - Apply the reference architectures and patterns set by the Platform Architect, and raise a case for change rather than diverging locally.

Desirable:

Skills/Background

#AGTech

Skills

API Management, Automation Technology, Cloud Architectures, Cloud Deployment, Cloud Financial Operations, Component Libraries, Containerization, Database Management, DevOps, Disaster Recovery (DR), Edge Computing, Full Stack Development, Infrastructure As Code (IaC), Networking Concepts, Performance Optimizations, Quality Engineering, Secure Authentication, Serverless Computing, System Monitors, Test Automation, Virtualization

Why GSK?

Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. 

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2. 5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases - to impact health at scale. 

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we're committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. data.title: Principal Release Engineer
data.description:
Job Summary

As a Principal Software Release Engineer, you will define, own, and continuously improve the end-to-end release lifecycle for software delivered across cloud-service and storage-platform environments. You will coordinate release planning, build generation, readiness validation, change approvals, deployment execution, status reporting, and post-release follow-through while progressively replacing manual handoffs with reliable automation and clear engineering controls. 

Job Requirements

Own the end-to-end software release lifecycle, from release intake and planning through build, validation, approval, deployment, verification, and closure. 

Plan and coordinate concurrent releases across development, test, staging, and production environments, maintaining clear schedules, dependencies, milestones, owners, and decision points. 

Design, maintain, and improve CI/CD and release automation that reduces manual steps, accelerates delivery, and provides repeatable, auditable outcomes. 

Partner with development and quality teams to confirm required test coverage, regression results, performance validation, and environment readiness; escalate gaps that could compromise release quality. 

Lead response to build or deployment failures by rapidly coordinating triage, clarifying ownership, documenting the failure path, and ensuring the correct new release, hotfix, retry, rollback, or recovery workflow is initiated. 

Conduct post-release reviews and convert lessons learned into improved tooling, templates, quality gates, automation, and release policy. 

Mentor engineers and release participants on release processes, tools, quality expectations, change controls, and failure-recovery practices. 

Job Requirements

12+ years of software engineering, DevOps, build and release engineering, site reliability engineering, or production engineering experience, including technical leadership for complex, business-critical software releases. 

Demonstrated experience managing the full release lifecycle for production software or cloud services across multiple environments and teams. 

Hands-on experience with CI/CD systems, build automation, source control, branching and versioning strategies, artifact management, and deployment pipelines. 

Proficiency in one or more scripting or programming languages such as Python, PowerShell, Bash, Go, or similar languages used for release automation. 

Experience with Azure DevOps, Git, Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, or comparable build, release, and work-tracking platforms. 

Ability to analyze release risks using defect data, test evidence, dependencies, configuration changes, and operational impact rather than relying only on schedule readiness. 

Strong troubleshooting skills with the ability to isolate build, pipeline, configuration, environment, and deployment issues under time pressure. 

Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including concise executive status, detailed technical handoffs, and decision-focused escalation. 

High attention to detail, disciplined follow-through, and the ability to manage multiple releases and priorities without losing traceability or control. 

Education

IC - Typically requires a minimum of 15 years of related experience. Mgr & Exec - Typically requires a minimum of 10 years of related experience.

About The Role

Nasdaq Technology is looking for a passionate Quality Engineer -Specialist focused on test automation for the Eclipse Intelligence Platform (EIP). If innovation and quality drive you forward, this is the place for you!

As a Quality Engineer Specialist, you will be a key member of a cross-functional team, ensuring the quality and reliability of critical data solutions for financial markets around the globe. You will work with cutting-edge technologies including Java, AWS, Kubernetes, and modern microservices architecture to build comprehensive test automation frameworks and strategies. 

In this role, you will have the opportunity to work in a strong experienced team delivering complex technology solutions to our external clients. You will work with and learn from subject matter experts and have the opportunity to take on more responsibility and progress within the quality engineering team. 

What You'll Be Doing (Role Responsibilities)

- Test Automation Framework Development: Design, develop, and maintain robust test automation frameworks for EIP platform microservices

- Analytical Mindset: Strong problem-solving and analytical skills to troubleshoot complex issues and identify root causes

 - Attention to Detail: Meticulous attention to detail and commitment to quality assurance standards 
 - Continuous Learning: Passion for learning new testing tools, technologies, and methodologies 
 - Adaptability: Ability to work in a dynamic, fast-paced agile environment with changing priorities 
 - Quality Advocacy: Drive to promote quality practices and improve overall software quality

Education: 

- Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or equivalent work experience

It Would Be Great If You Have (Preferred Qualifications)

Job Description

As a Test Automation Engineer, you will design and implement automation solutions that validate system behavior across UI, APIs, and integrations. You will contribute to building a robust quality engineering ecosystem by integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines and supporting continuous delivery. 

In this role, you will translate requirements into effective test strategies, combining automation with manual, exploratory, and integration testing to ensure comprehensive quality coverage across all application layers. 

This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys hands-on coding, solving complex validation challenges, and improving system quality at scale, while taking ownership of end-to-end quality outcomes and collaborating closely with cross-functional teams. 

Responsibilities

Automation Development & Framework Ownership

- Design, develop, and own scalable test automation frameworks and reusable components
 - Build automated test suites across: 
 - UI (Web/Mobile)
 - API and integration layers
 - Ensure automation solutions are maintainable, reliable, and extensible across teams

Test Strategy & Implementation

- Translate requirements into automation-ready test scenarios, test data, and validation strategies
 - Contribute to test strategy, coverage planning, and quality goals
 - Identify test gaps and proactively mitigate risks
 - Perform automation feasibility analysis to determine optimal test approach (manual vs automated)

Delivery & Execution Excellence

- Execute a balanced mix of automated and manual tests aligned with sprint goals, ensuring comprehensive validation across functional, integration, and edge-case scenarios. 
 - Contribute to task breakdown, estimation, and sprint commitments
 - Proactively raise risks, blockers, and testability concerns
 - Identify, log, prioritize, and track defects through resolution lifecycle
 - Perform root cause analysis and collaborate with development teams for fixes

Manual & Functional Testing

- Design, document, and execute detailed test cases and test scenarios
 - Perform functional, exploratory, and regression testing across features
 - Validate end-to-end workflows and business scenarios
 - Identify edge cases and usability issues through exploratory testing
 - Ensure test coverage for areas not suitable for automation

Quality, Standards & Engineering Practices

- Write clean, testable, and maintainable automation code
 - Participate in code reviews and continuous improvement of automation frameworks
 - Ensure adherence to Definition of Ready (DoR) and Definition of Done (DoD)
 - Take ownership of end-to-end quality outcomes across assigned areas
 - Follow established DevOps, security, and quality engineering practices

CI/CD & DevOps Integration

- Integrate automation into CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps preferred)
 - Enable continuous testing and shift-left quality practices
 - Monitor and improve pipeline stability, execution time, and reliability
 - Validate and troubleshoot system integrations, data flows, and error handling based on defined architectural designs and interfaces

Non-Functional Testing

- Contribute to performance, reliability, and resilience testing
 - Validate system behavior under load, stress, and failure scenarios

Observability & Debuggability

- Leverage logs, metrics, and traces to improve test reliability
 - Support root cause analysis of failures and improve system observability

Test Data & Environment Management

- Design and manage test data strategies and datasets
 - Ensure availability of stable, production-like test environments

Incident & Operational Support

- Assist in troubleshooting defects across environments
 - Support maintenance and continuous improvement of automation suites
 - Analyze and reduce flaky tests and unstable scenarios

Collaboration & Growth

- Collaborate with developers, QA, Product Owners, and Tech Leads
 - Actively learn and adopt new tools, frameworks, and best practices
 - Contribute to team knowledge sharing and a strong quality culture

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, IT, or related field
 - 5+ years of experience in software testing with strong automation focus
 - Experience in designing and implementing test automation frameworks
 - Strong understanding of testing principles, SDLC, STLC, and Agile practices

Technical Skills

- Programming experience in one or more: C#, Java, Python, JavaScript, Swift
 - Experience with automation tools such as Selenium, Katalon, Playwright, Cypress
 - Experience with: 
 - API testing (REST, Postman, etc. )
 - Version control (Git)
 - CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps)
 - Familiarity with: 
 - Test data management
 - Test reporting and logging tools
 - Debugging and root cause analysis
 - Release Management
Assets

- Experience with: 
 - Performance testing tools (JMeter, k6)
 - Security testing (SAST, DAST, SCA)
 - Exposure to: 
 - Cloud platforms (Azure preferred)
 - DevSecOps practices
 - Experience using AI-assisted tools responsibly (e. g. , GitHub Copilot)
Key Expectations

- Drive an automation-first approach (target 60-80% regression automation), while ensuring critical flows and edge cases are validated through manual testing where automation is not feasible or cost-effective. 
 - Own and evolve automation frameworks and quality engineering practices
 - Ensure high reliability, scalability, and stability of automation pipelines
 - Take accountability for quality outcomes, not just test execution
 - Ensure alignment with organizational quality, security, and compliance standards

Why Husky?

- Regulated Working Hours: Enjoy a structured work schedule that promotes a healthy work-life balance, allowing you to excel professionally while maintaining personal well-being. 
 - Visible Impact: Experience the satisfaction of seeing the direct outcomes of your work, as you contribute to projects that visibly enhance our company's technological capabilities and efficiency. 
 - Strategic Influence: Participate in architectural and technical reviews, contributing to the strategic direction of our cloud initiatives and making a tangible impact on our company's technological landscape. 
 - Empowered Involvement: Take an active role in decision-making processes and architectural reviews, where your expertise helps shape the future of our cloud solutions and overall business strategy. 
 - Valued Contributions: Be more than just a number in a large organization; at our company, every individual's input is valued and can lead to significant, tangible improvements in our operations and services. 
 - Impactful Role: Play a crucial part in both developing new applications and maintaining existing systems, ensuring their optimal performance and reliability. 
 - Cutting-Edge Projects: Work on innovative cloud solutions that are transforming our and our customer's business, giving you the opportunity to be at the forefront of technological advancements. 
 - Supportive Community: Work in an environment that recognizes and celebrates individual achievements, fostering a sense of community and mutual respect among team members. 
 - Collaborative Environment: Join a global team of skilled professionals around the globe where your ideas are valued, and collaboration is encouraged to solve complex challenges and drive success.

We are committed to equal employment opportunity and respect, value and welcome diversity in our workplace. Husky TechnologiesTM also values being a great place to work and strives to maintain a safe workplace. At Electrolux, as a leading global appliance company, we strive every day to shape living for the better for our consumers, our people and our planet. We share ideas and collaborate so that together, we can develop solutions that deliver enjoyable and sustainable living. 

Come join us as you are. We believe diverse perspectives make us stronger and more innovative. In our global community of people from 100+ countries, we listen to each other, actively contribute, and grow together. 

Join us in our exciting quest to build the future home. 

All about the role: 

As Lead SRE Engineer, you will report directly to the Platform Engineering and SRE Engineering Manager. 

The Lead Engineer will be part of our Cloud Native organization, will work closely with our Product teams in eCommerce, Digital Marketing and other Consumer solutions and be involved in the full Software Lifecyle. We already have a solid, modern Engineering foundation and want to continuously improve in a dynamic, iterative manner. 

This is both a creative and a detail-oriented role in a very multicultural environment. We want you to be bursting with opinions and passionate about sharing, as well as executing them in a collaborative way. 

About the CDI Experience Organization:

The role also connects the Hosting Portal to the enterprise infrastructure-as-code platform, so that teams starting their cloud journey in the portal are onboarded to it and can discover its golden paths.

Engineering roadmap and direction sit with the Engineering Director, reference architecture and standards sit with the Platform Architect, backlog order sits with the Product Owner, and deep reliability engineering sits with the Site Reliability Engineer deployed from Reliability Engineering & Operations.

 - Engineer for reliability by defining SLOs, instrumenting services and workflows for observability and automating to reduce toil, working with the Site Reliability Engineer on standards. 
 - Set and uphold engineering standards, secure-by-default practices and code quality within the platform, and hold them in code review. 
 - Contribute to incident response and drive permanent automated fixes with Reliability Engineering rather than repeating manual recovery. 
 - Mentor and technically lead other engineers, including partner engineers, linking engineering work to platform OKRs and outcomes. 
 - Integrate and assure supplier or managed-service components, holding partner-delivered engineering to the same standards and code quality as internal work. 
 - Work the platform's manual task and toil backlog, converting identified candidates into automation and evidencing the effort removed. 
 - Close observability coverage gaps for the platform, so that reliability can be measured rather than inferred. 
 - Contribute engineering-led items to the platform backlog held by the Product Owner, including technical debt, upgrade and automation work, with the cost of not doing them stated. 
 - Apply the reference architectures and patterns set by the Platform Architect, and raise a case for change rather than diverging locally.

- Degree in a technology or engineering discipline, or equivalent practical experience (e. g. , Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electronics).

Why is this level of Education Required?

- Deep engineering credentials are needed because the role sets the engineering standard other engineers and partner teams build to, and that standard has to hold under code review rather than by assertion. 

Related Experience Required

- Typically 8-10 years in cloud, infrastructure or software engineering, including at least two years as the senior technical voice in a team. 
 - Excellent knowledge and hands on experience with TypeScript (ES6+) and Node. js server-side development. 
 - Developed REST and GraphQL APIs based on Node. js (Express). 
 - Integrating with cloud provider and third-party APIs, with retries, idempotency and error handling for long-running operations.

 - Working knowledge of landing zones and serverless technologies across Azure and GCP. 
 - Knowledge of infrastructure-as-code, for example Terraform, applied to production estates rather than proofs of concept.

 - Track record building self-service capability that other teams adopted without hand-holding. 
 - Experience instrumenting for observability, defining SLOs and reducing toil through automation. 
 - Experience with AI-assisted engineering tooling, including judgement about when generated output is not fit to merge. 
 - Good knowledge and hands on experience with HTML5, CSS3 (including preprocessors)
 - Good knowledge and hands on experience with React, NextJS, GraphQL, Yoga, Prisma ORM, and Apollo Client. Previous experience in developing a React UIs with Mantine, Material UI, or Chakra UI. Familiar with popular patterns and libraries such as React Hooks, and server-state management (Apollo Client, TanStack Query). Previously developed schema-based forms either custom or based on a library such as react-hook-form or Formik, including data validator libraries such as Yup, Zod or JOI. Knowledge of modern authentication and authorization mechanisms such as OAuth v2 or SAML and JSON Web Token and libraries such as MSAL. 
 - Strong experience with test automation (unit & integration) tools such as Jest and Cypress. 

Desirable: 

- Previously worked in a central IT team within a regulated environment such as the Pharmaceutical or Finance industry, including knowledge of GxP, validation and audit readiness.

 - Workflow orchestration tools such as Temporal, Camunda, Azure Durable Functions or AWS Step Functions.

Serve as the quality, governance and product authority for Cyber Architecture & Solutions. You are accountable for ensuring every security solution Cyber Architecture and Solutions designs and builds meets the required quality, compliance and operational standard before it reaches the global managed service vendor - the independent quality gate between what Cyber Architecture and Solutions produces and what the vendor is asked to operate. You own the Cyber Architecture and Solutions governance framework, the security product portfolio, vendor governance for the managed service as a whole, and the programme capability that delivers all Cyber Architecture and Solutions change. Platform support engineering moves into this function, with a small internal team retaining accountability while the vendor operates more than 30 platforms and the data fabric under an OTO model. Seventeen roles, and the primary Cyber Architecture and Solutions interface to internal audit, regulators and the second and third lines of defence. 

About the team. Design Assurance and Product Management makes sure security is designed in before anything is built, and that GSK's security capabilities are run as products rather than projects. Design Assurance independently verifies that solutions meet the architecture standards set elsewhere in Cyber Architecture and Solutions; it writes none of those standards, and that separation is what makes the review worth anything. Product Management owns the security portfolio, vendor governance and investment analytics, and is how GSK manages its managed service vendor as a whole. Platform support engineering moves into this function, with a small internal team retaining oversight while the vendor operates more than 30 platforms and the data fabric under an OTO model. Seventeen roles. 

What makes this role different. The defining tension is that you assure against standards you do not own. You are also the executive accountable for a vendor operating more than 30 platforms, where the operational risk is real but the levers are contractual rather than direct. Expect audit and regulatory scrutiny of the governance framework you own, and be ready to evidence a governance function of yours that withstood it. 

Key responsibilities:

 - Define, own and continuously improve the Cyber Architecture and Solutions governance and quality framework - the assurance process, the pass or fail criteria for vendor handover and the exception regime - applying the design standards owned by the Architecture function rather than authoring them.

 - Hold ultimate commercial accountability for vendor governance across the managed service - performance, SLA, escalation and commercial levers, and oversight of platform support as it transitions to the OTO model - with day-to-day governance delegated to the Associate Director for vendor governance. 
 - Own Cyber Architecture and Solutions security risk and exception management at the most senior level: assess complex architectural risk exceptions, maintain the Cyber Architecture and Solutions risk register, and escalate material unmitigated risk with unambiguous clarity.

 - Protect the independence of assurance when it is commercially or politically inconvenient. 
 - Own the function's budget and the security tooling spend envelope it governs, and defend the consolidation savings committed in the annual plan against the renewal calendar. 

Basic Qualifications: 

- 15+ years in cyber security, including 7+ in senior leadership in a regulated environment leading leaders across geographies - domain focus: function head for cyber security product management and Design Assurance across the Cyber Architecture and Solutions portfolio
 - End-to-end product management of cyber security products - threat-led use-case definition, business case and investment, roadmap, vendor evaluation and selection, onboarding, adoption and value tracking, renewal and decommission - running capabilities as products with outcome KPIs (coverage, adoption, efficacy, cost per capability)
 - Building and leading a cyber security product management practice with domain product owners for each domain group, each mirrored to a Security Solution Engineering squad working in parallel, and technical deep dives proving product efficacy and integration
 - Leading an independent Design Assurance practice and governing a security managed service - binding pass or fail decisions on handover readiness made against standards owned by the Architecture function and never by you, supported by drift detection, QBRs and EBCs. 
 - Leading AI adoption across the portfolio and assurance - AI-enabled tool evaluation, assurance of agentic solutions and AI-driven lifecycle automation from intake to decommission

Preferred Qualifications: 

- Architecture literacy to make binding quality judgements on expert architecture output they do not own, expressed as non-conformance to a specific standard clause
 - Delivering enterprise security tool rationalisation with quantified savings, sequenced against renewal dates, with automated utilisation and renewal analytics
 - Evidencing design and product governance to internal audit, external audit and regulators, producing decisions, approvals and exceptions on demand

data.description:
Job Description

This strategy is key to the WSP in India Buildings Mechanical Electrical Public Health (MEP) business as we position ourselves to address the challenges of a changing global economy. The role is the cornerstone of the establishment of a MEP Design Capacity in Noida working and adhering to WSP Global standards and promoting technical excellence, in addition to creating and building a team. This will involve recruiting, leading, developing a team of Engineers over a relatively short period of time. The successful candidate will stimulate and manage significant growth in a technically demanding environment to time, cost and quality targets. Cultural awareness, an open mind and excellent communication skills are essential requirements for the role. 

Responsibilities

A major element of this role is to liaise with the WSP in India design teams to ensure that the following essential elements of the role are satisfactorily completed: -

- Agree and confirm the project brief to anticipate and identify needs and expectations in conjunction with others. 
 - Agree the project deliverables and programme. 
 - Agree the resource in India that will be required to undertake the designs to complete the project brief in time and cost. 
 - Agree the project fees according to brief, resource required and programme. 
 - Be responsible for the quality of detailed design to WSP in India and Global Building Regulations standards ensuring technical reviews and sign off including complex calculations and co-ordination issues. 
 - Ensure design are co-ordinated and due consideration of Health & Safety, Construction Design Management and Quality Assurance standards. 
 - Regularly communicate and update the local Indian and wider Global project teams on programme delivery and quality issues through use of staff utilisation charts and Key Performance Indicator (KPI) reporting etc. 
 - Review outputs of Computer Aided Design analysis, and determine additional levels of checking needed. 
 - Where necessary, development of energy strategies incorporating renewable technologies and low energy designs to satisfy local authority planning requirements and compliance with Building Regulations Part L. 
 - Inform the Commercial Director of Professional Indemnity issues in line with WSP in India policy. 
 - Ensure all company standards & efficient working practices are adopted. 
 - Maintain an overview & understanding of the team workload & associated resource requirements, and work with other team leaders to ensure resources are fully utilised, identify & address effectively any surplus or shortfall in available staff
 - The successful candidate will be a dynamic self-motivated individual who will take on a Leadership role in project work, focused on delivery to the client and technical excellence. 
 - The role requires management of a number of projects and becoming involved in design at an early stage. 
 - The role includes management of fees, invoicing, project-resource management, mentoring and coaching junior members of the team. The ability to plan and design deliverables against British Engineering standards for each stage of a project is a pre-requisite. 
 - The role will include a short term secondment to the to visit some of the key WSP in India offices and WSP in India personnel to better understand WSP in India as a business and to assist with acclimatisation to the WSP in India methods of working. 
 - Lead the design process, set clear goals and monitor their progress closely and encourage the rest of the team to deliver appropriate and cost effective solutions to the agreed programme; support those more inexperienced by technical review, mentoring and advice. 
 - Lead from the front accepting design challenges and giving them due consideration with the support of others to achieve resolution. 

Establishment and growth of GCC

- Responsible for the recruitment of the design team, in liaison with the Head of GCC
 - Contribute to the design of operational processes, systems and measures
 - Working with Support Services, the local resources and the other disciplines to ensure that all hardware, software, workspace and IT infrastructure is in place
 - Provide the technical training, mentoring and support to members of the new team, ensuring that the team is capable in the use of the required standards, processes and software tools at the earliest opportunity. 
 - Provide highly visible, inspirational leadership and direction for the emerging Buildings team, ensuring the Noida based team feel part of the wider team
 - Liaise with the established leadership of the GCC facility across the globe. 
 - Promote WSP in India Vision and Values - see below. 
 - Support and promote team work within the team, and the wider business

Technical and Project Management

- Raise the level of technical competence within the teams
 - Implement delivery and quality measurement processes
 - Agree Key Performance Indicators (KPI s) with the Head of GCC monitoring and regularly reporting. Identify and implement improvements to increase KPIs accordingly
 - Promote technical excellence in all our projects
 - Undertake technical reviews and contribute to the concept design
 - Provide continuous feedback to the Head of GCC on the effectiveness of the protocols and processes in place with a view to continuous improvement

Commercial

- Implement the project delivery systems and structures
 - Support management of resource requirements versus project requirements
 - Support liaison with UK business to drive up utilisation of GCC team
 - Support and advise UK on implementation of GCC within fee bid

Qualifications

- The applicant will have proven experience in the design of Building Services with significant experience in a similar role or demonstration of a good track record. 
 - The applicant will have proven experience in the design of Engineering Building Services. 
 - Must be conversant with technical mechanical or electrical software, such as IES, Amtech, Hevacomp, Relux and Dialux. 
 - A sound understanding of Microsoft Outlook, Word, Excel, Project is essential. 
 - Must be fluent in English with an excellent understanding of technical terminology. 
 - A sound understanding of Microsoft Outlook, Word, Excel, and project is essential. 
 - Must be fluent in English with an excellent understanding of technical terminology. 
 - The applicant should ideally have obtained British Chartered Engineer status or equivalent, possess a degree in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering and possess membership to an accredited engineering body. 

BGV: 

- Employment with WSP India is subject to the successful completion of a background verification ("BGV") check conducted by a third-party agency appointed by WSP India. 
 - Candidates are advised to ensure that all information provided during the recruitment process - including documents uploaded - is accurate and complete, both to WSP India and its BGV partner". 

About Us

WSP is one of the world's leading professional services consulting firms. We are dedicated to our local communities and propelled by international brainpower. We are technical experts and strategic advisors including engineers, technicians, scientists, architects, planners, surveyors and environmental specialists, as well as other design, program and construction management professionals. We design lasting solutions in the Transportation & Infrastructure, Property & Buildings, Earth & Environment, Power & Energy, Resources and Industry sectors, as well as offering strategic advisory services. Our talented people around the globe engineer projects that will help societies grow for lifetimes to come. 

With approximately 4, 000 talented people across 3 locations (Noida, Bengaluru & Mumbai offices) in India and more than 73, 000 globally, in 550 offices across 40 countries, we engineer projects that will help societies grow for lifetimes to come. 

At "WSP" we draw on the diverse skills and capabilities of our employees globally to compete for the most exciting and complex projects across the world and bring the same level of expertise to our local communities. We are proud to be an international collective of innovative thinkers who work on the most complex problems. Unified under one strong brand, we use our local expertise, international reach and global scale to prepare our cities and environments for the future, connect communities and help societies thrive in built and natural ecosystems. True to our guiding principles, our business is built on four cornerstones: Our People, Our Clients, Our Operational Excellence and Our Expertise. 

www. wsp. com

We are

- Passionate people doing purposeful and sustainable work that helps shape our communities and the future. 
 - A collaborative team that thrives on challenges and unconventional thinking. 
 - A network of experts channeling our curiosity into creating solutions for complex issues. 

Inspired by diversity, driven by inclusion, we work with passion and purpose. 

Working with Us

At WSP, you can access our global scale, contribute to landmark projects and connect with the brightest minds in your field to do the best work of your life. You can embrace your curiosity in a culture that celebrates new ideas and diverse perspectives. You can experience a world of opportunity and the chance to shape a career as unique as you. 

Our Hybrid Working Module

With us, you can operate in a flexible, agile, yet structured work environment and follow a Hybrid Work Model. 

- Maximize collaboration.
