 - Balance community, collaboration, opportunity, productivity, and efficiency. 

Health, Safety and Wellbeing

Our people are our greatest asset, and we prioritize a safe work environment. Health, safety, and wellbeing are integral to our culture, with each of us accountable for fostering a safe workplace through our "Making Health and Safety Personal" initiative. Our Zero Harm Vision drives us to reduce risks through innovative solutions, earning recognition for our global health and safety practices with the prestigious RoSPA Health and Safety Awards for six consecutive years. 

Inclusivity and Diversity

WSP India is dedicated to fostering a sustainable and inclusive work environment where our greatest strength - Our People -feel valued, respected, and supported. We ensure an unbiased approach in hiring, promotion, and performance evaluation, regardless of age, gender identity, race, religion, sexual orientation, marital status, physical ability, education, social status, or cultural background. 

Imagine a better future for you and a better future for us all. 

Join our close-knit community of over 73, 300 talented global professionals dedicated to making a positive impact. Together, we can make a difference in communities both near and far. 

With us, you can. 

Apply today.

data.title: GM - Multi Cloud Platform Lead
data.description:
Who We Are

VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology & Transformation. 

As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30, 000 FTE, our portfolio of next-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry-first model which brings together the best of in-house and 3rd party capability. 

We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal. 

#VOIS #BeUnrivalled #CreateTheFuture

About This Role

We are seeking an experienced technology leader to own and govern a diverse portfolio of technology products, multi-cloud platforms, infrastructure services, and enterprise transformation initiatives. This role combines Technology Portfolio Management, Strategic Account Management, Product Leadership, and Enterprise Transformation responsibilities to deliver business value, accelerate modernisation, enhance service excellence, and strengthen VOIS as a trusted strategic technology partner. 

The successful candidate will serve as the primary technology engagement lead between Vodafone markets and VOIS, collaborating with senior stakeholders including Product Managers, IT Leaders, Architects, Engineering Leaders, and CIO-level decision-makers. They will drive strategy, governance, cloud adoption, transformation programmes, and portfolio execution across complex technology environments. 

What You'll Do

- Own and govern a portfolio of technology products, cloud platforms, infrastructure services, and transformation initiatives aligned to strategic business objectives. 
 - Lead strategy, governance, and lifecycle management of multi-cloud platforms across Azure, AWS, OCI, and future cloud service providers. 
 - Act as the primary engagement interface between Vodafone markets and VOIS, building trusted and collaborative stakeholder relationships. 
 - Lead multiple Agile delivery teams to achieve portfolio objectives, customer outcomes, and strategic priorities. 
 - Contribute to business growth by supporting pre-sales activities and identifying opportunities across existing and new customers. 
 - Drive enterprise-wide transformation, cloud migration, cloud adoption, platform engineering, automation, resilience, and operational excellence programmes. 
 - Partner with Product Managers and business stakeholders to translate objectives into roadmaps, epics, features, and user stories. 
 - Champion SAFe Agile, Portfolio Management, DevOps, and modern engineering practices. 
 - Govern delivery performance, budgets, risks, dependencies, escalations, and stakeholder communications. 
 - Lead executive governance forums, service reviews, steering committees, portfolio reviews, and strategic planning discussions. 
 - Identify opportunities to expand technology services and increase business value delivery

Who You Are

- Extensive experience in Technology Delivery, Product Management, Cloud, Infrastructure, Transformation, or Service Leadership roles. 
 - Strong programme management expertise delivering large-scale transformation initiatives across multiple teams and business functions. 
 - Proven experience leading cloud migration, cloud adoption, and modernisation programmes in enterprise environments. 
 - Demonstrated success leading multiple Agile engineering teams within SAFe delivery models. 
 - Strong knowledge of cloud platform governance across Azure, AWS, GCP, OCI, and related cloud ecosystems. 
 - Experience managing platform lifecycle, resilience, security, performance, and cost optimisation. 
 - Strong understanding of cloud financial management, cloud efficiency, and value realisation principles. 
 - Proven ability to influence and engage CIOs, Product Leaders, IT Heads, and senior stakeholders. 
 - Experience defining technology roadmaps, governance frameworks, investment priorities, and portfolio strategies. 
 - Strong capability in: 
 - Multi-cloud strategy and governance
 - Growth planning
 - Capacity planning
 - Product and platform management

Not a perfect fit?

Concerned you may not meet every requirement? Vodafone is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align exactly with every aspect of the job description, you are encouraged to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best. 

What's In It For You

Opportunity to lead strategic, global-scale technology portfolios and transformation programmes. Exposure to senior executive stakeholders and enterprise technology leadership forums. Ability to influence cloud strategy, platform modernisation, and technology investment decisions. Opportunity to work across multiple markets, functions, and technology domains. A highly collaborative environment focused on innovation, customer value, and continuous improvement. Experience shaping the future direction of cloud, infrastructure, and platform services within a global organisation. 

What Skills You Will Learn

Advanced portfolio governance and strategic technology planning. Executive stakeholder management and strategic account leadership. Enterprise-scale cloud transformation and multi-cloud governance. SAFe Agile portfolio execution and large-scale delivery management. Cloud financial management, optimisation, and value realisation. Service excellence, resilience, and platform engineering best practices. Business growth identification and technology consulting capabilities. Enterprise transformation leadership across global teams and markets. 

VOIS Equal Opportunity Employer Commitment

Vodafone recognises and celebrates the value of diversity in building a workforce that reflects the customers and communities it serves. No form of discrimination is tolerated. This includes, but is not limited to, discrimination based on race, colour, age, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, maternity or parental status, ethnicity, disability, religion or belief, political affiliation, trade union membership, nationality, citizenship, indigenous status, medical condition, HIV status, neurodiversity, social origin, cultural background, marital or civil partnership status, or socio-economic background. 

Join Us

At Vodafone, we're working hard to build a better future. A more connected, inclusive and sustainable world. As a dynamic global community, it's our human spirit, together with technology, that empowers us to achieve this. 

We challenge and innovate in order to connect people, businesses, and communities across the world. Delighting our customers and earning their loyalty drive us, and we experiment, learn fast and get it done, together. 

With us, you can truly be yourself and belong, share inspiration, embrace new opportunities, thrive, and make a real difference. 

Alert

Apply for Vodafone jobs only through the official Vodafone Careers website to avoid job scams and fraud. 

#JDEnhancedByTARA

data.title: (PnP) VP Engineering
data.description:
The Job in short

You raise the engineering bar across Product & Platform - and you do it from Hyderabad as the senior craft and standards leader for our India superhub. You set what "good" means for how we build software, hold teams to it, and make Hyderabad a place the rest of Engineering takes cues from: talent density, technical judgment, and delivery discipline. 

Meet the job

As VP Engineering, You Own Engineering Excellence For Our Product Development Organisation Globally, With Hyderabad As Your Primary Stage. You Will

- Set and enforce global standards for engineering practice and Secure SDLC - what ships, what gets blocked, and how quality and predictability are measured across product teams. 
 - Be the lighthouse for the Hyderabad superhub: raise the local hiring and performance bar, build Staff+ talent density, and make the hub a visible benchmark for craft and accountability across Engineering. 
 - Own the engineering career framework and learning paths with engineering leadership so progression, calibration, and technical depth are consistent worldwide - and unmistakably strong in Hyderabad. 
 - Act with clear bar authority: advise product engineering leaders on architecture, quality, and delivery, and escalate or stop work when standards, security, or craft are at risk. 
 - Partner with Engineering Operations on developer experience, CI/CD, and AI-assisted workflows so tooling reinforces the bar rather than bypasses it. 
 - Scale excellence through chapters, mentorship, and targeted enablement - only where it hardens standards and talent, not as theatre. 

How about you?

We need a high-caliber engineering leader who has raised the bar in large, multi-site organisations - and who wants Hyderabad to be their proof point. You combine deep technical credibility with the backbone to reset culture where "yes" has outrun "done. "

- 10+ years of engineering leadership, with a proven record raising standards across organisations of 500+ engineers in multiple locations. 
 - Track record of hard resets: hiring bar, performance calibration, architecture/quality gates, and holding delivery pressure accountable to craft - not just running guilds or frameworks. 
 - Hands-on enough to pair in code and credible across web, mobile, and backend when guiding engineers and architects. 
 - Strong product sense: UX, business logic, and non-functionals - you know what good looks like end-to-end. 
 - Demonstrated ownership of career frameworks, engineering standards, and Secure SDLC in financial services or other regulated environments. 
 - Experience building or transforming a major engineering hub (or equivalent multi-site centre of excellence) - attracting senior talent and making that site a magnet, not a cost centre. 
 - Driven AI adoption in real product development, with judgment about where it raises quality and where it does not. 
 - A clear communicator who can set a vision, say no with reasons, and rally leaders around shared standards and commitments.

data.title: Architect - Logistics Systems
data.description:
Job Description

Williams-Sonoma India Technology Center

Job Description

Role Title Architect - Logistics Systems

Location Pune / Hyderabad, India (Hybrid)

About Williams-Sonoma India Technology Center

Williams-Sonoma India Technology Center is the technology hub for Williams-Sonoma, Inc. , supporting global digital commerce, supply chain, enterprise platforms, and customer experiences across our portfolio of brands. The India Technology Center partners closely with global business and engineering teams to build scalable, resilient, and innovative platforms that serve millions of customers worldwide. 

About The Team

The Logistics Technology team builds and supports the platforms that move products across the WSI supply chain, from distribution center operations and warehouse management to transportation and delivery for brands including Williams Sonoma, Pottery Barn, West Elm, and Rejuvenation. The team partners with Supply Chain, Distribution Center operations, product teams, delivery teams, and third-party vendors to deliver scalable solutions that keep fulfillment fast, accurate, and cost-effective. 

This is a hands-on, high-ownership team where architects and engineers work end to end: setting technical direction, designing systems, integrating with WMS and TMS platforms, and applying automation and AI to improve how the distribution network runs every day. 

About The Role

The Senior Architect will own the Logistics systems domain and provide broad technical leadership across Warehouse Management, Warehouse Execution, Warehouse Control, and Transportation Management platforms. The role sets architectural direction, defines and governs technical standards, and translates large programs and strategic initiatives into viable, scalable, and maintainable solutions. 

The role requires a senior technical leader who can operate as a domain subject matter expert, influence product and engineering direction, partner effectively with business stakeholders and vendors such as Manhattan Associates, and mentor architects and engineering practitioners across the enterprise. 

Key Responsibilities

- Set technical direction for the Logistics systems domain and ensure project and program designs align with enterprise principles, standards, and constraints. 
 - Create viable solution approaches for complex programs, decompose them into logical components, and define responsibilities, integration points, and dependencies across layers and systems. 
 - Propose and evaluate alternative designs, clearly articulate trade-offs, and make sound architectural decisions across competing approaches. 
 - Assess design impact across solution components and adjacent domain systems, including implications over a three-to-five-year horizon. 
 - Define and own enterprise integration architecture across WMS, WES, WCS, OMS, RMS, ERP, and TMS landscapes, including integration boundaries, canonical data flows, and system-of-record ownership. 
 - Decide the right integration style for each interaction, including synchronous, asynchronous, event-driven, and batch patterns, and document rationale, failure modes, idempotency, and recovery expectations. 
 - Design and govern reusable integration patterns, templates, service contracts, and reference implementations that delivery teams can adopt without rework. 
 - Define and advise on enterprise API standards, including versioning, backward compatibility, deprecation policy, governance, and security. 
 - Lead performance engineering for high-throughput and low-latency logistics workloads, including performance test strategy, capacity planning, bottleneck analysis, and ongoing optimization. 
 - Apply product thinking to platform and integration decisions by prioritizing capabilities based on user outcomes, business value, consumer needs, and roadmap alignment. 
 - Partner with product management and business teams to understand strategic initiatives and help decompose programs into deliverable projects. 
 - Initiate, lead, and contribute to creation and review of organizational technical standards, design principles, and architecture governance practices. 
 - Provide technical direction to architects and practitioners across Logistics and adjacent domains, review solution work, and mentor teams on complex technical topics. 
 - Accept ambiguity in large initiatives and devise practical approaches to resolve or accommodate uncertainty while maintaining delivery momentum. 

Experience

Required Qualifications

- 12+ years of software engineering and solution architecture experience, including at least 4 years in an architect role owning a business or systems domain. 
 - Proven track record setting architectural direction for enterprise-scale logistics, supply chain, retail, or distribution systems. 
 - Experience delivering in Agile environments, including program decomposition, estimation, and delivery tracking using Jira. 
 - Experience operating as a recognized subject matter expert across multiple major functions within a domain. 

Functional Expertise

- Proficient knowledge of Warehouse Management Systems, Warehouse Execution Systems, Warehouse Control Systems, and Transportation Management systems. 
 - Strong understanding of Distribution Center operations, slotting, labor management, fulfillment flows, and logistics execution processes. 
 - Hands-on experience with Manhattan WMOS and Manhattan Slotting, including third-party vendor integrations. 
 - Strong business acumen with the ability to connect technology direction to revenue, cost, service-level, and operational goals. 
 - Ability to learn adjacent skills and domains quickly where needed to make sound enterprise architecture decisions. 

Technical Expertise

- Deep technical expertise in microservices architecture, enterprise integration patterns, and scalable infrastructure design. 
 - Hands-on experience with Java, Spring Boot, RESTful web services, and event-driven integration using Kafka. 
 - Strong relational database skills across DB2, SQL Server, and Oracle, including data modeling for high-volume transactional systems. 
 - Experience with Kubernetes or similar container platforms, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and modern engineering practices. 
 - Working knowledge of secure coding standards, Git branching strategy, and code quality tools such as Sonar. 
 - Proficiency with observability tools such as AppDynamics, Splunk, ELK, and Grafana. 
 - Breadth across REST, messaging, streaming, file and batch interfaces, API gateways, and middleware, with sound judgment to select the right pattern for each use case. 
 - Experience defining API and event contract standards, including versioning, backward compatibility, schema evolution, and governance forums. 
 - Strong background in performance and load test design, throughput and latency profiling, capacity planning, and tuning of high-volume transactional systems. 
 - Working knowledge of zero-trust principles, OAuth 2. 0, OIDC, mTLS, token and secrets management, and API security controls. 

AI And Automation Skills

- AI-first mindset with the ability to define where AI and automation can create durable business and operational value. 
 - Experience using AI tools, AI agents, or automation platforms to improve operations, production support, data validation, reporting, testing, documentation, or knowledge retrieval. 
 - Ability to architect AI-agent led solutions for issue triage, exception monitoring, report generation, regression testing support, operational analytics, and enterprise knowledge retrieval. 
 - Practical understanding of retrieval-augmented generation, Model Context Protocol, agent tooling patterns, and safe grounding of AI in enterprise data and systems. 
 - Understanding of responsible AI practices including data privacy, security, auditability, compliance, validation of AI-generated outputs, and agent behavior evaluation. 
 - Awareness of AI security considerations such as prompt injection, data leakage, model and tool access control, tenant isolation, and guarded tool execution. 
 - Awareness of emerging supply chain data and compliance requirements such as Digital Product Passports and product traceability mandates. 

Leadership and Collaboration

- Demonstrated situational leadership with the ability to guide teams, drive execution, and deliver measurable business value. 
 - Ability to facilitate productive discussions across diverse stakeholder groups and drive alignment on architectural decisions. 
 - Experience mentoring architects and engineers and raising engineering standards across an organization. 
 - Strong communication skills with the ability to explain, defend, and adapt architectural decisions for both technical and business audiences. 

Education

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 

Why Join Williams-Sonoma India Technology Center

- Our people-first and performance-driven culture means that we provide opportunities to grow and build a career, and invest in the well-being of our associates, including comprehensive benefits to support you and your family. 
 - Scale and innovation of a Fortune 500 company combined with a high-ownership environment that empowers engineers to make real impact. 
 - Build and operate large-scale digital commerce and supply chain platforms serving millions of customers worldwide, working on systems that run at global scale. 
 - Continuous learning environment with opportunities to work on cutting-edge technologies, AI-driven solutions, and large-scale engineering challenges. 
 - Hybrid work model designed for flexibility and collaboration, with two in-office days for team engagement.

data.title: R0000860 - Professional Services Consultant
data.description:
We are a global team of innovators and pioneers dedicated to shaping the future of observability. At New Relic, we build an intelligent platform that empowers companies to thrive in an AI-first world by giving them unparalleled insight into their complex systems. As we continue to expand our global footprint, we're looking for passionate people to join our mission. If you're ready to help the world's best companies optimize their digital applications, we invite you to explore a career with us!

Role Description

We are a global team of innovators and pioneers dedicated to shaping the future of observability. At New Relic, we build an intelligent platform that empowers companies to thrive in an AI-first world by giving them unparalleled insight into their complex systems. As we continue to expand our global footprint, we're looking for passionate people to join our mission. If you're ready to help the world's best companies optimize their digital applications, we invite you to explore a career with us!

Your Opportunity

Join our team as a Professional Services Consultant, a critical role focused on the technical design, deployment, and adoption of the New Relic Observability platform for our most strategic customers. You will serve as the deep technical expert, translating complex customer needs into robust, scalable, and automated Observability solutions. 

In this role, you will bridge the gap between our product capabilities and the customer's modern, often cloud-native, application and infrastructure environments. You will architect solutions that leverage Platform Engineering best practices, integrating New Relic seamlessly into their CI/CD pipelines, automation frameworks, and internal developer platforms to drive wall-to-wall observability. Your success will be measured by the depth of technical value realized and the long-term strategic adoption of the platform across customer organizations. 

What You'll Do

- Architect and Design: Lead the technical design and architecture of comprehensive New Relic solutions, focusing on large-scale deployment, data correlation strategies, and best practices for instrumenting microservices, serverless, and complex distributed systems. 
 - Platform Integration & Automation: Design and implement automated deployment and configuration solutions for New Relic using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools (e. g. , Terraform, Ansible) and scripting (e. g. , Python, Go, Shell). Deeply integrate Observability into customer's Platform Engineering and CI/CD workflows (e. g. , Jenkins, GitLab, GitHub Actions). 
 - Technical Leadership: Serve as the subject matter expert on Observability concepts, APM, Infrastructure Monitoring, and Log Management. Lead technical workshops and design sessions with customer architects, engineers, and leadership to define the implementation roadmap. 
 - Troubleshooting and Optimization: Provide advanced technical guidance during initial deployments and optimization phases, addressing complex data ingestion, performance, and platform configuration challenges. 
 - Knowledge Transfer & Best Practices: Create and deliver technical documentation, blueprints, and training to enable customer Platform teams and internal Professional Services/Partner resources to confidently manage and extend the implemented solution. 

Your Qualifications

We believe that experience comes in many forms and are dedicated to building a diverse and inclusive team. If you believe you have the skills to be successful in this role, we encourage you to apply. 

- Extensive Technical Experience: 5+ years of hands-on experience in a technical consulting, solutions architecture, or senior engineering role, specifically focused on cloud and application performance technologies. 
 - Platform Engineering Mastery: Proven, extensive experience with core Platform Engineering concepts, including building and maintaining automated, self-service infrastructure and delivery pipelines. 
 - Automation and DevOps Proficiency: Deep expertise in Automation, Scripting (e. g. , Python), and CI/CD practices and tools. Experience with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) is highly valued. 
 - Observability Expertise: Exceptional knowledge and practical experience with Observability concepts (The Three Pillars) and products (New Relic, Datadog, Dynatrace, etc. ) is extremely important. You can articulate the 'why' and 'how' of Observability to technical and non-technical audiences. 
 - Cloud Proficiency: Hands-on experience designing and deploying solutions on major cloud providers (AWS, Azure, or GCP). 
 - Consultative Influence: Strong communication and presentation skills with the ability to influence senior technical stakeholders and drive consensus on complex technical architectures. 

Fostering a diverse, welcoming and inclusive environment is important to us. We work hard to make everyone feel comfortable bringing their best, most authentic selves to work every day. If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application or recruiting process, please reach out to resume@newrelic. com. 

We believe in empowering all Relics to achieve professional and business success through a flexible workforce model. This model allows us to work in a variety of workplaces that best support our success, including fully office-based, fully remote, or hybrid. 

Our hiring process

Headhunters and recruitment agencies may not submit resumes/CVs through this website or directly to managers. New Relic does not accept unsolicited headhunter and agency resumes, and will not pay fees to any third-party agency or company that does not have a signed agreement with New Relic.

The Automation Engineer independently manages end-to-end automation projects, from requirements gathering and analysis through development, testing, and deployment. Essential Skills

- Proven ability to manage and deliver automation projects independently from requirement gathering through deployment and implementation. 
 - Strong expertise in writing, debugging, error handling, and optimizing VBA code, including working with objects, methods, and events.

 - Ability to understand customer requirements and work effectively in a concept-to-design model. 
 - Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to identify issues, analyze root causes, and propose practical solutions. 
 - Experience integrating and automating workflows between Excel and other applications such as SharePoint, PowerPoint, and Outlook. 
 - Practical experience in automation using Excel VBA, Power Automate, GCP, BigQuery, and Python.

Work Environment

The role involves working in a highly collaborative, cross-functional environment that spans multiple time zones and cultures. You will use a modern technology stack that includes Excel VBA, Power Automate, GCP, BigQuery, Python, Power BI, Qlik Sense, and integrations with applications such as SharePoint, PowerPoint, and Outlook. The position emphasizes clear communication, regular interaction with stakeholders, and active participation in team discussions and presentations. Work is primarily focused on digital tools and data-driven solutions, with an emphasis on accuracy, reliability, and continuous improvement.

Diversity, Equity & Inclusion

data.title: Engineering Manager- TCMS
data.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner-and every person here makes that happen. You'll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world. 

This Position reports to: 

Engineering Manager - Traction

Your Role And Responsibilities

In this role, you will have the opportunity to lead the Train Control and Management System (TCMS) engineering function for railway transportation applications for ABB India, with responsibility for technology strategy, engineering delivery, software development, system integration, product quality, and customer satisfaction. 

The role will drive the development and delivery of reliable, safe, scalable, and cost-effective TCMS solutions for metro, commuter rail, EMU/MEMU, and locomotive applications, aligned with customer requirements, applicable railway standards, and ABB's global engineering processes. 

The work model for the role is: 

This role is contributing to the Motion business for Traction division based in Bangalore, India: 

You will be mainly accountable for: 

- Engineering Leadership & Strategy
 - Define and implement the TCMS engineering strategy in alignment with business objectives and global technology roadmaps. 
 - Lead and develop multidisciplinary engineering teams covering TCMS engineering, application engineering, and verification and validation. 
 - Establish engineering capacity planning, resource allocation, competency development, and succession planning. 
 - Drive engineering excellence, productivity, standardization, and continuous improvement across projects. 
 - Build a strong technical organization with clear ownership, accountability, and performance metrics. 
 - TCMS Product Development & System Architecture
 - Lead TCMS architecture, functional design, software development, configuration management, and system integration. 
 - Ensure integration of vehicle control, propulsion, auxiliary converters, braking, train communication networks, HMI, diagnostics, passenger information, and other vehicle subsystems
 - Govern interfaces between TCMS, propulsion control unit team and with customer. 
 - Drive reusable software platforms, modular architectures, product standardization, and localization initiatives. 
 - Ensure appropriate cybersecurity, safety, reliability, maintainability, and lifecycle management practices. 
 - Project Execution & Engineering Delivery
 - Take ownership of engineering deliverables, milestones, resource loading, and technical risks across multiple projects. 
 - Ensure timely delivery of software releases, engineering documents, interface specifications, test procedures, and validation reports. 
 - Drive resolution of critical technical issues during laboratory testing, combined system testing, vehicle integration, commissioning, and customer acceptance. 
 - Coordinate with project management, Global TCMS team, sourcing, quality, service, and global engineering teams. 
 - Manage engineering changes, deviations, configuration baselines, and product maturity throughout the project lifecycle. 
 - Verification, Validation & Quality
 - Establish a robust verification and validation strategy covering unit, software integration, system integration, vehicle-level, and regression testing. 
 - Ensure compliance with applicable railway standards and customer-specific requirements, including IEC 61375, IEC 62279, IEC 62425 and EN 50126/50128/50129, wherever applicable to the system and project. 
 - Drive prevention, root-cause analysis, corrective and preventive actions, and continuous improvement. 
 - Ensure engineering readiness for type testing, validation, customer witness testing, and commissioning. 
 - Strengthen requirements traceability, test coverage, design reviews, and release governance. 
 - Customer & Stakeholder Management
 - Act as the senior engineering interface for customers, rolling stock manufacturers, system integrators, and railway authorities. 
 - Lead technical reviews and resolve complex engineering issues with customers and suppliers. 
 - Align engineering scope, interfaces, responsibilities, assumptions, and acceptance criteria with stakeholders. 
 - Support technical proposals, tender reviews, design feasibility, risk assessment, and engineering cost optimization. 
 - Develop strong collaboration between Indian engineering teams and global technology centres. 
 - Business & Financial Performance
 - Align engineering investments, headcount, and capability development with business growth and project pipeline. 
 - Drive engineering cost optimization, localization, productivity improvement, and reuse of existing platforms. 
 - Support bids and order acquisition through technical strategy, solution validation, and realistic engineering estimates. 
 - Monitor engineering KPIs, including on-time delivery, software release maturity, defect leakage, rework, productivity, and resource utilization. 
 - Identify opportunities for new product development, technology differentiation, and expansion into emerging railway markets. 

Qualifications & Experience

- Bachelor's or master's degree in electrical engineering, Electronics, Electronics and Communication, Computer Engineering, or a related discipline. 
 - Typically, 15+ years of experience in railway engineering, TCMS, embedded systems, control systems, or rolling stock electronics. 
 - Significant experience leading engineering teams and delivering complex railway projects. 
 - Strong understanding of TCMS architecture, train communication networks, embedded software, system integration, verification and validation. 
 - Experience in metro, EMU/MEMU, locomotive, or other rolling stock applications. 
 - Familiarity with railway RAMS, software lifecycle processes, safety engineering, cybersecurity, and applicable railway standards. 
 - Experience in global engineering collaboration, customer management, project execution, and cross-functional leadership. 

Critical Leadership Competencies

- Strategic thinking and technology development. Engineering organization leadership and talent development. 
 - Strong system-level problem-solving and decision-making. Stakeholder management and customer orientation. 
 - Business acumen, cost consciousness, and execution discipline. Ability to balance technology innovation, project delivery, quality, and profitability. 

Reporting & Key Interfaces

- Reports to: Head of Engineering / Engineering Director / relevant business engineering leader, depending on ABB's organizational structure. 
 - Key interfaces: Global R&D, TCMS and propulsion engineering, project management, product management, quality, supply chain, manufacturing, service, customers, and rolling stock OEMs. 

More About Us
ABB Traction Division is a recognized leader in onboard propulsion technologies that drive innovation in rail, bus, and industrial vehicle electrification. A comprehensive range of high-performance and full lifecycle managed propulsion, auxiliary and energy storage solutions help improve energy efficiency and contribute to making transportation more sustainable. 

We value people from different backgrounds. Could this be your story? Apply today or visit www. abb. com to read more about us and learn about the impact of our solutions across the globe. #MyABBStory

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences. 

Ready to make an impact? Apply today or visit www. abb. com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe. 

Recruitment Fraud Warning

ABB never asks for payment from job applicants. All genuine job offers follow a formal application and interview process. 

View current job openings and apply at: https: //careers. abb/global/en/home

For more information, read our full fraud warning notice at: https: //global. abb/group/en/careers/how-to-apply/fraud-warning

Manager - Contract Manufacturing (CM) QA will collaborate with suppliers (CM, PCB Fabricators, Components) and internal cross-functional teams, including Purchase, Store, Engineering, Design, Manufacturing, Purchase and Production, to ensure manufacturing quality excellence across EMS partners as per Tejas networks requirements. 

Responsibilities

- Conduct supplier qualification assessments and process audits to ensure compliance with quality standards and business requirements. 
 - Define, monitor, and review Contract Manufacturer (CM) quality KPIs, and drive actions to improve performance. 
 - Review and approve Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA) related to customer complaints, yield losses, component failures, and significant process deviations. 
 - Validate manufacturing and assembly processes at Contract Manufacturer (CM) and System Integration sites to ensure compliance with product, process, and customer requirements. 
 - Implement, track, and ensure effective execution of Engineering Change Notices (ECNs). 
 - Review and approve quality plans for Pilot and Production Trials builds. 
 - Conduct weekly and monthly reviews of Contract Manufacturer (CM) quality performance and identify opportunities for improvement. 
 - Drive continuous improvement initiatives across CM processes to enhance product quality, process capability, and operational efficiency. 
 - Review PCBA production documentation and assess PCBA and system integration readiness prior to production builds. 
 - Collaborate with Design, Procurement, and Contract Manufacturing teams to resolve technical build issues and manufacturing queries within established timelines. 
 - Ensure manufacturing readiness and adherence to quality requirements throughout product introduction and production ramp-up activities. 

Mandatory Skills

- Interpretation of Gerber, BOM, Mechanical Fab drawing, Assembly Instructions. 
 - Knowledge on IPC-A-610, JDEC033, J-STD-001 standards. 
 - Knowledge on Mechanical Standards. 
 - Interpretation of Electronics & Mechanical technical queries. 
 - Excellent communication and collaboration skills to work effectively with cross-functional teams and influence stakeholders. 
 - Analytical mindset with proficiency in data analysis, presentation and report preparation skills. 
 - Diploma / Bachelor's degree in Electronics, or a related field. 
 - Candidates from EMS industry preferred. 

Qualifications

- Experience: 13 to 18 yrs of Proven experience in PCB assembly process & quality activities. 
 - Education: BE/B. Tech in Electronics or a related field. 

About Us

Tejas Networks is a global broadband, optical and wireless networking company, with a focus on technology, innovation and R&D. We design and manufacture high-performance wireline and wireless networking products for telecommunications service providers, internet service providers, utilities, defence and government entities in over 75 countries. Tejas has an extensive portfolio of leading-edge telecom products for building end-to-end telecom networks based on the latest technologies and global standards with IPR ownership. We are a part of the Tata Group, with Panatone Finvest Ltd. (a subsidiary of Tata Sons Pvt. Ltd. ) being the majority shareholder. Tejas has a rich portfolio of patents and has shipped more than 900, 000 systems across the globe with an uptime of 99. 999%. Our product portfolio encompasses wireless technologies (4G/5G based on 3GPP and O-RAN standards), fiber broadband (GPON/XGS-PON), carrier-grade optical transmission (DWDM/OTN), packet switching and routing (Ethernet, PTN, IP/MPLS) and Direct-to-Mobile and Satellite-IoT communication platforms. Our unified network management suite simplifies network deployments and service implementation across all our products with advanced capabilities for predictive fault detection and resolution. As an R&D-driven company, we recognize that human intelligence is a core asset that drives the organization's long-term success. Over 60% of our employees are in R&D, we are reshaping telecom networks, one innovation at a time. 

Diversity And Inclusion Statement

- Tejas Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating all inclusive environment for all employees. 
 - We welcome applicants of all backgrounds regardless of race color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, age or veteran status. 
 - Our goal is to build a workforce that reflects the diverse communities we serve and to ensure every employee feels valued and respected. 

About The Team

At Tejas Networks, product development is driven by a comprehensive lifecycle approach that begins with understanding customer and network requirements, followed by competitive analysis, architectural design, and implementation. This process emphasizes performance, scalability, cost-efficiency, and environmental considerations, culminating in deployment and operational support. The technology portfolio spans diverse networking domains, including optical transport (DWDM, OTN), broadband access (GPON, XGSPON, CPON), service provider routing (IP/MPLS, Segment Routing, MPLS-TP), and enterprise switching (L2/L3). Products range from compact systems to complex, multi-terabit, chassis-based platforms designed for high availability, modularity, and scalability. Overview

Microsoft is building the future of AI-powered work, and the Agent 365 team is at the centre of it. We're looking for a passionate Senior Software Engineer to help design, build and scale the platform that lets organisations deploy, manage and secure AI agents across the Microsoft Cloud. 

In this role you'll work on large-scale, cloud-native systems that use big data, machine learning, natural language processing and search technologies to give customers intelligent, secure and reliable agent experiences. You'll work closely with product managers, researchers, security experts and engineering teams around the world to turn complex customer needs into high-quality solutions on Azure, Microsoft Entra and Microsoft 365. 

Security and trust are at the core of what we build. You'll bring a security-first mindset, apply practices such as threat analysis and penetration testing, and help keep our services resilient and compliant. We value engineers who are curious, take ownership, engage directly with customers and enjoy solving hard problems in a fast-moving, collaborative environment. 

If you're excited by cloud and AI and want to shape how millions of people and organisations work with intelligent agents, we'd love to hear from you. 

Responsibilities

 - Creates, implements, optimizes, debugs, refactors, and reuses code to establish and improve performance and maintainability, effectiveness, and return on investment (ROI).

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

 - 8+ years of professional software development experience. 
 - Hands-on experience with C++ and/or C#, along with exposure to big data, machine learning (ML), natural language processing (NLP) and search technologies. 
 - Strong analytical skills, with experience in customer engagement and cross-functional collaboration. 
 - Familiarity with Microsoft Cloud services (Azure, Microsoft Entra, Microsoft 365). 
 - Security awareness, including penetration testing and threat analysis.

Preferred Qualifications

- A technical software engineer with a passion for cloud technologies and AI. 
 - Previous experience as a Software Development Engineer. 
 - Track record of working closely with agile, diverse engineering teams. 
 - Understanding of cloud, AI and other computing technologies, including business drivers and emerging trends across Microsoft and non-Microsoft technologies.

 - Self-starter who enjoys tackling new challenges and working independently. 
 - Ability to build relationships with senior technical and business leaders.

data.description:
We are a global team of innovators and pioneers dedicated to shaping the future of observability. At New Relic, we build an intelligent platform that empowers companies to thrive in an AI-first world by giving them unparalleled insight into their complex systems. As we continue to expand our global footprint, we're looking for passionate people to join our mission. If you're ready to help the world's best companies optimize their digital applications, we invite you to explore a career with us!

About The Team

The NR Lens team builds New Relic's Federated Data Platform - a distributed SQL query engine that lets customers connect external data sources (Snowflake, PostgreSQL, Google Sheets, AWS CloudWatch) and query them directly from New Relic. 

You'll work on the distributed query execution layer, connector architecture, and API gateway that powers cross-source JOINs and unified analytics across customer data stores. 

What You'll Do

- Design, build, and maintain cloud-native Java microservices in the NR Lens query path: SQL Gateway, Query Gateway, and data source connector plugins
 - Develop and harden JDBC connector integrations - including connection lifecycle management, credential handling, query pushdown optimization, and security validation
 - Improve query reliability and performance across a multi-tenant distributed SQL deployment serving 50+ customers
 - Build and operate services on AWS (EKS, IAM/STS, S3) with infrastructure-as-code practices
 - Implement security controls for user-supplied connection parameters (JDBC URL validation, SSRF prevention, hostname allowlisting)
 - Build materialized view scheduling, execution, and lifecycle management features
 - Design and implement deployment automation - canary deployments, progressive rollouts, observability integration
 - Collaborate with the NRDB/Dirac team on the internal connector bridging federated queries to New Relic's native telemetry engine
 - Participate in on-call rotation and incident response for production systems

What We're Looking For

Must Have

- 5+ years of professional Java development . 
 - Strong experience building cloud-native applications on AWS. 
 - Experience designing and operating containerized microservices on Kubernetes
 - Experience building and operating distributed systems at scale
 - Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform) and CI/CD pipelines
 - Experience with AWS security patterns. 
 - Experience with observability tooling - defining SLOs/SLIs, dashboards, alerting
 - Comfort debugging production issues across multi-service architectures
 - Experience with gRPC or Thrift-based service communication
 - Experience with GraphQL APIs

Nice To Have

- Strong understanding of SQL query execution - parsing, planning, optimization, or execution engines
 - Experience with JDBC drivers, connection pooling, and database connector development
 - Experience with distributed query engines or SQL-on-anything platforms
 - Experience developing plugins or connectors for distributed query engines (SPI-based architectures)
 - Knowledge of RBAC/authorization systems in multi-tenant SaaS environments

Please note that visa sponsorship is not available for this position.

Their experiences and perspectives inspire us to make our products and company the best they can be. We're looking for people who feel connected to our mission and values, not just candidates who check off all the boxes.

data.description:

____________________

Position summary

The Senior Supplier Quality and Development Engineer leads supplier quality and development initiatives across the global supply base for Corporate Supplier Quality and Development in India. This role supports sourcing and supply chain optimization projects by applying quality engineering expertise to improve supplier performance, reduce risk, and meet business goals. 

The position evaluates supplier capability, capacity, stability, and risk, while driving continuous improvement through standardized processes, supplier development, and advanced problem-solving tools. The role also provides technical leadership, mentoring, and support to internal teams and suppliers, and reports to the Mexico Manager of Supplier Quality and Development. 

Key Responsibilities

- Conduct supplier assessments for current and potential suppliers, identify risks, and drive corrective actions and development plans
 - Monitor supplier performance metrics and scorecards, and lead improvement plans to meet quality, safety, and delivery expectations
 - Lead supplier quality activities including capacity assessments, APQP, PPAP, corrective and preventive actions, and process improvement initiatives
 - Partner with internal stakeholders and suppliers on technical quality issues, sourcing projects, and supply chain optimization efforts
 - Mentor plant quality staff, supplier quality engineers, and suppliers on quality systems, best practices, and problem-solving tools
 - Support issue resolution, standardize quality processes, and drive continuous improvement across the supply chain
 - Perform other duties as assigned

Professional Experience/qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in mechanical, materials, industrial, or manufacturing engineering with 10+ years of supplier quality and/or quality assurance experience in a manufacturing or assembly environment; advanced degree preferred. 
 - Experience in manufacturing processes such as casting, machining, forgings, metallurgy, heat treatment, electronics, plastics, or coatings. 
 - Strong knowledge of quality tools and methodologies including Six Sigma, APQP, PPAP, FMEA, MSA, SPC, root cause analysis, and statistical problem-solving. 
 - Experience with supplier audits, quality management systems, ISO 9001, TS16949, AIAG CQI audits, metrology, inspection, and new product development. 
 - Strong analytical, project management, organizational, and communication skills, with the ability to lead teams and influence stakeholders in a matrix environment. 
 - Proficient in MS Office, ERP systems, and lean manufacturing tools; quality or engineering certifications are preferred. 
 - Domestic travel required, with 50%+ travel expected. 

About Regal Rexnord

Regal Rexnord is a publicly held global industrial manufacturer with 30, 000 associates around the world who help create a better tomorrow by providing sustainable solutions that power, transmit and control motion. The Company's electric motors and air moving subsystems provide the power to create motion. A portfolio of highly engineered power transmission components and subsystems efficiently transmits motion to power industrial applications. The Company's automation offering, comprised of controls, actuators, drives, and precision motors, controls motion in applications ranging from factory automation to precision control in surgical tools. 

The Company's end markets benefit from meaningful secular demand tailwinds, and include factory automation, food & beverage, aerospace, medical, data center, warehouse, alternative energy, residential and commercial buildings, general industrial, construction, metals and mining, and agriculture. 

Regal Rexnord is comprised of three operating segments: Industrial Powertrain Solutions, Power Efficiency Solutions, and Automation & Motion Control. data.title: Senior Power Platform Engineer

data.description:
Alimentiv is a global CRO with a singular focus: advancing therapies for patients with gastrointestinal diseases. GI is our WHY and for more than 30 years that purpose has driven our scientific rigour, operational excellence, and deep therapeutic expertise, including supporting more than 70% of IBD compounds in development. 
We operate as a private, profit-with-purpose company, channeling our commercial success back into scientific research, technology, and our people. With approximately 700 people across multiple countries and three service lines, we are growing deliberately, and the capability of our leaders and our organization is central to how we get there. 

If you want to do meaningful work, build something real, and invest back in research that changes lives - we want to meet you!

Job Overview

We are seeking an experienced Senior Integration Developer to design, develop, and maintain secure, scalable, and reliable integration solutions connecting business applications, clinical systems, and enterprise data platforms. 

In this role, you will leverage Azure Integration Services, APIs, messaging technologies, and event-driven architectures to enable seamless data exchange across internal systems, cloud platforms, and external partners. You will play a key role in improving integration performance, automation, monitoring, and security while ensuring compliance with relevant data governance and regulatory requirements. 

Working closely with technical teams, application owners, vendors, and business stakeholders, you will contribute to integration architecture decisions, support production environments, and provide technical guidance to junior developers. 

  

Key Responsibilities

- 
Design, develop, and maintain scalable integration solutions using Azure Logic Apps, Azure Functions, Azure Service Bus, Event Grid, and API Management. 

- 
Build and support REST/JSON and SOAP/XML integrations connecting enterprise applications, SaaS platforms, external vendors, and data environments. 

- 
Implement messaging and event-driven architectures, including queues, publish/subscribe patterns, message handling, and error recovery mechanisms. 

- 
Develop serverless applications and custom integration components using Python and/or C#, ensuring performance, reliability, and scalability. 

- 
Implement monitoring, logging, alerting, and troubleshooting solutions using Azure Monitor, Application Insights, and Log Analytics. 

- 
Automate integration deployments through Git-based CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform, ARM, or Bicep. 

- 
Develop reusable integration frameworks, automated testing processes, and standardised components to improve development efficiency and reliability. 

- 
Apply security best practices, including OAuth 2. 0, Microsoft Entra ID, managed identities, and Azure Key Vault, while ensuring compliance with GxP, GDPR, and HIPAA requirements. 

- 
Collaborate with application owners, vendors, and business stakeholders to translate technical and operational requirements into effective integration solutions. 

- 
Participate in technical design reviews, mentor junior developers, contribute to architecture improvements, and identify opportunities to optimise integration processes. 

Skills & Qualifications

- 
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related discipline; a Master's degree is preferred. 

- 
5-8 years of experience designing, developing, and supporting enterprise integration solutions, including APIs, messaging systems, event-driven architectures, and serverless technologies. 

- 
Expert-level proficiency in Azure Integration Services, including Azure Service Bus, Logic Apps, Azure Functions, Event Grid, and API Management. 

- 
Strong programming skills in Python and/or C#, with working knowledge of SQL and experience developing API-based and serverless integration solutions. 

- 
Proven experience designing, developing, and consuming REST and SOAP APIs using JSON, XML, OpenAPI, and OAuth 2. 0. 

- 
Strong experience with Azure Monitor, Application Insights, Log Analytics (KQL), and integration monitoring, troubleshooting, and performance optimisation. 

- 
Hands-on experience with Git, CI/CD automation using GitHub Actions, and infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform, ARM, or Bicep. 

- 
Familiarity with AWS integration services, including Lambda, SQS, SNS, EventBridge, and API Gateway; experience integrating with Databricks or Microsoft Fabric is advantageous. 

- 
Understanding of cloud security, data governance, and regulatory requirements, including GxP, GDPR, and HIPAA; experience in life sciences or healthcare is highly desirable. 

- 
Excellent communication, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work independently, collaborate across teams, mentor junior developers, and meet project deadlines. 

What We OfferIn addition, as an Alimentiv Employee, you're also eligible for the following programs: 

- Education Reimbursement program for full-time employees

- Monthly Cell Phone and Remote Work Allowance (dependent on role eligibility)

- One time office setup allowance (can be used to purchase a scanner/printer, extra monitor, office furniture, etc. )

- Working while visiting program - up to 4 weeks per year!

- Flexible Summer Hours Program from May - September

- Employee referral incentive - we know great people know other great people, and we think that warrants recognition!

- Full-time employees also become beneficiaries of the Alimentiv Trust after one year of employment, and permanent members after 5 years of employment

- Optional formal mentorship program (Alimentorship); country/region annual social events in person; leadership development programs for people leaders in accordance with your seniority; social committee and several other optional initiatives designed to support you in feeling like part of the Alimentiv team!

Additional benefits may be available depending on the country of employment and are subject to local policies and eligibility. 

Our Services

- End-to-end GI clinical trial services, from protocol design through submission support

- Central medical imaging management and endoscopic reading

- Precision medicine and biomarker solutions

- Real-world evidence and clinical consulting

- Histopathology and lab services through AcelaBio

How to ApplyTo apply for this position, please submit your resume through the Alimentiv Careers Portal or via LinkedIn's Easy Apply. Resumes must be submitted in English. 

Equal Opportunity and AccessibilityAlimentiv is committed to building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace. We are an equal opportunity employer and consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, colour, ethnicity, national origin, religion or belief, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital or family status, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.   
  
Accommodations are available upon request for persons with disabilities throughout the recruitment and selection process. Requests can be directed to recruitment@alimentiv. com. 

Stay Alert to Recruitment Scams
Alimentiv is aware of a continued increase in phishing scams, which use various methods of attack via email, text, voice and social media, including individuals posing as our recruiters and contacting candidates with fraudulent opportunities. Our hiring process always includes direct engagement with a recruiter or hiring manager, and we will never ask for sensitive personal information early in the process. 

Official communication will only come from company email addresses containing "@alimentiv. com". If you are contacted about an open job at Alimentiv, please verify the domain of the sender's email address and confirm that you are being asked to apply on this website. If something doesn't feel right, we encourage you to verify before responding. If you believe you have been the victim of a phishing scam, please contact your local government cyber authority to report it. 

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

data.title: Head – Mechanical Engineering (Defence & Aerospace)
data.description:
Experience: 10+ Years

Location: Gurugram  

Department: Engineering / R&D  

Reporting To: CEO / Head of R&D

  

Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced Head - Mechanical Engineering to lead mechanical design, structural development, packaging, integration and qualification of complex systems for defence and aerospace programmes. 

The candidate will lead the mechanical engineering team, own key design decisions, coordinate manufacturing and outsourced engineering vendors, and take mechanical systems from concept through detailed design, prototype, qualification and production. 

Projects include Tethered aerostat and radar platforms, Underwater Communication Systems, AUV systems, UAV/avionics platforms and surveillance systems. 

Previous hands-on experience in defence, aerospace or military-grade engineering programmes is mandatory. 

  

Key Responsibilities Technical Leadership & Team Management

  

●        Lead and mentor mechanical design, structural and manufacturing engineers across multiple projects. 

●          Define system mechanical architecture, structural concepts, packaging philosophy and interface requirements. 

●          Allocate engineering activities and ensure project milestones, technical reviews and deliverables are achieved. 

●        Conduct concept, PDR/CDR, manufacturing and test-readiness reviews. 

●        Coordinate closely with electronics, RF, firmware, systems and manufacturing teams. 

●        Identify mechanical risks and drive technical decisions and corrective actions. 

  

Mechanical Design & Analysis

  

●        Lead/review 3D modelling, detailed drawings, GD&T, tolerance stack-up and engineering calculations. 

●          Design/review structural frames, payload enclosures, LRUs, equipment racks, brackets, housings, mounts and mechanisms. 

●        Perform/review structural, static, dynamic, vibration, shock and thermal analyses. 

●        Apply FEA for structural integrity, deformation, modal response, fatigue and optimisation. 

●          Ensure appropriate material selection considering strength, weight, corrosion, environment and manufacturability. 

●          Design ruggedised solutions suitable for airborne, naval, underwater and field-deployed environments. 

●          Ensure mechanical designs consider thermal management, ingress protection, sealing, vibration isolation and maintainability. 

Manufacturing & Vendor Management

  

●          Coordinate with external vendors for machining, sheet-metal fabrication, composites, welding, casting, surface treatment and specialised manufacturing. 

●        Prepare technical drawings, manufacturing specifications, SOWs and acceptance criteria. 

●        Evaluate and review vendor designs, manufacturing processes, tooling and first-article components. 

●        Monitor vendor quality, timelines, manufacturing tolerances and delivery. 

●        Lead DFM/DFA activities and optimise designs for production, cost and repeatability. 

●        Support development of fixtures, jigs, assembly tooling and production documentation. 

  

Qualification & Reliability

  

●        Lead structural, environmental, vibration, shock, temperature and mechanical qualification activities. 

●          Experience with applicable defence/aerospace standards such as MIL-STD-810, JSS 55555, RTCA DO-160 or equivalent environmental requirements. 

●        Prepare/review qualification plans, test procedures, compliance matrices and test reports. 

●          Coordinate with certification, inspection and customer quality teams during qualification and acceptance. 

●        Conduct design FMEA, failure analysis and corrective-action activities. 

  

System Integration & Field Trials

  

●          Lead mechanical integration of electronics, sensors, antennas, payloads, power systems and other subsystems. 

●        Ensure interface compliance between mechanical, electrical and system-level assemblies. 

●        Support prototype assembly, system integration, field trials and qualification testing. 

●        Resolve mechanical issues identified during trials and customer acceptance. 

●        Maintain drawings, BOMs, interface documents, design calculations and configuration records. 

  

Mandatory Qualification & Experience

●        B. E. /B. Tech in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent discipline. M. Tech preferred. 

●          10+ years of mechanical product/system development experience, preferably in defence or aerospace. 

●        Minimum 3 years leading a mechanical engineering/design team. 

●        Prior experience working on defence/aerospace projects is mandatory. 

●        Strong hands-on mechanical design and engineering analysis capability. 

●        Expertise in 3D CAD and engineering drawings using SolidWorks, Creo, CATIA, NX or equivalent. 

●          Strong understanding of GD&T, tolerance analysis, materials, manufacturing processes and assembly design. 

●        Experience with structural/thermal FEA using ANSYS, Abaqus, Nastran or equivalent tools. 

●        Experience taking products from concept through prototype, qualification and production. 

●          Prior involvement in environmental/structural qualification or certification of defence/aerospace equipment. 

●        Experience coordinating outsourced design and manufacturing vendors. 

Technical Knowledge

Candidate should have strong knowledge of: 

  

●        Structural design and load calculations. 

●        Static, dynamic, modal, vibration and shock analysis. 

●        Fatigue and structural reliability. 

●        Thermal management and heat-transfer fundamentals. 

●        Sheet metal, CNC machining, welding, composites, casting and additive manufacturing. 

●        Material selection including aluminium alloys, steels, composites and engineering polymers. 

●        Corrosion protection, coatings and surface-treatment processes. 

●        Environmental sealing, IP-rated enclosure design and ruggedisation. 

●        Lightweight design and structural optimisation. 

●        Mechanical packaging of electronics and avionics equipment. 

  

Preferred Experience

●        Experience with DRDO, HAL, BEL, DPSUs, Indian Armed Forces or defence OEMs. 

●          Mechanical development of UAVs, aerostats, radar systems, underwater platforms, surveillance systems or similar equipment. 

●        Experience with airborne structures, payload mounting systems and ruggedised equipment. 

●        Exposure to underwater pressure housings, watertight enclosures and corrosion-resistant design. 

●        Experience with composite structures and lightweight aerospace design. 

●        Knowledge of configuration management, defence documentation and production quality processes. 

  

Leadership Competencies

●        Strong engineering judgement and design-review capability. 

●        Ability to lead and grow a multidisciplinary mechanical team. 

●        Strong analytical and structured problem-solving ability. 

●        Effective vendor management and manufacturing coordination. 

●        Ability to manage multiple programmes and aggressive development schedules. 

●        Strong communication with engineering teams, customers and external partners. 

●        Willingness to travel for manufacturing reviews, integration and field trials. 

  

Critical Selection Criteria: Defence/aerospace project experience, strong mechanical design and analysis capability, team leadership, vendor management and prior qualification/testing experience are mandatory.

data.description:
JOB DESCRIPTIONHead of Quality Control (QC)Company: DGZ Holdings

Business Units: Flavours of Calicut | Crizpo | DGZ Food Manufacturing LLP

Department: Quality Control / Quality Assurance

Experience: Minimum 10 Years

Job Type: Full-Time

Location: Kerala, India

Reporting To: Management

1. Job SummaryWe are looking for an experienced and detail-oriented Head of Quality Control to lead and oversee quality control and quality assurance operations across our food manufacturing units. The ideal candidate should have at least 10 years of experience in the food processing or FMCG industry, with strong expertise in food safety, quality management systems, regulatory compliance, product quality, and process improvement. 

The candidate will be responsible for establishing and maintaining quality standards across the entire production process, ensuring that all products meet applicable food safety regulations, company specifications, and customer expectations. 

2. Key ResponsibilitiesA. Quality Control & Assurance

- Lead and manage all Quality Control (QC) and Quality Assurance (QA) activities across manufacturing and packaging operations. 
 - Establish, implement, and monitor quality standards for raw materials, ingredients, work-in-progress, finished products, and packaging materials. 
 - Ensure consistent product quality, taste, texture, appearance, freshness, and shelf life across all product categories. 
 - Develop and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), quality specifications, inspection checklists, and quality control plans. 
 - Monitor quality at every stage of production, from raw material procurement to finished product dispatch. 
 - Establish appropriate sampling, testing, inspection, and product release procedures. B. Food Safety & Regulatory Compliance

- Ensure compliance with applicable FSSAI regulations, food safety standards, and other relevant statutory requirements. 
 - Implement and maintain food safety management systems, including HACCP-based controls, GMP, and GHP. 
 - Lead internal quality audits, hygiene inspections, and compliance assessments. 
 - Coordinate with external auditors, regulatory authorities, certification bodies, and testing laboratories as required. 
 - Ensure proper documentation, traceability, batch records, and quality-related statutory records are maintained. 
 - Monitor sanitation, personal hygiene, pest control, storage conditions, and overall manufacturing hygiene. C. Raw Material & Supplier Quality

- Establish quality specifications and acceptance criteria for raw materials, ingredients, and packaging materials. 
 - Work closely with Procurement and suppliers to ensure the quality and consistency of incoming materials. 
 - Develop supplier evaluation, approval, and performance monitoring processes. 
 - Investigate raw material quality issues and coordinate corrective actions with suppliers. 
 - Ensure appropriate inspection and testing of incoming materials before approval for production. D. Production & Process Quality

- Work closely with Production, New Product Development (NPD), Procurement, Packaging, and Warehouse teams to maintain consistent product quality. 
 - Monitor critical process parameters and establish suitable controls to minimize product defects and variations. 
 - Identify quality deviations during production and ensure timely corrective and preventive actions. 
 - Conduct root cause analysis for recurring quality issues and implement effective solutions. 
 - Establish in-process inspection procedures and ensure adherence to approved formulations, processing methods, and product specifications. 
 - Support process improvement initiatives to reduce rejection rates, wastage, rework, and customer complaints. E. Product Testing & Shelf-Life Management

- Oversee product sampling, sensory evaluation, laboratory testing, and third-party testing where required. 
 - Coordinate microbiological, chemical, physical, and other relevant tests based on product risk and regulatory requirements. 
 - Establish and monitor shelf-life validation procedures for new and existing products. 
 - Ensure appropriate packaging integrity, storage conditions, and product stability. 
 - Review test results and approve products for release in accordance with established quality standards and procedures. F. Customer Complaints & Corrective Actions

- Lead the investigation of customer complaints related to product quality, food safety, packaging, contamination, or shelf life. 
 - Identify root causes and implement corrective and preventive actions (CAPA). 
 - Maintain a complaint analysis system to identify recurring issues and improvement opportunities. 
 - Coordinate with Customer Support, Production, and other relevant teams to resolve quality-related concerns. 
 - Establish procedures for product withdrawal, recall, and incident management where necessary. G. Team Leadership & Training

- Lead, mentor, and develop the QC/QA team across manufacturing operations. 
 - Define team responsibilities, performance expectations, and quality-related KPIs. 
 - Conduct training sessions on food safety, hygiene, quality standards, documentation, and inspection procedures. 
 - Build a strong quality culture by promoting accountability and adherence to established processes. 
 - Ensure adequate staffing, training, and resources for effective quality operations. H. Documentation, Reporting & Continuous Improvement

- Maintain accurate records of inspections, testing, non-conformities, audits, corrective actions, and product approvals. 
 - Prepare periodic quality performance reports for management. 
 - Track quality KPIs, including rejection rates, customer complaints, non-conformities, audit findings, and CAPA closure. 
 - Identify opportunities to improve product consistency, process efficiency, food safety, and operational performance. 
 - Support new product launches, formulation trials, packaging changes, and process validation in coordination with the NPD team. 3. Educational Qualifications
 - Bachelor's or Master's degree in Food Technology, Food Science, Food Engineering, Microbiology, Chemistry, Biochemistry, or a related discipline. 
 - Additional qualifications in Food Safety, Quality Management, HACCP, or related fields will be an advantage. 
 - Relevant certifications in ISO 22000, FSSC 22000, HACCP, or Internal/Lead Auditing will be preferred. 4. Experience & Technical Requirements
 - Minimum 10 years of relevant experience in Quality Control and/or Quality Assurance within food manufacturing, food processing, or FMCG. 
 - Demonstrated experience in managing quality operations at a manufacturing facility, preferably with multiple product categories. 
 - Strong knowledge of FSSAI regulations, food safety practices, HACCP principles, GMP, GHP, and quality management systems. 
 - Experience in handling internal and external audits, regulatory inspections, product testing, and quality documentation. 
 - Practical experience in root cause analysis, CAPA, risk assessment, and non-conformance management. 
 - Experience in supplier quality management, shelf-life studies, product validation, and customer complaint investigations. 
 - Previous experience leading and managing a QC/QA team is essential. 5. Key Skills & Competencies
 - Strong leadership and team management skills. 
 - Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities. 
 - High attention to detail and a systematic approach to quality management. 
 - Strong communication and cross-functional coordination skills. 
 - Ability to identify potential quality risks and implement preventive measures. 
 - Strong documentation, reporting, and audit management capabilities. 
 - Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced food manufacturing environment. 
 - High standards of integrity, accountability, and commitment to food safety. 
 - Ability to drive continuous improvement and establish a quality-focused work culture. 6. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)Performance will be evaluated based on the following parameters: 

- Compliance with applicable food safety and regulatory requirements. 
 - Reduction in product rejection, rework, and quality-related wastage. 
 - Reduction in customer complaints and recurring product defects. 
 - Timely completion and closure of corrective and preventive actions. 
 - Successful completion of internal and external quality audits. 
 - Consistency of product quality across batches and production units. 
 - Effectiveness of supplier quality monitoring. 
 - Timely completion of product testing and shelf-life validation. 
 - Effectiveness of QC/QA team training and performance. 
 - Accuracy and completeness of quality documentation and traceability records. 7. Ideal Candidate ProfileThe ideal candidate will be a hands-on quality professional who combines strong technical knowledge with practical manufacturing experience and leadership capability. They should be comfortable working closely with Production, NPD, Procurement, Packaging, and Warehouse teams while maintaining independent judgment on quality and food safety matters. 

The candidate must be proactive in identifying risks, resolving quality issues, strengthening food safety systems, and ensuring that quality standards are consistently maintained across all products and manufacturing operations. 

8. Application ProcessInterested candidates may submit their updated CV along with details of their relevant experience, current CTC, expected CTC, and notice period. 

Email: hr@flavoursofcalicut. com

COMPANY PROFILE

Bain & Company is one of the top management consulting firms in the world that helps the world's most ambitious changemakers define the future. 

Across 65 cities in 40 countries, we work alongside our clients as one team with a shared ambition to achieve extraordinary results, outperforming the competition, and redefine industries.
