Global Business Services (GBS) is a network of five interconnected business functions hubs across India, Poland, Malaysia, Mexico and Portugal, serving Bain globally to run our business, support other functions, and help drive innovation internally. We are over 1000 business professionals - serving functions in operations, HR, finance, legal, tech, marketing, research, and data analytics - who support our offices globally. Our mantra of "shared innovation, seamless execution, " underpinned by a passion for results, teamwork, and creativity, helps Bain stay at the top of our game operationally. 

WHAT MAKES US A GREAT PLACE TO WORK

We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world's best places to work. We are currently the top-ranked consulting firm on Glassdoor's Best Places to Work list and have earned the #1 overall spot a record seven times. 

Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don't happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally. 

WHO YOU'LL WORK WITH

This position sits within an agile data engineering team, owning the quality of end-to-end data pipelines from source ingestion through medallion-layer transformation (Bronze/Silver/Gold) to BI/reporting consumption. The role suits someone who thinks like a data architect and builds/tests like an engineer, equally comfortable with pipeline design and hands-on SQL, PySpark, and automated data quality frameworks. 

WHERE YOU'LL FIT WITHIN THE TEAM

The engineer independently owns the data testing strategy for their workstream, including a reusable SQL validation library usable for both manual and automated checks, and constructively challenges design or process decisions that risk data integrity or delivery quality. Works closely with Data Engineers, the QA Manager, Product/Project Managers, and business stakeholders. 

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Requirement, Project and Business Understanding (20%)

- Develop deep expertise in the data domain and business context source systems, transformation logic, medallion layers, and downstream BI consumption. 
 - Build a thorough understanding of the pipeline lifecycle (ingestion → staging → transformation → curated/BI layer). 
 - Review source-to-target mappings and transformation logic before test design begins. 
 - Support the team on data QA methodologies and processes, with guidance from QA leadership. Test Planning, Design, Execution, and Defect Management (35%)

- Own the data testing strategy across full, incremental, delta, and historical loads, including insert/update/delete/cancel and effective-dated transactions. 
 - Design and execute ETL/ELT validation, reconciliation, schema, null/completeness, and transformation test cases across the medallion architecture. 
 - Validate pipelines end-to-end source through Databricks/ADF/Spark to final BI output, confirming numbers, aggregations, and business logic tie out. 
 - Define and enforce data quality rules and build reusable checks; investigate anomalies and drive root-cause analysis with Data Engineers. 
 - Manage the defect lifecycle and prepare test evidence, quality dashboards, and RCA reporting for release sign-off.   SQL Script & Automation Engineering (20%)

- Build and maintain a structured, version-controlled Databricks/SQL validation queries usable standalone for manual checks and pluggable into automated regression/CI without rework. 
 - Own inline maintenance of the library: refactor as schemas evolve, retire obsolete checks, keep naming and parameterization consistent, and document each script's purpose, inputs, expected output, and edge cases so it stays usable by the wider team. 
 - Set up and maintain automated data testing frameworks (e. g. , Datagaps, PySpark-based checks) that consume the library for scheduled/CI-triggered runs. 
 - Work with Data Engineers to wire validation into CI/CD, ensuring failures surface with actionable, traceable output.   Collaboration (15%)

- Provide input into the test strategy mix (manual/automated/framework-driven) in partnership with QA leadership and data engineering. 
 - Constructively challenge decisions that risk data quality or testability and propose practical alternatives. 
 - Participate fully in agile ceremonies; raise risks and quality concerns early and clearly. 
 - Partner with the business to understand the wider data system and act as a quality partner for delivery.   Leadership (10%)

- Own data testing deliverables, including the health of the automation/SQL library, for the workstream. 
 - Lead or contribute to QA initiatives that raise the bar on data testing practice across the team. 
 - Mentor junior testers on ETL/data testing techniques, SQL standards, and automation tooling

ABOUT YOU

- Strong understanding of ETL/ELT concepts, dimensional modeling, fact/dimension tables, and medallion architecture (Bronze/Silver/Gold), with the ability to trace a data point end-to-end into its BI report representation. 
 - Hands-on proficiency with Azure SQL/Databricks/Apache Spark (PySpark) for large-scale data validation and transformation testing. 
 - Working knowledge of Azure Data Factory (pipelines, linked services), Azure Storage (partitioning, Parquet/Delta), and third-party API integrations (e. g. , Salesforce, etc. )
 - Advanced SQL for backend validation and reconciliation across SQL Server/PostgreSQL/Databricks, with emphasis on writing maintainable, reusable, parameterized scripts. 
 - Working knowledge of Python for test scripting and validation automation. 
 - Practical exposure to ETL/data quality tools, Datagaps DataOps Suite (good to have), or equivalent (DQX, QuerySurge, Informatica, Talend, DataStage, SSIS). 
 - Ability to define and apply data quality rules systematically (completeness, accuracy, consistency, uniqueness, timeliness). 
 - Hands-on experience with AI-assisted test generation or anomaly detection, with the ability to adapt checks for AI-produced and consumed data pipelines. 
 - Comfort with Agile/Kanban delivery, CI/CD practices, and defect management tooling (JIRA, Azure Boards, or similar). 
 - A curious, quality-first mindset confident to constructively challenge decisions when quality is at risk. 
 - Strong written/verbal communication and stakeholder partnership skills; strong critical thinking and independent problem-solving. 

Experience: 

- 4-6 years in data testing/automation, with hands-on ETL, Data Warehouse, and/or Big Data testing experience. 
 - Proven experience testing pipelines on Databricks/Spark within a medallion or layered Lakehouse architecture. 
 - Experience with Azure Data Factory and Azure cloud storage constructs. 
 - Experience validating data through to BI/reporting layers (Power BI, Tableau, or similar), not just the warehouse layer. 
 - Experience with data quality frameworks/rule design and writing SQL validation scripts reused across both manual testing and automated regression, ideally with exposure to a tool such as Datagaps. 
 - Experience with SDLC/STLC, Agile ceremonies, and defect lifecycle management; prior ownership of a test strategy independently is strongly preferred. 
 - Familiarity with AI-assisted testing or data validation tools

Software Engineering & Automation

data.title: Director of Software Engineering
data.description:
About CAI Software

CAI Software builds purpose-built solutions that help manufacturers, processors, and distributors accelerate performance. Our mission is to enable manufacturers to transform performance through a connected, AI-assisted ecosystem that delivers visibility, control, and continuous improvement. We bring the deep operational expertise and enterprise infrastructure to be a true long-term performance partner. 

With 6, 200+ active customers worldwide and a market-leading position in every vertical we serve, CAI combines 45+ years of industry expertise with modern AI-driven execution - helping businesses move faster, operate smarter, and perform at their peak. We work across 15+ industries and 10+ countries, guided by three values built into our name: Candor, Accountability, and Impact. 

CAI Business Units and the Markets We Serve

CAI Software is organized into three business units: Graphic Communications, Process Manufacturing, and Discrete Manufacturing - aligned to the industries we serve. This structure keeps our teams close to customer needs while operating with the scale and support of a global software company. 

This role is part of our Graphic Communications business unit, which serves the global print and packaging industry with ERP and production software designed for commercial printers, packaging manufacturers, promotional and transactional print providers, sign and display manufacturers, and in-plant print operations. Our solutions help customers manage complex production environments, improve operational visibility, and deliver high-quality products efficiently and profitably. 

CAI India

CAI India is a strategic investment in the company's future. Our Bangalore Center of Excellence is a place of ownership, expertise, and accountability. Teams in India work on global products end to end, contribute to key decisions, and influence how CAI evolves as a business. This is not a support-led model, but rather a center designed to lead through knowledge, responsibility, and trust. 

About the Role

CAI Software is seeking a Director of Engineering to join our Graphic Communications team in Bangalore, India. This is a hands-on leadership role for someone with 20+ years of experience building and scaling enterprise products, ideally within the ERP or MIS domain. You'll stay technically engaged in architecture, design, and code-level decisions while providing strategic direction, mentoring engineering talent, and driving product modernization through AI-native development practices - equally comfortable in a design review, a customer conversation, or a hands-on coding session. 

What You'll Do

- Own and evolve the technical architecture for enterprise product lines, ensuring scalability, maintainability, and alignment with modern engineering practices
 - Stay actively engaged in the codebase, reviewing, prototyping, and contributing directly where needed rather than directing from a distance
 - Lead initiatives to modernize legacy enterprise, ERP, and MIS systems using AI-native development approaches such as AI-assisted coding, agentic workflows, and intelligent automation of legacy processes
 - Build engineering capability across the team through structured mentoring, technical coaching, and career development of senior and mid-level engineers
 - Define, track, and report on engineering KPIs (velocity, quality, release cadence, technical debt, adoption metrics) to drive continuous improvement and data-informed decisions
 - Partner directly with customers and stakeholders to understand real-world usage, pain points, and priorities, translating them into product and technical roadmaps
 - Manage, grow, and retain a high-performing engineering organization, fostering a culture of ownership, quality, and continuous learning
 - Collaborate closely with Product Management, QA, DevOps, and executive stakeholders to align engineering execution with business strategy

What We're Looking For

- 20+ years of hands-on experience in enterprise product development, with demonstrated depth in architecture, design, development, and delivery
 - Prior experience in ERP or MIS environments strongly preferred
 - Proven experience with a modern enterprise technology stack, including Java and . NET on the backend, React on the frontend, and PostgreSQL and/or Microsoft SQL Server
 - Demonstrated ability to operate across the full engineering lifecycle, from architecture and design through hands-on coding, code review, and production support
 - Strong track record of coaching and mentoring engineers at multiple levels of seniority
 - Experience defining and driving engineering KPIs and using data to guide technical and organizational decisions
 - Demonstrated customer-first orientation, comfortable engaging directly with customers and stakeholders to shape technical and product direction
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to balance technical depth with business pragmatism
 - Hands-on experience with AI-assisted development tools and practices, such as AI coding assistants, agentic development workflows, or AI-native SDLC, is a plus
 - Direct experience modernizing legacy enterprise products using AI - for example, re-architecting monolithic ERP/MIS systems, introducing intelligent automation, or embedding AI capabilities into existing product lines - is a plus
 - Familiarity with modern DevOps/CI-CD practices and release engineering at scale is a plus

Why Join CAI

At CAI, we are building something that matters. With 6, 200+ customers across 15+ industries and active investment in AI-driven performance tools, we are positioned to define what the next generation of manufacturing software looks like - and we are building the team to lead that work. 

Our four pillars define how we deliver for customers - and how we work: 

- Built to Fit - Fits how your business runs so performance comes standard
 - Built to Expedite - Speeds time to performance without heavy lifts or delays. 
 - Built to Deliver - AI turns action and insights into measurable performance. 
 - Built to Scale - Sustains and scales performance without disruption.

data.description:
Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy. Our integrations sync sales, payments, payroll and supplier data from Toast into accounting platforms accurately and on time, so owners can close their books with confidence. 

We're hiring a Senior Software Engineer (P3) to build full stack features for Toast's Accounting Integrations team in Chennai. The team sits in the Suppliers & Accounting division and connects Toast to the accounting software our customers run their books on. This is a high-growth moment for the team. We're extending our integrations to support Toast's expansion into Retail, and partnering across lines of business with the Fintech team to power in-house bookkeeping through Toast Books. You'll work with Java, Kotlin, React and AWS, and use AI tools every day to ship faster and better. 

A Day In The Life (Responsibilities)

- Independently design and implement well-defined features across the full stack, from backend sync services to the merchant-facing setup and mapping UI, with minimal day-to-day guidance.

 - Build and consume RESTful APIs, and integrate with third-party accounting APIs and internal Toast systems, handling auth, rate limits, retries and idempotency. 
 - Develop frontend features in React with TypeScript, focusing on usability and performance for restaurant and retail operators.

AI at Toast

At Toast, one of our company values is that we're hungry to build and learn. We believe learning new AI tools empowers us to build for our customers faster, more independently, and with higher quality. We provide these tools across all disciplines, from Engineering and Product to Sales and Support, and are inspired by how our Toasters are already driving real value with them. data.title: Principal Compiler Engineer
data.description:
Location : Hyderabad

Experience Level : 8+Years

Skill Set : NPU - Compiler Role

About the Role

We are seeking a highly experienced Compiler / Software Architect to join our NPU Hardware Architecture team and play a key role in the hardware-software co-design of next-generation AI inference accelerators. 

This is a unique role at the intersection of NPU hardware architecture, AI compilers, performance modeling, and software development. The position will work directly with hardware architects to define, evaluate, and prototype the software stack required to program current and future NPU architectures. 

Our NPU architecture is closely coupled with the compiler stack. Efficient utilization of the accelerator requires deep understanding of the hardware compute architecture, memory hierarchy, dataflow, scheduling, quantization, instruction set and execution model. The successful candidate will use this understanding to develop compiler and software proof-of-concepts, evaluate architectural proposals against real AI workloads, and influence the design of future NPU hardware. 

You will work closely with hardware architects, micro-architects, compiler engineers and AI software teams to answer a fundamental question: 

How should the NPU hardware and software be co-designed to deliver the best performance, power efficiency, programmability and scalability for real-world AI workloads?

What You Will Be Responsible For

Compiler & Software Architecture for NPU

- Develop compiler and software proof-of-concepts for current and next-generation NPU architectures. 
 - Define software abstractions and compiler flows that efficiently expose NPU hardware capabilities to AI workloads. 
 - Develop and evaluate compiler concepts including graph lowering, intermediate representations, operator mapping, scheduling, tiling, fusion, memory planning and code generation. 
 - Translate NPU architectural concepts into executable software models and demonstrate their feasibility using representative AI workloads. 
 - Develop lightweight compiler/runtime infrastructure to validate new hardware features before production software implementation. 
 - Analyze existing compiler limitations and identify architectural changes required to improve programmability and accelerator utilization. Hardware-Software Co-Design

- Work as an integral member of the hardware architecture team to co-design NPU hardware and software. 
 - Analyze how proposed hardware features can be effectively exposed through the compiler and software stack. 
 - Provide software-driven feedback on compute architecture, memory hierarchy, data movement, dataflow, scheduling, instruction set and accelerator programmability. 
 - Identify hardware features that provide meaningful benefits to real AI workloads and challenge features that add hardware complexity without sufficient software value. 
 - Define compiler requirements and software abstractions for new NPU capabilities. 
 - Participate in architecture and micro-architecture reviews and influence hardware decisions from a software and workload perspective. 
 - Evaluate architectural trade-offs considering performance, power, area, compiler complexity and software scalability. 

AI Workload & Performance Analysis

- Analyze representative AI models and workloads to identify compute, memory, bandwidth, scheduling and data-movement bottlenecks. 
 - Build software-based performance models and workload prototypes to evaluate architectural concepts. 
 - Develop experiments to quantify the impact of proposed hardware features on model performance and accelerator utilization. 
 - Investigate issues such as quantization, sparsity, operator fusion, tensor layouts, tiling, data reuse, memory bandwidth and scheduling efficiency. 
 - Correlate software/model-level performance with architectural and micro-architectural behavior. 
 - Use workload analysis to guide both current-generation optimizations and next-generation NPU architecture. Architecture Prototyping

- Rapidly prototype software solutions for architectural concepts that may be months or years away from production silicon. 
 - Develop functional models, compiler prototypes, simulators, emulators, reference implementations or runtime abstractions as needed to validate architectural ideas. 
 - Demonstrate end-to-end execution of representative AI workloads on proposed NPU architectures. 
 - Build proof-of-concepts that allow hardware architects to make informed architectural decisions before RTL implementation. 
 - Help establish software models and interfaces that can later evolve into production compiler components. 

Cross-Functional Leadership

- Work closely with NPU hardware architects, micro-architects, RTL designers and the production compiler/software organization. 
 - Bridge the communication gap between hardware and software teams and translate requirements in both directions. 
 - Participate in architecture definition from early concept through implementation and silicon bring-up. 
 - Mentor engineers and contribute to technical direction for compiler-driven hardware/software co-design. 
 - Influence the roadmap of future NPU architectures through workload and software-driven insights. 

Necessary Qualifications

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering or a related field. 

8+ years of experience in compiler development, systems software, computer architecture, AI accelerators, or a closely related area. 

Strong understanding of compiler architecture and compiler optimization techniques. 

Strong C++ programming skills and proficiency in Python. 

Strong understanding of computer architecture and familiarity with accelerator architectures, memory hierarchies and data movement. 

Experience analyzing AI/ML workloads and understanding performance bottlenecks. 

Ability to work across hardware and software boundaries and communicate effectively with hardware architects. 

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to rapidly prototype and evaluate architectural ideas. 

Good to have

- Experience developing compilers or software stacks for NPUs, GPUs, DSPs, TPUs or other AI accelerators. 
 - Experience with MLIR, LLVM, TOSA, StableHLO, Torch-MLIR or similar compiler infrastructure. 
 - Experience with accelerator-specific scheduling, tiling, memory management or code generation. 
 - Understanding of NPU architecture concepts such as dataflow, tensor engines, systolic/array-based compute, local SRAMs, DMA/data movement and accelerator instruction sets.

Job Description

The Lead Software Engineer oversees the QA team and manages the end-to-end testing lifecycle including defect management and reporting. They are responsible for ensuring efficient testing processes, driving process improvements and providing leadership to QA personnel. 

As the Lead Software Engineer, you will play a critical role in ensuring the quality and reliability of software products through comprehensive testing methodologies. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to understand product requirements, design test cases, and execute test plans to identify defects and ensure the highest level of product quality. Your expertise in manual & automation testing and test case development will be instrumental in delivering robust and user-friendly software solutions. 

Responsibilities

- Assign testing activities across the QA team. 
 - Provide directions to QA engineers and help to remove blockers. 
 - Ensure critical testing, regression, integration and UAT-support activities are adequately covered. Co-ordinate QA activities with development team, product owners and other stakeholders. 
 - Monitor progress and act as the primary point of contact for stakeholders regarding defect status and testing updates. 
 - Mentor and develop team members. 
 - Evaluate and integrate new tools and methodologies to enhance testing outcomes. 

Additional Responsibilities

Test Planning and Strategy: 

- Collaborate with product managers and development teams to understand project requirements and define comprehensive test plans. 
 - Design test strategies, including scope, approach, resources, and schedule estimation, to ensure thorough test coverage. 
 - Identify and prioritize test cases based on risk analysis and business impact. 

Test Case Development

- Create detailed, comprehensive, and well-structured test cases and test scenarios based on functional specifications and user stories. 
 - Define test data and environment setup requirements for effective test execution. 
 - Maintain test case repositories and ensure documentation accuracy and completeness. 

Manual Testing

- Execute manual test cases to validate software functionality, performance, usability, and compatibility across different platforms and environments. 
 - Identify, isolate, document, and track software defects using bug tracking tools (Jira) and collaborate with development teams to resolve issues. 
 - Perform ad-hoc testing as needed to uncover unexpected behaviors and usability issues. 

Regression Testing

- Conduct regression testing to ensure the stability of software releases and verify that new features and enhancements do not adversely impact existing functionalities. 
 - Automate repetitive manual test cases where applicable to improve testing efficiency and effectiveness. 

Quality Assurance

- Participate in peer reviews of test cases, test plans, and other testing artifacts to ensure quality standards are met. 
 - Continuously monitor and evaluate testing processes and methodologies to identify areas for improvement and optimization. 
 - Automated testing suites development
 - Develop and document scalable automated testing suites 
 - Convert manual tests to automated tests

Required

Oceaneering is a global provider of engineered services and products, primarily to the offshore energy industry. data.title: Senior Mobile Performance Tester
data.description:
Job Description

Senior Native Mobile Performance Testing Engineer

Primary Technologies: Apache JMeter | BlazeMeter | BrowserStack

Experience Required: 5-10 Years

Primary Specialization: Native Android and iOS Application Performance Engineering

Position Summary

We are seeking a highly skilled, hands-on Senior Native Mobile Performance Testing Engineer with deep expertise in Apache JMeter, BlazeMeter, and BrowserStack to design, develop, execute, and analyze performance tests for enterprise-native Android and iOS applications. 

This position is specifically focused on native mobile applications installed and executed directly on Android and iOS devices-not mobile websites, mobile browsers, or responsive web applications. 

The ideal candidate will have strong proven experience testing native mobile application packages (APK/AAB and IPA), combining JMeter/BlazeMeter protocol-level load testing with BrowserStack real-device native application automation to assess end-user responsiveness, application stability, backend scalability, and overall performance. 

The successful candidate must be capable of independently developing performance test frameworks, implementing realistic native mobile application workloads, executing distributed load tests, automating native application user journeys on real devices, and diagnosing performance bottlenecks across the mobile device, application, network, APIs, and backend infrastructure. 

This is a hands-on technical engineering position requiring strong scripting, mobile automation, performance analysis, troubleshooting, and technical leadership capabilities. 

Key Responsibilities

Native Android and iOS Application Performance Testing

- Design and execute performance tests for native Android and iOS mobile applications, rather than browser-based mobile applications. 
 - Test installable mobile application packages (APK/AAB and IPA) across real Android and iOS devices. 
 - Develop realistic workloads representing critical native application business transactions, user journeys, and production usage patterns. 
 - Measure native application startup and launch times, screen transition times, transaction completion times, responsiveness, and stability. 
 - Evaluate mobile application CPU utilization, memory consumption, rendering performance, battery impact, and application crashes using appropriate device-level instrumentation. 
 - Analyze native application performance under Wi-Fi, 4G, 5G, and varying bandwidth, latency, jitter, and packet-loss conditions. 
 - Identify performance bottlenecks involving native application code, mobile SDKs, device resources, API communication, and backend infrastructure. 
 - Evaluate performance differences across device models, hardware configurations, Android/iOS versions, and network conditions. 

JMeter and BlazeMeter Performance Engineering

- Develop, enhance, and maintain sophisticated JMeter scripts that simulate backend API traffic generated by native Android and iOS applications. 
 - Implement advanced HTTP(S)/REST scripting, correlation, parameterization, JSON processing, authentication handling, and dynamic test data. 
 - Configure and execute distributed performance tests using BlazeMeter. 
 - Design and execute load, stress, spike, endurance, capacity, scalability, and resiliency tests. 
 - Establish realistic workload models covering concurrent users, transaction distribution, pacing, think time, and ramp-up/ramp-down patterns. 
 - Analyze response-time percentiles, throughput, transaction rates, error rates, and infrastructure utilization. 
 - Build reusable performance testing frameworks and integrate automated tests into Agile and CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Correlate backend load-test results with performance observations from native Android and iOS devices. 

BrowserStack Native Mobile Application Testing

- Configure and execute automated native Android and iOS application tests using BrowserStack's real-device infrastructure. 
 - Use BrowserStack App Automate, App Live, and applicable real-device capabilities for testing installed mobile applications. 
 - Develop and maintain native mobile automation scripts using Appium or equivalent mobile automation frameworks. 
 - Automate application launches, native screen navigation, user interactions, and critical business transactions. 
 - Execute native mobile application automation scenarios in parallel with JMeter/BlazeMeter protocol-level load tests. 
 - Measure native application responsiveness and end-user experience while backend services are subjected to varying load conditions. 
 - Capture and correlate automation timings, native application logs, device diagnostics, and backend telemetry through supported BrowserStack capabilities and complementary instrumentation. 
 - Investigate performance differences across Android and iOS devices, operating system versions, and network configurations. 

Important: BrowserStack experience must involve testing native mobile applications installed on real devices. Experience limited to opening websites in mobile browsers through BrowserStack does not meet the primary requirement. 

Performance Analysis and Technical Leadership

- Define comprehensive native mobile application performance testing strategies, test plans, workload models, SLAs, SLOs, SLIs, and measurable acceptance criteria. 
 - Perform detailed performance diagnostics and root cause analysis using Dynatrace, Datadog, AppDynamics, Splunk, or comparable observability platforms. 
 - Correlate native application behavior with API latency, distributed traces, application logs, and infrastructure metrics. 
 - Evaluate performance risks associated with mobile application releases, operating system updates, SDK changes, and backend architecture modifications. 
 - Collaborate with native Android/iOS developers, DevOps, application architecture, and infrastructure teams. 
 - Assess testing environment readiness, device coverage, monitoring availability, and test-data requirements. 
 - Participate in Agile sprint activities and incorporate native mobile performance testing into continuous delivery. 
 - Prepare comprehensive performance reports, bottleneck analyses, and actionable recommendations. 
 - Provide technical guidance to performance engineers while remaining actively involved in scripting, automation, execution, and troubleshooting. 

Required Technical Skills

- Apache JMeter: Advanced scripting, HTTP(S)/REST protocols, correlation, parameterization, assertions, workload modeling, and distributed execution. 
 - BlazeMeter: Cloud-based performance testing, distributed load generation, orchestration, reporting, and performance analysis. 
 - BrowserStack: Native Android/iOS application testing on real devices using App Automate, App Live, and relevant diagnostic capabilities. 
 - Native Mobile Automation: Strong hands-on experience with Appium or comparable frameworks automating installed Android/iOS applications. 
 - Native Mobile Architecture: Understanding of application lifecycle, native UI interactions, API communication, mobile SDKs, authentication, background processing, and backend dependencies. 
 - Mobile Performance Diagnostics: Experience measuring application responsiveness, startup time, CPU, memory, rendering, crashes, and device resource consumption using appropriate diagnostic tools. 
 - Performance Monitoring: Experience with Dynatrace, Datadog, AppDynamics, Splunk, or equivalent enterprise observability platforms. 
 - Technical Foundations: JSON, regular expressions, REST APIs, Git, CI/CD, cloud infrastructure, and performance troubleshooting. 

Required Experience And Qualifications

- 5-10 years of overall experience in performance testing and performance engineering. 
 - Demonstrated hands-on performance testing experience with installed native Android and iOS applications, beyond mobile browser or mobile web testing. 
 - Advanced technical proficiency with Apache JMeter and BlazeMeter. 
 - Practical experience using BrowserStack for native mobile application testing on real devices. 
 - Hands-on experience developing Appium or equivalent native mobile automation scripts. 
 - Experience integrating protocol-level load testing with native application performance validation on physical devices. 
 - Ability to independently design, implement, and execute enterprise mobile performance testing solutions. 
 - Strong understanding of mobile application architecture, latency, throughput, concurrency, caching, asynchronous processing, and scalability. 
 - Experience working in Agile environments with cross-functional engineering teams. 
 - Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, documentation, and stakeholder communication skills. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Traditional desktop or mobile web application performance testing, as a secondary skill. 
 - Experience with Tricentis NeoLoad or other commercial performance testing platforms. 
 - Android Studio Profiler, Apple Instruments, or equivalent native mobile profiling tools. 
 - Experience with Android/iOS application logs, crash diagnostics, and profiling. 
 - Experience with mobile network conditioning and network emulation. 
 - AWS or other enterprise cloud platforms. 
 - Service virtualization, production log analysis, and distributed systems. 
 - Familiarity with Android Kotlin/Java or iOS Swift/Objective-C development for performance diagnostics. 

Web performance testing is a nice-to-have capability and must not substitute for native Android/iOS application performance engineering experience. 

Expected Outcomes

The Successful Candidate Will Be Expected To

- Establish a repeatable and scalable native Android/iOS performance testing capability. 
 - Deliver reusable JMeter/BlazeMeter load-testing assets and BrowserStack native application automation scenarios. 
 - Enable coordinated backend load testing and real-device native application performance validation. 
 - Define meaningful native mobile performance benchmarks and acceptance criteria. 
 - Identify, isolate, and document application, device, network, and backend performance bottlenecks. 
 - Provide actionable recommendations to improve native application responsiveness, scalability, stability, and reliability. 
 - Integrate native mobile performance validation into Agile and CI/CD processes. 
 - Deliver evidence-based performance assessments supporting production release readiness. 

Technical Screening Questions

- Native Application Experience

Describe your experience performance testing installed native Android and iOS applications. What native application performance metrics have you captured, and what tools did you use? How does your approach differ from testing websites in mobile browsers?

- JMeter + BlazeMeter + BrowserStack Integration

Explain how you would execute a BlazeMeter/JMeter backend load test while simultaneously running automated native Android and iOS application scenarios on BrowserStack real devices. How would you correlate the results?

- Native Mobile Performance Bottleneck Analysis

A native iOS or Android application experiences slow screen transitions and delayed API-driven updates during high backend load. How would you determine whether the bottleneck originates from native application processing, device resources, network conditions, APIs, or backend services?

- Native Mobile Application Performance Profiling

What tools and techniques have you used to measure native application startup time, CPU consumption, memory utilization, rendering performance, battery impact, and application crashes? Which metrics can you obtain through BrowserStack, and which require complementary diagnostic tools?

- Native Mobile Performance Framework Development

Describe how you would build an enterprise native Android/iOS performance testing framework from scratch using JMeter, BlazeMeter, BrowserStack, and Appium. Include native application automation, workload modeling, real-device testing, monitoring, reporting, and CI/CD integration.

The primary requirement is demonstrated performance testing of installed Android and iOS applications, including native application automation, device-level performance analysis, and concurrent backend load testing.

data.description:
Who We Are: 

Leap Metrics is headquartered in the Dallas/Fort Worth Metroplex. We are a data management, healthcare analytics, and AI-driven care management software company founded to improve health outcomes, lower the cost of care, and assist with regulatory compliance. Our software platform, SevidaTM️, stands for "in the service of human lives. " We are on a mission to empower healthcare to know enough to serve every life- better. 

We are a company of passionate, experienced technologists, an innovative group of developers, designers, client advocates, and clinicians. Our team has some of the best enterprise software minds in the technology industry. 

To learn more about us, please visit our website at http: //leapmetrics. io

Why work for Leap Metrics: 

MEANINGFUL MISSION - Empowering health providers to focus on care

FULFILLMENT - Make an impact by building a meaningful product

LEADING EDGE TECHNOLOGY - Advance your technical skills by working with the latest and most innovative technology

COMPANY CULTURE - Team-oriented, collaborative, supportive, innovative

About the Role: 

We are looking for an experienced, hands-on Enterprise Application Architect - Full Stack who can operate at both the architecture and engineering levels, understand a business problem, design the solution, explain and defend the architectural choices, guide engineers through implementation, and step into the code when necessary. 

The right candidate should be comfortable answering not only "How should we build this?", but also "Why is this the right architecture, what alternatives did we consider, and what are the trade-offs?"

The role requires strong experience across React, Node. js/NestJS, GraphQL, microservices, event-driven architecture, Kafka, MongoDB/MySQL, Kubernetes, GCP, authentication/authorization, caching, and modern AI-assisted development. 

What You Will Do: 

- Own end-to-end solution and application architecture for complex SaaS platforms. 
 - Translate business and functional requirements into scalable technical designs and architecture blueprints. 
 - Define application boundaries, modules, services, APIs, data flows, integration patterns, and deployment architecture. 
 - Make and document key architectural decisions, including technology selection and design trade-offs. 
 - Design systems using modular monolith, microservices and event-driven architectures where appropriate. 
 - Define GraphQL architecture, including schema design, federation/API composition and service boundaries. 
 - Design asynchronous workflows and integration patterns using technologies such as Kafka. 
 - Define data architecture across relational and NoSQL databases, including MySQL and MongoDB. 
 - Define an authentication and authorization architecture using solutions such as Keycloak/OAuth2/and OIDC. 
 - Design caching strategies using technologies such as Redis. 
 - Define cloud-native architecture on Google Cloud Platform and Kubernetes. 
 - Address scalability, performance, availability, resilience, observability, security and disaster recovery. 
 - Establish architecture standards, reusable patterns and engineering best practices. 
 - Create architecture, sequence, and data-flow diagrams, API specifications, and technical documentation. 
 - Conduct architecture and code reviews to ensure implementations conform to agreed designs. 
 - Build prototypes or proofs-of-concept to validate important architectural decisions. 
 - Work closely with product managers, business stakeholders and engineering teams to refine requirements and identify technical solutions. 
 - Mentor senior engineers and provide technical direction to development teams. 
 - Identify and manage technical debt and modernization opportunities. 
 - Evaluate new technologies and AI capabilities and determine where they provide meaningful business or engineering value. 
 - Remain hands-on and contribute to critical implementation areas when required. 

Requirements: 

- Approximately 10+ years of software engineering experience, with significant recent responsibility for application or solution architecture. 
 - Proven experience architecting and building large-scale SaaS/web applications. 
 - Strong hands-on background in React and Node. js, preferably NestJS and TypeScript. 
 - Strong understanding of microservices, modular architectures, and Domain-Driven Design principles. 
 - Strong experience designing event-driven architectures using Kafka or similar technologies. 
 - Strong experience with GraphQL, including schema design and federated/composed GraphQL architectures. 
 - Strong understanding of REST APIs and API design principles. 
 - Experience designing solutions using MySQL and MongoDB, including data modeling, indexing and performance considerations. 
 - Experience with authentication and authorization standards such as OAuth 2. 0, OpenID Connect, JWT, and Keycloak. 
 - Experience with Redis or comparable distributed caching technologies. 
 - Strong knowledge of Docker and Kubernetes architecture. 
 - Significant cloud architecture experience, preferably with Google Cloud Platform (GCP). 
 - Strong understanding of scalability, high availability, fault tolerance, observability, security, and disaster recovery. 
 - Experience defining CI/CD and cloud-native deployment architectures. 
 - Ability to analyze existing/legacy applications and develop pragmatic modernization strategies. 
 - Experience creating technical architecture documentation and presenting design decisions to engineering and business stakeholders. 
 - Experience working with globally distributed engineering teams. 
 - Ability to mentor developers and influence technical direction without becoming a bottleneck. 

Architecture Skills needed: 

The successful candidate should be comfortable making and defending decisions such as:

About The Role

You will be a senior technical contributor and a natural team lead for the WiFi and LAN area. You will help the team plan and prioritise work, coordinate technical activities, and ensure consistent and well-aligned delivery. 

This is a role where leadership is combined with means stepping away from engineering. You will work hands-on with architecture, design, implementation, troubleshooting and documentation, while coaching colleagues and creating a collaborative, accountable way of working. 

You will also act as an important link between engineers, customers, service management and external providers. By turning requirements and operational feedback into practical improvements, you will help develop global network services that provide real business value. 

The wider team supports infrastructure services across WiFi, LAN, WAN, Remote Access, DDI, firewalls, load balancing, web security and monitoring, providing opportunities to collaborate broadly between teams .

What You Will Do

 - Collect requirements and feedback from customers and stakeholders, then translate them into practical solutions. 
 - Contribute to common network architecture, design standards, roadmaps and service catalogue development. 
 - Review service performance, metrics and SLAs, and be able to lead improvement activities when needed. 
 - Present technical findings and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences. 
 - Keep processes, operational routines and documentation clear, current and useful. 
 - Involved and influence in 24/7 operation optimization vs delivery. 

What you bring

We are looking for someone with strong technical skills who is confident taking the lead and works well with others. You can organise work in a clear and practical way without adding unnecessary processes. You also understand how to meet today's operational needs while continuing to improve services for the future. 

- Proven experience as a team lead, technical lead or senior engineer who has coordinated and guided others.

What we offer

- A visible role in a global network organisation with the opportunity to influence services used across global regions.

 - Close collaboration with experienced colleagues, customers and strategic technology partners. 
 - A working environment where practical ideas, clear communication and a positive team spirit matter. 

Location

We are the ASSA ABLOY Group

Our people have made us the global leader in access solutions. In return, we open doors for them wherever they go. With nearly 63, 000 colleagues in more than 70 different countries, we help billions of people experience a more open world. Our innovations make all sorts of spaces - physical and virtual - safer, more secure, and easier to access. 

As an employer, we value results - not titles, or backgrounds. Data Engineering Manager

Riveron is seeking a hands-on Data Engineering Manager to be part of our data engineering team in India. This is not a pure people-management role - you will be writing code, building pipelines, and architecting data platforms daily alongside your team. We're looking for someone who leads from the codebase, not just from a conference room. If you bring deep implementation experience across Microsoft Fabric, Snowflake, and Databricks and can pair strong architectural thinking with real delivery output, we'd love to hear from you. 

Who You Are

- A data engineering professional with 8 to 12 years of experience, including 1-3 years balancing technical leadership with active, hands-on implementation - you've managed teams without stepping away from the keyboard. 
 - You write production-quality code daily. This role requires active coding and pipeline development - not just code reviews and architectural diagrams. 
 - Hands-on, implementation-level expertise with Microsoft Fabric, Snowflake, and Databricks is non-negotiable. You've personally built, deployed, and tuned production workloads on these platforms. 
 - Strong data architecture background spanning lakehouse design, medallion architecture, data vault, dimensional modeling, and enterprise data platform design - grounded in systems you've actually built, not just designed on paper. 
 - Deep proficiency in SQL and Python - you can write complex transformations, optimize query performance, debug pipeline failures, and build automation frameworks yourself. 
 - Proven experience building and shipping ETL/ELT frameworks using Azure Data Factory, dbt, Spark, and platform-native orchestration tools. 
 - Solid working knowledge of Azure cloud data services (Synapse Analytics, Data Lake Storage, Azure SQL Database) and comfort operating in multi-cloud environments. 
 - Well-versed in data governance, data quality frameworks, cataloging, lineage, and security best practices - with experience implementing these controls, not just defining policies. 
 - Proficient with Git-based version control, CI/CD pipelines for data workloads, and Infrastructure as Code - you commit code, open pull requests, and maintain deployment pipelines alongside your team. 
 - Comfortable working in Agile delivery environments and translating business requirements into scalable technical designs. 

What You'll Do

- Spend a significant portion of your time writing code - building data pipelines, developing transformation logic, configuring platform services, and shipping production-ready solutions. 
 - Lead, mentor, and grow a team of data engineers while remaining the team's strongest technical contributor and setting the standard through your own code and architectural decisions. 
 - Design and personally implement scalable data platforms on Microsoft Fabric, Snowflake, and Databricks - selecting the right platform for each use case and building the solution end to end. 
 - Architect and build lakehouse and data warehouse solutions, defining and coding ingestion patterns, transformation layers, storage strategies, and consumption models. 
 - Own critical and complex implementation work - the toughest pipeline builds, the most challenging performance problems, and the architectural spikes that set direction for the team. 
 - Write and maintain shared libraries, frameworks, and reusable components that accelerate the team's delivery and enforce engineering standards. 
 - Conduct deep, line-level code reviews focused on correctness, performance, and maintainability - not just approval stamps. 
 - Partner with analytics, data science, and business stakeholders to translate data requirements into engineered solutions and personally prototype key components. 
 - Establish and enforce best practices for data modeling, pipeline reliability, observability, testing, and documentation - by building the reference implementations yourself. 
 - Optimize platform performance and manage costs across Snowflake compute, Databricks clusters, and Fabric capacities through hands-on tuning and configuration. 
 - Implement data governance and security controls across engineering initiatives, ensuring compliance, data quality, and lineage traceability at the code and platform level. 
 - Stay current with the evolving data platform landscape and evaluate emerging tools through hands-on proof-of-concept work, not just vendor demos. 

Preferred Qualifications

- A career path that shows sustained, hands-on implementation even as responsibilities grew - architect-turned-manager, not analyst-turned-manager. 
 - Hands-on experience building medallion-architecture lakehouses on Databricks or Microsoft Fabric, and designing and tuning performant Snowflake warehouse structures. 
 - Experience implementing CI/CD for data pipelines using Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions, including writing the pipeline definitions and deployment scripts yourself. 
 - Familiarity with dbt for transformation orchestration, with personal experience writing and maintaining dbt models and tests. 
 - Exposure to real-time or near-real-time data ingestion patterns (Kafka, Event Hubs, Spark Structured Streaming) through direct implementation. 
 - Experience with data mesh or domain-oriented data platform strategies is a strong plus. 
 - Strong communication skills with the ability to articulate architectural trade-offs to both technical and non-technical audiences. 
 - Excellent stakeholder management skills, with experience running sprint planning, design reviews, and cross-functional delivery coordination. 

About Riveron

At Riveron, we partner with clients-from global multinationals to high-growth private entities-to solve complex finance challenges, guided by our DELTA values: Drive, Excellence, Leadership, Teamwork, and Accountability. Our entrepreneurial culture thrives on collaboration, diverse perspectives, and delivering exceptional outcomes. This inclusive environment offers flexibility, progressive benefits, and meaningful opportunities for impactful work that supports well-being in and out of the office.

LinkedIn Glassdoor Instagram Facebook

data.title: Lead Software Engineer (Priv Controls)
data.description:
Bitwarden is the trusted identity security leader for millions of users worldwide, empowering enterprises, developers, and individuals to securely manage and share sensitive information anywhere. Bitwarden makes it easy for all users to extend robust security across their devices with password management, secrets management, and passwordless and passkey innovations. The company is headquartered in Santa Barbara, California. Learn more at bitwarden. com. 

As a Lead Software Engineer on Bitwarden's Privileged Access Management (PAM) team, you will lead the design and development of our next-generation privileged access platform. You'll own critical gateway services, terminal access protocols, and auditing/enforcement at the intersection of security, scalability, and user experience. 

In alignment with our modern True Ownership model, our engineers are "T-shaped" professionals who own their services end-to-end-from initial design and secure development to automated testing, deployment, and operational health in production. This role offers unique opportunities to build secure-by-default patterns and make significant contributions to our open-source security ecosystem. 

RESPONSIBILITIES

- End-to-End Delivery: Support Bitwarden goals by designing, developing, testing, deploying, and operating secure, performant gateway controls, audited terminal logins, and session recording mechanics for our PAM product line. 
 - Decoupled Architecture: Maintain strict service boundaries and design resilient APIs that allow the PAM platform to operate as an independent, decoupled tenant on our core platform infrastructure. 
 - Upstream Collaboration: Partner closely in a co-located, cross-functional "Embedded Trio" (Product, Design, and Engineering) to rapidly design and validate technical solutions prior to code implementation. 
 - Automated Quality: Eliminate manual testing barriers by building and maintaining robust automated test suites, integration harnesses, and CI/CD pipelines for your team's services. 
 - Operational Stewardship: Own the operational health, performance, and reliability telemetry of your services in production, proactively participating in sustainable on-call rotations and postmortem analyses. 
 - Documentation: Build and maintain high-quality internal architecture specifications, API contracts, and external open-source developer documentation. 

WHAT YOU BRING TO BITWARDEN

- Overall Experience: 8+ years as a Lead Software Engineer with team lead experience paired with AI assisted development practices, including experience leading a team's technical direction, mentoring senior engineers and being accountable for outcomes you did not implement yourself. 
 - Quality: Experience with JEST or any other unit testing framework. Set the bar in pull request review and own the team's conventions for testing, error handling, API design, and secure coding, keeping automated suites, integration harnesses, and CI/CD pipelines strong enough that manual testing is never the safety net. Maintain the architecture specifications, API contracts, and open source developer documentation that go with them. 
 - Technical Stack: Strong proficiency and experience in AI-Led Development in C# / . NET, Rust, or TypeScript. 
 - Security Domain Expertise: Practical experience designing or implementing secure gateway architectures, reverse proxies, and session proxying (SSH, RDP, or HTTPS). 
 - Identity & Auditing: Understanding of Identity and Access Management, key-rotation protocols, and real-time audit logging systems. 
 - T-Shaped Engineering Mindset: Practical experience with containerized environments (Docker/Kubernetes), automated test frameworks (unit, integration, and end-to-end), and SRE/observability tools (APM, alerting, and telemetry dashboards). 
 - Secure Coding: Familiarity with zero-trust and zero-knowledge security architectures, encryption standards and threat-modeling methodologies. 
 - Collaborative Spirit: A highly collaborative and adaptable mindset, excited to work in rapid, outcome-driven feedback loops. 
 - Open Source Passion: Excitement and enthusiasm for open source, developer advocacy, and building a more secure internet. 
 - Problem-Solving: Excellent problem-solving skills-valuing written, clear documentation and using data to make technical decisions. 

Why Join Us

This is an opportunity to play a foundational role in shaping our India Engineering COE from the ground up. Our user community loves us and we love them. Come to work each day with a sense of purpose as we bring a more secure internet experience to everyone from our friends and family to the world's largest organizations. 

Become an expert. You'll get immersed in the prominent technology markets of security and open source software. You'll work alongside talented global teams, solve meaningful engineering challenges, influence how we scale our engineering organization & contribute to products used by customers around the world. 

If you're passionate about building exceptional teams, enabling engineering excellence, and making a lasting impact within a fast-growing engineering company, we'd love to hear from you. 

Equal Opportunity Employer

We are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where everyone can do their best work. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and make employment decisions based on skills, experience, qualifications, and business needs.

If we receive a high volume of applications, we reserve the right to close the advert before the scheduled closing date. Therefore, we encourage interested applicants to apply at their earliest convenience. 

About us

Christian Aid exists to create a world where everyone can live a full life, free from poverty. We are a global movement of people, churches and local organisations who passionately champion dignity, equality and justice worldwide. We are the changemakers, the peacemakers, the mighty of heart. 

We're committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace, and recognise the value this brings in forming strong, creative and high performing teams. We welcome applications from all sections of the community, and from those with experience from outside of the voluntary sector. And no, you don't have to be Christian to work here - we encourage people of all faiths and none to apply. 

We just ask that everyone lives out our values of dignity, equality, justice and love. We value a good work-life balance, so we're open to part-time and flexible working. We also offer hybrid working for our office-based colleagues. 

About the role

Reporting in to the Digital Product Owner, the Senior QA Tester will take ownership of Quality Assurance (QA) within Christian Aid's core Digital Team, ensuring the delivery of high-quality, reliable, and user-friendly websites that are consistent and coherent. 

This strategic role will embed agile testing practices, streamline QA processes, and foster a culture of continuous learning and improvement within the Digital Team and the CRM Team, with an equal division of time between the two teams based in different divisions. 

Some of the main responsibilities of the Senior QA Tester will include: 

- Identify, manage and mitigate risks related to both digital and CRM projects ensuring high quality work that is impactful. 
 - Collaborate with the Digital Product Owner and CRM Technical Lead to verify that all designs and technical outputs meet quality standards and align with project goals and wider organisational values and goals. 
 - Collaborate with the Digital Optimisation Analyst and CRM Technical Lead to ensure all test results are properly tracked, analysed, and shared to support continuous learning, feedback and optimisation. 
 - Design, write and execute visual regression and behaviour-driven testing for every code release, identifying and reporting any issues to the development teams to support a culture of continuous learning and improvement. 
 - Report and track defects: Log defects, provide clear information for developers to fix them, and retest to verify the issues are resolved. 
 - Manage continuous improvement and optimise testing processes to enhance efficiency, effectiveness, consistency and coherency. 
 - Utilise relevant analytics tools to measure feature performance against expected outcomes and provide actionable feedback to guide future development. 
 - Create and execute manual scripts/scenarios, implementing a consistent standard across all CRM developments supporting with quality and consistency. 
 - Manage 3rd party conformance with QAT & UAT standards by proactively raising identified issues and putting forward suggested improvements supporting with a culture of continuous learning and improvement. 
 - Provide daily progress reports through stand-ups and parking lot meetings building relationships based on trust and openness. 

About you

Who we are looking for

Essential: 

- Higher education or equivalent experience obtained in a relevant subject area. 
 - Substantial experience working with content management systems (CMS), particularly Drupal. 
 - Developed ability in application of usability, accessibility and security standards. 
 - Understanding of cross browser limitations and work arounds. 
 - Understanding of optimisation techniques (both in file weight and perceived/actual rendering speed) and performance measurement. 
 - Developed ability to interpret complex communications briefs from others. 
 - Highly developed communication and collaboration skills and ability to work in an Agile team environment. 
 - Highly developed interpersonal, negotiation and influencing skills. 
 - Experience of Dynamics 365 CRM CE. 
 - Experience with Cypress / Percy / PlatformSH / SEMRush
 - Competency in test automation, test-driven development (TDD), and exploratory testing, along with a general understanding of development principles, programming languages
 - Experience of working with developers to unit test key use case scenarios

Further information

At Christian Aid we strive to be an inclusive and diverse employer and recognise the value that this brings in helping to build strong, creative and high performing teams. 

We are actively encouraging racialised minorities, LGBTQ+, people with disabilities, returning parents or carers who are re-entering work after a career break, people with caring responsibilities, people from low socioeconomic backgrounds, women, and older workers to apply. This is because these groups are under-represented within our teams, especially at senior level, and we recognise and value the contributions members of these groups make to strong, creative and high performing teams. 

We have a strong Christian ethos and we encourage applications from all faiths. Applicants will be expected to demonstrate an understanding of and sympathy with Christian Aid's faith identity. 

All successful candidates will require a DBS/police check appropriate to the role and location and a Counter Terrorism Sanction check as part of your clearance for commencing your role with us. We also participate in the Inter Agency Misconduct Disclosure Scheme. In line with this Scheme, we will request information as part of the referencing process from job applicants' previous employers about any findings of sexual exploitation, sexual abuse and/or sexual harassment during employment, or incidents under investigation when the applicant left employment. By submitting an application, the job applicant confirms their understanding of these recruitment procedures. 

This role requires applicants to have the right to live and work in the country where this position is based and undertake the role that you have been offered. If you are successful and we make you an offer for the role, we will be required to conduct a right to work check on your immigration status in the UK. We will contact you regarding the documentation you will need to provide to evidence this.

data.title: Senior Quality Engineer
data.description:
About StarRez

StarRez is the global leader in student housing software, providing innovative solutions for on and off-campus housing management, resident wellness and experience, and revenue generation. Trusted by 1, 400+ clients across 25+ countries, StarRez supports more than 4 million beds annually with its user-friendly, all-in-one platform, delivering seamless experiences for students and administrators. With offices in the United States, Australia, the UK, and India, StarRez blends the robust capabilities of a global organization with the personalized care and service of a trusted partner. 

About StarRez

StarRez is the global leader in student housing software, providing solutions for on- and off-campus housing management, resident wellness and experience, and revenue generation. Trusted by 1, 400+ clients across 25+ countries, StarRez supports more than 4 million beds annually. With offices in the United States, Australia, the UK, and India, StarRez blends the capabilities of a global organisation with the personalised care of a trusted partner. 

The Role

StarRez Go is our staff-facing mobile companion to the main platform, used by housing staff to run inspections, check residents in and out, manage maintenance and look up resident information from the field, running on iOS and Android phones and tablets. 

You will be the quality owner for the Go app. Your end users are staff on rounds, often on shared devices, using the camera and ID scanning, and handling student data. A failure in the field means a stalled check-in line or a missed inspection, so your quality approach will need to account for the end user

This is a hands-on role; you will not manage people. You will set the quality bar for the mobile team, do the work to hold it, and coach your peers in quality practices so that quality is baked in at every stage. The goal is a team that builds quality in, not a QA who inspects for it. 

What You Will Own

- Own the end-to-end test strategy for the StarRez Go app 
 - You will set the quality bar for the mobile team, coach your peers in quality practices so that quality is baked in at every stage and raise it early when quality is slipping. 
 - Champion StarRez's quality standards and advocate for quality throughout the software delivery lifecycle. 
 - Design and execute validation strategies for feature-related initiatives. 
 - Partner with Product, Design and Engineering from ideation through delivery to ensure acceptance criteria, personas, customer journeys, test data, edge cases, non-functional expectations, and quality gates reflect real user operations and the intended product experience 
 - Decide what is automated, manual and exploratory, and be able to defend each decision. 
 - Own backward compatibility: older app versions remain in the field after a release. Define and test version support. 
 - Apply AI tools and techniques to improve product quality and enhance the effectiveness and efficiency of quality engineering practices and processes. 

Required Qualifications

- 5+ years in software or quality engineering, with a deep focus on quality in complex systems. 
 - Hands-on experience testing native or cross-platform mobile apps on iOS and Android, including tablets. 
 - Experience testing mobile apps used in field or operational settings.

In this hourly, remote contractor role, you will work as a Malayalam Quality Assurance Lead (QAL) to oversee quality, consistency, and trainer performance across Malayalam AI training projects. You will review AI-generated Malayalam content and trainer/QA work, evaluate output quality against project guidelines, provide precise written feedback, and ensure that all contributors follow the expected quality standards. 

You will assess work for accuracy, fluency, grammar, spelling, tone, cultural appropriateness, meaning preservation, instruction-following, formatting, and adherence to project-specific rubrics. You will spot recurring quality issues, communicate updates to trainers and QAs, support onboarding, maintain documentation, and help activate contributors who are not working consistently. This role requires strong Malayalam and English skills, excellent attention to detail, structured communication, and the ability to manage quality workflows across remote teams. 

This role is with SME Careers, a fast-growing AI Data Services company and subsidiary of SuperAnnotate, delivering training data for many of the world's largest AI companies and foundation-model labs. Your Malayalam quality leadership will directly help improve the world's premier AI models by ensuring that Malayalam training data is natural, accurate, culturally appropriate, well-documented, and aligned with client expectations. 

Selection process involves an AI interview, a domain-specific task, and an interview with a recruiter. 

Key Responsibilities

- Quality monitoring: Spot-check Malayalam items, identify quality issues, provide ongoing feedback through DMs, and escalate recurring or critical issues. 
 - Trainer and QA communication: Update trainers and QAs on Discord about new item guidelines, project changes, workflow updates, and quality expectations. 
 - Question handling: Respond to trainer/QA questions clearly and promptly, especially around Malayalam wording, register, translation fidelity, cultural context, Kerala usage, diaspora usage, and edge cases. 
 - Trainer/QA activation management: DM contributors who are inactive or not working, encourage activation, track follow-ups, and flag availability issues when needed. 
 - Documentation: Create and maintain Malayalam project documentation, including style guides, trackers, FAQs, quality notes, examples, honeypots, and onboarding materials. 
 - Onboarding and training: Schedule and run onboarding/training calls with trainers and QAs to explain project expectations, workflows, rubrics, quality standards, and Malayalam-specific style requirements. 
 - Quality alignment: Ensure all trainers and QAs apply Malayalam language guidelines consistently and understand updates as projects evolve. 
 - Process improvement: Identify recurring quality gaps, propose workflow improvements, and help build scalable QA processes for Malayalam-language projects. 

Your Profile

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Malayalam, Linguistics, Translation, Communications, Journalism, English, Education, Quality Assurance, or a relevant domain/related field. 
 - Native or near-native Malayalam proficiency with strong reading and writing skills. 
 - Strong grasp of the English language to follow project guidelines, communicate with teams, and provide clear feedback in English. 
 - 3+ years of professional experience in Malayalam writing, editing, translation, localization, content QA, AI training, education, annotation, or related language-review workflows. 
 - Strong understanding of Malayalam grammar, spelling conventions, punctuation, tone, register, regional variation, and cultural context. 
 - Ability to evaluate Malayalam content against detailed rubrics and identify issues such as mistranslation, literal phrasing, unnatural tone, hallucinated claims, ambiguity, or inconsistent terminology. 
 - Experience leading or supporting remote teams of trainers, annotators, reviewers, editors, or QAs is strongly preferred. 
 - Comfortable working in fast-moving remote environments using tools such as Discord, Google Sheets, Google Docs, trackers, dashboards, and project management systems. 
 - Highly detail-oriented and organized, with the ability to maintain style guides, FAQs, trackers, onboarding materials, honeypots, and other quality documentation.
