data.title: Manager, Core Infrastructure Engineering
data.description:
Job Description

For a single team delivering components of distributed systems. Translates goals into a 1-2 quarter execution plan, sets coding, testing, and scalability practices, and provides hands-on oversight of performance tuning and load/perf testing. Guides the team in building fault-tolerant, in-service-upgradable components (redundancy, replication, failover) and in applying resiliency patterns (retries, circuit breakers, timeouts). Ensures robust observability (tests, alarms, dashboards, telemetry) and operational readiness via reviewed runbooks and standard procedures. Manages delivery of scoped features and correctness testing (including fault-injection/brownouts), and directs implementation of data replication/synchronization to maintain integrity and availability. Leads team incident response and root-cause efforts, enforces no-customer-downtime practices, and drives use of automation/IaC for troubleshooting. Oversees team security implementation (encryption, access controls), tracks remediation plans, verifies compliance documentation, and coaches adherence to change-management plans for safe patching, updates, and rollbacks. 

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

System Design & Architecture - System Scalability: 

- Provides oversight to the team on the development of components of distributed systems, including the use of distributed state management tools. 
 - Monitors and enables optimization of code and/or systems for large-scale data processing. 
 - Guides team to implement scalability requirements for assigned components. 
 - Coaches team to leverage data plane platforms to effectively handle large-scale data retrieval, storage, and processing. 
 - Ensures team accurately implements and executes performance and load testing. 

System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Design: 

- Provides guidance to the team in building fault-tolerant systems capable of withstanding in-service updates by leading the implementation of redundancy, replication, and automatic failover mechanisms. 
 - Guides the design of components to effectively handle service disruptions. 
 - Coaches team on various approaches to handle network unreliability, including retry mechanisms, circuit breakers, and timeouts. 

System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Performance: 

- Guides team to implement testing and alarming configurations for detecting and addressing issues/failures. 
 - Ensures team effectively supports recovery efforts by reviewing and aligning on runbooks and operational procedures. 
 - Coaches team on building and customizing dashboards, telemetry systems, and alerting mechanisms to monitor component health. 

System Design & Architecture - Correctness / Availability: 

- Manages the implementation and design of functional requirements and testing for features within an existing system. 
 - Coaches team on implementing test scenarios (e. g. , fault-injection, brown-out) to evaluate system correctness. 
 - Guides the implementation of data replication and synchronization techniques within the team to maintain data integrity and availability. 

Operational Troubleshooting & Incident Management: 

- Leads team efforts in diagnosing, debugging, and resolving issues in system components to support ongoing operation. 
 - Ensures teams are following protocols for preventing interruptions, ensuring no maintenance windows are required for customers and users when resolving issues. 
 - Manages team in effectively implementing automation scripts and tooling when troubleshooting operational issues. 
 - Creates schedules and manages operational support rotations. 

Compliance & Security: 

- Manages team implementation of robust security measures to protect data and applications in multi-tenant environments, overseeing encryption techniques and access controls. 
 - Manages execution of remediation plans to address identified security gaps, ensuring continuous improvement of security measures. 
 - Reviews documentation and ensures cloud infrastructure compliance with industry standards and regulations. 

Automation & Change Management: 

- Leads the maintenance of automation scripts and tools (e. g. , Infrastructure as Code (IaC)) to manage cloud infrastructure. 
 - Coaches team on change management plans for patching, updating, and rolling back applications. 

Core Responsibilities

Planning & Execution: 

- Creates and owns the execution plan for the team's work and multiple projects or initiatives, monitoring timelines and budgets (when applicable) to ensure projects are completed on time and in adherence with requirements. 
 - Delegates work across the team and helps them prioritize their work. 
 - Identifies resource needs and adapts plans based on changing priorities and business needs. 

Collaboration & Partnership: 

- Strengthens collaborative partnerships across teams to align on expectations and shared objectives. 
 - Guides team members to build relationships with business leaders, stakeholders, and/or customers to ensure effective collaboration. 
 - Practices active listening and asks insightful questions to promote an inclusive culture. 

Problem Solving: 

- Leads team to identify and address moderately complex operational and/or technical issues in accordance with standard practices, providing guidance as appropriate. 
 - Directs team to analyze data and/or information from multiple sources to troubleshoot moderately complex errors. 

Continuous Learning: 

- Actively seeks learning opportunities for self and team to enhance knowledge and skills in key areas and remain current with industry advancements. 
 - Uses feedback and training to elevate personal and team skills, modeling a commitment to learning. 
 - Identifies skill gaps within the team and supports team members in learning opportunities by providing resources and fostering an environment that encourages knowledge-sharing. 

Continuous Improvement: 

- Identifies and recommends improvements and encourages the team to share ideas to increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows within a team. 
 - Reviews and provides feedback on team members' ideas and seeks input from others on alternative approaches and methods for improving work. 

Performance and Development: 

- Coaches and provides direction to team members in alignment with performance management processes, guidelines, and expectations. 
 - Facilitates goal-setting discussions with team members, ensuring individual goals are aligned with broader team goals. 
 - Identifies development opportunities to help team members improve performance. 
 - Contributes to the talent acquisition pipeline by leading candidate interviews, assessing promotion eligibility, and managing talent resources. 

About Us

Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives. 

True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That's why we're committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs. 

We're committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation-request_mb@oracle. com or by calling 1-888-404-2494 in the United States. 

Oracle is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans' status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Oracle will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.

data.title: Operations Manager – Quality & Training
data.description:
Join our global team for a career filled with opportunities to solve challenges both small and large, local and global, simple and complex. 

Wilhelmsen Ship Management is a third-party ship manager providing various services across the globe. With a huge strength of Employee and Seafarers, we own and operate the world's largest Maritime Network in more than 70 countries. 

We are now building a dynamic, fast-growing travel start-up looking for enthusiastic and driven individuals to help us reshape the future of travel in our reputed organization. Be part of something exciting from the ground up, with room for professional growth & development. We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Operations Manager - Quality & Training to join our dynamic team in Wilhelmsen Ship Management India Ltd. The ideal candidate should have a passion for service excellence, people development, continuous improvement, and a deep understanding of marine and corporate travel operations. This is an exciting opportunity for individuals who are passionate about driving quality standards and building high-performing teams. 

Main Responsibilities and Tasks
The position is responsible for performing the following activities: 

- Quality Assurance & Compliance: Ensure operational activities adhere to defined quality standards, SOPs, client requirements, and agreed SLAs. Conduct regular audits and quality reviews to identify improvement opportunities. 
 - Training & Development: Develop, coordinate, and deliver onboarding, refresher, and advanced training programs for marine and corporate travel consultants to ensure required competency levels are maintained. 
 - Quality Monitoring: Monitor transaction quality, service delivery standards, booking accuracy, ticketing compliance, and customer interactions through structured quality assessments and evaluations. 
 - Performance Improvement: Analyze quality scores, operational performance, customer feedback, and audit findings to identify knowledge gaps and implement corrective action plans. 
 - Staff Errors/ADMs: Investigate staff errors, ADMs, and operational deviations. Implement preventive measures, coaching plans, and targeted training to minimize recurrence. 
 - Knowledge Management: Maintain and regularly update training materials, process documents, SOPs, airline policies, client requirements, and knowledge repositories. 
 - Calibration & Coaching: Conduct regular calibration sessions with Team Leaders and Operations Managers to ensure consistency in quality standards and evaluations. Provide coaching and mentoring where required. 
 - Client Satisfaction: Monitor customer feedback and service quality trends to ensure defined client satisfaction parameters are achieved and exceeded. 
 - Inter Department and Vendor Coordination: Work closely with Operations, Product, Technology, Vendors, and other stakeholders to ensure seamless implementation of quality and training initiatives. 
 - Compliance: Ensure strict adherence to data privacy, protection, confidentiality, and internal compliance requirements. 
 - Reporting & Analytics: Prepare regular quality, training, and performance reports. Present insights, trends, and recommendations to management for continuous improvement. 
 - Team Management: Manage Quality and Training resources, conduct appraisals, performance reviews, development discussions, and establish KPIs for team members. 
 - Continuous Improvement: Drive quality improvement projects, process excellence initiatives, automation adoption, and operational best practices across the organization. 
Others
Carry out any other instructions as and when assigned by superior (ad-hoc issues). 

Mandatory Requirements

- Proficiency in using travel management technologies and GDS. 
 - Strong understanding of marine and corporate travel processes. 
 - Experience handling multi-national crew travel. Experience handling Filipino and Indian crew is an advantage along with European crew. 
 - Good knowledge of European sectors along with other markets like Asia & Americas. 
 - Experience in quality management, training delivery, coaching, or operational excellence within the travel industry. 
 - Minimum 5+ years of experience in marine and corporate travel, with exposure to Quality and/or Training functions. 
 - Must have handled a team before. 
 - Experience using COMPAS or similar crew management tools is an advantage. 
 - Strong analytical skills with experience in reporting, audits, and root cause analysis. 
 - Good proficiency in English, both oral and written. 
 - IATA certified or equivalent. 
Competency Requirement
Management & Professional

- Customer Focus
 - Quality Orientation
 - Learning & Development
 - Problem Solving & Decision Making
 - Team Commitment
 - Coaching & Mentoring
 - Communication & Influencing
 - Continuous Improvement Mindset
 - Creativity & Innovation
 - Professionalism

data.title: Oracle Hiring For Senior DevOps Engineer – Autonomous Database
data.description:
Oracle hiring Senior DevOps Engineers to work on Autonomous Database cloud services in Hyderabad and Bengaluru

Role Overview - Senior DevOps Engineer (Autonomous Database)

Oracle is hiring experienced Senior DevOps Engineers to join its Autonomous Database team, which builds and operates Oracle's next-generation cloud database services such as Autonomous Data Warehouse (ADW) and Autonomous Transaction Processing (ATP). 

In this role, you'll work on designing, deploying, and operating highly scalable cloud database services. You'll contribute to production operations, automation, capacity planning, performance optimization, and release engineering, ensuring Oracle's autonomous services remain reliable, self-healing, and efficient at scale. 

Job Category: Product Development

Experience: 6 to 10+ years

Location: Hyderabad, Bengaluru India

Required Skills: Cloud Service, DevOps

Required Responsibilities

- Take responsibility for the implementation and operations of core database platform services. 
 - React to product deficiencies by implementing automation, self-healing systems, and real time monitoring and maintain system health. 
 - Become key contributor to the development of platform services, including architecture, provisioning, configuration and support. 
 - partner with distributed teams to prototype and implement new database platform services and keep up with evolving cloud infrastructure stacks. 
 - Continuously innovate and improve the overall platforms and scalability of oracle's cloud-based autonomous database services. 

Required Skills

- Strong experience in DevOps practices, with focus on cloud services, CI/CD pipelines and automation tools. 
 - Experience with Autonomous Database or Cloud Database services. (Oracle, AWS, Azure)
 - Understanding of cloud infrastructure, especially Oracle cloud infrastructure. (OCI)
 - Expertise in managing production environments, ensuring uptime, scalability and continuous performance monitoring. 
 - Ability to implement automation and create self-scaling, self-healing systems. 

Why Join Oracle?

Oracle offers a unique opportunity to work across the entire technology stack, from database internals to cloud service platforms. As part of the Autonomous Database team, you'll contribute to cutting-edge cloud innovations used by customers globally. 

Oracle Also Provides

- Global career growth opportunities
 - Exposure to enterprise-scale cloud systems
 - A collaborative and inclusive work culture
 - Continuous learning and skill development
 - Opportunities to participate in community and volunteer initiatives

Career Growth at Oracle (DevOps & Cloud)

Role

Senior DevOps Engineers at Oracle gain deep exposure to cloud-native architectures, distributed systems, and large-scale automation. With experience, professionals can grow into roles such as: 

- Principal DevOps Engineer
 - Cloud Architect
 - Site Reliability Engineer (SRE)
 - Engineering Manager
 - Cloud Platform Lead

Oracle's internal mobility and global projects allow engineers to build long-term careers in cloud and infrastructure leadership. 

Oracle Senior DevOps Engineer - Interview Preparation Tips

Candidates should be ready to discuss real-world DevOps and cloud operations experience. 

Prepare Examples Around

- Designing CI/CD pipelines and automation workflows
 - Managing high-availability production systems
 - Handling incidents, outages, and performance bottlenecks
 - Experience with cloud platforms (OCI, AWS, Azure)
 - Implementing monitoring, alerting, and self-healing systems

Clear communication and the ability to explain complex systems simply are key evaluation areas. 

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

- Is this a senior-level role? Yes, this role is intended for professionals with 6+ years of DevOps or cloud engineering experience. 
 - Is experience with Oracle Cloud mandatory? OCI experience is preferred, but strong experience with other major cloud platforms is also considered. 
 - Are both Hyderabad and Bengaluru locations available? Yes, the role is open for candidates in both locations. 
 - Does this role involve on-call or production support? Yes, as a senior DevOps role, production operations and system reliability are part of the responsibility. 
 - Is this a permanent position at Oracle? Yes, this is a full-time role within Oracle's Product Development organization. 

How To Apply

👉 Apply through Oracle's official careers portal

data.title: Lead Principal Core Infrastructure Engineer
data.description:
Job Description

Oracle Cloud Infrastructure is expanding across existing and new regions. Our Networking organization builds systems that manage Internet and backbone traffic, mitigate congestion, and reduce customer impact while enabling network operations to scale efficiently. 

The Lead Principal Core Infrastructure Engineer mentors engineering teams and leads the architecture of highly scalable, interdependent distributed systems. This role identifies and eliminates performance and scalability bottlenecks for hyperscale workloads, defines scalability requirements with stakeholders, and designs elastic, high-impact systems while driving innovation in data plane platforms. 

We are seeking a Lead Principal Core Infrastructure Engineer to define technical direction and lead the development of highly available, scalable network control, intelligent routing and automation systems. You will combine deep networking knowledge with software and distributed systems expertise to connect real-time observability with safe, automated routing decisions. 

Your work will span autonomous traffic management, policy-driven network optimization, and software-based routing infrastructure. You will identify performance and scalability bottlenecks, define requirements with stakeholders, and design resilient services that protect customer connectivity during growth, failures, and infrastructure changes. 

This is a hands-on individual contributor role with broad architectural influence. Based in IDC alongside the engineering team, you will lead initiatives from design through production operations, contribute to critical implementations, and establish standards for availability, security, observability, and safe deployment. You will collaborate across engineering and operations teams while mentoring senior engineers and developing technical leadership. 

Responsibilities

RESPONSIBILITIES

- Define technical strategy and architecture for scalable routing, network control, and automation systems. 
 - Design algorithms and distributed services for route computation, congestion management, traffic steering, fault isolation, and recovery. 
 - Correlate network and infrastructure signals to assess customer impact and enable safe automated responses. 
 - Identify performance bottlenecks and optimize capacity, resource utilization, routing convergence, and behavior under heavy load. 
 - Architect and build highly available, fault-tolerant systems with reliable state management, replication, automated failover, and recovery. 
 - Define service-level objectives, operational KPIs, telemetry, monitoring, and alerting for service health and routing outcomes. 
 - Establish simulation, scale testing, phased migrations, in-service upgrades, verification, and rollback practices. 
 - Lead production troubleshooting, incident response, and root-cause analysis; establish runbooks and drive reliability improvements. 
 - Integrate security controls, auditability, infrastructure as code, and automated deployment, patching, and lifecycle management. 
 - Contribute production-quality code, review designs and implementations, and maintain architecture and operational documentation. 
 - Partner with cross-functional engineering, product, and business stakeholders to define technical strategy and deliver high-impact initiatives. 
 - Mentor senior engineers, influence architectural direction, and promote engineering excellence through technical leadership, hiring, and knowledge sharing. 

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - 10+ years of relevant experience building and operating large-scale distributed systems, network control planes, or network automation platforms. 
 - Strong Linux systems and networking knowledge, including containers, process and memory behavior, network namespaces, resource isolation, and packet-level troubleshooting. 
 - Experience designing highly available distributed services with reliable state management, observability, overload protection, and failure recovery. 
 - Demonstrated ability to lead architecture and delivery across teams, resolve ambiguous requirements, communicate technical trade-offs, and mentor senior engineers. 
 - Deep knowledge of L2/L3 networking, routing and switching, software-defined networking, traffic engineering, and WAN technologies. 
 - Strong expertise in BGP and MP-BGP, IPv4/IPv6, route reflection, routing policy, and VPN address families, including practical experience with convergence and reachability troubleshooting. 
 - Strong programming skills in one or more languages such as Go, Python, Java, or C++, with experience in API design, concurrency, automated testing, and production debugging. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Production expertise with Junos and Juniper cRPD or comparable virtualized routing platforms. 
 - Experience with BGP Add-Path, Optimal Route Reflection (ORR), Prefix Independent Convergence (BGP-PIC), route-flap damping, and large-scale routing tables. 
 - Knowledge of MPLS, RSVP-TE, PCEP, bandwidth reservation, latency-aware routing, and shared-risk link groups. 
 - Experience with NETCONF, Junos XML APIs, gRPC, OpenConfig, and model-driven network automation. 
 - Experience tuning containerized networking workloads, including cgroups, socket buffers, veth, and SR-IOV. 
 - Experience with infrastructure as code, automated lifecycle orchestration, and rolling upgrades for stateful services. 
 - Understanding of Clos fabrics, overlay/underlay integration, ECMP behavior, and backbone transit. 
 - Experience building distributed active measurement and telemetry systems. 
 - Experience with simulation, failure injection, or formal methods to validate complex distributed-system behavior. 
 - Experience applying traffic prediction, machine learning, or AI techniques to network optimization, anomaly detection, or operational intelligence.

FactSet creates flexible, open data and software solutions for over 200, 000 investment professionals worldwide, providing instant access to financial data and analytics that investors use to make crucial decisions.

Job Description

FactSet's ecosystem spans a wide range of teams and technologies. This role focuses on integrating and supporting a centralized CI/CD pipeline platform that brings consistency and governance to how software is built, tested, and deployed - without slowing teams down. 

The work is less about building from scratch and more about making the right pieces fit together on a scale. Good engineering judgment is as important as technical skill: the platform needs to be consistent where it matters and flexible enough to support the teams that rely on it.

- Build a centralized CI/CD platform to support a diverse portfolio of applications with varying build tools, test frameworks, and deployment targets

 - Must be proficient in Microsoft SQL Server 2014 and RDBMS concepts. 
 - Proficiency in developing reports using SSRS (or other report-building tools). 
 - Must have experience in React. Js / Angular. 
 - Should have working knowledge of cloud technology: AWS, Azure, and GCP (Google Cloud Platform). 
 - Preferably worked in an Agile development environment. 
 - Preferably worked in an enterprise product environment. 
 - Excellent analytical skills and problem-solving skills. 
 - Must have good interpersonal and communication skills.

Aurigo is an AI-native capital program management platform trusted by over 300 customers managing more than $450 billion in capital programs across North America. Recognised as one of the Top 25 AI Companies of 2024 and a Great Place to Work for three consecutive years, we leverage artificial intelligence to create smarter, more connected outcomes. At Aurigo, we don't just build software - we help shape the future of infrastructure.

data.description:
Summary

Position Summary

Artificial Intelligence & Engineering

AI & Engineering leverages cutting-edge engineering capabilities to help build, deploy, and operate integrated/verticalized sector solutions in software, data, AI, network, and hybrid cloud infrastructure. These insights are powered by engineering for business advantage, helping transform mission-critical operations. 

Join our AI & Engineering team to help transform technology platforms, driving innovation, and help make a significant impact on our clients' achievements. You'll work alongside talented professionals reimagining and re-engineering operations and processes that could be critical to businesses. 

Senior Manager - AI & Data, Cloud & Generative AI (Japan Market Focus)

Position Summary

Level: Senior Manager

As a Senior Manager at Deloitte Consulting, you will be responsible for overall technical delivery as part of large-scale software solutions at enterprise level. You will lead functional and technical teams on the project located across shores guiding and mentoring junior team members and collaborating to understand the functional requirements. You will respond to new sales or proposals and support end-to-end delivery of the project along with estimations and planning. 

You will be responsible for managing the design, development, and deployment of large-scale system implementations at an enterprise level. You will be responsible for independently managing the team and guiding team members at different levels through their career path, work through technical leads across shores to manage implementation of the functional requirements and implement them on platforms like Guidewire and Majesco. You will own the end-to-end delivery of the project from estimations, planning, and execution. You would also be responsible for managing the status and end to end delivery of the final product. 

About The Role

We are looking for a Senior Manager to lead client delivery, AI governance orchestration, and go-to-market activities across AI & Data, Cloud, and Generative AI engagements, with a specific focus on Japan-market and clients. This role combines hands-on delivery and architectural leadership with business development and advisory responsibility - requiring fluency in Japanese, prior exposure working in Japan, and the ability to bridge CAIO/CIO-level strategic agendas on Advice & Implementation of Data Modernization on cloud along with Scaled AI adoption. 

What You'll Do

AI-Driven Modernization & Delivery

- Deliver on AI-driven modernization and build enterprise data utilization foundations through cloud lift-and-transform initiatives. 
 - Provide design, architecture, and delivery expertise on Snowflake and/or Databricks platforms as part of modernization engagements. 
 - Drive engineering teams to accelerate and scale prototyping, moving PoCs into production-grade delivery. 
 - Champion upfront investment in AI PoCs to build organizational momentum for broader enterprise implementation. 
 - Showcase engineering SME and conduct hands-on workshops across App Modernization, Data Engineering, AI/ML Platform Design, AI Use Case Prioritization, Legacy Exits, Quality Engineering, and DevSecOps. 

AI Governance & Enterprise Strategy

- Partner with cross-Op groups to advise on AI governance and Trusted & Secure AI assessments, shaping the broader technology roadmap. 
 - Maintain strong command on AI & data governance, secure AI adoption practices, and data platform modernization principles. 
 - Align technology modernization initiatives with business priorities, scaling AI adoption across the Group/enterprise. 

Use Case Identification & Business Enablement

- Lead AI use case identification, requirements definition, and implementation across both business and corporate functions. 
 - Orchestrate workshop supports connecting the CAIO/CIO agenda with feasible, prioritized use cases. 
 - Lead workshops on AI-based Business Process Reengineering (BPR), Physical AI business opportunities

Tech Sales Leadership & Client Advisory

- Drive and promote Deloitte's AI implementation capabilities directly to clients 
 - Lead and enable technology-led sales pursuits, RFP responses, and solutioning for AI & Data / Cloud / GenAI opportunities 
 - Bring forth perspectives on Global Delivery Pods, Forward deployment Engineers (FDE Pods ), Staff Augmentation methodologies to shape delivery archetypes 
 - Act as a trusted technical/business advisor in client discussions, bridging technical teams and Japanese business stakeholders with cultural and linguistic fluency

Capability & Practice Building

- Contribute to the firm's AI & Data / GenAI offering development, including industry use cases, accelerators, and reusable IP. 
 - Mentor and upskill delivery teams, particularly around AI/Cloud/GenAI delivery and Japan market readiness. 
 - Represent the practice in internal and external forums, alliance partner sessions, and thought leadership initiatives. 

Required Qualifications

- 12-15+ years of experience in technology consulting, with at least 4-5 years focused on AI/ML, Data platforms, Cloud, and/or Generative AI. 
 - Demonstrated experience working on client engagements in Japan or with Japanese clients (onshore, offshore, or hybrid delivery models). 
 - Business-level or native fluency in Japanese (JLPT N2 or above strongly preferred) and professional fluency in English. 
 - Hands-on design/architecture and delivery expertise on Snowflake and/or Databricks. 
 - Proven experience establishing or operating within an AI Center of Excellence, including AI governance frameworks and enterprise AI roadmaps. 
 - Strong knowledge of AI & data governance, secure/trusted AI adoption assessments, and data platform modernization on cloud 
 - Demonstrated experience leading technology-led sales pursuits, proposal development, and client pitches. 
 - Experience with Global Delivery Pod, FDE Pod, or Staff Augmentation delivery models and contract structuring. 
 - Measurable growth/uplift in sales team win rates for Japan Market on tech-led (AI & Data, GenAI) pursuits through enablement and reusable assets. 
 - PoC-to-production conversion rate demonstrating sustained AI implementation momentum. 
 - Strong internal reputation as the bridge between CAIO/CIO strategic agendas and feasible delivery. 
 - Strong understanding of enterprise AI architecture patterns: agentic AI, RAG/GraphRAG, knowledge graphs, MCP-based integrations, LLM governance frameworks. 
 - Strong executive communication skills - able to build and deliver C-suite (CAIO/CIO)-ready narratives connecting strategy to feasible use cases. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Prior expatriate assignment or extended engagement based in Japan. 
 - Experience in Physical AI strategy, including GTM, capability acquisition, and manufacturing/procurement strategy. 
 - Experience in financial services, manufacturing, or other Japan-heavy industry verticals. 
 - Certifications in cloud platforms (AWS/Azure/GCP) or AI/ML specializations. 
 - Experience designing human-agent mixed business processes or leading AI-based BPR workshops. 

Location: Bengaluru / Hyderabad

Our purpose

Deloitte's purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities. 

Our people and culture

Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients' most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work. 

Professional development

At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India . 

Benefits To Help You Thrive

At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially-and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you. 

Recruiting tips

From developing a stand out resume to putting your best foot forward in the interview, we want you to feel prepared and confident as you explore opportunities at Deloitte. Check out recruiting tips from Deloitte recruiters.

data.description:
Job Description

Title: Engineering Team Leader - Mechanical-Husky (India) Guindy, Chennai

Id: 21203

Type: FullTime

Location: Chennai, India

At Husky TechnologiesTM, our success is based on your success. Our ability to keep our customers in the lead is based on building the strongest team possible. 

Husky TechnologiesTM has a strong foundation built on innovation, close customer relationships and a unique culture and values. We are dedicated to offering our customers the highest quality products and services and are looking for people with the inspiration and talent to develop with us as we pursue our ambitious growth strategy. We are a leader in developing state-of-the-art technology and it is this technology base that uniquely positions us to serve customers who seek differentiation through solutions that provide speed, flexibility and maximum productivity. This capability is at the core of our mission and competitive strategy. 

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a wealth of opportunity for personal growth and development. Most importantly, Husky Technologies TM offers an opportunity to work with - and be challenged by - a team of great people. Our success is possible because of the creativity, intelligence and passion of our people around the world and their desire to lead change. At the same time, we are not afraid to expect a lot and strive for leadership in all of our key markets. We are a company taking on new challenges and for the right people this means exceptional career development opportunities, the chance to be part of a team that is the best in the world at what we do and the experience that comes from working in an environment that demands constant transformation and innovation. 

Husky TechnologiesTM is an exciting company with tremendous potential. We have a great team and great expectations. If you are attracted to bold goals, believe in uncompromising honesty, support mutual respect, care about environmental responsibility, have a passion for excellence and a desire to make a positive contribution - then we want you to join the Husky TechnologiesTM team!

Engineering Team Leader, Platform Mechanical

Lead and develop a mechanical engineering team made up of junior, senior, and specialist level designers in the development of new Husky products and solutions with a focus on innovation, quality, risk mitigation and customer satisfaction. 

Key Responsibilities/Areas Of Accountability

- Lead, manage and develop the team, which includes but is not limited to coaching, mentoring and cross-training. 
 - Oversee the design, development, and release of engineering for new Husky machine platforms as well as critical service and customer support requests. 
 - Ensure the team is effective in delivering new products that meet the requirements defined by the businesses as essential for success - aligned with product definition and the Husky Operating model. 
 - Planning and scheduling design activities to ensure committed completion dates are met as per business needs. 
 - Enforcement of Product Development Process, Design Documents and Risk Mitigation as well as applicable directives and standards our machines must comply with. 
 - Participate in, and lead as needed, technical discussions, design reviews, and executive updates to ensure the implementation of high-quality solutions with stakeholder transparency. 
 - Influence and establish engineering standards through solid design decisions, processes and tools. 
 - Participate in process creation, product architecture decisions, technology roadmap creation and continuous improvement initiatives
 - Encourage team members to think, organize and lead while providing them with developmental and career growth opportunities. 
 - Lead effective cross-disciplinary collaboration between various stakeholders and teams. 
 - Facilitating collaboration between other departments (Supply chain, Service, Operations)
 - Interviewing and hiring new team members. 

Critcal Capabilities And Qualifications

- Excellent communication skills (verbal, written, interpersonal and presentation)
 - Strong leadership skills with the ability to motivate and develop a team. 
 - Strong decision-making and judgment. 
 - System level thinking at both a product and enterprise level. 
 - Excellent knowledge of the mechanical design discipline
 - Demonstrates high degree of flexibility and embraces changing priorities. 
 - Knowledge of Husky products, tools, standards, processes and technology is an asset. 

Education

- Bachelor or Master's of engineering degree from accredited university

Experience

- 10+ years relevant engineering experience. 
 - Proven leadership experience. 
 - Previous engineering experience in heavy machinery or injection molding industry is an asset. 

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a competitive compensation and benefits package and excellent opportunities for growth and advancement. We are committed to equal employment opportunity and respect, value and welcome diversity in our workplace. Husky TechnologiesTM also values being a great place to work and strives to maintain a safe workplace. Accordingly, Husky TechnologiesTM conditions all offers of employment on satisfactory completion of background checks. No agency or telephone inquiries please.

data.title: Staff Engineer, Software (FDE)
data.description:
Work Schedule

Standard (Mon-Fri)

Environmental Conditions

Office

About Company: 

ThermoFisher Scientific Inc. is the world leader in serving science, with revenues of more than $25 billion and approximately 1, 30, 000 employees globally. We help our customers accelerate life sciences research, solve elite analytical challenges, improve patient diagnostics, deliver medicines to market, and increase laboratory efficiency. 

Through our world-class brands-Thermo Scientific, Applied Biosystems, Invitrogen, Fisher Scientific, and Unity Lab Services-we offer an unmatched combination of innovative technologies, purchasing convenience, and comprehensive services. 

About Team: 

We are the Digital Foundation Platform team - the software center of excellence (CoE) for Thermo Fisher Scientific. We develop and deliver foundational components, SaaS-based applications, digital lab (Cloud-based) tools, and foundational AI and agentic AI solutions to help scientists work more efficiently and precisely, enabling them to make our world healthier, cleaner, and safer. Our elite software products and solutions accelerate scientific discovery and lab productivity. These solutions

- Provide rich content, selection tools, teamwork tools, and scientific apps that allow our customers to focus on innovation and the complexities of their science. 
 - Build a connected world for our customers where discoveries happen in a thoughtful way - where every device/product is connected, self-aware, and self-healing-thereby enabling efficient workflows and collaborative science. 
 - Enable our customers to efficiently handle their labs by providing them with insight into workflow processes, asset uptime, and product availability. 

We give them the flexibility to access what they need when they need it, allowing them to select and receive products and services across multiple channels. We apply industry-standard methodologies to the design, development, and deployment of best-in-class software products built to demonstrate the power and scalability of the cloud. 

Roles & Responsibilities: 

Purpose: 

The Software Staff Engineer provides software and systems architectural and design leadership to multiple Software Development Scrum Teams delivering Connect Platform & Ecosystem, Customer tenancy, Authorization, and Digital product subscriptions and entitlements. The role is that of a Lead Developer who is motivated to actively contribute to the architecture, design, and development of new features. The person is also expected to perform all aspects of software development, including programming, system design, code review, design review, unit testing, and integration testing. In addition to that, the role also demands leading, empowering, mentoring, and providing ample guidance to the other team members with respect to technical challenges. 

Responsibilities: 

- Partner with business stakeholders to understand business objectives, workflows, and pain points
 - Discover and prioritize high-value AI Business use cases with measurable impact
 - Translate business requirements into scalable solution architectures using existing reusable capabilities
 - Select the most appropriate AI models (LLMs, SLMs, multimodal, domain-specific) based on use case, performance, cost, and latency
 - Design Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures, including vector databases, indexing strategies, chunking, embedding models, and retrieval patterns
 - Identify and compose the right platform components, reusable services, tools, APIs, and agentic building blocks
 - Configure and orchestrate agents, multi-agent workflows, memory, tools, and enterprise integrations
 - Integrate enterprise data sources, knowledge repositories, and external systems securely
 - Optimize prompts, reasoning workflows, model parameters, and inference strategies for accuracy and performance
 - Validate solutions through prototypes, pilot deployments, and business acceptance testing
 - Drive solution adoption from Private Preview to General Availability (GA)
 - Monitor solution effectiveness, collect operational and business feedback, and continuously optimize deployments
 - Capture reusable patterns, reference architectures, and best practices to continuously enhance the agentic AI platform
 - Collaborate with platform engineering teams to identify capability gaps and influence future platform evolution
 - Able to understand, articulate, and challenge the requirements
 - Guides design activity to other programmers on technical aspects relating to the project
 - Proactively looks for ways and patterns to continuously automate feature testing with measurable and tangible goals
 - Is authentic, transparent, and leads by example, holding self and others accountable. Inspires, motivates, and collaborates with others
 - Anticipates needs and problems while creating solutions. Is willing to ask difficult questions and take risks. Greets challenge and change as opportunity
 - A highly motivated fast learner who can self-start and "figure out what needs figuring out"
 - Actively participates in development community of practices in sharing and learning standard processes, leads initiatives within the community , and is involved in other organization initiatives
 - Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Ability to effectively document artifacts and processes and then explain them to others

Candidate Requirement: 

Education: Bachelor's in engineering or master's in computer science with 10+ years of proven experience

Required Skills, Knowledge, and Experience: 

- Minimum 10 years' experience in Agentic Application Development using Python, Java, C++, C#, Go, JavaScript/TypeScript, or equivalent languages. Related technologies; Expertise in OOAD principles and methodologies
 - Extensive experience in Java application development frameworks and technologies: Apache Tomcat, Jetty, Juice, Spring, and JSON/XML/Ajax
 - Strong in programming fields like object-oriented principles, design patterns, data structures, and unit testing (TDD using JUnit), Domain-Driven Design (DDD)
 - Minimum 4 years' experience in cloud computing using AWS such as S3, DynamoDB, SNS, SES, EC2
 - Proven experience in designing Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures, including vector databases, indexing strategies, chunking, embedding models, and retrieval patterns. 
 - Demonstrable experience in identifying and composing the right platform components, reusable services, tools, APIs, and agentic building blocks. 
 - Hands-on experience in configuring and orchestrating agents, multi-agent workflows, memory, tools, and enterprise integrations. 
 - Minimum 4 years' experience with databases (Postgres/MySQL/Oracle/NoSQL DB), persistence frameworks, and SQL
 - Extensive knowledge in handling sophisticated data structures and well-versed in developing multithreaded applications. 
 - 3 Years of proven experience with GitHub, Docker, and CI/CD frameworks (Jenkins, GHA)
 - Experience with defining and implementing Non-Functional Requirements (NFR - Security, Performance, Cost, and code quality)
 - Experience in designing and architecting large-scale, highly available distributed software

Senior Workato Integration Engineer

Join us in bringing joy to customer experience. Five9 is a leading provider of customer experience software, bringing the power of AI and cloud innovation to customers worldwide. 

Living our values every day results in our team first culture and enables us to innovate, grow, and thrive while enjoying the journey together. 

We are seeking a skilled and experienced Senior Workato Integration Engineer to join our IT / Enterprise Applications team. This role is responsible for designing, building, and scaling enterprise integrations across Five9's business application ecosystem using Workato, while establishing the integration standards and best practices that support the company's continued growth. 

The ideal candidate will have a minimum of 5 years of integration experience, a Workato certification, deep technical expertise across modern integration patterns and security practices, and the ability to lead technical discussions with both architects and business stakeholders. 

The position is based in Chennai or Bengaluru, India, and requires working hours that overlap with the US Pacific time zone, where our Technology teams are primarily based. 

Key Responsibilities

- Design, build, and maintain enterprise-grade integrations and automations using Workato across Five9's business application ecosystem. 
 - Define and maintain integration standards, reusable patterns, and design guidelines so integrations remain scalable and maintainable as systems evolve. 
 - Standardize error handling across recipes, including retry logic, dead letter queues, compensating transactions, alerting, and logging. 
 - Optimize Workato recipes for performance and cost, minimizing unnecessary API consumption and job usage. 
 - Support and maintain integrations between UKG Pro, Deel, Greenhouse, Degreed Learning Experience Platform, Replicon, and other business applications, partnering with Business Technology teams as needed. 
 - Design and implement secure authentication patterns (OAuth 2. 0, JWT, SAML, API keys, certificates) and manage secrets in accordance with least privilege principles. 
 - Design an enterprise integration architecture and lead technical discussions with architects and business stakeholders. 
 - Troubleshoot complex, cross-system production issues and drive them to resolution. 
 - Improve the quality and consistency of integration and data documentation, leveraging AI tools such as Copilot where appropriate. 
 - Evaluate and incorporate Workato's AI capabilities, including MCP, Workato Genies, and Agent Studio, into Five9's automation strategy where appropriate. 
 - Mentor other integration engineers and help grow the team's technical capabilities. 
 - Stay current with Workato platform updates, integration best practices, and emerging AI-driven automation capabilities. 

Key Requirements: 

- Minimum of 5 years of hands-on integration experience. 
 - Workato certification required (e. g. , Workato Automation Pro or higher). 
 - Strong hands-on experience with REST APIs, including HTTP methods, authentication, pagination, rate limits, webhooks, and JSON payloads. 
 - Experience designing reusable, versioned APIs and integrations that remain maintainable as systems evolve. 
 - Strong understanding of authentication and security practices, including OAuth 2. 0, JWT, API keys, Basic Auth, SAML, certificates, secret management, encryption, and least privilege access. 
 - Proficiency working with JSON and XML, including parsing, transformation, and mapping of complex payloads. 
 - Experience with data transformation, including mapping, filtering, aggregation, cleansing, deduplication, and schema conversion. 
 - Working knowledge of SQL, including querying databases, troubleshooting, and relational data models. 
 - Experience implementing robust error handling, including retry logic, dead letter queues, compensating transactions, alerts, logging, and graceful failure handling. 
 - Understanding of event-driven architecture, including webhooks, event streams, asynchronous processing, and message-based integrations. 
 - Familiarity with common integration patterns, including request/response, publish/subscribe, polling, batch processing, ETL, orchestration, and choreography. 
 - Experience with, or strong interest in, business applications such as Salesforce, NetSuite, GCP, UKG, Deel, Ramp, Jira, Freshservice, and Coupa is a big plus. 
 - Familiarity with Workato's emerging AI capabilities, including MCP, Workato Genies, and Agent Studio, is a big plus. 
 - Experience with version control and CI/CD practices for integration development is a plus. 
 - Familiarity with monitoring and observability tooling for integration health and performance is a plus. 
 - Awareness of data privacy and compliance considerations (e. g. , GDPR, SOC 2) as they relate to integrations is a plus. 
 - Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and communication skills, with the ability to lead technical discussions and mentor other engineers. 
 - Ability to work independently and collaboratively across a distributed, global team. 

Why You'll Love This Role: 

- You will play a key role in shaping how Five9's core business systems connect and scale through modern integration and automation technology. 
 - You will work at the forefront of Workato's evolving AI capabilities, including agentic automation and enterprise AI use cases. 
 - You will collaborate with cross functional teams across the enterprise while helping define the integration standards that power the company's growth. 
 - If you enjoy solving complex, cross-system problems and building resilient, scalable integrations, this role offers strong technical depth and growth opportunities. 

Five9 embraces diversity and is committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. The more inclusive we are, the better we are. Five9 is an equal opportunity employer. 

Five9 is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities throughout the application and interview process. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please contact us at accommodations@five9. com to request an accommodation. Requests will be handled confidentially and in accordance with applicable law. 

View our privacy policy, including our privacy notice to California residents here: https: //www. five9. com/pt-pt/legal. 

Note: Five9 will never request that an applicant send money as a prerequisite for commencing employment with Five9.

data.description:
Position Title: Senior Engineer / Assistant Manager / Deputy Manager - Fabrication (Projects & ME)

Location: Satyavedu

ob Description

The Senior Engineer / Assistant Manager / Deputy Manager - Fabrication (Projects & ME) is responsible for the process planning, industrialization, robotic automation, and technical validation of chassis and frame fabrication lines. Sitting at the core of structural manufacturing engineering, this role leads the development of advanced joining processes (MIG, TIG, Resistance, Laser, and Friction Stir Welding), robotic programming (ABB, Fanuc, Yaskawa), WPS/PQR specifications, and metallurgical validation. The incumbent oversees the complete project lifecycle-from DFMEA/PFMEA design reviews and fixture/gauge procurement to Cpk/Ppk trials, PPAP approval, ergonomic line balancing (MOST), and SBP strategic capacity planning-ensuring high weld quality, safety compliance, and zero-defect mass production. 

Key Responsibilities

- Process Planning & Weld Engineering: Formulate Process Flow Diagrams, PFMEAs, Control Plans, WPS/PQR standards, and torch/parameter sequences across manual and robotic joining lines (MIG/TIG/Spot/Laser). 
 - Robotic Automation & Line Setup: Program and commission robotic welding cells (ABB, Fanuc, Yaskawa), integrate automated seam tracking, design ergonomic layouts, and optimize cycle times using MOST. 
 - Tooling, Jigs & Fixture Development: Conceptualize, procure, and prove out welding jigs, locators, Poka-Yoke clamping mechanisms, gauges, and Special Purpose Machines (SPMs) with vendors. 
 - Metallurgical Validation & Quality Control: Perform mechanical testing (tensile, bend, macro/micro, hardness) and NDT inspections to guarantee weld penetration, structural integrity, and IATF 16949 / ISO 3834 compliance. 
 - NPD, APQP & Industrialization: Lead cross-functional trials for New Product Development (NPD), execute ECN updates, drive APQP/PPAP sign-offs, and prove line capability (Cpk/Ppk) for mass production readiness. 
 - Operational Excellence & Cost Optimization: Drive VA/VE projects, scrap reduction, setup time optimization (SMED), OEE improvements, and long-term Strategic Business Plan (SBP) budget/capacity projections. 

Desired Skills & Experience

- Education: B. E. / B. Tech in Mechanical, Production, Metallurgy, Automotive, or Mechatronics Engineering. Experience Requirements by Band: 

- Senior Engineer: 3-6 years of hands-on experience independently managing fabrication process setups, NPD trials, and improvement projects. 
 - Deputy Manager: 9-12+ years of leadership experience driving SBP long-term roadmaps, mentoring engineering teams, upgrading plant technology, and projecting multi-year capital budgets.

Job Description

Renesas is looking for a Principal Engineer, Validation. to redefine how automotive‐grade silicon quality is built-driving first‐time‐right silicon, eliminating customer escapes, and setting a new industry benchmark for validation excellence

Key Responsibilities

data.title: R&D Engineer 3, Software
data.description:
Overview

Keysight is at the forefront of technology innovation, delivering breakthroughs and trusted insights in electronic design, simulation, prototyping, test, manufacturing, and optimization. Our ~16, 800 employees create world-class solutions in communications, 5G, automotive, energy, quantum, aerospace, defense, and semiconductor markets for customers in over 100 countries. Learn more about what we do. 

Our award-winning culture embraces a bold vision of where technology can take us and a passion for tackling challenging problems with industry-first solutions. We believe that when people feel a sense of belonging, they can be more creative, innovative, and thrive at all points in their careers. 

We are looking for a Senior Observability Engineer to design, build, and continuously improve monitoring and observability for our enterprise environment. Most of the work focuses on on-premises systems: physical servers, virtualized infrastructure, and on-prem Kubernetes clusters, along with the infrastructure layers underneath them. Some cloud use cases are also in scope. Your goal is to give system owners and business stakeholders an accurate, actionable view of the health and uptime of the systems they depend on. 

You will also help shape how we apply agentic AI to observability, moving from dashboards and alerts toward intelligent triage, correlation, and assisted remediation. 

Responsibilities

Architecture and Design

- Design end-to-end monitoring and observability solutions for enterprise applications running on VMs, Kubernetes, and bare-metal servers, and extend them to cloud workloads where needed. 
 - Define a layered monitoring strategy that covers hardware, OS, virtualization, network, storage, platform services, and applications. 
 - Set standards for metrics, logs, alerting, dashboards, and service health models, including SLIs and SLOs where they apply. 
 - Make sound architectural decisions on tool roles, data flows, retention, scalability, and high availability across the observability stack. 
 - Define alert escalation policies, incident response workflows, and event correlation strategies to reduce operational noise and improve service reliability. 
 - Design service topology, dependency mapping, and business service monitoring across infrastructure and application layers. 
 - Secure observability platforms and integrations through access controls, authentication, encryption, and vulnerability remediation. Maintain compliance with enterprise security standards through platform hardening, audit readiness, and regular security reviews. 

Implementation

- Build and maintain monitoring with Zabbix, covering templates, discovery, triggers, proxies, and integrations. 
 - Design and maintain log collection, parsing, enrichment, and routing pipelines into Splunk, including forwarders, sourcetypes, field extractions, indexes, and searches. 
 - Contribute to metrics and visualization with Prometheus and Grafana, particularly for Kubernetes workloads and unified dashboards. 
 - Automate the configuration and onboarding of monitoring using infrastructure-as-code and APIs. 

Agentic AI for Observability

- Design and implement AI agents that support observability workflows. Examples include alert triage and deduplication, cross-source event correlation, root-cause hypotheses, incident summarization, and runbook-driven remediation with human-in-the-loop approval. 
 - Integrate LLM-based agents with monitoring and logging platforms through APIs and tool protocols such as MCP. 
 - Define guardrails, permission boundaries, and auditability for AI-driven actions on production systems. 
 - Measure the real impact of these agents on operations, for example on MTTD, MTTR, alert noise, and on-call load. 

Collaboration

- Work closely with system owners to understand architecture, failure modes, and dependencies, and to translate them into meaningful monitoring. 
 - Partner with consumers and stakeholders of those systems to define what "healthy" and "available" mean to them, and to make sure observability gives them the visibility they need. 
 - Provide technical leadership and mentoring, and run knowledge sharing across operations, infrastructure, and development teams. 

Continuous Improvement

- Regularly review alert quality, coverage gaps, and signal-to-noise ratio, and tune or retire monitoring accordingly. 
 - Use incidents and post-mortems as input to improve detection and response. 
 - Track the evolution of the observability toolset and the wider technology landscape. 

Qualifications

Required

- 7+ years in infrastructure, operations, or observability engineering, with at least 3 years focused on monitoring and observability, primarily in on-premises enterprise environments. 
 - Hands-on, production-level experience with Zabbix and Splunk. 
 - Proven experience monitoring physical servers, virtualization platforms (e. g. , VMware, Hyper-V, KVM), and Kubernetes clusters. 
 - Strong understanding of infrastructure layers: compute, OS (Linux and Windows), networking, storage, and the dependencies between them. 
 - Solid experience with log collection and processing at scale: parsing, normalization, enrichment, retention, and search optimization. 
 - Practical experience applying agentic AI (LLM agents, tool use, automation) to monitoring, operations, or incident management, along with a working understanding of how these systems behave and where their risks lie. 
 - Experience designing monitoring architecture, not only operating existing tools. 
 - Experience defining alert escalation policies, incident response workflows, and event correlation strategies to reduce operational noise and improve service reliability. 
 - Experience designing service topology, dependency mapping, and business service monitoring across infrastructure and application layers. 
 - Working knowledge of securing observability platforms, including access control, authentication, encryption, and hardening. 
 - Strong scripting skills (e. g. , Python, Bash, PowerShell) and comfort working with REST APIs. 
 - Excellent communication skills and the ability to work with both technical owners and non-technical stakeholders. 

Nice to Have

- Experience with Prometheus (exporters, alerting rules, Alert manager, long-term storage). 
 - Experience with Grafana (dashboard design, multi-source visualization, alerting). 
 - Experience monitoring cloud workloads (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and hybrid environments. 
 - Software development experience, such as building integrations, tools, exporters, or services. 

Careers Privacy Statement***Keysight is an Equal Opportunity Employer. ***

You will also drive deployment automation, replacing manual release cycles with CI/CD pipelines that accelerate delivery velocity for a platform serving Tier-1 advertising data systems.

Job Description

As an Electrical Quality Engineer for Solar Projects, you will play a crucial role in ensuring the quality, reliability, and safety of our solar power installations. This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Privacy Engineer based in India. 

As a Senior Privacy Engineer, you will play a key role in designing and developing technology that protects users' privacy across digital products and services. You will lead complex engineering projects, build innovative privacy solutions, and help strengthen protections against online tracking and emerging threats. Working within a distributed, remote-first engineering team, you will take ownership of major technical components from initial planning through implementation and ongoing improvement. You will collaborate across teams to ensure new features and product developments uphold strong privacy standards. The role offers opportunities to contribute to privacy-focused search technologies, AI-powered experiences, and advanced tracking protection systems.  - Define and continuously improve the quality assurance strategy for network security software across major releases, patches, and hotfixes.

 - Drive risk-based testing and shift-left practices to identify defects and security risks early in the development lifecycle. 
 - Lead quality reviews and make release go/no-go recommendations based on testing results, risk assessments, and product readiness. 
 - Networking and Security Test Leadership
 - Provide technical leadership across firewall capabilities, including stateful firewalling, NAT, IPSec and SSL VPNs, routing, and high availability. 
 - Oversee testing of security services such as intrusion prevention, DPI-SSL, gateway antivirus, application control, and web filtering. 
 - Review product requirements, design documents, and architecture proposals to identify quality, security, and reliability risks. 
 - Develop comprehensive test strategies covering functional behavior, end-to-end customer workflows, throughput, performance, scalability, and stress testing. 
 - Ensure robust validation of failover scenarios, upgrades and downgrades, configuration migrations, and long-duration system stability. 
 - Champion negative testing and security-focused scenarios to validate resilience against misuse, abuse cases, and potential threats. 
 - Automation and Test Infrastructure
 - Define the long-term automation roadmap across UI, API, CLI, and end-to-end testing, with measurable coverage and effectiveness goals. 
 - Partner with automation leaders to develop scalable, reliable test frameworks integrated into CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Improve automated test suite stability by reducing flaky tests and strengthening the reliability and usefulness of test results. 
 - Oversee test environment strategy across physical hardware appliances, virtual firewalls, and cloud deployments. 
 - Collaborate with infrastructure teams on test environment availability, capacity planning, and operational reliability. 
 - Quality Metrics and Continuous Improvement
 - Track key quality indicators, including defect leakage, production escape rates, regression effectiveness, automation return on investment, and test flakiness. 
 - Lead regular release readiness reviews and communicate quality risks, trends, and recommendations to senior stakeholders. 
 - Conduct root cause analyses for production defects and customer-impacting incidents, addressing systemic quality gaps. 
 - Translate customer and field feedback into preventive testing improvements and stronger engineering practices. 
 - People Leadership and Stakeholder Collaboration
 - Build, mentor, and retain a strong QA leadership team comprising managers, technical leads, and senior engineers. 
 - Establish clear performance expectations, career development pathways, and technical growth plans. 
 - Influence engineering and product leadership to prioritize quality, reliability, security, and customer outcomes. 
 - Represent the QA function in leadership discussions, cross-functional reviews, and customer escalations. 
Requirements

- Professional experience: 10+ years of total technical experience, including at least 2 years in an engineering management or leadership role. 
 - Networking expertise: Strong hands-on understanding of networking and security fundamentals, including TCP/IP, routing, NAT, VPN technologies, high availability, authentication mechanisms, and intrusion prevention or deep packet inspection concepts. 
 - Domain experience: Proven experience testing firewall products, network security solutions, or comparable complex system software. A strong networking background is essential for this position. 
 - Quality ownership: Demonstrated ability to lead quality assurance for complex software releases, establish testing strategies, and manage release readiness and risk. 
 - People management: Experience leading, developing, and scaling QA teams, including collaboration across locations and time zones. 
 - Automation and CI/CD: Strong knowledge of test automation strategy, automated regression testing, continuous integration, continuous delivery, and quality engineering practices. 
 - Technical judgment: Ability to assess architecture and design decisions, identify security and reliability risks, and develop comprehensive test coverage for complex systems. 
 - Communication and influence: Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to align technical teams and influence senior decision-makers. 
 - Preferred platform experience: Previous experience with SonicOS or comparable firewall operating systems is an advantage. 
 - Additional preferred qualifications: Familiarity with security and compliance frameworks such as FIPS, Common Criteria, or SOC 2; experience testing hybrid hardware, virtual, and cloud environments; and experience handling customer escalations and field issue root cause analysis. 
 - Location and work arrangements: The role is based in Pune, India. Candidates should confirm any relocation expectations and applicable working arrangements during the hiring process. 

Benefits

- Location flexibility: The role is advertised with remote-work tagging, although the listed location is Pune, India; the precise remote or hybrid arrangement should be confirmed. 
 - Leadership opportunity: Shape quality strategy for critical network security software and influence release decisions at scale. 
 - Technical impact: Work on complex firewall technologies, security services, automation frameworks, and large-scale test infrastructure. 
 - Professional growth: Mentor engineering leaders, strengthen technical leadership capabilities, and influence cross-functional engineering practices. 
 - Continuous improvement: Drive measurable advances in automation coverage, testing effectiveness, release predictability, and customer reliability. 
 - Collaborative environment: Partner with engineering, product, DevOps, release management, and support teams.

data.title: Senior Principal Cloud Platform Engineer
data.description:
SambaNova is a leader in next-generation AI infrastructure, delivering a full-stack inference platform for customers worldwide. At the core of SambaNova's technology is the RDU (Reconfigurable Dataflow Unit) - a chip built on a dataflow architecture rather than the traditional GPU model. Its decode performance is especially strong for agentic workloads like multi-turn agents, code generation, and long-running applications. RDUs are packaged into SambaRack, rack-scale hardware that lets customers deploy state-of-the-art models with better performance, greater energy efficiency, and faster time to value. 

About The Team

The Cloud Platform team owns the production inferencing service that serves SambaNova's models to customers on RDU accelerators, including capacity planning, deployment, monitoring, and incident response across regions in the United States, Asia, Europe, and Latin America. 

About The Role

As a Senior Principal Cloud Platform Engineer you'll keep our AI inferencing platform reliable, fast, and scalable. Your focus is uptime, latency, and resource utilization on the inference endpoints customers depend on. The work spans monitoring, deployment, capacity planning, and incident response, and includes a shared on-call rotation covering 24/7 coverage. 

Responsibilities

- Owning the availability, latency, and efficiency of the production inferencing service, including change management, emergency response, and standing up AI infrastructure in new regions
 - Building and maintaining monitoring, alerting, and dashboards in Prometheus, Grafana, and Datadog covering service health, model latency and throughput, and RDU utilization
 - Leading incident response, running blameless post-mortems, and automating the toil those incidents expose
 - Finding and fixing performance bottlenecks, and designing auto-scaling policies that handle variable inference load without overspending
 - Managing cloud and on-prem infrastructure as code in Terraform and Ansible, and building the CI/CD pipelines that deploy new model versions and service updates

Required Qualifications

- B. S. in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related field, or equivalent practical experience
 - 3+ years in a Site Reliability Engineering, DevOps, or related role supporting a large-scale, customer-facing service in a public cloud environment (AWS, GCP, Azure)
 - Strong programming and scripting skills in Python, Go, or Java
 - Production experience with Docker and Kubernetes
 - Deep understanding of monitoring and observability tooling such as Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, or the ELK Stack
 - Experience with infrastructure as code using Terraform or CloudFormation
 - Experience with CI/CD tooling such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or ArgoCD
 - Strong Linux system administration fundamentals

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience in a hybrid environment spanning cloud and on-premise data center infrastructure
 - Experience supporting ML or AI inferencing services in production
 - Familiarity with GPU-accelerated computing and optimizing workloads for NVIDIA GPUs, for purposes of mapping to RDUs
 - Knowledge of model serving frameworks such as vLLM, SGLang, or Ray
 - Experience managing and tuning databases (SQL or NoSQL) and caching systems such as Redis or Memcached

Base Salary Range: 

Base Pay Range

₹8, 900, 000-₹10, 800, 000 INR

Submission Guidelines

Please note that in order to be considered an applicant for any position at SambaNova Systems, you must submit an application form for each position for which you believe you are qualified. 

EEO Policy

SambaNova Systems is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard basis of age (40 and over), color, disability, gender identity, genetic information, marital status, military or veteran status, national origin/ancestry, race, religion, creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding), sexual orientation, and any other applicable status protected by federal, state, or local laws. 

Benefits Summary For US-Based, Full-Time Employment Positions

SambaNova offers a competitive total rewards package, including the base salary, plus equity and benefits. We cover 95% premium coverage for employee medical insurance, and 77% premium coverage for dependents and offer a Health Savings Account (HSA) with employer contribution. We also offer Dental, Vision, Short/Long term Disability, Basic Life, Voluntary Life, and AD&D insurance plans in addition to Flexible Spending Account (FSA) options like Health Care, Limited Purpose, and Dependent Care. Our library of well-being benefits available to you and your dependents includes a full subscription to Headspace, Gympass+ membership with access to physical gyms, One Medical membership, counseling services with an Employee Assistance Program, and much more.
