 - Cost-Sensitive Engineering: Demonstrate a relentless focus on minimizing cloud operational spend, compute overhead, and execution costs per transaction. Core Skills & Competencies

 - Round 1: Elite Core Engineering & Architecture Deep-Dive
 - Focus: Severe testing of . NET/C# memory allocations, asynchronous programming models, multi-threading, and SQL Server transactional plan internals. 
 - Round 2: The AI-Augmented Hyper-Velocity Coding Challenge
 - Focus: A live, 60-minute, hands-on programming test. Candidates must leverage Generative AI tools (Devin/Cursor paradigms) to modernize a complex legacy code block into fully instrumented, spec-driven code. 
 - Round 3: Scale, Hybrid Infra & Cost-Sensitive Systems Design
 - Focus: Whiteboard scenario cracking. Designing for 5M daily transactions, maintaining sync across On-Prem and AWS DR, and proving compute-cost efficiency. 
 - Round 4: High-Throttle Executive & Cultural Fit
 - Focus: Evaluation of written and verbal communication fluency, mental stamina under high pressure.

Company Description Neologic Automation Systems is a specialized engineering company focused on test automation, validation systems, industrial automation, and advanced manufacturing solutions. The organization helps manufacturers improve product quality, traceability, and production efficiency through customized testing and validation solutions. Its expertise includes automated test equipment, end-of-line testing, PCB functional testing, NI TestStand and LabVIEW development, PLC and HMI integration, vision inspection systems, data acquisition and reporting, and robot-based automation. With extensive experience in automotive, electrical, electronics, and manufacturing industries, Neologic Automation Systems delivers reliable and scalable solutions that ensure product quality and process excellence. The company is committed to validating performance, ensuring quality, and building confidence in every product. 

Role Description This is a full-time, on-site LabVIEW Developer role based in Bengaluru South. The LabVIEW Developer will design, develop, and maintain test and validation applications using LabVIEW and NI TestStand for automated test equipment and industrial automation projects. Responsibilities include gathering requirements from engineering and production teams, implementing data acquisition, control, and reporting modules, and integrating test systems with PLCs, HMIs, vision systems, and robot-based automation where applicable. The role involves debugging and optimizing existing LabVIEW code, ensuring robust performance, traceability, and compliance with industry standards, and preparing technical documentation, test procedures, and user manuals. The LabVIEW Developer will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to support commissioning, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement of test and validation systems at customer sites. 

Qualifications

- Strong proficiency in LabVIEW development, including modular application design and hardware interfacing. 
 - Experience with NI TestStand for test sequence development, automation workflows, and result management. 
 - Knowledge of data acquisition systems, instrumentation, and measurement techniques for automated testing. 
 - Familiarity with PLC and HMI integration, industrial communication protocols, and control system concepts. 
 - Understanding of vision inspection systems, robot-based automation, and Industry 4. 0 connectivity and traceability is an advantage. 
 - Ability to analyze requirements, design test architectures, and validate solutions for automotive, electrical, electronics, or manufacturing applications. 
 - Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and ability to debug complex software and hardware interactions. 
 - Effective written and verbal communication skills and ability to collaborate with multidisciplinary engineering teams on-site. 
 - Bachelor's degree in Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation, Mechatronics, Computer Science, or a related engineering field. 
 - Prior experience in automated test equipment development, end-of-line testing, or PCB functional testing is preferred.

The Revenue Analytics team builds the data platforms, intelligent products, modern application capabilities, and AI-enabled automation that power enterprise decision-making. We combine deep engineering expertise with business context to deliver trusted, scalable systems that support both human and agent-driven workflows. 

Our team partners with business and technology leaders to solve complex challenges through modern data architecture, governed data products, integrated app services, and agentic systems. We emphasize production reliability, measurable business value, and responsible automation-not experimentation without operational accountability. 

Role Description: Hands On Data Lead & Systems Integrator

We are seeking a Lead Member of Technical Staff (LMTS) to serve as a primary technical execution lead across our core data platform and its application integration interfaces. 

This is a hands-on technical leadership role. While operating within the overarching platform architecture established by Principal Engineers, you will own the delivery of high-impact data engineering projects, build resilient pipelines, and ensure data products seamlessly plug into downstream applications, web tools, and agentic workflows. You will bring deep expertise in core data engineering (Python, Snowflake, dbt, SQL) complemented by solid working knowledge of the app development ecosystem (Node. js, APIs, microservices) to bridge data platforms with full-stack systems. You will lead project-level execution, mentor senior engineers, and translate complex requirements into production-ready software. 

Core Responsibilities

- Data Engineering Project Leadership & Execution: Lead the design, execution, and optimization of end-to-end data pipelines for batch and event-driven workloads. Own project-level technical delivery, write high-performance production code, and guide team members to deliver scalable data products on schedule. 
 - Data Platform & Product Design: Define patterns for data ingestion, transformation, orchestration, and storage using Python, SQL, dbt, Snowflake, and Airflow. Establish standards for data contracts, semantic consistency, lineage, and reusable data assets to support both business analytics and AI applications. 
 - App Ecosystem & Integration Layering: Design and maintain lightweight API integration components, Node. js services, and middleware that expose data platform capabilities to full-stack applications, web dashboards, and external enterprise platforms (Salesforce, AWS). 
 - Agentic Architecture & Tool Integration: Implement enterprise-controlled agentic capabilities and AI-enabled workflows. Integrate autonomous agents and Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers into application endpoints and data pipelines, ensuring structured outputs, context retrieval, and clear human-agent handoffs. 
 - Verification & Production Reliability: Establish testing strategies, CI/CD pipelines, performance tuning, and operational observability across both data pipelines and app integration services. Define and enforce SLOs/SLAs for pipeline availability, data freshness, and API endpoint performance. 
 - Cross-Team Leadership & Quality Standards: Conduct code and design reviews. Mentor Senior and Associate Engineers, championing engineering standards for clean code, automated testing, and documentation across both data and application interfaces. 

Technical Profile

- Core Data Engineering Foundations: 
 - Deep expertise in Python and advanced SQL, with a strong background in operating production data platforms. 
 - Extensive experience with data stack technologies: dbt, Apache Airflow, Apache Spark, and Snowflake (including query optimization, performance tuning, cost management, and complex troubleshooting). 
 - Command of distributed systems, dimensional/domain-oriented data modeling, batch/streaming patterns, and Data Mesh / data-as-a-product concepts. 
 - Application Ecosystem & Integration Knowledge: 
 - Practical experience with Node. js and TypeScript / JavaScript for building lightweight backend services, microservices, or integration layers. 
 - Hands-on knowledge of designing and consuming REST APIs, GraphQL, webhooks, and event queues (Kafka, AWS SQS/SNS). 
 - Understanding of web app integration patterns, API gateways, and enterprise authentication protocols (OAuth2, SSO). 
 - AI & Agentic Engineering: 
 - Practical experience building or integrating AI-enabled workflows using frameworks like LangGraph or LangChain. 
 - Working knowledge of Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, structured outputs, context engineering, vector stores, and retrieval mechanisms. 
 - Effective use of AI-native developer tools (e. g. , Cursor, Codex, Claude Code) with rigorous review and testing of generated code. 
 - Cloud & DevOps Infrastructure: 
 - Hands-on experience operating on cloud platforms, preferably AWS. 
 - Familiarity with Docker, container orchestration (Kubernetes/ECS), serverless deployment (Lambda), CI/CD pipelines, and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform). 

Qualifications

- Experience: Typically 10 to 14+ years of hands-on experience in Data Engineering, Software Engineering, or Platform Engineering (or equivalent demonstrated technical depth). 
 - Execution Leadership: Proven track record of leading complex data projects from requirements through architecture, deployment, and ongoing operation. 
 - Hybrid Systems Knowledge: Ability to serve as the bridge between core data platform engineering (Python/SQL/Snowflake) and web application developer teams (Node. js/APIs). 
 - Business & Communication Skills: Ability to translate technical implementation choices into business outcomes, work closely with product managers, and communicate effectively across engineering teams.

About Business

JOB DESCRIPTION

Adani Group: Adani Group is a diversified organisation in India comprising 10 publicly traded companies. It has created a world class logistics and utility infrastructure portfolio that has a pan-India presence. Adani Group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, in the state of Gujarat, India. Over the years, Adani Group has positioned itself to be the market leader in its logistics and energy businesses focusing on large scale infrastructure development in India with O & M practices benchmarked to global standards. With four IG rated businesses, it is the only Infrastructure Investment Grade issuer in India. 

Adani Green Energy Limited (AGEL): AGEL is part of the Adani Group's promise to provide a better, cleaner, and greener future for India. Driven by the Group's philosophy of Growth with Goodness', the Company develops, builds, owns, operates, and maintains utility- scale grid-connected solar, wind farm and energy storage (Hydro PSP and Battery) projects. The electricity generated is supplied to central and state government entities and government- backed corporations. On the back of long-term Power Purchase Agreements (PPAs) with central and state government entities, AGEL has leveraged its capabilities and expanded its presence across 12 Indian states. With the integration of pump storage and battery storage projects with large solar & wind portfolio, AGEL shall be best placed amongst peers to supply round-the-clock green power to India's grid. The Company continuously adopts and deploys the latest technologies in its projects. With the target of 50 GW renewable energy capacity by 2030, AGEL is driving India on its renewable energy journey. 

Job Purpose: Incharge - PSS is responsible for overseeing the operations and management of the pooling substation team, ensuring that all activities align with safety regulations, operational standards, and organizational goals. This role involves developing and implementing effective policies, fostering team collaboration, and optimizing performance to ensure reliable and efficient power distribution and supply within the designated area.

- Lead end-to-end execution of EHV/HV transmission lines (33kV and above) from site mobilization to commissioning.

 - Prepare daily/weekly progress reports, MIS dashboards, and execution updates for management review. 
 - Lead and guide site engineers, supervisors, and contractor teams for effective execution delivery. 

Qualifications

- 12-16 years of experience in transmission line execution projects (renewable/power infrastructure preferred). 
 - Experience in large-scale solar/wind evacuation projects will be preferred. 
 - Strong leadership, stakeholder coordination, and problem-solving skills. 
 - Willingness to be based at Khavda site location with extensive on-ground involvement.

data.title: Senior Principal Verification Engineer
data.description:
Job Description

We are seeking an experienced Senior Principal ASIC/SoC Verification Engineer to join our dynamic and fast‐paced engineering team. In this role, you will be responsible for ensuring the functional correctness, robustness, and overall quality of our cutting‐edge semiconductor and SoC designs. If you thrive in a collaborative environment and enjoy solving complex technical challenges, this opportunity is an excellent fit. 

Responsibilities

RESPONSIBILITIES

- Verification Planning and Execution
 - Develop and execute comprehensive SoC/IP‐level verification plans aligned with design specifications and project goals. 
 - Drive verification closure through functional, code, and assertion coverage, ensuring high‐quality deliverables. 
 - Apply industry‐standard ASIC/SoC verification techniques including test planning, testbench creation, constrained‐random and directed stimulus, assertions, and coverage‐driven verification. 
 - Perform SoC integration verification, validating interactions across subsystems, interfaces, and power/performance domains. 
 - Testbench & Environment Development
 - Architect, develop, and enhance SystemVerilog UVM/OVM‐based testbenches for IP and SoC‐level verification. 
 - Build and integrate reusable Verification IP (VIP) and scalable verification components. 
 - Collaborate with internal teams and third‐party VIP providers to ensure seamless integration and compliance. 
 - Develop checkers, scoreboards, monitors, and coverage models to support robust verification. 
 - Methodology, Flows & Best Practices
 - Demonstrate strong understanding of ASIC/SoC design and verification methodologies, including constraint‐random verification and object‐oriented programming principles. 
 - Contribute to verification methodology improvements, automation, and flow optimization. 
 - Ensure adherence to best practices in UVM architecture, reuse, and maintainability
 - Advanced Verification Skills
 - Perform Gate‐Level Simulation (GLS) including SDF annotation, timing verification, and debug of post‐synthesis/post‐layout issues. 
 - Execute power‐aware verification using UPF/CPF, validating power modes, isolation, retention, and sequencing. 
 - Debug complex SoC‐level issues involving multiple clock domains, resets, and power states. 
 - Apply formal verification techniques where appropriate to complement simulation‐based verification. 
 - Technical Skills
 - Strong proficiency in SystemVerilog (UVM/OVM) and scripting languages such as Python, Perl, Tcl, C/C++, and Verilog PLI. 
 - Familiarity with standard protocols and interfaces (e. g. , I2C, SPI, UART, AXI/AHB/APB). 
 - Experience with simulation, debug, and coverage tools from major EDA vendors (Synopsys, Cadence, Siemens). 
 - Knowledge of CI/regression automation, version control, and workflow tools is a plus
 - Collaboration & Communication
 - Work effectively with design, architecture, DV, validation, and firmware teams to drive verification to completion. 
 - Communicate technical concepts clearly through documentation, reviews, and cross‐functional discussions. 
 - Demonstrate initiative, strong analytical problem‐solving skills, and adaptability in a diverse team environment.

 - Collaborate with globally distributed engineering teams to deliver reliable, well-governed CPQ/CLM solutions in an Agile environment
 - Drive strong engineering practices across code quality, documentation, release management, and platform governance

 - Leverage AI-powered engineering tools (GitHub Copilot, Salesforce Agentforce Vibes, Claude Code, Cursor) to improve productivity, code quality, and documentation - with sound judgment on security, privacy, and responsible AI usage.

 - Provide mentorship and technical guidance to junior engineers and administrators where needed
 - Contribute to a culture of ownership, collaboration, and continuous improvement

Minimum Requirements

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field
 - 9+ years of experience in Salesforce development and enterprise application engineering, with 3+ years specifically in CPQ and/or CLM implementation

Success Measures

- In 3 months, you will: Develop a strong understanding of MongoDB's Salesforce ecosystem, business processes, and current implementations by working closely with senior engineers and stakeholders
 - In 6 months, you will: Successfully deliver one or more critical Salesforce initiatives and establish yourself as a trusted technical contributor within the Sales Apps team
 - In 12 months, you will: Become a go-to engineer for key Salesforce solutions, build strong cross-functional partnerships, and contribute meaningfully to the scalability, quality, and long-term evolution of the CRM platform

MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. As our Certification Manager for fire suppression schemes you will be responsible for the effective management and development of the Certification Schemes for this range of products. You will deliver high-quality "right first time" product evaluation, achieving client satisfaction and achieving company commercial targets. 

The position involves management of client certification projects, reviewing of relevant standards and ensuring changes are transitioned and delivered accordingly. - Technical support of Contract Reviews and ensuring applications are set up correctly
 - Certification applications are processed timely and effectively
 - Technical reports are reviewed timely and effectively
 - Certification recommendations are made when in ownership of the project
 - Fee-earning project utilisation is maximised
 - Delivery of projects to customer expectations and deadlines
 - Provide policy and authoritative input on technical, regulatory and procedural issues

Person Specification

- Previous experience related to the certification or assessment of fire equipment / suppression systems OR
 - Experience gained in Quality Management within a manufacturing environment, specifically within the areas of pressure equipment (e. g. pipes, valves), extinguishants (e. g. chemicals) or fire suppression equipment (e. g. extinguishers, hose reels, sprinkler systems, water mist, fire blankets)

 - Familiarity with reading and understanding Standards
 - Excellent verbal and written communication skills - capable of communicating technical issues to a wide audience including clients with limited technical knowledge
 - General knowledge of business principles and operating practices (commercial awareness

Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY's strategy by ensuring effective support to EY's growth agenda.

Successful candidates advance to a competency-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

data.title: Integration Engineer
data.description:
As an Integration and Automation Engineer in the Technology Architecture team at Basware IT, you'll build and run the integration fabric that connects our enterprise systems - directly impacting how reliably data and processes flow across finance, operations, and customer-facing platforms. You'll design, build, and support integrations on Azure Integration Services, standing up the APIs, event-driven interfaces, and automations other teams depend on, while helping shape this into a dedicated Integration and Automation practice as it grows. You're hands-on by nature: comfortable owning a build end-to-end - writing the code, securing it, load-testing it, and troubleshooting it in production - and picking up new tools fast, including AI-assisted development, without needing everything taught. 

- Integration development - design and build integrations on Azure Integration Services - Logic Apps, Azure Functions, Service Bus, and Event Grid/Event Hubs - that are reliable, maintainable, and reusable. 
 - API management - build and manage APIs end-to-end through Azure API Management, including policies, versioning, throttling, and lifecycle, exposing them securely to internal and external consumers. 
 - Security & authentication - implement OAuth2 / OpenID Connect, JWT validation, and Managed Identities across integrations and APIs, and manage secrets and certificates through Azure Key Vault. 
 - Event-driven & asynchronous processing - design pub/sub and queue-based patterns using Service Bus topics/subscriptions and Event Grid/Event Hubs for decoupled, scalable system-to-system communication. 
 - Data handling & transformation - map and transform data between JSON, XML, and flat-file formats, handle schema evolution, and build validation and quality checks into pipelines rather than bolting them on afterward. 
 - Resilient API & integration design - build in retry policies, circuit breakers, idempotency, dead-letter handling, and graceful degradation so integrations fail safely and recover on their own wherever possible. 
 - Reliability & observability - monitor integrations in production using Azure Monitor, Application Insights, and Log Analytics; troubleshoot failures and drive fixes that improve stability over time. 
 - CI/CD & source control - build and maintain deployment pipelines in Azure DevOps (ARM/Bicep) and work disciplined Git workflows so releases are repeatable and low-risk. 
 - AI-assisted development - use tools like GitHub Copilot and Claude as part of your everyday workflow - for design, coding, testing, and documentation - while owning the quality of everything you ship. 
 - Collaboration - work closely with Enterprise Data, Solution Architecture, and AI Enablement so integrations are built with the wider platform in mind, not in isolation. 

, 

Must-have Skills & Experience

- Hands-on, production-grade experience building integrations on Azure Integration Services - Logic Apps, Azure Functions, Service Bus, and API Management. 
 - Practical experience building and securing APIs end to end, including OAuth2/OpenID Connect, JWT, API keys, and Managed Identities. 
 - Working knowledge of event-driven architecture - Event Grid and/or Event Hubs, pub/sub and queue-based messaging patterns. 
 - Strong grasp of data handling and transformation - JSON, XML, schema mapping, and building validation and error handling into the pipeline itself. 
 - Experience designing resilient, error-resistant APIs and integrations - retry logic, circuit breakers, idempotency, and dead-letter/exception handling - not just the happy path. 
 - Solid programming fundamentals (C#/. NET, Python, or JavaScript) applied to Azure Functions and custom integration logic. 
 - A demonstrated ability to learn new tools quickly, particularly AI-assisted development tools - our toolchain evolves fast, and curiosity matters as much as current skills. Hands-on experience with Claude and/or Azure AI tooling in a real development workflow is a strong plus. 
 - Strong written and spoken English communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across multicultural, globally distributed teams. 
 - Comfort operating independently in a small, growing team, with the flexibility to take on ambiguous problems. 

Nice to have

- Experience with Power Automate. 
 - SQL Server / T-SQL for data debugging, stored procedures, and integration troubleshooting. 
 - Exposure to Azure Data Factory or Databricks for data ingestion pipelines. 
 - Microsoft certification such as AZ-204 (Azure Developer Associate) or equivalent. 
 - Familiarity with Finance Technology and SaaS business
 - Prior experience in an enterprise environment with multiple integrated systems. 

How We Think About AI

We value curiosity and a proactive willingness to explore AI-driven technologies, and we provide room to experiment and learn - AI capability is something we build, not just buy.

data.title: Application Architect-AI Integration
data.description:
Introduction

A career in IBM Consulting is built on long-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide. You'll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you'll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact. At IBM Consulting, curiosity fuels success. You'll be encouraged to challenge the norm, explore new ideas, and create innovative solutions that deliver real results. Our culture of growth and empathy focuses on your long-term career development while valuing your unique skills and experiences. 

Your Role And Responsibilities

As an Application Architect for AI Integration, this role is responsible for designing and governing end-to-end architectures that embed AI capabilities into enterprise applications and workflows. The Application Architect collaborates with stakeholders to translate business objectives into scalable designs, balancing vendor-managed services with custom development, and drives governance for AI integration. 

Your Primary Responsibilities Will Include

- Designing Architectures: defining reference patterns for AI services, models, and orchestration layers to integrate seamlessly with existing systems, APIs, and data platforms. 
 - Collaborating with Stakeholders: translating business objectives into scalable, resilient, and policy-compliant designs, ensuring performance, security, compliance, and cost objectives are met. 
 - Governing AI Integration: driving governance for prompts, guardrails, and lifecycle management, ensuring observability, privacy, and responsible AI principles are embedded from design through operations. 

Preferred Education

Master's Degree

Required Technical And Professional Expertise

- AI Architecture Design: Experience with designing end-to-end architectures that embed AI capabilities into enterprise applications and workflows, ensuring seamless integration with existing systems, APIs, and data platforms. 
 - Technical Governance: Experience with driving governance for prompts, guardrails, and lifecycle management, ensuring observability, privacy, and responsible AI principles are embedded from design through operations. 
 - Reference Pattern Development: Experience with defining reference patterns for AI services, models, and orchestration layers, including Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and hybrid reasoning. 
 - Stakeholder Collaboration: Experience with collaborating with stakeholders to translate business objectives into scalable, resilient, and policy-compliant designs, balancing vendor-managed services with custom development. 
 - AI Service Integration: Experience with integrating AI services, models, and orchestration layers with existing systems, APIs, and data platforms, meeting performance, security, compliance, and cost objectives. 

Preferred Technical And Professional Experience

- Advanced AI Concepts: Experience with emerging AI technologies and trends, such as explainable AI and edge AI, can be beneficial. 
 - Cloud Native Services: Knowledge of cloud-native services and serverless architectures can be advantageous in designing scalable AI integrations. 
 - Data Platform Integration: Familiarity with integrating AI services with various data platforms and APIs can be useful.

data.title: Quant Developer - Low Latency C++
data.description:
About BestEx Research

BestEx Research is a financial technology and research firm specializing in building sophisticated execution algorithms and transaction cost modeling tools servicing multiple asset classes. The firm provides high-performance algorithmic execution services to hedge funds, CTAs, asset managers, and banks through a traditional electronic broker and in a broker-neutral Software as a Service (SaaS) model. 

Its cloud-based platform, Algo Management System (AMS), is the first end-to-end algorithmic trading solution for equities and futures that delivers an entire ecosystem around execution algorithms, including transaction cost analysis (TCA), an algorithm customization tool called Strategy Studio, a trading dashboard, and pre-trade analytics in a single platform. The platform is currently live for U. S. , Europe, and Canadian equities and global futures trading. 

BestEx Research is disrupting a $100 billion industry by challenging the status quo of stale, black-box solutions from banks and offering next-generation execution algorithms that combine performance improvement with transparency and customization. BestEx Research uses leading-edge technology to support its low-latency, highly scalable research and trading systems, with its backend in C++, research libraries in C++/Python and R, and web-based technologies for delivering its front-end platforms. 

BestEx Research's mission is to become the leader in automation and measurement of execution across asset classes globally and significantly reduce transaction costs for our clients. 

Visit for more information about our mission, products, research, and services. 

Why Join Us?

BestEx Research's Bangalore office is not an "offshore center. " It's a core engineering and research hub-working on the exact same problems and projects as our U. S. team. You'll be part of the global brain trust, solving some of the hardest problems in trading, systems, and data science. 

What You'll Love: 

- Zero bureaucracy, zero silos-engineers directly collaborate with traders, researchers, and the CEO
 - Direct ownership and end-to-end visibility on production systems
 - Daily opportunity to learn from pioneers in HFT, low-latency systems, and algo trading
 - A high-trust environment where performance speaks louder than hierarchy
 - Competitive compensation in India, including equity and cash bonuses
 - 5-week structured training program: 

Your Role: Build What Most Engineers Never Get to Touch

- Market microstructure and trading mechanics
 - Algorithmic execution and strategy design
 - Exchange simulators and performance testing
 - Market data systems and real-time analytics
 - Hands-on exercises using production research data
 - Continuous professional development, with refresher courses, advanced sessions, and on-demand training tailored to your growth
 - Global exposure: Opportunities to collaborate with, visit, or relocate to our U. S. , Singapore, or London offices, based on performance and business needs

You'll be part of a lean, focused team building ultra-low-latency trading systems, real-time exchange simulators, execution algorithms, and alpha forecasting models. Our engineers own the stack-from C++ nanosecond-sensitive infrastructure to Python-based research platforms. 

This role is ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of research and engineering-comfortable building systems, testing hypotheses, and working directly with data that moves markets. 

What You'll Work On

- Architect and implement: 
 - Execution algorithms across global markets
 - Exchange simulators and tick-level backtesting frameworks
 - Smart Order Routing systems across lit and dark venues
 - Models for market impact, price prediction, and volume forecasting
 - High-performance trading systems optimized for throughput and latency
 - Core infrastructure to support new asset classes and global markets
 - Collaborate closely with global quants, traders, and senior engineers
 - Analyze system performance across app, OS, and hardware layers

Requirements

You Should Have

- Bachelor's or Master's from a top-tier CS, Math, or Engineering program (IIT/NIT/BITS preferred but not required)
 - 2+ years hands-on C++ experience (C++14/17/20) in performance-sensitive applications
 - Strong fundamentals in data structures, OS, networks, and concurrency
 - Python fluency for data analysis and prototyping (preferred but not required)
 - Experience with large-scale, real-time systems (trading experience is a plus but not mandatory)
 - Passion for learning-markets, systems, and modeling

Bonus Points For

- Deep experience with TCP/IP, multi-threading, and latency optimization
 - Prior work on trading platforms, FIX engines, or exchange protocols
 - SQL optimization and experience with research or market data pipelines
 - Contributions to open-source C++/Python performance tools

Benefits

Why This Role Is Rare

- Exposure to real-time trading systems live in global markets
 - Direct mentorship from senior algorithmic trading and software engineering veterans
 - Blend of research, systems design, and algorithm development
 - Equity and cash compensation
 - Zero red tape, no outsourcing mentality

data.title: Senior DevOps & Platform Engineering Lead
data.description:
An extraordinarily talented group of individuals work together every day to drive TNS' success, from both professional and personal perspectives. Come join the excellence!

Overview

TNS Automation Development is seeking a senior, hands-on engineering leader to own and evolve the platforms, infrastructure, and software delivery capabilities behind our network automation strategy. Our automation ecosystem supports more than 70, 000 network devices. This role combines deep technical ownership with leadership across platform reliability, cloud architecture, DevSecOps, release management, and operational excellence. You will partner with Automation Developers, Network Engineers, Security, Global Systems, cloud teams, and business stakeholders to build a scalable, secure, resilient, and maintainable automation ecosystem. 

Responsibilities

What You Will Own

Platform Engineering & Operations

- Own the architecture, deployment, operation, and lifecycle of network automation applications and supporting services. 
 - Design and operate containerized applications on Kubernetes using Helm, Argo, and Terraform. 
 - Own the Nautobot platform stack, including Python/Django, Celery, uWSGI/NGINX, PostgreSQL, Redis, Kubernetes, AWS, and GitLab CI/CD. 
 - Lead platform upgrades, plugin lifecycle management, performance tuning, capacity planning, resiliency, and observability improvements. 

DevOps & Software Delivery

- Build and manage application images, containers, and deployment workflows. 
 - Own GitLab standards, branching strategy, runners, CI/CD pipelines, release promotion, and software delivery practices. 
 - Establish reliable release processes across development, test, and production environments. 

Cloud, Security & Risk

- Partner with Global Systems and cloud teams to evolve AWS infrastructure, hosting models, scalability, disaster recovery, and operational support. 
 - Own and manage AWS infrastructure supporting network automation platforms, including IAM roles and policies, EKS, EC2, VPC networking, security groups, S3, load balancing, and platform monitoring. 
 - Embed DevSecOps practices, including SAST, dependency scanning, container scanning, and infrastructure security validation. 
 - Ensure platform and deployment practices align with corporate security policies and audit requirements. 

Technical Leadership

- Serve as the senior technical authority for platform engineering and DevOps within the Automation team. 
 - Set engineering standards and guardrails, mentor developers, and influence the future of network automation at TNS. 

Qualifications

Required Experience

- 10+ years of progressive IT engineering experience, including 5+ years of hands-on DevOps or platform engineering. 
 - Proven experience deploying and operating production applications on Kubernetes.

data.title: Medical Coding Audit Manager
data.description:
Manages the day-to-day operations of the Medical Coding Evaluation team supporting Veradigm's enterprise coding capability. The team reviews the outputs of AI agents against clinical documentation to confirm that codes are supported, billable, and accurate, and its judgments establish the clinical ground truth used to measure how our AI agents perform. 

Owns the scoring guide that defines how agent output is judged, incorporating input from the reviewers who apply it. Adjudicates disagreements between reviewers, measures and reports inter-reviewer agreement, and defines the clinical metrics reported to customers, so that accuracy claims made commercially and under federal transparency requirements are defensible. Builds and develops a distributed team of certified coders, plans capacity across specialties, and extends the team's scope across coding, chart preparation, and clinical note quality as the AI roadmap expands. 

Essential Functions / Major Job Responsibilities

- Develops and maintains the scoring guide with clinical experts, updating it as specialties and agent behaviors expand. 
 - Manages daily operations for the review team, including assignments, priorities, capacity, and throughput. 
 - Adjudicates dual-review disputes, documenting rationale and identifying reviewer error versus guide ambiguity. 
 - Tracks inter-reviewer agreement, using low agreement to refine guidance rather than penalize staff. 
 - Runs calibration rounds across reviewers to set throughput benchmarks and validate scaling readiness. 
 - Reports clinical metrics, accuracy, claims inclusion, and risk impact, to leadership, product teams, and clients. 
 - Plans specialty coverage, starting with internal medicine and expanding as scope broadens. 
 - Expands scope into chart prep and note quality, establishing evaluation criteria for subjective tasks. 
 - Validates automated scoring through sampling and reports divergences between automated and expert review. 
 - Coordinates design-partner evaluations to maintain consistent review standards across teams. 
 - Enforces approved data access boundaries, authorized data tiers, and compliant review tools. 

Job Requirements

- Bachelor's Degree in Health Information Management, Healthcare Administration, or equivalent technical or business experience
 - 8+ years relevant work experience; 2-3 years at the Expert level or equivalent experience - Preferred
 - 4 Years ICD-10-CM, CPT, and HCPCS coding across multiple specialties, with strong attention to detail and a high accuracy rate
 - 2 Years coding auditing or coding quality review
 - 2 Years outpatient or ambulatory coding in a multi-specialty or large group practice setting
 - 1 Year developing coding guidelines, audit criteria, or annotation standards that others apply
 - 1 Year reviewing output from automated or computer-assisted coding tools, or other structured annotation work
 - Medicare Risk Adjustment or HCC coding experience - preferred
 - 2-4 years relevant leadership experience, including leading distributed or remote teams - preferred

Certifications

- CPC, CCS, or CCS-P - AAPC or AHIMA coding certification, active -Required
 - CPMA - Certified Professional Medical Auditor - Preferred
 - CRC - Certified Risk Adjustment Coder - Preferred

Knowledge, Skills And Abilities

- Expert-level knowledge of medical coding, including ICD-10-CM, CPT, HCPCS Level II, modifier application, E/M documentation guidelines, and CMS claims processing rules. 
 - Ability to write clear, unambiguous evaluation criteria that multiple reviewers can apply to reach the same conclusion on the same record. 
 - Working understanding of measurement concepts relevant to human review, including inter-rater agreement, sampling, and the difference between reviewer error and ambiguous guidance. 
 - Ability to explain coding reasoning to engineers and product managers who have no coding background, and to translate their technical questions into coding terms. 
 - Sound judgment in cases where documentation is incomplete or coding guidance does not clearly apply, and the discipline to distinguish confident conclusions from uncertain ones. 
 - Proven ability to lead others, including where the next-level leader is not in the same location or time zone. 
 - Ability to work independently with minimal supervision in an environment where standards and processes are still being established. 
 - Working knowledge of HIPAA privacy and security requirements as they apply to handling clinical information and de-identified data. 

Working Arrangements

- Standard work week or as defined by assignment requirements. 
 - Primarily works in a standard office environment or remotely. 
 - Requires periodic overlap with United States time zones to collaborate with Applied Intelligence, product, and engineering teams. 

Travel

- Up to 10% travel may be required. 

Benefits

Veradigm believes in empowering our associates with the tools and flexibility to bring the best version of themselves to work. Through our generous benefits package with an emphasis on work/life balance, we give our employees the opportunity to allow their careers to flourish.

data.title: Data Center Manager, Data Center Operations
data.description:
Description

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we're the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain - and we're looking for talented people who want to help. 

You'll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You'll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you'll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion. 

You will be a proven manager with experience managing teams of high performers. You will have the ability to refine and develop processes to optimize operational excellence in every area of your role. You will be able to drive performance levels to achieve the pace at which we build and operate Data Centers in India for Amazon Data Services India Private Limited ("ADSIPL"). You will have previous experience in Data Centers, either building or managing (or both) along with exposure to developing great relationships with both internal teams and external vendors. 

You will also have a passion for technology along with a desire to be the best at your job every day!

Key job responsibilities

About The Role

As a Data Center Manager in ADSIPL, you will get to manage the world's largest Cloud Computing Infrastructure in India. We encounter interesting, challenging & complex problems every day, being a technical manager in ADSIPL means that you can innovate to solve these issues and help drive Operations Excellence in all areas of your role. 

Your day job at ADSIPL will include (but not limited to): 

- Managing and developing teams of engineers, providing both technical and leadership expertise and ensuring highest levels of performance. 
 - Maintaining existing co-located and in-house Data Centers
 - Helping build and bring online new Data Centers
 - Constantly improving all our processes and procedures. We believe there is nothing we cannot improve
 - Assisting & managing relationships with external vendors & contractors
 - Liaising with internal teams & management groups
 - Ensuring we adhere to and exceed local Health & Safety standards in all our Data Centers
 - Creating and maintaining metrics on all aspects of our Data Centers and utilizing those metrics to drive positive changes
 - Assisting in implementing service methodologies including incident management, problem management, change management, capacity management, etc. 

What are we looking for in a successful AWS Returner Data Centre Manager (DCM) candidate along with the technical knowledge and experience. 

People Management. 

As a successful candidate you will have managed a team of at least 5 individuals, over a period of at least 3 years. You will be able to demonstrate how you have continued to improve performance of an existing team along with displaying skills in creating or growing a team. Experience managing both high & low performing employees will be of advantage along with conflict management. 

Incident Management. 

You will have a lot of experience dealing with high severity situations, show a clear understanding of the wider blast implications of any issue/outage and potential consequences of differing outcome scenarios. You will also have experience in Change Management & Fault Management. 

Vendor Management. 

An Amazon, individual has to deal with vendors, contractors & security companies. You will be able to prove you have experience dealing with external vendors and be able to display incidents of both problem & conflict management when dealing with same. 

Process Improvement. 

You will be able to demonstrate an ability of taking both a good working process & a bad process and improving. You will have experience in processes mapping, implementing remediation steps and how this affected the overall business you were working in. Experience in Kaizen/Lean/Six Sigma is preferable

Health & Safety. 

Health & Safety should be at the forefront of every manager's mind. Managers should be able to positively influence the Safety culture of the Data Center organization. 

About The Team

About AWS

Diverse Experiences

Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn't followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don't let it stop you from applying. 

Why AWS

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world's most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating - that's why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses. 

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there's nothing we can't achieve. 

Inclusive Team Culture

AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do. 

Mentorship and Career Growth

We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional. 

Basic Qualifications

- Experience that includes strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and effective communication abilities
 - 4+ years of data center engineering or operations experience
 - 3+ years of managing technical teams with significant personnel management experience and examples of developing engineers and building successful teams experience

Preferred Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or above in engineering or equivalent STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering and Mathematics) field, or 4+ years of network and operating system support experience

Job Description

About Williams-Sonoma, Inc. 

Founded in 1956 and headquartered in San Francisco, California, Williams-Sonoma, Inc. is a Fortune 500, digital first, multi-channel specialty retailer. Our company vision is to own the home, and the places where our customers work, stay, and play. We bring the latest home furnishing trends to life for customers through the individual lenses of our ten distinct brands, each serving different life stages and rooms of the home and beyond. Our brands include Williams Sonoma, Williams Sonoma Home, Pottery Barn, Pottery Barn Kids, Pottery Barn Teen, West Elm, Rejuvenation, Mark & Graham, GreenRow, and Dormify. We are committed to sustainability, continuously working to protect our planet, while building an open and collaborative culture across our organization. 

With more than 500 retail stores globally and multiple international franchise operations, technology is a core driver of our business strategy. We build and operate in-house platforms powering e-commerce, supply chain, merchandising, analytics, and customer experience ecosystems worldwide. 

The Logistics Technology team at Williams-Sonoma, Inc. builds and supports the platforms that move product across our supply chain - from distribution center operations and warehouse management to transportation and delivery for brands including Williams Sonoma, Pottery Barn, West Elm, and Rejuvenation. We partner closely with Supply Chain, Distribution Center operations, and third-party vendors to deliver scalable microservices that keep fulfillment fast, accurate, and cost-effective. It is a hands-on, high-ownership team where engineers work end to end - designing systems, integrating with WMS and TMS platforms, and applying automation and AI to improve how our distribution network runs every day. 

Role Overview

The Staff Software Engineer will be responsible for leading the design, development, and delivery of enterprise-grade, scalable microservices applications supporting Logistics and Warehouse Management Systems. This role requires strong technical leadership, hands-on development expertise, and close collaboration with cross-functional business and technology teams, including third-party vendors such as Manhattan Associates. 

Impact of the Role

- Provide technical leadership for the Logistics domain - designing, developing, and leading delivery of scalable, enterprise-grade microservices. 
 - Own application health in production - monitoring, alerting, incident triage, and root-cause resolution. 
 - Lead integrations across Warehouse Management, Transportation Management, Slotting, and Labor Management systems and Distribution Center operations. 
 - Identify and deliver AI and automation opportunities that improve Logistics operations, production support, and business-user productivity. 
 - Drive Agile delivery and mentor engineers to raise the bar across the team. 
 - Guide teams, drive execution, and deliver measurable business value. 

Technology Platforms You Will Work On

- Java, JavaEE, Spring Boot, and Spring MVC/WebFlux
 - Microservices and RESTful APIs
 - Kafka, MQ, TCP/IP, and file systems
 - JPA and SLF4J logging
 - DB2, SQL Server, and Oracle
 - Kubernetes and CI/CD pipelines
 - Git and Sonar
 - AppDynamics, Splunk, ELK, and Grafana
 - Manhattan WMOS
 - Transportation Management Systems
 - Manhattan Slotting
 - Labor Management systems
 - Jira
 - AI tools, AI agents, and automation platforms

Key Responsibilities

- Provide technical leadership for the Logistics domain - designing, developing, and leading delivery of scalable, enterprise-grade microservices. 
 - Drive hands-on development of Java and Spring Boot services, RESTful APIs, and event-driven integrations using Kafka. 
 - Define and enforce engineering standards for secure coding, unit testing, Git branching strategy, and code quality. 
 - Lead deployments and CI/CD automation on containerized platforms, including automated testing and release readiness. 
 - Own application health in production - monitoring, alerting, incident triage, and root-cause resolution. 
 - Lead integrations across Warehouse Management, Transportation Management, Slotting, and Labor Management systems and Distribution Center operations. 
 - Partner with business stakeholders and third-party vendors such as Manhattan Associates to translate logistics requirements into scalable technical solutions. 
 - Identify and deliver AI and automation opportunities that improve Logistics operations, production support, and business-user productivity. 
 - Drive Agile delivery - sprint planning, estimation, and delivery tracking - and mentor engineers to raise the bar across the team. 

Qualifications

- 10+ years of software engineering experience, including at least 3 years as a Java Lead. 
 - Proven track record delivering enterprise-scale microservices applications in a retail, supply chain, or logistics environment. 
 - Experience delivering in Agile environments using Jira for sprint planning, estimation, and delivery tracking. 
 - Strong knowledge of logistics, warehouse management, and Distribution Center operations. 
 - Hands-on experience integrating with Manhattan WMOS, Transportation Management Systems, Manhattan Slotting, and Labor Management systems. 
 - Experience leading third-party vendor integrations, integration platforms, and enterprise web services. 
 - Strong business acumen with the ability to align technology solutions to revenue and operational goals. 
 - Extensive hands-on experience with Java, JavaEE, Spring Boot, Spring MVC/WebFlux, Microservices, and Kafka. 
 - Proficiency with RESTful web services, JPA, SLF4J logging, and application configuration management. 
 - Strong relational database skills across DB2, SQL Server, and Oracle. 
 - Experience with containerized platforms such as Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, and automated testing. 
 - Working knowledge of secure coding standards, Git repository and branching strategies, and code quality tools such as Sonar. 
 - Proficiency with monitoring and observability tools such as AppDynamics, Splunk, ELK, and Grafana, including alert and notification setup. 
 - Proficiency with Enterprise Integration Systems architecture using Kafka, MQ, TCP/IP, file systems, etc. 
 - Strong AI-first mindset. 
 - Experience using AI tools, AI agents, and automation platforms to improve operations, production support, data validation, reporting, testing, and documentation. 
 - Ability to design AI-agent-led solutions for use cases such as issue triage, exception monitoring, report generation, knowledge retrieval, regression testing support, and operational analytics. 
 - Understanding of responsible AI practices, including data privacy, security, auditability, compliance, and validation of AI-generated outputs. 
 - Demonstrated situational leadership - guiding teams, driving execution, and delivering measurable business value. 
 - Ability to facilitate productive discussions across diverse stakeholder groups and drive alignment. 
 - Experience mentoring engineers and raising engineering standards across a team. 
 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent work experience. 

Why Join Williams-Sonoma India Technology Center

- Our people first and performance driven culture means that we provide opportunities to grow and build a career and invest in the well-being of our associates, including comprehensive benefits to support you and your family. 
 - Scale and innovation of a Fortune 500 company combined with a high-ownership that empowers engineers to make real impact. 
 - Build and operate large-scale digital commerce platforms serving millions of customers worldwide, working on systems that run at global scale. 
 - Continuous learning environment with opportunities to work on cutting-edge technologies, AI-driven solutions, and large-scale engineering challenges. 
 - Hybrid work model designed for flexibility and collaboration, with two in-office days for team engagement.

data.title: Senior Configuration and Delivery Manager
data.description:
Job Description

Configuration and Delivery Manager would be responsible for configuration control, release coordination, deployment governance, and delivery readiness across current and upcoming WSP Digital Products. The role would ensure that product configuration, environment readiness, version control, release packages, deployment approvals, and production releases are managed through controlled, traceable, auditable, and repeatable processes across development, test, staging, and production environments. 

Responsibilities

Configuration Management

Define and maintain configuration management standards across applications, environments, release packages, and deployment artefacts. 

Maintain traceability for product versions, configuration items, environment variables, dependencies, release baselines, and deployment records. 

Coordinate configuration changes across application, integration, data, infrastructure, and environment layers. 

Ensure configuration decisions are documented, controlled, and auditable. 

Release & Deployment Management

Plan, coordinate, schedule, and govern product releases across current and upcoming digital products. 

Maintain release calendars, deployment schedules, release notes, release scope, deployment checklist, and rollback plans. 

Coordinate release readiness reviews, QA sign-offs, DevOps readiness, CAB inputs, and production deployment approvals. 

Track release risks, deployment issues, defects, rollback outcomes, and post-release validation status. 

Environment & Delivery Readiness

Coordinate environment readiness across Dev, QA, UAT, staging, production, and support environments. 

Ensure environment consistency, access readiness, dependency readiness, and deployment sequencing before release execution. 

Support environment refresh, configuration updates, smoke-test coordination, and deployment troubleshooting. 

Work with DevOps and engineering teams to improve repeatability and reliability of deployment practices. 

Compliance, Metrics & Continuous Improvement

Maintain release evidence, approval records, deployment logs, release decisions, and audit-ready documentation. 

Track release metrics including deployment frequency, failed deployments, rollback frequency, defect leakage, and release predictability. 

Identify recurring release and configuration issues and drive preventive improvements with engineering, QA, DevOps, and support teams. 

Contribute to release SOPs, configuration playbooks, governance checklists, and operational documentation. 

Required Technical Skills

Configuration Management | Advanced - software baselines, version control, configuration item traceability, environment configuration, and audit records

Release Management | Advanced - release planning, deployment coordination, CAB inputs, release readiness, rollback planning, and sign-offs

DevOps / CI-CD Awareness | Proficient - Azure DevOps, GitHub, branching, tagging, pipelines, deployment controls, and release artefacts

Environment Governance | Proficient - Dev, QA, UAT, staging, production readiness, environment refresh, and deployment sequencing

ITIL / Change Governance | Proficient - change, release, configuration, risk-based approvals, governance documentation, and auditability

Stakeholder Coordination | Advanced - coordination across engineering, QA, DevOps, business, support, and leadership teams

Required Experience

Minimum 8 years of professional experience in configuration management, release management, DevOps coordination, IT operations, or software delivery governance. 

Experience managing enterprise release cycles across multiple environments and product teams. 

Experience with configuration baselines, release packages, deployment records, change controls, and audit-ready documentation. 

Working knowledge of Azure DevOps, Git, branching strategies, build/release pipelines, and deployment governance.

data.title: Senior DevOps & Platform Engineering Lead
data.description:
An extraordinarily talented group of individuals work together every day to drive TNS' success, from both professional and personal perspectives. Come join the excellence!

Overview

TNS Automation Development is seeking a senior, hands-on engineering leader to own and evolve the platforms, infrastructure, and software delivery capabilities behind our network automation strategy. Our automation ecosystem supports more than 70, 000 network devices. This role combines deep technical ownership with leadership across platform reliability, cloud architecture, DevSecOps, release management, and operational excellence. You will partner with Automation Developers, Network Engineers, Security, Global Systems, cloud teams, and business stakeholders to build a scalable, secure, resilient, and maintainable automation ecosystem. 

Responsibilities

What You Will Own

Platform Engineering & Operations

- Own the architecture, deployment, operation, and lifecycle of network automation applications and supporting services. 
 - Design and operate containerized applications on Kubernetes using Helm, Argo, and Terraform. 
 - Own the Nautobot platform stack, including Python/Django, Celery, uWSGI/NGINX, PostgreSQL, Redis, Kubernetes, AWS, and GitLab CI/CD. 
 - Lead platform upgrades, plugin lifecycle management, performance tuning, capacity planning, resiliency, and observability improvements. 

DevOps & Software Delivery

- Build and manage application images, containers, and deployment workflows. 
 - Own GitLab standards, branching strategy, runners, CI/CD pipelines, release promotion, and software delivery practices. 
 - Establish reliable release processes across development, test, and production environments. 

Cloud, Security & Risk

- Partner with Global Systems and cloud teams to evolve AWS infrastructure, hosting models, scalability, disaster recovery, and operational support. 
 - Own and manage AWS infrastructure supporting network automation platforms, including IAM roles and policies, EKS, EC2, VPC networking, security groups, S3, load balancing, and platform monitoring. 
 - Embed DevSecOps practices, including SAST, dependency scanning, container scanning, and infrastructure security validation. 
 - Ensure platform and deployment practices align with corporate security policies and audit requirements. 

Technical Leadership

- Serve as the senior technical authority for platform engineering and DevOps within the Automation team. 
 - Set engineering standards and guardrails, mentor developers, and influence the future of network automation at TNS. 

Qualifications

Required Experience

- 10+ years of progressive IT engineering experience, including 5+ years of hands-on DevOps or platform engineering. 
 - Proven experience deploying and operating production applications on Kubernetes. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with AWS, Terraform, Helm, Docker, Git, GitLab administration, runners, and CI/CD pipeline design. 
 - Strong hands-on AWS experience including IAM, EKS, EC2, VPCs, S3, security controls, monitoring, and cloud networking. 
 - Hands-on Experience operating distributed application platforms using Kubernetes, Celery, Redis, and containers. 
 - Experience implementing DevSecOps practices and security scanning across the software lifecycle. 
 - Experience supporting highly available production applications with demanding operational requirements. 
 - Ability to lead architecture decisions, solve complex platform problems, and guide engineers through implementation. 

Preferred Experience

- Nautobot, NetBox, or comparable network source-of-truth platforms.

 - GitLab Runner architecture and management; Argo-based deployment workflows. 
 - Enterprise platforms operating in regulated environments. 

What Success Looks Like

- Within the first 12 months, you will: 
 - Lead the transition of the Nautobot AWS/Kubernetes platform from vendor-managed operations to a TNS-owned and operated service, including architecture, deployment, upgrades, security, monitoring, and lifecycle management. 
 - Standardize GitLab workflows, CI/CD pipelines, and release management. 
 - Provide clear technical leadership for platform engineering and automation infrastructure.

For this role in the United States, we anticipate paying $125, 000k - $155, 000K. The actual amount may be higher or lower than the range provided considering each candidate's knowledge, skills, abilities, and geographic location. TNS offers a competitive benefit package. 

If you are passionate about technology, love personal growth and opportunity, come see what TNS is all about!

TNS is an equal opportunity employer. TNS evaluates qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, protected veteran status, disability/handicap status or any other legally protected characteristic.

data.title: Head of Enterprise Technology
data.description:
Location: Indore or Hyderabad, India

Reports to: Office of the CEO

About YASH Technologies

YASH Technologies is a customer-centric, transformational global IT solutions and services partner with a proven track record delivering exceptional outcomes for Fortune 1000 enterprises across multiple industries. For nearly 30 years, YASH has grown through strong client relationships, deep technical capability, and a values-driven culture shaped by founder leadership. As we enter our next phase of growth, we are focused on building the technology and infrastructure needed to scale with more clarity and discipline. 

About the Role

YASH is looking for a Head of Enterprise Technology to join the Office of the CEO and help reimagine how we transform technology to enable our business. This role has multiple mandates: (1) Understand the core YASH business and build trust with global leadership, (2) Work in a phased approach to build and transform the enterprise technology function, and (3) Re-imagine enterprise technology for the world of AI. We are looking for someone who can work collaboratively in a matrixed organization and lead through empathy and influence. This is a hybrid role with an expectation of three days per week onsite and travel as needed (~10%). 

What You'll Do

Partner with the Business

- Understand the core business, provide solutions that transform business processes, and showcase internal solutions to YASH customers. 
 - Deliver the Enterprise Technology vision and operating model, anchored to YASH's business strategy while serving as a technology thought leader to the CEO. 
 - Turn unclear problems into clear processes, owners, and measures, and keep those processes light enough to be used. 
 - Keep core systems reliable while moving the function forward in practical, incremental steps that the business can absorb. 

Establish and Collaborate On Enterprise Technology

- Set and establish baseline and innovative standards for architecture, security, data, integration, and service management. 
 - Establish and run a product led operating model using innovative and agentic ways of working. 
 - Govern and manage the global application portfolio. 
 - Manage Enterprise Technology spend and make build vs. buy decisions. 
 - Lead a core team in a matrix model, manage vendors and sourcing, and attract people who want to be business enablers, not order takers, and work in a "fail fast and learn" model. 

Establish and Manage Security, Data, Infrastructure, and Service Management

- Work collaboratively to transform, manage, and govern enterprise data to drive real time business decisions. 
 - Establish and manage enterprise wide role-based access, security, and manage regulatory compliance. 
 - Establish global service management, service levels, and operations so application support and management is predictable, measured, and trusted, without adding unnecessary bureaucracy. 
 - Be accountable for keeping YASH infrastructure reliable, secure, cost effective, and incrementally improving. 

Lead with Empathy and Roll Up Your Sleeves

- Be ok not directly owning all functions on day 1, building credibility and trust, and working collaboratively to create positive outcomes. 
 - Read people well, build real relationships, and understand what each leader and team needs before proposing a solution. 
 - Bring ideas and outside perspective, question "how we have always done it, " and make the case with evidence and empathy. 
 - Be comfortable building a prototype, configuring a workflow, analyzing a cost model, or writing the standard yourself. Use delegation to multiply your impact, not to avoid the work. 

What You'll Need (Required)

- 12+ years of experience in global enterprise technology, product management, and IT service management. 
 - History of standing up or materially rebuilding an enterprise technology function, ideally in a founder-led, PE-backed, or rapidly scaling organization. 
 - Experience delivering through partners, outsourced providers, or internal service organizations, with clear service levels and accountability. 
 - Technical credibility from architecture, design, hands on delivery, to product management. 
 - Strong business judgment and high EQ with the ability to advise, constructively challenge, and influence senior leaders. 
 - Practical experience applying AI in an enterprise from business processes to engineering, development, and support. 
 - Comfort operating in an entrepreneurial, fast paced environment with exposure to senior leadership. 
 - Experience owning and shaping a technology budget and P&L. 
 - Working knowledge of security, access control, data privacy, and a record of working to make them real in enterprises. 
 - Track record of working across multiple geographies and experience in professional services. 

Compensation & Benefits

YASH Technologies offers a competitive and comprehensive Cost to Company (CTC) package, commensurate with the candidate's experience, expertise, and the strategic importance of the role. 

The compensation structure includes fixed pay and a performance-linked variable incentive, with the opportunity to earn up to 120% of the eligible incentive amount, subject to individual and organisational performance. 

In addition, YASH offers a comprehensive benefits programme, including medical insurance for employees and their families, parental medical insurance, group personal accident coverage, performance-based rewards and recognition, and other employee benefits as per company policy. 

For the right candidate, compensation will not be a constraint. The final package will be determined based on the candidate's experience, capabilities, and overall fit for the role. 

Equal Opportunity Employer

YASH Technologies provides equal employment opportunities to applicants and employees without regard to race, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, religious practices and observances, national origin, pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions, status as a protected veteran or spouse/family member of a protected veteran, or disability.

data.title: Staff Engineer - Backend
data.description:
ABOUT QUINCE

Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world's finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast. 

What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come - and return - to Quince because they trust us to deliver. 

OUR CULTURE

Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren't interested in replicating how others do retail. We're building a better way - at a speed and scale unlike anything that's been done before. 

- We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA. Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose - soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price - we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place. 
 - Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths. 
 - Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory. 

If you're someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you. 

THE ROLE

Staff Engineer (Backend)

We're looking for a Staff Engineer (Backend) to join our engineering organization. In this role, you will drive the architecture, scalability, and reliability of critical backend systems across multiple teams. You will operate at a strategic level, influencing technical direction, solving highly complex problems, and enabling teams to build robust, high-performing systems. 

Success in this role means defining long-term technical vision, improving engineering excellence across the organization, and mentoring senior engineers while driving large-scale impact. This position is critical to scaling our platform and supporting Quince's mission of delivering exceptional quality at incredible value. 

Responsibilities: 

- Own and evolve multiple critical applications/services, ensuring long-term scalability, reliability, and maintainability
 - Lead the design and architecture of complex, large-scale distributed systems, frameworks, and platforms across teams
 - Define and drive the roadmap for engineering and operational excellence at an organizational level
 - Conduct deep performance analysis and lead system-wide optimizations to ensure high scalability and efficiency
 - Drive technical planning, system design reviews, and estimation for large, cross-team initiatives
 - Collaborate with product, data, and infrastructure stakeholders to define ambiguous requirements and translate them into scalable system designs
 - Provide technical leadership and mentorship to senior and mid-level engineers across teams
 - Establish and enforce best practices for coding standards, system design, observability, and reliability
 - Review and guide critical architectural and code decisions across multiple teams
 - Stay ahead of emerging technologies and introduce new architectural patterns to improve system capabilities
 - Raise the engineering bar by actively contributing to hiring, team building, and technical culture

Qualifications: 

- Strong computer science fundamentals including data structures, algorithms, and advanced system design
 - 8+ years of experience working on backend and distributed systems
 - Deep expertise in Java, Spring/Spring Boot, and SQL/NoSQL databases
 - Proven experience designing and scaling highly reliable, large-scale distributed systems across multiple services/teams
 - Strong understanding of concurrency, multithreading, and high-performance system design
 - Deep knowledge of system architecture, design principles, and trade-off analysis at scale
 - Experience driving organization-wide technical initiatives and architectural decisions
 - Strong focus on code quality, latency optimization, observability, and system reliability
 - Ability to operate effectively in highly ambiguous, fast-paced environments with significant ownership
 - Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills across technical and business teams
 - Proven track record of mentoring senior engineers and influencing engineering culture

Preferred: 

- Experience with cloud-native architectures (AWS preferred)
 - Strong understanding of microservices, event-driven systems, and distributed system patterns
 - Experience leading large-scale system migrations or platform transformations
 - Familiarity with observability tools, monitoring systems, and SRE practices
 - Experience in high-growth startups or scaling consumer internet platforms
 - Passion for building platforms that enable teams to move faster with high reliability

WHY QUINCE?

Joining Quince means being part of a mission-driven team reshaping retail. You will work alongside talented colleagues, tackle meaningful challenges, and contribute to building a more sustainable, accessible future for customers and partners alike. 

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & HIRING INTEGRITY

Quince provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applications for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran or military status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. 

Quince is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation to complete your application or to perform the essential functions of a role at Quince, please let us know by completing this accommodation form. We review all requests individually and will work with you to determine appropriate accommodations on a case-by-case basis. 

Employment is contingent upon successful completion of a background check. Quince will conduct background checks in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws. 

Security Advisory: Beware of Frauds

At Quince, we're dedicated to recruiting top talent who share our drive for innovation. To safeguard candidates, Quince emphasizes legitimate recruitment practices. Interviews are conducted via phone, in person, or through the approved platforms Google Meets or Zoom-never via messaging apps or other calling services.
