data.description:
Powering the world's payments ecosystem
ACI powers the payments ecosystem - globally, and you power ACI. You'll innovate, collaborate, and grow in an energetic technology culture with decades of proven success. ACIers - in all roles and levels - are truly your colleagues and many are your friends. Our size and reach allow you to see the global impact of your work. You are visible, your talents are valued, and you are empowered to shape the future of payments. 
As a Principal Cloud Engineer in Pune, you will join a diverse, passionate team dedicated to powering the world's payments ecosystem. This role is focused on designing, automating, and evolving cloud platform capabilities that support ACI's enterprise infrastructure strategy and next-generation payment solutions. AWS, Kubernetes, Infrastructure as Code, automation, and continuous compliance are key focus areas for this role. 
Job Summary
ACI Worldwide is seeking a highly experienced Principal Cloud Engineer to provide technical leadership for enterprise cloud infrastructure, platform engineering, automation, and cloud governance initiatives. This role is ideal for a hands-on technical leader with AWS, Kubernetes, EKS, Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD, Platform Engineering, Cloud Security, and Automation expertise who can drive technical strategy, influence engineering direction, and mentor engineering teams across the organization. The ideal candidate will bring a software-defined mindset and the ability to architect, automate, and orchestrate cloud solutions at scale. 
Key Responsibilities
- Define and drive cloud architecture, technical strategy, and engineering standards across enterprise platforms. 
- Lead the design and implementation of scalable, secure, highly available cloud infrastructure solutions. 
- Drive adoption of Infrastructure as Code (IaC), automation, and platform engineering best practices. 
- Architect and implement AWS and Kubernetes-based solutions, including Amazon EKS environments. 
- Build and optimize CI/CD pipelines, automated deployment workflows, and cloud operational frameworks. 
- Lead cloud governance, security, compliance automation, and operational excellence initiatives. 
- Provide technical leadership across engineering teams and serve as the escalation point for complex cloud infrastructure challenges. 
- Partner with Product, Engineering, Infrastructure, and Security teams to align technology investments with business objectives. 
- Mentor engineers and promote engineering excellence, innovation, automation, and cloud-first strategies. 
- Drive enterprise cloud modernization and continuous compliance initiatives through automated controls and evidence generation. 

Required Qualifications
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or related field. 
- 12+ years of experience in Cloud Engineering, Platform Engineering, DevOps, or Infrastructure Engineering. 
- Proven experience designing and delivering large-scale cloud infrastructure solutions. 
- Strong experience leading architecture, automation, and cloud transformation initiatives. 
- Experience influencing technical direction and mentoring engineering teams. 
- Experience in Payments, Financial Services, FinTech, or other regulated industries preferred. 

Technical Expertise
- Expert-level experience with AWS Cloud Services, Kubernetes, Amazon EKS, and Cloud-Native Infrastructure. 
- Deep expertise in Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation, Bicep, or equivalent technologies). 
- Strong knowledge of CI/CD pipelines, Git-based workflows, platform automation, and DevOps practices. 
- Experience with Containerization Technologies, Kubernetes Orchestration, and Cloud Platform Operations. 
- Strong understanding of Cloud Networking, Security, Compliance, Reliability Engineering, and Governance. 
- Experience implementing automated configuration management and secure cloud deployment frameworks. 
- Experience developing pipeline-driven infrastructure delivery and enterprise cloud automation solutions. 
- Strong understanding of scalability, performance optimization, operational resilience, and security best practices. 
- Experience evaluating and adopting emerging technologies, including AI-powered engineering tools. 

AI & Emerging Technologies
- Proven experience evaluating and integrating AI/ML capabilities into cloud platforms and engineering operations. 
- Strong understanding of Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), AI Agents, and AI-driven automation concepts. 
- Experience leveraging AI-powered cloud services from AWS, Azure, OpenAI, or equivalent providers. 
- Ability to identify opportunities where AI can improve cloud operations, infrastructure management, compliance automation, and engineering productivity. 
- Experience establishing governance, security, privacy, and responsible AI practices within enterprise environments. 
- Demonstrated use of AI-assisted engineering tools to accelerate delivery, automation, and platform reliability. 
- Ability to drive technical strategy and architectural decisions related to AI adoption within cloud engineering organizations. 

Professional Skills
- Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills. 
- Strong strategic and architectural thinking with a business-outcome mindset. 
- Ability to influence technical direction without direct authority. 
- Passion for mentoring and developing engineering talent. 
- Strong problem-solving and decision-making capabilities. 
- Ability to balance technical depth with enterprise-wide impact. 

Preferred Qualifications
- Advanced AWS, Kubernetes, or Cloud Platform Certifications. 
- Experience leading enterprise cloud transformation initiatives. 
- Experience with FinOps, cloud cost optimization, and cloud governance frameworks. 
- Knowledge of continuous compliance and automated audit evidence generation. 
- Windows administration experience is considered a plus. 
- Industry thought leadership, conference speaking, publications, or technical community contributions. 

Ideal Candidate
The ideal candidate combines deep expertise in AWS, Kubernetes, Amazon EKS, Infrastructure as Code, Cloud Automation, Platform Engineering, and Cloud Security with the ability to architect and scale AI-enabled cloud platforms, driving innovation while ensuring security, compliance, reliability, and business value. The successful candidate will possess a software-defined mindset and demonstrate the ability to build, automate, and orchestrate cloud solutions at enterprise scale. 
Core Capabilities
We seek colleagues who embody our core capabilities - these shape our culture and enable us to make a meaningful impact together: 
- Ensure Accountability: holding self and others accountable to meet commitments. 
- Drives Results: consistently achieving results, even under tough circumstances. 
- Customer Focus: building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions. 
- Cultivate Innovation: creating new and better ways for the organization to be successful. 
- Collaborates: building partnerships and working collaboratively with others. 
- Courage: stepping up to address difficult issues, saying what needs to be said. 

In return for your expertise, we offer opportunities for growth, career development, and a competitive compensation and benefits package-all within an innovative and collaborative work environment. 
Are you ready to help us transform the payments ecosystem? To learn more about ACI Worldwide, visit our web site at www. aciworldwide. com

data.description:
Job Description Summary

L'ingénierie des systèmes est une discipline d'ingénierie interfonctionnelle axée sur une approche, un état d'esprit et un processus. Toutes les activités qui tiennent compte des besoins à la fois commerciaux et techniques des clients dans le but de fournir un produit de qualité qui réponde aux besoins des utilisateurs. Discipline qui exécute un processus robuste de conception, de création et d'optimisation de systèmes, comprenant l'identification et la quantification des exigences système, la création de concepts de conception de système alternatifs, la réalisation d'études commerciales de conception, la sélection et la mise en œuvre des meilleures conceptions et la vérification que la conception est correctement intégrée et exécutée. Processus allant du concept à l'exploitation en passant par la production. 

Influence la qualité de son propre travail et du travail des collègues de son équipe. Exécute les tâches opérationnelles/techniques standard généralement soumises à des instructions et à des routines professionnelles. Une certaine latitude est accordée pour réorganiser l'ordre des tâches en fonction de l'évolution des situations professionnelles. 

Job Description

Rôles et responsabilités

- Identifie, développe, évalue, introduit et gère des solutions d'ingénierie répondant aux besoins technologiques en matière de contrôle de produits et de systèmes de contrôle. Applique la théorie du contrôle et la modélisation mathématique à la conception et au contrôle de systèmes avec les comportements souhaités. Comprend l'opérabilité, la définition des limites, l'optimisation du cycle, la logique de contrôle, les logiciels liés au contrôle, les capteurs, les algorithmes matériels et logiciels, ainsi que les informations en retour permettant de contrôler les performances des dispositifs, sous-systèmes et systèmes. 
 - Élargir la connaissance de sa propre discipline technique pour exécuter la politique/stratégie. Peut inclure des rôles de soutien dans des domaines de connaissances techniques spécialisés. Poursuivre son acquisition de connaissances et de compétences de haut niveau. 
 - Compréhension de base des principaux facteurs opérationnels ; utilise cette compréhension pour accomplir son propre travail. Bonne compréhension de la manière dont le travail de sa propre équipe s'intègre aux autres équipes et contribue à son domaine. 
 - Peut disposer d'une certaine autonomie pour prendre des décisions dans un cadre défini. Résout des problèmes dans des situations qui exigent une bonne connaissance technique et un bon discernement et ce, selon les procédures établies. Consulte les membres les plus expérimentés de l'équipe pour les problèmes extérieurs aux instructions et/ou aux paramètres définis. 
 - Un poste de ce niveau nécessite de bonnes relations interpersonnelles et peut être nécessaire pour diriger une équipe junior. Pour les rôles en relation avec le client, développe des relations solides avec le client et sert d'interface entre le client et GE Vernova. Explique les informations techniques à ses collègues. 

Qualifications De Base

- 
 - Pour les rôles en dehors des États-Unis - Ce rôle nécessite une expérience de base de la fonction et de la station de travail audio numérique. Connaissances de niveau équivalent à une licence dans une université accréditée (ou un baccalauréat avec une expérience dans un domaine pertinent). 
 - Pour les rôles aux États-Unis - Licence d'une université accrédité (ou diplôme d'études secondaires et/ou diplôme d'étude général avec au moins 2 ans d'expérience dans la fonction). 

Caractéristiques souhaitées

- Solides compétences en communication orale et écrite. Solides compétences relationnelles et de leadership. Capacité à travailler de manière autonome. Solides compétences en résolution de problèmes. Remarque : Pour se conformer aux exigences légales américaines en matière d'immigration et autres, il est nécessaire de préciser le nombre minimum d'années d'expérience requis pour tout poste basé aux États-Unis. Pour les rôles en dehors des États-Unis, pour assurer la conformité avec la législation applicable, les juristes doivent mentionner le niveau d'expérience requis et non PAS un nombre minimum d'années. Cette description de poste a pour but de fournir un guide détaillé du rôle. Toutefois, il n'est pas prévu de modifier ou de restreindre et/ou d'élargir de quelque manière que ce soit les tâches requises de chaque employé, telles qu'elles sont définies dans leur contrat de travail respectif et/ou convenues d'un commun accord entre un employé et son responsable. 

Additional Information

Relocation Assistance Provided: Yes

Sr. Software Engineer - Power Automate (Desktop & cloud) Job

Date: Oct 24, 2026

Job Requisition Id: 66872

Location: 

Bangalore, KA, IN Hyderabad, TG, IN Indore, MP, IN Pune, MH, IN

Requirement: Exp: 3-5 Yrs

Existing Automation : 

The current invoice processing solution is automated using Power Automate Desktop, Power Automate Cloud Flows, and an AI Document Processing Model. 

Existing Process Flow

- Vendors send invoices through email. 
 - The bot monitors the mailbox and downloads invoice attachments. 
 - Invoices are received from 11 different vendors, each having different invoice formats/templates. 
 - An AI model extracts key invoice details such as: Vendor details, Invoice Number, Invoice Date, Purchase Order (PO) Number, Invoice Amount, Line Item Information
 - Extracted data is stored in a SharePoint List for tracking. 
 - The bot reads the extracted data from SharePoint. 
 - Using UI automation, the bot logs into the AX Windows application. 
 - Invoice details are entered into AX and the invoice creation/posting process is completed. 
 - Processing status is updated for monitoring and reporting. 

Business Requirement for D365

The Business Wants To Eliminate The Dependency On: 

- AX Windows application
 - Power Automate Desktop UI automation
 - SharePoint-based intermediate processing and move to a D365 Invoice Capture based solution. 

D365 Task : 

- Vendor invoices are received through configured intake channels such as Email. 
 - D365 Invoice Capture automatically imports and processes incoming invoices. 
 - AI-powered extraction captures invoice header and line-item details. 
 - Extracted data is validated within D365 Invoice Capture. 
 - Purchase Order matching and business rule validations are performed directly in D365. 
 - Validated invoices are automatically created as Vendor Invoices in D365 Finance. 
 - Invoice approval, processing, and posting are managed within D365 without any UI automation. 
 - Users can track and monitor invoice status directly from D365 Finance. 

D365 Skills Required : 

Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance

D365 Invoice Capture Setup & Configuration

D365 Finance Integration

The role involves direct interaction with customers, providing tier-1 service, support, and expertise in project management and business development. 

What would a typical day be like?

Job Description Summary

L'ingénierie des systèmes est une discipline d'ingénierie interfonctionnelle axée sur une approche, un état d'esprit et un processus. Toutes les activités qui tiennent compte des besoins à la fois commerciaux et techniques des clients dans le but de fournir un produit de qualité qui réponde aux besoins des utilisateurs. Exerce un impact sur les approches, projets et programmes du domaine fonctionnel ou de l'organisation et des méthodes de travail affectées.  - Control and protection system modelling (MATLAB/Simulink)

 - Recruit, develop, and mentor engineering talent to build a high-performing, resilient organisation.

 - Manage engineering resources, workloads, schedules, and project milestones. 
 - Define project work breakdown structures (WBS), required resources, and skill sets to ensure timely delivery. 
 - Uphold and promote Safety, Quality, Delivery, and Cost (SQDC) principles across teams. 

Required Qualifications

- Engineering degree or equivalent including power systems and power electronics subjects or proven equivalent knowledge and experience in HVDC Control &Protection System Engineering.

Job Title : : Automation Engineer - Salesforce CRM

Role Summary

We are looking for a Salesforce CRM Automation Engineer with 4-6 years of experience to design, develop, enhance, and maintain scalable test automation solutions for Salesforce CRM applications. The role will focus on increasing regression coverage, reducing manual testing effort, improving automation reliability, and enabling continuous testing within Client's Agile/DevOps delivery pipelines. 

Key Responsibilities

- Design, develop, and maintain robust automation for Salesforce CRM. 
 - Automate critical CRM business scenarios including account and contact management, customer/broker interactions, lead/opportunity workflows, activities, and other applicable CRM processes. 
 - Develop automation coverage for Salesforce Lightning UI, business workflows, validations, role-based scenarios, integrations, and APIs. 
 - Analyze existing manual regression suites and identify high-value automation candidates based on business criticality, risk, repeatability, and regression frequency. 
 - Build reusable, scalable, and maintainable Salesforce automation components, libraries, utilities, and test suites. 
 - Enhance existing automation frameworks to improve stability, maintainability, reusability, and execution efficiency. 
 - Implement and maintain Selenium-based Salesforce UI automation or other approved automation technology used by the program. 
 - Automate UI, functional, regression, integration, and API/service-level testing across Salesforce CRM workflows. 
 - Validate integrations between Salesforce CRM and upstream/downstream applications through appropriate API, service, database, and end-to-end automation. 
 - Develop reliable automation for dynamic Salesforce UI components, reusable workflows, data-driven scenarios, and role/profile-based functionality. 
 - Integrate automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines to support continuous testing and faster feedback. 
 - Analyze automation failures and differentiate between application defects, automation-script issues, environment problems, integration failures, and test-data issues. 
 - Manage automation test data and dependencies while adhering to applicable masked/synthetic-data requirements. 
 - Maintain automation coding standards, reusable libraries, documentation, execution evidence, and reporting. 
 - Collaborate closely with Salesforce functional SMEs, developers, business analysts, functional testers, and Test Leads to ensure automation covers business-critical CRM regression scenarios. 
 - Participate in automation code reviews and continuously improve test coverage, execution speed, framework stability, and maintainability. 
 - Evaluate approved AI/GenAI-assisted testing accelerators through controlled PoCs where applicable. 
 - Ensure AI-generated tests, automation code, and artifacts receive appropriate human review and validation before adoption. 

Must-Have Skills

- Strong hands-on experience in Salesforce CRM testing and test automation. 
 - Strong understanding of Salesforce CRM business processes and workflows. 
 - Hands-on experience automating Salesforce Lightning UI applications. 
 - Strong experience with Selenium-based UI automation. 
 - Experience handling dynamic Salesforce UI elements, synchronization, reusable components, and complex business workflows. 
 - Strong experience in API/service test automation and integration validation. 
 - Experience designing, developing, and maintaining enterprise automation frameworks. 
 - Strong programming/scripting skills appropriate to the automation framework, such as Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, or equivalent, depending on the program technology stack. 
 - Experience developing reusable automation components, utilities, and data-driven tests. 
 - Experience integrating automated test suites with CI/CD and continuous-testing pipelines. 
 - Good understanding of Git/source control, branching, pull requests, and code-review practices. 
 - Experience with test-data management and reusable test component design. 
 - Strong debugging, root-cause analysis, and automation failure-triage skills. 
 - Experience working within Agile/DevOps delivery models. 

Good-to-Have

- AI/GenAI-assisted test generation and maintenance
 - SQL/database validation
 - Experience optimizing large enterprise regression suites

data.title: Senior Engineer - USA Structures
data.description:
Arcadis is the world's leading company delivering sustainable design, engineering, and consultancy solutions for natural and built assets. 

We are more than 34, 000 people, in over 30 countries, dedicated to improving quality of life. Everyone has an important role to play. With the power of many curious minds, together we can solve the world's most complex challenges and deliver more impact together. 

Qualifications & Experience: 

- Post-Graduation in Civil/Structure Engineering 
 - Actively progressing towards professional licensure, such as P. Eng. (Professional Engineer) in the United States 
 - 10-12 years of relevant experience in the design and delivery of highway and rail bridges, stations, and associated civil and utility structures. 
 - Extensive experience leading design teams and managing multidiscipline infrastructure projects is highly desirable. Minimum 3 years of working experience on Design & Build Projects in USA. 

Key Responsibilities: 

- Lead and oversee the delivery of complex structural design projects for highways, railways, and associated civil or utility works, ensuring compliance with client and regulatory requirements. 
 - Provide technical leadership and mentorship to design teams, reviewing and approving work to ensure quality, constructability, and safety. 
 - Manage all stages of the design process, from concept development and optioneering through detailed engineering to construction support and project close-out. 
 - Take primary responsibility for project planning, resource allocation, scheduling, and delivery against programme timelines, budgets, and health & safety objectives. 
 - Carry out design and production of Structural design, CAD/BIM production and 3D modelling and quantity estimation in D&B projects with development of alternative technical schemes and detailed design of projects. 
 - Ability to understand and carry out existing condition survey and prepare reports. 
 - Serve as the main point of contact for clients, stakeholders, and multidisciplinary teams, fostering strong professional relationships and ensuring effective communication. 
 - Oversee the resolution of complex technical and interdisciplinary design issues, driving innovation and value engineering where appropriate. 
 - Ensure robust quality assurance and control procedures are implemented across all deliverables. Lead knowledge-sharing initiatives and actively contribute to the development of team capabilities and best practices. 

Required Specific Competencies: 

- Demonstrated ability to lead, motivate, and develop engineering teams, fostering a collaborative and high-performance culture.

data.description:
In most instances, this position requires in-person interviews as part of the hiring process. Minimum qualifications: 

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience. 
 - 8 years of experience in software engineering with Information Retrieval (IR), Natural Language Processing (NLP) or Machine Learning (ML). 
 - Experience with launching user-facing, large-scale, production quality systems. 
 - Experience designing, implementing, and optimizing large-scale, high-performance, distributed search or quality systems in production environments. 

Preferred qualifications: 

- Experience with embedding-based retrieval, vector search, query understanding or Large Language Models (LLMs) applied to search/recommendation systems. 
 - Experience mamaging system latency improvements (e. g. , progressive loading, perfecting techniques, or bypassing post-retrieval latency overhead) and scalability enhancements. 
 - Background in defining metrics, analyzing user-perception surveys, and running complex search experiments. 
 - Good understanding of agentic architectures, tool-calling, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) grounding layers. 
 - Exceptional collaboration and communication skills, with a proven ability todrive technical alignment with cross-functional stakeholders and navigate competing priorities. 

About The Job

Google Cloud's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google Cloud's needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. You will anticipate our customer needs and be empowered to act like an owner, take action and innovate. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward. 

We are building Intuitive, and effective searching and finding experiences by enabling search journeys that bridge across Google Workspace products (e. g. , Gmail, Chat, Drive, etc. ). We have an ambitious roadmap for making Workspace Search excellent, including the usage of advanced Machine Learning (ML) technologies, significant user-facing changes, revamping our evaluation framework and more. 

AI will change the future of work in profound ways, and our products- Gmail, Docs, Drive, Calendar, Sheets, Vids and Meet are at the forefront. From pre-computed summaries for email threads, summaries for meetings, and videos created from a document using lifelike AI avatars, our AI opportunity is huge. Our mission is to meaningfully connect people so they can create, build, and grow together and as part of the team you can build how productivity tools should work 5-10 years into the future. You will work with model builders (Google DeepMind), work with exceptional leaders, and have the ability to impact billions of users across the world. 

Responsibilities

- Lead the architecture, design and implementation of end-to-end search solutions, from understanding natural language queries to developing and deploying machine learning models that significantly improve search quality. 
 - Drive innovation by exploring and integrating machine learning techniques, algorithms, and architectures to enhance search relevance and user experience. 
 - Own the technical goal and roadmap for critical areas of Workspace Search, collaborating with cross-functional teams to define and deliver on a strategic roadmap. 
 - Establish and refine evaluation frameworks and metrics to measure and track progress against key performance-indicators.

Endpoint Agent - Senior Software Engineer

You will have the opportunity to shape not only our technology architecture, but also how engineering teams leverage AI to build high-quality software faster and more effectively.

Job Summary

We are looking for a motivated Endpoint Software Engineer to help develop and maintain Kaseya's endpoint management agents. You will work alongside senior engineers to deliver new capabilities, improve platform reliability, and solve complex device management challenges across multiple operating systems. 

This role is ideal for engineers passionate about operating systems, systems programming, device management, and endpoint security. 

What You Will Do

- Design and implement new features for endpoint agents across Windows, macOS, Linux, and mobile platforms. 
 - Develop software components supporting monitoring, automation, patching, inventory collection, and device management. 
 - Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code. 
 - Investigate customer-reported issues and production escalations. 
 - Participate in root-cause analysis and resolution of agent-related problems. 
 - Work with Product and Support teams to understand customer enhancement requests and contribute to implementation plans. 
 - Improve agent stability, performance, scalability, and security. 
 - Develop integrations with operating system management and security frameworks. 
 - Build telemetry and diagnostics capabilities that improve supportability. 
 - Participate in design discussions, code reviews, and sprint planning. 
 - Collaborate with cloud, platform, QA, and support teams. 
 - Continuously learn and expand expertise in system software and endpoint technologies. 

What You Bring

- 5+ years of software engineering experience developing system software, endpoint software, or platform services. 
 - Strong proficiency in C# and . NET 
 - Deep understanding of at least one operating system platform (Windows, macOS or Linux) 
 - Strong knowledge of operating system fundamentals including - Processes, Threads, Filesystems, Networking, Security fundamentals 
 - Good understanding of operating system security features and device management concepts. 
 - Familiarity with one or more MDM ecosystems - Intune, Apple MDM, Android Enterprise, Linux management tools

Nice to have

- Experience with RMM, UEM, EDR, XDR, or endpoint security products. 
 - Proficiency in one of C, C++, Rust, Go, F# 
 - Knowledge of scripting technologies such as PowerShell, Bash, Python, or AppleScript. 

What Success Looks Like

A successful Endpoint Engineer at Kaseya: 

- Builds secure, high-quality endpoint software. 
 - Owns features from design through production support. 
 - Solves complex customer and platform challenges. 
 - Improves reliability, security, and performance of endpoint agents. 
 - Partners effectively across Product, Support, Security, and Engineering teams. 
 - Learns continuously and stays current with evolving operating system and device management technologies.

data.title: Lead Embedded Firmware Engineer – Residential Gateways (prplOS & Wireless)
data.description:
Lead Embedded Firmware Engineer - Residential Gateways (prplOS & Wireless)Role

Overview

We are looking for a Lead Embedded Firmware Developer with 12+ years of experience to drive the architectural direction, optimization, and scaling of our next-generation Residential Gateway products. Our software architecture leverages prplOS, making our platform inherently SoC-independent across diverse silicon, including Broadcom and MaxLinear SoCs. 

In this role, you will serve as the technical authority for our embedded firmware and wireless stack. You will own the Linux wireless architecture, scaling our platform to support cutting-edge Wi-Fi 6E and Wi-Fi 7 capabilities, while ensuring carrier-grade stability through deep system-level profiling and optimization using tools like perf and Valgrind. Additionally, you will champion automation by using Python scripting to build robust testing and unit testing framework methodologies that ensure code quality across the entire lifecyle. 

Key Responsibilities

- Technical Leadership & Architecture: Lead the architectural design of resilient, hardware-agnostic gateway firmware, mentoring engineering teams and establishing embedded development best practices. 
 - Test Automation & Scripting: Architect and implement automated testing and unit testing frameworks using Python to validate system components, APIs, and overall firmware reliability. 
 - Performance Profiling & Optimization: Use perf, Valgrind (Memcheck, Massif, Helgrind), and kernel utilities to profile OS memory and CPU management, eliminate memory leaks, resolve race conditions, and minimize CPU bottlenecks. 
 - Wireless Stack & Driver Integration: Design, configure, and optimize Wi-Fi 6E and Wi-Fi 7 features using hostapd, wpa_supplicant, and iw sub-systems. 
 - Firmware Development: Architect, develop, and maintain high-performance firmware in C and C++ across various gateway hardware platforms. 
 - SoC Abstraction: Leverage prpl APIs to maintain hardware-agnostic implementations across multiple carrier-grade SoCs. 
 - Inter-process Communication (IPC): Develop and maintain scalable services utilizing ubus and/or iMTP to ensure reliable internal bus communication. 
 - Network Stack Management: Design and troubleshoot robust Layer 2 and Layer 3 network stacks to ensure optimal routing, bridging, and packet forwarding. 
 - Service Management & Provisioning: Implement and maintain device management and service models, including TR-181 data models and USP (User Services Platform / TR-369). 
 - Containerization & Lifecycle Management: Configure and manage containerized microservices and virtual execution environments using Docker and prpl LCM (Lifecycle Management). 
 - Version Control: Manage source code, branching strategies, and firmware release pipelines using Git. 

Must-Have Requirements

- Experience: 10+ years of hands-on embedded firmware development experience in the telecom, networking, or residential gateway industries. 
 - Languages: High proficiency in C and modern C++ programming within resource-constrained embedded systems. 
 - Platform Expertise: Strong working knowledge of Embedded Linux development within OpenWrt or prplOS ecosystems. 
 - Device Management: Deep, production-level expertise with broadband management standards, explicitly TR-181 data models and USP (TR-369). 
 - Containerization: Demonstrated experience deploying, isolating, and configuring containerized microservices using Docker and lifecycle tools like prpl LCM. 
 - Advanced Linux Wireless: Deep knowledge of the Linux Wireless stack, including hostapd, wpa_supplicant, iw, and Linux wireless drivers. 
 - Networking Protocols: Deep understanding of Layer 2/3 networking and core routing/bridging concepts. 
 - Profiling & Debugging: Hands-on experience with Linux profiling and debugging tools, specifically perf and Valgrind. 
 - Version Control: Strong expertise managing source code and branching strategies via Git. 

Good-to-Have Requirements

- Next-Gen Wi-Fi: Experience implementing, configuring, or debugging next-generation wireless features like Wi-Fi 6E and Wi-Fi 7. 
 - Scripting & Automation: Proficiency in Python for creating automated test scripts, hardware validation, or test execution. 
 - Testing Frameworks: Experience building or maintaining unit testing frameworks (e. g. , CUnit, Unity, PyTest) in an embedded context. 
 - IPC Frameworks: Deep familiarity with OpenWrt ubus and message bus architectures like iMTP. 
 - Hardware Abstraction: Hands-on experience developing abstraction layers on Broadcom or MaxLinear residential gateway SoCs. 

Weekly Hours

40

Time Type

Regular

Location: 

Bangalore, India, Hyderabad, India

All hiring, promotion, and other employment decisions remain merit-based and free from discrimination on the basis of race, color, religion, religious creed, national origin, ancestry, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, physical disability, mental disability, pregnancy, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, citizenship status, military status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. data.title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer
data.description:
About Armor Defense Inc

At Armor, we are committed to making a meaningful difference in securing cyberspace. Our vision is to be the trusted protector and de facto standard that cloud-centric customers entrust with their risk. We strive to continuously evolve to be the best partner of choice, breaking norms and tirelessly innovating to stay ahead of evolving cyber threats and reshaping how we deliver customer outcomes. We are passionate about making a positive impact in the world, and we're looking for a highly skilled and experienced talent to join our dynamic team. 

Armor has unique offerings to the market so customers can a) understand their risk b) leverage Armor to co-manage their risk or c) completely outsource their risk to Armor. 

Learn more at: https: //www. armor. com

Summary

We are looking for a highly skilled Senior Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) to join our infrastructure team with expertise across Cloud Deployments, Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), Active Directory, Office 365, Zerto, Rubrik, VMware, and NSX-T. This hands-on, automation-heavy role focuses on system reliability, scalability, and proactive problem prevention. You will be responsible for building and maintaining resilient infrastructure, automating repetitive tasks, monitoring, and improving

performance, and driving incident reduction strategies across hybrid cloud environments. 

This role operates in a hybrid structure with on-site presence four days a week, specifically Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday, based in Pune, India. 

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES (Additional duties may be assigned as required)

- 
 - Own the design and roadmap for hybrid identity (Entra ID and on-prem AD), including conditional access and secure authentication standards. 
 - Design, deploy, and administer VMware vSphere and NSX-T environments, including capacity planning and secure network topologies. 
 - Define and own the DR strategy for Zerto and Rubrik, ensuring RTO/RPO and compliance requirements are met. 
 - Plan and lead workload migrations across VMware, AWS, and Azure. 
 - Define SLIs/SLOs and design monitoring, alerting, and incident response workflows for production services. 
 - Build and maintain reusable Terraform modules; set IaC standards for the team. 
 - Develop automation frameworks in Python/PowerShell, including self-healing and proactive detection. 
 - Design and maintain CI/CD and GitOps pipelines (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps or equivalent). 
 - Own the automated vulnerability patch management program. 
 - Optimize Office 365 services (Exchange Online, SharePoint, Teams, Intune) for security and performance. 
 - Lead response and resolution for high-impact incidents; act as on-call escalation point. 
 - Conduct blameless postmortems and drive remediation to closure. 
 - Mentor SRE team members and review scripts, Terraform, and change plans. 
 - Represent infrastructure in security and compliance audits (PCI, HIPAA, ISO). 

Required Skills

- 6-10 years in SRE on Windows-based production environments, including ownership of platform reliability. 
 - Deep expertise in VMware (vSphere, ESXi, vCenter, NSX-T), including capacity planning and architecture design. 
 - Expert-level Microsoft Entra ID and on-prem Active Directory: hybrid identity design, conditional access strategy, identity protection, and troubleshooting at scale. 
 - Strong programming/scripting in Python and PowerShell, with the ability to build reusable automation frameworks and self-healing mechanisms. Infrastructure-as-code with Terraform, including module design and DRY principles. 
 - CI/CD and GitOps experience (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps or equivalent). 
 - Designing and implementing observability: defining SLIs/SLOs and building dashboards and alerting with Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, or ELK. 
 - DR design and ownership with Zerto and Rubrik, including RTO/RPO planning, DR testing, and compliance. 
 - Strong networking knowledge: virtual network topology design, firewalls, load balancing, and DNS. 

Preferred Skills

- Production experience with AWS or Azure, including Secure Landing Zone design. 
 - Experience planning and executing workload migrations across VMware, AWS, and Azure. 
 - Kubernetes and Linux/Unix production experience. 
 - Ansible or similar configuration management tools. 
 - Experience owning vulnerability and patch management programs at scale.

Job Title: Senior DevOps Cloud Engineer, AI

Job Summary

The future is bright for the Porch Group, and we'd love for you to be a part of it as our Senior DevOps Cloud Engineer with the Information Technology team. 

Help us build world class infrastructure in public cloud, mainly GCP and AWS. We are seeking a Senior DevOps Cloud Engineer with a strong focus on AI-enabled platforms and automation to design, build, and operate highly scalable, secure, and intelligent cloud infrastructure. 

As a Senior DevOps Cloud Engineer, you will be responsible for designing, building, and operating highly scalable, secure, and intelligent cloud infrastructure, while maintaining and improving the reliability and performance of our company's technology stack. 

You will work closely with development teams to design scalable and highly reliable software systems, play a critical role in optimizing CI/CD pipelines using AI insights, and leverage automation to improve reliability, performance, and cost efficiency across cloud environments. 

Your role will involve identifying and resolving complex issues before they impact customers, implementing automation to streamline our operations, and advocating for best practices in reliability, scalability, and maintainability. As a senior member of the team, you will mentor junior engineers, drive technical initiatives, and collaborate across departments to achieve our reliability goals. 

What You Will Do As A Senior DevOps Cloud Engineer

- Build infrastructure/systems that balance operational excellence, security, reliability, performance efficiency, and cost optimization. 
 - Improve the observability of our systems to anticipate and address issues before they become critical, leveraging strategies like infrastructure as code, system operational and health metrics, CI/CD pipelines, and infrastructure automation.

 - Integrate AI-powered tools into DevOps workflows for predictive monitoring, anomaly detection, intelligent alerting, and auto-remediation.

data.title: Principal Software Engineer
data.description:
Overview

What happens when AI agents can rewrite millions of lines of code orders of magnitude faster than humans can review them? That question drives the Future of Scalable Software Engineering (FoSSE) team in Microsoft's CoreAI division. We build AI agents that transform some of the world's largest codebases, including Windows and Azure. Generating code is becoming the easy part; knowing whether to trust it is the real challenge. 

We combine AI agents with static analysis, testing, and formal verification to make large-scale software transformation practical and trustworthy, and we design tools that spend scarce human attention where it matters most. The team began in Microsoft Research and moved to CoreAI in 2025, and we continue to collaborate closely with Microsoft Research, so research depth meets production stakes every day. 

Here are the main problems we are currently working on: 

Migration at scale: We work on migrating hundreds of millions of lines of code, across Windows, Azure, Office, and other products, to work with new versions of dependent packages, new compilers and new platforms. Examples include increasing language-standards conformance of code, remediating CodeQL and other static analysis findings, and retargeting services from x86 to ARM. 

Language modernization: We move legacy C/C++ (and C#) codebases to Rust, with validation gates at every step. Differential testing against the original, held-out tests, and specification extraction with formal verification (such as Verus proofs) mean each migration is backed by evidence, not optimism. 

Specification-driven development: We help brownfield codebases adopt specification-driven development by inferring formal specifications for existing code. The specifications are grounded using execution traces and then used to generate concurrency and fault-tolerance tests, find subtle bugs, and ultimately create a validation guardrail for future AI-driven code changes. We are working with formal tools such as TLA+, F*, Lean and Verus in this work. 

You will be onsite at least three days a week and learn and grow through working with talented colleagues. 

Responsibilities

- Lead the design and delivery of agentic tools and infrastructure for one or more of our problem areas (such as migration at scale, language modernization, or specification-driven development). 
 - Set technical direction for a problem area end to end, from architecture to production adoption. 
 - Architect systems that let a small expert team drive transformations across hundreds of millions of lines of code. 
 - Define the validation strategies and quality bars that make agent-produced changes trustworthy at scale. 
 - Lead cross-organizational efforts with partner teams, such as Windows, Azure, compiler, and security teams, and with the research community. 
 - Turn ambiguous, fast-moving problems into roadmaps while staying flexible as models improve. 
 - Mentor senior engineers and raise the engineering bar across the team. 
 - Represent the team externally through talks, papers, and our blog. 

Qualifications

Required qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science or related areas and 10+ years of experience. Or a Master's degree with 8+ years of experience. Or a PhD in computer science or related areas with 5+ years of experience. 
 - Experience coding in languages such as C, C++, C#, or Rust. 
 - Experience building developer tools using LLM-based agents. 
 - Experience with compilers and program analysis. 
 - Excellent technical design, problem-solving, and debugging skills. 
 - Strong communication and collaboration skills, customer obsession, and a passion for shipping high-quality products. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with Rust and C/C++ interop and memory safety. 
 - Experience testing at scale, such as differential testing, property-based testing, or fuzzing. 
 - Experience with formal methods such as TLA+, model checking, F*, Lean, Verus, Dafny, or similar. 
 - Experience working with very large codebases and build systems. 
 - Interest or experience in human-AI interaction and developer experience design. 
 - Experience leading research-to-production transitions. 
 - Track record of leading technical efforts across teams or organizations. 
 - Publications or open-source contributions are a plus. 

Why join us

- Work on the hardest problems in agentic software engineering, at real scale. 
 - Join a small team with outsized leverage, where a handful of experts steer changes across hundreds of millions of lines of code. 
 - Blend research and engineering: ideas here ship to tools used by Windows, Azure, and other large teams. 
 - Build on, and contribute back to, the research community around TLA+, F*, Lean, Verus, etc.

data.description:
Job Description Summary

L'ingénierie des systèmes est une discipline d'ingénierie interfonctionnelle axée sur une approche, un état d'esprit et un processus. Toutes les activités qui tiennent compte des besoins à la fois commerciaux et techniques des clients dans le but de fournir un produit de qualité qui réponde aux besoins des utilisateurs. Discipline qui exécute un processus robuste de conception, de création et d'optimisation de systèmes, comprenant l'identification et la quantification des exigences système, la création de concepts de conception de système alternatifs, la réalisation d'études commerciales de conception, la sélection et la mise en œuvre des meilleures conceptions et la vérification que la conception est correctement intégrée et exécutée. Processus allant du concept à l'exploitation en passant par la production. 

Exerce une influence sur les opérations département et est responsable de la planification et/ou de l'exécution. Ce rôle jouit d'une certaine autonomie, mais est axé sur l'exécution d'activités au sein d'une discipline opérationnelle couverte par les pratiques et procédures fonctionnelles standard. Un certain discernement peut être nécessaire, mais généralement dans le cadre d'une orientation. 

Job Description

Rôles et responsabilités

- Identifie, développe, évalue, introduit et gère des solutions d'ingénierie répondant aux besoins technologiques en matière de contrôle de produits et de systèmes de contrôle. Applique la théorie du contrôle et la modélisation mathématique à la conception et au contrôle de systèmes avec les comportements souhaités. Comprend l'opérabilité, la définition des limites, l'optimisation du cycle, la logique de contrôle, les logiciels liés au contrôle, les capteurs, les algorithmes matériels et logiciels, ainsi que les informations en retour permettant de contrôler les performances des dispositifs, sous-systèmes et systèmes. 
 - Développer une connaissance approfondie d'une discipline technique. Se fonde sur une expérience antérieure et une expertise technique acquise pour mettre en œuvre une politique/stratégie. 
 - Compréhension approfondie des principaux facteurs opérationnels ; utilise cette compréhension pour accomplir son propre travail. Compréhension approfondie de la manière dont le travail de sa propre équipe s'intègre aux autres équipes et contribue à son domaine. 
 - Fait preuve de discernement et est en capacité de proposer différentes solutions en dehors des paramètres définis, dans le cadre d'une orientation. Se fonde sur une expérience antérieure et la formation professionnelle pour résoudre des tâches simples. Possède les compétences techniques et l'esprit d'analyse nécessaires à la résolution de problèmes. Peut utiliser plusieurs sources internes en dehors de sa propre équipe pour prendre des décisions. 
 - Un poste à ce niveau est susceptible d'être un contributeur individuel, avec des compétences interpersonnelles éprouvées ou un People Leader capable d'embaucher et de développer des talents. Fournit des conseils informels aux nouveaux membres de l'équipe. 

Qualifications De Base

- 
 - Pour les rôles en dehors des États-Unis - Ce rôle nécessite une expérience significative de la fonction et de la station de travail audio numérique. Connaissances de niveau équivalent à une licence dans une université accréditée (ou un baccalauréat avec une expérience dans un domaine pertinent). 
 - Pour les rôles aux États-Unis - Licence d'une université accrédité (ou diplôme d'études secondaires et/ou diplôme d'étude général avec au moins 4 ans d'expérience dans la fonction). 

Caractéristiques souhaitées

- Solides compétences en communication orale et écrite. Solides compétences relationnelles et de leadership. Capacité à influencer les autres et à diriger de petites équipes. Mener des initiatives d'envergure et d'impact modérés. Capacité à coordonner plusieurs projets simultanément. Identification efficace des problèmes et compétences en résolution de problèmes. Capacités d'analyse et d'organisation prouvées. Remarque : Pour se conformer aux exigences légales américaines en matière d'immigration et autres, il est nécessaire de préciser le nombre minimum d'années d'expérience requis pour tout poste basé aux États-Unis. Pour les rôles en dehors des États-Unis, pour assurer la conformité avec la législation applicable, les juristes doivent mentionner le niveau d'expérience requis et non PAS un nombre minimum d'années. Cette description de poste a pour but de fournir un guide détaillé du rôle. Toutefois, il n'est pas prévu de modifier ou de restreindre et/ou d'élargir de quelque manière que ce soit les tâches requises de chaque employé, telles qu'elles sont définies dans leur contrat de travail respectif et/ou convenues d'un commun accord entre un employé et son responsable.

data.title: Solution Engineer - Quality, Laboratory & OT Systems
data.description:
Description

At Envalior, we combine over a century of materials expertise with innovation and digital technology to help create sustainable, high-performance solutions for our customers around the world. As our laboratories, manufacturing sites, and quality organizations become increasingly digital, we are looking for a Solution Engineer who can help bridge business processes and technology across Quality, Research & Technology (R&T), and Operational Technology (OT) domains. 

This role offers a unique opportunity to become a key technology partner for our global laboratory and quality functions, helping ensure that critical systems are reliable, compliant, efficient, and aligned with Envalior's business ambitions. 

The Role

As a Solution Engineer - Quality, Laboratory & OT Systems, you will act as the subject matter expert and trusted advisor for a portfolio of laboratory, quality, and manufacturing applications, with a primary focus on Laboratory Information Management Systems (LIMS). 

LIMS applications sit at the heart of Envalior's quality and laboratory operations. They support the management of laboratory samples, testing workflows, quality data, product specifications, and batch release activities across manufacturing and R&D environments. As the system owner and technical lead, you will ensure these platforms continue to deliver business value while supporting operational excellence and continuous improvement. 

You will work closely with Quality, R&T, Operations, Manufacturing, Digital Solutions Delivery, and Technology Services teams worldwide to support existing solutions while identifying opportunities for innovation, automation, and simplification. 

What You Will Do

Own and Support Critical Laboratory & Quality Systems

- Serve as the IT System Owner for Envalior's LIMS QA solutions. 
 - Manage the lifecycle of laboratory and quality applications, including enhancements, upgrades, integrations, and support activities. 
 - Ensure platforms remain secure, stable, and aligned with evolving business requirements. 
 - Act as the primary escalation point for complex application and process issues. 
 - Support business continuity across laboratory and quality operations globally. 

Partner with the Business

- Develop a deep understanding of Quality, R&T, and Operational Technology processes. 
 - Collaborate with laboratory managers, quality teams, manufacturing stakeholders, and digital colleagues to identify opportunities for improvement. 
 - Translate business challenges into scalable digital solutions. 
 - Build strong relationships with stakeholders and effectively communicate the value of technology-enabled change. 

Drive Innovation and Digital Transformation

- Propose innovative information solutions by combining existing systems with emerging digital technologies. 
 - Evaluate opportunities to improve laboratory efficiency, data management, automation, and operational performance. 
 - Simplify and modernize existing application landscapes. 
 - Eliminate waste, reduce complexity, and improve user experience through technology and process optimization. 

Enable Reliable Laboratory Operations

- Support systems used for sample management, laboratory workflows, testing activities, and quality data management. 
 - Ensure effective system integrations between laboratory, manufacturing, and enterprise platforms. 
 - Help maintain accurate, timely, and accessible laboratory information across the value chain. 
 - Support the digital backbone that enables quality decision-making and product release activities. 

Lead Continuous Improvement

- Identify opportunities to strengthen system performance and business processes. 
 - Promote best practices in application management, information architecture, and digital solutions. 
 - Support change management initiatives and user adoption activities. 
 - Drive a culture of operational excellence and continuous improvement across supported domains. 

Requirements

Education

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Business Administration, Chemistry, Materials Science, or a related discipline. 

Experience

- Experience in application management, solution engineering, business analysis, or related digital roles. 
 - Experience supporting Quality, Manufacturing, Laboratory, R&T, or Operational Technology environments. 
 - Strong stakeholder management and communication skills. 
 - Experience working within global and cross-functional organizations. 
 - Demonstrated ability to lead change and drive continuous improvement initiatives. 

Preferred Technical Expertise -

Laboratory & Quality Systems

- ZhuoMES
 - GUSLAB / LABSQ
 - Unilab
 - Thermo Fisher SampleManager LIMS
 - WinLIMS

OT & Manufacturing Solutions

- Eschbach Shiftconnector
 - AssetWise

Sustainability & Quality Platforms

- Credit360
 - Other Quality, OT, and R&T SaaS applications

Additional Capabilities

- Information architecture (data, process, and application landscape)
 - Application lifecycle management
 - Systems integration and interfacing
 - Change management
 - Technical project delivery
 - Analytical problem solving
 - Operations, Quality, and R&T process knowledge

What Success Looks Like

In this role, you will become the trusted digital partner for Envalior's Quality and Laboratory community. You will ensure our LIMS landscape delivers reliable support to laboratories worldwide while helping the business embrace new technologies and more efficient ways of working. 

You Will Be Successful If You Can

- Balance technology expertise with business understanding. 
 - Influence stakeholders through collaboration and credibility. 
 - Simplify complex challenges into practical solutions. 
 - Drive operational efficiency through digital innovation. 
 - Continuously improve the applications and processes that support Envalior's quality and laboratory operations. 

Benefits

Competitive Compensation

Join us at Envalior and enjoy competitive compensation packages, inclusive of a global bonus program and individual performance bonuses, ensuring your hard work is recognized and rewarded. 

Comprehensive Benefits

Your well-being matters to us. At Envalior, we provide an array of benefits supporting your financial security, health, and overall well-being. This includes retirement plans, health programs, life insurance, and comprehensive medical care. 

Work-Life Balance & Flexibility

Maintain a healthy balance between work and personal life with Envalior's commitment to supporting your schedule. 

Training & Development Opportunities

At Envalior, your growth matters. We encourage and invest in your professional and personal development. We support our employees in their growth and personal development through ongoing investment in their knowledge and skills via training, coaching, and mentoring. 

Diversity & Inclusion

At Envalior, our people drive our success, so it's only right that we provide a diverse and inclusive working environment and foster a culture of belonging, openness, and respect. We value diversity as a cornerstone of our success. We are committed to nurturing and empowering every individual to reach their full potential. 

APPLY NOW!

Ready to pioneer change with Envalior? Join us in our mission to drive innovation, sustainability, and excellence. Apply today and become a part of our transformative journey towards a more sustainable future. 

Submit your application online by sending your CV and motivation letter in English through our career portal. If you have any questions, feel free to connect directly with our recruiter at Deepanshu. Tripathi@envalior. com

Envalior is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. 

If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, you may contact us at Talent. Acquisition@Envalior. com. 

OUR HERITAGE

With a combined heritage of over 100 years, Envalior brings together two established global materials players: DSM Engineering Materials and LANXESS High Performance Materials. Our unique combined portfolio of longstanding material-, application-, and design expertise enables our customers to develop and launch sustainable future-proof designs. Envalior is the brand new materials powerhouse that was Launched in early 2023. 

We aim to be a global leader in sustainable and high-performance engineering materials. We imagine the future by shaping the world of today and tomorrow. We're conscious that this is both a privilege and a responsibility - so, when we imagine the future, we're guided by our key values to help us create a better world.

data.title: Lead Engineer - Controls & Protection
data.description:
Job Description Summary

Systems Engineering ist eine funktionsübergreifende technische Disziplin, die sich auf einen Ansatz, eine Denkweise und einen Prozess konzentriert. Alle Tätigkeiten, die sowohl die geschäftlichen als auch die technischen Anforderungen der Kunden berücksichtigen, mit dem Ziel, ein Qualitätsprodukt bereitzustellen, das die Anforderungen der Benutzer erfüllt. Die Disziplin zur Umsetzung eines soliden Prozesses zum Entwerfen, Erstellen und Optimieren von Systemen, der aus der Identifizierung und Quantifizierung von Systemanforderungen, der Erstellung alternativer Systementwurfskonzepte, der Durchführung von Design-Trade-off-Studien, der Auswahl und Implementierung der besten Entwürfe und der Überprüfung der Tatsache besteht, dass das Design ordnungsgemäß integriert ist und ausgeführt wird. Prozess, der vom Konzept über die Produktion bis zum Betrieb verläuft. 

Beeinflusst den Abteilungsbetrieb und ist verantwortlich für die Planung/Ausführung. Die Rolle hat eine gewisse Autonomie, konzentriert sich jedoch auf die Ausführung von Aktivitäten innerhalb einer operativen Disziplin, die durch funktionale Standardpraktiken und -verfahren abgedeckt wird. Möglicherweise ist ein gewisses Urteilsvermögen erforderlich, dies erfolgt jedoch in der Regel unter Anleitung. 

Job Description

Rollen und Verantwortlichkeiten

- Identifizieren, entwickeln, bewerten, führen ein und verwalten Engineering-Lösungen für die Anforderungen der Produkt- und Steuerungssystemtechnologie. Wenden die Steuerungstheorie und mathematische Modellierung auf Entwurfs- und Steuerungssysteme mit dem gewünschten Verhalten an. Beinhaltet Bedienbarkeit, Festlegen von Grenzen, Zyklusoptimierung, Steuerlogik, steuerungsbezogene Software, Sensoren, Hardware- und Softwarealgorithmen sowie Feedback zur Steuerung der Leistung von Geräten, Subsystemen und Systemen. 
 - Vertiefung der Kenntnisse einer technischen Disziplin. Verwendet vorherige Erfahrung und erworbenes technisches Fachwissen, um Richtlinien/Strategien umzusetzen. 
 - Fundiertes Verständnis der wichtigsten Geschäftstreiber; nutzt dieses Verständnis, um eigene Arbeit zu leisten. Vertiefte Kenntnisse darüber, wie sich die Arbeit des eigenen Teams in andere Teams integriert und zum Bereich beiträgt. 
 - Verwendet ein gewisses Maß an Urteilsvermögen und hat die Fähigkeit, verschiedene Lösungen außerhalb der festgelegten Parameter vorzuschlagen, aber mit Anleitung. Verwendet vorherige Erfahrung und die Ausbildung am Arbeitsplatz, um einfache Aufgaben zu lösen. Hat Zugriff auf die technischen Fähigkeiten und das analytische Denken, die zur Lösung von Problemen erforderlich sind. Kann mehrere interne Quellen außerhalb des eigenen Teams verwenden, um Entscheidungen zu treffen. 
 - Eine Stelle auf dieser Ebene ist wahrscheinlich ein einzelner Mitarbeiter mit nachgewiesenen zwischenmenschlichen Fähigkeiten oder Führungsnachwuchs, der Talente einstellen und entwickeln kann. Bietet informelle Anleitung für neue Teammitglieder

Grundqualifikationen

- Diese Rolle erfordert fortgeschrittene Erfahrung. Der Wissensstand ist vergleichbar mit einem Bachelor-Abschluss einer akkreditierten Universität oder Hochschule (oder einem Abitur mit relevanter Erfahrung). 

Gewünschte Eigenschaften

- Sehr gute mündliche und schriftliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten. Ausgeprägte Sozialkompetenz und Führungsqualitäten. Fähigkeit, andere zu beeinflussen und kleine Teams zu führen. Initiativen von mittlerem Umfang und mittlerer Wirkung leiten. Fähigkeit, mehrere Projekte gleichzeitig zu koordinieren. Effektive Erkennung und Lösung von Problemen. Nachweisliche analytische und organisatorische Fähigkeiten. Hinweis: Um die Einwanderungsbestimmungen der USA und andere gesetzliche Anforderungen zu erfüllen, muss die Mindestanzahl der Jahre an Erfahrung angegeben werden, die für eine Tätigkeit in den USA erforderlich sind. Für Rollen außerhalb der USA sollten sich die JDs auf das für die Rolle erforderliche inhaltliche Erfahrungsniveau konzentrieren, um die Einhaltung der geltenden Rechtsvorschriften zu gewährleisten, und eine Mindestanzahl von Jahren sollte NICHT verwendet werden. Diese Stellenbeschreibung soll einen allgemeinen Leitfaden für die Rolle liefern. Sie soll jedoch nicht die von jedem Mitarbeiter gemäß dem jeweiligen Arbeitsvertrag und/oder gemäß einer anderweitigen Vereinbarung zwischen einem Mitarbeiter und seinem Vorgesetzten geforderten Pflichten ändern oder anderweitig einzuschränken/erweitern. 

Additional Information

Relocation Assistance Provided: Yes

data.title: Performance Optimization Architect/Manager
data.description:
Company

Qualcomm India Private Limited

Job Area

Engineering Group, Engineering Group > Systems Engineering

General Summary

Qualcomm is a company of inventors that unlocked 5G ushering in an age of rapid acceleration in connectivity and new possibilities that will transform industries, create jobs, and enrich lives. But this is just the beginning. It takes inventive minds with diverse skills, backgrounds, and cultures to transform 5Gs potential into world-changing technologies and products. This is the Invention Age - and this is where you come in. 

Qualcomm has been at the forefront of driving the revolution in the mobile gaming space by providing state of the art powerful GPUs as part of the Snapdragon program. Snapdragon Elite Gaming delivers the full suite of desktop-level features, including volumetric rendering for hyper-realistic visuals. Qualcomm® AdrenoTM GPU is the powerhouse engine behind high-performance graphics and rich user experiences with low power consumption. Our AdrenoTM GPU is designed to quickly render complex geometries for next-level visuals in games and apps-with super-fast responsiveness and superior mobile connectivity for truly immersive experiences. As part of GPU performance and architecture team, the candidate will be working on the latest and greatest in GPU architecture and Computer Graphics. The role revolves around working on analyzing the most popular games and benchmarks which use highly advanced rendering techniques, evaluating their performance on Qualcomm GPUs, define new optimizations/algorithms/configurations for the Adreno GPUs and modeling them to define next generation of AdrenoTM GPU

Responsibilities

- Conduct system level performance analysis and bottleneck analysis for intricate, high-performance GPUs and System-on-Chips (SoCs). 
 - Utilize hardware models at various levels of abstraction, including performance models, RTL test benches, emulators, and silicon, to scrutinize and identify performance bottlenecks in the system. 
 - Comprehend key performance use-cases of the product and formulate workloads and test suits focusing on graphics, machine learning, automotive, video, and computer vision applications. 
 - Collaborate closely with architecture and design teams to explore architecture trade-offs related to system performance, area, and power consumption. 
 - Develop necessary infrastructure, including performance models, testbench components, and performance analysis and visualization tools. 
 - Lead efforts to enhance turnaround time, identify representative data-sets, and facilitate early performance analysis in the product development cycle. 

Qualifications

- Bachelor's (BE/BTech) or Master's (MS/MTech) degree in a relevant field; PhD is a plus, or equivalent experience. 
 - Knowledge of Graphics APIs e. g. OpenGL, Vulkan, DirectX, Metal
 - A minimum of 12 years of experience in Computer Graphics or a related field with exposure to performance analysis and complex System-on-Chip (SoC) and/or GPU architectures. 
 - Profound understanding of System-on-Chip (SoC) architecture, graphics pipeline, memory subsystem architecture, and Network-on-Chip (NoC)/Interconnect architecture. 
 - Expertise in programming languages (C/C++) and scripting languages (Perl/Python). Exposure to Verilog/System Verilog, SystemC/TLM is highly advantageous. 
 - Strong debugging and analysis skills, including data and statistical analysis, and proficiency in using RTL dumps to debug failures. 
 - Hands-on experience in developing performance simulators and cycle accurate/approximate models for pre-silicon performance analysis is a significant advantage. 

Keywords: 3D graphics; benchmark analysis; gpu; performance modeling; compute architecture, Complier, OpenGL, Vulkan, DirectX

Minimum Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 6+ years of Systems Engineering or related work experience. 

OR

Master's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 5+ years of Systems Engineering or related work experience. 

OR

Qualcomm is also committed to making our workplace accessible for individuals with disabilities. We will not respond here to requests for updates on applications or resume inquiries).

data.description:
Job Description

Role: Tech Lead Data Engineer

Location: Bengaluru

What you'll do

We're MiQ, a global programmatic media partner for marketers and agencies. Our people are at the heart of

everything we do, and as a Tech Lead - Data Engineering, you'll be right at the center of it. This role

combines technical excellence, hands-on problem-solving, and engineering leadership to help us build

optimized, scalable, and cost-efficient data products and pipelines across our platforms. 

You will lead by example, guiding a team of data engineers to build and maintain robust data systems while

collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver high-impact business outcomes. This role goes beyond

writing code-you'll be setting standards, making architectural decisions, mentoring team members, and

driving technical innovation across the organization. 

Who are your stakeholders?

You'll Work Closely With

- Data Engineering Team members along with Principal engineers and Data Architects
 - Product Managers and Product Leads across global business units
 - Engineering managers and cross-team leads (DevOps, Data Science, Analytics)
 - Internal data consumers like Analysts, Business Intelligence, and ML teams
 - Platform teams responsible for cost optimization and infrastructure scalability

What you'll bring

- 6+ years of experience in Data Engineering, with 2+ years in a technical or team

leadership role

- Strong expertise in data architecture, data modeling, distributed computing, and modern

data platforms

- Proficiency with big data ecosystems like Spark, Databricks, Kafka, Presto, and Delta

Lake

- Strong coding skills in Python, Scala or Java, and a solid understanding of software

engineering principles

- Expertise in SQL/NoSQL, data & delta lakes, and cloud-native services (preferably AWS

or GCP)

- Proven track record in building production-grade ETL pipelines and event-driven systems
 - Experience leading POCs, evaluating tools, and setting engineering best practices across

teams

- Familiarity with DataOps, DevOps and CI/CD, including tools for monitoring, alerting, 

and observability

- A passion for mentoring and developing engineers, and a love for collaborative problem-

solving

We've highlighted some key skills, experience and requirements for this role. But please don't

worry if you don't meet every single one. Our talent team strives to find the best people. They

might see something in your background that's a fit for this role, or another opportunity at

MiQ. If you have a passion for the role, please still apply. 

What impact will you create?

As a Tech Lead, your mission is to set direction, not just velocity. You will: 

- Drive the architectural vision for scalable, cost-optimized, and performant data systems
 - Design, review, and guide the implementation of complex pipelines and data products
 - Introduce and champion engineering best practices, design patterns, and quality standards
 - Act as a force multiplier by mentoring engineers and helping them level up
 - Represent the team in technical forums and work closely with leadership on strategic initiatives
 - Bring a product mindset to engineering and advocate for the "why" as much as the "how"
 - Keep your hands dirty-build things, break things (responsibly), and help your team learn from both

What's in it for you?

At MiQ, you'll be empowered to influence technical strategy at a global scale. You'll be joining a diverse and

dynamic team in our Center of Excellence, where innovation and experimentation are encouraged and

Job Area

Engineering Group, Engineering Group > Hardware Engineering

General Summary

As a leading technology innovator, Qualcomm pushes the boundaries of what's possible to enable next-generation experiences and drives digital transformation to help create a smarter, connected future for all. As a Qualcomm Hardware Engineer, you will plan, design, optimize, verify, and test electronic systems, bring-up yield, circuits, mechanical systems, Digital/Analog/RF/optical systems, equipment and packaging, test systems, FPGA, and/or DSP systems that launch cutting-edge, world class products. Qualcomm Hardware Engineers collaborate with cross-functional teams to develop solutions and meet performance requirements. 

Minimum Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Engineering, or related field and 3+ years of Hardware Engineering or related work experience. 

OR

Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Engineering, or related field and 2+ years of Hardware Engineering or related work experience. 

OR

PhD in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Engineering, or related field and 1+ year of Hardware Engineering or related work experience. 

Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced CPU/SoC Validation Engineer with strong knowledge of ARM Generic Interrupt Controller (GIC) architecture and hands-on experience in post-silicon validation, system-level debugging. The engineer will own validation of interrupt-controller functionality across CPU, firmware, power-management, and OS interactions. 

Key Responsibilities

- Develop and execute post-silicon validation plans for ARM GICv3/GICv4 and CPU interrupt subsystems. 
 - Validate GIC components including: Distributor (GICD)Redistributor (GICR)CPU interface and system registersInterrupt Translation Service (ITS)SGI, PPI, SPI and LPI interrupt flows
 - Validate interrupt routing, prioritization, masking, preemption, affinity, acknowledgement and EOI behavior. 
 - Develop stress scenarios covering: Concurrent interrupt generationHigh interrupt ratesMulti-core interrupt routingSGI broadcast and targeted SGIsInterrupt migration and CPU hotplugInterrupt handling during CPU idle and low-power transitions
 - Validate GIC behavior across CPU power collapse, suspend/resume, reset and DVFS transitions. 
 - Debug complex issues involving lost interrupts, unexpected routing, interrupt latency, stuck interrupts and incorrect GIC state. 
 - Analyze key GIC registers such as GICD, GICR, ICC system registers, ICH virtualization registers and ITS state. 
 - Validate interactions between the GIC and OS/kernel, firmware, hypervisor and power-management software. 
 - Work closely with CPU architecture, firmware, kernel, power-management, design and verification teams to root-cause silicon issues. 
 - Use hardware/software debugging techniques including register dumps, trace, kernel logs, crash dumps and waveform/trace correlation. 
 - Develop automation and stress workloads for interrupt validation and regression testing. 
 - Track validation coverage, defects, risks and closure status through engineering tracking systems. 

Required Technical Skills

- Strong understanding of ARMv8/ARMv9 architecture. 
 - Strong understanding of ARM GICv3/GICv4 architecture. 
 - Good knowledge of: SGI / PPI / SPI / LPIInterrupt affinity and routingPriority masking and preemptionGroup 0 / Group 1 interruptsSecure and Non-secure interrupt handlingGIC Distributor and RedistributorCPU interface registersITS and MSI-based interruptsVirtual interrupts / vGIC concepts
 - Understanding of CPU power states, clock/power collapse, reset sequences and low-power entry/exit. 
 - Programming/scripting experience with C/C++, Python and shell scripting. 
 - Experience with JTAG/debuggers and SoC debug methodologies is desirable. 

Preferred Experience

- 7 to 16 years of experience in CPU/SoC post-silicon validation or silicon bring-up experience. 
 - Validation of ARM-based multicore SoCs. 
 - Knowledge of virtualization, hypervisors and virtual interrupt handling. 
 - Experience debugging interactions among GIC, CPU low-power states, DVFS and firmware. 
 - Ability to convert architectural requirements into validation scenarios, stress tests and measurable coverage.

We're looking for a hands-on Principal Software Engineer (P5) who is deeply focused on AI-driven development, agentic AI systems, and practical delivery of production software. This person will not only set the technical direction but also take full ownership of complex initiatives-leading projects from concept through architecture, implementation, launch, and continuous improvement. 

This role is ideal for a senior technologist who:

Technical Leadership & Architecture

- Set and evolve architectural standards through real-world implementation

 - Make principled tradeoffs between speed, scalability, correctness, and cost
 - Act as a technical escalation point for the most challenging problems (distributed systems, data, AI workflows)
 - Influence technical direction across multiple teams without becoming a bottleneck
 - Provide full technical leadership for projects by coordinating architecture, engineering execution, dependency management, risk mitigation, and cross-team alignment
 - Communicate clearly with product owners, engineering leaders, security, DevOps/SRE, QA, and business stakeholders to keep delivery aligned with business outcomes

AI‐Assisted Engineering & Developer Productivity

- Leverage AI-powered development tools (GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude, etc. ) to accelerate development
