Job Description

Provana is looking for a rare engineering leader. Someone who doesn't just manage software teams, but actively reshapes how software is built. 

As our AI Native Software Engineering Manager, you will be the company's foremost practitioner of agentic AI software development practices compressing entire development cycles and turning ideas into production in days rather than months owning the full engineering lifecycle from idea to production across both internal enterprise transformation and externally-facing product lines. 

You will lead a team of forward-deployed engineers embedded across Provana's business units and product divisions. You will be equally at home architecting a multi-agent workflow that automates legal document processing and pairing with an engineer on a complex PostgreSQL schema migration. Hands-on coding is not optional it is core to how you lead. 

This role sits at the intersection of organizational transformation and product innovation. You will compress the distance between what AI can do and what Provana ships at speed and at scale. 

What You Will Own

INTERNAL ENTERPRISE TRANSFORMATION (Org-Wide) : 

- Lead engineering for AI-driven transformation across Finance, Legal, HR, IT, and Accounts replacing manual workflows with rule bases and/or intelligent, agentic systems that deliver measurable efficiency and productivity gains. 
 - Define and enforce a spec-driven development culture internally ensuring every project begins with a precise, versioned specification before a single line of code is written. 
 - Establish BMAD-based multi-agent workflows that mirror real team structures (Analyst PM Architect Dev QA), enabling fast, high-quality delivery by small teams. 
 - Build context engineering standards: like CLAUDE. md files, organizational skill libraries, MCP server integrations, and agentic toolchains that become institutional assets in the pod based FDE model. 

External-facing Products & Services

- Architect and deliver agentic capabilities within Provana's legal tech products including foreclosure legal support, dispute resolution, compliance management, and automated e-filing systems. 
 - Drive the next generation of Healthcare RCM products, embedding generative AI and agentic workflows into billing, coding, credentialing, denial management, and patient access pipelines. 
 - Lead development within Provana's Agentic BPM platform building compound agent systems for process orchestration, workflow automation, and operational intelligence at enterprise scale. 
 - Extend Provana's Speech AI and Conversational AI capabilities designing and shipping production-grade voice and language products for contact center, compliance monitoring, and customer interaction domains. 
 - Collaborate with product and domain teams to ship AI features that directly improve client outcomes: reduced denial rates, faster cycle times, improved compliance coverage, and lower cost-to-serve. 

Team Leadership & Engineering Excellence

- Manage, mentor, and grow a team of forward-deployed engineers across product and internal domains defining career paths, conducting code reviews, and setting quality standards. 
 - Act as the primary technical thought leader on AI-native development practices: agentic software development, swarm architectures, context engineering, and spec-driven workflows. 
 - Partner with executive and product leadership to translate business priorities into engineered solutions with clear ROI, defined success metrics, and delivery timelines. 
 - Build and maintain Provana's internal AI engineering playbook a living system of standards, tools, agent skills, and practices that every engineer can leverage. 
 - Evaluate and adopt emerging AI coding tools, models, and frameworks; maintain hands-on proficiency with Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Cursor, and next-generation agentic platforms. 

Required Qualifications

- 8 - 12 years of software engineering experience, with at least 3 years in a technical lead or engineering management role. 
 - Hands-on experience with Claude Code, Cursor, OpenAI Codex, or equivalent agentic coding tools as core development workflow. 
 - Deep hands-on coding ability you write, review, and architect production code daily, not just in theory. 
 - Solid data engineering skills: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, vector databases, RAG pipeline design, and data modeling for AI applications. 
 - Demonstrated experience with agentic software development: building, orchestrating, and deploying multi-agent systems in production environments. 
 - Experience building with LLM APIs (Anthropic, OpenAI, Azure OpenAI) including prompt engineering, tool use, eval harnesses, and production observability. 
 - Fluency in spec-driven development structured PRDs, versioned specs as source of truth, and context engineering discipline. 
 - Generative AI integration experience: RAG systems, structured generation, agent memory, multi-step reasoning, and output validation. 
 - Proficiency with the BMAD method or equivalent multi-agent orchestration frameworks for structured software delivery. 
 - Strong communication skills ability to write clear technical specifications, architectural decision records, and executive-level summaries. 
 - Strong Azure platform skills including Azure OpenAI, AKS, Azure Functions, and Azure SQL / Cosmos DB. 
 - Demonstrated ability to influence without authority and drive engineering culture across cross-functional teams. 

Technical Stack

AI & Agentic : 

- Claude Code - OpenAI Codex - Cursor - BMAD Method - Spec-Driven Dev - Agentic Swarms - RAG - MCP Servers - Context Engineering. 

Cloud (Azure)

- Azure OpenAI - Azure AKS - Azure Functions - Azure DevOps - Azure AI Studio - CI/CD Pipelines - Docker / Kubernetes. 

Data & Backend

- PostgreSQL - MongoDB - Vector DBs - Python - Node. js / TypeScript - REST / GraphQL APIs - Event-Driven Architecture. 

Domains

- Legal Tech - Healthcare RCM - Agentic BPM - Speech AI - Conversational AI - Finance Ops - HR Automation - Compliance Tech. 

(ref: hirist. tech)

data.title: Lead Backend Developer
data.description:
Location : Bangalore

Department : Engineering

Reports to : SVP

Experience required : 6+ years

About Tracxn

Tracxn (Tracxn. com) is a Bangalore-based product company providing a research and deal sourcing platform for Venture Capital, Private Equity, Corp Dev, and professionals working around the startup ecosystem. 

We are a team of 600+ working professionals serving customers across the globe. Our clients include Funds like Andreessen Horowitz, Matrix Partners, GGV Capital, and Large Corporations such as Citi, Embraer & Ferrero. 

Founders

- Neha Singh (ex-Sequoia, BCG | MBA - Stanford GSB)
 - Abhishek Goyal (ex-Accel Partners, Amazon | BTech - IIT Kanpur)

About Technology Team

Tracxn's Technology team is 60+ members strong and growing. The technology team is subdivided into multiple smaller teams, each owning one or more services/components of the technology platform. Ours is a young team of motivated engineers with a minimal management structure where almost everyone is actively involved in technical development and design activities. We have a team-centric culture where the ownership and responsibility of a feature or module lie with a team compared to an individual. 

We value ownership, continuous learning, consistency, and discipline as a team. 

Our Tech Stacks

We work on an array of technologies, including but not limited to backend and frontend systems such as Java, Python, Spring Boot, Node. js, ReactJS, Next. js, Webpack, and Storybook; cloud and serverless platforms like AWS, etc; data and infrastructure technologies such as Elastic Stack (Elasticsearch), MongoDB, MySQL, Redis, Kafka, and Ansible; large-scale web crawling solutions; modern data pipelines and ETL workflows; and AI/ML-driven projects. 

Job Overview

We are looking for experienced software engineers with 6+ years of overall software development experience, including backend development and proven people-management skills. The ideal candidate will lead the engineering team(s), drive technical excellence, and ensure timely delivery of high-quality software solutions. 

Job Responsibilities

- Lead, mentor, and manage a team of software engineers
 - Own technical planning, architecture discussions, and execution
 - Collaborate with product managers and stakeholders
 - Drive best practices in software development, testing, and deployment
 - Conduct code reviews and ensure high engineering standards
 - Manage delivery timelines, resource planning, and technical risks
 - Support hiring, onboarding, and performance management of engineers

Job Requirements

Professional Experience : 

- Proven experience leading or managing software engineering teams
 - Track record of delivering complex, scalable software systems
 - Experience driving technical initiatives and influencing architectural decisions
 - Strong collaboration experience with product, design, and cross-functional teams. 

Technical Leadership & Management

- Ability to mentor, coach, and grow engineers across different experience levels
 - Experience conducting performance reviews and providing technical feedback
 - Strong ownership of team delivery, timelines, and quality
 - Experience balancing hands-on technical work with people management

Backend & System Architecture Expertise

- Strong proficiency of modern backend architectures, design patterns, and microservices architecture. 
 - Proficiency in at least one server-side programming language (e. g. , Java, Python, etc. )
 - Solid understanding of API design principles and implementation
 - Hands-on experience with relational and non-relational databases and knowledge of data pipelines and data warehousing concepts. 

Technical Competencies

- Strong system design and problem-solving skills
 - Knowledge of caching strategies, performance optimization, and scalability
 - Understanding of data modeling and query optimization
 - Familiarity with search and indexing technologies
 - Understanding of security best practices in backend systems

Culture

- Work with performance-oriented teams driven by ownership and passion. 
 - Learn to design systems for high accuracy, efficiency, and scalability. 
 - No strict deadlines, focus on delivering quality work. 
 - Meritocracy-driven, candid culture. No politics. 
 - Very high visibility regarding which startups and markets are exciting globally. 

(ref: hirist. tech)

Senior Manager, Platform Software Engineering
data.description:
Job Description

Leads one or more platform teams; defines tactical and key strategic elements for middleware evolution serving multiple consumers. Accountable for performance, cost control, and reliability outcomes; escalations for distributed debugging and upgrade safety. Drives significant cross-team improvements to observability, SLOs, and resilience patterns. Engages stakeholders inside and outside the group; socializes migration plans and adoption playbooks. 

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

Platform Software Development: 

- Lead multiple platform teams to standardize middleware patterns and client libraries used by several consumer teams. 
 - Establish group-level guardrails for APIs/SDKs, deprecation strategies, and upgrade playbooks; track adoption and risk. 
 - Sponsor shared observability frameworks and capacity models across teams; review error-budget posture and corrective actions. 

Software Development and Coding - Design, Testing, and Optimization: 

- Leads teams and provides technical recommendations and guidance in designing software solutions and identifying, analyzing and ensuring alignment with requirements. 
 - Manages the execution of processes to develop and guide new software features and enhancements following design specifications, ensuring accessibility, and to develop documents to clarify software design and code. 
 - Leads code and/or functional reviews to drive improvements across a project. 
 - Leads and reviews teams to conduct debugging and troubleshooting to identify and fix software issues across multiple components or functional areas. 
 - Provides teams guidance to implement software testing (e. g. , functional and non-functional), quality assurance processes, software error logging, monitoring, and observability for effective debugging. 
 - Utilizes an analytic approach to conduct performance profiling and optimization of coding. 
 - Leads teams in troubleshooting and resolving issues related to application programming interface (API) functionality and integration. 
 - Leads teams to implement API versioning, lifecycle, and interoperability strategies. 

Software Architecture - Software System Structural Design: 

- Leads teams to design and develop software, systems, and services. 
 - Acts as a role model to provide technical guidance and domain expertise in software architecture decisions and best practices. 
 - Leads teams to conduct periodic reviews and ensures adherence to architectural framework(s) and internal development practices and standards. 
 - Collaborates with cross-functional teams to align and build software architecture with business and/or customer goals and priorities in focus. 
 - Leads teams to implement performance optimization and scalability strategies in software design. 
 - Impacts teams to conduct regular technology research and evaluation for architectural enhancements. 

Issue/Defect Collaboration - Software Products Support: 

- Collaborates with stakeholders and external clients and/or partners to understand customer issues and align solutions. 
 - Leads team(s) to provide technical guidance and appropriately prioritize support to customers regarding reported issues. 
 - Acts as a role model for teams to advocate for customers' interests and suggests product enhancements based on feedback. 
 - Develops, modifies, and executes policies to ensure customer satisfaction through timely resolution of issues and effective communication. 
 - Leads teams through processes for handling customer issues and/or defects handling and directs them to training opportunities as needed. 
 - Manages the investigation and troubleshooting of complex product maintenance issues to ensure customer agreement on short- and long-term solutions. 

Practices and Standards Compliance - Security and Compliance: 

- Collaborates with teams and other stakeholders within and outside of group to establish, follow, and enforce documented security criteria, development industry best practices and processes, and coding standards. 
 - Ensures clarity of teams' operational objectives for adherence to broad acceptance criteria. 
 - Implements moderately complex secure software development practices requiring information gathering and analysis to prevent security vulnerabilities. 

Development Operations - System Maintenance: 

- Leads teams in performing periodic maintenance and testing operations for systems that require upgrading or patching (e. g. , for critical vulnerabilities). 
 - Delegates assignments to teams to implement and evolve standard operating procedures (SOP) for development and for driving improvements, ensuring automation, testing, and debugging of systems to ensure service/product availability, health, support, and reliability. 

Core Responsibilities

Planning & Execution: 

- Manages multiple medium- to large-scale projects or initiatives across teams, ensuring timelines, deliverables, and budgets when applicable are monitored and met. Provides direction to teams on project work, setting priorities, and aligning with business needs. Guides teams on adjusting plans to accommodate resource or timeline changes. 

Collaboration & Partnership: 

- Drives cross-functional partnerships to align expectations and shared objectives across multiple teams. Coaches team members to develop strategic relationships with business leaders, stakeholders, and external partners to foster collaboration and long-term success. Promotes inclusivity by actively seeking and listening to diverse perspectives, ensuring others feel heard and respected. 

Problem Solving: 

- Provides direction to multiple teams on addressing complex operational and/or technical issues as well as providing guidance on analyzing complex data and/or information to identify solutions. Reviews and provides insights into unresolved or critical issues, helping the team to identify potential solutions. 

Continuous Learning: 

- Models engaging in continuous learning to deepen expertise and stay ahead of industry trends, integrating best practices into strategic planning. Leverages feedback to drive personal and team skill improvements. Identifies skill gaps across teams, and empowers team members to pursue learning and knowledge sharing opportunities that build their expertise in new areas and coaches them to apply learnings to advance the organization. 

Continuous Improvement: 

- Drives team to collaborate on, develop, and implement ideas to increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows within and across teams, providing oversight. Guides team to adopt new ideas for alternative approaches and methods and encourages feedback for continued improvement. 

Performance and Development: 

- Drives performance across teams by providing feedback and coaching in alignment with performance management processes, guidelines, and expectations. Discusses development goals with team members, shares opportunities to facilitate career development, and ensures individual goals are aligned with broader organizational goals. Develops and manages talent acquisition pipeline by leading candidate interviews, monitoring promotion eligibility, and/or orchestrating talent resources. 

About Us

Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives. 

True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That's why we're committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs. 

We're committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation-request_mb@oracle. com or by calling 1-888-404-2494 in the United States. 

Oracle is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans' status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Oracle will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.

data.title: Senior Platform Software Engineer
data.description:
Job Description

Owns moderately complex components within platform services or SDKs; leads team-level improvements to integration frameworks and developer tooling. Performs deep debugging across a bounded set of distributed services, driving fixes that protect downstream consumers and upgrade paths. Analyzes usage, performance, and error budgets for specific platform surfaces; implements targeted resilience and capacity optimizations. Authors and curates team-scoped documentation, samples, and adoption guidance. 

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

Platform Software Development: 

- Own a bounded platform component (service module, SDK area) and evolve its contracts for multi-tenant use. 
 - Perform deep debugging across a limited-service graph; drive compatibility-safe remediation plans. 
 - Implement targeted resilience/capacity patterns and document adoption guidance for team consumers. 

Software Development and Coding - Design, Testing, and Optimization: 

- Designs software solutions and analyzes and helps identify requirements to achieve business and operational goals, independently. 
 - Adheres to and suggests improvements to all phases of the software development lifecycle. 
 - Utilizes working knowledge to develop new software features and enhancements following design specifications and develops documents to clarify software design and code. 
 - Leads code reviews in designated areas to help drive improvements. 
 - Conducts debugging and troubleshooting to identify and fix moderately complex software issues. Develops fixes for identified issues. 
 - Implements software testing (e. g. , functional and non-functional testing), quality assurance processes, software error logging, monitoring, and observability for effective debugging, ensuring review by manager and/or lead throughout the process. 
 - Exercises judgment and discretion to conduct performance profiling and optimization of coding. 
 - Troubleshoots and resolves moderately complex issues related to application programming interface (API) functionality and integration. 
 - Implements moderately complex API versioning, lifecycle, and interoperability strategies. 

Software Architecture - Software System Structural Design: 

- Designs and develops software, systems, and services aligned to pre-defined system architecture. 
 - Develops working knowledge of software architecture decisions and best practices. 
 - Collaborates with team leads to review work to ensure alignment with software architecture. 
 - Implements moderately complex performance optimization and scalability strategies in software design. 

Issue/Defect Collaboration - Software Products Support: 

- Collaborates within and beyond immediate team to understand customer issues and align solutions. 
 - May provide technical guidance and support to customers regarding customer-reported issues, independently. 
 - Coaches, mentors, and guides others to advocate for customers' interests and suggests product enhancements based on feedback. 
 - Influences team to ensure customer satisfaction through timely resolution of issues and effective communication. 
 - Implements customer issue and/or defect handling and training processes, independently. 
 - Investigates and troubleshoots complex product maintenance issues to ensure customer agreement on short- and long-term solutions (e. g. , future enhancements). 

Practices and Standards Compliance - Security and Compliance: 

- Collaborates with the team to establish and follow development practices and coding standards. 
 - Exercises judgment and discretion to ensure code quality and adherence to broad acceptance criteria during development. 
 - Keeps up to date with industry best practices and applies them to software development processes. 
 - Implements secure coding practices to prevent security vulnerabilities. 

Development Operations - System Maintenance: 

- Performs periodic maintenance and testing operations for systems that require upgrading or patching (e. g. , for critical vulnerabilities). 
 - Exercises judgment and discretion to drive improvements, ensure automation, testing, and debugging of systems to ensure service/product availability, health, support, and reliability. 

Core Responsibilities

Planning & Execution: 

- Independently manages work, monitoring timelines and deliverables to ensure projects or initiatives stay on track and meet requirements. Proactively prioritizes work and adapts to resource or timeline shifts, suggesting adjustments to maintain project efficiency. 

Collaboration & Partnership: 

- Collaborates across teams to align on expectations and achieve shared objectives. Builds and maintains a comprehensive understanding of business, stakeholder, and/or customer needs to build and support effective partnerships. Actively listens to diverse perspectives and asks questions to ensure understanding of others. 

Problem Solving: 

- Independently identifies and addresses standard and non-standard issues in accordance with standard practices, escalating more complex issues as appropriate. Analyzes data and/or information from multiple sources to troubleshoot standard and non-standard errors. Contributes to knowledge sharing and best practices. 

Continuous Learning: 

- Embraces continuous learning by actively seeking to build knowledge and new skills and/or tools and staying current with industry trends and best practices. Seeks out and leverages feedback and training to improve skills. Contributes to a culture of continuous learning and knowledge sharing with team members. 

Continuous Improvement: 

- Develops ideas and recommends updates to increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows within a team. Seeks input from team members on alternative approaches and methods for improving work. 

About Us

Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives. 

True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That's why we're committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs. 

We're committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation-request_mb@oracle. com or by calling 1-888-404-2494 in the United States. 

Oracle is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans' status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Oracle will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.

data.title: Sr. Staff Software Engineer, Embedded & Edge AI
data.description:
Description

Synaptics is leading the charge in AI at the Edge, bringing AI closer to end users and transforming how we engage with intelligent connected devices, whether at home, at work, or on the move. As the go-to partner for the world's most forward-thinking product innovators, Synaptics powers the future with its cutting-edge Synaptics AstraTM AI-Native embedded compute, VerosTM wireless connectivity, and multimodal sensing solutions. We're making the digital experience smarter, faster, more intuitive, secure, and seamless. From touch, display, and biometrics to AI-driven wireless connectivity, video, vision, audio, speech, and security processing, Synaptics is the force behind the next generation of technology enhancing how we live, work, and play. 

Overview

Synaptics is looking for talented Sr. Staff Software Engineer to join our dynamic and growing organization. You will be responsible for the software development for Synaptics Astra® SL Series of Embedded processors. The Astra® SL Series is a family of highly integrated AI-native Linux SoCs optimized for multi-modal Consumer and Industrial IoT workloads with high-performance hardware accelerators for edge-based inferencing, security, graphics, vision and audio. These processors incorporate multiple high-performance compute engines including a quad-core Arm64 CPU subsystem, multi-TOPS NPU, GPU for AI-acceleration and 3D Graphics, along with multimedia accelerators for Image Signal Processing, 4K video encode and decode, backed by industry-grade security certifications. This position reports to the Director, Software Engineering. 

Responsibilities & Competencies

Job Duties

- Develop device drivers for GPU/Display/Camera as well as the Media/Camera/Graphics framework for our Astra processor series 
 - Development of bare metal drivers for pre and post silicon bring up 
 - Provide technical leadership and mentorship on various Software lifecycle components including requirements analysis, design, implementation, qualification, and production release 
 - Participate in design reviews, documentation, and process improvements to ensure quality and efficiency 
 - This is an exciting opportunity to be a part of a large team around the world working to create revolutionary products

Competencies

- Solid understanding of software system architecture 
 - Excellent skills in C/C++ programming 
 - Excellent knowledge of Linux system programming and kernel drivers
 - Proactive, self-starter, able to work independently in a fast-paced environment to complete projects on time with minimal guidance
 - Well organized with strong attention to detail; proactively ensures work is accurate
 - Positive attitude and work ethic; unafraid to ask questions and explore new ideas 
 - Resourceful and able to solve complex problems through adaptation of existing technology and investigation of new technology with a solid understanding of product architecture
 - Analytical and able to make informed decisions based on experience 
 - Sets clear expectations and objectives, and brings parties together to drive key initiatives
 - Ability to work within a diverse team and mentor developing team members 
 - Excellent verbal and written communication skills 
 - Strong collaboration skills, with the ability to influence technical decisions across engineering teams

Qualifications (Requirements)

- Bachelor's degree (Master's preferred) in CSE/ECE or related field or equivalent 
 - 12+ years of relevant industry experience 
 - 8+ years of experience working with embedded firmware/hardware 
 - Expertise with systems analysis, profiling, and low-level debugging with ability to interpret and isolate root causes 
 - Experience in trusted software development in Secure OS/TEE 
 - Strong development experience with device drivers, including Display, GPU, Audio, and Camera drivers 
 - Demonstrated knowledge of display, graphics, multimedia, including Display, GPU, MIPI, Audio, and Camera ISP subsystems 
 - Experience with Linux Display, Graphics, Video, and Audio subsystems, including OpenGL, Framebuffer driver, DRM/KMS, V4L2, and ALSA 
 - Proven proficiency with Linux graphics stack (Wayland, EGL, X11, Qt5 / Qt6 and QML) 
 - Experience developing and integrating Media framework (Gstreamer/OpenMax) 
 - No travel required

Belief in Diversity

Synaptics is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to workforce diversity. Qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, color, age, religion, protected veteran or disability status, or genetic information. 

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

data.title: Propulsion Systems Engineer, Engine Test & Acceptance
data.description:
About Astrobase Space Technologies

Astrobase Space Technologies is an early-stage Bengaluru company building a two-stage orbital launch vehicle. Our engine is a LOX-methane full-flow staged-combustion engine. The Astrobase Propulsion team is looking for experienced and passionate professionals who can own the vehicle's stage fluid and propulsion systems from design to flight. 

Key Responsibilities

- Write engine and component test plans and procedures: proof and leak checks, functional and valve-timing checks, water and LN2 flow tests, and hot-fire runs. 
 - Set test objectives, test matrices, redlines and abort criteria with the cycle and controls engineers; chair test readiness reviews. 
 - Define the test-article configuration, stand interfaces and instrumentation list (pressure, temperature, flow, vibration, high-speed channels); verify calibration and channel checkout before each run. 
 - Interface with system specialists and bring engine to test stand; conduct and own test process. 
 - Review data against pre-test predictions after every run; issue quick-look and final test reports. 
 - Lead anomaly investigations to root cause and verified corrective action; disposition test-related nonconformances at MRB. 
 - Assess every engineering change for its effect on completed test and acceptance evidence, and decide what must be repeated. 
 - Write the engine acceptance test specification; maintain as-tested against as-built records and compile the acceptance data package and certificate of conformity for each flight engine. 

DESIRED QUALIFICATION

- B. E. /B. Tech/M. E. /M. Tech in Mechanical or Aerospace Engineering. 
 - Min. 5+ years in liquid rocket engine or propulsion component testing. 
 - Has written and run test procedures on a cryogenic stand (LOX, LN2, LCH4 or LH2). 
 - Has led an anomaly investigation through to a closed corrective action. 
 - Instrumentation and DAQ: transducer selection, calibration traceability, sample rates and filtering. 
 - Python or MATLAB for test-data reduction. 

Preferred Qualification

- Has accepted and delivered flight propulsion hardware under AS9100D, including AS9102 first-article inspection. 
 - Oxygen-service cleaning and compatibility (ASTM G93, IEST-STD-CC1246, NASA-STD-6001). 
 - Pressure-system safety on test stands (ASME B31. 3, NASA-STD-8719. 17). 
 - Liquid rocket engine qualification and acceptance practice (SMC-S-016; Aerospace TR-RS-2023-00026). 
 - Turbopump-fed or staged-combustion engine test experience. 
 - Stand sequencing and automated redline logic. 

What We Offer

- Salary: ₹24-36 LPA fixed CTC, variable pay based on experience and role fitment. 
 - Attractive early-stage stock options (ESOPs). 
 - Group health insurance: employee, spouse, children and parents. 
 - Insurance: term-life and personal-accident cover. 
 - Work environment: Challenging, stimulating, research-driven work solving rocket problems every day with a great team. We have a good time, and unlimited coffee. 

WHY WORK WITH US?

At Astrobase, We Believe In The Power Of Human Ingenuity And Collaboration To Push The Boundaries Of Space Exploration. As a Team Member, You'll Be

- Creating History: Join us in developing cutting-edge launch vehicles, playing a pivotal role in transforming space access and shaping the future of space exploration. 
 - Collaborating with Experts: Work alongside ISRO scientists and industry veterans with decades of experience in designing India's iconic space missions like Chandrayaan 3
 - Growth Opportunities: As Astrobase scales, you'll have the chance to take on leadership roles and be part of an expanding organization driving change in the Indian space sector. 
 - Pioneering Space Technology: Your contributions will not only impact Astrobase but also influence the global space ecosystem. Be part of something larger than yourself. 

Astrobase is an equal-opportunity employer; we hire on skills, merit and experience. Apply with your CV and a short note on combustion hardware you have designed, built or tested.

data.title: Head of PBU - Vantage AI
data.description:
About Us

Head of Product Business Unit, Anchanto Vantage AI

Anchanto | Pune, India | Reports to the Chief Executive Officer | Unit of 10 to 30 people, growing with each bet

About Anchanto

Anchanto is an e-commerce and supply chain technology company headquartered in Singapore, with offices in twelve countries across Asia Pacific, the Middle East and Europe and its largest engineering center in Pune. Brands, retailers and logistics service providers use our purpose built SaaS products to run and scale their e-commerce and omnichannel operations: Order Management, Warehouse Management, Anchanto Grid with more than 200 ready integrations to marketplaces, carriers and enterprise systems, Parcel Tracking, Control Tower and Operations Experience. Our AI enabled agentic services, launching soon, help customers run their commerce operations with less manual work and faster decisions. More than 360 enterprise customers, including L'OrÃ©al, Panasonic, EstÃ©e Lauder, DKSH, Toll and Bosch, process over 200 million orders a year through Anchanto across more than 700 warehouses. Anchanto is an Asendia portfolio company. 

THE UNIT

Anchanto Vantage AI is the data, intelligence and economics business of Anchanto, and the Product Business Unit that builds our new products. Every customer runs their operation on our software, so we hold the most complete operational and financial data they have: orders, inventory, fulfilment events, carrier performance, marketplace performance, settlements and cost to serve, correlated in one place. Vantage AI is built on that asset. It owns the central data layer across every Anchanto product and the products that monetize it: data access for enterprise data and AI teams through MCP, connectors and streaming; operational, business and market insights; Anchanto Settle and Anchanto E-commerce Economics, the financial operations and economics products for e-commerce, starting with marketplace settlement reconciliation and extending to cost to serve, channel contribution and the financial health of the operation; and agentic decisioning for e-commerce and supply chain, where the system sees the stock out, the SLA breach or the margin leak before the customer does and acts or recommends the action. 

A Product Business Unit (PBU) at Anchanto is Product Management and Engineering for one business, brought together as a single threaded organization with one head, one backlog and one set of priorities. This unit is different from the other PBUs in one respect: it takes bets. It builds more than one new product, runs each through stage gates, and either spins it out as its own PBU or closes it on evidence. The first bet in build is Anchanto Settle and E-commerce Economics; the data foundation and the agentic products follow. 

THE ROLE

You build a product business from the data Anchanto already holds. You set where each product goes, build it with your own product and engineering team, take it to the first paying customers with the revenue teams, and answer for what it earns. This is not a pure product management role and it is not a data platform role: you lead the engineers who build the data layer and the products on it, you own the technical quality of what ships, and you are measured on outcomes, not activities. It is also not a role that protects its bets. You propose them, you fund them against a gate, and you close the ones that fail. 

WHAT YOU OWN: STRATEGY, ROADMAP, ENGINEERING, BETS AND RESULTS

- Product strategy. For each product in the unit you know the market, the buyer and the competitors better than anyone in the company, set the strategy and the positioning ambition with the industry research leaders, and give the CROs your input on pricing, packaging and the entitlement model (included, paid module, download and page level) before anything is built. 
 - The portfolio of bets. You propose which products the unit builds, in what order, with what envelope and against what gate. Each bet moves through the same gates: problem validated with named design partners; first paying customer; ten paying customers; gross margin at scale; then spin out as its own PBU or close. You take the close decision yourself and put it in writing with the evidence. 
 - The data foundation. The central data lake and pipelines from every Anchanto product, the warehouse model, shard discipline, access and entitlement, and the MCP, connector and streaming layer that gives enterprise customers their data back. Nothing above it works without it, so it is built first and kept to an internal SLA for every other unit that consumes it. 
 - Roadmap, decisions and execution. One backlog per bet; what gets built, in what order and how; technical design within the architecture and security guardrails; release decisions; and whether a product can meet a scope and a date. Customer priorities and asks on live products come to you from the Delivery team, your internal customer. 
 - The way we build. Specs based, AI assisted engineering from the first line of code. Two pizza teams per bet, forward deployed engineers with design partners, built on Anchanto Grid and the Vantage data layer rather than on new plumbing. A bet does not get its own infrastructure. 
 - Results and people. The unit's P&L and the spend envelope of each bet; reliability and customer satisfaction for live products; unit structure, hiring, promotions and the final interview of every person joining the unit. Your people are not a bench for other units; a transfer out of the unit is your decision. 

CUSTOMERS, DESIGN PARTNERS AND THE REVENUE TEAMS

This is not a sales role and carries no quota. The CROs set market priorities, the go to market and what and how each product is sold; the revenue teams own the customer connect and close every deal. A 0 to 1 unit needs discovery, so the rule here is wider than in the other units: you run design partner and discovery conversations with enterprise data teams, finance teams and operations leaders, with the account owner in the room and informed before and after, and you bring the revenue teams the product story, the demos and the answers. You never price, negotiate or close alone, and you never go around the account owner to reach a customer. 

How You Manage Your People

- Every person in the unit has written objectives and two or three KPIs for the quarter, reviewed monthly; nobody is without them thirty days after joining. Everyone in the unit is full time on the unit; nobody works on Vantage on the side of another job. 
 - Feedback is direct, factual and given within the week, in writing when it matters. 
 - You represent the company to your team, not the team to the company. Management debt, wrong decisions, undelivered feedback and unaddressed interpersonal issues, is fixed within thirty days of knowing about it. 
 - Performance is measured against objectives, not effort or tenure. An underperformer gets a written plan and a date; if it passes you take the decision yourself, including exit. People are confirmed and promoted only after a documented assessment and a direct conversation. 
 - The unit reports in numbers, weekly in writing and monthly in the outcome review. 
 - You talk to your N-1, your N-2 and every individual contributor, with skip level one to ones at least quarterly, and the unit runs on a written meeting cadence you publish in your first thirty days and keep. 

OWNING CUSTOMER ESCALATIONS

An escalation on a live product of the unit is yours from the moment it is raised until the customer confirms it is closed. You do not trivialize it, and you do not expect the CEO or the CROs to lead it. You own the fix and the communication: first written update within the hour, a fixed written cadence until closed, root cause and corrective action within five working days after. For the data layer, an outage or a data quality failure felt by another unit's customer is your escalation too. 

How You Are Measured

You own outcomes, not activities. Products without customers cannot be judged on retention and margin yet, so the outputs below are built for a unit that takes bets. You run the unit on five to eight controllable input metrics that you propose, prove move the outputs, and review every week. Numbers are baselined in your first month and verified by Finance. 

- Gate progress

Each bet against the gate committed in the quarterly plan: design partners signed, first paying customer, ten paying customers, gross margin at scale; bets closed on evidence count as progress, bets kept alive without evidence do not. 

- Time to revenue and ARR per bet

Months from start to first paying customer; ARR, net revenue retention and churn per product once live; deals unblocked or lost on product capability. 

- Data foundation

Products connected to the central data layer, data freshness and quality, enterprise customers on MCP, connector or streaming access, internal SLA met for the other units. 

- Time to market

Weeks from bet approved to a product early adopters can use; weeks from first build to first paying customer; early adopters signed and live with the revenue and account management teams each quarter; planned versus actual on the quarterly plan with variances explained in writing. 

- Reliability and customer satisfaction

Availability, incidents and time to resolve, data quality incidents, escalations by count, root cause and time to close, NPS or CSAT on live products. 

- AI leverage and AI first approach

Share of work built specs based and AI assisted, automation percentage by activity, and whether every product is designed AI first and agentic rather than as a dashboard. 

- Team EPS and health

Team EPS score, attrition and regretted attrition, skills coverage, and whether the unit runs without you in the room. 

PLANNING AND CADENCE

You write the product plan for the unit as a portfolio: which bets, the thesis and the buyer of each, the envelope, the gate and the date it is reviewed. The annual plan each October is a six page narrative with targets and resource scenarios. Four weeks before each quarter you write a ninety day plan derived from both, presented to and aligned with the leadership team; execution is measured against it. Weekly unit review on the inputs in writing, monthly outcome review with the CEO, quarterly gate review per bet, and a review of the two or three CEO goals for the unit. 

Skills And Prior Experience

Must haves for every candidate. Candidates without all of these will not be shortlisted. 

- At least fifteen years of industry experience, and at least one product taken personally from zero to paying customers in B2B SaaS, fintech or commerce technology, with accountability for its results. 
 - Global experience. Has worked in, and built or run operations outside India, with customers or teams in more than one country. India only experience does not qualify. 
 - Education. Engineering from IIT or NIT, or an MBA from IIM or a top ranked global business school. 
 - Data and AI products. Has built or run a product whose value is data, analytics or AI driven decisions, and can sit with an enterprise data team and a finance team in the same week and be credible with both. 
 - Domain. E-commerce, marketplaces, logistics or supply chain, or the finance and operations functions they serve. 
 - Decides and manages directly. Makes the call quickly, takes the trade off and answers for the outcome; has closed a product or a project of their own on evidence; has set objectives for every person, given hard feedback in time, taken exit decisions personally and owned the communication in a customer crisis. 

Career paths we are open to. Nobody arrives with product, technology, data and business skills at the same depth, so we hire from four paths and test for the second skill in each. 

- Technology or data leader with product skills. CTO, Director of Engineering, Head of Data or equivalent who has built, released and commercialized data or AI systems, and has also owned a roadmap, met the market and made product trade offs. 
 - Product leader with technology depth. Head of Product for a data, analytics, fintech or commerce product in B2B SaaS, who has led or closely directed engineering and has shipped and commercialized what they defined. 
 - Operations or finance practitioner from a large 3PL, retailer, brand or marketplace. Has run e-commerce finance, settlements, supply chain or fulfilment operations at scale and has specified, bought or built the data and systems behind it well enough to direct a product team. 
 - Consultant or transformation leader. Head of a data, analytics, supply chain or commerce practice who has delivered data platforms, decisioning systems and operating models for clients end to end rather than advised from the side. 

In every path the second skill must be shown with specific examples. This role is not a data platform lead with a product manager reporting in, a BI or reporting manager, an innovation lab head who demonstrates but does not sell, a product leader who hands execution to someone else, a second sales channel to the customer, or a union leader for the team. Compensation: fixed salary, variable pay tied to the scorecard, and long term incentives; details shared with shortlisted candidates. 

Benefits Why Join Anchanto

At Anchanto, we believe in creating an environment where people can build meaningful careers, continuously develop their capabilities and gain exposure to a truly global business. 

- Global Exposure: Work with diverse teams, customers and stakeholders across international markets and gain experience in a global B2B SaaS environment. 
 - Learning & Development: We invest in our people through sponsored learning, certifications and development opportunities aligned with your professional growth. 
 - International & Onsite Opportunities: Client-facing roles may offer opportunities to travel and work onsite with customers across our global markets. 
 - Medical Insurance: Comprehensive medical insurance coverage to support your health and well-being. 
 - Comprehensive Leave Benefits: Maternity, Paternity, Marriage and Bereavement leave, along with Comp Off and flexibility to support important personal commitments. 
 - Recognition for Long-Term Contribution: Tenured employees are eligible for additional monetary benefits, extra paid leave and company-sponsored paid vacations as part of our commitment to recognising long-term contribution. 
 - Flexibility & Work-Life Balance: A supportive and flexible work environment that enables employees to manage professional responsibilities alongside personal priorities. 
 - Meaningful Career Growth: Take ownership of challenging, high-impact work and contribute to products and solutions that serve global brands, retailers and logistics businesses.

Amex GBT is a place where colleagues find inspiration in travel as a force for good and - through their work - can make an impact on our industry. We're here to help our colleagues achieve success and offer an inclusive and collaborative culture where your voice is valued. 

This role focuses on designing and maintaining enterprise Java services within distributed architectures. You'll work across the full development lifecycle-from API design and Spring Boot development to deployment automation and production support-while collaborating with cross-functional teams in AWS and Linux environments. 

What You'll Do

- Build, develop, and maintain Java-based services/APIs (REST/SOAP) and SOA/web services in a distributed, multi-tier architecture, managing XML and JSON data exchanges. 
 - Develop and maintain Spring Boot applications with containerized deployments on Docker, Tomcat, and OpenShift using strong Unix/Linux operational skills. 
 - Support and implement integrations using Kafka and various queuing or messaging approaches. 
 - Work with relational databases (Postgres, SQL Server) and NoSQL databases, including XML data handling, schema design, and query optimization. 
 - Participate in or lead Java migration/upgrade efforts (JDK 8/11 → JDK 17), ensuring compatibility, performance, and security. 
 - Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines and automation (Maven builds, GitHub workflows, Jenkins jobs, artifact publishing to Nexus). 
 - Integrate with communication platforms including SMS providers (Syniverse/Twilio), email delivery platforms (SparkPost), and security integrations (Proofpoint/DMARC). 
 - Collaborate with multi-functional teams to develop clear user documentation and communicate status, risks, and build decisions. 
 - Fix and support applications across multiple runtime environments and deployment platforms. 
 - Mentor team members and contribute to continuous improvement of development practices and architecture standards. 

What We're Looking For

- 5+ years of extensive hands-on Java development experience, including JDK 11 and/or JDK 17 (beyond Java 8), with strong object-oriented design and coding skills. 
 - Experience building and integrating APIs and services using REST, SOAP/Web Services, SOA, XML, and JSON data formats. 
 - Advanced XML transformation experience with XSLT programming skills. 
 - 4+ years of experience in Node. js development experience with working knowledge of JavaScript and related technologies. 
 - Knowledge of distributed systems concepts including multi-tier architecture, algorithms, and messaging/queuing patterns. 
 - Hands-on experience with CI/CD tooling (Maven, GitHub, Jenkins, Nexus or equivalent) along with applied Unix/Linux command knowledge for production troubleshooting. 
 - Experience with application servers (Apache Tomcat) and containerization platforms (Docker and OpenShift). 
 - Demonstrated ability to work across multiple databases including relational (Postgres, SQL Server) and NoSQL solutions. 
 - Experience integrating with SMS and email communication platforms, including delivery callbacks, templates, compliance, and security protocols. 
 - Strong communication and collaboration skills with ability to document technical decisions and manage cross-functional projects. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Direct experience on JDK migration projects (JDK 8/11 → JDK 17) including compatibility, dependency upgrades, testing, and performance tuning. 
 - Production-level expertise with Kafka (streams, consumer groups, retries/DLQ patterns, schema evolution) and hands-on experience with SMS/email platform integrations (Syniverse, Twilio, SparkPost, Proofpoint/DMARC).

About Gartner IT: 

Join a world-class team of skilled engineers who build creative digital solutions to support our colleagues and clients. We make a broad organizational impact by delivering cutting-edge technology solutions that power Gartner. Gartner IT values its culture of nonstop innovation, an outcome-driven approach to success, and the notion that great ideas can come from anyone on the team. 

About this role: 

Director, Quality Assurance will directly manage QA team and will provide leadership in the development of test strategies, design, build, review, execution, and automation of test cases. 

What you will do: 

The responsibilities include, but are not limited to the following: 

- Develop and implement a comprehensive, long-term Quality Assurance and Quality Engineering strategy that aligns with the company's goals and growth plans. 
 - Establish and enforce QA best practices, processes, and standards across teams, covering functional, non-functional, performance, and security testing. 
 - Define and monitor Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) and metrics to assess the effectiveness of QA initiatives, providing actionable insights and reports to senior leadership. 
 - Lead the integration of AI/ML technologies into testing frameworks to optimize outcomes, enhance efficiency, and increase test coverage. 
 - Champion a culture of innovation, encouraging the exploration of new AI/ML techniques and methodologies within the QE teams. 
 - Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing, cross-functional team of QA engineers, automation specialists

What You Will Need

Strong IT professional with 11-16 years of experience in software testing (websites and/or mobile applications). The candidate should have strong qualitative and quantitative critical thinking skills along with high on ownership and accountability. 

Must have:

data.title: Tech Lead
data.description:
Job Description - Technical Lead

Company: MAKO IT

Experience: 3-6 Years

Location: Chennai - Work from Office

Shift: 2: 00 PM - 11: 00 PM IST

Employment Type: Full-Time

Career Path: Technical Lead → Senior Technical Lead → Solution Architect

About The Role

We are looking for a highly motivated and hands-on Technical Lead to join our SaaS Integration & Solutions team. 

The ideal candidate should have strong technical expertise in API integrations, backend development, and solution design, along with the ability to lead projects and develop a high-performing engineering team. 

This position offers a clear growth opportunity toward a Solution Architect role, where the individual will progressively take responsibility for designing scalable integration solutions, making architectural decisions, and driving technical excellence. 

A key expectation is to build and develop a team of engineers, including fresh graduates, through structured training, mentorship, technical guidance, and hands-on project exposure. 

Key Responsibilities

- Technical Leadership & Integration Development
 - Design, develop, and maintain integrations between enterprise SaaS applications. 
 - Work extensively with REST APIs, webhooks, authentication protocols, and data synchronization. 
 - Develop backend services and custom integration solutions using Python and/or Node. js. 
 - Lead technical discovery, requirement analysis, estimation, development, testing, and deployment. 
 - Troubleshoot complex integration issues and provide sustainable technical solutions. 
 - Maintain high coding standards, conduct code reviews, and implement engineering best practices. 
 - Develop reusable integration components, connectors, and frameworks. 
 - Solution Architecture & Technical Growth
 - Gradually take ownership of end-to-end integration solution architecture. 
 - Translate complex business requirements into scalable and maintainable technical designs. 
 - Prepare solution architecture documents, API specifications, integration workflows, and technical diagrams. 
 - Evaluate alternative integration approaches based on scalability, security, performance, and maintainability. 
 - Identify opportunities to standardize and automate integration development. 
 - Collaborate with senior leadership on architectural decisions and technical improvements. 
 - Develop the technical and business understanding required to progress into a Solution Architect role. 
 - Team Building & Fresher Development
 - Build and develop a capable team of integration engineers. 
 - Actively participate in technical interviews, fresher hiring, and candidate evaluations. 
 - Design structured onboarding and technical training programs for fresh graduates. 
 - Mentor junior engineers in Python, APIs, integration concepts, coding standards, and debugging. 
 - Create practical assignments, learning milestones, and technical assessments. 
 - Gradually transition trained freshers into independent project contributors. 
 - Conduct regular technical reviews, knowledge-sharing sessions, and performance feedback discussions. 
 - Identify future technical leaders within the team and support their professional growth. 
 - Build a team culture focused on ownership, continuous learning, and technical excellence. 
 - Project Delivery & Ownership
 - Independently manage multiple integration projects from initiation to successful delivery. 
 - Prepare accurate technical estimates, implementation plans, and delivery timelines. 
 - Allocate technical tasks based on team capabilities and project priorities. 
 - Monitor project execution, identify risks, and resolve technical dependencies. 
 - Ensure quality deliverables, appropriate documentation, and timely project closure. 
 - Take complete ownership of technical escalations and issue resolution. 
 - Establish repeatable delivery practices to improve consistency and productivity. 
 - Customer Communication & Solution Consulting
 - Participate in technical discovery sessions and discussions with international customers. 
 - Understand customer business processes and recommend suitable integration solutions. 
 - Conduct solution walkthroughs, technical demonstrations, and implementation discussions. 
 - Communicate technical dependencies, challenges, and project progress proactively. 
 - Collaborate with implementation managers, project managers, and customer success teams. 
 - Build customer confidence through technical expertise, accountability, and effective communication. 

Required Technical Skills

Must-Have

- 5-8 years of software development experience with strong exposure to enterprise SaaS integrations. 
 - Strong hands-on experience in Python and/or Node. js. 
 - Excellent knowledge of REST APIs, webhooks, JSON, OAuth 2. 0, and authentication mechanisms. 
 - Experience with third-party system integrations, data mapping, and synchronization. 
 - Strong understanding of backend architecture, databases, and integration design patterns. 
 - Experience independently designing and delivering technical solutions. 
 - Strong debugging, troubleshooting, and analytical skills. 
 - Experience guiding junior engineers or mentoring developers. 
 - Good English communication skills and confidence in customer-facing technical discussions. 
 - Ability to manage multiple parallel technical projects. 

Good-to-Have

- Experience with Workato, MuleSoft, Zapier, Make, or similar iPaaS platforms. 
 - Experience with enterprise SaaS applications such as Salesforce, HubSpot, Jira, or ServiceNow. 
 - Knowledge of AWS/Azure, Docker, and CI/CD. 
 - Experience developing reusable connectors, SDKs, and integration frameworks. 
 - Familiarity with AI-assisted software development and workflow automation. 
 - Experience designing training programs or mentoring fresh graduates. 
 - Exposure to SaaS implementation, professional services, or customer onboarding projects. 

Leadership Expectations

- Strong hands-on technical contributor with a leadership mindset. 
 - Willingness and ability to recruit, train, and develop freshers. 
 - Ability to build a self-sufficient integration engineering team. 
 - Strong ownership of customer commitments and technical delivery. 
 - Proactive approach to solving problems and improving processes. 
 - Interest in learning system architecture and growing into a Solution Architect position. 
 - Ability to balance coding, mentoring, customer communication, and project responsibilities. 

Growth Opportunities

This role provides a structured progression toward Solution Architect responsibilities. 

Initial Phase - Technical Leadership

- Own integration development and technical project delivery. 
 - Establish development standards and reusable integration practices. 
 - Mentor freshers and develop their technical capabilities. 

Growth Phase - Team & Solution Ownership

- Build a capable team that can independently execute integration projects. 
 - Lead increasingly complex solution designs. 
 - Improve technical estimation, scalability, and integration architecture. 

Future Phase - Solution Architect

- Own end-to-end technical architecture across integration projects. 
 - Define reusable solution patterns, technical standards, and frameworks. 
 - Guide multiple engineering teams on architecture and technical decisions. 
 - Collaborate with business and delivery leadership on complex customer solutions. 

Required Skills

Solution Design Python REST API SaaS Integrations Customer-Facing API Integration Technical Lead Technical Project Delivery

If you are looking for a challenging and exciting career in the world of technology, then look no further. Position Overview

The IC Validation team leads all post-silicon activities, including chip bring-up, validation, and characterization of new timing devices. You will play a key role in our New Product Introduction (NPI) cycle, as our products cross from pre-silicon design to post-silicon validation to ensure exceptional product quality and performance. We seek candidates who demonstrate a passion for learning, initiative, curiosity, and engineering ingenuity. A positive attitude and a strong disposition for teamwork are essential.

 - Lead the design and development of high-speed PCBs (EEVBs), including discrete analog circuits, used for validation and characterization. 
 - Assemble and maintain test setups in the laboratory to support validation and characterization. 
 - Define, develop, and/or acquire software and/or hardware tools in support of silicon test efforts. 
 - Develop automation scripts to automate data collection, decrease data collection times, ensure repeatable measurements, and generate reports. 
 - Own post-processing the characterization data, conducting a detailed analysis (we use JMP for this purpose), and then reviewing the analyzed data with the IC design and marketing teams. 

Required Experience And Skills

- Bachelor's in Electrical Engineering with 8+ years of relevant experience, or a Master's with 6 years of experience. 
 - Strong EE fundamentals; experience with PLLs, synthesizers, and jitter strongly preferred
 - Background in validation, test, or characterization of IC devices
 - Extensive hands-on experience with lab instrumentation (oscilloscopes, signal generators, spectrum/phase noise analyzers, power supplies, etc. )
 - Ability to troubleshoot and debug hardware and software
 - Experience developing automated test systems and validation infrastructure

The Opportunity

We are looking for a Staff Software Engineer to shape the systems that give Hinge Health care-team members a clear, actionable view of the people they support. Member Records is the care-team-facing context layer within CareHub: it brings together member history, clinical context, active programs, program focus, indications, device and fulfillment status, onboarding progress, and program transitions so care teams can spend less time navigating fragmented systems and more time delivering personalized care. 

As a hands-on technical leader, you will help define the architecture and technical direction for Member Records while continuing to build production software. You will work across the user interface, backend services, APIs, and data models, partnering with Product, Design, Clinical, Quality, and adjacent engineering teams. You will turn complex healthcare workflows into reliable, intuitive experiences and lead work from discovery and technical design through implementation, launch, and operational support. 

This is an opportunity to own a meaningful product area end to end, influence technical decisions beyond your immediate team, and raise the quality, reliability, and effectiveness of the systems and engineers around you. 

What You'll Accomplish

- Lead the architecture and end-to-end delivery of complex, cross-service Member Records initiatives-from discovery through production-bringing clarity to ambiguous requirements, dependencies, and trade-offs. 
 - Set and advance a multi-quarter technical direction for Member Records in partnership with engineering and product leadership. 
 - Establish durable technical patterns for APIs, domain models, integrations, testing, observability, and secure handling of member data. 
 - Mentor and support junior engineers, providing thoughtful code reviews and real-time pairing. 
 - Integrate and leverage AI technologies to automate processes and enhance product features. 
 - Raise the engineering bar through high-quality design and code reviews, pairing, mentoring, hiring participation, and coaching other engineers toward greater technical ownership. 
 - Strengthen operational ownership by defining meaningful health metrics, improving incident response, and addressing root causes rather than symptoms. 

Hinge Health Hybrid Model

We believe that remote work and in-person work have their own advantages and disadvantages, and we want to be able to leverage the best of both worlds. Employees in hybrid roles are required to be in the office 3 days/week. 

This is a Bengaluru-based role that involves regular interaction and collaboration with Hinge Health colleagues in San Francisco, CA. 

- Time zones: San Francisco is in the Pacific Time Zone, which is 12 hours and 30 minutes behind India Standard Time (e. g. , 8am in San Francisco is 8: 30pm in Bengaluru). 
 - Hours: Applicants should be open to meetings in the late evening following India Standard Time to align with San Francisco working hours (8am - 6pm PT). 

Basic Qualifications

- Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related technical degree
 - 9+ years of professional software engineering experience, with meaningful experience delivering production software. 
 - 3+ years hands-on experience with TypeScript and modern React application development. 
 - 3+years backend experience with Node. js, service development, API design, and integration patterns. 
 - 1+ years of experience in mentoring and leading junior team members, collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams, and contributing to project planning and decision-making
 - Experience with using AI tools such as Github copilot or Cursor

Preferred Qualifications

- Full stack engineer with strong experience to backend technology like NodeJS, RDBMS
 - Exposure to microservices, distributed systems, containerization, 
 - Experience taking ownership of features from technical design through launch and ongoing production support. 
 - Strong understanding of software engineering fundamentals, including testing, observability, performance, availability, and secure development practices. 
 - Ability to communicate technical decisions clearly to both technical and non-technical partners. 
 - A collaborative, product-minded approach and the ability to work effectively in a remote, cross-functional environment. 
 - Familiarity with AI-assisted software development or integrating AI capabilities into production workflows. 

About Hinge Health

At Hinge Health, we're using technology to scale and automate the delivery of healthcare, starting with musculoskeletal (MSK) conditions, which affect over 1. 7 billion people worldwide. Our AI-powered, human-centered care model spans MSK, pelvic health, gastrointestinal (GI) and migraine care. With over 60 partnerships with health plans, PBMs and other ecosystem partners, Hinge Health is available to over 25 million people across more than 2, 900 employers. The company is headquartered in San Francisco with additional offices in Montreal and Bangalore. Learn more at hingehealth. com. 

What You'll Love About Us

- Inclusive healthcare and benefits: In addition to comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, we provide employees and their family members with Group Medical Coverage (GMC), Group Term Life Insurance (GTL), and Group Personal Accident Insurance (GPA). 
 - Well-being & Growth: We offer a lifestyle stipend to support your overall well-being, along with learning and development opportunities to help you grow both personally and professionally. 
 - Ownership: Grow with us through discounted company stock through our ESPP with easy payroll deductions. 

Culture & Engagement

Hinge Health is an equal opportunity employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind. We make employment decisions without regards to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, veteran status, disability status, pregnancy, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. We provide reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities. If you feel you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, let us know by reaching out to your recruiter. 

By submitting your application you are acknowledging we are using your personal data as outlined in the personnel and candidate privacy policy. 

Beware of Phishing Attempts: We've noticed an increase in phishing where fraudsters impersonate employees and send fake job offers to steal sensitive information. GeForce NOW is NVIDIA's Cloud Gaming service, streaming games at the highest quality to any and every user, regardless of their device type and capabilities - low-end PCs, Macs, TV or mobile devices. We deliver zero-downtime global rollouts with automatic drift detection. Our reliable staging environments replicate production accurately.  - Experience handling Vault, Terraform, Ansible, and Helm in both on-premises and cloud environments
 - Experience in developing and scaling RESTful, gRPC, MCP APIs and backend services. 
 - Experience running hybrid multi-cloud and bare-metal at production scale, and owning a platform roadmap end-to-end. 

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd

- Backstage or similar internal developer portals for self-service tooling
 - Comprehensive expertise covering backend services as well as platform and infrastructure engineering
 - Daily use of AI-assisted tools (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor) - we use these daily

data.title: Senior Manager, Test Engineering- Networking background is a must
data.description:
For more than 30 years, SonicWall  has delivered a partner-first unified cybersecurity portfolio that helps SMBs, MSPs, and IT teams consolidate network security, endpoint security, security service edge (SSE), and threat response across hybrid environments. By bringing connected technology, real-time threat intelligence, automation, and expert services together, SonicWall helps organizations simplify security operations, achieve better security outcomes, and lower total cost of ownership. Backed by a global ecosystem of more than 17, 000 partners, SonicWall delivers enterprise-grade protection built for SMB and mid-market realities.   

For more information, visit www. sonicwall. com or follow us on X, LinkedIn, Facebook, and Instagram.   

Role Overview

We are looking for a highly experienced Senior QA Manager to own end-to-end quality for SonicOS, the core operating system powering SonicWall's next-generation firewall products. This is a high-impact leadership role where you will define quality strategy, drive automation and test infrastructure investments, and partner closely with Product Management, Development, Release Engineering, DevOps, and Support teams to ensure every release meets high standards of reliability, security, and customer trust. 

You will be responsible not just for test execution, but for shaping how quality is built into the product lifecycle - from early design reviews and threat modelling to release readiness and post-release learning. 

Key Responsibilities

Quality Strategy & Release Ownership

- Define and continuously improve the QA strategy for SonicOS across major releases, patches, and hotfixes
 - Establish quality gates, entry/exit criteria, and clear release readiness standards
 - Drive risk-based testing and shift-left practices to catch issues early
 - Own go/no-go decisions for releases from a quality standpointFirewall Domain & Technical Leadership

- Provide strong technical leadership across firewall features such as: 
 - Stateful firewall, NAT, VPN (IPSec/SSL), routing, HA
 - Security services like IPS, DPI-SSL, Gateway AV, App Control, Web Filtering
 - Review PRDs, design documents, and architecture proposals with a quality & security mindset
 - Define comprehensive test strategies covering: 
 - Functional correctness and complex E2E customer workflows
 - Performance, scale, and stress (throughput, sessions, DPI impact)
 - HA failover, upgrades/downgrades, config migrations, and long-run stability
 - Champion security and negative testing to validate abuse cases and threat scenariosAutomation, CI/CD & Test Infrastructure

- Define the long-term automation vision (UI, API, CLI, E2E) and measurable coverage goals
 - Partner with automation leads to build scalable, reliable frameworks integrated into CI/CD
 - Drive stability and reliability of automated test suites (reduce flakiness, improve signal)
 - Own strategy for testbeds spanning hardware appliances, virtual firewalls, and cloud deployments
 - Work with infra teams to ensure availability, capacity planning, and reliability of test environmentsExecution Excellence & Metrics

- Own and track key quality metrics: defect leakage, escape rate, regression effectiveness, automation ROI, flakiness trends
 - Lead regular release readiness and quality reviews with senior stakeholders
 - Drive deep root cause analysis for production escapes and systemic quality gaps
 - Convert learnings from field issues into preventive quality improvementsPeople Leadership & Stakeholder Influence

- Build, mentor, and retain a strong leadership bench of QA managers, leads, and senior engineers
 - Set clear expectations, career paths, and technical growth plans for the QA organization
 - Influence engineering leadership and PMs to prioritize quality, reliability, and customer impact
 - Represent QA in leadership forums, customer escalations, and cross-functional reviewsRequired Skills & Experience

- 10+ years of total technical experience, including at least 2+ years in a management or leadership role
 - Strong background in testing firewall / network security products or similar system software
 - Deep understanding of networking and security fundamentals (TCP/IP, routing, NAT, VPN, HA, IPS/DPI concepts, authentication mechanisms)
 - Experience owning quality for complex, large-scale system software releases
 - Proven leadership experience managing and scaling QA teams across geographies
 - Strong exposure to automation strategy and CI/CD-driven quality practices
 - Excellent communication skills with the ability to influence senior technical stakeholdersGood to Have

- Prior experience with SonicOS or comparable firewall OS platforms
 - Exposure to security compliance programs (FIPS, Common Criteria, SOC2)
 - Experience testing in hybrid environments (hardware + virtual + cloud)
 - Experience handling customer escalations and field issue RCAWhat Success Looks Like

- Predictable, high-quality SonicOS releases with reduced Sev1/Sev2 customer issues
 - Measurable improvement in automation coverage and test effectiveness
 - Faster feedback cycles for Dev and PM through shift-left and CI/CD integration
 - Strong QA leadership bench and high team engagement
 - Improved customer trust and reduced critical escalations

SonicWall is an equal opportunity employer.     

We are committed to creating a diverse environment and are an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, ethnicity, religion, sex, gender, gender identity and expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age, marital status, veteran status, pregnancy, or any other basis prohibited by applicable law. 

At SonicWall, we pride ourselves on recruiting a diverse mix of talented people and providing active security solutions in 100+ countries. 

Applicant Privacy Notice
