data.title: Principal AI/ML Architect
data.description:
About Egen: 

Egen is a fast-growing, entrepreneurial technology company with a data-first mindset. We bring together exceptional engineering talent and advanced technology platforms, including Google Cloud and Salesforce, to help clients drive action and impact through data and insights. 

We are committed to being a place where talented people choose to do their best work - applying deep engineering and technology expertise to envision how data, AI, and platforms can change the world for the better. We are dedicated to learning, thrive on solving difficult problems, and continually innovate to achieve fast, effective results. If that describes you, we want you on our team. 

About the opportunity: 

As a Principal AI/ML Architect, you will set the technical direction for Egen's most complex generative AI, agentic AI, and applied machine learning engagements while remaining personally hands-on in the work that matters most. We treat AI as a software engineering discipline. You will raise that bar by architecting systems that succeed in production and helping the engineers around you do the same. 

You will own the hardest architectural problems in our portfolio: agentic platforms operating at scale, applied-ML solutions, advanced retrieval systems, and AI in regulated or high-stakes environments where being wrong is expensive. Document intelligence and RAG pipelines are part of your toolkit, not the ceiling. You will take systems from an ambiguous business problem to a robust, scalable service, solving for latency, reliability, cost, security, and governance. 

You will also be the senior technical face of our engagements. You will partner directly with client leadership to translate business strategy into AI architecture, shape solutions during pre-sales, guide engineering teams, and earn the trust that turns a project into a long-term program. 

What you will do: 

- Set enterprise AI architecture and technical direction: Own the end-to-end architecture for complex GenAI, agentic AI, and ML platforms. Define reference architectures, reusable patterns, engineering guardrails, and technology choices across engagements. 
 - Build at the frontier - hands-on: Stay close to the code on the highest-leverage technical work, including foundation-model and embedding fine-tuning, advanced RAG, semantic search, evaluation harnesses, and novel agentic workflows using Python and Google Cloud Vertex AI. 
 - Engineer AI for production: Design for latency, reliability, security, cost, scalability, and maintainability from day one. Apply disciplined MLOps and LLMOps practices so systems are versioned, evaluated, monitored, deployed, and continuously improved. 
 - Architect agentic systems at scale: Design and operate multi-step reasoning and multi-agent workflows using ADK, LangChain, MCP, and custom agent frameworks, with robust orchestration, state management, tool use, memory, human oversight, failure isolation, and verification controls. 
 - Establish evaluation, observability, and responsible AI standards: Define measurable quality criteria and production telemetry for accuracy, groundedness, safety, drift, latency, and cost. Embed privacy, security, governance, and responsible AI throughout the lifecycle. 
 - Shape data and retrieval architectures: Design production-scale retrieval and knowledge systems spanning data ingestion, chunking, metadata, embeddings, vector and hybrid search, re-ranking, provenance, permissions, and continuous content refresh. 
 - Advise clients and shape opportunities: Partner with client executives and engineering leaders to translate business strategy into AI roadmaps and solution architectures. Lead discovery, technical workshops, estimates, trade-off discussions, and pre-sales solutioning. 
 - Multiply engineering capability: Raise the technical bar through architecture reviews, design documents, code reviews, mentoring, reusable accelerators, and clear standards that help senior and mid-level engineers deliver with greater confidence. 
 - Own outcomes across the full lifecycle: Guide initiatives from problem framing and experimentation through production rollout, operational readiness, adoption, and measurable business value. Surface risks early and drive decisions to resolution. 

Your technical toolkit: 

Languages and software engineering

Expert-level Python; strong shell scripting; API and service design; clean, tested, maintainable code; distributed-system fundamentals; and full SDLC ownership. 

Models and AI ecosystem

Deep, current expertise with Google Gemini, GPT-class models, LLaMA and other open models; advanced prompt engineering; structured outputs; model selection; fine-tuning; and rigorous evaluation. 

Agentic AI engineering

Hands-on production experience with Google Agent Development Kit (ADK), LangChain, custom agent frameworks, tool use, Model Context Protocol (MCP), workflow orchestration, planning, memory, state, guardrails, human-in-the-loop controls, and multi-agent design. 

Retrieval and search

Advanced RAG, hybrid and semantic search, embeddings, re-ranking, and vector platforms such as Vertex AI Vector Search, pgvector, Pinecone, or equivalent technologies. 

Cloud infrastructure and AI systems

End-to-end experience architecting highly available, scalable AI and software environments across Google Cloud / Vertex AI, AWS, and Azure, including model serving, data integration, IAM, networking, security, observability, and cost management. 

Frameworks

Strong command of LangChain, LlamaIndex, or equivalent orchestration layers - together with the judgment to use simpler, more maintainable patterns when appropriate. 

MLOps and LLMOps

CI/CD, model and prompt versioning, experiment tracking, automated evaluation, observability, model monitoring, drift detection, rollback, and production incident response. 

Data and ML foundations

Strong SQL and data engineering; classical machine learning; neural networks; training, tuning, and inference; and the ability to connect data quality to model and product outcomes. 

Basic qualifications: 

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related technical field; equivalent practical experience will also be considered. 
 - 15+ years of progressive experience across software engineering, machine learning, data, or AI, including substantial ownership of production systems at scale. 
 - Demonstrated principal-level technical leadership, including architecture ownership, cross-team technical direction, and decision-making across complex engagements or product portfolios. 
 - A proven record of deploying generative AI, agentic AI, and/or applied-ML products into production - beyond proofs of concept. 
 - Deep hands-on expertise with Python, modern LLM and ML architectures, agent frameworks, Google Cloud / Vertex AI, production APIs, and scalable software systems. 
 - Experience establishing evaluation, observability, security, privacy, governance, and responsible AI controls for enterprise AI solutions. 
 - Strong data engineering and SQL knowledge, with the ability to design reliable data and retrieval foundations for AI products. 
 - Senior client-facing experience, with the communication skills to explain technical choices, risks, and business value to executive stakeholders and engineering teams. 

Preferred qualifications: 

- Experience training, tuning, or adapting neural networks, embedding models, or foundation models. 
 - Architecture experience in regulated or high-stakes domains such as healthcare, financial services, or the public sector. 
 - Google Cloud Professional Machine Learning Engineer, Professional Cloud Architect, or comparable certification. 
 - Experience building reusable AI accelerators, reference implementations, or platform capabilities across multiple clients or product teams. 
 - Pre-sales experience including discovery workshops, solution shaping, estimation, proposal development, and technical presentations. 
 - Familiarity or good to have understanding with Kubernetes, infrastructure as code, event-driven architectures, and modern data platforms. 

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

data.title: Director of Software Engineering – AI/ML
data.description:
Renesas is one of the top global semiconductor companies in the world. We strive to develop a safer, healthier, greener, and smarter world, and our goal is to make every endpoint intelligent by offering product solutions in the automotive, industrial, infrastructure and IoT markets. Our robust product portfolio includes world-leading MCUs, SoCs, analog and power products, plus Winning Combination solutions that curate these complementary products. We are a key supplier to the world's leading manufacturers of electronics you rely on every day; you may not see our products, but they are all around you. 

Renesas employs roughly 21, 000 people in more than 30 countries worldwide. As a global team, our employees actively embody the Renesas Culture, our guiding principles based on five key elements: Transparent, Agile, Global, Innovative, and Entrepreneurial. Renesas believes in, and has a commitment to, diversity and inclusion, with initiatives and a leadership team dedicated to its resources and values. At Renesas, we want to build a sustainable future where technology helps make our lives easier. Join us and build your future by being part of what's next in electronics and the world. 

Job Description

In this role, you will lead the definition and execution of AI/ML-driven initiatives, drive adoption of ML/AI across frontend and backend design and development flows across the company, enable next-generation intelligent design automation capabilities, and collaborate with cross-functional leaders to integrate AI into engineering productivity, automation, and decision-making processes. 

Job Responsibilities

- Define and own the AI/ML strategy for Engineering group's software and design flows
 - Lead the transformation of semiconductor design workflows by deploying AI-driven (agentic) solutions across Frontend (modelling, synthesis, optimization) and Backend (place-and-route, timing closure, physical optimization)
 - Drive end-to-end integration of AI into engineering toolchains
 - Establish scalable frameworks for: 
 - Data collection, labelling, and pipeline management
 - Model training/fine tuning, validation, and deployment
 - Lead cross-functional collaboration with: 
 - EDA, design, architecture, and platform teams
 - External vendors and partners as needed
 - Build and grow a high-performance engineering team
 - Define KPIs to measure productivity gains, quality improvements, and ROI from AI initiatives
 - Ensure alignment with enterprise AI programs and governance frameworks
 - Drive continuous innovation and adoption of emerging AI/ML technologies in semiconductor workflows

Qualifications

- MTech/BTech in EE/CS with 20+ years of software development experience and 10+ years of engineering management experience (including leading managers or large teams)
 - 7+ years in semiconductor and/or EDA industry
 - Proven experience in Applying ML/AI to real-world engineering or automation problems
 - Proven experience building and scaling AI/ML platforms leveraging technologies such as LangChain, vector databases, and RAG-based architectures
 - Deep understanding of LLM ecosystems, including embeddings, knowledge retrieval, and integration of AI agents into production workflows
 - Strong understanding of software architecture, distributed systems, Data pipelines and ML workflows
 - Demonstrated ability to Lead cross-functional initiatives and translate business/engineering needs into technical solutions
 - Should have exposure to quality processes for project execution, delivery, and working with multiple teams across geos
 - Strong communication skills for executive-level engagement
 - Preferred Hands-on experience with EDA tools, chip design flows, or semiconductor development lifecycle
 - Prior Hands-on experience with AI/ML frameworks (e. g. , TensorFlow, PyTorch, or similar) is a plus
 - Prior experience building AI-driven solutions for Design optimization and Automation/ productivity improvement is preferred
 - Familiarity with Cloud platforms and scalable compute infrastructure and Data-driven decision systems is preferred

Additional Information

Renesas is an embedded semiconductor solution provider driven by its Purpose 'To Make Our Lives Easier. ' As the industry's leading expert in embedded processing with unmatched quality and system-level know-how, we have evolved to provide scalable and comprehensive semiconductor solutions for automotive, industrial, infrastructure, and IoT industries based on the broadest product portfolio, including High Performance Computing, Embedded Processing, Analog & Connectivity, and Power. 

With a diverse team of over 21, 000 professionals in more than 30 countries, we continue to expand our boundaries to offer enhanced user experiences through digitalization and usher into a new era of innovation. We design and develop sustainable, power-efficient solutions today that help people and communities thrive tomorrow, 'To Make Our Lives Easier. '

At Renesas, you can: 

- Launch and advance your career in technical and business roles across four Product Groups and various corporate functions. You will have the opportunities to explore our hardware and software capabilities and try new things. 
 - Make a real impact by developing innovative products and solutions to meet our global customers' evolving needs and help make people's lives easier, safe and secure. 
 - Maximize your performance and wellbeing in our flexible and inclusive work environment. Our people-first culture and global support system, including the remote work option and Employee Resource Groups, will help you excel from the first day. Are you ready to own your success and make your mark?

Join Renesas. Let's Shape the Future together. 

Renesas Electronics is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer, committed to supporting diversity and fostering a work environment free of discrimination on the basis of sex, race, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, military status, veteran status, or any other basis protected by law. For more information, please read our Diversity & Inclusion Statement.

data.title: DevOps Engineer IV (Infrastructure)
data.description:
Lead DevOps & Cloud Infrastructure Engineer

What this Job Entails

This is a hands-on lead role owning the cloud infrastructure and DevOps function for Astreya's product portfolio. The person in this seat is accountable for how our products get built, deployed, secured and run - in our own environments and inside customer environments. 

Google Cloud is the primary platform; Azure is secondary. This is not a role that sets direction and hands the work to someone else: the expectation is that this person writes the Terraform, debugs the cluster, runs the deployment, and then mentors the engineers who will do it next time. They act as the subject matter expert for infrastructure across product, engineering and delivery teams, and as the technical owner in customer conversations about deployment, security and hosting models. 

Scope

- Owns the infrastructure and deployment layer end to end, from CI pipeline to production runtime, across multiple products on independent release cadences
 - Resolves complex problems where the diagnosis requires in-depth evaluation of many interacting variables - networking, identity, cluster behaviour, managed service limits, cost
 - Exercises independent judgment in selecting platform services, patterns and tooling, and is expected to defend those choices technically and commercially
 - Operates as a player-coach: a small team reports to this role, and the role remains individually productive

Your Roles and Responsibilities

Cloud infrastructure (primary)

- Design, build and operate our GCP footprint: GKE, Artifact Registry, Cloud SQL (Postgres), Cloud Storage, Memorystore (Redis), Vertex AI, Cloud Monitoring/Logging, Cloud DNS
 - Own network and perimeter design: VPC architecture, Private Service Connect, Cloud NAT, Cloud Armor, private connectivity to customer systems
 - Own secrets, keys and identity: Secret Manager, Workload Identity, IAM design and least-privilege service accounts, KMS, certificate lifecycle
 - Run R&D on platform services we haven't used yet - evaluate the GCP service, identify the Azure and AWS equivalents, and produce a recommendation with a working proof of concept, not a slide
 - Manage cloud cost: attribution by product and environment, budget alerts, rightsizing, commitment planning

Deployment into environments (a core reason this role exists)

- Make deploying our products into a new environment a repeatable, documented, low-drama exercise - both customer-VPC and Astreya-hosted models
 - Own the deployment artefacts: Helm charts, namespace and pod topology, environment configuration, migration and rollback paths
 - Work directly with customer infrastructure and security teams during onboarding - answer their architecture and security questions, adapt to their constraints, and get us to production
 - Produce and maintain the evidence infrastructure security reviews and audits ask for: architecture diagrams, data flow, access controls, encryption posture, audit logging, retention

DevOps and platform engineering

- Own CI/CD across products: build pipelines, artefact promotion, environment strategy, source control branching strategies across multiple release cadences
 - Write automation and internal tooling for provisioning and operating infrastructure - infrastructure as code (Terraform) as the default, scripts and services where it isn't
 - Build the observability layer: metrics, logs, traces, alerting, dashboards and SLOs that let us find problems before customers do
 - Improve scalability, reliability, capacity and performance of the platform, including the infrastructure serving AI/LLM workloads
 - Harden the platform: image scanning, dependency and vulnerability management, network policy, secrets hygiene, patching

Leadership and process

- Lead and mentor DevOps and infrastructure engineers; set standards and review their work
 - Work with product owners and engineering leads to understand requirements, surface infrastructure bottlenecks early, and propose resolutions
 - Own incident response for platform issues and produce root cause analyses for outages that are honest about cause and specific about prevention
 - Design and implement improvements to existing support processes and tooling; introduce innovations and follow through on execution, not just proposal
 - Document decisions, runbooks and resolution history so the next person doesn't rediscover them
 - Other duties as required. This list is not a comprehensive inventory of all responsibilities assigned to this position

Required Qualifications/Skills

- Bachelor's degree (B. S/B. A) from a four-year college or university and 8+ years' related experience and/or training; or an equivalent combination of education and experience
 - Deep, hands-on Google Cloud experience - has designed and run production workloads on GCP, not just passed a certification
 - Strong Kubernetes experience in production: GKE preferred, including networking, ingress, autoscaling, resource management and debugging failures under load
 - Infrastructure as code at a professional standard - Terraform, module design, state management, review discipline
 - Strong scripting and coding ability (Python, Go, Bash or equivalent) and enough software development experience to work inside application repositories, not just around them
 - Practical cloud networking and security depth: VPC design, private connectivity, IAM, secrets management, TLS
 - CI/CD ownership across multiple products and release trains, with source control branching strategies
 - Monitoring, alerting and incident management experience, including writing the RCA afterwards
 - Experience with open-source tooling in large distributed systems
 - Good communication skills - can hold a technical conversation with a customer's security team and a working conversation with a developer on the same day
 - Ability to pick up unfamiliar technology quickly and carry several threads at once

Preferred Qualifications

- Working Azure knowledge (AKS, Key Vault, Entra ID, VNet) and the ability to translate a GCP design onto it; AWS exposure a bonus
 - Experience deploying a product into customer-controlled cloud environments as a vendor
 - Experience supporting AI/ML workloads in production - Vertex AI, model endpoints, GPU scheduling, inference cost control
 - Exposure to SOC 2, ISO 27001 or comparable audits from the infrastructure side
 - Experience integrating with enterprise ITSM platforms (ServiceNow) and the connectivity that requires
 - Prior experience as a first or early infrastructure hire on a product team
 - Relevant certification (Google Professional Cloud Architect, Professional Cloud DevOps Engineer, CKA)

Physical Demand & Work Environment

- Must have the ability to perform office-related tasks which may include prolonged sitting or standing
 - Must have the ability to move from place to place within an office environment
 - Must be able to use a computer
 - Must have the ability to communicate effectively
 - Some positions may require occasional repetitive motion or movements of the wrists, hands, and/or fingers

data.title: Manager - Project Quality
data.description:
Job Description

Be part of the solution at Technip Energies and embark on a one-of-a-kind journey. You will be helping to develop cutting-edge solutions to solve real-world energy problems. 

We are currently seeking a Manager -Project Quality, to join ourQuality team based in Dahej, Gujarat. 

About us: 

Technip Energies is a global technology and engineering powerhouse. With leadership positions in LNG, hydrogen, ethylene, sustainable chemistry, and CO2 management, we are contributing to the development of critical markets such as energy, energy derivatives, decarbonization, and circularity. Our complementary business segments, Technology, Products and Services (TPS) and Project Delivery, turn innovation into scalable and industrial reality. 

Through collaboration and excellence in execution, our 17, 000+ employees across 34 countries are fully committed to bridging prosperity with sustainability for a world designed to last. 

About the opportunity we offer: 

Job Purpose: 

To lead and manage all day-to-day Quality Control (QC) inspection activities on the shop floor for assigned projects. This role ensures execution of Inspection and Test Plans (ITP) and Quality Control Plans (QCP), manages coordination with Third-Party Inspection (TPI) agencies and Authorized Inspectors (AI), tracks daily inspection workloads, and guarantees that high-quality inspections and on-time documentation are consistently achieved

Job Responsibilities: 

Shop Floor Inspection & Quality of Inspection: 

- Look after and supervise all daily inspection activities on the shop floor across fabrication, welding, assembly, Surface treatment and testing for assigned projects. 
 - Ensure the highest quality of inspection is maintained by QC Engineers, preventing any defective or non-compliant products from passing to the next manufacturing stage. 
 - Conduct random surveillance checks on the shop floor to ensure strict compliance with approved drawings, welding procedures, and quality standards. 

Traveller, ITP & QCP Management: 

- Ensure precise physical execution of the Inspection and Test Plan (ITP) and Quality Control Plan (QCP) for all assigned project modules. 
 - Routinely update, sign off, and manage manufacturing Travellers (routing cards) in real-time as physical inspection stages are cleared to ensure seamless production flow. 

TPI & AI Coordination (Customer & Third-Party Management): 

- Plan, coordinate, and manage customer visits and client audits, ensuring readiness of facilities, documentation, inspection activities, and relevant departments, while facilitating timely closure of observations and audit findings. 
 - Act as the primary shop-floor point of contact and coordinator for Client Representatives, Third-Party Inspection (TPI) agencies, and ASME Authorized Inspectors (AI). 
 - Schedule and coordinate witness, hold, and review points efficiently to ensure external inspectors are present without causing production bottlenecks or unnecessary downtime. 

NCR Management & RCA Participation: 

- Identify process or product deviations, raise Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs), and halt non-compliant processes immediately. 
 - Manage the shop-floor NCR log, track the physical execution of approved rework/repair instructions, and ensure dimensional/welding corrections are verified. 
 - Actively participate in cross-functional Root Cause Analysis (RCA) meetings with Production, Engineering, and Head QC to investigate recurring defects and implement preventive measures. 

Inspection Load Tracking & Transaction: 

- Monitor, track, and manage the daily inspection load and inspection call transactions requested by the production department. 
 - Dynamically allocate QC Engineers and inspectors to various workstations or modules to balance workloads, eliminate inspection delays, and meet tight dispatch schedules. 

On-Time Documentation & Record Keeping: 

- Ensure all stage-wise inspection reports, dimension check sheets, NDE clearance reports, painting inspection reports and visual weld reports are accurately generated and signed concurrently with the physical inspection. 
 - Maintain strict discipline regarding on-time documentation to ensure there are no delays during the final Manufacturing Data Record (MDR) compilation and product dispatch. 

Starting Date: October 2026

About you: 

We love to hear from you and how you match with this position. To be successful in this mission you should consider the following requirements: 

Qualification: -

Diploma / bachelor's degree in engineering (Mechanical, Production, or Metallurgy preferred)

Experience: -

- Minimum 10 years of hands-on experience in shop-floor quality control, inspection, and testing within heavy engineering, fabrication, or process equipment manufacturing environments. 
 - Minimum 3+ years in a lead, supervisory, or Project Quality Management (PQM) role. 
 - Relevant certifications such as ASNT NDE Level II, AWS-CWI, or CSWIP 3. 1 are highly preferred

Skills require: - (IT, Communication etc)

- Expertise in reading and executing ITPs, QCPs, and manufacturing Travellers. 
 - Strong coordination and negotiation skills for TPI (Third-Party Inspection) and AI (Authorized Inspector) management. 
 - NCR lifecycle management and participation in RCA (Root Cause Analysis). 
 - Manpower planning and inspection load tracking/transaction management. 
 - Excellent time-management skills for ensuring on-time documentation. 
 - Proficiency in MS Office (Excel, Word) and online systems for tracking shop-floor data. 
 - Assertive communication and shop-floor conflict resolution. 

Your career with us: 

Working at Technip Energies is an inspiring journey, filled with groundbreaking projects and dynamic collaborations. Surrounded by diverse and talented individuals, you will feel welcomed, respected, and engaged. Enjoy a safe, caring environment where you can spark new ideas, reimagine the future, and lead change. As your career grows, you will benefit from learning opportunities at T. EN University, such as The Future Ready Program, and from the support of your manager through check-in moments like the Mid-Year Development Review, fostering continuous growth and development

What's next?

Once receiving your application, our Talent Acquisition professionals will screen and match your profile against the role requirements. We ask for your patience as the team completes the volume of applications with reasonable timeframe. Check your application progress periodically via personal account from created candidate profile during your application. 

We invite you to get to know more about our company by visiting and follow us on LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, X and YouTube for company updates.

Senior Advanced Embedded Engr

Join a company that's reintroducing itself to the aviation community we've helped advance for more than a century. At Honeywell Aerospace (NASDAQ: HONA), we're launching as an independent, publicly traded aerospace and defense company built on a legacy of operational excellence and mission-focused execution. 

Our new brand identity pairs that heritage with real momentum, as we build technology that helps pilots navigate with confidence, aircraft operate more efficiently, and operators stay ahead of change. With our systems on board 90% of the world's aircraft, your work here has reach that's rare to find anywhere else. 

Focusing on our customers, investing in innovation, and building a culture of accountability and performance is how we're shaping what comes next. 

Every horizon. Every mission. Every day.

Our technology helps operators fly more safely, reduce fuel consumption, improve on-time performance and deliver a better experience for the people on board. 

As aviation continues to evolve, we're also developing systems to support autonomous and supersonic platforms, bringing the same focus on safety and efficiency to the next era of flight. With approximately 36, 000 employees worldwide and net sales of $17. 4B in 2025, Honeywell Aerospace is one of the largest dedicated aerospace companies in the world. Explore our businesses: https: //www. honeywellaerospace. com

- Good understanding in avionics concepts, domain and processes with an expertise in the field of Verification & Validation of avionics embedded software.

At Meraki, we're making IT easier, faster, and smarter. Our cloud teams build and maintain our cloud applications, which manage millions of networks, cameras, and sensors all over the world. With this data, we power our dashboard and a rich set of programmable APIs that allow our customers to gain insight into the state of their networks.

 - Solve challenging architecture problems to build scalable and extendable systems
 - Work with cisco's cross BU to handle Cisco Secure Connect E2E solutions and adding new features for Secure connect
 - Take complete ownership from conception to production release by leveraging your ability to influence, facilitate, and work collaboratively across teams
 - Work closely with Product Managers, UX designers, and front-end engineers to develop simplified workflows for our customers
 - Ensure the quality of these systems by adding tests, monitoring, and alerting systems

Minimum Qualifications

- 7+ years of experience in automation
 - Hands-on experience with languages and technologies including Ruby on Rails, PostgreSQL, Kubernetes, ELK, Grafana, Terraform, GIT, and several AWS services like RDS and DynamoDB.

 - Hands on experience on writing complex automation framework using python or other scripting languages
 - Hands on experience on doing UI automation using Selenium/robot framework
 - Good debugging skills
 - Experience working with Azure and/or AWS cloud
 - Able to test & automate end to end solutions, scale level tests using python or any available framework
 - Hands on experience on automation and manual testing

- Experience or willingness to work in an agile environment (Scrum. )
 - Personal projects or contributions to open-source projects. 
 - Experience with Cypress
 - Experience with Continuous Integration (CI) systems
 - Experience with Docker and/or other container technologies

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we're revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era - and beyond. We've been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint. 

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you'll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere. 

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

- be in direct response to an application you have submitted through the company career site
 - begin with screening or an interview
 - originate from a Cisco email address, and
 - be conducted across email, phone, or WebEx

Cisco will never make a job offer without conducting an interview process or ask you for money in any way. If you have been requested to apply for a role or have received an offer from a site other than https: //careers. cisco. com or cisco. wd5. myworkday. com, do not provide any personal identifying information, including your Aadhaar or other personal identifying number, birth certificate, banking information, driver's license, or passport.

data.title: Staff Software Engineer
data.description:
PeopleSoft Developer

About The Role

#JLLTechAmbitions

JLL, an international real estate management company, is looking for PeopleSoft Developers to join our JLL Technology Engineering organization. You will work on mission-critical financial systems, combining hands-on PeopleSoft development with analysis of business needs, root-cause work on production issues, and delivery of enhancements through the full change lifecycle. 

The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced, changing environment, enjoys solving business problems through creative thinking, and brings a "Get it done" attitude with a "Think ahead" mentality. You should be comfortable working independently and with a distributed team, and able to lead by example. 

Responsibilities

- Develop and enhance: design, code, and unit test customizations and enhancements to JLL's PeopleSoft Financials modules using PeopleCode, Application Engine, Application Packages, Component Interfaces, SQR, and SQL. 
 - Resolve production issues: analyze incidents and batch failures, determine root cause, deliver fixes, and move solutions through the change lifecycle. Document recurring failures as SOPs and known-error articles. 
 - Translate requirements: work with finance users and functional analysts to turn business needs into functional and technical specifications, and articulate requirements in enough detail for thorough testing. 
 - Build and support integrations: develop and maintain interfaces with upstream and downstream systems using Integration Broker, file layouts, and Component Interfaces, and monitor interface and batch process flows. 
 - Reporting: build and maintain BI Publisher reports, PS Queries, and SQRs for finance, audit, and operational needs. 
 - Upgrades and infrastructure: take part in PeopleSoft Update Manager (PUM) and PeopleTools upgrades, including keep/drop analysis, compare-report review, and retrofit of customizations, and support PeopleSoft environments on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI). 
 - Testing and quality: prepare test cases, run unit and system integration testing, coordinate user acceptance testing, and track defects to closure.

At Keyrus, you will not just develop skills - you will develop judgment. Your expertise sharpens with every system you architect, every client challenge you solve, and every deployment that compounds on the last. 

Over time, you grow into one of the rarest professionals of the intelligence era: someone who bridges data, AI, and human decision-making at scale, across industries and geographies. This is not a role you fill. It is a discipline you master and a story you help write to become a Keyrus Architect of Intelligence. 

Technology amplifies. Keyrus culture differentiates. Industrial discipline connects the two. 

Role Details

🗓 Target start date: January 2027

data.title: Advanced Specialist - Process Quality
data.description:
About The Role

The Advanced Specialist - Process Quality is a subject‐matter expert and hands‐on leader responsible for ensuring manufacturing process robustness, product safety and regulatory compliance across assigned projects. This role provides technical leadership for process quality activities during new product introductions, process changes and production support, working closely with cross‐functional teams and suppliers to deliver safe, high quality and cost‐effective solutions. 

Key Responsibilities

- Process Quality Leadership
 - Lead process quality input to design reviews, DFMEA/PFMEA sessions, control plan development and process flow definitions. 
 - Define and maintain process requirements, work instructions and inspection criteria ensuring traceability between design, validation and production documentation. 
 - Provide technical guidance to manufacturing, engineering and supplier teams on process controls, error‐proofing and poka‐yoke solutions. 
 - Validation & Qualification
 - Develop and oversee process validation protocols, capability studies and production qualification activities to demonstrate sustained compliance and performance. 
 - Plan and manage pilot builds, pre‐production runs and production part approval (PPAP) activities to secure customer and regulatory approvals. 
 - Risk Management & Problem Solving
 - Drive risk assessment activities (PFMEA) and facilitate cross‐functional mitigation actions; ensure effectiveness of controls through verification activities. 
 - Lead structured root cause analysis for process or quality deviations, implement corrective and preventive actions and track closure to ensure sustained resolution. 
 - Supplier Quality & Collaboration
 - Support supplier selection, capability assessments and technical reviews; resolve supplier process issues and ensure alignment to control plans and quality requirements. 
 - Collaborate with Purchasing, Engineering and Manufacturing to ensure supplier deliverables meet safety, regulatory and customer expectations. 
 - Performance Monitoring & Reporting
 - Monitor process quality metrics and capability indicators; prepare clear reports and escalate technical or process risks to project leadership when required. 
 - Maintain documentation and evidence of process performance for internal and customer audits. 
 - Continuous Improvement
 - Identify and drive improvement initiatives to enhance process stability, manufacturability and cost effectiveness. 
 - Coach and engage colleagues to adopt best practices and lessons learned from launches and production experience. 
Required Skills & Competencies

- Strong background in process quality, manufacturing engineering or similar disciplines within automotive or safety‐critical industries. 
 - Practical experience with PFMEA/DFMEA, control plans, SPC, capability studies and process validation techniques. 
 - Demonstrated problem‐solving skills with experience in structured root cause analysis and effective corrective action deployment. 
 - Ability to manage complex trade‐offs between risk, cost and schedule and to make sound technical decisions under uncertainty. 
 - Proven ability to influence cross‐functional teams and suppliers through clear communication and technical credibility. 
 - Proficiency with MS Office; experience with PLM/ERP, quality systems or manufacturing tools is desirable. 

Behavioural Competencies & Traits

- Accountability and ownership for delivery of process quality outcomes. 
 - Attention to detail and disciplined execution to meet safety and quality objectives. 
 - Adaptability to changing priorities and evolving project needs. 
 - Collaborative mindset with ability to build trust across functions and suppliers. 
 - Drive for continuous improvement and measurable impact. 

Education

- Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Technical Science or a related discipline; relevant professional certifications (e. g. , Six Sigma, CQE) are an advantage. 

Experience

- Typically 7+ years' relevant experience in process quality, manufacturing or quality engineering roles; experience in automotive or other safety‐critical product environments is preferred. 

Language

- English (required). 

We are committed to inclusive recruitment and welcome applications from all suitably qualified candidates. In our international work environment you will find opportunities for career development, technical training and leadership growth. 

More lives saved - more life lived!

data.title: Full-Stack Tech Lead – AI Best Practices - Remote
data.description:
Company Description

McFadyen Digital is the leading advisor and implementer of eCommerce Marketplace solutions. During 15 years of implementing marketplaces, we've built dozens of platforms that cumulatively generate billions of dollars of gross merchandise value (GMV). We're honored to have supported 10% of the Fortune 500 with their digital marketplace initiatives. Over 250 global brands like ABB, AB InBev, ACCO, Albertsons, American Red Cross, American Eagle Outfitters, US Army, US Agriculture Dept, (and many more) have entrusted their digital transformations to McFadyen. We operate global offices across the US, Brazil, and India. McFadyen Digital has been a trusted employer for 35 years and believes that people are the most important part of our company. We're proud of our Great Place to Work certification. 

Learn more about us at our website: www. mcfadyen. com

About AI Best Practices (AIBP)

AI Best Practices (ai-best-practices. com) is a knowledge platform and toolset that helps enterprises benchmark and improve how they apply AI across their value chains. It pairs a content-rich Wiki - covering use cases, AI tools, ROI frameworks, and industry categorization - with Librarian, an AI-driven backend that curates, scores, and surfaces that content. The platform serves C-suite and VP-level decision-makers evaluating AI maturity, tooling, and vendor fit across industries. 

AIBP is a product line built and operated by McFadyen Digital. This role owns the full-stack engineering of the AIBP web application portfolio (Wiki, Librarian, and the surrounding product surface) end-to-end - including how work is planned, ticketed, sequenced, and released. 

Job Description

Do you want to own architecture, delivery, and release for a fast-moving AI-native product line - not just write code for one? Can you turn a rough roadmap into a sequence of self-contained, agent-ready Linear tickets without anyone needing to ask a follow-up question? Have you made Claude Code and Claude. ai your daily driver for coding, planning, and ticket-writing, and built your own skills, hooks, or MCP integrations on top of them? Can you judge in seconds when AI-generated code needs a second look - especially around auth, access control, or anything destructive? Do you thrive in fast, ambiguous, unscoped delivery rather than traditional phased client work? If you answered yes, then we want to talk to you!

We need a full-stack tech lead to own fast-moving AI-native products end-to-end - and to be the person who turns roadmap into shipped software through well-run Linear tickets, realistic timelines, and clean releases. We build with AI as a first-class part of the workflow: Claude (Claude Code and Claude. ai) is our daily driver for coding, ticket drafting, planning, and status reporting, alongside agentic coding tools, custom skills/hooks/MCP servers, and spec-driven plan/execute/verify loops. You'll work the same way - full-time, hands-on daily, owning architecture, planning, and delivery, and mentoring/reviewing other engineers. 

Responsibilities

Top 5 responsibilities

- Own architecture and technical direction across the AIBP web application portfolio - data model, auth/access control, API design, and deployment. 
 - Ship full-stack features end-to-end - UI, backend logic, schema/migrations, and cloud deploy. 
 - Plan and run the team's work in Linear as the single source of truth - break initiatives into tickets, sequence them against timelines, and keep status, priority, and dependencies accurate at all times. 
 - Build and own delivery timelines and project plans, setting realistic estimates for a fast pace and flagging delays and blockers early with a clear cause and recovery plan. 
 - Own the release process end-to-end - decide what ships, verify migration/deploy readiness, write release notes, and hold the rollback plan. 

Additional Responsibilities

- Write and review tickets so they're self-contained and agent-ready - clear scope, acceptance criteria, and file/test pointers - whether executed by a person or an agentic coding tool. 
 - Use Claude (Claude Code and Claude. ai) as the default way of writing code, drafting/refining tickets, planning work, and producing status reports. 
 - Review PRs, mentor other engineers, and set technical and ticket-quality standards. 
 - Judge when AI output needs verification - especially auth, access control, and destructive data operations. 
 - Keep tests (unit/integration/E2E) and CI/CD gating healthy as things move fast. 
 - Report status concisely to stakeholders - what shipped, what's at risk, and what's needed to unblock it. 
 - Linear & ticket quality: keep Linear accurate as the single source of truth (not a wiki or chat thread); maintain ticket hygiene - status, labels, priority, linked dependencies, sub-issue structure - continuously, not just before a status meeting. 
 - Timeline & project planning: keep milestones, dependencies, and sequencing visibly current as scope shifts; surface risk and slippage the moment they're known, with a cause and recovery plan attached. 
 - Release ownership: gate every release through CI/CD and required checks, confirm migration safety, and ensure release notes and a rollback plan exist for every release; run post-release monitoring and any hotfix path. 

Qualifications

Top 5 qualifications

- 8-12 years of software engineering experience, including 3+ years in a lead/ownership capacity. 
 - Strong TypeScript/React expertise with a modern full-stack framework such as Next. js (deep App Router experience a plus). 
 - 2+ years of daily, hands-on use of agentic coding tools, with Claude (Claude Code and/or Claude. ai) as a true daily driver - not occasional autocomplete. 
 - Relational database design and ORM experience (Prisma, Drizzle, TypeORM, or similar), with sound judgment on migration safety and cascade behavior. 
 - Fluency with Linear (or an equivalent issue tracker) as a planning and delivery tool, not just a task list. 

Additional Qualifications

- REST API design experience: auth boundaries, rate limiting, CSRF protection. 
 - Solid experience on at least one major cloud/edge platform (AWS, Azure, GCP, or Cloudflare) and the judgment to apply it elsewhere. 
 - CI/CD literacy: gating, required checks, migration safety. 
 - Session-based auth, RBAC, JWT experience; awareness of CSRF/XSS/injection and secure-by-design habits. 
 - Testing across the pyramid: mocked unit, real-DB integration, browser E2E (Playwright or equivalent). 
 - Release management: versioning, changelogs, rollback strategy, deployment gating. 
 - Has built/customized skills, hooks, subagents, or MCP integrations - extends the tooling, doesn't just consume it. 
 - Comfortable with spec-driven plan execute verify workflows, including using Claude to draft and refine Linear tickets themselves. 
 - Uses AI for UI/UX generation and can carry it to production quality. 
 - Thrives in fast, ambiguous, unscoped delivery - not traditional estimated client work. 

Nice to Have

- Experience running Linear as the source of truth across multiple concurrent workstreams or teams. 
 - CMS-style platforms (admin + public rendering split). 
 - SEO/AEO/GEO awareness (structured data, sitemaps, AI-crawler design). 
 - Experience running a smaller companion service alongside a larger app. 
 - Direct Cloudflare Workers/D1/R2 or Next. js App Router experience. 
 - Public/OSS contributions in agentic-tooling ecosystems. 

What We Can Offer You

- A career with thought leaders who literally wrote the book on Marketplace Best Practices. 
 - A career in the fast-paced world of retail eCommerce, digital marketplaces, and platform businesses. 
 - A career with first movers who are deploying new business models and strategies worldwide. 
 - A career in a flat management structure without a rigid hierarchy and bureaucracy. 
 - A career in a culture that rewards creativity and innovation, risk-taking and teamwork. 

Additional Information

Our Core Values: Caring, Adaptable, Proactive, Empowering Clients

Keywords: Claude Code, Claude. ai, MCP, agentic coding, TypeScript, React, Next. js, App Router, Prisma, Drizzle, TypeORM, Linear, Playwright, CI/CD, RBAC, JWT, Cloudflare, AWS, Azure, GCP, release management

data.title: AI Principle Architect
data.description:
Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we're helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential. 

Title And Summary

AI Principle Architect

Mastercard's Business & Market Insights (B&MI) group empowers organizations to achieve growth and innovation goals by delivering unparalleled data-driven intelligence and cutting-edge AI solutions. By harnessing proprietary data, frontier generative AI, and global expertise, B&MI helps businesses make smarter, faster, and more impactful decisions. We transform complex, multi-modal data into agentic systems and generative applications that drive measurable business outcomes and sustained competitive advantage. 

We're looking for a Principal Architect, Generative AI & ML Engineering, for the Operational Intelligence Program within B&MI. As a principal-level technical leader, you'll define the architecture vision and technical strategy for our agentic AI platform. On this platform, agents make extensive tool calls into enterprise services and APIs and must run securely, reliably, and at scale. You'll set the standards teams build on across tool calling, multi-agent orchestration, self-correcting agents, memory, retrieval, and LLMOps. You'll also make the key decisions on models, platforms, and trade-offs. Working closely with engineering, product, security, and business leaders, you'll shape the long-term direction of Gen AI across B&MI and mentor architects and senior engineers. You'll also stay hands-on with prototypes that de-risk big bets. The hardest problems in enterprise Gen AI are reliability, integration, security, and scale. If you've solved them as a backend or distributed systems architect and have started applying that experience to LLM systems, we'd love to hear from you. 

Roles & Responsibilities

- Own the architecture and technical roadmap for the Operational Intelligence Gen AI platform, defining reference architectures and standards that teams across the program can reuse and scale. 
 - Architect the enterprise tool-calling layer, setting standards for how internal services, data platforms, and external APIs are exposed to agents as tools. This covers schemas, contracts, versioning, access control, and resilient execution (parallel and chained calls, retries, timeouts, idempotency, circuit breakers, and fallbacks). 
 - Set the architecture for multi-agent and skills-based agent systems (e. g. , LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen), including when to use agents versus deterministic workflows and how agents coordinate, delegate, and share context. 
 - Design self-correcting agent patterns: tool critics and verifiers that check tool selection, arguments, and results, plus reflection and plan-and-execute loops that catch errors before agents act or respond. 
 - Architect agent memory and state for long-running, multi-step sessions, including short- and long-term memory (e. g. , Mem0, Zep, LangGraph memory), session persistence, and memory scoping and retention. 
 - Define retrieval architecture for grounded reasoning, including Self-RAG, Corrective RAG (CRAG), adaptive retrieval, and Graph-RAG, built on vector databases (e. g. , Pinecone, pgvector, OpenSearch) and knowledge graphs (e. g. , Neo4j, AWS Neptune). 
 - Design the inference and orchestration layer for high throughput, covering async processing, streaming, caching, rate limiting, and model routing across OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, and open-source models. 
 - Establish the LLMOps architecture on Databricks (AWS), including MLflow, CI/CD for prompts and agents, and model lineage. Set platform-wide evaluation and observability standards: end-to-end tracing of tool calls, tool-selection accuracy, task success rates, cost, and latency. 
 - Build security and Responsible AI into the architecture, including guardrails, prompt-injection defenses, hallucination mitigation, data privacy, and audit trails that meet Mastercard's data ethics and regulatory standards. 
 - Own key architecture decisions and trade-offs, such as build versus buy, model and vendor selection, and cost versus latency versus accuracy, documented through architecture decision records. Assess emerging models, frameworks, and standards such as MCP for production readiness. 
 - Lead design reviews and partner with engineering, product, security, and data teams to align on architecture and raise the engineering bar across the program. 
 - Stay hands-on, building prototypes and reference implementations that de-risk decisions and give teams a working starting point. 

All About You

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, AI/ML, or Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - Significant experience architecting large-scale distributed systems in production, including microservices, event-driven systems, data platforms, and cloud-native infrastructure. 
 - Deep expertise in API design and systems integration, including contracts, security models, and reliability patterns for services consumed by many teams. You understand what changes when the consumer is an LLM. 
 - Hands-on experience designing and shipping LLM-powered systems in production, especially agents that use tool/function calling, memory, and retrieval, and a clear view of how they fail. 
 - Strong Python skills for hands-on prototyping (async programming, FastAPI or similar), plus SQL proficiency. 
 - Deep experience with at least one major cloud platform (AWS preferred; Azure or GCP welcome), including its AI services such as Bedrock, SageMaker, Azure OpenAI, or Vertex AI. 
 - A solid grounding in security, privacy, and compliance for enterprise systems, ideally in financial services or another regulated industry. 
 - The ability to influence without authority, aligning engineering, product, and leadership around a technical direction and explaining trade-offs in business terms. 
 - Nice to have: hands-on experience with tool critics, Self-RAG, CRAG, reflection loops, memory frameworks such as Mem0 or Zep, MCP tool servers, or agent evaluation frameworks. 
 - Nice to have: exposure to fine-tuning (LoRA, PEFT, RLHF), multimodal models, or knowledge graphs. 
 - Coming from backend or distributed systems architecture? The hardest problems in enterprise Gen AI are reliability, integration, security, and scale, and you've solved them before. If you've started applying that experience to LLM systems, we want to hear from you, even if you haven't used every tool listed here. 

Corporate Security Responsibility

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must: 

- Abide by Mastercard's security policies and practices; 
 - Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed; 
 - Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
 - Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard's guidelines.

data.title: Principal Software Engineering Manager
data.description:
Overview

The Microsoft Windows & Devices (W+D) team is on a journey to deliver iconic experiences across hardware, software, and services that people love and use every day. A core part of the W+D strategy is delivering devices with excellent Fundamentals and delightful AI experiences that blend the power of the Edge with the scale of the cloud. 

As a Principal Software Engineering Manager in W+D Silicon and Fundamentals Team you will set technical and execution direction along with building and growing a high performing team in the areas of AI, silicon and software. We remain laser-focused on establishing Fundamentals as a delighter for the Copilot+ PC brand. If you love the pursuit of excellence and are inspired by the challenge of driving innovations that impact how the world lives, works and plays, then we invite you to an exciting opportunity to innovate, influence, transform, inspire and grow within the W+D Silicon and Fundamentals Team. 

This role carries end‐to‐end ownership across people, technology, and delivery, with an explicit mandate to drive AI‐forward engineering practices at scale to improve productivity, quality, and developer effectiveness. 

Responsibilities

This role focuses on leading teams that design, build, validate and operate scalable software solutions in the areas of AI, silicon and software with laser-focus on establishing great Fundamentals. As a Principal Software Engineering Manager, focuses on people leadership, technical direction, and delivery outcomes across teams. 

In This Role, You Are Expected To

- Lead, coach, and support a team of Software Engineers by providing clear expectations, regular feedback, and career guidance through one-on-one connections, mentoring, and performance discussions. 
 - Set and align technical direction and execution plans by partnering with Product Managers and cross-functional stakeholders to translate customer needs and business priorities into engineering plans. 
 - Support operational excellence and delivery consistency by reinforcing engineering fundamentals, planning practices, and coordinated response to incidents and live-site issues. 
 - Leverage customer feedback, telemetry, and product usage data to identify improvement opportunities, prioritize investments, and guide teams toward long-term Windows Fundamentals enhancements. 
 - Establish and reinforce engineering practices for design reviews, code reviews, testing, and continuous integration to support secure, maintainable, and scalable solutions. 
 - Provide technical guidance and escalation support by working with engineers on complex diagnostics using debugging tools, performance analysis, and code-level investigation, and representing the team in cross-organization discussions. 
 - Foster a customer-focused and inclusive team environment where engineers understand customer impact, collaborate across teams, and take shared ownership of outcomes that matter to customers. 

AI‐Forward Engineering

- Champion AI‐assisted and agentic engineering workflows across the org; set standards and expectations so teams use AI to move faster without compromising security or quality. 
 - Establish guardrails and best practices for responsible use of AI tools-ensuring correctness, security, privacy, and compliance. 
 - Encourage teams to use AI to: 
 - Accelerate root‐cause analysis and debugging
 - Improve test coverage and validation
 - Reduce toil through automation and repeatable workflows
 - Partner with AI‐forward initiatives across Windows to scale learnings, patterns, and reusable assets. 
Qualifications

Required Qualifications: 

- 
 - Bachelor's degree in computer science or related technical field AND 12+ years in AI/ML software or systems engineering
 - 4+ years of people management experience, including hiring and developing engineering teams
 - Act as the primary bridge between model development teams, software API engineers, and Microsoft ecosystem stakeholders to define feature acceptance thresholds and validation gating. 
 - Lead the design and delivery of internal tools that automate the measurement of accuracy degradation (e. g. , drift in quantized INT4/INT8 models) and API-level performance overheads. 
 - Align engineering metrics with the Windows AI Foundry, DirectML, and ONNX Runtime specifications to ensure flawless execution providers. 
 - Establish regression tracking systems to evaluate how model updates alter API response latencies, memory footprint, and user-experience quality across Windows PC form factors. 
 - Strong technical background in systems, platform, on-device AI experiences with the ability to guide architecture and technical decisions. 
 - Strong familiarity with the Windows ML architecture, DirectML, and implementing Execution Providers (EPs) within ONNX Runtime
 - Proven track record of working side-by-side with model training/fine-tuning teams and application-layer software engineers
 - Familiarity with Windows architecture, OS fundamentals, and On Device AI concepts. 
 - Familiarity with scripting or automation to support operational efficiency and repeatable processes.

#WSSIJOBS

Additional Or Preferred Qualifications

Other Requirements: Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings: 

- Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter. 

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

data.title: Director, Product Engineering
data.description:
About StarRez

StarRez is the global leader in student housing software, providing innovative solutions for on and off-campus housing management, resident wellness and experience, and revenue generation. Trusted by 1, 400+ clients across 25+ countries, StarRez supports more than 4 million beds annually with its user-friendly, all-in-one platform, delivering seamless experiences for students and administrators. With offices in the United States, Australia, the UK, and India, StarRez blends the robust capabilities of a global organization with the personalized care and service of a trusted partner. 

The Role

We are seeking a strategic, people-first Director of Product & Engineering to lead and grow a portfolio of product and engineering teams in India. Reporting to the VP of Engineering and India Site Lead, you will lead Engineering Managers, senior technical leaders and Product Owners across multiple teams, with accountability for strategy, delivery, organisation design and team performance. Working closely with Product Managers in the US and UK and global Engineering, Design, Quality and business leaders, you will turn customer and business needs into clear strategic direction and predictable outcomes. You will build a high-performing, AI-first product and engineering organisation that delivers meaningful value for customers

What You Will Own

- Engineering leadership and high-performing teams: Lead, coach and grow Engineering Managers and senior technical leaders across multiple teams. Build strong succession, capability and career-development practices, and create an accountable, inclusive and high-performing engineering culture. 
 - Technical direction and architecture: Set the technical direction for your teams in partnership with global Engineering and Architecture. Drive sound decisions on architecture, scalability, security and platform investment, and balance feature delivery with technical debt and long-term system health. 
 - Delivery excellence: Partner with Product Managers and the Director of Product to turn the product roadmap into realistic engineering plans, capacity and milestones. Own predictable, high-quality delivery, and surface risks, dependencies and trade-offs early. 
 - AI-first engineering: Lead the practical adoption of AI across the software development lifecycle, including coding, testing, code review and delivery. Measure its impact on productivity and quality, and share what works across the global organisation. 
 - Quality, reliability and operational excellence: Own engineering standards, CI/CD, test automation, observability and incident management for your teams. Use metrics such as DORA, defect rates and uptime to drive continuous improvement, and ensure strong handling of production issues and customer escalations. 
 - Security and compliance: Ensure your teams build and operate software that meets StarRez security and data privacy standards, including obligations such as SOC 2, GDPR and FERPA for student data. 
 - Organisation design and scale Define team structures, ownership boundaries and operating rhythms as the India Product & Technology organisation grows. Own headcount planning for your teams, manage vendor relationships, and partner with Talent Acquisition and global leadership to hire and retain exceptional talent. 
 - Global partnership and stakeholder visibility: Build trusted partnerships with Product, Engineering, Design and Quality leaders in the US, UK and Australia. Keep teams aligned with customer needs and business priorities, and give stakeholders clear visibility of plans, progress, risks and outcomes

Required Qualifications

- 15+ years in software engineering, including 5+ years leading Engineering Managers or multiple engineering teams. 
 - Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field. 
 - Proven experience leading product engineering teams in a SaaS product environment, managing multiple teams. 
 - Track record of improving delivery, quality and reliability using agile, DevOps and engineering metrics. 
 - Hands-on experience driving practical use of AI tools in engineering teams. 
 - Strong people leadership, including coaching leaders, building high-performing teams and shaping organisation design. 
 - Experience partnering with globally distributed Product, Engineering and business stakeholders across time zones. 
 - Strong customer, commercial and stakeholder orientation, with the ability to connect strategy to measurable outcomes

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience building or scaling product and engineering teams in India for a global product company. 
 - Experience leading AI-enabled change in product development or engineering operations. 
 - Experience in property management technology, student housing or higher education is a plus. 

Even if you don't have all of the Preferred Qualifications listed above, but feel you have what it takes to succeed in the role, we would love to hear from you!

Reasons to join our Team: 

StarRez is not just a workplace - it is a place to belong, build, and grow. 

- A Culture That Lasts: Many of our team members have been with us for 20+ years - a testament to our people-first philosophy. 
 - Global Impact, Local Ownership: Join a team that spans across Australia, the USA, the UK, and Canada, working on industry-leading solutions while building the India centre for Product & Technology. 
 - Long-Term Vision: We are not here for short-term gains. We invest in our people for the long haul, creating an environment where you can grow, lead, and thrive. 
 - Innovation with Stability: Backed by Vista Equity Partners, we combine the agility of a scaling SaaS company with the stability of long-term industry leadership. 
 - Z-Factor: We take pride in our culture of passion, care, and high performance. The Z-Factor defines how we support our teams, foster growth, and ensure that everyone at StarRez thrives. If you are excited about shaping product strategy, growing exceptional leaders and building game-changing products in a high-impact, collaborative environment - StarRez India is the place for you

StarRez is an equal opportunity employer.

We've built a world-class, connected culture rooted in shared values that empowers our teams to thrive and succeed from anywhere. When you join Planview, you're not just joining a company, you're joining a movement to transform how the world works. 

Discover more about our portfolio at planview. com, and connect with us on LinkedIn, Instagram, and X. 

The Opportunity

- Senior individual contributor responsible for the reliability, scalability, and delivery of a large-scale enterprise SaaS work-management platform. 
 - Owns CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure automation, and observability, partnering closely with backend, frontend, and SRE/CloudOps teams. 

What You'll Do

- Design, implement, and maintain CI/CD pipelines for multiple services, improving speed, safety, and repeatability of deployments. 
 - Automate infrastructure using Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) tools to provision, configure, and manage cloud resources in a consistent, reproducible way. 
 - Operate and evolve containerized workloads and orchestration platforms (e. g. , Kubernetes) for high availability and efficient scaling. 
 - Implement and refine monitoring, logging, and alerting to ensure system health, performance, and early detection of issues.

Tech stack

- CI/CD: modern pipeline tooling (e. g. , Git-based workflows, pipeline-as-code, automated testing and release gates). 
 - IaC: tools for declarative infrastructure management (e. g. , Terraform-class tooling). 
 - Containers & orchestration: Docker-style containers; Kubernetes-class orchestrators. 
 - Cloud: experience with at least one major public cloud provider. 
 - Observability: metrics, logs, and tracing platforms; alerting and dashboarding. 

What You'll Bring

Experience & qualifications

 - Strong experience building and operating CI/CD pipelines for multi-service environments. 
 - Solid hands-on skills with containers and at least one orchestration platform.

data.title: Software Development Engineer II, Infrastructure Supply Chain Automation, Infrastructure Supply Chain Automation
data.description:
Description

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we're the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain - and we're looking for talented people who want to help. 

As a Software Development Engineer II on our Infrastructure Supply Chain Automation team, you will build large-scale distributed applications using serverless technologies, data lakes, and NoSQL databases to automate the complex processes that keep AWS infrastructure growing ahead of customer demand. The team is expanding quickly with a strong pipeline of projects ready for you on day one, and we are actively investing in new features and AI adoption. If you enjoy building systems from the ground up and solving problems that require creative, unconventional thinking, this is the role for you. 

Key job responsibilities

- Design and build large-scale distributed applications using serverless technologies, data lakes, and NoSQL databases to automate infrastructure supply chain processes for AWS. 
 - Collaborate with internal teams such to understand scaling requirements, translating them into technical designs that account for performance, security, and long-term maintainability. 
 - Write high-quality, well-documented code across the full development lifecycle, from requirements gathering through deployment and operations, ensuring solutions can be maintained by engineers new to the codebase. 
 - Mentor junior engineers through code reviews and design discussions, actively training new team members on system architecture and operational practices. 
 - Identify root causes of operational issues and drive permanent fixes, improving system reliability through proactive monitoring and automation. 

A day in the life

You start your morning reviewing deployment metrics and triaging any operational alerts. By mid-morning, you are whiteboarding a new automation workflow with teammates, weighing tradeoffs around data structures, algorithms, and service dependencies. After lunch, you pair with a junior engineer on a code change, coaching them through the review process. Later, you pick up one of the projects waiting in the team's backlog, scoping the technical approach and drafting a design document for peer review. 

About The Team

The Infrastructure Supply Chain Automation team sits within AWS Infrastructure Services and directly contributes to the scaling capability of core AWS services. We work alongside software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, and operations managers across AWS. Together we help deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. With a growing project pipeline and active investment in AI-driven capabilities, this is a compelling time to join. You will experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion. 

Inclusive Experiences

Amazon values inclusive experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn't followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don't let it stop you from applying. 

Why AWS

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world's most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating - that's why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses. 

Basic Qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
 - 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
 - 2+ years of building complex software systems experience
 - Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred Qualifications

- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
 - Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https: //amazon. jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you're applying in isn't listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

Software Engineer II - Java Full stack and AI (with Python)

All About Us
