Join the industry's most passionate, motivated & engaged global team - Our employees are encouraged to drive innovation every day in support of a more connected world - A World Beyond Cash. 

Overview

The MasterCard D&S Technology development team is engaged in working with new and innovative technologies to build business solutions that keep MasterCard positioned as a leader in delivering value added business analytic and reporting solutions to our diverse customer base. We work collaboratively with our product partners and other technical teams to continuously improve and enhance our existing products and drive new products to the global marketplace. We are currently seeking candidates that will be responsible to support the technical lead in design and produce a high-quality code using different languages. 

Role

- Design and develop high quality, secure, scalable software solutions based on technical requirements specifications and design artifacts within expected time and budget. 
 - Work closely with Product Owners to develop beautiful, usable UIs and creative visualizations. 
 - Stay abreast of latest on the technology trends and industry best practices to hone and maintain your talent. 
 - Participate in architectural discussions, iteration planning, and feature sizing meetings. 
 - Develop code of high quality with customer focussed approach. 
 - Provide support during System and User Acceptance Testing. 
 - Adhere to Agile processes and participate actively in agile ceremonies. 

All About You

- Strong 3-6 years of experience in Full Stack Java application development and support, using modern and industry-standard development tools and practices. 
 - Hands-on experience with Java 8 or higher and Spring Framework (Spring 5 or above) for building scalable backend services. 
 - Proven experience in developing RESTful web services using Spring Boot / Spring REST APIs. 
 - Solid understanding of relational databases such as Oracle or SQL Server, with expertise in writing optimized and performant SQL queries. 
 - Experience with modern frontend frameworks such as React or Angular for building responsive user interfaces. 
 - Exposure to CI/CD pipelines using tools like Jenkins, Maven/Gradle, SonarQube, Chef, or equivalent automation tools. 
 - Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) for application deployment, monitoring, and scaling, along with understanding of cloud-native and microservices architecture. 
 - Familiarity with containerization and orchestration technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes. 
 - Hands-on experience or exposure to Databricks and big data ecosystems, including working with Spark-based data processing, ETL pipelines, or Delta Lake. 
 - Exposure to AI/ML concepts and AI-powered development tools (e. g. , Copilot, AI-assisted testing, or code generation) and ability to integrate AI/ML services/APIs into applications. 
 - Familiarity with application servers and development environments including Tomcat, Apache, STS, Eclipse, IntelliJ IDEA, and Visual Studio Code. 
 - Good understanding of Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and experience working in Agile (Scrum/Kanban) methodologies. 
 - Experience working in global, cross-functional teams, with strong technical problem-solving skills. 
 - AI model development skills preferred

Corporate Security Responsibility

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must: 

- Abide by Mastercard's security policies and practices; 
 - Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed; 
 - Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
 - Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard's guidelines.

data.title: Embedded Quality Assurance Engineer
data.description:
Are you. . . 

- Interested in the physics behind how we perceive color and appearance?
 - Interested in innovation for precision measurement instruments?
 - Interested in working in a strong international R&D team?

If so, read on!

X-Rite Pantone is the leading company for color measurement systems and solutions, worldwide and over a wide range of markets (print and packaging, consumer electronics, automotive, textile, etc. ). Our products combine precision optical measurement systems with advanced algorithms, powerful embedded computing, and software. 

Role Overview - Embedded Quality Assurance Engineer - Bangalore (India)

As an Embedded Quality Assurance Engineer, you will play a key role in ensuring the quality, reliability, cybersecurity, and performance of X-Rite's embedded software solutions. You will work closely with software, firmware, systems, and product teams throughout the development lifecycle to validate new features, improve test automation, and ensure robust product releases. This role combines hands-on testing, test automation development, and collaboration with cross-functional teams in a global engineering organization spanning India, Europe, and the United States. You will contribute directly to the quality of our market-leading spectrophotometers, color measurement systems, and spectral imaging products. 

Key Responsibilities

- Design, develop, execute, and maintain comprehensive test plans and test cases for embedded software products. 
 - Develop and enhance automated test frameworks, regression test suites, and validation tools to improve quality and efficiency. 
 - Execute functional, integration, system, regression, and exploratory testing of embedded devices and associated software components. 
 - Analyze test results, investigate defects, and work closely with software and firmware engineers to identify root causes and verify fixes. 
 - Collaborate with development teams to ensure quality is integrated throughout the software development lifecycle. 
 - Support cybersecurity validation activities, including security testing and verification of security requirements. 
 - Assist in improving test coverage, automation capabilities, release readiness criteria, and quality metrics. 
 - Participate actively in Agile development processes, including sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives. 
 - Acquire a strong understanding of customer use cases and product functionality to help ensure high-quality product releases. 
 - Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives through automation, AI-assisted testing, process optimization, and knowledge sharing. 

Required Qualifications

Bachelor or Master of Science in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field. 3-7 years of experience in software quality assurance, embedded systems testing, or test automation. 

Experience and training in most of the following areas are required: 

- Experience testing embedded Linux-based systems and software-driven hardware products. 
 - Experience developing automated tests using Python, PyTest, GoogleTest, or similar frameworks. 
 - Experience with software debugging, defect tracking, and test management processes. 
 - Familiarity with version control systems such as Git. 
 - Experience working with CI/CD environments and automated build pipelines. 
 - Understanding of software development lifecycles and quality assurance best practices. 
 - Experience working within Agile development environments (Scrum and/or Kanban). 
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. 
 - Effective verbal and written communication skills in English. 
 - Ability to work independently while contributing effectively within a collaborative team environment. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with Embedded Linux and Yocto-based systems. 
 - Experience with hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) and system-level automated testing. 
 - Familiarity with programming languages such as C, C++, Python, and Bash. 
 - Experience with tools such as GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, or Azure DevOps. 
 - Familiarity with optical measurement systems, instrumentation products, or related industrial devices. 

Personal Attributes

- Strong ownership mindset with a passion for product quality and customer satisfaction. 
 - Curious, hands-on, and eager to learn new technologies and domains. 
 - Structured and detail-oriented approach to testing and problem solving. 
 - Collaborative team player with strong communication and influencing skills. 

We recognize that people come with a wealth of experience and talent. We believe in the value of unique perspectives, and we welcome candidates from diverse backgrounds who may not meet every criterion to apply and bring their distinctive experiences to our team. 

We Offer

- A dynamic, international, and innovative work environment. 
 - Exciting technical challenges and expert colleagues with decades of experience in the field. 
 - A position in our Bangalore office with flexibility in the time schedule and hybrid work model. 
 - A human sized organization where you'll have contact beyond the R&D department. 
 - Coaching and learning opportunities at every stage of your career. 

Immerse yourself in a vibrant and dynamic workplace that spans industries such as printing, packaging, photography, graphic design, video, automotive, paints, plastics, and textiles. Join a team that thrives on pushing the boundaries of what's possible, where innovation meets impact, and cross-functional teamwork sets us apart. 

X-Rite Pantone is proud to part of the Product Quality & Innovation segment of Veralto (NYSE: VLTO), a $5B global leader dedicated to ensuring access to clean water, safe food and medicine, and trusted essential goods. When you join Veralto's vibrant global network of 16, 000 associates, you join a unique culture and work environment where purpose meets possibility: where the work you do has an everyday impact on the resources and essentials we all rely on, and where you'll have valuable opportunities to deepen your skillset, pursue your ambitions, and grow your career. Together, we're Safeguarding the World's Most Vital ResourcesTM-and building rewarding careers along the way. 

Contact@shilpashetty

At Veralto, we value diversity and the existence of similarities and differences, both visible and not, found in our workforce, workplace and throughout the markets we serve. Our associates, customers and shareholders contribute unique and different perspectives as a result of these diverse attributes. 

Unsolicited Assistance

We do not accept unsolicited assistance from any headhunters or recruitment firms for any of our job openings. All resumes or profiles submitted by search firms to any employee at any of the Veralto companies, in any form without a valid, signed search agreement in place for the specific position, approved by Talent Acquisition, will be deemed the sole property of Veralto and its companies. No fee will be paid in the event the candidate is hired by Veralto and its companies because of the unsolicited referral.

data.title: System Test Engineer
data.description:

You will collaborate with global cross-functional teams to ensure high-quality, reliable, and scalable product performance for cutting-edge automotive solutions. 

Our Team

At Koch Companies

Any compensation range provided for a role is an estimate determined by available market data. The actual amount may vary depending on each candidate's knowledge, skills, abilities, and geographic location. Please connect with your recruiter to learn more about our compensation philosophy.

data.description:
We are Siemens

Siemens Digital Industries Software is a leading provider of solutions for the design, simulation, and manufacture of products across many different industries. Formula 1 cars, skyscrapers, ships, space exploration vehicles, and many of the objects we see in our daily lives are being conceived and manufactured using our software. 

Siemens Digital Industries Software is looking for a Software QA Engineer to join our Engineering Intelligence team and help ensure the quality, reliability, and performance of cloud-delivered engineering applications used by global manufacturers. 

You will work with quality engineers, developers, product owners, and engineering domain experts to define and execute end-to-end workflows across SaaS, OnPrem, and High Performance Computing (HPC) environments. The role combines software quality engineering with engineering simulation workflows, cloud technologies, automation, and complex distributed systems. 

You will play a key role in ensuring that our applications not only function correctly, but also deliver reliable and credible engineering results. 

Key Responsibilities

- Design and execute comprehensive testing: Plan and perform functional, integration, system, exploratory, end-to-end, and performance testing for complex engineering and cloud-delivered applications. 
 - Validate engineering workflows: Test simulation-driven workflows from model setup and execution through solver behavior and result validation, ensuring both functional correctness and engineering credibility. 
 - Build test automation: Develop, maintain, and enhance automated test suites using modern frameworks such as Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, or similar technologies to improve regression coverage and release efficiency. 
 - Test cloud and distributed applications: Validate web-based and cloud-native applications across microservices, event-driven architectures, and distributed environments. 
 - Analyze and troubleshoot quality issues: Investigate failures, defects, performance bottlenecks, and unexpected behaviors; perform root-cause analysis and verify fixes. 
 - Work with CI/CD and engineering infrastructure: Integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines and troubleshoot test environments across Windows, Linux, containers, and Kubernetes-based environments. 
 - Drive quality across the product lifecycle: Collaborate with developers, architects, product owners, and domain experts to define acceptance criteria, identify quality risks, and continuously improve test strategy and coverage. 

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline. 
 - 5+ years of hands-on software QA/testing experience involving technically complex software, with strong experience in test planning, execution, defect analysis, and validation. 
 - Strong experience with web/UI test automation using Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, or similar frameworks. 
 - Experience with CI/CD pipelines and tools such as GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD, or equivalent. 
 - Working knowledge of Windows and Linux/Unix environments, with strong debugging and troubleshooting skills. 
 - Understanding of microservices, event-driven architectures, and distributed applications, with exposure to troubleshooting Kubernetes-based environments. 
 - Strong analytical, problem-solving, debugging, and communication skills, with the ability to work independently and collaborate effectively in Agile teams. 

Preferred Experience

- Experience with engineering simulation, CAE, CAD, or other scientific/technical software, including understanding of simulation workflows beyond basic tool operation. 
 - Strong understanding of simulation concepts such as meshing, physics modeling, solver configuration, convergence, numerical stability, and result validation. 
 - Experience with API testing using tools such as Postman and performance testing using JMeter, Gatling, or similar. 
 - Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP and testing applications deployed in cloud environments. 
 - Experience with Docker and Kubernetes, including debugging applications and test environments in containerized environments. 
 - Experience testing HPC environments, including Linux clusters, MPI-based workloads, and job schedulers such as Slurm or PBS. 
 - Experience with performance, scalability, reliability, or security testing of distributed or cloud-based applications. 

Why Us

At Siemens Software, flexibility is how we work - hybrid by default, built on trust and autonomy. Together, 30, 000 people across more than 200 countries build technology that shapes the real world. You'll grow through real projects, strong technical peers, and global mobility, backed by the scale and benefits of an industrial software leader. We're committed to equality and inclusion, and we hire based on merit, skills, and impact. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow!

Let's foster a culture of creativity and innovation. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Our biggest asset is our team of passionate engineers and technically minded managers.   

  

You'll be joining a team of highly skilled and talented team players who're proud of what they own and deliver. - Work with engineering teams to design, develop and deliver cloud based infrastructure projects on a modern tech stack (Redis, Elasticsearch, Docker, Terraform on AWS)
 - Drive evaluation, development and roll out of new common microservices
 - Operate, support, and upgrade shared services and frameworks. Scale these as their usage invariably grows along with Okta's business. 
 - Help with design and code reviews. Ensure high programming standard by writing unit and functional tests. 
 - Assist with monitoring, troubleshooting of services and frameworks the team owns
 - Collaborate with architects, QA, product owners, security and operations engineers
 - Help with mentoring new engineering hires and interns  

Minimum required knowledge, skills and abilities: 

- Immense passion about doing the right thing to help Okta's technology stay ahead of its anticipated business growth
 - Solid technology chops in architecting, implementing, tuning and debugging some of the largest cloud deployments in the enterprise world
 - Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
 - 7+ yrs of expansive programming experience in an object-oriented programming language like Java, especially in backend services. A good understanding of multithreading, garbage collection, memory management. 
 - 4+ yrs experience of working with MySQL or equivalent relational database systems. Knowledge of NoSQL databases is a plus. 
 - Demonstrated experience of working with ReST and good understanding of its fundamentals
 - Knowledge of Spring, Spring Boot, Hibernate and Tomcat
 - Knowledge of AWS, Redis, Elasticsearch, and Docker
 - Familiarity with network security, authentication and authorization as a nice-to-have

 - Experience with enterprise SaaS as a good-to-have

 - Work with CI/CD and engineering infrastructure: Integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines and troubleshoot test environments across Windows, Linux, containers, and Kubernetes-based environments. 
 - Drive quality across the product lifecycle: Collaborate with developers, architects, product owners, and domain experts to define acceptance criteria, identify quality risks, and continuously improve test strategy and coverage. 

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline. 
 - + years of hands-on software QA/testing experience involving technically complex software, with strong experience in test planning, execution, defect analysis, and validation. 
 - Strong experience with web/UI test automation using Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, or similar frameworks. 
 - Experience with CI/CD pipelines and tools such as GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD, or equivalent. 
 - Working knowledge of Windows and Linux/Unix environments, with strong debugging and troubleshooting skills. 
 - Understanding of microservices, event-driven architectures, and distributed applications, with exposure to troubleshooting Kubernetes-based environments. 
 - Strong analytical, problem-solving, debugging, and communication skills, with the ability to work independently and collaborate effectively in Agile teams. 

Preferred Experience

- Experience with engineering simulation, CAE, CAD, or other scientific/technical software, including understanding of simulation workflows beyond basic tool operation. 
 - Strong understanding of simulation concepts such as meshing, physics modeling, solver configuration, convergence, numerical stability, and result validation. 
 - Experience with API testing using tools such as Postman and performance testing using JMeter, Gatling, or similar. 
 - Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP and testing applications deployed in cloud environments. 
 - Experience with Docker and Kubernetes, including debugging applications and test environments in containerized environments. 
 - Experience testing HPC environments, including Linux clusters, MPI-based workloads, and job schedulers such as Slurm or PBS. 
 - Experience with performance, scalability, reliability, or security testing of distributed or cloud-based applications.

At Siemens Software, flexibility is how we work - hybrid by default, built on trust and autonomy. Together, 30, 000 people across more than 200 countries build technology that shapes the real world. You will design, develop, and maintain automated test frameworks and validation tools that support continuous testing across our embedded product portfolio. 

Working closely with quality assurance, software, firmware, DevOps, and systems engineering teams, you will help ensure high product quality by integrating automated testing into the development lifecycle and enabling rapid feedback in a CI/CD environment.

 - Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively within cross-functional engineering teams.

Personal Attributes

- Passion for automation, software quality, and engineering excellence. 
 - Strong ownership mindset with a focus on delivering reliable and maintainable solutions. 
 - Curious and proactive approach to problem-solving and continuous learning.

Immerse yourself in a vibrant and dynamic workplace that spans industries such as printing, packaging, photography, graphic design, video, automotive, paints, plastics, and textiles. Join a team that thrives on pushing the boundaries of what's possible, where innovation meets impact, and cross-functional teamwork sets us apart. 

X-Rite Pantone is proud to part of the Product Quality & Innovation segment of Veralto (NYSE: VLTO), a $5B global leader dedicated to ensuring access to clean water, safe food and medicine, and trusted essential goods. And you'll recognize the names of our clients. Most of them are on The Global 2000. They trust us to give them the latest in controls, audit and analytics software every day. Industry analysts consistently rank us as a top supplier management solution, and you'll be helping build that reputation. 

Read more about apexanalytix - https: //www. apexanalytix. com/about/

Job Details

The Role

apexanalytix is seeking an engineering executive to serve as VP of Engineering, based in the United States, reporting to the Chief Product & Technology Officer (CPTO) and sitting on the CPTO's leadership team. The role leads the engineering behind our two customer journeys, Supplier Journey and Buyer Journey. It is accountable for delivering them predictably, at high quality, and in a way that teams can own and run in production. 

We are moving to the product operating model. Product, engineering and design are organized into four persistent trios, each funded against outcome goals: Supplier Journey, Buyer Journey, Data & Intelligence, and Platform. The VP of Engineering leads the Supplier and Buyer engineering leads and the US engineering teams in those journeys. With both journeys in one engineering organization, the moments suppliers and buyers share (onboarding, validation and payment status) have a single engineering owner. 

Quick Take -

The VP of Engineering is the engineering partner to the VP of Product and the Head of Design in each trio, and works closely with the Head of AI & Data, who leads the Data & Intelligence trio, including the engineering for the data products we sell, machine learning, data science, data engineering and the agent platform. The role also works with the SVP Engineering & Head of India GCC, whose Noida engineers work in these trios; the Chief Architect; the VP Technology Operations; and the Head of GRC. Experience leading engineering for enterprise SaaS products in empowered, outcome-funded teams is required. 

Trusted Advisor

- Advises the CPTO and the executive team on engineering capacity, delivery risk, technical debt and the engineering investment needed to meet product and revenue goals. 
 - Brings an honest, data-backed view of feasibility to product discovery and investment decisions, so the company commits to what it can deliver well. 
 - Represents engineering to clients and partners on complex integrations, escalations and roadmap commitments, alongside Product and Go-to-Market leaders. 

The Work -

Engineering for the customer journeys

- Journey engineering. Leads the Supplier Journey and Buyer Journey engineering leads and their teams. Supplier Journey covers onboarding and validation (bank, tax, sanctions), the supplier portal and self-service, and inquiries and payment status. Buyer Journey covers supplier risk and compliance, invoice and payment controls, duplicate and fraud prevention, and Assurance & Recovery. 
 - Shared moments. Owns engineering for the moments suppliers and buyers share, so they work as one workflow seen from two sides, with clear lead and partner teams for each. 
 - Agents in the workflow. Makes sure journey teams build the agent experiences inside their workflows (such as onboarding, inquiry handling and duplicate-payment triage) on the shared building blocks from Data & Intelligence, to the same engineering and production standards as the rest of the product. 

Partnership with Data & Intelligence

- Shared building blocks. Works with the Head of AI & Data so journey teams use the shared data, scores, models and agent building blocks well, through clear, stable interfaces rather than one-off integrations. 
 - Workflow data. Makes sure journey workflows capture clean, well-defined data that Data & Intelligence can use to enrich data products and improve models. 
 - Consistent standards. Agrees with the Head of AI & Data how models and agents move into production in journey workflows, so they meet the same engineering, production and audit standards. 

Delivery and engineering excellence

- Empowered teams. Builds persistent engineering teams that own outcomes with their product and design partners, not tickets handed to them. Engineers join discovery early to test feasibility and shape solutions. 
 - Predictable delivery. Is accountable for predictable, high-quality delivery against the outcomes each trio commits to. Runs the engineering operating cadence with product and design and fixes delivery problems at the root. 
 - Quality and practices. Raises the bar on code quality, automated testing, CI/CD, observability and secure development. Tracks and improves DORA measures, defect escape rate and incident trends. Drives practical, measured adoption of AI-assisted development. 
 - Production ownership. Ensures teams own what they build in production, including on-call, incident response and root-cause follow-through, working with SRE in Technology Operations. 
 - Architecture and standards. Contributes to the global architecture council chaired by the Chief Architect and co-signs standards that affect the journey trios. Makes sure teams follow them and pay down technical debt deliberately. 

Leadership and management

- Organization. Leads engineering leads, managers and senior engineers across the Supplier Journey and Buyer Journey teams. Designs team boundaries around the trios and hires or promotes the leaders needed to run them. 
 - Global teams. Partners with the SVP Engineering & Head of India GCC so that Noida engineers in journey teams work as full members of those teams, with one set of standards and practices. 
 - Talent. Owns hiring, development, career paths and retention for US engineering, including a technical track to staff and principal engineer. 
 - Budget and reporting. Owns the engineering budget for these teams, including headcount, tooling and vendors. Gives the CPTO regular reporting on delivery, quality, reliability and team health, with each metric backed by data that can be re-run. 

First-Year Priorities

- Organize engineering into persistent teams aligned to the Supplier Journey and Buyer Journey, and appoint or hire the engineering leads to run them. 
 - Agree first-year outcome goals and engineering plans with product and design leaders for both journey trios. 
 - Agree with the Head of AI & Data how journey teams use shared data and agent building blocks, and ship at least one agent experience in a journey workflow to production standards. 
 - Assign a lead team for each supplier-buyer shared moment, and deliver at least one measurable improvement to a shared workflow. 
 - Set a baseline for delivery predictability, DORA measures, defect escape rate and production incidents, and show measurable improvement against it. 
 - Make sure every team owns its services in production, with on-call, runbooks and service-level objectives agreed with Technology Operations. 
 - Establish career ladders and a hiring plan for US engineering, including the technical track. 

Required Skills

- 15+ years in software engineering, including 7+ years leading engineering organizations of 50+ engineers through managers and directors in enterprise SaaS. 
 - A proven record of delivering complex B2B products predictably and at high quality, and of turning around delivery or quality problems. 
 - Experience building integration-heavy, data-intensive workflow products for enterprise clients at scale. 
 - Experience working in empowered product teams under the product operating model, as an equal partner to product and design in discovery and delivery. 
 - Strong technical depth in cloud-native SaaS architecture, distributed systems, integration and data-intensive platforms, sufficient to lead design reviews and make sound technical calls. 
 - Hands-on familiarity with modern engineering practices: CI/CD, automated testing, observability, DevSecOps and AI-assisted development. 
 - Experience bringing AI and agent capabilities into production workflows with appropriate guardrails and quality measures. 
 - A track record of hiring, developing and retaining strong engineering leaders and senior engineers. 
 - Experience leading distributed teams across US and India time zones. 
 - Experience operating in security- and compliance-regulated environments (for example SOC 1, SOC 2 and ISO 27001). 
 - Strong executive presence, able to represent engineering credibly to the CPTO, the executive team, clients and, as needed, the Board. 

Preferred Skills

- Domain experience in procure-to-pay, accounts payable, supplier management, payment fraud prevention, risk or fintech. 
 - Experience building integrations with ERP systems such as SAP, Oracle or Microsoft Dynamics. 
 - Experience in a PE-backed or high-growth SaaS company, connecting engineering investment to revenue and margin. 

Over the years, we've discovered that the most effective and successful associates at apexanalytix are people who have a specific combination of values, skills, and behaviors that we call "The apex Way". Read more about The apex Way - https: //www. apexanalytix. com/careers/

Benefits

At apexanalytix we know that our associates are the reason behind our successes. We truly value you as an associate and part of our professional family. Our goal is to offer the very best benefits possible to you and your loved ones. When it comes to benefits, whether for yourself or your family the most important aspect is choice. And we get that. apexanalytix offers competitive benefits for the countries that we serve, in addition to our BeWell@apex initiative that encourages employees' growth in six key wellness areas: Emotional, Physical, Community, Financial, Social, and Intelligence. 

With resources such as a strong Mentor Program, Internal Training Portal, plus Education, Tuition, and Certification Assistance, we provide tools for our associates to grow and develop.

data.title: DQC Manager / Lead
data.description:
Company: Lifeasy Interior

Department: Design & Technical Quality Control

Reporting To: Design & Operations Leadership

Location: Noida

About the RoleLifeasy Interior is looking for an experienced Drawing Quality Control (DQC) professional to bridge the gap between design intent and practical execution. 

The role goes beyond checking production drawings. It requires a strong understanding of interior design, materials, manufacturing processes, costing and site execution to help designers translate creative ideas into technically feasible, commercially viable and production-ready solutions. 

The DQC Lead will own the quality and timely delivery of production drawings, BOQs, BOMs and cutlists, while managing the 2D drafting team, coordinating with vendors and maintaining an organised repository of production documentation. 

An important part of this role is to elevate both design quality and customer experience (CX) by helping the Design Team resolve technical challenges early, minimise avoidable revisions and deliver designs that can be executed as promised. 

Key Responsibilities1. Design Feasibility & Technical Collaboration
 - Partner with designers to evaluate the practicality, constructability and commercial feasibility of proposed designs. 
 - Help translate creative design concepts into workable technical solutions without unnecessarily restricting design intent. 
 - Identify potential challenges involving materials, hardware, dimensions, joinery, manufacturing and installation, and recommend practical alternatives. 
 - Encourage early technical consultation to prevent avoidable design changes after customer approval or Design Freeze. 
 - Balance design aspirations, customer expectations, budget and execution feasibility to improve the overall customer experience. 2. Production Documentation & Quality
 - Own the quality and timely delivery of 2D production drawings, shop drawings, BOQs, BOMs and cutlists. 
 - Ensure all documents are accurate, complete and aligned with approved 3D designs, site measurements, specifications and material selections. 
 - Review 3D-to-2D interpretation, dimensions, detailing, quantities and manufacturing requirements before release. 
 - Ensure documentation is sufficiently clear for production teams and vendors to execute without repeated clarifications. 
 - Maintain revision control and ensure only the latest approved production files are used. 3. Production Planning & Vendor Coordination
 - Ensure drawings, material specifications, BOMs and cutlists are released in a sequence that supports production planning and project timelines. 
 - Identify technical dependencies, material availability constraints and pending approvals that could affect production readiness. 
 - Coordinate with vendors and internal teams to validate pricing, specifications, manufacturing feasibility and material alternatives. 
 - Work with Design, Estimation, Procurement and Operations to resolve discrepancies before they affect production or site execution. 
 - Support reliable production planning by ensuring that technical documentation and material requirements are available at the right time. 4. Design Quality & Continuous Learning
 - Identify recurring design and documentation errors and address their root causes. 
 - Conduct regular, constructive training sessions for designers using actual project examples, common mistakes and recommended technical approaches. 
 - Build practical design guidelines, detailing standards and checklists that help designers make better decisions independently. 
 - Encourage collaboration and knowledge-sharing rather than a fault-finding culture. 
 - Track recurring errors and improvement in design quality, first-time-right documentation and avoidable rework. 5. Team Management & Documentation Systems
 - Manage, guide and prioritise the work of the 2D drafting team to ensure quality and timely delivery. 
 - Allocate assignments based on project priorities, complexity, resource availability and committed timelines. 
 - Maintain a well-organised central repository of approved production files, shop drawings, BOQs, BOMs, cutlists, revisions and relevant technical references. 
 - Establish consistent file-naming conventions, folder structures, version control and retrieval protocols for future projects. 
 - Develop reusable drawing details, standard solutions and reference libraries to improve team efficiency and consistency. 
 - Maintain visibility of pending requests, drawing status, approval dependencies and production-documentation readiness. Candidate Requirements
 - Prior experience in a DQC role within residential interiors, modular furniture or a closely related design-to-production environment is mandatory. 
 - Strong knowledge of interior production drawings, shop drawings, joinery detailing, materials, hardware and manufacturing processes. 
 - Practical experience in reviewing 3D designs and translating them into accurate, executable 2D documentation. 
 - Working knowledge of BOQ, BOM, cutlist preparation, estimation and vendor pricing. 
 - Experience managing a drafting team and coordinating with designers, production teams, vendors and operations. 
 - Strong organisational skills, attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple projects systematically. 
 - Proficiency in relevant CAD and drawing-review tools. 
 - Strong communication skills and the ability to explain technical issues constructively and propose workable solutions. Measures of Success
 - Accurate and timely delivery of production-ready documentation. 
 - Improved design feasibility and fewer avoidable revisions after customer approval or Design Freeze. 
 - Reduction in drawing-related production errors, material wastage and site rework. 
 - Better coordination between Design, Estimation, Procurement, Vendors and Operations. 
 - Improved first-time-right quality and predictability of production planning. 
 - Regular designer training and measurable improvement in recurring error patterns. 
 - A complete, organised and reliable production-drawing repository for future reference. What We Expect From This RoleWe are looking for someone who can work alongside designers, understand their intent, identify practical challenges and help develop the right solutions. 

The ideal candidate combines technical depth with a collaborative mindset, strong organisational discipline and an understanding that good DQC is not just about preventing errors. It is about making good designs executable, improving customer confidence and enabling smoother project delivery. 

Interested candidates should share their resume highlighting their prior DQC experience, technical responsibilities, team management experience and exposure to residential interior production.

About RTX

At RTX, the world's largest aerospace and defense company, approximately 185, 000 people come together with a shared purpose: to solve the world's most complex challenges and make a meaningful difference. Through our three industry-leading businesses, advanced engineering capabilities, and significant investments in research and development, we are pushing the boundaries of science and technology to connect and protect our world. 

Join Collins Aerospace and help shape the future of flight. 

Collins Aerospace delivers technologically advanced, intelligent solutions that redefine the aerospace and defense industry. With deep technical expertise and a comprehensive portfolio of aerospace technologies, we help customers navigate the evolving demands of global aviation. 

Be part of a team that is advancing aviation safety, reliability, and innovation through world-class engineering. 

About The Role

We are looking for an experienced Avionics Software Verification & Validation (V&V) Engineer / Technical Lead to drive the verification, testing, debugging, and certification of safety-critical avionics software. 

In this role, you will work on requirement-based testing, structural coverage analysis, host- and target-based verification, and compliance with DO-178B/C certification objectives. You will collaborate with global engineering teams, contribute to certification reviews and audits, and help develop innovative tools and processes that improve software quality and engineering efficiency. 

This is an opportunity to combine deep technical expertise with technical leadership, mentoring, and continuous improvement while contributing to avionics systems that support safe and reliable flight operations. 

What You'll Do

Avionics Software Verification & Certification

- Design, develop, review, and execute requirement-based test cases, test procedures, and unit tests for safety-critical avionics software. 
 - Perform software verification and validation across host and target environments, including unit, integration, and system-level testing. 
 - Conduct Structural Coverage Analysis (SCA) and support the achievement of applicable software coverage objectives. 
 - Ensure compliance with DO-178B/C processes and objectives for applicable software assurance levels, including Levels A, B, and C. 
 - Support certification activities, including Stages of Involvement (SOI), technical reviews, compliance submissions, and internal and external audits. 
 - Maintain adherence to established software development, verification, quality, and documentation standards. 

Technical Problem-Solving & Tool Development

- Debug and troubleshoot software issues across host and target platforms, including software-software and hardware-software integration environments. 
 - Analyze system capabilities, software behavior, and reported issues to identify root causes and implement effective solutions. 
 - Develop and maintain Python-based automation and common engineering tools to improve development and verification efficiency. 
 - Apply engineering principles to design, develop, and implement technologies, components, subsystems, and systems that meet defined requirements and specifications. 
 - Contribute to continuous improvement in test automation, verification methodologies, and engineering workflows. 

Technical Leadership & Collaboration

- Collaborate with multidisciplinary and geographically distributed teams to deliver project milestones and engineering commitments. 
 - Lead or coordinate moderately sized engineering teams, as applicable, ensuring quality, timely execution, and alignment with project objectives. 
 - Coach and mentor junior engineers, review technical deliverables, and promote engineering best practices. 
 - Lead or contribute to innovation initiatives, quality improvement activities, and CORE workshops to deliver measurable product and process improvements. 
 - Identify novel technical solutions and ensure innovations are appropriately captured and protected through applicable intellectual property processes. 

What You'll Bring

Required Qualifications

- B. Tech. /B. E. or M. Tech. /M. E. in Computer Science, Electronics, Electrical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a related STEM discipline. 
 - Understanding of avionics systems and software architecture, particularly in areas such as Data Link, Communication, Navigation and Surveillance (CNS), Flight Management Systems (FMS), and cockpit displays. 
 - Strong proficiency in Python for scripting, test automation, and engineering tool development. 
 - Sound knowledge of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and DO-178B/C processes for safety-critical avionics software. 
 - Hands-on experience in software Verification & Validation, Structural Coverage Analysis, debugging, troubleshooting, and requirement-based testing. 
 - Experience in unit testing, integration testing, system testing, and software verification activities. 
 - Experience with software-software and hardware-software integration and debugging. 
 - Familiarity with Agile software development methodologies. 
 - Working knowledge of version control and project tracking tools such as Git or Subversion and Jira. 
 - Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills. 

Preferred Qualifications

- 6-9 years of avionics engineering experience, particularly in safety-critical software verification and certification. 
 - Hands-on experience with tools such as PyATE, Rapita, Coverity, and Jama. 
 - Knowledge of DevSecOps practices and tools or environments such as Docker, Visual Studio Code, and Artifactory. 
 - Sound programming knowledge of C/C++. 
 - Knowledge of avionics data link applications and protocols, including: Controller-Pilot Data Link Communications (CPDLC). Automatic Dependent Surveillance-Contract (ADS-C). ATN Context Management (CM). FANS ACARS Facilities Notification (AFN). Airline Operational Control (AOC) and Flight Management System (FMS) flight-planning applications. 
 - Familiarity with data link industry standards such as DO-258A, ED-110B, and DO-351. 
 - Demonstrated technical leadership, mentoring, and engineering review experience. 
 - A continuous improvement mindset, with an interest in Lean principles, innovation, and engineering excellence. 

Why Join Collins Aerospace?

- Make a real-world impact: Contribute to safety-critical avionics software that supports the future of aviation. 
 - Solve complex engineering challenges: Work with advanced technologies, rigorous certification processes, and sophisticated verification environments. 
 - Collaborate globally: Partner with experienced engineers and cross-functional teams across international locations. 
 - Grow your technical leadership: Mentor engineers, influence engineering practices, and contribute to innovation. 
 - Drive engineering excellence: Help improve product quality, verification efficiency, and software reliability. 

The recruiting team will provide further details regarding the role type and current site arrangements during the hiring process. For onsite and hybrid roles, commuting to and from the assigned location is the employee's responsibility. 

Education & Experience Guidelines

This position typically requires a university degree in Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics (STEM) and relevant professional experience. Equivalent experience or an advanced degree may be considered in accordance with the role's requirements and applicable local regulations. 

The level of responsibility and experience required will depend on the final position scope and assigned engineering responsibilities.

Back

Job title

Solution Architect

Location : Pune

Work Mode : WFO

Experience : 8+ Years

About Wai

Wai Technologies is a cutting-edge firm that pioneers innovative solutions in the tech industry. Renowned for its forward-thinking approach, the company seamlessly blends state-of-the-art technologies with visionary strategies to empower businesses worldwide. With a commitment to excellence and a focus on transformative digital experiences, Wai Technologies stands as a beacon of technological advancement, driving growth and fostering innovation in an ever-evolving digital landscape. 

As a Microsoft Solutions Partner, we excel in Cloud services, App Modernization, Data/AI, specializing in industries such as Healthcare, Fintech, Construction, and more. 

About The Role

We are looking for an experienced Solutions Architect to design and govern the architecture of banking-grade fintech platforms - digital wallets, money market/deposit accounts, payments, and value-added services (VAS). Think systems comparable to Shoprite Money Market, retail banking wallets, or similar high-volume consumer financial platforms. 

You will own end-to-end solution design, define integration and data architecture, and ensure every system we build satisfies financial regulation from day one. You will work closely with the Technical Lead and engineering teams who build to your designs. 

Key Responsibilities

Solution Architecture

- Design end-to-end architectures for banking and payments products: wallets, money market/transactional accounts, remittances, bill payments, airtime/VAS. 
 - Define integration patterns with core banking systems, payment switches, card schemes, and third parties (ISO 8583 / ISO 20022, EFT, RTC, DebiCheck, Rapid Payments, card issuing/acquiring). 
 - Design ledger, reconciliation, settlement, and clearing flows with strong guarantees around transaction integrity and idempotency. 
 - Own non-functional architecture: high availability, disaster recovery, capacity planning, and performance at retail scale. 
 - Lead build-vs-buy assessments and vendor selection (core banking, KYC, fraud, ledger platforms). 
 - Produce and maintain architecture artefacts: solution designs, sequence and data-flow diagrams, API contracts, and threat models. 
 - Establish and chair architecture governance (design reviews, standards, reference architectures). 

Compliance & Security by Design

Architect Systems Compliant With South African Financial Regulation

- SARB requirements and the National Payment System Act
 - FICA - KYC/AML/CFT controls, customer due diligence, transaction monitoring, FIC reporting
 - GDPR - data privacy, residency, consent, retention
 - PASA / payments industry rules and clearing/settlement participation
 - Design for PCI DSS compliance in card data environments. 
 - Embed security architecture: encryption, key management (HSMs), secure SDLC, fraud controls, and complete audit trails. 
 - Support audits, penetration tests, and regulator or sponsor-bank due diligence. 

Stakeholder Engagement

- Partner with product, compliance, legal, and operations to balance speed-to-market with regulatory obligations. 
 - Engage sponsor banks, card schemes (Visa/Mastercard), and fintech partners on integration and certification. 
 - Present architecture decisions and trade-offs to executives and external stakeholders. 

Minimum Requirements

- 8+ years in software engineering, with 4+ years in solution or enterprise architecture roles. 
 - Proven track record architecting banking or fintech systems in production - digital wallets, money market/deposit products, payment platforms, or mobile money. 
 - Deep understanding of double-entry ledgers, reconciliation, settlement, and clearing in the South African payments landscape. 
 - Strong working knowledge of FICA, GDPR, PCI DSS, SARB/NPS requirements and how they translate into system design. 
 - Expertise in distributed systems: microservices, event-driven architecture, messaging (Kafka/RabbitMQ), API design, and financial-grade data modelling. 
 - Cloud architecture experience (AWS, Azure, or GCP) in regulated environments. 

Advantages

- Core banking platform experience or proprietary ledger design. 
 - Card scheme certification experience (Visa/Mastercard issuing or acquiring). 
 - TOGAF, AWS/Azure Solutions Architect, CISSP/CISM, or PCI ISA certification. 
 - Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field. 

Personal Attributes

- Systems thinker who can zoom from regulatory obligation down to API contract. 
 - Clear communicator with executives, regulators, and engineers alike. 
 - Pragmatic - balances architectural purity with commercial delivery pressure. 

In addition to your standard CV

Please Ensure Your Application Specifically Addresses The Following

data.description:
Solution Architect - Full-Stack & Mobile Application Architecture

Surat / Ahmedabad

Hybrid / On-site

7+ years in software engineering (Java/. NET mandatory), with 2+ years in a dedicated Solution Architect role -including ownership of SADs, TDDs, design reviews, and architectural governance

About Project Tree

At Project Tree, we bridge the gap between complex business challenges and elegant technical solutions. As a premier IT service provider in Gujarat, we specialize in building scalable, future-ready applications. We are looking for a high-caliber Solution Architect to join our leadership team and define the technical foundations of our global enterprise projects. 

Role Overview

We are looking for a Solution Architect who can bridge the gap between business needs and technical execution. This is a hands-on role - you will design end-to-end application architectures across web and mobile, write and review code alongside delivery teams, and mentor developers as they grow. You will not just draw diagrams; you will roll up your sleeves and prove your designs work. 

Key Responsibilities

Architecture & Design

- Application Architecture: Design and own application architecture for full-stack and mobile solutions spanning frontend, backend, APIs, databases, mobile apps, and integrations. 
 - Requirements Translation: Translate business and functional requirements into technical designs, including component diagrams, data models, sequence flows, and technology selection rationale. 
 - Standards & Governance: Define and enforce architectural standards, design patterns, and coding best practices across project teams. 
 - Technology Evaluation: Assess and introduce modern technologies, frameworks, and tools where they add genuine value - not novelty. 
 - Data Modeling: Define data models and make informed decisions between relational and NoSQL approaches based on use cases. 
 - Data Lifecycle & Retention: Establish strategies for data storage, archival, and retention aligned with business and compliance needs. 
 - Data Consistency Patterns: Apply appropriate consistency models such as eventual consistency and CQRS where required. 

Hands-On Delivery

- Technical Delivery: Lead and participate in hands-on delivery - prototyping, building reference implementations, conducting code reviews, and resolving complex technical blockers. 
 - Planning & Estimation: Contribute to estimation, technical risk assessment, and solution proposals during project planning. 
 - Documentation: Document architectures clearly enough that teams can build from them independently. 
 - Architecture Artifacts: Create and maintain ADRs (Architecture Decision Records), C4 model diagrams, and API contracts (OpenAPI/Swagger). 

Leadership & Collaboration

- Mentoring: Mentor and coach mid-level and junior developers, fostering a culture of technical excellence and continuous improvement. 
 - Stakeholder Engagement: Collaborate with product owners, business analysts, and stakeholders to evaluate trade-offs and recommend pragmatic solutions. 

Observability & Monitoring

- Logging, monitoring, tracing (OpenTelemetry, ELK, CloudWatch)
 - Alerting & incident response design

KPIs & Success Metrics

- System Scalability & Performance: Ensuring applications can handle projected load with sub-second latency. 
 - Technical Debt Reduction: Measurable decrease in legacy issues and code complexity over time. 
 - Architectural Alignment: Zero major deviations from the approved design during the development lifecycle. 
 - Time-to-Market Efficiency: Improving delivery speed through reusable components and standardized frameworks. 
 - Performance Tuning Effectiveness: Implementation and impact of performance tuning strategies, including caching and database optimization. 
 - Load Testing & Benchmarking: Regular execution of load testing and benchmarking to validate system performance against defined thresholds. 
 - Profiling & Optimization Practices: Effective use of profiling tools and techniques to identify bottlenecks and improve system efficiency. 

Experience (Non-Negotiable)

Technical Skills & Qualifications

- 7+ years of hands-on professional software engineering experience, of which a mandatory 2+ years must have been in a dedicated Solution Architect role - with a proven track record of: 
 - Authoring Solution Architecture Documents (SADs) and Technical Design Documents (TDDs)
 - Providing technical direction to delivery teams and leading design reviews
 - Planning architecture and delivery roadmaps across full project lifecycles
 - Enforcing adherence to best practices, standards, and governance frameworks
 - Candidates who cannot evidence the above with real examples from prior roles will not be progressed. 

Backend

- Server-Side Technologies: Strong proficiency in Java or . NET (mandatory), with working knowledge of Node. js as an advantage. 
 - Object-Oriented Programming: Solid command of OOP principles (encapsulation, inheritance, polymorphism, abstraction) with demonstrable application in enterprise-grade backend systems. This is a core requirement, not a nice-to-have. 

Frontend

- UI Frameworks: Hands-on experience with React, Angular, or Next. js. 

Mobile

- Mobile Architecture: Experience in architecting mobile application solutions. Flutter experience is desirable. 

Solution Architect

- API Design: Solid experience designing RESTful and event-driven APIs. Knowledge of GraphQL APIs. 

Cloud

- AWS: Practical experience with AWS and its managed services for application workloads - compute, storage, messaging, and serverless. 

DevOps & Infrastructure

- CI/CD & Containers: Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), and infrastructure-as-code concepts. 

Delivery & Ways of Working

- Agile Methodology: Experience working in SAFe Agile or WaterAgile (hybrid waterfall/agile) delivery environments. 

Education

- Degree: Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science or information technology. 

Nice to Have

- Exposure to domain-driven design, microservices patterns, or event-driven architectures. 
 - Experience with integration middleware or API management platforms. 
 - AWS Solutions Architect certification, TOGAF, or equivalent. 
 - Prior consulting or multi-client delivery experience. 

Soft Skills

- AI-Augmented Delivery: Ability to leverage AI tools and LLMs within project execution - for design, development, review, documentation, and problem-solving - to accelerate delivery and improve quality. 
 - AI Enablement & Team Leadership: Capable of guiding and upskilling project teams in the effective use of the organization's approved AI tooling, establishing best practices, and ensuring the team consistently extracts maximum value from these tools. 
 - Strategic Communication: Excellence in articulating complex technical visions to stakeholders, clients, and engineering teams. 

What We Offer

- Career Evolution: We offer a merit-based trajectory from Architect → Senior Architect → Lead Architect, culminating in Principal Architect/CTO. Your journey is defined by transitioning from technical execution to Strategic Architectural Governance. 
 - Project Tree Life: We believe in celebrating our wins together! Enjoy a vibrant culture with frequent team lunches, dinners, annual trips, and our signature Cricket tournaments. 
 - The Advantage: Technical autonomy to shape the company's tech direction, premium hardware at our Iconic Shyamal (Ahmedabad) office, and competitive salary benchmarks. 

How To Apply

If this feels like the right role for you, click on the Apply button to submit your Resume and Architectural Portfolio/GitHub and complete the application form. 

To learn more about our vision and the impactful work we do, feel free to explore our website at https: //projecttree. in

data.title: Principal Software Engineer
data.description:
Overview

Working at Atlassian India

Atlassian's mission "to unleash the potential of every team" is the guiding light behind what we do. Our products, including Jira, Confluence and Bitbucket, help teams everywhere work better together, from NASA to Cochlear. 

Our office is in Bengaluru, but eligible candidates can work remotely across India: from home, from an office, or somewhere in between. We call this TEAM Anywhere. 

Your future team: KubePlat Team

The KubePlat group in Core Engineering owns Atlassian's entire Kubernetes ecosystem. Every Atlassian cloud product, including Jira, Confluence, Loom and Rovo, runs on the clusters, platform services and deployment systems we build and operate. Our mission is to provide Atlassian a secure, reliable, cost-efficient and globally distributed compute platform, as the foundation for building great products. 

What We Own

- Kubernetes infrastructure: hundreds of production clusters (EKS and GKE) across AWS, GCP and regulated cloud environments. 
 - Fleet management: automated, cloud-agnostic lifecycle management for clusters and platform components, with safe progressive rollouts. 
 - Kubernetes Platform-as-a-Service: an opinionated, multi-tenant platform for running Atlassian's microservices. 
 - Cloud resource management: self-serve, Kubernetes-driven provisioning of the cloud resources that services depend on. 
 - Secure sandboxed compute: strongly isolated environments for running untrusted code and AI-agent workloads. 
 - Software delivery: artifact management, deployment orchestration and automated verification for thousands of deployments every day. 
 - AI/ML infrastructure: the GPU compute, high-bandwidth networking and parallel filesystem ecosystem on Kubernetes that powers model training and AI inference behind Atlassian's AI features. 

We are in the middle of a major transformation: moving to a multi-cloud, cell-based architecture, meeting FedRAMP and data-residency requirements, and building a reliable, cloud-native foundation for AI training and inference at scale. 

Responsibilities

As a Principal Engineer, you will set the technical direction for Atlassian's Kubernetes, compute and AI/ML infrastructure platform. You will lead engineers across several teams on our hardest problems, and take large, cross-team initiatives from design to launch. 

What You'll Do

- Define the architecture and multi-year roadmap for a multi-cloud, cell-based Kubernetes fleet that scales to thousands of clusters. 
 - Design Kubernetes-native control planes (controllers, operators, CRDs and policy) that give engineers self-serve compute, networking and cloud resources. 
 - Raise platform reliability and security: reduce blast radius, build safe progressive rollouts, define SLOs, isolate workloads and support compliance (for example FedRAMP). 
 - Lead compute efficiency through autoscaling, bin packing, capacity planning and cost optimisation. 
 - Build the AI/ML infrastructure ecosystem on Kubernetes: GPU compute at scale, high-bandwidth, low-latency networking, and high-performance parallel filesystems for training and inference. 
 - Influence engineering and product leaders globally, set architectural standards, and mentor senior engineers. 

Qualifications

- 10+ years building and operating large-scale cloud infrastructure or platform-as-a-service systems. 
 - Deep, hands-on Kubernetes expertise from running it in production at scale: internals, networking, multi-tenancy, and building operators and CRDs. 
 - Strong experience with AWS and/or GCP (EKS/GKE) and distributed systems design. 
 - Strong programming skills in one or more languages such as Go, Python, Java or similar. 
 - Platform engineering experience with Infrastructure as Code, GitOps/CD (for example Terraform, Crossplane, ArgoCD) and observability. 
 - A track record of leading technical direction across teams, with excellent communication and mentoring skills. 

Nice to have

- Experience with Kubernetes fleet management, cell-based architectures, sandboxing (gVisor, Firecracker) or regulated environments. 
 - Experience providing AI/ML infrastructure: GPU clusters, high-bandwidth networking (for example RDMA, InfiniBand, AWS EFA, GPUDirect) or parallel filesystems (for example Lustre, Amazon FSx for Lustre, GCP Parallelstore). 
 - Contributions to CNCF open-source projects.

Process Overview*

Enterprise Independent Testing (EIT) strives to provide the company with transparent, proactive insights into process and control effectiveness that are used for managing risk, policy adherence, and driving operational excellence. EIT tests processes and controls throughout the year on behalf of Frontline Units (FLUs), Control Functions (CFs), and Global Risk Management to enable them to manage their processes and controls more effectively. EIT also participates in regular reviews, examinations, and routines with regulators, as well as Corporate Audit. 

Job Description*

TEST DEVELOPMENT AND TEST AUTOMATION (TD) IC

The Test Development and automation role is responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining comprehensive test procedures to evaluate control effectiveness, and looking for test automation feasibility and execution. 

The role requires collaboration with stakeholders to translate business, regulatory, and process requirements into structured, repeatable test scripts, ensuring completeness, accuracy, and consistency of testing outcomes, as well as checking for usable automated workflows . The role operates within a structured framework, ensuring all development activities are executed, tracked, and governed through a centralized system of record, including milestone tracking, documentation, and status reporting. 

The ideal candidate brings hands-on experience in test development, test execution, QA/QC, and test automation, with strong analytical, data, and problem-solving skills. 

Responsibilities*

- Design and develop test scripts aligned to EIT standards
 - Assess test steps and data sources to identify repeatable, rules-based automation opportunities
 - Design, build, test, and maintain automated test scripts or workflows aligned to EIT standards
 - Define input data, business rules, expected results, exception handling, and reconciliation checks for automated tests
 - Validate automated outputs against approved test procedures before deployment and after material changes
 - Translate business and control requirements into structured, repeatable test scenarios
 - Execute activities across the end-to-end Test Development Life Cycle (TDLC)
 - Ensure all development activities are accurately tracked in the system of record, with timely status updates and progression
 - Prepare and maintain attestation evidence and deliverables, ensuring alignment to defined acceptance criteria prior to closure
 - Collaborate with stakeholders across Test Execution, QA, and Risk teams to ensure seamless workflow progression
 - Identify, document, and escalate defects, control gaps, and process issues
 - Ensure adherence to standard operating procedures (SOPs), testing standards, and quality benchmarks
 - Adhere to defined SLAs, timelines, and quality benchmarks
 - Monitor automation performance, investigate failures, and maintain documentation, evidence, and change history
 - Contribute to continuous improvement and testing transformation initiatives

Education*

Graduate / Postgraduate in

- Business / Commerce / Banking
 - Finance / Risk / Operations
 - Technology or related disciplines

Experience Range*

4-6 years

Foundational skills*

- Demonstrated project management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and consistently meet defined SLAs
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities with the ability to develop integrated solutions
 - Strong data-analysis capability using Excel and query tools to profile, reconcile, and validate test populations
 - Ability to translate business objectives into comprehensive test requirements and scenarios
 - Strong understanding of test design, test lifecycle management, automation feasibility, and control validation
 - Hands-on ability to develop and troubleshoot automated tests using SQL, Python, or equivalent approved automation tools
 - Ability to convert manual test logic into reusable automation with defined inputs, rules, expected outputs, and exceptions
 - Understanding of automation controls, including validation, access management, version control, change management, and audit evidence
 - Ability to ensure accuracy, completeness, and consistency in testing outputs
 - Strong communication, stakeholder management, and influencing skills
 - Understanding of structured test lifecycle frameworks (e. g. , TDLC or equivalent)
 - Minimum 2+ years of experience in testing, risk management, process improvement, compliance, or front-line control roles demonstrating strong analytical capability
 - Minimum 2+ years of hands-on experience in Test Development, Test Execution, QA/QC, or test automation
 - Understanding and awareness of AI/other emerging technologies

Desired Skills

- Working knowledge of data warehousing and data mining concepts, with basic understanding of SAS/SQL query languages
 - Experience in writing queries to extract and analyze data from multiple data sources (e. g. , DB2, Teradata, Oracle, SQL Server, Hadoop, Hive)

12: 30 PM to 9: 30 PM (IST); As per business requirement (flexibility to support global stakeholders)

GIFT/HYD City

Job Description

As a Test Automation Engineer, you will design and implement automation solutions that validate system behavior across UI, APIs, and integrations. You will contribute to building a robust quality engineering ecosystem by integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines and supporting continuous delivery. 

In this role, you will translate requirements into effective test strategies, combining automation with manual, exploratory, and integration testing to ensure comprehensive quality coverage across all application layers. 

This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys hands-on coding, solving complex validation challenges, and improving system quality at scale, while taking ownership of end-to-end quality outcomes and collaborating closely with cross-functional teams. 

Responsibilities

Automation Development & Framework Ownership

- Design, develop, and own scalable test automation frameworks and reusable components
 - Build automated test suites across: 
 - UI (Web/Mobile)
 - API and integration layers
 - Ensure automation solutions are maintainable, reliable, and extensible across teams

Test Strategy & Implementation

- Translate requirements into automation-ready test scenarios, test data, and validation strategies
 - Contribute to test strategy, coverage planning, and quality goals
 - Identify test gaps and proactively mitigate risks
 - Perform automation feasibility analysis to determine optimal test approach (manual vs automated)

Delivery & Execution Excellence

- Execute a balanced mix of automated and manual tests aligned with sprint goals, ensuring comprehensive validation across functional, integration, and edge-case scenarios. 
 - Contribute to task breakdown, estimation, and sprint commitments
 - Proactively raise risks, blockers, and testability concerns
 - Identify, log, prioritize, and track defects through resolution lifecycle
 - Perform root cause analysis and collaborate with development teams for fixes

Manual & Functional Testing

- Design, document, and execute detailed test cases and test scenarios
 - Perform functional, exploratory, and regression testing across features
 - Validate end-to-end workflows and business scenarios
 - Identify edge cases and usability issues through exploratory testing
 - Ensure test coverage for areas not suitable for automation

Quality, Standards & Engineering Practices

- Write clean, testable, and maintainable automation code
 - Participate in code reviews and continuous improvement of automation frameworks
 - Ensure adherence to Definition of Ready (DoR) and Definition of Done (DoD)
 - Take ownership of end-to-end quality outcomes across assigned areas
 - Follow established DevOps, security, and quality engineering practices

CI/CD & DevOps Integration

- Integrate automation into CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps preferred)
 - Enable continuous testing and shift-left quality practices
 - Monitor and improve pipeline stability, execution time, and reliability
 - Validate and troubleshoot system integrations, data flows, and error handling based on defined architectural designs and interfaces

Non-Functional Testing

- Contribute to performance, reliability, and resilience testing
 - Validate system behavior under load, stress, and failure scenarios

Observability & Debuggability

- Leverage logs, metrics, and traces to improve test reliability
 - Support root cause analysis of failures and improve system observability

Test Data & Environment Management

- Design and manage test data strategies and datasets
 - Ensure availability of stable, production-like test environments

Incident & Operational Support

- Assist in troubleshooting defects across environments
 - Support maintenance and continuous improvement of automation suites
 - Analyze and reduce flaky tests and unstable scenarios

Collaboration & Growth

- Collaborate with developers, QA, Product Owners, and Tech Leads
 - Actively learn and adopt new tools, frameworks, and best practices
 - Contribute to team knowledge sharing and a strong quality culture

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, IT, or related field
 - 5+ years of experience in software testing with strong automation focus
 - Experience in designing and implementing test automation frameworks
 - Strong understanding of testing principles, SDLC, STLC, and Agile practices

Technical Skills

- Programming experience in one or more: C#, Java, Python, JavaScript, Swift
 - Experience with automation tools such as Selenium, Katalon, Playwright, Cypress
 - Experience with: 
 - API testing (REST, Postman, etc. )
 - Version control (Git)
 - CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps)
 - Familiarity with: 
 - Test data management
 - Test reporting and logging tools
 - Debugging and root cause analysis
 - Release Management
Assets

- Experience with: 
 - Performance testing tools (JMeter, k6)
 - Security testing (SAST, DAST, SCA)
 - Exposure to: 
 - Cloud platforms (Azure preferred)
 - DevSecOps practices
 - Experience using AI-assisted tools responsibly (e. g. , GitHub Copilot)
Key Expectations

- Drive an automation-first approach (target 60-80% regression automation), while ensuring critical flows and edge cases are validated through manual testing where automation is not feasible or cost-effective. 
 - Own and evolve automation frameworks and quality engineering practices
 - Ensure high reliability, scalability, and stability of automation pipelines
 - Take accountability for quality outcomes, not just test execution
 - Ensure alignment with organizational quality, security, and compliance standards

Why Husky?

- Regulated Working Hours: Enjoy a structured work schedule that promotes a healthy work-life balance, allowing you to excel professionally while maintaining personal well-being. 
 - Visible Impact: Experience the satisfaction of seeing the direct outcomes of your work, as you contribute to projects that visibly enhance our company's technological capabilities and efficiency.

 - Empowered Involvement: Take an active role in decision-making processes and architectural reviews, where your expertise helps shape the future of our cloud solutions and overall business strategy. 
 - Valued Contributions: Be more than just a number in a large organization; at our company, every individual's input is valued and can lead to significant, tangible improvements in our operations and services. 
 - Impactful Role: Play a crucial part in both developing new applications and maintaining existing systems, ensuring their optimal performance and reliability. 
 - Cutting-Edge Projects: Work on innovative cloud solutions that are transforming our and our customer's business, giving you the opportunity to be at the forefront of technological advancements. 
 - Supportive Community: Work in an environment that recognizes and celebrates individual achievements, fostering a sense of community and mutual respect among team members. 
 - Collaborative Environment: Join a global team of skilled professionals around the globe where your ideas are valued, and collaboration is encouraged to solve complex challenges and drive success. 

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a competitive compensation and benefits package and excellent opportunities for growth and advancement. We are committed to equal employment opportunity and respect, value and welcome diversity in our workplace. The role operates within a structured Test Development Life Cycle (TDLC) framework, ensuring all development activities are executed, tracked, and governed through a centralized system of record, including milestone tracking, documentation, and status reporting. 

The ideal candidate will demonstrate strong analytical capability, attention to detail, and hands-on experience in test development, test execution, and QA/QC practices.

 - Translate business and control requirements into structured, repeatable test scenarios. 
 - Execute activities across the end-to-end Test Development Life Cycle (TDLC).

 - Prepare and maintain attestation evidence and deliverables, ensuring alignment to defined acceptance criteria prior to closure. 
 - Collaborate with stakeholders across Test Execution, QA, and Risk teams to ensure seamless workflow progression. 
 - Identify, document, and escalate defects, control gaps, and process issues. 
 - Ensure adherence to standard operating procedures (SOPs), testing standards, and quality benchmarks. 
 - Adhere to defined SLAs, timelines, and quality benchmarks. 
 - Contribute to continuous improvement and testing transformation initiatives. 

Requirements*

Education*

- Graduate / Postgraduate in

Business / Commerce / Banking. 

Finance / Risk / Operations. 

Technology or related disciplines. 

- Certifications If Any: NA. 

Experience Range*

- 04 Years to 06 Years of total experience. 

Foundational Skills*

- Demonstrated project management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and consistently meet defined SLAs. 
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities with the ability to develop integrated solutions. 
 - Proficiency in MS Office tools, with strong expertise in Excel (data analysis, pivot tables, lookups). 
 - Ability to translate business objectives into comprehensive test requirements and scenarios. 
 - Strong understanding of test lifecycle management and test design principles. 
 - Ability to ensure accuracy, completeness, and consistency in testing outputs.
