data.title: Network Development Manager, Capacity Restoration Team
data.description:
Description

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we're the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain - and we're looking for talented people who want to help. 

You'll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You'll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you'll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion. 

Key job responsibilities

Team Leadership & People Management

- Manage a team of Network Development Engineers (NDEs) focused on capacity restoration tooling, automation, and network engineering solutions
 - Hire, develop, coach, and promote engineers; build a high-performing team that delivers successfully and sustainably
 - Strategically assign projects to grow engineer skillsets toward next-level demonstration
 - Drive a culture of operational excellence, data-driven decision-making, and continuous improvement
 - Establish and maintain a sustainable on-call rotation that honors SLAs without burning out engineers

Strategic Direction & Execution

- Define the vision, tenets, and strategic roadmap for the team and align with wider organizational goals
 - Own a line-up of capacity restoration products. 
 - Represent the team autonomously to senior leadership; drive long-term strategic direction with limited guidance
 - Write effective narratives (PR/FAQ, six-pager) for senior leaders; provide input to OP1/OP2 planning
 - Proactively identify architectural gaps and drive resolution of deficiencies in capacity restoration systems

Technical Ownership

- Drive engineering efforts to solve complex backbone/border network capacity problems at the architectural level
 - Understand system limitations, scaling factors, and reasons behind architectural decisions; question proposals and test assumptions
 - Make trade-offs between short-term team needs and long-term business/architecture needs, inclusive of cost
 - Drive simplification and optimization of capacity restoration processes and tooling
 - Decouple dependencies between fabrics and prevent duplicative engineering efforts across teams
 - Ensure development is focused on the right solutions with mindfulness of long-term architecture consequences

Operational Excellence

- Define audit mechanisms and metrics that explain team performance and variance against goals
 - Manage deferred maintenance across all systems; allocate engineering time to reduce technical debt
 - Hold postmortems and drive root-cause resolution; document lessons learned in COEs
 - Ensure team compliance with Amazon security, data handling, and operational policies
 - Collaborate cross-functionally with backbone operations, border engineering, and controller teams

Scope and Impact

- Own the development of one or more capacity restoration products spanning backbone and border network fabrics
 - Network products may have external or multi-org impact; trusted with organizational goals
 - Influence strategic direction of the team and may influence other team roadmaps
 - Work spans organizations and geographies in support of network availability, scalability, cost, and performance

About The Team

The Capacity Restoration Team (CRT) is responsible for restoring backbone and border network capacity impacted by failures, maintenance events, and service disruptions across Amazon's global network infrastructure. As the Network Development Manager for CRT, you will own the development and evolution of network capacity restoration solutions, automation tooling, and operational frameworks that ensure rapid, data-driven recovery of backbone/border network capacity.

Function: Engineering

Reports To: Engineering Manager

Are you. . .

 - Excited to take broader technical ownership and raise the engineering bar across the team?

If so, we'd love to meet you. 

Why Esko?

Esko, part of Veralto (NYSE: VLTO), is the global leader in packaging and product lifecycle solutions. More than 25, 000 customers across 140+ countries rely on Esko to design, manage, manufacture, and deliver products found on store shelves every day. Packaging for 9 out of 10 major consumer brands is managed using Esko solutions. As we enter our next phase of growth, we're making significant investments in cloud, AI, and platform engineering to build the future of product innovation. 

Our vision is to create the industry's leading AI-native Product Intelligence Platform. This modern, multi-tenant cloud platform unifies product, packaging, regulatory, quality, manufacturing, and supply chain data into a single intelligent ecosystem. By combining cloud-native architecture, intelligent automation, and AI-powered insights, we're helping global consumer goods, life sciences, and manufacturing companies innovate faster, improve compliance, reduce waste, and bring products to market with greater speed and confidence. 

About The Role

We are looking for a Software Engineer Specialist to help build and evolve the cloud foundation services that power Esko's SaaS products. 

This is a hands-on technical role focused on turning architectural direction into robust, production-ready platform capabilities. You will partner closely with Architects, bringing deep implementation expertise to technical decisions while owning the detailed design, implementation, quality, and operational readiness of complex cloud services. 

You will work on shared platform capabilities such as repository and data services, workflow, search, APIs, and other foundational services used across multiple Esko products. You will remain deeply hands-on while mentoring engineers, solving complex technical problems, and raising engineering standards across the team. 

What You Will Do

- Design, build, and evolve scalable cloud foundation services used across multiple Esko products. 
 - Own the detailed technical design and implementation of complex capabilities, from requirements through production. 
 - Remain deeply hands-on, writing high-quality code and solving complex distributed systems and engineering problems. 
 - Partner with Architects to translate architectural direction into production software, providing implementation feedback and identifying technical trade-offs. 
 - Improve the reliability, performance, observability, testability, and maintainability of platform services. 
 - Lead code reviews, technical problem-solving, root-cause analysis, and resolution of complex production issues. 
 - Drive engineering excellence through automated testing, code quality, design practices, and operational readiness. 
 - Mentor engineers through hands-on collaboration, reviews, and technical guidance. 

Required Experience

- 8+ years of professional software engineering experience building backend, cloud-native, or large-scale SaaS applications. 
 - Strong hands-on software engineering experience with Java/JVM technologies and modern backend frameworks. 
 - Strong experience designing and building REST APIs, microservices, and distributed systems. 
 - Experience translating architecture and high-level designs into detailed technical designs and production-quality implementations. 
 - Demonstrated ability to identify implementation trade-offs, challenge assumptions, and provide constructive technical feedback during design discussions. 
 - Strong understanding of distributed systems concepts including scalability, concurrency, consistency, availability, resiliency, and fault tolerance. 
 - Experience developing and operating scalable applications on AWS or another major cloud platform. 
 - Strong experience with relational and NoSQL databases such as PostgreSQL and Amazon DynamoDB, including data modeling, access patterns, transactions, indexing, and performance optimization 
 - Hands-on experience with Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, Git, and modern software delivery practices. 
 - Experience diagnosing complex production problems using logs, metrics, distributed tracing, profiling, and performance analysis. 
 - Experience mentoring engineers and influencing technical decisions through design reviews, code reviews, and sound engineering judgment. 

Preferred Experience

- Experience with Scala or other functional programming languages and functional programming concepts. 
 - Experience with Kafka, Redis, Akka, Elasticsearch/OpenSearch, or similar distributed technologies. 
 - Experience building shared cloud platforms or foundation services consumed by multiple products or engineering teams. 
 - Experience modernizing legacy or large-scale distributed systems. 
 - Experience establishing or improving engineering practices within a team or across related engineering teams. 

What Success Looks Like

- Architectural direction is translated into high-quality, scalable, production-ready implementations. 
 - Cloud platform services become more reliable, performant, observable, testable, and maintainable. 
 - Complex engineering problems are resolved with strong technical judgment and effective collaboration with Architects and other engineers. 
 - Engineers around you become more effective through mentoring, code reviews, and hands-on technical guidance. 
 - Engineering standards improve through stronger code quality, automated testing, operational readiness, and disciplined implementation. 
 - You become a trusted technical leader in your area, known for strong engineering judgment, hands-on technical depth, and consistently high-quality execution. 

At Veralto, we value diversity and the existence of similarities and differences, both visible and not, found in our workforce, workplace and throughout the markets we serve. data.description:
At Jacobs, we're challenging today to reinvent tomorrow by solving the world's most critical problems for thriving cities, resilient environments, mission-critical outcomes, operational advancement, scientific discovery and cutting-edge manufacturing, turning abstract ideas into realities that transform the world for good. 

Your impact

The Sr. CQV Engineer will be responsible for leading the efforts for commissioning, qualification, and validation of equipment/ systems, and processes in the production of Drug substances/ Drug Product/ Sterile Facilities/ API/ OSDs, as well as the Utility system, HVAC system and Area. 

The role will require the leadership of an experienced, energetic, and committed Senior CQV person with broad experience in C&Q, particularly biopharmaceuticals. 

The person should have experience of leading a team of CQV engineers for a project and managing the C&Q documentation and execution lifecycle from SLIA generation through to OQ completion. The lead will work closely with cross-functional teams, including engineering, quality assurance, and manufacturing, to support the successful delivery of projects. 

Key Responsibilities

- Lead and coordinate CQV projects, ensuring timely execution and compliance with industry regulations. 
 - To prepare C&Q plans in line with the strategic goals of the client and manage timely and compliant delivery of the plan. 
 - Ensure all commissioning and qualification procedures are implemented and adhered to at office and at site level. 
 - Track progress of C&Q activities as required and provide regular project updates and status reports to stakeholders. 
 - Ensure effective resource planning, including coordinating materials, spares and consumables for commissioning and qualification activities. 
 - Identify and mitigate project risks while ensuring project deliverables meet required quality and compliance standards. 
 - Provide leadership in team meetings and facilitate problem-solving discussions to ensure project milestones are met. 
 - Act as the primary point of contact between clients, internal teams, and external vendors to drive project success. 
 - Management of Contractors and Vendors, document control, punch list management. 
 - Participate in design, constructability, and commissioning reviews to ensure technical aspects are covered in the Commissioning Plan and schedule. 
 - Well versed with risk-based approaches to C&Q (e. g. , ASTM E2500, ISPE)

 - Complete the development, review and execution of validation plans, URSs/DQ/TMs/FATs/SATs/IQ/OQ protocols/reports.

- Bachelor's degree in engineering, Life Sciences, or a related field. Advanced degree preferred. B. Pharm. , M. Pharm. , B. Tech or BE or MSc.

 - Candidates must have proven experience of carrying out commissioning and qualification activities on multiple projects. 
 - Have functioned as CQV Lead level for at least one Project. 

Technical Skills

- Experience with paperless validation software such as KNEAT and/ or Valgenesis. 
 - In-depth knowledge of cGMP, FDA, EMA, and other relevant regulatory requirements. 
 - Strong project management skills with the ability to handle multiple priorities across national and international locations. 
 - Experience with process validation and computer system validation. 
 - Experience on DCS/ PCS system such as Delta-V, 800xA, etc. 
 - Familiarity with Construction management software such as EIDA, PIMS, Aconex, is an advantage. 
 - Familiarity with paperless validation software such as KNEAT and Valgenesis is an advantage. 

Soft Skills

- Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and a results-oriented mindset. 
 - Strong project management and organizational skills. 
 - Effective communication and interpersonal skills. 
 - Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

data.title: Deputy Manager - Quality (Data Center)
data.description:
Job Description

The Deputy Manager - Quality (ADLEC) will play a pivotal role in controlling and supervising quality assurance processes, working closely with process owners to enhance efficiency and product quality. This role is integral to the company's commitment to delivering high-quality electrical and digital systems, and the successful candidate will have a direct impact on the company's reputation and customer satisfaction. 

Responsibilities

- Design and build effective quality processes within the organization and work with all process owners to remove bottlenecks. 
 - Understand test methods and the operation of testing equipment. 
 - Conduct product and process audits and plan daily inspection activities to thoroughly inspect final products and components. 
 - Ensure effective quality-checking activities to prevent errors in subsequent processes. 
 - Conduct root cause analysis for product quality issues and present findings to senior management. 
 - Conduct stage-wise verification to check compliance with stated requirements and analyze stage-wise rejection to control CONQ and first-hand rejections. 
 - Provide quick and effective solutions to quality issues. 
 - Manage field returns and recommend corrective actions. 
 - Ensure timely analysis and resolution of customer complaints. 
 - Carry out calibration activities and ensure all instruments are calibrated on time. 
 - Track quality measures and achieve targets for first-hand rejections, cost of non-quality, customer returns index, instrument calibration, and other relevant measures. 
 - Conduct monthly SGIA audits and work toward achieving productivity targets. 
 - Support Production and other teams on a daily basis to ensure product quality. 
 - Train, develop, and coach team members, keeping them updated on the latest developments in the QA field. 
 - Handle customers during product inspections, compliance follow-ups, and factory assessments/evaluations. 
 - Prepare Manufacturing Control Plans. 
 - Demonstrate good communication skills and coordinate/collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams. 
 - Maintain good knowledge of electrical switchgear/switchboards and applicable IS/IEC standards. 

Qualifications

Functional Competencies

Understanding of product standards

Knowledge of manufacturing processes

Awareness of ISO 9001 and ISO 14001, TQM, etc. 

Planning and organizing skills

Product qualification, PPAP, and PFMEA tools

Qualifications, Role-specific Knowledge And Experience

Diploma/BE/B. Tech, preferably in Electrical Engineering. 

7+ years of relevant experience in the Quality department within the electrical switchgear/switchboard industry. 

At least 2-3 years of experience in process, product, and quality system audits. 

Quality certifications such as ISO, TQM, Six Sigma, etc. 

ISO 9001 / ISO 14001 Internal Auditor certification would be an added advantage. 

Proficiency in MS Office applications (Excel, Word, and PowerPoint), ERP systems, and technical tools such as SPC, SOC, and other quality tools. 

Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills.

The Test Cell Development/ Test Process Development Manager is responsible for leading the design, optimization, and deployment of wafer probe (wafer sort) and final test processes for NPI projects and release it for high-volume OSAT environment. Continuous Improvement & Projects

Leadership & Collaboration

 - Collaborate with design, product, and test engineering teams to ensure test coverage, yield, and throughput. 
 - Drive continuous improvement initiatives using Lean/Six Sigma practices. 
 - Monitor KPIs such as yield, defect detection rate, cycle time, and equipment utilization.

Technical skills:

Process Skills

- Lean, Six Sigma (Green/Black Belt preferred), project management experience. 

Soft Skills

ARP assesses if Intuit internal platforms are "agentic-ready" for end-to-end AI agent development. Its Eval engine normalizes top use cases, spawns agents in virtualized environments, executes plans, auto-files issue for friction (e. g. , missing docs/APIs), and re-runs checks on CI/CD deploys to prevent regressions. This role belongs to the Core Platform Framework team, which builds the Eval platform and requires research-minded engineers focused on agent orchestration and LLM tooling, distinct from the Operations/Adoption team. 

Responsibilities

The selected responsibilities for the Senior Staff Engineer role encompass leading and driving key architecture initiatives for the Eval platform: 

- Core Platform Architecture: Owning and evolving the virtualization/harness layer, the agent plan-then-execute engine, and the friction detection and auto-ticketing pipeline. 
 - Model Orchestration & Cost Efficiency: Transitioning from single static models to dynamic, step-level orchestration that routes tasks to cost-effective models (including open-source options and Claude) while monitoring cost and performance per step. 
 - Telemetry & Auditability: Designing scalable logging, cost, and telemetry systems to ensure full auditability and cost accountability for agent runs. 
 - Use-Case Normalization: Setting technical standards to normalize agent-readable use cases across differently-documented capability platforms. 
 - Cross-Team & Strategic Collaboration: Partnering with capability, operations, and adjacent platform teams on friction reporting, PRD-to-action pipelines, RAG-backed architecture context, and OPA policy validation. 
 - Roadmap Leadership & Governance: Guiding the roadmap from foundational tooling (plugins, RBAC, alerting) to automation (auto-fix agents, continuous re-runs) and governance visibility. 
 - Mentorship & Technical Standards: Mentoring engineers and elevating engineering standards through design reviews, architecture documentation, and hands-on contributions. 

Qualifications

Required: 

- 12+ years of software engineering experience, focused on large-scale distributed systems or developer platforms. 
 - Hands-on experience building or operating LLM-agent systems (orchestration loops, tool use, plan-and-execute patterns). 
 - Strong systems programming background (Python, Java) with virtualization, sandboxing, or IaC experience. 
 - Proficiency in Python, Java, Spring Boot, GraphQL, and React. 
 - Applied AI and prompt design skills for reliable, cost-aware LLM behavior. 
 - Proven Staff+ capability setting cross-team technical direction. 
 - Comfort navigating ambiguity in a research-driven, next-gen engineering environment. 

Preferred

- Building or contributing to LLM or agent evaluation/benchmarking frameworks. 
 - Policy-as-code , RAG pipelines, or vector databases for enterprise agent grounding. 
 - Cost/token optimization and multi-model routing. 
 - Intuit experience or internal developer tools (CI/CD, Jira automation, developer portals). 

Intuit provides a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. This position may be eligible for a cash bonus, equity rewards and benefits, in accordance with our applicable plans and programs (see more about our compensation and benefits at Intuit®: Careers | Benefits). Pay offered is based on factors such as job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and work location. To drive ongoing fair pay for employees, Intuit conducts regular comparisons across categories of ethnicity and gender.

data.title: Principal Software Engineer, RBS - Tech
data.description:
Description

The Retail Business Services (RBS) Technology team's mission is to transform the Amazon's e-commerce business through technology, delivering order of magnitude higher speed, scale and impact. This Principal Engineer role leads a strong charter to accelerate business functions currently done manually, by envisioning and developing ML/GenAI-driven Agentic core platforms, thus enabling self-service building of agents to perform cognitive tasks autonomously. 

Providing a delightful experience to Amazon's e-commerce customers and selling partners requires thousands of various types of tasks performed by business teams that operate at the interface of the company as well at the heart of it. These teams work with vendors to source products to increase selection and choice for the customers, audit the app/website experience to ensure trustworthy information is provided to customers to enable confident purchases, learn from customer feedback on product reviews and returns, and ensure the inventory is placed at the right location for fast delivery of orders, just to name a few activities. Manual activities reduces speed of operations, introduce undesirable variations and limit scale. Hence there is a need to automate these, while overcoming the challenges of 1) task-by-task automation being inefficient, 2) human cognitive work automation requires equivalent or better intelligent systems, 3) a vast variety of business use cases, and 4) ability to integrate with the existing ecosystem of 100s of tools. 

The Principal Engineer owns the charter of defining and building these scalable platforms for automation, leveraging the state-of-the-art technologies such as GenAI and Agentic infrastructure. The role will understand the express and latent needs of the space, by working with business and product teams. Further, the role will define the core services and platforms that will enable rapid automation through leverage of ML/GenAI. These platforms will enable self-service, low-code/no-code automation by deskilling automation development. The Principal Engineer sets the right quality bar for resilience, latency, maintainability, accuracy (precision/recall), usability, security/privacy and efficiency, for the team to adhere to. The ideal candidate is one who thrives on understanding the complexity of software systems, and brings a nuanced understanding of different aspects of automation technologies spanning machine learning and big data processing. Working with the rest of the team, peers and stakeholders, they will lead the technology decisions to empower thousands of task automation, from simple few steps, to complex ones involving several tool integrations and conditional steps. The enormous challenge requires creative thinking and passion to use technology to make customers' and internal teams' lives better. 

The Principal Engineer in this role collaborates with the team to grow/mentor talent, review work constructively and create a supportive learning environment. They never lose sight of the customer needs, and tackle ambiguous technical and product challenges to continually find ways to serve them better. They build mechanisms to expand and maintain coverage of the platforms to multiple geographies in which Amazon operates, multi-lingual needs, multitude of product types, and hundreds of teams. 

The role will embody the Amazon leadership principles of thinking big while diving deep, learning and inventing to move fast, and build trustful relationships to leverage resources and technologies available, delivering to customer needs and delighting them. 

Key job responsibilities

- Technical leadership on our most demanding, cross-functional projects
 - Setting the technology vision in alignment with business needs
 - Architecting and designing key parts of the core platforms and services
 - Working with the team, partners and stakeholders to make optimal technical decisions
 - Review the work of, inspire and mentor other engineers
 - Build consensus and harmonize on decisions with long-term implications
 - Partner with other senior roles (managers, business leaders) to optimize at company/group level
 - Set a high technical bar and lead by example
 - Exert technical influence over multiple teams, increasing their productivity and effectiveness by sharing your deep knowledge and experience. 

About The Team

Amazon's mission is to be the Earth's most customer-centric company. The Stores business within Amazon connects 100s of millions of customers with millions of sellers, to conveniently fulfill their shopping needs. The Retail Business Services Technology team turbocharges the pursuit of this mission by putting technology at the heart of these interactions. The team builds core platforms that leverage Machine Learning, to automatically discover customer and seller impacting frictions and eliminate them systematically. The RBS Tech team thrives on innovation, collaboration and talent growth. 

Basic Qualifications

- 12+ years of IT industry experience
 - BS or higher degree
 - Experience designing, building and maintaining software systems of large scale and complexity
 - Hands on experience with big data processing/storage, object-oriented design, usage of GenAI
 - Experience in working with multiple cross functional, cross geography teams
 - Experience of leading and mentoring senior engineers
 - Proven track record of delivering high-quality software

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience building web-scale systems and products
 - Good understanding of Machine Learning, Neural Networks, Image/Video processing

Company Description

It started with a simple idea: what if surgery could be less invasive and recovery less painful? Nearly 30 years later, that question still fuels everything we do at Intuitive. As a global leader in robotic-assisted surgery and minimally invasive care, our technologies-like the da Vinci surgical system and Ion-have transformed how care is delivered for millions of patients worldwide. 

We're a team of engineers, clinicians, and innovators united by one purpose: to make surgery smarter, safer, and more human. Every day, our work helps care teams perform with greater precision and patients recover faster, improving outcomes around the world. 

The problems we solve demand creativity, rigor, and collaboration. The work is challenging, but deeply meaningful-because every improvement we make has the potential to change a life. 

If you're ready to contribute to something bigger than yourself and help transform the future of healthcare, you'll find your purpose here. 

Job Description

Primary Function: 

At Intuitive, our mission is to advance minimally invasive care through innovation. As a Supplier Engineer, you will play a critical role in ensuring suppliers can consistently deliver high-quality, innovative products that meet Intuitive's stringent quality, delivery, capacity, and cost requirements. 

The Supplier Engineer serves as the technical interface between suppliers and internal cross-functional teams, including Design Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Quality Engineering, Supply Chain, and Operations. This role is responsible for supplier qualification, process validation, new product introduction (NPI), supplier performance improvement, and ongoing supplier development. 

Roles And Responsibilities

Supplier Development & Qualification

- Assess, qualify, and develop suppliers to meet Intuitive's technical, quality, regulatory, and business requirements. 
 - Lead supplier manufacturing readiness activities for new products and process changes. 
 - Evaluate supplier processes, capacity, quality systems, and technical capabilities. 
 - Support supplier selection and sourcing activities through technical assessments and on-site audits. 

New Product Introduction (NPI)

- Partner with Design Engineering and suppliers to support Design for Manufacturability (DFM) initiatives. 
 - Drive supplier readiness for product launches and scale-up activities. 
 - Ensure supplier qualification deliverables are completed on schedule, including: 
 - Process Flow Diagrams
 - pFMEA
 - Control Plans
 - Process Capability Studies
 - First Article Inspection (FAI)
 - Measurement System Analysis (MSA)
 - PPQP/PPAP submissions
 - Facilitate successful transfer from development to production. 
Supplier Quality & Continuous Improvement

- Monitor supplier performance against quality, delivery, cost, and capacity metrics. 
 - Lead supplier corrective action activities utilizing structured problem-solving methodologies. 
 - Drive root cause investigations and verify effectiveness of corrective and preventive actions. 
 - Support supplier audits and quality system assessments. 
 - Promote continuous improvement initiatives to reduce defects, improve process capability, and increase operational efficiency. 

Technical Manufacturing Support

- Provide expertise in various manufacturing processes. SME in either Metals or Electronics is a plus. 
 - Review engineering drawings and specifications, including GD&T requirements. 
 - Identify manufacturing risks and implement mitigation strategies. 

Project Management & Cross-Functional Collaboration

- Manage supplier-related project plans, timelines, and risk mitigation activities. 
 - Coordinate with engineering, sourcing, quality, and operations teams to achieve project objectives. 
 - Present supplier performance, project status, and risk assessments to stakeholders. 

Qualifications

Skills/Job Requirements: 

Education

Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or related technical field. 

Experience

5+ years of experience in one or more of the following: 

- Supplier Engineering
 - Manufacturing Engineering
 - Supplier Quality Engineering
 - Process Engineering
 - New Product Introduction

Technical Competencies

- Strong understanding of manufacturing processes and supplier development. 
 - Experience with APQP, PPAP, PPQP, FMEA, Control Plans, SPC, and capability studies. 
 - Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings and GD&T. 
 - Experience conducting supplier audits and technical assessments. 
 - Structured problem-solving skills (5 Whys, Fishbone, CAPA, SCAR). 
 - Working knowledge of ISO 9001 and/or ISO 13485 quality systems. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience in medical device, aerospace, robotics, or regulated manufacturing environments. 
 - Exposure to global supply chains and international supplier management. 
 - Project management experience with concurrent programs and multiple suppliers. 
 - Familiarity with machining, castings, and complex electromechanical assemblies. 

Travel

- Ability to travel to suppliers (domestic and international) as needed: minimum 30%

Key Success Metrics

- On-time supplier qualification and NPI launches. 
 - Supplier quality performance and defect reduction. 
 - Supplier delivery and capacity readiness. 
 - Successful completion of PPQP/PPAP activities. 
 - Supplier risk reduction and business continuity improvements. 
 - Achievement of cost, quality, and operational improvement goals.

data.title: Engineering Manager-DTT
data.description:
The Opportunity

As Engineering Manager -DTT (Traction Transformer) at GEC India, you will lead a multidisciplinary engineering organization delivering tender, order, product, and technology engineering services to global traction transformer factories and business units. You will translate business priorities into a clear engineering strategy, build scalable competencies and capacity, and establish robust governance for safe, compliant, high-quality, and on-time execution. Working closely with HUB engineering leaders, factories, product management, project management, supply chain, quality, and customers, you will drive standardization, digitalization, innovation, and continuous improvement while developing a strong leadership pipeline and an engaged, high-performing team. 

How You'll Make An Impact

- Define and execute the GEC India engineering strategy and capability roadmap for traction transformers in alignment with Business Unit, Global Product Group, HUB, and factory priorities. 
 - Lead engineering delivery for tenders, customer orders, design modifications, product development, value engineering, and lifecycle support, ensuring committed quality, cost, and schedule targets are achieved. 
 - Establish effective governance for project allocation, design reviews, technical risk management, escalation, change control, documentation, and engineering release processes. 
 - Ensure traction transformer designs meet contractual requirements, applicable railway and transformer standards, customer specifications, internal design rules, and safety and regulatory expectations. 
 - Own capacity and workforce planning, competency mapping, succession planning, recruitment, onboarding, and technical development for electrical, mechanical, and related engineering disciplines. 
 - Develop team and technical experts, set clear objectives, coach performance, and foster an inclusive culture of accountability, collaboration, knowledge sharing, innovation, and continuous learning. 
 - Manage resource utilization, productivity, external engineering spending, and cost recovery while balancing demand across factories, HUBs, and projects. 
 - Define and monitor KPIs for on-time delivery, first-time-right quality, engineering hours, productivity, utilization, cost performance, customer satisfaction, and competency development; implement corrective actions where required. 
 - Drive design standardization, modularization, reuse, digital engineering, automation, and deployment of common tools and processes across the traction transformer engineering network. 
 - Partner with factories and cross-functional teams to resolve complex technical issues, support root-cause analysis, capture lessons learned, and improve product quality, manufacturability, reliability, and total cost. 
 - Build trusted relationships with global stakeholders and customers, communicate priorities and risks transparently, and represent GEC India in technical and operational reviews. 
 - Ensure compliance with applicable external and internal regulations, procedures, information-security requirements, and engineering guidelines. 
 - Live Hitachi Energy's core values of safety and integrity by taking responsibility for your actions while caring for colleagues and the business. 

Your Background

- Bachelor's degree in electrical or mechanical engineering; a master's degree or formal qualification in engineering or business management is preferred. 
 - Typically, >14 years of progressive transformer engineering experience, including substantial experience in traction transformers and at least 5 years in people or functional leadership. 
 - Strong knowledge of traction transformer design, including electrical and mechanical design interfaces, dielectric and thermal performance, short-circuit withstand, losses, noise, insulation systems, cooling, materials, and manufacturing constraints. 
 - Demonstrated experience in tender engineering, order execution, design reviews, technical risk management, customer interfaces, and delivery of multiple projects in a global matrix organization. 
 - Working knowledge of applicable IEC, EN, railway, quality, and safety standards; familiarity with customer-specific and regional requirements is an advantage. 
 - Experience with engineering tools, product lifecycle management, design automation, digital workflows, and structured problem-solving methods such as Lean or Six Sigma are desirable. 
 - Proven ability to build and scale engineering teams, manage budgets and capacity, develop talent, lead change, and collaborate effectively across cultures, functions, and time zones. 
 - Strong commercial awareness, decision-making, stakeholder management, negotiation, communication, and presentation skills. 
 - Fluent spoken and written English is required; additional languages are an advantage.

data.title: Site Reliability Engineer Manager
data.description:
Role Summary

We're looking for an experienced SRE Manager to lead our Site Reliability Engineering team and own reliability strategy across our Cloud and Kubernetes platforms. You'll combine deep technical credibility with strong people leadership - setting direction, growing the team, and acting as the senior escalation point during the most critical incidents - while partnering closely with engineering and business leadership. 

This is a Rotational Shift role and an onsite position located at Bangalore, India. You will be required to work from the office on a full-time basis. We are only considering candidates who are within a commutable distance of our Bangalore office and are not offering relocation assistance at this time. 

Position Details

About The Role

- Lead and grow a team of SREs, setting technical direction and reliability strategy across AWS, GCP infrastructure and EKS platforms, and GKE platforms. 
 - Own the organization's Incident and Problem Management processes, ensuring major incidents are handled efficiently, with timely executive communication and thorough post-incident reviews. 
 - Drive the team's automation strategy, championing Python-based tooling and frameworks that reduce manual toil and improve reliability at scale. 
 - Set standards for Terraform-based infrastructure-as-code, ensuring secure, scalable, and consistent provisioning practices across teams. 
 - Define the organization's observability strategy, ensuring Grafana dashboards, alerting, and SQL/CloudWatch-based analysis practices scale effectively. 
 - Act as a senior escalation point and incident commander for the most critical, high-severity incidents, providing calm, decisive leadership under pressure. 
 - Partner with senior leadership, product, and engineering stakeholders to communicate risk, reliability posture, and remediation roadmaps clearly and confidently. 
 - Own hiring, mentoring, performance management, and career development for the SRE team. 
 - Design and build self-healing automation and runbooks that detect known failure patterns and trigger remediation automatically, reducing manual intervention and recovery time for recurring incidents. 
 - Implement and maintain monitoring across multiple regions to ensure consistent visibility into system health, latency, and failover readiness across all deployment zones. 
 - Proactively identify potential failure points and performance bottlenecks before they impact production and reduce operational workload by automating recurring manual tasks. 
 - Drive ITSM process maturity across the organization, partnering with other teams to embed Incident and Problem Management best practices. 
 - Manage on-call structure, escalation paths, staffing, and operational readiness for the team. 
 - Report on reliability metrics, incident trends, and improvement initiatives to senior leadership. 

About You

- You should have 8-12 years of experience in Site Reliability Engineering, DevOps, Infrastructure, or related disciplines, including significant experience leading and managing technical teams. 
 - You should have deep hands-on expertise with AWS infrastructure and the technical credibility to guide architecture, operational, and reliability decisions across complex cloud environments. 
 - You should have successfully led teams through complex EKS and GKE operational challenges, demonstrating strong troubleshooting and problem-solving capabilities in large-scale distributed systems. 
 - You should possess advanced proficiency in Python for automation and Terraform for infrastructure-as-code, with the ability to mentor engineers, review technical designs, and establish engineering best practices. 
 - You should have extensive experience owning and improving Incident and Problem Management processes, along with a strong understanding of observability tools and practices, including Grafana, SQL, CloudWatch Logs Insights, and alerting strategies. 
 - You should be an exceptional communicator who can clearly articulate technical risks, incident impacts, and reliability strategies to executive leadership and cross-functional stakeholders while building strong partnerships across engineering, product, and business teams. 
 - You should have a proven track record of hiring, developing, and leading high-performing technical teams, creating an environment focused on operational excellence, continuous improvement, and long-term reliability. 
 - You should hold an AWS Professional Certification (Solutions Architect, DevOps Engineer, or equivalent) and a Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA) or equivalent Kubernetes certification, and you demonstrate strong leadership qualities through strategic thinking, incident leadership, people development, and stakeholder trust.

Work within an OpenText technical delivery team in order to:

BE/B. Tech. or equivalent technical qualification

Minimum Of 8 Years Of Relevant Experience

Strong hands-on experience deploying, administering, automating, and troubleshooting OpenText xECM , and related components; cloud deployment experience is strongly preferred. 

- AI-assisted engineering: hands-on use of GitHub Copilot or comparable approved tools for code generation, refactoring, unit tests, troubleshooting, and technical documentation.

 - GitLab CI/CD: practical knowledge of pipeline configuration, reusable templates and shared libraries, automated build and testing, security checks, artifact management, approvals, deployment, rollback, and release management. 
 - Automation and infrastructure as code: experience with Terraform, Helm, Ansible, scripting, APIs, and automation of provisioning and operational workflows. 
 - Kubernetes and container orchestration: strong hands-on experience deploying and supporting production workloads using Kubernetes, Docker, and Helm. Skills should include pods, deployments, services, ingress, ConfigMaps, secrets, namespaces, persistent storage, resource limits, autoscaling, rolling updates, health probes, RBAC, network policies, logging, monitoring, upgrades, and root-cause troubleshooting. Exposure to managed Kubernetes services such as GKE, EKS, or AKS is preferred. 
 - OpenText solutions: deployment, administration, configuration, integration, and troubleshooting experience with TeamSite, LiveSite, Exstream, OTMM, xECM, Documentum, or related platforms. 
 - Platform engineering: working knowledge of Linux/UNIX and Windows administration, TCP/IP networking, web and application servers, databases, and secure application operations. 
 - Service reliability: experience with ITIL-aligned incident, problem, and change management in Agile or Scrum delivery environments. 
 - Ability to lead a small technical team, review technical deliverables, mentor engineers, and provide clear technical direction. 
 - Strong problem-solving, ownership, and customer-service mindset, with disciplined attention to reliability and quality. 
 - Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to collaborate effectively across global and cross-functional teams. 
 - Continuous-learning mindset and willingness to evaluate and adopt new AI, automation, cloud, and SRE practices. 

One last thing

- Programming or scripting experience in Python, Java, JavaScript, SQL, Shell, or PowerShell. 
 - Experience with relational databases such as PostgreSQL, Oracle, or Microsoft SQL Server. 
 - Knowledge of REST APIs, web services, LDAP, object-oriented programming, and application integration patterns. 
 - Exposure to AI-agent frameworks, retrieval-augmented generation, model evaluation, or MLOps/LLMOps practices is an advantage.

data.description:
Job Description

Digital. ai is the only AI-powered software delivery platform purpose-built for the enterprise, enabling the world's largest organizations to build, test, secure, and deliver high-quality software. By unifying

AI-driven insights, automation, and security across the software development lifecycle, Digital. ai empowers enterprises to deliver innovation with confidence. Trusted by 5, 000 global enterprises, Digital. ai is redefining how enterprises build better software in an AI-driven world. Additional information about Digital. ai can be found at digital. ai and on Twitter, LinkedIn, and YouTube. 

Our space and our audience: 

We help our customers innovate and transition to cloud and modern architectures, deliver strong developer experience while maintaining security and control with platform engineering capabilities, develop quality and secure mobile apps, and leverage and manage AI in the SDLC. Our global clients lead their industries as innovators in digitization across financial services, retail, telco, public services, technology, manufacturing, transportation, and energy with our AI-powered DevSecOps platform. We currently serve: 

- Over 50% of Fortune 100 companies

- 8 of 10 top banks

- 5 of 10 largest gaming companies

- 5 of 10 global airlines

- Over 50 worldwide government entities

**POSITION OVERVIEW**

Digital. ai is looking for a Senior Cloud Ops Engineer - Grade II to serve as a recognized subject matter expert in deploying and optimising Digital. ai's SaaS infrastructure, leading automation and runbook improvements that reduce toil while mentoring engineers across the team. 

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

- Is considered a subject matter expert on the service across the board, with deep knowledge of its Kubernetes and AWS components

- Designs, deploys and upgrades production EKS clusters and supporting AWS infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code

- Leads automation and optimisation efforts to reduce toil, and measures the results

- Drives cost, performance and capacity optimisation, including right-sizing, autoscaling and Spot and Savings Plans strategy

- Owns reliability outcomes for major services, including SLO definition, error budgets and capacity planning

- Builds and improves CI/CD and GitOps pipelines that make deployments safer and faster for other teams

- Improves observability by defining metrics, dashboards, alerts and tracing that support both reliability and optimisation decisions

- Applies security best practice across infrastructure, including least-privilege IAM, secrets management, network policies and patching

- Takes part in a light escalation rota and leads the fix for complex incidents, driving systemic fixes through to completion

- Evaluates and introduces tooling that improves observability, deployment safety and operational efficiency

- Teaches others across multiple areas of the service, and contributes to interviewing and mentoring of new hires

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS / EXPERIENCE**

- Degree or equivalent in Computer Science or a related field

- Typically requires 8+ years of professional experience or an advanced degree with comparable experience

- Has both deep and broad expertise across service components, and balances operational and implementation work with design work

- 4+ years running Kubernetes in production, including cluster upgrades, networking, RBAC, resource management and autoscaling (HPA/VPA, Karpenter or Cluster Autoscaler)

- Expert-level, hands-on AWS experience, including EKS, VPC design, IAM (IRSA or Pod Identity), load balancing, Route 53, S3 and multi-account structures

- Expert-level Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, OpenTofu, Pulumi or CDK), including reusable modules, remote state management and safe change rollout

- CI/CD and GitOps at scale (for example Argo CD, Flux, GitHub Actions or GitLab CI)

- Hands-on observability experience with metrics, logs and traces (for example Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry), used to find optimisation opportunities as well as to alert

- Track record of measurably improving the reliability, performance or cost of a production SaaS service, with concrete results

- Strong scripting or programming skills in Python, Go or Bash

- Working knowledge of Linux, container runtimes and networking (DNS, TLS, load balancing), and of security fundamentals such as least-privilege IAM, secrets management and image scanning

- Working knowledge of SLOs, incident response and post-incident reviews, with the ability to lead the response to a complex incident

- Proficient in AI-assisted monitoring, log analysis and predictive alerting; evaluates and implements AIOps tools to reduce toil and improve incident response times

- Proficient spoken and written English

- Work hours aligned with Central European Time (UTC+1)

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

- Kubernetes or AWS certifications (CKA, CKS, AWS Solutions Architect or DevOps Engineer Professional)

- Experience with cloud cost optimisation and FinOps practices, including tools such as Kubecost and reporting savings to leadership

- Experience owning SLOs/SLAs for a production service

- Experience with disaster recovery planning, multi-region design, chaos engineering or resilience testing

- Platform engineering experience, such as self-service tooling, golden paths, Backstage or Crossplane

- Experience with service mesh or advanced networking (Cilium/eBPF, Istio, Linkerd)

- Experience with policy as code and supply chain security (OPA/Gatekeeper, Kyverno, cosign, SBOMs)

- Experience leading large migrations, for example self-managed Kubernetes to EKS

- Experience participating in or leading on-call rotations and incident response programs

**WHAT WE OFFER**

**EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY**

Digital. ai is firmly committed to Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO). We maintain compliance with federal, state, and local laws that prohibit employment discrimination on the basis of age, race, color, gender, identity, gender expression, sex, pregnancy, national origin, ancestry, religion, physical or mental ability, medical condition, sexual orientation, marital status, citizenship status, protected military or veteran status, and all other protected classifications. We welcome everyone and believe that diversity is the foundation of innovation. For individuals with disabilities who would like to request an accommodation, please advise us within your job application or cover letter. 

**FRAUD PREVENTION ALERT**

Please note that Digital. ai does not use third-party recruiters. In an effort to protect you against possible impersonation, please verify the sender's email address, and if you are contacted by an unfamiliar or third party requesting personal or financial information on Digital. ai's behalf, please reach out directly to Digital. ai to confirm

data.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Full Stack Developer based in India. 

Join a technology-driven team building innovative Shopify applications used by thousands of e-commerce merchants worldwide. As a Senior Full Stack Developer, you will design, develop, and scale high-performance applications, plugins, and integrations that help online businesses operate more efficiently. You will work across the entire development lifecycle, combining modern frontend technologies with robust backend architectures and seamless third-party integrations. Collaborating closely with product, design, and QA teams, you will transform ideas into reliable, accessible, and scalable software solutions. Beyond hands-on development, you will contribute to architectural decisions, mentor fellow developers, and help shape the technical roadmap. This fully remote opportunity offers significant ownership, modern development tools, and a collaborative environment where engineering excellence and measurable impact are valued. 

Accountabilities

As a Senior Full Stack Developer, you will take ownership of the architecture, implementation, and continuous improvement of scalable e-commerce software solutions. Your responsibilities will include: 

- Planning, architecting, and developing Shopify applications, plugins, and API integrations. 
 - Building full-stack solutions using React, Next. js, Node. js, Express, and TypeScript. 
 - Integrating third-party systems, including ERP, payment, CRM, and logistics platforms, through REST and GraphQL APIs.

 - Contributing to architectural decisions and the evolution of the technical roadmap.

We are looking for an experienced, technically strong, and proactive developer who takes pride in writing clean code and building reliable software. The ideal candidate will bring: 

- At least five years of professional full-stack development experience.

 - Solid database experience with MongoDB, PostgreSQL, MySQL, or comparable technologies.

 - Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage complex development workflows. 
 - Excellent collaboration and communication skills, with a willingness to share knowledge and take responsibility. 
 - Native-level German proficiency and good written and spoken English. 
 - An entrepreneurial, results-driven mindset and a willingness to take initiative and go the extra mile. 

Benefits

 - Performance-based compensation: Fixed salary combined with performance-dependent commission. 
 - 30 days of annual leave, plus your birthday and Christmas off. 
 - High ownership and autonomy: Take responsibility for meaningful technical decisions and projects.

 - Collaborative team environment: Work alongside motivated colleagues in a performance-oriented setting. 
 - Flat organizational structure: Benefit from short decision-making processes and direct communication.

 - Professional growth: Contribute to the technical roadmap, exchange knowledge, and mentor other developers.

The Amazon Cross Border Core Technology team is seeking a seasoned Software Engineer to drive the development of innovative technologies that will shape platforms and products impacting a multibillion-dollar business and enhancing the global customer experience. Our team is focused on building next-generation services that will transform international trade at Amazon. We aim to revolutionize how shoppers worldwide discover and purchase global products. We're developing new services in areas like Customer Returns, Accounting, Customer Service and Mobile App to enhance the international shopping experience. Our goal is to offer a seamless, one-stop shopping experience for international customers, which includes: 

Building products (mobile and web based) that reach millions of new customers globally, delivering a world-class shopping experience with localized language, payment options, and currencies. 

Designing API-based services in NAWS that enable scalable platforms for both internal and external partners. 

Advancing customer experience technologies to support shoppers worldwide. 

Innovating strategies for global expansion and developing solutions that will sustain the continued rapid growth of this thriving business. 

Key job responsibilities

You're seeking a career where you can create, deliver, and make a lasting impact. You design solutions that reach millions of new customers globally, addressing complex problems with a holistic approach. You thrive in environments that demand intricate feedback loops and the development of robust ecosystems. You're passionate about solving real-world challenges with creative and thoughtful solutions, leveraging a deep understanding of the problem space. You constantly challenge yourself and others to improve, always striving for better outcomes. By collaborating closely with the business, you help define expansion strategies and develop innovative solutions that support the continued rapid growth of this dynamic and thriving business. 

About The Team

We're going to enable customers around the globe to purchase products on Amazon with guaranteed shipping and import duty fees. We're going to improve this experience by making selection available across all Amazon marketplaces, so that customers can search and browse in their preferred language and currency. Along the way, we're going to face seemingly impossible problems. We're going to argue about how to solve them, and we'll work together to find a solution that is superior to each of the proposals we came in with. We'll make difficult decisions, but we'll all understand why. We'll be the dream team. 

Basic Qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
 - 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
 - 3+ years of Video Games Industry (supporting title Development, Release, or Live Ops) experience
 - Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred Qualifications

- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
 - Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

data.title: QA Automation Lead / testing Lead automation of UI-- Gen AI
data.description:
Job summary

We are looking for an experienced QA Automation Lead with strong hands-on expertise in Playwright, JavaScript/TypeScript, and GenAI-assisted automation engineering using Claude AI. The candidate will lead automation delivery for International Marketplace features, stabilize the existing regression suite, and drive the migration of Playwright test scripts to the InteractAI platform. 

The role requires a combination of hands-on coding, automation framework expertise, test strategy, team leadership, and client-facing delivery management. The candidate must be comfortable using Claude AI to accelerate test script development, improve maintainability, troubleshoot failures, and optimize automation workflows. 

Key responsibilities

1. GenAI-based automation engineering

Use Claude AI to generate, enhance, debug, refactor, and optimize automation test scripts using JavaScript and TypeScript. 

Apply effective prompt engineering to convert business requirements and acceptance criteria into executable automation scenarios. 

Review and validate AI-generated code for correctness, maintainability, security, and adherence to coding standards. 

Identify opportunities to use AI for test design, failure analysis, test maintenance, and automation productivity improvements. 

2. Playwright framework development

Design, develop, and maintain scalable Playwright automation frameworks using JavaScript/TypeScript. 

Implement reusable page objects, fixtures, custom utilities, assertions, test hooks, reporting, and test data management. 

Optimize parallel execution, retries, browser coverage, test isolation, and execution performance. 

Establish standards for coding, code reviews, debugging, and flaky-test prevention. 

3. InteractAI migration

Assess the existing Playwright test inventory and determine migration readiness, complexity, dependencies, and priorities. 

Lead pilot migration and phased migration of existing Playwright scripts to InteractAI. 

Validate migrated scripts for functional equivalence, reliability, and execution results. 

Coordinate the retirement of legacy tests after successful migration and approval. 

4. UI, API, and end-to-end testing

Lead automation of UI, API, and end-to-end scenarios for International Marketplace features. 

Develop test strategies based on approved requirements, business workflows, and acceptance criteria. 

Ensure appropriate coverage of positive, negative, boundary, integration, and regression scenarios. 

Coordinate test data preparation, environment readiness, defect triage, and retesting. 

5. Regression stabilization and CI/CD

Analyze and resolve failing, flaky, duplicated, and obsolete regression tests. 

Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines using the client's existing tooling. 

Configure or enhance automated execution, reporting, failure diagnostics, and pipeline feedback. 

Monitor regression stability and drive continuous improvement. 

6. Test management and reporting

Manage test cases, execution results, defects, and traceability using JIRA, TestRail, Zephyr, or Xray, as applicable. 

Track automation coverage, migration progress, execution pass rates, defect trends, and delivery risks. 

Provide regular progress updates and escalate blockers and dependencies. 

7. Team and stakeholder leadership

Lead and mentor QA automation engineers; assign work and review technical deliverables. 

Collaborate with product owners, developers, client stakeholders, and internal QE teams. 

Drive estimation, sprint planning, prioritization, delivery tracking, and risk management. 

Prepare runbooks, technical documentation, knowledge-transfer materials, and transition plans for internal QE ownership. 

Mandatory technical skills

- Strong hands-on proficiency in JavaScript and TypeScript. 
 - Extensive practical experience with Playwright UI automation and automation framework development. 
 - Hands-on experience using Claude AI for automation script development, debugging, refactoring, or test design. 
 - Demonstrated ability to build automation scripts using AI assistance and independently validate the generated code. 
 - Experience with UI, API, and end-to-end automation testing. 
 - Experience troubleshooting flaky tests, stabilizing regression suites, and improving automation reliability. 
 - Experience with test management tools such as JIRA, TestRail, Zephyr, or Xray. 
 - Working experience with CI/CD integration and automated test execution pipelines. 
 - Proven experience leading a QA or automation team. 

Preferred skills

- Experience with InteractAI or a comparable AI-enabled automation platform. 
 - Experience migrating existing automation suites between frameworks or platforms. 
 - Experience with API authentication, test data management, cross-browser testing, and debugging complex application workflows. 
 - Familiarity with Git, code review workflows, and cloud-based test execution. 
 - Experience and leadership expectations
 - Suggested experience range: 8-12 years overall, with substantial recent hands-on Playwright automation experience. 
 - Ability to lead technical delivery while remaining actively involved in coding and troubleshooting. 
 - Strong client communication, problem-solving, planning, and mentoring skills. 
 - Expected deliverables
 - Existing Playwright test inventory and migration assessment. 
 - Pilot migration and phased migration of the regression suite to InteractAI. 
 - Stabilized and maintainable UI, API, and E2E automated regression suite. 
 - Automation of prioritized manual test cases. 
 - Test execution dashboards, defect reports, and migration status reports. 
 - CI/CD integration and execution documentation.

Organization OverviewCompany Description

Help us build the "System of Action" that supercharges global manufacturing teams. QAD is entering a high-velocity era to architect the world's first AI-native, agentic ERP. We are moving beyond legacy "systems of record" to build an autonomous platform where humans and AI work as a tag team to redefine how factories operate. Join us at this pivotal moment to build our next generation platform, lead the next generation of the Adaptive Enterprise and turn global speed into strategy. 

Job Description

Ignite Your Future: Strategic Leadership

Are you a distinguished technical leader ready to own the cross-stack architectural vision for an intelligent, adaptive SaaS platform? Sitting directly above our Senior Staff Engineering roles, you will serve as the chief technical authority for our full stack systems. At QAD, we are redefining the supply chain through a single System of Action that connects people, processes, and data. As a Full Stack Technical Architect, you will bridge high-level strategy with hands-on execution-driving architecture across frontend, backend, microservices, and cloud infrastructure while setting technical standards across engineering teams. 

The Mission: Defining the Platform's Future

You Will Be The Executive Driver In Setting The Technical North Star For The Platform, Translating The Company's Business Strategy Into a Multi-year Engineering Roadmap, And Ensuring Architectural Alignment Across All Product Pillars. You Will Lead And MentorPrincipal-level Engineers, Leverage Executive-level Expertise In Highly Specialized Fields To Innovate At Scale, And Govern The Development Standards For Cloud-native Architectures, Microservices, And Agile Product Development Across All Teams. You Will Be Instrumental In Ensuring The Platform Delivers On Its Core Pillars

- Adaptive Applications: The intelligent backbone powering the manufacturing enterprise. 
 - Champion AI: Agentic AI for manufacturing that drives measurable productivity and growth. 

Your Impact/ What You Will Be Doing

- End-to-End System Architecture: Define, govern, and execute the multi-year technical vision and architectural roadmap across the complete application lifecycle-from modern frontends to resilient backend microservices. 
 - Full Stack Standards & Governance: Establish and enforce enterprise-wide design patterns, API contracts, micro-frontend/microservices blueprints, and code governance standards. 
 - Hands-on Technical Leadership: Conduct deep design reviews, author architectural decision records (ADRs), resolve systemic performance bottlenecks, and write critical reference code. 
 - Next-Gen AI & Platform Integration: Architect robust full stack frameworks that support Adaptive Applications and Agentic AI workflows embedded directly into user-facing enterprise applications. 
 - Cross-Functional & Strategic Alignment: Collaborate with Product Leadership, Engineering Directors, DevOps/SRE, and Senior Staff Engineers to translate complex business objectives into scalable architectures. 
 - Technical Mentorship & Elevation: Mentor Senior Staff, Principal, and Lead Engineers, setting the technical bar and driving engineering excellence across multiple feature pods. 

Core Technical Foundations / What We Are Looking For

- Frontend Architecture: Advanced mastery of modern web frameworks (React, Angular, or Vue. js), micro-frontends, design systems, state management, and web performance optimization. 
 - Backend & Microservices: Deep architectural expertise in distributed systems, REST/GraphQL APIs, event-driven designs, and runtimes like Java, Node. js, Python, or Go. 
 - Data & Cloud Infrastructure: Extensive experience with relational & NoSQL databases, message brokers (Kafka/RabbitMQ), and cloud-native architecture (AWS/GCP/Azure). 
 - Core Engineering & Governance: Foundational expertise in Data Structures, System Design, Security (OAuth/OIDC), CI/CD automation, and high-availability design

The Mindset

- Strategic Visionary: Strong conceptual and strategic thinking to understand the most advanced issues and implications, applying this knowledge to define and execute the future direction of the platform. Exercises independent executive judgment in setting organization-wide methods and evaluation criteria. 
 - Organizational Leader: Demonstrates end-to-end responsibility for the architectural and organizational health of the entire function. Capable of driving complex, multi-year solutions and influencing critical company-wide technology choices. 
 - Adaptability & Innovation: Eagerness to rapidly assess and strategically adopt cutting-edge technologies that create a competitive advantage. 
 - Proactive Executive: Takes initiative to anticipate future organizational, technical, and business needs, risks, or improvements without explicit direction, establishing new executive standards where necessary. 

Qualifications

Qualifications & Next Steps

- Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline. 
 - Experience: 14+ years of hands-on software development experience, including 5+ years acting as a Technical Architect or System Architect overseeing multi-team systems. 
 - Location: On-site technical leadership role based in Pune (3-4 days in-office per week). 

Additional Information

Why QAD?

- Structured Mentorship: Benefit from a structured program and training designed for rapid career development. 
 - Inclusive Culture: Join a collaborative and inclusive environment that champions learning, growth, and diverse perspectives. 
 - Ready to step into the future of manufacturing? Apply now and start building a System of Action!

About QAD

QAD | Redzone is redefining manufacturing and supply chains through its intelligent, adaptive platform that connects people, processes, and data into a single System of Action. With three core pillars - Redzone (frontline empowerment), Adaptive Applications (the intelligent backbone), and Champion AI (Agentic AI for manufacturing) - QAD | Redzone helps manufacturers operate with Champion Pace, achieving measurable productivity, resilience, and growth in just 90 days. 

QAD is committed to ensuring that every employee feels they work in an environment that values their contributions, respects their unique perspectives and provides opportunities for growth regardless of background. JOB DESCRIPTION: 

At Thermo Fisher, our mission is to cure cancer with genomic data. It is a close-knit, collaborative, cross-functional setting where we believe none of us is as smart as all of us and we each have something valuable to contribute toward our goal. The software services team is tasked with applying industry best practices to the design, development, and deployment of world-class software products. We are looking to hire individuals with experience with software development and test engineering in clinical and research settings, and who can help us solve the next wave of technical challenges using the latest cloud-based, big-data, and rich analytics toolsets. 

We are seeking enthusiastic Leader in Software Verification and Validation who will define scope, design, for automated and manual tests for highly advanced bioinformatics software. We require strong coding skills as well as a solid understanding of Quality Assurance principles and Continuous Integration methods. You will drive writing positive and negative smoke and regression test scripts to test product functionality and integration with dependencies. You will drive strategies for test APIs, user interfaces, web services, and/or web apps and write performance, load, and stress tests. 

You are excited and passionate about participating in an Agile/SCRUM setting to meet and exceed customer expectations and continuously drive towards quality improvements. You like the idea of partnering with users and other team members to brainstorm the best possible approaches to validating systems. You welcome the challenge of working in a fast-paced, discovery-oriented environment and will be genuinely excited about the prospect of creatively exercising your problem-solving skills continuously to ultimately improve the human condition. 

Essential Functions: 

- Develop and implement software testing Strategy, Methods and Best Practices that allow high quality NGS analytics and instruments software products to be designed, developed, and released into the regulated in-vitro diagnostics/ medical device space. 
 - Lead and mentor a group of bioinformatics and software test engineers. 
 - Establish software quality standards and KPI metrics to actively measure software and bioinformatics product quality. Implement software quality tracking tools and methodologies to provide on-going visibility and action during software product development lifecycle. 
 - Single point of contact while working with external partners to deliver state of the art Software products in market. 
 - Partner with software and bioinformatics leadership, functional and project managers to identify appropriate scope of software testing, verification and validation required for a project and managing the overall testing activities for projects. 
 - Partner with internal and external stakeholders to drive the requirements for regulated assays and software. Help software development team to understand the complex informatics and visualization requirements leading into design implementation

Minimum Qualifications (must have): 

- Masters/PhD preferred or Bachelors with minimum 06 years of work experience and strong track record of industry productivity
 - 06+ experience performing software verification and validation testing, preferably in the medical device/ biotech space
 - Strong understanding of NGS-based regulated software, IVD assay development practices and informatics data analysis pipelines. 
 - Strong leadership abilities and extensive experience managing the activities of software quality engineering and assurance teams. Experience leading cross-functional, multi-site teams preferred. 
 - Practical experience as a leader in the use of modern software development methodologies/ processes with an ability to direct the use of resources to meet department goals
 - Good understanding in design control for regulated products (e. g. US-IVD, IVD-D, IVD-R, China and Japan regulations) and knowledge of applicable regulations and standards used in IVD and medical device software development (e. g. ISO 13485, IEC 62304, and 21 CFR 820). 
 - Ability to work well with senior leadership. 
 - Experience working in a fast paced, dynamic environment.
